items.title: Maalinta Macallimiinta Adduunka
items.description: Maanta oo kale, dunida waxaa si mug iyo miisaan leh looga maamuusaa Maalinta Macallimiinta Adduunka, oo ku astaysan 5ta Oktoobar. UNESCO, oo ah Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan waxbarashada, sayniska iyo dhaqanka, ayaa 5ta Oktoobar, sannad kasta, u astaysay Maalinta Macallimiinta Adduunka. Waa maalin lagu muujiyo kaalinta qiimaha leh ee baruhu ku leeyahay barbaarinta, garaadkobcinta iyo hagidda bulshada, iyo maamuuska uu mudanyahay. Maqaalkani wuxuu ka hadlayaa halka uu macallinku kaga jiray bulshadii Soomaaliyeed, halka uu maanta kaga jiro, iyo dhufsana-yaraha ka dhexeeya qanacsanaanta macallinka iyo tayada waxbarashada. Macallinkii Shalay Macallinku bulshada Soomaaliyeed wuxuu ku dhex lahaa ixtiraam iyo maamuus aan la soo koobi karin, siiba macallimiinta dugsiyada Qur’aanka iyo culimada akhrisa kutubta diinta. Xiriirka adag ee ku dhisnaa ixtiraamka iyo waalidnimada, ee u dhexeeyay waalidka, macallinka iyo ardayga, wuxuu kaalin weyn ku lahaa xifdinta Qur’aanka Kariimka ah iyo ku dhegganaanta diinta. Sidoo kale, xiriirkaasi wuxuu bulshada ka dhowray khilaaf iyo kala aragti duwanaansho diimeed, kuwaas oo maanta ka mid ah caqabadaha waaweyn ee wajahaya ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Macallinku sidaas kuma ahayn qof cashar gudbiya oo keliya; wuxuu ahaa barbaariye, hage iyo qof ubadka dhaxalsiiya aqoon iyo anshax. Bilowgii Waxbarashada Maaddiga ah In kasta oo billaawgii hore macallimiinta dugsiyadu tiro ahaan yaraayeen, taasina keentay in barayaal badan oo aan haysan shahaado jaamacadeed ay wax ka dhigaan dugsiyada, haddana waxaa la rumaysan yahay in niyadda wanaagsan, maamuuska loo hayay iyo xuquuqda la siin jiray ay sare u qaadeen waxtarkooda. Nidaamkii uu hoggaaminayay Maxamed Siyaad, oo aan ka soo jeedin bahda waxbarashada, ayaa—sida ay ka marag kaceen macallimiintii xilligaas—macallinka siiyay maamuus iyo qiime ballaaran, marka loo eego madaxweynayaashii ka danbeeyay oo qaarkood bahda waxbarashada ka yimid ama wax soo bartay. Dhismihii Kulliyadda Waxbarashada ee Lafoole Intaas laguma ekaan; waxaa la hirgeliyay Kulliyaddii Waxbarashada ee Lafoole, oo ka tirsanayd Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Hirgelinta Lafoole waxay ahayd tallaabo wanaagsan oo loo qaaday horumarinta macallimiinta iyo waxbarashada. Waxay noqotay kulliyaddii loogu jeclaa guud ahaan jaamacadda, iyadoo soo saartay macallimiin tayo sare leh oo door weyn ka qaatay horumarinta waxbarashada Soomaaliyeed. Maanta, dad badan oo Soomaaliyeed ayaa Lafoole u haysta inay ahayd jaamacad buuxda, iyaga oo moog in ay ahayd kulliyad ka tirsan Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Taasina waxay muujinaysaa halka ay gaareen waxtarkeeda iyo sumcaddeeduba. Lafoole waxay sidaas ku noqotay goob dhaxalsiin aqooneed iyo barbaareed, jiilal badan oo Soomaaliyeedna u ibafurtay aafaaq waxbarasho iyo mihnadeed. Maxay Suugaanyahannada Soomaaliyeed ku Tilmaameen Baraha? Qiimaha iyo maamuuska macallinka kuma ekayn nololmaalmeedka bulshada; wuxuu, sidoo kale, si weyn uga dhex muuqday suugaanta Soomaaliyeed. Haddii gabyaagii reer Masar ee Axmed Showqi uu hore u yiri: “U sarakac macallinka oo xushmee; macallinku wuxuu ku sigtay inuu noqdo rasuul,” abwaanka Soomaaliyeed ee Xasan Sheekh Muumin wuxuu yiri: Macallinku waa Maskaxdii dunidoo malaasan Mowjadaheeda Kala miirtay ee macnaysay Maadhkii qarsoonaa Waa misbaaxii Kaahiisu u miciinee Mugdigii ka meydhay Murtida dhuux aqoontiisa baro Lagama maarmee. Tixdani waxay baraha ku sawiraysaa ilayska aqoonta iyo qofka mugdiga aqoondarrada ka meydha. Sida murtida Soomaaliyeed lagu cabbiray, aqoontu waa iftiin lagu tilmaansado iyo ilays lagu sahantago. Sidoo kale, abwaan Xaaji Aadan Axmed Afqallooc, isaga oo ardayda Soomaaliyeed dareensiinaya qiimaha macallinka iyo aqoonta, wuxuu yiri: Oday waaya-aragaan ahoo ayni wayn jiraye Markaad ood ka bood tahay tashigu waa in kaa maqane Wixi dana Abwaankaa gartee inammo waa mooge Inaan anigu idin waaniyaa waa ammuur xaq ahe Ardayey aqoonsada cilmiga aafo waa jahale Ijtihaada adinkaa hor kici aradka Soomaale Akhlaaq xumo iska ogaada waad ku ambanaysaane Ma aflaxo ilmaha caasiyoo edebta diidaaye Haddii aadan akrimin macallinadu kuuma uursame’e Waa niman ammaanloo xumaan laga ilaashaaye Ixtiraam la’aan lagama helo aayo iyo khayre Waa kuu ilays meel mugdiya aad ku aragtaaye Waa kuu afkood ku hadashiyo odhaahda liisaane Waa ubaxa kii korinayoo aaminka ahaaye Waa amalka nolashaa dambood ku istareexdaaye Waa ilo biyalahoo ninkii ooman ka cabbaaye Waa kii ixsaan kuu galoo aadmi kaa dhigaye Waa kii abaal kugu lihiyo lama ilaawaane Waa kii aqoontiyo cilmiga kuugu aabba ahe Sida qamarka oogada jiruu kuu iftimiyaaye Iyagaa abuuraye sancada lama ogaadeene Ihaanada ma dooniyo waxaan laayiq u ahayne Haddii aad asluub yeelatoo dhawrto amarkiisa Asmac baraha liibaantu waa inaad addeecdaaye. Macallinka Maanta Macallimiinta xilligan jooga waxay la deris yihiin duruufo nololeed oo adag, waxaana taas u dheer in aan marar badan la siin maamuuska iyo qiimaha ay mudan yihiin. Dhibaatada ugu badan waxay ka taagan tahay macallimiinta ka hawlgala iskuullada gaarka loo leeyahay, oo qaar badan oo ka mid ahi ka cabtaan xuquuqdooda shaqo, gaar ahaan bilaha Luulyo iyo Ogoosto. Halkaas waxaa ka jira tabashooyin la xiriira mushaharka, fasaxyada iyo xuquuqda kale ee shaqaalaha. Dhanka kale, macallimiinta dawladda qudhoodu ma helaan dhammaan xuquuqda shaqaalaha rayidka ah ee dawladda; waxaana xusid mudan in sannadihii danbe macallimiin badan lagu soo xulay tartan furan. Dhawaan, waraysi uu bixiyay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Waxbarashada XFS, Mudane Faarax Sheekh Cabdulqaadir, ayaa lagu sheegay inuusan kordhin doonin xuquuqda macallimiinta qaranka, xataa haddii dawladdu hesho lacago dheeraad ah, isaga oo arrintaas u sababeeyay tirada badan ee macallimiinta iyo in aysan suurtagal ahayn inay helaan xuquuq la mid ah tan shaqaalaha kale ee dawladda. Haddaba, tiro badnaantu ma sabab bay u noqon kartaa in xuquuq la waayo? Qanacsanaanta Macallinka iyo Tayada Waxbarashada Niyadda macallinka oo la wanaajiyo, xuquuq iyo maamuusna la siiyo, aqoontiisa maaddeed iyo xirfaddiisa macallinnimana la kobciyo, waxay horseedi kartaa inuu soo saaro jiil aqoon iyo karti leh. Waaya-aragnimadii hore waxay muujinaysaa in marka macallinka la maamuuso, xaaladdiisa shaqona la wanaajiyo, uu si ka mug iyo miisaan badan uga qayb qaadan karo barbaarinta, garaad-qaabaynta iyo dhismaha jiilka soo kacaya. Maanta, dawladdu malaayiin doolar ayay ku bixisaa horumarinta waxbarashada, oo ay ka mid tahay horumarinta macallimiinta; hasayeeshee, waxaa weli hooseeya niyadda iyo maamuuska macallinka. Dad badanina waxay rumaysanyihiin in halkaas laga haysto qayb ka mid ah caqabadaha waxbarashada Soomaaliyeed. Cilmibaarisyo badan ayaa tilmaamaya in qanacsanaanta macallinka iyo tayada waxbarashada uu ka dhexeeyo xiriir dhow. Sidaas darteed, horumarinta waxbarashadu kuma eka dhismaha fasallo, dejinta manaahij ama bixinta agab; macallinka laftiisa ayaa ah halbowlaha habsocodka waxbarashada. Siday murtidu ahayd “Xaglo laaban xoolo kuma yimaaddaan.” Murtidaasi waxay ku baraarujinaysaa in miro iyo horumar lagu gaari karo hawl, dadaal iyo u guntasho. Sidaas si la mid ah, tayada waxbarasho ee la hiigsanayo lagama filan karo iyada oo la dayacay qofka hawshaas lafdhabarta u ah: macallinka!

items.title: Maxaa ka jira in la xirayo waddooyinka magaalada Muqdisho?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Booliska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa caawa beeniyay warar lagu faafiyay baraha bulshada oo sheegayay in maalinta berri ah la xirayo waddooyinka waaweyn ee magaalada Muqdisho. Taliska ayaa sheegay in wararkaasi aysan waxba ka jirin, isagoo meesha ka saaray jiritaanka qorshe hakad lagu gelinayo isu socodka magaalada, wuxuuna bulshada caasimadda uga digay inay ku qaldamaan xogaha aan la xaqiijin ee lagu faafinayo baraha bulshada iyo meelaha kale. Booliska ayaa bulshada kula dardaarmay inay ku tiirsanaadaan oo keliya xogta rasmiga ah ee kasoo baxda hay’adaha amniga, gaar ahaan marka ay jiraan warar la xiriira xaaladda amniga iyo isu socodka magaalada. “Bulshada waxaa laga codsanayaa in aysan ku qaldamin wararka aan la xaqiijin ee lagu faafinayo baraha bulshada iyo meelaha kale, ayna ku tiirsanaadaan oo keliya xogta rasmiga ah ee ay soo saaraan hay’adaha amniga,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Taliska booliska gobolka Banaadir. Taliska ayaa sidoo kale caddeeyay in isu socodka guud ee magaalada Muqdisho uu si caadi ah u socdo, isla markaana aysan jirin wax amar ah oo lagu xirayo waddooyinka waaweyn ee magaalada, iyadoo dadka magaalada lagu wargeliyay inay si caadi ah u wataan howl-maalmeedkooda. War-saxaafadeedkan ayaa imanaya kadib markii baraha bulshada lagu faafiyay warar sheegaya in waddooyinka waaweyn ee Muqdisho la xiri doono maalinta berri ah, taas oo walaac ku abuurtay qaar kamid ah bulshada caasimadda. Taliska booliska gobolka Banaadir ayaa ugu dambeyntiina adkeeyay baaqiisa ku aaddan in bulshada ay iska ilaaliyaan faafinta iyo rumaysashada wararka aan la xaqiijin, isla markaana xogta ku saabsan amniga iyo isu socodka magaalada ay ka raadsadaan oo keliya ilaha rasmiga ah. War-saxaafadeedkan ayaa imanaya kadib markii baraha bulshada lagu faafiyay warar sheegaya in waddooyinka waaweyn ee Muqdisho la xiri doono maalinta berri ah, taas oo walaac ku abuurtay qaar kamid ah bulshada caasimadda. Taliska booliska gobolka Banaadir ayaa ugu dambeyntiina adkeeyay baaqiisa ku aaddan in bulshada ay iska ilaaliyaan faafinta iyo rumaysashada wararka aan la xaqiijin, isla markaana xogta ku saabsan amniga iyo isu socodka magaalada ay ka raadsadaan oo keliya ilaha rasmiga ah. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay xiisadda ka taagan Magaalada Beledweyne
items.description: Xaaladda Magaalada Beledweyne ee Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa weli ah mid kacsan, iyadoo ay ka dhalatay cadaadisyo siyaasadeed iyo diidmo xooggan oo ku aaddan hannaanka doorashooyinka Hirshabelle. Dhallinyarada ku dhaqan magaaladaasi ayaa isku dayaya in ay muujiyaan inaanan Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle laga rabin Beledweyne iyo guud ahaanba Gobolka Hiiraan. Beledweyne ayaa gashay xaalad fowdo ah, ka dib doorashadii isku sidkaneyd ee Arbacadii laga qabtay goobo aad u xaddidan oo magaaladaasi ah, iyadoo daba socoto khilaafka siyaasadeed ee salka ku haya musharaxnimada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe) oo doonaya in mar labaad uu ku soo laabto xafiiska, halka odayaasha iyo siyaasyiinta reer Hiiraan ay ka soo horjeedaan. Goobaha codbixinta kooban ee toddobaadkii hore laga furay magaalada ayaa waxaa barbar socday dibadbaxyo ay dhigayeen dadka deegaanka, oo intooda badan qaadacay doorashadaasi. Siyaasiyiinta iyo odayaasha gobolka oo si adag uga horyimid in Cali Guudlaawe dib loogu doorto xilka ayaa ku doodaya in hannaanka hadda loo maray doorashada aysan ahayn mid xalaal ah oo heshiis lagu yahay. Dhanka kale Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa maanta xabsiga u taxaabay dhallinyaro lagu eedeeyay in ay abaabulayeen bannaanbax ballaaran. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa toddobaadkii hore ciidamo fara-badan oo kuwa militariga ah gaysay magaaladaasi, si ay gacan uga gaystaan sugidda amniga. Villa Somalia ayaa taageereysa dib-u-doorashada Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe, tallaabadan oo dadka deegaanka ay u arkaan mid xadgudub ku ah heshiiskii siyaasadeed ee ilaalinayay in shacabka labada gobol ee Hirshabelle (Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe) ay dareemaan in ay metelaad dhab ah ku leeyihiin maamulka. Iskusoo wada-duuboo xiisadda ka jirta Beledweyne ayaa sababtay hoos u dhac ku yimid dhaqdhaqaaqii ganacsiga ee magaalada, waxayna ganacsatadu sheegeen inuu yaraaday wax kala iibsigii suuqyada, oo la macno ah inuu gaabis noqday socodkii dadka ee suuqyada amaba uu yaraaday xiriirkii ganacsatada iyo macaamiisha.

items.title: Saudi Arabia Rethinks Its Alliances — Is Israel Back in the Equation?
items.description: Saudi Arabia Rethinks Its Alliances — Is Israel Back in the Equation? Saudi Arabia is reassessing its regional strategy as renewed fighting in Yemen, Houthi threats and shifting alliances expose the limits of its traditional partnerships. In this edition of TV7 Editor’s Note, Jonathan Hessen is joined by Col. (Ret.) Dr. Eran Lerman, former Deputy National Security Advisor to Israel, to examine Riyadh’s relations with the United Arab Emirates, Turkey and Pakistan, the changing balance of power in Yemen, and the broader implications for Israel and the Abraham Accords. The discussion also explores the strategic importance of Somaliland and the Horn of Africa, Chinese and Russian involvement in the region, and the mounting economic and political pressure facing the Islamic Republic of Iran. items.title: Dagaalkii ugu qaraara oo ka dhacay Yemen iyo ciidamada Sacuudiga taageero oo…
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) – Dagaalka Yemen ayaa galay marxalad aad u kulul kadib markii duqeymo xooggan oo cirka ah iyo weerarro dhulka ah ay isku mar ka billowdeen deegaannada istaraatiijiga ah ee ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee taageerada ka helaya Sacuudiga ay wadaan guluf ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta. Duqeymaha ayaa socday ku dhowaad 24 saac oo xiriir ah, waxaana la sheegay in in ka badan 100 diyaaradood oo dagaal ay ka qeyb qaadanayaan weerarrada lagu garaacayo goobaha ay Xuutiyiintu ku sugan yihiin ee ku dhow Bab al-Mandab iyo xeebaha Badda Cas. Waxaa sidoo kale la sheegay in 324 bartilmaameed oo muhiim ah lagu bartilmaameedsaday duqeymaha, taas oo muujineysa baaxadda weerarka socda. Inta ay duqeymaha cirka ah socdaan, ciidamada dowladda Yemen ayaa dhulka ka wada weerarro xooggan oo lagu doonayo in Xuutiyiinta looga riixo goobo muhiim u ah gacan-ku-haynta xeebaha. Ciidamadu waxay ku dhawaaqeen inay la wareegeen magaalada istaraatiijiga ah ee Mokha, oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Mokha, halkaas oo dagaallo culus ay ka dhaceen. Gulufka ayaa intaas ka sii gudbay, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay sheegteen inay qabsadeen magaalada Dhubab iyo goobo kale oo muhiim ah oo ku dhow Bab al-Mandab. Dhubab ayaa kamid ah meelaha muhiimka u ah isku socodka xeebaha, waxaana dib-u-qabsashadeeda lagu tilmaamay tallaabo muhiim ah oo ciidamada dowladda ay qaadayaan si ay dib ugu riixaan Xuutiyiinta. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale gaaray gobollada Ma’rib iyo Al-Jawf, halkaas oo ciidamada dowladda ay sheegeen inay dib ula wareegeen xeryo militari iyo goobo kale oo istaraatiiji ah. Howl-gallada socda ayaa isugu jira duqeymo cirka ah iyo weerarro dhulka ah, waxaana muuqata in ciidamada dowladda ay isku dayayaan inay hal mar dhowr jiho kaga cadaadiyaan Xuutiyiinta. Xaaladda ayaa sii cakirtay markii duqeymo laga soo sheegay caasimadda Sanca, oo ah xarunta ugu weyn ee Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayaan. Weerarrada ka socda magaalada iyo deegaannada kale ayaa muujinaya in dagaalku uusan ku koobneyn jiidaha Bab al-Mandab, balse uu gaarayo xarumaha muhiimka ah ee Xuutiyiinta. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale ku lug leh dagaalka, iyadoo taageerada uu siinayo ciidamada dowladda Yemen ay kusoo beegmayso xilli dagaalku ku wajahan yahay meel ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan ee gobolka. Bab al-Mandab ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah maraakiibta ganacsiga ee isaga kala goosha Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, taas oo dagaalka ka dhigaysa mid leh saameyn ka baxsan gudaha Yemen. Hase yeeshee, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay ku dhawaaqayaan guulo isdaba joog ah, Xuutiyiinta ayaa si adag u beeniyay in ciidamada kasoo horjeeda ay horumar weyn ka sameeyeen goobaha muhiimka ah ee ku dhow Bab al-Mandab. Ilo ku dhow kooxda ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiintu weli gacanta ku hayaan qeybo muhiim ah oo ka tirsan aagga, taasoo muujineysa in sheegashada labada dhinac ay si weyn u kala duwan tahay. Dagaalka ayaa hadda si gaar ah ugu sii kululaanaya Bab al-Mandab, Mokha iyo Dhubab, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isku dayayaan inay gacanta ku dhigaan dhulalka iyo marinnada istaraatiijiga ah. Haddii ciidamada dowladda ay xaqiijiyaan gacan-ku-haynta goobaha ay sheegteen inay qabsadeen waxay noqon kartaa isbeddel muhiim ah oo ku yimaada khariidadda dagaalka Yemen, balse haddii Xuutiyiintu sii haystaan goobaha muhiimka ah, gulufka cusub ayaa isu beddeli kara dagaal dheer oo khasaaro badan dhaliya. items.title: Abiy oo mar kale loo doortay ra’iisul wasaaraha Itoobiya
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed ayaa maanta dib loogu doortay inuu noqdo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha dalkaas. Baarlamaanka Itoobiya ayaa markii labaad u magacaabay Abiy inuu noqdo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha dalka kadib doorashadii baarlamaanka ee sanadkan iyo guushii uu xisbigiisa Prosperity Party ka gaaray. Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka Itoobiya, Axmed Shide ayaa ku dhawaaqay magacaabista Abiy, waxaana Ra’iisul Wasaaraha loo dhaariyay xilka si uu u hoggaamiyo dowladda federaalka muddada cusub ee baarlamaanka. Magacaabistan ayaa Abiy Ahmed u oggolaanaysa inuu sii wato hoggaaminta xukuumadda Itoobiya, xilkaas oo uu hayay tan iyo sanadkii 2018, markaas oo markii ugu horreysay loo magacaabay Ra’iisul Wasaare. Doorashadii baarlamaanka ee bishii Juun ayaa waxaa guul ka gaaray xisbiga Prosperity Party, kaas oo helay 438 kursi oo ka mid ah 486 kursi oo natiijooyinkooda la shaaciyay. Aqlabiyadda uu xisbigu ka helay baarlamaanka ayaa u suuragelisay in Abiy Axmed mar kale loo magacaabo hoggaanka xukuumadda, iyadoo tallaabadan ay sidoo kale qayb ka tahay dhismaha dowladda cusub ee federaalka Itoobiya. Si kastaba, codbixintu kama dhicin dhammaan deegaannada Itoobiya, waxaana meelaha aan doorashadu ka qabsoomin kamid ahaa Tigray iyo qaybo ka mid ah gobollada Amhara iyo Oromia. Dhaarinta Abiy ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Itoobiya ay gashay marxalad cusub oo siyaasadeed kadib doorashadii baarlamaanka iyo dhismaha hay’adaha cusub ee dowladda federaalka, iyadoo sidoo kale ay taagan yihiin xiisaddo dagaal. Abiy ayaa hadda bilaabaya muddada cusub ee xilkiisa, iyadoo xisbigiisa uu baarlamaanka ku leeyahay aqlabiyad ballaaran oo u saamaxaysa inuu dhiso oo hoggaamiyo dowladda cusub. items.title: Egypt, Somalia, Eritrea and Sudan summit: Red Sea, Nile and Ethiopia
items.description: CAIRO (Somaliguardian) – The leaders of Egypt, Somalia, Eritrea and Sudan have issued a consequential joint declaration on Somalia’s sovereignty, Sudan’s unity, Red Sea governance and Nile water security, creating a new framework for regional coordination as tensions with Ethiopia intensify. The El Alamein Joint Declaration, adopted after the four leaders met in Egypt on Sunday, does not name Ethiopia. Yet its language on the Red Sea, the Nile and territorial sovereignty directly touches some of Addis Ababa’s most sensitive strategic interests. For Somalia, the communiqué delivers its clearest political message: the four governments reaffirmed Somalia’s unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity and rejected “any recognition of or support for” Somaliland, describing such action as an infringement of Somalia’s sovereignty. The declaration also endorsed Somalia’s counterterrorism efforts and called on regional and international partners to provide adequate, sustainable and predictable financing for the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), as responsibility for national security gradually shifts to Somali forces. For Mogadishu, the timing is significant. Somalia is seeking to consolidate state authority while resisting external moves that could weaken its territorial claim. The explicit backing from Egypt, Eritrea and Sudan strengthens its diplomatic position on Somaliland and places Somalia firmly within a wider Red Sea security conversation. Sudan: unity over fragmentation On Sudan, the four leaders backed the country’s unity, sovereignty, territorial integrity and national institutions, rejected the creation of parallel entities and called for the resumption of a Sudanese-owned and Sudanese-led political process. They also rejected support for mercenaries – a position that carries particular weight as Sudan’s devastating war continues to divide the country between rival forces and competing centres of power. Ethiopia: the country not named, but impossible to ignore The most delicate dimension concerns Ethiopia. The leaders declared that governance of the Red Sea is the exclusive responsibility of littoral states, while affirming freedom of navigation. For landlocked Ethiopia, which has repeatedly stressed the strategic importance of reliable access to the Red Sea, the principle has obvious implications. The communiqué also called for international-law principles governing transboundary rivers, including the Nile, particularly “no harm,” prior notification, consultation and consensus. It rejected unilateral measures that could damage the existing water uses of Egypt and Sudan. Those provisions intersect directly with the long-running dispute over Ethiopia’s Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam. The summit comes as Ethiopia’s relations with Egypt and Eritrea have sharply deteriorated and fighting in northern Ethiopia has intensified. Addis Ababa has accused Egypt, Eritrea and Sudan of supporting an opposition alliance – allegations the three countries deny. Ethiopia and Eritrea have also severed diplomatic ties. A new regional equation The declaration does not establish a formal military alliance, but it creates a mechanism for continued consultation among the four states. That may prove more important than the summit itself. Egypt, Sudan, Eritrea and Somalia now share a stated position on Somalia’s territorial integrity, Sudan’s unity, Red Sea governance and Nile water principles. Their interests are not identical, but their strategic concerns are increasingly converging. The result is a striking new equation in the Horn of Africa: Somalia’s sovereignty, Sudan’s survival, Ethiopia’s regional ambitions and control of the Red Sea are no longer separate diplomatic questions. They are becoming parts of the same geopolitical contest. For Mogadishu, the summit is an unmistakable diplomatic gain. For Khartoum, it is regional backing against fragmentation. For Cairo and Asmara, it strengthens their regional positioning. And for Addis Ababa, the message is equally clear – even without Ethiopia’s name appearing once in the communiqué: the strategic map around the Horn is changing. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo hambalyo u diray Abiy Axmed
items.description: Muqdisho, 5 Oktoobar 2026 — Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa hambalyo u diray Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed, kaddib markii Baarlamaanka Itoobiya uu dib ugu doortay xilka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, isagoo bilaabay muddo xileed cusub oo shan sano ah. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay baraha bulshada ku sheegay inuu Abiy Axmed u rajeynayo guul iyo horumar muddada cusub, isagoo xusay in Soomaaliya ay rajaynayso inay si dhow ula shaqeyso Itoobiya. “Waxaan rajeynayaa inaan si dhow uga wada shaqeyno xoojinta xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya, iyo horumarinta nabadda, xasilloonida iyo barwaaqada wadaagga ah ee shucuubteena iyo Geeska Afrika.” Hambalyada Madaxweynaha ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya uu galay marxalad cusub. Labada hoggaamiye ayaa 29-kii Sebtembar kulan ku yeeshay Addis Ababa, kaas oo looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka labada dal, amniga gobolka iyo iskaashiga ganacsiga iyo diblomaasiyadda. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhawaan sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan diidnayn in Itoobiya ay hesho marin ganacsi oo ay ku isticmaasho dekedaha Soomaaliya, balse arrintaasi ay tahay in lagu heshiiyo wadaxaajood rasmi ah oo labada dowladood dhex mara. Dib-u-doorashada Abiy Axmed ayaa maanta si rasmi ah loo xaqiijiyey, waxaana uu dhaariyay Baarlamaanka Itoobiya si uu u hoggaamiyo dowladda federaalka muddo shan sano oo cusub ah.

items.title: Yemen says forces have retaken strategic Bab el-Mandeb from Houthis
items.description: SANAA (Somaliguardian) – Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces have secured effective control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, Yemen’s ​Information Minister Moammar al-Eryani told Reuters on Monday, though fighting continues with Houthi forces in the area. The government forces advanced rapidly along the coast with heavy Saudi air support to seize ‌key positions in the Dhubab area on the narrowest point of the strait, a vital oil route whose seizure by the Iran-backed Houthis last month sent shockwaves through energy markets. However, while Eryani said the military had seized Dhubab airstrip, located just inland from the strait, and cut off remaining Houthi forces in the area, another government source said fighting continued at a military base near the strait. The Houthis earlier denied that government forces had made gains, describing such claims as “completely untrue”, and they threatened to ​attack any aircraft flying in Saudi airspace. While recapturing the coastal area around the strait would make it harder for the Houthis to disrupt shipping between the Mediterranean and Indian Ocean, they ​could still target vessels with drones from positions further up the coast and inland. Meanwhile, the Houthis themselves made important advances near the city of Taiz, gaining ⁠sections of a mountain road to leave government forces there besieged, according to five military sources with the Yemeni government. One other government source denied the road had been cut. KEY ENERGY EXPORT ROUTE UNDER ​THREAT Fighting has raged along several frontlines in Yemen for weeks after a dormant civil war erupted in a spillover from the US-Iran conflict, with the Houthis seeking to control the vital Bab el-Mandeb Strait and firing missiles ​and drones at Saudi cities and infrastructure. With Gulf energy exports already restricted by Iran’s closure of the Hormuz Strait, the fighting in Yemen has threatened another major oil export route, pushing up global prices and raising new risks in a region already aflame. The renewed fighting has worsened a humanitarian crisis in Yemen, with the UN migration agency saying on Monday that some 184,000 people had now been displaced since the war resumed. The internationally recognised Yemeni government announced on Sunday the ​launch of its offensive to recapture territory, with President Rashad al-Alimi swearing to fight “until the country is liberated from the grip of the terrorist militia”. Saudi Arabia, which arms and trains Yemeni government forces, is backing ​the military campaign with air power and has sought logistical help from allies to push back the Houthis, restore free traffic in the Red Sea, and end the group’s attacks on its territory. Riyadh said on Monday it had ‌attacked hundreds of ⁠targets in Yemen to provide air cover for the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and Yemeni ground forces. The Yemeni government said it had launched attacks on several fronts including in the province of Sanaa, the Yemeni capital. The Houthi-run health ministry said two people had been killed and seven wounded in strikes on Sanhan and Sa’wan districts in Sanaa province. HEAVIEST FIGHTING IS IN SOUTHWEST YEMEN While the war has raged on several frontlines in Yemen, the heaviest fighting has been in the southwest, both in the coastal area near the strait and in the hills around Taiz, where the Houthis have been battling to surround government forces. Last week Houthi attacks damaged ​a culvert on the Taiz-Aden road, making it ​impassable. On Sunday night the group’s fighters made new ⁠advances into the town of al-Turbah, sitting atop a high promontory on the road, five government military sources said, though another government source denied this. A Houthi-run news agency on Monday cited a military source as saying the group had driven government forces from the al-Mawasit district of Taiz province, reaching the home of ​Alimi, head of Yemen’s interim presidential council. Those fresh advances leave Taiz, Yemen’s third-largest city with a population of over half a million and a garrison ​of thousands of government fighters, ⁠surrounded by Houthi forces, the government military sources said. Taiz, nestled among Yemen’s southern highlands, has been on the frontlines since early in the civil war, often under Houthi shell and sniper fire. In al-Mudhaffar area, just outside Taiz but within the area besieged by the Houthis, a long queue formed outside a petrol station on Monday as people waited for fuel and cooking gas canisters. “This is the daily state in Taiz. The suffering of citizens continues ⁠in this ​state,” said one man queuing, Shehab Hazaa. Yemen’s conflict began after the Houthis seized the capital Sanaa in 2014, prompting a Saudi-led ​coalition to intervene in the following year with an air campaign aimed at restoring the government and ousting the Iran-backed group. The fighting quickly ground to a bloody stalemate, with most frontlines stalled, leading to a major humanitarian crisis in what was already the ​poorest Arab state, until a ceasefire was agreed in 2022 that held until this summer.

items.title: Ciidamada Yemen oo la wareegay magaalada istiraatiijiga ah ee Mokha
items.description: Militariga Yemen ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay dib ula wareegeen Magaalada Mokha ee ku taala Badda Cas, iyagoo wada hawlgal ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta. Militariga ayaa war ay soo saareen ku sheegay in dagaalo ay ka dhaceen jihooyin dhowr ah oo u dhow Mokha, isla-markaana ay sababeen dhimashada iyo dhaawaca tiro ka mid ah xoogaga u dagaalama Xuutiyiinta. Militariga ayaa sheegay in Ciidamada Qalabka Sida oo xagga cirka uu Sacuudigu ka taageerayo ay qabsadeen Mokha. Saraakiisha Militariga ayaa laga soo xigtay in ciidamadu ay gacanta ku dhigeen dhowr dagaal-yahan oo ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta. Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen ee caalamka uu aqoonsan yahay oo gacan ka helaya kuwa Sacuudiga ayaa Isniintan weerar ballaaran ku qaaday deegaanada ku teedsan xeebaha galbeed ee dalkaasi ee ay Xuutiyiintu la wareegeen bishii September. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ayaa 10-kii September la wareegay gacan ku haynta magaalada dekedda leh ee Mokha, oo qiyaastii 75km dhanka waqooyi uga beegan marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Ciidamada Yemen ayaa mar sii horreysay la wareegay magaalada yar ee lagu magacaabo Dhubab, taas oo ku taala afka Marinka Bab El-Mandeb, iyadoo marinkan uu muhiim u yahay sahayda tamarta caalamka. Taliska Militariga Yemen ayaa sheegay in ciidamadu ay dib ula wareegeen goobo muhiim ah oo u dhow marin biyoodkan, iyadoona Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ay sheegtay in Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay dib ugu guranayaan dhulka buuraleyda. Gulufka dhulka iyo cirka isugu jira ee lagu qaaday Xuutiyiinta ayuu ujeedkiisu ahaa in xoogagaasi lagaga saaro aagga marin biyoodka ay qabsadeen bishii hore. Bab El-Mandeb waa marin istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah maraakiibta shidaalka iyo kuwa shixnadaha badeecadaha ee isugu kala goosha Asia, Yurub iyo Bariga Afrika.

items.title: Koox hubeysan oo maanta dil ka geysatay Somaliland – Sidee wax u dhaceen?
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Booliska Somaliland ayaa faah-faahin ka bixiyay dil ay koox hubeysan maanta ka geysatay waddada isku xirta Hargeysa iyo Berbera. Dilkan waxaa geystay koox burcad ah oo waddada u gashay gaari xamuul ah oo marayay dalcadda Kodayare ee degmada Laasgeel, sida uu sheegay Afhayeenka Booliska Somaliland, G/Sare Cabdicasiis Sheekh Ismaaciil. “Waxaan halkan kaga hadli doonaa dhacdo fool-xun oo ah dil ka dhacay dalcadda Kodayare ee waddada isku xirta Berbera iyo Hargeysa, kaddib markii baabuur xamuul ah oo waddadaasi marayay ay eedeysanayaal burcad ah oo goobtaasi taagnaa rasaas ooda kaga qaadeen,” ayuu yiri Afhayeenka Booliska Somaliland. Marxuumka la dilay ayaa lagu magacaabi jiray Ibraahim Cabdillaahi Aar oo 37 jir ahaa. Ciidamada Booliska oo tegay goobta uu dilku ka dhacay ayaa sheegay inay aqoonsadeen kooxdii falkaasi geysatay, isla markaana ay ku daba jiraan, iyagoo shacabka ka codsaday inay ku gacan siiyaan soo qabashadooda. “Falkaasi cid kale oo wax ku noqotay ama ku dhaawacantay midna ma jiro. Ciidanka Booliska wuxuu tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirayaa ehelkii iyo qaraabadii uu ka geeriyooday marxuum Ibraahim.” Sidoo kale, Afhayeenka Booliska ayaa sheegay in eedeysanayaasha ay ciidamada ammaanku ku daba jiraan, isla markaana marka gacanta lagu soo dhigo la horgeyn doono sharciga. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli waddada isku xirta Hargeysa iyo Berbera ay kamid tahay waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee Somaliland, waxaana ciidamada ammaanka laga sugayaa inay qaadaan tallaabooyin lagu xaqiijinayo amniga waddadaas oo ay maraan badeecooyinka ganacsi ee ugu badan. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli waddada isku xirta Hargeysa iyo Berbera ay kamid tahay waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee Somaliland, waxaana ciidamada ammaanka laga sugayaa inay qaadaan tallaabooyin lagu xaqiijinayo amniga waddadaas oo ay maraan badeecooyinka ganacsi ee ugu badan. items.title: Sawirro: R/W Xamza oo Galmudug uga qeyb-galay heshiis taariikhi ah oo ay wada gaareen…
items.description: Balanballe (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta safar ku tagay degmadda Balanballe ee Galmudug, waxaana halkaas si diirran ugu soo dhoweeyay Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Taliyaha NISA, musharaxa hoggaamiyaha Galmudug, maamulka degmada Balanballe iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee deegaankan ku dhaqan. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza ayaa goobjoog ka noqday heshiis taariikhi ah oo ay wada gaareen beelaha walaalaha ah ee degmooyinka Balanballe iyo Guriceel kadib colaado sanado badan qaatay. Xaflad balaaran oo ay kasoo qeyb-galeen bulshada labada degmo, odayaasha dhaqanka, waxgaradka iyo dhallinyarada, goobjoogna ka ahaayeen Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza, Madaxweynaha Galmudug, wasiirro iyo xildhibaanno heer federaal ah ayay labada ugaas ee beelahan oo kala ah Ugaas Maxamed Ugaas Kayse iyo Ugaas Xasan Ugaas Xasan meel fagaaro ah ku saxiixeen heshiis 8 qodob ka kooban oo gebi ahaanba lagu soo afmeeray colaaddii jirtay. “Gogoshan waxaa iiga muuqata in labada dhinac ay ka go’antahay in ay si dhab wh u heshiiyaan, Illaahayna wuxuu ballanqaaday in uu idin waafajinayo, haddii cid ku xad-gudubto heahiiskana waxaad ku heshiiseen in aad ku xallisaan Shareecada Islaamka,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza. Waxa uu intaasi ku daray in sida heshiiska ku cad qofkii qof kale dillo in lagu fuliyo qisaas. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha oo hadalkiisa sii watay ayaa si weyn u bogaadiyay heshiiska la gaaray, kaas oo uu ku tilmaamay in uu yahay mid waafaqsan qorshaha xukuumadda ee Soomaali Heshiis ah. Waxa uu sheegay in heshiiskan uu horseedi doono nabad waarta, horumar dhaqaale iyo in shacabka si wanaagsan loo gaarsiiyo adeegyada dowladda maadaamaa ay colaaddii dhammaatay. Mudane Xamza ayaa intii uu ku sugnaa degmada Balanballe waxa uu dhagax-dhigay iskuul ay dhigan doonaan carruurihii ku agoontoobay colaadihii beelaha dhex-maray, waxa kale oo uu Ra’iisul Wasaaraha dhagax-dhigay Aqalka Nabadda, iyo garoonka ciyaaraha Balanballe. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale waxa uu tababar usoo xirey cutub ka tirsan ciidanka Nabadsugidda, kuwaas oo ku biiraya ciidanka amniga dalka. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo laga riixay aagga Marinka Bab El-Mandeb
items.description: Ciidadamada Dowladda Yemen oo gacan ka helaya Ciidamada Sacuudiga ayaa Isniintan sameeyay horumar degdeg ah, iyagoona la wareegay deegaanada ku teedsan xeebaha galbeed ee dalkaasi ee dhaca Badda Cas iyo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb. Taliska Militariga Yemen ayaa sheegay inay Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta dib uga qabsadeen inta badan goobihii ay la wareegeen bishii hore ee September. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ayaa sheegtay in Xuutiyiinta ay dib ugu guranayaan dhulka buuraleyda ee dalkaasi, isla-markaana ay ciidamadu qarka u saaran yihiin inay la wareegaan gacan ku haynta magaalada dekedda leh ee Mokha. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in Ciidanka Cirka Sacuudiga ay gacan weyn ka gaysteen horumarka degdegga ah ee ay maanta ka sameeyeen dagaalka. Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen ee caalamka uu aqoonsan yahay ayaa sidoo kale la wareegay magaalada yar ee Dhubab, taas oo ku taala afka marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb, oo ah marin muhiim oo saliidda ah oo Xuutiyiintu ay la wareegeen bishii September, taasoo cabsi hor leh ka abuurtay suuqyada tamarta. Tallaabada Xuutiyiinta looga riixay aagga xeebta ee ku xeeran marin biyoodkan, inkastoo ay hoos u dhigeyso in ay carqaladeeyaan isu socodka maraakiibta shidaalka iyo kuwa shixnadaha badeecadaha ee Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, haddana waxay weli awoodaan inay dhulka ka fog xeebta ka weeraraan maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Xuutiyiinta ayaa haysta diyaaradaha drones-ka iyo gantaalada ballaastikada.

items.title: Political gatherings may produce headlines, but no such gathering
items.description: Political gatherings may produce headlines, but no such gathering can manufacture a veto over Somaliland’s future, erase its history, sovereignty, or the legitimate aspirations of its people. Moreover, such a gathering threatens not only Somaliland’s interests, but also the strategic interests of key countries in the region and its immediate neighbourhood. Using the failed Mogadishu administration as a proxy against Somaliland and other important friends in the region and beyond will never work.     Dr. Mohamed Hagi is the first Ambassador of the Republic of Somaliland to the State of Israel

items.title: DEG-DEG: Abiy Axmed oo markii saddexaad loo doortay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya
items.description: ADDIS ABABA — 5 Oktoobar 2026: Baarlamaanka cusub ee Itoobiya ayaa maanta mar kale u doortay Abiy Axmed inuu noqdo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha dalka, taas oo ka dhigan in uu xilka hoggaanka xukuumadda Itoobiya hayo xilli-hawleedkiisii saddexaad. Abiy Axmed ayaa markii ugu horreysay xilka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha qabtay 2018, waxaana dib loogu doortay 2021, kaddib doorashadii baarlamaanka ee dalka. Doorashadan cusub ayaa timid kaddib markii Xisbiga Prosperity Party, oo uu hoggaamiyo Abiy Axmed, uu guul weyn ka gaaray doorashadii baarlamaanka ee 2026. Baarlamaanka cusub ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u bilaabay shaqadiisa, iyadoo sidoo kale Axmed Shide, oo hore u ahaa Wasiirka Maaliyadda Itoobiya, loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka. Abiy Axmed ayaa hadda wajahaya muddo-xileed cusub oo shan sano ah, xilli Itoobiya ay ku jirto marxalad siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale oo muhiim ah, iyadoo dowladda looga baahan yahay inay wax ka qabato arrimaha amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo xasilloonida dalka.

items.title: U.S. Statement on Increased Tensions Between Ethiopia and Eritrea
items.description: U.S. Statement on Increased Tensions Between Ethiopia and Eritrea Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesman Office of the Spokesman Increasing cross-border tensions between Ethiopia and Eritrea have the potential to affect the entire region. The Horn of Africa cannot sustain another military conflict and humanitarian crisis. A conflict jeopardizes ongoing U.S. collaboration on shared interests with both countries. We strongly urge Ethiopia and Eritrea to respect the sovereignty and territorial integrity of their neighbors, exercise maximum restraint and return to dialogue and cooperation as agreed in their 2018 peace framework. Peace through dialogue is the only path toward sustainable security, economic growth, and prosperity.

items.title: United States and Japan Extend Science and Technology Agreement Indefinitely
items.description: United States and Japan Extend Science and Technology Agreement Indefinitely Office of the Spokesman October 2, 2026 Today in Tokyo, the United States and Japan signed a protocol that extends and amends the U.S.-Japan Agreement on Cooperation in Research and Development in Science and Technology, also known as the U.S.-Japan Science and Technology Agreement. Assistant to the President and Director of the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy Michael Kratsios signed for the United States and Minister for Foreign Affairs Motegi Toshimitsu signed for Japan. First signed in 1988, the Science and Technology Agreement provides a legally binding framework for scientific cooperation between the U.S. and Japanese governments. Under this framework, the United States and Japan have built countless links between their scientific communities. The protocol extends the Agreement indefinitely, a sign of the deep trust and respect between the U.S. and Japanese governments. The extended and amended Agreement positions both countries to sustain and strengthen their cooperation, with a focus on critical and emerging technologies that improve the lives of both peoples. The indefinite extension reaffirms the long-term U.S. and Japanese commitment to close partnership on science and technology, while advancing a secure, trusted innovation ecosystem that benefits both nations.

items.title: Axmed Shide oo loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Itoobiya
items.description: ADDIS ABABA — Wasiirkii hore ee Maaliyadda Itoobiya, Axmed Shide, ayaa loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka ee Itoobiya, kadib markii maanta la daah-furay baarlamaanka cusub ee dalka. Axmed Shide, oo muddo dheer ka tirsanaa dowladda federaalka Itoobiya, ayaa tan iyo sannadkii 2018 soo hayay xilka Wasiirka Maaliyadda. Intii uu xilkaas hayay, wuxuu door muuqda ku lahaa siyaasadaha dhaqaalaha iyo dib-u-habaynta maaliyadeed ee Itoobiya. Axmed Shide ayaa sidoo kale xildhibaan ka ahaa Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka, waxaana lagu soo doortay deegaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya. Doorashadiisa ayaa ah dhacdo si gaar ah uga dhex muuqata bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee Itoobiya, iyadoo Axmed Shide uu ka soo jeedo bulshada Soomaalida Itoobiya. Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka Itoobiya ayaa maanta bilaabay wejiga cusub ee baarlamaanka kadib doorashadii guud ee dalka. Warbaahinta Itoobiya ayaa sheegtay in baarlamaanka cusub si rasmi ah loo daah-furay 5-da Oktoobar 2026, iyadoo dalka uu gelayo marxalad cusub oo siyaasadeed.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo si adag uga hadlay xiriirka Imaaraadka Carabta
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Al Jazeera, ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku saabsan xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka Carabta, kaas oo muddooyinkii dambe wajahayay isbeddello iyo xiisado siyaasadeed. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in weli uu jiro xiriir u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Abu Dubai, isagoo xusay in safaaradaha labada dal ay shaqeynayaan. Balse wuxuu tilmaamay in Dowladda Federaalka ay joojisay dhammaan heshiisyadii ay kula jirtay Imaaraadka, sababo la xiriira mad-madowga iyo khilaafaadka soo kala dhex-galay labada dhinac. “Weli xiriir ayaan la leenahay Imaaraadka. Xiriirka ma aanan jarin, safaaraddeennu Imaaraadka way ku taallaa, safaaraddooduna Soomaaliya ayay ku taallaa, laakiin waxaan joojinay dhammaan heshiisyadii naga dhexeeyay. Heshiisyadaas intooda badan waxay ku saabsanaayeen amniga iyo ciidamada.” ayuu wareysiga ku yiri Madaxweynuhu. Sidoo kale, wuxuu is-barbar dhigay Washington iyo Abu Dhabi, isagoo sheegay in Mareykanku uusan si siyaasadeed ula macaamilin Somaliland, balse Imaaraadka Carabta uu ula dhaqmo si siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed, uuna ku dhiirrigeliyo inay ka go’do Soomaaliya. “Maraykanku si siyaasadeed ulama macaamilo Somaliland, laakiin Imaaraadku wuxuu Somaliland ula dhaqmaa si siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed, wuxuuna ku dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka go’do Soomaaliya,” ayuu mar kale yiri Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, Xasan Sheekh ayaa Imaaraadka Carabta ku tilmaamay dal aad muhiim u ah, wuxuuna sheegay in ay sii wadi doonaan dadaallada lagu doonayo in lagu hagaajiyo xiriirka labada dal. “Imaaraadku waa dal aad muhiim u ah marar badan ayaan isku daynay inaan hagaajinno xiriirka naga dhexeeya, laakiin ma aysan suuragelin. Si kastaba, waan sii wadi doonaa isku dayga aan ku hagaajinayno xiriirka,” ayuu mar kale yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya, xilli khilaafka u dhexeeya labada dal uu saameeyn ku yeeshay iskaashigooda, gaar ahaan heshiisyadii ay horay u wada galeen Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka. items.description: Balanballe, Isniin 5 Oktoobar, 2026 : Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta safar ku tagay degmadda Balanballe ee Galmudug, waxaana halkaas si diirran ugu soo dhoweeyay Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Taliyaha Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaran, Musharaxa Hoggaamiyaha Galmudug, maamulka degmada Balanballe , iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee deegaankan ku dhaqan. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa goobjoog ka noqday heshiis taariikhi ah oo ay wada gaareen beelaha walaalaha ah ee degmooyinka Balanballe iyo Guriceel, kadib colaado sanado badan qaatay. Xaflad balaaran oo ay kasoo qeybgaleen bulshada labada degmo, odayaasha dhaqanka, waxgaradka iyo dhallinyarada , goobjoogna ka ahaayeen Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa , Madaxweynaha Galmudug, wasiirro iyo xildhibaanno heer federaal ah ayay labada ugaas ee beelahan , ee kala ah Ugaas Maxamed Ugaas Kayse iyo Ugaas Xasan Ugaas Xasan meel fagaaro ah ku saxiixeen heshiis 8 qodob ka kooban oo gebi ahaanba lagu soo afmeeray colaaddii jirtay. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo ka hadlay madasha ayaa yiri “Gogoshan waxaa iiga muuqata in labada dhinac ay ka go’antahay in ay si dhab wh u heshiiyaan, Illaahayna wuxuu ballanqaaday in uu idin waafajinayo, haddii cid ku xad-gudubto heahiiskana waxaad ku heshiiseen in aad ku xallisaan Shareecada Islaamka”. Waxa uu intaasi ku daray in sida heshiiska ku cad qofkii qof kale dillo in lagu fuliyo qisaas. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo hadalkiisa sii watay ayaa si weyn u bogaadiyay heshiiska la gaaray , kaas oo uu ku tilmaamay in uu yahay mid waafaqsan qorshaha xukuumadda ee Soomaali Heshiis ah, wuxuuna sheegay in heshiiskan uu horseedi doono nabad waarta, horumar dhaqaale iyo in shacabka si wanaagsan loo gaarsiiyo adeegyada dowladda maadaamaa ay colaaddii dhammaatay. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa intii uu ku sugnaa degmada Balanballe waxa uu dhagax-dhigay iskuul ay dhigan doonaan carruurihii ku agoontoobay colaadihii beelaha dhex-maray, waxa kale oo uu Ra’iisul Wasaaraha dhagax-dhigay Aqalka Nabadda, iyo garoonka ciyaaraha Balanballe. Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre waxa uu dhanka kale tababar usoo xirey cutub ka tirsan ciidanka Nabadda Sugidda kuwaas oo ku biiraya ciidanka amniga dalka .

items.title: Itoobiya oo jawaab ka bixisay bayaankii isbahaysiga Masar, Eritrea, Sudan iyo Somalia
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Itoobiya ayaa jawaab rasmi ah ka bixisay bayaankii kasoo bxay shir-madaxeedka wadatashiga afar geesoodka ah ee madaxda waddamada Masar, Suudaan, Eritrea iyo Soomaaliya ee ka dhacay magaalada El Alamein, kaas oo laga soo saaray qodobo la xiriira arrimaha gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka. Madaxda afarta dal ayaa si weyn u adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay ixtiraamka sharciga caalamiga ah ee nidaamiya webiyada xuduudaha ka gudba, oo uu ku jiro webiga Niil, gaar ahaan mabda’a ah inaan waxyeello la geysan, iyo waajibka iskaashiga ee loo marayo wargelin horudhac ah, wadatashi iyo isku-raac. Sidoo kale Masar, Suudaan, Eritrea iyo Soomaaliya ayaa usoo jeediyay xukuumadda Addis Ababa in aanay keli ku noqon ka faa’iidaysiga biyaha Nile, oo ay horay uga dhistay biyo xireen si ay koronto uga dhaliso. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya ayaa intaas kadib soo saartay qoraal ay ku shaacisay in ay ku socoto danaha ay ka leedahay isticmaalka biyaha webiga Nile, iyadoo sidoo kale sheegtay inay jirto dan ku riixaysa raadinta marin ay u marto Badda Cas, sida ay hadalka u dhigtay. Itoobiya ayaa ku ddooday in juqraafi ahaan iyo taariikh ahaan xiriir dhow la leedahay Badda Cas, waxayna xustay in xadka Itoobiya uu qiyaastii 30 mayl u jiro xeebta Badda Cas. Waxaa kale oo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya intaas ku sii dartay in aanay ka gorgortami doonnin ilaalinta madax bannaanideeda iyo dhulkeeda, ayna diyaar u tahay is difaacis ay ku samayso arrimaheeda gudaha iyo danaheeda gaarka ah. Wasaaraddu ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqday in arrimaha biyaha iyo Badda Cas lagu saleeyo xaqiiqooyinka juqraafiyeed iyo taariikheed, iyadoo tilmaamtay inay doorbidayso wada-hadal, iskaashi iyo is-ixtiraam, balse ay difaacayso madaxbannaanideeda iyo danaha qarankeeda. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyadoo dalalka Masar, Suudaan, Eritrea iyo Soomaaliya ay si buuxda u diideen tallaabo kasta oo uu qaado hal dhinac, taas oo si taban u saamaynaysa isticmaalka biyaha ee hadda ka jira labada dal ee ku yaalla qaybta hoose ee webiga Nile. The post Itoobiya oo jawaab ka bixisay bayaankii isbahaysiga Masar, Eritrea, Sudan iyo Somalia appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ethiopia’s Press Statements Exposes the El-Alamein Contradiction
items.description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ethiopia issued a clear and principled press statement on 5 October addressing the El-Alamein Joint Declaration signed the day before by the leaders of Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan and Somalia. Although the declaration makes no direct reference to Ethiopia, its four core positions engage matters of established Ethiopian interest and responsibility. The text affirms support for Sudan’s unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity. It rejects any recognition of Somaliland as inconsistent with the sovereignty of the Federal Republic of Somalia. It asserts that governance of the Red Sea remains the exclusive preserve of littoral states. It further rejects unilateral measures affecting the Nile while invoking international law on transboundary rivers. Ethiopia’s statement responds by grounding regional discussion in the enduring geographic and historical facts that define the Horn, affirming the country’s legitimate role in both the management of the Nile and the security architecture of the Red Sea. The declaration’s language on transboundary rivers rejects unilateral measures affecting shared water resources. This formulation originates in Egyptian policy designed to maintain control over Nile utilization. The Ethiopian statement responds by recording that the highlands of Ethiopia generate approximately eighty-five percent of the Nile’s total flow through the Abay River. Any workable arrangement for managing these waters must therefore incorporate Ethiopia’s right to develop resources originating within its territory. Between 1929 and 1959 Egypt secured bilateral agreements with Sudan that allocated the bulk of the water and asserted a veto over upstream projects. Those agreements excluded Ethiopia and later served as the basis for systematic opposition to international financing of Ethiopian infrastructure. The Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam proceeded solely through domestic bonds and public contributions, establishing a non-consumptive hydroelectric facility that ended the prior pattern of external blockage. Continued insistence on zero-sum control of the river ignores the established principle of equitable and reasonable utilization that underpins modern basin cooperation. Egyptian policy toward Ethiopia has followed a consistent pattern of containment since the mid-twentieth century. From the 1950s onward Cairo provided organizational space, media platforms, and political sanctuary for Eritrean separatist groups, including the Eritrean Liberation Front whose formation was announced in the Egyptian capital in 1960. The practical effect was to divert Ethiopian military and fiscal resources into prolonged internal conflict, reducing the capacity available for major development works on the Blue Nile. Contemporary Egyptian activity extends this approach through bilateral defense agreements, joint exercises, and intelligence arrangements with states that border Ethiopia. The same government that invokes sovereignty to oppose Ethiopian maritime access has for decades supported mechanisms that weaken Ethiopian internal cohesion. The declaration asserts that responsibility for Red Sea security belongs exclusively to littoral states. The Ethiopian statement rejects this boundary by noting that the country’s nearest border lies approximately thirty miles from the Red Sea coast and that Ethiopia’s population exceeds one hundred twenty million. As the largest economy and primary source of commercial traffic in the region, Ethiopia generates the bulk of demand for ports serving the southern Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. Exclusion of this stakeholder from maritime security arrangements leaves the framework without the demographic weight and logistical capacity needed to secure approaches to the Bab el-Mandeb. The littoral states currently lack the combined naval assets, internal coherence, and sustained logistics required for independent enforcement. A security structure organized around political exclusion rather than geographic and economic integration therefore contains built-in enforcement shortfalls. Eritrea and Sudan introduce further inconsistencies into the sovereignty claims advanced at El-Alamein. Eritrean statements routinely affirm the inviolability of borders and non-interference. Operational practice after the November 2022 Pretoria Agreement has included continued military presence in Ethiopian border areas and efforts to establish unilateral buffer zones inside Ethiopian territory. In the current conflict that erupted in late September 2026, Ethiopian federal authorities and regional leaders have reported that Eritrean troops are actively fighting alongside the Tigray People’s Liberation Front and other members of the seven-group coalition known as the Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Alliance for Survival against the federal government. An Afar regional official told Al Jazeera that Eritrean forces were participating in fighting in that region, while Ethiopia’s army chief publicly accused Eritrea of providing backing to the rebel alliance. These reports, documented by the International Crisis Group in its September 2026 CrisisWatch update on Eritrea, underscore the contradiction between Asmara’s formal sovereignty rhetoric and its operational conduct. A government whose forces are reported to be engaged inside Ethiopian territory alongside groups seeking to overthrow the federal administration possesses limited standing to enforce territorial norms on others. Sudan’s record along the shared border with Ethiopia reveals a clear inconsistency with the sovereignty principles advanced at El-Alamein. In November 2020, while Ethiopian forces were concentrated on northern operations, the Sudanese Armed Forces advanced into the fertile Al Fashaga triangle and occupied areas long cultivated by Ethiopian farmers under the soft-border arrangements maintained through the 1972 exchange of notes and subsequent practical understandings. Sudanese units rapidly consolidated control over agricultural lands previously farmed by Ethiopian communities, expelling residents and altering the long-standing status quo that had preserved local livelihoods while formal demarcation remained unresolved. Ethiopia responded through diplomatic channels and continued advocacy for peaceful, African-led mechanisms under IGAD and the African Union rather than reciprocal military advances into Sudanese territory. The contrast is instructive. Sudan elected to exploit a moment of Ethiopian internal focus to alter facts on the ground by force, while Ethiopia has consistently channelled border disagreements into negotiation and regional mediation frameworks. This unilateral territorial action by Sudan undercuts the summit’s claims of principled support for sovereignty and institutional unity. The same tension becomes even more consequential in Somalia, where the declaration invokes sovereignty and institutional unity while overlooking Ethiopia’s longstanding role in sustaining both. The declaration’s treatment of Somalia therefore presents the clearest divergence between its stated principles and the regional realities that have shaped their survival. Somalia’s ability to preserve its federal institutions and territorial integrity has for more than two decades depended in significant part on Ethiopian security involvement. External military support has sustained the Federal Government of Somalia since the early 2000s, with Ethiopian forces playing a particularly persistent role in the country’s most contested areas. Under AMISOM and later ATMIS, Ethiopian deployments concentrated in Bay, Bakool and Gedo, sectors where other contingents were often less active. These forces absorbed sustained combat losses while maintaining the territorial and logistical links on which the federal government depended. Ethiopian policy consequently treated the survival of a functioning Somali state as directly connected to Ethiopia’s own border security. Somalia’s participation in a regional declaration centred on sovereignty while excluding one of the states that has repeatedly borne the operational burden of protecting that sovereignty therefore exposes a central contradiction in the framework. The transition from ATMIS to AUSSOM on 1 January 2025 further demonstrated the importance of operational continuity. Al-Shabaab launched a coordinated offensive in February 2025 across Hiiraan, Middle Shabelle, Lower Shabelle and parts of South West State, reversing important territorial gains made during the 2022–2023 government offensive through sustained attrition and the restoration of rural control. Ethiopian units remaining under AUSSOM and bilateral arrangements continued to hold forward positions, conduct joint operations with Somali forces and defend logistical corridors around Baidoa and other strategically important areas. This continuity matters to the argument of the El-Alamein declaration because the security of the Somali state cannot be separated from the actors that have actually maintained its territorial and institutional resilience. Political efforts in Mogadishu to limit or restructure Ethiopian participation therefore unfolded alongside the security responsibilities those forces continued to perform. The resulting tension illustrates the broader problem exposed by Ethiopia’s 5 October statement. Regional arrangements can formally invoke institutional unity and sovereignty, yet their effectiveness still depends on cooperation with Ethiopia where the security burden is greatest. The subsequent expansion of Egyptian participation within AUSSOM adds a further complication. Egypt brings military capacity and can contribute to Somalia’s security, but its strategic relationship with Mogadishu has developed alongside the Egypt-Ethiopia dispute over the Nile and wider competition over Ethiopia’s regional position. The arrival of another external military actor whose strategic interests intersect with Ethiopia’s introduces a broader geopolitical dimension into a theatre whose immediate security challenge remains Al-Shabaab. Ethiopia’s long operational presence, established intelligence relationships and direct security interests in Somalia give it a different strategic stake from states entering the theatre primarily through bilateral partnerships. The issue is therefore not whether Somalia should diversify its security partnerships. It is whether a regional framework built around Somali sovereignty and security can function coherently while politically marginalizing a neighbouring state that has repeatedly contributed forces, logistics and territorial knowledge to the preservation of that same sovereignty. Somalia’s signature at El-Alamein thus reinforces, rather than resolves, the contradiction identified by Ethiopia’s statement. Taken together, the El-Alamein declaration unites four states around the single objective of limiting Ethiopian influence while offering limited shared capacity for implementation. The signatories lack integrated economies, interoperable military forces, and internal stability sufficient to sustain the regional claims they advance. The practical challenges facing the Horn, including insurgency, maritime insecurity, and state fragility, require arrangements that incorporate the region’s largest demographic and economic actor. Frameworks organized solely around exclusion omit the geographic and commercial realities that determine security outcomes. By Bezawit Eshetu, Researcher, Horn Review

The same tension becomes even more consequential in Somalia, where the declaration invokes sovereignty and institutional unity while overlooking Ethiopia’s longstanding role in sustaining both. The declaration’s treatment of Somalia therefore presents the clearest divergence between its stated principles and the regional realities that have shaped their survival. Somalia’s ability to preserve its federal institutions and territorial integrity has for more than two decades depended in significant part on Ethiopian security involvement. External military support has sustained the Federal Government of Somalia since the early 2000s, with Ethiopian forces playing a particularly persistent role in the country’s most contested areas. Under AMISOM and later ATMIS, Ethiopian deployments concentrated in Bay, Bakool and Gedo, sectors where other contingents were often less active. These forces absorbed sustained combat losses while maintaining the territorial and logistical links on which the federal government depended. Ethiopian policy consequently treated the survival of a functioning Somali state as directly connected to Ethiopia’s own border security. Somalia’s participation in a regional declaration centred on sovereignty while excluding one of the states that has repeatedly borne the operational burden of protecting that sovereignty therefore exposes a central contradiction in the framework. The transition from ATMIS to AUSSOM on 1 January 2025 further demonstrated the importance of operational continuity. Al-Shabaab launched a coordinated offensive in February 2025 across Hiiraan, Middle Shabelle, Lower Shabelle and parts of South West State, reversing important territorial gains made during the 2022–2023 government offensive through sustained attrition and the restoration of rural control. Ethiopian units remaining under AUSSOM and bilateral arrangements continued to hold forward positions, conduct joint operations with Somali forces and defend logistical corridors around Baidoa and other strategically important areas. This continuity matters to the argument of the El-Alamein declaration because the security of the Somali state cannot be separated from the actors that have actually maintained its territorial and institutional resilience. Political efforts in Mogadishu to limit or restructure Ethiopian participation therefore unfolded alongside the security responsibilities those forces continued to perform. The resulting tension illustrates the broader problem exposed by Ethiopia’s 5 October statement. Regional arrangements can formally invoke institutional unity and sovereignty, yet their effectiveness still depends on cooperation with Ethiopia where the security burden is greatest. The subsequent expansion of Egyptian participation within AUSSOM adds a further complication. Egypt brings military capacity and can contribute to Somalia’s security, but its strategic relationship with Mogadishu has developed alongside the Egypt-Ethiopia dispute over the Nile and wider competition over Ethiopia’s regional position. The arrival of another external military actor whose strategic interests intersect with Ethiopia’s introduces a broader geopolitical dimension into a theatre whose immediate security challenge remains Al-Shabaab. Ethiopia’s long operational presence, established intelligence relationships and direct security interests in Somalia give it a different strategic stake from states entering the theatre primarily through bilateral partnerships. The issue is therefore not whether Somalia should diversify its security partnerships. It is whether a regional framework built around Somali sovereignty and security can function coherently while politically marginalizing a neighbouring state that has repeatedly contributed forces, logistics and territorial knowledge to the preservation of that same sovereignty. Somalia’s signature at El-Alamein thus reinforces, rather than resolves, the contradiction identified by Ethiopia’s statement. Taken together, the El-Alamein declaration unites four states around the single objective of limiting Ethiopian influence while offering limited shared capacity for implementation. The signatories lack integrated economies, interoperable military forces, and internal stability sufficient to sustain the regional claims they advance. The practical challenges facing the Horn, including insurgency, maritime insecurity, and state fragility, require arrangements that incorporate the region’s largest demographic and economic actor. Frameworks organized solely around exclusion omit the geographic and commercial realities that determine security outcomes. By Bezawit Eshetu, Researcher, Horn Review

items.title: Safiirka Somaliland u fadhiya Israa’iil Ayaa sheegay
items.description: Safiirka Somaliland u fadhiya Israa’iil, Dr. Maxamed Xaaji, ayaa sheegay in kulamo siyaasadeed aysan go’aamin karin mustaqbalka Somaliland ama meesha ka saari karin taariikhdeeda, madaxbannaanideeda iyo rabitaanka shacabka. Dr. Maxamed Xaaji ayaa qoraal uu soo saaray ku sheegay in kulamada noocaas ahi ay sidoo kale saamayn ku yeelan karaan danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee dalalka muhiimka ah ee gobolka iyo kuwa Somaliland deriska la ah. Safiirka ayaa sidoo kale dhaliilay in maamulka Muqdisho loo adeegsado sidii wakiil siyaasadeed oo ka dhan ah Somaliland iyo dalal kale oo uu sheegay inay saaxiib la yihiin. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in tallaabadaas ayna shaqayn doonin, isagoo ku adkaystay in mustaqbalka Somaliland iyo rabitaanka shacabkeeda aan lagu go’aamin karin kulamo siyaasadeed.

items.title: Serious buildup of troops and hardware on the Ethiopia-Eritrea border.
items.description: Serious buildup of troops and hardware on the Ethiopia-Eritrea border. There have been sustained external pressure, principally the United States in the last 24 hours, to stop the almost inexorable slide toward full-blown war. The massing of large rival forces along a volatile border is always dangerous even when order for invasion not given. The risk of an accidental war – an escalated artillery duel quickly sparking bigger conflict – is significally elevated. There is also the fatal war calculations of the two sides. Both sides have an incentive for escalation – PM Abiy is under immense pressure from his core base to press his current advantage while his army has the initiative and the upper hand in the north to finish the ‘Eritrea problem’ once and for all. Asmara, fully supported and possibly instigated by Egypt, calculates Ethiopa is too weakened, battling large internal armed insurrections, fighting on multiple fronts, and lacking the strength to take on Eritrea. Moving against Addis now, with active support from TPLF factions, possibly with support from other rebel groups like Fano and OLA, is from Asmara’s perspective advantageous. Rashid Abdi

items.title: Ciidamo duulaan ah oo ka baxay Luuq iyo Dooow, kuna jeeda…
items.description: Beledxaawo (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya gobolka Gedo ayaa sheegaya in maanta xaalad kacsanaan ah laa dareemayo aagga degmada Beledxaawo ee gobolkaasi, kadib markii halkaas laga dareemay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo iska soo horjeedo. Guddoomiyaha degmada Beledxaawo Cabdicasiis Xareed Cabdullaahi oo shir jaraa’id u qabtay wariyeyaasha ayaa sheegay in xaalad cusub ay kasoo korortay degmada, ayna ka war heleen duulaan uu sheegay inay soo qaadeen ciidamo ay hoggaaminayaan saraakiil ka amar qaata Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Xareed ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in ciidamadaas oo duulaan ah ay kasoo baxeen magaalooyinka Luuq iyo Doolow, kuna soo wajahan yihiin degmada Beledxaawo, si ay beegsadaan xerayaha ciidamada ee ku yaalla halkaasi. “Waxaa jira oo cusub maanta ciidan niman saraakiil ah wataan oo ka yimid Doolow illaa Luuq oo duulaan ku ah bulshada Beledxaawo iyo xeryaha ciidamada, sababtana aan la garaneyn hadda kahorna aan ka hadalnay arrin noocaas oo kale inay suuragal tahay,” ayuu yiri Xareed. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in haatan colaad cusub laga dareemayo Beledxaawo, isaga oo arrintaas ku eedeeyay dowladda Soomaaliya oo weli khilaaf uu kala dhexeeyo Jubbaland. “Waxaan bulshada Beledxaawo u sheegeynaa in ay jirto colaad cusub oo ka timid Doolow iyo Luuq wadaan rag saraakiil ah oo ka amar qaadanayaa wasiirka amniga iyo rag kale, annaga oo horay uga dignay arrintaas,” ayuu mar kale yiri guddoomiyaha degmada Belexaawo. Waxaa kale uu intaas sii raaciyay “Colaad ma rabno nabad baa rabnaa in laba wiil oo dambe ay isku dhintaan ma rabno waxaana raggaas ugu baaqeynaa inay ka fogaadaan wax kasta oo suuragelinaya inay colaad mar labaad ka qaraxdo degmada Beledxaawo”. Xiisaddan cusub ayaa kusoo aaday, xilli dhawaan ay heshiis gaareen Cabdirashiid Janan oo la safnaa dowladda dhexe iyo Jubbaland, kadib wada-hadallo ay yeesheen labada dhinac. items.title: Maxaa ka jira in maalmo kadib la xirayo garoonka Muqdisho?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed oo war-saxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa ka hadashay wararka sheegaya in maalmaha soo socda la xiri doono garoonka diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde, kadib markii arrintaas si weyn loogu faafiyay baraha bulshada. Hay’adda ayaa marka hore shacabka Soomaaliyeed la wadaagtay in aysan waxba iska beddelin shaqada garoonka, isla markaana ay sidii caadiga ahayd u socdaan duulimaadyada gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ee garoonka diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde. Sidoo kale, hay’addu waxay beenisay wararka la faafiyay ee ku aaddan in maalmaha soo socda la xirayo garoonka Muqdisho, iyadoo wararkaas ku tilmaantay kuwo aan waxba ka jirin, sida lagu caddeeyay bayaanka. “Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed (SCAA) waxay shacabka Soomaaliyeed la wadaageysaa inaysan waxba iska bedelin howlaha Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Aadan Cadde, ayna duulimaadyadii imaan jiray garoonka ay sidoodii u shaqeynayaan. Hay’addu waxay si cad u beenisay wararka dhoowaan la faafiyay ee sheegayay in garoonka la xirayo maalmaha soo socda,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka kasoo baxay Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka. Dhanka kale, Hay’adda ayaa farriin u dirtay guud ahaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed, waxayna ugu baaqday in xogta rasmiga ah ay kala socdaan bogga rasmiga ah ee Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka. “Shacabka waxaa lagu boorrinayaa inay xogta saxda ah ee ku saabsan duulimaadyada iyo howlaha garoomada dalka ka helaan oo keliya baraha rasmiga ah ee HDRS,” ayaa la raaciyay. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Wararka la xiriira xaaladda garoonka Aadan Cadde ayaa si weyn ugu fiday baraha bulshada, taas oo keentay walaac iyo hadal-heyn ku saabsan shaqada garoonka iyo suurtagalnimada in la xiro maalmaha soo socda, balse waxaa arrintaas meesha ka saartay Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed. Garoonka diyaaradaha magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ah garoonka ugu weyn ee Soomaaliya, waxaana si joogto ah uga howlgala diyaarado isaga kala goosha magaalada Muqdisho iyo magaalooyin gudaha dalka ah, iyadoo sidoo kale ay yimaadaan duulimaadyo caalami ah. items.title: Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan oo soo saaray mowqif adag oo ka dhan ah Somaliland
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan ayaa Axaddii si wadajir ah Soomaaliya ugula saftey mowqif ka dhan ah aqoonsi ama taageero loo fidiyo maamulka Somaliland, kadib shir afar geesood ah oo ka dhacay magaalada New Alamein ee dalka Masar. Mowqifkan ayaa lagu caddeeyey bayaanka wadajirka ah ee El Alamein, kaas oo kasoo baxay kulankii ay yeesheen madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki iyo hoggaamiyaha Sudan Abdel Fattah al-Burhan. Afarta hoggaamiye ayaa mar kale taageeray midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, iyagoo si gaar ah uga horyimid tallaabo kasta oo lagu aqoonsanayo ama lagu taageerayo Somaliland. Bayaanka ayaa si cad loogu yiri hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay isku raaceen “in la diido aqoonsi kasta ama taageero kasta oo loo fidiyo waxa loogu yeero ‘Somaliland’” , iyagoo sheegay in tallaabooyinka noocaas ah ay xadgudub ku yihiin madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Qodobkan ayaa ka sii ballaaran diidmada aqoonsiga diblomaasiyadeed oo keliya, maadaama uu sidoo kale si cad uga horyimid taageero kasta oo dibadeed oo loo fidiyo Somaliland. Somaliland ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay ka go’day Soomaaliya sanadkii 1991, balse muddo ka badan 35 sano ma aysan helin aqoonsi caalami ah. Israel ayaa 26-kii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland, waxaana tan iyo markaas sii xoogeysanayey xiriirka labada dhinac. Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi ayaa bishii June booqasho rasmi ah ku tagay Israel, halkaas oo lagu qaabilay baarlamaanka Knesset, xilli Hargeysa ay sidoo kale safaarad ka furtay Jerusalem. Bayaanka El Alamein ayaa hadda Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan si rasmi ah ugu daraya dalalka gobolka ee si cad uga soo horjeeda in Somaliland loo aqoonsado dal madax-bannaan ama taageero gaar ah loo fidiyo. Taageerada amniga Soomaaliya Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale taageero loogu muujiyey dadaallada Soomaaliya ee la dagaallanka argagixisada iyo xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda. Afarta hoggaamiye ayaa beesha caalamka iyo saaxiibada gobolka ugu baaqay inay bixiyaan “maalgelin ku filan, joogto ah oo la saadaalin karo” oo loogu talagalay howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Bayaanka ayaa sheegay in maalgelintaasi muhiim u tahay sidii Soomaaliya loogu wareejin lahaa mas’uuliyadda amniga, iyadoo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si tartiib ah ula wareegayaan howlaha ay hadda qabtaan ciidamada Midowga Afrika. Maalgelinta AUSSOM ayaa muddooyinkii dambe ahayd mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn ee horyaalla dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika. Badda Cas iyo Niilka Afarta dal ayaa sidoo kale mowqif wadajir ah ka qaatay arrimaha Badda Cas, iyagoo sheegay in maamulka iyo mas’uuliyadda marin-biyoodkaasi ay tahay “mas’uuliyad gaar ah oo u taal dalalka xeebaha ku leh Badda Cas.” Waxay sidoo kale adkeeyeen muhiimadda xorriyadda maraakiibta iyo isu socodka ganacsiga ee Badda Cas, oo ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan dunida. Arrimaha webiga Niilka, hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay ku adkeysteen mabda’a ah inaan waxyeello loo geysan dalalka kale, isla markaana arrimaha biyaha xuduudaha isaga gudba lagu maareeyo ogeysiis hore, wadatashi iyo heshiis wadajir ah. Waxay si cad u diideen tallaabooyin hal dhinac ah oo wax u dhimaya isticmaalka biyaha ee Masar iyo Sudan. Inkastoo Itoobiya aan si toos ah loogu magacaabin qodobkan, haddana Masar iyo Sudan ayaa muddo dheer khilaaf kala dhexeeyey Addis Ababa oo ku saabsan biyo-xireenka Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam. Dhanka Sudan, hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay taageereen midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalkaas, iyagoo sidoo kale diiday dhismaha hay’ado ama maamullo barbar socda dowladda. Waxay ku baaqeen geeddi-socod siyaasadeed oo ay Sudan leedahay, ayna hoggaaminayaan dadka reer Sudan, iyagoo sidoo kale ka digay taageerada calooshood u shaqeystayaasha ku lug leh dagaalka dalkaas. Masar, Soomaaliya, Eritrea iyo Sudan ayaa ugu dambeyn isku raacay in la sameeyo hannaan lagula socdo fulinta qodobada lagu heshiiyey, isla markaana kulamada afarta dhinac ah la joogteeyo marka loo baahdo. Israel ayaa 26-kii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland, waxaana tan iyo markaas sii xoogeysanayey xiriirka labada dhinac. Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi ayaa bishii June booqasho rasmi ah ku tagay Israel, halkaas oo lagu qaabilay baarlamaanka Knesset, xilli Hargeysa ay sidoo kale safaarad ka furtay Jerusalem. Bayaanka El Alamein ayaa hadda Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan si rasmi ah ugu daraya dalalka gobolka ee si cad uga soo horjeeda in Somaliland loo aqoonsado dal madax-bannaan ama taageero gaar ah loo fidiyo. Taageerada amniga Soomaaliya Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale taageero loogu muujiyey dadaallada Soomaaliya ee la dagaallanka argagixisada iyo xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda. Afarta hoggaamiye ayaa beesha caalamka iyo saaxiibada gobolka ugu baaqay inay bixiyaan “maalgelin ku filan, joogto ah oo la saadaalin karo” oo loogu talagalay howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Bayaanka ayaa sheegay in maalgelintaasi muhiim u tahay sidii Soomaaliya loogu wareejin lahaa mas’uuliyadda amniga, iyadoo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si tartiib ah ula wareegayaan howlaha ay hadda qabtaan ciidamada Midowga Afrika. Maalgelinta AUSSOM ayaa muddooyinkii dambe ahayd mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn ee horyaalla dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika. Badda Cas iyo Niilka Afarta dal ayaa sidoo kale mowqif wadajir ah ka qaatay arrimaha Badda Cas, iyagoo sheegay in maamulka iyo mas’uuliyadda marin-biyoodkaasi ay tahay “mas’uuliyad gaar ah oo u taal dalalka xeebaha ku leh Badda Cas.” Waxay sidoo kale adkeeyeen muhiimadda xorriyadda maraakiibta iyo isu socodka ganacsiga ee Badda Cas, oo ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan dunida. Arrimaha webiga Niilka, hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay ku adkeysteen mabda’a ah inaan waxyeello loo geysan dalalka kale, isla markaana arrimaha biyaha xuduudaha isaga gudba lagu maareeyo ogeysiis hore, wadatashi iyo heshiis wadajir ah. Waxay si cad u diideen tallaabooyin hal dhinac ah oo wax u dhimaya isticmaalka biyaha ee Masar iyo Sudan. Inkastoo Itoobiya aan si toos ah loogu magacaabin qodobkan, haddana Masar iyo Sudan ayaa muddo dheer khilaaf kala dhexeeyey Addis Ababa oo ku saabsan biyo-xireenka Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam. Dhanka Sudan, hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay taageereen midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalkaas, iyagoo sidoo kale diiday dhismaha hay’ado ama maamullo barbar socda dowladda. Waxay ku baaqeen geeddi-socod siyaasadeed oo ay Sudan leedahay, ayna hoggaaminayaan dadka reer Sudan, iyagoo sidoo kale ka digay taageerada calooshood u shaqeystayaasha ku lug leh dagaalka dalkaas. Masar, Soomaaliya, Eritrea iyo Sudan ayaa ugu dambeyn isku raacay in la sameeyo hannaan lagula socdo fulinta qodobada lagu heshiiyey, isla markaana kulamada afarta dhinac ah la joogteeyo marka loo baahdo. items.title: Dowladda Yemen oo xuutiyiinta ku qaadday weerarro tiro badan
items.description: Afhayeen u hadlay ciidamada dowladda Yemen ayaa sheegay in ay qaadeen 1,122 weerar oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday fariisimo ay leeyihiin Xuutiyiinta, oo ay ku jiraan goobo madaafiic, gantaallo iyo xarumo talis. Majid Cabdullaahi Nazili ayaa qoraal uu ku daabacay barta X ku sheegay in weerarrada loo adeegsaday diyaarado dagaal, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, gantaallo, madaafiic iyo hoobiyaal. Wuxuu sheegay in weerarradu ka dhaceen gobollada Saada, Al-Jawf iyo Tacis, iyo sidoo kale deegaannada xeebaha Yemen.
