items.title: Somaliland oo Israa’iil ka dalbatay difaacyada casriga si ay uga hortagto Turkiga
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Somaliland ayaa la sheegay inay Israa’iil ka dalbatay nidaamyo difaac oo casri ah, oo ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha iswada, iyadoo tallaabadan ay la xiriirto walaaca ay ka qabto awoodda militari ee Turkiga iyo joogitaankiisa Soomaaliya. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Somaliland ayaa wargeyska Middle East Eye u sheegay in Hargeysa ay dooneyso inay hesho qalab iyo nidaamyo difaac oo ay uga hortagto waxa ay u aragto khatar ka imaan karta dhinaca Turkiga. “Waxaan u baahanahay nidaamyada difaaca cirka, Turkigu wuxuu leeyahay diyaaradaha F-16 ee Muqdisho. Wuxuu doonayaa inuu saldhig ka dhiso Soomaaliya,” ayay mas’uuliyiinta Somaliland u sheegeen wargeyska. Warbixinta ayaa tilmaamaysa in Somaliland ay si gaar ah u danaynayso nidaamyada difaaca cirka, iyadoo sidoo kale la sheegay inay doonayso diyaaradaha iswada ee casriga ah, kuwaas oo qayb ka noqon kara qorshe ay ku xoojinayso awooddeeda difaac. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan walaacyada uu maamulka Somaliland ka qabo xiriirka militari ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, gaar ahaan taageerada difaac ee Ankara ay siiso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dhawaan dhistay Taliska Waqooyi oo fadhigiisu yahay magaalada Laascaanood, kaas oo lagu daray qaab-dhismeedka ciidamada dowladda ee ka howlgala waqooyiga dalka. Somaliland ayaa u aragta khatar amni oo ka dhan ah jiritaankeeda ciidamada ay Dowladda Federaalka ka qarameysay gobolka Sool, xilli Laascaanood uu si buuxda uga arrimiyo maamulka Waqooyi Bari. The post Somaliland oo Israa’iil ka dalbatay difaacyada casriga si ay uga hortagto Turkiga appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Siddeed Badmaax Oo Masaari Ah Oo Burcad-badeed Laga Sii Daayey Oo Muqdisho La Keenay
items.description: MUQDISHO (Goobjoog News) Siddeed badmaax oo Masaari ah oo muddo ku dhow shan bilood lagu haystay markabka M/T Eureka ayaa Muqdisho soo gaaray, kaddib markii laga sii daayey kooxihii afduubka ku haystay xeebaha Puntland. Safiirka Masar ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Salaax, ayaa badmaaxiinta ku qaabilay garoonka diyaaradaha Muqdisho, isaga oo u galbiyey xarunta safaaradda Masar. Halkaas ayaa hoy iyo ilaalin loogu diyaariyey inta laga dhammaystirayo safarkooda Qaahira. Badmaaxiinta ayaa lagu haystay markabka M/T Eureka tan iyo 2-dii May, markii markabka oo ka yimid biyaha Yemen loo kaxaystay dhinaca xeebaha Puntland. Waxay ka mid ahaayeen 22 shaqaale ah oo saarnaa markabka shidaalka qaada ee ku gooshayey calanka Togo. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Masar ayaa sheegtay in sii-dayntooda lagu gaaray xiriirro diblomaasiyadeed oo heer sare ah oo lala sameeyey mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliya iyo Yemen. Safaaradda Masar ee Muqdisho ayaa muddadii afduubka fududaynaysay xiriirka badmaaxiinta iyo qoysaskooda. Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Masar Cali Cabdi Awaare ayaa sheegay in badmaaxiintu nabad qabaan, isla markaana labada dowladood ay iska kaashanayaan dhammaystirka habraacyada dib loogu celinayo dalkooda. Waxaa la filayaa inay Qaahira ugu safraan duulimaadka ugu horreeya ee loo heli karo. Sii-daynta shaqaalahan ayaa kusoo beegantay xilli ciidamada Puntland ay kordhiyeen hawlgallada ka dhanka ah burcad-badeedda. Hase yeeshee, weli lama shaacin faahfaahinta heshiiska lagu sii daayey badmaaxiinta ama in lacag madax-furasho ah la bixiyey.

items.title: When geopolitics becomes economics
items.description: When geopolitics becomes economics From the Red Sea to the Strait of Hormuz, economic interests are driving a new contest for global influence By Dr Raza Muhammad PUBLISHED October 04, 2026 Currently, the world has 65 active conflicts, which is the highest number post WWII. Out of these nine are interstate and the remaining 57 are intra state. However, the most significant one that affects the whole world is the Iran-US war. Though scaled down in intensity after the Pakistan-brokered ceasefire and the Islamabad MoU, it still impacts the world economy the most. The recent unprecedented and quick sweep of Houthis capturing the southern coast of Yemen along the Red Sea has added a newer dimension to this imbroglio. To top it all, US President Trump’s denial to Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman’s requests to conduct strikes against the Houthis, and the Houthis’ assurances of not attacking the US and Israeli vessels, came as a surprise to all, but more so for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, an old US ally. Connecting these developments to Somaliland and its recognition by Israel in December 2025, and UAE’s reported intent to establish a military base there make it a complex maze of geo-strategy. Is it a complementary effort by Iran to counter the alternative oil supply route of KSA? Or is it a US-Israel tit-for-tat endeavour to pressurise KSA to join the Abraham Accords? items.title: Agaasimaha NISA oo Kormeeray Ciidamo Tababar ku Jira Balanballe
items.description: Balanballe, Galgaduud – 4 Oktoobar 2026: Agaasimaha Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA), Mudane Mahad Maxamed Salaad, ayaa maanta kormeeray xarunta ciidamada NISA ee degmada Balanballe ee gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo tababar loogu wado ciidamo ka tirsan hay’adda. Agaasime Mahad Salaad ayaa intii uu kormeerka ku guda jiray la kulmay ciidamada tababarka ku jira, isagoo kula dardaarmay inay si dhab ah uga dhabeeyaan waajibaadka iyo ballanta ay u qaadeen difaaca dalka, shacabka iyo diinta. Kormeerkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli NISA ay xoojineyso joogitaankeeda iyo kaabeyaasha amni ee gobolka Galgaduud. Bishii June ee sanadkan, Agaasimaha NISA ayaa Balanballe ka dhagax-dhigay xarun cusub oo loogu talagalay ciidamada hay’adda ee ka howlgeli doona degmada iyo deegaannada ku xeeran. Agaasimaha NISA iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa haatan ku sugan Balanballe, iyadoo degmada lagu wado inay martigeliso maalmaha soo socda munaasabado iyo kulamo waaweyn oo la xiriira dib-u-heshiisiin, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nabadda iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Booqashada Mahad Salaad ee Galmudug ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmaysa kulamo uu dhawaan la yeeshay qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saaray nabadda, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo xoojinta wada shaqeynta bulshada iyo hay’adaha dowladda.

items.title: Duqa Muqdisho oo la kulmay Safiirka Aljeeriya, casuumaad rasmi ahna ka helay Algiers
items.description: Muqdisho, 4 Oktoobar 2026: Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa kulan la yeeshay Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Aljeeriya u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Mudane Mohamed Alim. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Muqdisho iyo Algiers, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen sidii loo dhisi lahaa barnaamijyo iskaashi oo wax-ku-ool ah oo labada caasimadood ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu soo qaaday fursadaha lagu horumarin karo xirfadaha shaqaalaha, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha iyo aqoonta, iyo sidii Muqdisho ay uga faa’iideysan lahayd waayo-aragnimada Aljeeriya ee maamulka iyo horumarinta caasimadaha. Safiirka Aljeeriya ayaa Duqa Muqdisho u gudbiyay casuumaad rasmi ah oo uu ka siday Guddoomiyaha caasimadda Algiers, Mohamed Abdenour Rabhi, taas oo loogu martiqaaday Duqa Muqdisho inuu booqasho rasmi ah ku tago Aljeeriya. Duqa Muqdisho ayaa uga mahadceliyay Safiirka dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya, isagoo sidoo kale bogaadiyay doorka Aljeeriya ee taageerada horumarinta iyo bilicda caasimadda Muqdisho.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Itoobiya u yaboohay saddex deked
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay diyaar u tahay inay Itoobiya u oggolaato inay isticmaasho laba ama saddex dekedood oo Soomaaliyeed, si ay uga dhoofiso ugana soo dejiso badeecadaha. Xasan Sheekh ayaa arrintan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey Al Jazeera, maalmo kaddib markii uu magaalada Addis Ababa kula kulmay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Axmed. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan kasoo horjeedin in Itoobiya, oo aan bad lahayn, ay hesho marin ganacsi oo ay ku gaarto badda, balse arrintaas ay tahay inay ku timaaddo heshiis ay labada dowladood wada galaan. “Waxaan diyaar u nahay inaan Itoobiya u oggolaanno inay isticmaasho laba ama saddex dekedood oo Soomaaliyeed si ay wax uga soo dejiso ugana dhoofiso,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Waxa uu sheegay in heshiisyo dhaqaale lagu nidaamin karo canshuuraha, khidmadaha iyo arrimaha kale ee la xiriira isticmaalka dekedaha. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Itoobiya ay Soomaaliya u sheegtay inay u baahan tahay marin-badeed, balse aysan weli soo gudbin codsi rasmi ah oo qeexaya nooca marin ama heshiis ay dooneyso. Hadalka madaxweynaha ayaa yimid afar maalmood kaddib markii uu 29-kii September safar shaqo ku tegay Addis Ababa, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay Abiy Axmed. Safarkaas ayaa ku yimid codsi ka yimid Abiy, waxaana labada hoggaamiye ay ka wada hadleen xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Geeska Afrika. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya midkoodna kulankaas kaddib ma shaacin heshiis cusub oo laga gaaray arrinta marin-badeedka. Heshiiskii Ankara Hadalka Xasan Sheekh ayaa ah mid ka mid ah tilmaamaha ugu cadcad ee ilaa hadda laga helay waxa Muqdisho ay diyaar u tahay inay Itoobiya ka siiso arrinta badda. Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa bishii December 2024 magaalada Ankara ku gaaray heshiis ay Turkigu dhexdhexaadiyeen, kaas oo lagu dejiyey qaab ay labada dal uga wada xaajoon karaan marin-badeed ay Itoobiya hesho, iyadoo la ilaalinayo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Heshiiskaas ayaa dhigaya in Itoobiya ay heli karto marin ganacsi oo “ammaan ah, joogto ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo”, iyada oo loo marayo heshiisyo ay labada dal wada galaan, sida kireysi ama habab kale oo ganacsi. Labada dowladood ayaa bishii February 2025 Ankara ka bilaabay wada-hadallo farsamo oo lagu hirgelinayo heshiiskaas, balse ilaa hadda lama shaacin heshiis kama dambeys ah oo ku saabsan deked ay Itoobiya isticmaali doonto. Khilaafka labada dal ayaa markii hore ka dhashay heshiiskii Itoobiya ay bishii January 2024 la gashay Somaliland, oo ah gobol ka tirsan Soomaaliya. Heshiiskaas ayaa Itoobiya siin lahaa marin badeed, halka Somaliland ay sheegtay inuu ku xirnaa suurta-galnimada in Addis Ababa ay aqoonsato madax-bannaanideeda ay sheegato. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa heshiiskaas si adag u diiday, iyadoo ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. Heshiiskii Ankara ayaa markii dambe wadahadallada ku soo celiyey hannaan ay Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa si toos ah uga wada xaajoonayaan marin-badeedka. Maxay Itoobiya dhab ahaan rabtaa? Qodobka weli aan caddayn ayaa ah in marin ganacsi oo ay Soomaaliya bixiso uu dabooli karo waxa Itoobiya dhab ahaan ka dooneyso Badda Cas. Mas’uuliyiin Itoobiyaan ah ayaa bilihii dambe sii kordhiyey isticmaalka erayga “sovereign access” marka ay ka hadlayaan baahida dalkooda ee marin-badeedka, hadal ka ballaaran marin ganacsi oo keliya. Bishii September, mas’uuliyiin Itoobiyaan ah ayaa mar kale ku celceliyey in helitaanka marin ay Itoobiya si gaar ah u maamusho uu muhiim u yahay mustaqbalka dhaqaale iyo amni ee dalka. Dhanka kale, madaxda Itoobiya waxay sidoo kale sheegeen inay doonayaan inay arrintaas ku raadiyaan wada-hadal iyo hannaan diblomaasiyadeed. Heshiiska Ankara wuxuu Itoobiya siinayaa waddo ay ku heli karto marin-badeed, balse wuxuu si cad u dhigaya in heshiis kasta uu hoos imaanayo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, farqi ayaa weli u muuqda inuu u dhexeeyo waxa Muqdisho diyaar u tahay inay bixiso — oo ah marin ganacsi oo dekedaha Soomaaliyeed ah — iyo hadallada qaarkood ee kasoo baxaya Addis Ababa ee ku saabsan “sovereign access”. Xasan Sheekh ma uusan magacaabin dekedaha labada ama saddexda ah ee Soomaaliya ay Itoobiya u furi karto, mana uusan bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan muddada heshiiska, waddooyinka isku xiri kara Itoobiya iyo dekedahaas ama qaabka loo maamuli lahaa. Waxa uu sidoo kale caddeeyey in Itoobiya aysan weli soo gudbin codsi rasmi ah oo lagu ogaan karo waxa ay si dhab ah uga dooneyso Soomaaliya. Taasi waxay ka dhigan tahay in inkastoo Muqdisho ay hadda si cad miiska u saartay fursad ay Itoobiya ku isticmaali karto dhowr dekedood oo Soomaaliyeed, haddana faahfaahinta iyo baaxadda dalabka Addis Ababa ay weli yihiin kuwo aan si rasmi ah loo qeexin. Heshiiska Ankara wuxuu Itoobiya siinayaa waddo ay ku heli karto marin-badeed, balse wuxuu si cad u dhigaya in heshiis kasta uu hoos imaanayo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, farqi ayaa weli u muuqda inuu u dhexeeyo waxa Muqdisho diyaar u tahay inay bixiso — oo ah marin ganacsi oo dekedaha Soomaaliyeed ah — iyo hadallada qaarkood ee kasoo baxaya Addis Ababa ee ku saabsan “sovereign access”. Xasan Sheekh ma uusan magacaabin dekedaha labada ama saddexda ah ee Soomaaliya ay Itoobiya u furi karto, mana uusan bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan muddada heshiiska, waddooyinka isku xiri kara Itoobiya iyo dekedahaas ama qaabka loo maamuli lahaa. Waxa uu sidoo kale caddeeyey in Itoobiya aysan weli soo gudbin codsi rasmi ah oo lagu ogaan karo waxa ay si dhab ah uga dooneyso Soomaaliya. Taasi waxay ka dhigan tahay in inkastoo Muqdisho ay hadda si cad miiska u saartay fursad ay Itoobiya ku isticmaali karto dhowr dekedood oo Soomaaliyeed, haddana faahfaahinta iyo baaxadda dalabka Addis Ababa ay weli yihiin kuwo aan si rasmi ah loo qeexin. items.title: Cutubyo kale oo Ciidamada Militariga oo la geeyay Baydhabo
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sare u qaadday taageeradeeda militari ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, ka dib dagaalkii qaraaraa ee Isniintii ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isla-markaana u badan Kumaandooska Gorgor iyo gaadiid dagaal ayaa dhowrkii maalmood ee u dambeeyay laga dejiyay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud ee magaaladaasi. Ciidamadan oo laga daabulay Caasimadda Muqdisho ayaa loogu talagalay inay xoojin u noqdaan Militariga Somaliya iyo Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed ee horey ugu sugnaa bannaanada magaaladaasi. Saraakiisha Taliska Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa kuu sheegaya in durbaba ciidamada laga keenay Muqdisho la geeyay difaacyada ay ciidamada isku dhafan ku leeyihiin nawaaxiga magaalada. Tallaabada ciidamadan loogu qaaday Baydhabo ayaa muujineysa diyaargarow iyo xaalad dagaal oo aad u sarreysa, ka dib markii ay kordheen weerarada ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ay ka gaysanayaan magaalada ugu weyn ee Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Weeraradan ayaa abuuray walaac dhanka amniga iyo dib-u-dhac siyaasadeed, marka aad eegto in ay curyaaminayaan shaqada maamulka iyo dhismaha dowladnimada. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa taageero buuxda la garab taagan Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu hoggaamiyo, si loo sugo amniga, loona difaaco Magaalada Baydhabo. Loolanka awoodeed ee u dhexeeya maamulka cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed iyo hoggaankii hore ayaa horseeday deganaansho la’aan siyaasadeed iyo xasillooni daro amni, taasna waxay carqaladeynaysaa qorshaha siyaasadeed ee Villa Somalia ku maamuleyso dalka. Isku dhacyada hubeysan ee ku soo badanaya Baydhabo ayaa dhaliyay hubanti la’aan iyo cabsi xoog leh oo soo food saartay dadka deegaanka, taas oo khasab ka dhigeysa in Dowladda Federaalka ay wax ka qabato. Weerarkii ugu dambeeyay ee ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ay ka gaysteen Baydhabo ayaa u muuqday ka hortag weerar, xilli uu socday qorshe ay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed isugu diyaarinayeen hawlgal ciidamadaasi iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab looga sifeynayo deegaanada hoostaga magaaladaasi.

items.title: Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan and Somalia forge unified front on Red Sea governance and state sovereignty
items.description: The leaders of Egypt, Somalia, Sudan, and Eritrea have issued the Alamein Joint Declaration, establishing a unified four-nation front to assert exclusive sovereignty over Red Sea governance, defend the territorial integrity of member states, and categorically reject any unilateral measures affecting the Nile River. Meeting in New Alamein City on October 4, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi, Eritrean President Isaias Afwerki, Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, and Sudanese Transitional Sovereignty Council Chairman General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan agreed to establish a periodic joint mechanism to coordinate regional security. The quadripartite summit outlined a cohesive stance on Horn of Africa flashpoints, emphasising that Red Sea governance remains the exclusive responsibility of littoral states, whilst underscoring the necessity of ensuring the freedom and safety of international navigation in the Gulf of Aden and the Bab-el-Mandeb strait. Regarding transboundary rivers, particularly the Nile, the declaration emphasised the necessity of adhering to international law and the principle of no harm. The summit mandated cooperation through prior notification, consultation, and consensus, stating a complete rejection of any unilateral measures that harm the existing water uses of the Nile’s downstream states. Addressing the situation in Somalia, the declaration affirmed absolute support for the federal republic’s unity and explicitly rejected any interference targeting its sovereignty. The leaders stated they refuse any recognition or support for the so-called Somaliland, deeming it a direct violation of Somalia’s territorial integrity. They backed Mogadishu’s counter-terrorism efforts and called on international partners to provide sufficient, predictable, and sustainable funding for the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) to facilitate the orderly transfer of security responsibilities to Somali forces. On Sudan, the four nations pledged support for the country’s unity, sovereignty, and national institutions, whilst rejecting the establishment of any parallel entities and expressing total refusal of any support for mercenaries. The leaders encouraged the resumption of a Sudanese-owned and Sudanese-led political process. Egyptian Presidency Spokesperson Ambassador Mohamed El-Shenawy stated that al-Sisi outlined Egypt’s efforts to achieve ceasefires and comprehensive political settlements. Al-Sisi warned against foreign interventions that prolong conflicts and exacerbate human suffering, stressing that attempts to undermine state unity are explicit violations of international law, the United Nations Charter, and the Constitutive Act of the African Union. He reaffirmed Egypt’s continued support for national institutions in confronting security challenges, notably terrorism. The leaders also discussed ongoing economic and development cooperation projects, exploring ways to enhance regional integration in infrastructure, energy, and trade. The summit concluded with the visiting presidents expressing their appreciation for Egypt’s role in supporting continental stability and its policy based on African solidarity, dialogue, and the peaceful settlement of disputes. Dailynewsegypt .

items.title: Maxay tahay digniinta laga soo saaray Hargeysa?
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka magaalada Hargeysa ee caasimadda Somaliland ayaa digniin u diray shacabka, isagoo ugu baaqay inay ka feejignaadaan khatarta daadadka laga cabsi qabo inay ka dhashaan roobabka la saadaaliyay. Maamulka ayaa dadka uga digay inay qaadaan tallaabooyin taxaddar ah si looga hortago khatar nafeed iyo mid maaliyadeed oo ka dhalan karta roobabka iyo daadadka la filayo. Sida digniinta lagu sheegay, roobabka la saadaaliyay ayaa laga yaabaa inay ka bataan heerarkii caadiga ahaa ama ay da’aan saacado badan, taas oo kordhin karta suuragalnimada fatahaado iyo biyo badan oo magaalada kusoo rogmada. Daadadka ayaa sidoo kale sababi kara in waddooyin muhiim ah ay xirmaan, halka goobaha loogu talagalay inay biyaha qaadaan ay buuxsami karaan, taas oo keeni karta in biyuhu ku fatahaan meelaha ay dadku deggan yihiin. Waxaa kale oo laga digay khatarta ka dhalan karta dhismayaasha qadiimiga ah ama kuwa loo yaqaan qabyada ee dhameystirneen, kuwaas oo ay suuragal tahay inay dumaan haddii ay helaan roobab culus oo daba dheeraada. Maamulka Somaliland ayaa sidoo kale shacabka ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan meelaha ay ka jirto khatarta korontada, gaar ahaan goobaha ay biyuhu gaari karaan ama ay fiilooyinka korontadu soo gaari karaan. Dadka ayaa sidoo kale lagu wargeliyay inay ka fogaadaan meelaha biyaha laga gudbo ama la isaga kala tallaabo, maadaama qulqulka biyaha iyo daadadka xooggan ay keeni karaan khatar culus. Maamulka ayaa ugu dambeyn shacabka ugu baaqay inay si gaar ah uga feejignaadaan xaaladaha roobabka inta ay socdaan, isla markaana ay raacaan digniinaha iyo tilmaamaha laamaha ay khuseyso si loo yareeyo khasaaraha ka dhalan kara daadadka. items.title: Somaliland oo war cusub ka soo saartay damaca Itoobiya ee badda iyo heshiiskii MoU
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Somaliland ayaa sheegay inuu taageersan yahay in Itoobiya ay hesho marin badeed, xilli uu hore u fashilmay heshiiskii maamulka uu Itoobiya ugu ogolaanayay badda. Mowqifkan ayaa lagu sheegay bayaan ay 3-dii October 2026 soo saartay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Somaliland, taas oo sheegtay inay si joogto ah u taageertay heshiisyo lagu siinayo Itoobiya marin ay ka hesho badda. “Dowladda Somaliland waxay si joogto ah u taageertay heshiisyo gorgortan lagu gaaro oo u oggolaanaya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Itoobiya inay hesho marin badeed iyada oo loo marayo iskaashi labada dhinacba faa’iido u leh,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Somaliland. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in mowqifka Soomaaliya uu ka hor imanayo hadallada Muqdisho ee ku aaddan arrintan, iyadoo si gaar ah u xustay ololaha dowladda Soomaaliya ee ka dhanka ah is-afgaradkii Somaliland iyo Itoobiya ee la saxiixay 2024. Dhanka kale, Somaliland waxay sheegtay inay diiddan tahay faragelin lagu sameeyo heshiisyada ay la gasho dhinacyada kale, iyadoo ku adkaysatay inay sii wadi doonto heshiisyo ay ku sheegtay inay ilaalinayaan madax-bannaanida isla markaana gacan ka geysanaya horumarinta iyo barwaaqada gobolka. Is-afgaradkii ay Somaliland iyo Itoobiya kala saxiixdeen January 2024 ayaa salka ku hayay sidii Itoobiya loogu fududeyn lahaa helitaanka marin badeed. Arrintaasi waxay dhalisay khilaaf diblomaasiyadeed oo xooggan oo u dhexeeyay Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa xilligaas si adag uga hortimid is-afgaradka, iyadoo ku tilmaantay mid xadgudub ku ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, maadaama Somaliland ay Soomaaliya u aqoonsan tahay inay qayb ka tahay dhulkeeda. Hadalkan Somaliland ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan mabda’ ahaan diiddanayn in Itoobiya ay hesho marin badeed, balse uu xusay in arrintaasi ay ku imaan karto heshiis wadajir ah oo Itoobiya loogu oggolaanayo inay isticmaasho dekedaha Soomaaliya. Labada mowqif ayaa muujinaya kala duwanaanshaha ka taagan habka loo wajahayo doonista Itoobiya ee helitaanka marin badeed, iyadoo maamulka Somaliland uu ku adkaysanayo heshiisyo toos ah, halka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay sheegtay in isticmaalka dekedaha dalka lagu heshiin karo qaab wadajir ah. items.title: Gaza’s Medical Crisis Deepens as WHO Warns Aid Is Trapped in Delays
items.description: WHO Says None of Gaza’s Hospitals Is Fully Functional as Critical Medical Supplies Wait Weeks for Israeli Clearance GENEVA (WDN) — Gaza’s humanitarian crisis is deepening as critical medical supplies face prolonged delays before entering the territory, with the World Health Organization warning that patients are paying the price for a system it describes as slow, unpredictable and increasingly difficult to navigate. Reinhilde Van de Weerdt, the WHO’s representative in the Palestinian territories, said Gaza’s health system remains “utterly dire”, with none of its hospitals currently fully functional. “Not enough humanitarian aid is entering Gaza, and definitely not enough to allow for a meaningful expansion and restoration of health services,” she told reporters in Geneva from Jerusalem. At the heart of the problem, according to the WHO, is Israel’s approval system for humanitarian and medical shipments. The WHO says large quantities of medical supplies are waiting for clearance for a median of 74 days. When shipments are rejected, the approval process must begin again, creating further delays for hospitals already struggling to provide basic care. Essential Equipment Rejected The delays are affecting equipment that hospitals depend on to diagnose and treat patients. Van de Weerdt said X-ray machines, sterilization equipment, CT-scan spare parts and other essential medical supplies are regularly rejected. In one case, a shipment containing prosthetics and assistive devices was rejected four times within six months, she said. Medicines have generally faced fewer obstacles, with almost 87 percent of shipments approved and about 1 percent rejected, according to the WHO. But the organization says medicines alone cannot restore a health system whose hospitals, diagnostic equipment and other essential infrastructure have been devastated. “It’s not one single blockage. It’s a system, layered with delay after delay,” Van de Weerdt said. Behind every delay, she added, is a patient waiting for treatment. WHO: Count of Trucks Does Not Tell the Full Story The WHO is calling for the predictable and unimpeded entry of humanitarian and medical supplies into Gaza at scale. It also wants additional crossings opened and clear, publicly available rules governing humanitarian shipments. Van de Weerdt warned that the number of trucks entering Gaza should not be used as the sole measure of humanitarian access. “A truck full of non-priority supplies, or the right supplies arriving too late, doesn’t save lives,” she said. Israel maintains that its screening procedures are necessary to prevent materials with potential military applications from reaching Hamas, which it accuses of using civilian infrastructure and supplies to support its operations. A Health System on the Edge The consequences are being felt across Gaza’s already devastated health system. Hospitals are operating under extraordinary pressure while medical equipment, spare parts and other supplies remain difficult to obtain. For patients requiring specialized treatment, a delayed shipment can mean a delayed diagnosis, interrupted treatment or the absence of essential medical equipment altogether. The war began with Hamas’s October 7, 2023 attack on Israel, which killed 1,221 people, according to an AFP tally based on official Israeli figures. Israel’s subsequent military campaign has devastated large parts of Gaza and killed more than 74,000 people, according to Gaza’s health ministry, which operates under Hamas authorities. The United Nations has generally regarded the ministry’s casualty figures as credible, although they do not distinguish between combatants and civilians. For the WHO, however, the immediate issue is not simply the number of people killed. t is whether those who remain alive can obtain the medical care they need. “On the other side of every one of these delays is a patient who is waiting,” Van de Weerdt said. And in Gaza, where an entire health system is struggling to function, the cost of waiting can be measured in lives. items.title: Somalia won’t accept Israeli presence in Somaliland ‘under any circumstances,’ president says
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia will not accept Israeli presence in the country “under any circumstances” and will resist any attempts to be pulled into the Middle East’s crises, its President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud tells Al Jazeera. Speaking in an exclusive interview, Mohamud said that Israel was planning to establish a naval base in Berbera and use the city’s airport, adding that its real aim was to get closer to the Gulf states and Iran. Berbera is a port city on the Gulf of Aden coast in Somaliland – the self-declared republic in northwestern Somalia that Israel recognised last year, but which is claimed by Mogadishu. Berbera faces Yemen across the water near the strategic Bab al-Mandeb strait. The Iran-aligned Houthis have previously enforced a blockade on Israel-linked ships in the area. “We will overcome the challenges posed to our country by Israeli moves,” Mohamud said in his wide-ranging interview. He added that the Israeli plans fall under the “Greater Israel” project – referring to a term for various proposals, often rooted in biblical interpretations, for Israeli control over territory beyond its current borders. Some versions extend from the Nile to the Euphrates. Israel has not adopted it as official policy, but Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in an August 2025 interview that he felt connected to the vision, prompting condemnation from Arab governments. The Somali president described Israel as a “destabilising force” that does not abide by international law. He also criticised Tel Aviv’s recognition of Somaliland in December. No country other than Israel recognises Somaliland, while the region’s own residents are completely opposed to an Israeli presence, Mohamud said. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 and has governed itself independently for more than three decades. But it had not secured recognition from any United Nations member state until Israel’s move. Fight against armed groups The Somali president told Al Jazeera the United States remains his country’s strongest partner in the fight against “terrorism”, and added that al-Shabab has no presence in the major cities, leaving no possibility of the group taking control in Somalia. Al-Shabab is a Somali armed group that emerged from the Islamic Courts Union in the mid-2000s and pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012. It has fought Somalia’s federal government for years, holds territory in parts of southern and central Somalia, and has carried out deadly attacks, including in Mogadishu and in neighbouring Kenya. Regarding the East Africa region, Mohamud said Somalia’s relations with neighbouring Ethiopia are good, and Mogadishu does not object to Addis Ababa gaining access to the sea through a joint agreement to use Somali ports for its economic interests. Ethiopia has been landlocked since Eritrea became independent in 1993 and relies largely on Djibouti’s ports for trade. In January 2024, Addis Ababa signed a memorandum of understanding with Somaliland on sea access, which Somalia condemned as a violation of its sovereignty. Somalia and Ethiopia later agreed to ease tensions. Houthis ‘destabilising’ region Mohamud also accused Yemen’s Houthis of “destabilising the region” and disrupting navigation in the Bab al-Mandeb strait. His comments come as the group attempts to build on its lightning offensive that captured the country’s Red Sea coast last month. Thus far, Yemeni government forces have been able to hold their positions on the front lines and even claimed to have inflicted heavy losses against the Houthis. The Houthis have also intensified their attacks on Saudi Arabia, but the kingdom’s Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (MBS) has promised not to compromise on its security, saying the Yemeni rebels chose “chaos and destruction, threatening the Yemeni people and the region”.

items.title: Crude Oil Tanker Hit by Projectile Off Oman as Hormuz Shipping Risks Mount
items.description: Latest Attack Raises Fresh Alarm for Global Energy Shipping as Vessel Is Struck Near One of the World’s Most Critical Oil Routes MUSCAT (WDN) — A crude oil tanker was struck by an unknown projectile off Oman on Friday, triggering another maritime security alert in waters surrounding the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. The vessel’s master reported that the tanker was hit on its port side about four nautical miles east of Oman, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO). All crew members were reported safe, and no environmental impact had been reported at the time of the alert. Authorities have not identified the projectile or determined who was responsible for the attack. UKMTO advised vessels operating in the area to exercise caution and report suspicious activity as investigations continue. Another Blow to Commercial Shipping The incident comes amid a series of attacks and reported projectile strikes against commercial tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz. On September 29, three Liberian-flagged oil tankers were reportedly struck by unidentified projectiles while navigating the waterway, according to maritime intelligence firm Marisks. The origin of those projectiles has not been established. Another tanker was reported struck in the Strait on October 1, with the incident reportedly causing a fire and prompting the evacuation of its crew. The growing number of incidents is placing renewed pressure on one of the world’s most important energy corridors. Why Hormuz Matters The Strait of Hormuz is a narrow maritime passage connecting the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the wider Arabian Sea. It is a critical route for international energy shipments, making any sustained disruption potentially significant for global oil markets and commercial shipping. For tanker operators, the latest incidents add another layer of risk to navigation through the waterway, where vessels must already contend with heightened regional military tensions. The latest strike is particularly significant because it occurred only a few nautical miles from the Omani coast. The immediate outcome was less severe than some recent tanker incidents: no crew casualties or environmental damage were reported. But the unanswered questions are increasingly serious. Who launched the projectile? Was the tanker deliberately targeted? Was the incident connected to the wider regional conflict? And can commercial vessels continue to transit the waterway without facing unacceptable risks? None of those questions has yet been answered. For the shipping industry, however, the message is already clear: the security environment around Hormuz remains highly volatile. Every new strike risks increasing insurance costs, disrupting shipping schedules and encouraging operators to reconsider routes through one of the world’s most important energy corridors. For now, the tanker and its crew have survived the latest incident without reported casualties or an oil spill. But with multiple vessels already coming under attack, the wider danger to commercial shipping is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore. items.title: Puntland oo shaqo joojin ku sameysay taliye sare kadib dhacdadii…
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Puntland ayaa shaqo joojin ku sameeyay Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Mudug, Maxamuud Muuse Bile (Fardafuul) kadib dhacdadii baxsashada maxaabiista burcad-badeedda. Taliyaha ayaa ku-meel-gaar ahaan lagu beddelay ku-xigeenkiisa, Ayuub Siciid Cali Dheeg, kaas oo hadda sii haya xilka Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Mudug. Go’aanka shaqo joojinta taliyaha ayaa daba socda dhacdadii ay ku baxsadeen maxaabiis burcad-badeed ah oo uu kasoo qaaday deegaanka Garacad, kuwaas oo lagu soo qabtay markabkii SIBU 1. Dhacdada baxsashada ayaa dhacday 26-kii September, waxaana xilligaas goobta ka dhacay iska horimaad sababay dhimashada mid kamid ah maxaabiista burcad-badeedda, halka mid kalena uu ku dhaawacmay. Maxaabiista ayaa lasoo qabtay kadib markii howlgal lagula wareegay markabka SIBU 1, kaas oo kamid ahaa maraakiib ay burcad-badeeddu afduubteen. Tallaabadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli Puntland ay weli gacanta ku hayso maxaabiis kale oo burcad-badeed ah oo lagu qabtay howlgallo ka dhan ahaa kooxaha afduubka maraakiibta. Tirada maxaabiista ay Puntland hadda gacanta ku hayso ayaa gaaraysa ku dhowaad 30 qof, kuwaas oo laga soo qabtay maraakiibtii Honour 25 iyo SIBU 1 ee lagu afduubtay xeebaha maamulka. Baxsashada maxaabiista ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca habka loo sugayo amniga iyo ilaalinta burcad-badeedda lagu qabto howlgallada badda, iyadoo shaqo joojinta taliyaha booliska Mudug ay qayb ka tahay tallaabada laga qaaday dhacdadaas. items.title: Siisi oo soo faro-geliyey khilaafka siyaasadda Somalia
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ayaa markii ugu horreysay ka hadlay khilaafa siyaaasadda Soomaaliya, isaga oo ku baaqay in la xoojiyo heshiiska iyo is-afgaradka qaran ee u dhexeeya dhinacyada kala duwan ee dalka isku haya, isaga oo sheegay in arrintaasi muhiim u tahay midnimada iyo xasilloonida dalka. Sisi ayaa hadalkan jeediyey Sabtidii intii uu kulan la lahaa madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo ka dhacay magaalada cusub ee Al-Calamayn, sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay madaxtooyada Masar. Madaxtooyada Masar ayaa sheegtay in labada madaxweyne ay ka wada hadleen xaaladaha gudaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo Sisi uu carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo “is-afgaradka qaran” ee u dhexeeya dhinacyada iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee Soomaalida. Sisi ayaa sheegay in is-afgaradkaasi uu gacan ka geysan karo ilaalinta midnimada dowladda, xasilloonida dalka iyo sidii Soomaaliya isaga difaaci lahayd caqabadaha dhinaca amniga. Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay in labada madaxweyne ay ka wada hadleen xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Masar, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, maalgashiga iyo horumarinta iskaashiga labada dal. Taageerada Soomaaliya Madaxweynaha Masar ayaa sidoo kale ku celiyey mowqifka Qaahira ee taageerada madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Waxa uu sheegay in Masar ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, oo ay ku jiraan dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga iyo horumarinta, si loo xoojiyo awoodda hay’adaha dowladda iyo xasilloonida dalka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhankiisa uga mahadceliyey Masar taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, isaga oo ammaanay xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee labada dal iyo wada-shaqeynta sii ballaaraneysa. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Masar ayaa sare loo qaaday Janaayo 2025, markaas oo labada dal ay ku dhawaaqeen iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo ballaaran, kaas oo ay qeyb ka yihiin siyaasadda, amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo maalgashiga. Amniga gobolka Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay xaaladaha amni ee gobolka, gaar ahaan Geeska Afrika, Gacanka Cadmeed, marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo Badda Cas. Madaxtooyada Masar ayaa sheegtay in Xasan Sheekh iyo Sisi ay isku raaceen muhiimadda ay leedahay in Masar, Soomaaliya iyo dalalka gobolka ay sii wadaan wada-tashiga iyo isku-duwidda arrimaha la xiriira amniga iyo xasilloonida goobahaas. Masar ayaa sanadihii dambe kordhisay xiriirka siyaasadeed iyo kan amni ee ay la leedahay Soomaaliya, iyadoo marar badan ku celisay taageerada ay u hayso midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalka. Kulanka Sabtida ayaa dhacay xilli Xasan Sheekh uu ka qeyb-galayo shirar ka socda Al-Calamayn, halka Axadda la filayo inuu ka qeyb-galo kulan afar geesood ah oo ay yeeshaan madaxda Soomaaliya, Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan, kaas oo diiradda lagu saari doono arrimaha gobolka. Sisi ayaa hadalkan jeediyey Sabtidii intii uu kulan la lahaa madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo ka dhacay magaalada cusub ee Al-Calamayn, sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay madaxtooyada Masar. Madaxtooyada Masar ayaa sheegtay in labada madaxweyne ay ka wada hadleen xaaladaha gudaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo Sisi uu carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo “is-afgaradka qaran” ee u dhexeeya dhinacyada iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee Soomaalida. Sisi ayaa sheegay in is-afgaradkaasi uu gacan ka geysan karo ilaalinta midnimada dowladda, xasilloonida dalka iyo sidii Soomaaliya isaga difaaci lahayd caqabadaha dhinaca amniga. Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay in labada madaxweyne ay ka wada hadleen xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Masar, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, maalgashiga iyo horumarinta iskaashiga labada dal. Taageerada Soomaaliya Madaxweynaha Masar ayaa sidoo kale ku celiyey mowqifka Qaahira ee taageerada madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Waxa uu sheegay in Masar ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, oo ay ku jiraan dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga iyo horumarinta, si loo xoojiyo awoodda hay’adaha dowladda iyo xasilloonida dalka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhankiisa uga mahadceliyey Masar taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, isaga oo ammaanay xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee labada dal iyo wada-shaqeynta sii ballaaraneysa. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Masar ayaa sare loo qaaday Janaayo 2025, markaas oo labada dal ay ku dhawaaqeen iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo ballaaran, kaas oo ay qeyb ka yihiin siyaasadda, amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo maalgashiga. Amniga gobolka Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay xaaladaha amni ee gobolka, gaar ahaan Geeska Afrika, Gacanka Cadmeed, marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo Badda Cas. Madaxtooyada Masar ayaa sheegtay in Xasan Sheekh iyo Sisi ay isku raaceen muhiimadda ay leedahay in Masar, Soomaaliya iyo dalalka gobolka ay sii wadaan wada-tashiga iyo isku-duwidda arrimaha la xiriira amniga iyo xasilloonida goobahaas. Masar ayaa sanadihii dambe kordhisay xiriirka siyaasadeed iyo kan amni ee ay la leedahay Soomaaliya, iyadoo marar badan ku celisay taageerada ay u hayso midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalka. Kulanka Sabtida ayaa dhacay xilli Xasan Sheekh uu ka qeyb-galayo shirar ka socda Al-Calamayn, halka Axadda la filayo inuu ka qeyb-galo kulan afar geesood ah oo ay yeeshaan madaxda Soomaaliya, Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan, kaas oo diiradda lagu saari doono arrimaha gobolka. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo maanta ka qaybgalaya shir-madaxeed afar-geesood ah oo ka dhacaya Masar
items.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta magaalada New Alamein ee dalka Masar kaga qaybgalaya shir-madaxeed wadatashi ah oo ay isugu imanayaan hoggaamiyeyaasha Masar, Soomaaliya, Eritrea iyo Suudaan. Shirka ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalaya Madaxweynaha Masar Cabdifataax Al-Sisi, Madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Guddoomiyaha Golaha Madaxbannaanida Sudan, Cabdifataax Al-Burhan. Sida ay sheegtay Madaxtooyada Masar, kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa wadatashi iyo isku-dubbaridka mowqifyada ku saabsan arrimaha gobolka ee ay dalalku danaha wadaagaan. Kulanka ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee Geeska Afrika. Xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa si weyn u xumaaday, iyadoo Addis Ababa ay dhawaan jartay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Asmara, halka sidoo kale ay is-weydaarsadeen tallaabooyin diblomaasiyadeed Masar iyo Itoobiya. Xiisadaha ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli dagaallo ay dib uga soo cusboonaadeen waqooyiga Itoobiya. Soomaaliya ayaa ka qaybgalaysa shirka xilli ay xoojinayso xiriirka siyaasadeed iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee ay la leedahay Masar. Madaxweynaha Xasan Sheekh iyo Madaxweyne Al-Sisi ayaa Sabtidii magaalada New Alamein kulan gaar ah yeeshay, iyadoo dhinaca Masar uu mar kale xaqiijiyay taageerada uu u hayo madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee shirkan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmaya iyadoo Itoobiya ay weli door ku leedahay amniga Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dadaallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, halka Muqdisho ay dhankeeda sii xoojinayso xiriirrada ay la leedahay dalalka gobolka iyo kuwa kale ee caalamiga ah. Shirka New Alamein ayaa dhacaya iyadoo Masar ay martigelinayso kulamo iyo shirar heer sare ah oo Afrikaan ah, waxaana sidoo kale maanta magaalada lagu qabanayaa shirkii 8-aad ee Isku-dubbaridka Midowga Afrika ee bartamaha sanadka. Kulanka afarta-geesoodka ah ayaa la filayaa inuu fursad u noqdo hoggaamiyeyaasha Masar, Soomaaliya, Eritrea iyo Sudan inay ka wada hadlaan xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee Geeska Afrika iyo arrimaha kale ee gobolka ee ay danaha wadaagaan.

items.title: Talyaaniga oo Sheegay in Maraakiibta Midowga Yurub aysan  ku filnayn Sugidda Amniga Badda Cas
items.description: Wasiirka Difaaca Talyaaniga, Guido Crosetto, ayaa sheegay in tirada maraakiibta dagaalka ee waddamada Midowga Yurub ay ku biiriyeen Hawlgalka Aspides aysan weli ku filnayn sugidda amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee isticmaala Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab . Crosetto ayaa hadalkan sheegay kaddib kulan uu magaalada Rome kula yeeshay Madaxa Siyaasadda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Midowga Yurub, Kaja Kallas. Wuxuu soo dhaweeyay go’aanka ay qaar ka mid ah dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Yurub ku kordhinayaan taageerada Hawlgalka Aspides, balse wuxuu xusay in awoodda hadda jirta aysan weli dammaanad qaadi karin in maraakiibta ganacsiga ay si buuxda oo ammaan ah ugu kala gooshaan gobolka. Sida ay sheegeen ilo diblomaasiyadeed, Hawlgalka Aspides ayaa hadda haysta lix markab dagaal, waxaana Kaja Kallas ay horay u tilmaantay in hawlgalku u baahan yahay in ka badan toban markab si uu si wax-ku-ool ah u guto waajibaadkiisa, gaar ahaan marka la eego baaxadda Badda Cas iyo khataraha ka jira marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Talyaaniga ayaa dhankiisa sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu maraakiib dheeraad ah geeyo gobolka haddii ay dib u dhacaan go’aannada wadajirka ah ee Midowga Yurub. Dowladda Rome ayaa ka digtay in amni-darrada iyo hakadka ku yimaada isu-socodka maraakiibta ay kordhin karaan kharashaadka gaadiidka, dib u dhigi karaan gaarsiinta badeecadaha, isla markaana sare u qaadi karaan qiimaha ay bixiyaan ganacsatada iyo qoysasku. Hawlgalka Aspides waxaa Midowga Yurub bilaabay sannadkii 2024, ujeeddaduna waxay ahayd in maraakiibta ganacsiga laga ilaaliyo weerarrada ka dhaca Badda Cas, gaar ahaan kuwa lala xiriiriyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Xiisadaha ka jira xeebaha Badda Cas iyo khataraha ku dhow Bab al-Mandab ayaa sii adkeeyay amniga mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee isku xira Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Hawlgalka Aspides wuxuu ka duwan yahay Hawlgalka Atalanta ee Midowga Yurub, kaas oo diiradda saaraya la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo ilaalinta amniga badda ee Soomaaliya, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo qaybo ka mid ah Badweynta Hindiya. Inkastoo labada hawlgal ay iska kaashan karaan dhinacyada amniga badda iyo xog-wadaagga, haddana waxay leeyihiin waajibaadyo iyo aagag hawlgal oo kala duwan. Kordhinta awoodda ciidamada badda ee Midowga Yurub ayaa sidaas darteed saameyn ku yeelan karta habka loo wajahayo khataraha amni ee ka jira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Gobolka ayaa weli wajahaya caqabado dhinaca amniga badda ah, iyadoo ay socdaan dadaallo lagu ilaalinayo maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah.

items.title: Iran oo ka jawaabtay goodinta Trump ee tallaabada militari iyo cuna-qabateynta
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Iiraan ayaa si adag uga jawaabtay goodinta maamulka Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ee ku saabsan suuragalnimada in tallaabo militari laga qaado Tehran iyo in la kordhiyo cuna-qabateynta dhaqaale ee saaran dalkaasi. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan, Abbas Araghchi ayaa sheegay in cadaadis dheeraad ah iyo tallaabo militari aan marnaba looga guuleysan karin Tehran, isagoo muujiyay muhiimadda in waddada wada-xaajoodka la furo. Araghchi ayaa sheegay in Mareykanku uu horey ugu guuldarraystay siyaasadaha cadaadiska iyo tallaabooyinka militari ee uu qaaday, isagoo tilmaamay in ku celcelinta habkaasi aysan keeni doonin xal waara. “Tallaab militari iyo cuna-qabateyn lagu kordhiyo Iiraan xalka rasmiga ah ma ahan, Mareykanka horay ayuu ugu guuldarraystay arrintaan iyo dagaalka tooska ah,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan, Abbas Araghchi. Tehran ayaa dhinacyada ku howlan dadaallada dhex-dhexaadinta hor dhigtay shuruudo ay sheegtay inay muhiim u yihiin in la abuuro jawi u sahla wada-xaajood iyo xal diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu soo afjaro xiisadda. Mid ka mid ah qodobada ay Iiraan dalbanayso ayaa ah in laga qaado xayiraadaha uu Mareykanku saaray dekedaha dalka, iyadoo sidoo kale doonaysa in loo fasaxo dhaqaalaha ay Washington ka xayirtay. Dowladda Iiraan waxay sidoo kale dalbanaysaa in Mareykanku uu shuruud la’aan ku joojiyo dagaalka uu kula jiro dalkaasi, iyadoo arrimahaasi ay ku tilmaantay kuwo muhiim u ah in wada-hadal dhab ah uu dhex maro labada dhinac. Hadalka Araghchi ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiisadda u dhexeysa Iiraan iyo Mareykanka ay weli taagan tahay, iyadoo Washington ay cadaadis dhaqaale saareyso Tehran, halka dowladda Iiraan ay ku adkaysanayso in xal kasta lagu raadiyo wada-hadal iyo in laga qaado cuna-qabateynaha saaran. items.title: The Government of the Republic of Somaliland Rejects the Somalian President’s Misleading Claims
items.description: Republic of Somaliland Ministry of Foreign Affairs & International Cooperation     The Government of the Republic of Somaliland Rejects the Somalian President’s Misleading Claims The Government of the Republic of Somaliland Rejects the Somalian President’s Misleading Claims Hargeisa, Republic of Somaliland | 3 October 2026 The Government of the Republic of Somaliland firmly rejects the misleading claims made by the Somalian president in his recent interview with Al Jazeera. Somaliland and Somalia are two separate sovereign states with fundamentally different governance realities. The Somalian Government has no authority to determine Somaliland’s foreign relations or speak on behalf of its people. The Republic of Somaliland attained independence on 26 June 1960, before Somalia attained independence on 1 July 1960. Somaliland’s sovereignty rests on the continuity of that independent state within its inherited borders, consistent with the principle of uti possidetis juris (respect for boundaries inherited at independence). The restoration of its sovereignty on 18 May 1991 reaffirmed this enduring statehood. For more than three decades, Somaliland has built functioning institutions, held competitive elections, ensured peaceful transfers of power, and contributed to regional stability. Somalia’s continuing insecurity, political fragmentation, and institutional fragility cannot be obscured by misrepresenting Somaliland or threatening its sovereign partnerships. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland’s diplomatic relations with the State of Israel reflect the sovereign decisions of two states and advance peaceful cooperation, development, and regional stability. Claims that Berbera would serve as a platform for aggression against other countries are unfounded and misrepresent Somaliland’s commitment to peaceful relations. The Somalian president’s attempts to speak on behalf of the people of Somaliland are equally unacceptable. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland has consistently supported negotiated arrangements enabling the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia to secure access to the sea through mutually beneficial cooperation. The Somalian Government’s campaign against the 2024 Ethiopia–Somaliland Memorandum of Understanding directly contradicts its professed support for such access. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland rejects interference in its sovereign agreements and remains committed to arrangements that respect sovereignty and advance regional prosperity. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland condemns threats of force and interference in its internal affairs. It calls on the Somalian leadership to exercise restraint and address its domestic challenges responsibly. Somaliland will continue to safeguard its sovereignty, pursue peaceful diplomacy, and strengthen partnerships that promote stability across the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea. — END —

The Government of the Republic of Somaliland’s diplomatic relations with the State of Israel reflect the sovereign decisions of two states and advance peaceful cooperation, development, and regional stability. Claims that Berbera would serve as a platform for aggression against other countries are unfounded and misrepresent Somaliland’s commitment to peaceful relations. The Somalian president’s attempts to speak on behalf of the people of Somaliland are equally unacceptable. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland has consistently supported negotiated arrangements enabling the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia to secure access to the sea through mutually beneficial cooperation. The Somalian Government’s campaign against the 2024 Ethiopia–Somaliland Memorandum of Understanding directly contradicts its professed support for such access. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland rejects interference in its sovereign agreements and remains committed to arrangements that respect sovereignty and advance regional prosperity. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland condemns threats of force and interference in its internal affairs. It calls on the Somalian leadership to exercise restraint and address its domestic challenges responsibly. Somaliland will continue to safeguard its sovereignty, pursue peaceful diplomacy, and strengthen partnerships that promote stability across the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea. — END —

items.title: Hirshabelle and Galmudug: Elections or Appointments by Another Name?
items.description: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi Somalia’s latest experiments with direct elections in Hirshabelle and Galmudug are being presented by the Federal Government as a historic step toward democracy. But beneath the celebration lies a much deeper political dispute: are voters genuinely choosing their leaders, or are they being asked to validate political outcomes that have already been decided by the ruling party? The question has become particularly sharp because the Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP), led by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, has already selected its preferred candidates for the leadership of the two federal member states. In Hirshabelle, JSP nominated incumbent President Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe for another term and subsequently selected former Hiiraan governor Abdifatah Hassan Afrah as its candidate for deputy president. Afrah himself said President Hassan Sheikh played a role in his selection. In Galmudug, JSP emerged from the September 30 rerun with 67 of the 89 parliamentary seats, giving the party a commanding majority in the state legislature. Reports indicate that JSP and the Federal Government are backing Libaan Axmed Xasan (Libaan Shuluq) for the Galmudug presidency. This is where the opposition’s argument begins. The Election Is Direct But the Leadership Is Not The elections in Hirshabelle and Galmudug are technically elections for state assemblies and local councils, not direct presidential elections. But the state parliament ultimately determines who becomes president and deputy president. That distinction is crucial. If one political party controls a commanding majority of the state parliament and has already selected the candidates it wants to see occupy the executive leadership, critics argue that the presidential contest risks becoming a confirmation exercise rather than an open political competition. That concern is particularly strong in Galmudug, where JSP’s 67 seats give it more than enough parliamentary strength to determine the composition of the state leadership without requiring a broad coalition. The same concern exists in Hirshabelle, where JSP has openly backed Guudlaawe and Afrah. The ballot may therefore determine the composition of parliament, while the ruling party’s internal decisions may largely determine who occupies the presidency. That is the central political criticism surrounding the process. Opposition Says the Rules Were Never Agreed The dispute goes beyond individual candidates. Opposition groups have challenged the legitimacy of the electoral framework itself, including the composition and independence of the national electoral commission, the rules governing the elections and the constitutional amendments adopted under President Hassan Sheikh. Earlier opposition discussions with the Federal Government identified precisely these issues as central to reaching an electoral agreement: the election model, an independent and trusted electoral commission, and the constitutional framework. The opposition’s position is that an electoral system of this magnitude should emerge from broad political consensus, rather than being established unilaterally and then implemented by institutions that the opposition does not recognize. The constitutional dispute is particularly consequential. Parliament approved amendments extending presidential and parliamentary terms from four to five years. The Federal Government considers the amendments valid, while opposition groups have rejected them and disputed their application to the current leadership. The disagreement has remained one of the central unresolved issues in Somalia’s political crisis. The International Community Tried to Bridge the Gap This is also why the latest elections cannot be separated from the broader political negotiations that preceded them. For months, international partners and diplomats have sought to bring the Federal Government and opposition groups toward an agreement on the electoral roadmap. The issues were not limited to whether Somalia should have one-person-one-vote elections. They included who controls the electoral institutions, what rules govern the elections, which constitutional framework applies, and whether the major political actors accept the process. The opposition’s argument has been that an election conducted without agreement among the principal political stakeholders risks reproducing the very crisis it is supposed to resolve. The government, by contrast, has argued that Somalia cannot remain trapped indefinitely in negotiations among political elites and that citizens should be allowed to vote directly. Both arguments contain an important democratic principle.The question is whether they can coexist. Baidoa Offers a Warning The controversy is particularly sensitive because of what happened in South West State. The Federal Government’s confrontation with former South West President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen eventually developed into armed conflict after months of political disagreement. The federal intervention in Baidoa was presented by Mogadishu as necessary to restore stability and advance the electoral process. Laftagareen’s supporters, however, described it as an attempt to impose a political outcome on the state. The confrontation subsequently produced repeated fighting and a prolonged security crisis. For critics of the current electoral model, Baidoa is therefore the warning that hangs over Hirshabelle and Galmudug: when political competition is replaced by the imposition of a predetermined outcome, an election can become another source of conflict rather than a mechanism for resolving it. That comparison remains a political interpretation, not proof that the same outcome will occur in Hirshabelle or Galmudug. But the concern is understandable. Galmudug Already Exposed the System’s Weakness Galmudug itself has provided another warning. The Supreme Court annulled the July election after finding that the process had not complied with constitutional and electoral requirements and that irregularities had affected the integrity and outcome of the vote. It ordered a rerun. The rerun subsequently gave JSP 67 of 89 seats. The court’s intervention demonstrates that electoral institutions can correct a disputed process. But it also demonstrates something more uncomfortable: the first election was not sufficiently credible to survive judicial scrutiny. That should make the question of electoral legitimacy central to the next stage. The Bigger Political Objective Opposition figures have interpreted the sequence of events as part of a broader strategy by President Hassan Sheikh to consolidate political influence across South West, Hirshabelle and Galmudug through an electoral architecture that produces governments aligned with Villa Somalia. That is an opposition interpretation and has not been independently established as the government’s stated objective. What can be documented is that JSP has selected candidates in Hirshabelle and has emerged with a dominant parliamentary position in Galmudug. JSP is also the party led by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. The political consequence is therefore real regardless of how the strategy is interpreted. If the same national ruling party controls the parliamentary majorities that select the presidents of several federal member states, the traditional distinction between federal and state-level political power becomes considerably less clear. That raises an important federalism question: How much political independence can a federal member state exercise when its executive leadership depends on a parliamentary majority controlled by the same national party governing from Mogadishu? The government can point to something genuinely significant: people are voting directly. That is an important departure from Somalia’s long-standing system of clan-based indirect elections. But democracy is not simply the act of putting a ballot into a box. It also requires credible rules, trusted institutions, genuine competition, political inclusion and acceptance of the result by those who participate. That is where Somalia’s current experiment remains vulnerable. If opposition parties do not recognize the electoral commission, if major political actors reject the electoral rules, if constitutional amendments remain contested, and if the eventual state leadership appears predetermined by the dominant national party, the government may succeed in holding elections without achieving a political settlement. And that distinction could prove decisive. The Choice Facing Somalia The question facing Somalia is therefore larger than whether Hirshabelle and Galmudug have successfully conducted voting. It is whether direct elections will become a mechanism for broadening political participation or a mechanism for transferring political control from one level of government to another under the appearance of electoral competition. The difference will ultimately be measured not by the number of polling stations or ballots cast, but by whether political opponents believe they had a genuine opportunity to compete and whether citizens believe their votes — rather than decisions made within party headquarters — determined who governs them. Somalia needs elections. But it also needs elections that the losing side can accept. Without that political legitimacy, an election can produce a parliament, a president and a government — and still leave the underlying conflict unresolved. That is the lesson Somalia should take from Baidoa, and the question now hanging over Hirshabelle and Galmudug. items.title: Maamulka Soomaaliland oo Sheegay inuu Diyaar u yahay Heshiis Itoobiya Bad lagu siinayo
items.description: Maamulka Somaliland ayaa jawaab ka bixiyay hadallo uu Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyay Al Jazeera, isagoo ku saabsanaa xiriirka Soomaaliland iyo Israa’iil, magaalada Berbera iyo heshiiskii is-afgaradka Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliland ee 2024. Bayaan ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Maamulka Soomaaliland ayaa lagu sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan awood u lahayn inay go’aamiso xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliland ama ay ku hadasho magaca shacabka Somaliland, sida hadalka loo dhigey. Maamulka Soomaaliland ayaa sidoo kale bayaanka ku xusay taariikhda uu aaminsan yahay inay saldhig u tahay sheegashadiisa madaxbannaanida, isagoo sheegay in uu xornimada qaatay 26-kii Juun 1960, halka Soomaaliya ay xornimada qaadatay 1-dii Luulyo 1960, ayna dib ula soo noqoshada madaxbannaanida ku dhawaaqday 18-kii May 1991. Dhinaca xiriirka Israa’iil, Maamulka Soomaaliland wuxuu sheegay in xiriirka labada dhinac uu yahay go’aan ay qaateen labada dhinac, isla markaana uu ku salaysan yahay iskaashi diblomaasiyadeed, horumar iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Maamulka Hargeysa waxa uu sidoo kale beeniyay in magaalada Berbera loo adeegsan doono saldhig ama goob laga fuliyo weerarro ka dhan ah dalal kale. Sidoo kale, Maamulka Soomaaliland ayaa difaacay mowqifkiisa ku aaddan heshiiskii is-afgaradka ee Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliland ee 2024, isagoo sheegay inuu taageersan yahay heshiisyo Itoobiya u oggolaanaya inay hesho marin badeed oo lagu gaaro iskaashi labada dhinac faa’iido u leh. Maamulka Somaliland ayaa dhanka kale sheegay inuu diidayo faragelin lagu sameeyo heshiisyada uu la galo dhinacyada kale. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Maamulka Soomaaliland ayaa cambaareeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay hanjabaadaha xoogga iyo faragelinta lagu sameynayo arrimihiisa gudaha, isagoo sheegay inuu sii wadi doono dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga uu la leeyahay dhinacyada kala duwan ee gobolka, si loo horumariyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas.

items.title: Mekelle on the Brink as Tigrayan Fighters Retreat and Federal Forces Close In
items.description: Federal Forces Retake Mekelle Airport as TPLF Fighters and Leaders Reportedly Leave Tigray’s Capital MEKELLE (WDN) — Ethiopia’s renewed Tigray war has entered a dramatic new phase, with federal forces and their allies closing in on Mekelle after reportedly retaking the city’s main airport and Tigrayan fighters and political leaders beginning to abandon positions inside the capital. The developments represent the most serious battlefield setback for the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) since fighting erupted again on September 23, threatening to bring the renewed conflict directly into Mekelle. Three sources cited by Reuters confirmed that Ethiopian federal forces had regained control of Alula Aba Nega International Airport, roughly 10 kilometres from central Mekelle. A resident also reported hearing gunfire outside the city centre. AFP, meanwhile, reported that TPLF fighters and leaders were leaving Mekelle as pro-government forces advanced toward the city. Federal troops had not yet been independently confirmed inside the city at the time of the reports. Tigrayan Forces Begin to Withdraw The reported departure of Tigrayan fighters could be a major turning point. A journalist and residents in Mekelle told AFP that TPLF fighters and leaders were leaving the capital, while government offices and police stations were reportedly left without security personnel. Residents expressed fears that the security vacuum could lead to looting and wider disorder. A resident cited by Reuters also said some Tigrayan Defence Force fighters had abandoned their posts and returned home, while government facilities were being looted. Reuters said it could not independently verify those reports, and the TPLF had not immediately responded. The reports suggest that the battle for Mekelle may be approaching a decisive stage — but they do not yet establish that the federal government has captured the city itself. A Rapid Federal Advance The federal advance has been remarkably fast. Pro-government Tigrayan fighters said they had captured Milazat, about 20 kilometres southeast of Mekelle, while residents told Reuters that government forces were closing in on the capital. Earlier in the offensive, federal and allied forces also regained strategically important territory in southern Tigray, including Alamata. The government-aligned forces have now pushed the front line deep into Tigray after reversing advances made by TPLF-led forces at the beginning of the renewed conflict. The fighting has been the most serious escalation since the devastating 2020–2022 Tigray war. Mekelle Faces a Dangerous Security Vacuum For civilians, the immediate concern is no longer simply who wins the battlefield. It is what happens to the city if one force withdraws before another establishes effective control. Banks and businesses have already closed amid fears that fighting could reach the capital. Residents have described an atmosphere of fear, while communications disruptions and movement restrictions have complicated access to information and humanitarian assistance. The absence of police and security personnel from some government facilities could create additional risks. A peaceful transfer of control would limit civilian suffering. A contested entry into the city, however, could produce another round of urban fighting in a population centre that has already endured the consequences of war. Even if federal forces ultimately take full control of Mekelle, that would not necessarily mean the conflict is over. The TPLF and allied forces have fought from difficult terrain before, and the 2020 war demonstrated how quickly control of Mekelle could change. Federal forces captured the city during that conflict, only for the TPLF to retake it months later. Reuters noted that history as a warning against assuming that control of the capital alone would settle the conflict. The current war is also considerably broader than a confrontation between Addis Ababa and Mekelle. An alliance led by the TPLF has been fighting federal forces and their allies, while the conflict has spread into neighbouring Amhara and Afar regions. Ethiopia has also accused Eritrea, Sudan and Egypt of supporting the opposition alliance. Those countries have denied the allegations, while the African Union has urged restraint. The diplomatic dimension therefore makes the battle for Mekelle potentially much more consequential than a conventional regional confrontation. The Humanitarian Stakes Tigray is home to millions of people, and the renewed fighting has already disrupted civilian life. Electricity and communications have been affected, roads have been disrupted and civilians have begun moving away from areas where fighting is occurring. Humanitarian organizations are attempting to maintain access as the front lines shift. The immediate priority for civilians in Mekelle is therefore clear: security, functioning public services and protection from revenge, looting and indiscriminate violence. Whatever happens on the battlefield, the city’s population cannot afford another prolonged siege or a repeat of the devastation witnessed during the previous war. A Decisive Moment for Ethiopia The federal advance has placed Mekelle within reach of government forces and appears to have triggered a withdrawal by some Tigrayan fighters and leaders. But the next few days could determine whether the development becomes a rapid change of control or the beginning of another prolonged phase of war. For Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government, capturing Mekelle would represent a major military achievement. For the TPLF, losing the capital would be a severe setback but not necessarily the end of its ability to continue fighting. And for the people of Tigray, the overriding question is far more basic: Will the approach of federal forces bring the restoration of order — or will Mekelle become the opening battlefield of another devastating chapter in Ethiopia’s northern war? Ethiopia has also accused Eritrea, Sudan and Egypt of supporting the opposition alliance. Those countries have denied the allegations, while the African Union has urged restraint. The diplomatic dimension therefore makes the battle for Mekelle potentially much more consequential than a conventional regional confrontation. The Humanitarian Stakes Tigray is home to millions of people, and the renewed fighting has already disrupted civilian life. Electricity and communications have been affected, roads have been disrupted and civilians have begun moving away from areas where fighting is occurring. Humanitarian organizations are attempting to maintain access as the front lines shift. The immediate priority for civilians in Mekelle is therefore clear: security, functioning public services and protection from revenge, looting and indiscriminate violence. Whatever happens on the battlefield, the city’s population cannot afford another prolonged siege or a repeat of the devastation witnessed during the previous war. A Decisive Moment for Ethiopia The federal advance has placed Mekelle within reach of government forces and appears to have triggered a withdrawal by some Tigrayan fighters and leaders. But the next few days could determine whether the development becomes a rapid change of control or the beginning of another prolonged phase of war. For Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government, capturing Mekelle would represent a major military achievement. For the TPLF, losing the capital would be a severe setback but not necessarily the end of its ability to continue fighting. And for the people of Tigray, the overriding question is far more basic: Will the approach of federal forces bring the restoration of order — or will Mekelle become the opening battlefield of another devastating chapter in Ethiopia’s northern war? items.title: Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen oo sheegay in boqolaal Xuutiyiin ah lagu dilay dagaallada Cusub
items.description: Dagaallada ka socda Yemen ayaa sii xoogeysanaya, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee taageerada ka hela Sacuudiga ay sheegeen inay boqolaal dagaalyahanno Xuutiyiin ah ku dileen howlgallo militari oo ay ku doonayaan inay dib ugu qabsadaan dhul ballaaran oo ay Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayeen. Ciidamada dowladda ayaa sheegay in howlgalladaasi ay qeyb ka yihiin guluf ay ku doonayaan inay dib ugu soo ceshadaan deegaanno ay lumiyeen, iyadoo dagaallo culus ay ka socdaan jihooyin kala duwan. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay inay weerar ku qaadeen xarun ay leedahay shirkadda shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco oo ku taalla magaalada Riyadh. Kooxdu waxay sheegatay inay weerarka u adeegsatay hub ay ku jiraan gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn, hase yeeshee maamulka Sacuudiga ayaan si rasmi ah u xaqiijin in xarunta Aramco ee Riyadh la weeraray. Iskahorimaadyadan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dagaalka Yemen uu mar kale xoogeysanayo, iyadoo dhinacyada isku haya dalka ay midba midka kale ku eedeynayo inuu sii hurinayo colaadda. Ciidamada dowladda oo taageero ka hela isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa isku dayaya inay dib u soo ceshadaan dhulal ay Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayaan, halka Xuutiyiintu ay wadaan weerarro ay ku sheegayaan inay kaga jawaabayaan duqeymaha iyo howlgallada militari ee ka dhanka ah. Xaaladda ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka abuureysa amniga gobolka, gaar ahaan marinka Bab al-Mandab , oo ah marin-biyood istiraatiiji ah oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Dagaallo sii xoogeysanaya iyo weerarro ka dhaca gudaha Yemen iyo meel ka baxsan xuduudaha dalka ayaa kordhin kara khatarta ah in colaadda Yemen ay saameyn ku yeelato amniga iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga ee gobolka.
