items.title: Hamza Denies Al-Shabaab Talks, Raising Questions Over What He Meant by Opening the Door to Dialogue
items.description: Prime Minister Says No Negotiations Are Underway Two Days After Declaring Government Ready for Dialogue With Militants Who Abandon the Group MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre has denied that the Federal Government is negotiating with Al-Shabaab , only two days after publicly declaring that his government was prepared to engage members of the militant group who abandon its ideology and armed campaign. The apparent shift in emphasis has raised questions over exactly what the government means by its newly stated willingness to pursue dialogue with Al-Shabaab-linked individuals. Speaking on the Miizaan Podcast on October 2, Hamza said neither he nor President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud had held direct talks with Al-Shabaab and insisted that the government’s relationship with the group remains one of armed conflict. “We have not entered into talks, nor are we engaged with them,” Hamza said. “What stands between us is the liberation of the country.” But in the same interview, the prime minister again left the door open to dialogue. He said the government was prepared to talk to anyone who abandons Al-Shabaab’s ideology and armed campaign, adding that former militants could eventually return to Somali society. The distinction is important. The government is now saying it is not negotiating with Al-Shabaab as an organization, while simultaneously offering dialogue and reintegration to individuals who leave the group. That is different from a political negotiation with the organization itself. What Changed in Two Days? Hamza’s latest clarification follows comments reported two days earlier in which he said the government was ready to talk to those willing to abandon the group and its ideology. Those remarks were widely interpreted as an opening toward dialogue. The latest statement appears designed to draw a line between reintegration of defectors and negotiations with Al-Shabaab’s leadership. There is currently no independently verified evidence establishing that the Federal Government has entered into formal negotiations with Al-Shabaab. Hamza has also rejected allegations that the government has paid the militant group to reduce attacks in Mogadishu, calling such claims false. The government therefore faces a communications challenge: the more openly it talks about dialogue, the greater the likelihood that its opponents and the public will interpret those statements as preparation for negotiations with the organization itself. Why the Timing Matters The issue is emerging at a particularly sensitive moment for Somalia. Al-Shabaab remains one of the country’s most powerful armed actors, maintaining significant influence across parts of south-central Somalia despite years of Somali and international military operations. The group has demonstrated an ability to attack government-held areas and retain networks capable of striking Mogadishu. At the same time, Somalia remains politically divided. The Federal Government is engaged in a prolonged dispute with opposition groups and several federal member states over constitutional changes, elections and the distribution of political authority. That makes the question of who has the mandate to negotiate on behalf of Somalia unavoidable if the government ever moves beyond individual defections and considers talks with Al-Shabaab as an organization. Defectors Are One Question. Al-Shabaab Is Another There is a substantial difference between encouraging an individual militant to surrender and negotiating with an armed organization. The first can involve disarmament, rehabilitation, amnesty and reintegration. The second could involve much larger questions: political authority, territory, security arrangements, justice, constitutional order and the future relationship between the Somali state and an organization that has fought the government for years. Hamza’s latest comments suggest that the government’s immediate position is the former. The government is saying that anyone who abandons Al-Shabaab’s armed campaign can return to Somali society, while denying that it is negotiating with the organization itself. That distinction may allow Mogadishu to pursue defections without formally recognizing Al-Shabaab as a political negotiating partner. If dialogue with Al-Shabaab ever moves beyond individual defections, however, Somalia’s unresolved political crisis would become directly relevant. Any agreement affecting the country’s security or political order would have consequences far beyond the Federal Government. Puntland, Jubaland and other political actors have their own positions on Somalia’s constitutional and electoral future. Opposition groups have also disputed the legitimacy of aspects of the current electoral and constitutional framework. The Federal Government has argued that its constitutional reforms and electoral programme are necessary to move Somalia toward direct elections. Opponents have rejected important elements of the process and have called for broader political consensus. That unresolved dispute creates a fundamental question: Who speaks for Somalia if the government decides to negotiate a political settlement with Al-Shabaab? The Government Has Not Closed the Door Hamza’s statements should not, however, be interpreted as proof that the government has decided to negotiate with Al-Shabaab. The prime minister has explicitly denied that such negotiations are taking place. What he has confirmed is that the government is prepared to engage individuals who leave the organization and renounce its ideology and violence. That policy is not unprecedented in Somalia. Governments have previously encouraged defections and reintegration as part of efforts to weaken Al-Shabaab. The more consequential question would arise if the government moved from individual reintegration to organizational dialogue. That would require a much broader political discussion. A Delicate Message The apparent contradiction between “we are ready to talk” and “we are not talking” may therefore be less dramatic than it initially appears. Hamza appears to be distinguishing between an offer to former or potential defectors and an actual negotiation with Al-Shabaab’s leadership. But the political sensitivity of the issue means that every public statement will be closely examined. For a government fighting an insurgency while simultaneously trying to establish a new electoral and constitutional order, the consequences of opening any political channel with Al-Shabaab would extend far beyond the battlefield. For now, the government’s position is clear enough: there are no declared negotiations with Al-Shabaab, but the door remains open to those who abandon the group and seek a return to Somali society. Whether that remains the government’s position — or becomes the first step toward a broader political dialogue — is a question that only future developments can answer. items.title: Mdaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: Soomaaliya ma Aqbali doonto joogitaanka Israa’iil ee Dalka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan aqbali doonin joogitaanka Israa’iil gudaha dalka “xaalad kasta”, isaga oo sidoo kale sheegay in Muqdisho ay ka hortagi doonto isku day kasta oo Soomaaliya lagu lug gelinayo colaadaha iyo xiisadaha ka taagan Bariga Dhexe. Wareysi gaar ah oo uu siiyay Al Jazeera, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Israa’iil ay qorsheynayso inay saldhig ciidan oo dhinaca badda ah ka samaysato magaalada Berbera, isla markaana ay isticmaasho garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaaladaasi. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in qorshahaasi uu qeyb ka yahay dadaallo uu sheegay in Israa’iil ay ku doonayso inay ugu dhowaato dalalka Khaliijka iyo Iran. Berbera oo ku taalla xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed ayaa ah magaalo deked leh oo ku taalla waqooyiga Soomaaliya, taas oo ay dunidu u aragto goob muhiim ah markii la eego istiraatiijiyadda Juquraafi. Dekeddan ayaa sidoo kale ku dhow marinka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab, oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, halkaas oo ay horey uga dhaceen weerarro iyo xiisado la xiriira maraakiibta iyo colaadda gobolka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Israa’iil ku eedeeyay inay tahay awood gobolka ka dhalisa xasillooni-darro, isagoo sidoo kale dhaliilay go’aankii Israa’iil ay ku aqoonsatay Somaliland. Wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ka hortagi doonto tallaabo kasta oo uu sheegay inay wax u dhimi karto madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in isku day kasta oo Soomaaliya lagu dhex gelinayo colaadaha Bariga Dhexe uusan guuleysan doonin, isagoo xusay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay awood u leedahay inay wajahdo caqabadaha ka dhasha tallaabooyinka ay Israa’iil qaaddo ama qorsheyso. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay xaaladda Yemen, isagoo Xuutiyiinta ku eedeeyay inay khalkhal geliyaan amniga gobolka iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta ee marinka Bab al-Mandab. Hadallada madaxweynaha ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiisadaha gobolka iyo amniga marin-biyoodka Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ay weli yihiin arrimo muhiim ah oo saameyn ku leh ganacsiga iyo amniga gobolka.

items.title: Afrika oo ku baaqday in kheyraadka Qaaradda loo beddelo Warshado, Shaqooyin iyo Horumar
items.description: Madaxda Afrika, hay’adaha qaaradda iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha ganacsiga ayaa ku baaqay in Afrika ay ka gudubto marxaladda qorsheyaasha iyo ballanqaadyada, isla markaana ay xoogga saarto fulinta mashaariic wax-ku-ool ah oo lagu horumarinayo dhaqaalaha qaaradda. Baaqan ayaa ka soo baxay shirkii ugu horreeyay ee Alamein Africa Forum , oo lagu qabtay magaalada New Alamein ee dalka Masar, waxaana Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf , uu sheegay in Afrika aysan ka jirin aragti iyo himilo la’aan, balse caqabadda taagan ay tahay sidii qorshayaasha waaweyn loogu beddeli lahaa mashaariic si wanaagsan loo diyaariyey, loo maalgeliyey, loona hirgeliyey. Wuxuu tilmaamay in loo baahan yahay iskaashi dhow oo dhex mara dowladaha iyo waaxda gaarka loo leeyahay si loo dardargeliyo horumarka qaaradda. Madaxweynaha Burundi ahna Guddoomiyaha Midowga Afrika, Évariste Ndayishimiye , ayaa sheegay in Afrika ay leedahay kheyraad aad u badan, balse aan weli si buuxda looga faa’iidaysan. Wuxuu ku baaqay in kheyraadka dabiiciga ah loo beddelo wax-soo-saar, warshado iyo shaqooyin, iyadoo la xoojinayo iskaashiga u dhexeeya dowladaha, maalgashadayaasha iyo ganacsatada. Ndayishimiye ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqay in xiriirka Afrika uu ka gudbo iskaashi diblomaasiyadeed oo keliya, loona gudbo iskaashi dhaqaale, maalgashi iyo wax-soo-saar. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda Heshiiska Ganacsiga Xorta ah ee Qaaradda Afrika (AfCFTA) , isaga oo sheegay in heshiisku u baahan yahay kaabayaal ganacsi oo isku xiran, xuduudo fudud, nidaamyo canshuureed oo is-waafaqsan, adeegyo lacag-bixineed iyo silsilado wax-soo-saar oo isku xira dalalka qaaradda. Madaxweynaha Masar, Cabdel Fattah Al-Sisi , ayaa dhankiisa sheegay in Afrika ay u baahan tahay inay yeelato awood dheeraad ah oo ay mustaqbalkeeda ku qaabeyso, iyadoo nabadda, xasilloonida, madax-bannaanida iyo hay’adaha dowladeed ee xooggan ay yihiin saldhigga horumar waara iyo soo jiidashada maalgashiga. Al-Sisi ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in waaxda gaarka loo leeyahay ay door muhiim ah ka qaadan karto kobaca dhaqaalaha iyo shaqo-abuurka Afrika, wuxuuna ku baaqay in la xoojiyo xiriirka ganacsatada Afrika, lana fududeeyo ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga ka dhex dhaca dalalka qaaradda. Madaxweynaha iyo Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Agaasimayaasha Afreximbank , George Elombi, ayaa isna xoogga saaray muhiimadda ay leedahay in Afrika ay xoojiso hay’adaha maaliyadeed ee ay leedahay. Wuxuu sheegay in hay’adaha Afrika ay awood u leeyihiin inay kaalin muhiim ah ka qaataan wax ka qabashada caqabadaha dhaqaale iyo dibadda kaga yimaada qaaradda, isagoo dalalka Afrika ugu baaqay inay sii xoojiyaan maalgelinta iyo taageerada hay’adahooda. Ganacsade Aliko Dangote ayaa sheegay in Afrika ay u baahan tahay inay wax ka beddesho habka ay uga faa’iidaysato kheyraadkeeda. Wuxuu ku baaqay in qaaraddu ka gudubto dhoofinta kheyraadka ceeriin, isla markaana ay xoogga saarto farsamaynta iyo wax-soo-saarka gudaha si loo abuuro shaqooyin, loo kordhiyo dakhliga gudaha, loona dhiso dhaqaale adkaysi u leh dhibaatooyinka dibadda. Dangote ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in AfCFTA uu Afrika siin karo suuq ballaaran oo dhiirrigeliya warshadaynta iyo maalgashiga, balse arrintaasi ay u baahan tahay in la yareeyo caqabadaha ka jira xuduudaha, gaadiidka, lacag-bixinta iyo xeerarka ganacsiga. Dhanka kale, madaxa AUDA-NEPAD , Nardos Bekele-Thomas, ayaa sheegtay in Afrika aysan u baahnayn shirar badan oo keliya, balse ay u baahan tahay ficil, maalgelin iyo fulin. Waxay ku baaqday in mashaariicda qaaradda loo diyaariyo si ay u noqdaan kuwo maalgashadayaashu maalgelin karaan, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo mashaariicda isku xira dalal iyo gobollo badan. Guud ahaan, Alamein Africa Forum ayaa noqday madal lagu adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in Afrika ay ka faa’iidaysato kheyraadkeeda, suuqa ballaaran iyo awoodda dhalinyarada, iyadoo qorshayaasha Agenda 2063 iyo AfCFTA loo beddelayo mashaariic dhab ah oo keena wax-soo-saar, maalgashi iyo shaqooyin. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: Soomaaliya kama Hor istaagayso Itoobiya inay hesho Marin-badeed
items.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya uu yahay mid wanaagsan, isagoo xusay in Soomaaliya aysan Itoobiya ka hor istaageyn inay hesho marin-badeed ay u isticmaasho ganacsigeeda iyo danaha dhaqaale, balse arrintaasi ay tahay inay ku timaaddo heshiis rasmi ah oo dhex mara labada dal. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo wareysi siiyay Al Jazeera ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay diyaar u tahay inay Itoobiya siiso fursad ay uga faa’iidaysato marin-badeedyada Soomaaliya, iyadoo la dhowrayo madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo dhuleednimada ee dalka. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya uu horey u soo maray khilaaf xooggan, gaar ahaan kadib heshiiskii is-afgaradka ahaa ee Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliland ay gaareen horraantii 2024, kaas oo dowladda Soomaaliya ay si adag uga hortimid, iyadoo ku tilmaantay mid xadgudub ku ah madax-bannaanida iyo dhuleednimada Soomaaliya. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, labada dowladood ayaa markii dambe qaaday tallaabooyin lagu dejinayo xiisadda, waxaana la isla qaatay in khilaafaadka jira lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo hannaan diblomaasiyadeed. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Muqdisho aysan diiddanayn baahida Itoobiya ee marin-badeed, balse isticmaalka dekedaha iyo xeebaha Soomaaliya uu u baahan yahay heshiis ay labada dhinac si buuxda u isla oggol yihiin. Hadalka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa muujinaya in Soomaaliya ay arrinta marin-badeedka Itoobiya u aragto mid lagu gaari karo iskaashi iyo heshiis dowladeed, halkii ay noqon lahayd tallaabo hal dhinac ah oo aan oggolaansho ka haysan dowladda Soomaaliya. Itoobiya oo ah dal aan bad lahayn ayaa muddo dheer raadineysay marin-badeed ay ku xoojiso ganacsigeeda iyo isku-xirka gobolka, halka Soomaaliya ay dhinaceeda adkeyneyso in heshiis kasta oo arrintaas ku saabsan uu ku dhisnaado ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida iyo shuruucda caalamiga ah.

items.title: Aqoonyahan Cabdikariim Aw Raali Oo ka warbixiyay Taarikh Nololeedkiisii iyo aasaaskii ururkii UFO
items.description: Waa kulan Aqoon iyo waayo aragnimo badan watay oo aanu wadaagnay Xildhibaan hore C/kariim Aw raali, Dadka aan garanahayn C/kariim waxaan u soo raaciyay intan yar ee kooban oo aan ka qoray illaa 10 sanno ka hor maraan jigjiga ku kulanay anigoo waliba aan xusin Taariikhdiisii SNM iyo marxalado kale oo xiligaa aanu ku talagalin faafintooda. Waa kuma Xildhibaan hore C/kariin Aw Raali? Taariikh nololeed kooban. (Taariikh nololeedka C/kariin laguma soo koobi karo maqaalkan oo kale, laakiin kulan yar oo aan la qaatay kadib ayaan jeclaysatay inaan si dulmar ah idiinku soo gudbiyo qaybo kamida noloshiisa iyo waxqabadkiisa) Magacaciisu waa Abdulkarim Aw Axmed Guuleed, wuxuu ku caanyahay INA AW RAALI. Waxa dhalay Aw Raali oo badi gayiga Soomaalida caanka ahaa, siiba Deegaanka Soomaalida Ethiopia. Wuxuu ku dhashay Deegaanka soomaalida Ethiopia gaar ahaan waqooyiga Degmada Daroor sanad lagu qiyaaso 1940 kii, waxaanu la dhashay 5 wiil iyo 3 gabdhood. WAXBARASHADIISII HOOSE Waxbarashadiisa wuxuu ka bilaabay Quraanka, waxaanu ka bilaabay Deegaanka XAADAW oo ka tirsan deegaanka Jigjiga. Dugsigiisii Hoose, Dhexe iyo sareba wuxuu ku soo qaatay Caasimada dalka Ethiopia ee Adiis Ababa, waxa xusid mudan C/kariin Aw Raali inuu Dugsigiisii dhexe uu kaalinta 1 aad u galay Ethiopia oo dhan. Sidoo kale Dugsigiisii sarena kaalmaha hore ayuu ka galay. JAAMACADDIISII 1 AAD. Kadib markii uu kaalmaha hore galay Dugsigiisii sare waxa Qaadatay oo waxbarasho bilaasha (scholarship) siisay jaamacadii ugu meeqaamka saraysay xilligaa Africa oo ku taalay Harar Ethiopia oo la odhan jiray HAILE SELASIE MILITARY ACADEMY. Sidaas ayuu C/karim Aw Raali ku noqday military kamaan_dawsa kuna qaatay xidigtii 1 aad, 2 aad iyo darajooyin kale oo ciidan, kadib markii uu ka soo baxay jaamacadii military_ga 1965 kii darajo fiican oo ciidanna la siiyay wuxuu noqday madaxa machadka Tobabarka ciidanka military_ga ee HOLETA, sidoo kale wuxuu hogaan ciidanno kala duwan ka noqday xilliyadaa galbeedka Ethiopia, isagoo ka aag badashay dagaaladii Soomaalida iyo Oromadu kula jireen Ethiopia xilligaa. JAAMACADIISII 2 AAD (Master_tiisii) C/kariin Aw Raali markale waxa uu u tartamay imtixaan uu qaaday wadanka GERMANY oo markaa awood badan oo ciidan iyo mid siyaasadeedba caalamka ku lahaa, imtixaankaa wuxuu ka qaaday Jarmalku military_ga wadannada 3 Qaaradood oo Aduunkaa oo kala ahaa AFRICA, ASIA IYO LATIN AMERICA. Nasiib wanaag C/karim Aw Raali imtixaankaa uu Jarmalku qaaday wuxuu galay kaalinta 1aad ee saddexda qaaradood. Sidaa darteed waxa wasaaradii gaashaandiga ee dalka Ethiopia yimi safiirkii Jarmalka ee Ethiopia waxaanu Hanbalyeey guud ahaan wadanka, Taliyihii ciidanka military_ga Ethiopia iyo C/karim oo uu u sheegay inuu kaalintaa ku guulaystay wiig ka dibna loo qaadi doono Germany. “Subax hore ayaa lay yeedhay waxaana laygu yidhi waxa ku doonayaa Taliyihii military_ga, waan u imi anigoo dirayskaygii ku labisan waxaanu ii sheegay inaan maalmo kooban kadib aadi doono jaamacad jarmalkaa. Anigu markaa khayaali ayaan u haystaa oo ma rumaysni, passport degdaga ayaa lay amray wax yar kadibna waanu baxnay oo waxaanu raacnay diyaarad Talyaaniya illaa markay Masar uga kacday Jarmalkana maan rumaysan waayo waxa jiray markaa cadaadis xoogan oo ihoryaalay iyo dadka oo igu odhan jiray military_ga Ethiopia meel ka gaadhi maysid” sidaa waxa yidhi C/kariin Aw Raali. Sidaas ayuu ku galay jaamacadiisii labaad ee MASTER_ta waxaanu diyaariyay BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION. C/KARIIN AW RAALI isagoo ku jira jaamacadii ayuu dhacay inqilaabkii lagu afgambiyay boqor Haile Selasse. Maadaama oo uu wadanki shuuci noqdayna Ethiopia waxay dalbatay in loo soo celiyo saraakiishii Jarmalka wax ka baranayay laakiin C/kariin iyo saraakiishii kaleba way diideen waxaanay siiwateen waxbarashadoodii. C/karim markuu qorayay buugiisii qalinjabinta wuxuu tagay Soomaaliya sababtoo ah wuxuu qorayay mawduuciisii ahaa THE ECONOMY, LIVESTOCK, AND THE SOCIAL STATUS OF THE PASTORALISTS IN SOMALIA. Isla waqtigaasna wuxuu tagay dhakhtarka weyn ee hargaysa isagoo ku soo arkay qisooyin cajiiba iyo dayacnaan badan, sidoo kale wuxuu soo eegay xaalada qaxoontigii Soomaalida ee dagaaladii 1977 ee Somalia iyo Ethiopia oo daadsan kuna darxumaysan xeryo qaxoonti duleedka Hargaysa ku yaal. “Waxaan ku gaadhay go,aan adag sidii aan wax ugu qaban lahaa qaxoontigaa Soomaaliyeed ee maalin kasta dhimanaya iyo dhakhtarka weyn ee Hargaysa oo dhib badani ka jirto” waxa sidaa yidhi C/karim. C/kariin Aw Raali wuxuu ku noqday Germany waxaanay u dhamaatay jaamacadiisii 2aad 1979 kii, waxaana qaadatay shirkadii caanka ahayd ee SIEMENS AG, oo ka mid ahayd shirkadaha ugu waawayn dalka Jarmalka xaruunteeda magaalada MUNICH, waxaanu ka baydhay fiilkii militariga. Isla wakhtigaa uu ka shaqaynayay shirkadaa SIEMENS AG ayaa uu ku dhaqaaqay go,aankiisii ahaa wax u qabashada qaxoontigii Soomaaliyeed ee uu ku soo arkay duleedka Hargaysa iyo dhakhtarkii Hargaysa ee dayacnaa. ” Dadaal badan iyo dhibaatooyin kadib waxa C/karim u suurto gashay inay kulmaan dhakhtar Jarmala oo la odhan jiray DR RUPERT NEUDECK oo baryahaa aas aasay Haayad Jarmala oo qaxoontiga lagu caawiyo kuna bohoobeen dhakhaatiir Jarmali oo la odhan jiray G E D ( GERMAN EMERGENCY DOCTORS). Dr RUPERT Kulanno dhaadheer, xogo ku saabsan xaalada qaxoontiga oo uu la wadaagay, wariyayaal loo diray xeryaha qaxoontiga iyo wasiirkii DALXIISKA ee Somalia MD MAXAMED CUMAR JEES oo uu u keenay kadib waxa uu la qaatay Dr ki C/kariin in si dhakhsaa loo caawiyo qaxoontigaa, waxaanu ka bilaabay Dr RUPERT inuu bangiga dalka Jarmalka ka amaahdo lacag dhan DM 500,000.00 oo lacagta Jarmalkaa isagoo u rahmay gurigiisii. “Bishii May 1980 kii ayaanu soo fasax qaadanay aniga, Dr RUPERT, 4 dhakhtar oo kale iyo 3 nurse, waxaanu diyaarad xamuula ka soo gaxaysanay magaalada PARIS, waxaanan soo qaadnay daawooyin, cunto, bustayaal, taandhooyin, gaadhi Land-drover ah iyo waxyaalii kalee loo baahnaa. Markaa, waxaanu ka soo degnay Djibouti May 10/1980 isla maalintii xigtayna waxaanu u baxnay xaga Hargaysa, annagoo wadana alaabtii oo aanu 4 baabuur oo xamuula ku soo raray sidoo kale wadana gaadhigii Landrover ka ahaa. May 13-keedii ayaanu magaalada Hargeysa goor fiid ah soo gallay. Waagi markuu beryey ayaanu dawladii raadsanay oo aanu u dhaqaaqnay dhinicii Xeradii Biyo Xidhka. Maamulkiibaa noo yimid oo aanu wada sahaminnay meesha xarun caafimaad ku haboon. Degdegbaan ugu heshiinay halkii ugu habooneyd. Dhakhsaanu u bilawnay dhismihii teendhooyinka. Waxaanu dhisnay mid bukaanka carruurta, mid dumarka iyo mid ragga bukaanka ah la dhigi karo iyo mid bukaanka lagu baadho. Waxa kale oo aanu dhisnay laba teendhooyin oo aanu dhigannay kaydadka kala duwan. Gelinkii danbeba Dhakhaatiirti shaqadii bay bilaabeen. 4 dhakhtar iyo 3 nurse ah ayaan shaqada ku bilawnay oo wada ahaa khubaro waaweyn, muddo bil ahna way soo ruqsad qaateen. Todobada subaxnimo ayaa shaqada la bilaabi jiray lixda galabnimana waanu ka noqon jirnay. Qadada shaqadaa loogu geyn jiray. DR. RUPERT NEUDECK, oo ahaa madaxii Haayadda ayaa wacay Germany si uu u ogaado sida loo arkay Programkii Gudigii sahanka ku yimid ka tuseen TV-gii Germanka, madaama aanu isweydaaranay oo aanaan is arkin. Xaskiisii oo uu lahadlay ayaa u sheegtay in muraara dilaac laga qaaday, maalintii u horaysayna lacag ka badan 5 million oo ah lacagta Jarmalka DM (DEUTCH-MARK) account-ka Haayadda lagu soo shubay. Aad ayuu ugu farxay arinkaa Dr RUPERT” C/kariin Aw Raali. Waxa kale oo ay C/kariin Aw Raali iyo Dr RUPERT ay bilaabeen inay furaan 2 xero oo kale maadaamoo qaxoontigu badnaa, waxaanay fureen xeradii ADHI_CADAYS EE DACAR BUDHUQ IYO TII TOG_WAJAALE oo iyagana sidii tii BIYO XIDHKA ay uga shaqeeyeen, 18 cisho kadib waxa yimi safiirkii Somalia u fadhiyay Jarmalka iyo xildhibaano ka socda Jarmalka, waxay aad u amaaneen shaqada fiican ee ay hayaan iyo dadaalka ay sameeyeen sidoo kale waxay balanqaadeen C/karim oo fasaxii shirkadu siisay ka dhacayo inay Baarlamaanku shirkada ka codsandoonaan in fasaxa loo kordhiyo mushaharkiisana la siiyo. Kadib markii hawshii xeryaha qaxoontigu hagaagtay shaqadina iskuugu duba dhacday DR RUPERT wuxuu ku noqday Germany, C/karim Aw Raalina wuxuu abaabulay dib u dhiskii, nadaafadii, iyo qalabayntii Dhakhtarka weyn ee Hargaysa, waa kan isagoo ka sheekaynaya hawsha dhakhtarka weyn “Gudoomiyaha Hayadda ayaan warbixin u qoray oo aan u sheegay baahida Hosbitaalka, isna wuxu isoo weydiiyey inaan Dhakhtar u xilsaaro inuu baahida Hosbitaalka oo idil soo qoro. Maadaama aan fursaddaan doonayey aan helay aniguna dhakhatiirtii oo idil ayaan shir u qabtay inay baahida Hosbitaalka oo tafa tiran qoraan si Hosbitaalka loo casriyeeyo. items.fullContent: Waa kulan Aqoon iyo waayo aragnimo badan watay oo aanu wadaagnay Xildhibaan hore C/kariim Aw raali, Dadka aan garanahayn C/kariim waxaan u soo raaciyay intan yar ee kooban oo aan ka qoray illaa 10 sanno ka hor maraan jigjiga ku kulanay anigoo waliba aan xusin Taariikhdiisii SNM iyo marxalado kale oo xiligaa aanu ku talagalin faafintooda. Waxa dhalay Aw Raali oo badi gayiga Soomaalida caanka ahaa, siiba Deegaanka Soomaalida Ethiopia. Wuxuu ku dhashay Deegaanka soomaalida Ethiopia gaar ahaan waqooyiga Degmada Daroor sanad lagu qiyaaso 1940 kii, waxaanu la dhashay 5 wiil iyo 3 gabdhood. WAXBARASHADIISII HOOSE Waxbarashadiisa wuxuu ka bilaabay Quraanka, waxaanu ka bilaabay Deegaanka XAADAW oo ka tirsan deegaanka Jigjiga. Dugsigiisii Hoose, Dhexe iyo sareba wuxuu ku soo qaatay Caasimada dalka Ethiopia ee Adiis Ababa, waxa xusid mudan C/kariin Aw Raali inuu Dugsigiisii dhexe uu kaalinta 1 aad u galay Ethiopia oo dhan. Kadib markii uu kaalmaha hore galay Dugsigiisii sare waxa Qaadatay oo waxbarasho bilaasha (scholarship) siisay jaamacadii ugu meeqaamka saraysay xilligaa Africa oo ku taalay Harar Ethiopia oo la odhan jiray HAILE SELASIE MILITARY ACADEMY. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo shaaciyey qorshe xasaasi ah oo Israel ay ka damacsan tahay Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in Israel ay qorsheyneyso inay saldhig ciidan-badeed ka sameysato magaalada Berbera, isla markaana ay isticmaasho garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaaladaas. Xasan Sheekh ayaa arrintan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey Al Jazeera, oo qeybo ka mid ah la sii daayey Sabtida, iyadoo wareysiga oo dhameystiran la baahin doono Axadda. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalka aysan aqbali doonin joogitaan militari oo Israel ay ka sameysato dhul Soomaaliya ka mid ah. “Sinaba uma aqbali doonno joogitaan Israel ay Soomaaliya ku yeelato qaabka ay hadda ugu soo dhowaaneyso Somaliland,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh, sida lagu sheegay qeybo ka mid ah wareysiga la sii daayey. Waxa uu sheegay in, sida uu rumeysan yahay, ujeeddada Israel ay tahay inay Berbera ka hesho meel istaraatiiji ah oo u dhow dalalka Khaliijka iyo Iran, isla markaana ay isticmaasho dekedda iyo garoonka magaalada. Somaliland oo horey u beenisay Hadalka Xasan Sheekh ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo madaxda Somaliland ay horey u beeniyeen wararka sheegaya in heshiis laga gaaray saldhig militari oo Israel laga siiyo Berbera. Wasiirka gaashaandhigga Somaliland Maxamed Yuusuf Cali ayaa bishii June Reuters u sheegay in aysan jirin saldhig militari oo Israel ku leedahay Somaliland, isla markaana aysan socdaan wada-hadallo ku saabsan dhismaha saldhig noocaas ah. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu xaqiijiyey in Israel ay tababaro siinayso ciidamada milatariga iyo booliska Somaliland. Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi ayaa sidoo kale bishii February sheegay in aan wax heshiis ah laga gaarin saldhig militari oo Israel ay ka sameysato Somaliland, inkastoo uu meesha ka saarin iskaashi militari oo labada dhinac mustaqbalka dhex mara. Khilaafka ayaa sii xoogeysanaya tan iyo markii Israel ay bishii December 2025 si rasmi ah u aqoonsatay Somaliland, iyadoo noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee tallaabadaas qaada. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u diiday aqoonsigaas, iyadoo ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Midowga Afrika iyo dalal ay ka mid yihiin Masar iyo Turkiga ayaa iyaguna kasoo horjeestay tallaabada Israel. Maxay Berbera muhiim u tahay? Berbera waxay ku taallaa xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed, meel ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Goobtaas ayaa ah mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee ganacsiga caalamka, waxaana muhiimaddeeda militari iyo dhaqaale sii kordhiyey dagaallada Yemen iyo weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee maraakiibta ku socda Badda Cas. Reuters ayaa horraantii sanadkan sheegtay in goobta ay Somaliland ku taallo, gaar ahaan dekedda Berbera, ay soo jiidaneyso danaha dalal badan sababo la xiriira ganacsiga, amniga iyo isku socodka Badda Cas. Xasan Sheekh ayaa wareysiga Al Jazeera ku sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan dooneyn in khilaafaadka Bariga Dhexe loo soo raro Geeska Afrika. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku eedeeyey Xuutiyiinta Yemen inay qalqal geliyaan amniga gobolka isla markaana carqaladeeyaan maraakiibta isticmaasha Bab al-Mandab. Madaxweynaha ayaa ku dooday in dadka Somaliland ay kasoo horjeedaan joogitaan Israel. “Markan sidoo kale waxaan aaminsanahay inaan ka gudbi doonno caqabadda ay Israel abuureyso,” ayuu yiri. The post Xasan Sheekh oo shaaciyey qorshe xasaasi ah oo Israel ay ka damacsan tahay Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Duqayn xoogan oo ka dhacday Sanca iyo Xuutiyiinta oo garaacay xarun shidaal oo ku taala Riyadh
items.description: Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen ayaa caawa sheegay inay boqolaal weerar oo xagga cirka ah ka fuliyeen Magaalada Sanca iyo deegaano kale, oo Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay gacanta ku hayaan, xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo dagaalka u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo Dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudiga uu bari-taaro. Telefishinka afka Xuutiyiinta ku hadla ee Al Masirah ayaa sheegay in Sacuudiga uu duqayntii ugu xooganeyd ka gaystay Caasimadda Sanca. Goobjoogeyaasha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in qaraxyadii ugu badnaa ee hal maalin ay maanta ka dhaceen magaaladaasi. Goobjoogeyaasha ayaa waxay kaloo sheegeen inay arkeen diyaarado dagaal oo gantaalo ku ridaya magaalada. Afhayeen u hadlay Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen oo lagu magacaabo Korneyl Majed Abdullah Al Nazili ayaa sheegay in 257 hawlgal ay si sax ah ula beegsadeen goobaha, dhaqdhaqaaqyada iyo awoodaha militari ee Xuutiyiinta. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in Militariga Yemen ay adeegsadeen diyaaradaha dagaalka, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, gantaalada la hago iyo madaafiicda qoriga dhuunta dheer ee artillery-ga. Korneyl Al Nazili ayaa intaasi ku daray in qiyaasaha horudhaca ah ay muujinayaan in hawlgaladaasi lagu dilay ugu yaraan 700 oo ka tirsan Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta, isla-markaana lagu burburiyay bartilmaameedyo militari oo istiraatiiji ah, oo ay ku jiraan buu yiri 170 gaadiidka dagaalka ah iyo qalab culus. Al Nazili ayaa sheegay in hawlgaladan ay ka fuliyeen Sanca, Midi, Baqim iyo jiidaha hore ee dagaalka ee Al-Jawf, Marib, Al-Bayda iyo Lahij, isla-markaana hawlgalada qaarkood ay diiradda ku saareen aagga Taiz, sida uu yiri. Dagaal-yahanada Xuutiyiinta ayaa dhankooda sii wada weerarada ay ku hayaan bartilmaameedyada Dowladda Yemen iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegtay inay garaaceen xarun shidaal oo Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco ay ku leedahay Magaalada Riyadh. Wakaaladda Wararka Reuters ayaa goor sii horreysay oo maanta ah ku warantay in dab weyn uu ka kacay mid ka mid ah xarumaha Shirkadda Aramco ee Riyadh. Wakaaladda Wararka AFP ayaa iyana sheegtay in galabnimadii Sabtidan la arkay olol iyo qiiq ka kacaya xarun ay leedahay Shirkadda Aramco oo ku taala koonfurta Riyadh. Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay in duqaynta ay ka gaysteen gudaha Sacuudiga ay jawaab u tahay boqortooyada oo tobanaan jeer maanta garaacday Sanca. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa muuqaal uu caawa soo duubay ku sheegay in dagaal-yahanadooda ay weerarka u adeegsadeen gantaalo iyo diyaarado drones ah, isagoo intaasi ku daray in uu dab qabsaday xarunta la beegsaday. Masuuliyiinta iyo Saraakiisha Sacuudiga ayaan weli ka hadlin weerarka ay Xuutiyiintu ka gaysteen Riyadh. Xiisadda Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga ayaa cirka isku shareertay, ka dib markii Xuutiyiinta ay bishii July ku dhawaaqeen go’doomin badeed oo ka dhan ah Dekedaha Sacuudiga. Colaadda u dhexeyso labada dhinac ayaa sii xoogeysatay, ka gadaal markii Xuutiyiinta ay bishii September isku fidiyeen deegaanada xeebaha galbeed ee Yemen ee ku teedsan Badda Cas, isla-markaana ay la wareegeen gacan ku haynta marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed.

items.title: Somaliland’s ruling WADDANI Party and opposition parties KULMIYE and Kaah have separately defended Somaliland’s position on Israel’s……
items.description: The people of Somaliland, their clerics, scholars, traditional elders and political parties share a fundamental position on Somaliland as a nation and their right to self-determination, asserts Somaliland’s ruling WADDANI Party and opposition parties KULMIYE and Kaah have separately defended Somaliland’s position on Israel’s recognition of the Republic of Somaliland, and scoffed at insinuations by Somalia’s Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre concerning the response of Somaliland’s political and traditional institutions. KULMIYE Secretary-General Faisal Abdirahman Madar, speaking at a press conference in Hargeisa, said his party supports Israel’s recognition of Somaliland and considers the issue of Somaliland’s statehood to be beyond political negotiation. “The KULMIYE Party once again makes clear that the recognition Somaliland received from Israel is not subject to negotiation, and we support it. The decision concerning Somaliland’s existence is irreversible, and no one can change it,” Madar said. He called on Somalia’s federal government to recognize the Republic of Somaliland, saying Mogadishu still had an opportunity to take such a step. He also urged neighbouring countries to support Somaliland’s bid for wider international recognition. Israel formally recognized Somaliland as an independent and sovereign state on December 26, 2025, according to the statement, with the two sides subsequently signing a joint declaration establishing diplomatic relations. Similarly, Kaah Party leader Abdikarim Mohamed rejected remarks by Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre, who said Somaliland’s religious scholars, traditional elders and political parties did not support Israel’s recognition of Somaliland. Hamza made the remarks during an interview with a Somali TV podcast, saying: “We were pleased that the people of Somaliland, the religious scholars, traditional elders and all the political parties are not in agreement with this, and the Somali people do not accept it.” He disputed that characterization, saying Somaliland’s political parties, religious scholars and traditional elders share what he described as a fundamental position concerning Somaliland’s existence and right to self-determination, despite disagreements over other political issues. “I am telling you that the people of Somaliland, their religious scholars, traditional elders and political parties share one ‘fundamental’ position based on the existence of Somaliland as a nation and their right to self-determination,” he said. He accused the Somali prime minister of misreading political debates within Somaliland and said disagreements among Somaliland’s political actors should not be interpreted as opposition to Somaliland’s statehood. “Your statement appears to show that you have become confused and lost in the debates and views within Somaliland’s political parties and society,” Madar said. He concluded his response with a Somali chiding phrase denoting a browbeaten hypocrite, saying, “Let me cry, shut the door so that I hide,” which he used to characterize what he portrayed as the Somali government’s response to developments concerning Somaliland. The conservative WADDANI Party has, on several occasions, strongly and steadfastly defended Israel’s recognition of Somaliland, while consistently standing up for the interests of the Republic of Somaliland, whether on the issue of recognition or in support of the government and the President’s efforts to secure formal recognition from other countries around the world.   Source horntribune

items.title: Is-beddel lama filaan ah oo ku yimid dagaalkii gobolka Tigray
items.description: Mekelle (Caasimada Online) — Dagaalyahannada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha TPLF ayaa Sabtida isaga baxayay magaalada Mekelle, caasimadda gobolka Tigray, xilli ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya ay kusoo siqayaan magaalada, isla markaana ay dib ula wareegeen garoonkeeda diyaaradaha. Wariye maxalli ah iyo dad deggan Mekelle ayaa wakaaladda AFP u sheegay in xubnaha Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) ay bilaabeen inay magaalada ka baxaan, iyadoo xarumo dowladeed iyo saldhigyo boolis laga waayay ciidamadii ammaanka. “Dagaalyahannada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha TPLF way ka baxayaan Mekelle,” ayuu yiri wariyaha, isaga oo sheegay in ciidamada federaalka aan weli lagu arag gudaha magaalada. Dhanka kale, Reuters ayaa Sabtida werisay in ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ay dib ula wareegeen garoonka Alula Aba Nega ee Mekelle, sida ay sheegeen saddex ilo xog-ogaal ah. Garoonka ayaa ka mid ahaa goobo muhiim ah oo TPLF ay qabsatay markii dagaalka cusub uu qarxay 23-kii September. Qabsashada garoonka iyo ka bixitaanka xubnaha TPLF ayaa muujinaya isbeddel weyn oo ku yimid dagaalka, kadib markii xoogagga Tigray ay maalmo ka hor horumar ka sameeyeen gobollada deriska la ah Tigray. Dagaalka ayaa 23-kii September ka qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya, markii TPLF iyo xoogag ay xulafo yihiin ay weerarro ka bilaabeen qeybo ka mid ah Afar iyo Amhara, taas oo dhalisay cabsi laga qabo inuu dib u qarxo dagaal ballaaran oo la mid ah kii 2020-2022. Laakiin ciidamada federaalka iyo maleeshiyaadka taageersan dowladda ayaa maalmihii dambe qaaday weerar rogaalcelis ah, iyagoo dib u riixay xoogagga TPLF, kadibna dhowr jiho uga soo dhaqaaqay dhinaca Mekelle. Reuters ayaa Jimcihii werisay in ciidamada dowladda iyo xoogagga taageersan ay kusoo dhowaadeen Mekelle, iyadoo dagaalka cusub uu noqday kii ugu xooganaa tan iyo heshiiskii nabadeed ee 2022. Cabsi laga qabo fowdo Ka bixitaanka ciidamada iyo saraakiisha TPLF ayaa walaac ka dhaliyay gudaha Mekelle, halkaas oo dadka deegaanka ay ka cabsi qabaan in la waayo kala dambeynta ka hor inta aysan ciidamada dowladda gaarin gudaha magaalada. “Waxaan ka walaacsanahay in hantida dowladda iyo tan dadweynaha ay u nuglaato bililiqo, sababtoo ah magaalada ma joogaan ciidamo amni,” ayuu qof deggan Mekelle u sheegay AFP. Qof kale ayaa sheegay inuu ka baqayo in sharci-darro ay ku faafto magaalada. “Waxaan ka baqayaa nafteyda. Waxaan dooneynaa in si degdeg ah loogu soo laabto sharciga iyo kala dambeynta,” ayuu yiri. Xaaladda dhabta ah ee qeybo badan oo magaalada iyo gobolka ah ayaa weli adag in si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyo, maadaama gelitaanka warbaahinta uu aad u xaddidan yahay, isla markaana ay jiraan go’itaanno waaweyn oo dhanka isgaarsiinta ah. TPLF ayaa muddo dheer ahayd awoodda ugu weyn ee Tigray, waxaana horaantii sanadkan ay meesha ka saartay maamul ay dowladda federaalku taageeraysay. Hase yeeshee, horumarka ay hadda sameynayaan ciidamada dowladda ayaa TPLF dib ugu celinaya xaalad u eg tii bilowgii dagaalkii 2020, markii ciidamada federaalka ay qabsadeen Mekelle. Hoggaamiyaha TPLF Debretsion Gebremichael ayaa Khamiistii muujiyay in xoogaggiisu ay u wareegi karaan dagaal dhuumaaleysi ah haddii ay lumiyaan magaalooyinka waaweyn. “Waxaan ku shaqeyneynaa istaraatiijiyad aan cadowga ku garaaceyno meel kasta oo aan dooranno,” ayuu yiri. TPLF ayaa qaab la mid ah u dagaallantay kadib markii Mekelle ay ciidamada dowladda qabsadeen dabayaaqadii 2020. Dagaalyahannada Tigray ayaa markaas dib ugu laabtay dhulka miyiga ah, waxayna ugu dambeyn dib ula wareegeen magaalada bartamihii 2021. Xiisadda oo gobolka ku fidaysa Dagaalka cusub ayaan ku koobnaan oo keliya khilaafka gudaha Itoobiya, balse wuxuu sidoo kale sababay burbur weyn oo ku yimid xiriirka Addis Ababa kala dhexeeya Eritrea iyo Masar. Itoobiya ayaa ku eedeysay Eritrea, Masar iyo Sudan inay taageerayaan xoogagga kasoo horjeeda dowladda. Dalalka la eedeeyay ayaa diiday inay taageerayaan fallaagada. Addis Ababa ayaa Khamiistii xirtay safaaraddeeda Asmara, isla markaana cayrisay 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah. Eritrea ayaa jawaab ahaan ku dhawaaqday inay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed u jartay Itoobiya. Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale cayrisay diblomaasi Masri ah, iyadoo Qaahira ay qaaday tallaabo la mid ah. Khilaafka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa bilihii dambe sii xoogeysanayay, iyadoo Asmara ay Addis Ababa ku eedeysay inay damacsan tahay inay xoog ku hesho marin ay uga baxdo Badda Cas. Debretsion ayaa isaguna dagaalka hadda socda ku xiriiriyay loollanka gobolka. “Dagaalku waa mid goboleed, waana dagaal lagu doonayo in lagu xakameeyo Badda Cas,” ayuu yiri. Madaxda gobolka oo ku kulmaya Iyadoo dagaalku sii xoogeysanayo, madaxda Soomaaliya, Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan ayaa Axadda lagu wadaa inay kulan wada-tashi ah ku yeeshaan magaalada New Alamein ee Masar. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki, madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah al-Sisi iyo taliyaha ciidamada Sudan Abdel Fattah al-Burhan ayaa lagu wadaa inay ka qeyb-galaan kulanka. Afhayeenka madaxtooyada Masar ayaa Sabtida sheegay in kulanka afarta dhinac looga tashan doono arrimaha gobolka ee ay wadaagaan dalalkaas. Kulanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo Itoobiya uu xiriirkeedu aad u xumaaday Eritrea iyo Masar, isla markaana Addis Ababa ay labada dal ku eedeysay inay taageerayaan TPLF. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale ka qeybgalaya Alamein Africa Forum, oo ka socda Masar 2-da ilaa 4-ta October, waxaana madasha ka qeybgalaya madax iyo masuuliyiin sare oo Afrikaan ah. Nabad jilicsan oo burburtay TPLF waxay ahayd awoodda ugu weyn ee isbahaysigii xukumayay Itoobiya intii u dhaxeysay 1991 iyo 2018, kahor inta uusan ra’iisul wasaare Abiy Ahmed talada la wareegin, iyadoo awooddii siyaasadeed ee TPLF ay si weyn hoos ugu dhacday. Xiisaddii ka dhalatay loollankaas ayaa horseeday dagaalkii Tigray ee 2020-2022, oo noqday mid ka mid ah dagaalladii ugu dhimashada badnaa dunida sannadihii dambe. Heshiiskii Pretoria ee November 2022 ayaa soo afjaray dagaalkii weynaa, balse qodobbo muhiim ah oo heshiiskaas ka mid ah ayaan si buuxda loo dhaqan-gelin. Xasilloonidii jilicsaneyd ee heshiiskaas dhalisay ayaa sannadkii la soo dhaafay sii wiiqmeysay, waxaana dagaalka dib u qarxay bishii September uu hadda mar kale ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya keenay afaafka Mekelle. items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo ahmiyad siinaya dib-u-heshiisiinta dadka Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa maanta shir guddoomiyay shir la xiriira geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed. Shirkan oo ay yeesheen Golaha Wasiirada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa looga hadlay amniga deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed iyo dardargelinta geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada, sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay Xafiiska Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed. “Golaha Wasiirada ayaa si qoto dheer uga hadlay gogosha iyo geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la helo wada hadal loo dhan yahay, is afgarad siyaasadeed, bulsho iyo in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo hannaan nabadeed oo ku dhisan wadatashi iyo is qancin.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa adkeeyay nabadgelyada, midnimada bulshada iyo dib-u-heshiisiintu inay yihiin tiirarka aasaaska u ah horumarka iyo xasilloonida Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo dowladda ay sii wadi doonto dadaalada lagu mideynayo bulshada iyo xoojinta dowladnimada.” Shirkan ayaa daba socdo kulan uu Aadan Madoobe uu Khamiistii Madaxtooyada Baydhabo kula yeeshay wafdi uu hoggaaminayo Gudoomiyihii hore ee Golaha Shacabka, Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan oo gaaray magaaladaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Aadan Madoobe uu Maxamed Mursal ka codsaday inuu gacan ka gaysto doorka hoggaamineed ee dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada, isla-markaana uu ka aqbalay. Aadan Madoobe ayaa daneynaya in loo kala dab qaado maamulkiisa cusub iyo hoggaankii hore ee maamulka, kaas oo dagaal uu kala kulmayo. Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo aan aqoonsanayn doorashada Aadan Madoobe ayay ciidamadiisu weerar ku hayaan Magaalada Baydhabo. Aadan Madoobe oo Khamiistii ka hadlayay shir jaraa’id ayaa ku baaqay in wada hadal iyo is afgarad siyaasadeed lagu dhameeyo wax kasta oo lagu kala aragti duwan yahay. Ma cadda in Laftagareen iyo siyaasiyiinta deegaanka ee ku mowqifka ah ay aqbali doonaan wada hadal nabadeed iyo gorgortan siyaasadeed iyo in kale.

items.title: US air operations killed or wounded at least 216 civilians in Somalia
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – At least 216 civilians in Somalia were recorded as killed or injured by U.S. air operations between 2007 and May 2025, according to an investigation supported by Arab Reporters for Investigative Journalism (ARIJ). The investigation described the figure as the minimum number of civilian casualties its researchers were able to document in the incidents reviewed. It does not mean the United States has confirmed each casualty. Somalia in the four-country picture The investigation covered Somalia, Syria, Iraq and Yemen. Syria recorded the highest toll, with 1,336 people killed or wounded, followed by Yemen with 991, Iraq with 793 and Somalia with 216, for a combined total of at least 3,336. Somalia’s share is the smallest, about 6.5 percent of the total. How the figures were built Investigators analyzed 884 air operations across the four countries, excluding disputed or unclassifiable incidents and using the lowest documented casualty estimates. The Somalia total is therefore a floor, not a ceiling. Two findings are reported for all four countries combined, not for Somalia alone. Children account for nearly 42 percent of the casualties documented across the four countries, and the investigation does not establish that breakdown for Somalia’s figure. The investigation also found 2.3 civilians were killed for every combatant killed during the opening months of President Donald Trump’s second term, again across all four countries. It attributes the civilian toll to U.S. policies governing strike authorization and the level of civilian harm commanders are permitted to accept. An expert view on why civilians are missed The investigation quotes Wes Bryant, a former Pentagon civilian protection official, who said airstrikes often accompany ground operations conducted overnight or at dawn, and that failures to detect civilians contributed to many deaths. His comments address U.S. air operations generally, not Somalia specifically. The strike numbers The investigation’s data ends in May 2025, so it does not cover the full 2025 campaign. U.S. Africa Command (AFRICOM) carried out 124 strikes in Somalia in 2025, up from 10 in 2024, according to an AFRICOM spokesperson. That surpassed the previous all-time high of 63 in 2019. AFRICOM had launched at least 86 strikes in Somalia in 2026 as of September. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

U.S. Africa Command (AFRICOM) carried out 124 strikes in Somalia in 2025, up from 10 in 2024, according to an AFRICOM spokesperson. That surpassed the previous all-time high of 63 in 2019. AFRICOM had launched at least 86 strikes in Somalia in 2026 as of September. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Waa Kuwee Shaqooyinka Halista ugu Jira in Garaadgacmeedku Beddelo?
items.description: Markii ChatGPT si rasmi ah dunida loogu soo bandhigay dabayaaqadii 2022, dad badan waxay u arkayeen aalad cusub oo lagu diyaariyo farriimaha iimaylka, lagu xalliyo layliyada waxbarashada ama jawaabo loogu helo weydiimaha fudud. Dad yar ayaa markaas ku baraarugsanaa in sannado kooban gudahood garaadgacmeedku (Artificial Intelligence) saldhig u noqon doono doodda ugu weyn ee ka taagan suuqyada shaqada waa: yaa shaqadiisa sii xejisin doona, yuuse garaadgacmeedku barabixin doonaa? Dooddani kuma koobnaan shirkadaha waaweyn ee teknolajiyadda, sida OpenAI, Google iyo Microsoft. Waxay ku fidday bangiyada, warshadaha, shirkadaha gaadiidka, xarumaha adeegga macaamiisha iyo weliba goobaha shaqo ee ay dhallinyaradu inta badan ka bilaabaan noloshooda xirfadeed. Waxa la isku hayo ma aha oo keliya tirada shaqooyinka meesha ka bixi kara, ee sidoo kale, waa sida uu isbeddelkani u qaabayn doono mustaqbalka shaqooyinka, xirfadaha iyo nololmaalmeedka bulshooyinka. Welwelka laga qabo isbeddelkan waa mid isa soo taraya, mararka qaarkoodna waa la buunbuuniyaa baaxadda halistiisa. Sidaas oo ay tahay, xogaha ay soosaarayaan hay’adaha dhaqaalaha iyo suuqa shaqadu waxay muujinayaan in arrintu ka gudubtay heerkii oddorosidda iyo malaynta, oo garaadgacmeedku durba saamayn ku yeeshay habkii shaqooyinka qaarkood loo qaban jiray. Sanduuqa Lacagta Adduunka (International Monetary Fund) ayaa horraantii 2026 sheegay in ku dhowaad 40% shaqooyinka dunidu ay la kulmi karaan saamaynta garaadgacmeedka. Shaqooyinka qaarkood hawlahooda ayaa la fududayn karaa, kuwo kalena habkii loo qaban jiray ayaa isbeddelaya, halka qaar kale ay suurtaggal tahay in gebi ahaanba la beddelo. Tiradani, si kastaba, macnaheedu ma aha in 40% shaqooyinka dunidu ay meesha ka baxayaan. Hay’addu waxay si gaar ah u tilmaantay cadaadiska sii kordhaya ee shaqooyinka heerka dhexe, gaar ahaan kuwa xafiisyada ee hawlahoodu maalinlaha yihiin. Dhinaca kale, Madasha Dhaqaalaha Adduunka (World Economic Forum) ayaa warbixinteeda The Future of Jobs Report 2025 ku muujisay in isbeddelka suuqa shaqadu uusan ku koobnayn shaqooyin lumaya, maaddaama ay dhinac socoto baahida loo qabo xirfado cusub. Waxa ay si gaar ah u adkaysay muhiimadda tababbarka, kobcinta aqoonta iyo dibubarashada xirfadaha, si shaqaaluhu ula jaanqaadaan teknolajiyadda soo kordhaysa. Marka xogahaas la isu wada geeyo, waxaa soo baxaya sawir ka duwan aragtida guud ee ah in garaadgacmeedku la wareegayo shaqo kasta oo dadku qabtaan. Saamayntu waxay si weyn ugu xiran tahay nooca shaqada, heerka aqoonta ay u baahan tahay iyo sida ay hawlaheedu ugu habboon yihiin in lagu qabto nidaamyo iswada (automated systems). Shaqooyinka ku dhisan habraac joogto ah, hawlo soo noqnoqda iyo xog si fudud loo habayn karo ayaa si gaar ah ugu nugul isbeddelkan. Waxaa tusaale u ah shaqaalaha xoggelinta (data entry). Dadka maalin kasta tirooyin, diiwaanno iyo dukumentiyo ku geliya nidaamyada xogta waxay ka mid yihiin shaqaalaha ay suurtaggal tahay in hawlahooda qaar lagu beddelo barnaamijyada casriga ah. Aaladahani waxay akhriyi karaan dukumentiyada, shaandhayn (filtering ) ku samayn karaan xogta, ogaan karaan khaladaadka qaarkood, dabadeedna xogta ku kaydin karaan nidaamyo diyaarsan, iyaga oo hawlo waqti badan qaadan jiray ku dhammaynaya muddo kooban. Isbeddel la mid ah ayaa ka socda xarumaha adeegga macaamiisha. Shirkado badan ayaa qayb ka mid ah hawlihii jawaabcelinta u wareejiyay barnaamijyada wadasheekaysiga (chatbots). Halkii shaqaale uu maalin kasta ka jawaabi lahaa weydiimo isku mid ah, barnaamij ayaa macaamiisha siin kara macluumaadka ay u baahan yihiin, una gudbin kara adeegyada ku habboon. Nidaamyadani, waxay sidoo kale fududaynayaan helitaanka adeegyada saacad kasta, iyada oo aysan lagamamaarmaan ahayn in shaqaale kastaa xilligaas hawsha joogo. Illowse, weli waxaa jira cabashooyin iyo arrimo murugsan oo u baahan garashada, dhexdhexaadinta iyo go’aanka shaqaale aadane ah. Dukaamada waaweynna waxaa ka muuqda isbeddel kale. Goobo ganacsi oo badan ayaa hirgeliyay nidaamyo uu macmiilku isagu badeecadaha ku diiwaangelinayo, lacagtoodana ku bixinayo, isaga oo aan u baahnayn khasnaji. Nidaamyadan, oo loo yaqaanno “ Self-checkout Systems” , waxay yarayn karaan hawlaha ay shaqaalaha dukaamadu qabtaan. Waxaase muhiim ah in la kala saaro nidaamyada iswada iyo garaadgacmeedka, waayo adeeg kasta oo iswada kuma dhisna garaadgacmeed. Warshaduhu waxay iyaguna muddo dheer adeegsanayeen roboodyo (robots) iyo mashiinno qabta hawlo ay dadku hore u qaban jireen. Aaladahaasi waxay kala saaraan badeecooyinka, xirxiraan alaabta, qabtaanna shaqooyin u baahan saxnaan iyo isku-celcelin joogto ah. Horumarka garaadgacmeedku wuxuu sii ballaarin karaa awoodda nidaamyadan, gaar ahaan dhinacyada kashifaadda cilladaha (fault detection), qorshaynta waxsoosaarka iyo maamulidda hawlaha warshadaha. Isbeddelku kuma koobna beddelidda shaqaalaha, ee wuxuu sidoo kale saamaynayaa habdhiska waxsoosaarka, hawljoogtaynta (business continuity) iyo xirfadaha looga baahan yahay hawlwadeennada. Gaadiidku waa qayb kale oo teknolajiyadda casriga ahi saamayn ku yeelanayso. Baabuurta iskood isu wada iyo gaadiidka xamuulka ah ee lagu rakibo nidaamyada iswada ayaa laga sameeyay horumar farsamo, inkasta oo aanay weli si buuxda uga hirgelin dunida oo dhan. Badbaadada, kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, xaaladaha waddooyinka iyo shuruucda ayaa weli caqabad ku ah baahinta adeegyadan. Horumarkoodu, haddii uu sii baaho, wuxuu beddeli karaa qaybo ka mid ah hawlihii darawallada iyo shaqaalaha gaadiidku qaban jireen. Saamaynta garaadgacmeedku kuma eka shaqooyinka gacanta ama adeegyada joogtada ah. Waxaa soo baxaya in xitaa shaqooyinkii lagu tilmaami jiray kuwo maskaxeed ay la kulmayaan isbeddel weyn. Turjumaadda aasaasiga ah, tusaale ahaan, waxaa si muuqata u beddelay aalado ay ka mid yihiin Google Translate iyo barnaamijyada garaadgacmeedka ee wax soo saara (Generative AI). Qoraallo gaagaaban, sharraxaadaha suuqgeynta, farriimaha ganacsiga iyo qabyoqoraallada wararka ayaa iyaguna ka mid noqday hawlaha barnaamijyadani fududayn karaan. Halkaas waxaa ka dhashay baahi cusub oo loo qabo xaqiijinta xogaha, tifaftirka iyo ilaalinta tayada qoraallada. In barnaamij uu qoraal diyaarin karo macnaheedu ma aha in qoraalkaasi sax yahay, dhammaystiranyahay ama ku habboonyahay ulajeeddadii laga lahaa. Sidaas awgeed, hawlaha u baahan garasho sarraysa, hubinta xaqiiqooyinka iyo masuuliyad xirfadeed ayaa weli door weyn ku leh waxsoosaarka aqooneed. Arrimahan oo dhan marka la eego, waxay u muuqan kartaa in garaadgacmeedku yahay teknolajiyad loogu talagalay in shaqaalaha lagu beddelo. Sawirka dhabta ahi intaas wuu ka ballaaran yahay. Shaqooyinka qaarkood oo meesha ka baxaya ama hawlahooda la fududaynayo waxaa barbar socda xirfado iyo fursado shaqo oo cusub. Qoraal ay Madasha Dhaqaalaha Adduunku baahisay 15kii Janaayo 2026, kuna salaysan xogta LinkedIn, ayaa lagu sheegay in 1.3 milyan oo shaqooyin cusub oo garaadgacmeedka la xiriira ay soo baxeen laba sano gudahood. Shaqooyinkaas waxaa ka mid ah injineerrada garaadgacmeedka, khubarrada xogta (data specialists) iyo shaqaalaha diyaariya, qiimeeya ama summadeeya xogaha (data annotators) lagu tababaro nidaamyada cusub. Tiradani waxay marag u tahay in garaadgacmeedku abuurayo qaybo cusub oo suuqa shaqada ka mid ah. Haseyeeshee, lagama dhadhansan karo in tirada shaqooyinka cusub ay ka badan tahay dhammaan shaqooyinka lumay, maaddaama xogtaasi aysan ahayn xisaab guud oo isku dheellitiraysa shaqooyinka la abuuray iyo kuwa meesha ka baxay. Waxaa intaas dheer in garaadgacmeedku uusan si siman u saamaynayn xirfadaha kala duwan. Shaqooyinka ku dhisan xiriirka dadka, garashada duruufaha bulshada, halabuurka qotodheer iyo go’aanqaadashada masuuliyadda leh ayaa weli leh dhinacyo ay adag tahay in nidaamyo iswada si buuxda u qabtaan. Dhakhtarka qalliinka sameeya, tusaale ahaan, wuxuu u baahan yahay aqoon caafimaad, waaya-aragnimo iyo go’aanqaadasho ku dhisan xaaladda bukaanka. Inkasta oo robootyada casriga ahi ka qaybqaataan qalliinno qaarkood, haddana masuuliyadda hawsha iyo go’aannada caafimaadku waxay weli u baahan yihiin khubarro caafimaad. Macallinka fahmaya duruufaha ardayga, la socda horumarkiisa aqooneed, garanayana caqabadaha waxbarasho ee horyaalla, isaguna wuxuu qabtaa hawl aan ku koobnayn gudbinta macluumaadka. Waxbarashadu waa geeddisocod ku dhisan garaad-kobcin, garaad-qaabayn, xiriir aadane iyo dhaxalsiin aqooneed. Aaladaha garaadgacmeedku waxay kaalin ka qaadan karaan hawlahaas, mase fududa in ay dhammaantood beddelaan. Sidoo kale, lataliyayaasha caafimaadka maanka, hoggaamiyeyaasha hay’adaha iyo dadka ku hawlan xallinta mushkiladaha murugsan waxay adeegsadaan waaya-aragnimo, fahan duruufo iyo garasho bulsheed. Meelahaas, teknolajiyaddu waxay ka geysan kartaa gacan laxaad leh, gebi ahaanse lama wareegi karto. Marka laga gudbo shaqooyinka uu garaadgacmeedku beddeli karo, waxaa mudan in la eego xirfadaha looga baahan doono shaqaalaha mustaqbalka. Daraasad ay IMF soo bandhigay Janaayo 2026 ayaa muujisay in tobankii fursadood ee shaqo ee laga shaaciyo dalalka dhaqaalahoodu horumaray, ku dhowaad mid ka mid ahi u baahan yahay ugu yaraan hal xirfad oo cusub. Dalalka dhaqaalahoodu soo korayana saamigaasi wuxuu ku dhow yahay labaatankii fursadoodba mid. Isla daraasaddu waxay tilmaantay in shaqooyinka looga baahan yahay xirfadaha cusub ay mushaar dheeraad ah yeelan karaan. Saamayntaasise ma wada gaarto shaqaalaha oo dhan. Dadka ku jira shaqooyinka qaarkood, gaar ahaan dhallinyarada xirfadahooda bilowga ah ku shaqaysa, ayaa wajihi kara caqabado la xiriira yaraanshaha fursadaha shaqaalaysiinta iyo isbeddelka baahida loo qabo xirfadihii ay barteen. Xogahani waxay muujinayaan in laqabsiga garaadgacmeedku uusan ahayn masuuliyad saaran shaqaalaha oo keliya. Hay’adaha waxbarashada, shirkadaha iyo dawladuhuba waxay door ku leeyihiin diyaarinta xirfadaha cusub, horumarinta tababarrada iyo fududaynta, si shaqaaluhu ula jaanqaadaan isbeddelka suuqa shaqada. Arrintani waxay, sidoo kale, muhiim u tahay Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhallinyarada ku hawlan waxbarashada, ganacsiga, adeegyada, warbaahinta iyo xirfadaha teknolajiyadda. Inta ay aaladaha garaadgacmeedku ku sii fidayaan qaybahaas, waxaa sii kordhaya baahida loo qabo fahanka adeegsiga teknolajiyadda, xaqiijinta xogaha iyo ilaalinta tayada shaqada. Waxaana lagamamaarmaan ah in la tixgeliyo duruufaha gaarka ah ee dalka, sida helitaanka waxbarasho iyo tababbar, kaabayaasha teknolajiyadda iyo awoodda ganacsiyada. Suuqa shaqada ee ku sii tiirsanaanaya nidaamyada dhijitaalka ah waxaa kale oo soo foodsaari kara khataro la xiriira xogsiraysiga (confidentiality), xogsugidda (integrity) iyo badqabka macluumaadka. Shaqaalaha iyo adeegsadayaasha nidaamyadaasi waxay u baahan yihiin wacyiqab saybar (cyber awareness), si ay u fahmaan halisaha la xiriira xogaha shaqada iyo ilaalinta macluumaadka gaarka ah. Inkasta oo arrimahani aysan si toos ah u ahayn shaqooyinka uu garaadgacmeedku beddeli karo, haddana waxay ka mid yihiin aqoonta loo baahan yahay marka hawlaha shaqada loo wareejinayo adeegyada dhijitaalka ah. Sooyaalka horumarka teknolajiyaddu wuxuu ina barayaa in hal-abuur kasta oo cusub uu wax ka beddelo habnololeedka iyo shaqooyinka bulshada. Markii internetku baahay, waxaa soo baxay welwel la xiriiray shaqooyinka iyo ganacsiyadii uu saamayn lahaa. Dabadeed waxaa hanaqaaday adeegyo, meherado iyo xirfado cusub oo aan markii hore jirin. Geeddisocodkaas waxaa laga dheehan karaa sida teknolajiyaddu mararka qaarkood u beddesho shaqooyinkii hore, isla markaana u curiso fursado kale. Garaadgacmeedku wuxuu horseedi karaa isbeddel la mid ah, in kasta oo aan weli si buuxda loo saadaalin karin baaxadda saamayntiisa iyo sida ay faa’iidooyinka iyo khasaaruhu ugu kala qaybsami doonaan shaqaalaha, shirkadaha iyo dalalka dunida. Xuddunta dooddu, sida muuqata, ma aha oo keliya in garaadgacmeedku shaqooyinka dadka la wareegi doono iyo in kale. Waxaa iyaduna muhiim ah in la fahmo sida uu u beddelayo xirfadaha, waxsoosaarka iyo habka dadku u shaqeeyaan. Qofka bartay adeegsiga aaladaha cusub, kuna dara aqoon iyo xirfad sugan, wuxuu yeelan karaa fursado uu kula jaanqaado baahiyaha soo kordhaya. Mustaqbalka shaqadu uma eka mid ay mashiinnadu keli ku noqon doonaan, mana aha mid ay dadku hawlahoodii hore u qaban doonaan iyada oo aysan waxba iska beddelin. Waxaa muuqda suuq shaqo oo dib isu qaabaynaya, xirfado cusubna u baahan; suuq ay aqoonta, hal-abuurka, laqabsiga teknolajiyadda iyo garashada aadamuhu weli muhiimad weyn ku yeelan doonaan. Ugu danbayn, waxaa la gudboon shaqaalaha maanta in ay dib u eegaan xirfadahooda, aqoontooda kobciyaan, una diyaar garoobaan isbeddelka socda. Waayo, waxa mustaqbalka shaqada go’aaminaya kuma koobna awoodda ay mashiinnadu yeeshaan, ee waxaa qayb weyn ku leh sida bulshooyinku u maareeyaan teknolajiyadda, shaqaalahoodana ugu diyaariyaan ka faa’iidaysigeeda.

Horumarkoodu, haddii uu sii baaho, wuxuu beddeli karaa qaybo ka mid ah hawlihii darawallada iyo shaqaalaha gaadiidku qaban jireen. Saamaynta garaadgacmeedku kuma eka shaqooyinka gacanta ama adeegyada joogtada ah. Waxaa soo baxaya in xitaa shaqooyinkii lagu tilmaami jiray kuwo maskaxeed ay la kulmayaan isbeddel weyn. Turjumaadda aasaasiga ah, tusaale ahaan, waxaa si muuqata u beddelay aalado ay ka mid yihiin Google Translate iyo barnaamijyada garaadgacmeedka ee wax soo saara (Generative AI). Qoraallo gaagaaban, sharraxaadaha suuqgeynta, farriimaha ganacsiga iyo qabyoqoraallada wararka ayaa iyaguna ka mid noqday hawlaha barnaamijyadani fududayn karaan. Halkaas waxaa ka dhashay baahi cusub oo loo qabo xaqiijinta xogaha, tifaftirka iyo ilaalinta tayada qoraallada. In barnaamij uu qoraal diyaarin karo macnaheedu ma aha in qoraalkaasi sax yahay, dhammaystiranyahay ama ku habboonyahay ulajeeddadii laga lahaa. Sidaas awgeed, hawlaha u baahan garasho sarraysa, hubinta xaqiiqooyinka iyo masuuliyad xirfadeed ayaa weli door weyn ku leh waxsoosaarka aqooneed. Arrimahan oo dhan marka la eego, waxay u muuqan kartaa in garaadgacmeedku yahay teknolajiyad loogu talagalay in shaqaalaha lagu beddelo. Sawirka dhabta ahi intaas wuu ka ballaaran yahay. Shaqooyinka qaarkood oo meesha ka baxaya ama hawlahooda la fududaynayo waxaa barbar socda xirfado iyo fursado shaqo oo cusub. Qoraal ay Madasha Dhaqaalaha Adduunku baahisay 15kii Janaayo 2026, kuna salaysan xogta LinkedIn, ayaa lagu sheegay in 1.3 milyan oo shaqooyin cusub oo garaadgacmeedka la xiriira ay soo baxeen laba sano gudahood. Shaqooyinkaas waxaa ka mid ah injineerrada garaadgacmeedka, khubarrada xogta (data specialists) iyo shaqaalaha diyaariya, qiimeeya ama summadeeya xogaha (data annotators) lagu tababaro nidaamyada cusub. Tiradani waxay marag u tahay in garaadgacmeedku abuurayo qaybo cusub oo suuqa shaqada ka mid ah. Haseyeeshee, lagama dhadhansan karo in tirada shaqooyinka cusub ay ka badan tahay dhammaan shaqooyinka lumay, maaddaama xogtaasi aysan ahayn xisaab guud oo isku dheellitiraysa shaqooyinka la abuuray iyo kuwa meesha ka baxay. Waxaa intaas dheer in garaadgacmeedku uusan si siman u saamaynayn xirfadaha kala duwan. Shaqooyinka ku dhisan xiriirka dadka, garashada duruufaha bulshada, halabuurka qotodheer iyo go’aanqaadashada masuuliyadda leh ayaa weli leh dhinacyo ay adag tahay in nidaamyo iswada si buuxda u qabtaan. Dhakhtarka qalliinka sameeya, tusaale ahaan, wuxuu u baahan yahay aqoon caafimaad, waaya-aragnimo iyo go’aanqaadasho ku dhisan xaaladda bukaanka. Inkasta oo robootyada casriga ahi ka qaybqaataan qalliinno qaarkood, haddana masuuliyadda hawsha iyo go’aannada caafimaadku waxay weli u baahan yihiin khubarro caafimaad. Macallinka fahmaya duruufaha ardayga, la socda horumarkiisa aqooneed, garanayana caqabadaha waxbarasho ee horyaalla, isaguna wuxuu qabtaa hawl aan ku koobnayn gudbinta macluumaadka. Waxbarashadu waa geeddisocod ku dhisan garaad-kobcin, garaad-qaabayn, xiriir aadane iyo dhaxalsiin aqooneed. Aaladaha garaadgacmeedku waxay kaalin ka qaadan karaan hawlahaas, mase fududa in ay dhammaantood beddelaan. Sidoo kale, lataliyayaasha caafimaadka maanka, hoggaamiyeyaasha hay’adaha iyo dadka ku hawlan xallinta mushkiladaha murugsan waxay adeegsadaan waaya-aragnimo, fahan duruufo iyo garasho bulsheed. Meelahaas, teknolajiyaddu waxay ka geysan kartaa gacan laxaad leh, gebi ahaanse lama wareegi karto. Marka laga gudbo shaqooyinka uu garaadgacmeedku beddeli karo, waxaa mudan in la eego xirfadaha looga baahan doono shaqaalaha mustaqbalka. Daraasad ay IMF soo bandhigay Janaayo 2026 ayaa muujisay in tobankii fursadood ee shaqo ee laga shaaciyo dalalka dhaqaalahoodu horumaray, ku dhowaad mid ka mid ahi u baahan yahay ugu yaraan hal xirfad oo cusub. Dalalka dhaqaalahoodu soo korayana saamigaasi wuxuu ku dhow yahay labaatankii fursadoodba mid. Isla daraasaddu waxay tilmaantay in shaqooyinka looga baahan yahay xirfadaha cusub ay mushaar dheeraad ah yeelan karaan. Saamayntaasise ma wada gaarto shaqaalaha oo dhan. Dadka ku jira shaqooyinka qaarkood, gaar ahaan dhallinyarada xirfadahooda bilowga ah ku shaqaysa, ayaa wajihi kara caqabado la xiriira yaraanshaha fursadaha shaqaalaysiinta iyo isbeddelka baahida loo qabo xirfadihii ay barteen. Xogahani waxay muujinayaan in laqabsiga garaadgacmeedku uusan ahayn masuuliyad saaran shaqaalaha oo keliya. Hay’adaha waxbarashada, shirkadaha iyo dawladuhuba waxay door ku leeyihiin diyaarinta xirfadaha cusub, horumarinta tababarrada iyo fududaynta, si shaqaaluhu ula jaanqaadaan isbeddelka suuqa shaqada. Arrintani waxay, sidoo kale, muhiim u tahay Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhallinyarada ku hawlan waxbarashada, ganacsiga, adeegyada, warbaahinta iyo xirfadaha teknolajiyadda. Inta ay aaladaha garaadgacmeedku ku sii fidayaan qaybahaas, waxaa sii kordhaya baahida loo qabo fahanka adeegsiga teknolajiyadda, xaqiijinta xogaha iyo ilaalinta tayada shaqada. Waxaana lagamamaarmaan ah in la tixgeliyo duruufaha gaarka ah ee dalka, sida helitaanka waxbarasho iyo tababbar, kaabayaasha teknolajiyadda iyo awoodda ganacsiyada. Suuqa shaqada ee ku sii tiirsanaanaya nidaamyada dhijitaalka ah waxaa kale oo soo foodsaari kara khataro la xiriira xogsiraysiga (confidentiality), xogsugidda (integrity) iyo badqabka macluumaadka. Shaqaalaha iyo adeegsadayaasha nidaamyadaasi waxay u baahan yihiin wacyiqab saybar (cyber awareness), si ay u fahmaan halisaha la xiriira xogaha shaqada iyo ilaalinta macluumaadka gaarka ah. Inkasta oo arrimahani aysan si toos ah u ahayn shaqooyinka uu garaadgacmeedku beddeli karo, haddana waxay ka mid yihiin aqoonta loo baahan yahay marka hawlaha shaqada loo wareejinayo adeegyada dhijitaalka ah. Sooyaalka horumarka teknolajiyaddu wuxuu ina barayaa in hal-abuur kasta oo cusub uu wax ka beddelo habnololeedka iyo shaqooyinka bulshada. Markii internetku baahay, waxaa soo baxay welwel la xiriiray shaqooyinka iyo ganacsiyadii uu saamayn lahaa. Dabadeed waxaa hanaqaaday adeegyo, meherado iyo xirfado cusub oo aan markii hore jirin. Geeddisocodkaas waxaa laga dheehan karaa sida teknolajiyaddu mararka qaarkood u beddesho shaqooyinkii hore, isla markaana u curiso fursado kale. Garaadgacmeedku wuxuu horseedi karaa isbeddel la mid ah, in kasta oo aan weli si buuxda loo saadaalin karin baaxadda saamayntiisa iyo sida ay faa’iidooyinka iyo khasaaruhu ugu kala qaybsami doonaan shaqaalaha, shirkadaha iyo dalalka dunida. Xuddunta dooddu, sida muuqata, ma aha oo keliya in garaadgacmeedku shaqooyinka dadka la wareegi doono iyo in kale. Waxaa iyaduna muhiim ah in la fahmo sida uu u beddelayo xirfadaha, waxsoosaarka iyo habka dadku u shaqeeyaan. Qofka bartay adeegsiga aaladaha cusub, kuna dara aqoon iyo xirfad sugan, wuxuu yeelan karaa fursado uu kula jaanqaado baahiyaha soo kordhaya. Mustaqbalka shaqadu uma eka mid ay mashiinnadu keli ku noqon doonaan, mana aha mid ay dadku hawlahoodii hore u qaban doonaan iyada oo aysan waxba iska beddelin. Waxaa muuqda suuq shaqo oo dib isu qaabaynaya, xirfado cusubna u baahan; suuq ay aqoonta, hal-abuurka, laqabsiga teknolajiyadda iyo garashada aadamuhu weli muhiimad weyn ku yeelan doonaan. Ugu danbayn, waxaa la gudboon shaqaalaha maanta in ay dib u eegaan xirfadahooda, aqoontooda kobciyaan, una diyaar garoobaan isbeddelka socda. Waayo, waxa mustaqbalka shaqada go’aaminaya kuma koobna awoodda ay mashiinnadu yeeshaan, ee waxaa qayb weyn ku leh sida bulshooyinku u maareeyaan teknolajiyadda, shaqaalahoodana ugu diyaariyaan ka faa’iidaysigeeda.

items.title: Daawo: Natiijada doorashada HirShabelle oo la shaaciyay
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa maanta magaalada Jowhar kaga dhawaaqay natiijada doorashadii maalmo kahor ka dhacday deegaannada Dowlad-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee HirShabelle. Guddoomiyaha guddiga, Cabdikariim Axmed Xasan ayaa sheegay in doorashadu ka qabsoontay 10 degmo, iyadoo tartanka ay ka qayb galeen 13 urur siyaasadeed oo ku loollamay 99 kursi oo Golaha Wakiillada ah. Tirada guud ee codadka la dhiibtay ayaa gaartay 114,633, waxaana guddigu sheegay in 112,451 kamid ah ay ahaayeen codad ansax ah, halka 2,182 cod loo aqoonsaday kuwo aan ansax ahayn. Natiijada la shaaciyay ayaa muujineysa in ururka Caddaalad iyo Midnimadda Tiir uu ku guuleystay 759 cod iyo hal kursi, halka Madalsan uu isna helay 911 cod iyo hal kursi. Ururka Muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ayaa helay 122 cod iyo hal kursi, halka Dimuqraadiga Soomaaliyeed uu ku guuleystay 2,368 cod iyo laba kursi. Caddaaladda iyo Wadajir ayaa noqday ururka ugu codadka badan, isagoo helay 88,130 cod iyo 78 kursi halka Dadka Soomaaliyeed uu helay 113 cod, balse uusan wax kursi ah ku guuleysan. Sidoo kale, Ururka Iftiin Qaran ayaa helay 6,165 cod iyo shan kursi, halka Karaama uu helay 6,875 cod iyo lix kursi. Ururka Saab ayaa sidoo kale helay 120 cod, balse uusan wax kursi ah ku guuleysan, halka Dan Shacab uu isna helay 51 cod, mana helin wax kursi ah. Ururka Sincad ayaa helay 3,701 cod iyo saddex kursi, halka Dhallinyarada Talo-Qaran ay heleen 97 cod, balse uusan wax kursi ah ku guuleysan. Ugu dambeyn Ururka Ramaas ayaa isna helay 1,939 cod iyo laba kursi. Doorashadan ayaa qayb ka ah hannaanka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo guddigu sheegay in doorashooyinku ay u dhaceen si nabdoon oo xor ah. Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in howlaha ka socda dowlad-goboleedyada iyo Banaadir ay qayb ka yihiin diyaar-garowga doorashooyinka heer federaal ee Soomaaliya. The post Daawo: Natiijada doorashada HirShabelle oo la shaaciyay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: JSP oo 78 Kursi Ka Helay Baarlamaanka Hirshabeelle
items.description: Jowhar, 3 Oktoobar 2026 — Doorashada Baarlamaanka Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle ayaa gashay marxalad cusub, kaddib markii la sheegay in Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) uu helay 78 ka mid ah 99-ka kursi ee Baarlamaanka Hirshabeelle sida uu ku dhawaaqay Guddiga doorashooyinka. Tirada kuraasta uu helay JSP ayaa siinaysa ururka aqlabiyad ballaaran oo Baarlamaanka ah, iyadoo Madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe), uu yahay musharraxa JSP ee xilka hoggaanka maamulka. JSP ayaa 13-kii Sebtembar si rasmi ah Guudlaawe ugu dhawaaqay musharraxiisa doorashada Hirshabeelle. Haddii natiijada 78-ka kursi ay sidaas ku dhammaato, waxay JSP siinaysaa awood baarlamaan oo weyn marka la gaaro doorashada hoggaamiyaha maamulka, iyadoo Guudlaawe uu yahay musharraxa xisbiga. Si kastaba, geeddi-socodka doorashada ayaa waxaa hareeyay khilaaf siyaasadeed, gaar ahaan gobolka Hiiraan. Siyaasiyiin iyo odayaal dhaqameed ayaa ku baaqay in doorashada lagu saleeyo heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, halka qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta Hiiraan ay ka soo horjeedaan in doorashada lagu qabto qaabka hadda socda. Dhanka kale, dowladda federaalka ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ku adkeysanaysay in dalka loo gudbo nidaam doorasho oo qof iyo cod ah, iyadoo sheegtay in wada-hadallada siyaasadeed ay weli furan yihiin. Doorashada Hirshabeelle waxay sidoo kale kusoo beegmaysaa xilli aan weli heshiis siyaasadeed laga gaarin qaabka iyo maamulka doorashada federaalka, iyadoo dowladda iyo mucaaradku ay ku kala aragti duwan yihiin nidaamka doorashada, hay’adaha maamulaya iyo habka loo gaari karo heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay. Sidaas darteed, doorashada Hirshabeelle waxay noqotay mid si dhow loola xiriirinayo loolanka siyaasadeed ee doorashada federaalka, iyadoo natiijada ka soo baxda Jowhar ay saameyn ku yeelan karto isku dheelitirka siyaasadeed ee dalka xilli Soomaaliya ay isu diyaarinayso doorashooyinka heer federaal.

items.title: Jaamac oo qaaday tallaabo guul u ah Soomaaliya + Sawirro
items.description: Arusha (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa Jimcihii guddoomiyey kulanka 21-aad ee guddoonka guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC) kaas oo lagu qabtay magaalada Arusha ee Dalka Tanzania, iyadoo guddoominta shirkan ay guul wayn u tahay Soomaaliya. Jaamac ayaa hadda ah guddoomiyaha guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika, taas oo u suuragelisay fursaddan muhiimka ah, waxaana shirka diiradda lagu saaray arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan xaaladda waddamada ku bahoobay ururka EAC. Inta uu socday kulanka ayaa waxaa si gaar ah looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga baarlamaannada, horumarinta diblomaasiyadda baarlamaaniga ah, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha, iyo xaqiijinta in is-dhexgalka Bariga Afrika uu shucuubta Bariga Afrika u horseedo faa’iidooyin la taaban karo. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa ugu horreyn xubnaha kulanka ka qeyb galay la wadaagay horumarka uu sameeyey Baarlamaanka 11-aad ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska, dhameystirka iyo ansixinta Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, amniga iyo sarreynta sharciga, maamulka maaliyadda guud iyo sidoo kale horumarinta dhaqaalaha, isagoo tilmaamay in Goluhu uu ansixiyey in ka badan 56 sharci iyo 18 qaraar. Sidoo kale, guddoomiye Jaamac ayaa tilmaamay in himilada Golaha Shacabka ay tahay in si buuxda uu u guto waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee saaran, gaar ahaan sharci-dejinta iyo korjoogteynta, inuu u adeego danaha Shacabka Soomaaliyeed, islamarkaana uu gacan ka geysto xoojinta iskaashiga iyo is-dhexgalka Bulshada Bariga Afrika. Waxaa kale oo uu carabka ku adkeeyey in mustaqbalka Bulshada Bariga Afrika uu ku tiirsan yahay iskaashi xooggan, hay’ado adkaysi leh iyo baarlamaanno si wax-ku-ool ah uga shaqeeya danaha iyo himilooyinka shucuubtooda, sidoo kalena Soomaaliya ay ka go’antahay inay kaalinteeda si buuxda uga qaadato sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in iyadoo arrimahaasi laga duulayo Soomaaliya ay ku faraxsan tahay inay xaqiijiso diyaar-garowgeeda ku aaddan martigelinta Kulanka 22-aad ee Guddoonka Guddoomiyeyaasha Baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC), kaas oo lagu qaban doono Caasimadda Dalka ee Muqdisho dhammaadka bisha Janaayo ee sanadka 2027. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu rajo wanaagsan ka muujiyey in caasimadda Soomaaliya ee Muqdisho lagu soo dhoweeyo guddoonka guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika, si loo xoojiyo dadaalada wadajirka ah ee ku aaddan dhismaha Bulshada Bariga Afrika oo mideysan, barwaaqo ah, kuna naaloota nabad waarta. items.fullContent: Arusha (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa Jimcihii guddoomiyey kulanka 21-aad ee guddoonka guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC) kaas oo lagu qabtay magaalada Arusha ee Dalka Tanzania, iyadoo guddoominta shirkan ay guul wayn u tahay Soomaaliya. Jaamac ayaa hadda ah guddoomiyaha guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika, taas oo u suuragelisay fursaddan muhiimka ah, waxaana shirka diiradda lagu saaray arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan xaaladda waddamada ku bahoobay ururka EAC. Inta uu socday kulanka ayaa waxaa si gaar ah looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga baarlamaannada, horumarinta diblomaasiyadda baarlamaaniga ah, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha, iyo xaqiijinta in is-dhexgalka Bariga Afrika uu shucuubta Bariga Afrika u horseedo faa’iidooyin la taaban karo. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa ugu horreyn xubnaha kulanka ka qeyb galay la wadaagay horumarka uu sameeyey Baarlamaanka 11-aad ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska, dhameystirka iyo ansixinta Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, amniga iyo sarreynta sharciga, maamulka maaliyadda guud iyo sidoo kale horumarinta dhaqaalaha, isagoo tilmaamay in Goluhu uu ansixiyey in ka badan 56 sharci iyo 18 qaraar. Sidoo kale, guddoomiye Jaamac ayaa tilmaamay in himilada Golaha Shacabka ay tahay in si buuxda uu u guto waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee saaran, gaar ahaan sharci-dejinta iyo korjoogteynta, inuu u adeego danaha Shacabka Soomaaliyeed, islamarkaana uu gacan ka geysto xoojinta iskaashiga iyo is-dhexgalka Bulshada Bariga Afrika. Waxaa kale oo uu carabka ku adkeeyey in mustaqbalka Bulshada Bariga Afrika uu ku tiirsan yahay iskaashi xooggan, hay’ado adkaysi leh iyo baarlamaanno si wax-ku-ool ah uga shaqeeya danaha iyo himilooyinka shucuubtooda, sidoo kalena Soomaaliya ay ka go’antahay inay kaalinteeda si buuxda uga qaadato sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in iyadoo arrimahaasi laga duulayo Soomaaliya ay ku faraxsan tahay inay xaqiijiso diyaar-garowgeeda ku aaddan martigelinta Kulanka 22-aad ee Guddoonka Guddoomiyeyaasha Baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC), kaas oo lagu qaban doono Caasimadda Dalka ee Muqdisho dhammaadka bisha Janaayo ee sanadka 2027. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu rajo wanaagsan ka muujiyey in caasimadda Soomaaliya ee Muqdisho lagu soo dhoweeyo guddoonka guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika, si loo xoojiyo dadaalada wadajirka ah ee ku aaddan dhismaha Bulshada Bariga Afrika oo mideysan, barwaaqo ah, kuna naaloota nabad waarta. items.title: Askari saaxiibkiis u dilay caro uu ka qaaday Turub ay wada ciyaarayeen oo la xukumay
items.description: Eedeysane Dable Booliska Nuur Ibraahim Sahal, ayaa lagu soo eedeyay dembiga ah dil kas ah oo uu u geeystay Marxuum Ex Dable Booliska Libaan Nuux Sooc oo ay kawada tirsanaayeen Ciidanka laanta ilaalada canshuuraha Booliska, falkaasi, ayaana ka dhacay degmadda Xamar jajab, taariikhdu markii ay aheyd labo iyo tobankii bishii todobaad ee Sanadkaan 2026. Eedeysanaha ayaa ka carooday in loo diiday Turub ay askartu dheelayeen, madaama loo arkay in uusan wax aqoon ah u laheyn Ciyaarta, waxaana uu doontay Qori AK-47 ah, si xoog uu ugu Ciyaaro, marxuumka ayaana isna ku adkeystay go’aanka Diidmada Turubka uu isagu lahaa. Intaasi kadib Eedeysane Nuur, ayaa aflagaado iyo xabado tiro beel ah is daba dhigay, isaggoo adeegsanaya Qori Ak-47 ah, taasi oo keentay geerida Marxuum Ex Dable Booliska Liibaan Nuux Sooc. Baaris dheer ka dib Xafiiska Xeer ilaalinta Ciidamadda qalabka sida, ayaa Codsaday qaadista kiiskaan, Waxaana laga oggolaaday Kowdii Bishaan October 2026. Garsoorka Maxkamadda ciidamada qalabka sida oo waqti ku filan siiyey dhinacyadda dacwadda ayaa ugu dambeyn maanta ku xukumay Ex-Dable Booliska Nuur Ibraahim Sahal Dil Toogasho oo ah Qisaasta Marxuum Ex Dable Booliska Liibaan Nuux Sooc. Sida uu warbaahinta u sheegay Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda darajada 1aad ee Ciidamada qalabka sida, Gaashaanle sare Xasan Cali Nuur Shuute.
