items.title: Saraakiisha cusub ee Guutada 22aad Gorgor oo lagu dhaariyay TURKSOM (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Saraakiisha iyo Saraakiil Xigeenada Guutada 22aad ee Ciidanka Kumaandooska Gorgor ayaa lagu dhaariyay munaasabad ka dhacday Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee TURKSOM ee duleedka Magaalada Muqdisho. Kaaliyaha Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Maadey Nuurey Sheekh Ufurow, Taliyaha Taliska Tababarada & Doctrine-ka ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Axmed Ciise Axmed iyo Saraakiil kale oo ka kala tirsan Militariga Somaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa ka qaybgalay munasabadda dhaarinta. “Munaasabadda ayaa lagu muujiyay diyaargarowga, anshaxa iyo heeganka ciidanka cusub, kuwaas oo loo diyaariyay inay gutaan waajibaadkooda qaran, difaacaan dalka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isla-markaana u adeegaan ilaalinta amniga iyo midnimada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Somaliya.” Ayaa lagu yiri war maanta lagu daabacay bogga wararka ee Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Kaaliyaha Taliyaha Militariga Somaliya ayaa ciidamada kula dardaarmay inay ilaaliyaan anshaxa, wadajirka, daacadnimada iyo waajibaadka qaranimo, iyagoo mar walba dhowraya sharciga iyo karaamada shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Turkiga oo ah xulafo muhiim ah oo Somaliya ay leedahay ayaa xoojinaya dhismaha iyo tababarka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, wuxuuna sanad kasta soo saaraa cutubyo cusub oo biira ciidamada. Turkiga ayaa door weyn ka qaata tababarka iyo qalabaynta ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee loo diyaarinayo in ay si buuxda ula wareegaan amniga iyo difaaca dalka. Saldhigga TURKSOM oo qaab casri ah loo dhisay ayaa ah saldhigga ugu weyn ee Saraakiisha Militariga Turkiga ay ku tababaraan ciidamada cusub.

items.title: Somalia won’t accept Israeli presence ‘under any circumstances’: President Hassan Sheikh
items.description: Somalia will not accept Israeli presence in the country “under any circumstances” and will resist any attempts to be pulled into the Middle East’s crises, its President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud tells Al Jazeera. Speaking in an exclusive interview, Mohamud said that Israel was planning to establish a naval base in Berbera and use the city’s airport, adding that its real aim was to get closer to the Gulf states and Iran. Berbera is a port city on the Gulf of Aden coast in Somaliland – the self-declared republic in northwestern Somalia that Israel recognised last year, but which is claimed by Mogadishu. Berbera faces Yemen across the water near the strategic Bab al-Mandeb strait. The Iran-aligned Houthis have previously enforced a blockade on Israel-linked ships in the area. “We will overcome the challenges posed to our country by Israeli moves,” Mohamud said in his wide-ranging interview. He added that the Israeli plans fall under the “ Greater Israel ” project – referring to a term for various proposals, often rooted in biblical interpretations, for Israeli control over territory beyond its current borders. Some versions extend from the Nile to the Euphrates. Israel has not adopted it as official policy, but Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in an August 2025 interview that he felt connected to the vision, prompting condemnation from Arab governments. The Somali president described Israel as a “destabilising force” that does not abide by international law. He also criticised Tel Aviv’s recognition of Somaliland in December. No country other than Israel recognises Somaliland, while the region’s own residents are completely opposed to an Israeli presence, Mohamud said. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 and has governed itself independently for more than three decades. But it had not secured recognition from any United Nations member state until Israel’s move. Fight against armed groups The Somali president told Al Jazeera the United States remains his country’s strongest partner in the fight against “terrorism”, and added that al-Shabab has no presence in the major cities, leaving no possibility of the group taking control in Somalia. Al-Shabab is a Somali armed group that emerged from the Islamic Courts Union in the mid-2000s and pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012. It has fought Somalia’s federal government for years, holds territory in parts of southern and central Somalia, and has carried out deadly attacks, including in Mogadishu and in neighbouring Kenya. Regarding the East Africa region, Mohamud said Somalia’s relations with neighbouring Ethiopia are good, and Mogadishu does not object to Addis Ababa gaining access to the sea through a joint agreement to use Somali ports for its economic interests. Ethiopia has been landlocked since Eritrea became independent in 1993 and relies largely on Djibouti’s ports for trade. In January 2024, Addis Ababa signed a memorandum of understanding with Somaliland on sea access, which Somalia condemned as a violation of its sovereignty. Somalia and Ethiopia later agreed to ease tensions. Houthis ‘destabilising’ region Mohamud also accused Yemen’s Houthis of “destabilising the region” and disrupting navigation in the Bab al-Mandeb strait. His comments come as the group attempts to build on its lightning offensive that captured the country’s Red Sea coast last month. Thus far, Yemeni government forces have been able to hold their positions on the front lines and even claimed to have inflicted heavy losses against the Houthis. The Houthis have also intensified their attacks on Saudi Arabia, but the kingdom’s Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (MBS) has promised not to compromise on its security, saying the Yemeni rebels chose “chaos and destruction, threatening the Yemeni people and the region”. Al Jazeera.

items.title: Xaalad cusub oo kasoo korortay Koonfur Galbeed kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Xaalad cabsi iyo walaac xooggan ayaa ka dhalatay dagaalladii cuslaa ee maalmahan kusoo noqnoqday magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay, kuwaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Dagaalladan ayaa dhaliyay khasaare lixaadleh oo isugu jiro dhimasho, dhaawac, burbur iyo barakac ay sameeyeen dadka deegaanka, waxaana weli taagan cabsi horleh oo ku aadan in mar kale ay dagaalamaan labada dhinac oo weli isku horfadhiya bannaanka magaalada. Xidhibaan hore Maxamed Cumar Dalxa oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Shabelle Tv ayaa shaaca ka qaaday haddii aan wax laga qaban xaaladda taagan ay dagaallada kusii fidi karaan dhammaan deegaannada kale ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Hadda sow Baydhaba kama socda dagaalka, iyadoo tuulooyinka iyo degmooyinka uu ku fiday ayaad arkeysaa, yaa gurigiisa AK47 oolin? sidii shalay maanta ma aha,” ayuu yiri Dalxa. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ku baaqay in deganaan la muujiyo, isla arkaana wada-hadal iyo midnimo lagu wajaho xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo midda amni ee ka taagan Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. “Waxaan leeyahay baahashaan walaalow ayay ku fiican tahay Koonfur Galbeed oo la wada leeyahana ay ku suntanaato laakin dhabar iska taabashadan ma soconeyso,” ayuu sii raaciyay Xildhibaan hore Maxamed Cumar Dalxa oo kasoo jeedo deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyadoo haatan xaalad bandow ah lagu soo rogay Baydhaba, kaas oo xaddidaya dhaq-dhaqaaqa dadka iyo gaadiidka wixii ka dambeeya salaadda Maqrib. Go’aankan ayaa qayb ka ah tallaabooyin lagu xoojinayo amniga magaalada, iyadoo Baydhabo ay weli ka jirto xaalad amni oo u baahan feejignaan dheeraad ah iyo in si dhow loola socdo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ka dhacaya gudaha magaalada. The post Xaalad cusub oo kasoo korortay Koonfur Galbeed kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay iska horimaad ka dhacay Degmada Qoryooley
items.description: Kooxo hubeysan ayaa Sabtidan weerar ku qaaday Degmada Qoryooley ee Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose, halkaas oo la sheegay inay iska horimaad kula galeen Daraawiishta Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in kooxahan ay isku dayeen in ay isku fidiyaan degmada, balse ay ka hor istaaggeen Ciidamada Koonfur Galbeed. Warar is khilaafsan ayaa ka soo baxaya, waxa ay yihiin kooxda weerarka ku qaadday degmadaasi ee markii dambe dib looga saaray. Wararka qaar ayaa sheegaya in ay yihiin maleeshiyaad qaab beeleed u abaabulan, halka warar kalena ay sheegayaan in ay yihiin ciidamo taabacsan maamulka la magac-baxay Koonfur Bari, oo sheegtay in ay yihiin garab ka go’ay Koonfur Galbeed. Dadka deegaanka qaarkood ayaa laga soo xigtay in laba maleeshiyo beeleed ay ku dagaalameen gudaha degmada, maleeshiyo horey u joogtay degmada iyo mid dibadda ka soo duushay. Hase yeeshee Gudoomiyaha Degmada Qoryooley, Cabdi Axmed Cali oo mar dambe ka hadlay iska horimaadka ka dhacay degmadiisa ayaa ku waramay in ciidamo ka tirsan Koonfur Bari ay maanta soo weerareen Qoryooley. “Dagaalku wuxuu salka ku hayaa niman Koonfur Bari sheeganayo oo deegaanadan inay isku fidiyaan rabaan oo saldhiggooda uu Marka yahay.” Ayuu yiri Gudoomiyaha oo Universaltv la hadlay. Gudoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in Qoryooley ay ku sugan yihiin ciidan xoog leh oo ka tirsan Koonfur Galbeed, isla-markaana aysan qabsan karin koox dibadda ka soo duushay. items.title: Maxay ka wada-hadleen Xasan iyo Al-Sisi? + Sawirro
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta kulan gaar ah la qaatay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Carabta ee Masar, Mudane Cabdulfataax Al-Sisi, intii uu socday shir madaxeedka Madasha Ganacsiga Afrika ee ka socda magaalada cusub ee Al-Calamayn. Xasan iyo Al-Sisi ayaa kulankooda kaga wada-hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga taariikhiga ah ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Masar, iyaga oo si gaar ah diiradda u saaray dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, maalgashiga, ganacsiga iyo horumarinta iskaashiga labada dal. Labada Madaxweyne ayaa sidoo kale isla soo qaaday muhiimadda ay leedahay in la ballaariyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee labada dal, gaar ahaan fursadaha maalgashi iyo mashaariicda horumarineed ee kaalin ka qaadan kara kobcinta dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya iyo xoojinta xiriirka ganacsi ee labada dhinac. Kulanka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Madaxweyne Al-Sisi ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli labada dal ay muhiimad wayn siinayaan xoojinta xiriirkooda iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan, iyadoo Masar ay ka mid tahay dalalka Soomaaliya la leh xiriir diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashi muddo dheer soo jiray. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa haatan magaalada Al-Calamayn u tegay ka qeybgalka shir madaxeedka Madasha Ganacsiga Afrika, oo diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta iskaashiga dhaqaale, ganacsi iyo maalgashi ee dalalka qaaradda Afrika. Ka qeybgalka Soomaaliya ee madashan ayaa sidoo kale fursad u siinaya Dowladda Federaalka inay la kulanto madaxda iyo masuuliyiinta dalalka Afrika, isla markaana ay soo bandhigto fursadaha maalgashi ee ka jira Soomaaliya iyo qorshayaasha dowladda ee horumarinta dhaqaalaha dalka. Madasha Al-Calamayn ayaa loo qorsheeyay inay noqoto madal joogto ah oo labadii sanaba mar lagu qabto Masar, iyadoo ay si wadajir ah uga qeyb qaadanayaan dowladda Masar, Midowga Afrika, AUDA-NEPAD iyo Afreximbank The post Maxay ka wada-hadleen Xasan iyo Al-Sisi? + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sheekh Cali Wajiis: Ugaaska Xawaadle howl aan aheyn howshiisa ayuu galay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Sheekh Cali Maxamuud Xasan (Wajiis) oo kamid ah Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa si kulul uga hadlay xaaladda HirShabelle, gaar ahaan xiisadda ka taagan magaalada Beledweyne ee ka dhalatay doorashooyinkii ka dhacay halkaasi. Sheekh Cali Wajiis oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Telefishinka Somali Cable ayaa eedeyn culus u jeediyay Ugaaska Beesha Xawaadle, Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan Ugaas Khaliif oo isaga iyo siyaasiyiin kale ay haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wadaan magaalada Beledweyne, wuxuuna sheegay inuu gacmaha la galay arrimo uusan shaqo ku lahayn, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Ugaaska Xawaadle howl aan aheyn howshiisa ayuu galay, Ugaaska doorashooyin inuu galo ma ahan, mana loogu talagelin, Imaamka Mudulood iyo Ugaaska Mudulood oo doorasho ka hadlayo ma aragtay?,” ayuu wareysiga ku yiri Sheekh Cali Wajiis. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in doorka dhaqanka uu yahay inuu hoggaamiyo bulshada, sidoo kalena uu la shaqeeyo dowladda Soomaaliya. “Qaylada siyaasi ayaa iska leh waa nin u-gaarsada ah shabaq ayuu tuuranayaa waxbaa ugu soo dhacaayo dowladda ayuu rabaa inuu rux-ruxdo, laakiin dhaqan sidiisa waa dhowrsan yahay qabiil ayuuna hoggaamiyaa dowladdana waa la taliyaa,” ayuu mar kale yiri Sheekha. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Dhiiqo ayaa lala doonaayay Ugaaska, laakiin nasiib wanaag waa ka badbaaday lama gelin. Niman siyaasiyiin ah ayaa waxa ay rabeen in kaarka Ugaaska ay xoqdaan balse arrintaan Ugaaska ugu dmabeyn ka gaabsaday”. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, xilli ay weli tabasho qabto beesha Xawaadle oo ka hortimid sida loo wajahay doorashooyinkii dhawaan ka dhacay HirShabelle, kadib markii kaarka musharaxnimada ee JSP la siiyay Cali Guudlaawe oo mar kale u taagan xilka madaxweynaha. The post Sheekh Cali Wajiis: Ugaaska Xawaadle howl aan aheyn howshiisa ayuu galay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Steven Cook oo Sharraxay Sababaha Qaddiyadda Somaliland ay Muhiim Ugu Tahay Danaha Maraykanka
items.description: Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) oo soo bandhigtay sida Aqoonsigga Somaliland muhiim ugu yahay Danaha Maraykan Khabhiir isku Xidhay Danaha Istiraatiijiga ah ee Maraykanka iyo Aqoonsiga Somaliland Steven Cook, oo ah khabiir ka tirsan Golaha Xidhiidhka Dibadda ee Maraykanka (Council on Foreign Relations – CFR), isla markaana ku takhasusay arrimaha Bariga Dhexe iyo Afrika, ayaa sharraxay sababta qaddiyadda madax-bannaanida Somaliland ay muhiim ugu noqon karto danaha Maraykanka. Cook waxa uu si gaar ah u tilmaamay taariikhda Somaliland iyo goobta istiraatiijiga ah ee ay ku taallo. Steven xusay in Somaliland ay ku taallo Gacanka Cadmeed, oo ka soo horjeedda Yemen, isla markaana ay aad ugu dhaw marinka Baabul-Mandab, oo ah marin-biyood muhiim u ah isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Cook waxa uu sheegay in aqoonsiga Somaliland uu Washington u yeelan karo faa’iidooyin istiraatiiji ah, gaar ahaan dhinaca amniga iyo danaha juqraafi-siyaasadeed ee Maraykanka. Waxa uu xusay in Somaliland ay haysato deked leh biyo-qoto-dheer iyo garoon diyaaraaradeed (runway) aad u dheer, kuwaas oo, sida uu sheegay, noqon kara kaabayaal muhiim u ah danaha amni ee Maraykanka, isla markaana gacan ka geysan kara haddii loo baahdo hawlgallo ka dhan ah khatarta amni ee ka iman kara gobolka. Steven Cook waxa kale oo uu sheegay inay muuqato xiiso ka jirta gudah aWashington oo ku saabsan qaddiyadda madax-bannaanida Somaliland. Waxa uu xusay in Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), intii uu ku guda jiray safarkiisii Washington, D.C. iyo New York, uu la kulmay saraakiil ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Maraykanka, xubno ka tirsan Kongareeska iyo dhinacyo kale oo saamayn ku leh siyaasadda Maraykanka. Sida uu Cook sheegay, kulamadaasi waxay qayb ka ahaayeen dadaallada dibblumaasiyadeed ee lagu doonayo in Maraykanka lagu qanciyo inuu noqdo dalkii labaad ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada madax-bannaanida Somaliland. Cook waxa uu dooddiisa ku salaynayaa in goobta juqraafiyeed ee Somaliland, dekedda Berbera, marinka Baabul-Mandab iyo xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas ay Somaliland siinayaan muhiimad istiraatiiji ah oo sii kordhaysa marka laga eego danaha Maraykanka. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay taariikhda Somaliland iyo sida ay 1991-kii ugu dhawaaqday inay dib ula soo noqotay madax-bannaanideeda, kadib markii ay burburtay dowladdii dhexe ee Soomaaliya. Steven Cook oo ka hadlayay xarunta Golaha Xidhiidhka Dibadda ee Maraykanka (Council on Foreign Relations – CFR), ee dalka Maraykanka, ayaa hadalkiisa ku bilaabay sidany “Hogaamiyahan caalamiga ah ayaa booqday xarunta Golaha Xiriirka Arrimaha Dibadda (Council on Foreign Relations) ee magaalada New York. Waa hogaamiyaha Somaliland. Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi, oo si weyn loogu yaqaanno “Cirro”, ayaa safar laba toddobaad ah ku maray Washington, D.C. iyo New York. Wuxuu la kulmay saraakiil ka tirsan Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka, xubno ka tirsan Koongareeska, iyo dad kale. Wuxuu doonayaa in Mareykanku noqdo dalkii labaad ee aqoonsada Somaliland, waxaana muuqata inay jirto xiise loo qabo arrintaas oo gudaha Washington ah” Cook waxa kale oo uu intaas ku daray “Somaliland waxay ku dhawaaqday madax-bannaanideeda sannadkii 1991-kii, waxayna tan iyo markaas u shaqeynaysay sidii dal madax-bannaan. Dalkii ugu horreeyay ee aqoonsada madax-bannaanida Somaliland ayaa noqday Israel oo sidaas samaysay dabayaaqadii sannadkii 2025-kii. Halkan waxaa ku cad sababta ay arrinta madax-bannaanida Somaliland muhiim ugu tahay Mareykanka. Haddii aad eegto khariidadda, Somaliland waxay ku taallaa meel istiraatiiji ah oo ka soo horjeedda Yemen dhanka kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed. Somaliland waxay leedahay deked biyo qoto dheer leh iyo waddo diyaaradeed (runway) aad u dheer, taas oo ay isticmaali karaan ciidamada Mareykanka haddii ay u baahdaan inay qaadaan hawlgal amni.”

items.title: Xamza oo ka hadlay wada-hadal la sheegay inuu dhex-maray DF iyo Al-Shabaab
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa beeniyey wararka sheegaya in dowladda federaalka ay wada-hadallo ama heshiis toos ah la gashay kooxda Al-Shabaab, isaga oo sheegay in xiriir noocaas ah uusan hadda ka dhexeyn labada dhinac. Xamza, oo wareysi siiyey barnaamijka Miizaan Podcast ee Dawan Media, ayaa sheegay in mowqifka dowladda uu yahay in dalka laga xoreeyo Al-Shabaab, balse ay diyaar u tahay inay wadahadal la yeelato cid kasta oo ka tanaasusha fikirka iyo dagaalka kooxda. “Wada-hadal lama gelin, xiriirna nagama dhaxeeyo. Waxa naga dhexeeya waa xoreynta dalka,” ayuu yiri ra’iisul wasaare Xamza. “Qofkii wada-hadal doonaya ee jidkaas ka soo baxa diyaar ayaan u nahay. Wada-hadal weligeen ma diidin, waan la hadleynaa, waana soo dhoweyneynaa,” ayuu raaciyey. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xubnaha Al-Shabaab ay dib uga mid noqon karaan bulshada Soomaaliyeed haddii ay joojiyaan dilalka, kana tanaasulaan dagaalka ay kula jiraan dowladda. “Maalinta ay dilka joojiyaan oo ay dowladdooda aqbalaan waxay noqonayaan walaalaheen,” ayuu yiri. Xamza ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyey in isaga iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud midkoodna uusan wada-hadal toos ah la yeelan Al-Shabaab. Hadalladiisa ayaa jawaab u ah warar iyo eedo muddooyinkii dambe soo noqnoqday oo ku saabsan inay jiraan xiriirro ama is-afgaradyo qarsoodi ah oo dhex maray dowladda federaalka iyo kooxda. Eedaha lacagaha amniga Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay eedo sheegaya in dowladda ay lacago bixisay ama laaluush adeegsatay si ay u hesho xasillooni amni. Xamza ayaa beeniyey in dowladdiisu wax lacag ah siisay Al-Shabaab si loo yareeyo weerarrada ama loo gaaro heshiis dhinaca amniga ah. Wuxuu sheegay in dadka faafinaya eedahaas ay ku jiraan shaqsiyaad ay dowladdu ka shakisan tahay inay xiriir la leeyihiin Al-Shabaab, inkastoo uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo faahfaahsan oo arrintaas ku saabsan. Siyaasiyiin ayaa marar qaar sheegay in ay jiraann xiriirro u dhexeeya dowladda iyo Al-Shabaab, taas oo sababtay in ay yaraadaan qaraxyada Muqdisho. Si kastaba, sheegashooyinkaas ayaa badankood waxaa sameeyey dad xiriir la leh ama ka tirsanaa dowladdii madaxweyne Farmaajo, taasi oo loo arkay mid ay isaga leexinayaan sidii ay ugu fashilmeen sugidda amniga caasimadda. Dowladda federaalka ayaa si joogto ah u beenisay eedahaas, iyadoo ku adkeysaneysa in dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab uu weli yahay mid ka mid ah mudnaanta ugu weyn ee dhinaca amniga. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo kulan doceed la qaatay Madaxweynaha Masar
items.description: Al-Calamayn – 3 Oktoobar 2026: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa kulan doceed la qaatay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Carabta ee Masar, Cabdulfataax Al-Sisi, intii uu socday shir madaxeedka Madasha Ganacsiga Afrika ee ka socda magaalada cusub ee Al-Calamayn. Labada Madaxweyne ayaa kulankooda diiradda ku saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Masar, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, maalgashiga iyo horumarinta iskaashiga labada dal. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ahaa kulamo doceedyo ay madaxda ka qeybgalaysa Madasha Ganacsiga Afrika ku yeelanayaan magaalada Al-Calamayn, iyadoo Soomaaliya iyo Masar ay leeyihiin xiriir laba geesood ah oo soo jireen ah. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa magaalada Al-Calamayn uga qeybgalaya Madasha Ganacsiga Afrika, oo diiradda lagu saarayo fursadaha ganacsi, maalgashi iyo horumarinta iskaashiga dhaqaale ee qaaradda Afrika.

items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo ka hadlaysa xaaladda sii xumaanaysa ee Itoobiya
items.description: New York – 3 Oktoobar 2026: Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa qorsheynaya inuu yeesho wadatashi xiran oo looga hadlayo xaaladda sii xumaanaysa ee waqooyiga Itoobiya, gaar ahaan dagaallada ka socda gobolka Tigray iyo khatarta ay colaadahaasi ku yeelan karaan xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay inay si weyn uga walaacsan tahay kororka dagaallada, gaar ahaan adeegsiga drones iyo duqeymaha cirka, kuwaas oo khatar ku haya shacabka, kaabayaasha muhiimka ah iyo hawlaha gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Xogta Qaramada Midoobay waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa in xaaladda amni ay si gaar ah u adkeyneyso howlgallada gargaarka ee Tigray, iyadoo hay’adaha bani’aadannimada ay dalbanayaan in loo oggolaado inay si ammaan ah oo aan caqabad lahayn u gaaraan dadka u baahan taageerada. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kadib markii Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ay xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed si weyn u xumeeyeen, iyadoo Itoobiya ay xirtay safaaraddeeda Asmara, halka Eritrea ay ku dhawaaqday inay jartay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Itoobiya. Qaramada Midoobay waxay horey ugu baaqday dhammaan dhinacyada inay muujiyaan is-xakameyn, yareeyaan xiisadda, ilaaliyaan shacabka, isla markaana dib ugu laabtaan wadahadalka iyadoo la adeegsanayo qaab-dhismeedka heshiiskii Pretoria ee 2022. Walaaca ugu weyn ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ah in dagaalka Tigray uu ka gudbi karo xuduudaha Itoobiya, taasoo khatar gelin karta nabadda iyo xasilloonida guud ee Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Maxa DF ka tiri weerarka lagu qaaday xarunta korontada siisa Masjidka Nabiga SCW?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si kulul u cambaareysay weerarka lagu qaaday xarunta korontada siisa Masjidka Nabiga (NNKH) ee magaalada Madiinah, taas oo ay beegsadeen kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee dagaalka kula jirta Sacuudiga. Bayaan ksoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay in weerarkaas uu meel ka dhac ku yahay karaamada iyo xurmada goobaha Barakeysan ee Boqotooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. “Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee JFS waxay si adag u cambaareyneysaa weerarka lagu qaaday xarun koronto taas oo bixisa adeegga korontada ee Masjidka Nabiga (NNKH) ee magaalada Madiinah, Boqortooyada aan walaalaha nahay ee Sacuudi Carabiya. Wasaaraddu waxay u aragtaa weerarkaan lagu qaaday kaabayaasha rayidka ah ee u adeegaya mid ka mid ah goobaha ugu barakeysan Islaamka inuu meel ka dhac ku yahay karaamada iyo xurmada Goobaha Barakeysan,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Sidoo kale, waxaa warsaxaafadeedka lagu sheegay in falkan uu xadgudub ku yahay sharciga caalamiga ah iyo madaxbannaanida Dalka Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. Dowladda Soomaaiya ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday inay si buuxda u garab taagan tahay Dowladda iyo shacabka Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. “Soomaaliya waxay taageereysaa dadaallada Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ku ilaalinayso madaxbannaanideeda iyo amnigeeda, iyo sidoo kale badbaadada muwaadiniinteeda, dadka deggan iyo ku soo booqanaya goobaha barakeysan,” aya mar kale lagu yiri qoraalka. Waxaa kale oo uu bayaanka kusii daray “Iyadoo Soomaaliya ay xubin ka tahay Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC), waxay si cad u diiddan tahay dhammaan falalka khatarta ku ah xasilloonida gobolka, waxayna ku baaqeysaa in lala xisaabtamo cid kasta oo ka dambeysa weerarkan. Sacuudiga ayaa ka mid ah dalalka Carbeed ee xiriirka wanaagsan la leh Soomaaliya, iyadoo labada dal ay leeyihiin xiriir ku saleysan iskaashi dhinacyo badan leh, gaar ahaan arrimaha dhaqaalaha, horumarinta, waxbarashada iyo gargaarka bani’aadamnimo. items.title: Ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya oo dib ula wareegay garoonka Mekelle
items.description: Addis Ababa – 3 Oktoobar 2026: Ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaad taageersan dowladda ayaa la sheegay inay dib ula wareegeen Garoonka Diyaaradaha Alula Aba Nega ee magaalada Mekelle, caasimadda gobolka Tigray, xilli dagaallo xooggan ay ka socdaan waqooyiga dalka. Warbaahinta Reuters ayaa sheegtay in ilo xog-ogaal ah iyo ilo bani’aadamnimo ay xaqiijiyeen in ciidamada dowladda ay gacanta ku dhigeen garoonka, oo qiyaastii 10 kiiloomitir u jira bartamaha Mekelle. Ciidamada nabada Tigray, oo ay taageerto dowladda federaalka, ayaa sheegtay inay si buuxda ula wareegtay garoonka ayna waddo howlgallo ay magaalada Mekelle ku nadiifinayso. Reuters waxay xustay in sheegashadaas aanay si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin xilliga warbixinta la qorayay. Dagaallada u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo isbahaysi hubeysan oo uu hoggaaminayo TPLF ayaa dib uga qarxay Tigray 23-kii Sebtembar, waxaana loo arkaa inay yihiin xiisaddii ugu xoogganayd tan iyo dagaalkii 2020–2022. Ilo deegaanka ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in rasaas laga maqlayay gudaha Mekelle, halka qaar ka mid ah dagaalyahannada Tigray ay ka baxeen fariisimahooda. Qabsashada garoonka Mekelle waxay noqon kartaa isbeddel muhiim ah oo militari, balse falanqeeyayaal ayaa sheegay in aysan taasi ka dhignayn in dagaalku dhammaaday, iyadoo ay weli jiraan ciidamo iyo kooxo hubeysan oo ka dagaallamaya qaybo ka mid ah Tigray.

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada Koonfur Galbeed oo ka shiray amniga iyo geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta
items.description: Baydhabo, 3 Oktoobar 2026 – Golaha Wasiirrada maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa maanta kulan ku yeeshay magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo uu shir-guddoomiyay Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe). Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee amniga deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, xoojinta nabadgelyada iyo dardargelinta geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada. Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa qiimeeyay xaaladda amni ee deegaannada maamulka, waxaana diiradda lagu saaray dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha amniga iyo bulshada. Sidoo kale, kulanka ayaa si qoto dheer looga hadlay gogosha iyo geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada-hadal loo dhan yahay, is-afgarad siyaasadeed iyo bulsho, iyo in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo hannaan nabadeed oo ku dhisan wada-tashi. Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa sheegay in nabadgelyada, midnimada bulshada iyo dib-u-heshiisiintu ay yihiin tiirarka aas-aaska u ah xasilloonida iyo horumarka Koonfur Galbeed. Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto dadaallada lagu mideynayo bulshada, xoojinayo nabadgelyada iyo horumarinta dowladnimada.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo cambaareysay weerarka lagu qaaday xarun koronto oo adeegta Masjidka Nabiga
items.description: Muqdisho – 3 Oktoobar 2026: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u cambaareysay weerar lagu qaaday xarun koronto oo adeegta Masjidka Nabiga ee magaalada Madiina, dalka Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in weerarka lagu qaaday kaabayaal rayid oo koronto siiya mid ka mid ah goobaha ugu barakeysan Islaamka uu yahay fal ka dhan ah karaamada goobaha barakeysan, isla markaana ay u aragto xadgudub ka dhan ah sharciga caalamiga ah iyo madaxbannaanida Sacuudiga. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale muujisay garab istaag buuxa oo ay la leedahay dowladda iyo shacabka Sacuudiga, iyadoo taageertay dadaallada Boqortooyada ee lagu ilaalinayo madaxbannaanideeda, amnigeeda iyo badqabka muwaadiniinta, dadka deggan iyo booqdayaasha goobaha barakeysan. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa intaas ku dartay in Soomaaliya, oo xubin ka ah Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC), ay diiddan tahay fal kasta oo khatar gelinaya xasilloonida gobolka, waxayna ku baaqday in dadka ka dambeeyay weerarka lagula xisaabtamo.

items.title: Ciidamada Itoobiya oo la wareegay garoonka Mekelle, kun dhawaaqay…
items.description: Mekelle (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay howlgallo nadiifin ah ka wadaan gudaha magaalada Mekelle ee caasimadda gobolka Tigray, sida ay waxyar ka hor baahisay Reuters. Dhankeeda Wakaaladda wararka ee AFP, ayaa werisay in ciidanka Itoobiya iyo kooxaha taageersan ay sidoo kale maalintii labaad maamulayaan garoonka diyaaradaha Mekelle ee Alula Aba Nega, halka saldhigyada iyo xarumaha kale ee dowladda ee ku yaalla Mekelle ay haawanayaan, markii magaalada ay isaga baxeen ciidamada kooxda TPLF. Warbixinta AFP, ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay la wareegista ciidanka taageersan dawladda Itoobiya ee Mekelle, inay ka dhigantahay burbur gaaray TPLF, oo mar kale u muuqata dagaallo ay iskudayeen si deg deg ah inay ula wareegaan gobolka Tigray oo ay cadaadiyaan dawladda Abiy, in looga adkaaday, taasoo dib gacan sareynta ugu soo celinaysa xukuumadda Abiy Axmed. Xaaladdii toddobaadyo ka hor loo arkayay inay khatar gelinayso maamulka Abiy, markii TPLF ay 23 bishii September dib u bilowday dagaalka ayaa hadda u muuqata in meesha laga saaray , isla markaana TPLF iyo qorshihii ay ku mideeyeen kooxaha kale ee ka soo horjeeda xukuumadda Addis Ababa in iska caabin lagu joojiyay oo cadaadiska lagu soo celiyay dhinaca TPLF oo hadda dib ugu guranaya dhulka miyiga iyo buuralayda ah ee gobolka Tigray, halka goobaha TPLF ay ka gaareen gobolka Cafarta ay si dhaqso ah u luminayaan gacan ku heyntooda, taasoo dhabarka u saaraysa guul-darro kale , halka ay xasilloonida dib ugu soo laabanayo Addis Ababa. Dagaalkan ayaa waji kale galaya , haddii ciidanka Itoobiya ay u dhaqaaqaan dhinaca xadka Eritrea, iyadoo goobaha uu isha ku hayo Abiy ay ku jirto Adigrat oo loo tixgeliyo magaalada weyn ee Itoobiya ee ugu dhow xadka Eritrea, waana marin muhiim ah oo u jihaysan Eritrea iyo Badda Cas, taasoo cadaadis saaraysa Eritrea, oo ay dawladda Itoobiya ku eedeysay inay taageerto TPLF oo hadda lumisay xakameynta dagaalka. Si kastaba, h orumarkan ayaa imaanaya kaddib markii ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaadka taageera ay maalmihii la soo dhaafay guulo degdeg ah ka gaareen gudaha Tigray, halkaas oo dagaal culus uu toddobaadkii hore ka dhex qarxay dowladda iyo isbahaysi hubeysan oo ay hoggaamineyso Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF). Dagaallada hadda socda ayaa kusoo laabtay Tigray afar sano kaddib markii heshiiskii Pretoria uu hakiyey colaad ay ku dhinteen boqollaal kun oo qof, malaayiin kalena ay guryahooda uga barakaceen. Hase yeeshee, isbeddelka xulafeysi ee gobolka — gaar ahaan kala fogaanshaha Itoobiya iyo Eritrea iyo xiisadda sii kordheysa ee Addis Ababa kala dhexeysa Masar iyo Sudan — ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca ah in dagaalka cusub uusan ku ekaan gudaha Itoobiya. items.title: Mareykanka oo kordhiyey masaafurinta Soomaalida iyo 500 qof oo Minnesota lagu…
items.description: Minneapolis (Caasimada Online) — Tirada Soomaalida ku nool gobolka Minnesota ee lagu amray in laga masaafuriyo Mareykanka ayaa si weyn kor ugu kacday sanadkan, iyadoo in ka badan 500 oo qof ay heleen amarro masaafurin, taas oo ku dhow toban jibbaar tiradii sanadkii 2025. Wargeyska Minnesota Star Tribune , oo falanqeeyay xogta dowladda federaalka, ayaa sheegay in guud ahaan in ka badan 1,000 Soomaali magangelyo-doon ah lagu amray inay ka baxaan Mareykanka tan iyo bishii February, kuwaas oo in ka badan kala bar ay ku nool yihiin Minnesota. Qaar ka mid ah dadkaas ayaa durba laga masaafuriyey Mareykanka, halka kuwo kalena loo wareejiyey xarumo lagu hayo dadka socdaalka, oo ay ku jirto xarunta ciidamada Mareykanka ee Guantánamo Bay ee Cuba, sida uu qoray wargeysku. Kororka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu dedejiyey dacwadaha magangelyo-doonka, isla markaana uu yareeyey qaar ka mid ah waddooyinkii sharci ee Soomaalida u oggolaanayey inay sii joogaan Mareykanka. Inta badan Soomaalida Minnesota waa muwaadiniin Mareykan ah, waxay haystaan sharci ay dalka ku joogaan ama waxay ku jiraan habraaca codsiga magangelyada, sida ay sheegtay Star Tribune . Minnesota waxaa ku nool bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ugu weyn Mareykanka. Bishii February, maamulka Trump ayaa bilaabay nidaam dacwooyin degdeg ah oo loo bixiyey “rocket docket”, kaas oo garsoorayaasha socdaalka u oggolaanaya inay internet-ka ku qaadaan dacwadaha la xiriira muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed. Star Tribune ayaa sheegtay in tallaabadaasi ay qareennada socdaalka ku khasabtay inay muddo gaaban ku diyaariyaan dacwado markii hore loo qorsheeyey sannad ama ka badan kadib. Ku dhowaad dhammaan go’aannada masaafurinta Soomaalida ee siddeedii bilood ee ugu horreeyey sanadkan ayaa kasoo baxay nidaamkaas degdegga ah, sida uu wargeysku sheegay. Qareenno ku takhasusay arrimaha socdaalka ayaa Star Tribune u sheegay inay tahay arrin aan hore loo arag in maxkamadaha socdaalka loo sameeyo jadwal dacwadeed si gaar ah ugu wajahan dad kasoo jeeda hal waddan. Waxay sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyeen in dadka magangelyo-doonka ahi aysan helin waqti ku filan oo ay ku diyaariyaan dacwadahooda. Afhayeen u hadlay maxkamadaha socdaalka ayaa dhinaca kale sheegay in nidaamku mudnaan siinayo “in dacwadaha lagu soo gabagabeeyo waqtigooda”, isaga oo xusay in sharciga federaalka uu dhigayo in codsiyada magangelyada lagu go’aamiyo 180 maalmood gudahood. “Dib-u-dhac aan loo baahnayn wuxuu dhaawacayaa dadka leh dacwadaha saxda ah iyo shacabka Mareykanka ee doonaya in dadka aan lahayn dacwado sax ah sida ugu dhaqsaha badan dalka looga saaro,” ayuu afhayeenku u sheegay Star Tribune . Wargeysku wuxuu sheegay in qiyaastii 2.3 milyan oo codsi magangelyo ah ay weli ku jiraan maxkamadaha socdaalka ee Mareykanka. DhammaadkaTPS Maamulka Trump ayaa sidoo kale 17-kii March soo afjaray barnaamijka Temporary Protected Status (TPS) ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida siinayey ilaalin ku-meel-gaar ah oo ka hortageysay in la masaafuriyo. Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay inay qiimeyn kadib ku soo gabagabeysay in Soomaaliya aysan mar dambe buuxin shuruudaha sharci ee barnaamijka TPS. Joojinta TPS-ka si toos ah ugama dhigna in qof kasta oo horay barnaamijka uga tirsanaa la masaafurinayo. Dadka haysta sharci kale oo ay Mareykanka ku joogaan way sii joogi karaan, halka codsiyada magangelyada iyo noocyada kale ee ilaalinta sharciyeed lagu go’aamiyo hannaan gooni ah. DHS ayaa sheegtay in 1,082 qof ay haysteen TPS-ka Soomaaliya bishii December 2025, halka 1,383 codsi oo kale ay weli sugayeen go’aan. Dhanka kale, qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida laga saarayo Mareykanka ayaa loo sii marsiiyey dalal kale. Caasimada Online ayaa hore u werisay in Soomaali lagu hayay Guantánamo Bay, halka Star Tribune ay sheegtay in ugu yaraan laba qof oo kasoo jeeda Minnesota ay ka mid ahaayeen Soomaalidii halkaas loo wareejiyey. Qareen Marc Prokosch, oo matalay afar nin oo Guantánamo lagu hayay, ayaa tallaabadaas ku tilmaamay “xeelad cabsi-gelin siyaasadeed”. Afarta nin ayaa ku dhowaad bil ku qaatay Guantánamo ka hor inta aan loo qaadin Kenya. Prokosch ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah raggaasi uu markii dambe gaaray Muqdisho. Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Kastamka Mareykanka ee ICE ayaa difaacday in dadka qaar loo masaafuriyo dal saddexaad, iyadoo sheegtay in heshiisyada noocaas ahi gacan ka geystaan fulinta amarada masaafurinta. Muranka ku saabsan masaafurinta Soomaalida ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmaya iyadoo hay’adaha dowladda Mareykanka ay bixiyeen qiimeynno kala duwan oo ku saabsan xaaladda amni ee Soomaaliya. Star Tribune ayaa sheegtay in saraakiil ka tirsan Waaxda Amniga Gudaha iyo Waaxda Cadaaladda ay maxkamadaha socdaalka u gudbiyeen qoraallo ay ku doodayaan in xaaladda Soomaaliya ay saamaxeyso in qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida dib loogu celiyo dalka. Hase yeeshee, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka waxay Soomaaliya weli ku haysaa heerka ugu sarreeya ee digniinta safarka, Level 4: Do Not Travel , iyadoo sabab uga dhigaysa argagixiso, afduub, dambiyo iyo xaalado amni-darro. Kala duwanaanshaha qiimeyntaas ayaa hadda qeyb ka noqday doodaha sharci ee ku saabsan in Soomaalida wajahaya masaafurinta si ammaan ah dib loogu celin karo Soomaaliya. Kororka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu dedejiyey dacwadaha magangelyo-doonka, isla markaana uu yareeyey qaar ka mid ah waddooyinkii sharci ee Soomaalida u oggolaanayey inay sii joogaan Mareykanka. Inta badan Soomaalida Minnesota waa muwaadiniin Mareykan ah, waxay haystaan sharci ay dalka ku joogaan ama waxay ku jiraan habraaca codsiga magangelyada, sida ay sheegtay Star Tribune . Minnesota waxaa ku nool bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ugu weyn Mareykanka. Bishii February, maamulka Trump ayaa bilaabay nidaam dacwooyin degdeg ah oo loo bixiyey “rocket docket”, kaas oo garsoorayaasha socdaalka u oggolaanaya inay internet-ka ku qaadaan dacwadaha la xiriira muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed. Star Tribune ayaa sheegtay in tallaabadaasi ay qareennada socdaalka ku khasabtay inay muddo gaaban ku diyaariyaan dacwado markii hore loo qorsheeyey sannad ama ka badan kadib. Ku dhowaad dhammaan go’aannada masaafurinta Soomaalida ee siddeedii bilood ee ugu horreeyey sanadkan ayaa kasoo baxay nidaamkaas degdegga ah, sida uu wargeysku sheegay. Qareenno ku takhasusay arrimaha socdaalka ayaa Star Tribune u sheegay inay tahay arrin aan hore loo arag in maxkamadaha socdaalka loo sameeyo jadwal dacwadeed si gaar ah ugu wajahan dad kasoo jeeda hal waddan. Waxay sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyeen in dadka magangelyo-doonka ahi aysan helin waqti ku filan oo ay ku diyaariyaan dacwadahooda. Afhayeen u hadlay maxkamadaha socdaalka ayaa dhinaca kale sheegay in nidaamku mudnaan siinayo “in dacwadaha lagu soo gabagabeeyo waqtigooda”, isaga oo xusay in sharciga federaalka uu dhigayo in codsiyada magangelyada lagu go’aamiyo 180 maalmood gudahood. “Dib-u-dhac aan loo baahnayn wuxuu dhaawacayaa dadka leh dacwadaha saxda ah iyo shacabka Mareykanka ee doonaya in dadka aan lahayn dacwado sax ah sida ugu dhaqsaha badan dalka looga saaro,” ayuu afhayeenku u sheegay Star Tribune . Wargeysku wuxuu sheegay in qiyaastii 2.3 milyan oo codsi magangelyo ah ay weli ku jiraan maxkamadaha socdaalka ee Mareykanka. DhammaadkaTPS Maamulka Trump ayaa sidoo kale 17-kii March soo afjaray barnaamijka Temporary Protected Status (TPS) ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida siinayey ilaalin ku-meel-gaar ah oo ka hortageysay in la masaafuriyo. Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay inay qiimeyn kadib ku soo gabagabeysay in Soomaaliya aysan mar dambe buuxin shuruudaha sharci ee barnaamijka TPS. Joojinta TPS-ka si toos ah ugama dhigna in qof kasta oo horay barnaamijka uga tirsanaa la masaafurinayo. Dadka haysta sharci kale oo ay Mareykanka ku joogaan way sii joogi karaan, halka codsiyada magangelyada iyo noocyada kale ee ilaalinta sharciyeed lagu go’aamiyo hannaan gooni ah. DHS ayaa sheegtay in 1,082 qof ay haysteen TPS-ka Soomaaliya bishii December 2025, halka 1,383 codsi oo kale ay weli sugayeen go’aan. Dhanka kale, qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida laga saarayo Mareykanka ayaa loo sii marsiiyey dalal kale. Caasimada Online ayaa hore u werisay in Soomaali lagu hayay Guantánamo Bay, halka Star Tribune ay sheegtay in ugu yaraan laba qof oo kasoo jeeda Minnesota ay ka mid ahaayeen Soomaalidii halkaas loo wareejiyey. Qareen Marc Prokosch, oo matalay afar nin oo Guantánamo lagu hayay, ayaa tallaabadaas ku tilmaamay “xeelad cabsi-gelin siyaasadeed”. Afarta nin ayaa ku dhowaad bil ku qaatay Guantánamo ka hor inta aan loo qaadin Kenya. Prokosch ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah raggaasi uu markii dambe gaaray Muqdisho. Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Kastamka Mareykanka ee ICE ayaa difaacday in dadka qaar loo masaafuriyo dal saddexaad, iyadoo sheegtay in heshiisyada noocaas ahi gacan ka geystaan fulinta amarada masaafurinta. Muranka ku saabsan masaafurinta Soomaalida ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmaya iyadoo hay’adaha dowladda Mareykanka ay bixiyeen qiimeynno kala duwan oo ku saabsan xaaladda amni ee Soomaaliya. Star Tribune ayaa sheegtay in saraakiil ka tirsan Waaxda Amniga Gudaha iyo Waaxda Cadaaladda ay maxkamadaha socdaalka u gudbiyeen qoraallo ay ku doodayaan in xaaladda Soomaaliya ay saamaxeyso in qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida dib loogu celiyo dalka. Hase yeeshee, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka waxay Soomaaliya weli ku haysaa heerka ugu sarreeya ee digniinta safarka, Level 4: Do Not Travel , iyadoo sabab uga dhigaysa argagixiso, afduub, dambiyo iyo xaalado amni-darro. Kala duwanaanshaha qiimeyntaas ayaa hadda qeyb ka noqday doodaha sharci ee ku saabsan in Soomaalida wajahaya masaafurinta si ammaan ah dib loogu celin karo Soomaaliya. The post Mareykanka oo kordhiyey masaafurinta Soomaalida iyo 500 qof oo Minnesota lagu… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dagaalkii Muqdisho ee “Black Hawk Down”
items.description: WQ: Bahda Tifaftirka Maanta oo kale, 3dii Oktoobar 1993kii, waxaa magaalada Muqdisho ka qarxay dagaal culus oo dhex maray ciidammada gaarka ah ee Maraykanka iyo xoogaggii hubaysnaa ee Isbahaysigii Qaranka Soomaaliyeed (SNA), ee uu hoggaaminayay Jeneraal Maxamed Faarax Caydiid. Dagaalkan, oo socday ilaa subaxnimadii 4tii Oktoobar, ayaa taariikhda ku galay magacyada “Maalintii Raanjariska” (Rangers Day), “Dagaalkii Muqdisho” ( Battle of Mogadishu ) iyo “Black Hawk Down”, isaga oo ka mid noqday dhacdooyinkii sida weyn u saameeyay sooyaalka colaaddii sokeeye ee Soomaaliya, faragelintii milatari ee caalamiga ahayd iyo siyaasaddii arrimaha dibedda ee Maraykanka. Dhacdadan waxaa ka horreeyay burburkii Dawladdii Dhexe ee Soomaaliya, Jannaayo 1991kii, iyo dagaalladii sokeeye ee xigay, kuwaas oo dalka u horseeday burbur baahsan, barakac, macluul iyo kaladaadashadii hay’adihii dawliga ahaa. Xaaladdaas ayaa sababtay faragelintii Qaramada Midoobay, oo Abriil 1992kii dhistay Hawlgalkii UNOSOM I, si loo kormeero xabbadjoojinta, loona sugo gaarsiinta gargaarka bani’aadamnimada. Xilligaas, sawirradii iyo warbixinnadii ay saxaafadda caalamiga ahi ka diyaarisay Soomaaliya ayaa door ku lahaa in indhaha dunida lagu soo jeediyo macluushii iyo colaaddii dalka ka jirtay. Saxafiyiintii wax ka qorayay xaaladdaas waxaa ka mid ahaa Dan Eldon (1970–1993) , oo ahaa sawirqaade ku dhashay Ingiriiska, kuna soo koray Kenya. Eldon ayaa 1992kii tagay magaalada Baydhabo, oo ka mid ahayd degaannadii sida daran ay macluushu u saamaysay. Sawirradii uu ka qaaday carruurtii nafaqodarradu haysay, qoysaskii macluulaysnaa iyo dadkii ay colaadda iyo gaajadu saameeyeen ayaa ka mid noqday muuqaalladii lagu baahiyay warbaahinta caalamiga ah. Eldon wuxuu markii danbe sawirqaade u noqday wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters, isaga oo Muqdisho ka sii waday diiwaangelinta dhacdooyinkii dalka ka socday. 3dii Diseenbar 1992kii, Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa soo saaray Qaraarkii 794, oo oggolaaday in ciidammo caalami ah loo diro Soomaaliya. Waxaa xigay Hawlgalkii Rejosoocelinta ( Operation Restore Hope ) , oo ay fulinayeen ciidammadii UNITAF, ee uu Maraykanku hoggaaminayay. 9kii Diseenbar ayay ciidammadii ugu horreeyay ee Maraykanku ka soo degeen Muqdisho. 4tii Maajo 1993kii, masuuliyadda hawlgalka waxaa la wareegay ciidammadii Qaramada Midoobay ee UNOSOM II, oo loo xilsaaray nabadaynta, hubkadhigista kooxihii hubaysnaa iyo gacan ka geysashada dibudhiska hay’adaha dawliga ah. Hasayeeshee, xiriirkii ciidammada Qaramada Midoobay iyo xoogaggii Jeneraal Caydiid ayaa sii xumaaday, gaar ahaan, kaddib, dagaalkii 5tii Juun 1993kii, oo lagu dilay 24 askari oo nabad-ilaalineed oo u dhashay Bakistaan. Maalintii xigtay, Golaha Ammaanka ayaa soo saaray Qaraarkii 837, oo dalbaday in tallaabo laga qaado kuwii ka danbeeyay weerarradaas. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogaysatay markii ciidammada Maraykanku ay 12kii Luulyo 1993kii duqeeyeen guri ku yaallay koonfurta Muqdisho, oo ay shir ku lahaayeen xubno taageersanaa Caydiid, odayaal dhaqameed iyo dad kale. Dhacdadan, oo Soomaalidu u taqaanno “Isniintii Dhiigga” , ayaa sababtay dhimasho iyo dhaawac badan. Guddiga Caalamiga ah ee Laanqayrta Cas ayaa xilligaas sheegay in 54 qof ay ku dhinteen, 174 kalana ku dhaawacmeen. Dhanka Maraykanka, waxaa la sheegay in gurigu ahaa xarun laga abaabulayay hawlgallada Isbahaysiga, halka dhinaca Soomaalida qaarkood ay ku doodeen in halkaas uu ka socday kulan dhexdhexaadin iyo dibuheshiisiin ah. Duqayntaas ayaa sidoo kale sababtay dhacdo kale oo raad xanuun badan ku reebtay taariikhda saxaafadda. Dan Eldon iyo saddex saxafi oo kale, oo kala ahaa Hosea Maina, Anthony Macharia iyo Hansi Krauss , ayaa u dhaqaaqay goobtii la duqeeyay, si ay u diiwaangeliyaan khasaaraha iyo xaaladda ka dhalatay weerarka. Hasayeeshee, dad caraysnaa oo goobta ku sugnaa ayaa weeraray saxafiyiinta, iyaga oo afartoodiiba dilay. Eldon, Maina iyo Macharia waxay u shaqaynayeen Reuters, halka Krauss uu la shaqaynayay Associated Press. Saxafi kale oo la socday, Maxamed Shaffi, ayaa dhaawac ku baxsaday. Dhimashada afartaas saxafi ayaa ka mid noqotay dhacdooyinkii muujiyay heerka ay gaartay xiisaddii Muqdisho iyo halistii ay la kulmayeen dadkii isku dayayay inay dunida gaarsiiyaan xogta colaadda Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, duqayntii 12kii Luulyo ayaa sii xoojisay caradii iyo kalsoonidarradii hore uga dhex jirtay qaybo ka mid ah bulshada Muqdisho iyo ciidammada shisheeye. Ciidammada gaarka ah ee Maraykanka, oo ay ka mid ahaayeen Rangers, Delta Force iyo xubno ka tirsanaa SEAL Team Six, ayaa Muqdisho ka waday hawlgallo lagu baadigoobayay Jeneraal Caydiid iyo saraakiishiisa. Howard E. Wasdin, oo ka tirsanaa SEAL Team Six, ayaa buuggiisa SEAL Team Six: Memoirs of an Elite Navy SEAL Sniper ku faahfaahiyay hawlgalladii sirdoonka, gaar ahaan adeegsiga dad Soomaaliyeed oo xog-ururinta ka caawinayay ciidammada Maraykanka, iyo xarun qarsoodi ah oo lagu magacaabi jiray Pasha . Hawlgalladaas waxaa ka mid ahaa qabashadii Cismaan Cali Caato, oo ka mid ahaa saraakiishii ugu dhowaa Caydiid, bishii Sebtembar 1993kii. Galabnimadii Axadda, 3dii Oktoobar 1993kii, ciidammada gaarka ah ee Maraykanka ayaa hawlgal ka tirsanaa Operation Gothic Serpent ka fuliyay agagaarka Suuqa Bakaaraha iyo Hoteelkii Olympic, iyaga oo doonayay inay gacanta ku soo dhigaan laba sarkaal oo sare oo ka tirsanaa Isbahaysigii Qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Hawlgalkaas, oo loo qorsheeyay inuu muddo kooban ku dhammaado, ayaa isu beddelay dagaal daba dheeraaday, kaddib markii xoogaggii hubaysnaa ee Soomaalidu ay soo rideen laba diyaaradood oo qumaatiga u kaca oo nooca Black Hawk ahaa. Saddex diyaaradood oo kalena waxaa soo gaaray waxyeello. Dagaalka ayaa ku fiday waddooyin iyo xaafado ka tirsan Muqdisho, waxaana ciidammadii Maraykanka qaarkood ku adkaatay inay ka baxaan goobihii lagu dagaallamayay. Subaxnimadii 4tii Oktoobar, waxaa gurmad u fidiyay ciidammo isugu jiray Maraykan, Malaysiyaan iyo Bakistaan, iyaga oo adeegsanayay gaadiidka gaashaaman ee Malaysiya iyo taangiyada Bakistaan. Gurmadkaasi wuxuu suurtageliyay in la daadgureeyo ciidammadii ku go’doonsanaa qaybo ka tirsan magaalada Muqdisho. Dagaalkan, oo socday ku dhowaad 18 saacadood, waxaa ku dhintay 18 askari oo Maraykan ah iyo askari Malaysiyaan ah , halka tobannaan kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Waxaa, sidoo kale, nolol lagu qabtay duuliyihii Maraykanka ee Michael Durant, oo markii danbe la sii daayay. Dhanka Soomaalida, khasaaruhu aad buu u badnaa, inkasta oo aan weli la hayn tiro kama dambays ah oo si madaxbannaan loo xaqiijiyay. Warbixinta Human Rights Watch ayaa lagu sheegay in in ka badan 200 oo Soomaali ah ay ku dhinteen, ilaa 700 kalena ku dhaawacmeen, halka warbixinno kale ay soo bandhigeen qiyaaso ka sarreeya. Dadka waxyeelladu gaartay waxaa ku jiray dagaalyahanno iyo dad rayid ah. Inkasta oo dagaalka inta badan lagu soo koobo ciidammada Maraykanka iyo xoogaggii Jeneraal Caydiid, haddana waxaa jira warbixinno taariikheed oo tilmaamaya kaalintii kooxihii Islaamiyiinta Soomaaliyeed iyo xubno xiriir la lahaa al-Qaacidda. Warbixintii Guddigii Baarista Weerarradii 11kii Sebteenbar ee Maraykanka ayaa sheegtay in al-Qaacidda ay hub iyo tababarayaal u dirtay kooxo Soomaaliyeed oo la dagaallamayay ciidammada Maraykanka. Waxaa, sidoo kale, jira qoraallo ka hadlaya xiriirkii al-Qaacidda iyo al-Itixaad al-Islaami. Hasayeeshee, baaxadda doorkii tooska ahaa ee kooxahaasi ku lahaayeen dagaalkii 3–4 Oktoobar iyo cidda fulisay weerarradii lagu soo riday diyaaradaha ayaa weli u baahan caddayn iyo kalasaarid taariikheed. Dagaalkaas waxaa, sidoo kale, ka dhashay khasaare naf iyo maalba lahaa oo soo gaaray qoysas Soomaaliyeed oo aan ka qaybgelin dagaalka. Warbixinnada taariikheed iyo maragfurka dadkii goobta ku sugnaa ayaa ka warramay duqaymaha, rasaastii ku dhacday guryaha, barakacii iyo argaggaxii ay la kulmeen dadkii ku noolaa xaafadihii lagu dagaallamayay. Qaar ka mid ah qoysaskaasi waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in ciidammadii Maraykanku ay guryahooda galeen, kuna sugnaayeen intii dagaalku socday. Dhacdooyinkani waxay dhaliyeen su’aalo la xiriira ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah iyo masuuliyadda dhinacyadii dagaallamayay. Dagaalkii Muqdisho ayaa saamayn weyn kaga tegay xusuusta bulshada iyo suugaanta Soomaalida. Waxaa laga curiyay suugaan badan, gaar ahaan godka shiribka, oo lagu cabbiray dareenkii bulshada, dhacdooyinkii dagaalka iyo dhibaatadii dadka rayidka ah. Shiribyada dagaalkaas lagu xusuusto waxaa ka mid ah: “Raanjaris ma rootiyaa   Rayidkii aaba raamsadee?!” — Shirib Hore Dhinaca kale, Dagaalkii Muqdisho ayaa, sidoo kale, saameeyay siyaasaddii Maraykanka ee Soomaaliya. 7dii Oktoobar 1993kii, Madaxweyne Bill Clinton ayaa ku dhawaaqay qorshe ciidammada Maraykanka looga saarayo Soomaaliya ugu danbayn 31ka Maarso 1994kii. 16kii Nofeenbar 1993kii, Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa soo saaray Qaraarkii 885, oo lagu dhisay guddi baaritaan, laguna hakiyay hawlgalladii lagu soo qabanayay dadkii lagu tuhmay weerarradii ciidammada Qaramada Midoobay. Ciidammadii Maraykanka ayaa dalka ka baxay Maarso 1994kii, halka Hawlgalkii UNOSOM II uu soo gabaggoobay Maarso 1995kii. Dagaalkii Muqdisho iyo Tebintiisa Dagaalkaas waxaa markii danbe laga qoray buuagag, lagana sameeyay filimo iyo taxanayaal dukumentari ah. Waxaa ka mid ah buuggii uu Mark Bowden soo saaray 1999kii ee Black Hawk Down: A Story of Modern War , filimkii Black Hawk Down ee uu hagayay Ridley Scott, oo soo baxay 2001kii, iyo taxanihii dukumentariga ahaa ee Surviving Black Hawk Down , oo ay Netflix baahisay 10kii Febraayo 2025kii. Taxanaha Surviving Black Hawk Down , oo ka kooban saddex qaybood, ayaa waraysiyo la yeeshay askartii Maraykanka, dagaalyahannadii Soomaalida iyo dad rayid ah oo ka badbaaday dagaalkii Muqdisho. Dadka lagu waraystay waxaa ka mid ah hooyo Binti Cali Wardheere , oo dagaalkaas ku weyday saygeedii iyo laba wiil oo ay dhashay, halka gabadheeda Ifraax ay indhaha waxyeello ka soo gaartay. Waxaa, sidoo kale, lagu soo bandhigay maragfurka dad Soomaaliyeed oo xusuusta dhibaatadii ay kala kulmeen diyaaradaha dagaalka iyo weerarradii xaafadahooda ka dhacay. Waraysiyadaasi waxay muujinayaan sida ay xusuusta dhacdadu ugu kala duwan tahay ciidammadii dagaallamay iyo dadkii rayidka ahaa ee ku dhex noolaa. Waxay, sidoo kale, dib u soo nooleeyeen doodda ku saabsan cidda sheekada laga dhegaysto, xogta mudnaanta la siiyo iyo sida loo diiwaangeliyo khasaaraha iyo waaya-aragnimada dadka Soomaaliyeed. Sidaas awgeed, fahanka dagaalkaas kuma koobna oo keliya hawlgalkii ciidammada, diyaaradaha la soo riday iyo khasaaraha milatari, balse wuxuu sidoo kale u baahan yahay daraasaynta nolosha dadkii rayidka ahaa iyo dhacdooyinkii ka horreeyay dagaalka. Soddon iyo saddex sano ayaa maanta laga joogaa dagaalkii Muqdisho ee 3–4 Oktoobar 1993kii , oo weli ka mid ah dhacdooyinka sida weyn loogu xusuusto sooyaalka colaaddii sokeeye ee Soomaaliya, faragelintii ciidammada shisheeye iyo khasaaraha naf iyo maalba lahaa ee dagaalladii Muqdisho. Diiwaangelinta dhacdadan, ururinta maragfurka dadkii ay waxyeelladu gaartay iyo iskudubarididda ilaha Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa caalamiga ahi waxay muhiim u yihiin in jiilalka danbe ay helaan xog sugan oo dhinacyo kala duwan ka tarjumaysa. ____________ Tixraacyo United Nations Security Council. items.fullContent: WQ: Bahda Tifaftirka Maanta oo kale, 3dii Oktoobar 1993kii, waxaa magaalada Muqdisho ka qarxay dagaal culus oo dhex maray ciidammada gaarka ah ee Maraykanka iyo xoogaggii hubaysnaa ee Isbahaysigii Qaranka Soomaaliyeed (SNA), ee uu hoggaaminayay Jeneraal Maxamed Faarax Caydiid. Dagaalkan, oo socday ilaa subaxnimadii 4tii Oktoobar, ayaa taariikhda ku galay magacyada “Maalintii Raanjariska” (Rangers Day), “Dagaalkii Muqdisho” ( Battle of Mogadishu ) iyo “Black Hawk Down”, isaga oo ka mid noqday dhacdooyinkii sida weyn u saameeyay sooyaalka colaaddii sokeeye ee Soomaaliya, faragelintii milatari ee caalamiga ahayd iyo siyaasaddii arrimaha dibedda ee Maraykanka. Dhacdadan waxaa ka horreeyay burburkii Dawladdii Dhexe ee Soomaaliya, Jannaayo 1991kii, iyo dagaalladii sokeeye ee xigay, kuwaas oo dalka u horseeday burbur baahsan, barakac, macluul iyo kaladaadashadii hay’adihii dawliga ahaa. Xaaladdaas ayaa sababtay faragelintii Qaramada Midoobay, oo Abriil 1992kii dhistay Hawlgalkii UNOSOM I, si loo kormeero xabbadjoojinta, loona sugo gaarsiinta gargaarka bani’aadamnimada. Xilligaas, sawirradii iyo warbixinnadii ay saxaafadda caalamiga ahi ka diyaarisay Soomaaliya ayaa door ku lahaa in indhaha dunida lagu soo jeediyo macluushii iyo colaaddii dalka ka jirtay. Saxafiyiintii wax ka qorayay xaaladdaas waxaa ka mid ahaa Dan Eldon (1970–1993) , oo ahaa sawirqaade ku dhashay Ingiriiska, kuna soo koray Kenya. Eldon ayaa 1992kii tagay magaalada Baydhabo, oo ka mid ahayd degaannadii sida daran ay macluushu u saamaysay. Sawirradii uu ka qaaday carruurtii nafaqodarradu haysay, qoysaskii macluulaysnaa iyo dadkii ay colaadda iyo gaajadu saameeyeen ayaa ka mid noqday muuqaalladii lagu baahiyay warbaahinta caalamiga ah. Eldon wuxuu markii danbe sawirqaade u noqday wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters, isaga oo Muqdisho ka sii waday diiwaangelinta dhacdooyinkii dalka ka socday. 3dii Diseenbar 1992kii, Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa soo saaray Qaraarkii 794, oo oggolaaday in ciidammo caalami ah loo diro Soomaaliya. Waxaa xigay Hawlgalkii Rejosoocelinta ( Operation Restore Hope ) , oo ay fulinayeen ciidammadii UNITAF, ee uu Maraykanku hoggaaminayay. 9kii Diseenbar ayay ciidammadii ugu horreeyay ee Maraykanku ka soo degeen Muqdisho. 4tii Maajo 1993kii, masuuliyadda hawlgalka waxaa la wareegay ciidammadii Qaramada Midoobay ee UNOSOM II, oo loo xilsaaray nabadaynta, hubkadhigista kooxihii hubaysnaa iyo gacan ka geysashada dibudhiska hay’adaha dawliga ah. Hasayeeshee, xiriirkii ciidammada Qaramada Midoobay iyo xoogaggii Jeneraal Caydiid ayaa sii xumaaday, gaar ahaan, kaddib, dagaalkii 5tii Juun 1993kii, oo lagu dilay 24 askari oo nabad-ilaalineed oo u dhashay Bakistaan. Maalintii xigtay, Golaha Ammaanka ayaa soo saaray Qaraarkii 837, oo dalbaday in tallaabo laga qaado kuwii ka danbeeyay weerarradaas. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogaysatay markii ciidammada Maraykanku ay 12kii Luulyo 1993kii duqeeyeen guri ku yaallay koonfurta Muqdisho, oo ay shir ku lahaayeen xubno taageersanaa Caydiid, odayaal dhaqameed iyo dad kale. Dhacdadan, oo Soomaalidu u taqaanno “Isniintii Dhiigga” , ayaa sababtay dhimasho iyo dhaawac badan. Guddiga Caalamiga ah ee Laanqayrta Cas ayaa xilligaas sheegay in 54 qof ay ku dhinteen, 174 kalana ku dhaawacmeen. Dhanka Maraykanka, waxaa la sheegay in gurigu ahaa xarun laga abaabulayay hawlgallada Isbahaysiga, halka dhinaca Soomaalida qaarkood ay ku doodeen in halkaas uu ka socday kulan dhexdhexaadin iyo dibuheshiisiin ah. Duqayntaas ayaa sidoo kale sababtay dhacdo kale oo raad xanuun badan ku reebtay taariikhda saxaafadda. Dan Eldon iyo saddex saxafi oo kale, oo kala ahaa Hosea Maina, Anthony Macharia iyo Hansi Krauss , ayaa u dhaqaaqay goobtii la duqeeyay, si ay u diiwaangeliyaan khasaaraha iyo xaaladda ka dhalatay weerarka. Hasayeeshee, dad caraysnaa oo goobta ku sugnaa ayaa weeraray saxafiyiinta, iyaga oo afartoodiiba dilay. Eldon, Maina iyo Macharia waxay u shaqaynayeen Reuters, halka Krauss uu la shaqaynayay Associated Press. Saxafi kale oo la socday, Maxamed Shaffi, ayaa dhaawac ku baxsaday. Dhimashada afartaas saxafi ayaa ka mid noqotay dhacdooyinkii muujiyay heerka ay gaartay xiisaddii Muqdisho iyo halistii ay la kulmayeen dadkii isku dayayay inay dunida gaarsiiyaan xogta colaadda Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, duqayntii 12kii Luulyo ayaa sii xoojisay caradii iyo kalsoonidarradii hore uga dhex jirtay qaybo ka mid ah bulshada Muqdisho iyo ciidammada shisheeye. Ciidammada gaarka ah ee Maraykanka, oo ay ka mid ahaayeen Rangers, Delta Force iyo xubno ka tirsanaa SEAL Team Six, ayaa Muqdisho ka waday hawlgallo lagu baadigoobayay Jeneraal Caydiid iyo saraakiishiisa. Howard E. Wasdin, oo ka tirsanaa SEAL Team Six, ayaa buuggiisa SEAL Team Six: Memoirs of an Elite Navy SEAL Sniper ku faahfaahiyay hawlgalladii sirdoonka, gaar ahaan adeegsiga dad Soomaaliyeed oo xog-ururinta ka caawinayay ciidammada Maraykanka, iyo xarun qarsoodi ah oo lagu magacaabi jiray Pasha . Hawlgalladaas waxaa ka mid ahaa qabashadii Cismaan Cali Caato, oo ka mid ahaa saraakiishii ugu dhowaa Caydiid, bishii Sebtembar 1993kii. Galabnimadii Axadda, 3dii Oktoobar 1993kii, ciidammada gaarka ah ee Maraykanka ayaa hawlgal ka tirsanaa Operation Gothic Serpent ka fuliyay agagaarka Suuqa Bakaaraha iyo Hoteelkii Olympic, iyaga oo doonayay inay gacanta ku soo dhigaan laba sarkaal oo sare oo ka tirsanaa Isbahaysigii Qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Hawlgalkaas, oo loo qorsheeyay inuu muddo kooban ku dhammaado, ayaa isu beddelay dagaal daba dheeraaday, kaddib markii xoogaggii hubaysnaa ee Soomaalidu ay soo rideen laba diyaaradood oo qumaatiga u kaca oo nooca Black Hawk ahaa. Saddex diyaaradood oo kalena waxaa soo gaaray waxyeello. Dagaalka ayaa ku fiday waddooyin iyo xaafado ka tirsan Muqdisho, waxaana ciidammadii Maraykanka qaarkood ku adkaatay inay ka baxaan goobihii lagu dagaallamayay. Subaxnimadii 4tii Oktoobar, waxaa gurmad u fidiyay ciidammo isugu jiray Maraykan, Malaysiyaan iyo Bakistaan, iyaga oo adeegsanayay gaadiidka gaashaaman ee Malaysiya iyo taangiyada Bakistaan. Gurmadkaasi wuxuu suurtageliyay in la daadgureeyo ciidammadii ku go’doonsanaa qaybo ka tirsan magaalada Muqdisho. Dagaalkan, oo socday ku dhowaad 18 saacadood, waxaa ku dhintay 18 askari oo Maraykan ah iyo askari Malaysiyaan ah , halka tobannaan kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Waxaa, sidoo kale, nolol lagu qabtay duuliyihii Maraykanka ee Michael Durant, oo markii danbe la sii daayay. Dhanka Soomaalida, khasaaruhu aad buu u badnaa, inkasta oo aan weli la hayn tiro kama dambays ah oo si madaxbannaan loo xaqiijiyay. Warbixinta Human Rights Watch ayaa lagu sheegay in in ka badan 200 oo Soomaali ah ay ku dhinteen, ilaa 700 kalena ku dhaawacmeen, halka warbixinno kale ay soo bandhigeen qiyaaso ka sarreeya. Dadka waxyeelladu gaartay waxaa ku jiray dagaalyahanno iyo dad rayid ah. Inkasta oo dagaalka inta badan lagu soo koobo ciidammada Maraykanka iyo xoogaggii Jeneraal Caydiid, haddana waxaa jira warbixinno taariikheed oo tilmaamaya kaalintii kooxihii Islaamiyiinta Soomaaliyeed iyo xubno xiriir la lahaa al-Qaacidda. Warbixintii Guddigii Baarista Weerarradii 11kii Sebteenbar ee Maraykanka ayaa sheegtay in al-Qaacidda ay hub iyo tababarayaal u dirtay kooxo Soomaaliyeed oo la dagaallamayay ciidammada Maraykanka. Waxaa, sidoo kale, jira qoraallo ka hadlaya xiriirkii al-Qaacidda iyo al-Itixaad al-Islaami. Hasayeeshee, baaxadda doorkii tooska ahaa ee kooxahaasi ku lahaayeen dagaalkii 3–4 Oktoobar iyo cidda fulisay weerarradii lagu soo riday diyaaradaha ayaa weli u baahan caddayn iyo kalasaarid taariikheed. Dagaalkaas waxaa, sidoo kale, ka dhashay khasaare naf iyo maalba lahaa oo soo gaaray qoysas Soomaaliyeed oo aan ka qaybgelin dagaalka. Warbixinnada taariikheed iyo maragfurka dadkii goobta ku sugnaa ayaa ka warramay duqaymaha, rasaastii ku dhacday guryaha, barakacii iyo argaggaxii ay la kulmeen dadkii ku noolaa xaafadihii lagu dagaallamayay. Qaar ka mid ah qoysaskaasi waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in ciidammadii Maraykanku ay guryahooda galeen, kuna sugnaayeen intii dagaalku socday. Dhacdooyinkani waxay dhaliyeen su’aalo la xiriira ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah iyo masuuliyadda dhinacyadii dagaallamayay. Dagaalkii Muqdisho ayaa saamayn weyn kaga tegay xusuusta bulshada iyo suugaanta Soomaalida. Waxaa laga curiyay suugaan badan, gaar ahaan godka shiribka, oo lagu cabbiray dareenkii bulshada, dhacdooyinkii dagaalka iyo dhibaatadii dadka rayidka ah. Shiribyada dagaalkaas lagu xusuusto waxaa ka mid ah: “Raanjaris ma rootiyaa   Rayidkii aaba raamsadee?!” — Shirib Hore Dhinaca kale, Dagaalkii Muqdisho ayaa, sidoo kale, saameeyay siyaasaddii Maraykanka ee Soomaaliya. 7dii Oktoobar 1993kii, Madaxweyne Bill Clinton ayaa ku dhawaaqay qorshe ciidammada Maraykanka looga saarayo Soomaaliya ugu danbayn 31ka Maarso 1994kii. 16kii Nofeenbar 1993kii, Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa soo saaray Qaraarkii 885, oo lagu dhisay guddi baaritaan, laguna hakiyay hawlgalladii lagu soo qabanayay dadkii lagu tuhmay weerarradii ciidammada Qaramada Midoobay. Ciidammadii Maraykanka ayaa dalka ka baxay Maarso 1994kii, halka Hawlgalkii UNOSOM II uu soo gabaggoobay Maarso 1995kii. Dagaalkii Muqdisho iyo Tebintiisa Dagaalkaas waxaa markii danbe laga qoray buuagag, lagana sameeyay filimo iyo taxanayaal dukumentari ah. Waxaa ka mid ah buuggii uu Mark Bowden soo saaray 1999kii ee Black Hawk Down: A Story of Modern War , filimkii Black Hawk Down ee uu hagayay Ridley Scott, oo soo baxay 2001kii, iyo taxanihii dukumentariga ahaa ee Surviving Black Hawk Down , oo ay Netflix baahisay 10kii Febraayo 2025kii. Taxanaha Surviving Black Hawk Down , oo ka kooban saddex qaybood, ayaa waraysiyo la yeeshay askartii Maraykanka, dagaalyahannadii Soomaalida iyo dad rayid ah oo ka badbaaday dagaalkii Muqdisho. Dadka lagu waraystay waxaa ka mid ah hooyo Binti Cali Wardheere , oo dagaalkaas ku weyday saygeedii iyo laba wiil oo ay dhashay, halka gabadheeda Ifraax ay indhaha waxyeello ka soo gaartay. Waxaa, sidoo kale, lagu soo bandhigay maragfurka dad Soomaaliyeed oo xusuusta dhibaatadii ay kala kulmeen diyaaradaha dagaalka iyo weerarradii xaafadahooda ka dhacay. Waraysiyadaasi waxay muujinayaan sida ay xusuusta dhacdadu ugu kala duwan tahay ciidammadii dagaallamay iyo dadkii rayidka ahaa ee ku dhex noolaa. Waxay, sidoo kale, dib u soo nooleeyeen doodda ku saabsan cidda sheekada laga dhegaysto, xogta mudnaanta la siiyo iyo sida loo diiwaangeliyo khasaaraha iyo waaya-aragnimada dadka Soomaaliyeed. Sidaas awgeed, fahanka dagaalkaas kuma koobna oo keliya hawlgalkii ciidammada, diyaaradaha la soo riday iyo khasaaraha milatari, balse wuxuu sidoo kale u baahan yahay daraasaynta nolosha dadkii rayidka ahaa iyo dhacdooyinkii ka horreeyay dagaalka. Soddon iyo saddex sano ayaa maanta laga joogaa dagaalkii Muqdisho ee 3–4 Oktoobar 1993kii , oo weli ka mid ah dhacdooyinka sida weyn loogu xusuusto sooyaalka colaaddii sokeeye ee Soomaaliya, faragelintii ciidammada shisheeye iyo khasaaraha naf iyo maalba lahaa ee dagaalladii Muqdisho. Diiwaangelinta dhacdadan, ururinta maragfurka dadkii ay waxyeelladu gaartay iyo iskudubarididda ilaha Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa caalamiga ahi waxay muhiim u yihiin in jiilalka danbe ay helaan xog sugan oo dhinacyo kala duwan ka tarjumaysa. ____________ Tixraacyo United Nations Security Council. items.title: Pro-government forces claim to retake Mekelle airport in Ethiopia’s Tigray region
items.description: ADDIS ABABA (Somaliguardian) – A militia group allied to Ethiopia’s federal government said they had recaptured ​the main airport in the capital of ‌the northern Tigray region, an opposition stronghold. “We have taken full control of Mekelle Alula Aba ​Nega Airport. We are currently clearing ​the city of Mekelle,” the pro-government ⁠Tigray Peace Forces militia posted on X ​late on Friday. Reuters could not immediately verify ​the assertion. The Prime Minister’s Office did not respond immediately to a request for comment. The taking ​of Mekelle by pro-government forces would be ​a major setback for an opposition alliance led by ‌the ⁠region’s ruling party, the Tigray People’s Liberation Front, which launched a big offensive last week against the Ethiopian military. The TPLF ​could not ​immediately be ⁠reached for comment. Ethiopian federal forces and allied fighters have made ​a quick counterattack into Tigray, but ​analysts ⁠say the fighting – the worst escalation since a 2020-2022 civil war – threatens to widen ⁠into ​a wider regional conflict. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Kaniini laga yaabo inaad in badan isticmaashay oo ‘khatar ku ah beerka’
items.description: Kaniini laga yaabo inaad in badan isticmaashay oo ‘khatar ku ah beerka’ Waxaa laga helaa farmashiyeyaasha iyadoo uusan dhaqtar qorin, kaniinigan pracetamol-ka waa mid ka mid ah dawooyinka aadka looga isticmaalo adduunka. Dalka Mareykanka, waxaa lagu qiyaasaa in sanadkii la iibiyo ilaa 49,000 oo tan, amaba in 298 kaniini ah ay sanadkii kusoo aadeyso qofkiiba. Dalka UK, celcelis ahaan 70 xabbo oo kaniinigan ah ayaa qofkii kusoo aada sanadkii. Inkastoo qarniyo la yaqaannay kaniinigan, haddana weli si qoto dheer uma aysan baarin saynisyahannada. Saameynta kaniinigan ayaa kala duwan: Dadka qaar ayaa ka sheegta dhabar-xanuun, kuwo kalena waxay isku arkaan calaamado kale.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ku ballaarinaysa dhinacyada fikirka, dhaqaalaha iyo bulshada
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dadaallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ku ballaarinaysa meel ka baxsan howl-gallada milatari, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo dhinacyada fikirka, dhaqaalaha, warbaahinta, diinta iyo saameynta bulshada ee kooxdu ku sii jirto. Qormo ay baahisay Shabakadda TRT Afrika ayaa lagu sheegay in dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada uusan ku koobnaan karin goobta dagaalka, balse loo baahan yahay in wax laga qabto fikradaha, ilaha dhaqaale, dacaayadaha iyo saameynta bulsho ee u sahla kooxaha hubeysan inay sii wataan howlahooda. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa khudbad uu ka jeediyay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ku sheegay in dowladda ay la dagaallamayso argagixisada dhinacyada milatari, fikir iyo dhaqaale , taasoo muujinaysa in istaraatiijiyadda dowladda ay ka gudubtay dagaalka tooska ah ee goobaha howlgallada. Qormadu waxay tusaale u soo qaadatay isbeddelka laga dareemayo amniga Muqdisho, iyadoo saraakiisha dowladda ay tilmaameen in ay jiraan xaalado ay masuuliyiin sare si caadi ah ugu safraan magaalada, halka goobaha dadweynaha ay sidoo kale dib u bilaabeen inay noqdaan meelaha lagu qabto ciyaaro, munaasabado dhaqameed iyo kulamo ay bulshada si furan uga qaybqaadato. Dhanka kale, dowladda ayaa xoogga saaraysa dagaalka fikirka , gaar ahaan sidii loo wiiqi lahaa adeegsiga diinta ee lagu marin habaabinayo bulshada. Saraakiisha dowladda ayaa kooxda inta badan ugu yeera magaca “Khawaarij”, iyadoo loo marayo istaraatiijiyad lagu doonayo in kooxda laga sooco magaca iyo aqoonsiga dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed. Dowladda ayaa wadda qorshe ay ku diiwaangelinayso dugsiyada Qur’aanka iyo xarumaha waxbarashada diinta, iyadoo sidoo kale la doonayo in la xoojiyo isku-duwidda khudbadaha Jimcaha iyo wacyigelinta diimeed ee ka dhanka ah fasiraadaha xagjirka ah. Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta ayaa sidoo kale taageertay hindise la xiriira dhismaha Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed , kaas oo loo qorsheeyay inuu mideeyo culimada, xoojiyo doorkooda bulshada, isla markaana gacan ka geysto wacyigelinta diimeed, nabadda iyo ka hortagga fikirrada xagjirka ah. Dhinaca dhaqaalaha, dowladda ayaa sidoo kale bartilmaameedsanaysa ilaha dhaqaale ee Al-Shabaab, sida lagu sheegay qormada, kooxda Al-shabaab ayaa muddo dheer lacag ka ururinaysay ganacsatada, beeraleyda, gaadiidleyda iyo qaybaha kale ee bulshada, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay inay qaaday tallaabooyin lagu beegsanayo xisaabaadka, hababka isgaarsiinta iyo nidaamyada lacagaha ee lala xiriiriyo maalgelinta kooxda. Dagaalka warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada ayaa sidoo kale ka mid ah qorshaha, ayadoo Dowladdu ay kordhisay warbixinnada rasmiga ah ee ku saabsan xaaladaha amni, iyadoo la doonayo in laga hortago in kooxaha hubeysan ay si gaar ah u maamulaan sheekada iyo wararka ka dhasha weerarrada. Qormadu waxay sidoo kale xustay muhiimadda ay leedahay dib-u-soo-celinta goobaha dadweynaha iyo nolol maalmeedka bulshada, waxaana Ciyaaraha, munaasabadaha dhaqanka iyo isu imaatinnada bulshada loo arkaa qayb ka mid ah soo celinta noloshii caadiga ahayd iyo yareynta saameynta ay cabsi iyo hanjabaad amni ku yeesheen bulshada. Sidoo kale, dowladda ayaa isku dayaysa inay beddesho sawirka ku saabsan alle ubariga iyo geesinimada , iyadoo si weyn loo maamuuso ciidamada iyo saraakiisha ku dhinta dagaalka, isla markaana la qorsheynayo taageero waxbarasho iyo caafimaad oo loo fidiyo carruurta ay ka tageen askarta ku dhimatay howlgallada. Marka la isku geeyo tallaabooyinkan, istaraatiijiyadda dowladda Soomaaliya waxay isku dayaysaa in dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab laga dhigo mid aan ku koobnaan xoogga milatari oo keliya, balse lagu daro wiiqidda ilaha dhaqaale, ka hortagga dacaayadda, xoojinta wacyigelinta diimeed, soo celinta adeegyada iyo goobaha bulshada, iyo xoojinta kalsoonida shacabka ee hay’adaha dowladda . Qormada TRT Afrika waxay ku soo gabagabaynaysaa in awoodda ciidan oo keliya aysan ku filnayn in la wiiqo koox argagixiso oo muddo dheer ku tiirsanayd shabakad dhaqaale, fikradeed iyo bulsho; sidaas darteed, dagaalku wuxuu u baahan yahay in isku mar wax looga qabto awoodda dagaal iyo xaaladaha u sahla kooxda inay sii yeelato saameyn.

items.title: Baaritaan shaaciyey tirada shacabka Soomaaliya ee uu Mareykanka ku dilay duqeymo
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Ugu yaraan 216 qof oo rayid ah ayaa ku dhintay ama ku dhaawacmay duqeymo iyo howlgallo cirka ah oo Mareykanku ka fuliyey Soomaaliya intii u dhexeysay 2007 iyo May 2025, sida lagu sheegay baaritaan cusub oo ku saleysan xog ay ururisay hay’adda Airwars. Baaritaanka, oo ay daabacday Arab Reporters for Investigative Journalism (ARIJ), ayaa lagu falanqeeyey 884 howlgal oo cirka ah oo Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisu ka fuliyeen Soomaaliya, Suuriya, Ciraaq iyo Yemen. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay diiwaangeliyeen ugu yaraan 3,336 qof oo rayid ah oo ku dhintay ama ku dhaawacmay afartaas dal. Soomaaliya waxaa laga diiwaangeliyey 216 qof, halka Suuriya ay ahayd 1,336, Yemen 991 iyo Ciraaq 793. ARIJ waxay sheegtay in tirooyinkani yihiin khasaaraha ugu yar ee la xaqiijin karo, islamarkaana aysan ka dhigneyn dhammaan dadka rayidka ah ee waxyeelladu ka soo gaartay howlgallada militari ee Mareykanka. Baarayaashu waxay isticmaaleen xogta Airwars ee muddada u dhexeysa Janaayo 2007 ilaa dhammaadka May 2025, iyagoo dhacdo kasta ka qaadanayey tirada ugu hooseysa ee khasaaraha la diiwaangeliyey. Waxay sidoo kale meesha ka saareen dhacdooyinka muranku ka jiray in weerarku dhacay iyo kuwa aan si ku filan loo xaqiijin karin tirada dadka rayidka ah ee waxyeelladu gaartay. Farqi weyn oo u dhexeeya tirooyinka Airwars ma diiwaangeliso dhammaan duqeymaha Mareykanka, balse waxay xoogga saartaa howlgallada ay kasoo baxaan warar muujinaya in dad rayid ahi waxyeello soo gaartay. Hay’addu waxay xogteeda ka ururisaa warbaahinta gudaha iyo tan caalamiga ah, baraha bulshada, ogeysiisyada dhimashada iyo aaska, iyadoo xogaha kala duwan isbarbardhigta ka hor inta aysan qiimeyn heerka kalsoonida dhacdo kasta. Sidaas darteed, tirada 216-ka qof ma aha khasaaraha guud ee rayidka ka soo gaaray ku dhowaad labaatan sano oo Mareykanku howlgallo militari ka waday Soomaaliya. Airwars waxay hadda ku qiyaastaa in howlgallada Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya ay dileen inta u dhexeysa 85 iyo 162 qof oo rayid ah dhacdooyin ay hay’addu u aragto kuwo la xaqiijiyey ama lagu kalsoonaan karo. Waxa kale oo ay sheegtay in 35 ilaa 55 qof oo kale ay u badan tahay inay dhaawacmeen. Dhinaca kale, ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa qirtay oo keliya lix dhimasho oo rayid ah iyo 11 dhaawac oo ka dhashay howlgalladooda Soomaaliya, sida ku cad xogta Airwars. Farqiga weyn ee u dhexeeya labada tiro wuxuu qayb ahaan ka dhashaa hababka kala duwan ee loo baaro dhacdooyinka. Airwars waxay tixgelisaa warbixinnada maxalliga ah ee lagu kalsoonaan karo xitaa marka militariga Mareykanku uusan aqbalin in howlgalkiisa uu sababay khasaaraha rayidka. Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, ayaa sheegay inuu baaro eedeymaha khasaaraha rayidka isagoo adeegsanaya xog sirdoon, warbixinnada howlgalka iyo macluumaadka dadweynaha loo heli karo. Warbixintiisii ugu dambeysay ee saddex-biloodlaha ahayd, oo ku ekeyd 30-kii June, AFRICOM wuxuu sheegay inuu helay saddex dacwadood oo cusub oo ku saabsan waxyeello rayid, halka shan kiis oo hore ay weli furnaayeen. Laba kiis ayuu talisku xiray muddadaas, lix kalena way sii furnaayeen. Carruurta oo qayb ka ah khasaaraha Baaritaanka ARIJ wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in carruurtu ay ahaayeen qiyaastii 42 boqolkiiba dadka rayidka ah ee khasaaruhu gaaray afarta dal ee daraasaddu ka hadashay, taas oo u dhiganta 1,286 carruur ah. Hase yeeshee, tiradaas waxay isugu darsan tahay Soomaaliya, Suuriya, Ciraaq iyo Yemen, mana ka dhigna in 42 boqolkiiba 216-ka qof ee Soomaaliya lagu diiwaangeliyey ay carruur ahaayeen. Baaritaanku sidoo kale ma kala caddeyn inta ka mid ah 216-ka qof ee Soomaaliya ku dhintay iyo inta dhaawacantay. ARIJ waxay intaas ku dartay in militariga Mareykanku Soomaaliya iyo Yemen u adeegsaday Project Maven, oo ah nidaam sirdoon oo ku shaqeeya teknoolajiyadda sirdoonka macmalka ah, laguna farsameeyo xogta kormeerka laguna caawiyo aqoonsiga bartilmaameedyada. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay inay la xiriirtay dhowr hay’adood oo Mareykan ah si ay uga jawaabaan natiijooyinka baaritaanka, isla markaana codsigii ugu dambeeyey u dirtay Ciidamada Cirka Mareykanka bishii June 2026, balse aysan wax jawaab ah helin ka hor intii aan warbixinta la daabicin. AFRICOM ayaa dhankiisa sheegay inuu si dhab ah u qaato eedeymaha la xiriira khasaaraha rayidka, isla markaana uu sii wado daabacaadda qiimeynno saddex-biloodle ah oo ku saabsan dhacdooyinka lala xiriiriyo howlgallada Mareykanka. Baaritaanka, oo ay daabacday Arab Reporters for Investigative Journalism (ARIJ), ayaa lagu falanqeeyey 884 howlgal oo cirka ah oo Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisu ka fuliyeen Soomaaliya, Suuriya, Ciraaq iyo Yemen. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay diiwaangeliyeen ugu yaraan 3,336 qof oo rayid ah oo ku dhintay ama ku dhaawacmay afartaas dal. Soomaaliya waxaa laga diiwaangeliyey 216 qof, halka Suuriya ay ahayd 1,336, Yemen 991 iyo Ciraaq 793. ARIJ waxay sheegtay in tirooyinkani yihiin khasaaraha ugu yar ee la xaqiijin karo, islamarkaana aysan ka dhigneyn dhammaan dadka rayidka ah ee waxyeelladu ka soo gaartay howlgallada militari ee Mareykanka. Baarayaashu waxay isticmaaleen xogta Airwars ee muddada u dhexeysa Janaayo 2007 ilaa dhammaadka May 2025, iyagoo dhacdo kasta ka qaadanayey tirada ugu hooseysa ee khasaaraha la diiwaangeliyey. Waxay sidoo kale meesha ka saareen dhacdooyinka muranku ka jiray in weerarku dhacay iyo kuwa aan si ku filan loo xaqiijin karin tirada dadka rayidka ah ee waxyeelladu gaartay. Farqi weyn oo u dhexeeya tirooyinka Airwars ma diiwaangeliso dhammaan duqeymaha Mareykanka, balse waxay xoogga saartaa howlgallada ay kasoo baxaan warar muujinaya in dad rayid ahi waxyeello soo gaartay. Hay’addu waxay xogteeda ka ururisaa warbaahinta gudaha iyo tan caalamiga ah, baraha bulshada, ogeysiisyada dhimashada iyo aaska, iyadoo xogaha kala duwan isbarbardhigta ka hor inta aysan qiimeyn heerka kalsoonida dhacdo kasta. Sidaas darteed, tirada 216-ka qof ma aha khasaaraha guud ee rayidka ka soo gaaray ku dhowaad labaatan sano oo Mareykanku howlgallo militari ka waday Soomaaliya. Airwars waxay hadda ku qiyaastaa in howlgallada Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya ay dileen inta u dhexeysa 85 iyo 162 qof oo rayid ah dhacdooyin ay hay’addu u aragto kuwo la xaqiijiyey ama lagu kalsoonaan karo. Waxa kale oo ay sheegtay in 35 ilaa 55 qof oo kale ay u badan tahay inay dhaawacmeen. Dhinaca kale, ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa qirtay oo keliya lix dhimasho oo rayid ah iyo 11 dhaawac oo ka dhashay howlgalladooda Soomaaliya, sida ku cad xogta Airwars. Farqiga weyn ee u dhexeeya labada tiro wuxuu qayb ahaan ka dhashaa hababka kala duwan ee loo baaro dhacdooyinka. Airwars waxay tixgelisaa warbixinnada maxalliga ah ee lagu kalsoonaan karo xitaa marka militariga Mareykanku uusan aqbalin in howlgalkiisa uu sababay khasaaraha rayidka. Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, ayaa sheegay inuu baaro eedeymaha khasaaraha rayidka isagoo adeegsanaya xog sirdoon, warbixinnada howlgalka iyo macluumaadka dadweynaha loo heli karo. Warbixintiisii ugu dambeysay ee saddex-biloodlaha ahayd, oo ku ekeyd 30-kii June, AFRICOM wuxuu sheegay inuu helay saddex dacwadood oo cusub oo ku saabsan waxyeello rayid, halka shan kiis oo hore ay weli furnaayeen. Laba kiis ayuu talisku xiray muddadaas, lix kalena way sii furnaayeen. Carruurta oo qayb ka ah khasaaraha Baaritaanka ARIJ wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in carruurtu ay ahaayeen qiyaastii 42 boqolkiiba dadka rayidka ah ee khasaaruhu gaaray afarta dal ee daraasaddu ka hadashay, taas oo u dhiganta 1,286 carruur ah. Hase yeeshee, tiradaas waxay isugu darsan tahay Soomaaliya, Suuriya, Ciraaq iyo Yemen, mana ka dhigna in 42 boqolkiiba 216-ka qof ee Soomaaliya lagu diiwaangeliyey ay carruur ahaayeen. Baaritaanku sidoo kale ma kala caddeyn inta ka mid ah 216-ka qof ee Soomaaliya ku dhintay iyo inta dhaawacantay. ARIJ waxay intaas ku dartay in militariga Mareykanku Soomaaliya iyo Yemen u adeegsaday Project Maven, oo ah nidaam sirdoon oo ku shaqeeya teknoolajiyadda sirdoonka macmalka ah, laguna farsameeyo xogta kormeerka laguna caawiyo aqoonsiga bartilmaameedyada. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay inay la xiriirtay dhowr hay’adood oo Mareykan ah si ay uga jawaabaan natiijooyinka baaritaanka, isla markaana codsigii ugu dambeeyey u dirtay Ciidamada Cirka Mareykanka bishii June 2026, balse aysan wax jawaab ah helin ka hor intii aan warbixinta la daabicin. AFRICOM ayaa dhankiisa sheegay inuu si dhab ah u qaato eedeymaha la xiriira khasaaraha rayidka, isla markaana uu sii wado daabacaadda qiimeynno saddex-biloodle ah oo ku saabsan dhacdooyinka lala xiriiriyo howlgallada Mareykanka.
