items.title: Dab qasaare gaystay oo saamayn ku yeeshay boqollaal qoys oo ku nool Hargaysa
items.description: (ERGO) –  Hoy la’aan ayay wajahayaan labo boqol soddon iyo siddeed qoys oo ku nool magaalada Hargeysa iyo deegaannada kale ee Somaliland. Waxay ku guryo beeleen dabab u kacay si kedis ah tan iyo bishii 7aad ee sanadkan. Waxaa ka mid ah qoyska Foosiya Cabdi Aadan oo ka kooban 10 qof, kuwaas hoy la’aan ah. Waxay xaaladdan galeen markii bishii Luulyo uu dab baabi’yay guri labo qol jiingad ah oo ay degganaayeen xaafadda Dhego-sayn ee magaalada Hargeysa. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay waayeen dhaqaale ay dib ugu dhistaan, taas bidday inay marba qoys ku noqdaan dul-saar, maaddaama aysan haysan doorasho kale. “Wax mahaysataan iska ahay. Makhsin ayuu dabku ka kacay. Carruur yaryar baa huruday waan ka kiciyay. Carruurtii baan ka saaray markaa sidaas ayuu dabkaasi aan ula kulmay. Wax kama hadhin wixii hanti noo dhex-taalay halkaasay ku gubatay.” Foosiya waxay sheegtay in xilliga uu gurigu gubanayay ay ku maqneyd raadinta shaqo nadaafad ah si ay uga soo dhiciso biilka reerka. Nasiib darro, waxay ku soo beegan tahay gurigeedii oo holcaya. Foosiya ayaa sheegay inay xaaladdan ugu soo aaday xilli ninkeeda oo macallin dugsi ah uu shaqo la’aan yahay markii laga maarmay, taas oo keentay inay kiro iyo noloshii kale awoodi waayaan. Dhaqaale xumada iyo duruufaha kale ee awoodooda ka baxsan ayay tilmaamtay inay ku hoggaamiyeen inay ehelka u dan-sheegtaan. “Waxaan maanta i dhaahdo wax buuran baan meel ka sugaa wallaahi wuxuu ilaahay ii ogyahay mooyee ma jiro. Cuntada hooyaday baan ku tiirsanahay iyaduun baan ku cararaa.” Foosiya ayaa sheegtay in guriga ka gubtay ay u dhistay soddohdeed, markii ay awoodi waayeen inay iska bixiyaan kirada guryaha magaalada oo sanadihii danbe uu qiimahooda kordhayay. Waxay tilmaamtay inay gurigaas kaga baxday dhibaato ahayd in marba guri laga saaro, balse waxay mar kale wajahayaan hubanti la’aan dhanka hoyga ah. Foosiya gabbaad li’idda ku dhacday waxaa u raacda inaysan arrad-tir u gadan karin carruurteeda maaddaama dharkoodii uu ka mid noqday waxyaabihii gurigoodii uga dhex bas-beelay. “Jeebkaygii ma awoodo inaan maryo u iibiyo. Wixii aan wax gashaday dabkii buu iga raacay maanta laakiin walaahi halka iigu darani waa qaawanidaa awlaadaa yaryar uun haddana alxamdulilaah intaa hadduu odaygu noo camal helo waanu iska iibsan oo mar walba ilaahay baanu khayr ka rajaynaynaa.” Foosiya ayaa xustay in saddex ka mid ah carruurteeda oo kala jira 9, 13 iyo 16 oo kala dhiganayay fasallada 3aad, 4aad iyo shanaad ay ku dhacday waxbarasho la’aan. Waxay awoodi 18 doollar oo ay bishii ka dhiibaysay. Dababka ka kaca Somaliland ayaa sababay in qoysas badan ay waayaan hantidoodii iyo guryihii ay ku noolaayeen, taas oo keentay inay mutaan nolol adag. Dabka ayaa ka dhashay koronto sida Radio Ergo ka soo xigatay Ciidamada Dab damiska Somaliland. Xamda Xaashi Guuleed iyo qoyskeeda 13 ayaa ka mid ah qoysaskaas ka soo kaban la’ qasaaraha. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inuu dab baabi’iyay bishii sagaalaad ee sanadkan labo qol oo ay ku lahaayeen xaafadda Ugaaso ee magaalada Hargeysa. Xamda ayaa tilmaamtay inaysan keliya waayin guri balse ay maanta ka faro maran tahay wixii gogol, maacuun, sariiro iyo dhar ay haysteen, taas oo keentay inay saamaynta ku badato. “Hantidii aan ku waayay waxaan ku qiyaasi lahaa hanti badan, sariirtayda oo qudha ayaaba ahayd kun iyo shan boqol oo dollar. Dee carruurtaydii dirayskii baa kaga jirey wax badan baan ku waayay buugaagtoodii hawl badan ayaa iga soo gaadhay reer dab galay ma yara hawshoodu.” Xamda ayaa xustay in xilligii uu dabka ka kacay gurigeeda ay ilmo yar kula maqnayd madarasad, isla markii ay soo noqotayna ay aragtay iyadoo aysan wax uga cayman. Halka xubna kale ee qoyska ay reer qaraabo ah ku maqnaayeen. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay hadda isku biirsadeen maaraynta nolosha oo ku adag iyo hoy la’aan. Saygeeda oo ka shaqayn jiray dhismaha guryaha magaalada ayay xustay inuusan shaqo hayn. Waxaa intaas u dheer inay hayso hooyadeed oo waayeel ah, isla markaana aan si buuxda wax u kala garanayn oo daryeel iyo ilaalin uga baahan maaddaama ay sheegtay inay iska baxayso. Xamda tilmaantay inay ku dedaasho sidii ay u heli lahayd daawooyinka ay u baahan tahay balse aysan dantu u saamixin. Marka ay waxba u wayso waxay caawin waydiisataa ehelkeeda. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay xammili la’ yihiin hoy xumada iyo duruufaha ku xeeran oo aysan xilli maarayn u hayn. Haweeneydan ayaa ku taamaysay in lagu caawiyo sidii ay dib ugu dhisan lahayd hoygeedii. Cabdiqani Saleebaan Maxamed, oo ka mid ah shaqaalaha hay’adda Cadaalight kuna takhasusay arrimaha masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah, ayaa sheegay in waxyaabaha ugu badan ee sababa dababka ay ka mid yihiin dab qaybisooyinka la isticmaalo iyo fiilooyinka aan laga taxadarin dhaawaca soo gaara iyo tayadooda. “Waxyaabaha sababayaa waxa weeyaan hab nidaamyada, dagsiimada ama cufnaantooda way ka qayb qaadanaysaa. Waxaa kale oo sababaya dhismaha. Waxaa dhacda mararka qaar xadhig dhex roorkiisu aanuu qaadi karayn maayad laydh oo ku habboon ayaa dabeetana qofku soo iibsanayaa isaga oo aan hubin in shaygani u shaqaynaayo iyo inuu badbaado leeyahay. Cabdiqani ayaa sheegay in dababka noocan ah laga hortagi karo haddii bulshada la wacyigeliyo, isla markaana kor loo qaado fahamka iyo garaadka dadka ee ku aaddan khatarihiisa. Wuxuu bulshada ku baraarujiyay inay si gaar ah uga digtoonaadaan waxyaabaha sababi kara dabka, ayna qaataan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah ee looga badbaadi karo. Cabdiqani ayaa sheegay in waxyeellada dabka keliya aysan ku koobnayn inuu  guryo iyo hanti kale kale burburiyo, balse ay uu saamayn ku yeelan karo mustaqbalka qoysaska. Wuxuu soo jeediyay in taxaddarka iyo ka hortaggu ay yihiin tallaabooyinka ugu horreeyaa ee lagu yareyn karo khasaaraha. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in bulshada  looga baahan yahay inay si masuuliyad leh u isticmaalaan qalabka korontada. Waxaa muhiim ah in bulshada la baro aqoonta maaraynta dababka iyo in la helo iskaashi bulshada dhexdeeda ah si sanadkan kasta looga baaqsado qasaaraha dabka oo ku soo noqnoqda deegaannada Soomaalida. Dabka ayaa ka dhashay koronto sida Radio Ergo ka soo xigatay Ciidamada Dab damiska Somaliland. Xamda Xaashi Guuleed iyo qoyskeeda 13 ayaa ka mid ah qoysaskaas ka soo kaban la’ qasaaraha. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inuu dab baabi’iyay bishii sagaalaad ee sanadkan labo qol oo ay ku lahaayeen xaafadda Ugaaso ee magaalada Hargeysa. Xamda ayaa tilmaamtay inaysan keliya waayin guri balse ay maanta ka faro maran tahay wixii gogol, maacuun, sariiro iyo dhar ay haysteen, taas oo keentay inay saamaynta ku badato. “Hantidii aan ku waayay waxaan ku qiyaasi lahaa hanti badan, sariirtayda oo qudha ayaaba ahayd kun iyo shan boqol oo dollar. Dee carruurtaydii dirayskii baa kaga jirey wax badan baan ku waayay buugaagtoodii hawl badan ayaa iga soo gaadhay reer dab galay ma yara hawshoodu.” Xamda ayaa xustay in xilligii uu dabka ka kacay gurigeeda ay ilmo yar kula maqnayd madarasad, isla markii ay soo noqotayna ay aragtay iyadoo aysan wax uga cayman. Halka xubna kale ee qoyska ay reer qaraabo ah ku maqnaayeen. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay hadda isku biirsadeen maaraynta nolosha oo ku adag iyo hoy la’aan. Saygeeda oo ka shaqayn jiray dhismaha guryaha magaalada ayay xustay inuusan shaqo hayn. Waxaa intaas u dheer inay hayso hooyadeed oo waayeel ah, isla markaana aan si buuxda wax u kala garanayn oo daryeel iyo ilaalin uga baahan maaddaama ay sheegtay inay iska baxayso. Xamda tilmaantay inay ku dedaasho sidii ay u heli lahayd daawooyinka ay u baahan tahay balse aysan dantu u saamixin. Marka ay waxba u wayso waxay caawin waydiisataa ehelkeeda. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay xammili la’ yihiin hoy xumada iyo duruufaha ku xeeran oo aysan xilli maarayn u hayn. Haweeneydan ayaa ku taamaysay in lagu caawiyo sidii ay dib ugu dhisan lahayd hoygeedii. Cabdiqani Saleebaan Maxamed, oo ka mid ah shaqaalaha hay’adda Cadaalight kuna takhasusay arrimaha masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah, ayaa sheegay in waxyaabaha ugu badan ee sababa dababka ay ka mid yihiin dab qaybisooyinka la isticmaalo iyo fiilooyinka aan laga taxadarin dhaawaca soo gaara iyo tayadooda. “Waxyaabaha sababayaa waxa weeyaan hab nidaamyada, dagsiimada ama cufnaantooda way ka qayb qaadanaysaa. Waxaa kale oo sababaya dhismaha. Waxaa dhacda mararka qaar xadhig dhex roorkiisu aanuu qaadi karayn maayad laydh oo ku habboon ayaa dabeetana qofku soo iibsanayaa isaga oo aan hubin in shaygani u shaqaynaayo iyo inuu badbaado leeyahay. Cabdiqani ayaa sheegay in dababka noocan ah laga hortagi karo haddii bulshada la wacyigeliyo, isla markaana kor loo qaado fahamka iyo garaadka dadka ee ku aaddan khatarihiisa. Wuxuu bulshada ku baraarujiyay inay si gaar ah uga digtoonaadaan waxyaabaha sababi kara dabka, ayna qaataan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah ee looga badbaadi karo. Cabdiqani ayaa sheegay in waxyeellada dabka keliya aysan ku koobnayn inuu  guryo iyo hanti kale kale burburiyo, balse ay uu saamayn ku yeelan karo mustaqbalka qoysaska. Wuxuu soo jeediyay in taxaddarka iyo ka hortaggu ay yihiin tallaabooyinka ugu horreeyaa ee lagu yareyn karo khasaaraha. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in bulshada  looga baahan yahay inay si masuuliyad leh u isticmaalaan qalabka korontada. Waxaa muhiim ah in bulshada la baro aqoonta maaraynta dababka iyo in la helo iskaashi bulshada dhexdeeda ah si sanadkan kasta looga baaqsado qasaaraha dabka oo ku soo noqnoqda deegaannada Soomaalida. items.title: Xiisadda Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta oo Gaartay Madiina, Khamis Mushait iyo Cadan
items.description: Xiisadda u dhexeysa Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sii xoogeysatay, kaddib markii isbahaysiga uu hoggaamiyo Sacuudigu uu Xuutiyiinta ku eedeeyey inay diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn ku weerareen xarun koronto oo ku taalla magaalada Madiina, taas oo koronto siisa Masjidka Nabiga. Isbahaysiga ayaa sheegay in weerarku uu waxyeelleeyey hal qalab oo koronto beddela, balse uusan sababin hakad guud oo ku yimaadda shabakadda korontada magaalada. Sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha isbahaysiga, baaritaan lagu sameeyey burburka diyaaradda aan duuliyaha lahayn ayaa lagu ogaaday in weerarka ay ku lug lahaayeen Xuutiyiinta. Ilo militari oo ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta ayaa beeniyey eedeynta, iyagoo sheegay inaysan wax lug ah ku lahayn weerarka lagu sheegay xarunta korontada ee Madiina. Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu qabtay oo burburiyey gantaal ballistic ah oo loo waday magaalada Khamis Mushait. Dhanka kale, saraakiil maxalli ah ayaa sheegay in xarunta taliska isbahaysiga ee magaalada Cadan lagu weeraray gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn. Warbaahinta xiriirka la leh Xuutiyiinta ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in diyaaradaha dagaalka ee Sacuudigu duqeymo ka fuliyeen magaalooyin iyo deegaanno ay ka mid yihiin Sanca, Sacda, Taciz iyo Camraan. Afhayeen u hadlay ciidamada dowladda Yemen ayaa xaqiijiyey in isbahaysigu duqeeyey bartilmaameedyo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo muhiim ah oo ku yaalla Sanca, balse ma uusan faahfaahin ka bixin goobaha gaarka ah ee la beegsaday iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay. Is-dhaafsiga weerarrada ayaa sii kordhinaya walaaca laga qabo in colaadda Yemen ay mar kale isu beddesho dagaal ballaaran oo gobolka saameeya. Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa lagu tilmaamay inay ka mid tahay xaaladihii ugu adkaa tan iyo xabbad-joojintii ay Qaramada Midoobay garwadeenka ka ahayd ee 2022, inkastoo colaadda Yemen aysan si buuxda u dhammaan. Xiisaddu waxay sii xoogeysatay kaddib markii Xuutiyiintu bishii Luulyo ku dhawaaqeen tallaabooyin xannibaad badeed ah oo ay ku wajahayeen Sacuudiga, iyadoo sidoo kale la sheegay inay horumar ka sameeyeen qaybo ka mid ah xeebaha Badda Cas. Sacuudiga ayaa dhankiisa uga jawaabay duqeymo cirka ah iyo taageero uu siiyo ciidamada dowladda Yemen. Gulufkan cusub ee colaadda ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in dagaalladu saameeyaan magaalooyin iyo goobo muhiim ah oo ka baxsan furimaha dhaqanka, iyadoo Madiina, Khamis Mushait iyo Cadan ay ka mid noqdeen meelaha lagu soo warramay dhacdooyinka ugu dambeeyay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qaar ka mid ah sheegashooyinka ku saabsan weerarrada, cidda fulisay iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay ayaan weli si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin, iyadoo xaaladda goobaha colaadda ay weli tahay mid isbeddelaysa.

items.title: Qaraxyo ka Dhacay Addis Ababa iyo Mucaaradka oo Lagu Eedeeyay Weerarro Drone ah
items.description: Saddex qarax ayaa laga maqlay goobo kala duwan oo ku yaalla caasimadda Itoobiya ee Addis Ababa, xilli dagaallada ka socda waqooyiga dalka ay sii fidayaan, waxaana weli socda baaritaanno lagu ogaanayo sababta rasmiga ah ee qaraxyada. Sarkaal ka tirsan hay’adda sirdoonka Itoobiya iyo ilo diblomaasiyadeed ayaa xaqiijiyey in qaraxyada laga maqlay qaybo ka mid ah magaalada, balse ma aysan caddeyn waxa sababay iyo haddii ay xiriir la leeyihiin colaadda ka socota waqooyiga dalka. Mid ka mid ah qaraxyada ayaa laga maqlay meel u dhow xarunta taliska Ciidanka Difaaca Itoobiya, halka qarax kale laga maqlay agagaarka warshad ku taalla isla deegaankaas. Goobjoogayaal ayaa sheegay in aan la arkin burbur muuqda oo ka dhashay qaraxyada meel u dhow xarunta milatariga, taas oo sii kordhisay su’aalaha ku saabsan halka ay qaraxyadu ka yimaadeen. Ilo xiriir la leh isbahaysiga mucaaradka ayaa Reuters u sheegay in la fuliyey dhowr weerar oo loo adeegsaday diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, kuwaas oo ay ku jireen weerarro lagu bartilmaameedsaday xarunta taliska milatariga. Hase yeeshee, sheegashadaas weli si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Dowladda federaalka Itoobiya, Ciidanka Difaaca Itoobiya iyo TPLF ayaan ka jawaabin codsiyo loo diray oo ku saabsanaa sheegashada weerarrada drone-yada. Saacado ka hor inta aan qaraxyada la maqlin, Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Amniga Qaranka Itoobiya ayaa ku dhawaaqday in si ku-meelgaar ah loo mamnuucay dhammaan duullimaadyada diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Addis Ababa iyo deegaannada ku xeeran. Tallaabadan ayaa timid xilli walaac laga qabo in dagaallada ka socda waqooyiga dalka ay saameyn ku yeeshaan amniga caasimadda. Xoogagga mucaaradka ayaa hore aan si weyn loogu aqoon inay haystaan diyaarado drone ah oo hubeysan, balse warbixinno soo baxaya ayaa tilmaamaya inay heli karaan qaybo iyo awood farsamo oo la xiriirta adeegsiga diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Haddii baaritaannada lagu xaqiijiyo in qaraxyada Addis Ababa ay ka dhasheen weerarro drone oo ay fuliyeen xoogagga mucaaradka, dhacdadu waxay noqon kartaa horumar cusub oo dhinaca farsamada iyo juqraafiyeed ee colaadda Itoobiya ah, maadaama ay muujin lahayd in awoodda dagaalku gaartay meel ka baxsan furimaha waqooyiga. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale sare u qaadi karta walaaca laga qabo in colaadda ka socota waqooyiga Itoobiya ay ku faafto goobo kale oo dalka ah, gaar ahaan haddii weerarro lagu qaado xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dowladda iyo milatariga ee caasimadda. Si kastaba, ilaa hadda lama hayo xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo muujinaysa cidda ka dambeysay qaraxyada, nooca hubka la adeegsaday ama khasaaraha ka dhashay, iyadoo baaritaannada ay weli socdaan.

items.title: Dagaallada Itoobiya oo Barakiciyey Tobannaan Kun iyo Adeegyadii Mekelle oo Hakad Galey
items.description: Dagaallada ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa sababay barakaca tobannaan kun oo qof, iyadoo xaaladda amni ay saameyn ku yeelatay adeegyada muhiimka ah ee magaalada Mekelle iyo deegaanno ka tirsan Tigray iyo Canfarta. Isgaarsiinta, adeegyada bangiyada iyo qaar ka mid ah adeegyada kale ee aasaasiga ah ayaa hakad galay, taas oo saameyn ku yeelatay ganacsiga iyo nolol-maalmeedka dadka ku nool goobaha ay colaadu ka jirto. Ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaad taageersan ayaa sheegay inay dib ula wareegeen magaalada Erbeti iyo deegaanno kale oo ka tirsan Canfarta. Dhanka kale, kooxda Tigray Peace Forces ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada federaalku ay howlgallada ku taageereen duqeymo cirka ah. Dagaallada ka socda Canfarta ayaa sababay barakaca tobannaan kun oo qof, iyadoo dadka ku nool xerada Hitsats ee waqooyi-galbeed Tigray ay sheegeen inay maqlayaan madaafiic culus iyo rasaas. Xerada Hitsats waxaa ku nool qiyaastii 16,000 qof oo horey u ahaa barakacayaal muddo lix sano ah, waxaana hadda soo food saartay cabsi laga qabo in dagaallada sii fidaya ay ku qasbaan inay mar kale ka barakacaan deegaankooda. Mekelle gudaheeda, dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in go’itaanka isgaarsiinta iyo hakadka adeegyada bangiyada ay si weyn u saameeyeen dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga. Lacagt caddaanka ah ayaa yaraatay, iyadoo dadka qaar ay sheegeen inay ku adkaatay inay helaan raashin iyo adeegyo kale oo muhiim ah. Darawal taksi oo ku sugan magaalada ayaa sheegay in qiimaha shidaalka ee suuqa madow uu laba jibbaarmay, taas oo muujinaysa saameynta dhaqaale ee ka dhalatay hakadka adeegyada iyo isku-socodka gaadiidka. Dhanka milatariga, ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inay ku sii siqayaan koonfurta Tigray, halka isbahaysiga mucaaradka uu sheegay inuu deegaanno ka qabsaday gobolka Canfarta. Faahfaahinta ku saabsan dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada iyo gacan-ku-haynta dhulka ayaa weli ah kuwo aan si madax-bannaan loo wada xaqiijin. Fiditaanka colaadda, xirnaanshaha waddooyinka iyo hakadka adeegyada aasaasiga ah ayaa sii kordhinaya baahida bani’aadannimo ee dadka ay dagaalladu saameeyeen. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ku baaqday in la dejiyo xiisadda, lana furo waddo loo maro wada-hadal u dhexeeya dowladda Itoobiya iyo kooxaha mucaaradka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee iyadoo dagaalladu ay sii socdaan, xaaladda dadka rayidka ah ee Tigray iyo Canfarta ayaa weli ah mid walaac leh, gaar ahaan dadka horey uga soo barakacay colaadaha oo wajahaya khatar ah in mar kale ay guryahooda ka cararaan.

Fiditaanka colaadda, xirnaanshaha waddooyinka iyo hakadka adeegyada aasaasiga ah ayaa sii kordhinaya baahida bani’aadannimo ee dadka ay dagaalladu saameeyeen. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ku baaqday in la dejiyo xiisadda, lana furo waddo loo maro wada-hadal u dhexeeya dowladda Itoobiya iyo kooxaha mucaaradka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee iyadoo dagaalladu ay sii socdaan, xaaladda dadka rayidka ah ee Tigray iyo Canfarta ayaa weli ah mid walaac leh, gaar ahaan dadka horey uga soo barakacay colaadaha oo wajahaya khatar ah in mar kale ay guryahooda ka cararaan.

items.title: Xogta kulamo uu Mahad Salaad ka wado Dhuusamareeb
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Agaasimaha Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad-sugidda Qaranka ee NISA, Mahad Maxamed Salaad ayaa xalay magaalada Dhuusamareeb kulamo kala duwan kula yeeshay qaybaha bulshada, kuwaas oo isugu jiray siyaasiyiin, odayaasha dhaqanka, ganacsato, haween iyo dhallinyaro. Kulamada ayaa waxaa soo abaabulay Guddoomiyaha gobolka Galgaduud, Xuseen Cirfo, qaar kamid ah ganacsatada iyo siyaasiyiinta deegaanka, waxaana looga hadlay doorka bulshada Dhuusamareeb ee dhismaha iyo horumarinta dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Intii kulamadaasi socdeen, waxaa sidoo kale la iskaga xog-wareystay xaaladda nabadda iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada reer Galmudug, iyadoo si gaar ah loo eegay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo dadaallada lagu soo afjarayo khilaafaadka iyo colaadaha beelaha. Qaybaha bulshada ee uu la kulmay Mahad Salaad ayaa uga mahadceliyey, kuna bogaadiyey doorkiisa ku aaddan nabadeynta iyo dadaallada lagu soo afjaray colaaddii sokeeye ee ka jirtay aagga degmada Balanballe. Bulshada ayaa sidoo kale ka codsatay Agaasimaha NISA in la sii wado dadaallada dib-u-heshiisiinta, si loo gaaro nabad waarta oo ka hirgasha dhammaan deegaanada Galmudug. Dhankooda, bulshada Dhuusamareeb ayaa ballanqaaday inay door muuqda ka qaadan doonaan martigelinta kulamada iyo dadaallada dib-u-heshiisiinta, iyagoo muujiyey diyaar garowga ay u leeyihiin taageeridda nabadda iyo xasilloonida deegaanka. Kulamadan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Galmudug ay waddo dadaallo la xiriira xoojinta nabadda iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada, iyadoo qaybo kamid ah deegaanada Galmudug ay weli ka jiraan khilaafaadyo iyo colaado u baahan xal waara. Dhuusamareeb oo ah caasimadda dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug ayaa sidoo kale ah goob muhiim ah oo ay si joogto ah uga dhacaan kulamada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa bulshada ee la xiriira nabadda, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo mustaqbalka Galmudug. items.title: Dagaalka Taciz oo Dib u Qarxay iyo Xiisadda Bab al-Mandab-na Sii .
items.description: Dagaal u dhexeeya ciidamada Xuutiyiinta iyo ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa habeenkii dib uga qarxay dhowr jiho oo ka tirsan gobolka Taciz, iyadoo iska-horimaadyo laga soo sheegay xaafado la deggan yahay oo ku yaalla bariga magaaladaas. Dagaallada ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in Xuutiyiintu bilaabayaan guluf cusub oo milatari, iyadoo xaaladda amni ee gobolka ay mar kale sii xumaanayso. Sarkaal ka tirsan ciidamada maxalliga ah ayaa sheegay in iska-horimaadyadu ay gooyeen waddada muhiimka ah ee isku xirta Taciz iyo Cadan, taas oo ah marin muhiim u ah isu-socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka. Isbitaalka Al-Thawra ee Taciz ayaa, sida uu sheegay maamulaha isbitaalka Cabdiraxmaan Al-Sabri, qaabilay meydadka lix qof iyo 35 qof oo dhaawac ah. Tiradan ayaa muujinaysa saameynta ay dagaalladu ku yeesheen dadka rayidka ah iyo dhinacyada ku lugta leh, inkastoo aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin karin dhammaan faahfaahinta khasaaraha. Ciidamada dowladda Yemen ayaa dhankooda sheegay in madaafiic la is-weydaarsaday, isla markaana duqeymo cirka ah laga fuliyay jihooyinka galbeedka Taciz. Hase yeeshee, sheegashooyinka dhinacyada ee ku saabsan goobaha la beegsaday, khasaaraha iyo cidda gacanta ku dhigtay goobaha dagaalka ayaan weli si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. Taciz ayaa qiyaastii 100 kiiloomitir u jirta magaalada dekedda ah ee Mocha, oo sida lagu sheegay warbixinnada la xiriira colaadda ay Xuutiyiintu qabsadeen bishii hore. Kooxda ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inay la wareegtay jasiirado istaraatiiji ah oo ku yaalla Badda Cas, taas oo sii ballaarisay joogitaankeeda meelaha ku dhow Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin-biyood muhiim ah oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Haddii ay sii socdaan, dhaqdhaqaaqyada milatari ee ka dhacaya Taciz iyo nawaaxigeeda waxay yeelan karaan saameyn ka baxsan goobaha dagaalka, maadaama gobolka uu ku dhow yahay marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab oo muhiim u ah isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo gaadiidka badda ee u kala goosha Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Dib u soo cusboonaanshaha dagaallada ayaa sidoo kale sare u qaadaya walaaca laga qabo in xasilloonidii ka dhalatay xabbad-joojintii 2022 ay sii wiiqanto. Xabbad-joojintaasi waxay muddo dheer hoos u dhigtay dagaalladii waaweynaa ee ka socday Yemen, inkastoo colaadda iyo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee dalka aysan si buuxda u dhammaan. Xaaladda Taciz ayaa sidaas darteed weli ah mid si dhow loola socdo, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo haddii iska-horimaadyada cusub ay ku koobnaan doonaan aagga magaalada iyo nawaaxigeeda ama ay isu beddeli doonaan guluf ballaaran oo saameeya khadadka hore ee dagaalka iyo amniga marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab.

items.title: Xarunta SNAIC oo qabatay kulan dood-cilmiyeed looga hadlay mustaqbalka Garaad Gacmeedka Soomaaliya
items.description: Xarunta Garaad Gacmeedka Ummadda Soomaaliyeed (SNAIC) ee Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed (JUS) ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku qabatay kulan dood-cilmiyeed (Roundtable) oo diiradda lagu saaray mustaqbalka Garaad Gacmeedka Soomaaliya iyo sidii loo dhisi lahaa aasaas adag oo dalka u suurtageliya ka faa’iidaysiga fursadaha ay teknolojiyadda Garaad Gacmeedku bixiso. Kulanka waxaa ka qeyb galay wakiillo ka socday jaamacadaha, shirkadaha teknoolojiyadda iyo hay’ado kale oo daneynaya horumarinta Garaad Gacmeedka, kuwaas oo is dhaafsaday aragtiyo iyo talooyin la xiriira sidii Soomaaliya u yeelan lahayd hannaan isku-dubbaridan oo lagu horumarinayo aqoonta, cilmi-baarista iyo adeegsiga Garaad Gacmeedka. Doodaha kulanka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray shan arrimood oo muhiim u ah horumarinta Garaad Gacmeedka Soomaaliya. Qodobka koowaad wuxuu ahaa dhisidda xarumo iyo xafiisyo u gaar ah Garaad Gacmeedka , kuwaas oo door ka qaadan kara isku-xirka hay’adaha, jaamacadaha, cilmi-baarayaasha iyo qaybaha gaarka loo leeyahay. Qodobka labaad ayaa ahaa dejinta siyaasado iyo hannaan hagaya adeegsiga mas’uuliyadda leh ee Garaad Gacmeedka , iyadoo muhiimad gaar ah la siinayo in horumarka teknoolojiyaddu uu la jaanqaado ilaalinta xogta, amniga, asturnaanta iyo danaha bulshada. Sidoo kale, ka qeybgalayaashu waxay xoogga saareen kor u qaadidda aqoonta Garaad Gacmeedka , gaar ahaan in la ballaariyo fahamka bulshada, ardayda iyo xirfadlayaasha Soomaaliyeed ee ku saabsan teknoolojiyaddan iyo fursadaha ay u abuuri karto waxbarashada, ganacsiga iyo adeegyada bulshada. Doodda ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo qaaday baahida loo qabo soo saarista khubaro Soomaaliyeed oo heer sare ah , si dalka uu u yeesho aqoon iyo awood gudaha ah oo uu kaga shaqeyn karo cilmi-baarista, horumarinta iyo hirgelinta xalalka ku saleysan Garaad Gacmeedka. Qodobka shanaad ee kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray iskaashiga iyo isku-xirka dhinacyada kala duwan , iyadoo la tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in jaamacadaha, dowladda, shirkadaha teknoolojiyadda, cilmi-baarayaasha iyo hay’adaha kale ay yeeshaan wadashaqeyn joogto ah oo lagu horumarinayo Garaad Gacmeedka Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale fursad u noqday ka qeybgalayaasha inay soo bandhigaan aragtiyo, talooyin iyo khibrado la xiriira jihada uu qaadan karo horumarinta Garaad Gacmeedka Soomaaliya. Doodaha ka dhashay kulanka ayaa xoojinaya baahida loo qabo qorshe mideysan oo isku xiraya waxbarashada, siyaasadda, cilmi-baarista, hal-abuurka iyo baahiyaha suuqa shaqada. Xarunta Garaad Gacmeedka Ummadda Soomaaliyeed ayaa kulankan u aragta fursad lagu xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada kala duwan iyo sidii loo abuuri lahaa madal joogto ah oo lagu falanqeeyo arrimaha la xiriira Garaad Gacmeedka iyo doorkiisa mustaqbalka Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa kusoo dhammaaday is-dhaafsi aragtiyo iyo talooyin ku wajahan sidii Soomaaliya ay u horumarin lahayd awooddeeda aqooneed iyo farsamo ee Garaad Gacmeedka, iyadoo la adkeynayo iskaashiga u dhexeeya hay’adaha waxbarashada, dowladnimada, ganacsiga iyo bulshada.

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo shaaciyay Natiijada Doorashadii Galmudug iyo JSP oo Kuraasta ugu badan ku guulaystay
items.description: Guddiga doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa shaaciyay natiijada doorashadii isku sidkanayd ee goleyaasha deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Doorashada ayaa ka dhacday 11 degmo, waxaana ka qeyb galay 12 urur siyaasadeed, ayadoo tirada guud ee codbixiyeyaasha ka qeyb galay doorashada ay gaartay 149,475 qof. Waxaa la tiriyay 146,894 cod oo ansax ah, kuwaas oo u dhiganta 97.27% codadkii la dhiibtay, halka 2,581 cod, oo u dhiganta 1.73%, ay noqdeen codad xumaaday, sida guddigu ay sheegeen. Doorashada Golaha Wakiillada waxaa lagu tartamay 89 kursi, halka goleyaasha deegaanku ay ahaayeen 243 kursi. Ururka JSP ayaa helay codadka ugu badan, isagoo helay 105,716 cod, taas oo u dhiganta 71.97% codadka ansaxay, waxaana Natiijadan ay JSP ka dhigtay ururka helay codadka ugu badan ee doorashada. Dhanka kuraasta goleyaasha deegaanka, JSP ayaa ku guuleystay 179 kursi oo ka mid ah 243-ka kursi, taas oo u dhiganta 73.66% kuraasta guud. Ururka Sincad ayaa isna helay 17 kursi, isagoo ka mid noqday ururrada ugu badan ee kuraasta ka helay doorashada. Natiijada la shaaciyay ayaa muujinaysa in JSP uu helay inta badan codadka iyo kuraasta goleyaasha deegaanka, halka Sincad uu yahay ururka kale ee si muuqata uga dhex muuqda natiijada kuraasta. Doorashadan ayaa lagu tilmaami karaa mid ka mid ah doorashooyinka lagu cabbirayo taageerada ay ururrada siyaasadeed ku leeyihiin degmooyinka Galmudug, iyadoo natiijada kama dambaysta ah ay muujinayso sida codadka shacabka loogu beddelay kuraasta goleyaasha deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada.

Ururka JSP ayaa helay codadka ugu badan, isagoo helay 105,716 cod, taas oo u dhiganta 71.97% codadka ansaxay, waxaana Natiijadan ay JSP ka dhigtay ururka helay codadka ugu badan ee doorashada. Dhanka kuraasta goleyaasha deegaanka, JSP ayaa ku guuleystay 179 kursi oo ka mid ah 243-ka kursi, taas oo u dhiganta 73.66% kuraasta guud. Ururka Sincad ayaa isna helay 17 kursi, isagoo ka mid noqday ururrada ugu badan ee kuraasta ka helay doorashada. Natiijada la shaaciyay ayaa muujinaysa in JSP uu helay inta badan codadka iyo kuraasta goleyaasha deegaanka, halka Sincad uu yahay ururka kale ee si muuqata uga dhex muuqda natiijada kuraasta. Doorashadan ayaa lagu tilmaami karaa mid ka mid ah doorashooyinka lagu cabbirayo taageerada ay ururrada siyaasadeed ku leeyihiin degmooyinka Galmudug, iyadoo natiijada kama dambaysta ah ay muujinayso sida codadka shacabka loogu beddelay kuraasta goleyaasha deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan oo dalka Masar uga qeyb-galaya…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa magaalada Al-Caalameyn ee dalka Masar uga qeyb-galaya munaasabadaha heerka sare ah ee Afrika oo soconaya 2-da ilaa 4-ta October. Kulamada uu madaxweynuhu ka qeyb-galayo waxaa kamid ah Madasha Afrika ee Al-Caalameyn (Alamein Africa Forum), shirka dalalka aasaasay Hay’adda Horumarinta Midowga Afrika (AUDA-NEPAD) iyo Shirka 8-aad ee Isku-duwidda Bartamaha Sanadka ee Midowga Afrika. Munaasabadahan waxaa isugu imaanaya madaxda dalalka Afrika, wasiirro iyo mas’uuliyiin sare, iyadoo sidoo kale ay ka qeyb-galayaan wakiillo ka socda shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay, hay’adaha maaliyadda iyo kuwa ku shaqada leh maalgashiga. Ajandayaasha ugu waaweyn ee kulamada ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa sidii loo xoojin lahaa isdhexgalka dhaqaale ee qaaradda, horumar waara, maalgashi iyo ganacsi, iyo sidoo kale iskaashiga u dhexeeya dowladaha iyo ganacsatada Afrika. Madasha Al-Caalameyn ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo bandhigayaa mashaariic waaweyn iyo fursado maalgashi oo ka jira dalalka Afrika, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo qaybaha wax-soo-saarka iyo shirkadaha ka howlgala qaaradda. Sidoo kale, madasha ayaa lagu wadaa inay fududeyso xiriirro toos ah oo dhex mara dowladaha, ganacsatada, maalgashadayaasha iyo hay’adaha maaliyadeed, si loo abuuro fursado iskaashi iyo maalgashi oo dheeraad ah. Qorshaha ah in Madasha Afrika ee Al-Caalameyn la qabto labadii sanaba mar waxaa ansixiyay Shir-madaxeedka Midowga Afrika bishii Febraayo 2026, iyadoo Masar ay qabaneyso madasha iyadoo iskaashi dhow la leh bangiga dhoofinta iyo soo-dejinta Afrika (Afreximbank). Ka qeyb-galka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dalalka Afrika ay xoogga saarayaan kor u qaadista iskaashiga dhaqaale, maalgashiga iyo isku-xirka suuqyada qaaradda. items.title: Midowga Afrika oo war culus ka soo saaray xiisadda Itoobiya kala dhaxeysa Eritrea iyo Masar
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Midowga Afrika ayaa ka digay xiisadda sii xoogeysanaysa ee u dhexeysa Itoobiya, Eritrea iyo Masar, xilli xiriirka saddexda dal uu marayo marxalad xasaasi ah, iyadoo dhinacyadu ay isku weydaarsanayaan eedeymo iyo hadallo kulul. Ururka Midowga Afrika ayaa dalalkan ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan tallaabo kasta oo dhaawici karta nabadda iyo xasilloonida qaaradda, gaar ahaan mid horseedi karta isku dhac ama qalalaase ka dhaca xuduudaha dalalka ay xiisaddu ka dhex taagan tahay. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kaddib markii Itoobiya ay tallaabooyin diblomaasiyadeed ka qaaday diblomaasiyiin ka howlgala Safaaradda Masar ee Addis Ababa. Warqad loo diray safaaradda Masar ayaa lagu sheegay in diblomaasiyiinta qaarkood ay dalka uga baxaan muddo 48 saacadood ah. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka, waqtiga loo qabtay diblomaasiyiinta ayaa ka billaabmay 1-dii October, iyadoo tallaabadan ay kusoo beegantay xilli xiriirka Addis Ababa iyo Qaahira uu muddooyinkii dambe wajahayay khilaafaadyo siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Sidoo kale, Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa iyaguna wajahaya xiisad sii kordheysa, iyadoo labada dhinac lagu soo warramayo inay xoojinayaan diyaar-garowgooda militari. Arrintan waxaa barbar socda hadallo kulul oo ay mas’uuliyiin iyo dhinacyo kala duwan is dhaafsanayaan. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa Khamiistii amartay in la xiro safaaraddeeda magaalada Asmara, iyadoo sidoo kale 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah ku amartay inay dalka kaga baxaan 48 saacadood gudahood, tallaabo muujineysa heerka uu gaaray khilaafka sii xoogeysanaya ee labada dal. Go’aanka ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii qaraxyo dhowr ah habeenkii laga maqlay magaalada Addis Ababa, xilli dagaalka dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya uu sii ballaaranayo, isla markaana ay soo baxayaan walaac laga qabo inuu isu beddelo iska horimaad goboleed. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya ayaa sheegtay inay safaaradda Asmara u xireyso waxa ay ku tilmaantay “falal cadaawad iyo dagaal-doon ah oo toos iyo dadban” oo Eritrea ay kula kacday Itoobiya. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in 10-ka diblomaasi ee Eritrea loo aqoonsaday persona non grata kadib markii lagu eedeeyay inay ku lug lahaayeen “dhaqdhaqaaqyo khatar toos ah ku ah amniga qaranka Itoobiya” oo jebinaya xeerarka caalamiga ah ee xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed. Colaaddan ayaa Soomaaliya saamayn karta juquraafi ahaan, maadaama Itoobiya, Masar iyo Eritrea ay la leedahay xiriir diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashi amni, inkastoo Muqdisho caddeysay inay ilaalinayso mowqifkeeda ku aaddan xiriirka dalalka gobolka, iyadoo aan si rasmi ah ugu biirin dhinac kamid ah loollanka saddexda dal. Itoobiya ayaa Soomaaliya waxaa ka jooga ciidamo qeyb ka ah howl-galka AUSSOM, halka Masar ay kamid tahay dalalka heshiisyada amni la galay Soomaaliya, sidoo kalena ay qeyb ka tahay qorshaha howl-galka, inkastoo ciidamadeeda aan weli la keenin dalka. Eritrea ayaa iyaduna muddooyinkii lasoo dhaafay tababbarro militari siisay ciidamo Soomaaliyeed, taas oo ka dhigaysa Soomaaliya mid si dhow ula xiriirta dhinacyada ku lugta leh xiisadda ka taagan Geeska Afrika. Si kastaba, xaaladda ayaa si gaar ah isha loogu hayaa, iyadoo xiisad kasta oo ka dhalata xiriirka Itoobiya, Eritrea iyo Masar ay saameyn ku yeelan karto amniga iyo iskaashiga gobolka Geeska Afrika. The post Midowga Afrika oo war culus ka soo saaray xiisadda Itoobiya kala dhaxeysa Eritrea iyo Masar appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Fiqi oo si yaab leh isugu xiray kulamada mucaaradka ee Abu Dhabi iyo kooxda RSF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa qoraal uu soo saaray isku xiray kulamo ay siyaasiyiin Soomaali ah oo mucaarad ah ku leeyihiin Abu Dhabi iyo kooxda RSF ee dagaalka kula jirta dowladda Sudan. Fiqi ayaa ku eedeeyay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ah inay Abu Dhabi kula kulmeen dhinacyo xiriir la leh RSF, isagoo sheegay in kulamadaasi ay la xiriiraan qorshayaal looga soo horjeedo dowladnimada Soomaaliya. Wasiirka ayaa intaas ku daray in siyaasiyiintaas ay halkaasi ka baranayaan hababka loo abaabulo maleeshiyaad iyo dagaal, isaga oo arrintaas ku tilmaamay shirqool ka dhan ah dalka iyo nabadda, sida uu sheegay. “Shakhsiyaadka siyaasiyiinta sheegta ee shirqoolka dalkooda awgii Abu Dhabi shirarka loogu qabanayo waa kuwo aan rajo ka lahayn mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee dalka Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray “Waxaa ayaan-darro ah iyaga iyo kooxda RSF ee dalka Sudan burburintiisa loo kiraystay in isku meel shir loogu qabtay oo ay wax ka baranayaan RSF sida ay shaqada kuwa adeegsanaya u gudanayso, una xasuuqaysa dadkeeda.” Wasiirka ayaa ku eedeeyay shakhsiyaadkaas in ay la soo noqon doonaan shirqoollo ka dhan ah dowladnimada iyo nabadda, ayna isku dayi doonaan inay maleeshiyaad uruuris iyo hoggaamiye-kooxeednimo bilaabaan, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayuu sheegay inay waajib ku tahay inay si adag uga hortagto cid walba oo halis gelinaysa nabadda iyo dowladnimada, qaranimada iyo madax-bannaanida dalka. “Khaa’inul-wadan kastaana abaalkiisa la marsiin doono,” ayuu yiri Fiqi. Eedda ugu culus ee ku jirta qoraalka wasiirka ayaa ah in siyaasadda mucaaradka Soomaaliya lagu xirayo RSF-ta Sudan, taas oo hadalka wasiirka ka dhigaysa digniin amni oo ka baxsan khilaafka caadiga ah ee siyaasadeed. Illaa hadda ma jirto caddeyn madax-bannaan oo xaqiijinaysa in siyaasiyiinta Soomaalida ee Abu Dhabi ay qorsheynayaan hawlgallo militari oo ka dhan ah dowladda madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Si kastaba, hadallada wasiirka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya dowladda dhexe iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka uu sii xoogeysanayo, gaar ahaan arrimaha la xiriira doorashada iyo jihada siyaasadda dalka. The post Fiqi oo si yaab leh isugu xiray kulamada mucaaradka ee Abu Dhabi iyo kooxda RSF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Explosions heard in Ethiopia’s capital after drone flights banned
items.description: By Lucy Fleming, BBC Africa and Teklemariam Bekit, BBC Tigrinya Explosions were heard overnight in Ethiopia’s capital, some in the area of the military headquarters in the west and another in the south of the city, residents and diplomatic sources say. The blasts came hours after drone flights were banned over Addis Ababa and a week after fighting erupted in the north between the army and a newly launched alliance of armed groups including forces from the Tigray region. A source linked to the opposition fighters told the Reuters news agency they were behind what they said were drone strikes. “It was very loud. It was strong enough to set off car alarms,” a resident in a southern area of the city, near the base of the secret service, told BBC Amharic. He estimated that he heard the explosion in the Gotera neighbourhood some time around 00:30 local time (21:30 GMT). Another resident told the BBC that he and his friends were playing games when they heard an explosion. He lives in the western suburb of Torhayloch, a neighbourhood close to the military headquarters. There were no official reports confirming the cause of the explosions, the exact locations affected or whether there were any casualties or damage. The office of Ethiopia’s Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, the defence ministry as well as the federal and Addis Ababa police have not responded to BBC requests for comment. Meanwhile, Ethiopia’s foreign ministry has said it is closing its embassy in neighbouring Eritrea and expelling 10 Eritrean diplomats “for involvement in activities that pose a direct threat to Ethiopia’s national security”. Earlier, in a BBC interview, Eritrea’s government denied that it was backing the new rebel alliance. Clashes broke out last week after months of tension between the government and the party that controls Tigray, the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF). They both accuse each other of violating a 2022 peace deal that ended a brutal two-year civil war, which according to an Africa Union mediator is estimated to have cost 600,000 lives. Last month, seven armed movements, including the TPLF and an Amhara militia known as Fano, formed an alliance with the stated aim of removing the government in Addis Ababa. There is disagreement over which side started the latest fighting. The TPLF says it was responding to a federal offensive, including drone strikes, while the government says Tigrayan forces attacked first after seizing control of airports in the region. The BBC is unable to report from Tigray and surrounding areas. It is difficult to verify what is happening on the ground and access to the internet and the main telecoms service provider in Tigray have also been cut. Within Tigray, the national army and a pro-government militia appear to be advancing towards the region’s main city of Mekelle. In the southern Tigrayan town of Alamata, a medic told the BBC on Wednesday that 52 civilians had died in three days of heavy fighting . The TPLF is also reported to be fighting in neighbouring Afar region, a strategic area which connects landlocked Ethiopia to Djibouti and its ports. A humanitarian source has estimated that tens of thousands have fled their homes in Afar, according to the AFP news agency. Fighting around Lalibela in the Amhara region, a Unesco world heritage site where foreign tourists have been stranded for more than a week, has involved the national army and Fano fighters, now allied to the TPLF. The government has accused neighbouring Eritrea of backing these groups. One pro-government militia commander fighting in Tigray told the BBC that Eritrean soldiers were involved on the front lines. But in a rare response to the BBC from Eritrea’s government, Information Minister Yemane Gebremeskel dismissed the allegations. He accused Ethiopia’s ruling Prosperity Party (PP) of seeking external scapegoats for the country’s mounting challenges. “The PP regime has made it a habit to apportion blame to its neighbours in order to deflect attention from the myriad internal conflicts that it is fomenting in various parts of the country,” he told BBC Tigrinya. Eritrea was a key ally of Ethiopia during the Tigray war, fighting against the TPLF. But relations between the two neighbours have since deteriorated largely over the Ethiopian prime minister’s ambition to take ownership of one of Eritrea’s Red Sea ports. Ethiopia lost access to them when Eritrea seceded in 1993. Abiy has even hinted at taking the port of Assab – about 60km (37 miles) from the border – by force as he sees direct access to the sea as important for Ethiopia’s long-term future and economic prosperity. As concerns over security mount in Ethiopia, the country’s National Intelligence and Security Service (Niss) announced on Wednesday that it was imposing an indefinite ban on drone flights in Addis Ababa and surrounding areas. The agency said it would not issue permits for drone operations and warned that legal action would be taken against anyone flying drones in restricted areas. Niss said the measure was necessary to protect national leaders, critical infrastructure and major public events. items.fullContent: By Lucy Fleming, BBC Africa and Teklemariam Bekit, BBC Tigrinya Explosions were heard overnight in Ethiopia’s capital, some in the area of the military headquarters in the west and another in the south of the city, residents and diplomatic sources say. The blasts came hours after drone flights were banned over Addis Ababa and a week after fighting erupted in the north between the army and a newly launched alliance of armed groups including forces from the Tigray region. A source linked to the opposition fighters told the Reuters news agency they were behind what they said were drone strikes. “It was very loud. It was strong enough to set off car alarms,” a resident in a southern area of the city, near the base of the secret service, told BBC Amharic. He estimated that he heard the explosion in the Gotera neighbourhood some time around 00:30 local time (21:30 GMT). Another resident told the BBC that he and his friends were playing games when they heard an explosion. He lives in the western suburb of Torhayloch, a neighbourhood close to the military headquarters. There were no official reports confirming the cause of the explosions, the exact locations affected or whether there were any casualties or damage. The office of Ethiopia’s Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, the defence ministry as well as the federal and Addis Ababa police have not responded to BBC requests for comment. The BBC is unable to report from Tigray and surrounding areas. Within Tigray, the national army and a pro-government militia appear to be advancing towards the region’s main city of Mekelle. Niss said the measure was necessary to protect national leaders, critical infrastructure and major public events. items.title: Eritrea cuts ties with Ethiopia over Asmara embassy closure
items.description: (Reuters)- Ethiopia ordered the closure of its embassy in Eritrea and declared 10 Eritrean diplomats persona non grata on Thursday, prompting ​Asmara to sever all diplomatic ties with its neighbour after overnight blasts heard in Addis Ababa sparked fears about renewed conflict in northern Ethiopia spreading. Addis Ababa has accused Eritrea, Sudan and Egypt of supporting an ‌opposition alliance led by the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) that has battled troops loyal to Ethiopia’s federal government since last week. The three countries deny the accusation. The African Union Commission urged the three countries to exercise maximum restraint and refrain from actions or statements that could worsen tensions and undermine regional peace and stability. The clashes mark the biggest escalation of fighting in Ethiopia since the end of a 2020-2022 civil war in which hundreds of thousands of people were killed. Eritrea had fought in support of Ethiopia’s federal government in that conflict. Ethiopia’s Foreign Ministry said on Thursday it ​had “decided to close its Embassy in Asmara, Eritrea, in response to Eritrea’s direct and indirect acts of hostility and belligerence against Ethiopia”. It also said in a statement posted on its X account that 10 Eritrean diplomats, whom ​it did not name, were required to leave Ethiopia within 48 hours. RESPONSE Eritrea’s Information Minister Yemane Gebremeskel told Reuters that by expelling all Eritrean diplomats from Ethiopia the government was effectively closing ⁠its embassy in Addis Ababa. “Eritrea has no option but to reciprocate in kind and sever all diplomatic ties with Ethiopia with all the negative corollaries that this entails,” the foreign ministry said in a statement. Ethiopia’s government also declared an Egyptian diplomat ​persona non grata and ordered him to leave the country within 48 hours, the state-run Ethiopian Broadcasting Corporation and two sources with knowledge of the matter said. Egypt’s state-affiliated Al Qahera News, citing a senior Egyptian source, said Cairo had responded in kind ​by declaring an Ethiopian embassy counsellor in Egypt persona non grata and giving him 48 hours to leave. The source described Ethiopia’s move against the Egyptian diplomat as “unfortunate” and unjustified, and said Egypt had consistently rejected interference in the internal affairs of other countries. Egyptian foreign ministry spokesperson Nader Zaki told Reuters that Cairo’s action was justified. “Reciprocity is the currency of diplomacy,” he said. The sabre-rattling moves came hours after explosions were heard in Ethiopia’s capital and added to concerns that the fighting could spiral into a wider regional conflict. The African Union Commission urged the three countries “to address their ​differences through established diplomatic channels and peaceful dialogue” in a statement late on Thursday. A source linked to the opposition alliance told Reuters it had carried out several drone strikes in Addis Ababa, including some that targeted the military’s headquarters. If confirmed, it ​would be the first known drone attack by anti-government forces on Addis Ababa, which is hundreds of km (miles) from the front lines in the northern regions of Tigray, Amhara and Afar. Three diplomatic sources, speaking on condition of anonymity due to the sensitivity of the matter, confirmed ‌the blasts. Witnesses ⁠said there was no damage visible near the military base. Spokespeople for Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s office, the federal government, the Ethiopian National Defence Force (ENDF) and the TPLF did not respond to requests for comment. FRIEND-TURNED-FOE Ethiopia’s embassy in Eritrea was reopened in 2018 as part of a rapprochement with Asmara that won Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed the Nobel Peace Prize. The militaries of both countries fought side by side against the TPLF, Tigray’s main party, during the 2020-2022 war. But Eritrea was not a party to the peace deal that ended the fighting in November 2022, and relations between the two nations quickly soured. The two governments have also exchanged words over the issue of access to the Red Sea, with landlocked Ethiopia insisting that sea access is vital for ​its security and economy. Asmara has said it fears Addis Ababa ​will try to take its Assab port by force. Days ⁠after the latest clashes broke out, the chief administrator of the northern Afar region, Haji Awol Arba, told Al Jazeera that Eritrean soldiers had crossed into Afar to join the opposition alliance’s offensive. Eritrea’s information minister did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Federal troops and allied militiamen, meanwhile, made fresh gains in Tigray and Afar, a pro-government militia said on Thursday. Reuters ​could not independently verify the claims. INTELLIGENCE SERVICE BANS DRONE FLIGHTS OVER CAPITAL The national intelligence service has banned drones over Addis Ababa. Opposition forces had not previously been known to ​use armed drones but there is ⁠growing evidence they may possess some capability. On Tuesday, the pro-government Tigray Peace Forces (TPF) militia said it had captured drone frames and batteries from forces linked to the TPLF, which is the main political party in Tigray. Edward Bach, Senior Africa Analyst at risk intelligence company Verisk Maplecroft, said the opposition’s ability to strike Addis Ababa would be “a political game-changer”, undermining any government narrative that the capital is unaffected by the war and narrowing a key tactical advantage for federal forces, their aerial superiority. Federal forces have been advancing in southern Tigray, ⁠edging closer to ​the regional capital Mekelle, while the opposition alliance has captured towns in neighbouring Afar. Pro-government forces also recaptured the town of Erbeti in Afar, which TPLF ​forces had seized at the start of the conflict, the TPF said on X, thanking the ENDF for “magnificent air support”. In Afar, where the TPLF captured several towns in the early days of the new conflict, fighting has forced tens of thousands of people to flee their homes, Valerie Browning, a founder of ​the Afar Pastoralist Development Association, told Reuters. Source: Reuters The post Eritrea cuts ties with Ethiopia over Asmara embassy closure appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Eritrea oo xiriirka u jartay Itoobiya, kadib tallaabadii ay qaaday
items.description: Asmara (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Eritrea ayaa Khamiistii ku dhawaaqday inay gebi ahaanba xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed u jartay Itoobiya, saacado kadib markii Addis Ababa ay xirtay safaaraddeeda Asmara, isla markaana ay dalkeeda ka cayrisay 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Eritrea ayaa tallaabada Itoobiya ku tilmaantay “falal cadaawad ah oo aan cudurdaar lahayn”, waxayna sheegtay in Asmara aysan hadda heysan doorasho kale oo aan ahayn inay tallaabadaas si la mid ah uga jawaabto. “Xaaladda hadda jirta, Eritrea ma hayso wax doorasho ah oo aan ka ahayn inay si la mid ah uga jawaabto oo ay jarto dhammaan xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Itoobiya, iyadoo ay la socdaan dhammaan cawaaqibta taban ee arrintaasi leedahay,” ayay wasaaraddu ku tiri bayaan ay soo saartay. Go’aanka ayaa soo afjaraya xiriirkii diblomaasiyadeed ee labada dal ay dib u soo celiyeen sanadkii 2018, wuxuuna imaanayaa xilli xiisadda Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ay si weyn sare ugu kacday, iyadoo dagaalkuna mar kale ka qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya. Itoobiya ayaa goor sii horreysay Khamiistii sheegtay inay xireyso safaaraddeeda Asmara, isla markaana ay 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah ku amartay inay dalka uga baxaan 48 saacadood gudahood. Addis Ababa waxay diblomaasiyiinta ku eedeysay inay ku lug lahaayeen falal ay sheegtay inay “khatar toos ah ku yihiin amniga qaranka Itoobiya”, iyadoo sidoo kale Eritrea ku eedeysay “falal toos iyo dadban oo cadaawad iyo dagaalnimo ah”. Dowladda Itoobiya ma aysan faahfaahin falalka ay ku eedeysay diblomaasiyiinta Eritrea. Eritrea oo eedda ku celisay Itoobiya Eritrea ayaa si adag u diidday eedeymahaas, waxayna Itoobiya ku eedeysay inay isku dayeyso inay mas’uuliyadda xiisadda labada dal dusha ka saarto Asmara. “Tani runtii waa arrin lala yaabo,” ayay wasaaradda Eritrea tiri. “Xaqiiqdu waxay tahay in Itoobiya ay muddo saddex sano ah wadday ajande cadaawadeed oo joogto ah.” Asmara waxay si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqday dadaalka Itoobiya ee ku aaddan inay hesho marin ay ku gaarto Badda Cas, arrin muddooyinkii dambe noqotay mid ka mid ah qodobbada ugu waaweyn ee khilaafka labada dal. Eritrea waxay ku eedeysay dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed inay waddo qorshe ay ku raadineyso waxa ay Itoobiya ugu yeertay “marin madax-bannaan oo badeed”, iyadoo Asmara sheegtay in hadalladaas ay ku jiraan damac ku wajahan dekedo iyo dhul xeebeed ay Eritrea leedahay. Itoobiya ayaa dhowr jeer sheegtay in helitaanka marin lagu kalsoonaan karo oo Badda Cas ah uu muhiim u yahay mustaqbalkeeda dhaqaale iyo istaraatiijiyadeed. Eritrea ayaa si gaar ah uga carootay hadallada la xiriira dekedda Casab iyo sheegasho kasta oo u muuqata inay taabaneyso madax-bannaanida iyo dhulka Eritrea. Asmara waxay sidoo kale Itoobiya ku eedeysay inay martigelisay, tababartay isla markaana hub siisay kooxo mucaarad Eritrean ah, kuwaas oo ay sheegtay in loo adeegsanayo in gudaha Eritrea laga abuuro qalalaase iyo “isbeddel dowladeed”. Itoobiya ayaa dhinaceeda Eritrea ku eedeysay inay taageerto xoogag hubeysan oo dagaal kula jira dowladda federaalka Itoobiya, eedeymahaas oo Asmara ay beenisay. Dagaalka waqooyiga Itoobiya Burburka xiriirka labada dal ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli dagaal culus uu dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya, iyadoo dowladda Abiy Ahmed iyo xoogagga Tigray ay markale isku hayaan deegaano dhowr ah. Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale Eritrea, Masar iyo Sudan ku eedeysay inay taageerayaan isbaheysi cusub oo ay ku jiraan TPLF iyo kooxo kale oo hubeysan oo kasoo horjeeda dowladda federaalka. Dalalka lagu eedeeyey ayaa diiday sheegashada Addis Ababa. Dagaallada cusub ayaa ah kuwii ugu xooganaa ee waqooyiga Itoobiya ka dhaca tan iyo markii heshiiskii Pretoria ee 2022 uu soo afjaray wejigii ugu weynaa ee dagaalkii socday muddo laba sano ah. Eritrea iyo Itoobiya waxay dagaalkaas ahaayeen xulafo, waxaana ciidamada Eritrea ay garab siinayeen kuwa dowladda Itoobiya dagaalka ay kula jireen TPLF. Hase yeeshee Eritrea kama aysan qeybgelin heshiiskii nabadeed ee Pretoria, xiriirka Addis Ababa iyo Asmara ayaana si tartiib ah u xumaaday wixii ka dambeeyey heshiiskaas. Khilaafka Badda Cas, xaaladda Tigray iyo eedeymaha amni ee labada dhinac ayaa sii kala fogeeyey labada dowladood. Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa 2018 dib u soo celiyey xiriirkooda kadib ku dhowaad labaatan sano oo colaad ah oo ka dambeysay dagaalkii xuduudda ee 1998-2000. Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed iyo Madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki ayaa xilligaas ku heshiiyey inay soo afjaraan colaaddii muddada dheer u dhaxeysay dalalkooda, taas oo horseeday dib u furista xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed. Sideed sano kadib, go’aanka Eritrea ee ay ku jartay xiriirka Itoobiya ayaa meesha ka saaraya mid ka mid ah natiijooyinkii ugu waaweynaa ee heshiiskii 2018, xilli dagaalka waqooyiga Itoobiya uu sii kordhinayo walaaca laga qabo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Khilaafka Badda Cas, xaaladda Tigray iyo eedeymaha amni ee labada dhinac ayaa sii kala fogeeyey labada dowladood. Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa 2018 dib u soo celiyey xiriirkooda kadib ku dhowaad labaatan sano oo colaad ah oo ka dambeysay dagaalkii xuduudda ee 1998-2000. Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed iyo Madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki ayaa xilligaas ku heshiiyey inay soo afjaraan colaaddii muddada dheer u dhaxeysay dalalkooda, taas oo horseeday dib u furista xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed. Sideed sano kadib, go’aanka Eritrea ee ay ku jartay xiriirka Itoobiya ayaa meesha ka saaraya mid ka mid ah natiijooyinkii ugu waaweynaa ee heshiiskii 2018, xilli dagaalka waqooyiga Itoobiya uu sii kordhinayo walaaca laga qabo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. items.title: School closures put hundreds of teachers out of work in Garowe
items.description: (ERGO) – The families of hundreds of teachers in Garowe and nearby villages in Somalia’s Puntland state have lost their jobs after the closure of some schools and the overall reduction of teaching staff due to financial difficulties. Jama Mohamud Ahmed, a teacher, said he could no longer meet the basic needs of his nine-member family after losing his job. Jama taught English at Waberi primary and middle school in Garowe and earned $200 a month that covered food, water, rent and his children’s education. “We only cook once a day. We rely on relatives, friends and neighbours when we need help,” he said. “Not being able to provide enough food for my children is a heavy burden. If the situation continues like this, it will become even harder.” His family struggles to access water, relying on a jerrycan or less from better-off people who can afford the $0.40 charged by private water vendors. At the end of August, the family was evicted from their stone-built room when he failed to pay the $80 monthly rent, electricity and piped water. They moved from Koowda Agoosto to an open area on the outskirts of Garowe and built a makeshift shelter from cloth and sticks. Jama said his children, the youngest aged three, were struggling with the heat and cold, as the shelter is flimsy. “The number of students at the school where I taught has fallen sharply. Many parents have withdrawn their children and moved them to other schools, while others could no longer afford the school fees,” he explained. He has searched for casual jobs in Garowe over the past two months but hasn’t found work. Many are competing for the few jobs on offer. Three of his children, in grades four and six, have stopped attending school as he failed to pay their combined $25 fees. They were sent home. Jama, who has taught for nearly 10 years, said he regrets not having saved money and is uncertain about finding another teaching job. The affected teachers worked in private schools and schools run by the Puntland government and aid organisations in Garowe’s displacement camps. Hamdi Ali Ahmed, who taught science for 15 years at a primary and middle school in Shabelle camp, said she had been unable to provide enough food for her eight children since losing her job and monthly salary of $110 in July. “Unemployment has affected me severely. I cook for my children only on days when I have something to provide; when I have nothing, they go hungry,” Hamdi said. She is a single parent and has no other source of income. She is relying now on credit from a neighbourhood shop. This month, the shopkeeper reduced their supplies to 10 kilograms each of rice and sugar. She owes $150 that she has to repay next month or they will lose further credit. They also beg small amounts of water from neighbours as Hamdi can’t afford the $0.20 charged for a jerrycan by private borehole operators. The school where she worked was run by the Puntland education ministry. It was demolished, and everyone living in Shabelle camp was evicted. In the open area where they moved to, she has begun putting up a shelter but can’t afford to complete it. They have to share a neighbour’s toilet. Four of her children, in grades six and seven, have been out of school since she lost her job and they had to move out to the new site that has no services. “We are displaced and can’t afford to build a school ourselves. We are asking for a school to be built so that we can return to work,” she appealed. The chairman of the Nugal Teachers’ Association, Abdinasir Yusuf Halliye, said a survey conducted in June found that 400 teachers in public and private schools in Garowe and surrounding villages had lost their jobs since the beginning of the year due to financial difficulties and school closures. Some schools cut staff after parents could no longer afford school fees, leaving them unable to pay teachers’ salaries. Other schools have reduced staff, with some assigning one teacher to teach two or three subjects because they cannot afford to hire more staff. “We have reported information about the teachers and the challenges they face to all relevant authorities, but we have yet to see any action,” Abdinasir said. “Support from international organisations has ended, and schools no longer receive the assistance they previously relied on. We urge the Puntland government to pay closer attention to the challenges facing education and to provide any support available to teachers.” The chairman said 30 primary and middle schools had closed since the beginning of the year because of financial hardship in communities, mainly due to drought and recurring conflict. items.title: Somaliland’s Search for Recognition: The Historical and Political Questions Washington Cannot Resolve
items.description: By Ali H. Abdulla President Abdirahman Irro’s American visit raised Somaliland’s diplomatic profile. It also highlighted a deeper problem: international recognition cannot by itself resolve contested history, disputed territory and the absence of political unanimity within the borders Somaliland claims. Introduction President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi “Irro” travelled to the United States in September 2026 carrying the central foreign-policy objective pursued by successive Somaliland administrations for more than three decades: international recognition. The journey gave Somaliland valuable diplomatic visibility. On 24 September, Irro appeared before the Council on Foreign Relations in New York to discuss Somaliland’s campaign for recognition and the security environment in the Horn of Africa. That was a significant platform for an administration that has spent decades attempting to persuade influential governments that Somaliland should be treated as an independent state. Yet the visit also raises a more fundamental question. The central difficulty facing Somaliland may no longer be simply persuading Washington, London or other foreign capitals to accept its interpretation of history. It is determining whether the political community contained within the borders Somaliland claims possesses sufficient internal agreement about its own future. That question begins not in Washington, but in the history of the Somali territories themselves. Before the Colonial Map Somali society did not begin with the British Protectorate, Italian Somaliland or the borders drawn by European powers in the late nineteenth century. Long before colonial partition, Somali communities across the Horn were linked by language, Islam, kinship, customary institutions, commerce and pastoral movement. Clan identities were—and remain—important, but they existed within a much wider Somali cultural and linguistic environment. For pastoral communities in particular, political geography was historically determined less by fixed borders than by access to water and grazing. Families and livestock moved according to ecological necessity. Colonial frontiers subsequently divided populations whose economic and social lives crossed the boundaries European governments had negotiated. This history matters because Somaliland’s contemporary territorial claim relies heavily upon the boundaries of the former British Somaliland Protectorate. Those boundaries are historically real. But their existence does not mean that they represented an ancient frontier separating two historically distinct peoples. Following the withdrawal of Egyptian forces from the northern Somali coast, Britain negotiated a series of agreements with Somali clan elders during the 1880s. British parliamentary records later described agreements made with elders of several tribes between 1884 and 1886. The territorial reach of these arrangements into the hinterland was itself not precisely defined. In a 1955 parliamentary debate, Britain’s Minister of State for Colonial Affairs acknowledged that the exact area covered by the agreements had never been clearly delineated inland. This is important when colonial treaties are invoked today as evidence of immutable political geography. The North East State Exception There is an additional historical complication that deserves greater attention. The Dhulbahante, a member of the Northern Harti Alliance—the principal community inhabiting much of Sool and parts of the surrounding territories—did not conclude a formal treaty of protection with Britain. Historical scholarship and British colonial accounts distinguish their position from northern communities with which Britain entered formal protection agreements. The Warsangeli case, also a member of the Northern Harti Alliance, was different and should not be confused with it. Warsangeli elders entered into a formal agreement with Britain on 27 January 1886. Historical precision matters precisely because contemporary territorial arguments frequently rely upon colonial history. The Dhulbahante experience subsequently took a markedly different course. From 1899 until 1920, the Dervish movement led by Sayyid Mohamed Abdulle Hassan fought a prolonged struggle against colonial powers in the Somali territories. Scholarship describes the movement as drawing heavily—though by no means exclusively—from Dhulbahante and Ogaden communities, while also including participants from Isaaq and other clans. Its centres included places such as Taleh and Buuhoodle in what is now northern Somalia. The Dervish struggle should not be retroactively converted into a twenty-first-century referendum on Somaliland or Somalia. The political vocabulary of contemporary statehood cannot simply be projected backward onto people living more than a century ago. But neither should this history be erased. There is an obvious historical difficulty in arguing that the colonial status of British Somaliland alone permanently determines the political allegiance of a community that did not itself conclude a protection treaty with Britain and whose territory subsequently became a principal centre of prolonged armed resistance to colonial authority. Colonial boundaries are historical facts. They are not necessarily historical verdicts. Colonial Administration Did Not Create Two Unrelated Peoples After defeating Italian forces during the Second World War, Britain administered former Italian Somaliland as well as British Somaliland for part of the 1940s, albeit under different legal arrangements. In 1950, Britain transferred administration of the former Italian territory to Italy under a United Nations trusteeship arrangement. This was not simply restoration of Italian colonial sovereignty. The territory was placed under an international trusteeship intended to lead to independence. British Somaliland became independent on 26 June 1960. The former Italian-administered Trust Territory became independent days later, and the two united on 1 July to establish the Somali Republic. Somaliland’s advocates can therefore reasonably point out that British Somaliland briefly possessed separate independence before union. But there is another side to that history. The union occurred during an era in which Somali nationalism regarded colonial partition itself as something to be overcome. Somali populations had been divided among British, Italian, French, Ethiopian and Kenyan jurisdictions. Independence was consequently intertwined with a broader aspiration for Somali political unity. The fact that Britain administered one territory and Italy another undoubtedly produced different administrative experiences. It did not, however, establish that northern and southern Somalis had thereby become culturally unrelated peoples. What Germany Can—and Cannot—Teach Us Post-war Germany offers a useful illustration, although not a legal precedent. Germany was divided after the Second World War into two states with radically different political systems, economies and international alliances. Four decades of separate administration did not permanently extinguish the concept of a shared German national identity. When circumstances changed, reunification followed in 1990. Somalia is obviously different. Its divisions arose through colonial partition, failed state institutions, dictatorship, civil war, state collapse and competing claims of self-determination. German reunification therefore provides no legal formula for resolving Somaliland’s status. It illustrates only a narrower principle: a period of separate administration does not necessarily determine the permanent national identity of a population. The reverse is equally true. Sharing ethnicity, religion and language does not automatically require populations to inhabit one sovereign state. History alone therefore cannot resolve Somaliland’s status. Contemporary consent matters. And that is precisely where Somaliland now faces its most difficult challenge. Las Anod Changed the Argument The 2023 conflict in Las Anod fundamentally altered the political landscape. After months of fighting, SSC-Khaatumo forces consolidated control of Las Anod following the withdrawal of Somaliland forces in August 2023. The political movement that emerged there did not seek recognition as another independent Somali state. It instead sought integration into Somalia’s federal structure. That process culminated in the establishment of North East State in July 2025, which Somalia’s federal government recognised as a federal member state. Territorial control nevertheless remains complicated: NES claims Sool, Sanaag and the Buuhoodle/Cayn area, while its effective control has not extended uniformly across all those territories. Nor should the Warsangeli position be oversimplified. Although NES’s territorial conception encompasses Warsangeli areas, reporting and country-of-origin research in 2026 indicated that political alignment in Warsangeli areas was not uniform, with substantial continuing ties to Puntland. These distinctions matter. They demonstrate precisely why the northern political question cannot credibly be reduced to neat blocks on a colonial map. items.title: Dhacdo Dhab Ah Mise Masrax Siyaasadeed? Shakiga Sii Kordhaya oo Ku Gadaaman Dhacdadii Flydubai
items.description: Kaddib wararka sheegaya in iska-horimaad ka dhacay qolka duuliyeyaasha ee diyaarad Flydubai ah oo ku sii jeedday Tel Aviv, halkaas oo kaaliyaha duuliyaha lagu eedeeyey inuu mindi ku dhuftay kabtanka, dabadeedna diyaaraddu gashay hoobasho musiibo keeni kartay. Inkasta oo warbaahinta waaweyn ay dhacdada u soo bandhigeen sida sheeko halyeeynimo, badbaado mucjiso leh iyo adkaysi ka dhan ah argagixisada, haddana falanqeeyayaasha duulista, dadka baraha bulshada wax ku qora iyo indha-indheeyayaasha caalamiga ah ayaa isweydiinaya in dhacdadu ahayd masrax siyaasadeed oo la soo agaasimay. Sheekada dadweynaha loo soo bandhigay waxay sheegaysaa in kaaliyaha duuliyuhu mindi ku weeraray kabtanka, isagoo diyaaradda Boeing-ka ah hoos u dhigay qiyaastii 20,000 oo feet wax ka yar hal daqiiqo, xawaaraheeduna kor u dhaafay 700 mayl saacaddii. Sida sheekadu tilmaamayso, kabtanka oo dhaawac halis ah qaba ayaa haddana ku guuleystay inuu furo albaabka ammaanka adag leh, taasoo u saamaxday rakaabka oo ay ku jireen farsamo-yaqaan tuubooyinka ah oo fasax ku jiray iyo duuliyeyaal shaqo kale u safrayey iney qolka duuliyeyaasha galaan, weeraryahanka ka adkaadaan, diyaaradda xakameeyaan, dabadeedna si nabad ah ugu weeciyaan Sacuudiga. Dad badan ayaa ku doodaya in sheekadani ka hor imaanayso mabaadi’da cilmiga hawada iyo xaqiiqada duulista ee la hirgeliyey wixii ka dambeeyey weerarradii 11-kii Sebteembar. Duuliyaha ganacsiga Aaron Murphy, oo dhacdada ku tijaabiyey qalabka jilidda duulimaadka ee CNN, ayaa tilmaamay in diyaarad ku degaysa ku dhowaad 20,000 oo feet qiyaastii 35 ilbiriqsi, iyadoo ku socota xawaare ka badan 700 mayl saacaddii, ay la kulmi lahayd xoogag hawadeed oo kala goyn kara. Fikradda ah in jirka diyaaradda rakaabku u adkeysan karo culayskaas iyada oo aan burbur weyn gaarin ama aysan lumin qaybaha muhiimka ah ee lagu hago ayaa duuliyeyaal badan ku dhalisay shaki. Muuqaallada gudaha diyaaradda laga duubay ayaa muujinaya rakaab si caadi ah u taagan, wax u duubaya ama marinnada dhex socda, halka hoobasho xawaare sare leh ay caadi ahaan keeni lahayd xoogag G oo taban iyo gariir ka dhigaya in qofku istaago ama qolka duuliyeyaasha u socdo arrin aad u adag. Dadka dhacdada falanqeynaya waxay sidoo kale xuseen in hoobasho baaxaddaas leh ay sababi kartay dhibaatooyin cadaadiska hawada ah iyo soo dhicidda maaskarooyinka oksijiinta, balse muuqaalladu waxay muujinayeen armaajooyinka kore oo xiran iyo maaskarooyinka oo aan soo bixin. Intaa waxaa dheer, albaabbada qolka duuliyeyaasha ee diyaaradaha casriga ah waxay leeyihiin xaqiijin dhowr heer ah iyo qufullo adag; sidaas darteed, sheegashada ah in kabtan dhaawacmay oo weerar ku socda uu furay koodhka albaabka ayaa sii kordhisay shakiga. Joogitaanka laba duuliye oo kayd ah, faragelinta degdegga ah ee qof rakaabka ka mid ahaa iyo dhacdada oo isla markiiba loo adeegsaday xoojinta farriimo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni ayaa dadka dhaliilaya ku kallifay inay ku tilmaamaan “sheeko Hollywood” iyo masrax siyaasadeed. Iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan baaqyada lagu dalbanayo xogta aan la tafatirin ee qalabka duuba xogta duulimaadka FDRiyo codadka qolka duuliyeyaasha, ayaa sheekada rasmiga ahi waxay sii wajahaysaa su’aalo culus. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Halkii loo arki lahaa oo keliya dhacdo halyeeynimo hawada ka dhacday, waxay dunida hor dhigtay su’aasha ah in habraacyadii ammaanka duulista dhab ahaan la jebiyey iyo in kale, ama in riwaayadda cirka ka dhacday loo sameeyey dhagaystayaal kale oo dhulka joogay.

Sheekada dadweynaha loo soo bandhigay waxay sheegaysaa in kaaliyaha duuliyuhu mindi ku weeraray kabtanka, isagoo diyaaradda Boeing-ka ah hoos u dhigay qiyaastii 20,000 oo feet wax ka yar hal daqiiqo, xawaaraheeduna kor u dhaafay 700 mayl saacaddii. Sida sheekadu tilmaamayso, kabtanka oo dhaawac halis ah qaba ayaa haddana ku guuleystay inuu furo albaabka ammaanka adag leh, taasoo u saamaxday rakaabka oo ay ku jireen farsamo-yaqaan tuubooyinka ah oo fasax ku jiray iyo duuliyeyaal shaqo kale u safrayey iney qolka duuliyeyaasha galaan, weeraryahanka ka adkaadaan, diyaaradda xakameeyaan, dabadeedna si nabad ah ugu weeciyaan Sacuudiga. Dad badan ayaa ku doodaya in sheekadani ka hor imaanayso mabaadi’da cilmiga hawada iyo xaqiiqada duulista ee la hirgeliyey wixii ka dambeeyey weerarradii 11-kii Sebteembar. Duuliyaha ganacsiga Aaron Murphy, oo dhacdada ku tijaabiyey qalabka jilidda duulimaadka ee CNN, ayaa tilmaamay in diyaarad ku degaysa ku dhowaad 20,000 oo feet qiyaastii 35 ilbiriqsi, iyadoo ku socota xawaare ka badan 700 mayl saacaddii, ay la kulmi lahayd xoogag hawadeed oo kala goyn kara. Fikradda ah in jirka diyaaradda rakaabku u adkeysan karo culayskaas iyada oo aan burbur weyn gaarin ama aysan lumin qaybaha muhiimka ah ee lagu hago ayaa duuliyeyaal badan ku dhalisay shaki. Muuqaallada gudaha diyaaradda laga duubay ayaa muujinaya rakaab si caadi ah u taagan, wax u duubaya ama marinnada dhex socda, halka hoobasho xawaare sare leh ay caadi ahaan keeni lahayd xoogag G oo taban iyo gariir ka dhigaya in qofku istaago ama qolka duuliyeyaasha u socdo arrin aad u adag. Dadka dhacdada falanqeynaya waxay sidoo kale xuseen in hoobasho baaxaddaas leh ay sababi kartay dhibaatooyin cadaadiska hawada ah iyo soo dhicidda maaskarooyinka oksijiinta, balse muuqaalladu waxay muujinayeen armaajooyinka kore oo xiran iyo maaskarooyinka oo aan soo bixin. Intaa waxaa dheer, albaabbada qolka duuliyeyaasha ee diyaaradaha casriga ah waxay leeyihiin xaqiijin dhowr heer ah iyo qufullo adag; sidaas darteed, sheegashada ah in kabtan dhaawacmay oo weerar ku socda uu furay koodhka albaabka ayaa sii kordhisay shakiga. Joogitaanka laba duuliye oo kayd ah, faragelinta degdegga ah ee qof rakaabka ka mid ahaa iyo dhacdada oo isla markiiba loo adeegsaday xoojinta farriimo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni ayaa dadka dhaliilaya ku kallifay inay ku tilmaamaan “sheeko Hollywood” iyo masrax siyaasadeed. Iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan baaqyada lagu dalbanayo xogta aan la tafatirin ee qalabka duuba xogta duulimaadka FDRiyo codadka qolka duuliyeyaasha, ayaa sheekada rasmiga ahi waxay sii wajahaysaa su’aalo culus. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Halkii loo arki lahaa oo keliya dhacdo halyeeynimo hawada ka dhacday, waxay dunida hor dhigtay su’aasha ah in habraacyadii ammaanka duulista dhab ahaan la jebiyey iyo in kale, ama in riwaayadda cirka ka dhacday loo sameeyey dhagaystayaal kale oo dhulka joogay.

items.title: Dagaalka Cusub ee Itoobiya Ma Abuuri Karaa Firaaq Amni oo Soomaaliya Ka Dhasha?
items.description: Dagaalka dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa dhalinaya walaac ku saabsan mustaqbalka ciidamada Itoobiya ee ka hawlgala Soomaaliya. Warbixin ay Bloomberg baahisay ayaa sheegtay in Addis Ababa ay qorshaynayso inay Soomaaliya kala baxdo in ka badan 3,000 oo askari, si loogu adeegsado dagaalka gudaha Itoobiya, inkasta oo dowladda Soomaaliya aysan weli helin ogeysiis rasmi ah. Ciidamada Itoobiya waxay Soomaaliya uga hawlgalaan laba nidaam: qaar waxay ka tirsan yihiin Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, halka kuwo kalena ay dalka ku joogaan heshiisyo laba geesood ah. Waxay fariisimo muhiim ah ku leeyihiin gobollada Bay, Bakool, Hiiraan iyo deegaanno ku dhow xadka, waxaana dhowaan la beddelay cutubyo AUSSOM ka tirsan oo ku sugnaa Beledweyne iyo Halgan. Weli lama caddeyn in ciidanka la qorsheynayo in laga saaro Soomaaliya ay yihiin kuwa AUSSOM, kuwa heshiiska laba geesoodka ah ama labada qayboodba. Addis Ababa si rasmi ah uma shaacin qorshaha bixitaanka, halka sarkaal ka tirsan Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya uu sheegay inaan Muqdisho lagu wargelin wax ciidan-bixis ah. Haddii bixitaanku noqdo mid degdeg ah oo aan lagu beddelin ciidamo Soomaali ah ama kuwa AUSSOM, Al‑Shabaab waxay heli kartaa fursad ay ku weerarto saldhigyada laga baxo, waddooyinka sahayda iyo magaalooyinka xuduudaha ku dhow. Itoobiya ayaa tallaabo la mid ah qaaday markii dagaalkii Tigray billowday 2020, markaas oo kumannaan askari oo heshiis laba geesood ah ku joogay Soomaaliya dib loogu celiyey dalkooda. Khubaradu waxay hore uga digeen in bixitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya uu abuuri karo firaaq ay Al‑Shabaab ka faa’iidaysato. Khatartu kuma koobna fariisimaha ciidamada oo keliya, balse Itoobiya waxay door muhiim ah ku leedahay ilaalinta xadka dheer ee labada dal, xog-is-weydaarsiga sirdoonka iyo xaddididda dhaqdhaqaaqa Al‑Shabaab ee u dhexeeya Bakool, Gedo iyo Dowlad-deegaanka Soomaalida. Haddii ciidamada, diyaaradaha iyo awoodda sirdoonka Itoobiya loo weeciyo Tigray, Amxaarada iyo Canfarta, cadaadiska lagu hayo marinnada xuduudda ayaa yaraada. Arrintani waxay ku soo beegmaysaa xilli AUSSOM ay horay u wajahaysay maalgelin iyo taageero saadka la xiriirta oo aan degganayn. Mareykanka ayaa Qaramada Midoobay siiyey hal sano oo dheeraad ah si tartiib loogu soo afjaro taageerada hawlgalka, laakiin mustaqbalka raashinka, shidaalka, caafimaadka iyo gaadiidka ay ciidamada ku tiirsan yihiin weli wuxuu ku jiraa xaalad hubanti-la’aan ah. Dagaalka Itoobiya wuxuu sidoo kale keeni karaa barakac, ganacsi xumo iyo hub ku faafa xuduudaha gobolka, ayadoo tobannaan kun oo qof ay durba ka barakaceen dagaallada Canfarta, halka xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea uu si buuxda u burburay. Haddaba haddii colaadda gudaha Itoobiya isu beddesho dagaal goboleed, Addis Ababa waxaa ku adkaan karta inay sii waddo kaalinteeda milatari iyo midda diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya.
