items.title: Somalia’s Al-Shabaab Question: Who Has the Mandate to Negotiate?
items.description: By Abdullahi A. Nor Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre has reopened one of Somalia’s most sensitive questions by saying the government is prepared to engage members of Al-Shabaab who renounce the group and its ideology. He also denied that the government has held negotiations with the group or paid it to reduce attacks in Mogadishu. That distinction matters. The government is currently describing its position as an offer of reintegration to defectors, rather than a political negotiation with Al-Shabaab as an organization. But the comments inevitably raise a much larger question: who has the political mandate to negotiate Somalia’s future with an armed movement that still controls or heavily influences large parts of the countryside? That question cannot be separated from Somalia’s unresolved constitutional crisis. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s mandate has been the subject of a major political dispute since the scheduled end of his original four-year term in May 2026. Parliament subsequently approved constitutional amendments extending the presidential and parliamentary terms from four to five years. Opposition leaders rejected the change and accused the government of using constitutional reform to prolong its tenure. Reuters reported that Hassan Sheikh remained in office amid the dispute. The result is a fundamental disagreement over political legitimacy. For those who reject the extension, the current administration cannot legitimately make far-reaching political commitments on behalf of Somalia when the country’s electoral and constitutional settlement remains unresolved. From that perspective, any comprehensive political dialogue with Al-Shabaab should be left to an incoming government established through a broadly accepted constitutional and electoral process. Al-Shabaab Still Holds the Rural Advantage The argument for political engagement cannot, however, be dismissed simply because the government is politically divided.Al-Shabaab remains a powerful armed actor. The European Union Agency for Asylum reported that, as of March 2026, the group controlled or maintained a heavy presence across large parts of south-central Somalia and had expanded its territorial influence in several areas. This creates a striking contradiction at the heart of the Somali state. The government operates from Mogadishu, but its reach outside major urban centres remains severely constrained. Large areas of the countryside remain insecure or contested, and government officials and security personnel frequently depend on air transport when travelling beyond the capital because major roads remain vulnerable. The result is a state whose political authority is national in theory but whose effective reach remains limited in significant parts of the country. That reality makes any future political settlement with Al-Shabaab an issue that cannot simply be wished away. Rumours of a Secret Deal The relative reduction in the frequency of some of Al-Shabaab’s spectacular attacks in Mogadishu has also generated rumors that the government may have reached an undisclosed financial arrangement with the group. The allegations claim that millions of dollars are being paid in exchange for keeping the capital relatively quiet. There is no independently verified evidence establishing such a deal. Prime Minister Hamza has categorically denied the allegation, saying the government and Al-Shabaab have had no negotiations and that their relationship remains one of armed conflict. He attributed the payment allegations to figures associated with a previous administration and also accused some former officials of having links to Al-Shabaab, without providing publicly available evidence for those claims. The allegations should therefore remain allegations—not facts. But their circulation reflects a deeper public question: why has Al-Shabaab retained such substantial influence outside the capital despite years of international military assistance to the Somali government? A Fragmented Federal System The political crisis is further complicated by the fragmentation of Somalia’s federal system.Puntland and Jubaland have remained openly opposed to key policies of the Federal Government, while South West State suspended cooperation with Mogadishu before the federal government deployed forces to Baydhabo and established an interim administration there. Hirshabelle and Galmudug have remained considerably closer to the Federal Government. Some critics interpret this alignment through a clan-political lens, arguing that the states still cooperating with Mogadishu are politically closer to President Hassan Sheikh’s constituency. That interpretation is a political allegation rather than an established explanation; the governments involved have their own political calculations and interests. Nevertheless, the fragmentation is real. Somalia therefore faces the unusual prospect of considering negotiations with Al-Shabaab while its own federal political actors remain deeply divided over constitutional authority, elections and the distribution of power. The Timing of Dialogue Matters There is an important difference between reintegration and political negotiations. The government has a legitimate policy option to encourage individual Al-Shabaab members who abandon violence to defect, disarm and return to civilian life. Prime Minister Hamza says former members of the group already serve in government institutions and security forces. A national political negotiation with Al-Shabaab is a different matter. Such a process could involve questions of governance, constitutional authority, security arrangements, justice, territory and the future political order. Those decisions would affect every Somali community—not simply the administration currently occupying Villa Somalia. That is why the unresolved constitutional and electoral crisis cannot be separated from the question of dialogue. An Opening Al-Shabaab Could Exploit There is also a strategic danger in entering any major negotiation from a position of political weakness. If the Federal Government remains divided from several federal member states, lacks a broadly accepted electoral settlement and continues to face restrictions on its territorial reach, Al-Shabaab could enter negotiations with considerable leverage. Rather than producing peace, a poorly structured process could potentially allow the group to use political dialogue to consolidate gains made through years of armed conflict. That does not mean dialogue should be permanently rejected. It means that the legitimacy, timing and mandate of any dialogue matter as much as the dialogue itself. Somalia’s next political leadership may ultimately have to confront the question of whether military operations alone can defeat Al-Shabaab or whether a broader political settlement will eventually be necessary. But if that question is to be addressed nationally, it should be addressed by a government whose constitutional authority and electoral mandate are broadly accepted. Somalia does not merely need a conversation with Al-Shabaab. It needs first to settle the question of who has the legitimate authority to speak for Somalia. Abdullahi A. items.title: Ethiopia’s Seven-Front War Forces New Troop Pullback from Somalia
items.description: Addis Ababa Reportedly Plans to Withdraw More Than 3,000 Soldiers as Fighting Spreads Across Multiple Fronts Addis Ababa (WDN) — Ethiopia’s expanding internal conflict is beginning to carry consequences beyond its borders, with Addis Ababa reportedly preparing to withdraw more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government faces mounting military pressure at home. According to Bloomberg, people familiar with the plan said Ethiopia could begin withdrawing troops from Somalia within days or weeks. The sources did not specify whether the soldiers are serving under the African Union’s AUSSOM mission, bilateral security arrangements, or both. The reported withdrawal would reflect a difficult strategic calculation: as fighting spreads across multiple fronts inside Ethiopia, Addis Ababa is being forced to reconsider how many troops it can afford to keep deployed abroad. Ethiopia has maintained thousands of soldiers in Somalia for years, including forces operating under AUSSOM and others deployed under bilateral security arrangements. Ethiopian troops have been particularly active in areas including Bay, Bakool, Gedo and Hiiraan, many of them close to the Ethiopian border. Seven Fronts Put Pressure on Abiy The troop withdrawal report comes as Ethiopia faces renewed fighting in the north and growing armed opposition in several regions. Federal forces and their allies have been fighting Tigray forces and other armed groups, putting further strain on the 2022 Pretoria peace agreement that ended the two-year Tigray war. Recent fighting has reportedly spread around strategic areas including Alamata, while drone strikes and ground clashes have caused significant casualties. Médecins Sans Frontières said more than 700 wounded people had reached hospitals it supports in Korem, Alamata and Shire. The renewed violence comes four years after the Pretoria agreement ended the Tigray war, one of Ethiopia’s deadliest conflicts in decades. At the same time, the emergence of a broader armed opposition coalition has added another layer of pressure on Addis Ababa. Seven armed groups, reportedly including the TPLF, Oromo Liberation Army and Amhara Fano forces, have announced cooperation against Abiy’s government and called for a transitional political arrangement. The Ethiopian government has accused Eritrea, Egypt and Sudan of supporting armed groups opposed to Addis Ababa. The three countries have denied the allegations. A Wider Regional Contest The conflict is increasingly being viewed through a regional lens. Reports and political claims suggest that the UAE and Türkiye remain closely aligned with the Abiy government, while Eritrea, Egypt and other regional actors are alleged to be more sympathetic to forces opposed to Addis Ababa. These competing alignments remain politically contested and should not be treated as established military alliances without further evidence. The strategic stakes are particularly high in Afar, where instability could threaten the major transport corridor linking Addis Ababa with Djibouti. The route carries a large share of Ethiopia’s international trade. If Ethiopia’s internal conflict continues to widen, the government could face increasingly difficult choices over the deployment of its armed forces. Could the Federal Army Fragment? The most serious uncertainty concerns the cohesion of Ethiopia’s federal security forces. The seven-front opposition coalition represents several of the country’s major ethnic and regional constituencies. Some analysts and opposition figures have raised the possibility that prolonged fighting could weaken the federal military or encourage defections. There is, however, no confirmed evidence that Ethiopia’s federal army is currently disintegrating or preparing to join the opposition coalition. Such a development would fundamentally alter the balance of power in Ethiopia, but for now it remains a scenario rather than an established fact. Somalia Faces Its Own Security Dilemma Ethiopia has withdrawn troops from Somalia before when internal conflicts intensified. When the Tigray war erupted in 2020, Addis Ababa redeployed thousands of soldiers from Somalia to reinforce operations at home. A new withdrawal could therefore have direct consequences for Somalia. Ethiopian forces remain an important component of the regional security architecture, particularly in areas where Al-Shabaab remains active. A large-scale reduction could create security gaps unless Somalia and its international partners can rapidly compensate for the loss. For Addis Ababa, however, the dilemma is becoming increasingly difficult: maintain a substantial military presence abroad while multiple armed fronts demand troops at home, or pull forces back to confront an increasingly complex internal war. The reported withdrawal suggests that Ethiopia may once again be forced to prioritize the battle inside its own borders. As Ethiopia’s house burns on multiple fronts, its military commitments beyond its borders may increasingly become a luxury Addis Ababa can no longer afford. items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo dalbaday wada-hadal iyo ergo gaartay Baydhaba
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), ayaa ugu dambeyn dalbaday in wada-hadal lagu wajaho xaaladda kasii dareysa ee maamulkaas, iyadoo maanta ergadii ugu horreysay ay gaartay gudaha magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa Aqalka Madaxtooyadao ku qaabilay wafdi uu hoggaaminayay guddoomiyihii Hore ee Golaha Shacabka Mudane Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan oo uu wehlinayaan siyaasiyiin kale oo uu kamid yahay Aadan Saransoor, kuwaas oo kamid ahaa saaxibadii Lafta-gareen oo hadda dibadjoog ah, dagaalna kula jira Sheekh Aadan Madoobe. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta wada-tashiga, is-fahamka iyo iskaashiga siyaasadeed, iyadoo si gaar ah looga wada hadlay xaaladda guud ee Koonfur Galbeed, arrimaha siyaasadda, amniga, dowlad-dhiska iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa midnimada iyo wadajirka bulshada. Sida ay sheegtay Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, socdaalka wafdiga Maxamed Mursal yaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo ka qeybgalayaasha siyaasiyiinta gogasha dib-u-heshiisiinta ee dhowaan ka furmaysa caasimada ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Baydhaba Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada-hadalka iyo wada-tashiga siyaasadeed, si loo abuuro jawi horseeda xasillooni siyaasadeed, nabad waarta iyo horumar loo dhan yahay. Waxaa kale oo ay dhinacyadu is dhaafsadeen aragtiyo iyo talooyin ku aaddan xaaladda dalka iyo tan Koonfur Galbeed, iyagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in khilaafaadka iyo kala aragti duwanaanshaha lagu wajaho wada-hadal, is-qaddarin iyo xalal siyaasadeed oo lagu heshiiyo. Madaxweyne Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) oo madasha ka hadlay ayaa wafdiga uu hoggaaminayay guddoomiyihii hore ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya uga mahadceliyay booqashadooda magaalada Baydhaba iyo ka qeybgalka gogasha dib u heshiisinta. Aadan Madoobe ayaa sidoo kale soo dhaweeyay kaalinta ay madaxda Soomaaliyeed, siyaasiyiinta, waxgaradka, culimada iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada ka qaadanayaan xoojinta wada-tashiga, nabadda, dowlad-dhiska iyo midnimada shacabka Koonfur Galbeed, isagoo tilmaamay in wada-shaqeynta iyo is-dhaafsiga aragtiyaha ay muhiim u yihiin horumarinta dowladnimada iyo xasilloonida deeganka. Arrimahan ayaa kusoo aadayo, xilli maalmihii u dambeeyay ay dagaallo culus ka dhaceen gudaha Baydhaba, kadib weerarro ay kusoo qaadeen ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen, kuwaas oo s oo noqnoqoshadooda ay walaac gaar ah ka abuurtay magaaladaas oo hoy u ah boqolaal kun oo qof oo ku barakacay colaadaha iyo abaaraha ka jira qeybo kale oo dalka ah. The post Aadan Madoobe oo dalbaday wada-hadal iyo ergo gaartay Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Muungaab oo bogaadiyay doorashooyinkii ka dhacay Galmudug iyo HirShabelle
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) ayaa si wayn u bogaadiyay doorashooyinkii Arbacadii ka dhacay Dowlad-goboleedyada Galmudug iyo HirShabelle, kuwaas oo si nabad ah oo xasilooni leh uga qabsoomay magaalooyinka waa wayn ee maamuladaasi. Ugu horreyn guddoomiye Muungaab ayaa u hambalyeeyay shacabka, madaxda iyo dhammaan dhinacyadii ka qayb qaatay hirgelinta doorashooyinkan, isagoo ku ammaanay sida nabdoon ee ay u dhaceen iyo doorkii ay ka qaateen ilaalinta xasilloonida iyo kala dambeynta. Sidoo kale wuxuu hoosta ka xariiqay in qabsoomidda doorashooyinkan ay muujinayso muhiimadda ay leedahay in dalka laga sii ambaqaado hannaan doorasho oo ku dhisan ka-qaybgalka bulshada, nabadgelyada iyo xasilloonida siyaasadeed. “Maanta waa maalin kale oo taariikhi ah, oo muhiim u ah geeddi-socodka dowlad-dhisidda Soomaaliya, iyadoo shacabka ku dhaqan Dowlad-Goboleedyada 𝐇𝐢𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐛𝐞𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐞 iyo 𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐠 ay u dareereen goobaha codbixinta, si’ ay si’ toos ah ugu soo doortaan wakiilladooda. Doorashooyinkani waxay qayb ka yihiin geeddi-socod qaran oo ay 𝐛𝐚𝐫-𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐨𝐰 𝐮 𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐲𝐝 𝐝𝐨𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐢 𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐞𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐆𝐨𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐁𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐫 𝐞𝐞 𝐪𝐚𝐛𝐬𝐨𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐲 𝟐𝟓-𝐤𝐢𝐢 𝐃𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐚𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟓,” ayuu yiri Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab). Duqa Muqdisho ayaa sidoo kale doorashooyinka ka dhacay Galmudug iyo HirShabelle ku tilmaamay tallaabo muhiim ah oo loo qaaday dhanka horumarinta hannaanka dimuqraadiyadeed ee dalka iyo xoojinta doorka shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee ku aaddan doorashada cidda metelaysa. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu door muhiim ah ka qaatay xaqiijinta rajada iyo himilada shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee ku aaddan in dalka laga hirgeliyo doorasho qof iyo cod ah. “Hannaanka doorashada tooska ah wuxuu xoojinayaa codka shacabka iyo xaqa muwaadinka Soomaaliyeed ee ah inuu si toos ah u doorto cidda uu ku aaminayo metelaaddiisa, taasoo qayb ka ah 𝐡𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐚 shacabka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐅𝐞𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐲𝐚, 𝐌𝐮𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐞 𝐃𝐫. 𝐗𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧 𝐒𝐡𝐞𝐞𝐤𝐡 𝐌𝐚𝐱𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐮𝐝, uu rumeeyay riyada muwaadiniinta ee ah 𝐝𝐨𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐨 𝐪𝐨𝐟 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐜𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐡. Waxaan sidoo kale bogaadinayaa Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ee ku guuleystay fulinta doorashooyinkan,” ayuu mar kale yiri guddoomiyuhu. Horay doorashooyin noocan oo kale ah ayaa uga dhacay Gobolka Banaadir iyo Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo qayb ka ahaa geeddi-socodka lagu xoojinayo hannaanka doorashooyinka tooska ah ee dalka. Si kastaba, Doorashooyinkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirto marxalad muhiim ah oo la xiriirta hirgelinta hannaanka doorashooyinka tooska ah, iyadoo muhiimad gaar ah la siinayo ka-qaybgalka shacabka iyo in muwaadiniintu helaan fursad ay si toos ah ugu doortaan wakiilladooda. items.title: Baidoa War Deepens as Political Settlement Remains Elusive
items.description: Failed Nairobi Initiative, Renewed Fighting and Alleged Turkish Airstrikes Leave Civilians Paying the Price Baidoa (WDN) — The renewed fighting in Baydhabo has exposed the deeper political dispute behind the conflict, raising questions about why a crisis that could have been addressed through negotiations has instead been allowed to escalate into repeated armed confrontation. At the heart of the dispute is the Federal Government’s decision earlier this year to deploy forces to Baydhabo and remove former Southwest State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen from power. While the government presented the intervention as necessary to restore stability, Laftagareen’s supporters viewed it as a deliberate attempt to forcibly change Southwest State’s leadership and bring the state under direct control of Mogadishu. The confrontation has since evolved into a prolonged armed struggle between federal forces and forces aligned with Laftagareen. Aden Mohamed Nur Madobe , who now heads the federal-backed administration, has remained in Baydhabo amid heightened security, with his administration operating under heavy protection offered by UNSOM. A Peace Proposal That Never Took Off One of the most significant but less publicly discussed attempts to resolve the crisis came through a delegation led by a former Speaker of the House of the People Dr. Mursal and several heavy weight members of Parliament, who met Laftagareen in Nairobi. According to people familiar with the discussions, the meetings produced a possible political formula under which both Laftagareen and Aden Madobe would step aside, paving the way for a transitional administration to govern South West State until a fair and credible election could be held. The proposal offered a potential exit from the confrontation: neither rival would retain control, and the people of South West State would ultimately decide their leadership through an electoral process. But the initiative failed to gain the necessary political backing from Mogadishu. According to those involved in the effort, the proposal was effectively rejected by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government, and the military confrontation continued. The result has been another cycle of fighting in which political disagreements have increasingly been settled through military pressure rather than negotiation. Baidoa Pays the Price The latest fighting on September 28 again pitted federal and allied forces against forces associated with Laftagareen. The two sides have offered competing accounts of who initiated the clashes. What is increasingly difficult to dispute, however, is the cost to civilians. UNICEF said on September 30 that children had been killed and injured in the latest violence and that a health facility had been damaged. The agency warned that insecurity was restricting access to health care and other essential services at a time when families are already facing displacement, food insecurity and severe child malnutrition. Earlier fighting has also overwhelmed medical services. Reports from Baidoa said civilians struggled to move around the city and reach hospitals as fighting disrupted roads and normal activity. South West State was already facing major humanitarian pressures, including displacement, food insecurity and inadequate access to basic services. Renewed fighting risks producing another wave of displacement and further restricting humanitarian access. The humanitarian situation is particularly concerning as Somalia enters the Deyr rainy season. The British government announced £5 million in new humanitarian assistance on September 24 to help vulnerable Somali communities prepare for anticipated El Niño-related flooding, with support expected to reach up to 600,000 people and help keep essential health, nutrition, water and sanitation services operating. The Turkish Question The role of Türkiye has become another major source of controversy. Laftagareen-aligned officials and other local sources have accused Türkiye of using F-16 fighter jets and drones during the fighting in support of federal forces. Those allegations have been reported in connection with both the September 3 and September 28 clashes. However, the identity of the aircraft responsible and the chain of command behind any reported airstrikes have not been independently established. That uncertainty makes the issue all the more important. Türkiye is one of Somalia’s most important military partners, and its involvement in training and supporting Somali security forces is publicly known. But the reported use of Turkish military capabilities in a domestic political confrontation would raise serious questions about the boundaries between counterterrorism cooperation and Somalia’s internal political disputes. Why should foreign military assets be drawn into a conflict between Somali political factions? That is a question that requires a clear and credible answer. As the fighting continues, another opportunity for negotiations is emerging. The same group of Somali political figures involved in earlier mediation efforts is expected to travel to Baydhabo to restart talks between the competing sides. Their renewed effort comes after repeated rounds of fighting have failed to produce a decisive political outcome. The South West State Council for Peace, Unity and Development has also been conducting mediation efforts, including meetings with rival political actors, and has called for a peaceful resolution to the dispute. The new initiative offers another chance to return the conflict to the negotiating table. The central question now is whether the Federal Government will accept that the military route has failed to resolve the political dispute and allow a negotiated settlement to take precedence. A War Without a Political Exit Britain has expressed concern about the fighting and stressed the need for restraint and political dialogue. UNICEF has similarly focused on protecting children, schools, health facilities and humanitarian access. The message from the humanitarian community is increasingly clear: whatever the political disagreements, civilians cannot continue to bear the consequences. Baidoa’s crisis is therefore no longer simply a battle for control of a city. It is a test of whether Somalia’s political disputes can be resolved through negotiation rather than force. For the people of Baydhabo, the choice is painfully simple. Another military victory cannot deliver lasting political legitimacy. Only a negotiated settlement followed by a credible vote can give South West State a durable political future. items.title: Turkey, major power in Somalia, drawn into internal conflicts
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Turkey has poured huge sums into making Somalia one of its main foreign outposts but is being sucked into the country’s violent political battles, risking the goodwill it has built. Turkish F-16s fired missiles around Baidoa, a city in southern Somalia, on Monday as they helped federal troops fight off an attack by forces loyal to an ousted governor. Turkey was also accused of an airstrike on September 3 that injured opposition leader General Mahad Abdirahman in the southern town of Doolow, though the government claimed he was hurt by explosives “being prepared inside the house”. That incident sparked rare anti-Turkey protests in the region, with some burning its flag and desecrating images of Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan. “Turkey is a new colonial power that is occupying Somalia and is killing Somali people,” district commissioner Omar Abdullahi told a crowd of protesters in nearby Afmadow. “From today onwards, are we not at war with Turkey?” Huge investment While several Western countries have grown tired of funding a country in perpetual conflict, Turkey established its biggest overseas military base in Somalia. It is also building a spaceport on the Somali coast dedicated to launches and satellite technologies, as well as exploring for oil. The Turks have trained Somali troops, provided aid during droughts, floods and famines, and helped transform the capital, Mogadishu, with new roads and solar streetlights, while its companies run the city’s airport and seaport. Diplomats in Mogadishu jokingly complain of being awoken by the roar of the three Turkish F-16s. Many Somalis are grateful – particularly as Washington has cut vital aid needed for the fight against the Al Qaeda-linked insurgent group, Al-Shabaab that controls swathes of the country. But opposition parties say Turkish military training, vehicles, and drones – originally meant to battle Al-Shabaab – are being used against them and their militias, including during political clashes in Mogadishu in June. Somalia is in a deep political crisis after President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud pushed through unpopular reforms that included extending his mandate for a year, and the opposition met with Turkish diplomats to warn against taking sides. ‘Perfect cooperation’ Turkish construction work is pressing ahead regardless. The first phase of the spaceport at Warsheikh, around about 70 kilometres (40 miles) north of Mogadishu, is due to be completed soon, a local official said on condition of anonymity. Turkey is in Somalia for the long-term and its interests go far beyond the current government. “A succession of presidents and politicians has held office, and we have worked in perfect cooperation with these successive leaders,” said a senior Turkish official working on the Somalia file. “All political actors in Somalia know that Turkey’s support is intended for the Somali people and for Somalia, not for any specific political line,” he added. This was supported by a Western diplomat based in Mogadishu. “Turkey is a highly sophisticated actor and will support whoever best secures those interests,” he told AFP. ‘Disinformation’ The Somali government says the opposition is using “disinformation” to malign the relationship with Turkey. “It was shameful to see the Turkish flag being burned on Somali soil,” said parliament speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur at an event to commemorate the partnership on September 9. Somali MP Amina Mohamed Mursal told AFP that the Turks “are our brothers and sisters… They came to our aid during difficult times.” Some ordinary Somalis are still wary. “Turkey can no longer be seen as a neutral partner… Its backing of the federal government’s leadership is deepening political divisions and fuelling our resentment,” Mogadishu resident Dahir Ahmed told AFP. “Many people now openly criticise Turkey – a marked change from the widespread support it enjoyed when it first became involved in Somalia,” added Shueyb Yare, a businessman from the diaspora. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

Turkey is in Somalia for the long-term and its interests go far beyond the current government. “A succession of presidents and politicians has held office, and we have worked in perfect cooperation with these successive leaders,” said a senior Turkish official working on the Somalia file. “All political actors in Somalia know that Turkey’s support is intended for the Somali people and for Somalia, not for any specific political line,” he added. This was supported by a Western diplomat based in Mogadishu. “Turkey is a highly sophisticated actor and will support whoever best secures those interests,” he told AFP. ‘Disinformation’ The Somali government says the opposition is using “disinformation” to malign the relationship with Turkey. “It was shameful to see the Turkish flag being burned on Somali soil,” said parliament speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur at an event to commemorate the partnership on September 9. Somali MP Amina Mohamed Mursal told AFP that the Turks “are our brothers and sisters… They came to our aid during difficult times.” Some ordinary Somalis are still wary. “Turkey can no longer be seen as a neutral partner… Its backing of the federal government’s leadership is deepening political divisions and fuelling our resentment,” Mogadishu resident Dahir Ahmed told AFP. “Many people now openly criticise Turkey – a marked change from the widespread support it enjoyed when it first became involved in Somalia,” added Shueyb Yare, a businessman from the diaspora. items.title: Cagjar oo dib loogu doortay madaxweynaha deegaanka
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Mustafe Muxamed Cagjar ayaa mar kale loo doortay Madaxweynaha Dowlad Deegaanka Soomalida isagoo helay muddo xileed cusub oo shan sano ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa waxaa cod aqlabiyad leh ku doortay Xildhibaannada Dowlad Deegaanka, tani oo fursad kale siineysa Cagjar oo ismaamulka hoggaaminaya, tan iyo isbeddelkii ka dhacay deegaanka sanadkii 2018, xilligaas oo meesha laga saaray maamulkii Cabdi Maxamuud Cumar. Mustafe Cagjar ayaa si weyn loo hadal-hayay inuu xilka baneeynayo, balse soo laabashadiisa ayaa loo aanaynayaa dagaallada mar kale ka soo cusboonaaday gudaha dalka Itoobiya. Sidoo kale waxaa madaxweyne ku xigeenka maamulka cusub noqday Ibraahim Cusmaan, halka Mubashir Dubbad Raage loo doortay Afhayeenka Baarlamaanka Deegaanka. Mubashir Dubbad ayaamid kamid ah siyaasiyiinta ugu caansan deegaanka Soomaalida, waana xildhibaan ka soo gala magaalada Qabribayax, isagoo soo qabtay Wasaaradaha Maaliyadda iyo Hoggaanka Nabadgalyada. Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida ayaa waxaa muddooyinkii lasoo dhaafay ka jiray isbeddello siyaasadeed iyo amni, kuwaas oo saameeyay maamulka iyo hoggaanka deegaanka. Dib u doorashada Cagjar ee muddo xileedkan cusub ayaa kusoo aaday xilli Itoobiya ay ka jiraan xaalado amni iyo qalalaase ka dhashay khilaafaadyo iyo dagaallo ka socda dalkaasi. items.title: Sawirro: Xasan Sheekh oo warqadaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay laba safiir
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa xarunta Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay safiirrada cusub cusub ee Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye Midowga Yurub, kuwaas oo dhawaan soo gaaray magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimada dalka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa warqadaha aqoonsiga safiirnimo ka guddoomay Danjiraha cusub ee Türkiye Mudane Ferhat Alkan iyo Safiirka Midowga Yurub ee Soomaaliya mudane László Máthé, kuwaasi oo si rasmi ah u bilaabaya waajibaadkooda diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa Danjireyaasha cusub la wadaagay horumarka iyo guulaha Soomaaliya ka xaqiijisay dhinacyada amniga, dimuqraadiyeynta, dowlad-dhiska iyo horumarinta dalka, isaga oo adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo iskaashiga iyo xiriirka labada dhinac, si loo gaaro himilooyinka wadajirka ah. Dhankooda, Danjireyaasha aya Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya soo gaarsiiyay salaan iyo farriimo ay ka sideen madaxdooda, iyaga oo bogaadiyay horumarka iyo guulaha Soomaaliya ay ka gaartay dowlad-dhiska, amniga iyo horumarinta dalka. Labada safiir ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay in ay ka shaqeeyaan xoojinta xiriirrada Soomaaliya iyo dalalka ay matalaan, iyaga oo ballanqaaday in ay si dhow ula shaqeyn doonaan hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka, inta ay gudanayaan waajibaadkooda diblomaasiyadeed. Munaasabadda oo si maamuus sare leh ugu qabsoomtay Qasriga Madaxtooyada Qaranka, ayaa waxaa ka qeyb qaatay cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidamada Qalabka Sida oo salaan sharaf ku maamuusay Danjireyaasha warqadahooda u gudbiyey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay wadday dadaallo lagu ballaarinayo xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka caalamka, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo horumarinta danaha qaranka iyo kor u qaadista doorka Soomaaliya ee fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah. items.title: Hawlgal lagu raadinayo gaadiid lagu soo raray walxaha qarxa oo ka socda Baydhabo
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadu ay magaaladaasi ka wadaan hawlgal ay si qarsoodi ah uga baadigoobayaan gaadiid la sheegay in lagu soo raray walxaha qarxa. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in gaadiidkan magaalada la soo geliyay maalintii Isniinta, intii uu socday dagaalkii ay ku soo qaadeen ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo kaashanaya sida la sheegay maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. “Baabuurta laga raadinayo magaalada waa shan, waxayna isugu jiraan Leyla Calaawi, Prado, Noha/noah, Caasi iyo gaari Iska-roge ah. Xogaha aan helnay waxay muujinayaan in maalintii dagaalka baabuurtan la soo geliyay mgaalada.” Ayuu yiri Sarkaal ka tirsan Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda Koonfur Galbeed. Sarkaalkan ayaa Universaltv u sheegay in ciidamada ay sidoo kale magaalada ka baadigoobayaan 10 nin oo la tuhunsan yahay in ay ka tirsan yihiin xubnaha Al Shabaab ee ku qoran is qarxinta. Waxa uu sheegay in hawlgalku uu qaab aan muuqan uga socdo magaalada, iyadoo laga fogaanayo in la argagax-geliyo dadka deegaanka. “Ciidamada si dhow ayay ula socdaan dhammaan noocyada baabuurta ee laga shakisan yahay, iyagoo ka raadinaya xaafadaha, meelaha baabuurta la dhigto iyo garaashyada lagu sameeyo.” Ayuu yiri Sarkaalkan oo diiday in la soo xigto, sababtoo ah fasax uma haysto inuu Warbaahinta la hadlo. Dagaalkii ugu dambeeyay ee toddobaadkan ka dhacay Baydhabo, nin watay gaari Leyla Calaawi ahaa ayaa isku qarxiyay afaafka hore ee Hotel RB, waxaana halkaasi ku dhintay inta la xaqiijiyay 15 qof. Xulafada mucaaradka ee Laftagareen ayaa ku hanjabay inay sii wadi doonaan dagaalka ay sheegeen inay dib ugu xoreynayaan Koonfur Galbeed. Ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen oo ku sugan bannaanada Baydhabo ayaa culeys amni ku haya magaaladaasi, oo xarun u ah Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Isbahaysiga Ulo-badan iyo Adkaanta Abiy Axmad
items.description: Itoobiya, tan iyo 2015-kii waxay ku jirtay xiisado siyaasadeed iyo rabshado ciidan; qulqulatooyinka qowmiyaduhuna waxay ahaayeen kuwo xiriirsan oo marba heer joogay. Dagaalladu maalinba weji bay lahaayeen, maantana waxay maraysaa in TPLF iyo jabhado kale oo degaanno kala duwan ka jiray ay samaysteen isbahaysi ulo-badan ah oo ka dhan ah dawladda uu hoggaamiyo Abiy Axmad. Taa oo sawir cad ka bixinaysa sida uu u burburay heshiiskii Nabadda ee Pretoria (2022) oo u dhexeeyay Abiy iyo TPLF. Toddoba kooxood oo hubaysan iyo kuwo siyaasadeed oo ay ka mid yihiin TPLF, Fano, ONLF iyo OLA ayaa isla alkumay isbahaysi cusub oo loo bixiyay EPFAS. Waxay ku dhawaaqeen ujeeddo mid ah oo ah inay xukuumadda Abiy Axmed xilka ka tuuraan. Khubarada falanqaysa arrimaha Itoobiya iyo shabakadaha ka faallooda arrimaha gobolku, waxay tilmaameen in Ereteriya ay doorkan gadaal ka taagan tahay isbahaysigan cusub, iyadoo siinaysa taageero dhaqaale iyo sahay millateri oo ay ulo-badantu ku gaadho yoolkeeda weyn. Maadaama xoogagga isbahaysigu ay ku fidsan yihiin gobollo kala duwan oo dalka Itoobiya ah, waxay awood u leeyihiin inay isku waqti gobollo kala duwan ka furaan dagaal safmar ah oo daaliya awoodda dawladda. Inkasta oo marar kala duwan la arkay sheegashooyin dhahaya ulo-badantu waxay ku qalabaysan tahay daroon, misana lama xaqiijin karo oo waxaa hubaal ah in la’aantooda awoodda cirku ay ka dhigtay kuwo u nugul weerarrada cirka ee har iyo habeen ku socda. Guusha ugu weyn ee ay xoogagga mucaaradku ku taamayaan waa in ay isku dhereriyaan laamida dheer ee xiriirisa Maqalle illaa Addis Ababa, balse waxaa hanaqa gooyay duqaymaha daroonta oo ay dawladdu raaxada uga qaadday gulufyadii la soo tubay tubta dheer. Sidaa darteed, waxaa muuqata, dawladda Abiy oo haysata taageerada diblomaasiyadeed ee dawladihii kal hore ku qaybsanaa, oo lagu daray awoodda gaarka ah ee duqeymaha cirka, iyadoo adeegsanaysa diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones) oo lagu qalabeeyay farsamooyinka casriga ah in ay si fiican u banjarin karto niyadda isbahaysigan harjadaya iyo xulafooyinka taagtadaran ee dabada ka taagan. Meesha labaad ee ay rabshadaha jabhadahani ku fidi karaan waa jidka isku xira Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti oo ah halbowlaha dhaqaale ee dowladda Itoobiya. Muhiimaddiisa sarreysa ayaa jidkan mar walba ka dhigta mid ay adag tahay in mucaaradku gacanta ku dhigo. Sidaa awgeed, tabarta jabhaduhu waxay kusoo ururaysaa dagaal gorille iyo madax-adayg ay ugu dambaynta iyagu ku wiiqmaan. Ciidamada TPLF iyo kuwa Fano ayaa qaaday weeraro baahsan oo ay kula wareegeen garoomada diyaaradaha waaweyn ee Maqalle, Aksum, iyo Shire, iyadoo ay joogsadeen dhammaan duulimaadyadii gobolka. Dawladda federaalka ahina markiiba waxay bixisay jawaabo adag, iyada oo adeegsanaysa duqeymo dhanka cirka iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn oo lagu garaacay degaanno kala duwan oo Amxaarada iyo Tigree ku yaal. Judhii hore, jugta weerarrada qabsashada ahi waxay ka socotay degaanka Tigreega, iyo qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Amxaarada, mar dambe waxaynu aragnay in awoodda ulo-badantu ay si xooggan ugasoo foocantay dhanka Canfarta, kadib markii la arkay hal maalin oo isbahaysigu qabsaday saddex degmo oo Canfarta ka tirsan. Maalintaa warbaahinta badankeed waxay ka dhigaysay in isbahaysiga garbihiisa TPLF iyo Canfartu ay degaannadaa qabsadeen, balse xogaha rasmiga ahi waxay caddeeyeen in garabka Canfarta oo quraata ay dhulkaa qabsadeen. Arrintanina waxay muujinaysaa loollanka mar walba ka aloosan xuduudaha gudaha qowmiyadaha Itoobiya. Si kasta oo colaaddu ay uga hurayso furimo kala duwan, misana waxaa jirta in Abiy Axmad uu goostay in uu kala dhantaalo isbahaysigan ulo-badanta ah ee gudaha ka abuurmay. Sida ay xogaha qarsooni sheegayaan, Abiy Axmad wuxuu dadaal dheer ugu jiraa sidii uu u midayn lahaa awoodda Oromada, gaar ahaan madaxdoodii hore iyo xubnaha xagjirka ah mucaaradka ah ee isaga diiddan, si uu ugu qanciyo badbaadinta fursadda taariikhiga ah ee qowmiyaddiisu ku heshay hoggaaminta kursigii ay waa ku hamiyi jireen gaaristiisa. Si arrinkani u dhaqaaqo, xoguhu waxay sheegayaan in uu u habarwacday illaa shan ka mid ah madaxwaynayaashii Oromada oo qaarkood dibadjoog ahaa muddooyinkii dambe. Abiy, wuxuu madaxdaa ka dalbaday in ay gudaha soo galaan oo ay wadahadallo wax-ku-ool ah la galaan jabhadaha Oromada, iyo in ay la gorgortamaan oo ay ka keenaan waxa ay u baahan yihiin oo cad. Dhab ahaanshiyaha warkan waxaa la dareemay kolkii la arkay ulo-badanta garabkoodii Oromada oo ka gaabsaday dagaallada socda iyo furimihii ay ahayd in Abiy lagu furo. Sidoo kale, tan iyo maalintii isbahaysigan lagu dhawaaqay waxaan arkaynay in Jawar Maxamad uu dhankiisa ka dhimay culayskii badnaa ee uu muddaba ku hayn jiray xukuumadda Abiy Axmad. Sidoo kale, Abiy Axmad wuxuu haystaa Imaaraadka Carabta oo ka dhigtay saaxiib weyn oo Geeska Afrika u jooga. Markii uu xukunka yimidba qulqulatooyin dagaal baa ku furmay, dabadeed sarrifka suuqa madow ayaa cirka isku shareeray, maadaamaa dhaqaalihii dowladdu uu furimaha aadayo. Kadib Imaaraadku waxay Abiy siiyeen xirmo dhaqaale oo dhan 3 bilyan oo doollar (oo ay ku jirtay 1 bilyan oo si toos ah loogu shubay Bangiga Dhexe ee Itoobiya si loo xakameeyo dhibaatada sarrifka suuqa madow), halka 2-da bilyan ee kale ay aadday mashaariic waaweyn oo ka hirgalay degaanno kala duwan: sida mashaariicda tamarta qorraxda oo ay shirkadda Masdar ka hirgelisay Addis Ababa, degaanka Oromiya iyo kan Amxaarada; mashruuca jidka ganacsiga iyo sahayda saadka ee Waddada Berbera–Addis Ababa iyo dekedda qallalan ee Modjo oo ay maamusho shirkaddooda DP World; maalgashiga beero waaweyn oo ku yaalla degaannada Gambeellaha, Oromiya iyo Benishaangul-Gumuz; iyo dib-u-habaynta muuqaalka iyo goobaha dalxiiska ee magaalada Addis Ababa sida Unity Park, Friendship Park, iyo Entoto Park. Intaa oo keliya ma ahan ee Imaaraadku waxay si kalfuran Abiy dowladdiisa ugu qalabeeyeen diyaaradaha iswada ee duqeymaha cirka geysta, kuwaa oo sabab u ahaa guushii uu ka gaaray dagaalkii TPLF ee 2021-kii, oo ahaa fagaare uu ku waayay garabka dowlado badan oo Itoobiya ku saf ahaa. Guulaha waaweyn ee uu gaaray iyo garabka adag ee ay Imaaraadku u yihiin ayaa u horseeday in maanta ay xukuumaddiisu haysato garbihii diblomaasiyadda oo idil. Haddii shalay Maraykan ku saf ahaa TPLF, maanta waxaynu aragnaa in safiirka Maraykanku uu si cad ganafka ugu dhuftay hawlgalka isbahaysiga ulo-badan. Taa oo Abiy u saamaxaysa in uu si xarrago leh u muujiyo in isagu uu dowladnimo horumarsan u rabo dadkiisa, isbahaysiga ulo-badanna ay keliya xabbad iyo colaad wadaaminayaan oo aysan ku socon raad lagu gaari karo dhabbo dowladnimo. Dhinaca kale, safarkii uu Ra’iisal Wasaare Abiy Axmed bishan Sebteembar ku tagay Jabuuti, wuxuu salka ku hayey dhagax-dhigga mashruuca dhuumaha shidaalka ka qaadaya Jabuuti kadibna geynaya Itoobiya, oo ay ku baxayso lacag dhan $660 milyan oo doollar. Mashruucan oo dhulka dhex-maraya ayaa xulaya masaafo dhan 120 km, waxaana wadajir u fulinaya dowladda Itoobiya (iyada oo loo marayo Ethiopian Investment Holdings) iyo shirkadda Dangote Group ee uu leeyahay bilyaneerka reer Nayjeeriya ee Aliko Dangote. items.fullContent: Itoobiya, tan iyo 2015-kii waxay ku jirtay xiisado siyaasadeed iyo rabshado ciidan; qulqulatooyinka qowmiyaduhuna waxay ahaayeen kuwo xiriirsan oo marba heer joogay. Dagaalladu maalinba weji bay lahaayeen, maantana waxay maraysaa in TPLF iyo jabhado kale oo degaanno kala duwan ka jiray ay samaysteen isbahaysi ulo-badan ah oo ka dhan ah dawladda uu hoggaamiyo Abiy Axmad. Taa oo sawir cad ka bixinaysa sida uu u burburay heshiiskii Nabadda ee Pretoria (2022) oo u dhexeeyay Abiy iyo TPLF. Toddoba kooxood oo hubaysan iyo kuwo siyaasadeed oo ay ka mid yihiin TPLF, Fano, ONLF iyo OLA ayaa isla alkumay isbahaysi cusub oo loo bixiyay EPFAS. Waxay ku dhawaaqeen ujeeddo mid ah oo ah inay xukuumadda Abiy Axmed xilka ka tuuraan. Khubarada falanqaysa arrimaha Itoobiya iyo shabakadaha ka faallooda arrimaha gobolku, waxay tilmaameen in Ereteriya ay doorkan gadaal ka taagan tahay isbahaysigan cusub, iyadoo siinaysa taageero dhaqaale iyo sahay millateri oo ay ulo-badantu ku gaadho yoolkeeda weyn. Maadaama xoogagga isbahaysigu ay ku fidsan yihiin gobollo kala duwan oo dalka Itoobiya ah, waxay awood u leeyihiin inay isku waqti gobollo kala duwan ka furaan dagaal safmar ah oo daaliya awoodda dawladda. Inkasta oo marar kala duwan la arkay sheegashooyin dhahaya ulo-badantu waxay ku qalabaysan tahay daroon, misana lama xaqiijin karo oo waxaa hubaal ah in la’aantooda awoodda cirku ay ka dhigtay kuwo u nugul weerarrada cirka ee har iyo habeen ku socda. Guusha ugu weyn ee ay xoogagga mucaaradku ku taamayaan waa in ay isku dhereriyaan laamida dheer ee xiriirisa Maqalle illaa Addis Ababa, balse waxaa hanaqa gooyay duqaymaha daroonta oo ay dawladdu raaxada uga qaadday gulufyadii la soo tubay tubta dheer. Sidaa darteed, waxaa muuqata, dawladda Abiy oo haysata taageerada diblomaasiyadeed ee dawladihii kal hore ku qaybsanaa, oo lagu daray awoodda gaarka ah ee duqeymaha cirka, iyadoo adeegsanaysa diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones) oo lagu qalabeeyay farsamooyinka casriga ah in ay si fiican u banjarin karto niyadda isbahaysigan harjadaya iyo xulafooyinka taagtadaran ee dabada ka taagan. Meesha labaad ee ay rabshadaha jabhadahani ku fidi karaan waa jidka isku xira Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti oo ah halbowlaha dhaqaale ee dowladda Itoobiya. Muhiimaddiisa sarreysa ayaa jidkan mar walba ka dhigta mid ay adag tahay in mucaaradku gacanta ku dhigo. Sidaa awgeed, tabarta jabhaduhu waxay kusoo ururaysaa dagaal gorille iyo madax-adayg ay ugu dambaynta iyagu ku wiiqmaan. Ciidamada TPLF iyo kuwa Fano ayaa qaaday weeraro baahsan oo ay kula wareegeen garoomada diyaaradaha waaweyn ee Maqalle, Aksum, iyo Shire, iyadoo ay joogsadeen dhammaan duulimaadyadii gobolka. Dawladda federaalka ahina markiiba waxay bixisay jawaabo adag, iyada oo adeegsanaysa duqeymo dhanka cirka iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn oo lagu garaacay degaanno kala duwan oo Amxaarada iyo Tigree ku yaal. Judhii hore, jugta weerarrada qabsashada ahi waxay ka socotay degaanka Tigreega, iyo qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Amxaarada, mar dambe waxaynu aragnay in awoodda ulo-badantu ay si xooggan ugasoo foocantay dhanka Canfarta, kadib markii la arkay hal maalin oo isbahaysigu qabsaday saddex degmo oo Canfarta ka tirsan. Maalintaa warbaahinta badankeed waxay ka dhigaysay in isbahaysiga garbihiisa TPLF iyo Canfartu ay degaannadaa qabsadeen, balse xogaha rasmiga ahi waxay caddeeyeen in garabka Canfarta oo quraata ay dhulkaa qabsadeen. Arrintanina waxay muujinaysaa loollanka mar walba ka aloosan xuduudaha gudaha qowmiyadaha Itoobiya. Si kasta oo colaaddu ay uga hurayso furimo kala duwan, misana waxaa jirta in Abiy Axmad uu goostay in uu kala dhantaalo isbahaysigan ulo-badanta ah ee gudaha ka abuurmay. Sida ay xogaha qarsooni sheegayaan, Abiy Axmad wuxuu dadaal dheer ugu jiraa sidii uu u midayn lahaa awoodda Oromada, gaar ahaan madaxdoodii hore iyo xubnaha xagjirka ah mucaaradka ah ee isaga diiddan, si uu ugu qanciyo badbaadinta fursadda taariikhiga ah ee qowmiyaddiisu ku heshay hoggaaminta kursigii ay waa ku hamiyi jireen gaaristiisa. Si arrinkani u dhaqaaqo, xoguhu waxay sheegayaan in uu u habarwacday illaa shan ka mid ah madaxwaynayaashii Oromada oo qaarkood dibadjoog ahaa muddooyinkii dambe. Abiy, wuxuu madaxdaa ka dalbaday in ay gudaha soo galaan oo ay wadahadallo wax-ku-ool ah la galaan jabhadaha Oromada, iyo in ay la gorgortamaan oo ay ka keenaan waxa ay u baahan yihiin oo cad. Dhab ahaanshiyaha warkan waxaa la dareemay kolkii la arkay ulo-badanta garabkoodii Oromada oo ka gaabsaday dagaallada socda iyo furimihii ay ahayd in Abiy lagu furo. Haddii shalay Maraykan ku saf ahaa TPLF, maanta waxaynu aragnaa in safiirka Maraykanku uu si cad ganafka ugu dhuftay hawlgalka isbahaysiga ulo-badan. items.title: DEG-DEG: Sacuudi Carabiya oo diiday Codsiyo Israa’iil uga yimid oo ahaa in Diyaarado u soo diraan Rakaab Israa’iiliyiin ah
items.description: Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa diiday dhowr codsi oo Israa’iil ay u dirtay, kuwaas oo ahaa in diyaarado Israa’iili ah loo oggolaado inay dalkaas ka soo qaadaan rakaab Israa’iiliyiin ah oo saarnaa diyaarad Flydubai ah oo si degdeg ah ugu degtay Sacuudiga, sida uu AFP u sheegay ilo Sacuudi ah oo xog ogaal u ah arrinta. Diyaaradda ayaa ka soo duushay Dubai kuna socotay Tel Aviv, balse waxaa lagu qasbanaaday inay si degdeg ah ugu degto Tabuuk, kaddib markii kaaliyaha duuliyaha lagu eedeeyay inuu mindi ku weeraray duuliyaha, taasoo keentay in diyaaradda ay xaalad halis ah gasho. Rakaabkii ayaa farageliyay oo ka adkaaday kaaliyaha duuliyaha, waxaana diyaaradda si nabad ah loo dejiyay. Sida ay sheegeen ilo amni, Israa’iil waxay diyaarinaysay inay dirto diyaarado militari oo C-130 Hercules ah si ay rakaabka uga soo qaadaan Sacuudiga, balse Riyadh ayaa diiday codsigaas. Rakaabka ayaa ugu dambeyn lagu qaaday diyaarado kale oo Flydubai ah, si ay ugu sii gudbaan Israa’iil. Arrintan ayaa dhacday iyadoo Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Israa’iil aysan lahayn xiriir diblomaasiyadeed rasmi ah.

items.title: Mustafe Cagjar oo mar kale loo doortay Madaxweynaha Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida
items.description: Madaxweynaha Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida , Mustafe Maxamed Cumar (Cagjar) , ayaa mar kale loo doortay inuu hoggaamiyo deegaanka, taas oo u oggolaanaysa inuu sii wato xilka uu hayay tan iyo isbeddelkii siyaasadeed ee dhacay sannadkii 2018. Mustafe Cumar ayaa hoggaanka deegaanka yimid 22-kii Agoosto 2018 , kaddib isbeddel siyaasadeed oo ka dhacay Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida, ayadoo tan iyo xilligaas uu ahaa hoggaamiyaha ugu sarreeya ee maamulka deegaanka, isagoo muddo ku dhow siddeed sano hayay hoggaanka. Doorashadiisa cusub waxay ka dhigan tahay inuu sii wadi doono hoggaanka deegaanka xilli Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida ay ku jirto marxalad ay xoogga saarayso horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, maalgashiga, amniga iyo mashaariicda kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha. Sidoo kale, Ibraahin Cismaan Faarax ayaa mar kale loo doortay Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida. Xafiiska Madaxweynaha Deegaanka Soomaalida ayaa hadda si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay in Mustafe Maxamed Cumar uu yahay Madaxweynaha, halka Ibraahin Cismaan uu yahay Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka. Mustafe Cumar ayaa hoggaanka deegaanka ku soo jiray tan iyo 2018, waxaana warbixinno hore lagu xusay in muddadiisa ay deegaanka ka dhacayeen mashaariic horumarineed iyo maalgashi, iyadoo weli ay jiraan caqabado la xiriira abaaraha, kaabayaasha iyo adeegyada bulshada. dib-u-doorashada Mustafe Cumar ayaa ka dhigaysa mid kamid ah madaxweyneyaashii ugu waqtiga dheeraa deegaanka, halka Ibraahin Cismaan Faarax uu sii wadanayo xilka Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka.

items.title: Loolanka Doorashada Mareykanka oo saameyn ku yeeshay Xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Washington
items.description: Xiriirka u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka ayaa wajahaya caqabado cusub, iyadoo loolanka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan gudaha Mareykanka uu saameyn ku yeelanayo dadaallada Soomaaliya ee lagu xoojinayo xiriirka maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump. Warbixin ay 1-dii Oktoobar 2026 baahisay Africa Intelligence ayaa sheegtay in jawiga siyaasadeed ee Mareykanka uu sii adkaanayo xilli ay dalkaasi isu diyaarinayo doorashooyinka bartamaha xilliga ( midterm elections ). Warbixintu waxay tilmaamaysaa in kooxaha muxaafidka ah ee Mareykanka ay isku dayayaan inay fadeexad ballaaran oo la xiriirta leexinta ama si khaldan loo maareeyay dhaqaalaha gargaarka dadweynaha u adeegsadaan cadaadis siyaasadeed oo ka dhan ah xisbiga Dimuqraadiga. Xaaladdan siyaasadeed ee gudaha Mareykanka ayaa, sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, adkeynaysa dadaallada Muqdisho ay ku dooneyso inay xiriir wanaagsan la yeelato maamulka Trump. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa muddooyinkii dambe waday dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo iskaashiga diblomaasiyadeed. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, isbeddellada siyaasadeed ee Washington ayaa noqday arrin saameyn ku yeelan karta sida maamulka Trump u wajahayo faylka Soomaaliya. Arrintan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay Mareykanka u aragto saaxiib muhiim ah oo dhinaca amniga ah, iyadoo Washington ay taageerto dadaallada dowladda Soomaaliya ee ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo kooxaha xiriirka la leh Al-Qaacida . Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale xustay in xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Washington uu ku dhex jiro arrimo siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed oo ballaaran, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan xaaladda amniga Soomaaliya, siyaasadda gudaha, iyo xiriirka Soomaaliya ay la leedahay dhinacyada gobolka iyo beesha caalamka. Dhanka kale, xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale soo jiitay dareenka saaxiibbada caalamiga ah, iyadoo dowladda federaalka ay wajahday cadaadisyo siyaasadeed oo gudaha ah iyo walaacyo la xiriira mustaqbalka hannaanka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Xariirka Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka wuxuu hadda ku jiraa marxalad ay si weyn u saameyn karaan siyaasadda gudaha Mareykanka, doorashooyinka 2026 iyo mudnaanta amni iyo diblomaasiyadeed ee maamulka Trump . Warbixinta Africa Intelligence ayaa muujinaysa in dadaallada Muqdisho ee ku aaddan hagaajinta xiriirka Washington aysan si fudud u soconayn, iyadoo siyaasadda gudaha Mareykanka ay noqotay caqabad dheeraad ah.

Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa muddooyinkii dambe waday dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo iskaashiga diblomaasiyadeed. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, isbeddellada siyaasadeed ee Washington ayaa noqday arrin saameyn ku yeelan karta sida maamulka Trump u wajahayo faylka Soomaaliya. Arrintan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay Mareykanka u aragto saaxiib muhiim ah oo dhinaca amniga ah, iyadoo Washington ay taageerto dadaallada dowladda Soomaaliya ee ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo kooxaha xiriirka la leh Al-Qaacida . Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale xustay in xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Washington uu ku dhex jiro arrimo siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed oo ballaaran, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan xaaladda amniga Soomaaliya, siyaasadda gudaha, iyo xiriirka Soomaaliya ay la leedahay dhinacyada gobolka iyo beesha caalamka. Dhanka kale, xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale soo jiitay dareenka saaxiibbada caalamiga ah, iyadoo dowladda federaalka ay wajahday cadaadisyo siyaasadeed oo gudaha ah iyo walaacyo la xiriira mustaqbalka hannaanka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Xariirka Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka wuxuu hadda ku jiraa marxalad ay si weyn u saameyn karaan siyaasadda gudaha Mareykanka, doorashooyinka 2026 iyo mudnaanta amni iyo diblomaasiyadeed ee maamulka Trump . Warbixinta Africa Intelligence ayaa muujinaysa in dadaallada Muqdisho ee ku aaddan hagaajinta xiriirka Washington aysan si fudud u soconayn, iyadoo siyaasadda gudaha Mareykanka ay noqotay caqabad dheeraad ah.

items.title: Itoobiya oo qorshaynaysa inay Soomaaliya kala Baxdo kumannaan Askari
items.description: Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa qorshaynaysa inay Soomaaliya kala baxdo in ka badan 3,000 askari , iyadoo warbixin ay baahisay Bloomberg sheegtay in Addis Ababa ay doonayso inay dib ugu celiso ciidamadeeda dalka, si ay uga qeyb qaataan dagaallada sii xoogeysanaya ee ka dhanka ah kooxaha fallaagada ah ee gudaha Itoobiya. Sida ay Bloomberg ku warrantay, ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegay in ciidamadan ay bilaabi karaan ka bixitaanka Soomaaliya maalmaha ama toddobaadyada soo socda. Ilo-wareedyada ayaa codsaday inaan magacyadooda la shaacin, maadaama aysan awood u lahayn inay warbaahinta kala hadlaan arrintan. Qorshahan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladda Itoobiya ay wajahday dagaallo sii xoogeysanaya oo gudaha dalka ah, gaar ahaan iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay la tacaalayaan kooxo hubeysan oo fallaago ah. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, xaaladda gudaha Itoobiya ayaa keentay in dowladda Addis Ababa ay dib u eegto halka ay u adeegsanayso ciidamadeeda iyo kheyraadkeeda milatari. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, weli si cad looma xaqiijin tirada ciidamada Itoobiya ee Soomaaliya ka bixi doona iyo in dhammaan ciidamadan ay ka tirsan yihiin Howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM , ama ay ku jiraan ciidamo Itoobiyaan ah oo Soomaaliya ku jooga heshiisyo amni oo laba geesood ah. Dhanka Soomaaliya, warbixintu waxay tilmaamaysaa in dowladda federaalka aysan weli helin ogeysiis rasmi ah oo ku saabsan qorshaha Itoobiya ee ciidamadeeda looga saarayo dalka, dowladda Itoobiya sidoo kale weli si rasmi ah ugama aysan hadlin warbixinta Bloomberg. Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer ka mid ahayd dalalka ciidamo ku leh Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ahaa dadaallada amniga iyo dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab. Haddii qorshaha cusub la hirgeliyo, bixitaanka kumannaan askari ayaa saameyn ku yeelan kara qaabka ay ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo kuwa caalamiga ah u maareeyaan ammaanka deegaanada ay ciidamada Itoobiya ka howlgalaan. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale xustay in Itoobiya ay horey u soo wajahday xaalad la mid ah sanadkii 2020 , xilligaas oo dagaalkii Tigray uu billowday, iyadoo ciidamo Itoobiyaan ah oo ku sugnaa Soomaaliya dib loogu celiyay Itoobiya si looga qeybgeliyo dagaalka gudaha dalka.

items.title: Duulimaadyo u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Muqdisho oo Maanta baaqday kadib Shuruudda Kaarka Aqoonsiga NIRA
items.description: Duulimaadyadii gudaha ee u kala gooshi jiray Puntland iyo Muqdisho ayaa saaka baaqday, kadib markii la sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay soo rogtay shuruud ah in rakaabka gudaha dalka u kala safraya ay haystaan Kaarka Aqoonsiga Qaranka ee ay bixiso Hay’adda Aqoonsiga iyo Diiwaangelinta Qaranka (NIRA). Wararka ka imaanaya Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Garoowe ayaa sheegaya in rakaabkii saaka la qorsheeyay inay raacaan Freedom Airlines, oo duulimaadkeedu ahaa Garoowe–Muqdisho–Nairobi, ay dib uga soo laabteen garoonka kadib markii ay soo baxday in looga baahan yahay kaarka aqoonsiga NIRA. Dadka rakaabka ah ayaa sheegay in arrintu caqabad ku noqotay safarkooda, maadaama Puntland aysan ka jirin xafiisyo ay NIRA ka qaadato kaarka aqoonsiga. Qaar ka mid ah dadka saaka safarkoodu baaqday ayaa la sheegay inay Muqdisho iyo Nairobi ugu safrayeen arrimo shaqo, halka kuwo kalena ay u socdeen adeegyo caafimaad. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale dhalisay walaac ku saabsan saameynta ay shuruudda cusub ku yeelan karto isu-socodka gudaha dalka, gaar ahaan dadka u kala safra gobollada iyo magaalooyinka aan weli si buuxda looga hirgelin adeegyada NIRA. Ilaa hadda Puntland kama aysan soo saarin war rasmi ah oo ku saabsan arrintan, halka shirkadda Freedom Airlines aanay si cad ugu wargelin dhammaan rakaabkeeda baaqashada ama isbeddelka ku yimid duulimaadkii saaka.

items.title: Modi oo Bogaadiyay Kabtan Smit Machchhar
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Hindiya Narendra Modi ayaa si weyn u ammaanay Kabtan Smit Machchhar, kaddib dhacdadii halista ahayd ee ku dhacday duulimaadka Flydubai FZ1073, kaas oo 30-kii Sebteembar ka ambabaxay Dubai kuna socday garoonka Ben Gurion ee Tel Aviv. Flydubai waxay xaqiijisay in diyaaradda ay dhacdo kala kulantay iyadoo hawada ku jirta, balse ay si nabad ah ugu degtay garoonka Tabuk ee Sacuudi Carabiya, dhammaan rakaabka iyo shaqaaluhuna ay badqabaan.Sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiinta Israel, iska horimaad ayaa ka dhacay gudaha qolkii duuliyayaasha, waxaana la sheegay in duuliyihii labaad uu weeraray Machchhar. Ra’iisul Wasaare Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in weerarku sababay in diyaaradda ay si khatar ah hoos ugu dhacdo, iyadoo xaaladdu u muuqatay inay horseedi karto masiibo weyn. Machchhar, oo dhaawacmay, ayaa sida lagu sheegay warbixinnada kala duwan awooday inuu furo albaabka qolkii duuliyayaasha. Taasi waxay siisay rakaab iyo shaqaale fursad ay gudaha ugu galaan, uga hortagaan weerarka, isla markaana gacan uga geystaan xasilinta xaaladda diyaaradda. Duuliyayaal kale oo diyaaradda saarnaa ayaa sidoo kale ka qayb qaatay sidii diyaaradda loo xakameyn lahaa.Diyaaradda ayaa ugu dambeyn si nabad ah ugu degtay Tabuk, halkaas oo rakaabka iyo shaqaalaha lagu badbaadiyay. Flydubai ayaa sheegtay in kooxaheedu ay la shaqeynayaan hay’adaha ay khusayso, iyadoo baaritaanku socdo. Modi ayaa Machchhar ku tilmaamay geesi, isagoo sheegay in inkastoo uu si daran u dhaawacmay uu muujiyay geesinimo iyo go’aan adag oo uu ku ilaalinayay nolosha dadka kale. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Hindiya ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ficillada duuliyaha ay gacan ka geysteen badbaadinta dad badan iyo ka hortagga musiibo weyn.Netanyahu isna wuxuu si gaar ah u ammaanay Machchhar iyo rakaabkii iyo shaqaalihii ka qayb qaatay xakamaynta xaaladda. Hadalladiisa rasmiga ah wuxuu ku sheegay in dadkii ku lug lahaa gurmadka ay muujiyeen geesinimo iyo karti degdeg ah, isla markaana diyaaradda si nabad ah loogu dejiyay Tabuk. Warbixinno kale ayaa tilmaamaya in mid ka mid ah rakaabka Israel, Yaniv Hayoun, uu ka mid ahaa dadka galay qolkii duuliyayaasha xilli xaaladdu cakirnayd. Doorkiisa ayaa sidoo kale si weyn loogu ammaanay inuu gacan ka geystay joojinta weerarka iyo xasilinta diyaaradda. Dhacdada ayaa dhalisay baaritaan ku saabsan waxa sababay iska horimaadka iyo ujeeddada duuliyihii lagu eedeeyay weerarka. Ilaa hadda, sababta saxda ah ee weerarka iyo haddii uu jiray qorshe ka baxsan falka gudaha diyaaradda si buuxda looma xaqiijin. Flydubai waxay sheegtay inay la shaqaynayso hay’adaha ay khusayso inta baaritaanku socdo.Dhacdadan ayaa sidoo kale muujisay muhiimadda ay leedahay go’aan qaadashada degdegga ah marka xaalad halis ah ay ka dhacdo diyaaradda. Si kastaba, in dhacdadan si rasmi ah loogu tilmaamo isku day argagixiso ama weerar qorshaysan waxay u baahan tahay natiijada baaritaanka socda. The post Modi oo Bogaadiyay Kabtan Smit Machchhar first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Pakistan oo duqeymo ka fuliyay Afghanistan, iyadoo Kabul ay sheegtay dhimashada Haween iyo Carruur
items.description: Pakistan ayaa duqeymo cirka ah ka fuliyay gudaha Afghanistan, iyadoo Islamabad ay sheegtay in weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsaday xeryo iyo goobo ay ku dhuumanayeen kooxo hubeysan, isla markaana lagu dilay 22 dagaalyahan . Duqeymaha ayaa dhacay habeenkii Arbacada, waxaana Pakistan ay sheegtay in bartilmaameedyadu la xiriireen kooxaha hubeysan ee ay ku eedeyso inay weerarro ka geystaan gudaha Pakistan. Dhanka kale, dowladda Afghanistan ayaa sheegtay in duqeymaha ka dhacay gobollada Kunar iyo Helmand ay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 9 qof oo ay ku jiraan haween iyo carruur , halka 11 qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen. Afhayeenka dowladda Afghanistan, Zabihullah Mujahid , ayaa sheegay in saddex guri ay ku burbureen weerarrada, isagoo si adag u cambaareeyay duqeymaha. Pakistan ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay Afghanistan ku eedeynaysay inay dhulkeeda u oggolaanayso kooxo hubeysan, gaar ahaan Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) , inay halkaas ka abaabulaan weerarro ka dhan ah Pakistan. Dowladda Afghanistan ayaa eedeymahaas diidday, waxayna Islamabad ku eedeysay inay duqeymo ka fuliso gudaha Afghanistan, kuwaas oo ay sheegtay inay waxyeello u geystaan dadka rayidka ah. Xiisadda u dhaxaysa labada dal ayaa mar kale sare u kacday kadib muddo ku dhow saddex bilood oo xaaladdu ahayd mid deggan, ayadoo Labada dhinac ay weli si kala duwan uga warbixinaya cidda la beegsaday iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay duqeymaha.

items.title: Sidee u dhacay weerarkii diyaaradda u socotay Israel?
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Diyaarad ay leedahay shirkadda FlyDubai oo ku sii jeedday magaalada Tel Aviv ayaa Arbacadii si degdeg ah ugu degtay waqooyiga Sacuudi Carabiya, kadib markii mid ka mid ah duuliyeyaasha lagu eedeeyey inuu mindi ku weeraray duuliyihii kale, xilli diyaaradda ay si lama filaan ah kumannaan feet hoos ugu dhacday. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in mid ka mid ah duuliyeyaasha diyaaradda FZ1073 uu weeraray duuliyihii kale, isla markaana uu u muuqday inuu isku dayay inuu diyaaradda burburiyo. Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in rakaab iyo xubno ka tirsan shaqaalaha diyaaradda ay gudaha u galeen qolka duuliyeyaasha, ayna xakameeyeen duuliyaha weerarka geystay. Duuliyeyaal kale oo FlyDubai ah oo diyaaradda saarnaa balse aan waqtigaas shaqada ku jirin ayaa kadib la wareegay hagisteeda, iyagoo ugu dambeyn si nabad ah uga dejiyey Tabuk. Hase yeeshee, weli si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin in ujeeddada duuliyaha la tuhunsan yahay ay ahayd inuu diyaaradda rido, mana cadda waxa sababay weerarka. FlyDubai ayaa sheegtay in sababta iyo ujeeddada dhacdada ay weli baaritaan ku jiraan, iyadoo ka digtay in laga hordhaco natiijada baaritaanka. Diyaaradda oo nooca Boeing 737 Max 8 ah ayaa ka soo duushay Dubai, waxayna ku sii jeedday Tel Aviv markii ay dhibaatadu ka dhacday hawada Sacuudi Carabiya, meel ku dhow xadka Jordan. Xogta adeegga dabagalka duulimaadyada ee FlightRadar24 ayaa muujisay in diyaaraddu ay ku socotay joog dhan 34,000 feet markii ay si xooggan hoos ugu dhacday. Diyaaraddu waxay lumisay in ka badan 14,000 feet muddo ku dhow 30 ilbiriqsi, kahor inta aysan dib u kicin, haddana mar kale hoos u dhicin, sida lagu sheegay xogta duulimaadka. Rakaabkii saarnaa ayaa sheegay in xaalad cabsi iyo jahwareer leh ay ka dhalatay gudaha diyaaradda, iyadoo dad badan ay markii hore u maleeyeen inay diyaaradda dhaceyso. Rakaab iyo shaqaale farageliyey Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo kasoo baxday dhacdada ayaa muujisay in duuliyaha la weeraray uu door muhiim ah ka qaatay in dadka kale ay gudaha u galaan cockpit-ka. Duuliyaha, oo lagu magacaabo Smit Machchhar kana soo jeeda India, ayaa la sheegay inuu dhaawac culus qabay oo dhiig baxayay, balse isagoo dhulka cockpit-ka yaalla uu awooday inuu furo qufulka albaabka. Rakaab iyo shaqaale sugnaa bannaanka ayaa markaas gudaha galay, halkaas oo ay ku xakameeyeen co-pilot-ka lagu eedeeyey weerarka. Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in rakaab iyo xubin ka tirsan shaqaalaha ay xoog ku galeen qolka duuliyeyaasha, halkaas oo lagu qabtay ninka la tuhunsan yahay. Warbixinno laga helay rakaabka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dagaalka qolka duuliyeyaasha ka dhacay uu sababay dhaawacyo, ka hor inta aan xaaladda gacanta lagu dhigin. Asaf Rajuan, oo ka mid ahaa rakaabkii ka qeyb qaatay xakameynta duuliyaha, ayaa sheegay in rakaabku ay si degdeg ah uga falceliyeen markii ay ogaadeen khatarta ka jirta gudaha cockpit-ka. Rakaab kale oo lagu magacaabo Yaniv Hayun ayaa sidoo kale ka mid ahaa dadkii galay qolka duuliyeyaasha. Muuqaal lagu duubay gudaha diyaaradda oo ay warbaahinta caalamiga ah xaqiijisay ayaa muujiyey rag dhaawac ah oo dhiig ka muuqdo, iyadoo ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah uu xirnaa dharka duuliyeyaasha FlyDubai. Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in dhacdadu ay u muuqatay isku day fashilmay oo lagula wareegayey diyaaradda, balse mas’uuliyiinta wali ma aysan shaacin wax caddeyn ah oo muujinaysa sababta ama ujeeddada ka dambeysay falka. Laba mas’uul oo ka tirsan ammaanka Israel ayaa sheegay in baarayaasha ay eegayaan dhowr suurtagal, oo ay ku jirto in dhacdadu ahayd weerar lagu beegsanayey rakaabka Israel, balse baaritaankaasi wali ma gaarin gunaanad. Diyaaradda oo dirtay calaamadda afduubka Xogta FlightRadar24 ayaa sidoo kale muujisay in diyaaradda ay markii hore dirtay code-ka degdegga ah ee 7700 , oo loo isticmaalo xaaladaha degdegga ah. Wax yar kadib waxay u beddeshay 7500 , oo ah code caalami ah oo duuliyeyaashu isticmaalaan marka ay jirto faragelin sharci-darro ah ama afduub diyaaradeed. Diyaaraddu waxay muddo kooban gashay hawada Jordan, kahor inta aysan 180 darajo dib ugu leexan Sacuudi Carabiya oo ay u dhaqaaqin dhinaca Tabuk. Markii xaaladda cockpit-ka la xakameeyey, duuliyeyaal kale oo FlyDubai ah oo diyaaradda saarnaa ayaa la wareegay hagisteeda. Joogitaanka duuliyeyaashaas kale ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaaray in diyaaradda si nabad ah loo dejiyo kadib markii labada duuliye ee markii hore waday ay ku lug yeesheen iska horimaadka. Degitaan degdeg ah oo Tabuk ah Diyaaradda ayaa ugu dambeyn si nabad ah ugu degtay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Tabuk, waqooyi-galbeed Sacuudi Carabiya, saacaddu markay ahayd 9:45 subaxnimo waqtiga deegaanka. Garoonka Tabuk ayaa sheegay in captain-ka iyo co-pilot-ka loo qaaday isbitaal si loogu daweeyo dhaawacyada, inkastoo aan faahfaahin buuxda laga bixin xaaladdooda. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Imaaraadka Carabta, GCAA, ayaa dhacdada ku tilmaantay “dhacdo amni”, waxayna sheegtay in baaritaan lagu sameynayo dhinacyada amniga iyo hawlgalka duulimaadka. Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in diyaaradda ay saarnaayeen 174 qof, intooda badanna ay ahaayeen muwaadiniin Israeli ah. FlyDubai ayaa sheegtay in dhammaan rakaabka la xaqiijiyey inay badqabaan. Mas’uul Israeli ah ayaa sheegay in co-pilot-ka lagu eedeeyey weerarka uu yahay muwaadin u dhashay Cumaan, inkastoo mas’uuliyiinta Cumaan aysan weli arrintaas si rasmi ah uga hadlin. Netanyahu ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga ay gacanta ku dhigeen qofka lagu tuhunsan yahay weerarka. Shirkadda FlyDubai ayaa xaqiijisay in dhacdo amni ay ka dhacday duulimaadka, iyadoo sheegtay in shaqaalaheedu ay sugeen diyaaradda, isla markaana ay la shaqeynayaan hay’adaha ay khuseyso baaritaanka. Shirkaddu waxay diyaarisay diyaarado kale oo Tabuk ka soo qaaday rakaabka iyo shaqaalaha, kuwaas oo saacado kadib gaaray Tel Aviv. Sababta rasmiga ah ee dagaalka ka dhex qarxay labada duuliye, sida saxda ah ee diyaaradda ay sida xooggan ugu hoos dhacday iyo ujeeddada ninka la tuhunsan yahay ayaa dhammaantood weli qeyb ka ah baaritaanka. items.title: Waa Kuma Dr. Maxamed Aadan Sheekh?
items.description: Noloshii Dr. Maxamed Aadan Sheekh waxay isaga gudubtay qaybo waaweyn oo ka mid ah sooyaalka Soomaaliya ee qarnigii labaatanaad, si gaar ah noloshii reerguuraaga, middii gumaystaha iyo Maamulkii Wasaayada ee Talyaaniga, halgankii gobannimada, dhismihii dawladnimada ummadda Soomaaliyeed, xukunkii milatariga, kobocii waxbarashada sare, xariggii siyaasadeed iyo noloshii qurbaha. Wuxuu ahaa dhakhtar qalliin, siyaasi, qoraa, indheergarad iyo aqoonyahan ay taariikhnololeedkiisu si dhow ula falgalay isbedbeddeladii siyaasadeed iyo kuwii bulsheed ee dalku soo maray. Ilaha ka warramaya dhalashadiisa iskuma wada raacsana sannadka iyo goobta. Xusuusqorkiisa iyo qoraallo qoyskiisa laga soo xigtay waxay tilmaamayaan inuu sannadkii 1936 ku dhashay miyiga agagaarka Gaalkacyo, gobolka Mudug; halka diiwaanka Golaha Degaanka Torino uu dhalashadiisa ku qorayo 14kii Maarso 1935. Waxaase isku dhow ilaha ka warramaya in yaraantiisu ku soo martay bulsho xooladhaqato ah iyo waaqaca miyiga ee bartamaha dhulka Soomaaliyeed. Diiwaanka Torino, dhinaca kale, wuxuu geeridiisa si cad ugu qorayaa 1dii Oktoobar 2010. (Xigasho: Città di Torino ) Dr. Maxamed wuxuu ku dhex barbaaray bulsho geel iyo ari dhaqato ah. Sida uu xusuusqorkiisa kaga warramay, qoysku wuxuu ahaa reer hayaami jiray, noloshuna waxay ku wareegaysay xoolaha, daaqa, biyaha iyo geeddiga. Sidaas awgeed, waaya-aragnimadii ugu horraysay ee noloshiisu waxay ahayd mid si qoddo dheer ugu xirnayd dhaqankii miyiga iyo habnololeedkii xooladhaqatada. Carruurnimadiisii waxaa ka mid ahaa muddadii qoysku ku sugnaa Gallaaddi. Halkaas ayuu aabbihii kala qaybqaadan jiray waraabinta geela. Ceelasha Gallaaddi qaarkood waxay ahaayeen kuwo dhaadheer oo af dhuuban; carruurta oo jirkoodu yaraa awgeedna mararka qaarkood ayaa ceelka hoos loogu dejin jiray si ay biyaha uga soo dhaamiyaan. Hawshaas ayuu Maxamed Aadan yaraantiisii qayb ka ahaa. Aabbihii wuxuu kula dardaarmi jiray inuu hees-hawleedyada geela isku maaweeliyo marka uu ceelka dhaadhacayo. Muuqaalladaas miyiga, ceelka, geela iyo geeddigu waxay qayb ka noqdeen waaya-aragnimadiisa nololeed iyo xusuustii uu markii danbe dib ugu noqday qoraalladiisa. Hasayeeshee, qoysku wuxuu bilaabay inuu ka fekero nolol ka baxsan meertadii hayaanka. Aabbihii wuxuu go’aansaday in wiilkiisa waxbarasho loo raadiyo. Go’aankaasi wuxuu noqday barbilowga geeddisocod cusub: Maxamed Aadan wuxuu ka soo tallaabay noloshii geeljirnimada, wuxuuna u soo gudbay Muqdisho, magaalo uu markii danbe wax ku bartay, ka shaqeeyay, xilal sare ka qabtay, waxna ka qoray. Muqdisho waxaa lagu dejiyay qaraabo magaalada ku noolayd. Waxbarashadiisii hore waxaa ka mid ahaa dugsi ku yaallay Xamarjajab, oo xilligii maamulkii Ingiriiska lagu dhigan jiray maaddooyin ay ka mid ahaayeen af Carabiga, xisaabta iyo diinta. Muddo uu Dhagaxbuur joogayna wuxuu sii ambaqaaday barashada Qur’aanka iyo af Carabiga. Carruurnimadiisii iyo dhallinyaranimadiisii hore waxay sidaas ugu kala gooshayeen degaanno iyo maamullo kala duwan, xilli Geeska Afrika uu marayay kalaguur siyaasadeed oo weyn. Markii Maamulkii Wasaayada Talyaaniga ee Soomaaliya (AFIS) la bilaabay 1950, waxbarashadiisu waxay gashay weji kale. Wuxuu bilaabay barashada af Talyaaniga, dabadeedna wuxuu isku darsaday waxbarasho iyo tababarro kala duwan. Hamuunta waxbarasho ee ka muuqatay sannadahaas waxay markii danbe isu beddeshay barasho madaxbannaan, aqoonkororsi iyo ku xeeldheeraan aan ku koobnayn caafimaadka oo keliya. Ka hor intii uusan dibadda u bixin wuxuu soo maray macallinnimo. Imtixaan uu galay kaddib waxaa loo diray Buurhakaba, halkaas oo uu ka dhigi jiray af Carabiga, xisaabta iyo juqraafiga. Isla muddadaas ayuu ku lugyeeshay hawlihii Ururkii Dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed (SYL). Sidaas ayay waxbarashada, shaqada iyo dareenka siyaasadeedba goor hore ugu kulmeen taariikhnololeedkiisa. Sannadkii 1958 ayuu Talyaaniga u aaday waxbarasho sare. Wuxuu caafimaadka ku bartay Rooma, qalliinkana wuxuu ku takhasusay Bologna. Treccani waxay ku tilmaamaysaa dhakhtar qalliin oo Talyaaniga ku soo tababartay, isla markaana markii dambe door weyn ku yeeshay iskaashigii jaamacadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Talyaaniga. Sidaas ayuu uga mid noqday jiilkii hore ee dhakhaatiirta Soomaaliyeed ee waxbarashada jaamacadeed iyo takhasuska caafimaad dibadda ku soo qaata. Waxbarashadiisu, hasayeeshee, caafimaadka kuma koobnayn. Siyaasadda, falsafadda, sharciga iyo arrimaha bulshada ayuu si joogto ah u daalacan jiray. Magtabadaha iyo goobaha cilmibaaristu waxay u ahaayeen meelo aqoonkororsi iyo garaadkobcin joogto ah. Markii uu Soomaaliya ku soo noqday wuxuu ku shaqeeyay xirfaddiisa caafimaad, isaga oo qalliinno ka samayn jiray Muqdisho xilli dhakhaatiirta Soomaaliyeed ay tiro koobnaayeen. Dhanka kale, qoraalka iyo doodaha aqooneed ayuu sii waday. Sidaas ayay xirfadda caafimaadka, siyaasadda iyo dhaqanka aqooneed ugu wada kulmeen hal qof. Galiddiisii Siyaasadda Kaddib afgenbigii askarta ee 21kii Oktoobar 1969, Dr. Maxamed Aadan Sheekh wuxuu galay safka hore ee maamulka cusub, isaga oo loo dhiibay xilka caafimaadka. Intii uu xilalka dawladda hayay wuxuu ka mid noqday aqoonyahannadii rayidka ahaa ee lagu daray hoggaankii cusbaa. Mid ka mid ah meelaha uu kaalingalkiisa raad weyn ku reebay waxay ahayd waxbarashada sare. Iskaashigii Dr. Maxamed Aadan Sheekh iyo qalliinsameeyihii Talyaaniga ahaa Paride Stefanini ayaa Treccani ku tilmaamaysaa barbilowgii mashruuca Jaamacadda Muqdisho ee 1972. Iskaashigaasi wuxuu horseeday barnaamij Soomaali iyo Talyaani ah oo lagu kobcinayay kulliyadaha sayniska iyo caafimaadka, laguna diyaarinayay aqoonyahanno iyo macallimiin Soomaaliyeed. Dr. Maxamed wuxuu dabadeed xil ka qabtay Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare, isaga oo ka qaybqaatay horumarinta waxbarashada, dhaqanka iyo hay’adaha aqoonta. Wuxuu, sidoo kale, ka mid ahaa masuuliyiintii xilligii hirgelinta rasmiga ah ee farta Soomaaliga. Kaalintaas marka la lafagurayo, waxaa muhiim ah in go’aankii farta aan qof keliya loo nisbayn. Dhabtii, go’aankaasi, wuxuu ahaa dadaal ay ka wada qaybqaateen afyahanno, aqoonyahanno, guddiyo farsamo iyo hoggaankii dawladda. Sannadkii 1975 ayuu galay xariggiisii siyaasadeed ee ugu horreeyay. Qoraallada qoyskiisa laga soo xigtay waxay sheegayaan in markii danbe la sii daayay oo uu dib ugu noqday hawlihii siyaasadda. Markii uu soo baxay wuxuu qayb ka noqday hawlihii la xiriiray Xisbiga Hantiwadaagga Kacaanka Soomaaliyeed. Wuxuu ka shaqeeyay arrimaha ideolojiyadda iyo qoraalka, wuxuuna guddoomiye ka noqday guddiga tifaftirka ee wargeyska  Halgan . Shaqadaas waxay ku lug lahayd qoraal, micnayn, warbixinno iyo faaqidaadda afkaarta siyaasadeed ee Xisbiga Hantiwadaagga Kacaanka Soomaaliyeed (XHKS). Dr. Maxamed wuxuu sidoo kale door ku lahaa jawigii Daraasaadka Soomaaliyeed ee xilligaas kobcayay. Halkan waxaa muhiim ah in taariikhda si kala cad loo dhigo: Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Daraasaadka Soomaaliyeed, Somali Studies International Association (SSIA), waxaa si rasmi ah Chicago looga yagleelay 1978, Barafasoor Xuseen-Tansaaniya Maxamed Aadanna wuxuu ka mid ahaa garwadeennadii ugu muhiimsanaa. Dr. Maxamed Aadan Sheekh waxaa lagu xusuusan karaa kaalingalkiisii jawiga aqooneed iyo dhiirrigelinta doodaha ku saabsan Soomaaliya, balse aasaaska SSIA si gaar ah isaga looma nisbayn karo. (Xigasho:  events.snu.edu.so ) Xariggii 1982 iyo Xabsigii Labaatanjirow Wejigii ugu adkaa taariikhnololeedkiisa siyaasadeed wuxuu billowday 9kii Juun 1982, markii isaga iyo lix xubnood oo kale oo baarlamaanka iyo hoggaanka siyaasadda ka tirsanaa la xiray.
