items.title: 20–28ka Sibteenbar: Toddobaadkii Madoobaa ee Saxaafadda Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Marka dib loo eego dhacdooyinkii isdabajoogga ahaa ee dhacay intii u dhexaysay 20kii illaa 28kii Sibteenbar 2012kii, waxaa cad in xeeladda kooxda argaggixisada ah ee al-Shabaab (AS) ay dhaafsiisnayd dilka wariyayaashii xaqa tebintiisa ku dhiirraday ee baaddilkii argaggaxisada ganafka ku dhuftay. Ujeedda AS ayaa ahayd in ay wiiqaan oo ay aamusiiyaan dareenka iyo dhiirranaanta bulshada inteeda kale. Si aan u fahanno culayska iyo doogta maskaxeed ee kooxda argaggixisada ah ee AS ku reebtay saxaafadda, waa inaan si dhow u milicsannaa dhacdooyinkii isxigxigay ee bilowday 20kii Sibteenbar 2012kii. Maalintaas, laba naftood-halige ah oo walxaha qarxa isku soo xiray ayaa si qorshaysan isku qarxiyay maqaayadda Baar Village oo ku dhowayd guriga Hooyooyinka. Goobtani keliya ma ahayn maqaayad cunto, waxayse xilligaas wariyayaasha u ahayd barkulanka ugu weyn ee ay ku sheekaystaan, iskuguna xogwaraystaan waayaha dalka. Weerarkaas arxandarrada lahaa waxaa ku dhimatay ugu yaraan 15 qof, oo ay ku jireen saddex suxufi oo miisaan ku lahaa dalka. Kuwaas oo ay ka mid ahaayeen Cabdisataar Daahir Sabriye oo ka tirsanaa hawlwadeennada Telefishinka Qaranka, Liibaan Cali Nuur oo ka shaqaynayay Raadiyow Muqdisho, iyo Cabdiraxmaan Yaasiin oo ka tirsanaa warbaahinta qaranka. Gumaadka ka dhacay goobtaas wuxuu xanbaarsanaa farriin xeeladeed oo ah in gebi ahaanba albaabbada loo laabo barkulankii ay wariyayaashu isku xogwaraysan jireen, aragtiyahana ku wadaagi jireen, isla markaasna lagu dhowri jiray xorriyadda ra’yiga iyo fekerka madaxbannaan. Haddaba, xeeladda liidata ee cabsigelinta ee kooxda argaggixisadu kuma ekayn qarax meel qura ka dhacay, waxayse wajigeedu soo ifbaxay maalin kaddib. 21kii Sibteenbar 2012, wax ka yar 24 saac kaddib dilkii saddexdii suxufi ee Baar Village, waxaa magaalada Muqdisho lagu dilay Xasan Yuusuf Absuge, oo ahaa soosaare dhiirran oo ka tirsanaa Radio Maanta. Falalkan wada anfariirka leh ee muddada yar gudaheed ku dhacay, waxay muujiyeen xeelad loogu talagalay in lagu abuuro xaalad argaggax oo baqdin-u-joog ah. Marka uu suxufi kasta oo magaalada jooga ogaado in saaxiibbadiis lagu laayay qarax, isla markaasna kii subaxaas ka hadlay idaacaddana isla habeenkiiba la toogtay, waxaa su’aal gashay dareenkii dhiirranaanta iyo runsheegidda. Haddii ay suxufiyiintu markii hore taxaddar dheeraad ah yeelan jireen marka ay furimaha dagaalka joogaan, maalmahaas waxay ku baraarujiyeen in khatartu aysan ku ekayn goobaha colaadda. Waxay garwaaqsadeen in markan dagaalku u soo guuray xafiisyadii shaqada, goobihii shaaha lagu cabayay, iyo luuq kasta oo ay maraan, iyagoo si cad u fahmay inay yihiin bartilmaameed toos ah oo la ugaarsanayo. Waxyeelladii ka dhalatay weerarradan kuma ekayn keliya dhimashada weriyayaasha, sidoo kale waxay raad weyn ku reebtay guud ahaan madaxbannaanidii iyo tayadii wararka ee dalka. Warbixin rasmi ah oo uu soo saaray ururka National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ) 23kii Sibteenbar 2012, oo xilligaas cinwaan looga dhigay “Impunity: War on Somalia’s Journalists” , ayaa lagu caddeeyey in beegsigan baaxadda leh uu suxufiyiinta geliyay xaalad adag oo cabsi ah. Cabsidani waxay ku khasabtay in wariyeyaal badani ay doortaan badbaadada naftooda, halkii ay runta tebin lahaayeen, iyadoo qaar kalena ay shaqada gebi ahaanba isaga baxeen. Dhinaca kale, hay’adda Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ) ayaa warbixin ay soo saartay 1dii Oktoobar 2012 ku dhawaaqday in sannadkaas uu yahay kii ugu dhiigga badnaa ee soo maray saxaafadda Soomaaliya, taas oo raad caafimaaddarro ku reebtay xaaladda maskaxeed ee weriyayaasha. Marka ay kooxuhu awood u yeeshaan inay cabsi ku beeraan qofka wararka soo tebiya, waxaa meesha ka baxa kalsoonidii iyo dhiirranaantii lagu sheegi lahaa xaqiiqada jirta. Haddaba, weerarkii maqaayadda Baar Village haddii uu argaggax ku abuuray wariyeyaasha tebiya siyaasadda iyo warbixinnada amniga ee dalka, dhacdooyinkii xigay ee dhacay dhammaadkii bishii Sibteenbar ee isla sannadkaas 2012kii waxay muujiyeen in qorshaha argaggixisada AS uu yahay mid lagu tirtirayo qof kasta oo magaca suxufi sita ama cid kasta oo bulshada u hawlgasha, codna u noqota. Kooxdu waxay billowday inay ugaarsato xataa dhallinyarada ka shaqaynayay qaybaha madaddaallada, ciyaaraha, iyo tebinta wararka caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo isu haystay inay ka fog yihiin loollanka hubaysan iyo kan siyaasadeed ee dalka ka jira. 27kii Sibteenbar 2012, degmada Heliwaa ee magaalada Muqdisho waxaa lagu dilay Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cali. Cabdiraxmaan wuxuu ahaa qoraa iyo weriye firfircoon oo maalin kasta bulshada u tebin jiray wararka ciyaaraha ee shabakadda Ciyaaraha Maanta. Dilka weriyahan wuxuu meesha ka saaray aragtidii ahayd, ‘haddii aadan siyaasadda tebin, dhib kuuma imaanayo’. Maalin kaddib dilkii Cabdiraxmaan, oo ku beegnayd 28kii Sibteenbar 2012, waxaa gudaha caasimadda lagu dilay Axmed Cabdullaahi Faarax, oo ahaa weriye iyo sawirqaade u shaqaynayay wakaaladda wararka rasmiga ah ee dalka Yemen ee SABA. Dilalka isdabajoogga ahaa ee Cabdiraxmaan iyo Axmed waxay soo xireen siddeed maalmood oo gumaad ah, iyadoo muddadaas gudaheed magaalada Muqdisho lagu dilay lix suxufi. Arrintani waxay bishii Sibteenbar ee sannadkii 2012kii ka dhigtay bishii ugu dhiigga badnayd ee soo martay taariikhda saxaafadda Soomaaliya. Ururka caalamiga ah ee Reporters Without Borders (RSF) ayaa warbixin rasmi ah oo uu soo saaray 19kii Diseenbar 2012, cinwaan looga dhigay “War on Somalia’s Journalists” , bishaas Sibteenbarna u aqoonsaday bishii ugu dhiigga badnayd ee sooyaalka saxaafadda Soomaaliya. Maanta oo laga joogo 14 sano, diiwaanka caalamiga ah ee ay ururiyaan hay’adaha u ololeeya xuquuqda wariyayaasha ayaan lagu arkin bil ka danbaysay oo ay ku dhimatay tiro intaas la eg oo suxufiyiin ah, taas oo ka dhigan in toddobaadkan iyo bishan ay weli ku suntanyihiin masiibadii ugu xumayd ee soo marta warbaahinta dalka. Xeeladdan cadowgu adeegsanayay oo ah “codka shacabka aammusi”, ma noqon mid ku kooban Sibteenbar 2012kii oo keliya, waxayse dib u soo laabatay afar sano kaddib. 27kii Sibteenbar 2016, dabley hubaysan oo mooto watay ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku dhex dilay Cabdicasiis Cali Xaaji, oo ahaa weriye caan ah oo ka tirsanaa idaacadda madaxbannaan ee Radio Shabelle. Toogashada Cabdicasiis waxay ahayd farriin kale oo muujinaysa in bisha Sibteenbar ay noqotay bil xusuus xun u ah saxaafadda, isaga oo noqday weriyihii 13aad ee idaacaddaas laga dilo tan iyo sannadkii 2007dii. Raadka dilalkan isxigxigay ee silsiladda ahaa wuxuu keenay in hay’adaha xuquuqda aadanaha iyo amniga saxaafadda ay qayladhaan ka soo saaraan xaaladda dalka. Warbixin gaar ah oo ay soo saartay hay’adda Amnesty International 24kii Sibteenbar 2012kii, oo cinwaan looga dhigay “Somalia: Human rights priorities for the new Somali government” , ayaa si dadban ugu bidhaamisay nuxurka murtida ah ‘Waysha gowrac, dibigu ha ku quustee’. Hay’adda ayaa warbixinteeda ku sheegtay in beegsiga suxufiyiinta ka shaqeeya arrimaha bulshada ee aan ku jirin loollanka siyaasadda, sida wariyayaasha ciyaaraha, loogu talagalay in lagu argaggaxiyo suxufiyiinta kale oo dhan, si qof kasta u dareemo inuusan badbaado lahayn meel kasta oo uu joogo. Sidoo kale, ururka Reporters Without Borders (RSF) ayaa warbixintoodii sannadlaha ahayd ee soo baxday 19kii Diseenbar 2012kii ku caddeeyay in Soomaaliya ay tahay dalka labaad ee caalamka ugu khatarta badan suxufiyiinta, iyadoo silsiladdan dhacdooyinka Sibteenbar loo soo qaatay marag cad oo muujinaya in cadowgu uusan wax kala sooc ah u samaynayn cid kasta oo bulshada cod u noqota, iyadoo makarafoon ama qalin adeegsanaysa. Gunaanadkii, toddobaadkii madoobaa ee bishii Sibteenbar 2012kii wuxuu cashar iyo cibra u noqday bahda saxaafadda, iyada oo ay ka dhasheen isbeddello waaweyn oo dhanka badqabka iyo sharciga ah. Markii ugu horraysay taariikhda dalka, ururka National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ) oo kaashanaya xiriirka caalamiga ah ee International Federation of Journalists (IFJ) ayaa bishii Nofeenbar 2012kii magaalada Muqdisho ka bilaabay tababbarkii ugu horreeyey ee lagu barayo suxufiyiinta habraacyada badbaadada rasmiga ah ee naftooda. Waxaa la qoray buugag hagaya amniga wariyayaasha. Sidoo kale, ololayaashii dabagalka caddaaladda ee ka dhashay gumaadkii Sibteenbar 2012kii waxay dhaliyeen in dowladda Soomaaliya lagu khasbo isbeddel sharci; waxaana 8dii Sibteenbar 2020 si rasmi ah loo ansixiyey Xafiiska Xeer-ilaaliyaha Gaarka ah ee u xilsaaran baarista denbiyada loo gaysto suxufiyiinta. Inkasta oo weerarradaas ee kooxda argaggixisada ah ee AS ay reebeen masiibo iyo mahadho weyn, haddana suxufiyiinta Soomaaliyeed marna isma dhiibin, mana oggolaan in la aammusiyo codkooda. Waxay muujiyeen dadaal iyo dhiirranaan, iyagoo sii watay tebinta xaqiiqada, maantadan la joogona waxay weli si dhab ah cod iyo indho ugu yihiin bulshada Soomaaliyeed, qalinka iyo makarafoonkuna ay noqdeen kuwo ka adkaaday cabsida iyo qaraxyada.
items.fullContent: Marka dib loo eego dhacdooyinkii isdabajoogga ahaa ee dhacay intii u dhexaysay 20kii illaa 28kii Sibteenbar 2012kii, waxaa cad in xeeladda kooxda argaggixisada ah ee al-Shabaab (AS) ay dhaafsiisnayd dilka wariyayaashii xaqa tebintiisa ku dhiirraday ee baaddilkii argaggaxisada ganafka ku dhuftay. Ujeedda AS ayaa ahayd in ay wiiqaan oo ay aamusiiyaan dareenka iyo dhiirranaanta bulshada inteeda kale. Si aan u fahanno culayska iyo doogta maskaxeed ee kooxda argaggixisada ah ee AS ku reebtay saxaafadda, waa inaan si dhow u milicsannaa dhacdooyinkii isxigxigay ee bilowday 20kii Sibteenbar 2012kii. Maalintaas, laba naftood-halige ah oo walxaha qarxa isku soo xiray ayaa si qorshaysan isku qarxiyay maqaayadda Baar Village oo ku dhowayd guriga Hooyooyinka. Goobtani keliya ma ahayn maqaayad cunto, waxayse xilligaas wariyayaasha u ahayd barkulanka ugu weyn ee ay ku sheekaystaan, iskuguna xogwaraystaan waayaha dalka. Weerarkaas arxandarrada lahaa waxaa ku dhimatay ugu yaraan 15 qof, oo ay ku jireen saddex suxufi oo miisaan ku lahaa dalka. Kuwaas oo ay ka mid ahaayeen Cabdisataar Daahir Sabriye oo ka tirsanaa hawlwadeennada Telefishinka Qaranka, Liibaan Cali Nuur oo ka shaqaynayay Raadiyow Muqdisho, iyo Cabdiraxmaan Yaasiin oo ka tirsanaa warbaahinta qaranka. Gumaadka ka dhacay goobtaas wuxuu xanbaarsanaa farriin xeeladeed oo ah in gebi ahaanba albaabbada loo laabo barkulankii ay wariyayaashu isku xogwaraysan jireen, aragtiyahana ku wadaagi jireen, isla markaasna lagu dhowri jiray xorriyadda ra’yiga iyo fekerka madaxbannaan. Haddaba, xeeladda liidata ee cabsigelinta ee kooxda argaggixisadu kuma ekayn qarax meel qura ka dhacay, waxayse wajigeedu soo ifbaxay maalin kaddib. 21kii Sibteenbar 2012, wax ka yar 24 saac kaddib dilkii saddexdii suxufi ee Baar Village, waxaa magaalada Muqdisho lagu dilay Xasan Yuusuf Absuge, oo ahaa soosaare dhiirran oo ka tirsanaa Radio Maanta. Falalkan wada anfariirka leh ee muddada yar gudaheed ku dhacay, waxay muujiyeen xeelad loogu talagalay in lagu abuuro xaalad argaggax oo baqdin-u-joog ah. Marka uu suxufi kasta oo magaalada jooga ogaado in saaxiibbadiis lagu laayay qarax, isla markaasna kii subaxaas ka hadlay idaacaddana isla habeenkiiba la toogtay, waxaa su’aal gashay dareenkii dhiirranaanta iyo runsheegidda. Haddii ay suxufiyiintu markii hore taxaddar dheeraad ah yeelan jireen marka ay furimaha dagaalka joogaan, maalmahaas waxay ku baraarujiyeen in khatartu aysan ku ekayn goobaha colaadda. Waxay garwaaqsadeen in markan dagaalku u soo guuray xafiisyadii shaqada, goobihii shaaha lagu cabayay, iyo luuq kasta oo ay maraan, iyagoo si cad u fahmay inay yihiin bartilmaameed toos ah oo la ugaarsanayo. Waxyeelladii ka dhalatay weerarradan kuma ekayn keliya dhimashada weriyayaasha, sidoo kale waxay raad weyn ku reebtay guud ahaan madaxbannaanidii iyo tayadii wararka ee dalka. Warbixin rasmi ah oo uu soo saaray ururka National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ) 23kii Sibteenbar 2012, oo xilligaas cinwaan looga dhigay “Impunity: War on Somalia’s Journalists” , ayaa lagu caddeeyey in beegsigan baaxadda leh uu suxufiyiinta geliyay xaalad adag oo cabsi ah. Marka ay kooxuhu awood u yeeshaan inay cabsi ku beeraan qofka wararka soo tebiya, waxaa meesha ka baxa kalsoonidii iyo dhiirranaantii lagu sheegi lahaa xaqiiqada jirta. items.title: Walking Garowe: Discovering the Life of the City
items.description: By Ali Mohamed My journey to Garowe began on 19 September 2026, when I travelled to the capital of Puntland State of Somalia to participate in the Puntland Development and Research Center (PDRC) Annual Peace Conference 2026. I had been invited to present my research paper titled: “Security Transition, Institutional Fragility and the Path to Somali-Led Stabilization: Navigating the AUSSOM Drawdown and Financing Transition.” at the conference that brought together researchers, academics, practitioners, policymakers and peacebuilding actors from Somalia and beyond. I arrived with the clear purpose of presenting my research and engaging in discussions on peace, governance and security. Yet, as the days unfolded, I discovered that the most memorable part of my visit would extend far beyond the conference programme. My experience of Garowe became an opportunity not only to participate in an important academic gathering, but also to observe, walk through and experience the everyday social life of a city I was visiting for the first time. My first encounter with Garowe began at Gen. Abshir Airport, where we received a warm and generous welcome from the PDRC team. For a first-time visitor, such hospitality creates an immediate sense of belonging and comfort. From the airport, I travelled towards my accommodation with Mukhtar Hersi, a member of PDRC, who shared with me stories and observations about Garowe, its development, its people and some of the places we passed along the way. As we travelled through the city, he explained different landmarks and features of Garowe, including the bridge we passed on our way to the hotel. His explanations gave me an initial understanding of the city, but they also made me more curious. I quickly realized that I did not want to experience Garowe only through the window of a vehicle. I wanted to see it at street level, to walk through its public spaces, observe its social life and understand the city beyond the formal programme that had brought me there. That curiosity became the beginning of an unexpected part of my journey. On my first evening, I spoke with my friend Abdirahman Guure and told him that I wanted to walk around the city. I wanted to see how people spent their evenings, how businesses operated, where people gathered and how the city changed after sunset. We parked the car and began walking without a strict itinerary. What followed was several hours of conversation, laughter, observation and exploration. From approximately 6:30 in the evening until 11:00 at night, we moved through different parts of Garowe, sharing stories and enjoying the atmosphere of the city. One of our stops was Xalwo Kismayo, where I had the opportunity to taste Xalwo Kismayo. It was a simple experience, but one that became part of the memory of my first night in Garowe. We continued our walk towards Barxada Garowe, a public space where people came together to take photographs, meet friends, socialize and enjoy the evening. Standing there and observing the movement of people gave me a perspective that no conference presentation could provide. I was seeing the city not as a place described through policy documents or research reports, but as a living social environment shaped by ordinary interactions. Young people were spending time together, families and friends were moving through the area, businesses were serving customers, and public spaces were functioning as places of social connection. It reminded me that understanding a society requires attention not only to its institutions and policies, but also to the everyday spaces in which people create relationships and experience their communities. After several hours of walking, we were tired enough to take a bajaj and return to our destination, bringing our first exploration of Garowe to an end. The following evening, 20 September, PDRC hosted a welcoming event ahead of the conference, alongside the launch of the Shuke Institute for Mediation and Training. The event brought together guests and participants from different parts of Somalia and beyond, creating an opportunity for introductions, professional conversations and exchanges around peacebuilding and mediation. Being part of such a gathering was particularly meaningful because it brought together people working across different areas of Somalia’s peace and governance landscape. Yet, when the formal welcoming programme concluded at around 9:30 p.m., my curiosity about Garowe remained. Once again, I contacted my friend and suggested that we go out and explore the city. That second evening of walking became another memorable experience. We moved through Wadada Wasaaradaha, passed areas around the state house and continued observing the streets and neighbourhoods. This time, I was more conscious of the details around me. I paid attention to how businesses operated in the evening, how people moved around the city, how public spaces were used and how different parts of Garowe connected with one another. We continued walking until approximately midnight. What initially appeared to be a simple evening walk had gradually become an informal exercise in observation. As a researcher, I have always been interested in understanding communities and institutions, but experiencing the city directly reminded me that some forms of knowledge emerge through observation, conversation and participation in everyday life. The conference officially began the following morning, bringing the focus back to research, policy and peacebuilding. The programme featured panels, presentations and discussions that examined important questions concerning Somalia’s peace, governance and security. With approximately 300 participants attending, the conference provided a valuable platform for researchers, practitioners and other stakeholders to exchange ideas and reflect on Somalia’s contemporary challenges. I had the opportunity to present my own research and engage with other participants whose experiences and areas of expertise offered different perspectives on the issues under discussion. The academic environment was stimulating, but my experience outside the conference hall continued to shape how I understood the place in which these discussions were taking place. For me, this contrast between the conference room and the streets of Garowe became particularly significant. Inside the conference, we discussed institutions, governance, security, peacebuilding and policy. Outside, those same concepts existed in much more practical and visible forms. Governance could be observed through public spaces and infrastructure, economic activity could be seen through businesses and markets, social cohesion could be observed through the ways people gathered and interacted; and the everyday experience of citizens provided a human dimension to the larger questions discussed by researchers and practitioners. The experience reinforced for me that academic and policy discussions become more meaningful when they remain connected to the communities and social environments they seek to understand. On the evening of 22 September, after another full day of conference activities, I once again suggested to my friend that we go for a walk. By then, exploring Garowe on foot had almost become part of our routine. We travelled from our destination towards Barxada and continued through Wadada Soddonka and Wadada Shacabka. Along the way, we continued observing the city and discussing what we had experienced during the conference and throughout our stay. Eventually, we sat at a restaurant and spent time simply enjoying the atmosphere, talking, laughing and observing the surrounding social life. After several days of formal discussions, it was refreshing to step away from the academic environment and spend time in an ordinary social setting. Looking back, I realize that my visit to Garowe consisted of two interconnected experiences. The first was professional and academic, attending the PDRC Annual Peace Conference 2026, presenting research, listening to panels, participating in discussions and meeting scholars and practitioners. The second was personal and observational, walking through the city, tasting local food, travelling by bajaj, visiting public spaces, observing businesses and talking with my friend about the people, places and everyday realities of Garowe. These two experiences complemented each other. The conference helped me think about Somalia through research and policy, while the city itself allowed me to experience some of the social realities behind those broader discussions. As a researcher, I found this particularly valuable. Research often requires us to move beyond abstract concepts and examine how institutions, policies and social processes are experienced in everyday life. A city is more than its administrative structures, roads and buildings. It is also the people who occupy its public spaces, the businesses that sustain its economy, the friendships that shape social life and the informal interactions that create a sense of community. My walks through Garowe offered a small but meaningful opportunity to observe these dimensions directly. My first visit to Garowe therefore became much more than a conference trip. I arrived to present a paper, but I also found myself learning from the city itself. I came with questions about peace, governance and security, and I left with memories shaped by conversations, hospitality, long walks and everyday encounters. The warmth of the PDRC team, the guidance of Mukhtar Hersi, Maryama Hamid, and Amina Abdulkadir the friendship that accompanied my evening explorations and the opportunity to observe Garowe beyond the conference programme all contributed to an experience that I will remember. Perhaps the most important lesson from the journey is that understanding a place requires more than attending its formal events. Sometimes, understanding begins when you leave the conference hall, put aside the schedule and walk through the streets. My experience in Garowe reminded me that behind every policy discussion are communities, streets, businesses, families, friendships and everyday human experiences. The conference gave me an academic platform, but Garowe gave me a different kind of classroom, the city itself. I travelled to Garowe as a researcher invited to present a paper at one of Somalia’s important peace and policy gatherings. I returned with something broader a deeper appreciation of the value of experiencing communities directly and listening to the stories that exist beyond formal programmes. My first visit to Garowe was therefore not simply about presenting research. It was about discovering a city, experiencing its social life and allowing the journey itself to become part of the researcher’s story. items.fullContent: By Ali Mohamed My journey to Garowe began on 19 September 2026, when I travelled to the capital of Puntland State of Somalia to participate in the Puntland Development and Research Center (PDRC) Annual Peace Conference 2026. I had been invited to present my research paper titled: “Security Transition, Institutional Fragility and the Path to Somali-Led Stabilization: Navigating the AUSSOM Drawdown and Financing Transition.” at the conference that brought together researchers, academics, practitioners, policymakers and peacebuilding actors from Somalia and beyond. I arrived with the clear purpose of presenting my research and engaging in discussions on peace, governance and security. Yet, as the days unfolded, I discovered that the most memorable part of my visit would extend far beyond the conference programme. My experience of Garowe became an opportunity not only to participate in an important academic gathering, but also to observe, walk through and experience the everyday social life of a city I was visiting for the first time. My first encounter with Garowe began at Gen. Abshir Airport, where we received a warm and generous welcome from the PDRC team. For a first-time visitor, such hospitality creates an immediate sense of belonging and comfort. From the airport, I travelled towards my accommodation with Mukhtar Hersi, a member of PDRC, who shared with me stories and observations about Garowe, its development, its people and some of the places we passed along the way. As we travelled through the city, he explained different landmarks and features of Garowe, including the bridge we passed on our way to the hotel. His explanations gave me an initial understanding of the city, but they also made me more curious. I quickly realized that I did not want to experience Garowe only through the window of a vehicle. I wanted to see it at street level, to walk through its public spaces, observe its social life and understand the city beyond the formal programme that had brought me there. That curiosity became the beginning of an unexpected part of my journey. On my first evening, I spoke with my friend Abdirahman Guure and told him that I wanted to walk around the city. I wanted to see how people spent their evenings, how businesses operated, where people gathered and how the city changed after sunset. We parked the car and began walking without a strict itinerary. What followed was several hours of conversation, laughter, observation and exploration. From approximately 6:30 in the evening until 11:00 at night, we moved through different parts of Garowe, sharing stories and enjoying the atmosphere of the city. One of our stops was Xalwo Kismayo, where I had the opportunity to taste Xalwo Kismayo. It was a simple experience, but one that became part of the memory of my first night in Garowe. We continued our walk towards Barxada Garowe, a public space where people came together to take photographs, meet friends, socialize and enjoy the evening. Standing there and observing the movement of people gave me a perspective that no conference presentation could provide. I was seeing the city not as a place described through policy documents or research reports, but as a living social environment shaped by ordinary interactions. Young people were spending time together, families and friends were moving through the area, businesses were serving customers, and public spaces were functioning as places of social connection. It reminded me that understanding a society requires attention not only to its institutions and policies, but also to the everyday spaces in which people create relationships and experience their communities. After several hours of walking, we were tired enough to take a bajaj and return to our destination, bringing our first exploration of Garowe to an end. The following evening, 20 September, PDRC hosted a welcoming event ahead of the conference, alongside the launch of the Shuke Institute for Mediation and Training. The event brought together guests and participants from different parts of Somalia and beyond, creating an opportunity for introductions, professional conversations and exchanges around peacebuilding and mediation. Being part of such a gathering was particularly meaningful because it brought together people working across different areas of Somalia’s peace and governance landscape. Yet, when the formal welcoming programme concluded at around 9:30 p.m., my curiosity about Garowe remained. Once again, I contacted my friend and suggested that we go out and explore the city. That second evening of walking became another memorable experience. We moved through Wadada Wasaaradaha, passed areas around the state house and continued observing the streets and neighbourhoods. This time, I was more conscious of the details around me. I paid attention to how businesses operated in the evening, how people moved around the city, how public spaces were used and how different parts of Garowe connected with one another. We continued walking until approximately midnight. What initially appeared to be a simple evening walk had gradually become an informal exercise in observation. As a researcher, I have always been interested in understanding communities and institutions, but experiencing the city directly reminded me that some forms of knowledge emerge through observation, conversation and participation in everyday life. The conference officially began the following morning, bringing the focus back to research, policy and peacebuilding. The programme featured panels, presentations and discussions that examined important questions concerning Somalia’s peace, governance and security. With approximately 300 participants attending, the conference provided a valuable platform for researchers, practitioners and other stakeholders to exchange ideas and reflect on Somalia’s contemporary challenges. I had the opportunity to present my own research and engage with other participants whose experiences and areas of expertise offered different perspectives on the issues under discussion. The academic environment was stimulating, but my experience outside the conference hall continued to shape how I understood the place in which these discussions were taking place. For me, this contrast between the conference room and the streets of Garowe became particularly significant. Inside the conference, we discussed institutions, governance, security, peacebuilding and policy. Outside, those same concepts existed in much more practical and visible forms. Governance could be observed through public spaces and infrastructure, economic activity could be seen through businesses and markets, social cohesion could be observed through the ways people gathered and interacted; and the everyday experience of citizens provided a human dimension to the larger questions discussed by researchers and practitioners. The experience reinforced for me that academic and policy discussions become more meaningful when they remain connected to the communities and social environments they seek to understand. On the evening of 22 September, after another full day of conference activities, I once again suggested to my friend that we go for a walk. By then, exploring Garowe on foot had almost become part of our routine. We travelled from our destination towards Barxada and continued through Wadada Soddonka and Wadada Shacabka. Along the way, we continued observing the city and discussing what we had experienced during the conference and throughout our stay. Eventually, we sat at a restaurant and spent time simply enjoying the atmosphere, talking, laughing and observing the surrounding social life. After several days of formal discussions, it was refreshing to step away from the academic environment and spend time in an ordinary social setting. Looking back, I realize that my visit to Garowe consisted of two interconnected experiences. The first was professional and academic, attending the PDRC Annual Peace Conference 2026, presenting research, listening to panels, participating in discussions and meeting scholars and practitioners. The second was personal and observational, walking through the city, tasting local food, travelling by bajaj, visiting public spaces, observing businesses and talking with my friend about the people, places and everyday realities of Garowe. These two experiences complemented each other. The conference helped me think about Somalia through research and policy, while the city itself allowed me to experience some of the social realities behind those broader discussions. As a researcher, I found this particularly valuable. Research often requires us to move beyond abstract concepts and examine how institutions, policies and social processes are experienced in everyday life. A city is more than its administrative structures, roads and buildings. It is also the people who occupy its public spaces, the businesses that sustain its economy, the friendships that shape social life and the informal interactions that create a sense of community. My walks through Garowe offered a small but meaningful opportunity to observe these dimensions directly. My first visit to Garowe therefore became much more than a conference trip. I arrived to present a paper, but I also found myself learning from the city itself. I came with questions about peace, governance and security, and I left with memories shaped by conversations, hospitality, long walks and everyday encounters. The warmth of the PDRC team, the guidance of Mukhtar Hersi, Maryama Hamid, and Amina Abdulkadir the friendship that accompanied my evening explorations and the opportunity to observe Garowe beyond the conference programme all contributed to an experience that I will remember. Perhaps the most important lesson from the journey is that understanding a place requires more than attending its formal events. Sometimes, understanding begins when you leave the conference hall, put aside the schedule and walk through the streets. My experience in Garowe reminded me that behind every policy discussion are communities, streets, businesses, families, friendships and everyday human experiences. The conference gave me an academic platform, but Garowe gave me a different kind of classroom, the city itself. I travelled to Garowe as a researcher invited to present a paper at one of Somalia’s important peace and policy gatherings. I returned with something broader a deeper appreciation of the value of experiencing communities directly and listening to the stories that exist beyond formal programmes. My first visit to Garowe was therefore not simply about presenting research. It was about discovering a city, experiencing its social life and allowing the journey itself to become part of the researcher’s story. items.title: Sawirro: R/W Xamza oo maanta duleedka Muqdisho ka daah-furay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta duleedka magaalada Muqdisho ka furay Bandhigga Dalxiiska Soomaaliya oo ay qabanayso Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska. Bandhigan ayaa waxaa ka qeyb-galay boqolaal kamid ah bulshada caasimadda, iyadoo lagu soo bandhigay raasumaalka dalxiiska dalkeenna. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza ayaa sheegay in fursadaha dalxiiska dalka ay yihiin kuwo aad u badan, isla markaana ay qayb ka qaadan karaan dakhliga dalka haddii la oofiyo shuruudaha loo baahan yahay, lana helo karaan aadane oo ku habboon, teknoolajiyad casri ah iyo xirfado. Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa bogaadiyay ganacsiyada gaarka loo leeyahay iyo cid kasta oo maalgashi ku samaysay dalxiiska, gaar ahaan dhinaca xeebaha, oo uu sheegay inay ku jiraan fursadaha ugu waaweyn ee dalxiiska dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha oo sii hadlayay ayaa sidoo kale taabtay qaddiyadda qaranimada iyo madax-bannaanida dalka, isagoo sheegay in warqad uu nin siyaasi ah u Qaramada ay ahayd mid nasiib darro ah oo dhaawac weyn ku ah qaranimadda iyo midnimada dalka. “Midnimimadu waa tiirka adag oo la’aantii aysan ummadi taagnaan karin, kaas oo ka sarreeya khilaafaadka siyaasadeed iyo kala aragti duwanaanshaha jiri kara xilliyada qaar,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray: “Haddii midnimo la waayo, waxaa beylah loo noqonayaa cadaw. Midnimadeennu waa dhaxal jiilba jiil usoo dhiibayay, loona huray naf iyo maal.” The post Sawirro: R/W Xamza oo maanta duleedka Muqdisho ka daah-furay… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dad fara-badan oo ku dhintay dagaalka Baydhabo
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegaya inuu kordhay dhimashada iyo dhaawaca ka dhashay dagaalka culus ee Isniintii ka dhacay magaaladaasi. Hay’adaha ammaanka iyo ilaha caafimaadka ee magaalada ayaa laga soo xigtay inay diiwaangeliyeen dhimashada 50 qof oo isugu jiray dhinacyadii dagaalamay iyo dad rayid ah. Weerarka ismiidaaminta ee lagu qaaday Hotel RB oo keliya ayaa la xaqiijiyay inay ku dhinteen shan iyo toban qof, oo lagu kala sheegay ilaaladii hotelka iyo dad shacab ah oo goobta ku sugnaa ama ka ag-dhawaa. Nin la socday gaari Leyla Calaawi ahaa oo laga soo buuxiyay walxaha qarxa ayaa la sheegay inuu beegsaday hotelka, ka dib markii uu garowsaday in ay xiran tahay waddada Madaxtooyada Baydhabo. Sarkaal ka tirsan hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa inoo sheegay in sidoo kale la diiwaangeliyay dhaawaca 120 qof oo dad shacab ah. “Dhibaatada ugu weyn waxay shacabka ka soo gaartay hoobiyeyaal ku dhacay guryahooda.” Ayuu yiri Sarkaalkan oo ka gaabsaday in la soo xigto. Waxa uu intaasi ku daray “Waxaan intaas idiinkugu darayaa waxaa jira dad shacab ah oo ku dhintay dagaalka, kuwaas oo dad is xilqaamay ay aas u sameeyeen. Marka kuma jiraan tirada dadka la diiwaangeliyay ee dhintay.” Dagaalkan ayaa sidoo kale gaystay burbur hantiyadeed oo isugu jira guryo la deganaa iyo goobo ganacsi oo ku yiilay gudaha magaalada. Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sheegtay in saddex kun oo nin oo ka tirsan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay shalay soo weerareen magaalada ugu weyn Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee Baydhabo. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ayaa sheegtay in maleeshiyada Al Shabaab iyo ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo isku dhafan ay soo weerareen magaalada. Dagaalka oo xilligii Salaadda Subax ka qarxay magaalada ayaa soo geba-gaboobay abaarihii 1-da duhurnimo, ka dib markii Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ay dib u riixeen xoogagii weerarka soo qaaday. Dagaalkan ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay midkii ugu darnaa ee muddooyinkan ka dhaca Magaalada Baydhabo.

items.title: Sudan oo Fiiso u Diiday Madaxa Sirdoonka Itoobiya oo Doonayay Booqasho Degdeg ah
items.description: Dowladda Sudan ayaa la sheegay inay fiiso gelitaan u diidday Redwan Hussein, Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Amniga Qaranka Itoobiya, kaas oo codsaday inuu booqasho degdeg ah ku tago dalkaas. Sida uu qoray wargeyska Al-Karama oo soo xigtay ilo diblomaasiyadeed oo sar-sare, Redwan Hussein ayaa codsi u gudbiyay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Sudan, si loogu oggolaado inuu si degdeg ah dalka u galo, hase yeeshee dowladda Sudan ayaa diidday inay fiisaha siiso. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo khilaafka u dhexeeya Sudan iyo Itoobiya, iyadoo dowladda Sudan ay Addis Ababa ku eedeysay inay taageerto ciidamada RSF ee dagaalka kula jira milateriga Sudan ee uu hoggaamiyo Jeneraal Cabdifataax Al-Burhan. Lama shaacin sababta rasmiga ah ee uu Redwan Hussein u doonayay inuu booqashada degdegga ah ku tago Sudan, mana jirto faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo laga bixiyay jawaabta dowladda Itoobiya ee arrintan.

items.title: Garoomada Diyaaradaha Galmudug oo la Xiray Doorashada Awgeed
items.description: Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada ee Galmudug ayaa ku dhawaaqday in dhammaan garoomada diyaaradaha ee maamulka la xirayo laga bilaabo 30-ka Sebtembar 2026, sababo la xiriira xaaladda amni iyo doorashada ka socota deegaannada maamulka. Warqad rasmi ah oo kasoo baxday Wasaaradda ayaa lagu wargeliyay Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed iyo Ururka Diyaaradaha in la joojinayo duulimaadyada iyo adeegyada la xiriira garoomada diyaaradaha Galmudug. Go’aankan ayaa saameyn ku yeelanaya duulimaadyada isku xira magaalooyinka Galmudug iyo caasimadda Muqdisho, iyadoo aan weli la shaacin muddada ay xirnaanshaha garoomadu socon doonto iyo xilliga dib loo furayo.

items.title: Puntland oo soo furatay markab kale kadib dagaal culus oo dhacay
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Badda Puntland ee PMPF ayaa howlgal ka dhan ah burcad-badeedda ku qaaday kooxo gacanta ku hayay markabka Honour 25, kaas oo la sheegay inuu u rarnaa ganacsato reer Puntland. Howl-galka ayaa isku beddelay iska horimaad dhexmaray ciidamada PMPF iyo kooxaha burcad-badeedda, kaasi oo sababay dhaawacyo soo kala gaaray labada dhinac. Kadib dagaalka, ciidamada Puntland ayaa ku guuleystay inay soo furtaan markabka, iyadoo kooxda burcad-badeedda lagala wareegay, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil ka tirsan ciidamada fuliyay howlgalka. Markabkan ayaa kamid noqonaya maraakiibta ay kooxaha burcad-badeeddu afduubka u haysteen, kuwaas oo toddobaadkan ciidamada Puntland ay howl-gallo uga soo furteen, iyadoo iska horimaadyadii dhacay ay sababeen dhimasho iyo dhaawac, halka sidoo kale la xiray qaar kamid ah burcad-badeedda. Howl-galka Honour 25 ayaa noqonaya kii labaad ee muddooyinkii dambe ay ciidamada PMPF ku beegsadaan burcad-badeedda, iyagoo awood u yeeshay inay soo furtaan markab ay kooxahaasi haysteen muddo toddobaad ah. Soo furashada markabka ayaa sidoo kale meesha ka saartay dalabyo lacageed oo ay kooxaha burcad-badeeddu ku doonayeen in lagu sii daayo markabka iyo dadka la socday. Burcad-badeeddu ayaa muddooyinkii dambe wajahayay cadaadis sii kordhaya, iyadoo awooddooda ay hoos u dhacday kadib markii maraakiib ay afduub ku qabsadeen qaarkood si xoog ah looga soo furtay, halka qaar kamid ah kooxihii afduubka geystay la qabtay. Si kastaba, Puntland ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto howl-gallada lagu beegsanayo kooxaha burcad-badeedda, kuwaas oo muddooyinkii dambe ku soo badanayay deegaanadeeda, iyadoo hadafka howl-gallada lagu sheegay in lagu soo afjaro burcad-badeedda. items.title: Suugaanta Gurracan ee Dumarka loo Adeegsado
items.description: Suugaanta Soomaaliyeed waa mid ka mid ah aaladaha lagu gudbiyo taariikhda ummadda Soomaaliyeed, habdhaqankeeda, habfikirkeeda bulsheed, sida ay u wada nooshahay iyo guud ahaan anshaxeeda. Suugaantu, sideedaba, waa weel lagu kaydiyo garaadka, dhaqanka iyo waaya-aragnimada dadka maanta nool iyo kuwii hore u noolaa. Hadal suugaaneed oo jiilba jiil u gudbaa wuxuu dhaxalsiiyaa bulshada murti iyo aqoon; wuxuu, sidoo kale, sii noolayn karaa aragti mudan in dib loo eego. Haddii aan si fudud u qeexno, suugaantu waa hadal loo yiri si farshaxannimo leh, oo leh dareen ama habdhac ka duwan hadalka caadiga ah. Waxay u kala baxdaa laba qaybood oo waaweyn: tix iyo tiraab. Tixda waxaa ka mid ah gabayga, geeraarka, jiiftada, hees-hawleedyada iyo heesaha casriga ah. Tiraabtana waxaa ka mid ah maahmaahyada, sheekafaneedda, sheekaxariirrada iyo murtida hiddaraaca ah. Suugaanta Soomaalidu waa mid hodan ku ah sifaynta wanaagga iyo ka sheekaynta nolosha dadka Soomaaliyeed. Waxay soo bandhigtaa quruxda degaannada, xayawaanka ay dadku dhaqdaan, arrimaha lagu wada dhaqmo iyo xiriirka ragga iyo dumarka. Marka si gaar ah loo eego suugaanta dumarka ka hadasha, waxaa ku jira oraahyo iyo tixo badan oo dumarka Soomaaliyeed loogu gefayo. Qaar ka mid ah maahmaahyada, heesaha iyo gabayadu waxay haweenka u sifeeyaan dad aan lahayn fikir ballaaran ama garaad lagu kalsoonaan karo. Waxay xukun guud ka soo saaraan caqligooda iyo kartidooda, iyaga oo aan tixgelinayn in gabadh kastaa tahay qof leh garaad, fikir iyo awood ay nolosheeda wax kaga qabsan karto. Suugaanta noocaas ahi waxay dumarka Soomaaliyeed ku abuuri kartaa dareen liidasho ah oo aanay mudnayn. Waxaa dhici karta in gabar soo koraysaa, marka ay marar badan maqasho in dumarku aanay wax qaban karin ama aan taladooda la qaadan karin, ay ka labalabayso muujinta fikirkeeda. Oraahyadaas waxaa sidoo kale loo adeegsan karaa in lagu aamusiyo haweenka doonaya in ay ka hadlaan xuquuqdooda, baahiyahooda iyo waxyaabaha aanay raalli ka ahayn. Dumarka iyo raggu waa dad Ilaahay abuuray, mid kastana leh xuquuq iyo waajibaad. Gabadha Soomaaliyeed, sida dumarka kale ee adduunka ku nool, waxay doonaysaa in ay nolosheeda kaalin ku yeelato, iyada oo diinteeda haysata, wixii Ilaahay farayna samaynaysa, wixii uu ka reebayna ka fogaanaysa. Hasayeeshee, waxaa jira xaalado ay gabadhu aragti gurracan kala kulanto bulshada. Wax ay u aragto qalad ayaa mararka qaarkood loogu dhigaa wax sax ah, iyada oo maahmaahyo iyo gabayo loo soo daliishanayo. Haddaba, aan eegno qaar ka mid ah maahmaahyada dumarka loo adeegsado: “Dumarku waa carruur cago weyn.” “Abaal raaga rag baa leh, mid baaqdana haween baa leh.” “Indheergarad ragna way ku yar tahay, naagana kuma jirto.” “Reer haddii uu halaabi rabo, habar baa hoggaanka u qabata.” “Rag qawl baa xira, dumarna meher.” “Gabadhi waa meel xun joog.” “Shir naagood oo shan dhaafay waa shar.” “Tolkaaga iyo xaaskaaga midna looma xoog weynaado.” “Rag gar baa kala saarta, dumarna jaan.” “Walaashaa iskuma hubtidee, seedigaa ha iska hallayn.” “Sir naageed lama sal gaadho.” “Dumar iyo carruurba la isma ciyaar baro.” “Naago iyo dheri yaraan ma laha.” “Cindiga naageed iyo cir roobaad midna lama malayn karo.” “Kas dumar oo kadalloob, rag kaaga danbeeyay kaad ku ogayd ma aha.” “Doqon iyo naag nimay legdaan kama kacaan.” “Talo dumar tagdarro ayay u dhacdaa.” “Naag been waa lagu soo xero geliyaa, run baa lagu dhaqaa.” “Naagi nin ay taqaan nin ma mooddo.” “Dumar iyo dameerraba ducolaan ayay tarmaan.” “Naag waa balaayo loo baahan yahay.” “Sirtaada naag looma sheegto.” “Naagta carrabkeedu waa seef aan mirirayn.” “Gabar nin dhali karaa dhiqi kara.” “Tol yarraaday, tafo naagood baa laga dayaa.” Maahmaahyadan iyo kuwo kale oo badan ayaa dumarka laga adeegsadaa. Haddii si xeeldheer loo akhriyo, waxaa muuqanaysa in qaar badan oo ka mid ahi haweenka ku sifaynayaan wax aan wanaagsanayn. Qaarkood waxay dumarka la simayaan carruur; qaar kalena waxay ka fogaynayaan talada, hoggaaminta ama kalsoonida. Sidaas ayuu hadal kooban oo la iska yiraahdo u noqon karaa xukun guud oo lagu qiimeeyo haweenka, halkii qof walba lagu eegi lahaa garaadkiisa iyo waxqabadkiisa. Marka laga soo tago maahmaahyada, waxaa jira gabayo iyo heeso dumarka looga hadlay, kuwaas oo abwaannada iyo fannaaniinta qaarkood ku tilmaameen waxyaabo laga baaqsan karayay. Waxaa ka mid ah tixdan: Gabay: “Haddii dumar talo lagu halleeyo” Haddii dumar talo lagu halleeyo, way hallaabaane, Halkii ay u jeedaan baa lagu wada hoobtaaye, Hog madow iyo god bay kugu hoggaanshaane, Hortaada bay qoslaan, hadhowna kugu hiishaane, Haween waa caqligooda, mid dhex yaal labada hiliboode. Hees: Wuxu waa haweenoo, Haweenna waa carruuroo, Markay hoyga kuu gashoo, Oo habeenno kuu dhaxdoo, Jinni baa u heesee. Tixahani waxay ina tusayaan in dumarka Soomaaliyeed wax badan oo aysan mudnayn looga sheegay qaybo ka mid ah suugaanta. Hadalkaas waxaa sii xoojin kara in maahmaahda, gabayga ama heestu ay si fudud xusuusta ugu haraan, dabadeedna loogu celceliyo iyada oo aan laga fiirsan aragtida gurracan ay haweenka ka gudbinayaan. Waxaa kaloo mudan in la xusuusto in haweenka Soomaaliyeed aanay suugaanta ku ahayn oo keliya dad laga hadlay. Iyaguna way curiyeen, way qaadeen, waxayna dhaxal geliyeen heeso iyo maansooyin. Mid ka mid ah diiwaannada heesaha Soomaaliyeed waxaa lagu xusay 193 heesood oo ay curiyeen haween Soomaaliyeed. Kaalintaas hal-abuur waxay ballaarinaysaa sawirka haweenka ee laga dhex arko suugaanta. Haddii facii hore ee Soomaaliyeed ay sidaas silloon uga hadleen dumarka, sebenkan la joogo waxaa muuqata kaalinta ay haweenku ka qaataan dhinacyada kala duwan ee nolosha, hadday tahay siyaasadda, waxbarashada, shaqada ama daryeelka bulshada. Waxay qabtaan hawlo mug leh oo aan looga maarmi karin. Sidaas darteed, jiilka maanta jooga waxaa la gudboon in uu dib u eego oo ka fiirsado hadalladii gurracnaa ee dumarka loo adeegsan jiray, kana fogaado in uu sii gudbiyo oraah xaqiraad xanbaarsan. Suugaanta waa la dhowri karaa, iyada oo isla mar ahaantaasna si garasho leh loo lafagurayo figradaha iyo nuxurrada ay gudbinayso.

items.title: Sawirro: Xasan Sheekh oo maanta ka degay Addis Ababa iyo Abiy Ahmed oo…
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa booqasho shaqo oo hal maalin ah ku tagay magaalada Addis Ababa ee caasimadda Itoobiya, halkaas oo uu kulan kula yeeshay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Ahmed. Kulanka labada mas’uul ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka soo jireenka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa iskaashiga labada dal. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada-hadlay xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee ka jirta gobolka Geeska Afrika, iyagoo is dhaafsaday aragtiyo ku saabsan arrimaha saameynta ku leh nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Intii uu socday kulanka, waxaa si gaar ah loo adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay horumarinta iskaashiga dalalka gobolka, si loo xoojiyo dadaallada lagu ilaalinayo nabadda iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Booqashada Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ee Addis Ababa ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli ay labada dal muhiimad gaar ah siinayaan xiriirkooda iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo arrimaha gobolka. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer ku salaysnaa arrimo dhinacyo badan leh, oo ay kamid yihiin amniga, ganacsiga, dhaqaalaha iyo iskaashiga gobolka. Sidoo kale, iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa muhiim u ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka iyo wada-shaqeynta dalalka gobolka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha, iyadoo labada dal ay wadaagaan dano la xiriira xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Booqashada Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ee Addis Ababa ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli ay labada dal muhiimad gaar ah siinayaan xiriirkooda iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo arrimaha gobolka. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer ku salaysnaa arrimo dhinacyo badan leh, oo ay kamid yihiin amniga, ganacsiga, dhaqaalaha iyo iskaashiga gobolka. items.title: Dhulgariir cabbirkiisu yahay 4.4 oo ka dhacay waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya
items.description: Dhulgariir cabbirkiisu yahay 4.40 magnitude ayaa saacadihii hore ee Talaadada, 29-ka Sebtembar 2026 , laga diiwaangeliyay meel ku dhow waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya. Sida xogta hordhaca ah lagu sheegay, dhulgariirku wuxuu ka dhacay qiyaastii 186 kiiloomitir dhanka waqooyi-bari kaga beegan degmada Caluula , iyadoo qoto-dheertiisa lagu sheegay ku dhowaad 10 kiiloomitir . Dhulgariirka ayaa dhacay 3:11 aroornimo waqtiga maxalliga ah , waxaana laga yaabaa in gariirkiisa laga dareemay deegaanno ku dhow goobta uu ka dhacay. Ilaa hadda, xogta la heli karo ma tilmaamayso wax khasaare ah oo nafeed ama mid hantiyadeed oo ka dhashay dhulgariirka. Mas’uuliyiinta iyo hay’adaha la socda dhaqdhaqaaqa dhulka ayaa laga sugayaa xog dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan goobta saxda ah, xoogga gariirka iyo haddii uu saameyn ku yeeshay dadka ku nool deegaannada ku dhow.

items.title: Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud oo amaray sharciga la horgeeyo maamulka Isbitaalka Muqdisho
items.description: Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka ayaa Taliska Saldhigga Booliska degmada Yaaqshiid faray in baaritaan lagu sameeyo dhacdo ka dhacday Isbitaalka Muqdisho Specialist , taas oo la xiriirta haweeney lagu magacaabo Zamzam Maxamuud Cilmi . Sida ku cad warqad rasmi ah oo uu soo saaray Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud, taariikhdeeduna tahay 28-ka Sebtembar 2026 , Xafiisku wuxuu sheegay inuu gudanayo waajibaadkiisa sharci ee ku xusan Qodobka 12/1 ee XHCS iyo Qodobka 8 ee Xeerka Nidaamka Garsoorka. Warqadda ayaa Taliska Saldhigga Booliska Yaaqshiid lagu faray inuu si degdeg ah u horgeeyo Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud maamulka Isbitaalka Muqdisho Specialist , kaas oo warqaddu sheegtay inuu dhiban u yahay Zamzam Maxamuud Cilmi, oo muddo 8 maalmood ah ku xayirnaa Isbitaalka sababo la xiriira arrin caafimaad. Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in maamulka isbitaalku uu hayay haweeneyda, iyadoo aan warqadda lagu faahfaahin sababta saxda ah ee keentay in muddo intaas le’eg ay isbitaalka ku sugnaato. Taliska Booliska Yaaqshiid ayaa loo xilsaaray inuu baaritaan ku sameeyo dhacdada , kadibna Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud u soo gudbiyo wixii kasoo baxa baaritaanka. Dhacdadan ayaa hadda loo gudbiyay hay’adaha sharciga, iyadoo baaritaanka la filayo inuu caddeeyo xaaladda haweeneyda, sababta ay isbitaalka ugu sugneyd iyo haddii ay jiraan wax masuuliyad sharci ah oo ka dhalan karta dhacdada.

items.title: Booliska oo qaaday tallaabo la xiriirta kiis fool xun oo ka dhacay isbital ku yaal Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Booliska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyay dhacdo ka dhacday Isbitaalka Muqdisho ee degmada Yaaqshiid, taas oo la xiriirta hooyo iyo ilmaheeda oo isbitaalka lagu hayay, kadib markii qoyskeedu awoodi waayeen bixinta kharashaadka caafimaadka iyo jiifka. Hooyadan oo lagu magacaabo Zamzam Maxamuud Cilmi ayaa boolisku waxay sheegeen in 19-kii September 2026 tagtay isbitaalka, halkaas oo qalliin loogu sameeyay, iyadoo 20-kii Sebtembar ay dhashay wiil. Taliska ayaa sheegay in qoyskeeda oo danyar ah ay awoodi waayeen bixinta kharashaadka caafimaadka iyo jiifka, taas oo keentay in maamulka isbitaalku dacwad ka gudbiyo aabbaha ilmaha, isla markaana la xiro. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka, 28-kii Sebtembar Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka ayaa soo saaray amar horkeenis ah, waxaana lagu faray in hooyada iyo ilmaheeda laga soo badbaadiyo xaaladda ay ku jireen, iyadoo la raacayo habraaca sharciga. Taliska ayaa sheegay in ciidanka boolisku ay amarka gaarsiiyeen maamulka isbitaalka, ayna ku amreen in hooyada iyo ilmaha la fasaxo. Hase yeeshee, boolisku waxay sheegeen in maamulka isbitaalku uu diiday in la sii daayo, isagoo ku adkaystay in aan la fasixi doonin illaa laga bixiyo lacagta lagu leeyahay, iyadoo kharashaadka jiifkuna uu weli socday. Booliska ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in hooyadu ay wajahaysay xaalad caafimaad oo ay ku tilmaameen daryeel-xumo, isla markaana Xeer Ilaalintu ay amartay in si degdeg ah loo soo badbaadiyo. Sida war-saxaafadeedka lagu sheegay, aabbaha ilmahana wuxuu weli ku xirnaa maamulka isbitaalka. Markii ciidamada ay tageen isbitaalka si ay u fuliyaan amarka, waxaa dhacay is-mariwaa iyo rabshad dhex martay ciidanka iyo maamulka isbitaalka, sida uu sheegay Taliska Booliska. Boolisku ayaa sheegay in xaaladdu ay gaartay amar-diiddo iyo adeegsiga hub, taas oo keentay in ciidamada ay hubkooda gudaha isbitaalka la galaan si ay u badbaadiyaan hooyada. Taliska ayaa sidoo kale caddeeyay in aan la oggolayn in goob dadweyne hub lala galo. Taliska Booliska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa sheegay in hooyadu ay gudaha isbitaalka ku jirtay xaalad go’doon ah, ayna wax cunto ah cunin dhowr maalmood. Ugu dambeyntiina, booliska ayaa sheegay in dhacdadan ay hadda ku socoto baaris, ayna sharciga waafajin doonaan cid kasta oo lagu helo fal sharci-darro ah ama khalad la xiriira dhacdada. Sidoo kale, Taliska ayaa sheegay in maamulka isbitaalka iyo cid kasta oo lagu helo fal dambiyeed la horgeyn doono maxkamadda. items.title: Safiirka cusub ee Midowga Yurub oo booqday xarunta tababarka ciidanka Soomaaliya
items.description: Safiirka cusub ee Midowga Yurub u qaabilsan Soomaaliya ayaa booqasho ku tagay xarunta Hawlgalka Tababarka Midowga Yurub ee Soomaaliya (EUTM Somalia) , halkaas oo uu kula kulmay saraakiisha iyo masuuliyiinta hawlgalka. Booqashada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada amniga iyo taageerada Midowga Yurub uu siinayo Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan horumarinta iyo tayeynta hay’adaha amniga dalka. Safiirka ayaa xaqiijiyay in Midowga Yurub uu sii xoojin doono wada-shaqeynta dhow ee uu la leeyahay Soomaaliya , isagoo tilmaamay in taageerada Midowga Yurub ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu taageerayo mudnaanta amni ee dowladda Soomaaliya. EUTM Somalia ayaa muddo sanado ah kaalin ka qaadanayay tababarka iyo tayeynta ciidamada Soomaaliya, iyadoo taageerada Midowga Yurub ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu dhisayo ciidamo Soomaaliyeed oo awood u leh inay si madax-bannaan u gutaan waajibaadkooda amni. Booqashada safiirka cusub ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay xoogga saarayso xoojinta awoodda hay’adaha amniga iyo sidii masuuliyadda amniga dalka loogu sii wareejin lahaa ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Midowga Yurub ayaa Soomaaliya ka taageera dhinacyo ay kamid yihiin amniga, tababarka ciidamada, horumarinta hay’adaha iyo xoojinta awoodda dowladda , iyadoo labada dhinac ay muddo dheer lahaayeen iskaashi dhinacyo badan taabanaya.

items.title: Puntland Forces Mount Operation to Retake Hijacked HONOUR 25
items.description: MOGADISHU— Puntland security forces have launched an operation to retake the HONOUR 25, a fuel tanker reportedly seized by Somali pirates and held in Puntland since April 21, 2026. The operation reportedly took place in Dharinbaar, an area within Bandar-Beyla district of the Karkaar region, where the vessel was believed to have been held by the pirates. The circumstances surrounding the operation and its outcome remain unclear. Authorities have yet to provide confirmed information on possible casualties, the condition of the vessel or the status of the crew and the armed group that had been holding the ship. The HONOUR 25, sailing under the Palau flag, was reportedly en route to Mogadishu’s international port when it was hijacked off the Puntland coast. The vessel was carrying approximately 18,000 barrels of fuel and had 17 crew members aboard. Ten were Pakistani nationals, while the remaining crew members were from Indonesia, India and Sri Lanka. The reported operation comes shortly after Puntland forces announced the conclusion of an operation to secure the release of the MT SIBU 1, another vessel that had been held by Somali pirates. Further details are expected from Puntland authorities as information emerges on the operation, the safety of the crew and the status of the vessel. items.title: Muxuu daarranyahay Safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Addis Ababa ?
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa gaaray magaalada Addis Ababa ee caasimadda Itoobiya, halkaas oo uu kulamo iyo wada-hadallo gaar ah kula yeelanayo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed. Safarka Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay gobolka Geeska Afrika ka jiraan xaalado amni iyo siyaasadeed oo sii cakirmaya, gaar ahaan dagaallada iyo xiisadaha ka taagan waqooyiga Itoobiya. Kulamada Xasan Sheekh iyo Abiy Axmed ayaa la filayaa in diiradda lagu saaro xoojinta xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya, iskaashiga labada dal iyo arrimaha amniga gobolka , iyadoo sidoo kale laga wada hadli karo xaaladaha cusub ee ka jira Geeska Afrika iyo guud ahaan Badda Cas. Itoobiya ayaa xilligan wajahaysa dagaallo iyo iska horimaadyo cusub oo ka socda qaybo ka mid ah waqooyiga dalka, gaar ahaan deegaannada Tigray iyo Amxaarada. Xukuumadda Addis Ababa ayaa sidoo kale eedeymo u jeedisay dalalka Suudaan, Eritrea iyo Masar , iyadoo ku eedeysay inay door ku leeyihiin ama taageero siinayaan dhinacyada ku lugta leh colaadaha. Dalalkaasi ayaa qaarkood beeniyay eedeymaha Itoobiya, waxaana xiisadaha u dhexeeya dowladaha gobolka ay sare u qaadeen walaaca laga qabo in colaadaha gudaha Itoobiya ay saameyn ku yeeshaan amniga iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Dhanka kale, xaaladda Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab Al-Mandab ayaa kamid ah arrimaha muhiimka ah ee amniga gobolka, iyadoo dagaalka Yemen iyo weerarrada ka dhaca marin-biyoodkaasi ay saameyn ku yeesheen isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo amniga guud ee gobolka. Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa labaduba muhiim u ah amniga Geeska Afrika, waxaana labada dowladood ay sannadihii u dambeeyay xoogga saarayeen xoojinta xiriirkooda iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha gobolka. Safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Addis Ababa ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xasaasi ah, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo natiijada wada-hadallada uu la yeelanayo Abiy Axmed iyo qodobada ay labada dhinac kasoo saaraan xaaladda gobolka.

Itoobiya ayaa xilligan wajahaysa dagaallo iyo iska horimaadyo cusub oo ka socda qaybo ka mid ah waqooyiga dalka, gaar ahaan deegaannada Tigray iyo Amxaarada. Xukuumadda Addis Ababa ayaa sidoo kale eedeymo u jeedisay dalalka Suudaan, Eritrea iyo Masar , iyadoo ku eedeysay inay door ku leeyihiin ama taageero siinayaan dhinacyada ku lugta leh colaadaha. Dalalkaasi ayaa qaarkood beeniyay eedeymaha Itoobiya, waxaana xiisadaha u dhexeeya dowladaha gobolka ay sare u qaadeen walaaca laga qabo in colaadaha gudaha Itoobiya ay saameyn ku yeeshaan amniga iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Dhanka kale, xaaladda Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab Al-Mandab ayaa kamid ah arrimaha muhiimka ah ee amniga gobolka, iyadoo dagaalka Yemen iyo weerarrada ka dhaca marin-biyoodkaasi ay saameyn ku yeesheen isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo amniga guud ee gobolka. Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa labaduba muhiim u ah amniga Geeska Afrika, waxaana labada dowladood ay sannadihii u dambeeyay xoogga saarayeen xoojinta xiriirkooda iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha gobolka. Safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Addis Ababa ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xasaasi ah, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo natiijada wada-hadallada uu la yeelanayo Abiy Axmed iyo qodobada ay labada dhinac kasoo saaraan xaaladda gobolka.

items.title: Aljeeriya oo Qaramada Midoobay u sheegtay in Israa’iil ay doonayso inay kala qaybiso Soomaaliya
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Aljeeriya, Axmed Attaf, ayaa Qaramada Midoobay ka sheegay in Israa’iil ay waddo dadaallo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo lagu kala qaybinaayo Soomaaliya, isagoo sidoo kale dhaliilay siyaasadda Israa’iil ee Suuriya, Lubnaan iyo Falastiin. Attaf ayaa hadalkan ka jeediyay magaalada New York intii uu socday doodda heerka sare ee Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo ka hadlayay xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee Bariga Dhexe iyo guud ahaan caalamka. Wasiirka Aljeeriya ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Israa’iil inaysan si buuxda u ilaalin xabbad-joojinta Gaza, isaga oo sheegay in rayidka Falastiiniyiinta ay weli ku dhimanayaan inkastoo heshiiska xabbad-joojintu jiro. Aljeeriya ayaa khudbadda ku celisay taageeradeeda ku aaddan dhismaha dowlad Falastiini ah oo madax-bannaan oo leh madax-bannaani buuxda, caasimaddeeduna tahay Qudus. Dhanka kale, Attaf wuxuu cambaareeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay weerarrada Israa’iil ee ka socda Suuriya iyo Lubnaan, isagoo hadalkiisa ku daray eedeynta ah in Israa’iil ay waddo “dadaallo lagu kala qaybinaayo Soomaaliya.” Hase yeeshee, wasiirku khudbaddiisa kama uusan bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan eedeynta Soomaaliya, mana caddayn waxa uu ula jeeday ama tallaabooyinka uu ku saleynayay hadalkaas. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay sare u kacayaan xiisadaha diblomaasiyadeed iyo amni ee Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo Qaramada Midoobayna ay marar badan ka digtay in colaadaha gobolka ay sii fidi karaan. Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, António Guterres, ayaa intii uu socday kalfadhiga Golaha Guud ku baaqay in la yareeyo xiisadaha, lana xoojiyo wada-hadalka iyo xalalka diblomaasiyadeed. Attaf ayaa sidoo kale ka digay hoos u dhaca kalsoonida u dhexeysa dowladaha, isagoo sheegay in adeegsiga xooggu uu sii kordhayo halka wada-tashiga, heshiisyada iyo diblomaasiyadda dhinacyada badan ay luminayaan doorkoodii. Wasiirka Aljeeriya wuxuu ku baaqay in dib-u-habeyn lagu sameeyo nidaamka Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo sheegay in isbeddellada ku dhacay nidaamka caalamiga ah ay u baahan yihiin hay’ad caalami ah oo si wanaagsan uga tarjumaysa xaaladda cusub ee dunida. Arrimaha amniga Gacanka ayaa sidoo kale kamid ahaa qodobadii uu Attaf ka hadlay, isagoo sheegay in Aljeeriya ay walaac ka qabto xaaladda ka taagan gobolka, isla markaana ku baaqday tallaabooyin lagu yareynayo xiisadaha laguna ilaalinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Khudbadda Attaf waxay qayb ka ahayd maalintii ugu dambeysay ee doodda heerka sare ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, oo sannadkan lagu qabtay halkudhigga “Soo celinta kalsoonida, maaraynta isbeddelka: Qaramada Midoobay oo u adeegta dhammaan.” Hadallada Aljeeriya waxay sidoo kale qayb ka yihiin dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee ay dalkaasi ka wado Qaramada Midoobay, gaar ahaan arrimaha Falastiin, xalka laba dowladood iyo xaaladda amni ee Bariga Dhexe.

items.title: Somalia: Puntland frees second tanker from pirates
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Puntland Maritime Police Force (PMPF) troops have freed the Palau-flagged tanker MT Honour from Somali pirates in the Bandarbayla district, days after releasing the SIBU 1 tanker, in a fast-moving push against piracy off the regional coast, Daily Somalia reported on Tuesday. The MT Honour was chartered by Puntland businesspeople and hijacked on April 21 while en route to the capital, Mogadishu. The rescue was a planned operation. At least two pirates holding the vessel were injured, and all the others were arrested. The operation came just days after Puntland forces freed SIBU 1 with assistance from Iraqi armed militias. It also follows weeks after Puntland President Saeed Abdullahi Deni announced that his government would fight the pirates without mercy, as it had fought ISIS militants and dislodged them from vast, rugged, mountainous terrain in the Bari region. The rescue was overshadowed on Saturday, when Caasimada Online reported that at least 19 pirates arrested in the SIBU 1 operation had escaped from a convoy carrying them to the regional capital, Garowe. The convoy was driving near Jariiban after the gunmen had first been taken from Garacad town. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Soomaaliya oo guul taariikhi ah ka gaartay shirweynaha caalamiga ah ee…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Soomaaliya ayaa guul muhiim ah ka gaartay Shirweynaha Caalamiga ah ee Tayada Daryeelka Caafimaadka ee ISQua, kaddib markii Maareeyaha Hay’adda Qaran ee Caymiska Caafimaadka Bulshada Soomaaliyeed, Dr. Cabdirisaaq Yuusuf Axmed Jalaaludiin, loo doortay xubin buuxda oo ka tirsan Golaha Sare ee La-talinta ee Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Tayada Daryeelka Caafimaadka (ISQua). Dr. Cabdirisaaq Jalaaludiin ayaa ka qayb-galay Meertada 42-aad ee Shirweynaha Caalamiga ah ee Tayada Daryeelka Caafimaadka ee ISQua, oo lagu qabtay magaalada Dublin ee dalka Ireland. Intii uu socday shirweynaha, Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa soo bandhigay laba dhigaal cilmiyeed oo ku saabsan tayada adeeg-bixinta caafimaadka, isagoo sidoo kale ka qaybqaatay doodaha iyo falanqaynta ay sameeyeen khubaro caalami ah oo diiradda lagu saaray tayada daryeelka caafimaadka iyo badqabka bukaanka. Doodaha shirweynaha ayaa sidoo kale lagu falanqeeyay doorka hoggaaminta ee horumarinta nidaamyada caafimaadka iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa tayada adeegyada caafimaad ee la gaarsiiyo bulshada. Doorashada Dr. Jalaaludiin ee Golaha Sare ee La-talinta ee ISQua ayaa Soomaaliya u abuureysa fursad ay si toos ah uga qaybqaadato doodaha iyo talooyinka caalamiga ah ee la xiriira tayada iyo badqabka daryeelka caafimaadka. Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa golahan ku matali doona gobolka Bariga Dhexe iyo Afrika muddo shan sano ah, taas oo sare u qaadaysa ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee madasha caalamiga ah ee looga arrinsado tayada daryeelka caafimaadka. Ka qayb-galka shirweynaha iyo doorashada Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa sidaas darteed noqotay fursad muhiim ah oo Soomaaliya ay ku xoojin karto doorkeeda iyo ka qaybqaadashadeeda dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu horumarinayo tayada adeegyada caafimaadka iyo badqabka bukaannada. items.title: Puntland oo labo sanno oo xabsi ku xukuntay Nin lagu eedeeyay inuu Ari ka iibiyay…
items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Puntland ayaa xukun laba sano oo xabsi ciidan ah ku ridday Barkhad Faarax Yaasiin Yuusuf, kaddib markii lagu soo oogay dacwad la xiriirta taageeridda kooxda Daacish. Barkhad ayaa lagu eedeeyay inuu kooxda Daacish ka iibiyay 10 neef oo Ari ah, iyadoo dacwadda lagu sheegay in xoolahaasi ay kooxda ka heshay isaga. Maxkamaddu waxay dhageysatay eedeymaha loo soo jeediyay Barkhad iyo caddeymaha la xiriira kiiska, kaddibna waxay go’aamisay xukunka laba sano oo xabsi ciidan ah. Mas’uuliyiinta Puntland ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay adkeeyay tallaabooyinka lagu wajahayo cid kasta oo lagu tuhmo inay taageero, sahay ama adeegyo kale siiso kooxaha hubeysan. Xukunka maxkamadda ayaa ka dhigan in Barkhad uu qaadan doono xabsi ciidan oo muddo laba sano ah. Kiiskan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Puntland ay waddo howlgallo iyo tallaabooyin amni oo ka dhan ah kooxda Daacish ee ku sugan qaybo ka mid ah dhulka buuraleyda ah ee gobolka Bari. items.title: Booliska gobolka Banaadir oo sheegay in si qasab looga soo furto Isbitaal xoog ku heysto Haweeney wajaheysay xaalad caafimaad darro
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Taliska Ciidanka Booliiska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa sheegay in baaritaan lagu hayo dhacdo ka dhacday mid ka mid ah isbitaallada ku yaalla magaalada Muqdisho, kaddib markii baraha bulshada lagu faafiyay muuqaallo muujinaya ciidamo Booliis ah oo hubeysan oo gudaha u galay isbitaalka. Booliska oo faah faahin ka bixinayay sababta keentay diida ayaa ku sheegay in Hooyo lagu qalay Cunug, ay awoodi weysay inay bixiso lacagta qaliinka, madaama ay kasoo jeeday Qoys danyar ah. “Zamzam ayaa 19/09/2026 tagtay isbitaalka, halkaas oo qalliin loogu sameeyay, iyadoo 20/09/2026 ay dhashay wiil, Qoyskeeda oo danyar ah ayaa awoodi waayay inay bixiyaan kharashaadka caafimaad iyo jiifka, taas oo sababtay in maamulka isbitaalku dacwad ka gudbiyo aabbaha ilmaha, lana xiro” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay taliska Booliska. Sidoo kale taliska booliiska ayaa sheegay in xeer ilaalinta ku amartay maamulka isbitaalka, inuu fasaxo hooyada iyo ilmaha, Hase yeeshee, maamulka isbitaalka ay diideen kuna adkaystay in aan la sii deyn doonin illaa laga bixiyo lacagta lagu leeyahay, iyadoo kharashka jiifkooduna uu weli socdo. Waxa uu xusay booliska in Hooyada ay wajahaysay xaalad caafimaad oo la xiriirta daryeel-xumo, isla markaana Xeer-ilaalintuna ay amartay in Booliisku si degdeg ah u soo badbaadiyaan hooyada, iyada oo aabbahana uu weli u xiran yahay maamulka isbitaalka. Booliska oo difaacayay tallaabada ciidamada ay gudaha ugu galeen ayaa yiri “Markii ciidanku u tageen fulinta amarka, waxaa dhacay is-mariwaa iyo rabshad dhex martay ciidanka iyo maamulka isbitaalka, iyadoo ay timid amar-diiddo iyo adeegsiga hub, taas oo keentay in ciidamadu hubkooda gudaha isbitaalka la galaan Si ay u badbaadiyaan hooyada oo ku jirtay xaalad daryeel-xumo ah, isla markaana go’doon ku noqotay Gudaha isbitaalka oo aan wax cunto ah cunin dhowr maalmood”. Ugu dambeyn taliska booliska ayaa sheegay inuu caddeynayo in aan la oggolayn in goob dadweyne hub lala galo, sidoo kalana dhacdadana ay hadda ku socoto baaris, waxa ayna tilmaameen in sharciga la waafajin doonaa, maxkamaddana la horgayn doonaa maamulka isbitaalka oo ku kacay fal aad u fool xun, iyo cid kasta oo lagu helo fal sharci-darro ah ama khalad la xiriira dhacdadan. Sidoo kale taliska booliiska ayaa sheegay in xeer ilaalinta ku amartay maamulka isbitaalka, inuu fasaxo hooyada iyo ilmaha, Hase yeeshee, maamulka isbitaalka ay diideen kuna adkaystay in aan la sii deyn doonin illaa laga bixiyo lacagta lagu leeyahay, iyadoo kharashka jiifkooduna uu weli socdo. Waxa uu xusay booliska in Hooyada ay wajahaysay xaalad caafimaad oo la xiriirta daryeel-xumo, isla markaana Xeer-ilaalintuna ay amartay in Booliisku si degdeg ah u soo badbaadiyaan hooyada, iyada oo aabbahana uu weli u xiran yahay maamulka isbitaalka. Booliska oo difaacayay tallaabada ciidamada ay gudaha ugu galeen ayaa yiri “Markii ciidanku u tageen fulinta amarka, waxaa dhacay is-mariwaa iyo rabshad dhex martay ciidanka iyo maamulka isbitaalka, iyadoo ay timid amar-diiddo iyo adeegsiga hub, taas oo keentay in ciidamadu hubkooda gudaha isbitaalka la galaan Si ay u badbaadiyaan hooyada oo ku jirtay xaalad daryeel-xumo ah, isla markaana go’doon ku noqotay Gudaha isbitaalka oo aan wax cunto ah cunin dhowr maalmood”. Ugu dambeyn taliska booliska ayaa sheegay inuu caddeynayo in aan la oggolayn in goob dadweyne hub lala galo, sidoo kalana dhacdadana ay hadda ku socoto baaris, waxa ayna tilmaameen in sharciga la waafajin doonaa, maxkamaddana la horgayn doonaa maamulka isbitaalka oo ku kacay fal aad u fool xun, iyo cid kasta oo lagu helo fal sharci-darro ah ama khalad la xiriira dhacdadan. items.title: Puntland oo sheegtay in weerartay Markab u afduubnaan kooxo burcad-badeed
items.description: Boosaaso ( Raxanreeb Online) Puntland ayaa sheegtay in ay weerartay markabka Honour 25 oo koox Burcad-badeed ah tan bishii Abriil ee sanadkan ku haysteen xeebaha degmada Banderbayla ee gobolka Karkaar. “ciidamada badda Puntland ee PMPF ayaa goordhow weerar ku qaaday marakabkii labaad oo koox Burcad-badeed ah ku haysatay deegaanka Dharinbaar oo ka tirsan degmada Banderbayla ee gobolka Karkaar” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay Puntland. Puntland waxay sheegtay in ciidmada PMPF ayaa markabka hareereeyeen, islamarkaana guul hordhac ah laga gaaray howlgalka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in qaar ka mid ah kooxda Burcad-badeedda ay shalay ka degeen markabka, kaddib markii ay wada hadal la gashay Puntland. Markabka Honour 25 oo ku gooshaya calanka dalka Palau waxaa mulkiyadiisa sheegtay ganacsade Cismaan Shire Quud oo ka soo jeeda Puntland, kaas oo tilmaamay in uu shidaal u siday Muqdisho. Puntland ayaa maalmo ka hor furatay markabka SIBU 1 oo koox Burcad-badeed ah ku haysatay xeebaheeda, iyada oo howlgalkaas ay ka qaybqaateen maleeshiyaad Ciraaqi ah oo ka socday shirkadda leh markabka. The post Puntland oo sheegtay in weerartay Markab u afduubnaan kooxo burcad-badeed appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Aljeeriya oo shaacisay qorshe ay Israel ka damacsan tahay Soomaaliya
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Aljeeriya ayaa Israa’iil ku eedeysay inay waddo dadaallo lagu kala qeybinayo Soomaaliya, iyadoo mar kale Qaramada Midoobay ka caddeysay sida ay uga soo horjeeddo aqoonsiga ay Israa’iil siisay Somaliland. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Aljeeriya Axmed Attaf, oo Isniintii ka hadlayay fadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee New York, ayaa Israa’iil ku eedeeyay inay waddo “dadaallo lagu kala qeybinayo Soomaaliya”, xilli uu sidoo kale si weyn uga hadlay xaaladda Gaza, Suuriya iyo Lubnaan. Hadalka Attaf ee Soomaaliya wuxuu ahaa mid kooban, balse wuxuu sii xoojiyay mowqifka adag ee Aljeeriya ay ka qaadatay khilaafka ka dhashay aqoonsigii Israa’iil siisay Somaliland. Israa’iil ayaa 26-kii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee si rasmi ah Somaliland ugu aqoonsada dal madax-bannaan, tallaabadaas oo dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya si xooggan u diidday. Somaliland ayaa sheegatay inay Soomaaliya ka go’day sanadkii 1991-kii. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya waxay se ku adkeysaneysaa in Somaliland ay tahay qayb aan laga goyn karin dhulka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Muqdisho ayaa aqoonsiga Israa’iil ku tilmaamtay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, waxaana dowladda Soomaaliya ay bilowday dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo ay taageero uga raadineyso dalalka iyo ururrada caalamiga ah. Midowga Afrika iyo dalal dhowr ah ayaa sidoo kale markaas kadib dib u xaqiijiyay taageeradooda midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Mowqifka adag ee Aljeeriya Aljeeriya ayaa ka mid noqotay dalalka sida ugu cad uga horyimid tallaabada Israa’iil. Wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Aljeeriya ayaa markii aqoonsiga lagu dhawaaqay ku tilmaantay tallaabo “sharci-darro ah” oo si weyn u dhaawaceysa madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, isla markaana khatar ku ah nabadda iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Aljeeriya waxay sidoo kale ku doodday in aqoonsiga Somaliland uu kasoo horjeedo mabda’a Afrika ee dhowrista xuduudihii dalalku lahaayeen markii ay xornimada qaateen, kaas oo muddo dheer saldhig u ahaa mowqifka Midowga Afrika ee murannada xuduudaha. Attaf ayaa isla mowqifkaas horay uga sheegay kulan heer wasiir ah oo Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika looga hadlayay Soomaaliya. Wuxuu xilligaas sheegay in tallaabada Israa’iil ay abuuri karto “il cusub oo xiisad iyo colaad ah oo ka dhalata Geeska Afrika”, isaga oo ku baaqay in dalalka Afrika ay si wadajir ah u difaacaan madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka qaaradda. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya Hadalka cusub ayaa sidoo kale kusoo aadaya xilli Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya ay sare u qaadayaan xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan. Attaf ayaa toddobaadkii hore New York kula kulmay wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya Cabdisalaam Cabdi Cali, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xiriirka labada dal, xaaladda Geeska Afrika, Badda Cas iyo arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya. Labada wasiir ayaa sidoo kale mar kale adkeeyay taageerada madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, iyagoo kasoo horjeestay faragelin dibadeed oo sii hurin karta xiisadaha gobolka. Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya ayaa sidoo kale horey u kala saxiixday saddex heshiis oo lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiga hay’adaha labada dowladood, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin guddi wadajir ah oo dowladeed, hannaan wadatashi siyaasadeed iyo iskaashi dhinaca tababarka diblomaasiyiinta. Iskaashiga ayaa sidoo kale gaaray dhinaca amniga iyo difaaca. Wasiirka gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Sabtidii Muqdisho kula kulmay safiirka Aljeeriya Mohamed Alim, waxaana kulanka diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka difaaca iyo amniga ee labada dal. Fiqi ayaa uga mahadceliyay Aljeeriya taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, isaga oo ku baaqay in la sii ballaariyo iskaashiga labada dowladood. Hadalka Attaf ee Golaha Guud ayaa sidaas kusii xoojinaya mowqif Aljeeriya ay muddooyinkii dambe si joogto ah uga muujineysay fagaarayaasha Afrika iyo kuwa caalamiga ah: inay taageersan tahay in arrinta Somaliland lagu saleeyo madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. The post Aljeeriya oo shaacisay qorshe ay Israel ka damacsan tahay Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .
