Dagaalkii ka dhacay Baydhaba oo lagu dilay 70 maleeshiyo
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in in ka badan 70 dagaalyahan lagu dilay dagaal culus oo Isniintii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba, kaas oo billowday waaberigii. War-saxaafadeed uu maamulka Koonfur Galbeed soo saaray fiidnimadii Isniinta ayaa lagu sheegay in ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo kuwa maamulka ay iska caabiyeen weerar ay sheegeen inay soo qaadeen dagaalyahanno Al-Shabaab ah oo ay garab socdeen ciidamo taageersan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen. Maamulka ayaa sheegay in dagaalka lagu dilay in ka badan 70 dagaalyahan, isla markaana qaar ka mid ah dadka la dilay ay ahaayeen ajaaniib. Si kastaba, tirada dhimashada ee maamulka sheegay iyo aqoonsiga dadka lagu sheegay ajaaniibta si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in xoogaggii weerarka qaaday ay la kulmeen khasaare culus, balse ma aysan shaacin tiro rasmi ah oo dhimasho ah. Dhanka kale, afhayeen u hadlay garabka taageersan Lafta-gareen ayaa sheegay in ciidamadoodu ay iyagu weerar ku qaadeen fariisimo ay ciidamada Koonfur Galbeed ku lahaayeen magaalada. Hadalkan ayaa ka duwan warbixinta maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo labada dhinac ay si kala duwan uga warramayaan cidda bilowday dagaalka iyo sida uu isku dhacu ku qarxay. Dagaalka Isniinta ayaa ah kii ugu dambeeyay ee taxane iska hor imaadyo ah oo Baydhaba ka dhacay bilihii la soo dhaafay, kuwaas oo salka ku haya khilaaf siyaasadeed oo markii dambe isu beddelay loollan militari oo lagu muransan yahay gacan-ku-haynta magaalada iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. 17-kii Agoosto, dagaal culus ayaa ka dhacay gudaha Baydhaba kaddib markii ciidamo taageersan Lafta-gareen ay soo galeen magaalada. Ciidamada dowladda ayaa markii dambe dib uga saaray xoogaggaas, halka Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ay sheegtay in ku dhowaad 30 ka mid ah weeraryahannada la dilay. Dagaal kale ayaa 3-dii Sebtembar ka dhacay duleedka Baydhaba. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa markaas sheegtay in ciidamo taageersan Lafta-gareen iyo dagaalyahanno Al-Shabaab ah ay weerarka ka qeyb qaateen, inkastoo sheegashada ku saabsan Al-Shabaab aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. Isbitaalka Gobolka Bay ayaa dagaalkaas qaabilay 71 qof oo dhaawac ah, oo ay ku jireen 15 haween ah, halka ugu yaraan hal qof oo rayid ah la xaqiijiyay inuu dhintay. Soo noqnoqoshada dagaallada ayaa walaac gaar ah ka abuurtay Baydhaba, oo ah xarunta maamulka Koonfur Galbeed isla markaana hoy u ah boqolaal kun oo qof oo ku barakacay colaadaha iyo abaaraha ka jira qeybo kale oo dalka ah. Dagaalka Isniinta ayaa muujinaya in khilaafkii markii hore ahaa muran siyaasadeed uusan weli xal helin, isla markaana uu hadda galay marxalad ay labada dhinac marar badan awood militari isku dayayaan inay ku xaqiijiyaan gacan-ku-haynta Baydhaba. The post Dagaalkii ka dhacay Baydhaba oo lagu dilay 70 maleeshiyo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Soo noqnoqoshada dagaallada ayaa walaac gaar ah ka abuurtay Baydhaba, oo ah xarunta maamulka Koonfur Galbeed isla markaana hoy u ah boqolaal kun oo qof oo ku barakacay colaadaha iyo abaaraha ka jira qeybo kale oo dalka ah. Dagaalka Isniinta ayaa muujinaya in khilaafkii markii hore ahaa muran siyaasadeed uusan weli xal helin, isla markaana uu hadda galay marxalad ay labada dhinac marar badan awood militari isku dayayaan inay ku xaqiijiyaan gacan-ku-haynta Baydhaba. items.title: Dowladda Ingiriiska oo isku dayaysa inay ka hortagto tallaabo Trump uu doonayo inuu qaado
items.description: Dowladda Britain ayaa sheegtay inay wada-hadallo kula jirto Mareykanka oo ku saabsan suurtagalnimada in la mamnuuco dhoofinta naaftada, iyadoo sidoo kale diyaargarow sameyneysa haddii tallaabadaas la dhaqan geliyo. Wasiirka Maaliyadda Britain, John Healey, ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay la xiriirayso mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka, isla markaana ay hubineyso in dalka uu haysto keyd naafto oo ku filan. Qiimaha naaftada Britain ayaa Isniintii gaaray heerkii ugu sarreeyay abid, iyadoo litirku celcelis ahaan marayay 199.18 pence, sababo la xiriira cadaadiska ku yimid sahayda shidaalka ee ka dhashay dagaallada Bariga Dhexe iyo Ukraine. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu si dhab ah uga fiirsanayo in la xaddido ama la mamnuuco dhoofinta naaftada Mareykanka, si loo yareeyo qiimaha shidaalka gudaha dalka. Britain waxay ku tiirsan tahay Mareykanka qayb weyn oo ka mid ah naaftada ay dibadda ka soo dejiso, sidaas darteed falanqeeyayaasha ayaa ka digaya in xayiraad dhoofintu ay sii kordhin karto qiimaha shidaalka Britain.   Bbc somali

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee dagaalka Itoobiya oo sii Xoogeysanaya
items.description: Dagaallada ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa sii xoogeysanaya, iyadoo iska horimaadyo u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo xoogagga Tigray ay ka socdaan qaybo ka mid ah Tigray iyo deegaannada ku dhow ee Amhara iyo Afar, taasoo dib u soo cusbooneysiisay walaaca laga qabo in colaaddii gobolka ay mar kale si ballaaran u qaraxdo. Wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee dagaalka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo xoogag taageersan ay sheegeen inay dib ula wareegeen magaalada Alamata , oo ku taalla koonfurta Tigray. Warar ay xaqiijiyeen ilo kala duwan ayaa sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay gudaha magaalada gaareen, iyadoo Alamata ay tahay goob istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah isu-socodka iyo sahayda ciidamada. Dhanka kale, xoogagga Tigray ayaa la sheegay inay dhaqdhaqaaqyo militari ka sameeyeen qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Afar iyo Amhara, iyadoo dagaallo culus laga soo wariyey deegaanno kala duwan. xogta ku saabsan cidda gacanta ku haysa qaar ka mid ah goobaha dagaalka iyo khasaaraha soo gaaray dhinacyada ayaa weli ah mid xaddidan, maadaama isgaarsiinta qaybo ka mid ah Tigray ay hakad ku jirto. Hakadka ku yimid adeegyada internet-ka iyo taleefannada ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyey in si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyo wararka kasoo baxaya goobaha dagaalka. Dhinacyada isku haya colaadda ayaa midba midka kale ku eedeynaya mas’uuliyadda carqaladda isgaarsiinta, balse eedeymahaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Dagaallada ayaa sidoo kale saameyn weyn ku yeeshay dadka rayidka ah, ayadoo hay’adda Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) ay sheegtay in boqolaal qof oo dhaawac ah la gaarsiiyey xarumaha caafimaadka, iyadoo warbixinno laga helay isbitaallada Korem iyo Alamata ay muujinayaan koror weyn oo ku yimid dadka qaba dhaawacyada dagaalka. Qoysas badan ayaa sidoo kale ka barakacay deegaannada ay colaadaha ka socdaan, ayadoo Xaaladdu ay sii xumaanayso kadib markii dowladda Itoobiya ay dalal deris ah oo ay ka mid yihiin Eritrea iyo Suudaan , iyo sidoo kale Masar, ku eedeysay inay taageero siinayaan xoogagga Tigray. Suudaan ayaa si cad u diiday eedeymahaas, halka eedeymaha kale aysan weli helin xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo ku filan. Sidaas darteed, sheegashooyinka ku saabsan faragelinta dibadda ayaa weli ah arrin ay dhinacyadu isku hayaan. Dagaalladan cusub ayaa walaac weyn ka dhaliyey mustaqbalka heshiiskii nabadeed ee Pretoria , kaas oo sanadkii 2022 lagu soo afjaray dagaalkii Tigray ee socday muddo laba sano ah. Dib u soo laabashada dagaallada ayaa hadda khatar ku ah xasilloonida Tigray iyo gobollada deriska ah, iyadoo sidoo kale kordhin karta barakaca iyo baahida bani’aadannimo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee xaaladda dhabta ah ee goobaha qaar ayaa adag in si buuxda loo ogaado, ayadoot irada dhimashada iyo dhaawaca, iyo sidoo kale isbeddellada cusub ee gacanta ku haynta goobaha dagaalka aan weli si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin karin.

items.title: Isbitaalka Gobolka Bay Oo Qaabilay 69 Qof Oo Dagaalkii Baydhabo Waxyeello Ka Soo Gaartay
items.description: Isbitaalka Gobolka Bay ee magaalada Baydhabo ayaa 28-kii Sebteembar qaabilay 69 qof oo waxyeello ka soo gaartay dagaal ka dhacay magaalada , sida ay sheegtay hay’adda Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF). Sida ay MSF sheegtay, dadka isbitaalka la geeyey waxaa ka mid ahaa shan carruur ah , halka saddex qofna ay dhinteen, ayadoo Hay’addu xustay in tiradani ay ka tarjumayso oo keliya dadka gaaray Isbitaalka Gobolka Bay, sidaas darteedna aysan ahayn tirada guud ee khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalka. Intii uu dagaalku socday, waddooyin gala qaar ka mid ah xarumaha caafimaadka ayaa la xiray, taasoo caqabad ku noqotay in dhaawacyada iyo dadka kale ee u baahnaa daryeel caafimaad ay si degdeg ah u gaaraan goobaha caafimaadka. MSF ayaa sheegtay in xaaladdan ay suuragal ka dhigi karto in tirada dhabta ah ee dadka waxyeelladu gaartay ay ka badan tahay kuwa isbitaalka la gaarsiiyey. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in xarun caafimaad si weyn loo burburiyey , halka mid ka mid ah shaqaalaha caafimaadkana la dilay. Intaa waxaa dheer, gaari ambalaas ah ayaa la dhacay, iyadoo laba shaqaale caafimaad oo la shaqeynayey kooxaha ay taageerto MSF la dhacay, mid ka mid ahna dhaawac soo gaaray. MSF ayaa walaac ka muujisay saameynta ay colaadaha noocan ah ku yeelanayaan badbaadada xarumaha caafimaadka, shaqaalaha caafimaadka iyo gaadiidka gurmadka. Hay’addu waxay tilmaantay in marka waddooyinka caafimaadka la xiro ama xarumaha iyo ambalaasyada la carqaladeeyo ay adkaanayso in dhaawacyadu helaan daryeel degdeg ah, taasoo kordhin karta khatarta dhimashada iyo dhaawacyada. Sida ay MSF sheegtay, dagaalkan ayaa ahaa kii saddexaad ee ka dhaca gudaha iyo hareeraha Baydhabo muddo lix toddobaad gudahood ah . Soo noqnoqoshada dagaallada ayaa culays dheeraad ah saaraysa adeegyada caafimaadka ee magaalada, gaar ahaan Isbitaalka Gobolka Bay oo horey u qaabilayey dad qaba xaalado kala duwan oo bani’aadannimo, oo ay ku jiraan dadka barakacayaasha ah iyo carruurta la ildaran nafaqo-darrada. Xogta ay MSF soo bandhigtay waxay muujinaysaa culayska uu dagaalku ku yeeshay adeegyada caafimaadka ee Baydhabo, iyadoo ay weli jirto baahi loo qabo in la ogaado xaaladda dadka ku sugan meelaha ay colaadaha saameeyeen iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalka ee aan gaarin xarumaha caafimaadka. Hay’adaha caafimaadka iyo kuwa samafalka ayaa wajahaya caqabado dheeraad ah oo la xiriira amniga, gaarsiinta gargaarka iyo ilaalinta shaqaalaha caafimaadka, xilli dadka rayidka ah ay weli u baahan yihiin adeegyo caafimaad oo joogto ah.

items.title: Netanyahu oo Bin Zayed hor dhigay arrin xasaasi ah xilli uu wajahayo fadeexad culus
items.description: Abu Dhabi (Caasimada Online) — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu, Axaddii safar qarsoodi ah ku tagay Imaaraadka Carabta, ayaa madaxweyne Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan ka codsaday inuu si cad u beeniyo war sheegaya inuu Netanyahu uga digay weerar weyn oo Xamaas qorsheyneysay ka hor 7-dii Oktoobar 2023, sida ay sheegtay Associated Press . Netanyahu iyo Mohamed bin Zayed ayaa kulan qaatay ku dhowaad saacad, sida ay AP u sheegeen laba qof oo xog-ogaal u ahaa safarka. Mid ka mid ah dadkaas, oo sheegay inuu xog toos ah ka hayay wadahadalka, ayaa sheegay in Netanyahu uu madaxweynaha Imaaraadka ka doonayay inuu beeniyo warbixin uu horraantii bishan daabacay wargeyska Israel ee Haaretz. Haaretz ayaa sheegay in Mohamed bin Zayed uu Netanyahu la hadlay maalmo ka hor weerarkii 7-dii Oktoobar, una sheegay in hoggaamiyihii Xamaas Yahya Sinwar uu diyaarinayay howlgal weyn oo horseedi kara dhiig badan iyo qalalaase gobolka ka dhaca. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in hoggaamiyaha Imaaraadka uu Netanyahu kula taliyay in la dejiyo xaaladda Gaza iyo Daanta Galbeed, isla markaana xal dhaqaale loo raadiyo xaaladda Gaza. Xafiiska Netanyahu ayaa si adag u beeniyay inuu helay digniintaas, wuxuuna ku hanjabay inuu tallaabo sharci ah ka qaadi doono Haaretz . Codsi xasaasi ah Safarka Axaddii ayaa markii hore waxaa shaaciyay Channel 12 ee Israel, balse ujeeddada kulanka ayaa si buuxda u soo baxday markii AP iyo Haaretz ay soo wariyeen in muranka digniinta ka hor weerarkii Xamaas uu qeyb weyn ka ahaa wadahadalka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Imaaraadka ayaa ka gaabsatay inay faallo ka bixiso kulanka la sheegay, balse waxay sheegtay in UAE iyo Israel ay leeyihiin “xiriir furan oo toos ah”, isla markaana xog kasta oo sirdoon oo muhiim ah lagu wadaago hay’adaha ay khuseyso. Ma cadda in Mohamed bin Zayed uu aqbalay codsiga Netanyahu ee ahaa inuu si cad u beeniyo warbixinta. Muranka ayaa Netanyahu u imanaya xilli Israel ay isu diyaarineyso doorasho baarlamaan oo loo asteeyay 27-ka Oktoobar, iyadoo wixii dhacay ka hor weerarkii 7-dii Oktoobar ay weli yihiin arrin weyn oo siyaasadda gudaha Israel ka taagan. Weerarkii Xamaas ee 7-dii Oktoobar 2023 ayaa Israel ku noqday fashil amni iyo sirdoon oo weyn, waxaana tan iyo markaas Netanyahu iyo dowladdiisa daba socday su’aalo ku saabsan digniino la sheegay in Israel heshay ka hor weerarka. Netanyahu ayaa si joogto ah u diiday wararka sheegaya inuu helay digniin cad oo ku saabsan weerar soo socda. Xiriirka UAE iyo Israel Israel iyo Imaaraadka ayaa xiriir diblomaasiyadeed sameystay 2020 kadib heshiisyadii Abraham Accords, waxaana xiriirkooda tan iyo markaas ku soo kordhay iskaashi dhinacyada amniga iyo sirdoonka ah. items.title: Somalia Braces for Heavy Rains as Aviation Authority Issues Weather Alert
items.description: SCAA Urges Airlines, Airports and Passengers to Monitor Changing Weather Conditions MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia is expected to receive rainfall across several parts of the country in the coming days, prompting the Somali Civil Aviation Authority (SCAA) to issue a weather alert and urge heightened caution among aviation operators and passengers. The SCAA said forecasts indicate moderate to heavy rainfall in parts of western Somalia, the central regions and areas of the east. Among the regions expected to receive moderate rainfall are Sool, Nugaal, Mudug, Shabelle and Gedo, although rainfall intensity is expected to vary by location. The authority warned that changing weather conditions could affect flight safety and urged airlines, airports and passengers to closely monitor weather forecasts and aviation advisories. Passengers travelling during the affected period are therefore advised to remain alert to official weather and flight information and follow updates issued by airlines and aviation authorities. Despite the expected rainfall, the SCAA said current forecasts do not indicate a major storm or cyclone affecting Somalia during the coming week. The authority said it will continue monitoring weather conditions through forecasts and daily reports to provide information on developments that could affect flights and air safety across Somalia. “We urge all airlines, airports and users of aviation services to closely monitor changes in weather forecasts,” the SCAA said. items.title: Baidoa Fighting Raises Questions Over Turkey’s Growing Role in Somalia
items.description: Allegations of Turkish Airstrikes Risk Turning a Strategic Partnership Into a Political Liability Baidoa (WDN) — Somalia’s latest fighting in Baidoa is raising uncomfortable questions about Turkey’s expanding security role in the country, after the camp of former Southwest State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen accused Ankara of using Turkish F-16 fighter jets against his forces. Laftagareen’s office said Monday that its forces had launched an operation in Baidoa aimed at restoring security and order. It accused federal and Southwest forces of resisting the offensive and alleged that Turkish aircraft carried out airstrikes that caused civilian casualties and property damage. The claims have not been independently verified. Turkish authorities have not been publicly established as having carried out the alleged strikes, while Somali federal authorities have given a different account of the fighting, saying their forces repelled an attack involving Al-Shabaab and Laftagareen-aligned fighters. What is clear is that Baidoa experienced heavy fighting on Monday, with fighter jets and drones reported during the clashes. Medical authorities and aid agencies reported civilian casualties and serious disruption to access to healthcare. Turkey’s Somalia Partnership Under Pressure The allegations carry particular weight because Turkey is not a distant military partner in Somalia. Ankara has developed one of the country’s deepest security relationships, including a 10-year defense and economic cooperation framework and a military presence focused on training and strengthening Somali security institutions. Turkey’s military deployment in Somalia was also extended through July 2028.That makes the accusations politically significant even before they are independently established. If Turkey were perceived by a substantial section of Somali society as directly intervening on one side of a dispute between the federal government and a Somali political faction, Ankara could face a difficult long-term credibility problem. Turkey has built its Somalia relationship over more than a decade through humanitarian assistance, infrastructure, diplomacy and security cooperation. Its official position has emphasized support for Somalia’s stability and state institutions. Turning that partnership into an instrument associated with one side of Somalia’s internal political struggle could therefore create consequences extending well beyond the battlefield. A Domestic Political Conflict with Foreign Security Power The Baidoa confrontation is fundamentally rooted in a Somali political dispute over control and legitimacy in Southwest State. Federal forces took control of Baidoa earlier this year after relations between Mogadishu and Laftagareen collapsed. Since then, repeated clashes have transformed the political dispute into an increasingly militarized confrontation. Monday’s fighting was the latest and among the most serious episodes. The involvement—or even perceived involvement—of a powerful foreign military partner introduces another layer to the conflict. For Ankara, the distinction between supporting Somalia’s national security institutions and becoming associated with one side of a domestic political confrontation is crucial. For Somalia, the issue is equally sensitive. Foreign military assistance is intended to strengthen national institutions, but if that assistance becomes identified with political factionalism, it risks deepening mistrust rather than strengthening state legitimacy. The Long-Term Cost Turkey has invested heavily in its relationship with Somalia, and the partnership extends beyond military cooperation into economic, humanitarian and diplomatic ties. Ankara’s own official account describes Somalia as a longstanding strategic partner. That relationship could face a very different political environment if Turkish forces or aircraft become widely perceived as participants in Somalia’s internal conflicts. The immediate question is therefore not only who won Monday’s battle, but whether Somalia’s international security partnerships are becoming entangled in its unresolved political disputes. The allegations surrounding Turkish F-16s require independent investigation rather than political assumption. But the controversy itself is significant. For Ankara, the strategic challenge is clear: maintaining a long-term partnership with Somalia may require ensuring that Turkish military power is not perceived as becoming an instrument in Somalia’s domestic political struggle. items.title: Midowga Yurub oo Itoobiya Ugu Deeqay €18 Milyan oo Gargaar Bani’aadannimo ah
items.description: Midowga Yurub ayaa ku dhawaaqay deeq cusub oo dhan €18 milyan oo loogu talagalay wax ka qabashada xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Itoobiya, xilli colaadaha iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada militari ee ka jira waqooyiga dalka ay sii kordhinayaan baahida dadka rayidka ah, barakaca iyo caqabadaha hortaagan gaarsiinta gargaarka. Deeqdan cusub ayaa lagu taageerayaa dadka ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo xaaladaha bani’aadannimo, waxaana dhaqaalaha loo adeegsan doonaa dhinacyada muhiimka ah sida cuntada, nafaqada, caafimaadka, biyaha iyo fayadhowrka, hoyga, ilaalinta dadka nugul iyo waxbarashada xaaladaha degdegga ah. Maalgelintan cusub waxay wadarta taageerada bani’aadannimo ee Midowga Yurub uu Itoobiya siiyey sannadka 2026 ka dhigeysaa €61 milyan . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, €18-ka milyan ee hadda lagu dhawaaqay waa maalgelin cusub, halka lacagta kale ay ka kooban tahay qoondooyin hore oo Midowga Yurub uu Itoobiya u qoondeeyey sannadkan. Guddiga Yurub ayaa sheegay in go’aanka lagu bixiyey taageeradan cusub uu la xiriira xaaladda sii xumaanaysa ee waqooyiga Itoobiya, halkaas oo dagaallada iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada militari ay saameyn ku yeesheen dadka rayidka ah iyo helitaanka adeegyada aasaasiga ah. Midowga Yurub ayaa sidoo kale xusay xaaladda ka jirta magaalooyinka Mekelle, Axum iyo Shire , iyo wararka ku saabsan duqaymo ay fuliyeen diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ciidamada Itoobiya. Xaaladda amni ayaa sidoo kale adkeynaysa howlaha hay’adaha samafalka, iyadoo burburka waddooyinka, hakadka isgaarsiinta iyo dagaallada ka socda goobaha muhiimka ah ay caqabad ku yihiin qiimeynta baahida dhabta ah iyo gaarsiinta gargaarka dadka ay xaaladdu saameysay. Midowga Yurub ayaa dhinacyada ay khuseyso ugu baaqay inay dejiyaan xiisadda, ilaaliyaan dadka rayidka ah, isla markaana hay’adaha bani’aadannimada u oggolaadaan inay si ammaan ah oo aan caqabad lahayn u gaaraan dadka u baahan gargaarka. Baaqan ayaa imanaya xilli baahida bani’aadannimo ay sii kordhayso, gaar ahaan meelaha ay colaadaha iyo barakacu saameeyeen. Sii xumaanshaha xaaladda Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelan kara guud ahaan Geeska Afrika , oo ay Soomaaliya iyo Suudaan ka mid yihiin dalalka wajahaya baahiyo bani’aadannimo oo ballaaran. Maadaama dhaqaalaha gargaarka caalamiga ah uu xaddidan yahay, kororka baahida Itoobiya wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa sida deeq-bixiyeyaashu u kala hormariyaan taageerada dalalka gobolka. Deeqdan €18-ka milyan ah ayaa qayb ka noqonaysa dadaallada Midowga Yurub ee wax looga qabanayo xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Itoobiya, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo badbaadinta dadka rayidka ah iyo in la sii wado adeegyada aasaasiga ah xilli colaadaha iyo barakacu ay sii kordhinayaan baahida gargaarka.

items.title: Sheikh Sharif’s Home Surrounded as Somalia’s Political Deadlock Deepens
items.description: Latest Security Move Against Opposition Leader Raises Fresh Questions Over Government Intimidation After Months of Failed Political Talks Mogadishu (WDN) — Somali security forces surrounded the Mogadishu residence of former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed on Monday night, blocking roads around the compound and restricting movement in an escalation that opposition figures are likely to view as another attempt at political intimidation. Security forces, reportedly backed by military vehicles, established positions around Sheikh Sharif’s home near Aden Adde International Airport after evening prayers. Witnesses said several roads leading to the compound were blocked and civilians were prevented from passing through. The government has not explained the operation, and the immediate reason for the deployment remains unclear. But the move comes against a deeply polarized political backdrop in which Sheikh Sharif has emerged as one of the leading opposition figures challenging President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud over constitutional changes and the country’s electoral model. A Familiar Pattern of Pressure The deployment is not occurring in isolation. Earlier confrontations involving government forces and opposition-linked figures have already raised accusations of intimidation. In June, Sheikh Sharif accused the government of intimidation after clashes between security forces and opposition-aligned militias in Mogadishu. The latest deployment therefore reinforces a believe among opposition leaders that security institutions are increasingly being used as a political pressure tool. That interpretation remains a political allegation rather than an independently established explanation for Monday night’s operation. No official statement has yet linked the security deployment to Sheikh Sharif’s political activities. Months of Talks, No Settlement The confrontation comes after months of negotiations between the federal government and opposition groups failed to resolve the country’s central political disputes. The two sides remain divided over the constitutional framework, presidential and parliamentary mandates, and the model for the next elections. Opposition figures say no electoral agreement has been reached, while the government maintains that it remains open to dialogue. Sheikh Sharif said on September 18 that the talks had failed to move forward, accusing those in power of lacking interest in a settlement. The opposition has subsequently called for broader political consultations and, if negotiations fail, a national conference to address the impasse. International Mediation Losing Momentum The prolonged deadlock has also tested the patience of Somalia’s international partners. The United States, Britain and other international actors have spent months encouraging the Somali parties to reach an agreement, with diplomatic efforts repeatedly failing to bridge the divide. Earlier international initiatives sought to bring together the federal government, opposition leaders and federal member states around an agreed electoral roadmap. The opposition has now appealed to the UN Security Council for international mediation and support for an agreed electoral model, arguing that previous attempts at dialogue have failed. The continued political impasse is therefore no longer simply a dispute between rival Somali politicians. It is increasingly becoming a test of whether Somalia’s political institutions can produce consensus without resorting to pressure, confrontation or the deployment of security forces around political opponents. From Political Dispute to Security Problem The latest operation around Sheikh Sharif’s residence illustrates the danger. When political negotiations repeatedly fail and security forces become visible around opposition leaders, the boundary between political disagreement and coercive politics becomes increasingly difficult to maintain. President Hassan Sheikh has told the international community that Somalia’s political future should be determined through dialogue, constitutional law and elections. The continuing confrontation with opposition leaders, however, demonstrates how far the political system remains from that objective. After months of negotiations, Somalia still lacks a political settlement acceptable to its principal competing camps. The latest security deployment around Sheikh Sharif’s home risks deepening that mistrust—and turning a political deadlock into an even more dangerous security crisis. Months of Talks, No Settlement The confrontation comes after months of negotiations between the federal government and opposition groups failed to resolve the country’s central political disputes. The two sides remain divided over the constitutional framework, presidential and parliamentary mandates, and the model for the next elections. Opposition figures say no electoral agreement has been reached, while the government maintains that it remains open to dialogue. Sheikh Sharif said on September 18 that the talks had failed to move forward, accusing those in power of lacking interest in a settlement. The opposition has subsequently called for broader political consultations and, if negotiations fail, a national conference to address the impasse. International Mediation Losing Momentum The prolonged deadlock has also tested the patience of Somalia’s international partners. The United States, Britain and other international actors have spent months encouraging the Somali parties to reach an agreement, with diplomatic efforts repeatedly failing to bridge the divide. Earlier international initiatives sought to bring together the federal government, opposition leaders and federal member states around an agreed electoral roadmap. The opposition has now appealed to the UN Security Council for international mediation and support for an agreed electoral model, arguing that previous attempts at dialogue have failed. The continued political impasse is therefore no longer simply a dispute between rival Somali politicians. It is increasingly becoming a test of whether Somalia’s political institutions can produce consensus without resorting to pressure, confrontation or the deployment of security forces around political opponents. From Political Dispute to Security Problem The latest operation around Sheikh Sharif’s residence illustrates the danger. When political negotiations repeatedly fail and security forces become visible around opposition leaders, the boundary between political disagreement and coercive politics becomes increasingly difficult to maintain. President Hassan Sheikh has told the international community that Somalia’s political future should be determined through dialogue, constitutional law and elections. The continuing confrontation with opposition leaders, however, demonstrates how far the political system remains from that objective. After months of negotiations, Somalia still lacks a political settlement acceptable to its principal competing camps. The latest security deployment around Sheikh Sharif’s home risks deepening that mistrust—and turning a political deadlock into an even more dangerous security crisis. items.title: Somaliland Pushes to Take Control of Its Airspace and Border Entry System
items.description: Hargeisa Seeks Greater Control Over Aviation and e-Visa as It Expands Its Drive to Operate as an Independent State Hargeisa (WDN) — Somaliland says it is pursuing efforts to take full control of its airspace and end Somalia’s electronic visa system for travelers arriving in Hargeisa, in another move reflecting its ambition to exercise the functions of an independent state. Somaliland’s Minister of the Presidency, Khadar Hussein Abdi, said the administration was pursuing the issues through diplomatic channels and other initiatives being handled discreetly. He said Aviation and Airports Minister Fuad Ahmed Nur was leading efforts over airspace management and what Somaliland considers obstacles to controlling flights serving the territory. “Minister Fuad is handling the aviation and airspace issues wisely and discreetly, and we hope he will achieve success soon,” Khadar told members of the Somaliland diaspora in the United States. The minister added, Fuad remains in the United States and is continuing diplomatic efforts on the issue. A Challenge to Somalia’s Federal Authority Control of airspace and immigration procedures are among the practical functions associated with state authority. Somaliland’s push to control both therefore goes beyond an administrative dispute and reflects its broader effort to operate independently of Mogadishu. The administration has also challenged Somalia’s e-Visa system, arguing that travellers heading to Somaliland should not be required to obtain entry authorization from Somalia. Khadar linked the campaign to Somaliland’s wider diplomatic strategy, saying some government initiatives are deliberately kept confidential until they produce results. He cited Israel’s recognition of Somaliland as an example, suggesting that the outcome reflected diplomatic efforts that had not previously been publicly disclosed. The minister did not provide details of the other diplomatic initiatives he said were underway. Airspace and Visa Dispute The dispute over airspace and entry procedures highlights the continuing institutional separation between Hargeisa and Mogadishu. While Somalia regards Somaliland as part of its territory, Somaliland maintains that it restored its independence from Somalia in 1991 and has pursued international recognition as a sovereign state. Its latest efforts to control aviation and immigration arrangements are therefore another attempt to exercise authority over functions normally administered by a national government. For Hargeisa, the objective is clear: to strengthen its ability to manage the territory’s airspace, borders and international access independently of Mogadishu. items.title: Dakhliga Kastamka Soomaaliya oo Hoos U Dhacay Ku Dhawaad 40% Sababo la Xiriira xirnaanta Marinka Hormuz
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in carqaladaha ka jira marinka istaraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz ay saameyn weyn ku yeesheen dhaqaalaha dalka, iyadoo dakhliga kastamka Soomaaliya uu hoos u dhacay ku dhawaad 40 boqolkiiba . Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo khudbad ka jeediyay kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegay in carqaladaha ku yimid isu-socodka badeecadaha iyo maraakiibta ay si toos ah u saameeyeen dakhliga dowladda iyo dhaqaalaha guud ee Soomaaliya. Hoos-u-dhaca dakhliga kastamka ayaa ku soo beegmay xilli Soomaaliya ay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay badeecooyinka dibadda laga keeno, taas oo ka dhigaysa carqaladaha silsiladaha sahayda iyo kororka kharashaadka gaadiidka kuwo si toos ah u saameeya suuqa gudaha. Dhibaatada kuma eka dakhliga dowladda oo keliya, waxaana sidoo kale sare u kacay qiimaha cuntada, shidaalka iyo gaadiidka , halka kharashaadka la xiriira caymiska iyo dhoofinta badeecadaha ay kordheen. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa horey u sheegtay in qiimaha shidaalka Soomaaliya uu si weyn u kacay, taas oo iyaduna kor u qaaday qiimaha cuntada iyo biyaha iyo kharashaadka gaadiidka. Saameynta carqaladaha marinka Hormuz ayaa sidoo kale laga dareemay dhinaca soo dejinta. Warbixin ay Qaramada Midoobay soo bandhigtay ayaa sheegtay in mugga cuntada Soomaaliya loo soo dhoofiyo uu hoos u dhacay 40 boqolkiiba marka loo eego xilligii ka horreeyay bilowgii dhibaatada, taas oo saameyn ku yeelatay helitaanka iyo awoodda dadka ay ku iibsan karaan raashinka muhiimka ah. Soomaaliya waxay xilligan wajahaysaa duruufo dhaqaale iyo bani’aadannimo oo is-biirsaday, iyadoo kororka qiimaha badeecooyinka iyo shidaalka uu ku soo beegmay xilli dalka ay ka jiraan caqabado la xiriira cunto-yarida iyo awoodda qoysaska danyarta ah ee wax iibsiga. Qaramada Midoobay waxay horey uga digtay in malaayiin Soomaali ah ay wajahayaan heerar sare oo cunto-yari ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dowladda Soomaaliya ma aysan caddeyn muddada saxda ah ee hoos-u-dhaca ku dhow 40-ka boqolkiiba uu khuseeyo , mana aysan shaacin qiimaha lacageed ee dakhliga kastamka ee la sheegay inuu lumay. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha ayaa ku soo beegantay xilli walaaca laga qabo saameynta carqaladaha Hormuz uu sii xoogeysanayo, iyadoo hay’adaha caalamiga ah ay ka digayaan in khalkhalka ku yimaada marinkan muhiimka ah uu saameyn ku yeelan karo tamarta, ganacsiga, gaadiidka iyo qiimaha cuntada ee dalal badan, gaar ahaan kuwa dhaqaalahoodu nugul yahay.

items.title: Booliska Soomaaliya oo War ka soo saaray Hooyo iyo Dhallaan dayac kala kulmay mid kamid ah Isbitaallada Muqdishu
items.description: Taliska Booliiska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyay dhacdo ka dhacday Isbitaalka Muqdisho ee degmada Yaaqshiid, taas oo la xiriirta hooyo lagu magacaabo Zamzam Maxamuud Cilmi iyo wiil ay qalliin ku dhashay 20-kii Sebtembar 2026. Sida Booliisku sheegay, Zamzam ayaa isbitaalka tagtay 19-kii Sebtembar, halkaas oo qalliin loogu sameeyay, iyadoo maalintii xigtay dhashay wiil, waxaana qoyska hooyada oo lagu sheegay inay yihiin dad danyar ah  la sheegay inay awoodi waayeen bixinta kharashaadka caafimaadka iyo jiifka, arrintaas oo keentay muran u dhexeeyay qoyska iyo maamulka isbitaalka. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka Booliiska, maamulka isbitaalka ayaa dacwad ka gudbiyay aabbaha ilmaha, kaas oo loo xiray arrinta la xiriirta lacagaha lagu leeyahay isbitaalka. Dhanka kale, hooyada iyo ilmaheeda ayaa weli ku sugnaa gudaha isbitaalka, iyadoo kharashka jiifkoodu uu sii socday. 28-kii Sebtembar, Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka ayaa soo saaray amar horkeenis ah, waxaana lagu faray in hooyada iyo ilmaheeda laga soo badbaadiyo xaaladda ay ku jireen, iyadoo la raacayo habraaca sharciga. Ciidanka Booliiska ayaa sheegay inay amarka gaarsiiyeen maamulka isbitaalka, isla markaana ay ku wargeliyeen in hooyada iyo ilmaha la fasaxo. sida Taliska Booliisku sheegay, maamulka isbitaalka ayaa diiday in hooyada iyo ilmaheeda la sii daayo, isagoo ku adkaystay in aan la fasixi doonin ilaa laga bixiyo lacagta lagu leeyahay. Booliisku wuxuu sheegay in xilligaas hooyadu ay wajahaysay xaalad caafimaad oo la xiriirta waxa uu ku tilmaamay daryeel-xumo, iyadoo sidoo kale la sheegay inay gudaha isbitaalka ku jirtay xaalad go’doon ah oo ay dhowr maalmood cunto la’aan ahayd. Xeer-ilaalinta ayaa sida Booliisku sheegay amartay in si degdeg ah loo badbaadiyo hooyada iyo ilmaha, halka aabbaha ilmaha uu weli ku xirnaa maamulka isbitaalka. Markii ciidamada loo diray fulinta amarka, waxaa dhacay is-mariwaa u dhexeeyay ciidamada iyo maamulka isbitaalka, kaas oo markii dambe isu beddelay rabshad. Taliska Booliiska ayaa sheegay in xaaladda ay ka dhalatay amar-diiddo iyo adeegsiga hub, taas oo keentay in ciidamada ay hubkooda gudaha isbitaalka la galaan si ay u fuliyaan amarka looguna badbaadiyo hooyada iyo ilmaha. Booliisku wuxuu sheegay in tallaabadaas ay timid xilli hooyadu ku jirtay xaalad caafimaad oo degdeg ah, isla markaana ay go’doon ku ahayd gudaha isbitaalka. Taliska Booliiska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa sidoo kale caddeeyay in aan la oggolayn in goobaha dadweynaha, gaar ahaan xarumaha caafimaadka, hub lala galo, waxaana uu sheegay in dhacdadan si gaar ah loo baarayo. Booliisku wuxuu tilmaamay in baaritaanka lagu ogaan doono masuuliyadda dhinacyada ku lugta lahaa dhacdada iyo cid kasta oo ku kacday fal sharci-darro ah ama khalad la xiriira dhacdada. Maamulka isbitaalka iyo cid kasta oo lagu helo inay ku kacday fal sharci-darro ah, sida uu sheegay Taliska Booliisku, waxaa la horgeyn doonaa hay’adaha garsoorka, iyadoo sharciga loo waafajin doono. Dhacdadan ayaa timid xilli dood ka dhalatay xaaladda hooyada iyo ilmaheeda, kharashaadka caafimaad ee qoyska lagu leeyahay, xarigga aabbaha iyo sida loo fuliyay amarka Xeer-ilaalinta.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo xubin sare ku yeelatay Golaha Sare ee ururka caalamiga ah ee Tayada Daryeelka Caafimaadka
items.description: Soomaaliya ayaa guul muhiim ah ka gaartay shirweynaha caalamiga ah ee tayada daryeelka caafimaadka, kaddib markii masuul Soomaaliyeed loo doortay xubin buuxda oo ka tirsan Golaha Sare ee La-talinta ee Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Tayada Daryeelka Caafimaadka, ISQua. Maareeyaha Hay’adda Qaran ee Caymiska Caafimaadka Bulshada Soomaaliyeed, Dr. Cabdirisaaq Yuusuf Axmed Jalaaludiin, ayaa ka qaybgalay Meertada 42-aad ee Shirweynaha Caalamiga ah ee Tayada Daryeelka Caafimaadka ee ISQua, kaas oo lagu qabtay magaalada Dublin ee dalka Ireland. Intii uu socday shirweynaha, Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa soo bandhigay laba dhigaal cilmiyeed oo diiradda lagu saaray tayada adeeg-bixinta caafimaadka, isagoo sidoo kale ka qaybqaatay doodaha iyo falanqaynta ay yeesheen khubarada caalamiga ah ee caafimaadka. Doodaha shirweynaha ayaa xoogga lagu saaray arrimo muhiim u ah horumarinta nidaamyada caafimaadka, gaar ahaan tayada daryeelka caafimaadka, badqabka bukaanka iyo doorka hoggaaminta ee lagu horumarinayo adeegyada caafimaadka. Guusha ugu weyn ee Soomaaliya ka soo hoyatay shirweynaha ayaa timid kaddib markii Dr. Cabdirisaaq Yuusuf Axmed Jalaaludiin loo doortay xubin buuxda oo ka tirsan Golaha Sare ee La-talinta ee ISQua. Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa golahaasi ku matali doona gobolka Bariga Dhexe iyo Afrika muddo shan sano ah, taas oo Soomaaliya siinaysa fursad ay si toos ah uga qaybqaadato doodaha, talooyinka iyo qorshayaasha caalamiga ah ee la xiriira tayada iyo badqabka daryeelka caafimaadka. Doorashadan ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya u abuureysa fursad ay ku soo bandhigto waayo-aragnimadeeda, caqabadaha ka jira nidaamka caafimaadka iyo dadaallada socda ee lagu horumarinayo adeegyada caafimaadka iyo caymiska caafimaadka bulshada. Ka qaybgalka shirweynaha ISQua iyo doorashada Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaya tallaabo muhiim ah oo Soomaaliya ku xoojinayso matalaaddeeda fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah ee caafimaadka, iyadoo sidoo kale sare u qaadaysa doorka dalka ee doodaha ku saabsan tayada adeegyada caafimaadka iyo badqabka bukaannada. ISQua waa urur caalami ah oo diiradda saara horumarinta tayada iyo badqabka daryeelka caafimaadka, iyadoo isu keena khubaro iyo hay’ado caafimaad oo ka kala socda dalal badan oo caalamka ah.

Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa golahaasi ku matali doona gobolka Bariga Dhexe iyo Afrika muddo shan sano ah, taas oo Soomaaliya siinaysa fursad ay si toos ah uga qaybqaadato doodaha, talooyinka iyo qorshayaasha caalamiga ah ee la xiriira tayada iyo badqabka daryeelka caafimaadka. Doorashadan ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya u abuureysa fursad ay ku soo bandhigto waayo-aragnimadeeda, caqabadaha ka jira nidaamka caafimaadka iyo dadaallada socda ee lagu horumarinayo adeegyada caafimaadka iyo caymiska caafimaadka bulshada. Ka qaybgalka shirweynaha ISQua iyo doorashada Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaya tallaabo muhiim ah oo Soomaaliya ku xoojinayso matalaaddeeda fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah ee caafimaadka, iyadoo sidoo kale sare u qaadaysa doorka dalka ee doodaha ku saabsan tayada adeegyada caafimaadka iyo badqabka bukaannada. ISQua waa urur caalami ah oo diiradda saara horumarinta tayada iyo badqabka daryeelka caafimaadka, iyadoo isu keena khubaro iyo hay’ado caafimaad oo ka kala socda dalal badan oo caalamka ah.

items.title: Xukuumadda Somaliland Oo Miisaaniyada Qaranka Markii ugu Horaysay Ka Maalgelisay Tallaalka Xoolaha
items.description: Xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa markii ugu horreysay miisaaniyadda qaranka ka maalgelinaysa olole ballaadhan oo tallaal iyo nafaqayn xoolaha ah, kaas oo wajigiisa koowaad lagu tallaalayo 250,000 oo neef oo adhi ah, lagana fulinayo gobollada Togdheer iyo Daad-madheedh, iyadoo wajiga labaadna lagu qorsheynayo in adeeggu gaadho ku dhawaad hal milyan oo neef. Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Xannaanada Xoolaha iyo Horumarinta Reer Miyiga, Cali Axmed Cabdi (Cantar), ayaa Ololahan tallaalka xoolaha ka daah-furay magaalada Burco, ee xarunta gobolka Togdheer. Waxaana Wasiir ku xigeenka ku weheliyaan qaar ka mid ah agaasime-waaxeedyada Wasaaradda xannaanada xoolaha iyo maamulka Gobolka Togdheer. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in tallaalkani yahay kii ugu horreeyey ee ay si madax-bannaan u fuliso, iyada oo aanay cid kale ka helin taageero, waxaana wajigiisa koowaad lagu tallaalayaa 250,000 oo neef oo adhi ah oo ku nool Togdheer iyo Daad-madheedh. Wajiga labaad ee ololaha oo lagu qaban doono magaalada Hargeysa ayaa lagu qorsheynayaa in lagu gaadho ku dhawaad hal milyan oo neef, taas oo sare u qaadaysa baaxadda adeegyada caafimaadka xoolaha ee dalka. Agaasimaha Waaxda Caafimaadka Xoolaha iyo isku-duwayaasha gobollada Togdheer iyo Daad-madheedh ayaa sheegay in adeeggan uu ahaa mid xoolo-dhaqatadu baahi weyn u qabeen, iyaga oo xusay muhiimadda uu u leeyahay ka hortagga cudurrada iyo ilaalinta xoolaha. Masuuliyiinta ayaa xoolo-dhaqatada ugu baaqay inay si buuxda uga faa’iidaystaan tallaalka iyo adeegyada caafimaad ee la siinayo xoolahooda, si loo yareeyo khasaaraha ka dhasha cudurrada. Dhanka kale, Maamulaha Cashuuraha Berriga ee Gobolka Togdheer ayaa bulshada ugu baaqay inay ka faa’iidaystaan ololaha, isaga oo sheegay in tallaalka iyo daaweynta xoolaha lagu maalgeliyey cashuurtii ay bulshada bixisay. Ololahan ayaa lagu xoojinayaa caafimaadka iyo wax-soo-saarka xoolaha, kuwaas oo laf-dhabar u ah nolosha xoolo-dhaqatada iyo dhaqaalaha qoysas badan. Khadar M. Xaashi

items.title: Tensions in northern Ethiopia raise concern; EU allocates 61 million in humanitarian aid
items.description: Brussels – In Ethiopia, “as tensions rise again in the north, civilians cannot be made to pay that price once more,” the European Commissioner for Equality, Crisis Preparedness and Management, Hadja Lahbib, warned as fears grow of a further escalation of the conflict in northern Ethiopia. The EU has announced €61 million in humanitarian aid to support the most vulnerable people affected by conflicts, displacement, epidemics and climate-related crises. With the money, “Europe is standing with those most in need, but aid must be able to reach them,” said Lahbib, calling for “an immediate de-escalation of violence in northern Ethiopia” and stressing “urgent de-escalation of violence in Northern Ethiopia.” The decision comes as the European Union is “deeply concerned” over the rapid deterioration of the situation in the north of the country. According to Brussels, military activity has been reported in various locations, and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front’s forces have reportedly seized the airports at Mekelle, Axum and Shire in the Tigray region. The EU has also been following with concern the various drone strikes carried out in recent weeks by the Ethiopian National Defence Forces. Brussels calls for immediate de-escalation, the protection of civilians and unhindered humanitarian access, reiterating that respect for international humanitarian law is “imperative and non-negotiable”. The EU also condemns attacks on humanitarian convoys and any form of denial of access to aid. The funds will finance food and nutritional assistance, healthcare, water and sanitation, protection, shelter and essential goods, as well as education in emergencies. Particular attention will be paid to displaced people, refugees and the communities hosting them. Of the total of 61 million, 18 million form part of the new package announced by Commission President Ursula von der Leyen in New York, bringing the EU’s humanitarian aid to Ethiopia in 2026 to 61 million. The allocation remains subject to approval by the budgetary authority. Source EU news

items.title: Maxay tahay digniinta kasoo baxday hay’adda duulista rayidka Soomaaliyeed?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Roobab kala duwan ayaa laga saadaaliyay qaybo kamid ah Soomaaliya maalmaha soo socda, iyadoo Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed (SCAA) ay soo saartay digniin la xiriirta xaaladaha cimilada iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karaan duulimaadyada. SCAA waxay sheegtay in saadaasha maalmaha soo socda ay muujinayso roobab xooggan oo ka da’aya meelo kala duwan oo dalka ah, gaar ahaan dhulka galbeedka, gobollada dhexe iyo qaybo kamid ah bariga Soomaaliya. Gobollada Sool, Nugaal, Mudug, Shabeellaha iyo Gedo ayaa kamid ah meelaha saadaashu tilmaamayso in roobab dhex-dhexaad ah ay ka da’i karaan, iyadoo xoogga roobabku uu ku kala duwanaan karo deegaannada. Xaaladdan cimilada awgeed, hay’addu waxay dhinacyada ku shaqada leh duulista ugu baaqday inay muujiyaan feejignaan dheeraad ah. Hay’adda ayaa xustay in isbeddellada cimiladu ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan badqabka duulimaadyada, sidaas darteedna ay muhiim tahay in shirkadaha diyaaradaha, garoomada iyo rakaabku ay si joogto ah ula socdaan saadaasha hawada iyo digniinaha la xiriira duulimaadyada. Iyadoo roobab laga filayo qeybo badan oo dalka, saadaasha toddobaadka soo socda ma muujineyso in Soomaaliya ay xilligan wajihi doonto duufaanno waaweyn. “Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa dhamaan shirkadaha diyaaradaha, garoomada iyo dadka isticmaala adeegyada duulista inay si joogto ah ula socdaan isbeddellada saadaasha cimilada,” ayey tiri hay’addu. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto dabagalka xaaladda cimilada, iyadoo adeegsanaysa saadaasha hawada iyo warbixinno maalinle ah si loo helo xog ku saabsan xaaladaha saameyn kara duulimaadyada iyo badqabka hawada Soomaaliya. The post Maxay tahay digniinta kasoo baxday hay’adda duulista rayidka Soomaaliyeed? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: MSF oo qaylo dhaan ka soo saartay dagaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Hay’adda Dhakhaatiirta Aan Xuduudda Lahayn (MSF) ayaa walaac ka muujisay iska horimaadyada ku soo badanaya Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Wakiilka Hay’adda MSF ee Somaliya, Dr. Elshafie Mohammed ayaa sheegay in hay’addu ay si weyn uga walaacsan tahay saamaynta rabshadaha sii kordhaya ee ka jira Magaalada Baydhabo ay ku yeelanayaan dadka rayidka ah iyo helitaanka adeegyada caafimaadka ee lagama maarmaanka ah. “MSF waxay si degdeg ah ugu baaqeysaa dhammaan dhinacyada ku lugta leh colaadda inay ilaaliyaan dadka rayidka ah, bukaanada, shaqaalaha caafimaadka iyo xarumaha caafimaadka, ayna xaqiijiyaan in dadka u baahan daryeelka caafimaad ay si ammaan ah oo aan caqabad lahayn u gaari karaan isbitaalada.” Ayuu yiri Wakiilka MSF ee Somaliya. Hay’adda ayaa warsaxaafadeed ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in dagaalkii xooganaa ee maanta ka dhacay magaalada uu noqonayo kiisii saddexaad ee ka dhaca Baydhabo iyo nawaaxigeeda, tan iyo 17-kii bishii hore ee August. “Waxaa la soo sheegay in xarun caafimaad uu burbur xoogan soo gaaray, isla-markaana la dilay shaqaale caafimaad. Gaari gurmadka degdegga ah (ambulance) ayaa la dhacay, iyadoo sidoo kale la soo sheegay in la weeraray guryo ay dad rayid ah deganaayeen. Laba shaqaale caafimaad oo la shaqeynayay kooxaha MSF ayaa la dhacay hantidooda, mid ka mid ahna waa la dhaawacay.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Dr. Elshafie Mohammed, Wakiilka Hay’adda MSF U Qaabilsan Somaliya ayaa warsaxaafadeedka ku sheegay “Kani waa markii saddexaad muddo lix toddobaad ah oo dagaal uu ka qarxo Magaalada Baydhabo, taas oo keentay in dagaalku uu cawaaqib xun ku yeesho dadka rayidka ah. Waa wax aan la aqbali karin in dadka rayidka ah iyo daryeelka caafimaadka lagu hayo rabshado. Dadka dhaawaca ah waxay u baahan yihiin daryeel caafimaad oo degdeg ah, laakiin qaar badan ma gaari karaan isbitaalka. Haddii aan la helin dawayn waqtigeeda ku habboon, kuwo badan ayaa dhiigbax u dhiman kara.” Dr. Elshafie Mohammed ayaa mar kale dhinacyada dagaalka ku lugta leh ugu baaqay “Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa dhammaan dhinacyada inay ilaaliyaan dadka rayidka ah, kaabeyaasha dadweynaha iyo inay hubiyaan in bukaanadu ay si ammaan ah u gaari karaan xarumaha caafimaadka, iyagoon cabsi, dib-u-dhac ama caqabad lahayn.” Kooxaha la shaqeeya Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Isbitaal Goboleedka Baay ama Isbitaalka Weyn ee Baydhabo ayaa Isniintan qaabilay dhaawacyada 69 qof, kuwaas oo sidoo kale diiwaangeliyay dhimashada saddex qof oo rayid ah, sida ay sheegtay MSF. MSF ayaa sheegtay in waddooyinka Baydhabo ay ku xirmeen dagaalka, taasoo ay sheegtay inay si weyn u xaddiday helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka. MSF ayaa intaasi ku dartay in tiro yar oo ka mid ah dadkii dhaawacmay ay u suurtagashay inay gaaraan Isbitaalka Guud ee Baydhabo.

items.title: Maxkamadda Kenya oo amartay in baasaboorka loo celiyo xildhibaan C/raxmaan Shariif
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya ayaa dowladda dalkaas ku amartay inay muddo 24 saac gudahood ah dib ugu soo celiso baasaboorkiisa Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Bashiir Shariif. Xildhibaanka ayaa Soomaaliya ku metela Baarlamaanka Bariga Afrika (EALA). Cabdiraxmaan ayaa 14-kii August lagu qabtay garoonka diyaaradaha Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, xilligaas oo saraakiisha socdaalka ay diideen inuu gudaha u galo Nairobi kadib markii ay su’aalo ka keeneen jinsiyadaha Soomaaliya iyo Kenya ee uu haysto. Cabdiraxmaan ayaa markii dambe loo masaafuriyay Muqdisho, iyadoo laga qaaday baasaboorkiisa. Xildhibaanka ayaa arrintaas u gudbiyay Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya, isagoo ka horyimid tallaabadii lagu qaaday iyo su’aalaha laga keenay dhalashadiisa Kenya. Dacwadda uu xildhibaanku gudbiyay wuxuu ku sheegay inuu yahay muwaadin Kenyan ah, isla markaana uu dhalashada dalkaas ku helay waalidkiis oo labaduba kasoo jeeda Gaarisa, uuna halkaas ku dhashay. items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo sheegtay in dagaalkii Baydhabo lagu dilay in ka badan 70 xubnood oo Al-Shabaab ah
items.description: Baydhabo – Madaxtooyada Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay magaalada Baydhabo lagu dilay in ka badan 70 xubnood oo ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan dagaalyahanno ajaaniib ah. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa lagu sheegay in dagaalka uu ka dhacay magaalada Baydhabo, kaddib markii ciidanka ammaanka ay ka hortageen weerar ay kooxda Al-Shabaab ku soo qaaday magaalada, kaas oo loo adeegsaday gaadiid laga soo buuxiyey walxaha qarxa iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn (drones). Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in dagaalka lagu furtay hub iyo gaadiid dagaal, halka gaadiid kale oo ay kooxda adeegsanaysay la gubay. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka, weerarka ayaa lagu beegsaday goobo ganacsi, xarumo waxbarasho, xarumo caafimaad, masaajiddo iyo dhismayaal kale oo ku yaalla magaalada Baydhabo. Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeedu si degdeg ah uga jawaabeen weerarka, isla markaana ay ku guuleysteen inay iska caabiyaan kooxda, iyagoo sheegay in xaaladda amniga magaalada ay gacanta ku hayaan. Dhanka kale, war-saxaafadeedka laguma sheegin khasaaraha dhimasho iyo dhaawac ee soo gaaray ciidamada Koonfur Galbeed iyo dadka rayidka ah ee ku nool magaalada Baydhabo. Dagaalka maanta ka dhacay Baydhabo ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay magaalada ka taagan tahay xiisad amni, iyadoo la adeegsanayo hub culus iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn.

items.title: Soomaaliya Iyo UN‑Habitat Oo Qorsheynaya Siyaasad Qaran Oo Guryaha Ah
items.description: NAIROBI (Goobjoog News) — Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Deegaamaynta Aadanaha ee UN‑Habitat ayaa bilaabay wada-hadallo lagu hormarinayo siyaasad qaran oo isku xirta guryaha la awoodi karo, horumarinta magaalooyinka iyo xalalka waara ee dadka barakacayaasha ah. Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Kenya, Jabriil Ibraahim Cabdulle, ayaa magaalada Nairobi kulan kula yeeshay masuuliyiinta xafiiska UN‑Habitat ee Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray kaabayaasha magaalooyinka, hab-nololeedka bulshada, maamulka deegaanka iyo sidii arrimaha guryaha loogu dari lahaa Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka. Dhinacyadu waxay sidoo kale ka wada hadleen diyaarinta kulan loogu magac daray “Somali Housing Breakfast,” kaas oo la filayo inuu isu keeno dowladda, bangiyada, ganacsatada, hay’adaha horumarinta iyo qaybaha kale ee ay arrintu khusayso. Ujeeddadu waa in la abuuro iskaashi lagu dejin karo siyaasad mideysan oo hagta maalgelinta iyo horumarinta guryaha Soomaaliya. Qorshaha ayaa lagu xiriirinayaa hindisaha Africa Affordable Housing Compact, iyadoo UN‑Habitat ay taageero ka geysanayso isku-dubbaridka hay’adaha kala duwan. Siyaasadda la qorsheynayo waxaa la filayaa inay wax ka qabato baahida qoysaska dakhligoodu hooseeyo iyo dadka barakacayaasha ah, isla markaana guryaha lagu xiro adeegyada muhiimka ah iyo qorsheynta magaalooyinka. Safiir Jabriil ayaa muujiyey diyaar u ahaanshaha Soomaaliya ee fududeynta iskaashiga iyo in wada-hadallada loo beddelo tallaabooyin la isku dubbariday. Arrintan ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh magaalooyinka Soomaaliya oo wajahaya koror dadweyne, barakac joogto ah iyo culays ku sii kordhaya guryaha, waddooyinka, biyaha iyo adeegyada kale ee aasaasiga ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qorshuhu weli wuxuu marayaa heer wada-tashi. Lama ansixin siyaasad rasmi ah, mana la shaacin miisaaniyad, tirada guryaha la dhisayo, goobaha laga hirgelinayo ama jadwalka fulinta; sidaas darteed, tallaabada xigta waxay ku xirnaan doontaa natiijada kulanka iyo sida hay’adaha ka qaybgalaya ugu heshiiyaan maalgelinta iyo hirgelinta qorshaha.

items.title: Ethiopia’s Nuclear Dream Meets a Country at War
items.description: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh Ethiopia is preparing to enter the nuclear age with Russia’s help, but the country’s most immediate crisis is not an energy shortage. It is political fragmentation and renewed armed conflict. That creates a striking contradiction. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed is pursuing an ambitious nuclear programme designed to give Ethiopia a stable source of electricity beyond its heavy dependence on hydropower. Yet as Addis Ababa looks decades into the future, armed conflicts are again spreading across the country, former enemies are joining forces against the federal government, and the political future of Abiy’s administration is becoming increasingly uncertain. The question is no longer simply whether Ethiopia can build a nuclear power plant. Can a politically unsettled state safely and sustainably pursue such an ambitious strategic project while parts of the country remain at war? Nuclear Ambition Ethiopia and Russia have been advancing plans for Ethiopia’s first nuclear power plant through cooperation with Russia’s state nuclear company, Rosatom. The two countries signed an intergovernmental nuclear cooperation agreement in 2017, ratified by Ethiopia in 2021. In September 2025, Rosatom and Ethiopian Electric Power signed an action plan to advance the project, including detailed technical work, preparation of a feasibility-study roadmap and steps toward a future intergovernmental agreement. For Abiy’s government, nuclear power represents more than electricity. Ethiopia generates the overwhelming majority of its electricity from hydropower, leaving the economy exposed to variations in rainfall and water availability. Nuclear energy could eventually provide a large, continuous source of electricity for industrialisation and economic expansion. Abiy himself has described nuclear power as part of Ethiopia’s effort to build reliable energy, industrial capacity and technological capability.  But the strategic ambition comes at a politically difficult moment. A Country Being Pulled Apart Ethiopia is confronting armed conflicts involving competing ethnic, regional and political forces. The Tigray conflict that devastated the country between 2020 and 2022 has again erupted into serious fighting. In September 2026, clashes intensified between federal forces and Tigrayan forces and spread toward neighbouring Afar and Amhara. Tigrayan forces also seized airports, prompting Ethiopian Airlines to suspend flights to the region. The crisis has become even more complicated with the emergence of the Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Alliance for Survival, a coalition bringing together seven armed groups, including the Tigray People’s Liberation Front, Amhara Fano and the Oromo Liberation Army. These groups have very different histories and, in some cases, have previously fought each other. Yet they now share a common objective: challenging and removing Abiy’s government and establishing a transitional political order. The significance is difficult to overlook. The conflict is no longer confined to one region or one ethnic constituency. It is becoming a wider confrontation over the political structure and future direction of Ethiopia. The Abiy Question Abiy came to power in 2018 promising political reform and reconciliation. His early rapprochement with Eritrea earned him the 2019 Nobel Peace Prize. But the years since have been dominated by conflict. The Tigray war shattered relations between Addis Ababa and the TPLF. Fighting subsequently spread to Amhara, while armed conflict has continued in Oromia. Now former adversaries have formed an alliance against the federal government. That does not mean the alliance is certain to defeat Abiy or that his government is about to collapse. The coalition itself contains deep ideological, territorial and historical contradictions, and analysts have questioned whether its members can maintain unity beyond their shared opposition to the federal government. But it does mean that Ethiopia’s political trajectory has become considerably harder to predict. Could Nuclear Power Become a Burden? Nuclear energy can offer Ethiopia long-term advantages: dependable electricity, industrial capacity and diversification away from exclusive reliance on hydropower. But nuclear infrastructure also requires something electricity alone cannot provide: long-term institutional stability. A nuclear programme demands strong regulators, secure infrastructure, highly trained personnel, reliable financing, effective emergency systems and political institutions capable of maintaining policy continuity across governments. That is where Ethiopia’s current crisis becomes relevant. If political instability deepens, if regional governments and armed movements continue challenging federal authority, or if Abiy’s government eventually faces a major political transition, the nuclear project could become caught in disputes over financing, security, institutional control and national priorities. The nuclear programme itself is not evidence of political instability, nor is there evidence that it is currently unsafe. The issue is whether Ethiopia’s political and institutional environment can sustain such a complex undertaking over the decades required to build and operate a nuclear facility. The Bigger Contradiction Ethiopia is therefore pursuing two very different futures at the same time. One is technological: nuclear power, industrialization, expanded electricity generation and greater energy independence. The other is political: armed conflict, ethnic and regional tensions, competing visions of federal power and an emerging alliance determined to challenge the government in Addis Ababa. The first requires decades of stability. The second threatens to consume the immediate political horizon. Ethiopia’s nuclear ambition may ultimately become one of the country’s most important development projects. But nuclear power cannot resolve the political conflicts now threatening the country’s unity. The decisive question for Abiy Ahmed may therefore be less about whether Ethiopia can enter the nuclear age than whether he can create the political stability necessary for Ethiopia to reach it. A nuclear future requires more than reactors, engineers and billions of dollars. It requires a state stable enough to outlive its political leaders. And that is precisely the uncertainty Ethiopia is confronting today. The key factual distinction is important: the Russia-Ethiopia agreement is an advancing nuclear-power project, not evidence that construction of the first plant has already begun. The September 2025 action plan called for further project development, feasibility work and preparation for a future intergovernmental agreemen Meanwhile, the political-security backdrop has materially deteriorated in September 2026: seven-armed groups have announced an alliance against Abiy’s government, and fighting has spread from Tigray toward Afar and Amhara. items.title: Lafta-gareen oo war yaab leh soo saaray kadib dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen ayaa dowladda Turkiga ku eedeeyay in diyaarado dagaal oo F-16 ah ay duqeymo ka fuliyeen magaalada Baydhabo, xilli dagaal culus uu ka socday magaalada Isniintii. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay xafiiska Lafta-gareen maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 28-ka September ayaa lagu sheegay in lix gantaal lagu garaacay gudaha iyo hareeraha Baydhaba, kuwaas oo sida uu sheegay sababay dhimasho, dhaawac iyo burbur hantiyeed. Lafta-gareen ayaa si toos ah dowladda federaalka iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu eedeeyay mas’uuliyadda weerarrada, isagoo sheegay in diyaaradaha F-16-ka ee Turkiga loo adeegsaday dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay Baydhaba. Waxa uu sidoo kale dowladda federaalka ku eedeeyay inay dooneyso inay curyaamiso awoodda iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaale ee Koonfur Galbeed, inkastoo war-saxaafadeedku uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo madax-bannaan oo muujinaya halka ay gantaalladu ku dhaceen, cidda si toos ah u ridday ama tirada dadka ku dhintay iyo kuwa ku dhaawacmay. Eedeynta ku saabsan diyaaradaha F-16-ka ayaa timid iyadoo warbaahinta AFP ay sheegtay in diyaarado dagaal iyo kuwa aan duuliyaha lahayn loo adeegsaday dagaalkii Baydhaba. Dad deegaanka ah oo AFP la hadlay ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay arkeen ama maqleen duqeymo ay ku tilmaameen kuwo ka yimid diyaarado Turki ah, balse si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin cidda fulisay duqeymahaas. Lafta-gareen ayaa dhinaca kale bogaadiyay maleeshiyadiisa oo uu ugu yeeray ciidamada Daraawiishta, isagoo sheegay inay howlgal ka sameeyeen Baydhaba oo ay kaga hortageen ciidamo ku sugnaa aagagga Salbalaar iyo Afbalaar. Waxa uu sheegay in howlgalkaasi “si guul leh” kusoo dhammaaday, isla markaana khasaaro culus la gaarsiiyay ciidamada ka soo horjeeda. Dowladda federaalka iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ee uu hoggaamiyo Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur Madoobe ayaa iyaguna bixiyay war ka duwan, iyagoo sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay dib u riixeen weerar lagu soo qaaday magaalada. Labada dhinac ayaa sidaas ku kala sheegtay guulo dagaalkii Isniintii. Dagaalka ayaa qarxay aroortii markii ciidamo taageersan Lafta-gareen ay gudaha u galeen qeybo ka mid ah Baydhaba, halkaas oo ay kula dagaallameen ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo kuwa maamulka Sheekh Aadan Madoobe. Madaafiic, rasaas culus iyo qaraxyo ayaa laga maqlayay xaafado badan, kahor inta aysan xaaladdu degin galinkii dambe. Khilaafka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa soo jiitamayay tan iyo markii ciidamada dowladda federaalka ay la wareegeen Baydhaba bishii March, kaddib muran siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeyay dowladda dhexe iyo Lafta-gareen. Lafta-gareen ayaa markii dambe dib u soo nooleeyay sheegashadiisa madaxtinimada, isagoo diiday maamulka Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ee dowladda federaalka aqoonsan tahay. Iska horimaadyo dhowr ah ayaa tan iyo markaas ka dhacay Baydhaba, iyadoo khilaafka siyaasadeed uu si isa soo taraysa ugu wareegayo dagaal hubeysan oo u dhexeeya labada dhinac. The post Lafta-gareen oo war yaab leh soo saaray kadib dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland oo shaacisay in wado qorshe ay maamulka hawada kula wareegayso
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Somaliland ayaa sheegtay inay waddo dadaallo ay ku doonayso inay si buuxda ula wareegto maamulka hawadeeda, iyadoo sidoo kale qorsheyneysa in meesha laga saaro nidaamka dal-ku-galka elektaroonigga ah ee Soomaaliya (e-Visa) ee dadka u safraya Hargeysa. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada Somaliland, Khadar Xuseen Cabdi ayaa sheegay in arrimahan ay xukuumaddu ka waddo dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed iyo kuwo kale oo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo si taxaddar leh oo qarsoodi ah loo maamulayo. Sida uu sheegay wasiirku, Wasaaradda Duulista iyo Horumarinta Madaarrada Somaliland, Fu’aad Axmed Nuur ayaa si gaar ah ugu howlan arrimaha la xiriira duulimaadyada iyo caqabadaha ka taagan maamulka hawada. “Si xikmad leh oo qarsoodi ah ayuu Wasiir Duulista Fu’aad u wadaa hawsha duulimaadyada iyo caqabadaha ka taagan hawada, dhawaana waxa aanu rajaynaynaa inuu guul ka gaadho,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Madaxtooyadda oo la hadlay qaar kamid ah jaaliyadda Somaliland ee ku nool Mareykanka. Khadar ayaa intaas ku daray in Fu’aad Axmed Nuur uu weli ku sugan yahay Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu sheegay inuu ka sii wadi doono hawlaha la xiriira arrinta maamulka hawada iyo caqabadaha Somaliland ay sheegtay inay kala kulanto dhinacyada arrintan ku lugta leh. Hadalkiisa ayuu sidoo kale kusoo qaaday aqoonsigii ay Israa’iil siisay maamulka Somaliland, isagoo sheegay in qaar kamid ah tallaabooyinka diblomaasiyadeed ee xukuumadda aan hore loo shaacin, balse ay soo baxayaan kadib marka la gaaro natiijada laga doonayo. “Waad ogaydeen, aroor qudha uun baa lagu soo toosay aqoonsiga Israa’iil. Waxa la is waydiiyay xaggee bay ka mareen, sirdoonadii ina daba socday sida kuwa Turkiga,” ayuu yiri wasiirka. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada ayaa sheegay in Madaxweyne Cirro uu siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda u maamulo hab uu ku tilmaamay “hanaan qunyar socod ah oo sir ah”, isagoo arrimaha maamulka hawada ku daray dadaallada noocaas ah. Doodda ku saabsan maamulka hawada iyo e-Visa ayaa muddooyinkii dambe kamid ahayd culeysyada uu maamulka Somaliland uu wajahayo, iyadoo xukuumaddu ku doodayso in dadka u safraya Somaliland aan lagu qasbi karin inay dal-ku-gal ka qaataan Soomaaliya, oo ay sheegto inay ka go’day. The post Somaliland oo shaacisay in wado qorshe ay maamulka hawada kula wareegayso appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo sheegtay in dagaal-yahanadii ugu badnaa ay maanta soo weerareen Baydhabo
items.description: Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ka hadashay dagaalka qaraar ee maanta ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo, oo Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) uu sheegtay inay ciidamadiisu weerareen magaaladaasi. Afhayeenka Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, Maxamed Sheekh Cabdullaahi (Xaayow) ayaa sheegay in maleeshiyada Al Shabaab oo keliya ay soo weerareen magaalada, isagoona meesha ka saaray in weerarka ay qayb ka ahaayeen ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Laftagareen. “Nimankii arxanlaaweyaasha ahaa ee Al Shabaab ayaa maanta si argagaxisanimo oo dhab ah magaalada ku soo galay saakay abaare Salaaddii Subax, ayagoo magaalada ku soo galay qaraxyo naf iyo gawaariba leh, isla-markaana drone wax la yiraahdo oo ay wataan la soo galay.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka oo xusay in saddex kun oo Shabaab ah ay weerarka soo qaadeen. “Nimanka maanta Baydhabo soo weeraray ma ahayn niman la saari karo ama la bixin karo. Waxaa lagu qiyaasay ugu yaraan saddex kun oo nin, sida aan xogta la soconay illaa Galgaduud, Hiiraan iyo Bu’aale Shabaabkii joogay baa isku habar wacday oo la soo daldalaayay maalmahaan oo dhan ayaan ogayn.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed oo carabta ku adkeeyay “Ugu yaraan saddex kun oo nin iyo dheeraad ayaa Baydhabo maanta soo galay oo soo weeraray.” Afhayeenka oo BBC la hadlay ayaa intaasi ku daray “Ilaahay baa ka awood badnaa, shacabka Koonfur Galbeed baa ka awood badnaa, Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed iyo Ciidamada Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed baa ka awood badnaa.” Dhanka kale Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga Somaliya ayaa sheegtay in weerar qaraxyo ku bilowdeen ay magaalada ku soo qaadeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab iyo kuwa Laftagareen, oo sida ay sheegtay isku milmay. Wasaaradda ayaa warkan ku sheegtay qoraal lagu daabacay boggeeda internet-ka. Xafiiska Laftagareen ayaa beeniyay eedeyntaasi, iyadoona war uu Laftagareen soo saaray lagu sheegay in weerarka ay qaadeen Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed. Siyaasiyiinta iyo Saraakiisha Koonfur Galbeed ee la safan Laftagareen ayaa Isniintan qaarkood lagu arkay magaalada, intii uu dagaalku ka socday. Weerarkan ayaa u muuqdo mid lagu kediyay maamulka cusub Koonfur Galbeed ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu hoggaamiyo, xilli Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed ay isku diyaarinayeen hawlgal uu ujeedkiisu ahaa in taageereyaasha Laftagareen iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab lagaga sifeeyo deegaanada hoostaga Baydhabo. Tan iyo markii meesha laga saaray maamulkii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ayaa afar jeer weeraray Magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo ay weeraradaasi gaysteen 30-kii bishii May, 17-kii August, 3-dii iyo 28-ka bishan September oo maanta ku beegneyd. Dagaalkan ugu dambeeyay ayaa lagu sheegay kii ugu waqtiga dheeraa ee ka dhaca Baydhabo, marka loo eego saddexdii weerar ay ku lugta lahaayeen ciidamada ka amarka qaata Laftagareen ee ka dhacay magaaladaasi.

items.title: Waa sidee xaaladda Baydhaba kadib dagaalkii saaka?
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Xaaladda magaalada Baydhabo ayaa degan saacado kadib markii uu magaalada ka dhacay dagaal u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda, kuwa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed iyo ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen. Dagaalka ayaa sababay khasaare kala duwan oo isugu jira dhimasho, dhaawac iyo burbur hantiyeed, hase yeeshee tirada rasmiga ah ee khasaaraha weli lama xaqiijin. Wararka laga helayo magaalada ayaa sheegaya in xaaladda amni ay hadda ka wanaagsan tahay sidii ay ahayd xilligii uu dagaalku socday, iyadoo dhaq-dhaqaaqa shacabka uu si tartiib ah dib ugu soo laabanayo. Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku sugan Baydhabo oo isugu jira militariga iyo booliiska iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa howlgallo xaqiijin amni ah wada, waxaana sidoo kale nawaaxiga magaalada lagu arkayaa ciidamada tiro badan. Goobaha muhiimka ah ee magaalada ayaa weli lagu arkayaa ciidamo dheeraad ah, kuwaas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga kadib iska horimaadkii dhacay saaka. Dadka magaalada ayaa bilaabay inay dib ugu laabtaan goobahooda shaqo iyo hawlahooda maalinlaha ah, iyadoo la sugayo faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo kasoo baxda dhinacyada amniga oo ku saabsan dagaalkii dhacay. Inkasta oo xaaladda magaalada ay hadda deggan tahay, haddana waxaa laga cabsi qabaa in mar kale uu qarxo dagaal u dhaxeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Dagaalka maanta ayaa waxaa guullo ka sheegtay dowladda, iyadoo Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ay sheegtay in ciidamadu ay jab culus gaarsiiyeen ragga weerarka soo qaaday oo ay tilmaamtay inay ahaayeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab iyo kuwa Lafta-gareen ee isku milmay, iyadoo soo bandhigtay maydadka xubno la dilay inta uu socday dagaalka. Sidoo kale waxay wasaaraddu sheegtay in ciidamadu ay si geesinimo leh uga hortageen weerarka, isla markaana ay si buuxda ay gacanta ugu hayaan magaalada Baydhaba. items.title: Xildhibaanno Muqdisho ku sugan oo taageero wayn u muujiyay Lafta-gareen
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaanno ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya oo maanta la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa taageero wayn u muujiyay Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo mar kale ciidamadiisa ay saaka weerar kusoo qaadeen Baydhaba, halkaas oo uu ka dhacay dagaal ay la galeen ciidamada dowladda. Xildhibaannadan oo laga soo doorto Koonfur Galbeed ayaa garab istaagay madaxweyne Lafta-gareen iyo kooxdiisa ee haatan dagaalka kula jira Aadan Madoobe iyo xukuumaddiisa, waxayna dhanka kale eedeymo u jeediyeen Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Aadan Lafta-gareen oo kamid ah xildhibaannada hadlay ayaa si weyn u difaacay walaalkiis, wuxuuna tilmaamay in aanu argagixiso ahayn ee uu u dagaalamaya xaqa Koonfur Galbeed. Waxaa kale oo uu meesha ka saaray in diyaarado ay u adeegsadeen weerarkii Baydhaba. “Waxaa magaalada soo weeraray ciidankii dowladda Koonfur Galbeed oo duuulaanka horay loogu qaaday ayaa dib usoo noqday, diyaaradaha iyaga ma wadan waxaa watay niman xildhibaanno ah oo Koonfur Galbeed ka tirsan oo dhibaatada meesha ka wado,” ayuu yiri Aadan Lafta-gareen. Sidoo kale Xildhibaan Maxamed Xasan Maxamed (Murjaan) ayaa tilmaamay ciidamada Lafta-gareen ay yihiin kuwa xaq-u-dirir ah oo u dagaalamaya inay xoreeyaan deegaankooda, isla markaana ujeedkooda uu yahay inay soo celiyaan nidaamkii sharciga ahaa, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Meel ay Shabaab soo weerartay ma arkin, laakiin ciidamo xaq-u-dirir ah oo dagaalamaayo ayaa la’ii sheegay inay weerarka soo qaadeen hadda waxaa maqlaayay waxaa la kiciyay F-16 meesha shacab ayaa la leynayaa,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Maxamed Xasan Murjaan. Dhankeeda Xildhibaan Maryan Macallin oo Baydhaba laga soo doortay ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dagaalka ka socda Koonfur Galbeed uu yahay mid loo soo xawilay, isla markaana lagu burburinayo jiritaankooda, sida ay hadalka u dhigtay. “Annagu argagixiso ma arkin dadka waxaas leh waxay ka shaqeynayaan burburka Koonfur Galbeed waa kuwa dagaalka qaybta ka ah. Jiriraankeenna ayaa la diidan yahay gobollada kale waxaa la leeyahay maxaa ku mac, maxaase ku qaaraar?” ayay tiri Xildhibaan Maryan Macallin. items.title: Xogta shir muhiim ah oo Soomaaliya ku guddoomisay Nairobi, kaasi oo lagu ansixiyay…
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Maaliyadda Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Biixi Imaan Cige ayaa maanta shir Guddoomiyay kulanka 29-aad ee Madasha Iskaashiga Dalalka Geeska Afrika. Kulanka waxaa ka qayb-galay qaar ka mid ah Wasiirrada dalalka ku bahoobay madasha, wakiillo ka socday dowladaha deeq-bixiyeyaasha iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin Bangiga Adduunka, Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika, IGAD iyo Midowga Yurub. Shirka oo ahaa kulan hal maalin ah ayaa diiradda lagu saaray horumarinta is-dhexgalka gobolka, xoojinta iskaashiga iyo maalgelinta mudnaanta dhaqaale ee dalalka Geeska Afrika. Waxaa si gaar ah xoogga loo saaray horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, gaar ahaan korontada, biyaha iyo waddooyinka isku xira dalalka ku bahoobay madashaan. Intii uu socday kulanka, waxaa sidoo kale lagu ansixiyay qorshe-hawleedka horumarinta ganacsiga Geeska Afrika, kaas oo ay hore u diyaariyeen Wasiirrada Ganacsiga ee dalalka ku bahoobay Hindisaha Geeska Afrika. Qorshaha ayaa ka dhashay kulankii Wasiirrada Ganacsiga ee Madashani oo bishii Agoosto 2026 lagu qabtay magaalada Addis Ababa ee dalka Itoobiya. Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya ayaa uga mahadceliyay dowladaha ku mideysan Madasha Hindisaha Geeska Afrika iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah taageerada muhiimka si joogto ah u siiya hindisahan, gaar ahaan kaalintooda ku aaddan horumarinta, iskaashiga iyo maalgelinta mashaariicda muhiimka u ah dalalka Geeska Afrika. Kulanka 29-aad ayaa sidoo kale xoojisay muhiimadda ay leedahay in dalalka gobolka iyo saaxiibadooda caalamiga ah ay sii xoojiyaan iskaashiga, si loo dardargeliyo mashaariicda gobolka iyo horumarinta fursadaha dhaqaale ee Geeska Afrika. The post Xogta shir muhiim ah oo Soomaaliya ku guddoomisay Nairobi, kaasi oo lagu ansixiyay… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay khasaraha nafeed ee dagaalka Baydhabo uu gaystay
items.description: Warar dheeraad ah ayaa ka soo baxaya khasaaraha nafeed ee uu gaystay dagaalka culus ee maanta ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, ka dib markii ay weerar ballaaran ku soo qaadeen ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ciidamadaasi kula dagaalamay xaafadaha magaalada. Ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ayaana la sheegay in markii ugu horreysay ay magaalada ku soo weerareen diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Ugu yaraan 21 qof oo isugu jira dhinacyadii dagaalamay iyo dad rayid ah ayaa ku dhintay dagaalka, halka tobanaan kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen, sida laga soo xigtay ilaha caafimaadka ee magaalada. Mashquul badan ayaa laga soo sheegaya Isbitaal Goboleedka Baay oo sidoo kale loo yaqaano (Isbitaalka Weyn ee Baydhabo), halkaas oo la geeyay dhaawacyada ugu badan. Gaari laga soo buuxiyay walxaha qarxa oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday Hotel RB ayaa la sheegay in uu ka dhashay khasaaraha ugu badan ee hal goob ah. Dagaalkan ayaa lagu sheegay kii ugu waqtiga dheeraa ee ka dhaca Magaalada Baydhabo, marka loo eego weeraradii ay horey magaaladaasi uga gaysteen ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen. Dagaalka Isniintan ka dhacay Baydhabo oo bilowday xilligii Salaadda Subax ayaa soo geba-gaboobay abaarihii 1-da duhurnimo.
