Crisis Group ayaa horey uga hadashay halista colaadaha Itoobiya, gaar ahaan xiisadaha ka jira gobollada waqooyiga dalka.

items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo Tababar u Soo Xiray Dufcaddii 12-aad ee Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab
items.description: Muqdisho, 28 Sebteembar 2026: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa tababar ugu soo xiray Dugsiga Tababarka Shahiid G/le Xasan Tuure dufcaddii 12-aad ee Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab. Ciidanka dufcaddan ayaa muddadii tababarka lagu baray xeerka ciqaabta, xuquuqda aadanaha, xirfadaha caafimaadka iyo isgaarsiinta, cilad-bixinta hubka iyo xeeladaha dagaalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha oo ay wehliyaan Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa ciidanka ku bogaadiyey dadaalka iyo adkaysiga ay muujiyeen muddadii tababarka, isaga oo kula dardaarmay inay aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay barteen ugu adeegaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana ay ka shaqeeyaan difaaca dalka. Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in Xukuumadda DanQaran ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso dhismaha iyo tayeynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, si loo helo ciidan leh tababar, tayo iyo awood ay ku gutaan waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee loo igmaday. Waxa uu sidoo kale ciidanka cusub kula dardaarmay inay ilaaliyaan sharciga, kuna sifoobaan waddaniyad, daacadnimo iyo u heellanaanta difaaca dalka. Munaasabadda xiritaanka tababarka ayaa lagu soo bandhigay xirfadaha iyo aqoonta ciidan ee ay barteen dufcadda 12-aad ee Kumaandooska Danab, kuwaas oo loo diyaariyey gudashada waajibaadka qaran ee la xiriira difaaca dalka, sugidda amniga iyo la-dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada ah.

items.title: DF oo maydad soo bandhigtay kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Gaashaanshigga Soomaaliya ayaa faah-faahin hordhac ah ka bixisay dagaalka ka socda magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay, kaas oo u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-areen). Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadu ay jab culus gaarsiiyeen ragga weerarka soo qaaday oo ay tilmaamtay inay ahaayeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab iyo kuwa Lafta-gareen ee isku milmay, iyada oo soo bandhigtay maydadka xubno la dilay inta uu socday dagaalka. Sidoo kale waxaa qoraalka lagu sheegay in ciidamadu ay si geesinimo leh uga hortageen weerarka, isla markaana ay si buuxda ay gacanta ugu hayaan magaalada Baydhaba. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo ka hadlay dagaalka Baydhaba ayaa sheegay in la jabiyay maleeshiyaadka weerarka soo qaaday, isaga oo boggaadiyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Birmadka ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. “Mataanihii Argagixisada ee saakay soo weeraray Baydhabo jab xooggan ayaa dhabarka loo saaray,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Axmed Macallin oo qoraal kooban ku daabacay Facebook-giisa. Si kastaba, Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, iyadoo wararkii ugu dambeeyay ayaa sheegayaan in weli dagaalka uu socda, isla markaana ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen ay ka dhex-dagaalayamaan Masaajida Carabta iyo Jaamaca oo labaduba ku yaalla agagaarka Afar irdoodka Baydhaba. The post DF oo maydad soo bandhigtay kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Itoobiya Oo Eritrea Ku Eedeysay Iny Toos Uga Qeyb-qaadanayso Dagaallada Ka Socda Canfarta.
items.description: Waxaa sii xoogaystay dagaallada culus ee ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya, kaas oo u dhaxeeya ciidanka Xabshida Itoobiya iyo

Aabbe 13 Sano Carruurtiisu U Haysteen Inuu Dhintay isaga oo la jooga Suuriya waxaa ka dhacday qiso murugo badan oo muujinaysa raadadka culus ee cabsi iyo cabudhin ay qofka ku reebi karaan. Nin Suuriyaan ah ayaa muddo in ka badan 13 sano ku noolaa meel aad u cidhiidhi ah oo uu ku dhex qariyay gurigiisa, isagoo ka baqayay in la qabto oo xabsiga loo taxaabo xilligii xukuumaddii Bashaar Al-Asad. Ninku bannaanka uma soo bixi jirin. Cuntada, biyaha, dharka iyo daawada waxaa si qarsoodi ah ugu keeni jirtay xaaskiisa, iyadoo waxyaabahaas uga soo gudbinaysay dalool yar oo derbiga ku yaallay. Meeshaas cidhiidhiga ah ayuu ku cuni jiray, ku tukan jiray, kuna seexan jiray. Laakiin waxa ugu murugada badnaa waxay ahayd in carruurtiisu ay guriga kula noolaayeen, haddana aysan garanayn in aabbahood uu derbi gadaashiisa nool yahay. Si carruurtu aysan si kama’ ah u fashilin sirta, hooyadood waxay u sheegtay in aabbahood uu dhintay. Sannado badan ayuu ninku maqli jiray codadka carruurtiisa, qosolkooda iyo ciyaartooda, isagoo dhowr tallaabo oo keliya u jira, balse aan awoodin inuu u soo baxo, la hadlo ama laabta ku qaado. Carruurtiisu waxay u haysteen inuu dhintay, halka uu isagu maalin kasta maqli jiray iyaga oo nool. Wax walba waxay is beddeleen markii uu dhacay nidaamkii Bashaar Al-Asad dhammaadkii 2024. Markii uu ogaaday in xukunkii uu ka baqayay uu burburay, ninkii 13-ka sano ku dhuumanayay gidaarka gadaashiisa ayaa ugu dambayn ka soo baxay meesha uu noloshiisa ku aasnaa. Carruurtiina waxaa loo sheegay runta: aabbahood ma dhiman — wuu noolaa, wuxuuna sannado badan ku jiray gurigooda dhexdiisa. Markii ay arkeen, waxaa dib loo soo celiyay kulan ay noloshu muddo dheer ka xayuubisay. 13 sano ayuu derbi gadaashiis ku noolaa, laakiin waxa uu ugu adkaa ma ahayn cidhiidhiga meesha uu ku dhuumanayay; waxa ugu xanuunka badnaa waxay ahayd inuu maqli jiray carruurtiisa isaga oo aan awoodin inuu yiraahdo: “Aabbihiin waan ahay.” Qisadani waxay noqotay mid ka mid ah sheekooyinka xanuun By Maxamed Cadde

items.title: Ciidamo ku biiraya Kumaandooska Danab oo tababar loo soo xiray (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Raysal Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka, Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta ciidamo cusub tababar ugu soo xiray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Gaashaanle Xasan Tuure (Ex Ballidoogle) ee Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose. Ciidamadan oo ku biiraya Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay dufcaddii 12aad ee Danab ee tababar loogu soo xiro dugsigaasi. “Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ayaa la baray xeerka ciqaabta, xuquuqda aadanaha, xirfado kala duwan oo caafimaadka iyo isgaarsiinta ka mid tahay, cilad bixinta hubka iyo xeeladaha dagaalka ee tabaha kala duwan ah.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Xafiiska Raysal Wasaaraha. Raysal Wasaaraha ayaa ciidamada ku bogaadiyay dadaalka iyo adkaysiga ay muujiyeen muddadii ay ku jireen tababarka, sida lagu sheegay warka, waxaana uu kula dardaarmay in aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay barteen ugu adeegaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo difaaca dalkooda. “Waxa uu sidoo kale ku booriyay ciidanka cusub in ay ilaaliyaan sharcjga, ayna noqdaan kuwo ku suntan waddaniyad, daacadnimo iyo u heelanaanta difaaca dalka, si looga guuleysto kooxaha Khawaarijta ah iyo cid walba oo dalkooda u diidan nabadda iyo horumarka ay u baahan yihiin shacabka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa dhanka kale lagu sheegay “Intii ay socotay munaasabadda ayaa lagu soo bandhigay xirfadaha iyo aqoonta ciidan ee ay muddada tababarka ku qaateen ciidanka ka tirsan dufcaddan, kuwaas oo loo diyaariyay gudashada waajibaadka qaran ee ku aaddan difaaca dalka, sugidda amniga iyo la dagaalanka kooxaha argagixisada ah ee diidan nabadda iyo dowladnimada Somaliya.” Raysal Wasaare Barre ayaa waxaa munaasabadda ku wehlinayay Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud. Somaliya oo sida la sheegay wajaheysa ciidamo yari ayaa diiradda saareysa tababarka ciidamada, si loo helo cutubyo cusub oo buuxiya kaalinta ciidan yarida.

items.title: At UN, Algeria says Israel seeks to divide Somalia, violates Gaza ceasefire
items.description: Algerian Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf on Monday said Israel is seeking to divide Somalia, attacking Syria and Lebanon, and failing to uphold the Gaza ceasefire agreement. Addressing the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York, Attaf said Israel continued to kill Palestinian civilians despite the ceasefire in Gaza, which has been in effect since October 2025. He reaffirmed Algeria’s support for the Palestinian people’s right to establish “an independent, fully sovereign state with Jerusalem as its capital.” Attaf also condemned Israel’s “continued attacks” in Syria and Lebanon and its “efforts to divide Somalia.” Turning to wider international affairs, Attaf warned of mounting crises and declining trust between states, saying the use of force was again taking precedence over consensus. He called for reform of the UN, saying it had become necessary in light of profound global changes and the need for a more just and representative international system. On the Gulf, Attaf said Algeria was following the escalation there with concern and urged steps to reduce tensions to preserve regional security and stability. Anadolu .

items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo shaaca ka qaaday magacyada ragga hoggaaminayay weerarkii…
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Afhayeenka Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Sheekh Cabdullaahi(Xaayow) oo shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Baydhaba ayaa ka warbixiyay dagaalka ka socda magaaladaasi, kaas oo dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda, kuwa Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed iyo ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen. Xaayow ayaa sheegay in weerarka ay soo qaadeen maleeshiyaad Al-Shabaab oo doonaya inay carqaladeeyaan ammaanka Baydhaba, isagoo sheegay in cashir lama filaan ah loo dhigay. Sidoo kale wuxuu soo bandhigay magacyada horjoogayaal Al-Shabaab oo uu sheegay inay hoggaaminayeen weerarka saaka lagu qaaday caasimada KMG ah ee Koonfur Galbeed. “Saaka waxaa magaalada soo weeraray naf-lacaarayaashii iyo nabad-diidayaashii Al-Shabaab, iyagoo rabitaankoodii gurracnaa raba inay ummaddaas ku carqaladeeyaan iyo nabadda magaalada arbushaad iyo xumaana inay ka abuuraan, iyaga oo ay hoggaaminayeen niman waa wan oo Shabaab Amiiradoodii ah oo la yiraahdo Macallin Saalax, Jaylaani nin la yaraahdo, Guuleed iyo Xasan Yacquub oo deegaannadan u dhashay,” ayuu yiri afhayeenka Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale wuxuu sii raaciyay “Ilaahey mahaddii cashir ayaa loo dhigay geesiyaasha ciidamada qalabka sida dhammaantood iyo ciidanka Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed waxay u dhigeen cashir lama ilawaan ah. Dadweynaha waxaan u sheegeynaa is dajiya xaaladda magaalada waa nabad”. Afhayeenka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sidoo kale xusay in saacadaha soo socda ay faah-faahin dheeraad ah ka bixin doonaan dagaalka ayna soo bandhigi doonaan khasaaraha la gaarsiiyay ragga weerarka soo qaaday iyo maxaabiista ay gacanta ku dhigeen. Dhinaca kale, afhayeen u hadlay kooxda Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ayaa isna guul ka sheegtay dagaalka, wuxuuna tilmaamay in ciidamadooda ay gudaha u galeen magaalada, welina uu socda howlgalka, isaga oo shacabka ugu baaqay inay ku sugnaadaan guryahooda. “Guusha waa dhowdahay magaalada Baydhaba iyo Koonfur Galbeed dhammaanteedba gacanteenna ayay mardhow soo geli doontaa haddii Ilaahey idmo,” ayuu isna yiri Ugaas Xasan. Dagaalka Baydhaba ayaa soo noq-noqday bilihii ugu dambeeyay, wuxuuna saameyn wayn ku yeeshay ammaanka guud ee magaaladaas oo ay horay uga dhaceen doorashooyin ay dowladda dhexe ka qabatay Koonfur Galbeed, laguna soo doortay Sheekh Aadan Madoobe. Sidoo kale wuxuu soo bandhigay magacyada horjoogayaal Al-Shabaab oo uu sheegay inay hoggaaminayeen weerarka saaka lagu qaaday caasimada KMG ah ee Koonfur Galbeed. “Saaka waxaa magaalada soo weeraray naf-lacaarayaashii iyo nabad-diidayaashii Al-Shabaab, iyagoo rabitaankoodii gurracnaa raba inay ummaddaas ku carqaladeeyaan iyo nabadda magaalada arbushaad iyo xumaana inay ka abuuraan, iyaga oo ay hoggaaminayeen niman waa wan oo Shabaab Amiiradoodii ah oo la yiraahdo Macallin Saalax, Jaylaani nin la yaraahdo, Guuleed iyo Xasan Yacquub oo deegaannadan u dhashay,” ayuu yiri afhayeenka Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale wuxuu sii raaciyay “Ilaahey mahaddii cashir ayaa loo dhigay geesiyaasha ciidamada qalabka sida dhammaantood iyo ciidanka Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed waxay u dhigeen cashir lama ilawaan ah. Dadweynaha waxaan u sheegeynaa is dajiya xaaladda magaalada waa nabad”. Afhayeenka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sidoo kale xusay in saacadaha soo socda ay faah-faahin dheeraad ah ka bixin doonaan dagaalka ayna soo bandhigi doonaan khasaaraha la gaarsiiyay ragga weerarka soo qaaday iyo maxaabiista ay gacanta ku dhigeen. Dhinaca kale, afhayeen u hadlay kooxda Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ayaa isna guul ka sheegtay dagaalka, wuxuuna tilmaamay in ciidamadooda ay gudaha u galeen magaalada, welina uu socda howlgalka, isaga oo shacabka ugu baaqay inay ku sugnaadaan guryahooda. “Guusha waa dhowdahay magaalada Baydhaba iyo Koonfur Galbeed dhammaanteedba gacanteenna ayay mardhow soo geli doontaa haddii Ilaahey idmo,” ayuu isna yiri Ugaas Xasan. Dagaalka Baydhaba ayaa soo noq-noqday bilihii ugu dambeeyay, wuxuuna saameyn wayn ku yeeshay ammaanka guud ee magaaladaas oo ay horay uga dhaceen doorashooyin ay dowladda dhexe ka qabatay Koonfur Galbeed, laguna soo doortay Sheekh Aadan Madoobe. Somali Lawmakers Back Laftagareen as Baidoa Crisis Deepens
items.description: MOGADISHU—Several members of Somalia’s House of the People have publicly voiced their support for former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen, following renewed clashes in Baidoa between forces loyal to him and forces aligned with the Federal Government. The lawmakers, who represent constituencies in South West State, defended Laftagareen and his supporters while accusing the federal government of contributing to the escalating political and security tensions in the region. Aadan Laftagareen, a member of parliament and brother of the former South West State president, rejected allegations that his brother and his forces were linked to terrorism. He said Laftagareen was defending what he described as the rights and interests of the people of South West State. Aadan also disputed reports that Laftagareen’s forces had used aircraft during the latest fighting in Baidoa. He instead accused other lawmakers from South West State of contributing to the escalation. “The forces that attacked the city were South West State forces that had previously been attacked and later returned,” Aadan said, without providing evidence to support his account. Another South West State lawmaker, Mohamed Hassan Mohamed Murjaan, described forces loyal to Laftagareen as “fighters for justice” and said they were seeking to reclaim their territory and restore what he referred to as the legitimate constitutional order. “I have not seen an area attacked by Al-Shabaab,” Murjaan said, while claiming that civilians were being affected by the fighting. He also referred to reports that F-16 fighter jets had been deployed, a claim that could not be independently verified. Maryan Moallin, a lawmaker representing Baidoa, similarly rejected claims that the clashes were linked to an Al-Shabaab assault. She described the conflict as part of a broader effort to undermine the political and institutional standing of South West State. “We have not seen terrorists,” Maryan said, accusing those making such claims of contributing to what she described as the destabilization of South West State. The lawmakers’ statements come amid escalating tensions between federal authorities, South West State officials and supporters of Laftagareen. The competing accounts of the fighting, including claims concerning the identity of the forces involved and the alleged use of military aircraft, remain unverified. items.title: Iiraan oo cabasho u gudbisay ICAO, maxayse ku sheegeen?
items.description: Iiraan oo cabasho u gudbisay ICAO, maxayse ku sheegeen? Madaxa Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Iiraan ayaa sheegay inuu cabasho rasmi ah u gudbiyay Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Duulista Rayidka (ICAO), isagoo ka jawaabaya xannibaadaha lagu soo rogay warshadaha duulista ee Iiraan. Abuzar Shiroudi ayaa wakaaladda wararka IRNA u sheegay in cabashada rasmiga ah lagu caddeeyay “dukumentiyada iyo caddeymaha Iiraan ee ku saabsan carqaladaynta hawlaha duulimaadyada.” Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in “weerarrada lagu qaado garoomada diyaaradaha, diyaaradaha iyo raadaarrada ay yihiin tusaale cad oo ka mid ah dambiyada dagaalka, marka loo eego sharciga iyo xeerarka caalamiga ah,” isagoo intaas ku daray in Iiraan ay arrintan la xiriirta cabasho kale u gudbisay maxkamadda Hague. Wuxuu yidhi: “Marka laga hadlayo weerarrada iyo duqeymaha lagu qaado garoomada diyaaradaha iyo diyaaradaha, ururka caalamiga ah ee ICAO wuxuu Iiraan siiyay xaqa ay arrintan uga cabanayso. Hase yeeshee, kiisaska ayaa hadda horyaalla maxkamadda Hague, mana jirto wax natiijo ah oo weli naloo soo sheegay. Sidoo kale, in Iiraan ay xaq u yeelan doonto magdhow iyo in kale waxay ku xirnaan doontaa go’aanka maxkamadda Hague.” Tan iyo toddobaadkii hore, markii la dhaqan geliyay cunaqabateyn Mareykanku saaray shirkadaha diyaaradaha ee Iiraan, garoomo diyaaradeed oo ku yaalla dalal kala duwan ayaa joojiyay duulimaadyadii ay sameyn jireen shirkadaha Iiraan. Ciraaq, Georgia, Imaaraadka Carabta, Jamhuuriyadda Azerbaijan iyo Cumaan, kuwaas oo ahaa meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay u safraan Iiraaniyiintu iyo duulimaadyada transit-ka ah ee ku sii jeeda Yurub iyo Mareykanka, ayaa joojiyay duulimaadyadii Iiraan kadib cadaadis uga yimid Mareykanka. Wakaaladda wararka Fars ayaa sheegtay in shirkadaha diyaaradaha ee Iiraan ay wadahadallo kula jiraan dhinacyo kala duwan sidii loo furi lahaa waddooyin cusub oo duulimaad.

items.title: Baidoa at the Brink: Federal Force Risks Turning Political Crisis into a War
items.description: As Laftagareen Forces Push into Baidoa, Mogadishu Faces a Choice: Reconciliation or a Battle It May Not Be Able to Control BAIDOA (WDN) — Heavy fighting erupted in Baidoa on Monday as forces loyal to former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen clashed with federal and South West forces, sending residents into their homes and pushing the city closer to a potentially prolonged political war. The fighting is the latest and most serious escalation in a dispute that has been building for months. Local reports said Laftagareen-aligned forces entered parts of Baidoa, while federal and South West forces defended their positions. Both sides claimed military gains, but the battlefield situation and casualty figures remained unclear. The South West administration and the Federal Government described the attackers as armed groups and repeated allegations of links to Al-Shabaab. Laftagareen’s camp, meanwhile, presented the fighting as part of its campaign to regain control of Baidoa. Neither side’s competing claims have been independently verified. A Political Dispute That Has Become a Military Confrontation What began as a political struggle over the leadership and future of South West State has increasingly become a confrontation between armed Somali forces. Federal forces took control of Baidoa in March, after which Laftagareen resigned. A federal-backed administration led by Sheikh Adan Mohamed Nur Madobe subsequently emerged. Laftagareen and his supporters rejected the new political arrangement. Since then, the city has repeatedly been drawn into armed clashes. Fighting on August 17 was followed by another major confrontation on September 3. On that occasion, the Associated Press reported that Bay Regional Hospital received 24 wounded people and one civilian who died, while residents described heavy gunfire and civilians fleeing affected neighbourhoods. Monday’s fighting shows that the confrontation has not been contained. The Risk Mogadishu May Be Creating for Itself The Federal Government now faces a difficult choice. It can continue treating the dispute primarily as a security problem and attempt to defeat Laftagareen’s forces militarily—or it can pursue a political settlement aimed at removing the conflict from the battlefield. The first approach carries a serious risk. Laftagareen’s forces have repeatedly demonstrated their ability to return to the fight and penetrate areas around or inside Baidoa. Their supporters describe themselves as fighting to restore their political authority and remove federal forces from the city. In August, a spokesman for the former South West president explicitly said their campaign would continue until federal forces were expelled from Baidoa. That means every additional military confrontation could deepen local grievances, widen the conflict and make reconciliation more difficult. A federal military victory in Baidoa may therefore prove far easier to declare than to sustain. Could Force Ultimately Hand Baidoa Back to Laftagareen? The most important question is what happens after the fighting. Even if federal and South West forces succeed in holding government positions today, they still face a political constituency supporting Laftagareen and armed forces capable of returning to the battlefield. A prolonged confrontation could gradually transform the dispute from a struggle over political leadership into a broader conflict involving communities, clans and competing claims to legitimacy. That is precisely the scenario Somalia’s political leadership should seek to prevent. An extended war in Baidoa could also divert federal security forces from the fight against Al-Shabaab, expose civilians to greater danger and threaten humanitarian operations in a city that serves as a major humanitarian hub for people displaced by conflict and drought. Reconciliation Is the Alternative The Federal Government has a political alternative: reconciliation before escalation becomes irreversible. BREAKING NEWS: Southwest Reconciliation Efforts Gain Momentum as Laftagareen Signals Path Toward Political Settlement – WardheerNews   an opportunity my good friend President Hassan refused even to consider – very sad indeed. That would require direct negotiations with Laftagareen and other South West stakeholders, guarantees for civilian protection, agreement on the status of security forces and a political framework for determining the legitimate leadership and future administration of the state. Such a process would not mean accepting every demand made by Laftagareen’s camp. Nor would it require abandoning the federal government’s position. It would mean recognising a basic political reality: a dispute that has repeatedly returned to the battlefield cannot be permanently solved by military deployments alone. The African Union and other international partners also face a test. They can help facilitate a political process rather than becoming drawn into a domestic struggle over who controls Baidoa. Previous analysis has already warned that the crisis risks escalating into a wider conflict and has raised concerns about the neutrality of international security actors. Baidoa Does Not Need Another War The latest fighting should therefore be treated as a warning, not simply another military episode. Every hour of fighting makes reconciliation harder. Every civilian forced to hide in a home deepens public fear. Every soldier killed narrows the political space for compromise. And if the Federal Government continues to rely primarily on military force, it risks creating the very outcome it is trying to prevent: a prolonged conflict in which Laftagareen’s forces gain greater political momentum by presenting themselves as the force resisting federal control. Baidoa cannot be permanently secured by defeating one side on the battlefield. It can only be stabilised through a political settlement that gives its people a stake in the future of their city and state. For Mogadishu, the choice is increasingly stark: reconciliation now, or risk turning Baidoa into a war that neither side can easily end. items.title: Sawirro: Xamza oo tababar u soo xiray ciidamo ku biiraya…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre, oo ay weheliyaan Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa maanta tababar u soo xiray ciidamo cusub oo ku biiraya Kumaandoosta Danab ee Xoogga Dalka, kuwaasi oo si gaar ah loo baray cilad-bixinta hubka iyo xeelaha dagaalka. Munaasabadda tababarka lagu soo xirayay ayaa lagu qabtay Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidanka ee Ballidoogle ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, taas oo horay loogu magac daray Shahiid Gaashaanle Xasan Tuure, waxaana ka qaybgalay qaar ka mid ah taliyayaasha ciidanka, macallimiintii bixiyey tababarka iyo saraakiil ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamza Cabdi Barre oo madasha ka hadlay ayaa ciidanka kula dardaarmay inay kaalin muuqata ka qaataan dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo soo celinta xasilloonida dalka. Wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ay laf-dhabar u yihiin hawlgallada lagu ciribtirayo kooxaha argagixisada ah iyo kuwa caqabad ku ah dowladnimada Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ciidanka faray inay ilaaliyaan midnimada dalka, sharciga iyo karaamada shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isagoo xusay in guusha laga gaarayo dagaalka ay ku xiran tahay isku-xirnaanta hay’adaha dowladda, ciidamada iyo shacabka. Dhankiisa Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa ciidanka ugu hambalyeeyay dhammaystirka tababarka, isagoo sheegay in askarigu uusan kaliya ahayn qof dagaal gala, balse uu yahay masuul qaadaya waajibka ilaalinta qaranka iyo shacabka. Fiqi ayaa sidoo kale kula dardaarmay ciidanka inay ku dhaqmaan anshaxa iyo shuruucda ciidanka, ayna muujiyaan daacadnimo, feejignaan iyo masuuliyad marka ay gudanayaan waajibaadkooda. Wuxuu sidoo kale ku adkeeyay inay ilaaliyaan sharafta iyo sumcadda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa isna dhankiisa sheegay in xoogga la saaray kor u qaadista tayada ciidanka, gaar ahaan tababarka iyo horumarinta xirfadaha ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran. Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed ayaa intaas ku daray in dufcaddan oo ah tii 12-aad ee Danab ay heshay tababar u suurtagelinaya gudashada waajibaadyo ciidan oo culus, isagoo ku boorriyay ciidanka inay aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay heleen u beddelaan karti iyo waxqabad muuqda oo ay uga adeegaan dalka. Munaasabadda ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo bandhigay xirfadaha iyo aqoonta ay ciidamadu ku barteen muddadii uu socday tababarku, iyadoo ay muujiyeen heerka xirfadda ciidan ee ay gaareen iyo diyaar-garowgooda ku aaddan ka qaybqaadashada hawlgallada lagu soo afjarayo kooxaha argagixisada ah iyo kuwa ka soo horjeeda dowladnimada Soomaaliya. items.title: Dhibaatada uu Barakacu Leeyahay
items.description: Barakacu wuxuu ka mid yahay dhibaatooyinka ugu waaweyn ee ay bulshada Soomaaliyeed la daalaadhacayso, nolosha dadkana saamayn weyn ku yeeshay. Qayb badan oo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ka mid ahi waa dad sabool ah; noloshooduna waxay ku tiirsan tahay xoolaha, beeraha, kalluunka iyo ganacsiyo yaryar. Iyada oo ay sidaas tahay, waxaa mararka qaar dhaca abaaro iyo dhibaatooyin kale oo dadka ku qasba inay raadsadaan degaan ay ku noolaadaan. Halkaas waxaa ku luma ilihii ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd, sida beerihii iyo xoolihii ay dhaqan jireen. Barakacu waa in qof ama bulsho duruufo adag, sida colaad, abaar ama faqrinnimo, awgeed uga guuro degaankii uu ku noolaa. Dadka gudaha ku barakacay waxay u guuraan degaan kale oo dalkooda ku yaalla, iyaga oo aan ka tallaabin soohdinta dalka ( Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (2012)). Barakacayaashu inta badan waa dad lagu qasbay, ama ay lagama maarmaan u noqotay, inay ka guuraan guryahoodii iyo degaannadoodii. Tusaale ahaan, dadka barakacayaasha ah ee magaalada Muqdisho ku nool waxaa ka mid ah dad ka soo barakacay degaannada kale ee dalka iyo dad ku barakacay isla magaalada gudaheeda. Dhibaatooyinka Soomaaliya haysta waxaa ka mid ah barakaca baahsan ee dadka ka kaxeeya degaannadii ay ku noolaayeen. Sida ay sheegeen hay’adaha UNHCR, UNDP iyo IOM, barakaca gudaha Soomaaliya waxa uu inta badan ka dhashaa laba arrimood oo is biirsaday: amnidarrada iyo isbeddelka cimilada. Dagaallada siyaasadeed ee mararka qaar dhaca iyo dagaal beeleedyadu waxay dhaawacaan nolosha bulshada, dadkana ku qasbaan inay guuraan. Sababaha waaweyn ee barakaca waxaa kale oo ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada: fatahaadaha webiyada, abaaraha daran, xoolaha oo biyo la’aan u dhinta, waxsoosaarka beeraha oo yaraada iyo roobabka mahiigaanka ah. Dhibaatooyinkaas ayaa sababa in kumannaan qof ay ka barakacaan degaannadooda, gaar ahaan gobollada ay webiyadu maraan. Sidoo kale, barakacu waxa uu ka dhalan karaa dillaaca cudurrada faafa, sida shuban-biyoodka iyo cagaarshowga. Gobollada iyo Meelaha ay Dadku u Barakacaan Dadka gudaha ku barakacay waxay inta badan u guuraan magaalooyinka waaweyn si ay u helaan amni, gargaar iyo nolol ay ku tiirsanaadaan. Marka dhibaatooyinkaas ay qabsadaan, waxay badanaa u barakacaan meelaha ugu dhow ama degaanno ay filayaan inay nolol ka heli karaan. Meelaha ay barakacayaashu ku badan yihiin waxaa ka mid ah: Banaadir (Muqdisho): Waa gobolka martigeliya barakacayaal badan. Waxay deggan yihiin degmooyinka iyo degaannada magaalada daafaheeda ah, sida Dayniile, Garasbaaley iyo Kaxda. Baay (Baydhabo): Magaalada Baydhabo waxay ka mid tahay meelaha ay isugu yimaadaan dadka ka soo barakaca gobollada deriska ah. Waxaa, sidoo kale, ka hawlgala hay’ado bixiya gargaar iyo adeegyo bani’aadannimo. Gedo (Luuq iyo Doolow): Degaannada gobolka qaarkood waxaa ka jira barakac ay sababaan abaaraha iyo dagaallada u dhexeeya beelaha wada dega. Isku dhacyada ku saabsan qaybsiga khayraadka degaanka ayaa mararka qaar colaadda sii hurinaya. Gobollada Dhexe (Galgaduud iyo Mudug): Waxaa ka jira barakac ka dhasha dagaallada iyo abaaraha, iyo sidoo kale colaadaha u dhexeeya ciidamada iyo al-Shabaab. Hiiraan: Fatahaadaha webiga Shabeelle ayaa saameeya degaannada gobolka. Marka webigu fataho, biyuhu waxay gaaraan magaalooyin iyo degaanno kale, dadkiina waxay ku qasbanaadaan inay ka barakacaan guryahooda. Tirakoobka Barakaca ka Jira Soomaaliya Sida lagu sheegay xogta uu qoraalkani xiganayo, sannadkii 2025 qiyaastii 3.5 ilaa 4 milyan oo qof ayaa gudaha Soomaaliya ku barakacsanaa. Dabayaaqadii 2025 iyo bilowgii 2026, waxaa la soo wariyay in ku dhowaad 211,000 oo qof ay ka barakaceen degaannadoodii; 64% barakacaas waxaa loo aaneeyay abaaraha, halka 36% loo aaneeyay amnidarro. Xogta qoraalku ka soo xigtay UNHCR, OCHA iyo IOM waxay xustay gobolladan: Mudug: Bishii Febraayo 2026 oo keliya, qoraalku wuxuu sheegayaa in ku dhowaad 80,000 oo qof ay gobolka ka barakaceen. Hobyo iyo Jariiban ayaa ka mid ah degaannada ay abaaruhu saameeyeen. Hiiraan iyo Shabeellada Dhexe: Dagaallada, amnidarrada iyo fatahaadaha webiga Shabeelle ayaa sababa barakac ka dhaca degaanno ay ka mid yihiin Beledweyne iyo Jowhar. Baay iyo Gedo: Abaaraha saameeyay degaannada Diinsoor, Luuq, Doolow iyo Beledxaawo ayaa yareeyay dalaggii beeraha, waxyeellana u geystay xoolihii ay dadku dhaqan jireen. Sool, Sanaag iyo Togdheer: Sida lagu sheegay warbixinnada bishii Maarso 2026, abaaraha ba’an ee degaannadan ka jiray ayaa sababay in kumannaan qoys ay ka barakacaan miyiga. Sababaha ugu waaweyn ee barakaca: Abaaraha: Qiyaastii 64% barakaca dhacay bilowgii 2026 ayaa qoraalku u aanaynayaa abaaraha. Amnidarrada iyo colaadaha: Qiyaastii 36% ayaa loo aanaynayaa dagaallada u dhexeeya ciidamada dawladda iyo argaggaxisada oo dhinac ah iyo dagaalbeeleedyo u dhexeeya qabiillada ceelka iyo carshinta wadaaga; inkastoo ay dhowaanahan soo ifbaxeen dagaallo kale oo dhex maro dhinacyo isku diiddan ajendayaal siyaasadeed ama dano u gaar ah.

items.title: Five-Year-Old Girl Found Dead Near Family Home in Baidoa
items.description: Ikhlaas Ibrahim Amin Had Been Missing for Two Days; Three People Detained as Police Investigate Her Death Baidoa (WDN) — A heartbreaking search for a missing five-year-old girl has ended in tragedy after the body of Ikhlaas Ibrahim Amin was discovered just meters from her family home in the Xaqsoor area of Baidoa, South West State. Ikhlaas disappeared at around 2 p.m. on Wednesday, according to relatives. For two days, security forces searched Baidoa and surrounding areas in an effort to find the child. Her body was discovered late Friday near a maternal and child health centre adjacent to her family’s home. Police have detained three people in connection with the investigation — two women and a young man. A police officer said one of the detainees had been working as a guard at the health facility where the girl’s body was found. Authorities stressed that those detained remain under investigation and have not been formally charged. Questions Surround Her Death A relative, Ibrahim Mohamed Amin, said the family noticed injuries on the child’s body which they believed indicated that she had been beaten and strangled. Those claims have not been officially confirmed by police or medical authorities. Ikhlaas’s body was taken to Bay Regional Hospital, where medical examinations and a post-mortem investigation are being conducted to establish the official cause of death. Until those findings are released, the circumstances surrounding the child’s death remain unclear. Leadership Demands Answers The case has drawn the attention of South West State leader Adan Mohamed Nur (Adan Madoobe), who reportedly instructed police and intelligence authorities to conduct an urgent investigation. A presidential official said Adan Madoobe wants the investigation completed quickly so authorities can establish how the child died and identify anyone responsible. Police say the investigation remains ongoing and that they are working to establish what happened at the location where Ikhlaas was found and whether others may have been involved. A Family Already Displaced The tragedy has struck a family that had already endured displacement. Ikhlaas’s family was among internally displaced families relocated in July to newly constructed homes in Xaqsoor. Now, instead of celebrating the security of a new home, the family is mourning the loss of a five-year-old child whose life ended under circumstances that remain unanswered. Her relatives are demanding a full investigation, the establishment of the official cause of death and the prosecution of anyone found responsible. For the community, the questions are painfully simple: How did a five-year-old girl disappear from her home and end up dead so close to where her family lived? And perhaps most painfully: Who will answer for Ikhlaas? The investigation continues, with the family and community awaiting the medical findings and an official account from the authorities of how the little girl’s life came to such a devastating end. items.title: Itoobiya oo 3 dal ku eedeysay dagaalka ay isbaheysiga 7-da koox ku iclaamiyeen Abiy
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) — Taliyaha ciidamada Itoobiya Field Marshal Birhanu Jula ayaa Masar iyo Suudaan ku eedeeyay inay taageerayaan isbahaysi cusub oo ay sameysteen kooxo hubeysan oo doonaya inay xukunka ka tuuraan ra’iisul wasaare Abiy Ahmed, xilli dagaallo culus ay dib uga qarxeen waqooyiga dalka. Birhanu ayaa sheegay in kooxaha kasoo horjeeda dowladda federaalka aysan awoodi karin inay gaaraan hadafkooda haddii aan dibadda laga “riixin, taageerin oo sahay laga siin”, isagoo si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqay Masar iyo Suudaan. Waxa uu sidoo kale Eritrea ku eedeeyay inay tahay isku xiraha dowladaha shisheeye iyo kooxaha hubeysan ee gudaha Itoobiya ka dagaallamaya. Taliyaha ciidamada Itoobiya ma uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo madax-bannaan oo taageeraya eedeymahaas, halka Masar iyo Suudaan aysan si rasmi ah uga jawaabin hadalladiisa. Eritrea ayaa horey dhowr jeer u beenisay eedeymaha Addis Ababa ee ah inay taageerto kooxaha hubeysan ee Itoobiya. Hadallada Birhanu ayaa kusoo aadaya toddobaad kaddib markii toddobo urur oo hubeysan iyo kuwo siyaasadeed ay ku dhawaaqeen isbahaysi cusub oo lagu magacaabo Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Alliance for Survival , kaas oo sheegay in hadafkiisu yahay in meesha laga saaro dowladda Abiy Ahmed laguna beddelo maamul ku-meel-gaar ah. Isbahaysiga waxaa ka mid ah Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray ee TPLF, Oromo Liberation Army, ONLF iyo Amhara Fano National Movement — kooxo qaarkood oo dhinacyo iska soo horjeeday ka kala dagaallamay dagaalkii Itoobiya ee 2020 ilaa 2022. Samaysanka isbahaysigan ayaa muujinaya isbeddel weyn oo ku yimid xulafaysiga siyaasadeed iyo militari ee Itoobiya. TPLF iyo xoogagga Fano waxay dagaalkii hore ahaayeen cadaw, balse hadda waxaa mideynaya mucaaradnimada ay kala soo horjeedaan dowladda Abiy Ahmed. Dagaal dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Eedeymaha taliyaha ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale imanaya xilli dagaalkii waqooyiga Itoobiya uu galay marxalad cusub. Ciidamada Tigray ayaa toddobaadkan la wareegay garoomo diyaaradeed oo ku yaalla gobolka Tigray, waxaana dagaallo ay la galeen ciidamada federaalka laga soo sheegay deegaanno ka tirsan Afar iyo Amhara. Dhinacyada ayaa isku eedeeyay inay bilaabeen dagaalka, iyadoo dowladda federaalka iyo TPLF ay bixiyeen warar iska soo horjeeda oo ku saabsan cidda qaaday weerarradii horseeday isku dhacyada cusub. items.title: Dagaal culus oo ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa maanta weerar culus ku qaaday Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Ciidamadan ayaa jihooyin kala duwan ka weeraray magaalada, iyagoo adeegsanaya qoryaha daran-dooriga u dhaca, qaraxyo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Goobjoogeyaasha ayaa sheegay in inta badan ciidamada taageersan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed ay magaalada ka soo galeen xaafadaha Towfiiq iyo Suuqa Xoolaha. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada weerarka soo qaaday ay si qoto dheer isugu soo fidiyeen bartamaha magaalada, isla-markaana ay dagaal qaraar kula galeen Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed. Saraakiisha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa xaqiijiyay in xoogaga mucaaradka ay diyaarad drone ah la beegsadeen xarunta saadka ee taliska. Saraakiisha ayaa sheegay in gaari laga soo buuxiyay walxaha qarxa ay sidoo kale la beegsadeen RB Hotel ama Hotel RB oo magaalada gudaheeda ku yaala, isla-markaana uu burbur soo gaaray hotelkaasi. Dadka deegaanka ayaa soo sheegaya in dagaalku uu si toos ah u saameeyay guryaha dadka shacabka ah iyo goobaha ganacsiga qaar ee magaalada. Diyaaradaha dagaalka F-16 ee Ciidanka Cirka Turkiga ay leeyihiin ayaa la arkayay iyagoo ka qayb qaadanaya dagaalka, ka dib markii ay adkaatay in magaalada dib looga riixo ciidamadii soo weeraray. Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka, Booliska Baydhabo iyo Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa hadda si buuxda gacanta ugu haya magaalada, iyadoona ay dib uga gurteen ciidamadii kale. Weerarka ayaa imanaya, xilli uu socday qorshe lagu weerari lahaa goobaha ay bannaanada Baydhabo kaga sugan yihiin ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dagaalka Isniintan ka dhacay Baydhabo ayaa noqonaya kiisii labaad ee taageereyaasha Laftagareen ay muddo bil gudaheed ah ka gaystaan magaaladaasi. Weerarkan midkii ka horreyay ayay 3-dii bishan ka gaysteen Baydhabo. Si kastaba ha-ahaatee ma cadda khasaaraha nafeed ee dagaalka uu gaystay, marka laga soo tago in dad ku dhinteen, kuwo kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen.

items.title: At least 27 people killed in two mass shootings in South Africa
items.description: Cape town (WDN) – Gunmen killed at least 27 people in two separate mass shootings in South Africa’s largest cities, police said Sunday, as the country continues to grapple with high levels of violent crime. Watch the Video At least 27 people killed in two mass shootings in South Africa according to the Africanews In the first attack, eight gunmen armed with assault rifles entered a bar west of Johannesburg at around 7:30 p.m. GMT on Saturday and opened fire on patrons, killing 17 people and wounding 15, police said. The attackers initially shot at people drinking outside the bar before moving indoors and continuing to fire, according to police. The dead included 13 men and four women. The gunmen also set fire to two vehicles before fleeing the scene. Police said the motive remained unknown and that no arrests had been made. Hours later, another shooting took place at an entertainment venue in a township outside Cape Town. Ten people were killed and 11 others wounded, police said. Five victims died at the scene, while the others succumbed to their injuries on the way to hospital. No suspects had been arrested in that attack either. The shootings come as South Africa battles widespread gun violence, with authorities frequently linking deadly attacks to gang conflicts and competition among informal businesses. The country of around 62 million people records about 60 murders a day, placing it among the nations with some of the world’s highest murder rates. Authorities have repeatedly deployed the military to support police in areas affected by severe violence. In March, soldiers were sent to crime hotspots in Johannesburg as President Cyril Ramaphosa described rampant crime as one of the country’s biggest threats. The military has also been deployed during previous periods of unrest, including the Covid-19 lockdown in 2020, riots following the imprisonment of former president Jacob Zuma in 2021 and a wave of truck burnings in 2023. In 2019, about 1,300 soldiers were deployed to support police operations in the gang-plagued Cape Flats around Cape Town. Despite these efforts, shootings and other violent crimes remain a persistent problem. In Johannesburg, 10 women have been killed in the same municipality over the past two months. The latest victim was found on Saturday, police said, semi-naked and having been stoned to death. A suspect has been arrested in connection with that killing, police said. The other nine victims were mostly women in their 20s and 30s. Some were found stripped of their clothes and showed signs of sexual assault. Police have offered a 400,000-rand ($25,000) reward for information leading to the arrest of those responsible. The Democratic Alliance, South Africa’s second-largest political party, has offered an additional $31,000. Courtesy of AfricanNews 11th woman found dead as killings raise alarm The discovery of another woman’s body in a municipality east of Johannesburg has brought the number of women found dead in the area over the past 10 weeks to 11, deepening concerns over a string of killings in a country already struggling with severe levels of violence against women. Police said Sunday that the latest victim was found in an open field in Ekurhuleni shortly after midday. A security company vehicle passing through the area spotted the body and alerted authorities. The woman’s identity, age and cause of death had not yet been established. The latest discovery came a day after police were called to another scene in the same municipality, where the body of a woman was found near a cemetery. Provincial police chief Tommy Mthombeni said the woman appeared to have been killed with stones. A post-mortem examination was expected to establish the precise cause of death. Police said a man linked to that killing was arrested almost 400 kilometres away after leaving the area. His arrest brings the number of people currently in custody in connection with the series of killings to four. Authorities have stressed that the cases have not been formally connected. The deaths have nevertheless attracted growing public attention, particularly because eight of the 11 bodies were discovered this month alone. Several of the victims were found partially or completely undressed, while some showed indications of sexual assault, according to police. Most of the other victims were women in their 20s and 30s. The investigations come against the backdrop of South Africa’s long-running struggle with gender-based violence. Despite repeated government initiatives aimed at addressing violence against women, the issue remains widespread and has been declared a national crisis. The scale of demand for support services was illustrated by figures from the country’s Gender-Based Violence Command Centre. Between September 1 and 16, the centre received 6,782 distress calls – an average of more than 400 calls a day. That represented a 21 percent increase compared with the same period in August. For investigators in Ekurhuleni, however, the immediate priority remains identifying the latest victim and determining how she died. Police have not said whether the 11 deaths share a common perpetrator or motive. Until forensic examinations and investigations establish links between the cases, authorities are treating them individually. The uncertainty has done little to ease anxiety among residents as investigators continue to examine a succession of crime scenes across the sprawling municipality. The latest death adds another case to a grim tally that has placed renewed focus on the vulnerability of women in communities where open spaces, abandoned areas and other isolated locations can become crime scenes. As police pursue suspects and await forensic findings, families and communities are left with a more immediate question: who the victims were, and whether those responsible for their deaths can be brought to justice. Several of the victims were found partially or completely undressed, while some showed indications of sexual assault, according to police. Most of the other victims were women in their 20s and 30s. The investigations come against the backdrop of South Africa’s long-running struggle with gender-based violence. Despite repeated government initiatives aimed at addressing violence against women, the issue remains widespread and has been declared a national crisis. The scale of demand for support services was illustrated by figures from the country’s Gender-Based Violence Command Centre. Between September 1 and 16, the centre received 6,782 distress calls – an average of more than 400 calls a day. That represented a 21 percent increase compared with the same period in August. For investigators in Ekurhuleni, however, the immediate priority remains identifying the latest victim and determining how she died. Police have not said whether the 11 deaths share a common perpetrator or motive. Until forensic examinations and investigations establish links between the cases, authorities are treating them individually. The uncertainty has done little to ease anxiety among residents as investigators continue to examine a succession of crime scenes across the sprawling municipality. The latest death adds another case to a grim tally that has placed renewed focus on the vulnerability of women in communities where open spaces, abandoned areas and other isolated locations can become crime scenes. As police pursue suspects and await forensic findings, families and communities are left with a more immediate question: who the victims were, and whether those responsible for their deaths can be brought to justice. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo shaaciyey in uu 40% hoos u dhacay dakhligii DF ka soo geli jiray…
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) — Dakhliga gudaha ee Soomaaliya ka hesho canshuuraha kastamka ayaa hoos u dhacay qiyaastii 40%, kadib markii carqaladaha ka jira marin-biyoodka Hormuz ay saameyn ku yeesheen ganacsiga, isla markaana sare u qaadeen kharashaadka wax soo dejinta, sida uu sheegay madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Madaxweynaha oo Khamiistii khudbad ka jeediyey Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegay in ku tiirsanaanta Soomaaliya ee badeecadaha laga soo dejiyo Bariga Dhexe ay dalka si gaar ah ugu nugleysay carqaladaha ka dhaca marinkan muhiimka u ah ganacsiga caalamka. “Carqaladdu waxay sidoo kale sababtay in qiyaastii 40% uu hoos u dhaco dakhligeenna gudaha ee ku saleysan kastamka,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Waxa uu sheegay in dakhliga kastamku uu yahay il muhiim ah oo lagu maalgeliyo dib-u-habeynta dhaqaalaha, kobaca iyo dadaallada lagu dhimayo saboolnimada. Madaxweynuhu ma uusan sheegin muddada uu qiyaastan 40% ah daboolayo, mana uusan soo bandhigin tirooyin faahfaahsan oo muujinaya heerka dakhliga kastamka ka hor iyo kadib hoos u dhaca. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in carqaladaha marin-biyoodka Hormuz ay sare u qaadeen qiimaha cuntada iyo shidaalka, sicir-bararka, kharashaadka gaadiidka iyo caymiska badeecadaha loo soo raro Soomaaliya. “Xaqiijinta isu-socod xor ah oo caddaalad ah oo ka jira marin-biyoodkaas waxay muhiim u tahay ilaalinta dhaqaalaha nugul sida Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri. Saameynta wax soo dejinta Qiyaasta cusub ee uu madaxweynuhu bixiyey ayaa daba socota xog hore oo dowladda Soomaaliya soo bandhigtay, taas oo muujisay saameynta qalalaasaha Hormuz ku yeeshay dhaqaalaha dalka ee sida weyn ugu tiirsan wax soo dejinta. Warbixin ay hay’adda tirakoobka qaranka u gudbisay Golaha Wasiirrada bishii May ayaa lagu sheegay in mugga badeecadaha soo galaya Soomaaliya uu hoos u dhacay ku dhowaad 40% intii uu socday qalalaasaha Hormuz. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in xaaladdaasi ay sababtay in qiimaha cuntadu kordho 10%, halka kharashaadka adeegyada caafimaadku sare u kaceen 14%, iyadoo badeecooyin kale ay diiwaangeliyeen koror ka badan intaas. Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa markaas kadib hay’adaha dowladda ee ay khuseyso faray inay qaadaan tallaabooyin lagu yareynayo culayska dhaqaale ee saaran shacabka. Soomaaliya waxay dibadda ka soo dhoofsataa qayb weyn oo ka mid ah cuntada, shidaalka iyo badeecadaha kale ee muhiimka ah, taas oo qoysaska iyo ganacsatada ka dhigaysa kuwo si toos ah u dareema kororka kharashaadka maraakiibta iyo carqaladaha ku yimaada silsiladaha sahayda caalamka. Saameyntu kuma koobna qiimaha badeecadaha oo keliya, balse waxay sidoo kale gaartay dhaqaalaha dowladda. Canshuuraha laga qaado badeecadaha soo mara dekedaha iyo meelaha kale ee laga soo galo dalka ayaa qayb muhiim ah ka ah dakhliga gudaha ee dowladda federaalka, waxaana laga maalgeliyaa adeegyada iyo kharashaadka dowladda. Marka wax soo dejintu hoos u dhacdo, dakhliga kastamkuna wuu yaraadaa, xilli kharashaadka gaadiidka iyo caymisku ay kor u sii qaadayaan qiimaha ay macaamiishu bixiyaan. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in dowladdu ay sii waddo dadaallada lagu kordhinayo dakhliga gudaha, inkastoo ay jiraan cadaadisyada dhaqaale ee dibadda ka imanaya. Waxa uu Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u sheegay in Soomaaliya ay xoojisay maamulka maaliyadda dadweynaha iyo hufnaanta miisaaniyadda, iyadoo sidoo kale la ballaarinayo nidaamka maaliyadeed laguna dadaalayo hagaajinta jawiga maalgashiga. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya la filayo inuu sanadkan gaaro kobac dhab ah oo dhan 3.1%, inkastoo ay jiraan saameynno xooggan oo ka imaanaya dhaqaalaha caalamka. items.title: Fighting Erupts in Baidoa as Rival Forces Clash
items.description: BAIDOA— Heavy fighting broke out in Baidoa early Tuesday morning between forces aligned with Somalia’s South West State administration and fighters loyal to former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen, according to local sources. The fighting began at dawn and reportedly spread to several neighborhoods of the city. Residents said they could hear sustained gunfire in parts of Baidoa as the clashes continued. The scale of casualties remains unclear. No independently verified figures on deaths or injuries were immediately available. The two sides have offered conflicting accounts of the fighting. Mohamed Sheikh Abdullahi Xaayow, a spokesperson for the South West State administration, said government forces had repelled an attack by what he described as armed groups. He accused Al-Shabaab of being behind the assault, although the allegation has not been independently verified. Separately, Hassan Abdi Mohamed, the Information Minister for the faction aligned with Laftagareen and a former spokesperson for the former South West State president, claimed that forces loyal to Laftagareen had made advances during the fighting. He also claimed that his forces had destroyed military vehicles supplied to Somalia by Turkey and set fire to several weapons and ammunition storage facilities belonging to opposing forces inside Baidoa. Those claims could not be independently verified. The clashes come amid growing political tensions in South West State, where competing factions have been involved in a dispute over political authority and control. Baidoa hosts key South West State institutions as well as Somali federal government security forces, making the city a strategically important center in the region. The situation in Baidoa remained fluid, with further details on casualties, the extent of the fighting and control of military positions still emerging. items.title: Dowladda Federaalka iyo Koonfur Galbeed oo war ka soo saaray dagaalkii Baydhabo
items.description: Warar kala duwan ayaa kasoo baxay dagaalkii saaka ka dhacay magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Bay, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ay siyaabo kala duwan uga hadleen cidda ka dambeysay weerarka iyo xaaladda dagaalka. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in dagaalka ay soo qaadeen ciidamadii maamulka Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen iyo dagaalyahanno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ay si xooggan uga hortageen weerarka, isla markaana ay dib u riixeen kooxihii weerarka soo qaaday, ayadoo sheegtay in dagaalka lagu dilay xubno ka tirsan kooxihii weerarka soo qaaday, iyadoo soo bandhigtay muuqaallo iyo sawirro ay ku tilmaantay inay yihiin qaar ka mid ah dadkii lagu dilay iska horimaadka. Dhanka kale, Wasaaradda Warfaafinta ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa iyaduna ka hadashay dagaalka, oo sheegtay in ciidamadu ay iska caabiyeen weerar ay ku tilmaantay mid ay soo qaadeen xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab iyo maleeshiyaad lala xiriirinayo ciidamadii hore ee Laftagareen. Dagaalka ayaa ahaa mid culus, waxaana magaalada laga maqlayay qaraxyo iyo rasaas xooggan, iyadoo la adeegsanayay hub noocyo kala duwan ah. Wararka qaar ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn lagu adeegsaday iska horimaadka, hase yeeshee faahfaahinta ku saabsan cidda adeegsatay iyo khasaaraha ay geysteen weli si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo shir-guddoominaysa kulanka 29-aad ee Madasha Iskaashiga Geeska Afrika
items.description: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Biixi Imaan Cige, ayaa maanta shir-guddoomiyay kulanka 29-aad ee Madasha Iskaashiga Dalalka Geeska Afrika, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray arrimo la xiriira horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo xoojinta iskaashiga dalalka gobolka. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay sidii loo horumarin lahaa dhaqaalaha dalalka Geeska Afrika, iyadoo sidoo kale xoogga la saaray dhismaha iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha ee isku xira dalalka gobolka. Kaabayaasha isku xira dalalka Geeska Afrika ayaa loo arkaa kuwo muhiim u ah fududeynta isu-socodka dadka iyo badeecadaha, ballaarinta ganacsiga gobolka iyo abuurista fursado dhaqaale oo dheeraad ah. Madashan ayaa sidoo kale fursad u siinaysa dalalka gobolka inay iska kaashadaan arrimaha dhaqaalaha iyo mashaariicda horumarineed, gaar ahaan kuwa xoojin kara isku-xirka iyo is-dhexgalka dhaqaale ee Geeska Afrika. Shir-guddoominta kulanka oo uu hoggaaminayo Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli dalalka Geeska Afrika ay wadaan dadaallo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga dhaqaale iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha gobolka.

Madashan ayaa sidoo kale fursad u siinaysa dalalka gobolka inay iska kaashadaan arrimaha dhaqaalaha iyo mashaariicda horumarineed, gaar ahaan kuwa xoojin kara isku-xirka iyo is-dhexgalka dhaqaale ee Geeska Afrika. Shir-guddoominta kulanka oo uu hoggaaminayo Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli dalalka Geeska Afrika ay wadaan dadaallo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga dhaqaale iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha gobolka.

items.title: Ciidankii Lafta-gareen oo dagaal culus ku qaaday magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Baydhabo (Raxanreeb Online) Wararka laga helayo magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegaya in uu halkaas saaka waaberigii uu ka qarxay dagaal u dhexeeya ciidanka Lafta Gareen dacaadda u ah oo gudaha u soo galay magaalada Baydhabo iyo ciidanka kale ee dawladda Soomaaliya. Dagaalka oo saacado socday waxa laisku adeegsaday hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan oo xataa ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Drone oo dagaalkan ka qayb qaatay. Ciidanka Lafta Gareen ayaa ku guulaystay in ay ka dhex dagaallamaan gudaha Baydhaba iyaga oo duullaan ka soo qaaday bannaanka magaalada oo ay ku lee yihiin fadhiisimo ciidan. Afhayeenka maamuulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa saxaafadda u sheegay in ay dib u riixeen kooxaha saaka soo galay Baydhabo kuwaas oo uu ku eedeeyey in ay ahaayeen argagaxiso. Lama sheegin khasaaraha rasmiga ah ee dagaalkan ka dhashay sida dhimashada, dhaawac iyo bur burka soo gaadhey dhulkii ay degganaayeen rayidka ku dhaqan magaalada Baydhabo. Wixii kusoo kordho warkan halkan kala soco. The post Ciidankii Lafta-gareen oo dagaal culus ku qaaday magaalada Baydhabo appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Ethiopia on the brink of civil war
items.description: Abiy Ahmed ruled Ethiopia, a fragile country thst always suffers from severe ethnic polarization, with a strange, absolute authority driven by his intense delusions and obsessive whims. His most famous project born of these “hallucinations” was his pursuit of direct access to the Red Sea coast, a delusion driven by Ethiopia’s status as the world’s most populous landlocked nation and its heavy economic reliance on neighboring ports. Ethiopia now faces the major danger of sliding back into a full-scale civil war as the 2022 Pretoria peace agreement collapses and renewed fighting erupts in the northern regions. Large-scale fighting broke out in late September 2026 between federal forces and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), with clashes spreading across Tigray, Amhara, and Afar. The TPLF joined a new coalition of opposition groups aimed at overthrowing Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. News papers and reliable local sources indicate that opposition forces are mobing towards Addis Ababa, facing a lot of less resistance from the federal army forces. Tigrayan forces seized regional airports including Mekelle, Axum, and Shire, severely disrupting civilian flights and humanitarian logistics. Deteriorating relations with neighboring Eritrea and rising fears of a broader regional spillover threaten to draw outside states into the conflict. Expanding drone strikes, blocked roads, and renewed violence are worsening food security and putting millions of civilians at risk once again. This current arned conflict might to the collapse of Ethiopia, leading to an exodus of refugees to neighboring countries. Wether or not Ethiopia can survive from civil war only time will tell. Jama Ismail (Jama Falaag) jamafalaag@gmail.com

items.title: Somalia PM denies paying Al-Shabaab to keep Mogadishu secure
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre has denied his government pays Al-Shabaab to stop attacks on Mogadishu, saying it has never held talks with the group. Barre said in an interview with Dawan TV that the government does not pay the Islamist militant group large sums of money so that the capital remains relatively secure and authorities can boast about it. He said the allegations were spread by members of the government of former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmajo, but did not name them. Barre said he believed those officials themselves had contacts and friendly relations with Al-Shabaab. He did not provide evidence for the accusation. Barre said the government and Al-Shabaab were engaged only in fighting, not talks, but he did not rule out future talks with the group. The government has never been averse to talks, he said, but only wants to talk to anyone in Al-Shabaab who wants to renounce the group and its ideology. Those who do have the right to live as they wish and could even join the government, he said. Former Al-Shabaab members currently work for the government and some hold senior official portfolios, he added. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Turkiga iyo Qatar oo cambaareeyay weerar ay degganayaal Israa’iiliyiin ah ku galeen Al-Aqsa
items.description: Dowladaha Turkiga iyo Qatar ayaa si adag u cambaareeyay gelitaanka kooxo ka mid ah degganayaasha Israa’iil ay ku galeen barxadda Masjidka Al-Aqsa ee Qudus, iyadoo la sheegay in ciidamada Israa’iil ay ilaalinayeen dadkaasi xilli ay gudaha u galayeen goobta barakeysan. Turkiga ayaa sheegay in tallaabooyinka noocan ah ay yihiin kuwo sii kordhin kara xiisadda ka taagan Qudus, isagoo ku baaqay in la dhowro xaaladda taariikheed iyo sharci ee Masjidka Al-Aqsa, isla markaana laga fogaado tallaabo kasta oo wax ka beddeli karta xaaladda goobta. Qatar ayaa iyaduna cambaareysay waxa ay ku tilmaantay sii socoshada duullaannada degganayaasha Israa’iiliyiinta ah ee Al-Aqsa , iyadoo sheegtay in gelitaanka lagu sameeyay iyadoo ay ilaalinayaan ciidamada Israa’iil. Doha waxay ku tilmaantay arrintan xadgudub ka dhan ah sharciga caalamiga ah iyo tallaabo kicin karta dareenka Muslimiinta iyo Falastiiniyiinta, ayadoo Dowladda Qatar waxay sidoo kale ku adkaysatay in Masjidka Al-Aqsa uu yahay goob cibaado oo muhiim u ah Muslimiinta , iyadoo diidday tallaabo kasta oo hal dhinac ah oo lagu beddeli karo xaaladda taariikheed iyo sharci ee goobta barakeysan. Labada dal ayaa ugu baaqay beesha caalamka inay qaaddo tallaabooyin lagu ilaalinayo goobaha barakeysan ee Qudus, lagana fogaado tallaabooyinka sii hurin kara xiisadaha u dhexeeya Falastiiniyiinta iyo Israa’iil. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay weli taagan tahay xiisad xooggan oo ku saabsan xaaladda Masjidka Al-Aqsa iyo goobaha barakeysan ee Qudus , iyadoo gelitaanka kooxaha degganayaasha Israa’iiliyiinta ah iyo joogitaanka ciidamada Israa’iil ay marar badan dhaleeceyn kala kulmaan dhinacyada Falastiiniyiinta iyo dowlado ka tirsan gobolka.

items.title: Somalia’s Dialogue Trap: Months of Talks, No Political Breakthrough
items.description: From May to September, Negotiations Have Produced Meetings, Statements and More Disagreement — But No Political Settlement MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s political dialogue is once again heading back to the negotiating table, but after months of meetings, diplomatic appeals and repeated promises of compromise, there is little evidence that the country’s political leaders have moved closer to a settlement. The pattern is becoming difficult to ignore. The high-level negotiations between the Federal Government and the Somali Future Council held from May 13 to 15 ended without consensus. The African Union subsequently urged the parties to return to an inclusive and substantive dialogue based on genuine negotiation, compromise and constitutional order. Since then, diplomatic efforts have continued. Yet the central disputes over elections, constitutional changes, political legitimacy and the rules governing the transition remain unresolved. By September, opposition figures were still saying that the negotiations had stalled. On September 18, former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed said the talks had failed to move forward and accused those in power of lacking interest in reaching a settlement. Four days later, Mohamed Abdirahman Dhabancad, a member of the Future Council’s technical committee, said no political agreement had been reached on the elections. That leaves a question increasingly being asked across Somalia: What has actually been achieved after months of dialogue? The Same Talks, the Same Deadlock The latest diplomatic effort risks becoming another round of negotiations in which the parties sit across the table, repeat their positions, issue statements and return home without resolving the fundamental dispute. International diplomats can facilitate meetings. They can encourage compromise. They can provide venues, technical expertise and political pressure. But they cannot manufacture Somali political consensus. The problem is that the disagreement is no longer simply about the mechanics of an election. It is about who has the authority to determine the rules of the political transition and whether those rules have sufficient national consent. The Federal Government says it is prepared to negotiate. The opposition and several political actors, however, continue to challenge the government’s approach to constitutional reform and the electoral process. Himilo Qaran, led by Sharif, has gone further, calling for disputed constitutional changes to be suspended and arguing that the electoral process should rest on a political agreement accepted by the country’s principal stakeholders. Until that fundamental disagreement is addressed, another meeting may simply produce another communiqué. The Trust Deficit Begins Before the Negotiations For many opposition figures, the problem is not merely what happens inside the negotiating room. It is what the government does outside it. The Federal Government has pursued major constitutional and electoral changes while political negotiations have remained unresolved. Parliament approved constitutional amendments that changed the electoral framework and extended federal institutional terms; the government maintains that those amendments provide the legal basis for the current framework, while opponents dispute their legitimacy and lack of broader political consensus. The electoral commission is also already functioning and preparing for elections. Its official website describes the National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission as the institution responsible for administering elections and electoral boundaries. For opponents, however, the sequence matters: how can a government ask for confidence at the negotiating table while continuing to advance contested political and electoral arrangements outside it? That is one of the central obstacles to rebuilding trust. The International Community Has a Bigger Job Than Calling for Dialogue The international community has repeatedly called on Somalia’s leaders to negotiate. The African Union did so after the May talks failed. The United Nations and other international partners have also supported renewed political dialogue. The United States and Britain were reported in July to be preparing another diplomatic effort, although expectations for a breakthrough were already described as low. But simply urging Somali leaders to “return to dialogue” may no longer be enough. If international partners genuinely want the negotiations to produce a political settlement, they may need to focus not only on bringing the parties into the room but on creating conditions in which both sides believe that negotiations can change what happens outside the room. That means greater attention to contested unilateral actions, the use of state security forces in political disputes, constitutional procedures and the independence and credibility of electoral institutions. It also means insisting that any future electoral roadmap command broad political acceptance rather than merely reflecting the position of whichever side controls federal institutions. The Land Question Has Become Part of the Trust Crisis The dispute over public land in Mogadishu has added another layer to the political crisis. Investigations and civil-society reports have raised allegations concerning the transfer, sale or reclamation of public properties and the treatment of displaced families. One recent investigation alleged that more than 180 government-owned properties had been transferred to private buyers and estimated their combined value at more than $1 billion. Those allegations have not been established through a judicial finding, and the government has not publicly accepted the investigation’s conclusions. Other organizations have called for independent investigations into alleged land seizures, evictions and abuse of authority. These allegations should not be treated as proven corruption without credible investigations and documentary evidence. But politically, they cannot simply be ignored. Where public land is involved, the question is not only whether a particular transaction was legal. It is whether citizens believe public assets are being managed transparently and whether those responsible can be held accountable. For that reason, calls for investigations into disputed land transactions and the financial interests of senior officials should be addressed through independent legal and financial mechanisms, rather than political accusations alone. What Would Restore Confidence? If the international community wants another round of negotiations to produce something different, the process needs more than another invitation to talk. The immediate objective should be to establish a credible political framework in which disputed unilateral measures are reviewed or temporarily restrained while negotiations continue. That could include: agreement on a mutually acceptable electoral roadmap; independent review of disputed constitutional changes; confidence-building measures concerning electoral institutions; guarantees against the use of state security forces for partisan political purposes; transparent investigation of disputed public-land transactions; and a mechanism to monitor implementation of any political agreement reached. The opposition’s demand for international guarantees should also be considered as part of the confidence-building discussion, rather than dismissed outright. The Future Council has previously called for a stronger international role in mediation and guarantees for implementation. Somalia Does Not Need Another Meeting. It Needs an Agreement. The danger now is that dialogue itself becomes a substitute for political settlement. From May to September, Somalia has seen negotiations, mediation efforts, diplomatic statements and renewed calls for compromise. Yet the central dispute remains. Sharif says the talks have stalled. Dhabancad says no electoral agreement has been reached. The African Union says the May negotiations ended without consensus. And international partners continue to call for dialogue. That is not a political settlement. It is a cycle. Somalia’s international partners therefore face a choice of their own: continue encouraging another meeting, or help create the conditions under which the next meeting must produce concrete decisions. The country does not need another round of talks that ends with the same positions and another promise to meet again. Somalia needs an agreement on the rules of the political game — one that is negotiated, broadly accepted, constitutionally grounded and capable of being implemented. Until that happens, another dialogue may produce headlines, but it will not produce a solution. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee Dagaalka Baydhabo oo weli socda
items.description: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee laga helayo magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegaya in dagaal culus uu weli ka socdo qaybo ka mid ah magaalada, iyadoo dhinacyadu ay isu adeegsanayaan hub noocyo kala duwan ah. Ilo maxalli ah iyo muuqaallo lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya in xaaladdu ay weli kacsan tahay, iyadoo laga maqlayo rasaas iyo qaraxyo ka dhacaya qaybo ka mid ah Baydhabo, balse m a jiraan xogo madax-bannaan oo si rasmi ah u xaqiijin kara khasaaraha iyo halka uu dagaalku marayo weli lama hayo . items.title: Somalia parliament speaker plans to cut pay of absent lawmakers
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s parliament speaker, Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur Jama, plans to cut the salaries of about 50 lawmakers for not regularly attending assembly meetings, Somali Stream reported on Sunday. Jama has ordered the parliament secretariat to provide him with the names of lawmakers who are often absent from meetings, and has ordered that they receive no stipends or salaries by September. If carried out, it would be the first time a speaker of the Somali parliament has made such an attempt. It is the first move of its kind Jama has taken since his recent election. The plan would affect at least 50 lawmakers, among them ministers in the government of Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre. It was not immediately clear whether the secretariat had supplied the names, how many missed meetings would qualify a lawmaker as regularly absent, or when any cut would take effect. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Dagaal diyaarado Drone ah loo adeegsaday oo ka socda magaalada Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya gobolka Baay ayaa sheegaya in saaka dagaal qaraar uu ka qarxay duleedka magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay, kaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen iyo kuwa dowladda Soomaaliya ee ku sugan magaaladaasi. Dagaalka ayaa yimid, kadib markii ciidanka Lafta-gareen ay weerar xoogan oo qaraxyo ku bilowday ay kusoo qaadeen magaalada, waxaana kadib sidaas ku qarxay dagaal foolka fool ah oo u dhexeeya labada dhinac, kaas oo la’isku adeegsanayo hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in haatan gudaha Baydhaba laga maqlayo daryanka hubka culus iyo rasaas ay dhinacyadu is-weydaarsanayaan, taas oo cabsi ku beertay dadka deegaanka oo marar badan lagu kor dagaalamay. Sidoo kale, waxaa lasoo wariyay in ciidanka weerarka soo qaaday ay adeegsadeen diyaarado Drone ah oo qaraxyo lagu soo xiray, kuwaas oo beegsaday xero ciidamada dowladda ay ku leeyihiin bannaanka magaalada, waxaana kadib xerada ka kacay dab, sida ay sheegeen ilo deegaanka ah. Afhayeenka kooxda Lafta-gareen oo lagu mgacaabo Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo muuqaal soo duubay ayaa ka warbixiyay xaaladda, wuxuuna sheegay inay gudaha u galeen magaalada, welina uu socdo howlgalka, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Geesiyaasha Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa agta mariyey fadhiisimo ay ku suganaayen maleeshiyaadka Salbalaar iyo Af-Balaar, iyagoo sidoo kale la wareegay qeybo badan oo ka mid ah magaalada Baydhabo. Howlgalka dib-u-xoreynta koonfur galbeed ayaa socda,”ayuu yiri afhayeenku. Sidoo kale, wuxuu farriin u diray dadka deegaanka oo uu ugu baaqay in aysan bannaanka usoo bixin, isla markaana ay ku nagaadaan guryahooda, inta uu socdo howlgalka, si aysan waxyeello uga soo gaarin dagaalka haatan socda. Xaaladda ayaa haatan kacsan, mana jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay dhinaca saraakiisha Koonfur Galbeed iyo kuwa dowladda oo ku aadan dagaalka ka socda magaalada Baydhaba. items.title: IGAD oo Muqdisho tababar ku saabsan nabad-dhisidda iyo hoggaaminta u qabatay haween Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Urur-goboleedka IGAD ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ka bilaabay barnaamij lagu xoojinayo doorka haweenka Soomaaliyeed ee nabad-dhisidda, xalinta khilaafaadka iyo ka qaybgalka geeddi-socodka hoggaaminta iyo go’aan-qaadashada. Tababarka oo soconaya muddo saddex maalmood ah waxaa ka qaybgalaya ku dhowaad 20 haween ah , kuwaas oo isugu jira hoggaamiyeyaal dumar ah iyo xubno ka tirsan guddiyada nabadda ee deegaanka. Barnaamijkan waxaa IGAD iska kaashanaya Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqda Aadanaha ee Soomaaliya , waxaana lagu tababarayaa ka qaybgalayaasha xirfado ay ka mid yihiin falanqaynta khilaafaadka, dhexdhexaadinta, wada-xaajoodka, fududeynta wadahadallada, hoggaaminta, u doodista iyo nabad-dhisidda ku salaysan bulshada . Tababarku wuxuu qayb ka yahay mashruuca Building Women’s Economic Resilience for Sustainable Peace (BWERSP) , kaas oo ay maalgeliso Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika . IGAD ayaa sheegtay in dadaalkan uu diiradda saarayo sidii haweenka loogu kordhin lahaa ka qaybgalka dadaallada nabadda iyo hababka go’aan-qaadashada, maadaama haweenka Soomaaliyeed ay muddo dheer door muuqda ku lahaayeen xalinta khilaafaadka bulshada, inkastoo fursadaha ay ku galaan qaab-dhismeedyada rasmiga ah ee nabad-dhisidda ay xaddidnaayeen. Barnaamijkan ayaa sidoo kale lagu daray haweenka ka soo jeeda bulshooyinka ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo barakacu, sida haweenka barakacayaasha ah, dadka dib ugu soo laabtay deegaanadooda iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada . Tababarkan ayaa daba socda kulan kale oo IGAD ay Muqdisho ku qabatay bishii Luulyo , kaas oo ay ka qaybgaleen mas’uuliyiin dowladeed, guddiyada nabadda ee haweenka, kooxaha dhallinyarada, odayaasha dhaqanka, culimada iyo dhinacyada kale ee ka shaqeeya nabad-dhisidda. Ujeeddada barnaamijka cusub ayaa ah in la xoojiyo xiriirka u dhexeeya hindisayaasha nabadda ee ay hoggaamiyaan haweenka, hay’adaha dowladda iyo ururrada bulshada , iyadoo Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo xalinta khilaafaadka iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta ee heer deegaan. Dadaalkan wuxuu sidoo kale qayb ka yahay hirgelinta ajendaha Haweenka, Nabadda iyo Ammaanka (Women, Peace and Security) ee IGAD, kaas oo diiradda saaraya kordhinta ka qaybgalka haweenka ee nabad-dhisidda iyo go’aan-qaadashada guud ahaan gobolka.
