items.title: Fahad Yasin Condemns Cuts to Benefits for Somalia’s Fallen Soldiers and Veterans
items.description: Former Intelligence Chief Says Reductions Send a “Deeply Disappointing” Message to Those Who Sacrificed Their Lives and Health for the State Mogadishu (WDN) — Former National Intelligence and Security Agency chief Fahad Yasin has sharply condemned what he says is a decision by Somalia’s Federal Government to reduce financial benefits for military retirees, soldiers disabled in service and families of fallen members of the armed forces. In a lengthy statement addressed directly to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and his administration, Fahad described the reported reductions as deeply disappointing and warned that they risk undermining confidence in the state among the very people who have sacrificed most for it. Fahad published the statement on his Facebook page under the title “ A Statement to President Hassan and His Administration.” He argued that the issue did not begin with the latest decision, saying there had previously been complaints about the treatment of vulnerable members of the Somali armed forces, particularly families of fallen soldiers, disabled personnel and retirees. He warned that further reductions in their financial support could reinforce a perception that those who gave their lives, health and working years to Somalia are being neglected rather than protected and honoured by the state. A Question of Law and Accountability Fahad’s criticism comes as the Federal Government has established a legal framework governing the care of orphans of fallen soldiers, disabled personnel and retired members of the Somali Armed Forces. The government issued Regulation No. 198 governing the agency responsible for those groups in March 2026, with the regulation subsequently published in the government’s official bulletin in August. Fahad argued that any decision affecting their financial rights should therefore be supported by a clear legal basis, transparent procedures and accountability. He challenged President Hassan Sheikh and his administration to explain publicly: the legal basis for the reported reductions; who authorized the decision; the legal authority under which it was implemented; and why the financial burden was being placed on what he described as the most vulnerable members of the armed forces. Without such an explanation, Fahad said, serious questions could arise over whether the decision is consistent with the laws and regulations intended to protect the rights of fallen soldiers, disabled personnel and retirees. “This Is More Than a Financial Decision” The former intelligence chief expressed particular disappointment at the prospect of reducing payments to families left behind by soldiers who died serving the country. He argued that such payments should not be treated as charity. The families of fallen soldiers, he said, have a claim on the state because their relatives made the ultimate sacrifice in Somalia’s service. Disabled soldiers, meanwhile, paid for their service with their health and physical abilities. “The martyrs gave the nation the most precious thing a human being possesses — their lives,” Fahad said. He argued that the children and widows of fallen soldiers should therefore not have to regard government assistance as a favour. Instead, he said, it should be understood as an obligation arising from the sacrifices made by those who died defending the country. What Message Does This Send to Soldiers? Fahad’s most pointed argument concerns the effect of the reported reductions on serving troops. He asked how a soldier currently fighting on the front lines could be expected to make the ultimate sacrifice for the country if the message from the state is that his family could later see its support reduced. The question goes directly to the relationship between a military and the state it serves. “How can the soldier on the front line today be expected to sacrifice his life for the nation if the message is that, when he is killed or disabled, the support provided to his children and family will be reduced?” Fahad asked. He argued that an effective military depends not only on weapons and training but also on trust. A soldier must believe that the state he is defending today will protect his family tomorrow if he dies in service. If that confidence is weakened, he warned, one of the foundations of the national armed forces is also weakened. A Call for the Decision to Be Reversed Fahad called on President Hassan Sheikh and his administration to immediately reverse any cuts to benefits affecting fallen soldiers, disabled personnel and military retirees and to restore the financial rights of their families. He rejected the argument that budget savings should begin with the families of soldiers who died defending Somalia. “A budget cannot be repaired by starting with the orphans of soldiers who died for the country,” he argued. “Savings cannot be sought from the families of those who gave their lives to save the nation.” He also called on parliament, the judiciary and other relevant institutions to examine the legal basis for the decision and ensure that the rights of fallen soldiers, disabled personnel and retirees cannot be reduced simply through an administrative decision. The Deeper Issue: What Does the State Owe Its Soldiers? At the heart of Fahad’s statement is a question that extends beyond the reported financial reductions. It is a question of the state’s obligation to those who serve it. Somalia continues to depend heavily on its armed forces in the fight against Al-Shabaab and other security threats. Yet the former intelligence chief argues that the state’s commitment to its soldiers cannot end when they leave the battlefield — particularly when they leave it because they have been killed or permanently disabled. His argument is ultimately about trust. A soldier who risks his life for Somalia needs confidence that the state will not abandon his family if he does not return. Fahad’s closing message was therefore directed not only at the government but at the principle of national responsibility itself: Those who died defending Somalia cannot defend themselves today. The state they died for must therefore become their voice, their protection and the guardian of the families they left behind. For Fahad Yasin, reducing their support is not merely a budgetary decision. It is a test of what Somalia believes it owes to those who sacrificed everything for the country. items.title: Future Council Draws the Line as Somalia’s Opposition Hardens
items.description: Puntland, Jubaland and Salvation Forum Bloc Says It Recognizes Farmaajo as an Opposition Figure Aligned with Its Position Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s Future Council has drawn a sharper political distinction within the country’s opposition movement, saying it recognizes former President Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed “Farmaajo” as an opposition figure aligned with its political position, while rejecting claims that certain former members of the Salvation Forum still belong to its opposition camp. The statement, made by Mohamed Abdirahman Dhabancad, a member of the Future Council’s technical committee, specifically distinguished Farmaajo from former members of the Salvation Forum who now participate in election-related meetings with international partners. Dhabancad accused those politicians of maintaining links with Villa Somalia — an allegation that has not been independently established. The distinction is politically significant. The Future Council is positioning itself as a principal opposition bloc, while making clear that not every politician who once belonged to the wider opposition movement is considered part of its current camp. The Council brings together Puntland and Jubaland with opposition figures from the Salvation Forum and has taken its political dispute with the Federal Government to the UN Security Council. Puntland and Jubaland at the Core The Future Council combines the leadership of Puntland and Jubaland with prominent national opposition figures, giving the bloc a political reach beyond Mogadishu. Its appeal to the UN Security Council for international engagement over Somalia’s electoral deadlock has further elevated its role in the national political confrontation. Farmaajo’s Distinct Position The former Puntland Minister, Dhabancad’s reference to Farmaajo is notable because the former president is not being described as a formal member of the Future Council. Rather, the Council says it considers him an opposition figure whose political position is aligned with its broader challenge to the Federal Government. That distinction places Farmaajo in a different category from the former Salvation Forum members whom the Council now accuses of being too closely associated with Villa Somalia. No Deal with Mogadishu Dhabancad also rejected suggestions that the Future Council and the Federal Government are currently negotiating an electoral agreement. He said the two sides have held discussions in the past but remain divided over the fundamental issues surrounding the next election.His message was blunt: there is no agreement and no political breakthrough between the two sides. The dispute remains centred on the electoral framework, constitutional changes and who should determine the rules for Somalia’s next national election. The Battle Over Who Speaks for the Opposition The latest statement underscores a broader struggle within Somalia’s opposition movement over who represents the principal opposition camp and who should have a seat at negotiations over the country’s political future. The Future Council is seeking to establish itself as a central opposition negotiating bloc, backed by Puntland and Jubaland and supported by prominent national political figures. Its recognition of Farmaajo as an aligned opposition figure — while excluding other former Salvation Forum members — further clarifies the political boundaries it is drawing. For now, Dhabancad’s central message is clear: The Future Council says there is no electoral deal with Mogadishu, no breakthrough has been reached, and the political deadlock remains unresolved. He said the two sides have held discussions in the past but remain divided over the fundamental issues surrounding the next election.His message was blunt: there is no agreement and no political breakthrough between the two sides. The dispute remains centred on the electoral framework, constitutional changes and who should determine the rules for Somalia’s next national election. The Battle Over Who Speaks for the Opposition The latest statement underscores a broader struggle within Somalia’s opposition movement over who represents the principal opposition camp and who should have a seat at negotiations over the country’s political future. The Future Council is seeking to establish itself as a central opposition negotiating bloc, backed by Puntland and Jubaland and supported by prominent national political figures. Its recognition of Farmaajo as an aligned opposition figure — while excluding other former Salvation Forum members — further clarifies the political boundaries it is drawing. For now, Dhabancad’s central message is clear: The Future Council says there is no electoral deal with Mogadishu, no breakthrough has been reached, and the political deadlock remains unresolved. items.title: Tigray Cut Off Again as Communications Blackout Deepens Civilian Misery
items.description: Internet and Phone Disruptions Leave Millions Struggling to Access Money, Information and Essential Services as Fighting Returns Mekelle (WDN) — Tigray is once again being pushed into isolation. Internet and telephone services have been severely disrupted across the northern Ethiopian region following the latest outbreak of fighting, cutting millions of people off from essential communications at precisely the moment they most need them. State-owned Ethio Telecom services have been completely disrupted, while the smaller Safaricom network has reportedly remained partially operational. Internet-monitoring group NetBlocks confirmed a regional disruption affecting northern Tigray. The consequences are potentially devastating. Tigray is already facing a severe shortage of cash. Duke Burbridge, an American humanitarian worker in Mekelle, told the BBC that residents had struggled for months to access cash and ATMs, warning that the loss of telecommunications could be “devastating for everybody.” For millions of people increasingly dependent on digital banking and mobile-money services, an internet shutdown is not simply an inconvenience. It can mean being unable to access money, contact relatives, obtain information, conduct business or reach help. A Region Cut Off at the Worst Possible Moment The blackout comes as fighting between Tigrayan forces and Ethiopia’s federal military has sharply escalated, raising fears that the region could again descend into a wider war. That makes the communications disruption particularly alarming. When fighting intensifies, civilians need reliable access to information. Families need to know whether relatives are safe. Hospitals and humanitarian organizations need communications. Journalists need to document events. Aid agencies need to assess needs and reach vulnerable communities. A communications blackout makes all of that harder. It also creates an information vacuum in which abuses can become harder to document and verify. Tigray Has Seen This Before The fear in Tigray is not simply theoretical. During the 2020–2022 war, the region was subjected to prolonged communications and internet restrictions. A UN investigation later documented the suspension of internet, telecommunications and banking services and described how those measures contributed to severe humanitarian consequences. Human Rights Watch previously warned that a complete communications shutdown affecting millions of people in Tigray during armed conflict could cause extensive civilian harm and, depending on the circumstances, potentially constitute collective punishment. It also stressed that communications restrictions must satisfy requirements of necessity and proportionality under international law. That history makes the latest blackout particularly disturbing. Who Ordered the Shutdown? The responsibility for the latest disruption remains contested. Reuters reported that several sources attributed the shutdown to Tigray’s ruling authorities, while a source close to the Tigray People’s Liberation Front denied responsibility and blamed the federal government. Ethiopian federal authorities, Ethio Telecom and Safaricom had not immediately responded to Reuters’ requests for comment. That dispute matters.  A communications blackout imposed during an armed conflict should not be treated as an ordinary technical failure. Whoever ordered or enabled it must be held accountable for its consequences. Millions Should Not Become Hostages to a War The people of Tigray have already endured years of war, displacement, hunger and the destruction of essential infrastructure. They should not now be forced to live through another communications blackout while armed forces fight around them. Cutting civilians off from the outside world does not make them combatants. It makes them more vulnerable. If authorities deliberately shut down communications across a civilian population without a lawful, necessary and proportionate justification, international human-rights standards raise serious concerns about freedom of expression, access to information and other fundamental rights. UN experts have previously condemned broad internet shutdowns as disproportionate measures. The International Community Cannot Look Away The international community should demand immediate clarification over who ordered the shutdown, why it was imposed and how long it is intended to continue. Independent humanitarian access and communications should be protected. Journalists and human-rights monitors should be able to document what is happening. And civilians should not be deprived of basic communications simply because fighting has returned to their region. Tigray has already experienced what happens when an entire population is cut off from the world. The lesson from the previous war should be clear: communications are not a luxury during conflict. They are a lifeline. Whether the latest blackout was ordered by federal authorities, regional authorities or resulted from competing wartime actions, civilians should not pay the price. Tigray’s people have suffered enough. They should not be silenced again. WardheerNews The post Tigray Cut Off Again as Communications Blackout Deepens Civilian Misery appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Xog ay baahisay warbaahinta Ciraaq oo si weyn u beenisay sheegashadii Puntland
items.description: Baghdad (Caasimada Online) – Qiyaastii 40 nin oo ka tirsan qabiil kasoo jeeda koonfurta dalka Ciraaq ayaa la sheegay inay ka qeyb qaateen howlgal hubeysan oo lagu soo furtay markab shidaal oo burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ay afduubteen, dhacdo si weyn looga hadal hayo warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada ee Ciraaq. Ragga ayaa ka tirsan qabiilka Al-Shaghanba ee gobolka Basra, waxaana hoggaamiye qabiil uu sheegay in ay u dhaqaaqeen sidii ay gacanta burcad-badeedda uga soo celin lahaayeen markabka oo uu lahaa nin kasoo jeeda isla qabiilka. Sheekh Cali al-Shaghanbi ayaa wakaaladda wararka Ciraaq ee Shafaq News u sheegay in markabka lagu qabsaday Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo burcad-badeeddu ay haysteen shaqaalihii saarnaa, kadibna ay dalbadeen lacag madax-furasho ah. Sida uu sheegay Sheekh Cali, ku dhowaad 40 nin oo kasoo jeeda degmada Abu al-Khasib iyo tuulada Jikour ee gobolka Basra ayaa abaabulay howlgalka, iyagoo xiriir iyo isku-duwid la sameeyay dhinacyo ka baxsan Ciraaq. Howlgalka ayaa ugu dambeyn lagu soo furtay markabka iyo shaqaalihii la socday, waxaana la qabtay toddobo nin oo lagu eedeeyay burcad-badeednimo, halka kuwo kale ay baxsadeen, sida uu sheegay hoggaamiyaha qabiilka. Muuqaallo lagu faafiyay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya rag hub culus sita oo la sheegay inay yihiin xubnaha qabiilka Ciraaqiga ah, kuwaas oo ku jira iska horimaad ka dhacay badda. Warbaahinta Ciraaq ayaa sheegtay in dagaalka lagu soo furtay markabka uu socday dhowr saacadood, inkastoo aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin dhammaan faahfaahinta muuqaallada la baahiyay. Warbaahinta Ciraaq ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in howlgalka uu dhacay kadib markii markabka muddo ku dhow bil uu gacanta ugu jiray burcad-badeedda. Sheegashada Puntland Dhacdadan ayaa waxaa barbar socda warar kale oo sheegaya in ciidamada Puntland ay door weyn ka qaateen soo furashada markabka. Markabka, oo lagu magacaabo Sibu 1 , ayaa la afduubtay bishii Agoosto, isla markaana howlgalka lagu soo furtay lala kaashaday mas’uuliyiinta Puntland. Sida warbixintaas lagu sheegay, Puntland ayaa horraantii toddobaadka billowday daba-galka markabkan iyo saddex markab oo kale oo burcad-badeeddu ku haysteen meel u dhow degmada Bandar Beyla. Ilo amni ayaa sheegay in Sibu 1 markii dambe lagu helay meel koonfur ka xigta Garacad, halkaas oo markab ay leeyihiin ciidamada Puntland uu jidgooyo badeed u dhigay, taasoo lama filaan ku noqotay kooxihii haystay markabka. Dhanka kale, bayaan loo nisbeeyay qabiilka Al-Shaghanba ayaa sheegay in howlgalka uu dhacay kadib “xiriir, isku-duwid iyo oggolaansho” ay ka heleen dowladda Soomaaliya. Wararka kale ayaa si gaar ah u xusaya maamulka Puntland, mana cadda heerka ay dhinacyada kala duwan mid walba uga qeyb qaateen howlgalka. Saddex markab oo kale — Honor 25, MT Eureka iyo MT Asana — ayaa wararku sheegayaan inay weli gacanta ugu jiraan kooxo burcad-badeed ah, kuwaas oo u dhaqaaqay dhanka xeebaha Hobyo ee gobolka Mudug. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli mar kale ay sare u kacayaan falalka burcad-badeednimada ee xeebaha Soomaaliya, kadib sanado ay aad u yaraayeen weerarrada noocan ah. Munaasabaddan oo ay si wadajir ah usoo qaban-qabiyeen Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa waxaa kasoo qeybgalay Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha iyo Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir, ahna Duqa Caasimadda. Waxaa sidoo kale kasoo qeybgalay taliyeyaasha ciidamadda Nabad Suggida iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka , Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Ciidanka Booliiska Soomaaliyeed. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo xafladda ka hor shir la qaatay taliyeyaasha iyo saraakiisha ciidamada kala duwan ee dalka ayaa dhagaystay warbixin ku saabsan amniga caasimadda, taas oo muujisay in 86.06% hoos loo dhigey falalkii amni darada Muqdisho intii u dhaxaysay 2023-2026 kadib qorshe xiriirsan oo amni. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha XFS Mudane Xamsa oo la hadlay saraakiisha ayaa yiri “ 𝐐𝐨𝐟𝐧𝐚 𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐧 𝐥𝐚𝐠𝐚 𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧 𝐢𝐧 𝐮𝐮 𝐚𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐤𝐮 𝐜𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐨, 𝐪𝐨𝐟𝐤𝐚 𝐮𝐮 𝐝𝐨𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐛𝐚 𝐡𝐚 𝐧𝐨𝐪𝐝𝐨”, isaga oo ciidamada kala duwan ku ammaanay guulaha waaweyn ee laga gaaray xaqiijinta amniga caasimadda iyo guud ahaan dalka.

items.title: Kulan looga hadlayay amniga Muqdisho oo ka dhacay Xarunta Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Raysal Wasaaraha Somaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa caawa booqday Xarunta Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ee Magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu ku shir guddoomiyay kulan looga hadlayay amniga Caasimadda Muqdisho. Kulanka ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi, Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil Fartaag, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska, General Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, Taliyaha Ciidanka Badda, Admiral Cabdiwahaab Cabdullaahi Cumar, Agaasimaha Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda & Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA), Mahad Maxamed Salaad, Gudoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) iyo masuuliyiin kale. Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa sidoo kale xaruntaasi kaga qaybgalay munaasabad lagu maamuusayay Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, kuwaas oo uu uga mahadceliyay doorkooda sugidda amniga caasimadda iyo guud ahaan dalka. Raysal Wasaaraha ayaa ciidamada ku amaanay guulaha ay ka gaareen xaqiijinta amniga magaala madaxda dalka ee Muqdisho. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa la tilmaamaa in ay wax weyn ka qabatay amniga Muqdisho, dhowrkii sano ee u dambeeyay. Ciidamo isku dhaf ah ayaa bishii April ee sanadkii 2023 lagu wareejiyay howlaha sugidda amniga ee magaalada. Xoogagan oo isugu jira Ciidamada Booliska, Nabad Sugidda Gobolka Banaadir iyo Polizia Militare ayaa ku guuleystay in ay wax ka bedelaan muuqaalkii amniga magaalada.

Kulanka ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi, Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil Fartaag, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska, General Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, Taliyaha Ciidanka Badda, Admiral Cabdiwahaab Cabdullaahi Cumar, Agaasimaha Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda & Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA), Mahad Maxamed Salaad, Gudoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) iyo masuuliyiin kale. Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa sidoo kale xaruntaasi kaga qaybgalay munaasabad lagu maamuusayay Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, kuwaas oo uu uga mahadceliyay doorkooda sugidda amniga caasimadda iyo guud ahaan dalka. Raysal Wasaaraha ayaa ciidamada ku amaanay guulaha ay ka gaareen xaqiijinta amniga magaala madaxda dalka ee Muqdisho. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa la tilmaamaa in ay wax weyn ka qabatay amniga Muqdisho, dhowrkii sano ee u dambeeyay. Ciidamo isku dhaf ah ayaa bishii April ee sanadkii 2023 lagu wareejiyay howlaha sugidda amniga ee magaalada. Xoogagan oo isugu jira Ciidamada Booliska, Nabad Sugidda Gobolka Banaadir iyo Polizia Militare ayaa ku guuleystay in ay wax ka bedelaan muuqaalkii amniga magaalada.

items.title: Hassan Sheikh’s Democratic Bubble and Somalia’s Dangerous Political Reality
items.description: By Abdullahi A. Nor President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s message to the United Nations reveals what may be the central contradiction of Somalia’s current political crisis. He wants the international community to support Somalia’s democratic transition — but he also appears to want the international community to accept the Federal Government’s definition of that transition without challenging the political process through which it is being pursued. That is not how democracy works. In his address to the UN General Assembly, Hassan Sheikh called on the United Nations and Somalia’s international partners to support constitutional reform, democratic institutions and the transition toward direct elections. He then emphasized that Somalia’s democratic transformation must remain “owned” and led by Somalis. On the surface, that sounds entirely reasonable. But there is a much harder question underneath it: Which Somalis? If the Federal Government and the principal opposition forces cannot agree on the electoral rules, constitutional changes or the administration of the next election, then it is difficult to argue that there is already a national Somali consensus behind the government’s approach. The President Appears to Be Living Inside a Political Bubble The most troubling feature of Hassan Sheikh’s position is not his stated commitment to direct elections. Somalia needs credible elections. It needs stronger institutions. It needs constitutional government. The problem is the apparent assumption that the government’s preferred route toward those objectives should automatically become the country’s route. That is where the president risks becoming trapped inside a political bubble. From within Villa Somalia, constitutional amendments may look like institutional reform, direct elections may look like democratic progress and government-led electoral preparations may appear to be the natural path forward. Outside that bubble, however, Somalia looks very different. Puntland and Jubaland have sharply disagreed with Mogadishu. Opposition leaders have rejected important aspects of the government’s political approach. The Somali Future Council has taken the dispute to the UN Security Council and called for international mediation. These are not minor disagreements. They concern the fundamental rules by which political power will be acquired and transferred. Who Owns Somali Democracy? Hassan Sheikh’s insistence on “Somali ownership” raises an obvious question. Does Somali ownership mean that the Federal Government in Mogadishu owns the process? If so, that is not national ownership. Somalia is a federal country. Its political legitimacy cannot simply be reduced to the preferences of the government sitting in the capital. Puntland is Somali. Jubaland is Somali. Hirshabelle is Somali. Galmudug is Somali and South West State is Somali. Opposition leaders, political parties, civil society and ordinary citizens are also Somali.If these constituencies disagree over the rules of the political system, their disagreement cannot be erased by declaring the process nationally owned. Ownership requires participation . And participation requires compromise. The UN Is Not Somalia’s Political Enemy There is also something deeply uncomfortable about telling the international community to support Somalia while simultaneously attempting to define the limits of what that support should mean. Somalia has relied on international partners for decades. The United Nations and other international institutions have supported humanitarian operations, state-building, security institutions, elections, constitutional processes and political dialogue. Somalia’s international partners are not strangers arriving at the gates of a fully functioning state. They have been part of Somalia’s survival. That does not mean foreigners should govern Somalia. It means international partners have a legitimate interest in ensuring that political agreements are inclusive, credible and capable of preventing renewed conflict. If Somali leaders cannot reach such an agreement themselves, asking international partners to facilitate dialogue is not a surrender of sovereignty. It is political realism. The Future Council’s Appeal Cannot Simply Be Ignored The appeal by the Somali Future Council to the UN Security Council should therefore not be dismissed as merely another opposition complaint. It represents a fundamentally different interpretation of Somalia’s political crisis. The coalition is arguing that the dispute requires external mediation precisely because the Somali political leadership has been unable to reach an agreement on the electoral framework. Whether one agrees with the Future Council’s proposals or not, its appeal demonstrates that the country’s political crisis has reached a point where international attention is being sought by major Somali actors themselves. That reality should force the president to reconsider the meaning of “Somali ownership.” If Somali political leaders are asking the UN to help them negotiate, the answer should not be to tell the UN to remain on the sidelines. Direct Elections Are Not the Entire Democratic Project Hassan Sheikh presents direct elections as the centrepiece of Somalia’s democratic transformation. But elections alone do not create democracy. The rules must be agreed. The institutions must be trusted. The opposition must have meaningful political space. Federal states must have confidence in the constitutional order. And the losing side must believe that the election was sufficiently legitimate to accept the result. Otherwise, direct elections can become another source of conflict rather than a solution to Somalia’s political crisis. The real democratic achievement would therefore not simply be putting ballots into boxes. It would be creating a political system in which the major Somali stakeholders accept the rules before the voting begins. The President Cannot Dictate Consensus This is where Hassan Sheikh’s position ultimately faces its greatest test. A president can propose constitutional reform. He can advocate direct elections. He can ask international partners for assistance. But he cannot manufacture national consensus by presidential declaration. Nor can he decide unilaterally which Somali political actors deserve to participate in determining the country’s political future. That is the essence of democratic politics. The president’s mandate gives him authority to govern. It does not give him ownership of Somalia’s political future. Somalia needs the International Community — and the International Community needs to be honest. The country remains dependent on international support in ways that cannot simply be wished away. Its security institutions require external assistance. Its humanitarian system depends heavily on international funding. Its political institutions continue to receive international support. It is unrealistic to tell the international community: finance us, protect us and support us — but do not question our political process . International partners should respect Somali sovereignty. But respect for sovereignty does not require silence in the face of political deadlock. Nor should international engagement mean imposing solutions on Somalia. The proper role is mediation, facilitation and support for agreements reached by Somalis themselves. The Choice Before Hassan Sheikh Hassan Sheikh now has an opportunity to demonstrate whether his commitment to democracy means more than direct elections. He can continue along a government-led path and insist that the international community simply support it. Or he can recognize that Somalia’s democratic transition requires something more difficult: political compromise.That means sitting with opponents. Listening to federal member states. Reconsidering disputed constitutional changes. Negotiating the electoral rules. And allowing the international community to help when Somali political leaders cannot resolve their differences alone. That would not weaken Somali ownership. It would demonstrate it. Somalia does not need a president who believes he can dictate the terms of consensus. It needs political leaders capable of building consensus even when they do not control the room. The UN cannot save Somalia from Somali political disagreements. But neither should Somalia’s leaders demand that the UN look away while those disagreements threaten to deepen the country’s political divisions. The future of Somali democracy cannot belong to one president, one government or one political camp. It must belong to Somalia. Abdullahi A. items.title: City Under Fire: Baidoa’s Civilians Pay the Price
items.description: Baidoa (WDN) — Baidoa is being pushed into an increasingly intolerable humanitarian and security crisis as fighting between forces aligned with Somalia’s Federal Government and supporters of former South West President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen continues to expose civilians to artillery, airstrikes and armed confrontation. What makes the situation particularly alarming is the reported use of increasingly sophisticated military capabilities in what remains, at its core, a political dispute over who governs South West State. Laftagareen has appealed to the United States, the United Nations, European Union, African Union and IGAD, urging international actors to condemn what he describes as a military assault on South West State and to launch an independent investigation into the reported air operations. Baidoa’s Civilians Caught in a Political War In his appeal, Laftagareen said federal military operations against his administration and its supporters had continued for approximately six months, with aerial operations intensifying during the past two months. He alleged that aircraft, including F16, had been used in operations around Baidoa and claimed that civilians and livestock had been killed. Those claims have not been independently verified. But the broader civilian danger is no longer theoretical. Fighting around Baidoa in recent weeks has already caused casualties and forced residents to flee their homes. The Associated Press reported that Bay Regional Hospital treated 71 wounded people, including 15 women, following fighting on September 3, while one civilian death was reported. The question is therefore becoming increasingly urgent: how much military force can be used in a political confrontation before the civilian population pays the price? Drones and F-16s Raise the Stakes The most serious allegations concern the reported use of drones and F-16 fighter aircraft. Laftagareen’s office has accused Türkiye-linked military capabilities of being used in strikes around Baidoa and in Doolow, including an attack on the residence of former Somali Correctional Service Commander General Mahad Abdirahman Aden, known as General Shub. The former Southwest administration alleged that an F-16 was involved in the Doolow operation and accused the Federal Government of directing the attack. Those allegations remain unproven. Somalia’s Federal Government denied involvement in the Doolow incident and said preliminary information suggested that explosions at the residence may have resulted from explosives being prepared inside the house. The government said it would establish a fact-finding committee to investigate the incident. That competing account makes an independent investigation all the more important. When Military Power Enters a Political Dispute The central concern is not simply whether Somalia possesses modern military aircraft or armed drones. It is where and why such weapons are being used. Drones and fighter aircraft are designed for military operations against armed threats. Their use in densely populated areas during a political confrontation carries a fundamentally different level of risk. Baidoa is not an empty battlefield. It is a major urban centre and humanitarian hub, home to large numbers of civilians and displaced people. Recent fighting has already disrupted civilian life and humanitarian operations. If advanced air power is being used against forces aligned with one political faction in a dispute over regional authority, the consequences extend beyond the immediate targets. Homes, markets, roads, businesses and families can all become exposed to the conflict. That is why the alleged use of F-16s and armed drones should be treated as a red-line issue for civilian protection, regardless of which political side is responsible. The Conflict Has a Political Origin At the heart of the crisis is not an external invasion or a conventional war between two states. It is a dispute over political authority, legitimacy and the future leadership of Southwest State. Federal forces took control of Baidoa in March, after which Laftagareen resigned. A new Southwest administration was subsequently established with federal backing. Fighting involving forces loyal to Laftagareen has since repeatedly challenged that political settlement. That context matters. When the underlying dispute is political, escalating the military response can deepen rather than resolve the disagreement. Every additional airstrike risks creating new grievances, displacement and demands for retaliation. The result could be a cycle in which a political disagreement increasingly acquires the characteristics of an armed conflict. An International Investigation Is Now Essential Laftagareen has asked international partners to investigate the reported attacks and establish responsibility. Such an investigation should examine the identity of the aircraft involved, the targets selected, the legal authority for each operation, the presence of civilians in affected areas, the chain of command and any civilian casualties or property damage. It should also establish whether military capabilities supplied or supported by foreign partners are being used consistently with their intended purpose and applicable legal obligations. No political faction should be presumed guilty before the facts are established. But neither should allegations involving civilian harm be dismissed without investigation. Baidoa Cannot Become the Battlefield for a Political Settlement Somalia’s political disputes cannot be solved from the air. If the central disagreement is about who should govern South West State, the ultimate solution must come through a political process capable of addressing competing claims of legitimacy and authority. Military aircraft may be capable of destroying positions. They cannot settle the political question that produced the confrontation in the first place. For the people of Baidoa, the immediate priority is simpler: an end to attacks, protection from further violence and the restoration of normal civilian life. The international community should therefore focus not only on who controls Baidoa, but on whether civilians are being protected while that political dispute unfolds. Because when a political crisis reaches the point where drones and fighter aircraft are reportedly being used over civilian areas, the question is no longer merely who wins the political contest. The question is how much of Baidoa will be left for civilians to return to when it is over. WardheerNews The post City Under Fire: Baidoa’s Civilians Pay the Price appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Soomaalidii ku jirtay xabsiga Guantánamo Bay oo laga soo dejiyey Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Siddeed nin oo Soomaali ah oo muddo ku dhow bil lagu hayey saldhigga ciidamada Mareykanka ee Guantánamo Bay ayaa laga soo masaafuriyey Mareykanka, iyagoo ugu dambeyn soo gaaray magaalada Muqdisho. Raggan ayaa Khamiistii ka baxay Cuba, waxayna safarkooda kusoo mareen Puerto Rico, Dakar iyo Nairobi, ka hor inta aysan diyaarad kale uga soo gudbin caasimadda Kenya una imaan Muqdisho. Adam Abdullah, oo ka mid ah ragga la soo masaafuriyey, ayaa MPR News u sheegay in markii hore ay u maleynayeen in diyaaradda ay saarnaayeen ay Guantánamo Bay u tageyso oo keliya inay shidaal qaadato, balse markii ay halkaas gaareen lagu wareejiyey xarun lagu hayo dadka ay dowladda Mareykanka u qorsheyneyso masaafurinta. Adam ayaa sheegay in ragga Soomaaliyeed ay maalintii labaad bilaabeen cunto-joojin, kaddib markii aan loo sheegin sababta halkaas loogu hayo iyo muddada ay ku sugnaan doonaan. “Waxay ahayd xaalad aad u adag,” ayuu yiri Adam. Wuxuu sidoo kale ku eedeeyey ilaalada xarunta inay garaaceen kaddib markii uu ka qeyb qaatay cunto-joojinta. “Way i garaaceen, waxayna i geliyeen qol aad u qabow si ay ragga kale u cabsi geliyaan,” ayuu Adam u sheegay MPR News. Sheegashadaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. MPR ayaa sheegtay in Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka aysan si gaar ah uga jawaabin eedeynta la xiriirta garaacista. Sagaal bilood oo xabsi ah Adam, oo 31 jir ah, ayaa Mareykanka tegay horraantii 2023, isagoo magangalyo-doon ah, waxaana loo oggolaaday inuu shaqeeyo inta dacwadiisa socdaalka ay socotay. Wuxuu ka shaqeynayey farsamada baabuurta gobolka Minnesota markii saraakiisha socdaalka Mareykanka ay xireen 12-kii December 2025. Kaddib waxaa loo kala wareejiyey xarumo ku yaalla Minnesota, Kentucky iyo Louisiana, ka hor inta aan dabayaaqadii August isaga iyo toddobo Soomaali kale loo gudbin Guantánamo Bay. Sahan Journal ayaa hore u sheegtay in garsoore socdaal uu 14-kii May amray in Adam laga masaafuriyo Mareykanka, isla markaana uusan lahayn racfaan weli socda markii loo dirayey Guantánamo. MPR ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in baaritaan ay ku sameysay diiwaannada maxkamadaha Minnesota aysan ku helin wax dambi ah oo Adam lagu helay, marka laga reebo laba ganaax oo la xiriiray meel baabuur la dhigay xilliga barafka. Adam ayaa sheegay in ragga Soomaaliyeed lagu hayey ilaalo adag, maalintii loo oggolaan jiray qiyaastii hal saac oo ay bannaanka ku qaataan, isla markaana silsilado lagu xiri jiray marka loo kaxeynayo inay telefoon isticmaalaan. Wuxuu sheegay inuu sii waday cunto-joojinta ilaa loo oggolaaday inuu la xiriiro qof ka tirsan safaaradda Soomaaliya, markaas oo uu ogaaday in la qorsheynayo in Muqdisho loo masaafuriyo. DHS oo difaacday tallaabada Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka ayaa difaacday tallaabooyinka laga qaaday ragga Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah dadka loo qaaday Guantánamo ay lahaayeen taariikh dambiyeedyo ay ka mid yihiin weerar, hub, dhac iyo dambiyo la xiriira maandooriyaha. Hase yeeshee, waaxdu ma aysan caddeyn eedeymaha gaar ahaan qof kasta lagu xiriirinayo. items.title: BF Soomaaliya oo u yeeray taliyaha ciidanka Xoogga iyo wasiirka difaaca + Sababta
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Difaaca Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa si deg-deg ah ugu yeeray wasiirka gaashaandhigga Axmed Macalin Fiqi iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Jeneraal Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, si wax looga waydiiyo cabasho ku saabsan 6,000 oo askari oo isugu jiro hawlgab, naafo iyo qoysaska askartii dhimatay oo la sheegay in la jaray xuquuqdoodii. Ugu horreyn guddiga ayaa su’aallo ka keenay jarista lacagaha loo qoondeeyay agoonta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isagoo nasiib darro ku tilmaamay in xuquuqdooda la dudsiiyo askartiii dalkan u shahiiday iyo kuwa u naafoobay, iyagoo la dagaalamaya cadowga. Guddiga oo soo bandhigay 4 su’aallood oo ku geedaamay arrintan ayaa wasiirka gaashaandhigga u qabtay inuu uga soo jawaabo muddo 72 saacadood gudahood ah, sidoo kalena isaga iyo taliyaha Xoogga ay si deg-deg ah u horyimaadaan guddiga difaaca ee Baarlamaanka. “Mudane Wasiir, waxa lagaa sugayaa in aad qoraal ahaan uga soo jawaabto su’aalaha sare ku xusan muddo 72 saacadood gudahood ah. Sidoo kale waxa lagu farayaa in aad hortimaado Guddiga Difaaca adiga iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, taariikhda hoos ku xusan. Taariikhda: 04/10/2026 Saacadda: 11:00 subaxnimo Goobta: Xafiiska Guddiga Difaaca, Golaha Shacabka, Villa Hargeysa,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Tallaabadan waxaa ka horreysay dood ay arrintan maanta ka keeneen xildhibaanno ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka oo eedda ugu wayn dusha u saaray xukuumadda Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza. “Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza iyo Wasiiradiisa ayaa jartay lacagta laga jartay agoonta ciidamada, Baarlamaanka ayaana looga yeerayaa hadddii uu imaan waayana gudoonka golaha ayaa xilkiisa ku weynayo,” ayuu yiri Daahir Amiin Jeesow. Dhankiisa Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Carab ayaa isaguna ka hadlay arrintan, wuxuuna difaacay qoysaska askarta geeriyootay iyo carruurta agoonta ah ee la sheegay in laga dhiman mushaarka. “Cid awood u leh inay jarto lacagtaas ma jirto waxaa la rabaa in la dhaco lacagta, sababtoo ah ninka askariga ah marka hore mushaar ayuu qaataa raashin ayaa la siiyaa waa in haddii uu dhintayne reerkiisa la daryeelaa,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Carab. The post BF Soomaaliya oo u yeeray taliyaha ciidanka Xoogga iyo wasiirka difaaca + Sababta appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sahra Cismaan Axmed oo sheegtay in la dilay gabadhii meydkeeda laga helay Baydhabo
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Haweenka, Arrimaha Qoyska & Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Koonfur Galbeed, Sahra Cismaan Axmed ayaa sheegtay in la dilay Ikhlaas Ibraahim Amiin, oo ahayd gabar shan jira oo Jimcihii meydkeeda laga helay mid ka mid ah xaafadaha Magaalada Baydhabo. Gabadhan oo qoyskeeda ay waayeen Arbacadii ayaa meydkeeda laga helay MCH ama goob caafimaad oo ku dhegan gurigooda oo ku yaala xaafadda Xaqsoor. Hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa meydkeeda baaritaan ugu diray Isbitaal Goboleedka Baay, xilli ay jireen calaamado muujinaya in xarig lagu ceejiyay. Wasiirka Haweenka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ka tacsiyeysay geerida Ikhlaas Ibraahim, iyadoona war ka soo baxay xafiiskeeda ku sheegtay in la dilay gabadhaasi, inkastoo aysan wax faahfaahin ah ka bixin qaabka loo dilay. “Marwo Sahro waxay si qoto dheer uga tacsiyeynaysaa geerida naxdinta leh ee gabadha yar, iyadoo tilmaameysa in dhacdadan ay tahay murugo weyn oo taabatay qalbiga bulshada, gaar ahaan qoyska iyo dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed ee jecel nabadda iyo badbaadada carruurta.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay “Marwo Sahro Cismaan Axmed waxay sidoo kale ugu baaqeysaa laamaha amniga iyo hay’adaha caddaaladda inay si degdeg ah, hufan oo waafaqsan sharciga u baaraan dhacdadan, cid kasta oo ku lug lahaydna sharciga la horgeeyo, si loo helo caddaalad iyo isla xisaabtan.” Warka ayaa lagu soo geba-gabeeyay”Dil loo gaysto ilmo yar oo aan waxba galabsan, waa dhacdo naxdin leh oo u baahan in si dhab ah loo baaro, iyadoo mudnaanta koowaad la siinayo xaqa dhibanaha iyo caddaaladda qoyskiisa. Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa dhammaan bulshada inay ilaashadaan xurmada nolosha, gaar ahaan tan carruurta, ayna la shaqeeyaan hay’adaha amniga si xaqiiqada dhacdadan loo helo, caddaaladdana loo xaqiijiyo.” Booliska Baydhabo ayaa saddex qof u soo qabtay kiiska gabadhaasi, oo laba ka mid ah ay gabdho yihiin iyo nin dhallinyaro ah, kaas oo waardiye ka ahaa goobta laga helay meydkeeda.

items.title: Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida oo Dil Toogasho ku Xukuntay Askari Dilay Muwaadin Faryaamo Ahaa
items.description: Muqdisho – Maxkamadda Darajada Koowaad ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa maanta dil toogasho oo ah qisaasta Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi ku xukuntay Ex-Dable Xoogga Dalka Cabdi Aadan Ibraahim, oo ku magac dheer “Soddon”, kaas oo lagu eedeeyay dilka muwaadin ku shaqaysanayay xirfadda dhismaha guryaha. Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi ayaa la dilay 26-kii Luulyo 2026, xilli uu shaqadiisa kasoo baxay, isla markaana uu saarnaa mooto Bajaaj uu u kireystay si uu ugu gaaro hoygiisa. Sida lagu sheegay faahfaahinta kiiska, eedeysanaha ayaa mooto Bajaajta ku joojiyay waddada xaafadda Iga-daba-geey ee degmada Garasbaaley, isaga oo doonayay in la sii qaado. Markii loo sheegay inaysan isku jiho u socon, ayuu muran kadib rasaas furay, waxaana laba xabbadood oo bastoolad ah uu riday mid kamid ah ay caloosha kaga dhacday Marxuumka, kaas oo isla goobta ku geeriyooday. Eedeysanaha ayaa la sheegay inuu isku dayay inuu baxsado, balse uu ku dhuuntay geed ku yaalla meel aan ka fogeyn goobta falka uu ka dhacay. Dad shacab ah ayaa ciidamada ammaanka ku wargeliyay halka uu ku dhuumanayay, waxaana halkaas lagu soo qabtay. Xafiiska Xeer Ilaalinta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa codsaday in kiiska la qaado, waxaana codsigaas la oggolaaday 16-kii Sebtembar 2026. Ugu dambeyn, Maxkamadda Darajada Koowaad ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa maanta ku dhawaaqday xukunka dilka toogashada ah ee qisaasta Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Darajada Koowaad ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Gaashaanle Sare Xasan Cali Nuur Shuute, ayaa warbaahinta u sheegay xukunka lagu riday eedeysanaha.

Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi ayaa la dilay 26-kii Luulyo 2026, xilli uu shaqadiisa kasoo baxay, isla markaana uu saarnaa mooto Bajaaj uu u kireystay si uu ugu gaaro hoygiisa. Sida lagu sheegay faahfaahinta kiiska, eedeysanaha ayaa mooto Bajaajta ku joojiyay waddada xaafadda Iga-daba-geey ee degmada Garasbaaley, isaga oo doonayay in la sii qaado. Markii loo sheegay inaysan isku jiho u socon, ayuu muran kadib rasaas furay, waxaana laba xabbadood oo bastoolad ah uu riday mid kamid ah ay caloosha kaga dhacday Marxuumka, kaas oo isla goobta ku geeriyooday. Eedeysanaha ayaa la sheegay inuu isku dayay inuu baxsado, balse uu ku dhuuntay geed ku yaalla meel aan ka fogeyn goobta falka uu ka dhacay. Dad shacab ah ayaa ciidamada ammaanka ku wargeliyay halka uu ku dhuumanayay, waxaana halkaas lagu soo qabtay. items.title: Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya oo Bilaabay Dhuun Shidaal
items.description: Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya oo Bilaabay Mashruuc Dhuun Shidaal oo 120 KM ah Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya ayaa 24-kii Sebtembar 2026 si rasmi ah u bilaabay mashruuc lagu dhisayo dhuun shidaal oo isku xiri doonta Damerjog ee Jabuuti iyo Dewele ee bariga Itoobiya. Mashruuca oo ay iska kaashanayaan Ethiopian Investment Holdings iyo Dangote Group ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu fududeeyo gaarsiinta shidaalka, yareeyo ku-tiirsanaanta gaadiidka booyadaha iyo xoojiyo isku xirka tamarta ee labada dal. Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya ayaa qaaday tallaabo cusub oo lagu beddelayo habka shidaalka loogu kala gudbiyo labada dal, kaddib markii la dhagax-dhigay mashruuc dhuun shidaal oo dhererkeedu yahay 120 kiiloomitir. Mashruuca ayaa isku xiri doona xarunta shidaalka ee Damerjog ee Jabuuti iyo Dewele oo ku taalla bariga Itoobiya. Waxaa iska kaashanaya Ethiopian Investment Holdings (EIH) iyo Dangote Group , iyadoo munaasabadda lagu bilaabay mashruuca ay ka qaybgaleen Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Ahmed, Madaxweynaha Jabuuti Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle iyo madaxa Dangote Group Aliko Dangote. Mashruucu wuxuu ka kooban yahay dhuun qaadda noocyo kala duwan oo shidaal ah iyo xarumo waaweyn oo kaydinta shidaalka ah oo laga dhisayo labada dhinac.Xarunta Damerjog waxaa loo qorsheeyay awood kaydin oo dhan 375,000 mitir kuyuubik , halka xarunta Dewele lagu qorsheeyay 875,000 mitir kuyuubik , taas oo ka dhigaysa awoodda kaydinta labada dhinac in ay ka badan tahay hal milyan oo mitir kuyuubik. Warbaahinta rasmiga ah ee Jabuuti waxay sheegtay in xarunta Damerjog ay awood u yeelan doonto inay sanadkii maamusho ilaa 5 milyan oo tan oo badeecooyin shidaal ah . Xaruntu sidoo kale waxay xiriir la yeelan doontaa kaabayaasha dekedda iyo tareenka ee Damerjog. Itoobiya oo raadineysa waddo shidaal oo ka hufan Itoobiya oo aan lahayn xeeb ayaa muddo dheer si weyn ugu tiirsanayd kaabayaasha dekedaha Jabuuti si ay u hesho badeecooyin ay ka mid yihiin shidaalka. Mas’uuliyiinta labada dal ayaa sheegay in dhuuntan ay yareyn karto ku-tiirsanaanta gaadiidka booyadaha, kharashaadka saadka iyo ciriiriga ka dhasha waddooyinka isku xira Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya. Ethiopian Investment Holdings ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in dhuuntu dedejin karto gaarsiinta shidaalka gudaha Itoobiya. Tallaabadan waxay sidoo kale la xiriirtaa qorshe ballaaran oo lagu horumarinayo marinka ganacsi iyo tamareed ee u dhexeeya labada dal. Damerjog ayaa horey loogu dhisay kaabayaal loogu talagalay qaabilaadda iyo maaraynta badeecooyinka shidaalka. Hay’adda Dekedaha iyo Aagagga Xorta ah ee Jabuuti waxay sheegtay in terminalka shidaalka ee Damerjog uu leeyahay awood maarayn sannadle ah oo gaareysa 25 milyan oo tan, isla markaana uu leeyahay xiriirro dhuumo oo loogu talagalay badeecooyin shidaal oo kala duwan. Mashruuc ka ballaaran dhuun shidaal Mashruuca cusub ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa qayb ka mid ah qorshe dheer oo lagu dhisayo isku-xir tamareed oo gobolka ah. Sida lagu sheegay wararka rasmiga ah ee Jabuuti, dhuunta 120-ka kiiloomitir ah ayaa noqonaysa tallaabada koowaad ee mashruuc loogu talagalay in si joogto ah shidaalka la sifeeyay looga raro Jabuuti loona gaarsiiyo suuqa Itoobiya. Mustaqbalka, qorshayaal kale ayaa laga yaabaa inay ballaariyaan doorka marinka, oo ay ku jiraan gaadiidka kheyraadka tamarta ee gobolka. Arrimahaas dambe weli waxay ku xiran yihiin qorshayaal iyo hirgelin dheeraad ah. Dhanka Jabuuti, mashruucu wuxuu xoojin karaa doorka dalka ee ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo tamarta gobolka. Dekedda Damerjog waxay ku taallaa meel istiraatiiji ah oo u dhow marin-biyoodka Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab, iyadoo horey loo sameeyay kaabayaal loogu adeegayo gaadiidka iyo kaydinta badeecooyinka tamarta. Ethiopian Investment Holdings iyo Dangote Group ayaa ah labada dhinac ee maalgelinaya horumarinta mashruuca. Warbixinno rasmi ah ayaa xaqiijinaya in dhagax-dhigga la sameeyay 24-kii Sebtembar, halka qiimaha guud ee mashruuca ballaaran uu ilo kala duwan ku kala sheegay tirooyin kala duwan; sidaas darteed qiimaha kama dambaysta ah ee dhammaan qaybaha mashruuca wuxuu u baahan yahay in si rasmi ah loo caddeeyo. Mashruucu, haddii loo hirgeliyo sidii loo qorsheeyay, wuxuu noqon karaa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah kaabayaasha isku xira dekedaha Jabuuti iyo suuqa weyn ee Itoobiya, isagoo diiradda saaraya kaydinta, gaadiidka iyo qaybinta shidaalka. The post Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya oo Bilaabay Dhuun Shidaal first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Daawo: BF oo mar kale ku dhegan R/W Xamza iyo kiis culus la xiriira lacag laga…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada) – Qaar kamid ah xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ayaa maanta si kulul uga hadlay wararka sheegaya in lacagaha loo qoondeeyay agoonta Ciidanka Xoogga la dhimay, kaddib markii qaar kamid ah qoysaskooda ay cabasho ka muujiyeen arrintaasi. Xildhibaanno badan oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa si adag uga hadlay arrintan, waxayna kiiskan ku eedeeyeen xukuumadda Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza iyo Golihiisa Wasiirrada. Xildhibaan Maxamed Xasan Murjaan oo kamid ah xildhibaannada ka hadlay xuquuqda laga goostay agoonta ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inay u doodayaan, isla markaana ay wadaan mooshin ka dhan ah Ra’iisul wasaaraha, ayna horkeeni doonaan Baarlamaanka, si looga doodo. “Mooshinka aan wadno wuxuu ku saabsan yahay shaqa gudasho la’aanta Ra’iisul wasaaraha waxaa kasoo dhicinay shaqaalaha rayidka hadda waxaa la aaday ciidanka, waana 6000 oo ah kuwa dhintay oo dalkan usoo jidaahay qoysaskood ayaa laga jartay,” ayuu yiri Murjaan. Sidoo kale, xildhibaan Maxamed Xasan Murjaan ayaa ku goodiyay inay tallaabo ka qaadi doonaan xukuumadda, isla markaana cid uun ay xilkeeda ku waydiin doonto kiiska, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Arrintan qof ayaa ku bixi doono ka xildhibaanno ahaan shaqadeenna ayaan gudan doonaa,” ayuu mar kale yiri Xildhibaanku. Dhankiisa Xildhibaan Daahir Amiin Jeesow oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa eedda ugu wayn dusha u saaray Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza iyo Golihiisa Wasiirrada, isaga oo sii xoojiyay arrinta ku aadan mooshinka socda “Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza iyo Wasiiradiisa ayaa jartay lacagta laga jartay agoonta ciidamada, Baarlamaanka ayaana looga yeerayaa hadddii uu imaan waayana gudoonka golaha ayaa xilkiisa ku weynayo,” ayuu yiri Daahir Amiin Jeesow. Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Carab ayaa isaguna ka hadlay arrintan, wuxuuna difaacay qoysaska askarta geeriyootay iyo carruurta agoonta ah ee la sheegay in laga dhiman mushaarka. “Cid awood u leh inay jarto lacagtaas ma jirto waxaa la rabaa in la dhaco lacagta, sababtoo ah ninka askariga ah marka hore mushaar ayuu qaataa raashin ayaa la siiyaa waa in haddii uu dhintayne reerkiisa la daryeelaa,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Carab. The post Daawo: BF oo mar kale ku dhegan R/W Xamza iyo kiis culus la xiriira lacag laga… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Baladweyne Splits in Two as Somalia’s Election Crisis Hits the Streets
items.description: Gunfire Reportedly Stops Demonstrators Crossing From Eastern Baladweyne Into Government-Controlled West as Hiiraan Official Warns: “If Hiiraan Dies, Somalia Dies” Baladweyne (WDN) — Somalia’s deepening electoral crisis has erupted onto the streets of Baladweyne, exposing a city increasingly divided between competing political visions for the country’s future. The latest confrontation came after demonstrators who gathered in eastern Baladweyne reportedly attempted to cross into the western part of the city, where Federal Government and Hirshabelle forces are deployed and where support for Mogadishu is said to be stronger. According to reports from the city, the demonstrators were met with gunfire from government and Hirshabelle security forces operating in the western, or Qoraxsin , section of Baladweyne. The demonstrators subsequently turned back toward eastern Baladweyne. The episode has transformed what began as a political demonstration into a stark illustration of the divisions running through one of Somalia’s most strategically important cities. One City, Two Political Camps Baladweyne now appears increasingly divided not simply by geography, but by competing political loyalties and sharply different views over Somalia’s next election. The reported confrontation between demonstrators from the eastern side and security forces deployed in the west has exposed the extent to which the national electoral dispute is being translated into local political tensions. What happens in Baladweyne matters beyond Hiiraan. The city is the political and economic centre of the region and has repeatedly been at the heart of debates over Hirshabelle’s political future. Its divisions therefore carry implications for the wider dispute over who should determine the electoral process and how the next political order should be established. Hiiraan Official Delivers Blistering Warning The political temperature rose further when the chairman of Tardo locality in Hiiraan, who had travelled to Baladweyne to participate in the demonstration, delivered a forceful attack on President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. Addressing the gathering, the official accused the president of pursuing an electoral process in Hirshabelle that would not be accepted in Hiiraan. “The election that Hassan Sheikh is conducting in Hirshabelle will not work in Hiiraan,” he said. He went further, accusing President Hassan Sheikh of having already “auctioned” the rest of Somalia politically while claiming that Hiiraan was the only area that had resisted what he described as that process. His most striking warning was directed at the fate of Hiiraan itself. “If Hiiraan survives, Somalia as a whole will survive. But if Hiiraan dies, Somalia as a whole will die,” he said. The Election Dispute Moves Into the Streets The confrontation in Baladweyne provides a powerful snapshot of Somalia’s wider political crisis. The dispute is no longer confined to negotiations among presidents, opposition leaders and political parties. It is increasingly reaching cities, communities and local administrations, where competing interpretations of the electoral process are generating visible political confrontation. In Baladweyne, the divide is particularly striking. The eastern side has become a visible centre of opposition to the direction of the electoral process, while the western side hosts forces aligned with the Federal Government and Hirshabelle authorities. The reported gunfire — and the demonstrators’ retreat — has now added a security dimension to an already bitter political dispute. Baladweyne Becomes a Warning Sign The central question is no longer simply whether Somalia will hold an election. It is whether Somalia’s political actors can agree on who controls the process, who establishes the rules and whether those rules will be accepted across the country. Baladweyne’s streets are showing what happens when those questions remain unresolved. For now, the city remains physically and politically divided, with rival views of Somalia’s electoral future confronting each other only a short distance apart. And the warning coming from Hiiraan could hardly be more dramatic: What happens in Hiiraan, its political leaders argue, could ultimately shape what happens to Somalia itself. The reported gunfire — and the demonstrators’ retreat — has now added a security dimension to an already bitter political dispute. Baladweyne Becomes a Warning Sign The central question is no longer simply whether Somalia will hold an election. It is whether Somalia’s political actors can agree on who controls the process, who establishes the rules and whether those rules will be accepted across the country. Baladweyne’s streets are showing what happens when those questions remain unresolved. For now, the city remains physically and politically divided, with rival views of Somalia’s electoral future confronting each other only a short distance apart. And the warning coming from Hiiraan could hardly be more dramatic: What happens in Hiiraan, its political leaders argue, could ultimately shape what happens to Somalia itself. items.title: Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Baabi’inta Hubka Nugliyeerka: Halis aan la Dhaaddayn
items.description: 26ka Sebtembar waxay dunidu isxusuusisaa in khatarta hubka nugliyeerku aysan ku koobnayn goobta uu qaraxu ka dhaco. Waxay gaari kartaa dadka, beeraha iyo nolosha dalal aan dagaalka qayb ka ahayn. Doodda hubka sida arxandarrada wax u gummaada ee nugliyeerka waxaa inta badan lagu soo qaadaa awoodda quwadaha iyo dheellitirka ciidamadooda. Waxaase dooddaas ka danbeeya weydiin culus: maxaa ku dhacaya dadka iyo degaankooda haddii hubkan la adeegsado? Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sannadkii 2013kii u asteeyay 26ka Sebtembar, sannad kasta, Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Baabi’inta Hubka Nugliyeerka ee ba’an wax u gummaada. Maalintani waxay fursad u tahay in dib loo eego raadkii xumaa ee hore loo mutay, halisaha weli taagan iyo dadaalka looga hortagayo in hubkaas halista ah mar kale la isu adeegsado. Amniga ku dhisan hanjabaadda aargoosiga Muddo dheer, dawladaha haysta hubka nugliyeerka waxay amnigooda qayb ahaan ku saleeyeen cabsigelinta nugliyeerka : in cadowga laga baajiyo weerar iyadoo la tusayo in weerarkiisa looga jawaabi karo weerar ba’an. Xisaabtaasi waxay ku tiirsantahay in dhinacyadu si sax ah u fahmaan awoodda iyo ujeeddada midba midka kale. Halkaas ayay tabardarradeedu taallaa. Xiisad siyaasadeed, xog si qalad ah loo fasiray ama digniin aan la xaqiijin waxay madaxda gelin kartaa xaalad ay go’aan culus ku gaaraan waqti kooban. Hubka loogu talaggalay in lagu baajiyo dagaal wuxuu, marka xisaabtu qaldanto, noqon karaa isha musiibada laga baqayo. Qiiqa dagaalku sidee ayuu beeraha u gaari karaa? Khasaaraha dagaal nugliyeer kuma ekaan karo burburka iyo shucaaca ka dhasha qaraxyada. Cilmibaaris ku salaysan moodeello cimileed iyo kuwo waxsoosaarka cuntada ah ayaa baaray waxa dhici kara haddii dababka ka kaca magaalooyinka la beegsado ay hawada sare u diraan qiiq madow oo badan. Qiiqaas oo gaara lakabka sare ee jawiga, istaraatosfeerka , wuxuu yarayn karaa iftiinka qorraxda ee dhulka soo gaara. Hoosudhaca iftiinka iyo isbeddelka heerkulku waxay dhaawici karaan waxsoosaarka dalagyada, kalluunka iyo xoolaha. Saameyntan suuraggalka ah ayaa qayb ka ah waxa loo yaqaan jiilaalka nugliyeerka . Baaxadda dhibaatadu waxay ku xirnaan lahayd baaxadda dagaalka iyo xaddiga qiiqa hawada gala; waa saadaal cilmiyeed, mana aha dhacdo hore dunida uga dhacday heerkaas. Dalka ka fog goobta dagaalka ayaa sidaas oo kale wajihi kara cunto yari. Qiiqa hawada gala iyo hakadka ku yimaadda waxsoosaarka cuntadu ma raacaan soohdimaha siyaasadeed. Casharkii Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki Waxa la hubo, oo aan moodeel lagu saadaalin, waa dhibaatadii ka dhalatay bambooyinkii atomiga ahaa ee lagu tuuray Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki sannadkii 1945. Qaraxyadu waxay dileen dad badan, waxay burburiyeen magaalooyin, waxayna dhaawacyo iyo cudurro muddo dheer jiray ku reebeen dad ka badbaaday. Dadkii ka badbaaday, oo loo yaqaan hibakusha , waxay dunida la wadaageen wixii ay arkeen iyo saamAyntii dhaawaca iyo shucaacu ku yeesheen noloshooda. Isbitaallada Laanqayrta Cas ee Japan ayaa tobannaan sano kaddib weli daryeelayay dad la ildaran dhibaatooyin caafimaad ee ay ka dhaxleen qaraxyadii ay sababeen madaxyadii nugliyeerku, oo ay ka mid yihiin noocyo kansar ah. Markhaatifurkooda ayaa doodda hub-ka-dhigista ku soo celinaya dadka ay go’aannada siyaasadeed saamaynayaan. Teknoolojiyadda iyo go’aanka aadanaha Garaadgacmeedka, weerarrada dhijitaalka ah iyo horumarka hababka hubka ayaa su’aalo cusub ka keenaya kalsoonida lagu qabi karo digniinaha amni. Haddii xog qaldan ama faragelin dhijitaal ahi saamayso nidaam digniin, waqtiga loo helo xaqiijinta xogta ayaa muhiim noqonaya. Taasi macnaheedu ma aha in garaadgacmeedka uu keligiis go’aaminayo adeegsiga hubka sida ba’an wax u gummaada ee nugliyeerka. Khatartu waxay ka dhalan kartaa sida xogta loo ururiyo, loo qiimeeyo, looguna bandhigo dadka go’aanka leh, gaar ahaan xilliga xiisaddu sarrayso. Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay ee Cilmibaarista Hub-ka-dhigista, UNIDIR, waxay tilmaantay in isdhexgalka teknoolojiyadahan iyo nidaamyada nugliyeerku kordhin karo halista xiisad sii xoogaysata. Heshiisyada iyo caqabadda hirgelintooda Heshiiska Kahortagga Faafitaanka Hubka Nugliyeerka ( NPT ) ayaa ka mid ah tiirarka ugu waaweyn ee xeerarka caalamiga ah ee arrintan khuseeya. Waxaa saxiixa loo furay 1968 , wuxuuna dhaqan galay 1970 . Heshiisku wuxuu ka hadlayaa kahortagga faafitaanka hubka nugliyeerka, iskaashiga adeegsiga nabadeed ee tamarta nugliyeerka iyo dadaalka hub-ka-dhigista. Heshiiska Mamnuucidda Hubka Nuliyeerka ( TPNW ) waxaa la ansixiyay 2017 , wuxuuna dhaqangalay 2021 . Dawladaha ku biiray ayuu ka mamnuucayaa, waxyaabo kale oo ay weheliyaan, samaynta, tijaabinta, haysashada, adeegsiga iyo ku hanjabidda adeegsiga hubka nugliyeerka. Baaxadda mamnuuciddaas iyo sida ay u hirgeli karto waxay ku xiran yihiin dawladaha heshiiska ku biira iyo tallaabooyinka ay qaadaan. Heshiisyadu waxay dejin karaan waajibaad iyo hannaan wadahadal. Haseyeeshee, dhimista khatartu waxay sidoo kale u baahan tahay in dawladuhu xoojiyaan kalsoonida, ilaaliyaan waddooyinka wadahadalka, si adag u hubiyaan digniinaha, una sii wadaan wadaxaajoodka hubka dhigista. Xusuus u baahan ficil Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki waxay muujiyeen dhibaatada hubkan marka la adeegsado. Daraasadaha cimilada iyo cuntaduna waxay muujinayaan in dagaal nugliyeer oo mustaqbalka dhaca uu saamayn gaarsiin karo dad aad uga fog goobta qaraxyada. 26ka Sebtembar sidaas darteed waa maalin lagu xusuusto dadkii waxyeelladu gaartay, laguna miisaamo go’aannada maanta la gaarayo. Su’aasha hortaalla dawladaha ma aha oo keliya sida looga baajin karo weerar; waa sida looga hortagi karo in qalad, xiisad ama dagaal uu dadweynaha dunida u horseedo khasaare aan dib loo sixi karin.

items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo ansixiyey Hindise-Sharciyeedka Iskaashiga Garsoorka Caalamiga ah
items.description: Muqdisho, 26 Sebtembar 2026 – Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ansixiyey Hindise-Sharciyeedka Iskaashiga Garsoorka Caalamiga ah, kaddib cod loo qaaday oo ay oggolaadeen 130 xildhibaan. Kulanka 19-aad ee kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Golaha Shacabka ayaa waxaa shir guddoomiyey Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow. Natiijada codbixinta ayaa muujisay in 130 xildhibaan ay oggolaadeen hindise-sharciyeedka, sagaal xildhibaan ay diideen, halka laba xildhibaan ay ka aamuseen. Dhanka kale, xildhibaannada ayaa akhrinta labaad marsiiyey Hindise-Sharciyeedka Wax-ka-beddelka Sharciga Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya, Sharci Lr. 130 ee soo baxay 22-kii Abriil 2012. Xildhibaannada ayaa ka dooday qodobbada hindise-sharciyeedka, iyagoo su’aalo weydiiyey mas’uuliyiinta Wasaaradda Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka iyo kuwa Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya oo kulanka ka qeyb galay. Ugu dambeyn, mudanayaasha Golaha Shacabka ayaa loo qeybiyey warbixinta akhrinta labaad ee heshiisyada u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ee ku saabsan iskaashiga garsoorka caalamiga ah.

items.title: Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo dacwo culus ka gudbiyay Xasan Sheekh iyo Jaamac
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen ayaa dacwad culus u gudbiyay beesha caalamka, gaar ahaan dowladda Mareykanka, Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Yurub, Midowga Afrika iyo IGAD, isagoo warqadda uu diray kusoo hadal qaaday xaaladda ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed. Lafta-gareen ayaa marka hore cambaareeyay weerar uu sheegay in madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo dowladdiisa ay ku qaadeen Koonfur Galbeed,isagoo sheegay inay meesha ka saareen maamulkii uu hoggaaminayay oo uu ku tilmaamay mid sharci ah. Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ayaa xusay in weerarka ay ka qayb-qaateen diyaarado dagaal, welina ay duqeymo ka wadaan agagaarka magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay. “Weerarka milatari ee ciidamada federaalka ayaa socday lixdii bilood ee la soo dhaafay. Labadii bilood ee la soo dhaafay, diyaaradaha Cessna ayaa sidoo kale loo adeegsaday, taas oo lagu dilay dad rayid ah iyo xoolo,” ayuu ku yiri qoraalka madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Diyaaraduhu waxay ku xareysan yihiin garoonka diyaaradaha Magaalada Muqdisho, waxaana weli loo adeegsanayaa duqaymaha”. Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo hadal qaaday weerarkii ka dhacay guriga taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta, Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan ee degmada Dooow, isagoo sheegay in loo adeegsaday diyaaradaha dagaalka F-16 ee dalka Turkiga, isla markaana ay amarka siiyeen madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) “Weerar kale oo ka dhacay Doolow, waxaa fuliyay diyaaradaha F-16 ee dowladda Turkiga, kuwaas oo ku shaqaynayay amarka madaxweynihii hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Guddoomiye Jaamac, waxayna weerareen General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan, oo loo yaqaan (General Shub),” ayaaa mar kale lagu yiri warqadda. Arrimahan ayuu tilmaamay inay khatar gelinayaan dadka rayidka ah, ayna wiiqayaan awoodda sharciga iyo guud ahaan xasilloonida Soomaaliya. items.title: R/W Xamza oo sameeyay magacaabis cusub + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) -Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta magacaabay agaasimeyaasha guud ee qaar ka mid ah wasaaradaha xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, si loo dardargeliyo hawlihii socday. Xamza ayaa wareegto uu soo saaray ku magacaabay agaasimaha guud ee wasaaradda tamarta iyo kheyraadka Biyaha, kaas oo loo magacaabay Cabdullaahi Ibraahim Cabdi. Sidoo kale, Axmed Yuusuf Cabdulle ayaa isna loo magacaabay agaasimaha guud ee wasaaradda isgaarsiinta iyo teknolojiyadda ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, sida lagu sheegay wareegtada. Ra’iisul wasaraaha ayaa magacaabistan u cuskaday qodobada 119-aad, farqada (D) ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, wuxuuna faray agaasimeyaasha cusub inay si hufan u gutaan waajibaadka shaqo ee loo igmaday. Waxaa kale oo uu ku amray inay dardargaliyaan shaqooyinka wasaaradaha ee loo igmaday, si horay loogu sii wado horumarka ay ku tallaabsaneyso xukuumadda Dan-Qaran. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii dambe waday isbeddello cusub oo ku aaddan xukuumaddiisa oo dhawaan u dabaal-dageyso waxqabadkeeda, maadaama ay u buuxsantay 4 sanno. Magacaabistan ayaa kusoo aaday, xilli xasaasi ah oo ay taagan tahay xiisad soo kala dhex-gashay Xukuumadda iyo Baarlamaanka, taas oo ka dhalatay qaraarkii kasoo baxay xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre ee ku aadanaa in xilalka agaasime-waaxeedyada wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda lagu buuxiyo hannaan tartan ah, kaas oo ay gebi ahaanba meesha ka saareen xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale keentay is-qab-qabsi awoodeed oo durbo ka dhex bilowday guddoonka Baarlamaanka iyo xafiiska ra’iisul wasaaraha. Is-haysiga labada xafiis ayaa loo arkaa mid salka ku haya ku tartanka awoodda iyo saamaynta siyaasadda dalka. items.title: Daawo: Jubaland oo digniin kasoo saartay xaaladda Gedo, kadib cabsi soo korortay
items.description: Doolow (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Gedo Maxamed Xuseen Alqaadi oo shir jaraa’id u qabtay wariyeyaasha ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda gobolka Gedo, gaar ahaan cabsi laga qabo fatahaado mar kale ku dhufta deegaannada gobolkaas oo hoostaga Jubbaland. Guddoomiyaha ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in saadaasha la bixiyay ay muujineyso in gobolka uu kamid ah yahay meelaha sida wayn looga cabsi qabo inay ku dhuftaan fatahaadaha, ayna isa soo tarayaan digniinaha la bixinayo. Al-qaadi ayaa shacabka gobolka Gedo ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan goobaha biyo fariisadka ah iyo hareeraha wabiga, si aysan usoo gaarin waxyeelo. “Waxaan ugu baaqeynaa shacabka dhibaatooyinka laga cabsi qabo inay iska ilaaliyaan, kana fogaadaan meelaha laga fili karo fatahaadaha waxaan ku boorineynaa shacabka inay aadaan meelaha aysan biyaha gaari karin, si aysan waxyeelo usoo gaarin,” ayuu yiri Alqaadi. Sidoo kale, wuxuu carrabka ku dhuftay in meelaha qaar roobabkii ka da’ay ay durbaba sababeen khasaare xooggan oo isugu jiro dhimasho, dhaawac iyo burbur hantiyeed. “Hadda degmada Buurdhuubo roob ayaa ka da’ay xoolana waa ku dhamaadeen, guryihiina way saameeyeen, hal qofna waa ku dhintay marka waxaan rabnaa arrintaas inaan uga digno shacabka,” ayuu mar kale yiri guddoomiyaha maamulka gobolka Gedo. Dhanka kale, wuxuu ku baaqay in dadka ay is caawiyaan, iskuna gurmadaan, haddii ay soo kororto xaalad culus oo ka dhalan karta roobabka la filayo inay ka da’aan gobolka. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in Jubbaland ay waddo dadaalo dheeraad ah, iyada oo kaashaneysa hay’adaha samafalka, si gurmad deg-deg ah loo sameeyo, haddii ay xaalad soo kororto Horay waxaa Gedo marar bdan ugu dhuftay fatahaado xooggan oo burburiyay buundooyinkii muiimka ahaa ee gobolkaas, kuwaas oo illaa iyo hadda aan helin wax dib u dayactir ah. Puntland Forces Reclaim Hijacked Tanker SIBU 1 After 48-Hour Operation
items.description: MOGADISHU— Puntland maritime forces have recaptured the fuel tanker SIBU 1 after a 48-hour operation off the coast of Somalia’s Mudug region, ending a hijacking that lasted more than a month, Puntland authorities said. All 20 crew members aboard the vessel were rescued during the operation, according to Puntland officials, who said the tanker was brought back under government control after security forces confronted the suspected pirates. SIBU 1 was hijacked on August 20. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported at the time that six armed men had seized the vessel off the coast of Yemen. Puntland authorities said their forces had been monitoring SIBU 1 and other vessels seized by suspected pirates before launching the operation to retake the tanker. The operation resulted in casualties among the suspected pirates, according to Puntland officials. One pirate was killed, four were wounded and 15 were captured. One Puntland security officer was also wounded during the operation. SIBU 1 had previously been placed under U.S. sanctions. Washington sanctioned the vessel in December, alleging that it was involved in the transportation of Iranian petroleum products as part of efforts to evade U.S. sanctions. Following the operation, Puntland authorities said the tanker and its crew had been safely recovered and that maritime forces would continue efforts to secure the coastline and combat piracy and other threats at sea. The recovery of SIBU 1 comes amid continued concerns over maritime security in waters off Somalia. Although piracy has declined substantially from its peak, the latest incident demonstrates that the threat has not been completely eliminated. items.description: Guddiga Qaranka Shaqaalaha Rayidka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo saaray qoraal rasmi ah oo ku saabsan fulinta iyo dib-u-eegista Qaraarka Golaha Shacabka , kaas oo loo diray Wasaaradaha iyo Hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka. Qoraalka oo ku taariikhaysan 26/09/2026 , kuna saxiixan Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka, ayaa lagu sheegay in la fulinayo qaraar Golaha Shacabka uu horey u soo gudbiyay, kaas oo wata tixraaca GSHH/B-11/23/09/2026 , lana xiriira xeerarka iyo habraacyada shaqaalaha dowladda. Guddigu wuxuu xusay in qaraarkaasi uu tixraacayo Sharciga Shaqaalaha Rayidka ee Lr. 132 ee 11 May 2025 , iyo qaraar kale oo ku saabsan hannaanka tartanka furan ee shaqaalaha dowladda , kaas oo ka soo baxay Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha. Sida ku cad qoraalka, Agaasimeyaasha Waaxyaha Maamulka Shaqaalaha ee Wasaaradaha iyo Hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka ayaa laga doonayaa inay si dhow uga qayb qaataan hawsha, isla markaana ay gutaan waajibaadka kaga aaddan fulinta qaraarka. Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka ayaa sidoo kale faray Wasaaradaha iyo Hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka inay qaataan mas’uuliyadda ku aaddan fulinta iyo dib-u-eegista Qaraarka Golaha Shaqabka , iyadoo la raacayo qodobbada sharciga iyo Dastuurka Federaalka Soomaaliya. Qoraalka ayaa si gaar ah u xusaya Qodobka 2-aad ee Qaraarka , iyo sidoo kale Qodobbada 158-aad iyo 159-aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya , kuwaas oo saldhig u ah waajibaadka iyo shaqada hay’adaha dowladda ee arrintan. Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in tallaabadan ay qayb ka tahay habraaca lagu hubinayo in qaraarrada iyo xeerarka la xiriira shaqaalaha dowladda loo maro nidaamka sharciga ah, iyadoo hay’adaha ay khusayso laga doonayo inay gutaan waajibaadkooda. Qoraalka waxaa ku saxiixan Xasan Abshirow Maxamed, Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka , waxaana loo diray Wasaaradda Shaqada iyo Hay’adda Dowladda, Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka iyo Xafiiska Madaxtooyada.
