items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo QM u jeexay khad cas oo ku saabsan doorashooyinka Soomaaliya
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Qaramada Midoobay iyo saaxiibada caalamka ugu baaqay inay taageeraan dadaallada Soomaaliya ugu gudbeyso doorasho qof iyo cod ah, balse wuxuu ku adkeystay in Soomaalidu ay yeelato lahaanshaha iyo hoggaanka geeddi-socodkaas. Xasan Sheekh, oo Khamiistii khudbad ka jeediyey Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, ayaa sheegay in dib-u-habeynta dastuurka ay saldhig u tahay hirgelinta codbixin dadweyne, dhismaha hay’ado lala xisaabtami karo iyo nidaam siyaasadeed oo xisbiyo badan leh. “Waxaan Qaramada Midoobay iyo saaxiibadeenna caalamka ku casuumeynaa inay taageeraan isbeddelkan, iyagoo gacan ka geysanaya xoojinta hay’adaha dimoqraadiyadda, laakiin mar walba ixtiraamaya lahaanshaheenna dimoqraadiyadda Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha. Hadalkiisa ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli khilaaf xooggan uu ka taagan yahay hannaanka loo marayo doorashooyinka soo socda, iyadoo dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradku ay isku hayaan qaabka codbixinta, maamulka doorashada iyo isbeddellada dastuurka. Waxaa sidoo kale sii xoogeysanaya kala duwanaanshaha ku saabsan doorka ay beesha caalamku ku yeelan karto xalinta khilaafka siyaasadeed. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku mideysan yihiin madax mucaarad ah iyo hoggaanka Puntland iyo Jubaland, ayaa dhowaan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ka codsaday inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo khilaafka doorashada, isla markaana beesha caalamku door muuqda ku yeelato ilaalinta heshiis kasta oo siyaasadeed. Warqad uu Golaha Mustaqbalka 11-kii September u diray Golaha Ammaanka ayuu ku dalbaday taageero caalami ah oo lagu gaaro hannaan doorasho oo la isku raacsan yahay. Goluhu wuxuu sidoo kale soo jeediyey in la sameeyo hannaan dhex-dhexaadin iyo dammaanad-qaad ah oo ay qeyb ka yihiin xubnaha Golaha Ammaanka iyo dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya. Mowqifkaas ayaa ka duwan kan uu Xasan Sheekh ka muujiyey Golaha Guud ee QM. Madaxweynaha ayaa soo dhoweeyey taageerada caalamiga ah ee lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha dimoqraadiyadda, balse wuxuu ku adkeystay in geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed ay Soomaalidu hoggaamiso. “Ujeedkeenna waa inaan noqono dimoqraadiyad wax ku ool ah, halkaas oo khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, sharci iyo doorashooyin, ee aan lagu xallin rabshado,” ayuu yiri. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu ay geeddi-socodka dib-u-habeynta dastuurka kala tashatay hoggaamiyeyaasha siyaasadda, dowlad-goboleedyada, bulshada rayidka ah, haweenka, dhalinyarada iyo Soomaalida dibadda. Hase yeeshee, hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ayaa ku doodaya in dowladda ay si keligeed ah u maamushay qeybo muhiim ah oo ka mid ah geeddi-socodka, isla markaana wadahadallo hore oo lagu doonayey heshiis doorasho aysan wax natiijo ah kasoo bixin. Khilaafka doorashada Wadahadalladii ugu dambeeyey ee dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka ayaa bishii July kusoo dhammaaday heshiis la’aan, kadib markii labada dhinac ay isku mari waayeen nidaamka codbixinta iyo cidda maamuleysa doorashooyinka soo socda. Inkasta oo dowladda iyo mucaaradku ay labaduba taageerayaan in Soomaaliya ay u gudubto doorasho toos ah, haddana waxay si weyn isugu khilaafsan yihiin qaabka loo hirgelinayo. Dowladda federaalka ayaa dooneysa in doorashada lagu galo xisbiyo siyaasadeed oo diiwaangashan, iyadoo ay maamuleyso guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa dhinaciisa soo jeediyey nidaam ku-meel-gaar ah oo shacabka siinaya fursad ay si toos ah u codeeyaan, balse weli lagu ilaalinayo nidaamka awood-qeybsiga beelaha ee 4.5 marka la qeybinayo kuraasta baarlamaanka. Khilaafka waxaa sii adkeeyey wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka ee baarlamaanka ansixiyey bishii March, kuwaas oo muddada xilka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka ka dhigay shan sano halkii ay markii hore ka ahayd afar sano. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa Golaha Ammaanka ka codsaday inuu taageero waxa uu ugu yeeray “hannaan doorasho oo loo dhan yahay, lana fulin karo”, kaas oo khuseeya hay’adaha federaalka iyo kuwa dowlad-goboleedyada. Waxa uu sidoo kale dalbaday hannaan ay dhinacyada caalamku ku dhex-dhexaadiyaan siyaasiyiinta Soomaalida, kuna dammaanad-qaadaan heshiis kasta oo laga gaaro khilaafka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhankiisa Golaha Guud ee QM u sheegay in Soomaaliya ay galayso marxalad cusub oo dimoqraadi ah, taas oo muwaadiniintu ay codkooda ku go’aaminayaan cidda maamuleysa awoodda siyaasadeed. “Tani waa bog cusub oo horumar leh, halkaas oo awoodda siyaasadeed ay go’aaminayaan muwaadiniinta, iyadoo dastuurku hagayo, sarreynta sharciguna ilaalineyso,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha. items.title: Mareykanka oo soo masaafuriyay Soomaali lagu hayay xabsiga Guantánamo Bay
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa Soomaaliya u masaafurisay siddeed nin oo Soomaali ah, kuwaas oo muddo ku dhow bil lagu hayay saldhigga ciidamada badda Mareykanka ee Guantánamo Bay ee dalka Cuba. Raggaasi ayaa lagu hayay xarunta kaddib markii ay hay’adaha socdaalka Mareykanka ku soo rogeen amarro masaafurin ah. Khamiistii ayay mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanku bilaabeen in Soomaaliya dib loogu celiyo, iyadoo tallaabadan ay qeyb ka tahay kiisaskooda socdaalka. Ragga la masaafuriyey waxaa ka mid ahaa Adam Abdullah, 31 jir ah, oo muddo ku noolaa gobolka Minnesota, kana shaqaynayay farsamada baabuurta xilli uu sugayay go’aanka codsigiisa magangelyo. Sidoo kale Adam ayaa sheegay in wakiillo ka tirsan hay’adda socdaalka iyo fulinta xuduudaha Maraykanka (ICE) ay xireen 12-kii Diseembar, xilli ay dowladdu bilowday howlgalkii ay ugu magac dartay Operation Metro Surge. Sida uu sheegay, marka laga reebo laba ganaax oo baabuurta la xiriiray, uusan lahayn wax dambi ah oo laga diiwaangeliyey Minnesota. Wuxuu Maraykanka yimid horraantii 2023, wuxuuna si sharci ah uga shaqaynayay makaanik. Guantánamo Bay ayaa ah saldhig ciidan oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay Cuba, waxaana muddo dheer loo adeegsanayay xarun lagu hayo maxaabiis iyo dad ay dowladda Mareykanku u aragto inay ku lug leeyihiin arrimo amni ama kiisaska kale ee la xiriira dowladda. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ku qaadeen Sacuudiga
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo ee dagaalka adag kula jira Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay inuu qabtay oo uu burburiyay diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn iyo gantaallo ballistic ah oo ay Xuutiyiintu soo rideen. Afhayeen u hadlay isbahaysiga ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in difaaca cirka Sacuudigu uu qabtay labada diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn, kuwaas oo Xuutiyiintu u ganeen dhanka magaalada Riyaad. Sidoo kale wuxuu intaas ku daray in difaaca cirka Sacuudigu uu qabtay oo burburiyay laba gantaal oo ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiintu ku bartilmaameedsadeen magaalada Khamis Mushait, oo ku taalla koonfur-galbeed Sacuudiga. Dhanka kae, Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ayaa xalay soo saaray digniino ku aaddan khatar suurtagal ah oo ka dhici karta Khamis Mushait. Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iiraan ayaa qaaday weerarro cusub, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa lagu beegsaday Riyaad, iyagoo sii waday weerarrada inkastoo ay beesha caalamku cambaareysay. Dhawaan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyay kororka weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ku hayaan Sacuudiga, isagoo sheegay in weerarradu waxyeello u geysteen dad rayid ah, oo ay ku jiraan haween iyo carruur. Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale weerarro ka fuliyeen meelaha muhiimka u ah maraakiibta shidaalka ee Sacuudiga, iyagoo carqaladeeyay isu-socodka badda ee gobolka. Weerarrada iyo xiisadaha ka dhashay ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeeshay qiimaha tamarta. Afhayeen u hadlay isbahaysiga ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in difaaca cirka Sacuudigu uu qabtay labada diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn, kuwaas oo Xuutiyiintu u ganeen dhanka magaalada Riyaad. Sidoo kale wuxuu intaas ku daray in difaaca cirka Sacuudigu uu qabtay oo burburiyay laba gantaal oo ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiintu ku bartilmaameedsadeen magaalada Khamis Mushait, oo ku taalla koonfur-galbeed Sacuudiga. Dhanka kae, Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ayaa xalay soo saaray digniino ku aaddan khatar suurtagal ah oo ka dhici karta Khamis Mushait. Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iiraan ayaa qaaday weerarro cusub, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa lagu beegsaday Riyaad, iyagoo sii waday weerarrada inkastoo ay beesha caalamku cambaareysay. Dhawaan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyay kororka weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ku hayaan Sacuudiga, isagoo sheegay in weerarradu waxyeello u geysteen dad rayid ah, oo ay ku jiraan haween iyo carruur. Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale weerarro ka fuliyeen meelaha muhiimka u ah maraakiibta shidaalka ee Sacuudiga, iyagoo carqaladeeyay isu-socodka badda ee gobolka. Weerarrada iyo xiisadaha ka dhashay ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeeshay qiimaha tamarta. items.title: “Somaliland waxa Mareykanka ku qabsaday waa cuqubo Rabbaani ah,” waxaa sidaas yiri…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Cabdirashiid Xaashi oo ah falanqeeye siyaasadeed iyo wasiir hore oo heer federaal ah ayaa ka hadlay fashilka safarkii hoggaanka Somaliland ee Mareykanka, xilli maamulka uu dadaal xooggan ugu jiro doonistiisa gooni-u-goosadka. Cabdirashiid ayaa sheegay in sababta fashilka keentay ay tahay in hoggaanka Somaliland ay haleeshay “cuqubbo Rabbaani ah” oo ka dhalatay garab-ka-bixii ay dano ku-meel-gaar ah awgood, garabkooda uga bexeen shacabka Falastiin ee dulman. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in garab istaaga Somaliland ee raggii mas’uulka ka ahaa xasuuqa iyo “isir-goynta” ka dhacday Gaza ee loo geystay carruurta Falastiiniyiinta ay waji gabax caalami ah dhex joojisay maamulka. “Xasuuqa Gaza ayaa keentay in dowladihii Yurub iyo xitaa shacabkii Marakanku ay Natenyahu iyo kooxdiisa ka guureen, halka Cirro iyo koxdiisu u guureen. Sida ay sheegtay UNICEF USA, in ka badan 64,000 oo carruur Falastiiniyiin ah ayaa la dilay ama la naafeeyey tan iyo Oktoobar 2023,” ayuu Cabdirashiid ku yiri qoraal uu soo saaray. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli hoggaanka Somaliland uu dadaal ugu jiro sidii uu u heli lahaa taageero caalami ah oo ku aaddan doonista gooni-u-goosadka, iyadoo safarkiisa Mareykanka uu dhaliyay hadal-heyn siyaasadeed. Hoos ka aqriso qoraalka oo dhameystiran: Kooxda Cirro waxa Maraykanka ku qabsaday cuqubay u eg tahay Sababta safarkii madaxweynaha Somaliland iyo kooxdiisa ee Maraykanku uu u harreereeyey fashilaad is wada fangashan (isdaba socda) — oo xitaaal xalay waxaan ujedey taraarax kale oo hor leh, markii su’aal hiillo (camiraad) u ekayd oo uu Cirro weydiiyey maalqabeen Ugandhees ahi ay si uun ugu leexatay Idi Amin Dada!, iyadoo kaaliye Iidlena baaq aan miro dhalin isku dayay inuu wax caymiyo); Tiiyoo maalintii ka horreyseyna Dr. Beyle iyo Dr. Fadal lagu eryanayey mid ka mid ah waddooyinka New York halka ayna ka sii horreysey Qosol-jabkii Laughter-gate. Sababta waxaas oo dhammi u dheceen waxay aniga iila eg tahay in ay dhacday ama ragaas ay haleeshay CUQUBO Rabbaani ah — oo ka dhalatay garab-ka-bixii ay kooxdani (dano ku-meel-gaar ah awgood), garabkooda ka bexeen shacabka Falastiin ee dulman iyo la faraqa-ku-xirashada raggii shacabkaas u geystay xasuuqa iyo isir-goynta adduunku ka argagaxay gaar ahaan carruurta Gaza. Taasoo keentay in dowladihii Yurub iyo xitaa shacabkii Marakanku ay Natenyahu iyo kooxdiisa ka guureen, halka Cirro iyo koxdiisu u guureen. Sida ay sheegtay UNICEF USA, in ka badan 64,000 oo carruur Falastiiniyiin ah ayaa la dilay ama la naafeeyey tan iyo Oktoobar 2023. Adduunka Rabbi ayaa iska leh, sida Suubanaha Nabigeennu sheegayna habaarka ama inkaarta kuwa la dulmiyey iyo Rabbina waxba uma dhexeeyaan; Marka markii ay nimanku soo labtaan halloo sheego in ay fudaydkii ay galeen ka toobad keenaan, isagana haraan Netanyahu, Smotrich iyo Ben-Gvir. Nin ku jecel baa runta kuu sheega. Towbadunna waa furan tahay. Ragguna waa khaldamaa. Ee akhyaareey u-turn ama kala wareeg sameeya. Ilaahayna Soomaalida gees ha ka mariyo cuqubada aad noo soo jiiddeen. Qab iyo isla weynina yaysan taladaan idinka indha tirin oo Jaamac Gaamushow diinta waa taqaan ee lafahaaga caynso. Oo waa tii Alle yiri: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَـٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ Maalin indhuhu argagax la taagmayaan! Oo Alle waatuu yiri, وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ The post “Somaliland waxa Mareykanka ku qabsaday waa cuqubo Rabbaani ah,” waxaa sidaas yiri… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Puntland forces free hijacked oil tanker Sibu 1 off Somalia’s coast, all 20 crew safe
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Puntland’s maritime police force freed the oil tanker MT Sibu 1 on Friday, ending a five-week hijacking off Somalia’s northern coast after a 48-hour operation that left all 20 crew members unharmed, regional officials said. The Puntland Maritime Police Force (PMPF) said its units stormed the Eritrean-flagged tanker in waters off the Mudug coast, disarming the pirates holding it and securing the vessel without casualties among the hostages. Mohamed Jama, a PMPF commander involved in the raid, said the assault had been underway for two days before the ship was retaken. “The ship is free and the pirates are all in the hands of our forces,” Jama said. Footage shared online showed PMPF forces firing as they approached the tanker before boarding and disarming the pirates found aboard. Six armed men seized the Sibu 1 on August 20 roughly 136 nautical miles east of Al Mukalla, Yemen, in the Gulf of Aden, according to the UK Maritime Trade Operations agency, then steered the tanker toward the Puntland coast. It is the sixth commercial vessel hijacked off the Horn of Africa since April, part of a piracy resurgence in waters that had seen attacks fall sharply over the past decade. The tanker was carrying about 228,000 barrels of gasoil and had been bound for Port Sudan when it was taken. It is managed by the UAE-based Qatrat Alnada Almasi Ship Management and was placed under U.S. Treasury sanctions last year over allegations it belonged to a shadow fleet moving Iranian petroleum products in breach of American sanctions. Puntland authorities said the crew of 20 — 16 Indian nationals, two Syrians, one Iraqi and one Sudanese — were all safe. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka dowladda oo qaaday tallaabo dhabar-jab ku ah Xamza
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka ee dowladda ayaa maanta fuliyay qaraarkii kasoo baxay Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ee lagu laalay go’aankii dhawaan kasoo baxay xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre ee ku aadanaa in xilalka agaasime-waaxeedyada wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda lagu buuxiyo hannaan tartan ah. Guddoonka Baarlamaanka ayaa Khamiistii amar ku bixiyay in guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka ee dowladda loo madaxbanneeyo gudashada waajibaadkiisa iyo fulinta hawlaha sharci ahaan loo igmaday ee ay kamid tahay shaqo qoridda, magacabidda iyo dalacsiinta shaqaalaha rayidka dowladda. Waxaa kale oo la faray inuu u hoggaansamo kala madaxbanaanida hay’adaha dowladda ee fulinta, garsoorka iyo sharcidajinta ee la xiriira arrimaha shaqaalaha. Intaas kadib guddiga ayaa ugu dmabeyn u hoggaansamay tallaabada Baarlamaanka, wuxuuna joojiyay boosaskii la xayaysiiyay ee agaasimeyaasha waaxda maamulka shaqaalaha ee wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha Dowladda. Tallaabadan ayaa dhabar-jab wayn ku ah Ra’iisul wasaaraha oo damacsanaa qorshe dib u habeyn loogu sameynayo shaqaalaha dowladda. “Iyadoo la fulinayo Qaraarka Golaha Shacabka ee summaddiisu tahay Tix: GHSH/B-11/23/09/2026, kuna taariikheysan 23/09/2026, kaasoo ujeeddadiisu tahay Qaraarka Golaha Shacabka ee Laalista Xeer Lr. 132 ee 11/05/2025 iyo Qaraarka Higelinta Hannaanka Tartanka Furan ee Shaqaalaha Dowladda ee Doorsoocasho ee Ka soo baxay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Lr. 205 ee 17/09/2026. Si waafaqsan Qodobka 1aad ee Qaraarka Golaha Shacabka BJFS, waxaa la hakiyey boosaskii la xayeysiiyey ee Agaasimiyaasha Waaxda Maamulka Shaqaalaha ee Wasaaradda & Hay’adaha Dowladda,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka uu soo saaray guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka. Sidoo kale, waxaa la faray dhammaan wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka ee Soomaaliya in ay ka gutaan waajibaadka kaga aadan fulinta Qaraarka Golaha Shacabka. Waxaa kale oo qoraalka lasii raaciyay “Sidaas darteed, si waafaqsan Qodobka 2aad ee Qaraarka iyo Qodobka 158aad iyo 159aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka ee Federaalka, waxa uu waajibaadkiisa u gudan doonaa si waafaqsan Dastuurka, sidoo kale, Guddiga wuxuu warbixinno joogto ah siin doonaa Golaha Shacabka arrimaha la xiriira fulinta qaraarka iyo tallaabooyinkiisa waxqabadkiisa”. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Arrintan ayaa keentay is-qab-qabsi awoodeed oo durbo ka dhex bilowday guddoonka Baarlamaanka iyo xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaaraha. Is-haysiga labada xafiis ayaa loo arkaa mid salka ku haya ku tartanka awoodda iyo saamaynta siyaasadda ee dalka. items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo ka digtay khatarta cunno-yarida ee ka dhalan karta El Nino
items.description: Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay inay heshay kaliya ku dhowaad 20 boqolkiiba lacagta ay u baahan tahay si loogu diyaar garoobo dhibaatooyinka cunno-yarida ee laga cabsi qabo inay ka dhashaan xaaladda cimilada ee El Niño . Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ku qiyaastay in loo baahan yahay 202 milyan oo doolar si loogu diyaargaroobo wax ka qabashada dhibaatooyinka la xiriira cunno-yarida ee laga filan karo 22 dal oo loo aqoonsaday inay khatar sare ku jiraan . sida ay sheegtay AFP oo soo xiganaysa sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan Qaramada Midoobay, illaa hadda waxaa la helay qiyaastii shan meelood meel lacagtaas. Hay’adaha saadaasha cimilada ayaa ka digaya in El Niño uu keeni karo isbeddello cimilo oo baahsan, kuwaas oo meelo ka mid ah dunida ka dhalin kara abaaro , halka meelo kalena ay ka dhici karaan roobab xooggan iyo fatahaado . Xaaladdan ayaa walaac gaar ah laga muujinayaa maadaama dalal badan oo ka mid ah kuwa halista ku jira ay durba la tacaalayaan cunno-yari ba’an , dhaqaale xumo iyo xaalado bani’aadannimo oo nugul. Abaaro daba dheeraada ama fatahaado xooggan ayaa sii dhaawici kara wax-soo-saarka beeraha, xoolaha iyo ilaha biyaha, taasoo cadaadis dheeraad ah saari karta bulshooyinka nugul. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa muhiimad gaar ah siinaysa in tallaabooyin hore loo qaado ka hor inta aysan xaaladaha cimiladu isu beddelin dhibaatooyin bani’aadannimo oo waaweyn. Dhaqaale la’aanta hadda jirta ayaa hase yeeshee adkeyn karta in la helo raashin, biyo, adeegyo caafimaad iyo taageero kale oo degdeg ah marka ay dhibaatooyinku soo baxaan. items.title: Local Forces, Faster Results
items.description: Said A. Ali, Researcher INTRODUCTION When pirates seized the oil tanker MT SIBU 1, also known as SEAMUL, off Yemen on August 20, 2026, help came not from an international navy or foreign warship, but from Puntland’s own maritime police. Within 48 hours, the tanker and its cargo were safe. The Puntland Maritime Police Force (PMPF) captured 47 pirates involved in the hijacking. One was killed, five were wounded, and 41 were detained unharmed. All 20 crew members were rescued, including 16 Indians, two Syrians, one Iraqi, and one Sudanese. This was not the first time. In December 2012, the same force freed MV Iceberg 1, a cargo ship whose owner, Azal Shipping, went bankrupt and abandoned ransom talks, leaving the crew captive for nearly 1,000 days. Two crew members died. After a 15-day blockade, PMPF stormed the ship, losing one soldier, and brought the 22 surviving crew members home. Fourteen years apart, these rescues point to the same lesson. local forces can deliver results when trusted to lead. Yet piracy off Puntland’s coast was allowed to fade from priority rather than being dismantled. As funding and attention shifted elsewhere, pirate attacks were rising again by 2024. That gap does not prove local forces cannot solve the problem; it shows they have rarely received sustained support. If Puntland makes maritime security a funded priority, the successes of Sibu 1 and Iceberg 1 could become lasting rather than occasional. The Issues Puntland’s record shows local forces can succeed when trusted to lead. What has not followed is investment commensurate with that success. Consider Calmiskaad. Since late 2024, Puntland’s Counter Terrorism Forces have waged a sustained campaign against ISIS Somalia in the Bari mountains, known as Operation Hilaac. The US and UAE support the operation with airstrikes and logistics, but Puntland forces remain in command. The campaign has been funded and prioritized for over a year. It shows that local forces can do more than perform when given the lead, they can excel when properly resourced. Puntland’s coastal forces, including PMPF, have not received the same commitment. Iceberg 1 and Sibu 1 are 14 years apart not because success is rare, but because piracy slid down Puntland’s priority list after the 2012–2013 crackdown. Funding and attention moved elsewhere, even though the threat remained. By 2024, piracy was rising again, and a weakened maritime force was caught off guard. That weakness was a choice, not a coincidence. The case for local forces becomes stronger when foreign patrols are examined honestly. International navies were not built around Somalia; they follow shifting global crises, from piracy to Red Sea attacks and Gulf tensions. As attention moves, Somalia’s coast receives less coverage. Even at their busiest, foreign patrols largely deterred or intercepted threats from a distance. They did not storm hijacked ships. Puntland’s coastal forces have now done so twice, freeing vessels and crews where foreign patrols could not. That is the advantage foreign missions cannot replicate permanence. A foreign patrol can leave when global priorities change. Puntland’s coastal forces cannot, because they have nowhere else to go. Local-led security can therefore be more sustainable than a temporary outside commitment. It depends on Puntland’s willingness to invest in the force already standing on its coast. Still, force alone will not end piracy. Rescues like Sibu 1 and Iceberg 1 stop hijackings after they happen; they do not remove the reasons young men turn to piracy. The 2026 resurgence is rooted in instability on land, not only gaps at sea (RUSI, 2026), and UNODC argues that piracy is ultimately defeated through courts, ports, and local economies not only at sea. A properly funded coastal force can prevent hijackings and rescue crews. But lasting progress also requires courts to process captured pirates, economic alternatives for young people recruited by pirate networks, and action against illegal foreign fishing, which has pushed coastal communities toward piracy. Local forces are the most reliable security response, tackling piracy’s root causes requires more than any force can provide alone. Conclusion and Recommendations The record is clear. When Puntland’s local forces are trusted to lead, they deliver results. Iceberg 1 and Sibu 1 show their coastal capability. Calmiskaad shows what that capability can achieve with sustained funding. The missing piece is Puntland’s decision to close the gap between what its forces can do and the resources they receive. Three steps follow. First, fund coastal forces as a national priority, not an emergency response. Puntland treats counter-terrorism as a standing commitment, with predictable budgets and long-term planning. Maritime security deserves the same approach, rather than a scramble for resources after a ship is seized. Second, ask international partners to support coastal forces as they support Operation Hilaac. The US and UAE provide airstrikes and logistics while leaving command in local hands. That model funding and equipment without foreign forces taking the lead should extend to maritime security. Third, pair force funding with the land-based work piracy requires. Well-resourced local forces can prevent hijackings and rescue crews. Ending piracy for good also requires courts that can process captured pirates, real jobs for coastal youth recruited by pirate networks, and a serious response to illegal foreign fishing. Puntland does not need to import security. Its forces have shown, twice and 14 years apart, that they can provide it. What remains unproven is Puntland’s willingness to fund that capability before the next ship is seized, rather than after. References Hockey, C. (2026, September 23). items.title: Fahad Yaasiin oo cambaareeyey dhimista lacaga loo qoondeeyo Askarta dhimatay
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Agaasimihii hore ee Hay’adda Nabad-Sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka Soomaaliya (NISA), Fahad Xaaji Yaasiin Daahir, ayaa cambaareeyay go’aan uu sheegay in lagu dhimay xuquuqda dhaqaale ee loo qoondeeyo hawlgabka, ciidamada ku naafoobay difaaca dalka iyo qoysaska askartii ku dhimatay gudashada waajibaadkooda qaran. Fahad Yaasiin ayaa sheegay in dadkaasi ay mudan yihiin daryeel iyo taageero joogto ah, maadaama ay qayb muhiim ah ka qaateen difaaca dalka, halka qaar kalena ay waayeen xubno qoyskooda ka mid ah oo ku dhintay gudashada waajibaadkooda. Wuxuu sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyay in wax laga beddelo lacagaha loo qoondeeyay qaybahan, isagoo dowladda ugu baaqay inay caddeyso sababta iyo saldhigga go’aanka lagu dhimay xuquuqda dhaqaale. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay jiraan dood iyo walaac ku saabsan daryeelka hawlgabka ciidamada, askarta ku naafoobay dagaallada iyo qoysaska askarta ku dhimatay howlgallada dalka. Fahad Yaasiin ayaa ugu baaqay dowladda inay dib u eegto go’aanka, isla markaana mudnaanta siiso daryeelka dadka naftooda iyo caafimaadkooda u huray difaaca Soomaaliya. The post Fahad Yaasiin oo cambaareeyey dhimista lacaga loo qoondeeyo Askarta dhimatay appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo weerar culus ka fuliyay Sacuudiga
items.description: Riyaad ( Raxanreeb Online) Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo ee dagaalka kula jira Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay inuu qabtay oo burburiyay diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn iyo gantaallo ballistic ah oo ay Xuutiyiintu soo rideen. Afhayeen u hadlay isbahaysiga ayaa sheegay in difaaca cirka Sacuudigu uu qabtay oo burburiyay laba diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn, kuwaas oo Xuutiyiintu u ganeen dhanka magaalada Riyad. Afhayeenku wuxuu intaas ku daray in difaaca cirka Sacuudigu uu sidoo kale qabtay oo burburiyay laba gantaal oo ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiintu ku bartilmaameedsadeen magaalada Khamis Mushait, oo ku taalla koonfur-galbeed Sacuudiga. Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo taageero ka hela Iran ayaa qaaday weerarro cusub, oo ay ku jiraan weerarro lagu qaaday Riyad, iyagoo sii waday weerarrada inkastoo ay beesha caalamku cambaareysay. Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa hore u cambaareeyay kororka weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ku hayaan Sacuudiga, isagoo sheegay in weerarradu waxyeello u geysteen dad rayid ah, oo ay ku jiraan haween iyo carruur. Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale weerarro ka fuliyeen meelaha muhiimka u ah maraakiibta shidaalka ee Sacuudiga, iyagoo carqaladeeyay isu-socodka badda ee gobolka. Weerarrada iyo xiisadaha ka dhashay ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeeshay qiimaha tamarta. The post Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo weerar culus ka fuliyay Sacuudiga appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Safiirka cusub ee Turkiga u qaabilsan Soomaaliya oo xilka la wareegay
items.description: Safiirka cusub ee Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan , ayaa si rasmi ah u bilaabay waajibaadkiisa diblomaasiyadeed ee Muqdisho, xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkigu uu marayo marxalad muhiim ah oo iskaashi iyo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed. Safiir Alkan ayaa sheegay inuu sharaf weyn u arko inuu Soomaaliya u matalo Türkiye xilli la xusayo 60-guurada aasaaska xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee labada dal , iyadoo sidoo kale sanadkan uu ku beegan yahay 15-guurada booqashadii taariikhiga ahayd ee Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, uu ku tagay Soomaaliya . Madaxweynaha Turkiga ayaa booqashadii Muqdisho ku tagay xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysay xaalad bani’aadannimo oo aad u daran, waxaana booqashadaasi noqotay mid muhiim u ah xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan. Safiirka cusub ayaa sheegay inuu Muqdisho kula kulmay dhallinyaro Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo la yeeshay kulan iyo wada sheekeysi uu ku tilmaamay mid diirran. Wuxuu xusay in dhallinyaradu ay muujiyeen aragtidooda ku aaddan horumarka amni iyo xasilloonida laga dareemayo Muqdisho iyo nawaaxigeeda sannadihii u dambeeyay. Alkan ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in Turkiga ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, horumarinta iyo xoojinta awoodda hay’adaha dowladda . Hadalkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya iyadoo xiriirka labada dal uu ku fidsan yahay dhinacyo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, waxbarashada, caafimaadka, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga iyo gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Safiirka Ferhat Alkan ayaa sheegay in mudada uu xilka hayo uu xoogga saari doono horumarinta xiriirka labada dal, isaga oo tilmaamay in iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye lagu dhisayo is-ixtiraam, kalsooni iyo dano wadaag ah . Wuxuu sheegay in hadafka ugu weyn uu yahay in xiriirka labada dal loo sii horumariyo jihada lagu gaari karo barwaaqada iyo daryeelka labada shacab ee uu ku tilmaamay kuwo saaxiib iyo walaalo ah. Safiirka ayaa sidoo kale ballanqaaday inuu dhegaysan doono fikradaha iyo talooyinka muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed iyo saaxiibbada Turkiga ee ku sugan Soomaaliya, isaga oo sheegay in albaabbada Safaaradda Türkiye ay mar walba u furnaan doonaan dadka Soomaaliyeed . Bilowga shaqada Safiir Ferhat Alkan ayaa sidaas ku soo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye ay xusayaan lixdan sano oo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed ah, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan in xiriirkooda iyo iskaashigooda loo sii gudbiyo heerar cusub.

items.title: Nin Soomaali oo maxkamad loo soo taagay inuu isku dayay dilka laba qof oo Yahuud ah
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) – Nin Soomaali haysta dhalashada Britain ayaa Jimcihii iska fogeeyey saddex eedeyn oo isku day dil ah, oo laba ka mid ah la xiriiraan weerar mindi loo adeegsaday oo bishii April lagu dhaawacay laba nin oo Yuhuud ah oo ku sugnaa waqooyiga London. Essa Suleiman, oo 45 jir ah kuna dhashay London, ayaa kasoo muuqday maxkamadda Old Bailey ee London, halkaas oo uu ku diiday laba eedeyn oo isku day dil ah oo ka dhashay weerarkii 29-kii April ka dhacay xaafadda Golders Green, oo ay ku nool yihiin dad badan oo Yuhuud ah. Waxa uu sidoo kale diiday eedeyn saddexaad oo isku day dil ah, taas oo la xiriirta nin ay muddo dheer is-yaqaaneen oo lagu weeraray koonfurta London saacado ka hor dhacdadii Golders Green. Suleiman ayaa sidoo kale diiday eedeyn ah inuu meel fagaare ah ku haystay mindi gacanteedu madow tahay. Dacwad-oogaha Deanna Heer KC ayaa maxkamadda hore ugu sheegtay in Suleiman lagu eedeeyey inuu marka hore tegay guri ku yaalla Southwark, halkaas oo uu mindi ku weeraray nin lagu magacaabo Ishmail Hussein oo ay saaxiibo ahaayeen muddo ku dhow 20 sano. Booliska ayaa sheegay in dhacdadaas laga soo wariyey Great Dover Street abaare 8:50 subaxnimo. Ninka guriga joogay ayaa waxaa soo gaaray dhaawacyo fudud, halka tuhmanaha uu goobta ka baxay ka hor intii aysan boolisku imaan. Saraakiisha ayaa deegaanka ka raadiyey balse waqtigaas ma aysan helin. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa sheegay in Suleiman uu markii dambe gaadiidka dadweynaha ku tegay Golders Green, halkaas oo uu yimid Highfield Avenue. Halkee ayuu ka dhacay weerarka Yahuudda? Sida maxkamadda loo sheegay, qofka ugu horreeyey ee halkaas lagu weeraray wuxuu ahaa Shloime Rand, oo 34 jir ah, kaas oo wax ku baranayey synagogue ku yaalla Highfield Avenue. Dacwad-oogaha ayaa sheegay in ninka lagu eedeeyey uu u soo dhaqaaqay Rand, kadibna hal mar xabadka kaga dhuftay mindi, taas oo sababtay in sambabkiisu dhaawacmo. Waxaa markaas la weeraray Norman Shine, oo 76 jir ah, kaas oo dacwad-oogayaashu sheegeen inuu soo gaaray dhowr dhaawac oo mindi ah, oo uu ku jiro dhaawac qoorta ah. Waxa uu isbitaalka ku jiray dhowr maalmood. Labada nin ayaa maxkamadda lagu sheegay inay xilliga weerarka xirnaayeen dhar si cad u muujinayey inay ka tirsan yihiin bulshada Yuhuudda Orthodox-ka ah. Dhacdada ayaa ugu dambeyn joogsatay markii qof shacab ah uu isku dayay inuu farageliyo oo mindida ka qaado ninka weerarka lagu eedeeyey. Booliska iyo adeegyada gurmadka ayaa kadib goobta yimid. Booliska ka hortagga argagixisada ayaa sheegay in tuhmanuhu sidoo kale isku dayay inuu weeraro saraakiishii goobta tagtay, ka hor inta aan lagu qabannin qalabka korontada ee Taser-ka. Wax sarkaal boolis ah kuma dhaawacmin dhacdada. Xiriirka argagixiso oo meesha laga saaray Booliska Britain ayaa isla maalintii weerarka si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay in dhacdada Golders Green loo baarayo fal argagixiso, waxaana baaritaanka hoggaaminayey Counter Terrorism Policing London. Hase yeeshee, arrintaas ayaa Jimcihii yeelatay weji cusub. Dacwad-ooge Heer ayaa maxkamadda ka sheegtay in Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) ay dib-u-eegis ku sameysay caddeymaha, kadibna go’aamisay inaan dacwadda maxkamadda lagu sii wadin iyadoo lagu saleynayo xiriir argagixiso. Counter Terrorism Policing London ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in dacwad-oogayaashu aysan maxkamadda ka codsan doonin in falalka lagu xiro argagixiso. Si kastaba, hay’addu waxay sheegtay in CPS ay rumeysan tahay inay jirto caddeyn ku filan oo lagu tilmaami karo falalka lagu eedeeyey Suleiman ee Golders Green inay yihiin dambiyo nacayb ku saleysan. Taliyaha Counter Terrorism Policing London Helen Flanagan ayaa sheegtay in dacwad-oogayaashu qorsheynayaan inay arrintaas u soo bandhigaan garsooraha arrin culays dheeraad ah ku yeelan karta xukunka haddii eedeysanaha dambiga lagu helo. Go’aankaas ayaa ka dhigan in inkastoo boolisku markii hore dhacdada ku tilmaameen weerar argagixiso, dacwad-oogayaashu aysan hadda ku doodi doonin maxkamadda in falalka lagu eedeeyey Suleiman ay lahaayeen xiriir argagixiso. Suleiman weli wuu diidan yahay dhammaan eedeymaha, mana jirto wax xukun ah oo ilaa hadda lagu riday. The post Nin Soomaali oo maxkamad loo soo taagay inuu isku dayay dilka laba qof oo Yahuud ah appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland offers to rename Berbera Airport after Trump
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro has suggested renaming Berbera International Airport after U.S. President Donald Trump, as his government intensifies a decades-long campaign for independence from Somalia. Irro raised the proposal during an interview with Council on Foreign Relations. This comes after he recently floated the idea of inviting Trump to build a Trump Tower in the capital, Hargeisa. “We are not giving anything for free,” Irro said. “We have to offer something. And we expect the other partner to have the same or equal opportunities.” Why Berbera Matters Berbera sits on the Gulf of Aden, close to the Bab el-Mandeb strait – one of the world’s busiest and most contested shipping corridors, linking the Red Sea to the Indian Ocean. Its airport has one of the longest runways in Africa, built by the Soviet Union in the 1970s and stretching more than 4,000 metres. The port was redeveloped with investment from the United Arab Emirates’ DP World and now anchors a free trade zone that Somaliland’s government presents as an economic gateway for the wider Horn of Africa. Irro has pointed to the port, an 850-kilometre coastline, fisheries, and untapped oil, gas and mineral reserves as leverage in talks with Washington. A Broader Bid for Recognition The airport proposal is one part of a wider package. Irro has said he would consider granting the United States expanded military access, including the possibility of a base at Berbera, and has not ruled out similar arrangements with Israel or other partners. The offer comes against a backdrop of shifting regional alignments. Israel recognised Somaliland in December, the first United Nations member state to do so — a move Hargeisa has cited as evidence that international opinion on its status is moving. The U.S. Africa Command has visited Hargeisa and Berbera to assess the territory’s strategic value, though Washington has not established a military base there. Washington’s Position Remains Unclear No agreement on renaming the airport, granting military access, or formal recognition has been reached. Somalia’s federal government in Mogadishu, which the United States continues to recognise as sovereign over the territory, opposes Somaliland’s independence and remains a U.S. partner on counterterrorism. Somaliland has functioned as a de facto independent state since declaring a break from Somalia in 1991, with its own government, currency and security forces, but it has never secured formal recognition from any UN member. What Comes Next Analysts say Somaliland’s push is unlikely to produce swift recognition given continued U.S. support for Somali sovereignty and regional opposition to redrawing the Horn of Africa’s borders. But officials in Hargeisa are betting that instability along Red Sea shipping lanes – including attacks linked to Houthi forces in Yemen, just across the Gulf from Berbera – will keep Washington’s attention on the territory’s strategic value. items.title: Xoojinta Ammaanka Badda Cas: Qalalaasaha ka Qiiqaya Geeska Afrika
items.description: Khataraha Badda Cas ayaa sii kordhaya, sababtuse aha Xuutiyiinta oo qura ma aha. Loollanada Geeska Afrika ayaa isbuuranaya, sidoo kale, waxay sababayaan faragelinta awoodo dibadeed, taasoo halis cusub ka sii hurinaysa marinbadeed halbowle u ah ganacsiga adduunka. Yemeni soldiers patrol the strategic Bab el-Mandeb Strait, Yemen, Sunday, April 5, 2026. (AP Photo/Abdulnasser Alseddik)Image bypicture alliance / ASSOCIATED PRESS | Abdulnasser Alseddik © Weerarrada ay Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen warshadaha shidaalka ee Sucuudigu waxay sii kordhiyeen aloosnaanta xiisadda iskeed u cakiran ee marinka Baabulmandab. Hasayeeshee kooxdan ay taageerto Iiraan maaha halista keliya ee waxyeellaysa ammaanka Badda Cas. Dhinaca kale ee badda loollan isku maran ayaa ka socda Geeska Afrika, kaas oo ay gadaasha ka hurinayaan awoodo heer dhexe ah oo beretan ku jira. Tanina waxay halis hor leh ku tahay mid ka mid marinnada badda ee ugu muhiimsan caalamka. Waqtigu waa gabaabsi, waayo dagaalka Maraykanka iyo Iiraan u dhexeeyaa wuxuu muujiyay goljilicda marinka Hurmus, taasina waxay cusboonaysiiyay danaynta jidad waxdhoofineed oo beddelkiisa ah. Bilihii Abril iyo May, maalin kasta Sucuudigu wuxuu ka dhoofiyay Badda Cas in u dhexaysa saddex ilaa afar milyan oo foosto oo shidaal ah. Tani waa labanlaabka xaddigii la mariyay marinka Baabulmandab sannadkii 2024. Sidoo kale, mashaariicda tamarta ee lagaga maarmayo marinka Hurmus waxay kordhinayaan ahmiyadda Baabulmandab, sida ballaarinta taxa tuunbooyinka Bari iyo Galbeed ee Sucuudiga, ama khadka la qorshaynayo ee isku xiraya Ciraaq iyo dekedda Caqaba ee Urdun ee Badda Cas. Waxay muujiyeen Xuutiyiintu siday u fududahay in la carqaladeeyo Baabulmandab, halistuse Yaman oo keliya kama imanayso. Waayo dagaalka Suudaan wuxuu xoog ugu sii fidayaa dhibaatada Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya. Waqooyiga Soomaaliyana, waxa isdhexgalay loollanka maxalliga ah iyo tartanka Sucuudiga iyo Imaaraadka iyo ka Israa’iil iyo Turkiga, taas oo qalalaase cusub ka oogaysa Gacanka Cadan. Isla waqtigaas waxaa soo labakacleeyay burcadbadeeddii oo taageero xooggan ka helaya ururka al-Shabaab. Intii u dhexaysay Abriil iyo Meey waxay afduubeen burcadbadeed Soomaali ahi saddex doonyood oo marayay Gacanka Cadan, kuwaas oo ay laba ka mid ahi ahaayeen kuwo shidaal. Tani waa tiro afduub oo ka badan intii aynu aragnay shantii sanno ee ugu danbeeyay oo la isku daray. Faafitaanka diyaaradaha iswada ee raqiiska ahi waxay ka dhigan tahay in dawladaha iyo jihooyinka aan xukuumiga ahayni ay qarash kooban ku beegsan karaan marinbadeedkan ciriiriga ah. Inkasta oo aanay weli kooxo kale ku dhaqaaqin xeeladaha Xuutiyiinta, haddana kooxda Daacish ee Soomaaliya ayaa bishi Jeenaweri ka fulisay Budlaan weerarkii ugu horreeyay ee loo diiwaangeliyay ee ay fulisay diyaarad iswadda. Sida oo kale warbixinno ayaa sheegaya inay kooxda al-Shabaab u adeegsatay diyaarado iswada ujeeddooyin sahan iyo kuwo borobagaando. Carqalad kasta oo ku timaadda qulqulka ganacsi iyo qulqulka tamareed ee marinka BaabulMandab wuxuu yeelanayaa raadayn aad u dhaafsiisan gobolka, gaar ahaanna wuxuu taabanayaa Yurubiyaanka tamarta soo dhoofsada iyo dhaqaalayaasha ku tiirsan waxdhoofinta. Sidaas darteed, mar kasta oo ay kororto ahmiyadda Badda Casi, waxa isna kordhaya ahmiyadda Geeska Afrika. Muqdisho waxay kaga jawaabtay aqoonsigan inay jartay xiriirkii diblomaasiyadeed iyo kii amni ee ay la lahayd Imaaraadka. Waqtigaas laga soo bilaabana waxay u dhowaatay Suduudiga iyo Gadar oo ay la galeen heshiisyo difaac, iyada oo sida oo kalana sii xoojisay isbahaysigii hore ee ay la lahayd Turkiga. Iyada oo badhtanka kaga jirta Abu Dabi laacdankeeda Muqdisho, waxay kordhisay taageerada ay siiso Budlaan iyo Jubbalaan, oo ah laba ismaamul oo Dawladda Federaalka ah xiriirka u jaray sannadkii 2024kii, iyaga oo raba inay sii adkeeyaan madaxbannaanidooda. Ahmiyadda taageeradani waxay sii xoogaysatay xilligan oo ay Soomaaliya gashay khilaaf dhanka hoggaaminta federaalka ah. Maaris 2026 wuxuu ku darsaday madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh muddaxileedkiisa iyo ka Baarlamaanka hal sanno oo dheeraad ah, markiii uu waqtigu ka dhammaaday 15 May. Waxa diiday muddokordhintan shakhsiyaad mucaarid ah, oo ay ku jiraan hoggaanka Jubbalaan iyo Budlaan, iyaga oo ku baaqay in doorasho la qabto. Markii ay dhexdhexaadintii burburtay, waxaa qarxay dagaal u dhexeeya xoogagga Xukuumadda iyo isbahaysiyada Mucaaridka Muqdisho 3dii iyo 4tii Juulaay. Tani waxay ina xasuusinaysaa xasarradii la socotay hannaankii doorashada ee sannadihii 2020 iyo 2021. Inkasta oo ciidamada Federaalka ah ee faraha badan ee caasimadda joogaa ay adkaynayaan in madaxweynaha awood xukunka lagaga rido, haddana qalalaasuhu wuxuu ka oogmi karaa goobo kale. Meesha ugu werwerka badanina waa Waqooyiga Soomaaliya, halkaas oo hirdan maxalli ahi xoog u soo jiidanayo dhinacyo dibadadeed. Laga soo bilaabo ku dhawaaqistii goonigoosadkii 1991, degaankan waxa gacanta ku haysay Soomaalilaan. Balse gobollada bariga ee Sool, Sanaag iyo Cayn gacankuhayntoodu waxay ahayd mid muran ka joogo, oo ay kula loollamayeen beelaha degaanka iyo dawladgoboleedka Budlaan ee deriska la ah. Xiisadahani waxay isu rogeen dagaal hubaysan sannadkii 2023, dagaalkaas oo ay ciidamada beesha Dhulbahante ee dawladda dhexe taageersani ku jebiyeen ciidankii Soomaalilaan. Markaas kaddib Muqdisho waxay taageertay in maamulgoboleed cusub laga dhiso degaankan, maamulkaas oo ah dawladda Waqooyibari, oo ku fadhiya dhul ay sheeganayaan Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaanba. Jaa’isadda weyn ee loo ordayaa waa gobolka Sanaag, ee ku yaalla xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed kaas oo leh ahmiyad istiraatiiji ah. Jilibyada gobolkan deggani waxay taageeradoodu u qaybsan tahay Soomaalilaan, Budlaan iyo Muqdisho, iyada oo abaaraha jiraana ay sii hurinayaan loollanka loogu jiro khayraadka. Qaybsanaanta gobolkan ka jirtaa waxay fursado soojiidasho leh u yihiin dhinacyada dibadda. Waxa jira warbixinno sheegaya inuu Turkigu qorshaynayo saldhig inuu ka samaysto Laasqoray, oo ah magaalada ugu muhiimsan xeebta Sanaag. Waxa lagu arkay xeebtan doonyo Turkigu leeyahay iyo diyaarado ku xiran Imaaraadka. Isla waqtigaas Muqdisho waxay doonaysaa inay kasbato jilibbo reer Budlaan ah iyo ganacsato ku xanaaqsan madaxweynaha maamulka, sidoo kalana waxay ishaartay inay ciidano geyn doonto Soomaalilaan. Caynkaas ayuu Waqooyiga Soomaaliya isugu rogayaa barxad dagaal, oo qaybsanaanta maxalliga ah iyo hirdanka awoodaha dibaddu ku kulmayaan. Waa hirdanka u dhexeeya Sucuudiga iyo Imaaraadka, ama Israa’iil iyo Turkiga. Loollan kasta oo toos ah oo gobolkan ka bilaabmaa wuxuu halis ku yahay Gacanka Cadan, sidoo kale wuxuu fursado u abuurayaa jihooyin kale sida: shabakadaha burcadbadeedda, ururka Daacish ee Soomaaliya, iyo argaggaxisada al-Shabaab, oo dhammaantood ka hawlgala gobolka. Labada urur ee jihaadiga ahi waxay hub laga soo tabriibiyay Xuutiyiinta ka heleen xeebaha gobolka. Dhanbaal ku Socda Yurub Xasilloonidarrada Geeska Afrika wuxuu halis kale ku abuurayaa isaga gooshitaanka Badda Cas, kaas oo toos u saamaynaya amniga iyo xasilloonida dhaqaalaha Yurub. Dhaqaalaha Yurub ee dheeldheelliyayaana ma ka karo inuu qaado culays kale oo kii marinka Hurmus ku soo biira. Sidaas darteed, waa inay Yurub iska dhaafto sawirka laga haysto ee ah inay tahay keliya jiho deeqbixiye ah. Waa inay samayso kahortag isugu jira awood debecsan iyo awood adag. Dhab ahaan Midowga Yurub waxa ka jooga Geeska Afriga laba hawlgal badeed oo kala ah “Aspides” iyo “Atalanta”, laakiin labada hawlgal waxa loo hindisay laba halisood oo kaladuwan. Atalanta waxa loo sameeyay si looga hortago burcadbadeedda Soomaalida, halka Asbides loo aasaasay si ay doonyaha uga ilaaliso weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, iyada oo leh waajibaad difaac oo bareer ah. Maadaama oo ay halista badeed sii kordhayso, waa inuu Midowga Yurub kordhiyo tirada baahsanaanta labadan hawlgal, isla markaana waa in lagu soo kordhiyo waajibaadkooda hawlo weerar, gaar ahaan kuwo ka dhan ah argaggaxisada al-Shabaab iyo ururka Daacish ee Soomaaliya. Arrinkani wuxuu keenayaa xoojinta dadaallada ladagaallanka burcadbadeedda, iyo kordhinta cadaadiska la saarayo dhinacyada gildilaya xasilloonida, isla markaana wuxuu dirayaa dhanbaal amni iyo awooded oo ay Yurub ku leedahay Badda Cas kaas oo la isku hallayn karo. Si loo yareeyo cabsida aargoosi, waa inay reer Yurub niyadda u dejiyaan dawladaha gobolka sida Sucuudiga iyo Jabuuti, una sheegaan in ballaarinta hawlaha weerar laga reebayo Xuutiyiinta. Sidoo kale, waa inay reer Yurub ku dadaalaan inay helaan joogitaan ciidan oo ka yimaadda darafyada reer Aasiya ee danaha waaweyn ka leh amniga Badda Cas, sida Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo Jabbaan. Isla waqtigaas waa inay Midowga Yurub iyo dawladaha xubnaha ka ahiba si toos ah ula xiriiraa dhinacyada Waqooyiga Soomaaliya, sida Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaan. Waayo joogitaanka xooggan ee reer Yurub ee dhanka amniga iyo horumarku wuxuu kordhin karaa saamaynta lagu yeelanayo gobolka xasarrada badan, taasina waxay wax ka taraysaa dedaaladda loogu jiro xasilintiisa. Sida oo kale waxa hawlgalka Midowga Yurub la siin karaa waajibaad dheeraad ah, tusaale ahaan, inuu taageero hawlgallada ka dhanka ah Daacish iyo al-Shabaab ee ay wadaan Budlaan iyo Xukuumadda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Wadashaqayntan weyni waxay Yurub siinaysaa saamayn dheeraad ah ay ku riixi karto wadahadallada Xukuumadda Federaalka ah iyo Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaan ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu muransan yahay; iyo inay siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliya ku qalqaalliso xal u helidda ismarinwaaga ka jira doorashada. Iyada oo taas laga duulayo, waa inuu Midowga Yurub ku dhaqmo maangalka wax-is-dhaafsiga si ay taageeradiisa dhaqaale uga qaybqaadato yoolalkan xasillinta gobolka, taageeradaas oo sannadka 2026 dhan 139 milyan oo yuuri, oo isugu jirta 76 Milyan oo oo lagu taageero hawlgalka Midowga Afrika, iyo 63 Milyan oo ah taageerada gargaarka aadaminimo. Waa in Midowga Yurub ay si adag ula shaqeeyaan Maraykanka iyo Ingiriiska, labadooda oo hore u hoggaamiyay dadaallo heshiisiineed oo lagu kalsoon yahay, oo la xiriiray ismariwaagii doorashada iyo dadaallada ammaanka ee Waqooyiga, sida ladagaallanka Daacish. Iskaashi kaas la mid ah ayaa xoojin kara dadaallada lagu xasilinayo xasarrada u dhexaysa Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya, iyada oo ay Waashintoon xiriir la samaysay labada dhinacba dhowaan. Ugu danbayntii, waa mahurto in xirhiir lala yeesho dhammaan dhinacyada saamaynta leh ee Bariga Dhexe. Xasilloonidarrada Geeska Afrika waxa sii hurinaya falalka tartan ee u dhexeeya labada garab ee samaysmaya ee kala ah Sucuudiga-Masar-iyo-Turkiga iyo garabka Israa’iil-iyo-Imaaraadka. Dagaalkii ugu danbeeyay ee Iiraan lala galayna wuxuu sare u qaaday qaddarinta ay dawladahani u hayaan iskaashatooyinka caalamiga ee la isku hallayn karo iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Markaa waa inay Yurub ammintan uga faa’iidaysato inay cadaadiskeeda isugu gayso in lays xakameeyo. Midowga Yurub, Jarmalka, Faransiiska, Talyaanjga iyo Isbayn, iyaga oo kaashanaya Ingiriiska, iyo haddii ay suurtagal tahay Maraykanka, waa inay u caddeeyaan awoodaha Bariga Dhexe in taageero kasta oo ay u fidiyaan Itoobiya ama Ereteriya oo sii ballaarin karta hirdanku inuu yahay khad cas, oo ay ka dhalanayaa ciqaabo degdeg ah oo saamaynaya xiriirka dalalkaasi la wadaagaan Midowga Yurub heerar kasta oo uu leeyahay. Qorshahan oo kalana waa in lagu dhaqmo awoodaha Bariga Dhexe marka laga hadlayo Waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Waxyaabo waaweyn ayay qaban karaan reer Yurub si ay uga hortagaan inuu loollanka Geeska Afrika isu beddelo mushkilad weyn. Ma haystaan faakihaysi ay ku sugaan inta aysan xasaradda Geeska Afriga isu rogin xaalad degdeg badeed oo kale. WQ: Martin Plaut

Markii ay dhexdhexaadintii burburtay, waxaa qarxay dagaal u dhexeeya xoogagga Xukuumadda iyo isbahaysiyada Mucaaridka Muqdisho 3dii iyo 4tii Juulaay. Tani waxay ina xasuusinaysaa xasarradii la socotay hannaankii doorashada ee sannadihii 2020 iyo 2021. Inkasta oo ciidamada Federaalka ah ee faraha badan ee caasimadda joogaa ay adkaynayaan in madaxweynaha awood xukunka lagaga rido, haddana qalalaasuhu wuxuu ka oogmi karaa goobo kale. Meesha ugu werwerka badanina waa Waqooyiga Soomaaliya, halkaas oo hirdan maxalli ahi xoog u soo jiidanayo dhinacyo dibadadeed. Laga soo bilaabo ku dhawaaqistii goonigoosadkii 1991, degaankan waxa gacanta ku haysay Soomaalilaan. Balse gobollada bariga ee Sool, Sanaag iyo Cayn gacankuhayntoodu waxay ahayd mid muran ka joogo, oo ay kula loollamayeen beelaha degaanka iyo dawladgoboleedka Budlaan ee deriska la ah. Xiisadahani waxay isu rogeen dagaal hubaysan sannadkii 2023, dagaalkaas oo ay ciidamada beesha Dhulbahante ee dawladda dhexe taageersani ku jebiyeen ciidankii Soomaalilaan. Markaas kaddib Muqdisho waxay taageertay in maamulgoboleed cusub laga dhiso degaankan, maamulkaas oo ah dawladda Waqooyibari, oo ku fadhiya dhul ay sheeganayaan Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaanba. Jaa’isadda weyn ee loo ordayaa waa gobolka Sanaag, ee ku yaalla xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed kaas oo leh ahmiyad istiraatiiji ah. Jilibyada gobolkan deggani waxay taageeradoodu u qaybsan tahay Soomaalilaan, Budlaan iyo Muqdisho, iyada oo abaaraha jiraana ay sii hurinayaan loollanka loogu jiro khayraadka. Qaybsanaanta gobolkan ka jirtaa waxay fursado soojiidasho leh u yihiin dhinacyada dibadda. Waxa jira warbixinno sheegaya inuu Turkigu qorshaynayo saldhig inuu ka samaysto Laasqoray, oo ah magaalada ugu muhiimsan xeebta Sanaag. Waxa lagu arkay xeebtan doonyo Turkigu leeyahay iyo diyaarado ku xiran Imaaraadka. Isla waqtigaas Muqdisho waxay doonaysaa inay kasbato jilibbo reer Budlaan ah iyo ganacsato ku xanaaqsan madaxweynaha maamulka, sidoo kalana waxay ishaartay inay ciidano geyn doonto Soomaalilaan. Caynkaas ayuu Waqooyiga Soomaaliya isugu rogayaa barxad dagaal, oo qaybsanaanta maxalliga ah iyo hirdanka awoodaha dibaddu ku kulmayaan. Waa hirdanka u dhexeeya Sucuudiga iyo Imaaraadka, ama Israa’iil iyo Turkiga. Loollan kasta oo toos ah oo gobolkan ka bilaabmaa wuxuu halis ku yahay Gacanka Cadan, sidoo kale wuxuu fursado u abuurayaa jihooyin kale sida: shabakadaha burcadbadeedda, ururka Daacish ee Soomaaliya, iyo argaggaxisada al-Shabaab, oo dhammaantood ka hawlgala gobolka. Labada urur ee jihaadiga ahi waxay hub laga soo tabriibiyay Xuutiyiinta ka heleen xeebaha gobolka. Dhanbaal ku Socda Yurub Xasilloonidarrada Geeska Afrika wuxuu halis kale ku abuurayaa isaga gooshitaanka Badda Cas, kaas oo toos u saamaynaya amniga iyo xasilloonida dhaqaalaha Yurub. Dhaqaalaha Yurub ee dheeldheelliyayaana ma ka karo inuu qaado culays kale oo kii marinka Hurmus ku soo biira. Sidaas darteed, waa inay Yurub iska dhaafto sawirka laga haysto ee ah inay tahay keliya jiho deeqbixiye ah. Waa inay samayso kahortag isugu jira awood debecsan iyo awood adag. Dhab ahaan Midowga Yurub waxa ka jooga Geeska Afriga laba hawlgal badeed oo kala ah “Aspides” iyo “Atalanta”, laakiin labada hawlgal waxa loo hindisay laba halisood oo kaladuwan. Atalanta waxa loo sameeyay si looga hortago burcadbadeedda Soomaalida, halka Asbides loo aasaasay si ay doonyaha uga ilaaliso weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, iyada oo leh waajibaad difaac oo bareer ah. Maadaama oo ay halista badeed sii kordhayso, waa inuu Midowga Yurub kordhiyo tirada baahsanaanta labadan hawlgal, isla markaana waa in lagu soo kordhiyo waajibaadkooda hawlo weerar, gaar ahaan kuwo ka dhan ah argaggaxisada al-Shabaab iyo ururka Daacish ee Soomaaliya. Arrinkani wuxuu keenayaa xoojinta dadaallada ladagaallanka burcadbadeedda, iyo kordhinta cadaadiska la saarayo dhinacyada gildilaya xasilloonida, isla markaana wuxuu dirayaa dhanbaal amni iyo awooded oo ay Yurub ku leedahay Badda Cas kaas oo la isku hallayn karo. Si loo yareeyo cabsida aargoosi, waa inay reer Yurub niyadda u dejiyaan dawladaha gobolka sida Sucuudiga iyo Jabuuti, una sheegaan in ballaarinta hawlaha weerar laga reebayo Xuutiyiinta. Sidoo kale, waa inay reer Yurub ku dadaalaan inay helaan joogitaan ciidan oo ka yimaadda darafyada reer Aasiya ee danaha waaweyn ka leh amniga Badda Cas, sida Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo Jabbaan. Isla waqtigaas waa inay Midowga Yurub iyo dawladaha xubnaha ka ahiba si toos ah ula xiriiraa dhinacyada Waqooyiga Soomaaliya, sida Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaan. Waayo joogitaanka xooggan ee reer Yurub ee dhanka amniga iyo horumarku wuxuu kordhin karaa saamaynta lagu yeelanayo gobolka xasarrada badan, taasina waxay wax ka taraysaa dedaaladda loogu jiro xasilintiisa. Sida oo kale waxa hawlgalka Midowga Yurub la siin karaa waajibaad dheeraad ah, tusaale ahaan, inuu taageero hawlgallada ka dhanka ah Daacish iyo al-Shabaab ee ay wadaan Budlaan iyo Xukuumadda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Wadashaqayntan weyni waxay Yurub siinaysaa saamayn dheeraad ah ay ku riixi karto wadahadallada Xukuumadda Federaalka ah iyo Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaan ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu muransan yahay; iyo inay siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliya ku qalqaalliso xal u helidda ismarinwaaga ka jira doorashada. Iyada oo taas laga duulayo, waa inuu Midowga Yurub ku dhaqmo maangalka wax-is-dhaafsiga si ay taageeradiisa dhaqaale uga qaybqaadato yoolalkan xasillinta gobolka, taageeradaas oo sannadka 2026 dhan 139 milyan oo yuuri, oo isugu jirta 76 Milyan oo oo lagu taageero hawlgalka Midowga Afrika, iyo 63 Milyan oo ah taageerada gargaarka aadaminimo. Waa in Midowga Yurub ay si adag ula shaqeeyaan Maraykanka iyo Ingiriiska, labadooda oo hore u hoggaamiyay dadaallo heshiisiineed oo lagu kalsoon yahay, oo la xiriiray ismariwaagii doorashada iyo dadaallada ammaanka ee Waqooyiga, sida ladagaallanka Daacish. Iskaashi kaas la mid ah ayaa xoojin kara dadaallada lagu xasilinayo xasarrada u dhexaysa Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya, iyada oo ay Waashintoon xiriir la samaysay labada dhinacba dhowaan. Ugu danbayntii, waa mahurto in xirhiir lala yeesho dhammaan dhinacyada saamaynta leh ee Bariga Dhexe. Xasilloonidarrada Geeska Afrika waxa sii hurinaya falalka tartan ee u dhexeeya labada garab ee samaysmaya ee kala ah Sucuudiga-Masar-iyo-Turkiga iyo garabka Israa’iil-iyo-Imaaraadka. Dagaalkii ugu danbeeyay ee Iiraan lala galayna wuxuu sare u qaaday qaddarinta ay dawladahani u hayaan iskaashatooyinka caalamiga ee la isku hallayn karo iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Markaa waa inay Yurub ammintan uga faa’iidaysato inay cadaadiskeeda isugu gayso in lays xakameeyo. Midowga Yurub, Jarmalka, Faransiiska, Talyaanjga iyo Isbayn, iyaga oo kaashanaya Ingiriiska, iyo haddii ay suurtagal tahay Maraykanka, waa inay u caddeeyaan awoodaha Bariga Dhexe in taageero kasta oo ay u fidiyaan Itoobiya ama Ereteriya oo sii ballaarin karta hirdanku inuu yahay khad cas, oo ay ka dhalanayaa ciqaabo degdeg ah oo saamaynaya xiriirka dalalkaasi la wadaagaan Midowga Yurub heerar kasta oo uu leeyahay. Qorshahan oo kalana waa in lagu dhaqmo awoodaha Bariga Dhexe marka laga hadlayo Waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Waxyaabo waaweyn ayay qaban karaan reer Yurub si ay uga hortagaan inuu loollanka Geeska Afrika isu beddelo mushkilad weyn. Ma haystaan faakihaysi ay ku sugaan inta aysan xasaradda Geeska Afriga isu rogin xaalad degdeg badeed oo kale. WQ: Martin Plaut

items.title: NISA oo sheegtay in duqeyn ka dhacday Shabeellaha Dhexe ku dishay xubno katirsan AS
items.description: Shabeellaha Dhexe ( Raxanreeb Online) Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka Soomaaliyeed (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in duqayn ka dhacday Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ee Dowlad-Goboleedka HirShabeelle lagu dilay xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Qoraal kasoo baxay hay’adda NISA, ayaa lagu sheegay in duqaynta ay iska kaashadeen ciidamada dowladda iyo saaxiibada Soomaaliya ka taageera hawlgallada cirka, waxa ayna xaqiijisay in Hawlgalka lagu beegsaday xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab oo ku sugnaa deegaanka Cali Gaduud ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Sidoo kale hay’adda ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka lagu dilay 12 xubnood oo katirsan kooxda Al-shabaab oo halkaasi isku uruursanayay. Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa ka mid ah deegaannada ay ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kuwa deegaanka ka wadaan hawlgallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo mararka qaar hawlgalladaasi ay taageeraan duqaymo cirka ah. items.title: Isgaarsiinta Tigray oo go’day iyo dagaalka galay oo maalintii afraad
items.description: Gobolka Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya waxaa ka go’ay adeegyada internet-ka iyo taleefannada, xilli dagaal u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo xoogagga Tigray uu galay maalintii afraad, taasoo sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo in colaadda dib ugu laabato dagaal ballaaran. Hay’adda NetBlocks, oo la socota xaaladda internet-ka caalamka, ayaa xaqiijisay carqaladda weyn ee ku timid isgaarsiinta gobolka, iyadoo xaaladda dhulka ay adkaynayso in si madax-bannaan loo helo xog dhamaystiran. Warbixin ay Reuters soo xigatay ayaa sheegtay in afar ilo-wareed ay TPLF ku eedeeyeen inay shirkadaha Ethio Telecom iyo Safaricom ku amartay inay joojiyaan adeegyada isgaarsiinta. ilo ku dhow TPLF ayaa eeddaas beeniyey, iyagoo sheegay in dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ay mas’uul ka tahay go’itaanka adeegyada. Dhinaca dagaalka, xoogagga Tigray iyo kooxaha ay isbahaysiga yihiin ayaa la sheegay inay la wareegeen saddex garoon diyaaradeed, isla markaana ay weerarro ka fuliyeen gobollada Canfarta iyo Amxaarada. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay inay jebisay weerarradaas, balse xaaladda dhabta ah ee garoomada, khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalka iyo sheegashooyinka labada dhinac ayaan si madax-bannaan loo wada xaqiijin. Isgaarsiinta oo go’day ayaa sii adkaynaysa helitaanka warar lagu kalsoonaan karo oo ka imanaya goobaha ay colaadaha ka socdaan. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeeshay isu-socodka hawada, iyadoo la hakiyey duulimaadyadii magaalada taariikhiga ah ee Lalibela kaddib markii dagaalku ku soo dhowaaday garoonka diyaaradaha. Dhanka kale, dadka ku nool Tigray ayaa bilaabay inay kaydsadaan raashin iyo sahay kale oo muhiim ah, halka qaar ka mid ah shacabka ay bangiyada kala baxayaan lacag iyagoo ka cabsi qaba in xaaladdu sii xumaato, isla markaana ay adkaadaan helitaanka adeegyada aasaasiga ah. Go’itaanka taleefannada iyo internet-ka ayaa si gaar ah u saameynaya xiriirka qoysaska, adeegyada lacagaha moobilka iyo awoodda shacabka ee helitaanka macluumaad degdeg ah. Xaaladda hadda ka taagan Tigray ayaa dib u soo celinaysa xusuusta dagaalkii 2020 ilaa 2022, kaas oo gobolka ka dhigay meel muddo dheer ay ka jireen isgaarsiin la’aan, sahay yari iyo dhibaatooyin baahsan oo dhinaca adeegyada caafimaadka iyo bani’aadannimada ah. Heshiiskii nabadda ee 2022 ayaa soo afjaray dagaalkaas, hase yeeshee xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee ka dhex jira dhinacyada Itoobiya ayaa weli ah arrimo xasaasi ah. Dagaallada cusub iyo fiditaanka iska horimaadyada gobollada deriska la ah ayaa walaac ka abuuraya mustaqbalka xasilloonida Itoobiya iyo guud ahaan Geeska Afrika. Haddii colaadda sii faafto, waxaa suurtagal ah inay saameyn ku yeelato isu-socodka ganacsiga, amniga xuduudaha iyo xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee deegaannada ku dhow goobaha dagaalka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xogta la hayo ma xaqiijinayso in dagaalku si toos ah u gaaray Dowlad-Deegaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya ama uu hadda saameyn muuqata ku yeeshay Soomaaliya. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Iyadoo xaaladdu weli kacsan tahay, go’itaanka isgaarsiinta iyo wararka iska soo horjeeda ee ka imanaya dhinacyada dagaallamaya ayaa muujinaya baahida loo qabo xaqiijin madax-bannaan, ilaalinta shacabka iyo in dhinacyadu ka fogaadaan tallaabooyin sii hurin kara colaadda.

items.title: Iska horimaad dhimasho sababay oo xiisad ka dhacay degmada Caluula
items.description: Xiisad ayaa ka dhacay degmada Caluula ee gobolka bari ee Puntland, kaddib iska horimaad sababay dhimashada hal qof iyo dhaawaca qof kale laga soo wariyay halkaas. Wararka ka soo baxaya deegaanka ayaa sheegaya in dhacdadu ay la xiriirto khilaaf ka dhashay maamulka degmada. Qofka dhintay ayaa lagu magacaabay Cabdifitaax Cumar Cali Muumin , waxaana wararka la helayo ay sheegayaan inuu ahaa darawalka guddoomiyaha degmada Caluula. Qof kale ayaa ku dhaawacmay dhacdada, hase yeeshee faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan xaaladdiisa caafimaad iyo goobta lagu daweynayo weli lama helin. Xiisadda ayaa timid xilli uu ka dhex jiray maamulka degmada khilaaf siyaasadeed, kaddib markii 11 xubnood oo ka tirsan Golaha Deegaanka Caluula ay sheegeen inay xilka ka qaadeen guddoomiyaha degmada, Axmed Maxamed Xasan, oo loo yaqaan Xamari . Golaha Deegaanka Caluula wuxuu ka kooban yahay 33 xubnood , kuwaas oo lagu doortay doorashadii goleyaasha deegaanka ee Puntland ee 2023. Dukumenti ka soo baxay Guddiga Doorashooyinka Puntland ayaa xaqiijinaya tirada 33-ka xubnood iyo natiijooyinkii doorashada degmada Caluula. Si kastaba, weli ma cadda habraaca sharci ee loo maray xil-ka-qaadista guddoomiyaha , iyo in go’aanka ay sheegeen xubnaha golaha uu helay ansixinta hay’adaha kale ee ay khusayso. Sidoo kale, faahfaahin rasmi ah lagama helin cidda uu iska horimaadku dhex maray, waxa si toos ah u sababay rasaasta iyo haddii ay jiraan dad loo qabtay dhacdada. Wararka la heli karo waxay tilmaamayaan in xaaladdu weli tahay mid u baahan dejin iyo xaqiijin dheeraad ah. Dhacdadan ayaa walaac ku abuurtay dadka deegaanka, iyadoo dhimashada iyo dhaawaca ka dhashay iska horimaadku ay kusoo beegmeen xilli uu muran siyaasadeed ka taagan yahay maamulka degmada. Ilaa hadda, maamulka Puntland iyo hay’adaha amniga ayaan soo saarin war rasmi ah oo dhamaystiran oo lagu caddeynayo sababta iska horimaadka, khasaaraha iyo tallaabooyinka laga qaaday dadka ku lugta leh.

Qof kale ayaa ku dhaawacmay dhacdada, hase yeeshee faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan xaaladdiisa caafimaad iyo goobta lagu daweynayo weli lama helin. Xiisadda ayaa timid xilli uu ka dhex jiray maamulka degmada khilaaf siyaasadeed, kaddib markii 11 xubnood oo ka tirsan Golaha Deegaanka Caluula ay sheegeen inay xilka ka qaadeen guddoomiyaha degmada, Axmed Maxamed Xasan, oo loo yaqaan Xamari . Golaha Deegaanka Caluula wuxuu ka kooban yahay 33 xubnood , kuwaas oo lagu doortay doorashadii goleyaasha deegaanka ee Puntland ee 2023. Dukumenti ka soo baxay Guddiga Doorashooyinka Puntland ayaa xaqiijinaya tirada 33-ka xubnood iyo natiijooyinkii doorashada degmada Caluula. Si kastaba, weli ma cadda habraaca sharci ee loo maray xil-ka-qaadista guddoomiyaha , iyo in go’aanka ay sheegeen xubnaha golaha uu helay ansixinta hay’adaha kale ee ay khusayso. Sidoo kale, faahfaahin rasmi ah lagama helin cidda uu iska horimaadku dhex maray, waxa si toos ah u sababay rasaasta iyo haddii ay jiraan dad loo qabtay dhacdada. Wararka la heli karo waxay tilmaamayaan in xaaladdu weli tahay mid u baahan dejin iyo xaqiijin dheeraad ah. Dhacdadan ayaa walaac ku abuurtay dadka deegaanka, iyadoo dhimashada iyo dhaawaca ka dhashay iska horimaadku ay kusoo beegmeen xilli uu muran siyaasadeed ka taagan yahay maamulka degmada. Ilaa hadda, maamulka Puntland iyo hay’adaha amniga ayaan soo saarin war rasmi ah oo dhamaystiran oo lagu caddeynayo sababta iska horimaadka, khasaaraha iyo tallaabooyinka laga qaaday dadka ku lugta leh.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qayb-gashay kulan soo dhaweyn ah oo Madaxweyne Putin u sameeyey madaxda Madasha Dhaqamada
items.description: Soomaaliya ayaa ka qayb-gashay kulan soo dhaweyn ah oo Madaxweynaha Federaalka Ruushka, Vladimir Putin, u sameeyey madaxda iyo masuuliyiinta ka qaybgalaya Madasha 12-aad ee Caalamiga ah ee Dhaqamada Midoobay , oo ka socota magaalada St. Petersburg ee dalka Ruushka. Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Soomaaliya, Cabdifataax Qaasim Maxamuud , ayaa ka mid ahaa masuuliyiinta Soomaaliyeed ee ka qaybgalay madasha, iyadoo kulamada halkaas ka socda ay diiradda saarayaan dhaqanka, ilaalinta hidaha iyo xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee dhinacyada farshaxanka iyo dhaqanka. Warbaahinta dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in Wasiirku St. Petersburg kula kulmay Wasiirka Dhaqanka Ruushka, Olga Lyubimova, si looga wada hadlo xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal. Madaxweyne Putin, oo khudbad ka jeediyay munaasabadda, ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay doorka dhaqanka ee isku soo dhoweynta shucuubta iyo sii wadidda wada-hadalka xilliyada ay xiriirrada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa dhaqaale adkaadaan. Sidoo kale, waxaa xoogga la saaray ilaalinta kala-duwanaanshaha dhaqamada, ka qaybgalka dhallinyarada iyo is-weydaarsiga aqoonta iyo waayo-aragnimada. Madasha sanadkan waxaa ka qaybgalaya wasiirro iyo masuuliyiin sare oo ka kala socda dalal badan. Warbaahinta rasmiga ah ee Iran waxay sheegtay in madashu ay isu keentay masuuliyiin iyo shaqsiyaad ka socda dhinacyada fanka iyo dhaqanka ee ku dhowaad 70 dal , iyadoo ay jiraan 44 wafdi oo rasmi ah. Intii uu Wasiir Cabdifataax Qaasim ku sugnaa St. Petersburg, wuxuu kulan laba-geesood ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Dhaqanka Ruushka, Olga Lyubimova. Kulanka ayaa lagu soo qaaday ilaalinta iyo horumarinta hidde-dhaqameedka, farshaxanka, suugaanta, tiyaatarrada iyo cilmi-baarista dhaqanka. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay is-dhaafsiga khubarada iyo fanaaniinta, horumarinta xarumaha dhaqanka iyo dardargelinta heshiisyada iskaashiga dhaqanka ee Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka. Wasiir Cabdifataax Qaasim ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay muhiimad gaar ah siinayso dhaqanka iyo farshaxanka, isaga oo tilmaamay in dhaqanku door ku leeyahay ilaalinta aqoonsiga qaranka, isku-xirka bulshada iyo xoojinta xiriirka shacabka labada dal. Ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee madashan ayaa sidoo kale u oggolaanaya dhinaca Soomaaliyeed inuu soo bandhigo hodantinimada hiddaha, dhaqanka iyo fanka Soomaaliyeed , isla markaana uu la wadaago dalalka kale khibradaha ku saabsan ilaalinta iyo horumarinta dhaqanka. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Soomaaliya ayaa 25-kii Sebtembar sheegay in Afrika ay u baahan tahay iskaashi wax-ku-ool ah oo ku dhisan is-ixtiraam oo lala yeesho dalalka iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan arrinta dib-u-soo-celinta hantida dhaqameed ee Afrika. Madasha St. Petersburg ayaa sidaas darteed Soomaaliya uga dhigan goob ay kaga qaybqaadan karto doodaha caalamiga ah ee ku saabsan mustaqbalka dhaqanka, ilaalinta hidaha iyo ballaarinta xiriirrada hay’adaha dhaqanka ee dalalka kala duwan.

items.title: UNHCR Representative: 230,000 Yemenis at Risk of Displacement
items.description: Yemen Monitor / Aden / Exclusive: The representative of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees in Yemen, Armin Yedgariyan, said that more than three thousand Yemenis have crossed into Djibouti since the conflict in the country renewed, warning of the expansion of internal and external displacement movement as military escalation continues on several fronts. Yedgariyan explained, in an interview with “Al-Arabi TV,” that the latest wave of fighting has pushed thousands of Yemenis to leave the country by sea, while UNHCR estimates indicate that the numbers of those leaving are likely to rise in the coming period if the confrontations continue and expand in scope. According to UNHCR, more than three thousand Yemenis have so far reached Djibouti across the Gulf of Aden, while hundreds of others have reached Somaliland and Puntland, amid UN preparations for the possibility of receiving more than ten thousand arrivals with the improvement of maritime navigation conditions and the continued state of instability in Yemen. The sea migration movement comes in conjunction with a wide wave of displacement inside Yemen; more than 130,000 people have fled their homes since the beginning of September, with fighting expanding on several fronts and front lines shifting from one area to another. The UNHCR representative warned that the continuation of displacement at the current pace could raise the number of newly displaced people to more than 230,000, noting that the movement of fighting lines pushes residents to leave from both sides of the contact lines in search of safer areas. Taiz Governorate is the epicenter of the current displacement wave, accounting for more than 60 percent of the total recorded displacement cases, while population movements have also been reported from the governorates of Al-Jawf, Marib, and Al-Hudaidah, in an indication of the multi-front nature of the current escalation. The UN official said that the conditions of the displaced are becoming increasingly difficult as new families arrive in already overcrowded displacement sites, amid growing needs for shelter, food, clean water, health care, and protection, coinciding with the declining capacity of local services and infrastructure to absorb the new numbers. UNHCR data indicate that about 70 percent of the newly displaced are women and children, while some families reported that they are being displaced for the fourth time, after moving repeatedly from one area to another during the years of war. The new displacement wave exacerbates a prolonged humanitarian crisis in Yemen, where more than 5.2 million people were internally displaced before the latest escalation, while more than 22 million people need some form of humanitarian assistance, according to UN estimates. At the same time, the humanitarian response faces an acute funding shortage; UNHCR said its operations in Yemen are only 18 percent funded during 2026, after receiving about 34 million dollars out of the 194 million required, while it urgently needs about 25 million dollars to respond to the needs resulting from the escalation and new displacement. UNHCR warned that continued fighting, insecurity, restrictions on movement, and damage to roads and infrastructure, including Al-Mokha Port, are obstructing the delivery of humanitarian assistance, calling for securing safe and unimpeded access to affected populations in areas witnessing accelerating displacement waves
