items.title: Beledweyne Erupts as Hirshabelle Election Crisis Deepens
items.description: Protesters Reject Hirshabelle Vote as Political Disputes Threaten to Deepen Somalia’s Federal Fragmentation Beledweyne (WDN) — Somalia’s political fragmentation is once again spilling into the streets. Hundreds of residents, politicians, elders and community figures gathered in Beledweyne on Thursday, protesting against the planned Hirshabelle leadership election and accusing the Federal Government and Hirshabelle authorities of pursuing a political process without sufficient local consensus. The demonstrations mark a dramatic escalation in a dispute that has been building for weeks and now threatens to destabilize relations between Hiiraan and Middle Shabelle, the two regions that make up Hirshabelle State. At the heart of the confrontation is a demand from influential Hiiraan politicians and elders that no election should proceed until a political agreement is reached on representation and power-sharing. “If You Reject Us, We Reject You” MP Gurey, speaking at the demonstration, delivered a blunt message to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Hirshabelle authorities. “If you reject us, we reject you too,” he said, rejecting what he described as the Hirshabelle election process and warning against governing through clan-based political arrangements. Another lawmaker, Mohamed Buraale, said there had previously been an understanding that political power within Hirshabelle would be shared between Hiiraan and Middle Shabelle. He accused Middle Shabelle of effectively controlling both the state capital and the presidency and warned that failure to resolve the dispute could lead to demands for an alternative political arrangement. A State Already Under Strain The confrontation is not occurring in isolation. Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Hagar Dabageed has accused President Hassan Sheikh of abandoning an earlier understanding that the Hawadle community would be considered for the Hirshabelle presidency. The allegation has been denied or disputed politically and has become one of the central grievances surrounding the election. The dispute intensified after the Justice and Unity Party (JSP) nominated incumbent Hirshabelle President Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe as its candidate for another term. That decision has further divided political opinion in Hiiraan, where influential figures have demanded that the electoral process be suspended until an agreement is reached. From Federal Dispute to State-Level Crisis The developments are becoming a wider test of Somalia’s federal political system. The Federal Government has promoted a direct electoral model, while opponents have raised concerns over political consensus, representation and the distribution of power among Somalia’s regions and communities. The dispute in Hirshabelle now raises a more fundamental question: what happens when a regional election is regarded by a significant part of one constituent region as lacking political consent? For Hiiraan’s political leaders, the answer appears increasingly confrontational. For the Federal Government, the challenge is to prevent a regional electoral dispute from becoming another centre of political confrontation. The Federal System Under Pressure The crisis comes after months of widening political divisions across Somalia, with disputes over elections, constitutional changes and the relationship between Mogadishu and the federal member states. Critics of President Hassan Sheikh’s approach argue that political arrangements backed by Villa Somalia risk weakening the federal system by empowering preferred candidates and bypassing negotiated agreements. Those accusations are contested, and the political positions of the various federal and regional actors remain sharply divided. But the developments in Beledweyne demonstrate that the dispute is no longer confined to political meetings in Mogadishu. It has reached the streets. The protests in Beledweyne, together with previous opposition to the electoral process from Hiiraan politicians and elders, show how quickly a dispute over one regional presidency can become a broader confrontation over political representation and federal authority. A Warning for Hirshabelle — and Somalia Somalia’s federal structure was designed to distribute political authority among the federal government and member states. Yet the latest confrontation exposes how fragile that arrangement can become when elections are pursued without agreement among competing political constituencies. The danger is not simply another disputed regional election. It is the possibility that political disagreements in one federal state begin to reproduce themselves across the country, deepening the fragmentation already visible in Somalia’s national politics. For now, the immediate flashpoint is Beledweyne. But the question hanging over Hirshabelle is much larger: Can a regional government survive when one of its constituent regions says the political process no longer represents its interests? The answer may determine whether the current crisis remains a Hirshabelle dispute — or becomes another chapter in Somalia’s widening political fragmentation. items.title: Afar boqol oo macalin oo shaqo la’aan noqday, markii ay xirmeen iskuullo ku yaalla Garowe
items.description: (ERGO) – Nolol xumo ayaa soo wajahday qoysaska afar boqol oo bare oo ku nool Garowe iyo tuulooyinka hoos taga, markii iskuullo ay wax ka dhigi jireen ay qaar xirmeen, kuwana ay dhimeen tirada macalimiinta. Jaamac Maxamuud Axmed oo ka mid ah wuxuu Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dhamaan baahiyaha aas-aasiga ah uu awoodi la’yahay qoyskiisa oo 9 ah, kaligiisna ku tiirsan. Ninkaan oo ka mid ahaa barayaasha iskuulka hoose dhexe ee Waaberi ee magaalada Garowe ayaa xusay in uu ka mid noqday macalimiin shaqadooda waayay, dhaqaala yari iskuulka soo wajahday darteed. Waxaa meesha ka baxday $200 oo ahaa mushaarkiisa bisha. Dhaqaalahaas ayuu ku dabari jiray cunnada, biyaha, kirada iyo waxbarashada carruurtiisa. Wuxuu xusay in baagamuudo-nimada soo wajahday awgeed uu hadda cunno ku filan u awoodi la’yahay reerkiisa. “Hal mar ayaan dabka shidana maalinkii. Wixii Illahey na siiyo ayaan dabka saarana. Ehel, asxaab ama daris aan caawimaad ka dalbano ayaan ku tiirsanahay. Cunno xumada carruurtayd culays aad u wayn ayay igu haysa.” Jamaac ayaa sheegay in uu ahaa macalin ardayda u dhiga luuqadda Ingriiska. Dhanka kale baahiyaha kale ee reerkiisu wajahayaan waxaa ka mid ah biyo yari. Waxay ku tiirsan yihiin jirgaan ama ka yar oo ay ka helaan dadka nolol dhaama dhaqaale ahaan. Wuxuu xusay in uu ka faro maran yahay $0.4 oo ay jirgaankii iibiyaan baraago gaar loo leeyahay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in qoyskiisa dhamaadkii bishii Ogosto laga soo saaray qol dhagax ah oo ay ku noolaayeen, markii uu awoodi waayay kirada, korontada iyo biyaha oo isku darkooda uu ku bixin jiray $80. Arrintan waxay ku qasabtay in ka soo guuran xaafada Koowda August oo ay daganayeen uuna reerka geeyo dhul banana oo duleedka magaalad ah. Waxay qoyskiisa halkaasi ka dhisteen cooshad ay ka samaysteen maryo iyo ullo laisku geeyay. “Kaligay ima saamayn arrintan maclimiin badan oo aan garanaya ayaa shaqo la’aan noqday oo baaga-muudo ah hadda.” Jaamac oo shaqo la’aan ah muddo 2 bil ah ayaa sheegay in marba marka la danbaysa aya ka sii darayso xaaaladda qoyskiisa. Wuxuu sheegay inmarar badan magaalada ka raadiyay shaqooyin xamaal ah si uu reerka dabka ugu shido hasa ahaate uu ku hungoobay. Wuxuu ayaa tilmaamay in xaaladdan ay uga waxbarasho beeleen saddex carruur. Wuxuu xusay in uu awoodi waayay $25 oo wax lagu barayay, taasi oo sababtay in laga soo eryo iskuulka.   Ninkaan oo bare ahaa ku dhawaad 10 sano ayaa tilmaamay in uusan waligiisa wax kayd ah samaysan taasi oo uu hadda uu ka shalaynayo. Iskuullada ay macalimiintooda shaqo la’aanta noqdeen ayaa iskugu jira kuwa gaar loo leeyahay iyo kuwa ay gacanta ku hayeen dowlada Putland iyo hay’ado samafal, kuwaas oo ku yaallay xeryaha lagu barakacay ee Garowe.   Xamdi Cali Axmed oo wax ka dhigaysay muddo 15 sano ah iskuul hoose dhexe oo ku yaallay xerada Shabeelle oo dadkii dagana laga barakiciyay ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo bishii July ay carruurteeda u awoodi la’dahay cunno ku filan. Haweeynaydan waa barakac xirfada macalinimada ay ahayd waxaa kaliya ee ay masruufkooda ka soo saarta 8 carruur ah oo uu aabbaahood ku dayacay. “Shaqo la’aanta aad ayay saamayn igu yeelatay. Macalimad ayaan ahaa oo xirafadeeda wixii ay ku hesho ilmaheeda ku maaraysa. Shaqo kale oo aan aqoono ama meel aan shaqo u raadiyo malahan. Cid aan caawimaad ka dalbanayana ma haysto.” Xamdi waxay sheegtay in tan iyo markii shaqo la’aantu ku dhacaday ay qoyskeedu ku tiirsan yiihiin dayn ay ka qaataan dukaan xaafadooda ku yaalla oo ay horay macaamiil ugu ahaayeen. Waxay xustay in bishaan uu dhimay raashinkii uu siin jiray isaga oo siiyay min 10 kiilo oo bir bariis iyo sinkor ah. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in in ay bisha danbe iska bixiyaan $150 oo dayn ah oo lagu leeyahay isaga oo ugu goodiyay in uu ka goosan doono haddii aysan gudin in uu siiyo dayn kale. Arrintaas ayaa timid markii ay meesha ka baxday lacag $110 oo ahayd oo ay bile mushaar ahaan u qaadan jirtay. Haweeynaydaan ayaa xustay in sidoo kale ay dhibaato ku qabaan helida biyaha. Waxay tilmaamtay in adeegsadaan biyo aan ku filnayn oo ay ka soo dawarsadan dadka dariska la ah, maddaama aysan awoodin $0.2 oo ay jirgaankii iibiyaan ceellal riig ah oo gaar loo leeyahay. Waxay tilmamtay in sidoo kale ay hoy xumo hayso. Wuxuu qoyskeeda ka mid ahaa qoysaskii daganaa xerada Shabeelle ee la barakiciyay. Waxay tilmamtay in ay ku nool yihiin sandaqad uu dhismiiheedu qabyo yahay wax ay ku dhamaystirtana aysan u hayn, maaddaama ay baagamuudo noqotay. Waxay xustay in aysan wax musqul ah lahayn oo ay dariskooda ka codsadaan in ay la isticmaalan. Nolol xumada soo wajahday qoyskeeda oo aysan xal u hayn ayay sheegtay in ay walwal kala kulanto. Burburka ku yimid iskuulka oo wasaaradda waxbarashad Puntland ay gacanta ku haysay ayay tilmaamtay in uu sababay waxbarasho la’aan soo wajahday carruur iyo macalimiin badan oo barakac ah “Dad barakac ah ayaan nahay awood uma lihin inaan iskuul dhisano. Waxaan codsanayna in iskuul naloo dhiso si shaqadeena u soo labato.” Carruurta waxbarashada u dhiganayay oo 4 ah waxay ku jireen fasallada lixaad iyo toddobaad. Lacagta ay ku dhiganayay iskuulka ayay xustay in iskudarkeedu ahaa $30. Dhanka kale Cabdinaasir Yuusuf Xalliye oo ah guddoomiyaha ururka barayaasha gobolka Nugaal ayaa sheegay in sababta ugu wayn ee iskuulladu u xirmayn ay tahay dhaqaale yari jirta. iskuullada qaar ayuu tilmaamay in macalin yari soo wajahday oo hal macalin lagu qoro in uu ardayda u dhigo labo ama saddex maado, maaddaama aysan dhaqaale u hayan macalimiin badan oo buuxin kara baahidaas. “Waxaan ognahay in kalmooyinkii hay’adaha calamiga ah meesha ka baxeen oo hadda ma helaan iskuullada tageeradoodii. Waxaan ku talinayna in dowlada Putland ay hoos u eegto daruufaha waxbarashada iyo kuwa macalimiinta. Waxaan soo jeedinayna in wixii kab ah ee macalimiinta la siin karo in la siiyo.” Guddomiyaha ayaa sheegay in in tan iyo bilowgii sanadkaan ay xirmeen 30 iskuul oo iskugu jiray hoose iyo dhexe, kuwaas oo sababsaday dhaqaale xumada bulshada soo foodsaartay oo uu aaminsan yahay in ay ka dhalatay roob la’aanta iyo colaadaha soo laalaabtay. The post Afar boqol oo macalin oo shaqo la’aan noqday, markii ay xirmeen iskuullo ku yaalla Garowe appeared first on Radio Ergo - Somali Humanitarian News and Information .

items.title: Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan oo kulan degdeg ah ka yeelanaya weerarrada Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa qabanaya kulan heer sare ah oo degdeg ah, si ay uga wada hadlaan sidii Sacuudiga loo taageeri lahaa iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan weerarrada Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee saddexda dal ay ka wada hadleen xaaladda, iyagoo cambaareeyay weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsaday Makka iyo goobo kale oo rayid ah. Waxay sidoo kale xaqiijiyeen xaqa Sacuudiga u leeyahay inuu is-difaaco. Saddexda dal ayaa qorsheynaya kulan ay yeeshaan taliyeyaasha ciidamada, kaas oo lagu qiimeyn doono taageerada Sacuudiga, iyadoo la adeegsanayo heshiiska wadajirka ah ee difaaca ee ay saddexda dal galeen. Heshiisku wuxuu dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado mid ka mid ah dhinacyada loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. items.title: Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan oo kulan degdeg ah ka yeelanaya xiisadda Yemen
items.description: Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa qorsheynaya kulan degdeg ah oo ay yeelanayaan taliyeyaasha ciidamada saddexda dal, iyadoo xaaladda Yemen ay sii xumaaneyso, isla markaana weerarro cusub laga soo sheegay gudaha Sacuudiga. Go’aanka kulanka ayaa yimid kadib kulan Khamiistii magaalada New York ku dhex maray wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee saddexda dal. Kulanka waxaa ka qeyb galay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga Amiir Faisal bin Farhan, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Pakistan Ishaq Dar iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga Hakan Fidan. Wada-hadallada ayaa si gaar ah loogu eegay sidii Sacuudiga loo taageeri lahaa iyadoo la adeegsanayo heshiiska cusub ee difaaca wadajirka ah ee saddexda dal. Heshiiska Mecca Joint Defence Agreement ayaa la kala saxiixday 7-dii Agoosto, waxaana uu dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaan saddexda waddan. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale saldhig u noqonaya ballaarinta iskaashiga difaaca iyo isku-duwidda milatari ee Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan, ayadoo 31-kii Agoosto, wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda iyo gaashaandhigga iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamada saddexda dal ay ku kulmeen Istanbul, halkaas oo ay ku heshiiyeen in la dhiso xoghayn ku taalla Sacuudiga iyo in la kordhiyo wada-shaqeynta dhinaca milatariga. Kulanka saddexda dal ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo Sacuudiga uu sheegay in uu wajahayo weerarro cusub oo kasoo socda Yemen, ayadoo Riyadh ay sheegtay in nidaamyadeeda difaaca cirka ay soo rideen lix gantaal oo ballistic ah oo loo waday dhinaca magaalooyinka Taif iyo Yanbu. Mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in digniino amni laga bixiyay dhowr goobood, balse markii dambe la sheegay in khatartii ay dhammaatay. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay inay fuliyeen weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo ay ku bartilmaameedsadeen goob ay ku tilmaameen “xasaasi” oo ku taalla Riyadh iyo xarumo ay leedahay shirkadda Saudi Aramco ee magaalada Yanbu. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga Sacuudiga, General Turki al-Malki, ayaa sheegay in haddii weerarradu sii kordhaan ay jawaab adag ka bixin doonaan. Dhanka Yemen, dagaallo culus ayaa ka socda dhowr jiho, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda iyo Xuutiyiintu ay isku hayaaan goobo istiraatiiji ah, waxaana warbixin ay AFP soo xigatay ay sheegtay in dagaalladii 24-kii saacadood ee ka horreeyay Jimcihii ay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 150 dagaalyahan , kuwaas oo 98 ay ahaayeen dhinaca ciidamada dowladda, halka 52 ay ka tirsanaayeen Xuutiyiinta. Dagaallada ayaa laga soo sheegay agagaarka buuraha Kahboub iyo dhulka u dhexeeya Lahj iyo Taiz, oo ku dhow marinka muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandeb . Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo warramay inay xoojiyeen joogitaankooda xeebaha Badda Cas, taas oo kordhisay walaaca laga qabo amniga marinka Bab al-Mandeb, oo ah waddo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka. Dagaallada ayaa saameyn xooggan ku yeeshay dadka rayidka ah, waxaana UNHCR ay sheegtay in in ka badan 230,000 oo qof ay ka barakaceen guryahooda tan iyo bilowgii Sebtembar, halka dadka gudaha Yemen horey ugu barakacay ay gaarayaan ku dhowaad 5.2 milyan .

items.title: Faransiiska oo shaaciyey in uu ciidamo u dirayo Sacuudiga xilli uu xoogeystay dagaalka
items.description: Paris (Caasimada Online) – Faransiiska ayaa ciidamo, raadaarro iyo nidaamyo difaac u diri doona Sacuudi Carabiya si ay gacan uga geystaan ilaalinta magaalada dekedda ah ee Yanbu ee ku taalla Badda Cas, waxaa sidaas Khamiistii ku dhawaaqay madaxweyne Emmanuel Macron. Yanbu ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u yeelatay dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga, xilli weerarro gantaallo ah ay halis geliyeen marinnada kale ee tamarta gobolka. Macron ayaa sheegay in Paris iyo Riyadh ay dhammeystireen heshiis lagu xoojinayo difaaca goobta, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in ciidamada Faransiiska aysan u socon inay si toos ah uga qeyb qaataan dagaallada gobolka. “Waxaan direynaa awood militari, taas oo ah ciidamo, nidaamyo raadaar iyo nidaamyo difaac si loo ilaaliyo goobtan — ma aha inaan ku lug yeelanno wax dagaal ah, balse inaan ilaalinno goobtan,” ayuu Macron u sheegay telefishinnada TF1 iyo France 2. Dekedda Yanbu, oo ku taalla xeebta galbeed ee Sacuudiga, ayaa ah mid ka mid ah xarumaha ugu muhiimsan ee dalkaas uu shidaalka uga dhoofiyo Badda Cas. Muhiimaddeeda ayaa sii korortay iyadoo xiisadaha gobolka ay carqaladeeyeen isu-socodka tamarta, taas oo Sacuudiga ku qasabtay inuu si weyn ugu tiirsanaado waddooyinka dhoofinta ee ka baxsan marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Qiimaha saliidda ayaa sidoo kale sare u kacay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, iyadoo suuqyada caalamka ay ka walaacsan yihiin weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo kaabayaasha iyo marinnada muhiimka u ah dhoofinta tamarta. Macron ayaa wareysiga ku sheegay in Faransiisku leeyahay kayd ku filan oo gaas iyo shidaal ah xilli jiilaalku soo dhowaanayo, isaga oo sheegay in dowladdiisu ay ka shaqeyneyso sidii loo ilaalin lahaa sahayda tamarta. Madaxweynaha Faransiiska ayaa sidoo kale ka digay suurta-galnimada in Mareykanku xaddido dhoofinta naftada, tallaabadaas oo uu sheegay inay “musiibo” ku noqon karto dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo kan Mareykanka laftiisa. Aqalka Cad ayaa Arbacadii beeniyay warar sheegayay in maamulka Mareykanka uu qorsheynayo mamnuucid 90 maalmood ah oo lagu soo rogo dhoofinta naftada, xilli qiimaha shidaalku sare u kacay. Khatarta Ruushka Macron ayaa isla wareysiga uga hadlay khatarta amni ee uu sheegay inuu Ruushku ku hayo dalalka Yurub, isagoo ku eedeeyay Moscow inay kordhisay weerarrada internetka, falalka burburinta iyo howlaha loo adeegsado diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Waxa uu sheegay in Faransiisku wajahayo khataro la mid ah kuwa dalal kale oo Yurub ah, kadib markii Jarmalku Ruushka ku eedeeyay isku day weerar oo loo adeegsaday drone kaas oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday garoonka Leipzig bishii Agoosto. Macron ayaa toddobaadkii hore madaxda xisbiyada Faransiiska ku casuumay qasriga Elysee, halkaas oo uu uga warbixiyay khataraha sii kordhaya ee uu sheegay inay ka imanayaan Ruushka. Waxa uu sidoo kale dowladda ku amray inay diyaariso qorshe lagu ilaalinayo kaabayaasha muhiimka ah ee dalka weerarrada drones-ka iyo kuwa internetka. Si kastaba, Macron ayaa beeniyay war uu qoray wargeyska El Mundo oo sheegayay in hay’adda sirdoonka Mareykanka ee CIA ay dowladaha Yurub uga digtay weerarro drones ah oo laga yaabo inay ka yimaadaan dhinaca Mediterranean-ka. “CIA-da ma aysan siin hay’adaha Faransiiska digniin noocaas ah,” ayuu yiri Macron. Ruushka ayaa horay u beeniyay eedeymaha dalalka Yurub ee ku saabsan weerarrada isku dhafan, isagoo ku tilmaamay kuwo aan sal lahayn oo ka dhashay waxa Moscow ay ugu yeerto naceybka ka dhanka ah Ruushka. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya oo xoojinaya iskaashiga socdaalka iyo arrimaha muwaadiniinta
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo dowladda Liibiya ayaa ku heshiiyey in ay xoojiyaan wada-shaqeynta iyo isku-duwidda labada dal, gaar ahaan arrimaha la xiriira socdaalka iyo xaaladda muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan gudaha Liibiya. Arrintan ayaa lagu soo qaaday kulan ka dhacay magaalada New York, kaas oo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali , uu la yeeshay Daahir Saalim Al-Baour , oo ah mas’uulka maareeya arrimaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Liibiya. Kulanka ayaa ka dhacay dhinacyada hawlaha Kalfadhiga 83-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, ayadoo Labada mas’uul ay ka wada hadleen dhowr arrimood oo khuseeya xiriirka labada dal, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray xaaladda muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan Liibiya iyo iskaashiga dhinaca socdaalka . Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya ayaa sidoo kale isla qaatay in la sii xoojiyo isku-duwidda iyo wada-shaqeynta labada dowladood si wax looga qabto arrimaha labada dhinac ay danaha wadajirka ah ka leeyihiin. Arrimaha socdaalka ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya, maadaama Liibiya ay tahay mid ka mid ah waddamada muhiimka ah ee Waqooyiga Afrika ee ay maraan muhaajiriin badan oo doonaya in ay u gudbaan dalalka Yurub. Muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidoo kale ka mid ah dadka ku sugan waddankaas, taas oo ka dhigaysa xaaladdooda iyo ilaalinta xuquuqdooda arrin si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah dowladda Soomaaliya. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah kulamo diblomaasiyadeed oo ay Soomaaliya ka waddo magaalada New York inta uu socdo Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa kulamadan uga faa’iideysanaysa xoojinta xiriirrada ay la leedahay dowladaha kale iyo ka wada-hadalka arrimaha khuseeya danaha Soomaaliya iyo muwaadiniinteeda. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in labada dhinac ay muujiyeen diyaar garow ay ku sii xoojinayaan iskaashiga, gaar ahaan dhinacyada socdaalka iyo arrimaha muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee Liibiya , iyadoo la doonayo in labada dowladood ay yeeshaan isku-duwid dhow oo ku saabsan arrimahaas.

Arrintan ayaa lagu soo qaaday kulan ka dhacay magaalada New York, kaas oo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali , uu la yeeshay Daahir Saalim Al-Baour , oo ah mas’uulka maareeya arrimaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Liibiya. Kulanka ayaa ka dhacay dhinacyada hawlaha Kalfadhiga 83-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, ayadoo Labada mas’uul ay ka wada hadleen dhowr arrimood oo khuseeya xiriirka labada dal, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray xaaladda muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan Liibiya iyo iskaashiga dhinaca socdaalka . Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya ayaa sidoo kale isla qaatay in la sii xoojiyo isku-duwidda iyo wada-shaqeynta labada dowladood si wax looga qabto arrimaha labada dhinac ay danaha wadajirka ah ka leeyihiin. Arrimaha socdaalka ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya, maadaama Liibiya ay tahay mid ka mid ah waddamada muhiimka ah ee Waqooyiga Afrika ee ay maraan muhaajiriin badan oo doonaya in ay u gudbaan dalalka Yurub. Muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidoo kale ka mid ah dadka ku sugan waddankaas, taas oo ka dhigaysa xaaladdooda iyo ilaalinta xuquuqdooda arrin si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah dowladda Soomaaliya. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah kulamo diblomaasiyadeed oo ay Soomaaliya ka waddo magaalada New York inta uu socdo Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa kulamadan uga faa’iideysanaysa xoojinta xiriirrada ay la leedahay dowladaha kale iyo ka wada-hadalka arrimaha khuseeya danaha Soomaaliya iyo muwaadiniinteeda. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in labada dhinac ay muujiyeen diyaar garow ay ku sii xoojinayaan iskaashiga, gaar ahaan dhinacyada socdaalka iyo arrimaha muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee Liibiya , iyadoo la doonayo in labada dowladood ay yeeshaan isku-duwid dhow oo ku saabsan arrimahaas.

items.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland oo khudbad ka jeediyay golaha caalamiga ah ee 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐥 𝐨𝐧 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐢𝐠𝐧 𝐑𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 (𝐂𝐅𝐑), 𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐘𝐨𝐫𝐤
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐤𝐚 𝐣𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐲𝐞𝐲 𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐚𝐡 𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐥 𝐨𝐧 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐢𝐠𝐧 𝐑𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 (𝐂𝐅𝐑), 𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐘𝐨𝐫𝐤 Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa magaalada New York khudbad taariikhi ah ka jeediyey Golaha Xidhiidhka Dibedda (Council on Foreign Relations – CFR), oo ka mid ah xarumaha ugu saamaynta badan Maraykanka ee daraasaadka iyo falanqaynta siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu madasha CFR si toos ah ugu bandhigay aragtida Somaliland, isaga oo xusay in Somaliland muddo 35 sano ah ay ahayd Qaran nabad ah, dimuqraadi ah, iskii isu maamula, isla markaana si masuuliyad leh uga qayb qaata xasilloonida gobolka. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu caddeeyey in Somaliland buuxisay dhammaan shuruudaha aasaasiga ah ee dawladnimada, isla markaana aanay aqoonsi u doonayn samafal ama deeq, balse ay doonayso in la aqoonsado xaqiiqada dawladnimo ee ay dhistay iyo madaxbannaanidii ay heshay sannadkii 1960-kii. Waxa uu sidoo kale iftiimiyey in aqoonsiga Somaliland aanu ahayn oo keliya arrin taariikhi ah, balse uu yahay fursad istiraatiiji ah oo xoojin karta ganacsiga, maalgashiga, shaqo-abuurka, iyo amniga Geeska Afrika, gaar ahaan ilaalinta mid ka mid ah marinnada badeed ee ugu muhiimsan dunida. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu si cad u qeexay in Somaliland ay tahay dal dimuqraadi ah oo nabad iyo xasillooni waarta ka hirgeliyey gobol ay qalalaasuhu ku badan yihiin, balse weli laga hor taagan yahay in ay cod yeelato. Halka Soomaaliya oo aan iskeed isku maamulin karin in ka badan 30 sano ay xubinnimadeeda Qaramada Midoobay u adeegsanayso cabbudhinta iyo cadaadiska Shacabka Somaliland. Ugu dambayn, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa Bulshada Caalamka hor dhigay arrin xujo iyo garnaqsiba ku ah Beesha Caalamka, taas oo ah: In ay weli Beesha Caalamku sii wadaan taageerada diblomaasiyad dhalanteed ah oo aan nabad iyo xasillooni waarta midkoodna keeni karin, ama in ay aqoonsato xaqiiqada dhabta ah ee Somaliland oo ah Dawlad nabad ah, dimuqraadi ah oo diyaar u ah in ay horumariso danaha dhaqaale iyo kuwa amni ee caalamku wadaago.

items.title: Madashii caawa Madaxwaynuhu ka qaybgalay ee Council on Foreign Relations waxa ay ahayd mid saddex arimood oo togan leh:
items.description: “Madashii caawa Madaxwaynuhu ka qaybgalay ee Council on Foreign Relations waxa ay ahayd mid saddex arimood oo togan leh: 1. Waxa ka soo qaybgalay dad micno leh oo qaybaha bulshada ka socda oo farriinta ay qaadaan meel gaadhsiin kara. Farriimo micno lehna waa loo dhiibay. 2. Waydiimaha la waydiiyay waxa ay ahaayeen kuwo fursad fiican siiyay madaxwaynaha inuu bixiyo xogta loo baahan yahay. 3. Diyaar garow fiican ayaa ka muuqday Madaxwaynaha iyo degenaansho uu kaga falceliyo waydiimaha. Waxyaabaha waydiimuhu ku saabsanaayeen ee Madaxwaynuhu ka jawaabay waxa ka mid ah ahaa ammaanka marin-biyoodka aynu ku naallo, dhaqaalaha, siyaasadda juquraafiyadeed guud ahaanteed, Taiwan iyo xidhiidhka aynu la leenahay. Waxa sidoo kale ku jiray waydiimo ku aadanaa nolosha hoose ee shacabka Somaliland sida xagga waxbarashada iyo caqabadaha uu aqoonsi la’aantu ku hayo qofka caadiga ah ee Somalilander ka ah. Guntii waxa ay ahayd fursad fiican oo laga faa’iideeyey” Garyaqaan Guuleed Dafac.

items.title: Officer Alleges Federal and Jubaland Officials Are Coordinating to Ignite Fighting in Balad-Xaawo
items.description: Competing Forces Mobilize in Gedo Border Town as Security Official Makes Explosive Accusation BALAD-XAAWO (WDN) — Balad-Xaawo is witnessing competing military mobilization by forces aligned with Somalia’s Federal Government and Jubaland — and an explosive new allegation now claims that senior officials on both sides are working together to push the town toward open conflict. Independent reports published this week confirmed opposing military movements in and around the strategic Gedo border town, with local residents expressing fears that the standoff could escalate into fighting. The allegation was made by a security officer identified only as Dhafoore, who accused Jubaland’s Minister of Interior Mohamed Ibrahim Oogle and Minister of Security Yusuf Hussein Dhuumaal of coordinating with Federal Government Security Minister Abdullahi Sheikh Ismail Fartaag and a senior military commander identified as General Khalid. According to Dhafoore, the officials are working to create conditions for violence to erupt in Balad-Xaawo. “The conflict in Balad-Xaawo is being fuelled by Jubaland’s Minister of Interior Mohamed Ibrahim Oogle and Minister of Security Yusuf Hussein Dhuumaal, who are working with Khalid and Minister Fartaag. We will not accept their plan,” Dhafoore said. Military Standoff Raises the Stakes The accusation comes as the town faces an increasingly tense security situation. Recent reports describe military movements involving forces directly aligned with the Federal Government and others associated with Jubaland. The competing deployments are reportedly linked to a struggle over control of Balad-Xaawo, while residents fear that the confrontation could turn violent. The situation is further complicated by forces associated with Abdirashid Janan, some of whom have reportedly resisted transferring their allegiance to Jubaland while remaining armed and positioned inside the town. An Allegation That Demands Answers Dhafoore’s claim is politically significant because it alleges cooperation between officials associated with competing political camps at a moment when their respective forces are engaged in a visible security standoff. However, the specific allegation that the named officials are deliberately coordinating to provoke fighting has not been independently established. No documentary evidence or public statement from the officials has been cited to substantiate the accusation. Dhafoore is also described as politically sympathetic to Jubaland President Ahmed Madobe, a factor relevant to assessing his account. The officials named in the allegation have not, in the material reviewed, publicly confirmed such a plan. Balad-Xaawo at a Dangerous Crossroads The developments place Balad-Xaawo once again at the centre of the political and security contest between Mogadishu and Jubaland. The town’s location near the Kenyan border gives any armed confrontation consequences beyond the immediate local dispute, potentially affecting civilian movement, commerce and cross-border activity. For now, the verified picture is of competing military mobilization and heightened tension. The more explosive claim — that senior Federal Government and Jubaland officials are jointly working to ignite the conflict — remains an allegation requiring further evidence. The coming days may show whether the standoff can be contained or whether Balad-Xaawo becomes the scene of another armed confrontation in Gedo. items.title: Somalia’s Flag, Turkey, and the Evidence: A Fact-Based Rebuttal
items.description: By Keynan Jama, International Trade Lawyer and Litigator WardheerNews recently published an opinion piece under the headline “ How Somalia’s Flag Was Sold to Turkey. ” The title makes a serious allegation. The evidence behind it is very thin. The article points to a signed agreement in March, a ship registered three days later, and a drone strike in September, months later and far away. None of those facts, taken alone or together, proves a conspiracy. This analysis separates what the article confirms from what it infers. It then explains what the law actually says under UNCLOS, a relevant international tribunal ruling, and the sanctions rules the article cites but misapplies. Transparency remains a legitimate demand. The agreement should be published. Ship owners should be screened. Public records should be kept. Those are fair points. But calling the arrangement a “sale” of the flag is a leap the facts do not support. What the Article Actually Shows Strip away the framing, and the confirmed facts are narrow. On their own, they prove very little if anything. March 30, 2026: Somalia’s minister for ports signed an agreement with Somali Ship Register Limited. The signatory was a Turkish national. April 2, 2026: The ship GUNEY , previously flagged in Honduras, became the first vessel under Somalia’s revived flag. September 9, 2026: Drones struck the tug TEDY near Odesa. Two Azerbaijani crew died. No Somali was on board. Turkey also holds separate deals with Somalia covering port and airport management, military training, oil rights, and fishing rights. Each fact checks out. None of them, by itself, proves foreign control of the registry. The real question is what the article builds on top of them. Where Reporting Ends and Guessing Begins The headline itself The claim is that Somalia’s flag was sold to Turkey. A government hiring a private company to handle ship paperwork is common. It happens all over the world. Liberia’s registry has been run by a U.S. company since 1948. The Marshall Islands hired a private firm in 1990. Both are among the biggest ship registries on the planet. Nobody calls that a sale. Under UNCLOS Article 94, the flag state keeps full legal responsibility no matter who does the paperwork. The article even admits this: “private administration is not automatically disreputable.” That is an odd thing to write directly under a headline claiming the flag was sold. The three-day gap The agreement was signed March 30. A ship joined the registry April 2. Three days. The article treats this as suspicious. It is not. New registries almost always line up a first ship before launch. That is how a registry proves it actually works. Fast timing is not proof of a secret plan. It is ordinary marketing. No document backs the claim. No message, no record, nothing beyond a calendar. A calendar is not evidence. The burden of proof, flipped The article argues that the burden belongs on the government to prove Somali officials can refuse, suspend, and deregister a ship against Turkish commercial or political pressure. Read that again. The government must prove it can resist pressure. But nobody has shown that pressure even exists. The article asks Somalia to disprove a threat nobody demonstrated. That is backwards. In law, and in plain fairness, the accuser brings the evidence, even in the court of public opinion. Not the other way around. A claim built so it cannot lose The article admits there is no public evidence that Ankara formally directs Somali Ship Register Limited. It then says that does not matter, because control can be “informal.” No evidence supports the claim. And no evidence could ever disprove it either. That is not analysis. That is a circular trap. Using tragedy as proof of something it does not prove Two men died on a tugboat near Odesa. That is a real loss, and it deserves respect. But the article admits elsewhere that no Somali was aboard. A ship’s crew does not need to match its flag. The strike, in the article’s own words, “does not prove that the registry was inappropriate.” Russia’s statement never even named the ship. So why open and close the whole piece with this attack? Because grief moves readers. Timelines do not. That is the function it serves here. Stacking unrelated facts to imply a plot Turkey runs Somalia’s main port and airport. It trains and helps command Somalia’s military. It holds rights to offshore oil and fish stocks. Now it handles the registry too. Listed together, it sounds coordinated. It sounds planned and omnipotent. But separate deals, negotiated separately, do not become one conspiracy just by sitting in the same paragraph. The article also notes that the minister who signed the deal later became Speaker of the House. The implication is obvious: a reward. But the implication is not evidence. Careers move for a hundred reasons. Borrowing the sound of law The article names six criteria from a 1970 British inquiry. It says Somalia’s registry matches several of them. That sounds official. It sounds legal. Two lines later, the article admits these criteria are “descriptive… not a binding legal test.” No treaty enforces them. No court applies them. Sounding like law does not make something law. What the Law Actually Says UNCLOS Article 91 and the M/V Saiga case Article 91 requires a “genuine link” between a ship and its flag state. The article leans hard on this rule. So look closely at the case it cites: M/V Saiga (No. 2) , decided by the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea in 1999. The tribunal’s actual ruling was that a weak genuine link does not cancel a ship’s registration, and other states cannot use it to deny recognition. The article cites this case correctly. Then it argues the opposite of what the case actually says. UNCLOS Article 94 and delegated paperwork Article 94 puts the legal duty on Somalia, not on the company that processes the forms. Hiring a private administrator does not, by itself, break that duty. A real breach needs proof: a botched safety inspection, an ignored complaint, a failed investigation. None of that shows up in the article. Once again, Liberia, the Marshall Islands, and Panama all delegate this way. It is the norm. It is not a red flag. Paris MOU port checks Registries get ranked—white, grey, or black list—only after thirty inspections over three years. Somalia’s new registry has no track record yet. So warnings about blacklisting apply to any brand-new registry, anywhere in the world, after due process. They say nothing specific about Turkey. OFAC sanctions rules Sanctions rules apply when a ship or its owner is already flagged by regulators. Nobody named in the article—not the ship, not the company, not the registrar—is under sanctions. The rule the article cites is real. It just does not fit the case at hand. Fair Points Worth Keeping Strip away the conspiracy, and some of the article’s advice still holds up. These are worth acting on regardless of the Turkey angle, innuendos, fragile time-links and misapplications of the laws: Publish the registry agreement and its terms in full. Keep a real-time, public list of registered ships. Make sure Somali officials, not the private company, hold final say on adding or removing a ship. Screen every ship owner for sanctions and true ownership before registration. Fund the investigation and enforcement work the law already requires. This is basic good governance. Liberia and the Marshall Islands built the same safeguards over time. None of it needs a “ sold ” headline to justify doing it. Conclusion The facts in the article check out. The dates. The ship. The strike. The other Turkish deals. All real. What does not check out is the leap from those facts to a hidden sale of Somali sovereignty. That leap runs on timing, implication, and a burden of proof turned upside down. Even the article’s own legal source—the Saiga ruling—argues against its conclusion, not for it. The better response is not to dismiss the article outright. It is to take its fair points on transparency seriously, and to reject the parts it never actually proved. items.fullContent: By Keynan Jama, International Trade Lawyer and Litigator WardheerNews recently published an opinion piece under the headline “ How Somalia’s Flag Was Sold to Turkey. ” The title makes a serious allegation. The evidence behind it is very thin. The article points to a signed agreement in March, a ship registered three days later, and a drone strike in September, months later and far away. None of those facts, taken alone or together, proves a conspiracy. This analysis separates what the article confirms from what it infers. It then explains what the law actually says under UNCLOS, a relevant international tribunal ruling, and the sanctions rules the article cites but misapplies. Transparency remains a legitimate demand. The agreement should be published. Ship owners should be screened. Public records should be kept. Those are fair points. But calling the arrangement a “sale” of the flag is a leap the facts do not support. What the Article Actually Shows Strip away the framing, and the confirmed facts are narrow. On their own, they prove very little if anything. March 30, 2026: Somalia’s minister for ports signed an agreement with Somali Ship Register Limited. The signatory was a Turkish national. April 2, 2026: The ship GUNEY , previously flagged in Honduras, became the first vessel under Somalia’s revived flag. September 9, 2026: Drones struck the tug TEDY near Odesa. Two Azerbaijani crew died. No Somali was on board. Turkey also holds separate deals with Somalia covering port and airport management, military training, oil rights, and fishing rights. Each fact checks out. None of them, by itself, proves foreign control of the registry. The real question is what the article builds on top of them. Where Reporting Ends and Guessing Begins The headline itself The claim is that Somalia’s flag was sold to Turkey. A government hiring a private company to handle ship paperwork is common. It happens all over the world. Liberia’s registry has been run by a U.S. company since 1948. The Marshall Islands hired a private firm in 1990. Both are among the biggest ship registries on the planet. Nobody calls that a sale. Under UNCLOS Article 94, the flag state keeps full legal responsibility no matter who does the paperwork. The article even admits this: “private administration is not automatically disreputable.” That is an odd thing to write directly under a headline claiming the flag was sold. The three-day gap The agreement was signed March 30. A ship joined the registry April 2. Three days. The article treats this as suspicious. It is not. New registries almost always line up a first ship before launch. That is how a registry proves it actually works. Fast timing is not proof of a secret plan. It is ordinary marketing. No document backs the claim. No message, no record, nothing beyond a calendar. A calendar is not evidence. The burden of proof, flipped The article argues that the burden belongs on the government to prove Somali officials can refuse, suspend, and deregister a ship against Turkish commercial or political pressure. Read that again. The government must prove it can resist pressure. But nobody has shown that pressure even exists. The article asks Somalia to disprove a threat nobody demonstrated. That is backwards. In law, and in plain fairness, the accuser brings the evidence, even in the court of public opinion. Not the other way around. A claim built so it cannot lose The article admits there is no public evidence that Ankara formally directs Somali Ship Register Limited. It then says that does not matter, because control can be “informal.” No evidence supports the claim. And no evidence could ever disprove it either. That is not analysis. That is a circular trap. Using tragedy as proof of something it does not prove Two men died on a tugboat near Odesa. That is a real loss, and it deserves respect. But the article admits elsewhere that no Somali was aboard. A ship’s crew does not need to match its flag. The strike, in the article’s own words, “does not prove that the registry was inappropriate.” Russia’s statement never even named the ship. So why open and close the whole piece with this attack? Because grief moves readers. Timelines do not. That is the function it serves here. Stacking unrelated facts to imply a plot Turkey runs Somalia’s main port and airport. It trains and helps command Somalia’s military. It holds rights to offshore oil and fish stocks. Now it handles the registry too. Listed together, it sounds coordinated. It sounds planned and omnipotent. But separate deals, negotiated separately, do not become one conspiracy just by sitting in the same paragraph. The article also notes that the minister who signed the deal later became Speaker of the House. The implication is obvious: a reward. But the implication is not evidence. Careers move for a hundred reasons. Borrowing the sound of law The article names six criteria from a 1970 British inquiry. It says Somalia’s registry matches several of them. That sounds official. It sounds legal. Two lines later, the article admits these criteria are “descriptive… not a binding legal test.” No treaty enforces them. No court applies them. Sounding like law does not make something law. What the Law Actually Says UNCLOS Article 91 and the M/V Saiga case Article 91 requires a “genuine link” between a ship and its flag state. The article leans hard on this rule. So look closely at the case it cites: M/V Saiga (No. 2) , decided by the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea in 1999. The tribunal’s actual ruling was that a weak genuine link does not cancel a ship’s registration, and other states cannot use it to deny recognition. The article cites this case correctly. Then it argues the opposite of what the case actually says. UNCLOS Article 94 and delegated paperwork Article 94 puts the legal duty on Somalia, not on the company that processes the forms. Hiring a private administrator does not, by itself, break that duty. A real breach needs proof: a botched safety inspection, an ignored complaint, a failed investigation. None of that shows up in the article. Once again, Liberia, the Marshall Islands, and Panama all delegate this way. It is the norm. It is not a red flag. Paris MOU port checks Registries get ranked—white, grey, or black list—only after thirty inspections over three years. Somalia’s new registry has no track record yet. So warnings about blacklisting apply to any brand-new registry, anywhere in the world, after due process. They say nothing specific about Turkey. OFAC sanctions rules Sanctions rules apply when a ship or its owner is already flagged by regulators. Nobody named in the article—not the ship, not the company, not the registrar—is under sanctions. The rule the article cites is real. It just does not fit the case at hand. Fair Points Worth Keeping Strip away the conspiracy, and some of the article’s advice still holds up. These are worth acting on regardless of the Turkey angle, innuendos, fragile time-links and misapplications of the laws: Publish the registry agreement and its terms in full. Keep a real-time, public list of registered ships. Make sure Somali officials, not the private company, hold final say on adding or removing a ship. Screen every ship owner for sanctions and true ownership before registration. Fund the investigation and enforcement work the law already requires. This is basic good governance. Liberia and the Marshall Islands built the same safeguards over time. None of it needs a “ sold ” headline to justify doing it. Conclusion The facts in the article check out. The dates. The ship. The strike. The other Turkish deals. All real. What does not check out is the leap from those facts to a hidden sale of Somali sovereignty. That leap runs on timing, implication, and a burden of proof turned upside down. Even the article’s own legal source—the Saiga ruling—argues against its conclusion, not for it. The better response is not to dismiss the article outright. It is to take its fair points on transparency seriously, and to reject the parts it never actually proved. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Golaha Ammaanka ka sheegay in aan la aqbali karin in…
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa khudbad ka jeediyay Fadhiga Guud ee Meertada 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo kaga hadlay xaaladda Soomaaliya iyo arrimaha caalamka. Madaxweynaha ayaa khudbaddiisa ku xusay caqabadaha ka dhashay colaadaha, loollanka juqraafi-siyaasadeed, isbeddelka cimilada iyo hoos u dhaca iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigay guulaha iyo horumarka Soomaaliya ay ka sameysay dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska, dimuqraadiyeynta iyo amniga, iyo sidoo kale dadaallada lagu dhammaystirayo Dastuurka dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa intaas ku daray horumarka laga sameeyay dib-u-habeynta waxbarashada, kobaca dhaqaalaha iyo hirgelinta doorashooyin loo dhan yahay, isagoo tilmaamay dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay arrimahaasi ku waddo. Dhanka kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ku baaqay in Qaramada Midoobay dib loogu soo celiyo kalsoonida caalamka, lana xoojiyo nidaamka dhinacyada badan iyo fulinta go’aannada caalamiga ah. Waxa uu sidoo kale carabka ku adkeeyay in aan la aqbali karin in Qaaradda Afrika ay ka maqnaato fadhiyada iyo madallada lagu go’aaminayo masiirka ummadda dunida, isagoo ku baaqay in codka Afrika uu si buuxda uga dhex muuqdo go’aanada caalamiga ah. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale markale xaqiijiyay taageerada Soomaaliya ee xaqa shacabka reer Falastiin u leeyihiin aayo-ka-tashi, dowladnimo iyo nolol ku dhisan nabad iyo amni. Waxa uu ku baaqay in la helo xal waara oo caddaalad ah oo ku saleysan laba dowladood, lana dhiso dowlad Falastiini ah oo madax-bannaan. items.title: Isbaheysiga Haybad Qaran iyo Xaqsoor oo xilkii ka qaaday Cumar Cabdirisaaq
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Isbaheysiga Xaqsoor iyo Haybad Qaran, Danjire Cabdiraxmaan Caynte ayaa Cumar Cabdirisaaq Xuseen ka qaaday xilka Xoghayaha Guud ee Isbaheysiga. Cumar Cabdirisaaq ayaa sidoo kale laga qaaday xubinnimadii Golaha Sare ee Siyaasadda ee Isbaheysiga, sida lagu sheegay go’aanka kasoo baxay hoggaanka isbaheysiga. Go’aankan ayaa yimid kaddib markii Guddiga Anshaxa ee Isbaheysiga uu sheegay in Cumar Cabdirisaaq lagu helay inuu ku xadgudbay xeerarka iyo anshaxa u degsan Golaha Sare ee Siyaasadda ee Isbaheysiga. Isbaheysiga ayaan si faahfaahsan u shaacin xeerarka iyo qodobbada anshax ee uu ku xadgudbay Cumar Cabdirisaaq Xuseen, kuwaas oo sababay in tallaabada laga qaado. Go’aanka xil-ka-qaadista ayaa sidoo kale meesha ka saaray doorkii uu Cumar Cabdirisaaq ku lahaa Golaha Sare ee Siyaasadda, kadib markii laga qaaday xubinnimadii uu ku lahaa golahaasi. Isbahaysiga Xisbiyada Haybad Qaran iyo Xaqsoor ayaa 23-ka Abriil 2026 ku dhawaaqay inay isku biireen, isla markaana ay sameysteen isbahaysi siyaasadeed. Isbaheysiga Xaqsoor iyo Haybad Qaran ayaa markaas sheegay in loo aasaasay xoojinta caddaaladda dalka iyo dib u soo celinta haybadda iyo sharafta qaranka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay mideeyeen awooddooda siyaasadeed. The post Isbaheysiga Haybad Qaran iyo Xaqsoor oo xilkii ka qaaday Cumar Cabdirisaaq appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo Khudbad ka Jeediyay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa khudbad ka jeediyay kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo diiradda saaray xaaladda caalamka, dib-u-habaynta Qaramada Midoobay, arrimaha Soomaaliya iyo doorka caalamka ee nabadda iyo horumarka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dunidu ay wajahday hubanti la’aan sii kordheysa, iyadoo ay jiraan colaado, loollan juqraafi-siyaasadeed iyo hoos u dhac ku yimid iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Waxa uu xusay in horumarka lagu gaarayo Yoolalka Horumarka Waara ee 2030 uu marayo 36%, taas oo uu ku tilmaamay mid aan ku filnayn. Soomaaliya oo dalbatay dib-u-habeyn Golaha Ammaanka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay uu u baahan yahay in laga dhigo mid matalaad badan leh, hufan oo wax-ku-ool ah. Waxa uu si gaar ah u xusay in Afrika aysan weli ku lahayn matalaad joogto ah Golaha Ammaanka, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay taageertay mowqifka guud ee Afrika ee ku aaddan matalaad buuxda oo qaaraddu ka hesho labada qaybood ee Golaha. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya, oo xilligan ka tirsan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika, ay ka shaqaynayso xoojinta iskaashiga Qaramada Midoobay iyo Midowga Afrika, ka hortagga colaadaha iyo taageeridda xalalka nabadeed ee ay Afrika hoggaaminayso. Soomaaliya oo ka hadashay madaxbannaanida iyo Falastiin Khudbadda ayaa sidoo kale lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda dhowrista madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo xuduudaha caalamiga ah ee dalalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay diiddan tahay tallaabooyin hal dhinac ah oo wax u dhimaya madaxbannaanida iyo midnimada dalalka, isagoo ku baaqay in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo waafaqsanaanta sharciga caalamiga ah. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay garab taagan tahay shacabka Falastiin, isla markaana ay taageerayso xal laba dowladood ah oo dhidibada u taagaya dowlad Falastiini ah oo madax-bannaan oo ka jirta xuduudihii 1967. Madaxweynaha oo dalbaday in Soomaaliya hoggaamiso mashaariicda UN-ka Madaxweynaha ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan doonayn in Qaramada Midoobay dalka ka baxdo, balse ay rabto iskaashi cusub oo isla-xisaabtan leh, kaas oo hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed ay door hoggaamineed ku yeeshaan fulinta mashaariicda. Waxa uu sheegay in gargaar badan oo UN-ku bixiyo uu weli ku socdo hannaan hay’ado barbar socda, mashaariic kala go’an iyo nidaamyo aan si buuxda ugu dhex jirin miisaaniyadda dowladda, taas oo uu sheegay inay caqabad ku tahay qorsheynta iyo dhismaha hay’adaha qaranka. Doorashooyinka iyo dimuqraadiyadda Soomaaliya Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay waddo dib-u-habeyn dastuuri ah oo saldhig u noqonaysa cod-bixin guud, hay’ado isla-xisaabtan leh iyo nidaam siyaasadeed xisbiyo badan leh. Waxa uu xusay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay muddo tobannaan sano ah ku taamayeen inay hoggaankooda ku doortaan codkooda, isagoo sheegay in doorashadii ugu dambeysay ee noocaas ah ay dhacday 1969-kii. Dowladda ayuu sheegay inay doonayso in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, sharci iyo doorashooyin, halkii laga adeegsan lahaa rabshado. La-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo amniga Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya ay sii waddo dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada, iyadoo xoojinaysa hay’adaha amniga, awoodda sirdoonka iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka deriska iyo beesha caalamka. Waxa uu ugu baaqay beesha caalamka taageero joogto ah oo la siiyo marxaladda kala-guurka amniga Soomaaliya, oo ay ku jirto maalgelinta howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in mas’uuliyadda amniga oo si buuxda loogu wareejiyo Soomaaliya ay u baahan tahay dhaqaale, qorshe marxalado leh iyo hay’ado Soomaaliyeed oo awood leh. Dhaqaalaha, cimilada iyo saameynta marin-biyoodka Hormuz Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu kobcayo, isagoo khudbadda ku sheegay in kobaca dhabta ah ee GDP-ga Soomaaliya sannadkan uu yahay 3.1%. Waxa uu sidoo kale tilmaamay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo maareynta maaliyadda dadweynaha, kordhinta dakhliga gudaha iyo horumarinta jawiga maalgashiga. Waxa uu ka digay saameynta isbeddelka cimilada, isagoo sheegay in abaarta la xiriirta isbeddelka cimiladu ay saameyneyso in ka badan 6 milyan oo qof oo Soomaaliya ah. Waxa kale oo uu sheegay in khalkhalka ka jira marinka Strait of Hormuz uu saameyn ku yeeshay qiimaha badeecadaha, shidaalka, gaadiidka iyo dakhliga canshuuraha gudaha Soomaaliya. Khudbaddiisa ayuu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku soo gabagabeeyay baaq ku saabsan in Qaramada Midoobay ay ilaaliso kalsoonida caalamka, iyadoo loo baahan yahay matalaad caddaalad ah, kheyraad la heli karo iyo natiijooyin la cabbiri karo, gaar ahaan dalalka soo koraya.

Waxa uu sheegay in gargaar badan oo UN-ku bixiyo uu weli ku socdo hannaan hay’ado barbar socda, mashaariic kala go’an iyo nidaamyo aan si buuxda ugu dhex jirin miisaaniyadda dowladda, taas oo uu sheegay inay caqabad ku tahay qorsheynta iyo dhismaha hay’adaha qaranka. Doorashooyinka iyo dimuqraadiyadda Soomaaliya Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay waddo dib-u-habeyn dastuuri ah oo saldhig u noqonaysa cod-bixin guud, hay’ado isla-xisaabtan leh iyo nidaam siyaasadeed xisbiyo badan leh. Waxa uu xusay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay muddo tobannaan sano ah ku taamayeen inay hoggaankooda ku doortaan codkooda, isagoo sheegay in doorashadii ugu dambeysay ee noocaas ah ay dhacday 1969-kii. Dowladda ayuu sheegay inay doonayso in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, sharci iyo doorashooyin, halkii laga adeegsan lahaa rabshado. La-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo amniga Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya ay sii waddo dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada, iyadoo xoojinaysa hay’adaha amniga, awoodda sirdoonka iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka deriska iyo beesha caalamka. Waxa uu ugu baaqay beesha caalamka taageero joogto ah oo la siiyo marxaladda kala-guurka amniga Soomaaliya, oo ay ku jirto maalgelinta howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in mas’uuliyadda amniga oo si buuxda loogu wareejiyo Soomaaliya ay u baahan tahay dhaqaale, qorshe marxalado leh iyo hay’ado Soomaaliyeed oo awood leh. Dhaqaalaha, cimilada iyo saameynta marin-biyoodka Hormuz Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu kobcayo, isagoo khudbadda ku sheegay in kobaca dhabta ah ee GDP-ga Soomaaliya sannadkan uu yahay 3.1%. Waxa uu sidoo kale tilmaamay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo maareynta maaliyadda dadweynaha, kordhinta dakhliga gudaha iyo horumarinta jawiga maalgashiga. Waxa uu ka digay saameynta isbeddelka cimilada, isagoo sheegay in abaarta la xiriirta isbeddelka cimiladu ay saameyneyso in ka badan 6 milyan oo qof oo Soomaaliya ah. Waxa kale oo uu sheegay in khalkhalka ka jira marinka Strait of Hormuz uu saameyn ku yeeshay qiimaha badeecadaha, shidaalka, gaadiidka iyo dakhliga canshuuraha gudaha Soomaaliya. Khudbaddiisa ayuu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku soo gabagabeeyay baaq ku saabsan in Qaramada Midoobay ay ilaaliso kalsoonida caalamka, iyadoo loo baahan yahay matalaad caddaalad ah, kheyraad la heli karo iyo natiijooyin la cabbiri karo, gaar ahaan dalalka soo koraya.

items.title: Wasiirka Warfaafinta oo Saint Petersburg kula kulmay Wasiirka Dhaqanka Ruushka
items.description: Saint Petersburg, Ruushka – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdifataax Qaasim Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Saint Petersburg kulan laba-geesood ah kula yeeshay Wasiirka Dhaqanka Federaalka Ruushka, Marwo Olga Lyubimova. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka ee dhinaca dhaqanka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay si gaar ah uga wada hadleen ilaalinta iyo horumarinta hidde-dhaqameedka, farshaxanka, suugaanta iyo tiyaatarrada. Sidoo kale, waxaa laga wada hadlay cilmi-baarista dhaqanka, is-dhaafsiga khubarada iyo fanaaniinta, iyo horumarinta xarumaha dhaqanka ee labada dal. Labada Wasiir ayaa isla soo qaaday dardargelinta is-afgaradka iskaashiga dhaqanka ee Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka, iyo sidii loo hirgelin lahaa barnaamijyo iyo mashaariic wax-ku-ool ah oo ka qayb qaata horumarinta iyo kobcinta dhaqanka. Wasiir Cabdifataax Qaasim ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay Soomaaliya siinayso dhaqanka iyo farshaxanka, isagoo tilmaamay in dhaqanku door muhiim ah ka qaato ilaalinta aqoonsiga qaranka, isku-xirka bulshada iyo xoojinta xiriirka shacabka labada dal. Dhankeeda, Wasiirka Dhaqanka Ruushka Olga Lyubimova ayaa muujisay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta xiriirka hay’adaha dhaqanka ee Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka, iyadoo ballanqaadday in la sii xoojin doono wada-shaqeynta iyo taageerada labada dhinac. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ahaa kulamada Wasiirka Warfaafinta uu la qaadanayo madaxda iyo masuuliyiinta ka qaybgalaya Madasha 12-aad ee Caalamiga ah ee Dhaqamada Midoobay, oo sanadkan lagu qabtay magaalada Saint Petersburg ee dalka Ruushka.

items.title: Wasiir Ayuub iyo qalalaasaha Awdal maxaa ka dhexeeya?
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Xogo dheeraad ah oo laga helayo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada siyaasadeed ee ka socda gobolka Awdal ayaa muujinaya eedeymo la xiriira dhaqaale lagu maalgelinayo dhalinyaro deegaanka ah, kuwaas oo lagu sheegay inay qeyb ka yihiin olole lagu abuurayo xiisado colaadeed oo cusub. Wasiirka Howlaha Guud ee Soomaaliya ahna Xildhibaan ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka, Ismaaciil Yuusuf ayaa si toos ah loogu xiriirinaya maalgelinta dhaq-dhaqaaqan. Sida xoguhu tilmaamayaan, lacagta ayaa loo adeegsanayaa abaabul, faafinta dacaayado siyaasadeed iyo olole lagu doonayo in lagu kordhiyo xiisadda colaadeed ee ka jirta deegaanka. Dadka loo adeegsanaayo ololahan ayaa iyagu u badan dhalinyaro reer Awdal ah oo qaarkood dano siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale ka leh xaaladda gobolka. Dhaq-dhaqaaqooda ayaa lagu sheegay inuu ka gudbay dood siyaasadeed oo caadi ah, waxaana eedeymaha ugu waaweyn ay yihiin in lacago loo adeegsanayo sidii qalalaase looga abuuri lahaa deegaan muddo lagu yaqaanay xasillooni. Mashruucan ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay in ujeeddadiisu tahay in bulshada deegaanka lagu tuso in wasiirka uu yahay shaqsi si gaar ah u garab taagan arrimaha Awdal, iyadoo dhalinyaro taageerta Ayuub ay si joogto ah baraha bulshada ugu baahiyaan qoraallo iyo muuqaallo lagu amaanayo, iyadoo si weyn loo buunbuuninayo doorkiisa iyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay deegaanka uu kasoo jeedo. Qoraallada iyo farriimaha lagu faafiyo baraha bulshada ayaa inta badan u muuqda kuwo Ayuub loogu soo bandhigayo inuu yahay shaqsi si dhab ah u metelaya danaha dadka deegaanka, taas oo looga dan leeyahay xoojinta muuqaalkiisa siyaasadeed iyo taageerada uu ku leeyahay bulshada. Arrintan ayaa qeyb ka ah olole lagu dhisayo sumcad shaqsiyeed, kaas oo aan ku koobnayn taageero dabiici ah oo ka dhalata bulshada, balse ay jiraan dhalinyaro si gaar ah dhaqaale ugu qaadanaya faafinta iyo buunbuuninta magaca wasiirka, si loogu abuuro sawir ah inuu yahay wakiil dhab ah oo danaha Awdal metela. Tan ayaa la sheegay in wasiir Ayuub uu ku doonayo in uu noqdo mas’uulka keliya ee hoggaanka sare ee dowladda ugala macaamilo malafka Awdal. Sidoo kale, ujeeddada ugu dambeysa ee dhaq-dhaqaaqan ayaa ahayn oo keliya in lagu muujiyo mowqif ku saabsan Soomaali-weyn, balse in xiisad haddii ay ka dhalato Awdal loo isticmaalo in taageero iyo dhaqaale badan looga raadsado Dowladda Federaalka. Tan ayaa arrinta ka dhigaysa mid leh dhinac siyaasadeed iyo mid dhaqaale oo isku xiran. Si kastaba, arrintan ayaa dhalinaysa su’aalo ku saabsan sababta wasiir ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka ugu bareeri karo inuu dhaqaale ku bixiyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo lagu khalkhal-gelinayo xasilloonida gobol nabdoon iyo abuurista colaad ka istaadhanta Awdal loo adeegsado in laga raadiyo macaash siyaasadeed iyo mid dhaqaale oo shaqsi ah. Dabayaaqadii sanadkii hore ayey aheyd markii rabshado xooggan ay ka dhaceen magaalada Borama ee xarunta gobolka Awdal, kuwaas oo sababay dhimashada 20 qof iyo in ka badan dhaawaca 214 qof. Rabshadahaasi oo billowday kadib markii xukuumadda Somaliland ay oggolaatay in magaalada Saylac lagu qabto munaasibadda Xeer Ciise, ayaa sidoo kale waxaa kaalin ka qaatay hurinta xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee gobolka. items.title: Mystery Meeting in New York Raises Questions Inside Somalia’s Government
items.description: Unconfirmed Report of Secret Encounter Between Foreign Minister and Somaliland President Fuels Political Suspicion New York (WDN) — A potentially sensitive diplomatic encounter in New York is raising questions inside Somalia’s political establishment after reports emerged that Foreign Minister Abdisalam Abdi Ali and Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi “Irro” were seen together in what was described as a private meeting not formally disclosed by the Somali government. The reported encounter comes at a particularly sensitive moment. President Irro has spent much of September in the United States pursuing Somaliland’s campaign for international recognition and strengthening its diplomatic and strategic relationships, while Somalia’s federal government has been working to counter that campaign. According to the reports circulating in diplomatic circles, the two officials were seen sitting together in New York, but the purpose, duration and circumstances of the alleged meeting remain unclear. There has been no official confirmation from Somalia’s Foreign Ministry, Villa Somalia or the Somaliland presidency establishing that the reported private meeting took place or explaining what was discussed. Why the Encounter is Raising Eyebrows The timing is what makes the report particularly sensitive. President Irro is in New York during the United Nations General Assembly high-level week, where Somaliland has been intensifying its international diplomatic campaign. His delegation has been using the U.S. visit to promote Somaliland’s case for recognition and to present the territory as a potential security and economic partner in the Horn of Africa. The diplomatic activity has included meetings with U.S. lawmakers and foreign-policy institutions. Irro also met Israel’s ambassador to the United Nations, Danny Danon, in New York on September 23. Against that backdrop, any undisclosed contact between Somalia’s foreign minister and the Somaliland president would inevitably attract scrutiny. Was the Meeting Merely Diplomatic — or Something More? At this stage, there is no verified evidence showing that the alleged encounter represented a secret political agreement, a change in Mogadishu’s Somaliland policy or an unauthorized diplomatic initiative. Nor is there evidence establishing that Israel arranged such a meeting. Those possibilities have nevertheless begun circulating because of the wider diplomatic activity surrounding Somaliland in New York. Israel formally recognized Somaliland in December 2025, according to multiple reports, while President Irro has continued to seek additional international recognition, particularly from the United States. That makes the timing and optics of any private encounter involving a senior Somali official particularly sensitive. But an Israeli connection should not be inferred merely because Irro separately met Israel’s UN ambassador. A Potential Test for Hassan Sheikh and His Foreign Minister The report could also raise questions about the relationship between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Foreign Minister Abdisalam. There is currently no verified evidence that Hassan Sheikh opposed any contact between his foreign minister and Irro, nor that the President regarded such contact as a breach of government policy. Indeed, diplomatic engagement between officials from Mogadishu and Hargeisa is not inherently unusual. The significance would depend on who authorized the encounter, what was discussed and whether any proposal or commitments were made. That is precisely why the reported secrecy is attracting attention. The Bigger Diplomatic Picture Somalia has been confronting an increasingly active Somaliland diplomatic campaign in Washington and New York. President Irro has openly presented Somaliland as a potential strategic partner on Red Sea and Gulf of Aden security, trade and investment, while seeking broader international recognition. A reported meeting with Somalia’s foreign minister, if confirmed, would therefore take place against one of the most consequential diplomatic campaigns Somaliland has mounted in years. For now, however, the central question remains unanswered: Did Abdisalam and Irro actually hold a private meeting, who knew about it, and what — if anything — was discussed? Until the Somali government or Somaliland presidency provides an account, the reported encounter remains an unverified claim rather than an established diplomatic event. But its timing alone is enough to ensure that any confirmation would attract considerable attention in Mogadishu, Hargeisa and beyond. items.title: Wafdi sare oo ka socda Talyaaniga oo Muqdisho yimid + Ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Taliska Hawlgallada Wadajirka ah ee Talyaaniga, S/Guud Giovanni Maria Iannucci ayaa booqasho rasmi ah ku yimid magaalada Muqdisho. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa qaabilay Taliyaha Taliska Hawlgallada Wadajirka ah ee Talyaaniga iyo Danjiraha Talyaaniga, iyadoo kulanka looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal. Kulanka oo uu taliyeyaasha ku weheliyay Danjiraha Talyaaniga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Pier Mario Daccò Coppi ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Talyaaniga. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale si gaar ah uga wada hadlay isbeddellada amni ee kasoo cusboonaaday gobolka, gaar ahaan xaaladda Badda Cas iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karto amniga Soomaaliya iyo gobolka. Wada-hadallada ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo qaaday saameynta xaaladda Badda Cas ay ku yeelan karto isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah, iyadoo la eegay muhiimadda ay leedahay xasilloonida iyo amniga marin-biyoodka gobolka. items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed cusub la yeelatay Jamhuuriyadda…
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dominikaanka ayaa ku heshiiyay aasaasidda xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo rasmi ah, taas oo qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo dalalka Latin America iyo Kariibiyaanka. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali ayaa magaalada New York kula kulmay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Jamhuuriyadda Dominikaanka, Víctor O. Bisonó Haza. Kulanka labada wasiir ayaa dhacay intii uu socday shirka meertada 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dominikaanka. Labada wasiir ayaa sidoo kale kala saxiixday heshiisyo cusub oo lagu aasaasayo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo rasmi ah oo dhex mara labada dal. Heshiisyada ayaa sidoo kale lagu tilmaamay mid lagu xoojinayaa isku-duwidda labada dal, kuwaas oo labaduba xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo la rajeynayo in tallaabadan ay horseeddo iskaashi dheeraad ah. Aasaasidda xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku ballaarinayso xiriirrada iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka Latin America iyo Kariibiyaanka. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya u horseedaysa inay yeelato xiriir rasmi ah oo ay la sameysato Jamhuuriyadda Dominikaanka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka shaqeyn doonaan horumarinta xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashi labada dhinac ah.
