items.title: Marka Aargoosiga Qabiilku uu Aamusiiyo Bini’aadantinimada: Milicsiga Sheeko Xanuun Badan
items.description: Soomaaliya waxay u baahantahay inay dib u dhisto wax dhaafsiisan waddooyin la maro, hay’ado ama xafiisyo dawladeed. Waxay, dhab ahaan, u baahantahay inay dib u dhisto ‘ kalsooni’: kalsooni ah in qof kasta oo Soomaali uu meel kasta u safri karo isaga oo aan la eegaynin qabiilka uu ka soo jeedo ; kalsooni ah in askarigu uu yahay astaan qaran, uuna ka tirsanyahay qaranka uu u adeegayo; iyo midda ugu muhiimsan oo kalsoonida inaan qof bani’aadan ah loo dili karin keliya jifada ama qabiilka uu ka dhashay awgeed. Dil dhowaan la soo sheegay oo uu ku saabsan yahay milicsigan, wuxuu si xanuun badan u muujinayaa inta uu aargoosiga qabiilku bani’aadanka uga fogayn karo danqashada damiirka. Askari ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed (SNA) ayaa ka safrayay saldhiggiisa milatari, isagoo ku sii jeeday qoyskiisa. Intii uu safarka ku jiray, wuxuu maray degaan ay deggan yihiin dad lala xiriirinayo colaad ka dhex jirta qabiilkiisa. Waa la joojiyay, waxaana loo aqoonsaday inuu ka soo jeedo qabiil kuwa isaga qabtay ay iska soo horjeedaan, waxaana loo bartilmaameedsaday sababtaas awgeed. Waxa ugu murugada badan ee ay sheekadani xanbaarsan thay ayaa ah in dhibbanaha aan si fudud loogu aqoonsan inuu ka tirsan yahay qabiilka loo arkayay in uu cadowga tolka. Wuxuu ahaa qof leh abtirsiin isku dhafan. Hooyadiis waxay ka soo jeedday isla qabiilka kuwa qabtay ay ka soo jeedaan. Xiriirka dhinaca hooyada ahi, marka la eego xiriirrada bulshada Soomaaliyeed, wuxuu masiibada ka dhigayaa mid sii adkaanaysa in la fahmo: raggii qabtay waxa uu ugu yeerayay marxuumka ay dili doonaan “abti” oo ah erey xanbaarsan dhalasho dhow oo ay wadaagaan kuwaan laftooda oo hooyadiis ayay dhaleen. Hasayeeshee, xitaa xiriirkaas abtinimo iyo baryadii uu baryay ma aysan badbaadin naftiisa. Sida ku cad warbixinta, askarigu wuxuu afduubayaashiisii ku baryaayay ereyo ay tahay inay damiirka qof kasta oo bani’aadan ah gilgishaan: " “Abtiyaal, waan gaajaysanahay. Tan iyo subaxdii waxba ma cunin.” “Abtiyaal, ma aanan samayn wax aan ku mutaysto dil.” “Abtiyaal, caafimaadkaygu ma fiicno. Waan xanuunsanahay.” Waxay ahayd fiidkii, wuuna gaajaysnaa. Oo waliba xanuunsanaa. Wuxuu sheegay inuusan wax dembi ah gelin. Wuxuu baryayay rag uu ugu yeerayay abtiyaal. Hasayeeshee, sida la sheegay, baryadiisii waa la iska indha tiray, waana la dilay. Haddii dhacdadan si dhab ah loo xaqiijiyo, dilku ma aha oo keliya masiibo ku dhacday hal qoys. Waa digniin akhlaaqeed oo weyn oo ku saabsan waxa dhaca marka aqoonsiga qabiilku uu ka xoog bato karaamada bani’aadamka, diinta, muwaadinnimada, sharciga iyo damiirka. Geerida askari loo dilay qabiilkiisa awgeed si gaar ah ayay u xanuun badantahay, sababtoo ah ujeeddada ciidanka qaranku waa inuu ka gudbo kalaqaybsanaanta noocaas ah. Dirayska Ciidanka Xoogga Soomaaliyeed waa inuu ka dhiganyahay in qofka xirani uu u adeegayo Soomaaliya, ee uusan u adeegaynin nasab gaar ah. Marka askari qaran lagu joojin karo waddo dadweyne, lagu aqoonsan karo qabiilkiisa, laguna dili karo aqoonsigaas awgiis, farriintu waxay ka gudbaysaa dhibbanaha. Waxay askari kasta oo Soomaaliyeed u sheegaysaa in adeegga uu u hayo qaranku uusan ku filnayn kana ilaalin karin xisaabaha gaarka ah ee ay sidato qabyaaladdu. Waxay muwaadiniinta caadiga ah u sheegaysaa in badbaadadoodu ku xirnaan karto cidda maamusha waddooyinka la isu maro halkii ay ku xirnaan lahayd awoodda dawladda iyo sarraynta sharciga. Waxayna bulshada u sheegaysaa in dawladdu weli la tartamayso nidaamyada aan rasmiga ahayn ee ku dhisan qabyaaladda iyo aargoosiga. Tani waa sababta dhismaha dawladnimada Soomaaliya ay u tahay in loo fahmo mashruuc lagu dhisayo akhlaaqda bulshada iyo nabad ku wada noolaanshahooda, sida uu u yahay mashruuc dib u dhis hay’ado dowladeed oo xooggan. Dhismaha dawladnimo laguma gaaro oo keliya samaynta wasaarado, meelmarinta sharciyo, qorista ciidamada amniga ama qabashada doorashooyin. Waxaa lagu gaaraa marka muwaadiniintu si tartiib ah u rumaystaan in sharcigu ka xoog badan yahay aargoosiga, in muwaadinnimadu ka muhiimsan tahay qabiilka, iyo in nolosha qof Soomaaliyeed ay qiimo leedahay iyada oo aan loo eegin nasabkiisa. Aargoosiga qabiilku aragtidaas lama jaanqaadi karo. Ma jirto bulsho dhisi karta nabad waarta iyadoo carruurteeda—si toos ah ama si dadban—baraysa in aqoonsiga qof loo arko cadow sababtoo ah qabiilkiisa taasna sabab u noqon karo dilkiisa. Ciqaab wadareed waa mid akhlaaq ahaan aan sinnaba loo difaaci karin, sababtoo ah qofna ma dhaxli karo lagumana ciqaabi karo dembiga uu galay qof kale. Askari gurigiisa ku sii jeeda dambiile kuma noqon karo oo keliya sababtoo ah qof ka tirsan qabiilkiisa ayaa meel kale dembi ka geystay. Caddaaladdu waa inay noqotaa mid ku salaysan shaqsiga iyo dambiga uu isagu gaystay, caddayn ku dhisan oo sharci ah, aargoosigu midkoodna ma aha. Dhacdadan waxay, sidoo kale, xanbaarsantahay arrimo damiirka nool dhaqaajinaya, bal suurayso in la dilo qof ku baryootamaaya xiriir kala dhexeeya kuwa isaga dilaya , sida “abti” oo kale. Dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed sooyaal ahaan wuxuu muhiimad weyn siiyay waajibaadka xigtada, martisoorka, ilaalinta iyo mangalyada xigaalka, dhinaca hooyada. Hasayeeshee, dhaqanka marna looma adeegsan karo rabshad loogu cudurdaaro dambi shaqsi kale gaystay, iyadoo la tuurayo qaayasoorrada bani’aadantinimo. Haddii aqoonsiga qabiilku uu ehelnimada (si gaar ah “abtinimada”) uu meesha ka saaro, una beddelo in lagu bannaysto dilka qof aan waxba galabsna, markaas aargoosigu wuxuu dhaawacay xiriirradii bulsheed ee ay qabiilooyinku sheeganayaan inay difaacayaan “waa ratigii reeryadiisa cunay”. Diintu waxay dejisay xad akhlaaqeed xoog badan. Si ulakac ah in loo qaado nolosha qof aan waxba galabsan lagama dhigi karo wax loo oggolyahay qabiil, si kasta oo ay tabasho taariikhi ah ama xusuus wadareed u qabaan, marna suurtagal ma aha in iimaanka lagu soo koobo salaad iyo cibaadooyin kale, iyadoo karaamada aasaasiga ah ee bani’aadamka lagu duudsiinayo xurgufooyin hore awgood. Mabaadi’da diintu waxay dalbanayaan caddaalad, isxakamayn, naxariis iyo islaxisaabtan. Tabasho waxay u baahan kartaa caddaalad; balse marna qof gaar ah ma siinayso awood uu ku noqdo garsoore, xeerbeegti iyo fuliyaha xukunka dilka. Maxaan ka baranaynaa dilkan arxandarrada ah? Marka kowaad, dalku wuxuu u baahanyahay dhaqan xooggan oo ku dhisan muwaadinnimo loo siman yahay. Soomaali kasta waa inuu awood u yeeshaa inuu meel kasta oo dalka ka mid ah ku safro, ka shaqeeyo, wax ku barto oo ugu adeego dalkiisa isaga oo aan qarin aqoonsigiisa qabiil cabsi uu ka qabo darteed. Tani waxay u baahan tahay wacyigelin dadweyne, wadahadal bulsho iyo hoggaan siyaasadeed oo si joogto ah u diida hadallada xanbaarsan eedda wadareed ee qabyaaladaysan. Marka labaad, hay’adaha amniga qaranku waa inay si dhab ah u noqdaan kuwo qaran. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo hay’adaha kale ee amnigu waxay u baahanyihiin heerar xirfadeed, silsilado amar oo la isku halayn karo, habraacyo ammaan ah oo lagu safri karo iyo hannaan lagu ilaaliyo shaqaalaha lagu beegsanayo qabiil awgiis. Askari qaran waa inuu dareemaa in dawladdu garab taagan tahay, iyada oo aan loo eegin nasabkiisa. Marka saddexaad, bulshooyinku waa inay kala saaraan dibuheshiisiin iyo islaxisaabtan-la’aan. Joojinta colaadda qabiilku macnaheedu ma aha in dhibbanayaasha la illoobo. Sidoo kale, macnaheedu ma aha in qoys kasta loo oggolaado inuu raaco nooca uu isagu u yaqaan caddaalad. Dibuheshiisiin waarta waxay u baahan tahay run, islaxisaabtan, magdhaw marka ay habboon tahay, cafis marka si xor ah uu ku yimaado, iyo dammaanadqaadaysa inaan rabshad hore loo xaliyay aanan dib loo soo celin. Marka afaraad, hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya waa inuu joojiyo inuu rabshadaha qabiilka u arko sifo aan laga maarmi karin oo nolosha Soomaaliyeed ka mid ah. Waa la fahmi karaa in qaabdhismeedyada qabiilku weli awood ay bulshada ku dhex leeyihiin. Laakiin, bisaylka siyaasadeed wuxuu u baahan yahay in qaabdhismeedyadaas loo beddelo kuwo taageera wadanoolaansho nabadeed, halkii ay go’aamin lahaayeen cidda mudan ilaalinta iyo cidda la dili karo. Marka shanaad, odayaasha degaanka iyo culimada diintu waxay leeyihiin masuuliyad muhiim ah. Waxay xoojin karaan silsiladaha aargoosiga ama waxay noqon karaan xoogag awood leh oo xakameeya. Marka nin dhallinyaro ah loo joojiyo qabiilkiisa awgiis, faragelinta ugu horraysa waa inay noqotaa: “Waa bani’aadan, waa muwaaddin Soomaaliyeed, wax dembi ahna ma uusan gelin.” Mabda’aas waa inuu ka xoog bato dareenka aargoosiga iyo uurgummaarka raagay. Ugu danbayn, Soomaali kasta waa inuu isweydiiyaa su’aalo aad u xanuun badan: Dal noocee ah ayaynu isku dayaynaa inaan dhisno? Ma dhisaynaa Soomaaliya uu qof ku badbaado sababtoo ah waa muwaadin, mise Soomaaliya ay badbaadadiisu ku xiran tahay qabiilkiisa? Ma dhisaynaa ciidan matala qaranka, mise waxaan keliya darees qaran u gelinaynaa shaqsiyaad weli u nugul rabshadaha qabiilka? Ma dhisaynaa nidaam caddaaladeed, mise caddaaladda waxaan u daynaynaa cidda maamusha waddooyinka la isaga gudbo? Oo ma ilaalinaynaa dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed, mise waxaan u oggolaanaynaa qaababka ugu xun ee aargoosiga qabiilku inay burburiyaan qiyamka qaraabanimada, martisoorka, karaamada iyo naxariista ay Soomaalidu si sax ah ugu faanto? Baryadii ugu danbaysay ee askariga laga soo xigtay waxay ahayd in uu ku halaanhalay gaajo, denbi-la’aan iyo xanuun uu dareemayo, dhabtiina dhammaantood waa arrimo danqasho leh. Ma ahayn dood siyaasadeed. Waxay ahaayeen ereyo bani’aadantinimo ku qotama. Adeegsigiisa ereyga “abti” ma ahayn difaac sharciyeed oo uu cuskanayay; wuxuu ahaa codsi ku wajahan xiriir ehelnimo oo ay ahayd inuu keeno naxariis iyo u danqasho dhalasho. Taasi waa sababta sheekadani aysan u noqon karin dhacdo kale oo murugo leh oo dhowr maalmood la xasuusto dabadeedna lagu aaso dhibaatada xigta. Haddii Soomaaliya ay dhab ka tahay dibudhiska nidaamka dawladnimo, dhacdooyinka noocan ahi waa inay noqdaan xisaabtan akhlaaqeed oo qaran. Dalku wuxuu u baahanyahay hay’ado ka hortagi kara dilalka aan sharciga ahayn, bulsho diidda ciqaabta wadareed, hoggaamiyayaal si aan leexleexasho lahayn u canbaareeya, ugana dhiidhiya aargoosiga, iyo muwaadiniin fahansan in qabiilna uusan ka weynayn nolosha bani’aadanka. Imtixaanka ugu danbeeya ee dhismaha dawladnimadu ma aha in dawladdu ku hadli karto magaca qaranka. Waa in qof kasta oo Soomaali ah oo caadi ahi rumaysan karo in qaranku ilaalin doono naftiisa, sharaftiisa iyo hantidiisaba. Soomaaliya oo askariga qaranka lagu dili karo oo keliya inuu ka tirsan yahay qabiil gaar ah weli ma aha Soomaaliya ballanqaadayso dhismaha dawladnimada bulshadu u baahan tahay. items.fullContent: Soomaaliya waxay u baahantahay inay dib u dhisto wax dhaafsiisan waddooyin la maro, hay’ado ama xafiisyo dawladeed. Waxay, dhab ahaan, u baahantahay inay dib u dhisto ‘ kalsooni’: kalsooni ah in qof kasta oo Soomaali uu meel kasta u safri karo isaga oo aan la eegaynin qabiilka uu ka soo jeedo ; kalsooni ah in askarigu uu yahay astaan qaran, uuna ka tirsanyahay qaranka uu u adeegayo; iyo midda ugu muhiimsan oo kalsoonida inaan qof bani’aadan ah loo dili karin keliya jifada ama qabiilka uu ka dhashay awgeed. Dil dhowaan la soo sheegay oo uu ku saabsan yahay milicsigan, wuxuu si xanuun badan u muujinayaa inta uu aargoosiga qabiilku bani’aadanka uga fogayn karo danqashada damiirka. Askari ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed (SNA) ayaa ka safrayay saldhiggiisa milatari, isagoo ku sii jeeday qoyskiisa. Intii uu safarka ku jiray, wuxuu maray degaan ay deggan yihiin dad lala xiriirinayo colaad ka dhex jirta qabiilkiisa. Waa la joojiyay, waxaana loo aqoonsaday inuu ka soo jeedo qabiil kuwa isaga qabtay ay iska soo horjeedaan, waxaana loo bartilmaameedsaday sababtaas awgeed. Waxa ugu murugada badan ee ay sheekadani xanbaarsan thay ayaa ah in dhibbanaha aan si fudud loogu aqoonsan inuu ka tirsan yahay qabiilka loo arkayay in uu cadowga tolka. Wuxuu ahaa qof leh abtirsiin isku dhafan. Hooyadiis waxay ka soo jeedday isla qabiilka kuwa qabtay ay ka soo jeedaan. Xiriirka dhinaca hooyada ahi, marka la eego xiriirrada bulshada Soomaaliyeed, wuxuu masiibada ka dhigayaa mid sii adkaanaysa in la fahmo: raggii qabtay waxa uu ugu yeerayay marxuumka ay dili doonaan “abti” oo ah erey xanbaarsan dhalasho dhow oo ay wadaagaan kuwaan laftooda oo hooyadiis ayay dhaleen. Hasayeeshee, xitaa xiriirkaas abtinimo iyo baryadii uu baryay ma aysan badbaadin naftiisa. Sida ku cad warbixinta, askarigu wuxuu afduubayaashiisii ku baryaayay ereyo ay tahay inay damiirka qof kasta oo bani’aadan ah gilgishaan: " “Abtiyaal, waan gaajaysanahay. Tan iyo subaxdii waxba ma cunin.” “Abtiyaal, ma aanan samayn wax aan ku mutaysto dil.” “Abtiyaal, caafimaadkaygu ma fiicno. Waan xanuunsanahay.” Waxay ahayd fiidkii, wuuna gaajaysnaa. Oo waliba xanuunsanaa. Wuxuu sheegay inuusan wax dembi ah gelin. Wuxuu baryayay rag uu ugu yeerayay abtiyaal. Hasayeeshee, sida la sheegay, baryadiisii waa la iska indha tiray, waana la dilay. Haddii dhacdadan si dhab ah loo xaqiijiyo, dilku ma aha oo keliya masiibo ku dhacday hal qoys. Waa digniin akhlaaqeed oo weyn oo ku saabsan waxa dhaca marka aqoonsiga qabiilku uu ka xoog bato karaamada bani’aadamka, diinta, muwaadinnimada, sharciga iyo damiirka. Geerida askari loo dilay qabiilkiisa awgeed si gaar ah ayay u xanuun badantahay, sababtoo ah ujeeddada ciidanka qaranku waa inuu ka gudbo kalaqaybsanaanta noocaas ah. Dirayska Ciidanka Xoogga Soomaaliyeed waa inuu ka dhiganyahay in qofka xirani uu u adeegayo Soomaaliya, ee uusan u adeegaynin nasab gaar ah. Marka askari qaran lagu joojin karo waddo dadweyne, lagu aqoonsan karo qabiilkiisa, laguna dili karo aqoonsigaas awgiis, farriintu waxay ka gudbaysaa dhibbanaha. Waxay askari kasta oo Soomaaliyeed u sheegaysaa in adeegga uu u hayo qaranku uusan ku filnayn kana ilaalin karin xisaabaha gaarka ah ee ay sidato qabyaaladdu. Waxay muwaadiniinta caadiga ah u sheegaysaa in badbaadadoodu ku xirnaan karto cidda maamusha waddooyinka la isu maro halkii ay ku xirnaan lahayd awoodda dawladda iyo sarraynta sharciga. Waxayna bulshada u sheegaysaa in dawladdu weli la tartamayso nidaamyada aan rasmiga ahayn ee ku dhisan qabyaaladda iyo aargoosiga. Tani waa sababta dhismaha dawladnimada Soomaaliya ay u tahay in loo fahmo mashruuc lagu dhisayo akhlaaqda bulshada iyo nabad ku wada noolaanshahooda, sida uu u yahay mashruuc dib u dhis hay’ado dowladeed oo xooggan. Dhismaha dawladnimo laguma gaaro oo keliya samaynta wasaarado, meelmarinta sharciyo, qorista ciidamada amniga ama qabashada doorashooyin. Waxaa lagu gaaraa marka muwaadiniintu si tartiib ah u rumaystaan in sharcigu ka xoog badan yahay aargoosiga, in muwaadinnimadu ka muhiimsan tahay qabiilka, iyo in nolosha qof Soomaaliyeed ay qiimo leedahay iyada oo aan loo eegin nasabkiisa. Aargoosiga qabiilku aragtidaas lama jaanqaadi karo. Ma jirto bulsho dhisi karta nabad waarta iyadoo carruurteeda—si toos ah ama si dadban—baraysa in aqoonsiga qof loo arko cadow sababtoo ah qabiilkiisa taasna sabab u noqon karo dilkiisa. Ciqaab wadareed waa mid akhlaaq ahaan aan sinnaba loo difaaci karin, sababtoo ah qofna ma dhaxli karo lagumana ciqaabi karo dembiga uu galay qof kale. Askari gurigiisa ku sii jeeda dambiile kuma noqon karo oo keliya sababtoo ah qof ka tirsan qabiilkiisa ayaa meel kale dembi ka geystay. Caddaaladdu waa inay noqotaa mid ku salaysan shaqsiga iyo dambiga uu isagu gaystay, caddayn ku dhisan oo sharci ah, aargoosigu midkoodna ma aha. Dhacdadan waxay, sidoo kale, xanbaarsantahay arrimo damiirka nool dhaqaajinaya, bal suurayso in la dilo qof ku baryootamaaya xiriir kala dhexeeya kuwa isaga dilaya , sida “abti” oo kale. Dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed sooyaal ahaan wuxuu muhiimad weyn siiyay waajibaadka xigtada, martisoorka, ilaalinta iyo mangalyada xigaalka, dhinaca hooyada. Hasayeeshee, dhaqanka marna looma adeegsan karo rabshad loogu cudurdaaro dambi shaqsi kale gaystay, iyadoo la tuurayo qaayasoorrada bani’aadantinimo. Haddii aqoonsiga qabiilku uu ehelnimada (si gaar ah “abtinimada”) uu meesha ka saaro, una beddelo in lagu bannaysto dilka qof aan waxba galabsna, markaas aargoosigu wuxuu dhaawacay xiriirradii bulsheed ee ay qabiilooyinku sheeganayaan inay difaacayaan “waa ratigii reeryadiisa cunay”. Diintu waxay dejisay xad akhlaaqeed xoog badan. Si ulakac ah in loo qaado nolosha qof aan waxba galabsan lagama dhigi karo wax loo oggolyahay qabiil, si kasta oo ay tabasho taariikhi ah ama xusuus wadareed u qabaan, marna suurtagal ma aha in iimaanka lagu soo koobo salaad iyo cibaadooyin kale, iyadoo karaamada aasaasiga ah ee bani’aadamka lagu duudsiinayo xurgufooyin hore awgood. Mabaadi’da diintu waxay dalbanayaan caddaalad, isxakamayn, naxariis iyo islaxisaabtan. Tabasho waxay u baahan kartaa caddaalad; balse marna qof gaar ah ma siinayso awood uu ku noqdo garsoore, xeerbeegti iyo fuliyaha xukunka dilka. Maxaan ka baranaynaa dilkan arxandarrada ah? Marka kowaad, dalku wuxuu u baahanyahay dhaqan xooggan oo ku dhisan muwaadinnimo loo siman yahay. Soomaali kasta waa inuu awood u yeeshaa inuu meel kasta oo dalka ka mid ah ku safro, ka shaqeeyo, wax ku barto oo ugu adeego dalkiisa isaga oo aan qarin aqoonsigiisa qabiil cabsi uu ka qabo darteed. Tani waxay u baahan tahay wacyigelin dadweyne, wadahadal bulsho iyo hoggaan siyaasadeed oo si joogto ah u diida hadallada xanbaarsan eedda wadareed ee qabyaaladaysan. Marka labaad, hay’adaha amniga qaranku waa inay si dhab ah u noqdaan kuwo qaran. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo hay’adaha kale ee amnigu waxay u baahanyihiin heerar xirfadeed, silsilado amar oo la isku halayn karo, habraacyo ammaan ah oo lagu safri karo iyo hannaan lagu ilaaliyo shaqaalaha lagu beegsanayo qabiil awgiis. Askari qaran waa inuu dareemaa in dawladdu garab taagan tahay, iyada oo aan loo eegin nasabkiisa. Marka saddexaad, bulshooyinku waa inay kala saaraan dibuheshiisiin iyo islaxisaabtan-la’aan. Joojinta colaadda qabiilku macnaheedu ma aha in dhibbanayaasha la illoobo. Sidoo kale, macnaheedu ma aha in qoys kasta loo oggolaado inuu raaco nooca uu isagu u yaqaan caddaalad. Dibuheshiisiin waarta waxay u baahan tahay run, islaxisaabtan, magdhaw marka ay habboon tahay, cafis marka si xor ah uu ku yimaado, iyo dammaanadqaadaysa inaan rabshad hore loo xaliyay aanan dib loo soo celin. Marka afaraad, hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya waa inuu joojiyo inuu rabshadaha qabiilka u arko sifo aan laga maarmi karin oo nolosha Soomaaliyeed ka mid ah. Waa la fahmi karaa in qaabdhismeedyada qabiilku weli awood ay bulshada ku dhex leeyihiin. Laakiin, bisaylka siyaasadeed wuxuu u baahan yahay in qaabdhismeedyadaas loo beddelo kuwo taageera wadanoolaansho nabadeed, halkii ay go’aamin lahaayeen cidda mudan ilaalinta iyo cidda la dili karo. Marka shanaad, odayaasha degaanka iyo culimada diintu waxay leeyihiin masuuliyad muhiim ah. Waxay xoojin karaan silsiladaha aargoosiga ama waxay noqon karaan xoogag awood leh oo xakameeya. Marka nin dhallinyaro ah loo joojiyo qabiilkiisa awgiis, faragelinta ugu horraysa waa inay noqotaa: “Waa bani’aadan, waa muwaaddin Soomaaliyeed, wax dembi ahna ma uusan gelin.” Mabda’aas waa inuu ka xoog bato dareenka aargoosiga iyo uurgummaarka raagay. Ugu danbayn, Soomaali kasta waa inuu isweydiiyaa su’aalo aad u xanuun badan: Dal noocee ah ayaynu isku dayaynaa inaan dhisno? Ma dhisaynaa Soomaaliya uu qof ku badbaado sababtoo ah waa muwaadin, mise Soomaaliya ay badbaadadiisu ku xiran tahay qabiilkiisa? Ma dhisaynaa ciidan matala qaranka, mise waxaan keliya darees qaran u gelinaynaa shaqsiyaad weli u nugul rabshadaha qabiilka? Ma dhisaynaa nidaam caddaaladeed, mise caddaaladda waxaan u daynaynaa cidda maamusha waddooyinka la isaga gudbo? Oo ma ilaalinaynaa dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed, mise waxaan u oggolaanaynaa qaababka ugu xun ee aargoosiga qabiilku inay burburiyaan qiyamka qaraabanimada, martisoorka, karaamada iyo naxariista ay Soomaalidu si sax ah ugu faanto? Baryadii ugu danbaysay ee askariga laga soo xigtay waxay ahayd in uu ku halaanhalay gaajo, denbi-la’aan iyo xanuun uu dareemayo, dhabtiina dhammaantood waa arrimo danqasho leh. Ma ahayn dood siyaasadeed. Waxay ahaayeen ereyo bani’aadantinimo ku qotama. Adeegsigiisa ereyga “abti” ma ahayn difaac sharciyeed oo uu cuskanayay; wuxuu ahaa codsi ku wajahan xiriir ehelnimo oo ay ahayd inuu keeno naxariis iyo u danqasho dhalasho. Taasi waa sababta sheekadani aysan u noqon karin dhacdo kale oo murugo leh oo dhowr maalmood la xasuusto dabadeedna lagu aaso dhibaatada xigta. Haddii Soomaaliya ay dhab ka tahay dibudhiska nidaamka dawladnimo, dhacdooyinka noocan ahi waa inay noqdaan xisaabtan akhlaaqeed oo qaran. Dalku wuxuu u baahanyahay hay’ado ka hortagi kara dilalka aan sharciga ahayn, bulsho diidda ciqaabta wadareed, hoggaamiyayaal si aan leexleexasho lahayn u canbaareeya, ugana dhiidhiya aargoosiga, iyo muwaadiniin fahansan in qabiilna uusan ka weynayn nolosha bani’aadanka. Imtixaanka ugu danbeeya ee dhismaha dawladnimadu ma aha in dawladdu ku hadli karto magaca qaranka. Waa in qof kasta oo Soomaali ah oo caadi ahi rumaysan karo in qaranku ilaalin doono naftiisa, sharaftiisa iyo hantidiisaba. Soomaaliya oo askariga qaranka lagu dili karo oo keliya inuu ka tirsan yahay qabiil gaar ah weli ma aha Soomaaliya ballanqaadayso dhismaha dawladnimada bulshadu u baahan tahay. Hawsha ina hor taalla sidaas darteed ma aha oo keliya inaan dhisno dawlad ka xoog badan qabaailka, balse waa inaan dhisno fahan ka xoog badan oo ku saabsan cidda aynu nahay: marka hore Soomaali, muwaadiniin si siman sharcigu u ilaaliyo, iyo bani’aadan noloshooda aan lagu qiimayn karin qabiil. Dhabtiina, qabiil kastana intaas ayaa deeqda. Waddada dibuheshiisiinta qaranku waxay bilaabataa marka aargoosigu dhammaado. Waxayna ku dhammaataa marka nolosha Soomaali kale ay ka qiimo badnaato tabashada aynu ka qabno qabiilkiisa. WQ: Maxamed Aadan Cabdiraxmaan Khabiir Arrimaha Maamulwanaagga

items.title: Sawirro: Isbitaalka Dalmar oo baaritaano bilaash u sameeyey maxaabiista Xabsiga Dhexe
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Isbitaalka Takhasusiga iyo Tacliimiga ah ee Dalmar, oo kaashanaya hay’adda Al-Nur Foundation ee Soomaaliya iyo Al-Basar International, ayaa booqasho caafimaad ku tagay Xabsiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya, halkaas oo maxaabiista ku jirta loogu fidiyey adeegyo caafimaad oo lacag la’aan ah. Dhakhaatiir iyo kalkaaliyeyaal ka socday Isbitaalka Dalmar ayaa qaar ka mid ah maxaabiista xabsiga ku jirta u sameeyey baaritaanno bilaash ah oo la xiriira aragga indhaha, dhegaha, sanka iyo cunaha. Maxaabiista ka faa’iideystay baaritaannada caafimaad ee loo sameeyey ayaa sheegay inay aad ugu baahnaayeen, iyagoo u mahadceliyey maamulka, dhakhaatiirta iyo hawlwadeennada Isbitaalka Dalmar ee xabsiga ku soo booqday. Guddoomiyaha Guud ee Isbitaalka Dalmar, Prof. Abdirisak Ahmed Dalmar, ayaa sheegay in tallaabadan ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu gaarsiinayo adeegyada caafimaad dadka u baahan, iyadoo la sameynayo baaritaanno caafimaad, wacyigelin iyo daaweyn, si loo aqoonsado baahiyaha caafimaad ee jira loona fududeeyo helitaanka daryeelka ku habboon. “Waxaan aaminsannahay in daryeelka caafimaadku yahay adeeg ay mudan yihiin dhammaan dadka, oo ay ku jiraan maxaabiista xabsiyada ku jirta, waxaana naga go’an inaan ka qaybqaadanno dadaallada lagu gaarsiinayo adeeg caafimaad oo tayo leh bulshada Soomaaliyeed meel kasta oo ay joogaan,” ayuu yiri Prof. Dr Abdirisak Dalmar. Kooxda ka socotay Isbitaalka Dalmar, oo ka koobnayd dhakhaatiir, kalkaaliyeyaal iyo hawlwadeenno, ayaa kulan la qaadatay saraakiisha Ciidanka Asluubta ee gacanta ku haya Xabsiga Dhexe. Waxay ka wada hadleen sidii la isaga kaashan lahaa in daryeel caafimaad loo fidiyo maxaabiista ku jirta xabsiga, iyadoo kulankaas uu ku dhammaaday jawi isfaham. Taliyaha Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, S/Gaas Maxamed Sheekh Xasan Xaamud, oo ka hadlay kulankaas, ayaa uga mahadceliyey, soona dhoweeyey dadaalka maamulka, dhakhaatiirta iyo shaqaalaha Isbitaalka Dalmar, booqashada ay ku yimaadeen xabsiga iyo daryeelka caafimaad ee ay u fidiyeen qaar ka mid ah maxaabiista oo ka cabanayey xanuunno kala duwan. Wuxuu xusay inay diyaar u yihiin fududeynta sidii adeegyo caafimaad loo gaarsiin lahaa dadka ku jira xabsiyada. Isbitaalka Dalmar, oo ah isbitaal ka yimid una yimid bulshada, ayaa had iyo jeer ka qaybqaata sidii adeegyo caafimaad oo bilaash ah loo gaarsiin lahaa qaybaha bulshada, gaar ahaan ardayda iskuullada, maxaabiista iyo dadka kale ee danyarta ah. The post Sawirro: Isbitaalka Dalmar oo baaritaano bilaash u sameeyey maxaabiista Xabsiga Dhexe appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somali Parliament Deals Blow to Hamza’s Civil Service Reform Plan
items.description: 136 MPs Reject Proposal as Dispute Over Senior Government Appointments Deepens Mogadishu (WDN) — In a striking parliamentary setback for Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre, Somalia’s House of the People has rejected a proposal linked to his plan to introduce open competition for senior positions across federal government institutions. The vote marks an unexpected confrontation between the executive and parliament at a politically sensitive moment, with 136 lawmakers voting against the proposal, according to reports of Tuesday’s parliamentary session. The measure concerned the recruitment and appointment of department directors across federal ministries and government agencies. Hamza’s government has presented the initiative as part of a broader civil-service reform aimed at making appointments more dependent on qualifications, experience, competence and merit. The Prime Minister had ordered the first phase of the reform to begin on September 20, with the Civil Service Commission overseeing the process. The government said the reform was intended to give qualified civil servants an equal opportunity to compete for senior administrative positions. Many are questioning why the current administration has chosen to propose these reforms only now, when its constitutional term has already expired? The obvious questions are: Why now, and why not during the past four years, when the government had ample time not only to initiate such reforms but, more importantly, to implement them? The timing inevitably raises questions about the government’s motives, priorities, and commitment to meaningful reform. An Unexpected Parliamentary Reversal What made Tuesday’s development particularly striking was the scale of parliamentary opposition. Rather than securing approval for the government’s proposal, the administration faced a clear majority of MPs rejecting the measure. The vote effectively halted the parliamentary initiative in its proposed form and exposed a significant disagreement over how senior positions in the federal civil service should be filled. The development comes after the Prime Minister publicly instructed ministries and government agencies to implement the new competitive recruitment system. Government officials have argued that the reform would strengthen professionalism and accountability within the civil service. Critics in parliament, however, have questioned the legal basis and implementation of the proposed system, according to reports surrounding the vote. Auditor General Also Raises Objections The parliamentary challenge was preceded by objections from Somalia’s Office of the Auditor General. Reports published Wednesday said the Auditor General opposed applying the open-competition system to the office, arguing that doing so could conflict with its constitutional independence. That objection added another layer to an increasingly visible institutional dispute over the Prime Minister’s civil-service initiative. The government’s position is that the recruitment reform rests on existing laws, regulations and institutional frameworks governing the federal civil service. The sequence of events has now raised a larger political question: is the disagreement over civil-service recruitment becoming a broader confrontation between Somalia’s executive institutions and parliament? The parliamentary rejection does not, by itself, establish a wider political rupture between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Prime Minister Hamza. Nor does the vote demonstrate that the President personally supported or opposed the parliamentary position. However, the episode has exposed an important institutional fault line. The Prime Minister has argued that senior government positions should increasingly be filled through transparent competition and professional criteria. Parliament’s rejection of the proposal, meanwhile, demonstrates that there is significant resistance to the way the reform is being pursued. Political Calculations Enter the Debate The dispute has inevitably attracted political interpretation because senior government appointments are highly consequential in Somalia’s political system. Opposition lawmakers who have long challenged policies associated with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Prime Minister Hamza may have found common ground with some government-aligned MPs in rejecting the measure. Whether that cooperation reflects a temporary parliamentary coalition or signals a deeper realignment remains unclear. Equally significant is the question of the President’s position. There is currently no sufficient evidence to conclude from the parliamentary vote alone whether Hassan Sheikh supports Hamza’s proposal, opposes it, or has sought to remain outside the dispute. For now, what is clear is that a major government reform announced only days ago has encountered a formidable parliamentary obstacle. And the surprise is not simply that MPs rejected the proposal — it is that 136 lawmakers were prepared to do so, turning a civil-service reform initiative into a highly visible test of the balance between Somalia’s executive and legislative institutions. items.title: Eritrean Opposition Builds Global Network as Israeli Connection Raises Questions Over Its Real Influence
items.description: Brigade N’Hamedu Organizes Abroad as Opposition Figures Seek to Challenge Isaias Afwerki TEL AVIV (WDN) — An Eritrean opposition movement is building an increasingly organized political network across several countries, including Israel, the United States, Canada and Europe, in an effort to unite Eritreans in the diaspora and prepare for a possible political transition in Eritrea. According to a report by Haaretz , Brigade N’Hamedu has established a 51-member international council following elections held among Eritrean communities in different countries. The movement says its objective is to bring together Eritreans abroad and develop a political structure capable of replacing the government of President Isaias Afwerki. The scale of the organization is notable. Its supporters are reportedly active in Israel, the United States, Canada, Sweden, Germany and Ethiopia, while its leaders say they maintain contacts with people inside Eritrea. Those claims of an internal network, however, have not been independently verified. An Opposition Movement Takes Shape The reported creation of the 51-member council represents an effort to move beyond scattered diaspora activism and establish a more coordinated political organization. The movement says it wants to build a democratic political system to replace the existing government and has been conducting diplomatic outreach, particularly in the United States. Ethiopia has also emerged as an important base for some of the movement’s activities, according to reports. That development is politically significant given the complicated relationship between Addis Ababa and Asmara. The movement has also developed a visible presence in Israel. Eritrean opposition supporters there recently participated in the selection of representatives to the international council. The Israeli connection may attract attention, but it should not automatically be interpreted as evidence of decisive external backing. Israel and Eritrea established diplomatic relations in 1993, and Israel’s Foreign Ministry continues to list Eritrea among the countries with which it has diplomatic relations. Israel has been a UN member since 1949. At the same time, Israel’s role in the Horn of Africa operates within a highly contested regional and international environment. Any assumption that an opposition movement’s presence in Israel necessarily translates into meaningful Israeli state support would therefore require evidence of an official government policy, financial assistance, military cooperation or diplomatic commitment. No such Israeli government commitment is established by the information currently available. This distinction matters. A movement can have members, offices, meetings or political activities inside Israel without those activities representing the policy of the Israeli government. A Network with Serious Controversies Brigade N’Hamedu is also a controversial organization. The movement has faced allegations concerning violent confrontations involving Eritrean diaspora communities in several countries. In Germany, members have faced scrutiny in connection with, clashes and alleged unlawful activities, although the precise responsibility of the organization for individual incidents has been disputed and should not be assumed from the allegations alone. The group’s supporters portray their campaign as a struggle for political change and democratic reform in Eritrea. Critics have accused elements associated with the movement of using confrontational tactics against supporters of the Eritrean government. These competing portrayals make the movement’s emergence particularly sensitive for Eritrean communities abroad. The Bigger Question Is Inside Eritrea Ultimately, the most important test for Brigade N’Hamedu may not be how many supporters it can mobilize overseas, but whether it can establish meaningful political influence among Eritreans inside the country. The movement says it has contacts inside Eritrea and is preparing for eventual political change. Those claims remain difficult to independently verify. For now, what is emerging is an increasingly structured opposition network operating across multiple countries and seeking to transform diaspora activism into a coordinated political force. The Israeli connection may provide the movement with a visible international platform, but a presence in Israel should not be confused with demonstrated Israeli state backing. The real question is whether Brigade N’Hamedu can turn its growing international organization into a credible political force capable of influencing Eritrea’s future. For a movement seeking to challenge one of Africa’s longest-serving governments, that will ultimately matter far more than where its overseas meetings are held. items.description: TAIPEI | Taiwan’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, Lin Chia-lung, received Somaliland’s Minister of Interior, Abdalle Mohamed Arab, and a delegation led by him during a meeting focused on strengthening bilateral relations and expanding cooperation between the two sides. The Somaliland delegation included the Director General of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Mohamed Abdirahman Hassan, and the Commander of the Somaliland Fire Brigade, Brigadier General Ahmed Mohamed Hassan “Sawaaxili.” The meeting focused on consolidating the longstanding and deepening relationship between Somaliland and Taiwan, as well as strengthening bilateral cooperation, which has continued to expand in recent years and increasingly developed into practical cooperation benefiting both sides. The two sides also discussed mechanisms for strengthening institutional links between their respective government agencies in order to create a stronger framework for cooperation and coordination. The discussions further covered ways to deepen diplomatic engagement and advance areas of mutual interest between Somaliland and Taiwan. The meeting reflects the continued development of relations between Somaliland and Taiwan, with both sides seeking to expand institutional cooperation and strengthen their diplomatic engagement.

items.title: Booliiska Soomaaliyeed oo Dib-u-eegis Ku Sameeyey Qorshayaasha Howlgallada Amniga
items.description: Muqdisho, 24 Sebteembar 2026 – Taliyaha Ciidanka Boliiska Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa shir guddoomiyey kulanka hoggaannada, qaybaha iyo fadhiyada madaxa-bannaan ee Ciidanka Boliiska Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray howlgallada amniga, iyadoo saraakiisha amniga ee loo xilsaaray ay kulanka ka jeediyeen warbixinno ku saabsan xaaladda amniga iyo howlaha socda. Sidoo kale, kulanka ayaa dib loogu eegay sida loo fuliyey qodobadii iyo go’aamadii kasoo baxay kulankii toddobaadkii hore, iyadoo la qiimeeyey horumarka laga sameeyey howlaha loo xilsaaray hoggaannada iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee Ciidanka Boliiska Soomaaliyeed. Taliyaha ayaa kulanka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay isku-duwidda howlaha amniga iyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee Booliiska.

items.title: Farmaajo oo warqad furan u diray Xasan, xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahayso…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Cabdullahi Maxamed (Farmaajo) oo warqad furan u diray Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa kaga hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo caqabadaha ka taagan gudaha dalka, xilli lagu jiro marxalad adag oo xasaasi ah. Farmaajo ayaa qoraalkiisa ku muujiyay baahida loo qabo in madaxda Soomaaliyeed ay wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad siyaasadeed u maraan xalinta khilaafaadka taagan , wuxuuna Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu baaqay in la raadiyo waddo siyaasadeed oo dalka looga gudbiyo xaaladda cakiran. Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo jeediyay talooyin saddex qodob ah oo ku aaddan raadinta xal looga gudbi karo arrimaha taagan ee masiiriga ah, isagoo Madaxweynaha ka dalbaday inuu hormuud ka noqdo wada-xaajood qaran oo ku dhisan tanaasul, si loo gaaro heshiis loo dhanyahay. Madaxweynihii hore ayaa sidoo kale soo hadal qaaday warqadaha ay Puntland iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka u direen Golaha Ammaanka, isagoo sheegay inay muujinayaan heerka uu gaarsiisan yahay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan gudaha dalka Soomaaliya. Hoos ka akhriso warqadda furan ee Farmaajo . Ku: Madaxweynaha Muddo Xileedkiisu Dhammaaday ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud September 24, 2026 Muqdisho, Soomaaliya Mudane madaxweyne, waxaan halkan kuugu soo gudbinayaa salaan qiimo weyn, aniga oo kuu rajaynayaa inaad caafimaad qabto. Warqaddan furan waxaan kuugu soo dirayaa kaalintayda muwaadinnimo, Madaxweynihii 9aad ee xilka kugu wareejiyey iyo hoggaamiyaha Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolal (N&N). Warqaddan furan waxaa igu kalifay in aan kuu soo diro xilligan uu dalkeennu marayo marxalad xaasaasi ah, marka laga eego dhinacyada amniga, siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha, duruufaha bulsho iyo guud ahaan saamaynta baaxadda leh ee ay nagu yeelatay loolanka juquraafi siyaasadeedka caalamiga ah oo halis weyn ku noqday midnimada iyo wadajirka dalka, sidaas darteed ayay lagama maarmaan iigu noqotay inaan si furan kuula wadaago in dalku samatabixin u baahan yahay, taas oo mas’uuliyaddeeda koowaad adiga kugu dhacayso. Sida aan la socdo, xilligan waxaad ku sugan tahay xarunta Qaramada Midoobey oo aad uga qayb galaysid kulanka Jimciyadda Guud ee Qaramada Midoobey iyo dabcan kulan doceedyo gaar ah oo muhiim u ah Soomaaliya. Maxfalka noocaas ah indhaha Beesha Caalamku waa furan yihiin, si wayna waxa ay ula socdaan waxa dalkeena ka jira iyo caqabadaha siyaasaddeed, amni iyo dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya wajahayso, waxaana aaminsanahay in sharafkaaga iyo midka ummadda Soomaaliyeedba ay ku jiri lahayd inaad kulan caynkaas ah ka qayb gasho, iyada oo uu kaa horreeyo war wanaagsan oo kor u qaadi karay sumcadda Qarankeenna. Waxaa nasiib darradaas tusaale iyo xaqiiq aan la inkiri karin u ah warqadaha ay kala qoreen Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland iyo Madasha Mustaqbalka, ayna u direen Xoghaya Guud ee Qaramada Midoobey iyo Golaha Ammaanka oo ah warqado dhiillo culus xambaarsan, muujinayana heerka aad gaarsiisay khilaafaadka iyo kala irdhowga soo dhexgalay ummadda Soomaaliyeed, muddadii afarta sano ahayd ee xilka laguu doortay. Sida aad la socoto dalkeenna wixii ka dambeeyey shirarkii dib-u-heshiisiinta qaran ee dib loogu soo celiyey hay’addaha qaranka, waxaa isku haynta dalka iyo dadka Soomaaliyeed aas-aas u ahaa afar tiir oo lagu ilaalinayey wadajirka dalka, si aan markale siyaasaddu u horseedin dowlad la’aan iyo kala tag dambe, waxa ayna afartaas tiir kala yihiin. 1.⁠ ⁠Hirgalinta iyo Ilaalinta dastuur si buuxda heshiis loogu yahay. 2. Hirgalinta iyo dhammeystirka hannaanka federaalka ee lagu heshiiyey. 3.⁠ ⁠Doorashooyin xilligooda ku dhaca iyo siyaasad loo dhan yahay. 4.⁠ ⁠Wadahadallada, tanaasulka iyo heshiis siyaasadeed oo ahaa jidka wax xallinta. Iyada oo aan maanka ku hayno in muddadii sharciga ahayd ee xafiiska laguu doortay dhammaatay, haddana waxaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo dib u dhiska qaranka dib u dhac weyn ku ah in maanta uusan jirin dastuur heshiis lagu yahay, dalkuna leeyahay labo dastuur, hannaankii federaalka oo wiiqmay, horena aad uga gaabisay wadahadalladii Somaliland, hadana ay qaar ka mid ah dowlad goboleedyadii dalku qarka u saaranyihiin in ay dalka ka go’ayaan iyo in aan wali lahayn hannaan doorasho oo heshiis lagu yahay, taas oo dalka galisay jahwareer siyaasadeed oo horseedi kara burbur. Sida ay khibradda iyo dhacdooyinkii siyaasaddeed ee dalkan soo maray muddooyinkii qaran burburka lagu jirey ay na barayaan in wadada kaliya ee Soomaaliya mashaakilkeeda siyaasaddeed lagu xallin jirey ay ahayd wada-hadal iyo siyaasad loo dhan yahay, jidkaas oo ahaa hab looga badbaaday dib u dhac badan oo dalkeennu la kulmi lahaa, sidaas darteed inaad meesha ka saarto hannaanka wada xaajood ee ku dhisnaa isku tanaasul iyo siyaasad loo dhan yahay, waxa ay muujinaysaa in xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalku sii adkaanayso, ayna ka dhalan karaan natiijooyin aan dalka u wanaagsanayn, adigana aan taariikhdaada madaxweynenimo boos wanaagsan dhigayn. Anniga oo maanka ku haya in wali dalka ay ka jirto khatarta Alshabaab, mustaqabalka Ciidamada Midowga Africa oo aan cadeyn, khilaafaadka baaxada leh ee siyaasadda gudaha ka jira, isbadalladda waaweyn ee siyaasadda aduunka ka taagan iyo duruufaha dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee dadkeenna haysta, waxa ay illa tahay inay kula gudboon tahay inaad qaaddo tillaabooyin siyaasadeed oo dhiirrasho iyo tanaasul ku dhisan, si dalkeenna looga badbaadiyo kala tag iyo dhaawac soo gaara midnimadiisa iyo wadajirkiisa, adiguna aad u gudato waajibka dastuuriga ah ee kaa saaran ilaalinta midnimada iyo isku haynta dalka. Sidaas darteed, waxa aan kuusoo jeedinayaa talooyin kooban oo aan u arko inay muhiim u yihiin raadinta xal looga gudbi karo arrimaha taagan ee masiiriga ah. 1. ⁠Si looga baaqsado fargalin shisheeye iyo go’aanno aan Soomaalida ka imaan waa inaad hormuud u noqotaa wada xaajood qaran oo ku dhisan tanaasul dhab ah oo keeni kara xal looga gudbo ismari-waaga jira. 2. ⁠Heshiis siyaasadeed oo laga gaaro arrimaha doorashooyinka waxa ay saldhig u yihiin sii socoshada dowlad sharciyad ku dhisan iyo qabsoomidda doorasho la isla oggol yahay oo dalka ka saarta hubinti la’aanta. Sidaas darteed, waa lagama maarmaan heshiis laga gaaro doorashooyinka, si looga badbaado khilaafaad keeni kara natiijooyin aan fiicneyn. 3.⁠ ⁠Waxaa lagama maarmaan ah in muddo kooban gudaheed ay qabsoonto doorasho loo dhan yahay, dalkana laga samata bixiyo marxaladdan jaahwareerka ah ee ay xukunka iska joogaan hay’ado sharciyaddii ka dhammaatay, taas oo halis ku ah jiritaanka qaranka iyo dowladnimadda ba. Eebbe dalka ha inoo dhowro, dowladnimadeenna ha xoojiyo, dadkeennana boggooda burcad ha ha isu mariyo. Dhamaad. items.fullContent: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Cabdullahi Maxamed (Farmaajo) oo warqad furan u diray Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa kaga hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo caqabadaha ka taagan gudaha dalka, xilli lagu jiro marxalad adag oo xasaasi ah. Farmaajo ayaa qoraalkiisa ku muujiyay baahida loo qabo in madaxda Soomaaliyeed ay wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad siyaasadeed u maraan xalinta khilaafaadka taagan , wuxuuna Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu baaqay in la raadiyo waddo siyaasadeed oo dalka looga gudbiyo xaaladda cakiran. Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo jeediyay talooyin saddex qodob ah oo ku aaddan raadinta xal looga gudbi karo arrimaha taagan ee masiiriga ah, isagoo Madaxweynaha ka dalbaday inuu hormuud ka noqdo wada-xaajood qaran oo ku dhisan tanaasul, si loo gaaro heshiis loo dhanyahay. Madaxweynihii hore ayaa sidoo kale soo hadal qaaday warqadaha ay Puntland iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka u direen Golaha Ammaanka, isagoo sheegay inay muujinayaan heerka uu gaarsiisan yahay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan gudaha dalka Soomaaliya. Hoos ka akhriso warqadda furan ee Farmaajo . Ku: Madaxweynaha Muddo Xileedkiisu Dhammaaday ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud September 24, 2026 Muqdisho, Soomaaliya Mudane madaxweyne, waxaan halkan kuugu soo gudbinayaa salaan qiimo weyn, aniga oo kuu rajaynayaa inaad caafimaad qabto. Warqaddan furan waxaan kuugu soo dirayaa kaalintayda muwaadinnimo, Madaxweynihii 9aad ee xilka kugu wareejiyey iyo hoggaamiyaha Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolal (N&N). Warqaddan furan waxaa igu kalifay in aan kuu soo diro xilligan uu dalkeennu marayo marxalad xaasaasi ah, marka laga eego dhinacyada amniga, siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha, duruufaha bulsho iyo guud ahaan saamaynta baaxadda leh ee ay nagu yeelatay loolanka juquraafi siyaasadeedka caalamiga ah oo halis weyn ku noqday midnimada iyo wadajirka dalka, sidaas darteed ayay lagama maarmaan iigu noqotay inaan si furan kuula wadaago in dalku samatabixin u baahan yahay, taas oo mas’uuliyaddeeda koowaad adiga kugu dhacayso. Sida aan la socdo, xilligan waxaad ku sugan tahay xarunta Qaramada Midoobey oo aad uga qayb galaysid kulanka Jimciyadda Guud ee Qaramada Midoobey iyo dabcan kulan doceedyo gaar ah oo muhiim u ah Soomaaliya. Maxfalka noocaas ah indhaha Beesha Caalamku waa furan yihiin, si wayna waxa ay ula socdaan waxa dalkeena ka jira iyo caqabadaha siyaasaddeed, amni iyo dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya wajahayso, waxaana aaminsanahay in sharafkaaga iyo midka ummadda Soomaaliyeedba ay ku jiri lahayd inaad kulan caynkaas ah ka qayb gasho, iyada oo uu kaa horreeyo war wanaagsan oo kor u qaadi karay sumcadda Qarankeenna. Waxaa nasiib darradaas tusaale iyo xaqiiq aan la inkiri karin u ah warqadaha ay kala qoreen Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland iyo Madasha Mustaqbalka, ayna u direen Xoghaya Guud ee Qaramada Midoobey iyo Golaha Ammaanka oo ah warqado dhiillo culus xambaarsan, muujinayana heerka aad gaarsiisay khilaafaadka iyo kala irdhowga soo dhexgalay ummadda Soomaaliyeed, muddadii afarta sano ahayd ee xilka laguu doortay. Sida aad la socoto dalkeenna wixii ka dambeeyey shirarkii dib-u-heshiisiinta qaran ee dib loogu soo celiyey hay’addaha qaranka, waxaa isku haynta dalka iyo dadka Soomaaliyeed aas-aas u ahaa afar tiir oo lagu ilaalinayey wadajirka dalka, si aan markale siyaasaddu u horseedin dowlad la’aan iyo kala tag dambe, waxa ayna afartaas tiir kala yihiin. 1.⁠ ⁠Hirgalinta iyo Ilaalinta dastuur si buuxda heshiis loogu yahay. 2. Hirgalinta iyo dhammeystirka hannaanka federaalka ee lagu heshiiyey. 3.⁠ ⁠Doorashooyin xilligooda ku dhaca iyo siyaasad loo dhan yahay. 4.⁠ ⁠Wadahadallada, tanaasulka iyo heshiis siyaasadeed oo ahaa jidka wax xallinta. Iyada oo aan maanka ku hayno in muddadii sharciga ahayd ee xafiiska laguu doortay dhammaatay, haddana waxaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo dib u dhiska qaranka dib u dhac weyn ku ah in maanta uusan jirin dastuur heshiis lagu yahay, dalkuna leeyahay labo dastuur, hannaankii federaalka oo wiiqmay, horena aad uga gaabisay wadahadalladii Somaliland, hadana ay qaar ka mid ah dowlad goboleedyadii dalku qarka u saaranyihiin in ay dalka ka go’ayaan iyo in aan wali lahayn hannaan doorasho oo heshiis lagu yahay, taas oo dalka galisay jahwareer siyaasadeed oo horseedi kara burbur. Sida ay khibradda iyo dhacdooyinkii siyaasaddeed ee dalkan soo maray muddooyinkii qaran burburka lagu jirey ay na barayaan in wadada kaliya ee Soomaaliya mashaakilkeeda siyaasaddeed lagu xallin jirey ay ahayd wada-hadal iyo siyaasad loo dhan yahay, jidkaas oo ahaa hab looga badbaaday dib u dhac badan oo dalkeennu la kulmi lahaa, sidaas darteed inaad meesha ka saarto hannaanka wada xaajood ee ku dhisnaa isku tanaasul iyo siyaasad loo dhan yahay, waxa ay muujinaysaa in xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalku sii adkaanayso, ayna ka dhalan karaan natiijooyin aan dalka u wanaagsanayn, adigana aan taariikhdaada madaxweynenimo boos wanaagsan dhigayn. Anniga oo maanka ku haya in wali dalka ay ka jirto khatarta Alshabaab, mustaqabalka Ciidamada Midowga Africa oo aan cadeyn, khilaafaadka baaxada leh ee siyaasadda gudaha ka jira, isbadalladda waaweyn ee siyaasadda aduunka ka taagan iyo duruufaha dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee dadkeenna haysta, waxa ay illa tahay inay kula gudboon tahay inaad qaaddo tillaabooyin siyaasadeed oo dhiirrasho iyo tanaasul ku dhisan, si dalkeenna looga badbaadiyo kala tag iyo dhaawac soo gaara midnimadiisa iyo wadajirkiisa, adiguna aad u gudato waajibka dastuuriga ah ee kaa saaran ilaalinta midnimada iyo isku haynta dalka. Sidaas darteed, waxa aan kuusoo jeedinayaa talooyin kooban oo aan u arko inay muhiim u yihiin raadinta xal looga gudbi karo arrimaha taagan ee masiiriga ah. 1. ⁠Si looga baaqsado fargalin shisheeye iyo go’aanno aan Soomaalida ka imaan waa inaad hormuud u noqotaa wada xaajood qaran oo ku dhisan tanaasul dhab ah oo keeni kara xal looga gudbo ismari-waaga jira. 2. ⁠Heshiis siyaasadeed oo laga gaaro arrimaha doorashooyinka waxa ay saldhig u yihiin sii socoshada dowlad sharciyad ku dhisan iyo qabsoomidda doorasho la isla oggol yahay oo dalka ka saarta hubinti la’aanta. Sidaas darteed, waa lagama maarmaan heshiis laga gaaro doorashooyinka, si looga badbaado khilaafaad keeni kara natiijooyin aan fiicneyn. 3.⁠ ⁠Waxaa lagama maarmaan ah in muddo kooban gudaheed ay qabsoonto doorasho loo dhan yahay, dalkana laga samata bixiyo marxaladdan jaahwareerka ah ee ay xukunka iska joogaan hay’ado sharciyaddii ka dhammaatay, taas oo halis ku ah jiritaanka qaranka iyo dowladnimadda ba. Eebbe dalka ha inoo dhowro, dowladnimadeenna ha xoojiyo, dadkeennana boggooda burcad ha ha isu mariyo. Dhamaad. items.title: Farmaajo oo Xasan Sheekh U Baaqay Wada-hadal
items.description: Farmaajo oo Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay wada-hadal iyo heshiis doorasho Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya Maxamed Cabdullaahi Maxamed (Farmaajo) ayaa warqad furan u diray Madaxweynaha Federaalka Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isagoo ku baaqay wada-hadal siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay iyo heshiis laga gaaro hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka. Warqadda oo ku taariikhaysan 24-ka Sebtembar 2026, Farmaajo wuxuu kaga hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed, amni, dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in khilaafaadka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada ay u baahan yihiin xal siyaasadeed. Farmaajo, oo sidoo kale ah hoggaamiyaha Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol (N&N), wuxuu warqadda ku sheegay inuu Xasan Sheekh ugu diray xilli madaxweynuhu ku sugan yahay xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ee New York, halkaas oo uu uga qaybgalayo shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo kulamo kale. Farmaajo oo dhaliilay xaaladda siyaasadeed Warqadda, Farmaajo wuxuu ku dhaliilay dowladda federaalka sida ay u maareysay arrimaha dastuurka, federaalka iyo doorashooyinka.Wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay wajahdo khilaaf siyaasadeed oo salka ku haya dastuurka, xiriirka dowladda dhexe iyo dowlad-goboleedyada iyo hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka. Farmaajo wuxuu sidoo kale soo hadal qaaday warqado ay Puntland iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka u direen Qaramada Midoobay iyo Golaha Ammaanka, isagoo sheegay in qoraalladaasi ay muujinayaan heerka uu gaarsiisan yahay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Warqadda Puntland ee 13-kii Sebtembar ayaa dhab ahaantii Qaramada Midoobay looga gudbiyay walaacyo la xiriira siyaasadda, amniga, nidaamka federaalka iyo doorashooyinka Soomaaliya. Puntland waxay sidoo kale dalbatay in Golaha Ammaanka uu taageero wada-hadal siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay.Dhanka kale, Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa sidoo kale Qaramada Midoobay u gudbiyay walaacyo ku saabsan xaaladda dastuurka, doorashooyinka iyo khilaafaadka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada. Talooyinka uu Farmaajo soo jeediyay Farmaajo wuxuu Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay inuu hormuud ka noqdo wada-hadal qaran oo ku dhisan tanaasul iyo heshiis siyaasadeed. Wuxuu sidoo kale ku baaqay in dhinacyada Soomaalida ay heshiis ka gaaraan hannaanka doorashooyinka, isagoo ku dooday in heshiis noocaas ahi muhiim u yahay in dalka laga saaro hubanti la’aanta siyaasadeed. Qodobka saddexaad ee talooyinkiisa wuxuu ahaa in muddo kooban lagu qabto doorasho loo dhan yahay, si dalka looga gudbiyo waxa uu ku tilmaamay jahawareer siyaasadeed.Farmaajo wuxuu sidoo kale warqadda ku xusay khatarta Al-Shabaab, mustaqbalka howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya iyo saameynta isbeddellada siyaasadeed ee caalamka, isagoo sheegay in arrimahaasi ay u baahan yihiin tallaabooyin siyaasadeed oo ku dhisan wada-hadal iyo tanaasul. Khilaafka dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay si gaar ah ugu xooganaa wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka iyo qaabka loo qabanayo doorashooyinka. Warbixin ay soo saartay Security Council Report ayaa hore u diiwaangelisay in mucaaradka, oo ay ku jiraan Farmaajo iyo madaxweynihii hore Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed, ay ka horyimaadeen wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka, iyagoo walaac ka muujiyay in aan heshiis siyaasadeed oo ballaaran laga gaarin.Sidoo kale, warbixin Qaramada Midoobay ah ayaa sheegtay in wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka ay taageereen xubno ka tirsan labada aqal ee Baarlamaanka, balse ay mucaaradku ka hor yimaadeen, taas oo muujinaysa in arrinta dastuurka ay weli tahay mid siyaasadda Soomaaliya si weyn ugu kala qaybinaysa dhinacyada. Warqadda Farmaajo waxay sidaas darteed kusoo beegmaysaa xilli khilaafka siyaasadeed uu weli ka taagan yahay dowladda federaalka, Puntland, Jubaland iyo kooxaha mucaaradka ah.Farmaajo ayaa ugu dambeyn Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay inuu qaado tallaabooyin siyaasadeed oo lagu ilaalinayo midnimada iyo wadajirka Soomaaliya, isagoo ku adkeystay in wada-hadal iyo tanaasul loo baahan yahay si looga gudbo khilaafaadka taagan. The post Farmaajo oo Xasan Sheekh U Baaqay Wada-hadal first appeared on Radio Dalsan .
