items.title: Somalia dispute drives Uganda-Turkey defence rupture: report
items.description: Kampala (Somalia Today) — Uganda’s decision to suspend military cooperation with Turkey is linked to tensions over Kampala’s long-running troop presence in Somalia and Ankara’s expanding role in the country’s security sector, according to sources familiar with the dispute. Middle East Eye reported on Monday that the row over Ugandan government critic Fred Lumbuye, who lives in Turkey, had become the public face of a broader disagreement over Somalia and the future of Uganda’s military deployment there. Sources cited by the publication said Somalia had asked Uganda to end its military presence, pointing to the growing capabilities of Somali forces trained and equipped with Turkish support. Neither Mogadishu nor Kampala has publicly confirmed the reported request “The whole episode is connected to the Ugandan army’s presence in Somalia,” one source familiar with the dispute told Middle East Eye. Uganda has about 4,500 soldiers serving with the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia, or AUSSOM, and roughly 2,000 more under a separate bilateral arrangement with Mogadishu, according to figures previously reported by Somalia Today . The Uganda Peoples’ Defence Forces announced on Saturday that it had suspended all defence and military cooperation with Turkey with immediate effect. Army spokesman Colonel Chris Magezi said the measure would remain in force until “outstanding issues of mutual defence and military cooperation” were resolved, but the UPDF did not publicly identify Somalia as the cause. Somalia at centre Uganda has been a key pillar of the African Union’s military operations in Somalia since becoming the first country to deploy troops under the AU mission in March 2007. Its forces currently lead AUSSOM’s Sector One, covering Mogadishu and parts of Lower Shabelle, both of which remain central to operations against Al-Shabaab. Turkey, meanwhile, has emerged as one of Somalia’s most important defence partners, training thousands of soldiers, supplying military equipment and helping develop specialised Somali units. Its military presence is centred on the TURKSOM training facility in Mogadishu, while Turkish-supplied drones have become increasingly important in government operations against Al-Shabaab. The partnership continues to deepen. On Monday, the same day Middle East Eye published its report, Somali Defence Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi met a Turkish military delegation led by TURKSOM commander Major General Sabahattin Kalkan. Somalia’s Defence Ministry said the talks focused on strengthening defence cooperation, training Somali troops and improving the armed forces’ capabilities. Fiqi thanked Turkey for its continued support in rebuilding Somalia’s military. Turkey’s parliament also voted in July to extend the deployment of Turkish forces in Somalia for another two years, until July 2028. Middle East Eye said sources familiar with the Uganda-Turkey dispute believed those growing Somali capabilities had reduced Mogadishu’s dependence on Ugandan forces. The publication said Uganda could lose millions of dollars annually if its deployments ended, citing sources who estimated the financial impact at between $60 million and $72 million a year. Uganda, Somalia or the African Union have not publicly confirmed those figures. Gradual transition Somalia’s government has publicly called for national forces to assume greater responsibility for security, although it has not issued a specific demand that Ugandan troops leave. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud said in August that the time was approaching for Somalia to thank foreign troops and take responsibility for defending the country itself. “The world and our friends have helped us, but our time has come — the time for us to take responsibility,” Mohamud said at a military graduation ceremony. “The time has also come for us to give the forces who are in our country beautiful flowers and say to them, ‘Brothers, thank you.’” Hussein Abdirzak, a Mogadishu-based analyst, told Somalia Today that Somali forces were better prepared for a gradual reduction in international security support than in previous years. “I think what the Somali government opposes is a rapid withdrawal,” Abdirzak said. “Somalia can now largely stand on its own, and its forces are much stronger than they were before.” He said expanded air capabilities, particularly Turkey’s support for Somali drone operations, had altered the military balance. “The government now has air capabilities and Turkish drones, and that has made a significant difference in the war,” he said. The question of how quickly foreign forces can leave remains unresolved. Al-Shabaab continues to operate across parts of southern and central Somalia, while AUSSOM still supports Somali forces, protects strategic infrastructure and holds positions in areas contested by the militants. Funding crisis The mission is also facing a funding crisis. The United States agreed this month to give the United Nations another year to wind down logistical support for AUSSOM beginning in January 2027. However, Washington still intends to end its backing for the UN Support Office in Somalia, which supplies peacekeepers with food, fuel, medical services and transport. Uganda’s military chief, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, said in August that all Ugandan troops would leave Somalia by August 1, 2027, although the Ugandan government has not publicly adopted his timetable as formal policy. “We are withdrawing completely from Somalia by the 1st of August 2027,” Kainerugaba said. “There will not be UPDF in Somalia after that.” Uganda’s defence minister had previously taken a different position, saying Kampala intended to remain in Somalia under its separate bilateral arrangement even if the structure of the AU mission changed. Lumbuye row The immediate public confrontation with Turkey has centred on Lumbuye, a Ugandan political commentator who has lived in Turkey for years and is wanted by Kampala over allegations including incitement and cyber-related offences. Hundreds of supporters of the Patriotic League of Uganda, a group chaired by Kainerugaba, demonstrated outside the Turkish embassy in Kampala on Friday demanding his extradition. Kainerugaba praised the demonstrators and warned that Turkey would have to meet Uganda’s demands. But Middle East Eye’s sources said the Lumbuye case was not the principal cause of the rupture, describing it instead as part of a wider disagreement over Uganda’s military interests in Somalia and Turkey’s expanding influence there. The dispute has therefore emerged at a sensitive moment for Somalia, as Mogadishu builds stronger national forces while the future size, financing and duration of the African Union mission remains unsettled. items.fullContent: Kampala (Somalia Today) — Uganda’s decision to suspend military cooperation with Turkey is linked to tensions over Kampala’s long-running troop presence in Somalia and Ankara’s expanding role in the country’s security sector, according to sources familiar with the dispute. Middle East Eye reported on Monday that the row over Ugandan government critic Fred Lumbuye, who lives in Turkey, had become the public face of a broader disagreement over Somalia and the future of Uganda’s military deployment there. Sources cited by the publication said Somalia had asked Uganda to end its military presence, pointing to the growing capabilities of Somali forces trained and equipped with Turkish support. Neither Mogadishu nor Kampala has publicly confirmed the reported request “The whole episode is connected to the Ugandan army’s presence in Somalia,” one source familiar with the dispute told Middle East Eye. Uganda has about 4,500 soldiers serving with the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia, or AUSSOM, and roughly 2,000 more under a separate bilateral arrangement with Mogadishu, according to figures previously reported by Somalia Today . items.title: Somali journalists’ Facebook pages hit amid China, Türkiye partnerships
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A coordinated wave of Facebook account suspensions, removals and false death reports struck Somali journalists and independent media outlets over the weekend of Sept. 12–13, according to the Somali Journalists Syndicate (SJS), landing within days of separate Chinese- and Turkish-backed “strategic communications” engagements with the Somali government in Mogadishu. SJS, an independent journalists’ union, said the attacks — which it has continued to track into a second wave reported Sept. 18 — included suspended pages, deleted content, fraudulent copyright claims and cases in which Meta, Facebook’s parent company, marked living journalists as deceased through its memorialization feature. Accounts suspended, journalists ‘memorialized’ Exiled journalist Zakariye Mohamud Timacadde said his Facebook page and personal profile, followed by more than 1 million people, were suspended around midnight on Sunday, Sept. 13, with no notification or explanation from Meta. The page had recently carried his reporting on forced evictions affecting hundreds of thousands of families in Mogadishu and on rising water prices charged by local companies in the capital. It remained unavailable as of the following Monday. Journalist Farah Abdulkadir Mohamed, who has more than 330,000 Facebook followers, told SJS his personal account was memorialized without warning — a feature Meta applies when a user is reported dead. Abdulkadir said he received hundreds of calls and messages from worried relatives after the change appeared, and that he had no way to reassure them because the same page still displayed the death notice. His account was restored the following day, again with no explanation. Gaylan Media, a diaspora-run outlet founded by Abdulkadir with more than 1.2 million Facebook followers and known for coverage of Somali security and political affairs, was removed from the platform the same weekend. A day earlier, on Saturday, Sept. 12, the page of London-based journalist Abdijaliil Osman — who hosts an interview program with roughly 191,000 followers — was also memorialized. “I actually do not have an idea who did this,” Osman told SJS. His page was later restored. Copyright claims used as a takedown tool SJS separately documented a pattern of fraudulent copyright complaints used to strip down critical reporting. Himilo Media, a Mogadishu outlet, said more than a dozen of its reports on local protests against Turkish military involvement in Somalia were hit with copyright claims in a single week; when the outlet disputed the claims, Meta rejected its appeals and the content came down regardless. Reviewing the claims, SJS found accounts filing them — operating under names including “The Odyssey” and “SACEM” — had no discernible online presence despite claiming to be content creators. Posing as a prospective client, an SJS investigator was told by the operator of “The Odyssey” that a fake copyright strike against a media organization would cost $5,000; the same person claimed to do “communication work for the Somali government,” SJS said. Kaab TV and SJS’s own press-freedom team reported similar copyright attacks the same week. Facebook pages tied to Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni and Jubaland’s presidency were also removed in the same period, according to SJS and a follow-up report by Garowe Online. The Turkey and China connection The attacks followed, by about a week, a Chinese-sponsored “Strategic Communications Forum” held in Mogadishu; SJS said sources told it that Chinese entities had separately invited Somali individuals to train and tour in China, including at a facility run by the Chinese Communist Party. On Sept. 12, Somalia’s Ministry of Information announced a Turkish-sponsored Strategic Communications Conference in Mogadishu and said Minister of Information Abdifatah Qasim Mohamud had met with Deniz Demir, coordinator of the Center for Combating Disinformation at the Turkish presidency’s communications directorate, to discuss “strengthening bilateral cooperation in the field of information,” according to a ministry statement on X. Five days earlier, on Sept. 7, Qasim had said publicly that Somalia’s actions against social media accounts carrying what he called terrorist propaganda had risen from 5,000 in 2012 to 82,000 in 2026 — a figure he did not break down or substantiate with an account list. That statement is not confirmed to relate directly to the weekend’s journalist-targeted incidents. Government denies censorship role, but questions remain A former Ministry of Information employee told SJS that journalists’ names and content had been forwarded to the ministry and the National Communications Authority. A former ministry official confirmed to SJS that the department maintains a working relationship with Meta, but said it has been used to help restore wrongly suspended accounts, not to censor media. SJS said there is no independently verified evidence establishing that Somalia’s federal government directed all of the incidents affecting politicians, journalists and media outlets, and Garowe Online separately reported that no evidence has surfaced showing the Turkish government itself removed accounts or filed copyright claims. Meta’s East Africa team did not respond to SJS’s request for comment. Not the first time Similar tactics surfaced in Somalia in late 2024, when local media organizations documented more than 32 Facebook accounts — including those of Puntland’s presidency, ministers and politicians — affected in comparable attacks, some involving fraudulent death documents submitted to trigger memorialization. The account of former Puntland President Abdirahman Mohamed Mohamud Farole, disabled at the time, has still not been restored, Garowe Online reported. Those 2024 cases were never publicly explained in full. Calls for accountability SJS Secretary-General Abdalle Ahmed Mumin said the organization was “extremely concerned” by what he described as a coordinated wave of online attacks, adding that such actions “directly undermine journalists’ ability to communicate with the public, report on issues of public interest and maintain contact with their audiences, families and communities.” SJS is calling on Meta to investigate the incidents, restore wrongly affected accounts and explain what happened, and on Minister Qasim to disclose the scope of the ministry’s partnerships with Chinese and Turkish entities and guarantee they are not used to intimidate journalists. Mumin said Somalia “should not follow in the footsteps of Turkey or China,” citing restrictions on independent media in both countries. The Ministry of Information has not issued a direct public response to SJS’s Sept. 14 findings as of this writing.

items.title: Muxuu Xasan Sheekh kusoo bandhigayaa shirka QM? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo haatan ku sugan dalka Mareykanka ayaa maanta ka qayb-galay furitaanka meertada 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, oo ka socota xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ee magaalada New York. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo hoggaaminayo wafdiga Soomaaliya ayaa madasha golaha guud ku soo bandhigaya horumarka Soomaaliya ka samaysay dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska, dimuqraadiyeynta, amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada. Sidoo kale wuxuu ka hadli doona mudnaanta Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nabadda iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale doonaysa in madashan caalamiga ah lagu muujiyo xaaladaha bani’aadamnimo ee Soomaaliya iyo baahida loo qabo in la kordhiyo taageerada iyo maalgashiga caalamiga ah ee dalka. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa inta uu ku sugan yahay New York ka qayb-galaya kulamada doodaha ah iyo kuwa gaar-gaarka ah ee qabsoomaya, kuwaas oo uu la qaadan doono madaxda iyo saraakiisha sare ee Qaramada Midoobay, dowladda Mareykanka iyo madaxda dalalka kale ee xubnaha ka ah ururka. Safarka Xasan Sheekh ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Soomaaliya ay xubin ka tahay Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay fursaddaas u adeegsanayso sidii ay caalamka ugu soo bandhigi lahayd arrimaha mudnaanta u leh Soomaaliya. Xubinnimada Soomaaliya ee Golaha Ammaanka ayaa sidoo kale sare u qaadaysa muhiimadda safarka madaxweynaha, maadaama Muqdisho ay fursad u haysato inay si toos ah uga qeyb qaadato doodaha iyo go’aannada la xiriira arrimaha amniga iyo nabadda caalamka. Waxaa kale oo ay Dowladda Federaalka doonaysa in ka qeyb-galka shirka Golaha Guud uu noqdo fursad lagu xoojiyo taageerada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo ajandayaasheeda amni, bani’aadamnimo iyo dhaqaale. The post Muxuu Xasan Sheekh kusoo bandhigayaa shirka QM? + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Midowga Yurub oo sheegay in howlgalka Badda Cas uu u baahan yahay in ka badan 10 markab dagaal
items.description: NEW YORK — 22 Sebtembar 2026: Madaxa siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Midowga Yurub, Kaja Kallas, ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka ciidamada badda ee Midowga Yurub ee Aspides uu u baahan yahay in la kordhiyo tirada maraakiibta dagaalka, iyadoo xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas ay sii xumaanayso. Kallas ayaa sheegtay in markii howlgalka la bilaabay 2024 loo qorsheeyay inuu u baahdo ugu yaraan 10 markab dagaal, balse hadda xaaladdu ay ka sii daran tahay. Sida ay sheegtay Reuters, waxaa xilligan goobta ka howlgala qiyaastii lix markab. Howlgalka Aspides waxaa Midowga Yurub bilaabay 2024, ujeeddadiisuna tahay ilaalinta maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Badda Cas, kaddib weerarro ay Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen maraakiibta. Kallas waxay sheegtay in howlgalka uu u baahan yahay maraakiib iyo diyaarado dheeraad ah, si looga jawaabo heerka khatarta ee sii kordhaya. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ay saameynayaan danaha Yurub iyo dhaqaalaha caalamka, gaar ahaan silsiladaha sahayda iyo qiimaha shidaalka. Kallas ayaa 19-kii Sebtembar warqad u dirtay 27-ka dal ee xubnaha ka ah Midowga Yurub, iyadoo ka codsatay inay kordhiyaan taageerada iyo ciidamadooda ay ku biirinayaan howlgalka Aspides. Dhanka kale, Talyaaniga ayaa sheegay inuu diyaarinayo howlgal ciidan-badeed oo u gaar ah oo gobolka ah, isagoo sheegay inuusan sugi karin jawaabta Midowga Yurub xaaladda cusub awgeed. Kallas waxay sidoo kale xustay in horumarrada Xuutiyiintu ka sameeyeen xeebaha Badda Cas ay kordhiyeen awoodda ay ku carqaladeyn karaan maraakiibta ganacsiga, xilli xaaladda marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo Strait of Hormuz ay horeyba u ahayd mid xasaasi ah.

items.title: Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud oo adkeeyay muhiimadda madaxbannaanida hay’adda
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya — Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in dhowrista madaxbannaanida Hay’adda Hantidhowrka Guud ay tahay mid ka mid ah mabaadi’da dastuuriga ah ee ay waajib tahay in dhammaan hay’adaha dowladda ay ilaaliyaan. Xafiiska ayaa xusay in madaxbannaanida Hantidhowrka Guud ay muhiim u tahay in Xafiisku si madax-bannaan ugu guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah, isla markaana uu si hufan u fuliyo shaqooyinka loo igmaday. Sida lagu sheegay qoraalka Xafiiska, waajibaadka iyo shaqooyinka Hantidhowrka Guud waxaa faahfaahinaya Sharciga Maareynta Maaliyadda Guud, Sharci Lr. 17 ee 2019, iyo Sharciga Hantidhowrka Guud, Sharci Lr. 14 ee 2023. Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ayaa ah hay’adda ugu sarreysa ee u xilsaaran hantidhowrista, diiwaangelinta iyo ilaalinta hantida guud iyo macaamilada maaliyadeed ee dowladda. Sidoo kale, wuxuu door ku leeyahay hubinta fulinta maareynta kheyradka guud iyo dhowrista shuruucda maaliyadda iyo miisaaniyadda dowladda. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in, sida ku cad Qodobka 63aad (2) ee Xeer-nidaamiyaha Sharciga Nidaamka Xukuumadda, Xeer Lr. 174 ee 15/02/2025, guddiyada iyo xafiisyada madax-bannaan ee dastuuriga ah loo nidaamiyo si waafaqsan mabaadi’da dastuuriga ah iyo qodobbo kale oo khuseeya. Xafiiska ayaa intaas ku daray in Guddiga Qaranka ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka Dowladda uu si buuxda u dhowro madax-bannaanida dastuuriga ah ee Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud, isla markaana tallaabo kasta oo kasta oo ku saabsan magacaabista, ka qaadista ama go’aannada kale ee shaqaalaha Xafiiska loo maro habraacyada dastuurka iyo shuruucda dalka. Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in ilaalinta madaxbannaanidiisu ay muhiim u tahay gudashada waajibaadkiisa ku aaddan la xisaabtanka, daahfurnaanta iyo ilaalinta hantida guud.

items.title: Berbera port operating at 30% of capacity, DP World official says
items.description: Berbera (Somalia Today) — Berbera port is operating at about 30% of its current capacity despite hundreds of millions of dollars in investment aimed at turning it into a major gateway for Ethiopia and the wider Horn of Africa, according to a senior DP World official. Jama Mohamed Ahmed, DP World’s commercial director for the Horn of Africa, disclosed the figure in an interview with Middle East Eye , saying the port had yet to attract the level of Ethiopian trade anticipated when it was expanded. DP World has increased Berbera’s annual container-handling capacity to 500,000 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs). The port can also handle about two million tonnes of general, bulk and break-bulk cargo a year. But Middle East Eye reported that the port was operating at roughly 30% of that capacity after plans to substantially increase Ethiopian traffic failed to materialise. The disclosure comes eight months after Somalia’s federal government annulled all agreements with the United Arab Emirates , including arrangements involving the ports of Berbera, Bosaso and Kismayo, as well as security and defence cooperation. Mogadishu said it made the January 12 decision in response to what it described as violations of Somalia’s sovereignty, national unity and political independence. Puntland, Jubaland and Somaliland rejected the federal decision and said their agreements with the UAE would remain in force. Ethiopian trade falls short DP World has promoted Berbera as an alternative maritime gateway for landlocked Ethiopia, which conducts most of its international trade through neighbouring Djibouti. Those ambitions received a potential boost in January 2024 when Ethiopia and Somaliland signed a memorandum of understanding over access to the coast. Somalia rejected the agreement as a violation of its sovereignty, triggering a diplomatic dispute with Ethiopia. Turkey later mediated talks between Mogadishu and Addis Ababa, culminating in the Ankara Declaration in December 2024. The Berbera port plans tied to increased Ethiopian trade have yet to materialise on the scale envisaged. Ahmed Abdi, a Mogadishu-based geopolitical analyst, told Somalia Today that the 30% utilisation figure reinforced long-held concerns about the UAE’s involvement in Berbera and Bosaso. “This confirms what we have believed for some time: that the reason the UAE illegally took control of the ports of Berbera and Bosaso was to suppress competition and protect Jebel Ali port,” Abdi said. “The plan has always been to provide the local administrations with limited funding and modest development, while preventing these ports from growing into serious competitors to Dubai in the long term.” The allegation that the UAE sought to suppress competition is Abdi’s assessment. DP World has instead presented its investments in Berbera as an effort to expand regional trade, improve infrastructure and provide Ethiopia and other Horn of Africa markets with another maritime gateway. Abdi said Somaliland and Puntland should reconsider their agreements with DP World, citing Eritrea and Djibouti, which previously ended their agreements with the Dubai-based port operator. ‘Major investment’ DP World took over management of Berbera under a long-term concession and has committed up to $442 million to the development and expansion of the port. The company said in 2021 that the first phase increased annual container capacity from 150,000 TEUs to 500,000. A planned second phase would extend the quay and raise annual capacity to as much as two million TEUs. DP World has also developed the Berbera Economic Zone and promoted a transport corridor linking the port with the Ethiopian border. In 2021, the company and Ethiopia’s transport ministry signed an agreement to explore development of the Ethiopian side of the corridor. DP World and its partners at the time envisaged up to $1 billion in logistics investment over 10 years, including dry ports, warehouses and container yards. Berbera continues to handle regional and international cargo despite its unused capacity. During Middle East Eye’s visit, Russian grain was being prepared for onward transport to Ethiopia and South Sudan, while containers arriving from China and destined for Egypt were being transferred between vessels. Workers were also unloading Indian sugar and Malaysian timber for the Somaliland market. Ahmed remained confident that traffic would eventually increase. “All the infrastructure is here. It’s only a matter of time,” he told Middle East Eye. The post Berbera port operating at 30% of capacity, DP World official says appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Odayaasha Beledxaawo oo digniin soo saaray kadib xaalad soo korortay + Video
items.description: Beledxaawo (Caasimada Online) – Iyadoo weli xaalad kacsanaan ah laga dareemayo degmada Beledxaawo ee gobolka Gedo ayaa waxaa maanta bayaan culus soo saaray odayaasha dhaqanka ee ku sugan degmadaasi, kaas oo ay kaga hadleen xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay, gaar ahaan colaadda Gedo. Odayaasha oo shir ku yeeshay Beledxaawo ayaa digniin kasoo saaray xiisadda ka taagan degmadaas, iyayga oo Dowladda Federaalka iyo Jubbaland ka codsaday inay culayska ka dul-qaadaan, ayna joojiyaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ka socda halkaasi, si looga hortago dagaal mar kale ka dhaca degmadaasi. Qaar kamid ah duubabka dhaqanka oo kulanka ka hadlay ayaa si gaar ah farriin ugu diray dowladda Soomaaliya, waxayna ka dalbadeen inay joojiso tallaab kasta oo horseedi karta isku dhac mar kale ka dhaca degmada Beledxawo. Waxaa kale oo ay ku baaqeen in arrimaha siyaasadda iyo maamulka ee dhaliyay khilaafka taagan lagu wajaho wada-hadal iyo deganaan. Sidoo kale, odayaasha dhaqanka ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inay qaadan doonaan doorkooda, isla markaana ay ka qayb-qaadanayaan sidii looga gaari lahaa xal waara, si nabad loogu soo dabaalo guud ahaan gobolka Gedo. “Dowladda haddii ay manfac leedahay waaa inuu ahaadaa nabadda ma rabno xabad nalagu laayo mar kale. Nama metalaan nimanka dhahaya is dila ee maalinba nin innoo soo diraayo waxaan leenahay colaadda aad noo soo xawileysaan naga daaya,” ayuu yiri mid kamid ah odyaasha deegaanka. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas sii raaciyay “Waxaa noqonay meesha qamaarka lagu ciyaaro oo dadkeeda la barakiciyo oo dhibaatada joogtada ah laga fuliyo”. Kulanka ayaa ugu dambeyn laga soo saaray go’aan culus oo looga hortagayo colaad mar kale ka dhacda Beledxaawo, waxaana odayaasha ay sheegeen in mar dambe aysan ogolaan doonin in dhexdooda la’isku diro, kadibna lagu dul dagaalamo. “Waxaan go’aan ku gaarnay inaan joojino colaadda ka taagan Beledxaawo oo wiilasheenna gacmaha qabsano war dhibka naga daaya oo Ilaahey ka baqa,” ayuu mar kale lagu yiri bayaanka ay soo saareen odayaasha dhaqanka. The post Odayaasha Beledxaawo oo digniin soo saaray kadib xaalad soo korortay + Video appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: What to know about USAID and the deadly impacts of US foreign aid cut
items.description: KATHMANDU, Nepal (AP) — The foreign aid landscape has changed dramatically since U.S. President Donald Trump’s administration dissolved the United States Agency for International Development, once the world’s largest humanitarian donor. Here’s a quick look at USAID, the impacts of its dissolution and what foreign aid looks like today: USAID’s roots and purpose U.S. President John F. Kennedy and Congress started USAID in the early 1960s. Beyond the belief that the U.S. has a moral obligation to help the world’s most desperate, supporters of USAID say the agency was a crucial tool of soft power diplomacy. Supporters say USAID directly benefited the country by engendering immense global goodwill toward the U.S., helping prevent the spread of diseases that could threaten American lives and providing stability in foreign countries that could otherwise pose a threat to U.S. security. The U.S. typically spent around 1% of its federal budget on U.S. foreign assistance A study published in The Lancet credited USAID programs with preventing 91 million deaths — including 30 million deaths of children under age 5 — in the first two decades of this century alone. Critics of the agency, including Trump, say it was wasteful and poorly run. US foreign aid cuts affect communities worldwide The U.S. foreign aid cuts have been devastating for millions of the world’s most vulnerable people. The Associated Press has documented widespread severe hunger , shortages of lifesaving medicine and spikes in child marriage, kidnapping and trafficking of children — consequences that are all linked to the funding cuts. Experts say the true impact won’t be measurable for years, because the repercussions of issues like malnutrition and untreated diseases take time to manifest. And the full extent of the damage may never be known, in part because the funding cuts eliminated the jobs of scores of front line workers who collected mortality data. Deaths linked to US foreign aid cuts Despite the U.S. government’s repeated insistence that no one has died as a result of its dissolution of USAID, the AP has documented deaths across the world linked to the funding cuts. In Nepal, the AP found that cuts to programs that ensured uneducated, impoverished pregnant women got proper nutrition and prenatal care have led to more babies and pregnant women dying. The AP also found that children in Myanmar , Nigeria and Somalia have died after cuts to food rations and nutrition programs. Because of global cuts to foreign aid, the Gates Foundation has predicted that 2025 will be the first year this century where child deaths will increase. US defends its decision In a statement to the AP, the U.S. State Department said the Trump administration had reinvigorated its assistance programs to focus on efficiency, effectiveness and partnership. The department also said the U.S. spends more on health and humanitarian assistance than any other country. “The rest of the world needs to contribute more and share the burden,” the department said. US foreign aid today The Trump administration’s new foreign aid strategy is more limited and is targeted toward initiatives that government officials say will further the United States’ interests. With health aid, for example, the U.S. is increasingly bypassing NGOs in favor of bilateral agreements with foreign countries . This means the money goes directly to foreign governments in exchange for concessions to the U.S., such as access to a country’s health data, which could be used to help detect outbreaks of infectious diseases. The U.S. says this model is more efficient. But some countries have pushed back , particularly over privacy concerns for their citizens’ medical records. Source: AP The post What to know about USAID and the deadly impacts of US foreign aid cut appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Egypt Declares Suez Canal Secure as August Revenue Surges to $567 Million
items.description: CAIRO- Egypt’s Suez Canal Authority (SCA) has declared the waterway safe, with maritime traffic flowing normally as August revenue rose 56.7 percent year-on-year to $567.1 million, up from $326 million in the same month of 2025. SCA Chairman Osama Rabie announced the figures during a ceremony in Alexandria marking World Maritime Day 2026, organized by the Maritime Transport Sector of the Ministry of Transport. The revenue increase represents a notable rebound for a canal that has endured significant disruptions in recent years. Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty previously said Red Sea tensions had cost Egypt roughly $11 billion in lost Suez Canal income. The latest numbers point to a recovery for one of the country’s most vital sources of foreign currency. The canal transited 1,358 vessels in August 2026, a 27 percent increase from 1,070 vessels in August 2025. Net tonnage rose 51.1 per cent to 68.3 million tonnes, up from 45.2 million tonnes a year earlier. Rabie emphasized that navigation remained stable and services continued at high efficiency. He added that canal pilots were carrying out their duties with the highest levels of readiness and professionalism. Despite the strong year-on-year gains, traffic has not returned to pre-disruption levels. Average canal transits stood at about 40.8 vessels per day between January and August 2026, compared with 73.7 per day in 2023. Canal revenue reached $4.67 billion in fiscal year 2025/2026, a 23 percent increase , though vessel transits and cargo tonnage remain below the canal’s peak performance. The Suez Canal remains a critical artery for global trade, linking the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea and offering the shortest maritime route between Asia and Europe.   The post Egypt Declares Suez Canal Secure as August Revenue Surges to $567 Million first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Maersk adds surcharge on Europe-Somalia container shipments
items.description: Mogadishu (Somalia Today) — Shipping giant Maersk will impose a new surcharge on containers shipped from Northern Europe and the Mediterranean to Somalia from October 7, raising freight costs for importers using the route. The Danish shipping group said it would introduce a Peak Season Surcharge (PSS) of $200 for a 20-foot dry container and $300 for 40-foot and 45-foot dry containers bound for Somalia and Tanzania. The charge will remain in place until further notice, according to a Maersk rate announcement published on Monday. It will apply to non-SPOT bookings, while shipments made through Maersk’s SPOT product will not be subject to the surcharge. The company said it would collect the fee according to each shipment’s freight payment terms and add it to other applicable charges. For an importer sending a standard 40-foot container from the affected European markets to Somalia, the measure means an additional $300 in freight costs under an eligible booking. Importers could absorb the extra expense or pass some of it further down the supply chain, depending on the type and volume of goods being shipped. What is a peak season surcharge? A Peak Season Surcharge is an additional fee that shipping companies add to their normal freight rates, typically when demand for cargo space increases or shipping capacity comes under pressure. Carriers can also introduce the charge when congestion or other operational constraints increase pressure on their networks. Despite its name, a peak season surcharge does not necessarily mean that imports into Somalia have suddenly risen sharply. It can reflect conditions across a wider shipping route or the carrier’s broader network. The surcharge is also not a Somali government tax, customs duty or port levy. It is a commercial shipping charge imposed by Maersk on top of its underlying freight rate. Maersk did not give a specific reason for introducing the new surcharge on shipments to Somalia and Tanzania, saying the measure was intended to allow it to continue providing its global services. Higher charge than Kenya Maersk has also announced a Peak Season Surcharge for shipments from Northern Europe and the Mediterranean to Kenya, effective on the same date. But the Kenyan rates are lower. The company will charge $150 for a 20-foot dry container bound for Kenya and $200 for a 40-foot or 45-foot container, compared with $200 and $300 respectively for Somalia and Tanzania, according to a separate Maersk notice . Maersk did not explain the difference in rates between the destinations. The latest measure follows another surcharge affecting Somalia in the opposite direction. From September 17, Maersk imposed a $500-per-container Peak Season Surcharge on cargo shipped from several East African countries, including Somalia, Kenya, Djibouti, Ethiopia and Tanzania, to Belgium, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland and Switzerland. In that case, the company cited prevailing market conditions and capacity constraints affecting trade into Northern Europe. Somalia relies heavily on imported goods, making international freight costs an important part of the price of bringing products into the country. The effect of the latest surcharge will vary depending on the value and volume of goods carried in each container. A $300 increase spread across a large shipment may add only a small amount to the cost of each item, although higher freight and logistics expenses can increase overall costs for importers. items.title: Nabadda Awdal iyo Selel Waa Mas’uuliyad Inaga Wada Saaran
items.description: Nabadda Awdal iyo Selel Waa Mas’uuliyad Inaga Wada Saaran Nabadda gobollada Awdal iyo Selel waa hanti qaali ah oo aynu dhammaanteen wada leenahay, waana waajib in si wadajir ah loo ilaaliyo. Nabadi jirto ayaa lagu wada noolaan karaa, lagu horumari karaa, laguna ilaalin karaa mustaqbalka jiilasha soo socda. Bulshada Awdal iyo Selel waa dad muddo dheer wada noolaa, is dhalay, is guursaday, is xiga, isla markaana wadaaga deegaan, dhaqan iyo nolol maalmeed. Waa bulsho ay walaaltinimadu ka weyn tahay wax kasta oo kala fogayn kara. Waxaan ugu baaqayaa dhammaan shacabka labada gobol in ay nabadda ilaashadaan, kana fogaadaan hadal ama ficil kasta oo keeni kara xurguf, colaad ama kala fogaansho. Khilaaf kasta waa in lagu dhammeeyaa wada-hadal, dulqaad, isu-tanaasul iyo is-ixtiraam. Waxaan sidoo kale si gaar ah ugu baaqayaa hoggaanka dhaqanka, cuqaasha, salaadiinta, culimada, waxgaradka, haweenka iyo dhalinyarada in ay hormuud ka noqdaan ilaalinta nabadda iyo dejinta bulshada. Hoggaanka dhaqanka ee labada dhinac waxaan ka codsanayaa in ay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan dowladda iyo hay’adaha nabadgelyada, si looga hortago wax kasta oo dhaawici kara xasilloonida iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Nabadda Awdal iyo Selel ma aha arrin cid gaar ahi leedahay. Waa mas’uuliyad inaga wada saaran. Waa inaynu ilaashannaa waxa ina mideeya, kana shaqaynaa in jiilasha dambe ay dhaxlaan bulsho nabad, walaaltinimo iyo wadajir ku nool. Walaalayaal, nabadda aynu ilaashanno. Nabadi waa nolol, horumar iyo mustaqbal. Mohamed Farah Tahar maantahar@gmail.com Aqoonyahan bartay Maamulka iyo Qorshaynta, ahna Caaqil ka mid ah Cuqaasha Somaliland.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya oo Mareykanka kala hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, Sareeye Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay u-qaybsanaha difaaca Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya, Colonel Egan O’Reilly, iyagoo ka wada-hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan xaaladda dalka. Kulanka oo saacado badan qaatay ayaa waxaa si gaar ah diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, gaar ahaan dib-u-dhiska, tayeynta iyo horumarinta ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Sareeye Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji ayaa dowladda Mareykanka uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay marwalba la garab taagan yihiin ciidamada qalabka sida, gaar ahaan ciidanka cirka Soomaaliyeed oo haatan dib usoo kabasho sameynaya, maadaama ay heleen taageero gudaha iyo dibadda ah. Dhankiisa, Colonel Egan O’Reilly ayaa ballan qaaday in dowladdiisu ay sii wadi doonto taageerada, wuxuuna taliska ciidanka cirka uga mahadceliyay soo dhaweynta ballaaran ee manta loogu sameeyay magaalada Muqdisho. Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah dalalka waa wayn ee taageerada siiya Soomaaliya, iyadoo kulanka lagu soo qaaday doorkiisa ku aadan la dagaallanka Al-Shabaab. Waxaa kale oo uu Mareykanka tababaraa, isla markaana bixiyaa mushaharka ciidamada Danab ee Xoogga dalka Soomaaliya ee la dagaalama kooxda Al-Shabaab, lana rumeysan yahay inay yihiin ciidamada ugu waxtarka fiican kuwa Soomaaliya ay hadda leedahay. Si kastaba, kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada ay dowladda Soomaaliya ku xoojineyso taageerade caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan dhanka difaaca iyo milatariga, maadaama lagu xilli xasaasi ah, uuna weli socdo dagaalka Al-Shabaab. items.title: Uganda Suspends Military Cooperation With Turkey Amid Extradition Dispute
items.description: KAMPALA— Uganda has suspended all military and defense cooperation with Turkey amid a diplomatic dispute over the alleged refusal by Ankara to extradite Ugandan political commentator Fred Lumbuye, a prominent critic of President Yoweri Museveni. Uganda People’s Defence Forces (UPDF) spokesperson Chris Magezi announced the decision in a statement posted on X, saying the suspension would take effect immediately. “The Uganda People’s Defence Forces has, with immediate effect, suspended all defense and military cooperation with the Republic of Turkey,” Magezi said. The move follows growing tensions between Ugandan authorities and Turkish officials over Lumbuye, who is based in Turkey and has been sought by Ugandan authorities. According to Agence France-Presse (AFP), Lumbuye faces 15 criminal charges in Uganda, including allegations of inciting violence, spreading false information and misuse of a computer. He has been a vocal critic of the Ugandan government and President Museveni. Uganda’s army commander, Muhoozi Kainerugaba, the president’s son, has reportedly been involved in efforts to secure Lumbuye’s return to Uganda. AFP reported that Kainerugaba has repeatedly clashed with Turkish officials over the issue. The dispute has also triggered protests in Kampala. On Friday, thousands of Ugandans affiliated with the Uganda Patriotic League, a social and political pressure group linked to Kainerugaba, demonstrated outside the Turkish Embassy in the Ugandan capital, according to AFP. The suspension of military cooperation marks a significant escalation in tensions between Uganda and Turkey as the dispute over Lumbuye’s case continues. items.title: Uganda and Turkey clash over military presence in Somalia
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Uganda’s decision to suspend all defence cooperation with Turkey is linked to the possible end of the African Union mission in Somalia, which could cost Kampala tens of millions of dollars in lost revenue, several sources familiar with the matter told Middle East Eye. The Uganda People’s Defence Forces (UPDF) announced on Saturday that it had suspended all defence and military cooperation with Ankara with immediate effect. Ugandan media had reported that the decision followed demonstrations outside the Turkish embassy in Kampala by supporters of the Patriotic League of Uganda (PLU), a group chaired by Uganda’s military chief, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba. The protesters had demanded the extradition from Turkey of Ugandan political commentator Fred Lumbuye, who has lived in the country since 2013. But sources told MEE that the dispute over Lumbuye was a pretext for a wider disagreement over Uganda’s military presence in Somalia and Turkey’s growing role in the country’s security sector. “Lumbuye has been living in Turkey since 2013 and this crisis has nothing to do with his presence, it is only a smoke screen,” said one of the sources familiar with the matter. “The whole episode is connected to Ugandan army’s presence in Somalia, which has close security ties with Ankara.” Uganda has roughly 4,500 troops in Somalia under the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (Aussom), the main international force supporting the Somali army, and a further 2,000 under a bilateral agreement, a military source told AFP. But the mission’s future was thrown into doubt after the US informed the African Union in July that it would end its payments to the UN Support Office in Somalia, which provides crucial logistical support to Aussom, by the end of the year. The development has raised questions over how the mission will be funded and whether countries such as Uganda will continue deploying troops. Sources told MEE that Somalia had asked Uganda to end its military deployment, citing the growing strength of Somali military brigades trained by Turkey. ‘Uganda could lose millions’ Ugandan forces were once crucial to protecting Somalia. In recent years, however, the Turkish military has trained nearly 25,000 Somali soldiers in Mogadishu and at least 10,000 additional commandos in Turkey. Sources familiar with the issue told MEE that Uganda receives at least $1,000 a month for each soldier deployed in Somalia. “Ending the mission could mean for Uganda to lose millions of dollars in a year,” a second source familiar with the matter told MEE. “Uganda is trying to pressure Turkey to find a solution to the crisis since it sees Ankara as the main stakeholder in Somali security issues.” The source estimated that Uganda could lose between $5m and $6m a month – or $60m to $72m a year – if the mission ends and Kampala withdraws all its forces. Tunc Demirtas, a researcher at the Ankara-based Seta think tank, said the growing capabilities of Somalia’s security forces meant the country was increasingly able to take responsibility for its own security. “Somalia’s government is now capable of providing its own security for its capital and surrounding regions and as its state capacity is built up, it requires less support from abroad,” Demirtas told MEE. “There is a war economy in Somalia and of course it was also contributing to Uganda.” The sources said that Ankara was seeking a solution to the dispute as it feared Turkish companies operating Uganda’s infrastructure and transport projects could be affected. The AFP news agency reported that Uganda could cancel a $3bn railway contract awarded to Turkish construction company Yapi Merkezi and expel Turkish nationals from the country. items.title: Maxaad ka ogtahay sababta ay dawlada Ugaandhi ay xidhiidhka ugu jartay Turkiga?
items.description: Ciidamada Uganda ayaa sheegay inay hakiyeen iskaashigii milateri ee kala dhexeeyay Turkiga, kadib markii la dalbaday in Ankara ay soo wareejiso qoraa siyaasadeed oo caan ah, kaas oo si adag u dhaliila Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni. “Ciidamada Difaaca Dadweynaha Uganda (UPDF) ayaa si degdeg ah u hakiyay dhammaan wixii iskaashi dhanka difaaca iyo milatariga ah ee kala dhexeeyay Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga,” ayuu yiri afhayeenka ciidamada Chris Magezi oo soo saaray bayaan uu ku daabacay bartiisa X. Sida ay tabisay wakaaladda wararka ee AFP, taliyaha ciidanka waddanka Uganda Muhoozi Kainerugaba, oo ah wiilka madaxweyne Museveni oo si weyn loogu arko inuu yahay ninka bedeli doona aabihiis, ayaa si isdaba joog ah waxay isugu dhaceen mas’uuliyiinta Turkiga waxaana uu salka ku hayay isku dhaco Uganda oo isku dayaysa in Fred Lumbuye oo nin dhaliila dowladda Uganda oo ku nool Turkiga loo soo gacan geliyo iyaga. Falanqeeyaha siyaasadda ayaa wajahaya 15 dacwadood oo dambi ah, oo ay ku jiraan kicin rabshado, faafinta macluumaad been abuur ah iyo si xun u isticmaalka kombiyuutarka. Jimcihii, kumanaan reer Uganda ah oo xiriir la leh Ururka Waddaniga ah ee Uganda, oo ah koox cadaadis bulsho iyo siyaasadeed oo xiriir la leh Muhoozi, ayaa dibadbax ka dhigay bannaanka safaaradda Turkiga ee caasimadda Kampala, sida ay tabisay AFP. Qoraal uu soo dhigay baraha bulshada, ayuu Kainerugaba ku yiri: “Waxaan u mahadcelinayaa dadweynaha wadaniyiinta ah ee PLU, kuwaas oo shalay dhigay bannaanbax ka dhacay Safaaradda Turkiga. Waxay caddeeyeen inay leeyihiin geesinimo. Turkidu waxay aqbali doonaan dhammaan dalabaadkayaga. Haddii ay sidaas yeeli waayaanna, ku noolaashaha Uganda waxay ku noqon doontaa mid aan suurtagal ahayn.” Waxa uu sidoo kale ku hanjabay in la xiri doono qof kasta oo u qareema Turkiga gudaha Uganda. “Tallaabadani waxay sii ahaan doontaa mid dhaqangal ah ilaa laga xallinayo arrimaha taagan ee ku saabsan difaaca wadajirka ah iyo iskaashiga milateri ee u dhexeeya labada dal,” ayuu raaciyay hadalkiisa afhayeenka ciidmada Uganda, Magezi, isagoon bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah. Sida ay daabacday wakaaladda wararka AP, Fred Lumbuye oo dhaliila xukuumadda talada haysa ee Uganda ayaa muddo sanado ah ku noolaa dalka Turkiga, balse xaaladdiisa sharci ee waddankaas ayaa ah mid aan caddayn. Qoraalladiisa ku saabsan siyaasadda Uganda ayaa waxaa daawada kumanaan qof, taas oo siinaysa madal iyo saameyn gaar ah oo aysan haysan dadka dalka gudihiisa ku dhaliila dowladda. Xidhiidhka Difaac ee ka dhaxeeyay labada dal Uganda iyo Turkiga waxay lahaayeen xiriir dhow oo difaaca muddo ku dhow toban sano. Bishii Juun 2016 waxay saxiixeen heshiis iskaashi oo ka dhexeeya warshadaha-difaaca, kaas oo lagu sii xijiyay heshiis kale oo tababar militari ah oo dhacay sannadkii 2022. Meelaha iskaashiga waxaa ka mid ah tababarka militariga, qalabka hubka iyo sahanka, is-waydarsiga tignoolajiyada iyo iskaashiga ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo amniga. Militarigu ma bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan arrimaha taagan ee ka dambeeya joojinta, laakiin sida ay bahisay AFP waxay imaaneysaa arrintani kadib hanjabaado ah in Uganda ay joojinayso qandaraas lagu dhisayo tareen SGR ah oo ay ku baxayso $3 bilyan oo doolarka maraykanka ah ee kaa oo ay Uganda horay ula gashay shirkadda Turkiga ee Yapi Merkezi, iyo sidoo kale hanjabaad kale oo ah in muwaadiniinta Turkiga laga saarayo dalka Uganda. Warbaahinta Turkiga ayaa bishii Juun sheegtay in Muhoozi Kainerugaba uu joojiyay qandaraaska “isagoo xoojinaya falal iyo hadallo cadowtinimo ah oo lala beegsaday Türkiga”. Bbc somali

items.title: Woqooyi Bari oo Xannibay Gaadiid Raran oo Ka Yimid Dekedda Berbera
items.description: Laascaanood (Raxanreeb Online) Woqooyi Bari oo Xannibay Gaadiid Raran oo Ka Yimid Dekedda Berbera Maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa xannibay gaadiid xamuul ah oo markii ugu horreysay muddo saddex sano ah ka soo baxay Dekedda Berbera ee Somaliland, kuwaas oo marayay jidka isku xira Burco iyo Laascaanood. Gaadiidkan ayaa la sheegay inuu u rarnaa ganacsato ku sugan magaalada Laascaanood, waxaana jidkaasi uu xirnaa tan iyo markii uu dhacay dagaalkii Goojacadde. Ciidamada Waqooyi Bari, ayaa sidoo kale xabsiga dhigay sagaal darawal oo waday gaadiidka, iyadoo illaa hadda ciidamadu gacanta ku hayaan gaadiidkii xamuulka ahaa. Xannibaadda gaadiidkan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay dib u soo bilaabatay isu-socodka ganacsiga ee u dhexeeya Dekedda Berbera iyo Laascaanood, kaddib muddo dheer oo waddadaasi xirnayd. items.title: Maxaa ka cusub qaraxa lagu beegsaday taliyaha Baydhaba?
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada ammaanka magaalada Baydhabo ayaa gacanta ku dhigay dhowr qof oo looga shakisan yahay inay ku lug leeyihiin qarax xalay ka dhacay magaalada, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil amni. Dhacdadan ayaa dhacday xilli Taliyaha Saldhiga Booliska Baydhabo, Cali Aadan Maxamed (Cali Taageey) uu kasoo baxay gurigiisa, isagoo ku sii jeeday saldhig ciidan oo ku yaalla xaafadda Xero Jaad. Qaraxa ayaa la sheegay inuu ahaa miino dhulka lagu aasay oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday taliyaha, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanku ay markii dambe bilaabeen baaritaanno lagu raadinayo dadka ku lugta leh dhacdada. Saraakiil ka tirsan laamaha ammaanka oo ka gaabsaday in magacyadooda la shaaciyo ayaa sheegay in dadka la qabtay ay kamid yihiin shaqsiyaad lagu tuhunsan yahay inay wax ka og yihiin qaraxa. Mid kamid ah dadka gacanta lagu dhigay ayaa si gaar ah loogu xiriirinayaa qaraxa, sida ay saraakiishu sheegeen, kaddib baaritaanno ay ciidamada ammaanku sameeyeen. Baaritaanku weli wuu socdaa, waxaana saraakiisha ammaanku sheegeen in marka la soo gaba-gabeeyo ay faahfaahinta natiijada baaritaanka iyo sababta loo qabtay dadkaasi la wadaagi doonaan warbaahinta. Si kastaba, dowladda iyo laamaha ammaanka ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin khasaaraha qaraxa, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo natiijada baaritaanka socda iyo xogta rasmiga ah ee laga filayo inay kasoo baxdo dhacdada. The post Maxaa ka cusub qaraxa lagu beegsaday taliyaha Baydhaba? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Guddiga Miisaaniyadda oo dib-u-eegis ku bilaabay Hindise-sharciyeedka wax-ka-beddelka Sharciga Bankiga Dhexe
items.description: Muqdisho, 22 Sebtembar 2026 – Guddiga Miisaaniyadda, Maaliyadda, Qorsheynta, Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah iyo La-xisaabtanka Hay’adaha Dowladda ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kulan wadatashi ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Maaliyadda XFS, Mudane Biixi Iimaan Cige, iyo Guddoomiyaha Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya. Kulanka oo ka dhacay xarunta Guddoonka iyo Guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa ayaa waxaa shir-guddoomiyey Guddoomiyaha Guddiga, Xildhibaan Cabdi Ibraahim Warsame (Qawdhan). Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray Hindise-sharciyeedka wax-ka-beddelka Sharciga Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya Lr. 130, iyadoo Guddigu uu Wasiirka Maaliyadda iyo Guddoomiyaha Bankiga Dhexe kala tashaday qodobbada wax-ka-beddelka lagu sameeyey iyo sababaha keenay in sharciga wax laga beddelo. Sidoo kale, waxaa laga hadlay qodobbada cusub ee hindise-sharciyeedka lagu soo kordhiyey iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karaan siyaasadda lacagta, nidaamka bangiyada iyo dhaqaalaha guud ee dalka. Wasiirka Maaliyadda iyo Guddoomiyaha Bankiga Dhexe ayaa Guddiga faahfaahin ka siiyey ujeeddooyinka hindise-sharciyeedka, baahida loo qabo wax-ka-beddelka sharciga iyo qorshaha lagu hirgelinayo qodobbada cusub. Xubnaha Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale mas’uuliyiinta weydiiyey su’aalo la xiriira hindise-sharciyeedka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay is-weydaarsadeen aragtiyo ku saabsan qodobbada u baahan dib-u-eegis iyo faahfaahin dheeraad ah. Guddiga ayaa sheegay inuu sii wadi doono wadatashiyada, dib-u-eegista iyo falanqaynta hindise-sharciyeedka, si loo hubiyo in wax-ka-beddellada la soo jeediyey ay noqdaan kuwo dhammaystiran oo waafaqsan Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo shuruucda dalka. Marka dib-u-eegista hindise-sharciyeedka la soo gabagabeeyo, waxaa loo gudbin doonaa Akhrinta Labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, halkaas oo Xildhibaannadu ay ka dhiiban doonaan talooyinkooda, aragtiyahooda iyo wax-ku-darradooda ku aaddan sharciga. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah wadatashiyada Golaha Shacabka uu ka sameynayo hindise-sharciyeedka wax-ka-beddelka Sharciga Bankiga Dhexe.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo ka wada hadlay horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka
items.description: Muqdisho, 22 Sebteembar 2026: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa magaalada Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay wafdi ka socday Dowladda Pakistan oo uu hoggaaminayay Taliyaha Difaaca Cirka, ahna Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan, Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, gaar ahaan dhismaha iyo horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, tayaynta awooddiisa iyo kobcinta tababarrada ciidanka. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa uga mahadceliyey wafdiga Pakistan booqashada ay ku yimaadeen Soomaaliya, isagoo tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Waxa uu sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay dadaal xooggan ku bixinayso dhismaha, tababarka, tayaynta iyo qalabaynta Ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo door muhiim ah ka qaadanaya howlgalada dalka looga ciribtirayo Khawaarijta. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, gaar ahaan horumarinta awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed iyo tayaynta guud ee hay’adaha amniga iyo difaaca dalka.

items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo dalbaday in la kordhiyo goobaha laga qaato Aqoonsiga NIRA
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – 22 Sebtembar 2026: Guddiga Arrimaha Gudaha, Maamulada Gobollada iyo Amniga ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta kulan la yeeshay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Cali Xoosh) iyo Maareeyaha Hay’adda Aqoonsiga iyo Diiwaangelinta Qaranka (NIRA), Cabdiwali Cali Cabdulle. Kulanka oo uu shir guddoominayay kusimaha Guddoomiyaha Guddiga, ahna Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Guddiga, Xildhibaan Nuur Axmed Diiriye (Nuur Afey), ayaa Wasiirka iyo Maareeyaha NIRA looga dhageystay warbixinno ku saabsan shaqada, waajibaadka iyo xaaladda guud ee Hay’adda NIRA. Guddiga ayaa si gaar ah diiradda u saaray adeegyada aqoonsiga iyo diiwaangelinta muwaadiniinta, iyadoo xubnaha Guddigu ay su’aalo ka weydiiyeen howlaha Hay’adda, caqabadaha horyaalla, adeegyada ay bulshada siiso iyo qorshayaasha horumarinta. Sidoo kale, kulanka ayaa looga hadlay iskaashiga u dhexeeya Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Hay’adda NIRA, iyo sidii loo sii horumarin lahaa adeegyada aqoonsiga ee dalka. Gebagebadii, Guddiga ayaa maamulka NIRA kula dardaarmay in la kordhiyo goobaha diiwaangelinta iyo adeegyada aqoonsiga, si muwaadiniintu si fudud ugu helaan adeegyada Hay’adda. Guddigu wuxuu sidoo kale ku boorriyay Hay’adda in la kordhiyo saacadaha shaqada, si loo fududeeyo helitaanka adeegyada aqoonsiga iyo diiwaangelinta muwaadiniinta.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ku baaqday iskaashi caalami ah oo lagu xoojinayo badbaadada carruurta
items.description: New York, Mareykanka — 22 Sebteembar 2026: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, ayaa magaalada New York kaga qeyb-gashay kulan heer sare ah oo diiradda lagu saaray ilaalinta carruurta iyo sidii loo dhisi lahaa nidaamyo digital ah oo ammaan u ah carruurta. Kulanka oo cinwaankiisu ahaa “The Invisible Architecture: Building Safe Digital Systems for Children – Advancing International Standards and Shared Responsibility” ayaa ka dhacay inta lagu guda jiro Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNGA81), waxaana martigelisay Marwada Koowaad ee Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye, Emine Erdoğan. Kulanka ayaa xoogga lagu saaray khataraha cusub ee carruurta kala kulmi karaan deegaanka digital-ka, iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sameeyo nidaamyo iyo siyaasado ilaaliya xuquuqda, badqabka iyo fayo-qabka carruurta. Wasiir Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi ayaa kulanka ka muujisay sida Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay ilaalinta carruurta iyo ka hortagga tacaddiyada, dhiigmiirashada iyo xadgudubyada, iyadoo si gaar ah loo eegayo khataraha ka dhalan kara isticmaalka tiknoolajiyadda iyo baraha digital-ka. Waxay sidoo kale adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay in xuquuqda iyo badbaadada carruurta lagu saleeyo siyaasadaha iyo nidaamyada digital-ka, si carruurtu uga faa’iideystaan fursadaha tiknoolajiyadda iyadoo laga ilaalinayo khataraha ka iman kara. Wasiiraddu waxay carrabka ku adkaysay baahida loo qabo iskaashi caalami ah iyo masuuliyad wadaag, si loo hubiyo in nidaamyada digital-ka loo qaabeeyo hab mudnaanta siinaya badbaadada, xuquuqda iyo fayo-qabka carruurta. Ka qeybgalka Soomaaliya ee kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee xoojinta ilaalinta xuquuqda carruurta iyo ka qeybqaadashada dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu horumarinayo badqabka carruurta ee deegaanka digital-ka.

items.title: Muqdisho oo lagu daah-furay Bandhigga Caalamiga ah ee Wax-soo-saarka iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho, Sebteembar 22, 2026 — Magaalada Muqdisho waxaa maanta ka furmay Bandhigga Caalamiga ah ee Wax-soo-saarka, Warshadaha iyo Habaynta Soomaaliya (SOMIPEX), oo loogu talagalay in lagu soo bandhigo wax-soo-saarka gudaha dalka, isla markaana lagu mideeyo warshadleyda, ganacsatada iyo maalgashadayaasha. Bandhiggan ayaa fursad u siinaya shirkadaha iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed inay bulshada iyo suuqa caalamka tusaan waxyaabaha gudaha dalka lagu soo saaro, kuwa la farsameeyo iyo awoodda warshadaha Soomaaliya. SOMIPEX ayaa sidoo kale diiradda saaraya sidii loo dhiirrigelin lahaa wax-soo-saarka gudaha, maalgelinta warshadaha iyo abuurista suuqyo cusub oo ay gaaraan badeecooyinka lagu soo saaro Soomaaliya. Munaasabadda waxaa lagu daah-furayaa hannaanka “Made in Somalia — Lagu Sameeyey Soomaaliya”, kaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu aqoonsado laguna dhiirrigeliyo badeecooyinka gudaha lagu sameeyo. Bandhigga ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo madal ay isugu yimaadaan ganacsatada, warshadleyda, maalgashadayaasha iyo daneeyayaasha kale, si looga wada hadlo fursadaha jira iyo horumarinta wax-soo-saarka iyo warshadaha dalka.

items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed iyo Madaxa WFP Soomaaliya oo ka wada hadlay dardargelinta gargaarka Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Baydhabo, 22 Sebtembar 2026: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa Xarunta Madaxtooyada Baydhabo ku qaabilay Madaxa Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Cunnada Adduunka (WFP) ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Hameed Nuru. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed iyo WFP, gaar ahaan xaaladda bani’aadantinimo ee ka jirta deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed iyo baahiyaha dadka nugul. Labada dhinac ayaa si gaar ah uga wada hadlay fududeynta iyo dardargelinta howlaha diyaaradaha WFP ee qaada raashiinka iyo agabka kale ee gargaarka, si loogu gurmado bulshada ay saameeyeen xaaladaha bani’aadantinimo iyo cimilada. Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in hay’adaha gargaarka ay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan Dowladda, si gargaarku si habsami leh, ammaan ah oo hufan u gaaro dadka loogu talagalay. Sidoo kale, Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa WFP uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay siiso shacabka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan bulshada ku nool deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed ee u baahan gurmadka bani’aadantinimo. Kulanka ayaa lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, WFP iyo hay’adaha kale ee bani’aadantinimada, si loo kordhiyo waxtarka gargaarka loona gaarsiiyo dadka ugu baahida badan.

items.title: Kiiska dilka Cabdinaasir Dahable oo dib usoo laba-kacleeyay iyo Somaliland oo…
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Qaraar ku saabsan sidii cadaalad loogu heli lahaa Cabdinaasir Muuse Cabdiraxmaan Dahable oo ka tirsanaa Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliya, ayaa la horgeeyay Golaha Wakiillada Somaliland. items.title: Danyar ku nool Hargaysa oo ka soo kaban waayay burbur ku yimid ganacsiyadooda
items.description: (ERGO) –  Rooda Xasan Aw Axmed waxay cunno ku filan u la’dahay qoyskeeda toban ah. Waxaa kow bishan ka xirantay meherad ganacsi oo ay ku iibin jirtay khudaar iyo cunnooyin bisil oo waddani ah. Waxaa meesha ka baxday lacag u dhaxaysa afar ilaa lix doollar oo ay maalinle uga heli jirtay shaqadeeda, taas oo ay ku maaraynaysay baahiyaha aasaasiga ah ee reerka.   Xaaladdan ayay galeen markii waddo bannayn ay hormuud u ahayd Dawladda Hoose ee Hargeysa ay saamaysay ganacsigeeda iyo 69 kale. Rooda ayaa sheegtay inaan la siin dhul kale. Waxaa u dheer inaysan awoodin inay meel kiraysato. Haweeneydan oo uu qoysku keligeed ku tiirsanaa weli ka quusan la’ halkii ay ku ganacsanaysay oo ay shaqo ka wadaan gawaarida wax dhisaya iyo shaqaale. “Wallaahi cagaftii baa naga qaaday. Meheradihii way naga dumeen alaabtii waataas oo way isku dul rasaysan tahay. Dee imika iyo haatanna waadigaa arkaya xaaladdii halkay marayso. Wax taakulayn ah maanaan, waxba noomay ballanqaadin dawladdu.” Burburka ku yimid ganacsigeeda wuxuu ku soo beegmay xilli qoyskeeda ay horay ula halgamayeen duruufo is-biirsaday. Rooda ayaa sheegtay in wiilkeeda 26 jir ah kaas oo iyadana oo aan oggayn ka tahriibay uu lix bilood Liibiya ugu yahay magafe. Xaaladdiisa ayay tilmaamtay inay ka sii darayso marba marka ka danbaysa. Waxaa soo waca kooxaha haysta iyaga oo jirdilaya si ay degdeg ugu bixiso lacag madax-furasho ah oo ay sii dayntiisa ku xireen, taas oo aysan awoodin bixinteeda. Ehelkeeda ayay xustay inay yihiin danyar aan caawin karin. Waxaa intaas u wehelisa saygeeda oo sariir-yaal ah. Lix bil ka hor ayay sheegtay inuu ku soo booday cudurka qallalka sida xaqiijisay dhaqtar markii danbe loo geeyay oo baaray. Rooda ayaa tilmaamtay in xaaladahan oo feker ku hayay ay u raacday in halkii il ee daqli ay waayeen, taas oo ku kordhisay  culeysyadii nolosha ee haystay iyada iyo qoyskeeda. “Waliba sidaasuu aniga inan yari iga tahriibay, odaygii iga bukaayoo askari buu ahaayoo uu igaga dhacay faalig dee saasay xaaladayadu maraysaa. Kun Shillin oo lacaga loo hayn maxaad u malayn xaaladiisa. Dee ilaahay uun baa gargaari kara.” Rooda waxay xustay in dhaqaalaha ay ka heli jireen ganacsigan uu si wanaagsan ugu filnaa daboolidda baahiyaha nolol maalmeedka qoyskeeda. Hase yeeshee, tan iyo markii ganacsigeedii joogsaday, xaaladooda nololeed ayaa hoos dhacday maaddaama ay dabka ku shidan jireen waxa maalinlaha u soo gala. Qoyskeeda oo in badan 20 sano barakac ku ahaa magaalada Hargeysa ayay sheegtay inay hadda wajahayaan xaaladdii ugu adkayd. Filashadeeda ayaa ahayd inay ganacsigan kaga baxdo xerada balse hadda waxay joogtaa quus. Dhamaan qoysaska ay ganacsiyadooda saamaysay waddo bixinta ayaa ka siman duruufaha dhaqaale ee ka dhashay. Yusur Muxumed Buuni, oo 94 jir ah ayaa sheegtay in qoyskeeda oo ka kooban sagaal qof ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd maqaaxi yar oo ay shaaha ku karin jireen, balse hadda meesha ka baxday. Haweeneydan ayaa tilmaamtay inaysan jirin cid kale oo u shaqaysa reerka. Noloshooda ayaa ku tiirsanayd shan doollar oo ay maalinle u helaysay, taas oo ka caawin jirtay daboolidda baahiyaha oo ay cunnadu ugu horreyso, kuwaas oo hadda ku soo wada furmay. “Ma shaqaysano maqaaxidaa yar baanu ku meermeeraa waanu ka helaynoo maalintii waxaanu ka helaynay intaan aqalka dhan la fujin een la dumin konton kun oo Somaliland Shilling ah oo wuu na deeqayoo wuu nagu filaa. Imikana waa iska joognaa uun Baraka alle. Wax hagaagsan kama helo samir uun baanu ku noolahay wallaahi.” Yusur ayaa sheegtay inuu u joogto wiil ay dhashay oo dhimir-ka jirran muddo saddex sano ah, kaas oo u baahan daryeel dheeraad ah. Waxay tilmaamtay inay dawooyin iyo wixii kale ee uu u baahdo ay uga gadaysay faa’iida ganacsigeeda balse hadda ay gacan maran tahay. Waxaa culeyska ku sii kordhinaya jirradiisa iyo masuuliyadda qoyska oo saaran iyada oo da’daas ah. Wiilkeeda labaad oo dhismaha ka shaqayn jiray ayaa ka kabi jiray nolosha balse hadda wax shaqo ah ma hayo sabab la xiriirta inuu waayay cid hawl u dirsata shaqooyinka magaalada oo yaraaday darteed. Qoysaska waddo bixintu ay saamaysay ayaa isugu jira kuwo wada waayay meelihii ay ku ganacsanayeen markii ay jidka ka mid noqdeen, halka kuwo kale ay u hareen meelo ciriiri ah oo aan ku filnayn. Dawladda Hoose ayaa ka gaabsatay bixinta macmuulaad ku saabsan saamaynta ka dhalatay waddo samaynta iyo inay qorsho kale u hayso dadkan. Cabdirisaaq Cabdillaahi Ismaaciil, oo ah xoghayaha Guddoomiyaha xerada State House, ayaa tilmaamay in arrintay ay keentay saamayn dhaqaale oo muuqata. Wuxuu sheegay inay dadkii waayeen meel kale oo ay si bilaash ah ugu ganacsan karaan. “Shaqadii baa istaagtay dadkiina intan yar buu ku noolaayee meesha ka soo baxaysaa. Dhaqaale la’aan badan bay saamaysay waddo furistaasu. Markaa wallaahi dhaqaale darro faro badan bay keentay.” Cabdirisaaq ayaa xusay in markii la dumiyay ganacsiyadan yaryar, ay qoysaskii ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd ay la kulmeen xaalad dhaqaale oo aad u adag. Wuxuu sheegay in qaar badan oo ka mid ah qoysaskaasi ay maanta ku adag tahay in ay helaan nolol-maalmeedkooda aasaasiga ah. “Wallaahi dab imika maba shitaanba. Meheradiina marka laga dumiyay, carruurtiina halkan u taagan tahay, iskuulkii u taagan yahay ee biyihii u taagan yihiin waad garan karaysaa qof meheradiina ka xidhan tay. Baahida iyo dhaqaale la’aanta annaga aad bay noo saamaysaa.” Burburka ganacsiyada qoysaskan oo deggan xerada State House waxay keentay inay dabooli kari waayaan baahiyahooda lagama maarmaanka ah. Waxay u baahan yihiin in loo raadiyo xal u fududeeya inay ka soo kabtaan dhaqaale burburka ka dhacay ee saameeyay iyaga iyo nolosha iyo waxbarashada carruurtooda. items.title: Khilaafka Uganda iyo Turkey oo salka ku haya Soomaaliya iyo arrin ay go’aansatay DF
items.description: Kampala (Caasimada Online) – Soomaaliya ayaa la sheegay inay xudun u noqotay khilaafka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya Uganda iyo Turkiga, kadib markii Kampala ay hakisay dhammaan iskaashigii militari iyo difaac ee Ankara, xilli ay soo baxayaan warar sheegaya in muranku si weyn ugu saabsan yahay mustaqbalka ciidamada Uganda ee jooga Soomaaliya. Warbaahinta Middle East Eye ayaa Isniintii werisay in muranka labada dal uusan ku koobneyn oo keliya dalabka Uganda ee ku saabsan in Turkiga uu u gacan geliyo Fred Lumbuye, oo ah nin mucaarad ku ah dowladda Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni, balse uu salka ku hayo khilaaf ballaaran oo ku saabsan joogitaanka ciidamada Uganda ee Soomaaliya. Ilo xog-ogaal ah oo warbaahintu soo xigatay ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay doonayso in Uganda ay soo afjarto joogitaankeeda militari, iyadoo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya ay sii kordheyso, gaar ahaan kuwa uu tababaray ama taageeray Turkiga. “Arrintan oo dhan waxay la xiriirtaa joogitaanka ciidamada Uganda ee Soomaaliya,” ayuu mid ka mid ah ilahaasi u sheegay Middle East Eye . Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Uganda midkoodna si rasmi ah uma xaqiijin in Muqdisho ay Kampala ka dalbatay inay ciidamadeeda kala baxdo dalka. Uganda ayaa Soomaaliya ku leh kumannaan askari oo ka tirsan howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, iyadoo ciidamo kale ay dalka ku joogaan heshiis laba geesood ah oo ay la gashay dowladda Soomaaliya. Middle East Eye ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Uganda ay sanadkii waayi karto malaayiin dollar haddii ciidamadeeda laga saaro Soomaaliya. Ilo ay warbaahintu soo xigatay ayaa qiyaasay khasaaraha dhaqaale inuu u dhaxeyn karo $60 milyan iyo $72 milyan sanadkii . Hase yeeshee, tirooyinkaas si rasmi ah uma aysan xaqiijin dowladaha Uganda iyo Soomaaliya ama Midowga Afrika. Uganda waxay kamid ahayd dalalkii ugu horreeyay ee ciidamo u soo dira Soomaaliya sanadkii 2007, waxaana muddo ku dhow labaatan sano ciidamadeedu door weyn ku lahaayeen howlgalka Midowga Afrika iyo dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab. Doorka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya Dhanka kale, Turkiga ayaa sanadihii dambe si weyn u xoojiyay kaalintiisa difaaca iyo amniga Soomaaliya. Ankara waxay Muqdisho ku leedahay xarunta tababarka ciidamada ee TURKSOM, waxaana halkaas lagu tababaray kumannaan askari oo Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku jiraan ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Gorgor. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya ka taageera tababarka, qalabeynta ciidamada iyo dhinacyada kale ee difaaca, halka diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Turkiga ay door sii kordhaya ku yeesheen howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Iskaashigaas ayaa weli sii xoogeysanaya. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Axaddii Muqdisho kula kulmay wafdi saraakiil Turki ah oo uu hoggaaminayay taliyaha xarunta TURKSOM, Major General Sabahattin Kalkan. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in kulanka looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca, tababarka iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Fiqi ayaa sidoo kale Turkiga uga mahadceliyay taageerada joogtada ah ee dib-u-dhiska ciidamada Soomaaliya. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay muddooyinkii dambe xoogga saareysay in ciidanka qaranku si tartiib ah ula wareego mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, inkastoo wali ay jiraan walaacyo la xiriira awoodda Al-Shabaab iyo maalgelinta howlgalka Midowga Afrika. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo WHO oo xoojinaya u diyaar-garowga caafimaad ee khataraha El Niño
items.description: Soomaaliya iyo Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka ee WHO ayaa xoojinaya iskaashiga iyo qorsheyaasha diyaar-garowga caafimaad, iyadoo dalka laga cabsi qabo inay xilliyada roobabka soo socda kordhaan saameynta cimilada daran ee la xiriirta xaaladaha El Niño. Arrintan ayaa lagu soo qaaday kulan dhexmaray Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Kenya, Jibriil Ibraahim Cabdulle , iyo Wakiilka WHO ee Soomaaliya, Dr. Humphrey Karamagi , oo ka dhacay safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Nairobi. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii loo xoojin lahaa hay’adaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, loo horumarin lahaa isku-duwidda hay’adaha kala duwan iyo kor loogu qaadi lahaa awoodda shaqaalaha caafimaadka, si bulshada loogu hubiyo adeegyo caafimaad oo la isku halayn karo xilliyada ay dhacaan xaaladaha degdegga ah ee ka dhasha isbeddelka cimilada. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay si gaar ah uga wada hadleen khataraha ka dhalan kara haddii xaaladaha El Niño ay sii xoogaystaan, iyagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sameeyo qorsheyn hore iyo digniin hore , halkii laga sugi lahaa in musiibo dhacdo kadibna wax laga qabto. Roobabka culus iyo fatahaadaha ayaa culays dheeraad ah saari kara nidaamka caafimaadka Soomaaliya, maadaama ay carqaladeyn karaan gaadiidka iyo helitaanka xarumaha caafimaadka, dhaawici karaan kaabeyaasha caafimaadka, isla markaana kordhin karaan khatarta cudurrada ka dhasha biyaha iyo cudurro kale. ilaalinta adeegyada caafimaad ee aasaasiga ah ayaa loo arkaa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qorshayaasha guud ee u-diyaargarowga musiibooyinka, gaar ahaan deegaannada ay horay u saameeyeen xaaladaha bani’aadannimo. Safiir Jibriil Ibraahim Cabdulle ayaa soo dhaweeyay taageerada joogtada ah ee WHO ay siiso Soomaaliya, isaga oo uga mahadceliyay hay’adda taageerada ay ka geysanayso horumarinta waaxda caafimaadka iyo hirgelinta mudnaanta caafimaad ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo WHO ayaa sidoo kale looga gol leeyahay in hay’adaha dowladda iyo bah-wadaagta horumarinta ay yeeshaan isku-duwid wanaagsan marka ay dhacaan xaalado degdeg ah oo la xiriira cimilada. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli dalal badan oo ku yaalla Geeska Afrika ay kordhinayaan diyaar-garowga ay ugu jiraan fatahaado, abaaro iyo xaalado kale oo ka dhasha isbeddelka cimilada, iyadoo digniinaha hore iyo qorsheynta degdegga ah loo adeegsanayo in lagu yareeyo saameynta ay musiibooyinku ku yeeshaan bulshada.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo xoojinaya iskaashiga difaaca iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Cirka
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa qaabilay wafdi sare oo ka socda Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan, kaas oo uu hoggaaminayay Taliyaha Difaaca Cirka ahna Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan, Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz. Kulanka waxaa qeyb ka ahaa Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji, waxaana looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray dib-u-dhiska iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay muhiimadda tababarka ciidamada, horumarinta aqoonta iyo xirfadaha saraakiisha Soomaaliyeed, iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya si uu uga qeyb qaato waajibaadka difaaca qaranka. Booqashada wafdiga Pakistan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiriirka iyo iskaashiga amni ee labada dal. Waxay sidoo kale daba socotaa booqasho uu Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi 4-tii Agoosto 2026 ku tagay Pakistan, markaas oo Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ay kala saxiixdeen Heshiis Is-afgarad (MoU) oo ku saabsan iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa xusay muhiimadda xiriirka saaxiibtinimo ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, isaga oo adkeeyay in iskaashiga labada dal uu si gaar ah uga qeyb qaato mudnaanta Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan dhismaha, tayeynta iyo xoojinta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed . Kulankan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya dadaallada Soomaaliya ay waddo ee lagu horumarinayo awoodda ciidamadeeda, iyadoo iskaashiga dalalka saaxiibka ah looga faa’iideysanayo tababar, khibrad iyo dhisidda awoodaha hay’adaha amniga iyo difaaca.

Booqashada wafdiga Pakistan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiriirka iyo iskaashiga amni ee labada dal. Waxay sidoo kale daba socotaa booqasho uu Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi 4-tii Agoosto 2026 ku tagay Pakistan, markaas oo Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ay kala saxiixdeen Heshiis Is-afgarad (MoU) oo ku saabsan iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa xusay muhiimadda xiriirka saaxiibtinimo ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, isaga oo adkeeyay in iskaashiga labada dal uu si gaar ah uga qeyb qaato mudnaanta Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan dhismaha, tayeynta iyo xoojinta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed . Kulankan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya dadaallada Soomaaliya ay waddo ee lagu horumarinayo awoodda ciidamadeeda, iyadoo iskaashiga dalalka saaxiibka ah looga faa’iideysanayo tababar, khibrad iyo dhisidda awoodaha hay’adaha amniga iyo difaaca.
