items.title: Why did Ted Cruz meet Cirro? Somaliland’s high-stakes Washington move
Doorasho, Dastuur iyo Somaliland: Maxaa Muqdisho Ka Socda?
items.description: Muranka siyaasadeed ee Muqdisho iyo eedaha loo jeedinayo dowladda Federaalka MUQDISHO — Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaysa muran siyaasadeed oo xooggan oo ku saabsan hannaanka doorashooyinka, muddo-xileedka hay’adaha dowladda iyo xiriirka Muqdisho la leedahay dhinacyada siyaasadda ee dalka, iyadoo dhaleeceeyayaashu ay su’aalo ka keenayaan jihada siyaasadeed ee dowladda iyo waxqabadkeeda. Doodda ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay weli ku jirto khilaaf ku saabsan qaabka doorashooyinka iyo isbeddellada dastuuriga ah ee la ansixiyay 2026. Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa bishii Maarso ansixiyay wax-ka-beddello dastuur oo suuragal ka dhigay in doorashooyinka dib loo dhigo, isla markaana muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka uu kordho. Arrintaas ayaa dhalisay dood iyo mucaarad siyaasadeed. Muranka ku saabsan doorashooyinka Soomaaliya Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud Qorshihii hore ee Soomaaliya wuxuu ku wajahnaa doorashooyin ku salaysan codka qof iyo cod, laakiin hirgelinta nidaamkaas waxaa hareeyay khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo is-afgaranwaa ku saabsan qaabka loo maamulayo doorashada. Hay’ado caalami ah ayaa hore u diiwaangeliyay in siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay 2026 wajahaysay kala-qaybsanaan iyo muran ku saabsan qaabka doorashooyinka. EUAA waxay sheegtay in khilaafkaasi uu ku saabsanaa, gaar ahaan, muddada xilalka hay’adaha federaalka iyo qaabka loo dhisayo nidaam doorasho oo la isku raacsan yahay. Dowladda Federaalka, dhankeeda, waxay sheegtay inay waddo hannaanka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod iyo dhismaha hay’adaha lagama maarmaanka u ah geeddi-socodkaas. Warbixin rasmi ah oo dowladda Soomaaliya soo saartay bishii May ayaa sheegtay in madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu waday dadaallo la xiriira dhammaystirka kala-guurka dimuqraadiyadeed iyo hirgelinta doorashooyinka qof iyo cod. Sidaas darteed, in si guud loo yiraahdo “wax doorasho ah ma dhicin” waxay u baahan tahay kala saarid: waxaa jira khilaaf iyo dib-u-dhac ku saabsan doorashooyinka federaalka, halka geeddi-socodyo doorashooyin oo heer maamul-goboleed ah ay ka dhaceen meelo ka mid ah dalka. Qaramada Midoobay waxay tusaale ahaan diiwaangelisay doorashooyin qof iyo cod ah oo Puntland ka dhacay bishii Luulyo 2024, inkastoo xogtaas ay tahay dhacdo heer maamul-goboleed. Mukhtaar Roobow iyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay liisaskii Maraykanka Wasiirka wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha islaamka ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane 𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐞𝐤𝐡 𝐌𝐮𝐤𝐡𝐭𝐚𝐚𝐫 𝐑𝐨𝐨𝐛𝐨𝐰 𝐂𝐚𝐥𝐢 Mid ka mid ah qodobada lagu soo hadal qaado dhaleeceynta dowladda ayaa ah magaca wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta, Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Abu Mansuur. Dowladda Maraykanka ayaa 2012 ku dartay Roobow barnaamijkeeda Rewards for Justice , iyadoo bixisay abaalmarin gaareysa $5 milyan oo loogu talagalay xog horseedi karta helitaankiisa. Waqtigaas waxaa lagu tilmaamay inuu ahaa hoggaamiye sare oo Al-Shabaab ah. Si kastaba, qodob muhiim ah ayaa ah in abaalmarintaas laga qaaday liiska Rewards for Justice sanadkii 2017, sida ay sheegeen ilo Maraykan ah oo uu soo xigtay Associated Press. Sidaa darteed, in Roobow maanta lagu tilmaamo inuu weli ku jiro “liiska dadka Maraykanku raadinayo” waxay u baahan tahay saxitaan iyo waqti-ku-xirnaan. Dhanka kale, xogta Waaxda Maaliyadda Maraykanka waxay muujinaysaa in Roobow lagu daray liiska Specially Designated Global Terrorist (SDGT) sanadkii 2008. Tani waa nidaam cunaqabateyn dhaqaale oo ka duwan barnaamijka Rewards for Justice. Xogta rasmiga ah ee dowladda Soomaaliya waxay hadda Roobow ku taxdaa wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta. Somaliland iyo siyaasadda gudaha Soomaaliya   Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) Doodda siyaasadeed ee Muqdisho ayaa sidoo kale ku xiran xiriirka dowladda Federaalka iyo Somaliland, gaar ahaan dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Hargeysa ay ka waddo Washington. Reuters waxay sheegtay in Somaliland ay 2026 sii xoojisay xiriirkeeda dibadda, halka dowladda Soomaaliya ay si cad uga soo horjeedo tallaabooyinka ay u aragto inay dhaawacayaan midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Warbixinno kale ayaa sheegay in Muqdisho iyo Hargeysa ay Washington u direen wafdiyo xilli ay sare u kacayeen doodaha ku saabsan siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Somaliland. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay Washington kala hadlayso arrimaha midnimada dhuleed iyo xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah. Sheegashada ah in dowladda Federaalka ay arrinta Somaliland u adeegsanayso “in lagu qariyo fashil dowladeed” waa aragti siyaasadeed oo dhaliilayaal ay qabaan , mana jirto xogta la helay oo si madax-bannaan u caddeyneysa in tani tahay ujeeddada dowladda. Doodda ku saabsan waxqabadka dowladda bilicda caasimada oo hoos udhac ku yimid Qiimeynta waxqabadka dowladda Federaalka waxay ku xiran tahay dhinaca laga eegayo. Dowladda waxay tilmaantaa hawlo ay ka waddo amniga, dhismaha hay’adaha, doorashooyinka iyo xiriirka caalamiga ah, halka mucaaradka iyo qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ay dhaliilayaan khilaafaadka siyaasadeed, dib-u-dhaca doorashooyinka iyo xiriirka u dhexeeya dowladda Federaalka iyo qaar ka mid ah maamul-goboleedyada. Dabayaaqadii 2026, Mareykanku wuxuu sidoo kale muujiyay walaac ku saabsan xaaladda maamulka iyo amniga Soomaaliya. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in Washington ay oggolaatay hal sano oo kala-guur ah oo loogu talagalay in Qaramada Midoobay ay si tartiib ah uga baxdo taageerada saadka ee AUSSOM, iyadoo Maraykanku hore u muujiyay inuu doonayo inuu joojiyo taageerada UNSOS muddadaas kadib. Arrintani waxay muujinaysaa in doodda ku saabsan dowladda Soomaaliya aysan ku koobnayn siyaasadda gudaha oo keliya, balse ay sidoo kale saameyn ku leedahay xiriirka Muqdisho iyo saaxiibbada caalamiga ah. The post Doorasho, Dastuur iyo Somaliland: Maxaa Muqdisho Ka Socda? first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Elections, the Constitution, and Somaliland: What Is Happening in Mogadishu?
items.description: Somalia’s political dispute deepens over elections and governance MOGADISHU Somalia’s federal government is facing renewed political criticism over elections, constitutional changes and relations with regional actors, as disagreements continue over the country’s political direction. The dispute comes after Somalia’s parliament approved constitutional amendments in March 2026 that could delay elections and extend the terms of federal institutions. The changes triggered opposition from political figures who questioned the process and its implications for the country’s electoral transition. The dispute over Somalia’s elections The President of the Federal Republic of Somalia, Hassan Sheikh Mohamud Somalia has been working toward a transition to universal suffrage, but disagreements over the electoral system and constitutional changes have complicated the process. The European Union Agency for Asylum reported that Somalia’s political environment remained highly divided in 2026, with disagreements over the electoral model and the constitutional changes affecting the terms of federal institutions. The federal government has defended its efforts to establish a one-person, one-vote system. In a May government briefing, officials said President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud was continuing efforts related to democratic transition, state-building and the implementation of universal suffrage elections. It would therefore be misleading to describe Somalia simply as having had “no elections.” Federal elections have faced delays and political disagreements, while electoral processes have taken place at subnational levels. A UN report, for example, documented one-person, one-vote district council elections held in Puntland in July 2024. Mukhtar Robow and his former US reward The Minister of Endowments and Religious Affairs of Somalia, Sheikh Mukhtar Robow Ali. Another issue raised in criticism of the federal government concerns Minister of Endowments and Religious Affairs Mukhtar Robow Ali, also known as Abu Mansur. The U.S. State Department announced in 2012 that its Rewards for Justice program was offering up to $5 million for information leading to Robow’s location. At the time, he was described by the U.S. government as a senior al-Shabaab leader. However, the reward was later withdrawn. The Associated Press reported in 2017 that Robow had been removed from the State Department’s Rewards for Justice list following consultations with the Somali government. There is an important distinction between that reward program and U.S. sanctions. The Treasury Department’s records show that Robow was designated as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist in 2008. Somalia’s official cabinet website currently lists Robow as the federal minister responsible for religious affairs. Somaliland and Mogadishu’s political debate The President of the Republic of Somaliland, Mr. Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi (Cirro) The political dispute in Mogadishu is also connected to relations between the federal government and Somaliland. Somaliland has continued to pursue international relations independently, while Somalia’s federal authorities oppose diplomatic initiatives that they say challenge the country’s territorial integrity. Reuters reported in June that Somaliland had expanded its engagement with Taiwan despite objections from Somalia and China. Somali and Somaliland delegations have also pursued competing diplomatic efforts in Washington as debate over U.S. policy toward Somaliland has intensified. Somali officials have said they are engaging Washington on territorial integrity, security and the country’s strategic relationship with the United States. Claims that the federal government is deliberately using the Somaliland issue to conceal poor governance are political allegations. The available evidence does not independently establish that this is the government’s purpose. A broader debate over government performance A decline in the capital’s revenue Assessments of the federal government’s performance differ sharply. Government officials point to security operations, institutional reforms, electoral preparations and international engagement, while opposition figures and critics have focused on political disputes, electoral delays and tensions with some federal member states. The United States has also expressed growing concern about Somalia’s governance and security environment. Reuters reported in September that Washington agreed to allow the United Nations another year to wind down logistical support for the African Union mission in Somalia, while maintaining its position that it would not continue supporting the UN Support Office in Somalia after the transition period. The debate therefore extends beyond domestic politics and has implications for Somalia’s relations with international partners and for the future of international security support. The dispute over Somalia’s elections The President of the Federal Republic of Somalia, Hassan Sheikh Mohamud Somalia has been working toward a transition to universal suffrage, but disagreements over the electoral system and constitutional changes have complicated the process. The European Union Agency for Asylum reported that Somalia’s political environment remained highly divided in 2026, with disagreements over the electoral model and the constitutional changes affecting the terms of federal institutions. The federal government has defended its efforts to establish a one-person, one-vote system. In a May government briefing, officials said President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud was continuing efforts related to democratic transition, state-building and the implementation of universal suffrage elections. It would therefore be misleading to describe Somalia simply as having had “no elections.” Federal elections have faced delays and political disagreements, while electoral processes have taken place at subnational levels. A UN report, for example, documented one-person, one-vote district council elections held in Puntland in July 2024. Mukhtar Robow and his former US reward The Minister of Endowments and Religious Affairs of Somalia, Sheikh Mukhtar Robow Ali. Another issue raised in criticism of the federal government concerns Minister of Endowments and Religious Affairs Mukhtar Robow Ali, also known as Abu Mansur. The U.S. State Department announced in 2012 that its Rewards for Justice program was offering up to $5 million for information leading to Robow’s location. At the time, he was described by the U.S. government as a senior al-Shabaab leader. However, the reward was later withdrawn. The Associated Press reported in 2017 that Robow had been removed from the State Department’s Rewards for Justice list following consultations with the Somali government. There is an important distinction between that reward program and U.S. sanctions. The Treasury Department’s records show that Robow was designated as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist in 2008. Somalia’s official cabinet website currently lists Robow as the federal minister responsible for religious affairs. Somaliland and Mogadishu’s political debate The President of the Republic of Somaliland, Mr. Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi (Cirro) The political dispute in Mogadishu is also connected to relations between the federal government and Somaliland. Somaliland has continued to pursue international relations independently, while Somalia’s federal authorities oppose diplomatic initiatives that they say challenge the country’s territorial integrity. Reuters reported in June that Somaliland had expanded its engagement with Taiwan despite objections from Somalia and China. Somali and Somaliland delegations have also pursued competing diplomatic efforts in Washington as debate over U.S. policy toward Somaliland has intensified. Somali officials have said they are engaging Washington on territorial integrity, security and the country’s strategic relationship with the United States. Claims that the federal government is deliberately using the Somaliland issue to conceal poor governance are political allegations. The available evidence does not independently establish that this is the government’s purpose. A broader debate over government performance A decline in the capital’s revenue Assessments of the federal government’s performance differ sharply. Government officials point to security operations, institutional reforms, electoral preparations and international engagement, while opposition figures and critics have focused on political disputes, electoral delays and tensions with some federal member states. The United States has also expressed growing concern about Somalia’s governance and security environment. Reuters reported in September that Washington agreed to allow the United Nations another year to wind down logistical support for the African Union mission in Somalia, while maintaining its position that it would not continue supporting the UN Support Office in Somalia after the transition period. The debate therefore extends beyond domestic politics and has implications for Somalia’s relations with international partners and for the future of international security support. items.title: Egypt, CIA Chief Affirm Support for Somalia’s Sovereignty
items.description: Cairo – Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi met with CIA Director John Ratcliffe in Cairo on Sunday, September 20, 2026, where both leaders reaffirmed support for Somalia’s security and stability. The meeting, also attended by Egyptian General Intelligence Director Hassan Rashad, focused on regional developments including the situations in Somalia, Sudan, Gaza, and the Horn of Africa . The talks underscore Egypt’s deepening role as a security partner in the Horn of Africa. Cairo has consistently opposed any actions undermining Somalia’s territorial integrity, particularly following Israel’s recognition of Somaliland in late 2025 . This meeting signals continued coordination between Egypt and the United States on regional security priorities. During the meeting, El-Sisi affirmed Egypt’s full support for efforts to reinforce security and stability in Somalia. He reiterated Egypt’s categorical rejection of any infringement upon Somalia’s sovereignty or territorial integrity . “Egypt views the United States as a key strategic partner in the political, security and economic spheres,” El-Sisi said during the meeting, commending ongoing coordination on regional issues . Ratcliffe expressed appreciation for Egypt’s active role in fostering security and stability across Africa. He emphasized the importance of sustained coordination between Egyptian and U.S. authorities, particularly regarding Somalia, Sudan, and international maritime security . The CIA director also commended Egypt’s pivotal role in supporting peaceful settlements to regional crises and highlighted existing cooperation between the CIA and Egyptian General Intelligence Service in counterterrorism and combating organized crime . The meeting covered multiple regional crises. On Gaza, El-Sisi called for full implementation of the second phase of the U.S.-proposed ceasefire plan, ensuring humanitarian aid access and creating conditions for a political process toward a two-state solution . Regarding Sudan, El-Sisi reaffirmed Egypt’s support for Sudan’s unity and stability, calling its sovereignty and territorial integrity “non-negotiable principles ” . The discussions also addressed the Iranian crisis, with El-Sisi supporting efforts toward a comprehensive agreement to restore regional stability and ensure freedom of international navigation . The post Egypt, CIA Chief Affirm Support for Somalia’s Sovereignty first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay oo xoojinaya iskaashiga, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo nabadda, dhaqaalaha iyo amniga cuntada
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf , iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, António Guterres , ayaa magaalada New York ku wada shir-guddoomiyey kulan heer sare ah oo u dhexeeya Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay, kaas oo looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga labada hay’adood. Kulanka waxaa lagu adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada shaqaynta Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay, gaar ahaan wax ka qabashada caqabadaha dhismeed ee horyaalla qaaradda iyo sidii Afrika ay uga heli lahayd door iyo faa’iido badan nidaamka caalamiga ah. Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay waxay si gaar ah uga wada hadleen dib-u-habaynta nidaamka maaliyadeed ee caalamka, waarta deynta iyo maaraynta deymo waara , iyadoo sidoo kale xoogga la saaray sidii dalalka Afrika ay qiimo dheeraad ah uga heli lahaayeen macdanta muhiimka ah ee qaaradda. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale sheegay baahida loo qabo in la dhammeystiro khariidadda wadajirka ah ee iskaashiga AU iyo UN-ka ee ka dambaysa sannadka 2026. Arrimaha nabadda iyo amniga ayaa ka mid ahaa qodobada ugu waaweyn ee kulanka. Labada dhinac waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen xoojinta qaab-dhismeedka nabadda iyo amniga Afrika, horumarinta diblomaasiyadda ka hortagga colaadaha iyo dhexdhexaadinta, iyo in la helo khayraadka lagama maarmaanka u ah xalalka ay Afrika hoggaaminayso. Kulanka waxaa lagu eegay xaaladaha ka jira Saaxil, Liibiya, Suudaan, Koonfurta Suudaan, Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC) . Sidoo kale waxaa la xaqiijiyey sii wadidda taageerada dadaallada dhexdhexaadinta ee Togo ka waddo xaaladda DRC. Soomaaliya oo ka mid ahayd dalalka laga hadlay Soomaaliya waxay ka mid ahayd dalalka si gaar ah loogu xusay wada-hadallada ku saabsan xaaladda nabadda iyo amniga qaaradda. Si kastaba, bayaanka Midowga Afrika ma uusan faahfaahin tallaabo cusub oo gaar ah oo Soomaaliya loogu dhawaaqay kulankan, balse wuxuu Soomaaliya ku daray dalalka laga hadlay xaaladdooda amni iyo siyaasadeed. Labada hay’adood waxay sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyeen saameynta ay Afrika ku leeyihiin colaadaha, carqaladaha silsiladaha sahayda caalamka iyo khalkhal ku yimaada marinnada muhiimka ah ee badda . Arrimahan ayaa cadaadis dheeraad ah saaraya dhaqaalaha Afrika iyo sugnaanta cuntada. Waxaa sidoo kale laga hadlay khatarta ka dhalan karta dhacdooyinka la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada , gaar ahaan marka ay sii kordhiyaan nuglaanta dalalka Afrika. Dhamaadka kulanka, AU iyo UN waxay isku raaceen in la qaado tallaabooyin la taaban karo, oo ay ka mid yihiin dhammeystirka khariidadda iskaashiga AU–UN , qorsheynta hawlgal wadajir ah oo ku saabsan Liibiya iyo Suudaan , aqoonsiga dalalka Afrika ee ugu nugul cunto-yaraanta iyo diyaarinta qorshayaal wax-ka-qabasho iyadoo la xoojinayo isku-duwidda iyo maalgelinta. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu sii adkeynayo xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay, gaar ahaan xilli qaaradda ay wajahayso caqabado dhinaca amniga, dhaqaalaha, cuntada iyo cimilada ah.

items.title: Toddoba koox oo Itoobiya uga dhowaaqay isbaheysi weyn oo xukunka looga tuurayo Abiy
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online — Toddoba urur oo isugu jira mucaarad siyaasadeed iyo kooxo hubeysan oo Itoobiyaan ah ayaa ku dhawaaqay isbahaysi cusub oo ay sheegeen inuu ujeedkiisu yahay in xilka laga tuuro xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed, laguna beddelo maamul ku-meel-gaar ah oo loo dhan yahay. Isbahaysiga cusub, oo lagu magacaabo Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Alliance for Survival , ayaa waxaa ku mideysan dhaqdhaqaaqyo ka kala socda gobollo dhowr ah oo Itoobiya ka tirsan, kuwaas oo qaarkood horey iskaga soo horjeeday dagaalladii dalka ka dhacay sannadihii u dambeeyay. Kooxaha xubnaha ka ah waxaa ka mid ah Amhara Fano National Movement, Oromo Liberation Army (OLA), Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), Ogaden National Liberation Front (ONLF), Afar Revolutionary Democratic Unity Front, Benishangul Peoples’ Liberation Movement iyo Gumuz Peoples’ Democratic Movement. Bayaan ay soo saareen ayay ku sheegeen inay isku raaceen inay mideeyaan awooddooda siyaasadeed iyo abaabulkooda, iyagoo dowladda Abiy ku eedeeyay kali-talisnimo, colaado daba-dheeraaday iyo xaalad dhaqaale oo sii xumaaneysa. “Waxaan, xoogagga shacabka ee ka walaacsan badbaadada shucuubta Itoobiya, qaadeynaa mas’uuliyadda taariikhiga ah ee ah in nidaamkan la rido,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Isbahaysigu wuxuu sheegay in haddii dowladda hadda jirta meesha laga saaro, la dhisi doono dowlad ku-meel-gaar ah oo ku shaqeysa axdi cusub, laguna bilaabo wada-hadal dastuuri ah oo loo dhan yahay. Si kastaba, bayaanka laguma faahfaahin cidda hoggaamineysa isbahaysiga, qaabka taliska milatari ama sida kooxaha xubnaha ka ah ay isugu dubbaridi doonaan howlgaladooda. Khilaafaad hore oo weli taagan Waxyaabaha isbahaysigan ka dhigaya mid si gaar ah isha loogu hayo waxaa ka mid ah taariikhda colaadeed ee u dhexeysa xubnihiisa. TPLF waxay dagaal adag la gashay dowladda federaalka intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022, halka xoogagga Amxaarada, oo Fano ay ka mid yihiin, ay markaas la dhinac ahaayeen ciidamada dowladda. OLA-na waxay xilligaas xiriir la lahayd dhinaca Tigrayga ee ka soo horjeeday Addis Ababa. Dagaalkii Tigray wuxuu si rasmi ah ugu dhammaaday heshiiskii Pretoria ee November 2022, laakiin xiriirka Addis Ababa iyo TPLF ayaa mar kale xumaaday, taasoo dhalisay cabsi laga qabo in colaado cusub ay ka qarxaan waqooyiga Itoobiya. Dhanka kale, dowladda federaalka iyo Fano ayaa dagaallamaya tan iyo 2023, kadib muran ka dhashay qorshe lagu mideynayay ciidamada gaarka ah ee gobollada iyo hay’adaha amniga federaalka. OLA-na waxay weli dagaal kula jirtaa ciidamada dowladda gudaha Oromia. Bilihii la soo dhaafay waxaa jiray warar sheegaya in TPLF, Fano, OLA iyo ONLF ay ka wada-hadlayeen iskaashi ka dhan ah Abiy Ahmed, inkastoo khilaafaad dhuleed iyo aragtiyo siyaasadeed oo aad u kala duwan ay caqabad ku noqon karaan iskaashi waara. OLA ayaa 17-kii September sheegtay in iskaashiga ka dhexeeya kooxaha mucaaradka uusan weli ka dhigneyn heshiis laga gaaray arrimaha waaweyn sida federaalka, is-maamulka iyo mustaqbalka qaab-dhismeedka Itoobiya. Isbahaysiga cusub ayaa lagu dhawaaqay saddex bilood kadib doorashadii guud ee Itoobiya, taasoo xisbiga Prosperity Party ee Abiy Ahmed uu ku helay 438 kursi oo baarlamaanka ah, sida ay shaaciyeen guddiga doorashada. Doorashadaas kama dhicin dhammaan dalka. Gobolka Tigray wax codbixin ah kama dhicin, halka amni-darro ay carqaladeysay codbixinta qeybo ka mid ah Amhara iyo Oromia. Abiy Ahmed wuxuu talada Itoobiya hayaa tan iyo 2018, wuxuuna sanadkii 2019 sameeyay xisbiga Prosperity Party kadib markii la kala diray isbahaysigii EPRDF ee muddo ku dhow 30 sano dalka maamulayay. Isbahaysiga cusub wuxuu abuurayaa saf mucaarad oo ka ballaaran kuwii hore, laakiin weli waxaa taagan su’aal ku saabsan sida kooxo leh taariikh colaadeed, muranno dhuleed iyo hadafyo siyaasadeed oo kala duwan ay hal mowqif ugu sii jiri karaan ka soo horjeedka dowladda Abiy Ahmed. The post Toddoba koox oo Itoobiya uga dhowaaqay isbaheysi weyn oo xukunka looga tuurayo Abiy appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Abiy Ahmed wuxuu talada Itoobiya hayaa tan iyo 2018, wuxuuna sanadkii 2019 sameeyay xisbiga Prosperity Party kadib markii la kala diray isbahaysigii EPRDF ee muddo ku dhow 30 sano dalka maamulayay. Isbahaysiga cusub wuxuu abuurayaa saf mucaarad oo ka ballaaran kuwii hore, laakiin weli waxaa taagan su’aal ku saabsan sida kooxo leh taariikh colaadeed, muranno dhuleed iyo hadafyo siyaasadeed oo kala duwan ay hal mowqif ugu sii jiri karaan ka soo horjeedka dowladda Abiy Ahmed. items.title: In kabadan 20,000 oo qoys oo saf u gala ceel sii guraya oo Buurxakaba u jira 8 km
items.description: (ERGO) – Qulqulka dadka biyo doonka ah ee subax walba ka jarmaada dagmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Bay ayaa joogto noqday 3 bil ee u danbeeyay, markii ay qalaleen ceelal-gacmeedyadii ay ku tiirsanaayeen. Waxay u lugeeyaan ceel la dhuro oo u jira magaalada 8 km. Biyaha ceelkan waxay u galaan safaf dhaadheer, waxaana qof kasta filashadiisu ay tahay helidda dhowr liitar oo biyo ah, balse dadka qaar ayaa dib uga soo laabta mararka qaar iyaga oo faro maran, saxmadda ka jirta ceel oo badan awgeed. Dadka caqabadda biyo helidda la daalaadhacaya waxaa ka mid ah Nuurta Xasan Ibraahim oo ku nool Buurxakaba. Galinka hore ee malintii ayay ku qaadataa in ay hesho 15 liitar oo biyo ah, waxaana ay beeqaamisaa biyahaas oo si adag ay ku hesho. Waxay sheegtay in maalmaha qaar ay ku soo hungowdo helidda biyaha. Ceelka oo sii biyo yaraynaya ayaa kuwada filnaan waayay dadka u soo aroora. Xaaladdaas ayay xustay in ay la kulanto ugu yaraan seddex mar oo ka mid ah toddobaad walba. Maalmaha ay soo hesho ayay tilmaamtay in ay dhibaato badan ka marto soo qaaditaanka biyaha. Waxaana taas u wehlisa in dadka awooda ay ka codsato in ceelka ay biyaha uga soo saaraan. “Aniga dhabarkeyga ayaa ku raadsadaa, meesha markii aan tagana waa ka tuugsadaa haddana waa la soo baxaa intii awooddayda ah, haddana lug ku imaanaa. Hal saac iyo bar ayaa loo soconaa biyahaas. Qof dameer wata ayaa kaa horeeya, mid mooto wata ayaa kaa horeysa. Jirgaankaaga ayaad ku fadhiisanaysaa inta mootaalayda ay shubanayaan.” Nuurto waxay xooggeeda iyo waqtigeeda oo dhan iskugu gaysay sidii qoyskeeda oo 10 ah ay u haraad tiri lahayd, taas oo saamayn ku yeelatay shaqooyin dhar-dhaqista, nadiifinta xafiisyada iyo isbitaallada iskugu jira oo ay subax walba u kalihi jirtay. Shaqooyinkan inta badan waxaa la qabtaa subaxa hore, balse Nuurto waxay door-biday in galinka danbe ay aaddo, markaas oo ay ka soo laabato socdaalka biyo doonka ah. Waxay xustay in dadkii ay u shaqayn jirtay ay ka maarmeen daaheeda darteed. Waxay sheegtay in dadka qaar ay siinayaan raashin dayn ama sadaqo ah, balse aysan marna ka helin biyaha oo ah baahi si guud uga wadajirta Buurxakaba, taas oo ku qasabtay in ay waqtigeeda ugu badan galiso heliddooda. Waxay ku maaraysaa qoyskeeda kiilooyin boorash ah oo laga soo siiyay billowgii bishan isbitaal ay shaqo nadafadeed ka qaban jirtay ka hor biyo yarida. Maamulka xarunta caafimaad ayay la wadaagtay howsha ku soo korortay iyo cunno xumada haysa. Maalmaha qaar dad dariskeeda ayaa soo waca iyaga oo ku wargaliya in ay u hayaan shaqo dhar-dhaqis ah oo lacag yar ay ka hesho sida ay sheegtay. “Haddii la tiraahdo; guri ii dhaq waan u dhaqaa. Haddii aan wax ka helo sida kiilo bariis ah ama $1, lacagtaas ayaan carruurta ugu soo gadnaa caanaha garoor ah. Haddii aan waxba helinna waan iska seexanaynaa. Hadda toddobadii saac ayaa la joogaa xitaa 25 senti ima soo gelin. Maxaan sameeyaa?.” Carruurteeda ayay sheegtay in ay ka cabanayaan gaajo, iyaduna aysan waxba u qaban karin. Boorashka oo gabaabsi ka sii ah ayay xustay in uusan ku filnayn carruurta haddii ay dabka u saarto, waxaa intaas u dheer iidaan la’aan. Waxay sidoo kale dhibaato ku qabaan cabidda biyaha ay ka keento ceelka la dhuro, kuwaas oo aan nadiif ahayn. Waxay sheegtay in ay kululayso si ay jeermiska uga disho, kadibna ay qaboojiso iyada oo dhigta meel hoos leh. Nuurto carruurteeda saddex ka mid ah waxay waxbarashada ka hareen bishii Julay, markii ay bixin waysay lacag ay iskuulka ku dhiganayeen. Waxay markii hore ku bixin jirtay lacag ay dhigaal-sanaysay, kuwaas oo qayb ka ahaa lacag $6 oo ay maalinle uga heli jirtay shaqada nadaafadda. Dhibaatada biyo yarida ee ka jirta Buurxakaba ayaa si guud u saamaysay dadka ku nool. Waxaa biyo la’aan noqday saddex ceel oo 20,000 oo qoys ay ku tiirsanaayeen, kuwaas soo ku kala nool Buurxakaba iyo 40 deegaan oo hoostaga sida ay sheegtay SOS Children’s Villages oo samaysay xog aruurin. Maxamed Axmed Maxamed, oo ah Isuduwaha Mashaariicda Caafimaadka iyo Nafaqada hay’addan ayaa sheegay in biyo yarida ay ka dhasheen cudurrada faafa, maaddama dadka ay dantu biday in ay cabbaan biyaha ceelasha la dhuro, kuwaas oo aan nadiif ahayn. Wuxuu xusay in ay ku howlan yihiin daawaynta dadka cudurro shubanka uu ka mid yahay ay soo riteen, kuwaas oo ay ku hayaan xarumo ay u diyaariyeen. “Celcelis ahaan bil walba waxaa la daawayn jiray 35, 36 ilaa 40 qof. Laakiin markii la soo gaaray May iyo Juun ilaa Julay dadka waxay gaareen ilaa 100 ka badan. Bilihii danbe aad bay u bateen kiisaska shubanka la dawaynayo, taasi oo saamaynteeda ay lahayd biyaha wasaqda ah ee la isticmaalaayo.” Wuxuu sheegayin kumanaan qoys ay ka barakaceen biyo yarida iyaga oo u hayamay Baydhabo tan iyo billowgii sanadkan. Kuwa ku haray magaalada iyo deegaannada ku dhow ayuu tilmaamay in ay la nool yihiin duruuf nolol xumo oo liidata. Dadka ku haray magaalada, isla markaana biyaha ku soo qaada dhabarkooda waa dumar. Waxay iskugu jiraan kuwa ilmahooda ay agoon yihiin iyo qaar lagu furay. Waxay isku kaashadaan koox koox si ay iskaga weshadaan socodka biyo doonka ah. Duniya Xasan Cabdi oo 45 jir ah caag 20 liitar qaad ah ayay ku xirtay xarig ka samaysan maryo iyo dun la isku tolay. Waxay jirgaanka ka soo laalaadisaa dhabarkeeda, waxaana xarigga ay ku qabataa gacmaha iyo qaybta hore ee wajigeeda. Waa qaabka kaliya ee ay ku xambaari karto biyaha ay soo hesho. Nidaamkan waa mid ay ka siman yihiin dadka aan haysan gaadiid ay biyaha ku qaataan. Faadumo saddexdii bil ee u danbaysay mid kasta oo ka mid ah waxay socotay ku dhawaad 500 km. Waa marka la isku daro masaafada ay lugayso maalin kasta oo ah 8 km oo soo socod iyo sii socod ah. Safarkaas ma wada noqon mid ay biyo ku helaysay. Maalmaha qaar dib ayay u soo laabanaysay iyada oo faro maran, aadna u niyad jabsan. Duniya oo ah hooyada siddeed carruur ah oo kan uu jiro labo sano waxay halgan ugu jirtaa ka samata-baxooda dhuruufaha cunno xumo iyo biyo yari “Salaadii ayaa baxaa. Hal jirgaan markaad keento kuma noqon kartid meeshaas. Feel ayaa la gala. Hal jirgaan haddaad hesho oo la timaaddo qof kasta galas ayuu ka cabaa. Ciyaalkii haddii dugsiga ay aadaan oo ka soo laabtaan waa laga ilaaliyaa ilaa la nadiifiyo. Jirkana looga nadiifiyaa. Biyo qaraar ah weeye. Lama isticmaalo qof daruuf haysta mooyee.” Tan iyo markii ay billowday in ay u aroorto ceel-biyoodka ka durugsan magaalada waxaa caqabad ku noqotay shaqo ay ka haysay maqaaxi cunnada lagu kariyo, maaddama inta badan maalintii waqtigeeda ay ku bixiso soo helidda dhowr liitar oo biyo ah. Waxay shaqadaas ku waysay duruufta haysa darteed. Waxay Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in habeenkii ay shaqo tagto iyada oo ku wareegta xaafadaha iyo maqaayadaha si ay u hesho shaqo nadaafadeed. Haddii ay hesho waxay xooggeeda ku beddelataa raashin. Carruurteeda waxay 24 saacba mar dabka loo saaraa raashin aan iidaan lahayn. Waxay sheegtay baahida ay isku dhaafiyaan, maaddama aysan heli karin cunno ku filan. Xaaladdan waxaa u dheer sida ay ku heli lahayd kirada gurga ay ku nooshahay oo labo qol ah. “Maanta 12 saac maqrabkii ayaa canbuulo loo saaray. Xaafadaha ayaa laga soo qaraabtaa, Guriga aan ku noolnahay waa kiro. Bishiaan ayaa afar ii ah oo aanan bixin. Iga bax ayaa la ileeyahay. Bishii waa $10. Aad ayaa daruuf inoo heysaa.” Waxay ka cabanaysaa dhabar xanuun la soo darsay tan iyo markii ay billowday in ay u aroorto ceel biyoodka. Waxay sheegtay in aysan seexan inta badan habeenkii, isla markaana aysan weli booqon xarun caafimaad si ay u ogaato caafimaadkeeda. Nolosha Duniya waxay waxay sawir guud ka bixinaysaa xaaladda qoysaska danyarta iyo barakaca iskugu jira, kuwaas oo ku nool Buurxakaba. Waxay daris la yihiin biyo yari iyo dhaqaale xumo sababtay cuno xumo iyo duruufo hoy la’aan ay ka mid yihiin. items.title: Markab shidaal oo marayay Hormuz oo la weeraray
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Markab shidaal ayaa lagu weeraray Marinka Hormuz, iyadoo Ururka Hawlgallada Ganacsiga Badda ee UK (UKMTO) uu sheegay in markabka lagu bartilmaameedsaday “gantaal aan la aqoon”. Weerarka ayaa dhacay xilli markabku marayay marinka muhiimka ah ee isku xira Gacanka Cumaan iyo Gacanka Faaris, waxaana dhaawac fudud kasoo gaaray laba ka mid ah shaqaalaha markabka, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil milatari. Inkasta oo weerarka uu dhacay, haddana markabku wuxuu sii watay socdaalkiisa, isaga oo ku sii jeeday dekedda uu u socday. Ilaa hadda lama soo sheegin waxyeello weyn oo markabka soo gaartay oo saameyn ku yeelatay safarkiisa. Ma jiraan warbixinno sheegaya in weerarku sababay waxyeello deegaan ama daadasho shidaal. Hay’adaha ay khusayso ayaa weli wada baaritaanno lagu ogaanayo sida uu weerarku u dhacay iyo cidda ka dambeysay. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Marinka Hormuz uu yahay mid ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan ee ay isticmaalaan maraakiibta shidaalka ee isaga kala goosha gobolka iyo suuqyada caalamka. UKMTO ayaa sidoo kale digniin u dirtay maraakiibta isticmaasha Marinka Hormuz, iyadoo kula talisay inay muujiyaan taxaddar dheeraad ah inta ay ku guda jiraan socdaalkooda aaggaasi. Hay’addu waxay maraakiibta ku boorrisay inay soo sheegaan dhaq-dhaqaaq kasta oo ay u arkaan mid shaki leh ama khatar ku ah ammaankooda, iyadoo weli socda baaritaanka la xiriira weerarka lagu qaaday markabka shidaalka. Hay’adaha ay khusayso ayaa weli wada baaritaanno lagu ogaanayo sida uu weerarku u dhacay iyo cidda ka dambeysay. items.title: Daawo: Maxaa ka dhexeeya kooxda Lafta-gareen iyo Jubbaland?
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Taliyihii hore ee Ciidamada Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, Jeneraal Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan (Shub) oo wareysi siiyay Shabelle Tv ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan xaaladda adag ee Koonfur Galbeed iyo xiriirka kooxda Lafta-gareen kala dhexeeyo Jubbaland. Mahad Cabdiraxmaan oo sodog u ah madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Gabeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in cilaaqaad wanaagsan uu ka dhexeeyo iyaga iyo madaxda sare ee maamulka Jubbaland, maadaama ay joogaan deegaanno ka tirsan maamulkaasi, gaar ahaan gobolka Gedo. Taliye Shub ayaa sidoo kale madaxweyne Axmed Madoobe iyo shacabka Jubbaland uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay muujiyeen isaga, kadib ‘duqeyntii lagula beegsaday’ gurigiisa oo ku yaalla gudaha degmada Doolow. “Jubbaland ayay ka dhaceen mudaharaadyada, Galmudugna kama dhicin, meeshii ay banaanbaxyadu ka dhaceen oo taageerada badan ii fidisay waa dowladda Jubbaland hal degmo oo arrintaas ka banaanbixin ma jirto, marka aad baan ugu mahacelinayaa wax waynba ii sameysay Jubbaland,” ayuu yiri Taliye Shub. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Meesha ay wax ugu gaareen waa Doolow meesha ugu dambeysay ee banaanbaxana waa Afmadow, waxaan kaloo si gaar ah ugu mahadcelinayaa madaxweynaha Jubbaland”. Dhinaca kale, wuxuu soo hadal qaaday xaaladda Koonfur Galbeed, isaga oo sheegay in wei ay sii wadi doonaan dagaalka, isaga oo wacad ku maray inay di ugu laabaan doonaan magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan ayaa sheegay in hadda ciidamadooda ay joogaan hareeraha magaalada, isla markaana ay sii wadi doonaan howlgalka, si ay magaalada uga saaraan dhinacyada kale ee kasoo horjeeda. “Ciidankeenna deegaankiisa ayuu joogaa horay ayuu u soconayaa Baydhabana waan taageynaa meelna kama aadeyno ninkii yimid isagaa tagi doono,” ayuu mar kae yiri taliyuhu. items.title: Madaxweynaha Maraykanka oo hanjabay iyo Iran oo ka digtay in aan la soo weearin
items.description: Donald Trump ayaa warbaahinta Fox News u sheegay inuu ku jiro “marxalad go’aan qaadasho”, isagoo tilmaamay in waqtiyada soo aadam ay dhici doonaan arrimo “aad u waaweyn” oo la xiriira Iran. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu la kulmo Madaxweynaha Iraan Masoud Pezeshkian, wuxuuna ka digay in haddii heshiis la gaari waayo, Iraan ay wajahi doonto burbur dhaqaale ama burbur baahsan. Axaddii ayey ahayd markii Iiraan ay sheegtay in ay heshay warar sheegaya in Maraykanka uu qorsheenayo weerarro ka dhan Iiraan, kuwaas oo ay waddamo Carab ah garab ku siinayaan, inkasta ooo aysan Iiraan magacaabin waddamadaasi.

items.title: God dahab ah oo ku dumay waqooyiga Suudaan, ugu yaraan 10 qof oo dhintay
items.description: God dahab laga qodo oo ku yaalla waqooyiga Suudaan ayaa dumay, waxaana ku dhintay ugu yaraan 10 qof , halka 21 qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen , sida ay sheegeen dad ka badbaaday shilkan. Burburka ayaa Sabtidii ka dhacay godad ku yaalla deegaanka Awny , oo u dhow xuduudda Suudaan iyo Masar, ayadoo Ilaa subaxnimadii Axadda, meydadka 10 qof laga soo saarayay burburka, halka 21 macdan-qode oo dhaawac ah laga soo badbaadiyay goobta. Mid ka mid ah dadkii ka badbaaday shilka ayaa sheegay in hawlgalka samatabbixinta ay inta badan sameynayeen macdan-qodayaasha laftooda , iyadoo aysan haysan qalab ku filan oo lagu fududeeyo baaritaanka iyo ka saarista dadka ku hoos jira burburka. Waxaa sidoo kale jiray walaac laga qabay in macdan-qodayaal kale ay weli ku hoos jiraan dhagxaanta iyo ciidda, iyadoo baaritaanku uu socday. Shilkan ayaa mar kale iftiimiyay khatarta ka jirta macdan-qodista yar-yar ee aan si rasmi ah loo nidaamin ee Suudaan, xilli dad badan, gaar ahaan dhalinyaro, ay ku tiirsanyihiin shaqada macdan-qodista iyagoo adeegsanaya qalab fudud, taasoo keenta in godadka aan si wanaagsan loo xoojin ay si joogto ah u dumaan. Shilkan ayaa sidoo kale dhacay hal toddobaad gudihiis kadib burbur kale oo ka dhacay gobolka Kordofan, halkaas oo ugu yaraan 82 qof lagu soo warramay inay ku dhinteen god dahab laga qodayay, iyadoo tobannaan kalena ay dhaawacmeen. Macdan-qodista dahabka ayaa muhiim u ah dhaqaalaha Suudaan, iyadoo macdan-qodista yar-yar ay shaqo siiso in ka badan laba milyan oo qof, sida ay sheegaan xogaha warshadaha. Si kastaba, dagaalka Suudaan ka socda tan iyo Abriil 2023 ayaa xaaladda uga sii daray, iyadoo dahabku uu sidoo kale noqday il dhaqaale oo muhiim u ah dhinacyada ku dagaallamaya dalka.

items.title: Puntland oo gacanta ku dhigtay ciidamo ay DF ka qoratay Mudug + Sawirro
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada ammaanka ee Puntland ayaa saaka waqooyiga magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug ku qabtay laba gaari BG ah, isla markaana siday ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Dowladda Federaalka, kuwaas oo la sheegay in laga qoray koonfurta gobolka Mudug. Wararka ayaa sheegaya ‘in ciidamada u gacan galay Puntland’ ay kasoo tallaabeen dhanka Galmudug, isla markaana ay u socdeen dugsiga tababarka Xanan-buure ee gobolka Galgaduud, balse dhexda laga qabtay. Saraakiil amni ayaa sheegay in ciidamadu ay jihada ka luntay, kadibna ay sidaas ugu gacan galeen maamul-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee Puntland oo xilligan khilaag iyo dagaalba uu kala dhexeeyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya in labada gawaari ay midkiiba saarnaayeen in ka badan 50 askari, kuwaas oo haatan lagu hayo waqooyiga magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug. Muuqaallo iyo sawirro lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinayo askarta oo saaran gawaarida, ayna joojinayaan ciidamada ammaanka ee Puntland. Dhanka kale ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay Puntland iyo dhinaca dowladda dhexe oo ku aadan ciidamadaas la sheegay inay lagu qabtay dhanka waqooyi ee Gaalkacyo, halkaas oo muddooyinkan ay ka jireen dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo iska soo horjeeda. Horay Puntland ayaa ula wareegtay xerooyin ay ciidamada dowladda ku lahaayeen gudaha maamulkaasi, kadib markii ciidamadeeda ay weerareen saldhigyo ay joogeen ciidamo la sheegay inay dowladdu ka qoratay halkaasi. items.title: Pope-ka Kaniisadda Kaatooliga ah oo ku baaqay in la taageero Soomaaliya, isagoo walaac ka muujiyay xaaladda bani’aadannimo
items.description: Pope-ka kaniisadda kaatooligga ah Pope Leo XIV ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujiyay xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee ka jirta qeybo ka mid ah Soomaaliya, isagoo ku baaqay in bulshada caalamku si degdeg ah uga jawaabto baahiyaha sii kordhaya ee shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Pope-ka ayaa hadalkan jeediyay Axaddii xilli uu dadka kula hadlayay munaasabadda Angelus ee ka dhacday Fagaaraha St. Peter’s Square ee Vatican-ka. Wuxuu sheegay inuu si weyn ula socdo xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Soomaaliya, isagoo xusay in rabshadaha iyo xaaladaha cimilo ee daran ay sii xumeynayaan duruufihii nololeed ee adkaa ee ay horay u wajahayeen dadka, gaar ahaan haweenka iyo carruurta. Pope Leo XIV ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada caalamka inay bixiso jawaab deeqsinimo leh, si dadka Soomaaliyeed ee ay xaaladdu saameysay ay u helaan gargaarka iyo adeegyada ay u baahan yihiin. Baaqan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay ay hoos u dhigeen gargaarkii bani’aadannimo ee Soomaaliya sababo la xiriira dhaqaale yari. Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan isku-duwidda arrimaha bani’aadannimada (OCHA) ayaa sheegay in kaliya ku dhowaad saddex-meelood meel miisaaniyadda uu u baahnaa la maalgeliyey. Sidoo kale, Barnaamijka Cunnada Adduunka ee Qaramada Midoobay (WFP) ayaa hoos u dhigay tirada dadka uu Soomaaliya ka caawiyo dhinaca cuntada. Sida warbixintu sheegtay, tirada dadka ka faa’iideysanayay gargaarka cuntada ayaa hoos uga dhacday qiyaastii laba milyan oo qof, iyadoo sannadka 2026 la gaarsiiyey ku dhowaad 600,000 oo qof. Dhanka kale, roobabka sannadka 2026 ayaa si weyn uga hooseeyay celceliskii caadiga ahaa qaybo badan oo gobolka ah, taasoo qoysas badan ku qasabtay inay xoolahooda u raraan deegaano kale oo ay ka heli karaan biyo iyo daaq. Hay’adda Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) ayaa iyaduna ugu baaqday deeq-bixiyeyaasha inay taageeraan dib-u-soo-celinta iyo ballaarinta adeegyada caafimaadka aasaasiga ah iyo kuwa nafaqada ee gobolka Mudug. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, in ka badan 70 xarumood oo caafimaad ayaa halkaas lagu xiray sababo la xiriira yaraanta maalgelinta. Xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Soomaaliya waxaa sidoo kale sii adkeeyay colaadaha iyo amni darrada daba-dheeraatay, ayadoo meelo qaar dadku ay wajahayaan colaado gudaha ah tan iyo burburkii dowladdii dhexe ee 1991.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo  kulan la qaatay Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaranka

items.title: Toddobo kooxood oo hubeysan oo ku dhawaaqay isbahaysi cusub oo ka dhan ah dowladda Abii Axmed
items.description: Toddobo kooxood oo hubeysan oo Itoobiyaan ah ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay sameysteen isbahaysi cusub oo ay ku mideysan yihiin, xilli kooxahan ay horey uga dhexeeyeen khilaafaad iyo dagaallo, iyagoo sheegay inay doonayaan inay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan sidii meesha looga saari lahaa dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed, isla markaana loo dhisi lahaa dowlad ku-meel-gaar ah oo loo dhan yahay. Isbahaysigan oo loogu magac daray “Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Alliance for Survival” , ama “Alliance for Survival” , ayaa lagu dhawaaqay Axaddii, iyadoo kooxuhu sheegeen inay doonayaan inay khilaafaadkooda dhinac iska dhigaan, ayna sameeyaan hannaan siyaasadeed oo cusub oo lagu soo afjaro colaadaha dalka ka socda. Isbahaysiga waxaa ku jira Amhara Fano National Movement , oo ah isbahaysi ka kooban garabyada Fano ee dagaalka kula jira ciidamada dowladda gobolka Amhara tan iyo 2023; Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) , oo muddo dheer awood siyaasadeed ku lahayd Itoobiya, isla markaana dagaal weyn la gashay dowladda federaalka intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022; iyo Oromo Liberation Army (OLA) oo dagaal kula jirta ciidamada dowladda qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Oromia tan iyo 2018. Waxaa sidoo kale ku biiray ONLF , Ugugumo , iyo jamhado kale, ayadoo isbahaysigan cusubi uu xasaasi ka dhigaya xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Itoobiya, gaar ahaan maadaama qaar ka mid ah kooxaha hadda isku dhinac noqday ay horey u ahaayeen dhinacyo iska soo horjeeday. Fano, tusaale ahaan, waxay intii lagu jiray dagaalkii Tigray garab taagnayd ciidamada dowladda federaalka, iyadoo dagaalkaas oo socday 2020 ilaa 2022 uu sababay dhimasho aad u badan iyo barakac ballaaran. Kooxaha isbahaysiga sameystay waxay dowladda Abiy Axmed ku eedeeyeen inay dalka ku maamusho waxa ay ku tilmaameen “xukun kali-talisnimo ah” , ayna Itoobiya u horseedayso kala qaybsanaan. Dhankooda, waxay sheegeen in xukuumadda ku-meel-gaarka ah ee ay doonayaan in la dhiso ay yeelan doonto hannaan lagu soo afjaro dagaallada, lagu ilaaliyo xuquuqda shacabka, laguna qabto wada-hadal qaran oo loo dhan yahay. dowladda Itoobiya ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga jawaabin ku dhawaaqista isbahaysigan, xilli  hoggaamiyeyaasha kooxahani ay sheegay in wada-hadallada lagu dhisayo isbahaysiga ay socdeen muddo ku dhow hal sano, taasoo muujinaysa in heshiiska cusub uusan ahayn tallaabo si lama filaan ah loo qaaday. Ku dhawaaqista isbahaysiga ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay mar kale sare u kacayaan xiisadaha gobolka Tigray, ayadoo heshiiskii nabadeed ee Pretoria ee 2022 ee soo afjaray dagaalkii u dhexeeyay dowladda federaalka iyo xoogaggii Tigray uu u muuqdo mid burbur qarka u saaran.

items.title: NISA oo weerar ku dishay laba horjooge iyo ilaaladooda + Magacyada
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Nabad-sugidda Soomaaliya ayaa faah-faahin dheeraad ah ka bixisay howlgal qorsheysan oo maanta ka dhacay deegaanno ka tirsan gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, kaas oo lagu beegsaday maleeshiyaad iyo horjoogayaal ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab. NISA ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in horjooge ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta iyo saddex kamid ahaa ilaaladiisa lagu dilay howlgalka oo ka dhacay deegaannada Guulane iyo Al-Furqaan, iyada oo sidoo kale la dhaawacay horjooge kale, sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka. Howlgalka oo bartimaameed ahaa ayaa dhacay xilli ay horjoogayaasha kasoo baxeen shir uga socday deegaanka, kadibna waxaa si toos ah beegsaday ciidanka dowladda iyo saaxibada caalamiga oo si wadajir ah u fuliyay howlgalka. “Ciidanka Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA), oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka, ayaa howlgallo qorsheysan oo ka dhacay deegaannada Guulane iyo Al-Furqaan ee Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ku dilay horjooge iyo saddax maleeshiyo ah oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta, halka horjooge kalena lagu dhaawacay, iyada oo hawlgalku dhacay xilli ay kasoo baxeen kulan ku qabsoomay deegaanka Guulane,” ayaa lagu yiri warka qoraalka ah ee NISA. Sidoo kale, afarta dhagar-qabe ee la dilay waxa ay kala ahaayeen Cumar Siyaad Caraaye oo ahaa horjoogaha Khawaarijta u qaabilsanaa mid ka mid ah beelaha dega Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, laba maleeshiyaad ah oo waday mootooyinka ay saarnaayeen horjoogeyaasha iyo dhagar-qabe kale oo ilaalo u ahaa. Sarkaalka la dhaawacay ayaa sidoo kale lagu magacaabaa Cabdi Maxamed Nuur oo isna ka mid ahaa horjoogeyaasha Khawaarijta u qaabilsan dhinaca qabaa’ilka. Sida ay ay sheegtay Hay’adda NISA Bartilmaameedyada waxaa si dirqi ah uga badbaaday Cabdullaahi Cali Caraaye iyo Cabdi Daalane oo qeyb ka ahaa horjoogeyaasha la beegsaday. Howlgalladan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee NISA ay ku burburinayso horjoogeyaasha iyo shabakadaha Khawaarijta, laguna wiiqayo awooddooda abaabul iyo fulinta dhagarta ka dhanka ah shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Muddooyinkii dambe Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa kordhisay beegsiga Al-Shabaab, waxaana todobaadyadii ugu dambeeyay dhacay howlgallo qorsheysan oo lagu dilay horjoogayaal iyo maleeshiyaad muhiim u ahaa kooxda. The post NISA oo weerar ku dishay laba horjooge iyo ilaaladooda + Magacyada appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Pakistan oo Soomaaliya Ka Taageeraysa Dhismaha Ciidanka Cirka
items.description: Xasan Sheekh oo Muqdisho ku qaabilay wafdi sare oo ka socda Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan MUQDISHO, 20 Sebteembar 2026 — Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ahna Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa Qasriga Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay wafdi sare oo ka socda Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca cirka iyo dhismaha awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya. Wafdiga Pakistan waxaa hoggaaminayay Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz, oo ah Taliyaha Difaaca Cirka iyo Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan. Kulanka waxaa sidoo kale ka qayb galay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Sareeye Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji. Sida ay sheegtay Wakaaladda Wararka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed (SONNA), wada-hadallada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray horumarinta awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya, tababarka iyo tayeynta ciidamada, iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan. Booqashada wafdiga Pakistan ayaa timid kaddib safar uu Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ku tagay Pakistan 4-tii Agoosto 2026. Sida ay sheegtay SONNA, booqashadaas waxaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga. Intii wafdigu ku sugnaa Muqdisho, waxaa sidoo kale la qorsheeyay kulamo ay la yeeshaan Taliska Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed si loo sii horumariyo wada-shaqeynta labada ciidan, gaar ahaan dhinaca difaaca cirka. Saraakiil iyo xubno ka tirsan jiilka cusub ee Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya ayaa ka qayb galay soo dhaweynta wafdiga. Booqashadan waxay ku soo beegmaysaa xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu dib-u-dhisayo laguna horumarinayo hay’adaha ciidamada qalabka sida. Maalmo ka hor, Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya ayaa Qaahira kula kulmay dhiggiisa Masar, waxaana labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen tababar, is-dhaafsi khibradeed iyo dhismaha awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya. Ilaa hadda, wararka la xaqiijiyay ma muujinayaan in booqashada wafdiga Pakistan ay dhalisay heshiis cusub oo gaar ah oo ku saabsan diyaarado, qalab ciidan ama nidaam difaac oo Soomaaliya ay heli doonto. Waxa la xaqiijiyay ayaa ah in labada dhinac ay ka wada hadlayaan sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga iyo awoodda difaaca cirka ee Soomaaliya. The post Pakistan oo Soomaaliya Ka Taageeraysa Dhismaha Ciidanka Cirka first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somalia’s Political Crisis Deepens as International Mediation Runs Out of Road
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s political crisis is entering a dangerous new phase, with nearly a year of international mediation failing to produce a concrete political roadmap while President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government continues to advance its electoral agenda amid deep opposition. The latest warning has come from the Future Council opposition coalition, which brings together prominent Mogadishu-based politicians and the administrations of Puntland and Jubaland. The opposition has renewed its appeal to the international community, including the United Nations, African Union, IGAD and foreign diplomatic missions in Somalia, urging greater pressure for a negotiated political settlement. The appeals come as world leaders and diplomats gather in New York for the UN General Assembly, placing Somalia’s unresolved political dispute once again before international policymakers. A Year of Mediation — But No Roadmap For almost a year, international actors have attempted to bridge the widening divide between President Hassan Sheikh and his political opponents. Several rounds of dialogue and mediation have failed to produce an agreement acceptable to the principal sides. Earlier international efforts were followed by Turkish-led initiatives, while opposition figures have continued to call for broader international involvement in the process. The central disputes include the framework for the next elections, the role of federal and regional authorities, and the political arrangements that should govern the transition toward the next national vote. Despite the impasse, the government has continued to promote its preferred electoral model. That has created a widening contradiction: international partners are calling for political dialogue while Somalia’s political actors continue to operate without an agreed national roadmap. Baidoa Has Turned the Political Dispute into a Security Crisis The consequences have become particularly visible in Baidoa, where political confrontation has escalated into armed clashes. Somali federal forces and fighters aligned with former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen clashed in Baidoa in August. The fighting involved heavy weapons and caused civilian casualties, according to reports from the area. The confrontation followed the federal government’s takeover of Baidoa earlier in the year and the subsequent political rupture between Mogadishu and Laftagareen. For Somalia’s international partners, Baidoa presents a difficult question: when political disputes between the federal government and regional actors become militarised, where should the line be drawn between counterterrorism assistance and internal political confrontation? Opposition leaders have alleged that military capabilities provided to the federal government for the fight against Al-Shabaab — including drones and other heavy weaponry — are being used against political opponents. Those allegations require independent verification. What is documented, however, is that heavy weapons have been used during clashes between federal forces and forces aligned with rival political authorities in Baidoa. Claims that F-16 aircraft have also been used in operations against opposition forces should likewise be independently verified before being presented as established fact. The Arms Embargo Question The opposition has called for the restoration of international restrictions on arms transfers to Somalia, arguing that the country’s political divisions make the unrestricted accumulation and deployment of heavy weaponry increasingly dangerous. But the legal position is more complicated than the opposition’s characterization suggests. The UN Security Council unanimously lifted the general arms embargo on Somalia’s federal government in December 2023. At the same time, the Council maintained an arms embargo against Al-Shabaab, with exemptions covering Somalia’s federal security institutions. The Council also required the Somali government to strengthen weapons and ammunition management and prevent military equipment from being transferred to unauthorized individuals or entities. The current debate is therefore not simply whether Somalia should be under a general arms embargo. It also concerns how weapons supplied to Somali security institutions are controlled, where they are deployed and whether their use remains consistent with their stated counterterrorism purpose. That distinction is increasingly important as political and military disputes overlap. International Indifference Under Scrutiny The growing frustration among opposition leaders reflects a broader concern: international engagement has produced repeated calls for dialogue but has yet to deliver a political settlement accepted by Somalia’s major stakeholders. The international community has invested heavily in Somalia’s security architecture, including support for African Union forces and Somali security institutions fighting Al-Shabaab. Yet the political foundation required to sustain that security architecture remains deeply contested. The latest decision by Washington to allow another year for the UN to wind down logistical support for AUSSOM illustrates the wider uncertainty surrounding Somalia’s security transition. The United States had initially planned to end its support for the UN logistics mechanism from January 2027 but has now agreed to a 12-month phase-down period. The extension provides additional time for a new financing and logistical arrangement. It does not resolve Somalia’s political crisis. Somalia’s international partners face a difficult choice. They can continue treating the political dispute primarily as an electoral disagreement and leave Somali leaders to negotiate at their own pace. Or they can recognize that the dispute has increasingly acquired a security dimension, particularly where federal and regional forces confront one another. The danger is not merely another failed round of negotiations. If political disagreements continue to spill into armed confrontation, international military assistance intended to strengthen Somalia’s fight against Al-Shabaab could become entangled in domestic political conflict. That would raise serious questions about civilian protection, weapons accountability and the credibility of Somalia’s broader security transition. The opposition’s appeal to the UN, AU, IGAD and diplomatic missions is therefore a demand for more than another round of statements urging dialogue. It is a call for the international community to help establish a political framework accepted by the principal Somali stakeholders before the electoral dispute becomes even more deeply militarised. Somalia Cannot Have a Security Transition Without a Political Settlement The central lesson from the past year is increasingly difficult to ignore: Somalia’s security challenges cannot be separated from its political crisis. Al-Shabaab remains a major security threat, while AUSSOM faces serious questions about its long-term financing and logistical support. At the same time, Mogadishu and key opposition and federal member-state actors remain divided over the country’s political future. More weapons alone cannot resolve those divisions. Nor can another year of mediation without a concrete political roadmap. The international community has spent years helping Somalia build security institutions. The immediate challenge is to ensure that those institutions remain focused on the national security threats they were established to confront — while Somalia’s political leaders negotiate an electoral and constitutional framework broad enough to command national acceptance. Until that happens, the widening gap between political dialogue and events on the ground risks becoming one of the most serious tests of Somalia’s fragile political and security transition. items.title: President Irro Takes Somaliland’s Recognition Fight to Capitol Hill — and Puts Strategic Partnership on the Table
items.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. (WDN) — Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi “Irro” has taken his campaign for international recognition directly to Capitol Hill, meeting one of Washington’s most prominent congressional advocates for Somaliland as Hargeisa seeks to transform its recognition bid into a broader strategic partnership with the United States. Irro met Senator Ted Cruz of Texas on Saturday to discuss Somaliland’s push for international recognition, stronger U.S.-Somaliland relations and cooperation in security, economic development and regional stability, according to Somaliland’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The meeting carries particular significance because Cruz has repeatedly urged Washington to recognize Somaliland as an independent state. In August 2025, he formally called on the Trump administration to grant recognition, arguing that Somaliland’s location along the Gulf of Aden gives it strategic importance to U.S. security interests. The message from Irro’s administration is increasingly framed around what Somaliland can offer Washington, rather than simply what it seeks from Washington. Somaliland says it wants a relationship based on shared strategic interests, mutual responsibility, security cooperation and economic partnership, rather than aid or dependency. That argument has particular resonance in a region where the Gulf of Aden, Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb have become increasingly important to international shipping and security calculations. Cruz has similarly framed Somaliland through the lens of U.S. strategic interests, including maritime security, counterterrorism and competition with China. In a 2025 letter to President Trump, he argued that Somaliland’s location and security cooperation made it an important potential U.S. partner. A Recognition Bid Meets Geopolitics The Washington campaign comes as Somaliland seeks to present itself not merely as a territory requesting diplomatic recognition, but as a potential strategic actor in the Horn of Africa. President Irro has also publicly discussed the possibility of expanded economic and security cooperation with Washington, including access to Somaliland’s strategically located port and other economic opportunities. At the same time, the diplomatic campaign faces a major unresolved question: engagement with Somaliland is increasing, but formal U.S. recognition has not followed. Reports earlier this year that Washington had already recognized Somaliland were false, according to fact-checking based on U.S. government statements. That distinction remains critical. Cruz Becomes a Key Voice on Capitol Hill For Somaliland, Cruz represents an influential congressional channel for advancing its case. Beyond his 2025 recognition appeal, Cruz pressed the U.S. State Department in July 2026 to consider a separate travel advisory for Somaliland rather than applying the same advisory to Somalia as a whole. His continued advocacy has helped keep Somaliland’s status and strategic position on the congressional agenda. For Irro, the Washington mission therefore goes beyond a single recognition request. It is an effort to persuade U.S. policymakers that Somaliland should be considered within the broader strategic calculations surrounding the Horn of Africa, Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. The Bigger Question for Washington The central question now is whether growing congressional interest will translate into a change in official U.S. policy. Somaliland has spent decades seeking international recognition. Its current Washington campaign is attempting to recast that demand in strategic terms: security cooperation, maritime interests, trade, investment and regional stability. The meeting between Irro and Cruz does not itself change U.S. policy. But it underscores the increasingly strategic way Somaliland is presenting its case in Washington — and the growing debate over how the United States should engage with Hargeisa in one of the world’s most geopolitically sensitive regions. items.title: Xasan oo qaabilay wafdiga Pakistan ee jooga Muqdisho + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa galabta qasriga madaxtooyada ku qaabilay wafdi sare oo ka socday ciidamada cirka ee dowladda Pakistan, iyada oo uu hoggaaminayay taliyaha difaaca cirka, ahna taliye ku-xigeenka ciidanka cirka Pakistan, Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz. Kulanka oo ahaa mid xasaasi ah ayaa waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb-galay wasiirka gaashaandhigga, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, taliyaha ciidanka Xoogga Soomaaliyeed, Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud iyo taliyaha ciidanka cirka Soomaaliya, Sareeye Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji. Inta uu socday kulanka ayaa waxaa looga hadlay sare u qaadista iyo dardargelinta dhismaha ciidanka cirka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidanka cirka, horumarinta tayada iyo tababarka ciidanka iyo xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan. Dadaalladan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshayaasha lagu horumarinayo laguna dhisayo Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, si loo dardargeliyo howlaha Taliska Guud ee ciidanka xds, loona xoojiyo awoodda difaaca cirka ee dalka. Kulankan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya muhiimadda ay dowladda Soomaaliya siinayso horumarinta iyo tayeynta ciidamada cirka, gaar ahaan xilli ay socdaan dadaallo lagu dhisayo ciidan Soomaaliyeed oo leh awood iyo tababar sare, kana qeyb qaata sugidda amniga iyo difaaca hawada Soomaaliya Si kastaba, kulanka manta ayaa daba socda heshiis dhanka iskaashiga difaaca ah oo ay dhowaan wada galeen labada dowladood, kaas oo ay wada saxiixeen wasiirka gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, oo horay booqasho rasmi ah ku tegay magaalada Islamabad, halka Pakistan uu u saxiixay wasiirka difaaca, Mudane Khawaja Muhammad Asif. Heshiiskaas ayaa ah mid lagu xoojinayo wada shaqeynta dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, iyada oo sidoo kale lagu horumarinayo awoodda ciidamada. Is-afgaradkan ayaa sidoo kale dhigaya in labada dhinac ay iska kaashadaan la-dagaallanka argagixisada, tababarrada ciidamada, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha, aqoonta milatari, kobcinta awoodaha difaaca iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta amniga. Waxaa kale oo uu saxiixa is-afgaradkaas muujiyay sida ay Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan uga go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirkooda istaraatiijiyadeed iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, isagoo saldhig u noqonaya wada-shaqeyn wax ku ool ah oo u adeegta danaha labada dhinac. items.title: Drone Strikes Rock Baidoa Outskirts as Political Crisis Takes Military Turn
items.description: Several Villages Reportedly Targeted as Tensions Between Federal Forces and Laftagareen-Aligned Fighters Escalate BAIDOA (WDN) — Explosions rocked the outskirts of Baidoa late last night as drones reportedly launched a series of strikes against positions believed to be occupied by forces aligned with former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. The reported airstrikes mark a dramatic new development in the escalating confrontation around Baidoa, where a bitter political dispute has increasingly spilled into the security arena. Local sources said several villages outside the South West capital were targeted after Laftagareen-aligned fighters were reportedly seen gathering in the area and preparing for possible military operations around Baidoa. The intensity and exact scale of the strikes remain unclear. There were no immediately confirmed reports of deaths or injuries, and the identity of the aircraft and the party responsible for the reported attacks could not independently be established. The developments nevertheless have heightened fears that the political confrontation over South West State could be entering a more dangerous phase, with military capabilities increasingly becoming part of the struggle between rival political forces. The reported targets were said to be areas where fighters aligned with Laftagareen had allegedly been mobilizing. However, there was no independent confirmation that those targeted were involved in preparations for an attack on Baidoa. The reports are particularly significant because of the growing sensitivity surrounding the use of drones and other advanced military capabilities in Somalia. Such weapons are primarily associated with counterterrorism operations against Al-Shabaab, making any confirmed deployment against forces linked to a political faction a potentially consequential development. For now, however, the reported strikes remain subject to verification. No official statement had been issued at the time of publication by the Somali federal government, South West authorities or Laftagareen-aligned forces confirming the attacks, identifying the targets or reporting casualties. Further details are expected as authorities respond to the overnight strikes. items.title: Garowe Lights Up as Somalia’s Political and Intellectual Voices Converge
items.description: GAROWE (WDN) — Garowe is preparing to welcome an extraordinary gathering of Somalia’s political, academic and civil society voices, as distinguished delegates converge on the Puntland capital for a major national forum on the country’s future. The city welcomed a stream of prominent guests yesterday ahead of the two-day conference, organized by the Puntland Development Research Center (PDRC), which opens on September 21 under the theme “Fragility, State-Building and Peacebuilding in Somalia.” The arrival of respected Somali intellectuals and political figures has generated a palpable sense of anticipation across Garowe, with the conference expected to provide a rare platform for open discussion about the challenges confronting Somalia and the difficult task of building durable institutions and lasting peace. Among the prominent figures arriving in Garowe were Dr. Abdirahman Abdullahi Baadiyow, Dr. Hassan Sheikh Ali Nur and Halima Ismail Ibrahim, known as Halima Yarey. More delegates are expected to arrive as the capital prepares for the formal opening of the conference. items.title: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya oo qaabilay Danjiraha Masar iyo wafdi saraakiil ciidan
items.description: Muqdisho, 20 Sebtembar 2026: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Danjiraha Jamhuuriyadda Carabta Masar u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Salaax Keshtah, iyo wafdi saraakiil ciidan ah oo booqasho ku jooga dalka. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray arrimaha la xiriira xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo milatariga ee Soomaaliya iyo Masar, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen arrimo khuseeya iskaashiga labada dal. Wafdiga saraakiisha Masar ayaa sidoo kale booqasho ku jooga Soomaaliya, iyadoo kulamadooda ay qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka iyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha difaaca ee labada dal. Kulanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya iyo Masar ay leeyihiin xiriir iskaashi oo dhinacyo badan leh, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, difaaca iyo tababarrada ciidamada.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Qasriga Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay wafdi sare oo ka socda Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan
items.description: Muqdisho: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ahna Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Dr. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa Qasriga Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay wafdi sare oo ka socda Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan. Wafdiga waxaa hoggaaminayay Taliyaha Difaaca Cirka ahna Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan, Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz. Kulanka waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb galay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed Sareeye Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji. Intii uu socday kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iyo dardargelinta dhismaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan horumarinta awoodda ciidan, tayeynta iyo tababarka ciidamada iyo xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in dadaalladan ay qeyb ka yihiin qorshayaasha lagu horumarinayo Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, si loo xoojiyo awoodda difaaca cirka ee dalka loona dardargeliyo howlaha Taliska Guud ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Somali general says he survived F-16 strike on his home
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Former Somali Custodial Corps chief General Mahad Abdirahman said an F-16 fighter jet bombed his house in the border town of Dolow, an attack he said he survived and was meant to kill him. Abdirahman, known as Shub, said the jet struck at midnight on Sept 3. In an interview with the Geed Fadhi podcast, he said he heard an F-16 roar over his house as he slept. When he fully woke, one missile had landed near his head and, within seconds, another fell in his bedroom. Somali Guardian could not independently verify his account. He did not say who owned the jet. The government’s account The federal government said earlier that it was investigating the incident and that an initial investigation showed explosives inside the house had exploded, rather than an air strike. Shub rejected that account. He said he did not know how to make bombs, that his house had never been used for such purposes, and that only Al-Shabaab knew how to make them. He said he has no affiliation with the group. Why he was targeted Shub said he had done nothing against the federal government and nothing that could justify bombing him with a warplane. He said he was resting at his home in the border town. The only thing he had done, he said, was speak in the media about what he described as land grabs by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. Videos of his comments spread widely on social media, he said, and his voice was placed over footage of people displaced by authorities. He said the government was angered by this and that he may have been targeted for that reason. Background: Turkish F-16s in Somalia Shub’s remarks came months after Turkey deployed four F-16 jets to Somalia. The jets have taken part in air strikes against Al-Shabaab and against opposition forces to the federal government, including those loyal to ousted Southwest president Abdiasis Laftagren in Bay region. Shub is linked to Laftagren and is his father-in-law. Informant and speaker claims Shub said he believed the strike was precise and guided by an informant in his house, particularly his driver. He said the man had been suspected before the strike and that officials had warned him the driver could inform on him and recommended he dismiss him. He kept him, he said, believing that even if the driver informed on him it would not harm him, and not knowing whether such a strike would ever hit him. He said the driver is now in custody. He also said parliament speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, known as Jama TikTok, phoned Hassan Sheikh Mohamud to congratulate him on the strike on his residence. According to Shub, the speaker told the president that the reports from Dolow that had deeply frustrated him would now stop, believing the strike had killed General Shub. Shub alleged that Al-Shabaab members are widespread in the government and hold high ranks, pointing at intelligence chief Mahad Salad, Minister of Religious Affairs Mukhtar Robow and Nur. He did not provide evidence for the claim that the three are Al-Shabaab members. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com
