items.title: Somalia Cannot Build Security While Its Politics Remain at War
items.description: By Abdullahi A. Nor Somalia is approaching a critical moment. After nearly a year of confrontation between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and his political opponents, international mediation has failed to produce the breakthrough many had hoped for. Meanwhile, the country’s political disagreements are increasingly spilling onto the security field. The latest decision by Washington to allow the United Nations another 12 months to wind down logistical support for the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) should therefore be understood for what it is: a postponement of a difficult security transition, not a solution to Somalia’s deeper crisis. Under the new arrangement, the United States has agreed to a 12-month transition beginning in January 2027, giving UNSOS additional time to reduce and eventually terminate its logistical support for AUSSOM. That support includes essential supplies and services such as fuel, food, medical assistance and transportation. The extra year is welcome breathing space for the African Union and the Somali government. But breathing space is not the same thing as political progress. Somalia’s Real Crisis Is Political The fundamental weakness in Somalia’s security transition is not simply a shortage of money, equipment or foreign logistical support. It is the absence of a political settlement sufficiently broad to allow the country’s institutions to function without becoming instruments of political confrontation. For almost a year, President Hassan Sheikh and his opponents have remained deeply divided over elections, constitutional arrangements, federal relations and the future distribution of political power. International mediation has attempted to bridge those differences. So far, it has failed. That failure matters because Somalia’s security institutions do not operate in a political vacuum. When federal and regional authorities disagree over legitimacy and political authority, military institutions inevitably become entangled in those disputes. Baidoa is the clearest warning. Baidoa Shows What Happens When Politics Becomes Militarised The crisis in South West State demonstrates how quickly a political dispute can become a security confrontation. Federal forces took control of Baidoa in March after relations between Mogadishu and the administration of former South West President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen collapsed. Laftagareen subsequently resigned. But the change of administration did not resolve the underlying political dispute. On August 17, federal troops and forces aligned with Laftagareen clashed in Baidoa. Heavy weapons were reportedly used during the fighting, while residents reported civilian casualties. On September 3, fighting erupted again around the city. The Federal Government accused armed groups, including Al-Shabaab, of involvement. That particular allegation remains unverified. A Baidoa hospital reportedly treated 71 wounded people following the fighting. ACLED has documented the wider pattern of violence, recording at least 78 armed engagements in Bay region between February 2 and August 28, predominantly in Baidoa district. These developments should force Somalia’s international partners to confront an uncomfortable reality: A political dispute over federal authority has developed into repeated armed confrontations involving Somali forces and rival political factions. This is no longer merely a disagreement conducted through political statements. What Are International Weapons Being Used for ? This brings us to an increasingly important question. Somalia’s international partners are providing the Federal Government with military equipment, training and other assistance to strengthen the country’s fight against Al-Shabaab. That assistance is justified by the continuing threat posed by the militant group. But opposition figures have alleged that drones and other military capabilities supplied to the Federal Government are also being used against political opponents, particularly in the confrontation surrounding Baidoa. That is a serious allegation and should be independently investigated rather than automatically accepted as fact. What is already documented, however, is the use of heavy weapons during fighting in Baidoa. That should be enough to prompt a broader question from Somalia’s international partners: Are weapons and military capabilities supplied for counterterrorism being used exclusively against armed extremist groups, or are they becoming entangled in Somalia’s internal political conflicts? The answer matters enormously. If international military assistance is used in domestic political confrontations, donors face an entirely different problem involving civilian protection, end-use monitoring and the credibility of international security assistance. AUSSOM Cannot Mediate Somalia’s Political Disputes There is a tendency in international policy circles to treat Somalia’s problems primarily as security problems. That approach is increasingly inadequate. AUSSOM can support Somali security forces. UNSOS can provide logistics. International partners can supply weapons, training and funding. But none of them can answer the fundamental political questions confronting Somalia. Who controls political authority? How will elections be conducted? What constitutional arrangements will govern federal and regional relations? How will disputes between Mogadishu and the federal member states be resolved? And, most importantly, what political rules will all major Somali actors accept? Until those questions are addressed, Somalia’s security transition will remain vulnerable to political shocks. One More Year Will Not Fix the Problem The additional 12 months of UNSOS support should be used constructively. The African Union and Somalia should use the period to establish a sustainable financing and logistical mechanism for AUSSOM. International donors should also clarify their expectations concerning the use, monitoring and accountability of military assistance. But Somalia’s political leaders must do something more fundamental. They must negotiate. The current confrontation cannot be resolved through military pressure, constitutional manoeuvring or competing claims to legitimacy. Nor can international actors indefinitely compensate for the absence of political agreement by supplying more resources to an increasingly contested security system. The extension of UNSOS may postpone a logistical crisis. It cannot postpone Somalia’s political crisis indefinitely. The International Community Should Look Beyond the Battlefield The international community has spent years helping Somalia build security institutions capable of confronting Al-Shabaab. That remains essential. But Somalia also needs institutions that are trusted across political and regional lines. A security force that is viewed by one side as a national institution and by another as an instrument of political power cannot provide the foundation for a stable federal state. The lesson from Baidoa is therefore difficult to ignore. When political disagreements remain unresolved, the security sector can become the arena in which those disagreements are fought out. And once that happens, every military deployment carries a political meaning. Somalia Needs a Political Reset The choice facing Somalia is becoming increasingly stark. It can continue down a path in which political disputes produce security confrontations, international partners provide emergency assistance and mediation efforts repeatedly stall. Or its political leaders can recognize that no military capability—whether drones, artillery, armoured vehicles or foreign logistical support—can substitute for political legitimacy and agreement. The additional year of UNSOS support is an opportunity. But it is an opportunity that Somalia cannot afford to waste. The country does not simply need more weapons, more funding or another extension. It needs a political settlement that allows those resources to serve the Somali state rather than become part of its political conflict. Until that happens, the international community may succeed in extending Somalia’s security transition without actually making it sustainable. Abdullahi A. items.title: Egypt’s Sisi rejects interference in Somalia during talks with CIA chief
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi rejected any interference that threatens Somalia’s sovereignty, unity or territorial integrity during talks with CIA Director John Ratcliffe, reaffirming Cairo’s support for Somalia’s security and stability, Egypt Today reported on Sunday. The meeting, attended by Egyptian intelligence chief Hassan Mahmoud Rashad, focused on developments in Somalia, security in the Horn of Africa and international maritime security, according to the report. Sisi reiterated Egypt’s opposition to any actions that could undermine Somalia’s sovereignty or territorial integrity, while reaffirming Cairo’s support for efforts to strengthen the country’s security and stability. Ratcliffe praised Egypt’s role in supporting stability in Africa and called for continued coordination between Cairo and Washington on regional security, the report said. The two sides also discussed strengthening intelligence cooperation to counter terrorism, organised crime and cross-border threats affecting the Red Sea and the wider region. The talks highlighted the security links between developments in Somalia, the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea, where threats to maritime security can have consequences beyond the region. Egypt and the United States have maintained security and intelligence cooperation on terrorism, transnational crime and regional stability, with the Red Sea and Horn of Africa remaining important areas of strategic concern. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Roshan Reddy oo lagu la’yahay Jabuuti
items.description: Jabuuti (Caasimada Online) – Roshan Micah Reddy oo ah suxufi baara musuq-maasuqa, maamulka dowladda iyo siyaasadda ayaa lagu la’yahay Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti, halkaas oo uu u joogay howlo la xiriira shaqadiisa, sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Difaaca Suxufiyiinta ee CPJ. Suxufigan u dhashay Koonfur Afrika ayaa waxaa lala la’yahay qof deegaanka ah oo la socday, kaas oo magaciisa lagu sheegay Kooki Mahmoud. Walaaca laga qabo halka ay ku dambeeyeen labada qof ayaa yimid kadib markii aan la helin wax xog ah oo ku saabsan xaaladdooda, iyadoo CPJ ay dowladda Jabuuti ka dalbatay inay caddeyso halka ay ku sugan yihiin iyo xaaladda suxufiga. Hay’addu waxay si gaar ah u codsatay in la xaqiijiyo haddii Reddy la xiray ama la afduubtay, iyadoo sheegtay inay walaac ka qabto xog la’aanta ku saabsan suxufiga Koonfur Afrikaanka ah. Reddy ayaa si qoto dheer u baara arrimaha la xiriira musuq-maasuqa, maamulka dowladda iyo siyaasadda, wuxuuna fadhigiisu yahay magaalada Johannesburg ee Koonfur Afrika. Reddy ayaa lagu yaqaan inuu xog-ururin iyo baaritaanno kadib soo gudbiyo macluumaadka uu helo. Reddy ayaa horey u booqday dalal kala duwan, halkaas oo uu kasoo diyaariyay warbixinno ku saabsan musuq-maasuqa, siyaasadda iyo habka ay u shaqeeyaan dowladaha maamula dalalka uu tagay. Warbixinnada uu horey u baahiyay ayaa dhaliyay falcelinno kala duwan, taas oo qayb ka ah walaaca hadda laga muujinayo xaaladdiisa inta uu ku sugan yahay Jabuuti. Waxaa jira warar aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin oo sheegaya in Reddy la xiray, hase yeeshee ilaa hadda ma jirto xaqiijin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan warkaas ama xaaladda labada qof. Dowladda uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle ayaa laga sugayaa inay ka jawaabto baaqa CPJ iyo inay bixiso xog rasmi ah oo ku saabsan halka uu ku dambeeyay suxufigan. The post Roshan Reddy oo lagu la’yahay Jabuuti appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maraykanka oo Boosaaso Ku Xoojinaya Joogitaankiisa
items.description: Maraykanka oo Puntland Ku Xoojinaya Joogitaankiisa Milatari, Boosaaso oo Noqonaysa Xarun Muhiim ah Maraykanka ayaa si muuqata u xoojinaya iskaashiga amni ee uu la leeyahay Puntland, iyadoo heshiis cusub oo la saxiixay bishii Agoosto uu dhigayo in la ballaariyo joogitaanka milatari ee Mareykanka ee magaalada Boosaaso. Tallaabadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Washington ay kordhisay howlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxaha hubeysan ee waqooyiga Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada lagu sugayo amniga Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. 2-dii Agoosto 2026, Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa Boosaaso kula kulmay wafdi ka socday AFRICOM oo uu hoggaaminayay Major General Claude Tudor, taliyaha U.S. Special Operations Command Africa. Puntland waxay sheegtay in labada dhinac ay kala saxiixdeen heshiis lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiga amniga, gaar ahaan la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo ilaalinta amniga badaha. Puntland waxay heshiiska ku tilmaantay mid u oggolaanaya Maraykanka inuu ballaariyo saldhiggiisa Boosaaso. Hase yeeshee, faahfaahinta heshiiska sida cabbirka xarunta, tirada ciidamada Maraykanka ee la filayo inay halkaas joogaan iyo muddada heshiisku soconayo si rasmi ah looma shaacin. World Politics Review ayaa sidoo kale xustay in Pentagon-ka uusan si rasmi ah uga hadlin qorshaha saldhigga. Maxaa Boosaaso muhiim uga dhigaya Maraykanka? Boosaaso waxay ku taallaa xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed, meel u dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Sidaas darteed, goobtu waxay leedahay muhiimad dhinaca amniga badda iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ganacsiga. Isla waqtigaas, buuraha Cal Miskaad ee gobolka Bari ayaa ah goob ay muddo ka howlgalaan dagaalyahanno ka tirsan ISIS-Somalia. Maraykanka ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay Puntland kala shaqeynayay howlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxdaas. AFRICOM waxay hore u xaqiijisay duqeymo ka dhan ah ISIS-Somalia oo ka dhacay buuraha Golis ee Puntland, oo ay ku jirto duqeyn dhacday Sebtembar 2025. Warbixinno ay soo xigteen warbaahin maxalli ah ayaa sheegay in diyaaradaha Maraykanka ay 3-dii Sebteembar 2026 sameeyeen hawlgallo sahamin ah oo ka dhacay Cal Miskaad, iyadoo la sheegay in duqeymo lagu qaaday goobo ay joogeen xubno looga shakisan yahay ISIS. Hase yeeshee, AFRICOM ma aysan soo saarin bayaan rasmi ah oo xaqiijinaya duqeymahaas gaarka ah, sidaas darteed xogtan weli waxay ku salaysan tahay warbixinno maxalli ah iyo ilo amni oo Puntland ah. Maraykanka oo si rasmi ah u aqoonsanaya dowladda federaalka Inkasta oo heshiiska Boosaaso uu si toos ah u dhexmaray Puntland iyo wafdi militari oo Maraykan ah, haddana bayaannada rasmiga ah ee AFRICOM waxay muujinayaan in Washington weli dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya u aqoonsan tahay dhinaca ay si rasmi ah ula xiriirto marka laga hadlayo duqeymaha milatari. Tusaale ahaan, 17-kii Sebteembar AFRICOM waxay sheegtay in ciidamada Maraykanku duqeyn ka fuliyeen gobolka Sanaag, qiyaastii 80 kiiloomitir koonfur-galbeed Boosaaso, iyagoo sheegay in hawlgalka lagu fuliyay “isuduwid” lala sameeyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Bayaankaas kuma xusin Puntland. Arrintan ayaa muhiim noqotay kadib markii Puntland iyo dowladda federaalku ay si weyn ugu kala aragti duwan yihiin maamulka amniga iyo awoodaha dowladda dhexe ee dalka. Warbixin dhowaan la daabacay ayaa xustay in AFRICOM iyo Puntland ay bixiyeen warar kala duwan oo ku saabsan cidda lala xiriiriyay hawlgalka 17-ka Sebteembar. Khilaafka Muqdisho iyo Garoowe Heshiiska Boosaaso wuxuu yimid xilli xiriirka Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka uu aad u xumaaday. Bishii Agoosto, ciidamada Puntland waxay la wareegeen xarumo ay joogeen ciidamo la safnaa dowladda federaalka, oo ay ku jireen xarun ku taalla Boosaaso. Dhacdooyinkaas waxay daba socdeen khilaafyo amni iyo siyaasadeed oo muddo socday. Qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ayaa heshiiska Mareykanka iyo Puntland ku xiray xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo rabitaanka Washington ee ah inay si toos ah ula shaqeyso maamullada awoodda ku leh goobaha ay ka jiraan khataraha amni. World Politics Review waxay ku doodday in qaabkan uu abuuri karo su’aalo ku saabsan sida iskaashiga amni ee Mareykanku ula jaanqaadayo xasilloonida iyo midnimada siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Tani waa aragti falanqeyn ah, mana aha mowqif rasmi ah oo dowladda Mareykanka ama Soomaaliya ay sidaas u qeexeen. Dagaalka ISIS iyo amniga badda Joogitaanka cusub ee Boosaaso wuxuu isku xirayaa laba arrimood oo Washington muhiim u ah: dagaalka kooxaha hubeysan iyo amniga marin-biyoodka Gacanka Cadmeed. Puntland ayaa muddo waday howlgallo ka dhan ah ISIS ee buuraha Cal Miskaad, halka Maraykanku uu siinayay taageero dhinaca cirka iyo sirdoonka ah. Isla markaana, Gacanka Cadmeed wuxuu muhiim u yahay maraakiibta isaga kala goosha Badda Cas, Bariga Afrika iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Bishii Agoosto, kulamo kale oo dhexmaray Puntland iyo saraakiisha AFRICOM ayaa diiradda lagu saaray qorshaha xarunta Boosaaso, dagaalka ka dhanka ah ISIS iyo Al-Shabaab, la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo tababarka ciidamada Puntland. items.title: Maleeshiyaad DCSH ah oo weerar ku qaaday guri qoys oo ku yaalla deegaanka Kayaxa
items.description: Qandala, 20 Sebteembar 2026: Maleeshiyaad ka tirsan DCSH ayaa weerar ku qaaday guri qoys degan deegaanka Kayaxa, oo u dhow tuulada Sheebaab ee magaalada Qandala, kaas oo la sheegay inuu lahaa sarkaal ka tirsan Ciidanka Daraawiishta Puntland. Weerarka ayaa lagu qaaday xilli guriga ay ku jireen saddex carruur ah oo yaryar, hooyadood iyo ayeeyadood. Sida uu sheegay Siciid Cali Oorshe oo ah aabbaha qoyska, maleeshiyaadka ayaa guriga ku weeraray rasaas iyo bambooyin gacanta laga tuuro. items.title: Waftigii madaxweynaha Somaliland oo la kulmay Jaaliyadda Somaliland ee woqooyiga Ameerika.
items.description: Waxa aan xalay Washington D.C. kulan ballaadhan oo muhiim ah kula yeeshay Jaaliyadda Somaliland ee Woqooyiga Ameerika. Waxa aan uga mahadceliyey kaalinta mugga leh ee ay kaga jiraan horumarinta dalka, kobcinta dhaqaalaha, daryeelka bulshada iyo u doodista qaddiyadda aqoonsiga Somaliland. Waxa aan sidoo kale la wadaagay natiijooyinka iyo horumarka laga gaadhay kulamadii diblomaasiyadeed ee aanu Washington kula yeelannay masuuliyiinta Maraykanka, xubnaha labada Aqal ee Congress-ka iyo hay’adaha siyaasadeed ee saamaynta leh. Waxa aan Jaaliyadda iyo guud ahaan Qurba-joogga Somaliland ugu baaqayaa inay mar walba ilaaliyaan midnimada iyo isku-duubnida, dalkoodana meel kasta si sharaf iyo masuuliyad leh ugu matalaan, kana qayb qaataan nabadda, xasilloonida iyo horumarka Qaranka. Aqoonsiga Somaliland waa xaq taariikheed iyo sharci ah oo hubaal dhammaystirmaya; waxaana dhammaanteen ina saaran waajib Qaran oo ah ilaalinta Qarannimadeenna iyo difaaca qaddiyaddeenna.

items.title: Jeneraalka Ruushka ee “Hero of Russia” oo Drone Lagu Dilay
items.description: Jeneraal Ruush ah oo lagu dilay weerar drone ah oo ka dhacay Donetsk DONETSK, Ukraine Major General Anton Grunis, oo ahaa taliyaha Guutada 4-aad ee Gaadiidka Ciidanka Ruushka, ayaa lagu dilay weerar drone ah oo ka dhacay qayb ka mid ah gobolka Donetsk ee ay Ruushku maamulaan, sida ay sheegeen ciidamada Ukraine. Robert “Madyar” Brovdi, taliyaha Ciidamada Nidaamyada aan Duuliyaha lahayn ee Ukraine, ayaa 16-kii Sebteembar sheegay in Grunis lagu dilay weerar habeenkii 12-kii Sebteembar lagu qaaday goob uu ku sugnaa. Sida uu sheegay, weerarka waxaa fuliyay cutubka Rarog ee guutada 427-aad ee Ciidamada Nidaamyada aan Duuliyaha lahayn ee Ukraine. Warbaahinta Reuters ayaa xaqiijisay in Grunis uu dhintay, iyadoo sidoo kale sheegtay in taliyaha Ruushka Apti Alaudinov uu xaqiijiyay geeridiisa, inkastoo uusan faahfaahin ka bixin sababta ama goobta uu ku dhintay. Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka si rasmi ah ugama aysan hadlin warbixinta weerarka. Grunis wuxuu ahaa taliyaha Guutada 4-aad ee Ilaalada ee Ciidamada Lugta Matoorka ee Ruushka. Magaciisa ayaa si weyn loo xusay bishii Luulyo, kaddib markii uu madaxweyne Vladimir Putin uga warbixiyay hawlgallada ciidamada Ruushka ee magaalada Kostiantynivka ee gobolka Donetsk. Moscow waxay sheegtay in ciidamadeedu ay la wareegeen magaalada, halka Ukraine iyo falanqeeyayaal madax-bannaan ay muran geliyeen sheegashadaas. Dabayaaqadii Agoosto, Grunis waxaa la guddoonsiiyay billadda Gold Star waxaana loo magacaabay “Hero of Russia”, oo ah mid ka mid ah abaalmarinnada ugu sarreeya ee Ruushka. Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka ayaa sheegtay in abaalmarinta lagu siiyay geesinimo iyo hawlgal milatari. Geeridiisa ayaa timid wax ka yar saddex toddobaad kaddib markii la guddoonsiiyay abaalmarinta. Sida ay sheegtay Ukraine, Grunis wuxuu noqday sarkaalka toddobaad ee darajo sare heer guuto, qayb ciidan ama ciidan-qaran—oo ay Ciidamada Nidaamyada aan Duuliyaha lahayn ee Ukraine sheegaan inay ku dileen weerarro drone ah. Tiradaas waa sheegashada dhinaca Ukraine, mana jirto xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo dhammaan kiisaskaas ah. Dilka Grunis wuxuu kusoo beegmayaa xilli labada dhinac ay si isa soo taraysa ugu tiirsan yihiin diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn si ay u beegsadaan xarumaha taliska, gaadiidka iyo goobaha ciidamada ee jiidda dagaalka. Gobolka Donetsk ayaa weli ah mid ka mid ah goobaha ugu muhiimsan ee dagaalka, iyadoo Ruushku doonayo inuu sii ballaariyo gacan-ku-hayntiisa dhulka Donbas, halka Ukraine ay isku dayayso inay joojiso horumarka ciidamada Ruushka. The post Jeneraalka Ruushka ee “Hero of Russia” oo Drone Lagu Dilay first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Wasiirka Warfaafinta oo la kulmay Wakiilka UNDP ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho, 20 Sebtembar 2026: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdifitaax Qaasim Maxamuud, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Wakiilka Hay’adda Horumarinta Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNDP), Mudane Christophoros Politis. Wakiilka UNDP ayaa markii uu yimid xarunta Wasaaradda waxaa soo dhaweeyay Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda, Mudane Cabdullaahi Xayir Ducaale, isagoo sidoo kale booqday xarumaha Warbaahinta Qaranka iyo kaydka taariikhiga ah ee Radio Muqdisho. Booqashada ayaa lagu soo bandhigay shaqada ka socota xarumaha warbaahinta qaranka iyo dadaallada lagu ilaalinayo dhaxalka taariikhiga ah ee warbaahinta Soomaaliya. Kulanka Wasiirka iyo Wakiilka UNDP ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta wada-shaqeynta Wasaaradda iyo UNDP, gaar ahaan dhinacyada warbaahinta, xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah, wacyigelinta bulshada, dhaqanka iyo dalxiiska. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay horumarinta awoodda warbaahinta, taageerada wacyigelinta doorashooyinka, ka hortagga wararka been-abuurka ah iyo marin-habaabinta, ka hortagga xagjirnimada rabshadaha wata (PCVE), iyo horumarinta dhaqanka iyo dalxiiska Soomaaliya. Wasiirka ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in wada-hadallada labada dhinac loo beddelo iskaashi farsamo oo la taaban karo, iyadoo la dejinayo mudnaanta, qorshe fulineed iyo hannaan joogto ah oo lagu isku-duwo Wasaaradda iyo UNDP. Labada dhinac ayaa isku raacay in la sii wado wada-hadallada farsamo, si fursadaha iskaashi ee la isla gartay loogu beddelo barnaamijyo iyo hawlo wax ku ool ah. Kulanka waxaa dhinaca Wasaaradda ka qeyb galay Agaasimaha Guud Cabdullaahi Xayir Ducaale, Agaasimaha Waaxda Istiraatiijiyadda Xiriirka Warbaahinta Cabdishakuur Cali Axmed iyo Agaasimaha SONNA Ismaaciil Mukhtaar Cumar, halka dhinaca UNDP ay ka qeyb galeen mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan qeybaha xiriirka dowladda, siyaasadda iyo warbaahinta.

items.title: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya oo qaabilay Danjiraha Masar iyo wafdi saraakiil ciidan
items.description: Muqdisho, 20 Sebtembar 2026: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Danjiraha Jamhuuriyadda Carabta Masar u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Salaax Keshtah, iyo wafdi saraakiil ciidan ah oo booqasho ku jooga dalka. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray arrimaha la xiriira xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo milatariga ee Soomaaliya iyo Masar, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen arrimo khuseeya iskaashiga labada dal. Wafdiga saraakiisha Masar ayaa sidoo kale booqasho ku jooga Soomaaliya, iyadoo kulamadooda ay qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka iyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha difaaca ee labada dal. Kulanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya iyo Masar ay leeyihiin xiriir iskaashi oo dhinacyo badan leh, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, difaaca iyo tababarrada ciidamada.

items.title: Muxuu danjire David Shinn ka yiri suurta-galnimada aqoonsi Mareykanku siiyo Somaliland?
items.description: Washignton (Caasimada Online) — Rajada Somaliland ay ka qabto inay aqoonsi ka hesho Mareykanka ayaa u muuqata mid sii yaraanaysa, inkastoo Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro uu Washington ka wado olole cusub oo uu taageero ugu raadinayo arrintaas. David Shinn, oo hore u soo noqday safiirka Mareykanka ee Itoobiya, isla markaana muddo dheer la socday arrimaha Somaliland, ayaa sheegay inuu markii hore rumeysnaa in Washington ay raaci karto tallaabadii Israel ee aqoonsiga Somaliland, balse hadda uu arko in fursaddaasi ay sii dhammaaneyso. “Kadib aqoonsigii Israel, waxaan u maleynayay in aqoonsiga Mareykanka uu aad ugu dhow yahay. Laakiin taasi ma dhicin,” ayuu Shinn u sheegay New Lines Magazine . “Hadda waxaan aaminsanahay in fursaddii ay dhaaftay,” ayuu raaciyay. Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa Mareykanka gaaray 5-tii September, isagoo bilaabay booqasho muddo bil ah soconeysa oo maamulkiisu rajeynayo inuu ku kasbado taageerada xildhibaannada iyo mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka. Warbaahinta New Lines ayaa sheegtay in wafdigiisu doonayo inuu la kulmo Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Marco Rubio ama Madaxweyne Donald Trump, inkastoo aan la hubin in labadaas kulan midkood uu dhici doono. Si kastaba, dowladda Mareykanka weli wax isbeddel ah kuma sameyn mowqifkeeda rasmiga ah ee ku aaddan midnimada Soomaaliya. Warbixin ay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka bishii June u gudbisay Congress-ka ayaa mar kale xaqiijisay in Washington ay aqoonsan tahay “madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed” ee Soomaaliya, oo Somaliland ay ku jirto, inkastoo warbixintu sidoo kale xustay fursado iskaashi oo amni, diblomaasiyadeed iyo ganacsi oo dhex mari kara Mareykanka iyo Hargeysa. Iskaashi aan u baahneyn aqoonsi Michael Woldemariam, oo ah bare ka tirsan Jaamacadda Maryland, kana faallooda arrimaha amniga Afrika, ayaa sheegay in caqabadda ugu weyn ee Somaliland hortaalla aysan ahayn oo keliya inay Mareykanka ka dhaadhiciso qiimaheeda istaraatiijiyadeed. Sida uu sheegay, Washington waxay heli kartaa waxyaabaha ay Somaliland ka rabto iyadoo aan wax aqoonsi ah siin. “Haddii Mareykanku wax uga baahan yahay Somaliland, wuu heli karaa isaga oo aan ku qasbanaan inuu aqoonsi bixiyo, taas oo sababi karta falcelin ka timaadda saaxiibada gobolka, laga bilaabo Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti ilaa Midowga Afrika iyo Khaliijka,” ayuu Woldemariam u sheegay New Lines . Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah ololaha Somaliland ay ku xayeysiineyso Berbera, oo dekeddeeda, garoonkeeda diyaaradaha iyo goobta ay kaga taallo dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed ee Yemen ay Hargeysa u aragto hanti istaraatiiji ah oo Mareykanka soo jiidan karta. Laakiin Mareykanka ayaa horey saldhigga Camp Lemonnier ugu leh Jabuuti, kaas oo ah saldhiggiisa joogtada ah ee ugu weyn Afrika, wuxuuna sidoo kale sii ballaarinayaa joogitaankiisa militari ee Boosaaso. Bishii August, taliyaha Ciidamada Howlgallada Gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Afrika, Major General Claude Tudor, ayaa Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni la gaaray heshiis lagu ballaarinayo joogitaanka militariga Mareykanka ee Boosaaso. Boosaaso ayaa ciidamada Mareykanka u dhoweyneysa fariisimaha kooxda Daacish ee Puntland, iyadoo isla markaana siinaysa marin dhow oo ay uga shaqeeyaan Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Maxay Berbera soo kordhin kartaa? Shinn ayaa sheegay in Berbera ay faa’iido yeelan karto haddii Mareykanku mararka qaar u baahdo meel kale oo ay diyaarado ama maraakiib isticmaalaan, balse uusan arkin baahi loo qabo in halkaas laga dhiso saldhig weyn oo buuxa. “Berbera in keyd ahaan loo isticmaalo waa mid faa’iido yeelan kartaa,” ayuu yiri, balse wuxuu sheegay inuusan “arkin baahida loo qabo in halkaas laga dhiso saldhig dhammaystiran,” gaar ahaan xilli ciidamada Mareykanka ay wajahayaan cadaadis dhinaca miisaaniyadda ah. Shinn ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in aqoonsiga Somaliland uu dhaawac weyn ku keeni karo xiriirka Washington iyo Muqdisho, xilli Mareykanku weli Soomaaliya uga baahan yahay iskaashi ku saabsan howlgalada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. items.fullContent: Washignton (Caasimada Online) — Rajada Somaliland ay ka qabto inay aqoonsi ka hesho Mareykanka ayaa u muuqata mid sii yaraanaysa, inkastoo Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro uu Washington ka wado olole cusub oo uu taageero ugu raadinayo arrintaas. David Shinn, oo hore u soo noqday safiirka Mareykanka ee Itoobiya, isla markaana muddo dheer la socday arrimaha Somaliland, ayaa sheegay inuu markii hore rumeysnaa in Washington ay raaci karto tallaabadii Israel ee aqoonsiga Somaliland, balse hadda uu arko in fursaddaasi ay sii dhammaaneyso. “Kadib aqoonsigii Israel, waxaan u maleynayay in aqoonsiga Mareykanka uu aad ugu dhow yahay. Laakiin taasi ma dhicin,” ayuu Shinn u sheegay New Lines Magazine . “Hadda waxaan aaminsanahay in fursaddii ay dhaaftay,” ayuu raaciyay. Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa Mareykanka gaaray 5-tii September, isagoo bilaabay booqasho muddo bil ah soconeysa oo maamulkiisu rajeynayo inuu ku kasbado taageerada xildhibaannada iyo mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka. Warbaahinta New Lines ayaa sheegtay in wafdigiisu doonayo inuu la kulmo Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Marco Rubio ama Madaxweyne Donald Trump, inkastoo aan la hubin in labadaas kulan midkood uu dhici doono. Si kastaba, dowladda Mareykanka weli wax isbeddel ah kuma sameyn mowqifkeeda rasmiga ah ee ku aaddan midnimada Soomaaliya. Warbixin ay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka bishii June u gudbisay Congress-ka ayaa mar kale xaqiijisay in Washington ay aqoonsan tahay “madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed” ee Soomaaliya, oo Somaliland ay ku jirto, inkastoo warbixintu sidoo kale xustay fursado iskaashi oo amni, diblomaasiyadeed iyo ganacsi oo dhex mari kara Mareykanka iyo Hargeysa. Iskaashi aan u baahneyn aqoonsi Michael Woldemariam, oo ah bare ka tirsan Jaamacadda Maryland, kana faallooda arrimaha amniga Afrika, ayaa sheegay in caqabadda ugu weyn ee Somaliland hortaalla aysan ahayn oo keliya inay Mareykanka ka dhaadhiciso qiimaheeda istaraatiijiyadeed. Sida uu sheegay, Washington waxay heli kartaa waxyaabaha ay Somaliland ka rabto iyadoo aan wax aqoonsi ah siin. “Haddii Mareykanku wax uga baahan yahay Somaliland, wuu heli karaa isaga oo aan ku qasbanaan inuu aqoonsi bixiyo, taas oo sababi karta falcelin ka timaadda saaxiibada gobolka, laga bilaabo Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti ilaa Midowga Afrika iyo Khaliijka,” ayuu Woldemariam u sheegay New Lines . items.title: Sacuudiga oo dalalka Yurub gaarsiiyey farriin gilgili karta
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa hakisay qaar ka mid ah shidaalkii ceyriinka ahaa ee ay u diri jirtay warshadaha sifeynta ee Yurub, xilli dagaalka sii ballaaranaya ee Bariga Dhexe uu cadaadis xooggan saarayo sahayda tamarta caalamka. Boqortooyada ayaa ugu yaraan laba shirkadood oo Yurub ku yaalla ku wargelisay inaysan heli doonin qeybtii shidaalka ee loo qorsheeyay bishii October, sida ay werisay Middle East Eye. Warshadaha sifeynta ee Yurub ayaa shidaalka Sacuudiga inta badan ku hela heshiisyo muddo dheer ah oo loogu talagalay in lagu xaqiijiyo sahay bille ah. Hase yeeshee, shirkadaha tamarta ayaa xaaladaha aan caadiga ahayn awood u leh inay hakad geliyaan ama baajiyaan shixnadaha, iyagoo adeegsanaya qodobka loo yaqaan force majeure . Go’aanka Sacuudiga ayaa imanaya iyadoo colaadda gobolka ay durba saameyn weyn ku yeelatay marinada ugu muhiimsan ee shidaalka iyo gaaska laga dhoofiyo Khaliijka. Qatar ayaa horraantii bishan kordhisay muddada force majeure ee qaar ka mid ah shixnadaha gaaska dabiiciga ah ee LNG illaa horraanta November, sababo la xiriira xannibaadda maraakiibta ee Marinka Hormuz. Dhuun muhiim ah oo la weeraray Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa markii hore u muuqatay inay ka badbaadi karto qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah carqaladaha Hormuz, sababtoo ah dhuunta East-West Pipeline oo shidaalka ka qaadda bariga dalka kuna geeysa dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas. Dhuuntaasi waxay Riyadh u saamaxday inay ka fogaato Marinka Hormuz, iyadoo qaadi kartay qiyaastii afar milyan oo fuusto maalintii, xilli dagaalku si weyn u yareeyay isu socodka maraakiibta ee marin-biyoodkaas. Hase yeeshee, weerar diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo dhacay toddobaadkii hore ayaa hakad geliyay dhuunta. Sacuudi Carabiya waxay sheegtay in weerarka laga soo qaaday dhinaca Ciraaq, halkaas oo ay ku sugan yihiin kooxo hubeysan oo xiriir la leh Iran. Weerarka ayaa sidoo kale saameeyay dhoofinta dekedda Yanbu, taas oo muhiimad gaar ah yeelatay tan iyo markii marinka Hormuz uu galay xaalad adag. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah shixnadihii Yurub loo waday la baajiyay, halka rarista shidaalka ee Yanbu la hakiyay. Xuuthiyiinta Yemen ayaa iyaguna sheegtay weerarro lagu qaaday Yanbu iyo xarumo kale oo ay leedahay shirkadda Saudi Aramco, iyadoo dagaalka Yemen uu mar kale si toos ah ugu soo laabtay gudaha Sacuudiga. Sabtidii, kooxda ayaa sheegatay weerarro cusub oo gantaallo iyo drones ah oo lagu qaaday Riyadh iyo xarun Aramco oo ku taalla Yanbu. Qiimaha shidaalka oo sare u kacay Carqaladaha cusub ayaa cadaadis ku kordhiyay suuqyada tamarta, iyadoo qiimaha shidaalka Brent uu toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay ka gudbay $100 fuustadii. Qiimuhu wuxuu kor u kacay gaar ahaan markii la ogaaday in dhuunta East-West ay shaqada joojisay iyo in qaar ka mid ah dhoofintii Sacuudiga la hakiyay. Brent ayaa Talaadadii gaaray $108.75 fuustadii, inkastoo uu maalintii xigtay hoos ugu dhacay $105.83 kadib markii Riyadh ay bilowday inay sahay dheeraad ah u mariso Cumaan. Saameyntu kuma koobna shidaalka ceyriinka ah. Sicirka naaftada iyo shidaalka diyaaradaha ayaa sidoo kale sare u kacay, iyadoo yaraanta sahayda iyo kharashka gaadiidka badda ay culeys dheeraad ah saarayaan Yurub iyo suuqyada kale. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa hadda isku dayaysa waddooyin kale oo ay ku sii waddo dhoofinta, waxaana ka mid ah shixnado loo marinayo Cumaan iyo marinno ku xiran Badda Cas iyo Mediterranean-ka. Dagaalkii Yemen oo dib u soo laba kacleeyay Xiisadda hadda jirta waxay dib u soo celisay khilaafkii muddada dheer u dhexeeyay Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Xuuthiyiinta. Riyadh ayaa 2015 hoggaamisay isbahaysi Carbeed oo dagaal ku qaaday Xuuthiyiinta kadib markii kooxdaasi ay la wareegtay Sanca iyo qeybo badan oo waqooyiga iyo galbeedka Yemen ah. Dagaalka ayaa si weyn u yaraaday kadib xabbad-joojintii 2022, iyadoo Sacuudigu bilaabay dadaallo uu uga baxayo colaadda. Laakiin dagaalladii dhowaan dib u qarxay ayaa xaaladda beddelay, Xuuthiyiintuna waxay ballaariyeen weerarrada ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga iyo kaabayaasha tamarta. Kooxdu waxay ku doodaysaa in Sacuudigu weli xannibaad ku hayo dekedaha iyo garoomada ay maamusho, waxayna sheegtay in qaadista xannibaaddaasi ay muhiim u tahay joojinta weerarrada ka dhanka ah boqortooyada. Xiisadda cusub ayaa muujisay nuglaanta marinada tamarta ee gobolka. Marinka Hormuz oo carqaladeysan iyo weerarrada lagu qaaday dhuunta East-West waxay halis gelinayaan laba waddo oo Sacuudi Carabiya iyo waddamada kale ee Khaliijku ku tiirsan yihiin si ay shidaalkooda u gaarsiiyaan suuqyada caalamka. items.title: Inside Somaliland: How Berbera Port is central to the Red Sea’s power struggle
items.description: Inside Somaliland: How Berbera Port is central to the Red Sea’s power struggle DP World’s investment in Berbera has been hamstrung by regional politics, but the UAE is deepening its military footprint in the historic entrepot A general view at dusk of Berbera Port, the official seaport of Berbera, the commercial capital of Somaliland, on 18 February 2026 (Tony Karumba/AFP) Sean Mathews in Berbera Published date: 20 September 2026 09:53 BST | Last update: 37 mins 12 secs ago “Berbera is the heart of Somaliland,” Jama Mohamed Ahmed, the commercial director of DP World in the Horn of Africa, tells me by way of introduction. We meet outside the glistening, reflective glass office building that is the UAE logistics giant’s headquarters in the Horn of Africa, in a country only recognised by Israel and closely aligned with the Emirates. The building could be any sterile corporate office in middle America or the Gulf; besides that, there is the large sign at the entrance with a wad of green leaves crossed out in red, titled: “No Kat” – the stimulant leaf chewed across the Horn of Africa and Southern Arabia. Of course, Berbera’s importance ripples far beyond Somaliland. For centuries, the port has been an entry point to Africa and entrepôt between the near and far East. Its importance was documented as early as the 1st century by an unknown Greek-speaking traveller in the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea, a historic account of the region’s ancient trading ports Malao, as Berbera was then called, was a “peaceable market-town” where copper, cloth, gold coins and glass were imported from India, and frankincense, myrrh, and cinnamon were exported to Arabia, along with some slaves. Today, Berbera sits at the centre of a raging geopolitical and economic battle to dominate the wider Red Sea. Pick a war, and Berbera could well be one of its flashpoints. Across the Gulf of Aden, Yemen’s Houthis are warily watching Israel and the UAE entrench themselves at a military base here. Meanwhile, to the south, Somalia, flush with new arms from Turkey, sees Berbera typifying the independent ambitions of Somalilanders which need to be stamped out. But for Ahmed, Berbera is all about jobs. DP World is owned by the Dubai government. Its $45m investment here in 2016 transformed the decaying port, which now employs 1,350 people, he tells me. Arriving from the West on a desert highway, Berbera announces itself beyond the sandy haze and acacia trees with a bevvy of ship-to-shore gantries rising like phalanxes over dozens of white fuel storage tanks. This is a one-business town. Ahmed is tall and lean. I see a little of Yemen in his sharp features. They remind me of the mixing and mingling between East Africa and Southern Arabia. He wears pressed grey slacks and a striped button-down, which I find common among Somaliland’s growing professional class. Walking me into his air-conditioned office, Ahmed tells me that Somalis trained by DP World in Berbera are going to Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, to work at the berths that DP World and Abu Dhabi Ports Group took a stake in three years ago. “We are now exporting knowledge,” he says proudly. “Before DP World came, everything at the port was done manually; we even used to carry wheelbarrows of cash in on payday. From software to physical infrastructure, there have been huge improvements.” The port embodies how the UAE is expanding its influence across East Africa – filling the void left by the US, Russia and even China. More than other corners of the Red Sea region, however, Somaliland was ripe for the UAE. 18 days sailing from China My journey to Berbera started in Jijiga, the growing capital of Ethiopia’s Somali region. From the Ethiopian border to the coast, the drive was smooth as stone along a 250-kilometre highway built by the UAE and guarded casually, but professionally, by Somaliland’s UAE-trained military. Signs emblazoned with the UAE’s flag dotted the highway unobtrusively, but appeared just enough to remind travellers who made this infrastructure possible. Just outside Berbera is a boarding school donated by the Gulf state. To ensure the quickest journey to the Gulf of Aden possible, the UAE even built a bypass around Hargeisa, Somaliland’s traffic-ridden capital, to accommodate lorries. Shipping containers are loaded and off-loaded onto the vessel Okee August at Berbera Port, on 31 August 2021 (Ed RAM/AFP) Somaliland is a former British protectorate. The empire’s colonial legacy here was lighter than in places like Egypt or India. Somaliland was home to the famed Camel Corps, in which a handful of British officers administered tribal law, called Xeer , and ensured the provisioning of Aden – a critical refuelling station across the Gulf-with livestock. In 1960, Somaliland won its independence, five days before neighbouring Somalia – which had been colonised by Italy. The two united to form the Somali Republic, but millions of Somalis in Ethiopia, Kenya and Djibouti – a former French colony – were left out of the union. From the start, the two territories suffered from an uneasy coexistence that culminated in Somali ruler Mohamed Siad Barre overseeing a military onslaught against Somaliland in the late 1980s. Somaliland declared its independence in 1991 after a decade of war, escaping the civil war and instability that later engulfed Somalia. But until Israel’s January 2026 diplomatic deal, the breakaway republic went unrecognised. The UAE’s readiness to invest in Somaliland gave it an outsized role here, and with commercial ties have come a military footprint. In 2017, the UAE established a military base at Berbera. Recent satellite imagery shared by open-source analysts suggests the UAE has expanded its presence at the city’s airport with new surface-to-air-missile sites, radar facilities and hangars. The UAE is also building a naval facility a few kilometres away from the commercial port. The construction has coincided with rising tensions not just between the UAE and Saudi Arabia, but also between Israel and the Houthis. The US-Israeli war on Iran hangs heavy over Berbera. Ahmed has felt its impact. “Our transshipment business with Jebel Ali, Salalah and Colombo suffered,” he said, listing the big ports of the UAE, Oman and Sri Lanka. “The last port we had going was Jeddah, but that stopped with the Houthi attacks,” he said. But many in East Africa see the war creating new opportunities for Berbera because of the need for alternative trade corridors. “The Persian Gulf is vulnerable. Ships there are trapped. The logistics aren’t dependable. Business will come to the Red Sea,” one well-informed businessman in Addis Ababa with port interests told me before I left for Somaliland. Ahmed agreed. “All the cargo coming from East Asia was transshipped to Gulf ports,” he said, using the industry term for when cargo is unloaded at one port before being sent to its final destination. “Now, they can come to Berbera. We are just 18 days sailing from China.” This kind of thinking offers one case for why Dubai diversified its port empire beyond the Gulf. But DP World’s commercial involvement in Berbera emerged alongside shifting security priorities. ‘The UAE filled a vacuum’ The year before the UAE and Somaliland inked their port deal, neighbouring Djibouti evicted DP World and Emirati troops stationed in the country. At the time, the UAE was allied with Saudi Arabia, and used Djibouti as a base to wage war against Yemen’s Houthis. Somaliland and Djibouti are decades-old rivals. The former French colony has been controlled since 1999 by Ismail Omar Guelleh, a wily Somali politician who has used Djibouti’s strategic position to rake in rents in return for port access. China and the US both have military bases there. Landlocked Ethiopia pays Djibouti roughly $2bn a year to access the sea. Somaliland saw a window of opportunity. English Somaliland Camel Corps troopers in 1913, between Berbera and Odwein in modern day Somaliland, a breakaway republic recognised only by Israel (National Archive of The Hague/Wikimedia) “Security and investment would go hand-in-hand,” Bashe Omar, Somaliland’s former ambassador to the UAE, who negotiated the 2016 port deal, said. I met Bashe in Hergaisa to better understand Somaliland’s motivations. He has a sonorous British accent, a trimmed goatee and a shaved head. He came to our meeting in an elegant ultramarine colored jellabiyad . “We weren’t looking for a one-sided agreement with the UAE. We wanted a partner,” he said. I asked Omar why Somaliland gravitated to the UAE. After all, its closer Gulf neighbour is Saudi Arabia, which purchases most of its livestock – a critical export and source of revenue for the government in Hargeisa. “Until Mohammed bin Salman, Saudi Arabia was very inward. The UAE filled the vacuum,” he said, referring to the Saudi Arabian crown prince. Saudi Arabia joined Egypt, Turkey and other Muslim states condemning Israel’s January 2026 recognition of Somaliland. Bashe told me that Somaliland wants good ties to Riyadh. “Saudi Arabia is discussing their Red Sea security. I don’t think their interests are served betting on Mogadishu. The Saudis’ historic ties have always been with Berbera,” he said. Saudi Arabia’s Hijaz region has centuries-old links to Berbera, but Riyadh reacted quickly to condemn Israel’s December 2026 recognition of Somaliland, unlike the UAE. Riyadh criticised the move for entrenching “unilateral separatist measures”. Since the US-Israeli war on Iran, Saudi Arabia has signed a mutual defence pact with Turkey, Somalia’s main foreign backer. Berbera has certainly come in handy for the UAE in its increasingly hot rivalry with Saudi Arabia. Abu Dhabi has used the airport as a stopover for flights carrying military equipment to the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), Reuters reported in December 2024. The RSF is battling Sudan’s military, which is backed by Egypt, Turkey and Saudi Arabia. Earlier this year, the UAE evacuated its ally and leader of Yemen’s Southern separatist movement, Aidarus al-Zubaidi, to Berbera, after Saudi Arabia attacked the group. Berbera sits at such a strategic intersection that it lends itself as a bargaining chip. The explorer Richard Francis Burton once came here in 1854 scouting for the East India Company. In his classic travelogue, First Footsteps in East Africa , Burton extolled the virtues of Berbera, which he christened “the emporium of East Africa” over Aden. Burton noted its “salubrious climate, abundance of sweet water…[and] excellent port”, although he would later take a javelin to the face in Berbera during a fight with Somali warriors. Berbera’s Somali rulers saw its appeal, too. As early as 1979, Said Barre offered the US access to the Soviet Union’s former naval and air base at Berbera after Moscow cast him aside as a proxy in favour of Ethiopia. The US came to Berbera in the mid-1980s, revamping its 15,000-foot airport runway – the largest in Africa. While Berbera’s military value has grown, it’s questionable how much the port is earning its keep in DP World’s portfolio. ‘Emporium of the East’ For DP World, Berbera is a gateway to the increasingly arable and industrialising southern region of Ethiopia, Africa’s second-largest country. “Berbera is designed to be the port for southern Ethiopia,” the businessman in Addis Ababa told me. In January 2024, Somaliland and Ethiopia signed a sweeping deal granting landlocked Ethiopia a 50-year lease on a swath of Somaliland’s coast. In exchange for a naval base and access to Berbera, Addis Ababa agreed to recognise Somaliland. The agreement would have been a boon for DP World. Thanks to the UAE’s investments, the port’s container capacity is 500,000 TEUs, logistics terminology for half a million twenty-foot containers. Its capacity to handle bulk cargo is two million tonnes. L to R: UAE Vice President Mohamed bin Rashid al-Maktoum, President Mohamed bin Zayed al-Nahyan, and Sharjah ruler in Abu Dhabi, on 27 May 2026 (Ryan Carter/UAE presidential Court/AFP) But the deal was never implemented, and the port is operating at roughly 30 percent capacity, Ahmed told me. Addis Ababa’s move to recognise Somaliland sparked ferocious pushback from Mogadishu, which threatened to expel Ethiopian troops based in Somalia fighting al- Shabab. Egypt also mobilised against a deal that would give its longtime rival access to the Red Sea. Turkey, which has extensive military and economic ties with Somalia, intervened and negotiated a climbdown for Ethiopia, which it has sold drones to. Ahmed took me on a tour of the port. We drove past men in safety vests, muscle shirts, and Macawis, colourful fabrics wrapped around their waists. Despite the sweltering late-summer heat and humidity, the men worked diligently. In 2023, the World Bank ranked Berbera as the most efficient port in sub-Saharan Africa. Grain from Russia was being bagged from one vessel for a final truck shipment to Ethiopia and South Sudan. Containers from China destined for Egypt were being unloaded before a new vessel arrived to take them onwards. Workers unloaded Indian sugar cane and Malaysian wood for Somaliland’s domestic market. Ethiopia’s quest for port access remains unfulfilled. Ahmed is confident the port will live up to its potential. “All the infrastructure is here. It’s only a matter of time,” he said. Meanwhile, the UAE has a new ally in Israel to deepen military cooperation in Berbera. “That’s the base over there,” my driver said, after we passed the columned British colonial villas and Ottoman mosque on the city’s outskirts – reminders of Berbera’s old rulers. Back in Hergaisa, when I told one Somaliland elder that I visited Berbera, he ruminated wistfully. “Our traders once went all the way to Nairobi from Berbera. Now everything is compartmentalised.” Leaving Berbera, I could feel its untapped potential. Ethiopia is close to the UAE and Israel. It has no qualms about Somaliland’s diplomatic deal with the former. But I wondered whether Somaliland’s decision to establish diplomatic relations with Israel only made it more isolated in the wider region. The path is wide open to an Israeli base here. The Somalilanders make no secret of their wish to deepen defence ties. “I would support a base for both the US and Israel in Berbera because it would make Somalia think twice,” Bashe said. Berbera has seen so many foreign powers come and go. I asked Bashe about the risks of the US or Israel entrenching themselves at the port. “If America came to Berbera and attacked the Houthis, for example, the Houthis would retaliate. So if they use Berbera for that, it should be in exchange for recognition,” he said. For the foreseeable future, Berbera’s commercial prospects will remain subservient to geopolitics.   Source Middle East Eye

items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo xoojineysa diyaar-garowga saameynta El-Niño
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa kulan la qaatay Guddiga Heer Wasiir ee Diyaar-garowga iyo Ka Jawaabidda Saamaynta El-Niño. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xaaladda cimilada iyo saadaasha roobabka El-Niño, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray qorshayaasha lagu xoojinayo diyaar-garowga iyo ka jawaabidda saameynta roobabka xooggan iyo fatahaadaha laga cabsi qabo inay saameeyaan bulshada ku nool deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. Guddiga ayaa Hoggaamiyaha warbixin ka siiyay qorshayaasha diyaar-garowga, wacyigelinta bulshada, kaydinta raashinka iyo dawooyinka, iyo isku-duwidda hay’adaha dowladda iyo bah-wadaagta samafalka ee ka howlgala gobolka. Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa faray guddiga in la dardargeliyo qorshayaasha ka hortagga iyo u diyaar-garowga saameynta El-Niño, si loo yareeyo khataraha fatahaadaha iyo dhibaatooyinka kale ee ka dhalan kara roobabka xooggan. Waxa uu sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in mudnaanta koowaad la siiyo badbaadinta nolosha iyo hantida shacabka, iyadoo la xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta dowladda, maamulka degmooyinka, bulshada deegaanka iyo hay’adaha samafalka. items.title: Somalia Faces Critical Security Transition as AUSSOM Support Comes Under Strain
items.description: MOGADISHU—Somalia could face a significant security transition as uncertainty grows over the future of international support for the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), the International Crisis Group (ICG) has warned in a new report. The report says AUSSOM remains heavily dependent on the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) for essential logistical services, including food, water, fuel, transportation and support to military bases across southern Somalia. Any major reduction in that assistance could significantly affect the mission’s ability to sustain operations. AUSSOM’s military presence has declined substantially from nearly 22,000 personnel in the mid-2010s to an estimated 12,000 troops, according to the ICG, amid growing financial and operational pressures. Somalia has meanwhile expanded and strengthened its national security forces, with more than 10,000 personnel trained with assistance from Türkiye, the United Arab Emirates and Eritrea. However, the ICG says Somali forces are not yet capable of fully assuming all responsibilities currently carried out by AUSSOM. The report also identifies political divisions as a major obstacle to building a unified national security structure. Tensions between the Federal Government and federal member states, particularly Puntland and Jubaland, could complicate efforts to coordinate military operations and establish a cohesive national force. Somalia’s bilateral security partnerships with Uganda, Kenya and Ethiopia could become increasingly important if AUSSOM is reduced or eventually withdrawn. The ICG notes that existing agreements could facilitate the continued deployment of troops from those countries under bilateral arrangements with Mogadishu. Türkiye’s expanding role in Somalia’s security sector is also highlighted, with Ankara having trained thousands of Somali troops. The United States, meanwhile, continues to conduct targeted counterterrorism operations against Al-Shabaab. The ICG warns that a complete withdrawal of UNSOS support could make it difficult for AUSSOM to maintain its current operational capacity. Areas vacated by African Union forces could become vulnerable to attacks or territorial advances by Al-Shabaab if Somali forces are unable to immediately fill emerging security gaps. The organization has called for urgent contingency planning to protect major cities, strategic roads and other critical infrastructure during any future transition. Somali forces, alongside troops from countries with bilateral security agreements, could play a greater role in maintaining security. The ICG has urged the Somali government and its international partners to develop a comprehensive security strategy ahead of expected changes to UNSOS and AUSSOM. The report also cautions that an expanding network of bilateral security arrangements could create competing spheres of influence across Somalia if they are not coordinated through a unified national framework. The ICG concludes that sustainable security will depend on Somalia’s ability to build a capable, nationally coordinated security force that can gradually assume greater responsibility for the country’s security, while addressing the political disputes that continue to undermine national security coordination. items.title: Abiy oo qaaday tallaabo kale oo la xiriirta damaciisa badda
items.description: New Delhi (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Ahmed ayaa ajandaha dalkiisa ee helitaanka marin-badeed u qaaday heer caalami ah, kadib markii uu arrintaasi si toos ah uga hadlay shirkii 18-aad ee madaxda dalalka BRICS ee lagu qabtay magaalada New Delhi ee dalka Hindiya. Abiy oo ka hadlayay shirka ayaa helitaanka badda ku xiriiriyay baahida Itoobiya ee ah inay dhaqaalaheeda sii koraya ku xirto suuqyada caalamka, isaga oo sheegay in maalgelinta oo keliya aysan ku filneyn dal doonaya inuu ballaariyo ganacsigiisa. “Helitaanka maalgelinta waa inay barbar socotaa helitaanka suuqyada,” ayuu yiri Abiy, isagoo intaas ku daray in ganacsigu ku tiirsan yahay dhaqdhaqaaq hufan oo lacagta iyo badeecadaha ah. Waxa uu markaas si toos ah ugu gudbay arrinta badda, isaga oo yiri: “Itoobiya, helitaanka badda marka ugu horreysa waa baahi dhaqaale.” Abiy ayaa sheegay in Itoobiya, oo ah dal leh dad badan iyo dhaqaale sii kobcaya, ay u baahan tahay marinno ganacsi oo lagu kalsoonaan karo oo kala duwan, si loo yareeyo kharashaadka, loo xoojiyo adkeysiga dhaqaalaha, loona abuuro fursado dhaqaale oo ballaaran. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku celiyay in Addis Ababa ay arrintan ku raadin doonto waddo nabadeed iyo heshiisyo wada xaajood lagu gaaro. Shirkii BRICS ee New Delhi, oo dhacay 12-13 September, waxaa ka qeyb galay hoggaamiyeyaasha qaar ka mid ah dalalka ugu awoodda badan dhaqaalaha soo koraya, oo ay ka mid yihiin Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Hindiya Narendra Modi, Madaxweynaha Shiinaha Xi Jinping, Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin, Madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah el-Sisi iyo Madaxweynaha Koonfur Afrika Cyril Ramaphosa. BRICS ayaa hadda ka kooban 11 dal, kuwaas oo marka la isku daro matala ku dhowaad kala bar dadka dunida, qiyaastii 40 boqolkiiba wax-soo-saarka caalamka iyo 26 boqolkiiba ganacsiga adduunka, sida ay sheegtay dowladda Hindiya. Sidaas darteed, hadalka Abiy wuxuu gaarayay dhegeystayaal aad uga ballaaran dalalka Geeska Afrika, isagoo arrinta marin-badeedka Itoobiya hordhigay dowlado iyo hay’ado saameyn weyn ku leh ganacsiga, maalgelinta iyo kaabeyaasha caalamka. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah istaraatiijiyad Itoobiya si tartiib ah u ballaarineysay tan iyo 2023, markaas oo Abiy Ahmed dib ugu soo celiyay doodda gudaha baahida dalkiisa ee helitaanka badda. Itoobiya ayaa kadib arrinta u gudbisay diblomaasiyadda gobolka iyo tan Afrika, iyadoo raadineysa heshiisyo ay la gaarto dalalka deriska ah. Abiy ayaa sidoo kale arrintan ka hadlay shirkii BRICS ee Kazan ee 2024, ka hor inta uusan mar kale miiska soo saarin New Delhi. Muhiimadda BRICS u leeyahay Itoobiya waxaa sii xoojinaya xiriirka dhaqaale ee ay Addis Ababa la leedahay xubnaha ururka. In ka badan 40 boqolkiiba badeecadaha Itoobiya dibadda ka soo dhoofsato ayaa ka yimaada dalalka BRICS, sida ay muujinayaan xogta hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay ee Ganacsiga iyo Horumarinta. Shiinaha ayaa kamid ah saaxiibada ugu waaweyn Itoobiya ee dhinacyada kaabeyaasha iyo warshadaha, halka Hindiya ay Itoobiya la leedahay iskaashi istaraatiiji ah. Xiriirka Ruushka ayaa isna sii xoogeysanayay, iyadoo Putin uu Itoobiya ku tilmaamay “saaxiib muddo dheer ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo” oo Ruushku ku leeyahay Afrika. Xiisaddii Soomaaliya Hadalka Abiy ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Soomaaliya, oo labadii sano ee la soo dhaafay khilaaf xooggan kala dhexeeyay Itoobiya arrinta badda, inkastoo labada dowladood ay dabayaaqadii 2024 heshiis ku gaareen Ankara. Khilaafka labada dal ayaa cirka isku shareeray bishii Janaayo 2024, markii Itoobiya ay is-afgarad la gashay Somaliland, kaas oo la xiriiray marin ay Itoobiya ka hesho xeebaha waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa tallaabadaas si adag uga hortimid, iyadoo ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. Xiisaddaas ayaa ugu dambeyn horseeday wadahadallo ay Turkigu dhex-dhexaadiyeen. Bishii December 2024, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Abiy Ahmed waxay Ankara ku gaareen heshiis ay labada dowladood dib ugu xaqiijiyeen ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee midba midka kale. Heshiiska Ankara wuxuu sidoo kale aqoonsaday baahida Itoobiya ee marin ganacsi oo lagu kalsoonaan karo, balse wuxuu si cad u qeexay in heshiis kasta oo noocaas ahi uu ku dhacayo hoos yimaada awoodda madax-bannaan ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa bishii Febraayo 2025 Ankara ka bilaabay wada-hadallo farsamo oo lagu raadinayo qaabka Itoobiya marin ganacsi uga heli karto badda iyadoo aan lagu xadgudbin madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Hase yeeshee, hadalka cusub ee Abiy wuxuu muujinayaa in Addis Ababa aysan arrinta badda ku koobeynin wada-hadallada Soomaaliya iyo dalalka kale ee gobolka. items.title: Taliyaha ciidanka xoogga dalka oo saxiixay sharciga adag oo ka hortagayo tacdiga loo geysto Haweenka
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa saxiixay Ka Hortagga iyo Wax-ka-qabashada Tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah Haweenka Xilliyada Colaadaha. Qoraal kasoo baxay xafiiska taliyaha ciidanka xoogga, ayaa lagu sheegay in amarkan uu xoojinayo dadaallada lagu hor istaagayo tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka, gaar ahaan kuwa ka dhaca xilliyada colaadaha, iyadoo la adkeynayo ilaalinta xuquuqda, karaamada iyo badqabka haweenka. Sidoo kale tallaabadan ayaa la tilmaamay in Dadejinayso waajibaadyo cad oo la xiriira ka hortagga, soo-sheegidda, baaritaanka iyo wax-ka-qabashada kiisaska tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka, iyadoo la raacayo shuruucda dalka iyo xeerarka caalamiga ah ee khuseeya ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah xilliyada colaadaha. Saxiixa Amarka Taliyaha ayaa la sheegay inuu ka dhashay wada-shaqeyn iyo dadaallo joogto ah oo ay wadeen Kooxda Xuquuqda Aadanaha iyo Ilaalinta ee UNTMIS iyo Wakiilka Gaarka ah ee Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Tacaddiyada Galmada ee la Xiriira Colaadaha, kuwaas oo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed kala shaqeynayay sidii ka hortagga iyo wax-ka-qabashada tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka xilliyada colaadaha The post Taliyaha ciidanka xoogga dalka oo saxiixay sharciga adag oo ka hortagayo tacdiga loo geysto Haweenka appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Dad badan oo kundhintay weerar Ukraine ay ku qaaday Ruushka
items.description: Moscow ( Raxanreeb Online) Ugu yaraan laba qof ayaa ku dhintay, lix kalena way ku dhaawacmeen weerar “baaxad weyn” oo habeenimo oo ay diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Ukraine ku qaadeen gobolka Moscow, sida uu sheegay guddoomiyaha gobolka, Andrei Vorobyev. Vorobyev wuxuu sheegay in 249 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn la soo riday, wuxuuna sidoo kale sheegay in dab ka kacay dhowr guri oo la deggan yahay. Bakhaar ku yaalla deegaanka ayaa sidoo kale dab qabsaday. Magaalada Moscow, warshad sifaysa shidaalka ayaa waxyeello soo gaartay, waxaana laba garoon diyaaradeed lagu soo rogay xayiraado duulimaad. Horaantii, sarkaal Ukraine ah ayaa sheegay in toddoba qof, oo ay ku jiraan laba carruur ah, lagu dilay weerarro ay Ruushku Sabtidii ka geysteen gobollada Kyiv iyo Sumy. Ruushka iyo Ukraine ayaa dhawaan kordhiyay weerarradooda, iyagoo bartilmaameedsanaya xarumaha tamarta iyo gaadiidka, iyo sidoo kale xarumaha waaweyn ee saadka. items.title: SOMALIA: Opposition Warns of Arms Diversion, Demands UN Embargo and International Dialogue
items.description: MOGADISHU — The Somali Salvation Council, an opposition coalition comprising the regional administrations of Puntland and Jubbaland, has formally addressed a series of diplomatic notes to the international community, including the United Nations and multiple foreign embassies, outlining its grave concerns over the prevailing political and security situation in Somalia. In the correspondence, the coalition alleges that military hardware and equipment have been diverted for use in internal political disputes and therefore demands the reimposition of the United Nations arms embargo on Somalia. The council further calls upon the UN and international stakeholders to spearhead an all-inclusive political dialogue process that brings together all parties affected by the current crisis. The opposition also insists that any political agreement reached through such dialogue must be underpinned by international guarantees and a robust enforcement mechanism to prevent a recurrence of past failures in implementing peace accords. The letters highlight deep apprehensions regarding election-related disputes, constitutional review processes, and the broader trajectory of Somalia’s political system. The Somali Salvation Council has previously taken part in international mediation efforts, including the Kampala talks on the future of foreign security forces in Somalia, during which it proposed an interim electoral management framework. The council argued then, as it does now, that the federal government’s mandate has expired and that the government lacks the impartiality required to oversee a credible electoral process. This latest diplomatic push comes at a time of persistent friction between the Federal Government of Somalia and opposition factions over electoral timelines, constitutional amendments, and the management of political transition. Should the council’s appeals gain traction within international circles, Somalia could enter a renewed phase of mediated dialogue. However, the federal government and other key actors continue to maintain divergent positions on how to resolve the deepening political impasse. items.title: Xasan oo shaaciyay macdano qaali ah oo la xaqiijiyay in ay Soomaaliya ku jiraan
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shaaciyay in la xaqiijiyay jiritaanka macdano muhiim ah oo ku jira dhulka Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo ay kamid yihiin uranium, lithium iyo cobalt. Hadalkan ayuu Madaxweynuhu sheegay xilli uu furayay Madasha Maaliyadda Horumarinta Soomaaliya oo looga hadlayay arrimo la xiriira kobcinta dhaqaalaha, soo jiidashada maalgashiga iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa ilaha dakhliga dalka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay leedahay khayraad dabiici ah oo kala duwan, kuwaas oo ay kamid yihiin macdanta dhulka hoostiisa, kalluumeysiga, xoolaha iyo beeraha, balse loo baahan yahay khibrad, maalgashi iyo iskaashi caalami ah si khayraadkaasi looga faa’iidaysto. “Maanta dunidu waxay si weyn u danaynaysaa macdanta, gaar ahaan waxa loo yaqaan macdanta dhifka ah. Haddii ay tahay uranium, lithium, cobalt iyo kuwo kale oo badan oo dunidu hadda raadineyso, waxaa la xaqiijiyay inay Soomaaliya ku jiraan,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Dhinaca maalgashiga, Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay xoogga saarayso abuurista jawi ku habboon oo ay maalgashadayaasha Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa caalamiga ah dalka ugu soo laaban karaan, iyadoo la doonayo in la ballaariyo fursadaha dhaqaale. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in kalsoonida maalgashadayaasha ay ku xiran tahay xasillooni, sharciyo cad iyo hay’ado awood u leh inay si hufan u shaqeeyaan. Wuxuu arrimahaas ku xiray horumarinta warshadaha, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo nidaamyada fududeynaya ganacsiga. Intii ay socotay Madasha Maaliyadda Horumarinta Soomaaliya, waxaa lagu soo bandhigay qorshayaal ay dowladdu sheegtay inay ku wajahan yihiin ballaarinta kobaca dhaqaalaha, kordhinta maalgashiga iyo dhisidda saldhigyo dhaqaale oo horseeda horumar waara. Si kastaba, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh si rasmi ah uma uusan xusin goobta ama meelaha laga helay macdanaha uu sheegay in Soomaaliya laga xaqiijiyay inay ku jiraan, iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya ay xilligan sidoo kale ku howlan tahay qorshayaal la xiriira soo saarista shidaalka. items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa saxiixay Ka Hortagga iyo Wax-ka-qabashada Tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah Haweenka Xilliyada Colaadaha. Amarkan wuxuu xoojinayaa dadaallada lagu hor istaagayo tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka, gaar ahaan kuwa ka dhaca xilliyada colaadaha, iyadoo la adkeynayo ilaalinta xuquuqda, karaamada iyo badqabka haweenka. sidoo kale Wuxuu Dadejinayaa waajibaadyo cad oo la xiriira ka hortagga, soo-sheegidda, baaritaanka iyo wax-ka-qabashada kiisaska tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka, iyadoo la raacayo shuruucda dalka iyo xeerarka caalamiga ah ee khuseeya ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah xilliyada colaadaha. Saxiixa Amarka Taliyaha wuxuu ka dhashay wada-shaqeyn iyo dadaallo joogto ah oo ay wadeen Kooxda Xuquuqda Aadanaha iyo Ilaalinta ee UNTMIS iyo Wakiilka Gaarka ah ee Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Tacaddiyada Galmada ee La Xiriira Colaadaha, kuwaas oo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed kala shaqeynayay sidii ka hortagga iyo wax-ka-qabashada tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka xilliyada colaadaha.

Ilhaan Cumar oo soo bandhigtay hindise lagu wareejinayo ku dhowaad $140 bilyan
items.description: Washington ( Raxanreeb Online) Xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar, oo ka tirsan Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka, ayaa soo bandhigtay hindise sharciyeed cusub oo lagu doonayo in ku dhowaad $140 bilyan oo loo qoondeeyay hay’adaha socdaalka iyo ilaalinta xuduudaha Mareykanka loo wareejiyo bulshooyinka ay saameeyeen hawlgallada hay’adahaas. Hindisaha oo loo bixiyay “Make ICE Pay Act” ayaa lagu sheegay in lacag dhan $139.6 bilyan loo isticmaali karo taageeridda bulshooyinka ay saameeyeen hawlgallada ICE (Immigration and Customs Enforcement) iyo CBP (Customs and Border Protection). Qorshahan ayaa lagu talinayaa in dhaqaalaha loo adeegsado gargaar dhaqaale, dib-u-bixinta kharashaadka ay galeen dowlad-goboleedyada iyo degmooyinka, taageerada dugsiyada iyo adeegyada bulshada, iyo sidoo kale caawinta hay’adaha aan faa’iido doonka ahayn iyo ganacsiyada yaryar ee ay saameeyeen hawlgallada socdaalka. Hindisaha ayaa si gaar ah u xusaya dhowr gobol oo ay ka mid yihiin Minnesota, California, Illinois, Louisiana, Maine, North Carolina iyo Oregon, kuwaas oo lagu sheegay inay la kulmeen saameyn ka dhalatay hawlgallo socdaal oo ay sameeyeen hay’adaha federaalka. Ilhaan Cumar iyo xildhibaannada taageeraya hindisahan ayaa ku doodaya in bulshooyinka ay saameeyeen hawlgallada socdaalka ay u baahan yihiin taageero dhaqaale iyo adeegyo dib loogu dhiso wixii ay ku tilmaameen saameyn ka dhalatay hawlgalladaas. Hindisaha waxaa sidoo kale taageeraya xildhibaanno kale oo ka tirsan Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin Angie Craig, Chuy García, Rashida Tlaib, Chellie Pingree, Sydney Kamlager-Dove iyo Janelle Bynum. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, hindisahan weli sharci ma noqon. Waa qorshe sharciyeed la soo jeediyay oo u baahan inuu maro hannaanka sharci-dejinta Mareykanka, oo ay ku jiraan dood, guddiyo iyo codbixinno ka hor inta uusan dhaqan gelin. items.title: Bakaracayaal ku sugan gobolka Bari oo wajahay xaalad adag
items.description: Qandala ( Raxanreeb Online) Boqollaal qoys oo horraantii bishan ka barakacay deegaanka Ceelgaal ee degmada Qandala, gobolka Bari, ayaa wajahaya xaalado nololeed oo adag, kaddib markii deegaanka ay saameeyeen roobab xooggan oo ay dabaylo wateen iyo daadad. Roobabka iyo daadadka ka dhacay deegaanka ayaa sababay khasaare soo gaaray dadka deegaanka, waxaana laga soo sheegay in ay waxyeello kasoo gaartay xoolihii ay dhaqanayeen iyo beerihii ay ku tiirsanaayeen nolol-maalmeedkooda. Qaar ka mid ah dadka deegaanka ayaa sidoo kale ahaa kalluumaysato, kuwaas oo nolol-maalmeedkooda ka heli jiray badda, hase yeeshee xaaladda cimilada iyo burburka ka dhashay roobabka ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay dhaq-dhaqaaqooda nololeed. Qoysaska barakacay ayaa hadda wajahaya baahiyo kala duwan oo ay ka mid yihiin cunto, biyo, hoy iyo adeegyo caafimaad, iyadoo xaaladdooda nololeed ay sii adkaanayso kaddib markii ay waayeen qayb ka mid ah hantidii iyo ilihii dhaqaale ee ay ku tiirsanaayeen. Dadka deegaanka ayaa ugu baaqaya maamulka Puntland, dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha samafalka inay si degdeg ah uga jawaabaan xaaladda qoysaska barakacay, isla markaana loo fidiyo gargaar bani’aadantinimo. Xaaladda qoysaskan ayaa muujinaysa saameynta ay roobabka xooggan iyo fatahaaduhu ku yeelan karaan bulshooyinka ku tiirsan xoolaha, beeraha iyo kalluumaysiga, gaar ahaan deegaannada ay adeegyada aasaasiga ahi xaddidan yihiin. items.title: Somaliland oo go’aano culus kasoo saartay xiisadda Awdal
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa soo saartay go’aanno cusub oo lagu adkaynayo sugidda amniga gobollada Awdal iyo Salal, iyadoo mamnuucday abaabulka dagaal iyo qaadashada hubka wixii ka dambeeya 2:00 duhurnimo ee Axadda maanta. Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Somaliland, Cabdirashiid Maxamed Axmed (Magaalo) ayaa sheegay in waqtiga loo qabtay kadib aan gobolladaasi laga samayn karin abaabul hubaysan, isla markaana aan la oggolaan doonin in qof si gaar ah u sita hub. Ciidamada ammaanka ayaa lagu amray inay tallaabo waafaqsan sharciga ka qaadaan dadka lagu qabto iyagoo sita hub aan sharciyeysneyn. Hubka laga qabto dadka aan haysan fasax sharci ah ayaa lagu wareejin doonaa ciidamada, halka dadka lagu qabtana loo gudbin doono hay’adaha garsoorka. Cabdirashiid Magaalo ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in qof kasta oo dagaal hubaysan kala hor yimaada ciidamada, isla markaana ku dhaawacma ama ku dhinta aanu magdhow ka dalban karin xukuumadda. Dhinaca kale, xukuumaddu waxay ugu baaqday odayaasha dhaqanka iyo shacabka ku nool Awdal iyo Salal inay la shaqeeyaan ciidamada ammaanka, si looga hortago falal sababi kara rabshado iyo dib-u-soo-noqoshada isku dhacyada. Awaamiirtan cusub ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli gobollada Awdal iyo Selel ay dhawaanahan ka jireen xiisado iyo Salal horimaadyo dhex maray qaybo ka mid ah bulshada deegaanka, iyadoo marar kala duwan la sameeyay heshiisyo nabadeed iyo dadaallo lagu doonayo in lagu qaboojiyo xaaladda. Inkasta oo ay jireen dadaallo dib-u-heshiisiin ah, haddana xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa hore u sheegtay in hawlaha lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda gobolladaasi ay weli socdaan, iyadoo awaamiirta cusub lagu sheegay kuwo la xiriira xoojinta amniga. Tallaabada cusub ayaa sidoo kale kusoo aadaysa xilli maamulka uu diiradda saarayo ka hortagga abaabul kasta oo hubaysan iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo sababi kara in xiisadaha ka jira Awdal iyo Salal ay mar kale isu beddelaan rabshado. The post Somaliland oo go’aano culus kasoo saartay xiisadda Awdal appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo u safraya dalka Mareykanka
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa saacadaha soo socda ku wajahan magaalada New York ee dalka Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu uga qaybgeli doono shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Madaxweynaha ayaa Soomaaliya ku matali doona Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo madaxda dowladaha caalamku ay isugu imaanayaan magaalada New York si ay uga qaybgalaan doodaha heerka sare ee Qaramada Midoobay. Inta uu ku sugan yahay New York, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ka qaybgeli doona kulamada iyo doodaha looga hadlayo arrimaha muhiimka ah ee caalamka, gaar ahaan nabadda iyo amniga, horumarka, isbeddelka cimilada, xaaladaha bani’aadantinimo iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu yeesho kulamo gaar-gaar ah oo uu kula qaato madaxda dowladaha iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan hay’adaha caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo looga hadli karo arrimaha khuseeya Soomaaliya iyo xiriirka ay la leedahay bulshada caalamka. Safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto xoojinta xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo taageerada caalamiga ah ee dhinacyada amniga, dowlad-dhiska, horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo xasilinta dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale fursad u heli doona inuu madasha Qaramada Midoobay ku soo bandhigo aragtida Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan xaaladda dalka, guulaha la gaaray iyo caqabadaha weli horyalla. The post Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo u safraya dalka Mareykanka appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Dawladda Sucuudiga ayaa war ka soo saartay oo xaqiijisay…
items.description: Sacuudiga oo hadda war cusub soo saaray Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa xaqiijisay in Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay isku dayeen inay Riyadh, caasimadda dalka, ku bartilmaameedsadaan gantaal ballistic ah. Tani waa weerarkii ugu horreeyay ee lagu qaado Riyadh tan iyo markii ay sii xooggaysatay xiisada. Horey, Xuutiyiintu waxay iyagoo adeegsanaya gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku bartilmaameedsadeen goobo “xasaasi” ah oo ku yaalla Riyadh, caasimadda Sacuudiga. Sacuudi Carabiya waxay sheegtay in gantaalkii lagu soo riday Riyadh “la qabtay oo la burburiyay.” Wakaaladda Associated Press ayaa sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah dadka deggan Riyadh ay maqleen qarax, kaddibna ay arkeen qiiq madow ooka kacaya meel u dhow garoonka diyaaradaha. AFP-na waxay sheegtay in laba qarax oo xooggan laga maqlay Riyadh Sabtidii, iyadoo wariyayaasheeduna ay arkeen haan shidaal oo ay leedahay shirkadda shidaalka ee Saudi Aramco, oo ku dhow garoonka diyaaradaha, oo dab qabsaday. Khilaafka u dhexeeya Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Xuutiyiinta ayaa galay marxalad cusub. Xuutiyiintu waxay gacanta ku hayaan qayb weyn oo ka mid ah Yemen, waxaana dhowaan ay qabsadeen magaalooyin xeebeedyo ku dhow Marinka Bab al-Mandab iyo jasiiradihiisa. Maraykanka ayaa Sabtidii ka digay in colaadda u dhexeysa Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Xuutiyiinta oo ay Iran taageerto ay “si degdeg ah u sii xoogaysan karto.”

Tallaabooyinkan ayaa lagu sheegay in loo marayo shuruucda dalka iyo xeerarka caalamiga ah ee khuseeya ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah xilliyada colaadaha, iyadoo la xoojinayo habraacyada wax looga qabanayo tacaddiyada. Saxiixa amarka Taliyaha ciidanka xoogga dalka ayaa ka dhashay wada-shaqeyn iyo dadaallo joogto ah oo laga sameeyay arrintan, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ahaa hawlo lagu xoojinayo ka hortagga tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka xilliyada colaadaha. items.description: Qandala (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Daacish ayaa xalay weerar ku qaaday guriga sarkaal ka tirsan ciidanka Daraawiishta Puntland, kaas oo ku yaalla deegaanka Kayaxa oo u dhow tuulada Sheebaab ee degmada Qandala. Xilliga uu weerarku dhacay, guriga waxaa ku sugnaa saddex carruur ah oo yaryar, hooyadood iyo ayeeyadood, waxaana lagu weeraray rasaas iyo bambooyin gacanta laga tuuro, sida uu sheegay sarkaalka ciidanka oo ah aabaha qoyska. Taliyaha Horinta Daljir ee ciidanka Daraawiishta Puntland, Siciid Cali Orshe oo ka hadlay weerarka lagu qaaday qoyskiisa ayaa sheegay in uusan marnaba noqon doonin cabsi-gelin uu uga haro dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda Daacish ee Calmiskaad. Inkastoo weerarku sababay burbur hantiyeed, haddana ma jirin wax khasaare nafeed ah oo kasoo gaaray dadka guriga ku sugnaa. Ciidanka Puntland ayaa goobta gaaray kadib markii ay heleen wararka ku saabsan weerarka, balse kooxdii weerarka geysatay ayaa goobta isaga baxsatay, sida uu sheegay Siciid Orshe. Ciidamada ayaa bilaabay raad-raac lagu baadi-goobayo kooxihii weerarka soo qaaday, iyadoo aan weli la shaacin in la qabtay cid loo tuhunsan yahay weerarka. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ciidamada Puntland ay wadaan howl-gallo culus oo ka dhan ah kooxda Daacish, taas oo jab xooggan lagu gaarsiiyay kooxda. The post Daacish oo weerar ku qaaday guriga sarkaal ka tirsan ciidamada Puntland appeared first on Caasimada Online .
