Taliyaha ayaa xusay in weerarka ay fulisay “diyaaradda F-16 ee Turkiga”, wuxuuna tilmaamay in laba gantaal ay ku dhufteen gurigiisa, kuwaas oo sababay burbur xooggan oo soo gaaray qaybaha kala duwan ee dhismaha. “Habeen habeennada kamid ah 12:00 Am marka ay tahay ayaa waxaan arkay diyaaradda F-16 oo i kor taagan qaylineyso waan kusoo kacay kadibna waxaa igu dhacay hal gantaal mar labaad kii kale ayaa isna yimid labadaas gantaal ayay igu tuurtay Ilaahey waxba iguma gaarsiinin,” ayuu yiri Taliye Shub. Waxaa kale oo uu intaa sii raaciyay “Gantaallada waxa ay ku dhaceen meesha aan jiifay madaxeyga meel kale kuma dhicin labaduba mid baa moodaa inuu qolkii aan deganaa uu dhex-galay, kaas oo burbur gaarsiiyay guriga”. Dhaawiciisa Taliye Shub ayaa intii uu ku guda jiray wareysiga ka warbixiyay sida ay wax u gaareen, isaga oo tilmaamay in dhaawacyo ay kasoo gaareen firirka qaraxa. Wuxuu sidoo kale soo bandhigay firir ku jiray jirkiisa, iyadoo dhaawaca soo gaaray uu ka muuqday wejigiisa. Sidoo kale, wuxuu sheegay in markii uu qaraxu dhacay uu si degdeg ah uga baxay guriga, kadibna uu lug ku tegay isbitaalka guud ee Doolow, halkaas oo loogu fidiyay gurmad caafimaad, laguna daweeyay, isagoo sheegay in haatan xaaladdiisa caafimaad ay soo hagaagtay. Cidda hoggaamineysay weerarka Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan (Shub) wuxuu sidoo kale shaaciyay xog ku saabsan cidda hoggaamineysay diyaaradda, isaga oo sheegay inuu ka dambeeyay nin darawal u ah oo ku sugnaa guriga, kaas oo uu xaqiijiyay in haatan uu xiran yahay, ayna ku socdaan baaritaanno la xiriira dhacdadaasi. “Isbitaalka markii aan tegay oo aan waxyar joogay waxaa ii yimid guddoomiyihii degmada nin darawal ahaa inta uu fiiriyay ayuu dhab dhahay kadibna xiray qoraygiina ka qaaday arrinka saas ayuu u dhacay,” ayuu yiri. Waxaa kale oo uu carrabka ku dhuftay in horay looga shakiyay ninkan, isla markaana uu Muqdisho u diray, balse uu mar kale wacay kuna laabtay degmada Doolow, iyadoo qaraxu dhacay saddex habeen isaga oo joogo guriga. “Qodobka kale ninkii gaariga ii wadaayay ee uu guddoomiyuhu xiray inuu hoggaaminayay ayaa isoo baxday ninkaas waa wiil yar oo markii hore Xamar darawalkayga ku ahaa niman siyaasiyiin oo saaxibadey ah oo dhowr habeen ila joogay waxay igu yiraahdeen ninkaas waa ka shakinay iska fasax, aniguna shaki ayaa i galay wiilka kolba taleefan ayuu meel la’istaagaa, waana arkay isagoo hoos u hadlaayo, kadibna Xamar ayaan u diray, haddane mar labaad ayuu ii soo laabtay,” ayuu mar kale ku yiri Wareysiga. Waxaa kale oo kusii daray “Qiso kalena waxay ahayd niman fuundiyaal ah oo guriga dayac tirayay aya sheegay inuu afarta jiho ka sawiray guriga. Waxaa kale oo yaableh gabar shaqaale ah oo guriga joogta ayaa qolka ugu gashay isagoo wax ku qor-qoranaayo waa meesha madaxeyga ah gabadhii waxay ku tiri nalkaan waa la daminayaa ee bannaanka u bax igu dami ayuu yiri ee iska soco shaqo ayaan haystaa, waana habeenka uu qaraxu dhici doono, tanina halkaas ayay kasoo boodaY. mmaxaa mugdigan geliyay oo ku sababay? waa information is doonanaayo illaa Baydhaba iyo Doolow”. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Weerarkii lagu qaaday guriga taliye Shub ayaa sare u qaaday xiisadda ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed oo ay horay uga dhaceen dagaallo u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. The post Daawo: Taliye Shub oo xog ka bixiyey ninkii hoggaaminayay weerarkii lagu qaaday appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Jubbaland oo Xoojineysa Diyaar-garowga Fatahaadaha Laga Cabsi Qabo
items.description: Kusimaha Madaxweynaha Jubbaland ahna Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad Goboleedka Jubbaland, Mudane Sheekh Cabdi Maxamed Cabdiraxmaan, ayaa maanta shir-guddoomiyay kulan ay yeesheen Golaha Wasiirrada Jubbaland. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda amniga iyo diyaar-garowga khataraha fatahaadaha, gaar ahaan kuwa laga cabsi qabo inay saameeyaan qaybo ka mid ah deegaanada Jubbaland. Golaha ayaa qiimeeyay saameynta fatahaadaha ay ku yeelan karaan bulshada, xoolaha, beeraha, deegaanka iyo kaabayaasha muhiimka ah, iyadoo wasiirrada lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sameeyo diyaar-garow hore iyo qorsheyaal wax looga qabanayo xaaladaha degdegga ah. Kusimaha Madaxweynaha Jubbaland ayaa warbixinno ka dhageystay Golaha Wasiirrada, isagoo faray hay’adaha dowladda inay xoojiyaan qorshayaasha ka hortagga iyo yareynta saameynta fatahaadaha, isla markaana si dhow isaga kaashadaan xaalad kasta oo soo kororta. Sidoo kale, kulanka ayaa lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay badbaadinta shacabka, ilaalinta kaabayaasha muhiimka ah iyo isku-duwidda hay’adaha dowladda, si loo yareeyo khasaaraha ka dhalan kara fatahaadaha laga cabsi qabo. Mas’uuliyiinta Jubbaland ayaa sheegay in diyaar-garowga hore iyo iskaashiga hay’adaha dowladda ay muhiim u yihiin in si degdeg ah looga jawaabo xaaladaha bani’aadannimo iyo kuwa deegaanka ee ka dhalan kara fatahaadaha.

items.title: Taliyaha Cusub ee Qaybta 3-aad ee AUSSOM oo Baydhabo Lagu Soo Dhaweeyay
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa magaalada Baydhabo kulan qado sharaf iyo sagootin ah ugu sameeyay Taliyihii hore ee Qaybta 3-aad ee Ciidanka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), Brigadier General Teklu Hurisa Janka. Kulanka oo ka dhacay Aqalka Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ahaa mid lagu sagootinayay taliyihii hore, iyadoo Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Madoobe uu uga mahadceliyay adeegii iyo dadaalkii uu muddadii uu xilka hayay ku bixiyay xoojinta amniga iyo xasilloonida deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa sidoo kale bogaadiyay wada-shaqeyntii dhex martay ciidamada AUSSOM iyo hay’adaha amniga Koonfur Galbeed, isagoo u rajeeyay Brigadier General Teklu Hurisa Janka guul iyo horumar mustaqbalkiisa. Dhanka kale, Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa soo dhaweeyay Taliyaha cusub ee Qaybta 3-aad ee AUSSOM, Brigadier General Hashim Mohammed Chikula, isagoo u rajeeyay inuu si wanaagsan u guto waajibaadka loo igmaday. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo qaaday muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, ilaalinta nabadda iyo xasilloonida Koonfur Galbeed, iyo taageerada ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ee ka howlgala deegaannada maamulka. Kulanka waxaa ka qeybgalay Wasiirka Xannaanada Xoolaha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Xasan Xuseen Maxamed (Eelay), Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Wasiirka Batroolka, Agaasimaha Guud ee Madaxtooyada iyo saraakiil ka tirsan Madaxtooyada Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo ka hadlay saameynta burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur, ayaa khudbad uu ka jeediyay Golaha Shacabka kaga hadlay saameynta burcad-badeednimadu ku yeelatay Soomaaliya, amniga badaha iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in burcad-badeednimadu aysan ahayn oo keliya caqabad dhinaca amniga badaha ah, balse ay saameyn weyn ku yeelatay sumcadda Soomaaliya, dhaqaalaha dalka, kalluumeysiga sharciga ah, bulshooyinka ku nool xeebaha iyo badqabka badmaaxiinta. Waxa uu xusay in heer caalami burcad-badeednimadu ay kordhisay kharashaadka gaadiidka badda, caymiska iyo sugidda amniga maraakiibta, iyadoo badmaaxiin badan ay la kulmeen afduub, rabshado iyo muddo dheer oo ay gacanta ugu jireen kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in cilmi-baaris uu sameeyay Bangiga Adduunku ay qiyaastay in burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya ay dhaqaalaha caalamka ku kordhisay kharash gaaraya ilaa 18 bilyan oo dollar sannadkii muddadii daraasadda. Isagoo ka hadlayay tallaabooyinka sharciyeed ee Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur wuxuu xusay in 10-kii Nofeembar 2025, Golaha Shacabka uu ansixiyay Hindise-Sharciyeedka Dib-u-eegista Sharciga La-dagaallanka Burcad-badeedda iyo Ka-hortagga Afduubka, halka 9-kii Sebteembar 2026 uu Aqalka Sare isna ansixiyay sharciga la xiriira la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo ka-hortagga afduubka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in ansixinta labada Aqal ay muujinayso muhiimadda ay Soomaaliya siinayso xoojinta sharciga, ilaalinta nolosha dadka, sugidda amniga badaha iyo ka qaybqaadashada amniga badaha ee heer gobol iyo caalami. Si kastaba, wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in sharci keliya aan lagu ciribtiri karin burcad-badeednimada, balse loo baahan yahay dhaqan-gelin wax-ku-ool ah, xoojinta hay’adaha amniga iyo ilaalinta badaha, awoodda garsoorka iyo dacwad-oogista, iyo sugidda amniga xeebaha. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku baaqay in la abuuro fursado dhaqaale oo wanaagsan oo ay helaan bulshada ku nool deegaannada xeebaha, iyadoo la sii xoojinayo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo dalalka gobolka iyo saaxiibbada caalamka. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa ugu dambeyn Xildhibaannada ugu baaqay in doodda ku saabsan burcad-badeednimada lagu saleeyo xog iyo faham qoto dheer, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo saameynta ay ku leedahay amniga, dhaqaalaha, bulshada xeebaha, khayraadka badda iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah, isla markaana la soo jeediyo xalal wax-ku-ool ah oo lagu xoojinayo amniga badaha Soomaaliya.

items.title: Mareykanka oo ku dhowaaqay go’aan culus oo la xiriira Eritrea
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa Jimcihii cunaqabateyn ka qaaday ciidamada Eritrea, xisbiga talada haya ee dalkaas iyo dhowr mas’uul iyo hay’ado kale, kuwaas oo tallaabooyin lagu soo rogay xilligii dagaalka Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya. Waaxda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in xaaladdii degdegga ahayd ee saldhigga u ahayd barnaamijka cunaqabateynta la xiriiray Itoobiya ay dhammaatay, taas oo keentay in magacyadii lagu daray liiska cunaqabateynta ee ku saleysnaa awooddaas laga saaro. Dadka iyo hay’adaha laga qaaday cunaqabateynta waxaa ka mid ah Ciidamada Difaaca Eritrea, xisbiga talada haya ee People’s Front for Democracy and Justice (PFDJ), shirkadda Red Sea Trading Corporation iyo Hidri Trust. Sidoo kale waxaa liiska laga saaray Hagos Ghebrehiwet W Kidan, oo la-taliye dhaqaale u ah PFDJ, iyo Abraha Kassa Nemariam, oo Mareykanku hore ugu sheegay madaxa xafiiska amniga qaranka Eritrea. Go’aanka cusub ma beddelayo eedeymihii hore ee Mareykanka ee la xiriiray xadgudubyadii ka dhacay dagaalka Tigray. Waaxda Maaliyadda ayaa sheegtay in tallaabadu la xiriirto oo keliya dhammaadka xaaladdii degdegga ahayd ee lagu aasaasay amarka fulinta ee Madaxweyne Joe Biden soo saaray bishii September 2021. Warbaahinta Reuters ayaa bishii May sheegtay, iyadoo soo xiganeysa dukumenti gudaha ah oo Mareykan ah, in maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu qorsheynayo inuu qaado cunaqabateyntan, xilli Washington ay dooneyso inay wanaajiso xiriirka Eritrea isla markaana ay dib u qiimeyneyso xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas. Afhayeen ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa Reuters xilligaas u sheegay in maamulka Trump uu doonayo inuu dhiirrigeliyo nabad iyo barwaaqo ka dhalata Geeska Afrika, isla markaana uu rajeynayo xoojinta xiriirka uu la leeyahay dowladda iyo shacabka Eritrea. Eritrea waxay leedahay xeeb dheer oo ku taalla Badda Cas, taas oo ka soo horjeedda Sacuudi Carabiya, halka marin-biyoodkaasi uu muhiimad sii yeelanayo xilli khilaafaadka Bariga Dhexe ay saameyn ku yeesheen maraakiibta ganacsiga. Cunaqabateyntii dagaalka Tigray Maamulka Biden ayaa cunaqabateyntan soo rogay bishii November 2021, xilligii uu socday dagaalkii labada sano qaatay ee ka dhacay gobolka Tigray, halkaas oo ciidamada Eritrea ay garab siinayeen ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ee la dagaallamayey xoogagga Tigray. Waaxda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in dhinacyada Eritrea ay door ku lahaayeen sii socoshada dagaalka, iyadoo soo xigatay warbixino la xiriiray dilal, dhac, tacaddiyo galmo iyo carqaladeyn lagu sameeyey gargaarka bani’aadannimo. “Waxaan cambaareyneynaa doorka joogtada ah ee dhinacyada Eritrea ay ku leeyihiin rabshadaha ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya,” ayay tiri Andrea Gacki, oo markaas madax ka ahayd xafiiska cunaqabateynta ee OFAC. Cunaqabateyntu waxay xanibtay hantida dadka iyo hay’adaha la bartilmaameedsaday ee ku jirta awoodda Mareykanka, waxayna guud ahaan muwaadiniinta iyo shirkadaha Mareykanka ka mamnuucday inay la macaamilaan. Bishii March 2023, xoghayihii arrimaha dibadda Mareykanka Antony Blinken ayaa sheegay in Washington ay go’aamisay in xubno ka tirsan ciidamada Eritrea, Itoobiya, Tigray iyo xoogagga Amxaarada ay galeen dambiyo dagaal intii uu socday colaadda. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xubno ka tirsan ciidamada Eritrea iyo Itoobiya, iyo xoogagga Amxaarada, ay galeen dambiyo ka dhan ah aadanaha, oo ay ku jiraan dil, kufsi iyo tacaddiyo kale oo galmo. Dowladda Eritrea ayaa marar badan diidday eedeymaha ah in ciidamadeedu galeen xadgudubyo baahsan intii uu socday dagaalka. Dadka iyo hay’adaha laga qaaday cunaqabateynta waxaa ka mid ah Ciidamada Difaaca Eritrea, xisbiga talada haya ee People’s Front for Democracy and Justice (PFDJ), shirkadda Red Sea Trading Corporation iyo Hidri Trust. Sidoo kale waxaa liiska laga saaray Hagos Ghebrehiwet W Kidan, oo la-taliye dhaqaale u ah PFDJ, iyo Abraha Kassa Nemariam, oo Mareykanku hore ugu sheegay madaxa xafiiska amniga qaranka Eritrea. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Yurub oo Ka Wada Hadlay Xoojinta Iskaashiga Labada Dhinac
items.description: Muqdisho, 19 Sebteembar 2026: Wasiir Ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Maxamed Cali (Nadaara), ayaa maanta ka guddoomay nuqul ka mid ah warqadaha aqoonsiga (Credentials) Safiirka cusub ee Midowga Yurub u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, Laszlo Mathe. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu guddoomay warqaddii looga yeeray Safiirkii hore ee Midowga Yurub ee Soomaaliya. Wasiir Ku-xigeenka ayaa Midowga Yurub uga mahadceliyay taageerada joogtada ah ee uu siiyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan taageerada uu u muujiyo madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, Wasiir Nadaara ayaa sheegay in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay diyaar u tahay inay Safiirka cusub kala shaqeyso xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Yurub, gaar ahaan dhinacyada nabadda iyo amniga, dowladnimada, ganacsiga iyo horumarinta. Safiirka cusub ee Midowga Yurub, Laszlo Mathe, ayaa xilkan kala wareegaya safiirkii ka horreeyay, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Yurub.

items.title: Madaxwaynaha hadalkiisii calamkii wada gaadh
items.description: Madaxwaynaha hadalkiisii calamkii wada gaadh dawlado waawayni hanti ku bixiye in hadalkiisa la dilo, qaylo isla oog satay muslim iyo gaal. Madaxwaynuhu haduunu waxba garanayn qof qarankiisa dunida gayn kara ahayn maxaa loo wada qaylinayaa cadawgii soomaaliland oo dawlada leh naftii ka qaaday, miyay iskaba aamusan ilayn qof aan waxba ogayn baa hadlee. Xaqiiqdu se waxay tahay madaxwaynu safarkiisa iyo hadalkiisuba hurdo u diiday dawlado waawayn. Siduu qaranku dunida kaga iibsamayo waa siduu madaxwayna hayagu u arko, maaha sida uu arko qof shaqsiyi cadan iyo madaw ku doono ha noqdee. Qolyaha reer soomaaliland “daqiiqad ku diblomasiga” ee safarka madaxwaynaha xumaanta la daba taagan cidaad duraysaan iyo cidad difaacaysan kala garanba mayne iska nasta. Madaxwaynuha Guul baan u Rajaynaya Soomaaliland guul leh. Ma ihi dadkan siyaasada ku bartay facebook waxaan ahay nin guri siyaasi ku soo koray isna siyaasada kuba dhashoo shaqadaa socotaa waa guul soomaaliland mahadain doonto. Siyaasada barta. Ayàanle Boobe Yuusuf

items.title: Mareykanka oo 8 Soomaali ah geeyey xabsiga Guantanamo
items.description: Washington — Ugu yaraan sideed nin oo Soomaali ah ayaa hadda lagu hayaa saldhigga ciidamada badda Mareykanka ee Guantánamo Bay, Cuba, iyadoo warbixinno cusub ay sheegayaan in ilaa 12 Soomaali ah halkaasi loo qaaday dabayaaqadii bishii Agoosto, kaddib markii markii hore loo sheegay in Soomaaliya lagu celinayo. Warbaahinta MPR News ayaa toddobaadkan sheegtay inay xaqiijisay in sideed Soomaali ah ay hadda ku jiraan saldhigga Guantánamo, taas oo muujineysa in tirada dadka Soomaaliyeed ee halkaasi loo wareejiyey ay ka badan tahay intii markii hore la ogaa. Arrintan ayaa soo baxday kaddib markii horaantii bishan la ogaaday in Adam Abdullah, oo ah Soomaali magangelyo-doon ah, loo wareejiyey Guantánamo kaddib markii ay ciidamada socdaalka Mareykanka ku xireen magaalada St Paul ee gobolka Minnesota. Sahan Journal , oo wareysatay laba ka mid ah ragga la xiray, ayaa sheegtay in ilaa 12 Soomaali ah ay toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay gaareen Guantánamo, inkastoo sideed ka mid ah ay weli halkaasi ku jiraan. Warbaahinta Mother Jones ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in 12 nin oo Soomaali ah la saaray diyaarad dabayaaqadii Agoosto, iyagoo loo sheegay in loo dhoofinayo Soomaaliya. Saddex ka mid ah raggaasi ayaa ka yimid gobolka Minnesota, sida ay sheegtay Sahan Journal . Dadka la xiray ayaa u sheegay warbaahinta in toddoba ka mid ah sideedda nin lagu hayo xabsiga Camp 6, halka nin kale lagu hayo meel go’doon ah. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka weli ma aysan soo bandhigin liis dhameystiran oo ay ku qoran yihiin Soomaalida loo qaaday Guantánamo, mana aysan sharxin sababta qof kasta loogu doortay in halkaasi loo wareejiyo. Dowladda Mareykanka oo difaacday tallaabada Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka ee DHS ayaa difaacday howlgalkan, iyadoo sheegtay in diyaaraddii lagu qaaday Soomaalida ay saarnaayeen dad ay ku tilmaantay “qaar ka mid ah kuwa ugu xun,” kuwaas oo ay sheegtay inay leeyihiin taariikh dembiyeed la xiriirta weerarro, hub, dhac, xatooyo iyo daroogo. Hase yeeshee, DHS ma aysan caddeyn eedeymaha dembiyeed ee qof kasta gaar ahaan lala xiriirinayo. Arrintaas ayaa si gaar ah su’aalo uga dhalisay kiiska Adam Abdullah oo 31 jir ah. Abdullah ayaa Mareykanka ku yimid 2023 isagoo magangelyo-doon ah, wuxuuna helay fasax shaqo iyo lambarka Social Security-ga, isagoo markii dambe ka shaqeynayey farsamada gawaarida ka hor inta aysan saraakiisha socdaalku ku xirin St Paul bishii December. MPR News ayaa sheegtay in diiwaannada maxkamadaha Minnesota ay ka heshay oo keliya laba ganaax oo la xiriira baarkin xilliga barafka, halka DHS aysan sharaxin sababta loogu doortay in Guantánamo loo qaado. Garsoore socdaal ayaa bishii May amray in dalka laga saaro, sida ay sheegtay Sahan Journal . Abdullah ayaa MPR News u sheegay in saraakiisha socdaalku u sheegeen in diyaaraddu ku sii jeeddo Soomaaliya, isla markaana Cuba ay keliya noqon doonto meel shidaal lagu qaato. Hase yeeshee, safarkiisa halkaasi ayuu ku dhammaaday, waxaana lagu hayaa Camp 6. Qareenkiisa Marc Prokosch ayaa sheegay in telefoonada uu kula hadlo Abdullah lagu koobay shan ilaa 10 daqiiqo, isla markaana uusan hubin in wada-hadalladooda ay yihiin kuwo qarsoodi ah. Senator Tina Smith oo ka tirsan xisbiga Dimuqraadiga, lagana soo doorto Minnesota, ayaa toddobaadkan sheegtay inay dowladda ka dalbaneyso jawaabo ku saabsan xarigga Abdullah. “Kiiska Mr. Abdullah, wax caddeyn ah lama soo bandhigin oo muujineysa waxa uu sameeyey,” ayay Smith u sheegtay MPR , iyadoo su’aal ka keentay in loo maray hannaan sharci oo ku filan. Kiisas kale oo Soomaali ah oo soo baxay Sahan Journal ayaa sidoo kale wareysatay Sakariye Abdi Mohamed oo 22 jir ah, kaas oo sheegay inuu Mareykanka yimid bishii Janaayo 2023, kaddibna helay fasax shaqo iyo shatiga wadista gaadiidka waaweyn. Sakariye ayaa sheegay in la xiray kaddib markii askari ka tirsan booliska gobolka Alabama uu joojiyey gaari xamuul ah oo uu waday bishii October 2025. Wuxuu ku dhowaad 11 bilood ku jiray xabsi ay maamusho laanta socdaalka, ka hor inta aan Guantánamo la geyn 26-kii Agoosto. Sakariye ayaa sheegay in markii Soomaalida la xiray ay mas’uuliyiinta weydiiyeen sababta halkaasi loogu sii hayo, loogu jawaabay in arrintu tahay “go’aan federaal ah oo ka yimid Washington, D.C.” Diiwaannada maxkamadaha federaalka ayaa muujinaya in Sakariye uu Maxkamadda Racfaanka ee Fifth Circuit u gudbiyey codsi dib loogu eegayo kiiskiisa socdaalka ka hor inta aan Guantánamo loo wareejin. Maxkamaddu waxay codsiga heshay 24-kii July, waxaana si rasmi ah diiwaanka loogu daray 30-kii July. Hase yeeshee, xogta maxkamadda ee dadweynaha loo heli karo ma caddeyneyso in codsigaasi uu sharci ahaan hakiyey masaafurintiisa. Dadka ay wareysteen Sahan Journal iyo Mother Jones ayaa sheegay in muddo dheer silsilado lagu hayo, xaaladaha xabsiguna ay qabow yihiin, jimicsiga la xaddiday, isla markaana ay jiraan ilaalo iyo dabagal joogto ah. DHS ayaa beenisay eedeymaha ku saabsan in maxaabiista si xun loola dhaqmo. Warbixinta Sahan Journal ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday isbeddel ku yimid habka loo helo dokumentiyada Soomaalida lagu masaafurinayo. Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Washington, Daahir Cabdi, ayaa warbaahinta u sheegay in saraakiisha socdaalka Mareykanka ay hadda si toos ah ula xiriiraan dowladda Muqdisho, halkii dokumentiyada laga soo mari lahaa safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Washington. “Nidaamka hadda waa la mideeyey, annaguna halkan dambe kuma sameyno,” ayuu yiri. Muranka ka jira siyaasadda Guantánamo Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa bishii Janaayo 2025 faray wasaaradaha Difaaca iyo Amniga Gudaha inay ballaariyaan xarunta lagu hayo dadka ajnabiga ah ee ku taalla Guantánamo Bay. Qoraalka madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in xarunta loo isticmaali doono dadka uu maamulka ku tilmaamay “ajaanib dambiilayaal ah oo mudnaan sare leh.” Maamulka Trump ayaa markii hore sheegay in qorshuhu suuragelin karo in ilaa 30,000 qof lagu hayo Guantánamo. Warbixin uu ciidamada Mareykanku daabacay bishii September 2025 ayaa sheegtay in Camp 6 loo isticmaalayey dadka socdaalka la xiriira ee loo aqoonsaday “khatar sare”, kuwaas oo lagu tilmaamay dad lagu helay dambiyo culus, xubno ama xiriir la leh kooxaha burcadda ah ama dad lala xiriiriyo argagixisada. Warbixintaasi waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in dadka xilligaas halkaasi lagu hayey ay lahaayeen amarro kama dambeys ah oo dalka looga saarayo, isla markaana qaarkood xiriir la lahaayeen ururro dambiyeed caalami ah ama ka ganacsiga daroogada. Dowladda Mareykanka ma aysan caddeyn in shuruudahaas ay sidoo kale khuseeyaan Soomaalida dhowaan la geeyey Guantánamo, mana aysan faahfaahin sida mid kasta oo ka mid ah sideedda nin uu ugu qalmo shuruudahaas. items.fullContent: Washington — Ugu yaraan sideed nin oo Soomaali ah ayaa hadda lagu hayaa saldhigga ciidamada badda Mareykanka ee Guantánamo Bay, Cuba, iyadoo warbixinno cusub ay sheegayaan in ilaa 12 Soomaali ah halkaasi loo qaaday dabayaaqadii bishii Agoosto, kaddib markii markii hore loo sheegay in Soomaaliya lagu celinayo. Warbaahinta MPR News ayaa toddobaadkan sheegtay inay xaqiijisay in sideed Soomaali ah ay hadda ku jiraan saldhigga Guantánamo, taas oo muujineysa in tirada dadka Soomaaliyeed ee halkaasi loo wareejiyey ay ka badan tahay intii markii hore la ogaa. Arrintan ayaa soo baxday kaddib markii horaantii bishan la ogaaday in Adam Abdullah, oo ah Soomaali magangelyo-doon ah, loo wareejiyey Guantánamo kaddib markii ay ciidamada socdaalka Mareykanka ku xireen magaalada St Paul ee gobolka Minnesota. Sahan Journal , oo wareysatay laba ka mid ah ragga la xiray, ayaa sheegtay in ilaa 12 Soomaali ah ay toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay gaareen Guantánamo, inkastoo sideed ka mid ah ay weli halkaasi ku jiraan. Warbaahinta Mother Jones ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in 12 nin oo Soomaali ah la saaray diyaarad dabayaaqadii Agoosto, iyagoo loo sheegay in loo dhoofinayo Soomaaliya. Saddex ka mid ah raggaasi ayaa ka yimid gobolka Minnesota, sida ay sheegtay Sahan Journal . Dadka la xiray ayaa u sheegay warbaahinta in toddoba ka mid ah sideedda nin lagu hayo xabsiga Camp 6, halka nin kale lagu hayo meel go’doon ah. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka weli ma aysan soo bandhigin liis dhameystiran oo ay ku qoran yihiin Soomaalida loo qaaday Guantánamo, mana aysan sharxin sababta qof kasta loogu doortay in halkaasi loo wareejiyo. Dowladda Mareykanka oo difaacday tallaabada Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka ee DHS ayaa difaacday howlgalkan, iyadoo sheegtay in diyaaraddii lagu qaaday Soomaalida ay saarnaayeen dad ay ku tilmaantay “qaar ka mid ah kuwa ugu xun,” kuwaas oo ay sheegtay inay leeyihiin taariikh dembiyeed la xiriirta weerarro, hub, dhac, xatooyo iyo daroogo. Hase yeeshee, DHS ma aysan caddeyn eedeymaha dembiyeed ee qof kasta gaar ahaan lala xiriirinayo. Arrintaas ayaa si gaar ah su’aalo uga dhalisay kiiska Adam Abdullah oo 31 jir ah. Abdullah ayaa Mareykanka ku yimid 2023 isagoo magangelyo-doon ah, wuxuuna helay fasax shaqo iyo lambarka Social Security-ga, isagoo markii dambe ka shaqeynayey farsamada gawaarida ka hor inta aysan saraakiisha socdaalku ku xirin St Paul bishii December. MPR News ayaa sheegtay in diiwaannada maxkamadaha Minnesota ay ka heshay oo keliya laba ganaax oo la xiriira baarkin xilliga barafka, halka DHS aysan sharaxin sababta loogu doortay in Guantánamo loo qaado. Garsoore socdaal ayaa bishii May amray in dalka laga saaro, sida ay sheegtay Sahan Journal . Abdullah ayaa MPR News u sheegay in saraakiisha socdaalku u sheegeen in diyaaraddu ku sii jeeddo Soomaaliya, isla markaana Cuba ay keliya noqon doonto meel shidaal lagu qaato. Hase yeeshee, safarkiisa halkaasi ayuu ku dhammaaday, waxaana lagu hayaa Camp 6. Qareenkiisa Marc Prokosch ayaa sheegay in telefoonada uu kula hadlo Abdullah lagu koobay shan ilaa 10 daqiiqo, isla markaana uusan hubin in wada-hadalladooda ay yihiin kuwo qarsoodi ah. Senator Tina Smith oo ka tirsan xisbiga Dimuqraadiga, lagana soo doorto Minnesota, ayaa toddobaadkan sheegtay inay dowladda ka dalbaneyso jawaabo ku saabsan xarigga Abdullah. “Kiiska Mr. Abdullah, wax caddeyn ah lama soo bandhigin oo muujineysa waxa uu sameeyey,” ayay Smith u sheegtay MPR , iyadoo su’aal ka keentay in loo maray hannaan sharci oo ku filan. Kiisas kale oo Soomaali ah oo soo baxay Sahan Journal ayaa sidoo kale wareysatay Sakariye Abdi Mohamed oo 22 jir ah, kaas oo sheegay inuu Mareykanka yimid bishii Janaayo 2023, kaddibna helay fasax shaqo iyo shatiga wadista gaadiidka waaweyn. Sakariye ayaa sheegay in la xiray kaddib markii askari ka tirsan booliska gobolka Alabama uu joojiyey gaari xamuul ah oo uu waday bishii October 2025. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha oo kawada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca
items.description: Beijing ( Raxanreeb Online) Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa magaalada Beijing kulan kula yeeshay dhiggiisa Shiinaha, Admiral Dong Jun. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, gaar ahaan ballaarinta iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga. Labada wasiir ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay sidii loo sii horumarin lahaa xiriirka labada dowladood iyo sidii loo dardargelin lahaa iskaashiga dhinaca ciidamada, tababarrada iyo arrimaha amniga. Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa kulanka kaga hadlay xaaladda amni ee Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ku waddo dhismaha iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Difaaca Shiinaha, Admiral Dong Jun, ayaa muujiyay muhiimadda ay Beijing siinayso xiriirka ay la leedahay Soomaaliya iyo iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan in iskaashiga labada dal loo ballaariyo dhinacyo kala duwan oo ay ka mid yihiin difaaca, amniga iyo tababarrada ciidamada. Labada Wasiir ayaa isla gartay in la dardargeliyo hirgelinta is-afgaradyada jira, lana sii ballaariyo iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga, si xiriirka istaraatiijiga ah ee labada dal loogu beddelo tallaabooyin la taaban karo oo wax ka tara nabadda iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan gobolka. items.title: Wafdi uu hoggaaminayo murashaxa madaxweynaha Galmudug Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo Gaaray Guriceel
items.description: Wafdi uu hoggaaminayo murashaxa hoggaamiyaha Galmudug Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo ay ku jiraaj mas’uuliyiin sar sare oo ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa gaaray magaalada Guriceel ee gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo si weyn loogu soo dhoweeyay. Murasharax madaxweyne Liibaan Axmed xasan ayaa sheegay in maadaama doorashada Galmudug dib loogu celinayo, loo baahan yahay in bulshada reer Guriceel ay si weyn uga qayb qaataan geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed iyo doorashada hoggaanka maamulka. Doorashadii hore ee Galmudug iyo natiijooyinkeedii ayaa muddooyinkii dambe dhaliyay muran siyaasadeed iyo mid sharci, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah arrimaha la xiriiray doorashada ay gaareen maxkamadaha dalka, islamarkaana ay wax kama jiraan ka dhigtay maxkamadda sare. Haatan waxaa  la filayo in dib loo bilaabo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada siyaasadeed ee la xiriira doorashada Galmudug, waxaa magaalada Guriceel gaaray mas’uuliyiin iyo siyaasiyiin bilaabay kulamo iyo ololeyaal taageero raadin ah. Wafdigan ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inay gaaraan magaalooyin kale oo ka tirsan Galmudug, halkaas oo ay ka sii wadi doonaan kulamada bulshada iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada siyaasadeed ee la xiriira doorashada hoggaanka dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug.

items.title: Midowga Yurub oo Maraykanka ugu baaqay inuu qaado xayiraadda safarka ee wafdiga Falastiin
items.description: Midowga Yurub ayaa ugu baaqay Dowladda Maraykanka inay dib uga fiirsato go’aanka ay ku diiday fiisooyinka mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Maamulka Falastiin iyo xubno ka tirsan Ururka Xoreynta Falastiin (PLO), kuwaas oo doonayay inay ka qaybgalaan shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee ka dhacaya magaalada New York. Midowga Yurub ayaa sheegay inuu ka xun yahay in mas’uuliyiinta Falastiin loo diido fiisooyinka sannadkii labaad oo xiriir ah, ayadoo Anouar El Anouni, oo ah afhayeenka adeegga diblomaasiyadda Midowga Yurub, uu sheegay in Washington looga baahan yahay inay dib u eegto go’aankaas, iyadoo Mareykanku yahay dalka martigelinaya xarunta Qaramada Midoobay. Arrintan ayaa timid maalmo kadib markii Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay uu ansixiyey in Madaxweynaha Falastiin, Mahmoud Abbas , uu khudbad ka jeediyo kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud isagoo adeegsanaya muuqaal horay loo duubay, maadaama uusan si toos ah ugu safri karin New York. Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, António Guterres , ayaa sidoo kale muujiyey inuu ka xun yahay go’aanka Maraykanka, isagoo walaac ka muujiyey saameynta ay xayiraaddu ku yeelan karto awoodda Dowladda Falastiin ay si buuxda uga qaybqaadato hawlaha Qaramada Midoobay. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Maraykanka ayaa sheegtay in xayiraadaha fiisaha loo kordhiyey mas’uuliyiinta Maamulka Falastiin iyo xubnaha PLO, iyadoo Washington ku sababaysay waxa ay ku tilmaantay dib-u-habayn la’aan iyo tallaabooyin wax u dhimaya rajada nabadda. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale ku eedaysay Maamulka Falastiin inuu raadinayo aqoonsi caalami ah oo ku saabsan dawladnimada Falastiin isaga oo aan wada-xaajood toos ah la gelin Israel, iyo inuu arrimo la xiriira khilaafka Israel u gudbiyey maxkamadaha caalamiga ah. Khudbadda Abbas ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa la filayaa inay diiradda saarto aqoonsiga caalamiga ah ee Dawladda Falastiin , dadaallada xal laba-dowladood ah iyo xaaladda bani’aadantinimo ee Gaza. Sidoo kale waxaa la filayaa inuu ka hadlo xaaladda Daanta Galbeed iyo ballaarinta degsiimooyinka Israel ee halkaas ka jira. Midowga Yurub ayaa xilligan ku sugan New York iyadoo ay socdaan diyaar-garowga Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay , kaas oo dooddiisa heerka sare ay bilaabanayso 22-ka Sebtembar 2026.

items.title: Faah faahin: Labo Weriye oo Rug-cadaa ah oo geeriyooday
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Alle hau naxariisto waxaa sacaadihii lasoo dhaafay geeriyooday Maxamed Aweys Muudey ( Boqorka Bartamaha ) iyo Xasan Kaafi Cabdiraxmaan ( Qoyste) oo ahaa labo weriye oo rug cadaaha soo shaqeeyey xiliyo adag. Wariye Boqorka Bartamaha ayaa shalay ku geeriyooday isbitaal ku yaalla dalka Jarmalka, kaddib dhaawac culus oo ka soo gaaray weerar uu nin Soomaali ah tooreey ku dhuftay. Dhinaca kale kale wariye Xasan Kaafi Qoyste oo muddo dheer ka soo shaqaynayay warbaahinta gudaha iyo midda dibada ayaa saaka si kedis ah ugu geeriyooday kaddib xanuun soo wajahay magaalada Muqdisho. Bahda saxaafadda Soomaalida iyo qaar kamid ah madaxda Soomaaliya ayaa ka tacsiyeeyay geerida labada wariye, oo wax badan u soo qabtay bahda Saxaafadda Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Muxuu Jaamac ka yiri halista kasoo korortay xeebaha dalka?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo maanta khudbad ka jeediyay Baaramaanka ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan halista kooxaha burcadbadeedda oo mar kale kusoo rogaal celiyay xeebaha dalka. Jaamac ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in burcadbadeedda ay saameyn weyn ku leedahay xasilloonida gobolka iyo guud ahaan caalamka, wuxuuna sheegay in Baarlamaanka Soomaaliyeed ay ka go’an tahay in uu xoojiyo qaab-dhismeedka sharciyeed ee lagama maarmaanka u ah xaqiijinta ujeeddooyinkan, isla markaana uu guto waajibaadkiisa korjoogteynta, si loo xaqiijiyo dhaqan-galka shuruucda muhiimka u ah bulshada Soomaaliyeed. “Doodda maanta ee Golaha Shacabka ee ku saabsan burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya iyo saameynteeda, waxaan Xildhibaannada ku boorrinayaa inay doodda ku saleeyaan xog- ogaalnimo, adinkoo diiradda saaraya saameynta ay ku leedahay amniga, dhaqaalaha, bulshooyinka xeebaha, khayraadka badda iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah, isla markaana soo jeedinaya xalal wax-ku-ool ah oo lagu xoojinayo amniga badaha iyo la-dagaallanka burcad-badeednimada,” ayuu yiri guddoomiyuhu. Hoos ka akhriso warsaxaafadeedka oo dhammaystirka;- Burcad-badeednimada ka jirta xeebaha Soomaaliya ma aha oo keliya caqabad dhinaca amniga badaha ah. Waxay saameyn culus ku yeelatay dalkeenna, dadkeenna, badmaaxiinta, kaluumeysatada, dhaqaalaha gobolka iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Gudaha Soomaaliya, burcad-badeednimadu waxay dhaawacday sumcadda dalka, waxay caqabad ku noqotay horumarinta dhaqaalaha badda iyo kalluumeysiga sharciga ah, waxay khatar gelisay bulshooyinka ku nool xeebaha, waxayna wiiqday kalsoonida lagu qabo amniga biyaha Soomaaliya. Heer caalami burcad-badeednimadu waxay kordhisay kharashaadka gaadiidka badda, caymiska iyo sugidda amniga maraakiibta, iyadoo badmaaxiin badan ay la kulmeen afduub, rabshado iyo muddo dheer oo ay afduub loohaystay. Saameynta dhaqaale ee burcad-badeednimaduna waxay ahayd mid aad u weyn. Cilmi-baaris uu sameeyey Bangiga Adduunka ayaa qiyaastay in muddadii daraasadda lagu sameeyey, burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya ay dhaqaalaha adduunka ku kordhisay kharash lagu qiyaasay ilaa 18 bilyan oo Doollarka Mareykanka ah sannadkii. Tani waxay muujinaysaa in burcad-badeednimadu aysan ahayn oo keliya dhibaato Soomaaliyeed, balse ay saameyn ku leedahay xasilloonida gobolka iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Sidaas darteed, Soomaaliya waxaa saaran masuuliyad qaran iyo waajibaad caalami ah oo ku saabsan in dhulkeeda iyo biyaheeda aan loo adeegsan saldhig laga fuliyo burcad-badeednimo, afduub iyo dambiyada kale ee la xiriira badaha. Arrintan awgeed, Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya wuxuu qaaday tallaabo sharci-dejineed oo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo la-dagaallanka burcad-badeednimada iyo ka-hortagga afduubka. 10-kii Nofeembar 2025, Kulankii 13aad ee Kalfadhiga 7aad, Golaha Shacabka wuxuu ansixiyey Hindise-Sharciyeedka Dib-u-eegista Sharciga La-dagaallanka Burcad-badeedda iyo Ka-hortagga Afduubka, Lr. 36 ee 30-ka Abriil 1975, kaas oo muhiim u ah casriyeynta iyo xoojinta hannaanka sharciyeed ee dalka ee la-dagaallanka burcad-badeednimada iyo dambiyada la xiriira. Sidoo kale, 9-kii Sebteembar 2026, Golaha Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ansixiyey La-dagaallanka Burcad-badeedda iyo Ka-hortagga Afduubka. Tani waxay ahayd tallaabo kale oo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo qaab-dhismeedka sharciyeed ee Soomaaliya ee la-dagaallanka burcad-badeednimada, afduubka iyo dambiyada kale ee la xiriira badaha. Ansixinta sharcigan ee labada Aqal waxay muujinaysaa sida Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ay uga go’an tahay xoojinta sarreynta sharciga, ilaalinta nolosha dadka, sugidda amniga badaha Soomaaliya iyo ka qaybqaadashada amniga badaha ee heer gobol iyo heer caalami. Hase yeeshee, sharci keliya laguma ciribtiri karo burcad-badeednimada. Shuruucdeenna waa in ay la socdaan dhaqan-gelin wax-ku-ool ah, xoojinta hay’adaha ammaanka iyo ilaalinta badaha, awoodda hay’adaha garsoorka iyo dacwad-oogista, sugidda amniga xeebaha, iyo abuurista fursado dhaqaale oo wanaagsan oo ay helaan bulshooyinka ku nool deegaannada xeebaha. Sidoo kale, waa inaan sii xoojinnaa iskaashiga aan la leenahay saaxiibadeenna gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay qaadanayso mas’uuliyadda koowaad ee amniga iyo maamulidda baddeeda. La-dagaallanka burcad-badeednimadu sidaas darteed ma aha oo keliya arrin amni. Waa qayb ka mid ah dib-u-dhiska dowladnimada Soomaaliya, ilaalinta madax-bannaanideenna iyo khayraadkeenna dabiiciga ah, xoojinta dhaqaalaha dalka, badbaadinta dadkeenna, iyo ka qaybqaadashada sugidda amniga ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee mara badaha. Golaha Shacabka waxaa ka go’an inuu sii xoojiyo qaab-dhismeedka sharciyeed ee lagama maarmaanka u ah xaqiijinta ujeeddooyinkan, isla markaana uu guto waajibaadkiisa korjoogteynta Baarlamaanka si loo xaqiijiyo in shuruucda aan ansixinno si buuxda oo wax-ku-ool ah loo dhaqan-geliyo. Doodda maanta ee Golaha Shacabka ee ku saabsan burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya iyo saameynteeda, waxaan Xildhibaannada ku boorrinayaa inay doodda ku saleeyaan xog- ogaalnimo, adinkoo diiradda saaraya saameynta ay ku leedahay amniga, dhaqaalaha, bulshooyinka xeebaha, khayraadka badda iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah, isla markaana soo jeedinaya xalal wax-ku-ool ah oo lagu xoojinayo amniga badaha iyo la-dagaallanka burcad-badeednimada. items.title: Somalia’s security clock is ticking: Can Somali forces survive the UNSOS, AUSSOM drawdown?
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The United States has given the UN more time to wind down its Somalia support, but not a permanent reprieve. International Crisis Group warns that the security architecture protecting Somalia for nearly two decades is approaching its end. The decisive question is whether Somali forces can assume responsibility before the system beneath them disappears. Somalia has been given more time. It has not been given more certainty. On 18 September 2026, the United States agreed to give the United Nations another year to phase out its support for the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia, or AUSSOM. The drawdown is now expected to begin in January 2027 rather than amounting to an abrupt end to UN support at the start of next year. But Washington is still moving away from funding and supporting the United Nations Support Office in Somalia, known as UNSOS, which provides the logistical machinery on which AUSSOM heavily depends. That distinction is at the heart of Somalia’s next security crisis. The International Crisis Group’s latest report, “Somalia Awaits a New Security Order as Mission Drawdown Looms,” argues that the multilateral security system that has helped the Somali government confront Al-Shabaab since 2007 is approaching its final phase. Crisis Group says the new U.S. position buys time for a more orderly transition — but does not solve the fundamental problem of what replaces UNSOS, and potentially AUSSOM, once the drawdown gathers pace. For Somalia, this is not simply a story about foreign troops leaving. It is a test of whether the country can finally carry the weight of its own security. And the answer is complicated. Somali forces are stronger than they were a decade ago. They have recruited and trained thousands of new personnel and increasingly lead operations against Al-Shabaab. But they still rely on foreign intelligence, air support, training, financing and — critically — logistics. But that does not mean Somali forces are incapable of assuming substantially greater responsibility. In fact, that transition has already begun. Can Somali forces: deploy rapidly across the country? supply troops without UN logistics? transport fuel and ammunition to remote positions? evacuate wounded soldiers? maintain vehicles and communications equipment? provide intelligence and surveillance? call in effective air support? reinforce an isolated base quickly? hold territory after an offensive? provide policing and administration after military forces arrive? operate under one coherent national command? maintain forces when foreign funding declines? Those are much harder questions. And this is where the Crisis Group assessment becomes particularly significant. It says the Somali National Army is still ill-prepared to rapidly and fully replace AUSSOM. Some areas handed over to Somali forces in recent years have subsequently fallen back into Al-Shabaab’s hands. Even when Somali forces have led operations, including campaigns in Lower Shabelle, they have remained dependent on external support. So the answer is not that Somalia has no capable forces. The answer is that Somalia has growing military capacity without yet possessing a fully self-sustaining national security system. That is a very different problem. Capturing territory is not the same as holding it This may be the single most important military lesson from Somalia’s transition. A military can capture a town. A state must hold it. The difference is enormous. Holding territory requires soldiers to remain supplied. It requires roads to remain open. It requires intelligence. It requires police. It requires functioning local administration. It requires courts, services and political legitimacy. If those systems do not follow the soldiers, an offensive can create only temporary control. Al-Shabaab has repeatedly demonstrated the ability to exploit such gaps. The group remains capable of asymmetric attacks, ambushes, improvised explosive-device attacks and economic coercion. That means the real measure of Somali military readiness should not be simply the number of troops on paper. It should be whether those troops can deploy, sustain, reinforce and hold territory independently. Why UNSOS is difficult to replace This is where Somalia’s transition becomes brutally practical. Suppose the UN leaves. Who supplies AUSSOM troops with fuel? Who transports supplies? Who maintains vehicles? Who handles medical evacuation? Who provides aviation? Who repairs infrastructure? Who supplies remote bases? Those are not theoretical questions. They are the daily mechanics of military power. Crisis Group says there is currently no obvious replacement for UNSOS capable of immediately providing the same level of logistical support to a multinational force. One possibility is for the African Union to create its own logistical operation. But the AU does not currently possess an equivalent system with UNSOS’s experience and scale. Another possibility is outsourcing logistics to private contractors. But Crisis Group notes that building a system with comparable capabilities could take up to two years – while the AU itself is struggling to finance the mission. The third possibility is simply shrinking AUSSOM. That would save money. It could also mean fewer bases, fewer troops and less ability to operate outside major population centres. In other words: Every replacement option involves a trade-off. Could AUSSOM survive without UNSOS? In its current form, the answer is highly uncertain. UNSOS currently supports AUSSOM across 49 locations, providing food, water, fuel, transportation, engineering, aviation, communications, maintenance and medical services. Crisis Group says AU officials privately regard the mission as unable to continue in anything resembling its current form without UN support. That leaves several possible futures. AUSSOM option one: Build an AU logistics system The AU could attempt to replace UNSOS. The problem is time, expertise and money. AUSSOM option two: Shrink the mission A smaller AUSSOM could concentrate on Mogadishu and other strategic locations. But fewer troops would mean less territorial coverage. AUSSOM option three: Create a regional force African troop contributors could retain forces under a new regional arrangement. But this would still leave questions over logistics, funding and command. AUSSOM option four: Shift toward bilateral security partnerships Uganda, Kenya, Ethiopia and other partners could maintain forces through bilateral agreements with Somalia. Türkiye could continue training and supporting Somali forces. The United States could continue counter-terrorism operations and air support. This may be the most realistic bridge. But it also creates a new problem. Somalia could trade one security system for a patchwork For almost two decades, the international security architecture in Somalia has had a common framework. A bilateral future would be different. Kenya and Ethiopia have powerful interests in border security. Uganda has maintained a long-running military presence in Somalia. Türkiye has developed an exceptionally close security partnership with Mogadishu. The United States is focused heavily on counter-terrorism. These interests overlap. They are not identical. Crisis Group therefore warns that a poorly coordinated bilateral system could produce zones of influence that reinforce Somalia’s existing political divisions. That could create a strange new map of Somalia: one partner focused on Mogadishu; another near the Kenyan border; another around Ethiopia’s frontier; Somali forces operating between them; and Al-Shabaab exploiting whatever spaces remain weakly protected. The challenge for Mogadishu will be to turn these separate relationships into a coherent national security strategy. That matters enormously. A national army cannot function effectively if the country’s political leadership remains divided over: who commands security forces; where troops should be deployed; how resources are distributed; how federal and state authorities share power; how elections are organised; and which institutions ultimately control national security. Crisis Group notes that during political crises, federal and state forces have sometimes faced one another. That is the nightmare scenario for a country attempting to consolidate its security architecture. Every soldier deployed against another Somali security force is a soldier unavailable for the fight against Al-Shabaab. Every political dispute that paralyses security coordination gives an armed insurgency another opening. What could Al-Shabaab gain from a badly managed transition? This question requires precision. The Crisis Group report does not say that Al-Shabaab will automatically defeat the Somali government after UNSOS withdraws. That would be an unjustified conclusion. But it does identify several vulnerabilities that could become more serious. 1. Abandoned or weakened bases If foreign troops withdraw from positions without a Somali replacement capable of holding them, Al-Shabaab could move into the resulting vacuum. 2. Vulnerable roads Control of roads and economic corridors matters both militarily and financially. 3. Isolated towns Smaller towns surrounded by areas of Al-Shabaab influence could become particularly exposed. 4. Reduced logistical reach Without UN support, foreign troops may have to consolidate closer to major cities or their own national borders. 5. Reduced operational tempo A shortage of fuel, transport, aviation or medical evacuation can restrict military operations even when troops remain available. 6. Political fragmentation If federal and state authorities continue to disagree over security, Al-Shabaab can benefit from the resulting gaps. The Crisis Group report specifically highlights vulnerabilities around parts of Lower Shabelle and Hirshabelle, including towns and roads that could become more exposed if foreign forces withdraw. The danger, therefore, is not necessarily an overnight collapse. It is incremental erosion. A base here. A road there. A rural district elsewhere. A government presence that becomes thinner. An insurgent network that becomes bolder. Security transitions rarely fail with one dramatic event. They can fail one gap at a time. The money problem behind Somalia’s security problem There is another reality that cannot be ignored: security costs money. Troops require salaries. Vehicles require fuel. Aircraft require maintenance. Bases require electricity, water and repairs. Wounded soldiers require evacuation and medical treatment. Communications systems require equipment and maintenance. And none of these requirements disappear because international troops leave. UNSOS’s current system is therefore not merely a military arrangement. It is an enormous financial mechanism. Reuters reports that UNSOS operates with an annual budget of roughly $500 million, underscoring the scale of the infrastructure that Somalia and its partners are being asked to replace. Meanwhile, AUSSOM itself has struggled with funding. Crisis Group describes the AU mission as having run a substantial deficit for years, while traditional donors have reduced their contributions. The financial problem therefore has two layers: Who pays for the international mission? And increasingly: Who pays for Somalia’s own security forces? Somalia has improved its domestic revenue collection and has financed some military operations itself, according to Crisis Group. But the country’s fiscal capacity remains limited relative to the scale of its security requirements. That makes donor coordination essential. Somalia’s foreign partners could become the bridge The end of UNSOS does not necessarily mean the end of international military assistance. Far from it. Crisis Group identifies an increasingly important network of bilateral relationships. Türkiye Türkiye has become one of Somalia’s most important security partners, training thousands of Somali troops and providing military capabilities including drones and F-16 aircraft. Ankara also has extensive strategic and economic interests in Somalia. United States Washington says it intends to continue bilateral counter-terrorism operations, including air capabilities, even as it moves away from supporting UNSOS. Uganda Ugandan forces have maintained a major presence around Mogadishu and have been central to the African Union mission since its beginning. Kenya Kenyan forces remain particularly important in areas near Somalia’s southern border. Ethiopia Ethiopian forces maintain a significant security role along their border and within Somalia. These relationships could provide the security bridge Somalia needs. But there is a condition. They have to be coordinated. Somalia needs a security coalition, not competing security arrangements This may be the most important recommendation emerging from the Crisis Group report. Mogadishu should establish a regular forum bringing together: the Federal Government; federal member states; AUSSOM troop contributors; bilateral military partners; the African Union; the United Nations; major donors. The purpose would be simple: Who is responsible for what after UNSOS? Which force protects which city? Who supports which road? Who provides aviation? Who pays? Who supplies Somali units? Where will foreign forces remain? Which positions will Somali forces inherit? What happens if Al-Shabaab attacks? And how does Somalia ensure that foreign security partnerships strengthen rather than fragment the national security system? Crisis Group argues that such coordination is essential to prevent bilateral security relationships from turning into competing zones of influence. This is not diplomatic housekeeping. It is national security planning. The 14,000-soldier question Mogadishu said in early August that it had approximately 14,000 troops available for military operations who could potentially be used as holding forces in areas vacated by departing AU troops, according to Crisis Group. That figure sounds substantial. But numbers alone can be deceptive. A force of 14,000 soldiers cannot automatically substitute for an international mission simply because the headcount appears comparable in some locations. The real comparison is capability. AUSSOM brings foreign contingents with established command structures, external financing, military logistics and access to the UNSOS support network. Somali units may have fewer resources and remain dependent on external support. A one-for-one substitution could therefore be dangerous. The question should not be: How many Somali soldiers can replace departing AU soldiers? It should be: How many Somali soldiers can sustainably hold each strategically important area with the logistics, intelligence, mobility and political support required to prevent its loss? That is a much harder calculation. What happens to Mogadishu? Mogadishu is likely to remain the centre of gravity of the new security order. The city has benefited from improved security in recent years, and the Somali government retains control of the capital. Crisis Group argues that Al-Shabaab remains largely concentrated in rural areas even though it continues to threaten the government and conduct attacks. That means a future security architecture is likely to prioritise: Mogadishu; major regional capitals; airports; ports; major roads; economic corridors; strategically important towns. But concentrating resources in urban centres carries a risk. If rural areas are abandoned too quickly, Al-Shabaab can consolidate its influence outside the cities. That can eventually translate into economic pressure, taxation, recruitment and attacks against government-controlled areas. Urban security and rural security are therefore not separate problems. They are connected. What happens to rural Somalia? This could be the hardest part of the transition. Al-Shabaab has historically demonstrated that it does not need to control every major city to remain a powerful insurgent organisation. Its rural presence allows it to: move fighters; collect taxes; establish checkpoints; gather intelligence; launch attacks; threaten supply routes; and impose its authority in areas where government institutions are weak. A smaller international footprint could therefore produce a geographic imbalance: government control in cities, insurgent influence in the countryside. That may be sustainable for a period. But it does not amount to a decisive resolution of Somalia’s security problem. What Somali forces need before the final handover If Somalia is to assume the security burden successfully, troop recruitment cannot be the only priority. The country needs to build the supporting architecture around its soldiers. 1. Logistics Somali forces must increasingly be able to supply themselves with food, fuel, transport and equipment. 2. Medical evacuation A force operating without dependable casualty evacuation becomes vulnerable quickly. /UNSOS currently provides medical infrastructure and MEDEVAC/CASEVAC support. 3. Mobility Somali forces must be able to move rapidly between threatened areas. 4. Intelligence Operations against an adaptive insurgency depend on reliable intelligence. 5. Air support Foreign air capabilities have become an important component of operations against Al-Shabaab. 6. Command and control Federal and state forces need a clearer national security framework. 7. Financing A sustainable national army requires predictable domestic and international financing. 8. Territorial governance Military operations need to be followed by functioning civilian administration. 9. Political agreement Federal and member-state authorities need to agree on who is responsible for what. 10. Accountability A national security force needs public legitimacy as well as battlefield capability. That is what makes the transition so difficult. Somalia is not merely building an army. It is trying to build a state capable of sustaining an army. The danger of replacing one dependency with another There is an uncomfortable possibility hidden inside the transition. Somalia could successfully reduce its dependence on a UN-AU security structure only to become more dependent on several bilateral partners. That would be a change in architecture, but not necessarily a complete transition to self-reliance. Crisis Group sees bilateral relationships as the most pragmatic short-term way of preventing a major security deterioration. But it also makes clear that this should be viewed as a temporary bridge while Somali forces develop the capacity to assume greater responsibility. The distinction is crucial. Bilateral assistance can buy time. It cannot permanently substitute for a functioning Somali security state. The 2027 question The most important date may no longer be simply 31 December 2026. The real question is what Somalia looks like during and after the expected 2027 drawdown. The additional year gives Mogadishu and its partners an opportunity to plan. But the year could also disappear quickly. By the time the logistical drawdown is fully under way, Somalia cannot still be debating basic questions about who will provide fuel, transport and medical evacuation. Those decisions need to be made before the infrastructure disappears. Crisis Group therefore argues that Somalia and its partners should use the temporary reprieve to construct a new security system capable of operating from the second half of 2027. That makes 2026–27 less a period of waiting than a period of preparation. Is Somalia ready? The evidence points to a nuanced answer. Somalia is more capable than it was. Its security forces have expanded. Thousands of troops have received foreign training. Somali forces increasingly lead operations. The government has developed greater domestic revenue capacity. International partners remain willing to provide forms of bilateral support. But Somalia is not yet fully self-sufficient. Its forces remain dependent on external logistical and operational assistance. Some areas transferred to Somali forces have subsequently been lost. Political disputes continue to weaken national security coordination. Federal and state security structures remain fragmented. AUSSOM itself still provides an important security buffer. And the logistical infrastructure behind that mission is now approaching its own transition. That is why the most accurate answer is neither “Somalia is ready” nor “Somalia is incapable.” The evidence suggests that Somalia can assume more responsibility, but a rapid one-for-one replacement of AUSSOM by Somali forces would carry significant risks. What Somalia should do now The Crisis Group report points toward a practical roadmap. First: Build the replacement system before dismantling the old one The transition should not be based on hope that another arrangement will emerge later. Second: Keep bilateral partners coordinated Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Türkiye, the United States and other partners should operate within a coherent Somali-led security framework. Third: Prioritise strategic territory Somali forces should be ready to move into areas where foreign troops withdraw, particularly around major towns, roads and infrastructure. Fourth: Avoid overextending the army Crisis Group argues that Somalia should be cautious about launching major new offensives while the security architecture itself is being transformed. Fifth: Resolve political disputes A fragmented political system cannot easily produce a unified national security force. Sixth: Create predictable financing Somalia and its partners need a realistic multi-year funding model for both international support and the Somali security forces. Seventh: Give federal member states a place in the security transition A national security plan that excludes powerful regional actors risks reproducing the very divisions that have weakened the security sector. The biggest mistake would be to confuse withdrawal with transition There is a temptation to see the end of UNSOS as simply the end of international involvement. That would be wrong. The real story is about what comes after the international system. If the withdrawal is coordinated, Somalia could emerge with a more genuinely Somali-led security architecture, supported by carefully structured bilateral partnerships. If the withdrawal is chaotic, Somalia could face shrinking security coverage, increased pressure on vulnerable towns and roads, financial crises inside security institutions and greater opportunities for Al-Shabaab. The outcome is therefore not predetermined. It depends on what happens during the transition. Somalia’s security order is being rewritten For nearly twenty years, the international community has helped Somalia keep the lights on in its security sector. Now the scaffolding is coming down. The United States has granted another year for the UN to wind down its support, giving Somalia and its partners additional time. But the direction of travel remains unmistakable. UNSOS is approaching the end of its current role, while AUSSOM faces the difficult task of determining whether and how it can survive without the logistical system that sustains it. Somali forces have made real progress. But progress is not the same as readiness for complete independence. The decisive test will be whether Somalia can convert an expanding army into a sustainable national security institution — one capable not merely of fighting, but of supplying itself, holding territory, protecting roads, working with regional authorities and maintaining security after foreign partners reduce their presence. Al-Shabaab will be watching that transition. So will Somalia’s neighbours. So will Türkiye, the United States, the African Union, the European Union and the Gulf states. And perhaps most importantly, so will ordinary Somalis living in the towns and villages where the difference between a functioning security system and a security vacuum is measured in whether a road remains open, a market remains accessible, a school remains protected and a family can travel without fear. The coming transition is therefore larger than the fate of one UN office. It is a test of the Somali state itself. Can Somalia take responsibility for its own security? The evidence suggests that it is moving toward that goal. But the evidence also suggests that it is not yet ready to do so without substantial external support. That is precisely why the next year matters. The clock has not stopped. It has merely been reset. And when UNSOS finally begins to disappear, Somalia will discover whether the security architecture built in its place is strong enough to stand on its own. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com
