items.title: Political Violence Addressed: 14-Month Sentence for Attacker of Ilhan Omar
items.description: Minneapolis – (WDN) – A federal court in Minnesota has sentenced 56-year-old Anthony James Kazmierczak to 14 months in prison after he was found guilty of assaulting U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar during a town hall meeting in Minneapolis on January 27, 2026. Kazmierczak was sentenced on Thursday to 14 months in prison, followed by three years of supervised release, after admitting to the assault. In May, he previously confessed to attacking a federal officer. Court documents reveal that he had premeditated the assault, fueled by his political opposition to Omar’s views. During the incident, Kazmierczak was seated in the front row of the event when he unexpectedly approached Omar. He was carrying a syringe filled with a liquid later confirmed to be apple cider vinegar, which came into contact with Omar’s clothing and skin. Kazmierczak also shouted abusive remarks at Omar before being swiftly subdued by her security team and subsequently arrested by Minneapolis police. Fortunately, Omar was unharmed and continued with the town hall meeting despite the attack. Prosecutors indicated that the assault was not a spontaneous act. According to filings presented to the court, Kazmierczak had sent messages to at least three individuals prior to the meeting, indicating his intent to disrupt the event. Further evidence presented to the court revealed that Kazmierczak had spoken with a neighbor about caring for his dog and had sought information regarding bail arrangements, which the prosecution argued demonstrated he anticipated being arrested after the incident. Following the assault, Kazmierczak sent Omar an apology text stating, “I’m sorry if I scared you.” Judge Joan N. Ericksen characterized the attack as a deliberate act rather than a random occurrence, noting that Kazmierczak had obtained tickets to the meeting weeks prior. Prosecutors also shared posts Kazmierczak made on social media, in which he criticized former President Joe Biden and the Democratic Party while expressing support for former President Donald Trump. The U.S. Department of Justice noted that Kazmierczak acknowledged his attack was linked to his opposition to Omar’s political beliefs. Minnesota U.S. Attorney Daniel N. Rosen remarked that this case exemplifies instances where some individuals transform their political grievances into criminal acts. Kazmierczak expressed regret for the incident during the court proceedings and extended his apologies to Omar. The new sentencing order also prohibits Kazmierczak from contacting Omar during his supervised release. Ilhan Omar, a Somali-American congresswoman representing Minnesota, has long been a prominent figure in U.S. political debates, particularly concerning immigration and federal policies. items.title: Further Sanctions on Cuba’s Mineral Wealth and Military Modernization Apparatus
items.description: Further Sanctions on Cuba’s Mineral Wealth and Military Modernization Apparatus Press Statement Marco Rubio, Secretary of State September 17, 2026 For decades, the Cuban regime has channeled all of the island’s resources into the hands of a narrow and corrupt military elite, leaving ordinary Cubans without reliable power, food, or dignity. Today, pursuant to President Trump’s Executive Order (E.O.) 14404, “Imposing Sanctions on Those Responsible for Repression in Cuba and for Threats to United States National Security and Foreign Policy,” I am designating 11 actors that fuel this exploitation: four state-run enterprises that strip Cuba’s nickel reserves for regime profit, four military enterprises dedicated to research and development for weapons systems, naval capabilities, and battlefield simulation, and three military officials leading them. The Trump Administration will not stand by as Cuba’s elite enrich themselves through resource extraction and hoard resources for Cuba’s repressive security apparatus while the Cuban people go without. President Trump remains committed to a Cuba governed by its people, not by a military class that treats the island’s future as its own private inheritance. The Department’s actions are being taken pursuant to E.O. 14404, which authorizes sweeping sanctions on Cuba, including against persons who support the Cuban regime’s security apparatus and those responsible for repression in Cuba and other threats to U.S. national security. These actions also further both E.O. 14380, “ Addressing Threats to the United States by the Government of Cuba ” and National Security Presidential Memorandum 5 , which directs the Executive Branch to improve human rights, encourage the rule of law, foster free markets and free enterprise, and promote democracy in Cuba

items.title: Mareykanka oo digniin kasoo saaray Doolow kadib markii…
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa digniin cusub oo dhinaca amniga ah u dirtay muwaadiniinteeda, iyadoo uga digtay inay u safraan aagga Doolow ee Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya, sababo la xiriira walaac laga qabo xaaladda amni ee deegaanka. Warbixinta digniinta ayaa xustay in qaybo ka mid ah Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida iyo dhulka ku dhow xuduudda Soomaaliya loo arko goobo ay ka jirto khatar amni oo sare. Khataraha la tilmaamay waxaa kamid ah argagixiso, afduub iyo qalalaase amni. Shaqaalaha dowladda Mareykanka ee ku sugan Itoobiya ama qorsheynaya inay u safraan dalkaasi ayaa iyagana lagu wargeliyay xannibaad gaar ah oo ku saabsan Doolow. Sida ay sheegtay Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Addis Ababa, shaqaalaha dowladda looma oggola inay tagaan aaggaasi haddii aysan haysan oggolaansho gaar ah. Sidoo kale, digniinta ayaa muwaadiniinta Mareykanka kula talisay inay ka fogaadaan meelaha loo aqoonsaday inay khatartu ka jirto, ayna muujiyaan feejignaan dheeraad ah marka ay ku sugan yihiin ama u safrayaan deegaanada ku dhow xuduudda. Inkasta oo Doolow si gaar ah loogu xusay digniinta, Safaaradda Mareykanka ma aysan shaacin faahfaahin ku saabsan khatarta gaarka ah ee keentay digniinta cusub. Sidoo kale, ma aysan magacaabin koox ama dhinac gaar ah oo ay la xiriirinsay xaaladda amni ee ay ka digtay. Doolow iyo deegaanada ku dhow xuduudda Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa muhiim u ah isku socodka labada dal, maadaama ay yihiin marinno ay isaga gudbaan dadka iyo gaadiidka. Safaaradda ayaa ugu dambeyntiina muwaadiniinta Mareykanka ku boorisay inay si joogto ah ula socdaan xaaladda amni, ayna qaataan taxaddarrada lagama maarmaanka ah marka ay ku sugan yihiin ama u safrayaan deegaanada uu Mareykanku u aqoonsaday inay khatartu ka jirto. Si kastaba, ilaa hadda ma jirto jawaab rasmi ah oo kasoo baxday dowladda Itoobiya ama maamulka Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida oo ku aaddan digniinta ay soo saartay Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Addis Ababa. items.title: Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo dhisay xukuumad cusub
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen ayaa soo saaray warqad uu ku sheegay wareegto magacaabis, taas oo uu ku dhisay xukuumad cusub. Magacaabistan oo kasoo baxday xafiiska Lafta-gareen ayaa waxaa xubnaha la magacaabay loo kala xilsaaray wasaarado kala duwan oo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, waxbarashada, caafimaadka bulshada, beeraha iyo waraabka, iyo gaadiidka. Xubnaha cusub ee Lafta-gareen uu sheegay inuu wasiirro u magacaabay ayaa waxaa ka mid ah Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo loo magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta iyo Wacyigelinta Bulshada ee Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale, Ilyaas Cali Nuur ayuu Lafta-gareen sheegay inuu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Isboortiga, halka Cabdi Axmed Qaasim uu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud iyo Dib-u-dhiska ee maamulkaasi. Macallin Aadan Cali Arbow ayuu sheegay inuu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale, Ibraahim Aadan Cali Naja ayuu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Dowladaha Hoose ee Koonfur Galbeed, halka Maxamed Yuusuf Cali uu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Waraabka. Maxamed Ibraahim Cali ayaa isna wuxuu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Shaqada iyo Arrimaha Bulshada, halka Xasan Cabdulaqaadir Maxamed loo magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha. Waxaa sidoo kale Lafta-gareen uu sheegay inuu xilal wasiirnimo u magacaabay Xasan Cabdinuur Albaro iyo Mustaf Axmed Idow. Magacaabista Lafta-gareen ee xubnahan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli maamulka Koonfur Galbeed uu leeyahay xukuumad shaqeysa, isla markaana uu meel adag marayo dagaalka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya maamulka cusub iyo kii hore ee uu hoggaaminayo Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. items.title: Mareykanka oo $5 milyan ku raadinaya gabar Soomaali ah
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa ku dhawaaqday abaalmarin gaareysa illaa $5 milyan oo la siinayo cid kasta oo keenta xog ku saabsan Khadra Essa, oo ah haweeney Soomaali ah oo haysata dhalashada Netherlands, taas oo Washington ku eedeysay inay door sare ku lahayd koox haween ah oo ka tirsanaa ururka Daacish ee ka dagaallamay Suuriya. Barnaamijka Rewards for Justice ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Khadra Essa, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Umm Qaqa al-Somali, ay ahayd macallimaddii ugu sarreysay ee shareecada ee Nusaybah Katibah, oo ahayd guuto haween ah oo Daacish ka tirsan. Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, Khadra waxay Suuriya u safartay sanadkii 2014 si ay ugu biirto ISIS, waxaana halkaas lagu tababaray hubka, walxaha qarxa iyo weerarrada ismiidaaminta ah. Maamulka Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay inay si joogto ah u dhiirrigelin jirtay rabshadaha, xubnaha Daacish-na ku boorrin jirtay inay weerarro ka fuliyaan dalal kala duwan. Waxaa kale oo lagu eedeeyay inay baraysay fikrado xagjir ah oo lagu marmarsiyoon jiray weerarrada ismiidaaminta iyo dilka dadka rayidka ah, isla markaana ay ururka u qori jirtay xubno cusub. Guuto haween ah Nusaybah Katibah, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan ISIS-NK, ayaa sanadkii 2016 laga aas-aasay magaalada Raqqa ee Suuriya, si loo ururiyo loona tababaro haweenka dagaalyahannada ah. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in guutadan ay xilligii ay ugu xoogga badneyd lahayd boqolaal haween ah oo tababaran, kuwaas oo ay ku jireen muwaadiniin Mareykan iyo Yurub u dhashay. Inkastoo tiradeedu hoos u dhacday kadib markii Daacish laga qabsaday dhulkii ballaarnaa ee ay ka talin jirtay Suuriya iyo Ciraaq, haddana Washington waxay sheegtay in unuggan uu weli firfircoon yahay. Khadra Essa ayaa sidoo kale lagu eedeeyay inay hoggaamin jirtay koox si xoog ah ugu fulisa haweenka xeerarkii Daacish. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay inay bixisay amarro sababay ciqaabo jireed, oo ay ku jireen garaacis iyo dilal. Warbixinta Rewards for Justice ma sheegin da’da Khadra ama halka ay hadda ku sugan tahay, balse Suuriya ayay ku xustay goobta la xiriirta kiiskeeda. Carruur Mareykan ah oo la waayay Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale Khadra Essa ku xiriiriyay maqnaanshaha laba carruur ah oo Mareykan ah, Yusuf iyo Zahra Shikder. Sida ay sheegayaan mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka, hooyada carruurta ayaa sanadkii 2015 u kaxeysay Suuriya iyadoo aan oggolaansho ka haysan aabbahood, si ay ugu biirto Daacish. Kadib markii hooyadood ay ku dhimatay duqeyn militari oo lagu qaaday Daacish sanadkii 2019, Khadra ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay carruurta la wareegtay, kadibna geysay meel aan la ogeyn oo Suuriya ku taalla. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Khadra lagu ogaa inay gacanta ku haysay carruur kale oo la afduubtay ama la kaxeystay. Rewards for Justice ayaa si gaar ah u bixineysa abaalmarin gaareysa illaa $5 milyan oo lagu helayo xog horseedda in la helo, dib loo soo celiyo ama la soo badbaadiyo Yusuf iyo Zahra. Barnaamijka Rewards for Justice waxaa la aas-aasay sanadkii 1984, waxaana maamula Waaxda Amniga Diblomaasiyadda ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka. Barnaamijku wuxuu abaalmarin lacageed ku bixiyaa xog ka caawin karta Mareykanka inuu aqoonsado ama helo dadka lagu raadinayo arrimaha argagixisada, ka hortago weerarro ama carqaladeeyo maalgelinta kooxaha argagixisada. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay inay bixisay amarro sababay ciqaabo jireed, oo ay ku jireen garaacis iyo dilal. Warbixinta Rewards for Justice ma sheegin da’da Khadra ama halka ay hadda ku sugan tahay, balse Suuriya ayay ku xustay goobta la xiriirta kiiskeeda. Carruur Mareykan ah oo la waayay Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale Khadra Essa ku xiriiriyay maqnaanshaha laba carruur ah oo Mareykan ah, Yusuf iyo Zahra Shikder. Sida ay sheegayaan mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka, hooyada carruurta ayaa sanadkii 2015 u kaxeysay Suuriya iyadoo aan oggolaansho ka haysan aabbahood, si ay ugu biirto Daacish. Kadib markii hooyadood ay ku dhimatay duqeyn militari oo lagu qaaday Daacish sanadkii 2019, Khadra ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay carruurta la wareegtay, kadibna geysay meel aan la ogeyn oo Suuriya ku taalla. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Khadra lagu ogaa inay gacanta ku haysay carruur kale oo la afduubtay ama la kaxeystay. Rewards for Justice ayaa si gaar ah u bixineysa abaalmarin gaareysa illaa $5 milyan oo lagu helayo xog horseedda in la helo, dib loo soo celiyo ama la soo badbaadiyo Yusuf iyo Zahra. Barnaamijka Rewards for Justice waxaa la aas-aasay sanadkii 1984, waxaana maamula Waaxda Amniga Diblomaasiyadda ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka. Barnaamijku wuxuu abaalmarin lacageed ku bixiyaa xog ka caawin karta Mareykanka inuu aqoonsado ama helo dadka lagu raadinayo arrimaha argagixisada, ka hortago weerarro ama carqaladeeyo maalgelinta kooxaha argagixisada. Soomaaliya oo Codkeeda Ku Biirisay Doodda Nabadda iyo Amniga ee Shiinaha iyo Afrika
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa khudbad ka jeediyay Madasha 4-aad ee Shiinaha iyo Afrika ee Nabadda iyo Amniga, oo uu martigeliyay Wasiirka Difaaca Qaranka ee Jamhuuriyadda Shacabka Shiinaha, Admiral Dong Jun. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa madasha kaga hadlay arrimaha la xiriira nabadda, amniga iyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca, isagoo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, iyo guud ahaan iskaashiga Shiinaha iyo dalalka Afrika. Madasha ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii loo horumarin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca, iyadoo dalalka ka qeybgalaya ay ka wada hadlayaan caqabadaha amni ee ka jira qaaradda Afrika iyo fursadaha lagu xoojin karo wada-shaqeynta caalamiga ah. Ka qeybgalka Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale qeyb ka ah dadaallada dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso xiriirrada caalamiga ah ee dhinaca tababarka, tayeynta iyo dhismaha hay’adaha amniga iyo ciidamada qaranka. Madasha ayaa magaalada Beijing ku soo uruurisay masuuliyiin iyo wakiillo sare oo ka kala socda Shiinaha iyo dalal badan oo Afrikaan ah, si looga wada hadlo mustaqbalka iskaashiga nabadda iyo amniga.

items.title: Joshua Meservey: Somaliland way qeexi waysay sabab uu Mareykanka ku aqoonsado
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Joshua Meservey, oo ah khabiir sare oo ka tirsan machadka Hudson Institute ee fadhigiisu yahay Washington, ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay ku guul-darreysatay in ay soo bandhigto sabab uu Mareykanka u aqoonsado ama aqoonsigeedu muhiim ugu yahay danaha istaraatiijiyadeed iyo kuwa amni ee Washington. Meservey ayaa hadalkan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey telefishinka Israel ee i24NEWS, kaddib kulan 14-kii September ka dhacay Hudson Institute oo uu la yeeshay madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray doorka Somaliland ee Geeska Afrika iyo fursadaha iskaashi ee dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha istaraatiijiyadda, xilli maamulka Hargeysa uu dadaal xooggan ugu jiro inuu taageero uga helo Washington ololihiisa aqoonsi raadinta. Isagoo la hadlayey weriyaha i24NEWS Nicole Zedeck, Meservey ayaa sheegay in Somaliland mararka qaar soo bandhigto doodo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo sal leh, balse aysan weli si joogto ah u qeexin sababta Mareykanku dan ugu leeyahay inuu qaado tallaabada siyaasadeed ee aqoonsiga. “Somaliland si joogto ah uma aysan awoodin inay qeexdo sababta aqoonsigeedu muhiim u yahay,” ayuu yiri Meservey. Waxa uu sheegay in marka laga hadlayo siyaasadda juqraafiyeed iyo danaha qaranka, aysan ku filneyn in la soo bandhigo keliya muhiimadda goobta juqraafiyeed ama rabitaanka iskaashi, balse loo baahan yahay dood si gaar ah u caddeyneysa waxa Mareykanku ka helayo aqoonsiga Somaliland. “Marka laga hadlayo geopolitics-ka iyo danaha qaranka, waa inaad soo bandhigtaa dood cad oo lagu qanci karo, taas oo sharxeysa sababta ay muhiim ugu tahay Mareykanka inuu aqoonsado Somaliland,” ayuu yiri. Meservey ayaa tilmaamay in Hargeysa ay u baahan tahay inay diyaarsato dood istaraatiiji ah oo isku xiraysa danaha Somaliland iyo mudnaanta siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Mareykanka, kaddibna fariintaas si joogto ah looga gudbiyo Washington iyo caasimadaha kale ee ay taageerada ka raadineyso. Hadalladiisa ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Somaliland, maadaama sanadihii dambe ay ololaheeda aqoonsiga si weyn ugu saleysay goobta ay ku taallo, dekedda Berbera iyo u dhowaanshaha marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah ee Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Maamulka Somaliland ayaa isku dayaya inuu Washington tuso in Berbera iyo goobta istaraatiijiga ah ee ay ku taallo ay Mareykanka siin karaan fursado dhinacyada amniga, ganacsiga iyo la socodka dhaqdhaqaaqyada ka socda gobolka. Dooddaas ayaa sii xoogeysatay xilli Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ay noqdeen goob ay isku hayaan dano amni iyo kuwo istaraatiiji ah, gaar ahaan kaddib weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee maraakiibta iyo kororka tartanka quwadaha waaweyn ee Geeska Afrika. Kulankii Hudson Institute waxaa sidoo kale looga hadlay xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas, weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, ganacsiga maraakiibta iyo loollanka ay quwadaha waaweyn ugu jiraan saameynta gobolka. Safarka Madaxweyne Cirro ee Mareykanka ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaal ballaaran oo maamulkiisu ku doonayo inuu sare ugu qaado xiriirka Washington, isla markaana Somaliland uga dhigo arrin si weyn uga dhex muuqata doodaha siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Mareykanka. Hase yeeshee, hadalka Meservey wuxuu muujinayaa in helitaanka dhageysi siyaasadeed oo Washington ah uusan keliya ku xirneyn sheegashada ah in Somaliland leedahay goob istaraatiiji ah, balse ay sidoo kale u baahan tahay inay si faahfaahsan u muujiso sababta aqoonsigeedu u beddeli karo ama u xoojin karo danaha Mareykanka ee gobolka. Meservey ayaa horey uga mid ahaa dadka Washington ka taageera doodda ku saabsan in Mareykanku dib u eego siyaasaddiisa Somaliland, gaar ahaan iyadoo la eegayo isbeddellada ka socda Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika. Arrinta aqoonsiga Somaliland ayaa mar kale si weyn uga soo muuqatay Washington sanadihii u dambeeyey, iyadoo taageerayaasheedu ku doodayaan in xiriir dhow oo lala yeesho Hargeysa uu Mareykanka siin karo saameyn dheeraad ah oo gobolka ah. Dhinaca kale, dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya waxay Somaliland u aragtaa qeyb ka mid ah dhulkeeda, waxayna si joogto ah uga soo horjeeddaa tallaabo kasta oo lagu aqoonsanayo inay tahay dal madax-bannaan. Somaliland ayaa sheegatay inay Soomaaliya ka go’day sanadkii 1991-kii, waxaana tan iyo markaas ay waday dadaallo caalami ah oo ay ku raadineyso aqoonsi. Israel ayaa December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland tan iyo ku dhawaaqistii 1991-kii, tallaabadaas oo sii kordhisay dadaallada Hargeysa ay ugu jirto inay waddamo kale ku qanciso inay qaadaan tallaabo la mid ah. Hadalka Meservey ayaa sidaas darteed Somaliland hor dhigaya su’aal ka weyn sheegashada muhiimadda Berbera ama goobta ay ku taallo: waxa ay tahay sababta gaarka ah ee Mareykanku uga faa’iideysanayo aqoonsiga, iyo sida Hargeysa ay dooddaas ugu beddeli karto mid si joogto ah uga dhaadhicin karta siyaasiyiinta iyo go’aan-qaadayaasha Washington. The post Joshua Meservey: Somaliland way qeexi waysay sabab uu Mareykanka ku aqoonsado appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xamza Bin Laden oo farriin soo diray sanado kadib markii la sheegay in la dilay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Ururka Al-Qaacida ayaa baahiyay muuqaal hore aan loo arag oo uu ka soo muuqanayo Xamza Bin Laden, oo ah wiilka aasaasihii ururkaas Usama Bin Laden, kaas oo hadal uu jeedinayo ku sheegay in Muslimiintu ay wajahayaan dagaal dhinacyo badan leh, isaga oo ku baaqaya in la sii wado jihaadka. Muuqaalka ayaa qayb ka ah barnaamij soconaya ku dhowaad 52 daqiiqo oo ay 10-kii September baahisay As-Sahab, oo ah garabka warbaahinta Al-Qaacida, maalin ka hor sanad-guuradii 25-aad ee weerarradii 11-kii September ee Mareykanka. Barnaamijka ayaa isku daraya muuqaallo hore oo la xiriira weerarrada 9/11, hadallo iyo muuqaallo cusub oo Xamza Bin Laden ah, sida ay sheegtay hay’adda MEMRI oo kormeertay baahinta. Xamza ayaa muuqaalka ka soo muuqda isagoo xiran dhar dhaqameed Afghanistan ah, isla markaana si toos ah ula hadlaya kaamaradda. “Islaamku maanta wuxuu marayaa imtixaan adag, marxalad culus iyo dagaal dhan walba ah,” ayuu ku yiri muuqaalka, sida ay MEMRI u turjuntay hadalkiisa. Waxa uu sheegay in dagaalka uu ka hadlayo uusan ku koobnayn dhinaca militariga, balse uu sidoo kale ku fidsan yahay dhinacyada diinta, dhaqanka iyo dhaqaalaha. Xamza ayaa mar kale kasoo muuqda qaybaha dambe ee muuqaalka, halkaas oo lagu arkayo isaga oo tirinaya gabay. Su’aalo ka dhashay xaaladdiisa Muuqaalka cusub ayaa si gaar ah indhaha loogu hayaa, maadaama Mareykanka uu sanadkii 2019 shaaciyay in Xamza Bin Laden lagu dilay howlgal la dagaallanka argagixisada ah oo ka dhacay gobolka u dhexeeya Afghanistan iyo Pakistan. Madaxweynihii Mareykanka ee xilligaas Donald Trump ayaa 14-kii September 2019 sheegay in Xamza la dilay, isaga oo xilligaas ku tilmaamay shaqsi sare oo ka tirsanaa Al-Qaacida, kana qayb qaadanayay howlaha ururka. Hase yeeshee, muuqaalka hadda la baahiyay ma caddeynayo goorta hadallada Xamza la duubay, mana xaqiijinayo inuu maanta nool yahay. Al-Qaacida sidoo kale ma aysan bixin faahfaahin cad oo meesha ka saaraysa is-maandhaafka u dhexeeya sheegashadii Mareykanka ee dhimashadiisa iyo muuqaalka cusub. MEMRI ayaa xustay in As-Sahab ay muuqaalka ugu magac-dartay si fudud “Xamza Bin Laden”, iyada oo aan raacin erayo caadi ahaan loo adeegsado xubnaha dhintay ee kooxaha jihaadiga ah. Arrintaas ayaa sii kordhisay su’aalaha ku saabsan xaaladdiisa dhabta ah. Magaca Bin Laden Xamza Bin Laden ayaa kamid ahaa wiilasha Usama Bin Laden, oo Mareykanku ku dilay Pakistan sanadkii 2011. Ka hor inta aan la shaacin dhimashadiisa, Xamza wuxuu si joogto ah uga soo muuqan jiray fariimaha codka ee Al-Qaacida, isaga oo ku baaqayay weerarro ka dhan ah Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisa. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas u arkayay inuu noqon karo shaqsi muhiim ah oo mustaqbalka hoggaan sare ka qaban kara ururka. Muuqaalka cusub ayaa hadalladiisa lagu dhex daray muuqaallo badan oo ku saabsan aabihiis iyo weerarradii 11-kii September, taas oo muujinaysa in Al-Qaacida ay weli magaca iyo dhaxalka qoyska Bin Laden u adeegsaneyso dacaayaddeeda. Barnaamijka ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigaya cod hore oo Usama Bin Laden ah, isagoo weerarradii 9/11 ku tilmaamaya dhacdo wax weyn ka beddeshay xiriirka u dhexeeya Al-Qaacida iyo Mareykanka. Madaxweynihii Mareykanka ee xilligaas Donald Trump ayaa 14-kii September 2019 sheegay in Xamza la dilay, isaga oo xilligaas ku tilmaamay shaqsi sare oo ka tirsanaa Al-Qaacida, kana qayb qaadanayay howlaha ururka. Hase yeeshee, muuqaalka hadda la baahiyay ma caddeynayo goorta hadallada Xamza la duubay, mana xaqiijinayo inuu maanta nool yahay. Al-Qaacida sidoo kale ma aysan bixin faahfaahin cad oo meesha ka saaraysa is-maandhaafka u dhexeeya sheegashadii Mareykanka ee dhimashadiisa iyo muuqaalka cusub. MEMRI ayaa xustay in As-Sahab ay muuqaalka ugu magac-dartay si fudud “Xamza Bin Laden”, iyada oo aan raacin erayo caadi ahaan loo adeegsado xubnaha dhintay ee kooxaha jihaadiga ah. Arrintaas ayaa sii kordhisay su’aalaha ku saabsan xaaladdiisa dhabta ah. Magaca Bin Laden Xamza Bin Laden ayaa kamid ahaa wiilasha Usama Bin Laden, oo Mareykanku ku dilay Pakistan sanadkii 2011. Ka hor inta aan la shaacin dhimashadiisa, Xamza wuxuu si joogto ah uga soo muuqan jiray fariimaha codka ee Al-Qaacida, isaga oo ku baaqayay weerarro ka dhan ah Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisa. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas u arkayay inuu noqon karo shaqsi muhiim ah oo mustaqbalka hoggaan sare ka qaban kara ururka. Muuqaalka cusub ayaa hadalladiisa lagu dhex daray muuqaallo badan oo ku saabsan aabihiis iyo weerarradii 11-kii September, taas oo muujinaysa in Al-Qaacida ay weli magaca iyo dhaxalka qoyska Bin Laden u adeegsaneyso dacaayaddeeda. Barnaamijka ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigaya cod hore oo Usama Bin Laden ah, isagoo weerarradii 9/11 ku tilmaamaya dhacdo wax weyn ka beddeshay xiriirka u dhexeeya Al-Qaacida iyo Mareykanka. items.title: Shariif oo ku dhawaaqay in Somalia ay gashay marxalad adag, loona baahan yahay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda guud ee dalka, isagoo sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ku jirto marxalad adag oo dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga iyo dhaqaalaha ah. Shariif ayaa adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in la helo aragti mideysan oo ku aaddan sidii looga gudbi lahaa caqabadaha taagan, xilli dalka uu wajahayo marxalad adag oo kala guur ah. “Shirkaan Himilo Qaran waxa uu imaanayaa marxalad siyaasadeed oo culus oo dalku marayo. Ujeeddadu waxay tahay in ra’yi la is dhaafsado oo ku saabsan dalka sida loo badbaadinayo, ummadda Soomaaliyeed sida loo mideynayo iyo sida hore loogu soconayo,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynihii hore oo ka hadlayay shir uu Muqdisho ku qabtay xisbigiisa Himilo Qaran. Madaxweynihii hore ayaa tilmaamay in xaaladda hadda jirta ay u baahan tahay in Soomaalidu ay isu keento aragtideeda, isla markaana ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeyso sidii dalka looga saari lahaa marxaladda adag ee uu ku jiro. “Waxaan joognaa marxalad adag oo u baahan in Soomaalidu ra’yigooda isu keento, fikirkeedana mideyso, una istaagto sidii marxaladdan looga gudbi lahaa,” ayuu yiri Shariif. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray “Arrintu hadda kuma aaddana kursi iyo doorasho iyo is-riixriix, waxay si dhab ah ugu aaddan tahay masiirka ummadda iyo jiritaankeeda.” Shariifka ayaa intaas ku daray in Soomaaliya aysan ka go’doonsanayn isbeddellada ka socda gobolka iyo dunida, sidaas darteedna loo baahan yahay in laga yeesho qorshe iyo jawaab ku habboon xaaladaha gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Ugu dambeyntiina wuxuu ku baaqay in Soomaalida gudaha iyo dibadda ay iska kaashadaan sidii wax looga qaban lahaa caqabadaha dalka, isagoo rajo ka muujiyay in doodaha iyo isu-imaatinnada siyaasadeed ay horseedi karaan tallaabooyin wax ku ool ah. items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo kulan la qaatay hay’adda 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐂𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐮𝐬 𝐅𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa ka qayb-galay Qado-Sharaf ay isaga iyo weftigiisa ku maamuuseen Hay’adda International Conservation Caucus Foundation (ICCF), oo uu fadhigeedu yahay Washington, D.C. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta khayraadka dabiiciga ah, deegaanka iyo badaha, iyo fursadaha iskaashi ee Somaliland iyo Hay’adaha dalka Maraykanka ee ka shaqeeya arrimaha ilaalinta deegaanka iyo horumarka faa’iido u leh aadamaha. Hay’adda International Conservation Caucus Foundation (ICCF) waa Hay’ad madaxbannaan oo uu fadhigeedu yahay Washington, D.C., kana shaqaysa arrimaha ilaalinta deegaanka, khayraadka dabiiciga ah, duurjoogta, badaha iyo horumar aayatiin leh. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa si mug leh ugu mahad naqay martiqaadka iyo soo-dhoweynta diirran ee ay u fidisay Hay’adda International Conservation Caucus Foundation (ICCF), isaga oo adkeeyey in ilaalinta khayraadka dabiiciga ah iyo horumarinta dhaqaale waara ay yihiin tiirar muhiim u ah mustaqbalka Somaliland, isaga oo muujiyey in iskaashi caalami ahi uu door weyn ka qaadan karo kobcinta khayraadka, ilaalinta deegaanka iyo abuurista fursado dhaqaale oo waara. Qado-Sharaftani waxa ay qayb ka tahay dedaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee is-daba-joogga ah ee Madaxweynaha iyo weftiga ballaadhan ee uu hoggaaminayo ay ka wadaan Washington, D.C., si loo ballaadhiyo iskaashiga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, loona dhiso xidhiidho ku salaysan dano-wadaag, ilaalin khayraadka dabiiciga ah iyo aragti fog oo istaraatiiji ah. items.title: Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Koonfur Galbeed oo is-casilay
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Koonfur Galbeed, Axmed Cali Muuse ayaa iska casilay xilkii, isagoo si rasmi ah ugu gudbiyay Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Madoobe warqaddiisa is-casilaadda. Warqadda is-casilaadda ee uu gaarsiiyay hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayuu ku sheegay inuu si ikhtiyaari ah uga degayo xilka Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, isaga oo codsaday in la aqbalo is-casilaaddiisa. Sidoo kale wuxuu ku xusay in intii uu xilka hayay uu ku dadaalay ilaalinta caddaaladda, madax-bannaanida garsoorka, dhowrista dastuurka iyo u adeegidda shacabka maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. “Waxaan go’aansaday inaan si ikhtiyaari ah uga dago xilka Guddoomiyenimada Maxkamadda Sare, laga bilaabo taariikhda la aqbalo is-casilaaddan,” ayuu ku sheegay warqaddiisa is-casilaadda. Guddoomiyaha ayaa waxa kale oo uga mahadceliyay hoggaamiyaha maamulka, garsoorayaasha iyo hay’adaha dowladda wada-shaqeyntii ay lahaayeen intii uu xilka hayay, isagoo muujiyay in uu qadarinayo taageeradii iyo iskaashigii uu kala kulmay intii uu xilkaasi hayay. Is-casilaadda Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa dhaqan-geli doonta marka si rasmi ah loo aqbalo. Ilaa hadda ma jirto wax war ah oo kasoo baxay xafiiska hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Madoobe oo tilmaamaya in la aqbalay iyo in kale warqadda is-casilaadda ee uu Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare gudbiyay. items.title: Sawirro: Fiqi oo kulan weyn la yeeshay dhiggiisa Shiinaha
items.description: Beijing (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa kulan heer sare ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Difaaca Shiinaha, Admiral Dong Jun. Kulanka oo ku qabsoomay jawi saaxiibtinimo iyo is-afgarad leh ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sii xoojinta xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga. Labada dhinac waxay adkeeyeen muhiimadda wada-shaqeyn ku dhisan is-ixtiraam, ilaalinta madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed, kana jawaabta xaaladaha amni ee Soomaaliya iyo isbeddellada ka socda gobolka iyo caalamka. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa dhiggiisa Shiinaha uga warramay horumarka ay Soomaaliya ka sameysay dhinacyada amniga iyo xasilloonida, guulaha laga gaaray dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada iyo dib-u-dhiska ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale wuxuu tilmaamay in mudnaanta Dowladda Federaalka ay tahay dhismaha ciidan qaran oo tababaran, qalabeysan, awoodna u leh difaaca dalka iyo la wareegidda mas’uuliyadda amniga qaranka. Admiral Dong Jun ayaa bogaadiyey horumarka muuqda ee Soomaaliya ka gaartay amniga, dowlad-dhiska iyo tayeynta ciidanka qaranka. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa dhankiisa Dowladda Shiinaha uga mahadceliyey taageerada soo jireenka ah ee wax-ku-oolka ah iyo garab-istaagga joogtada ah ee ay u fidiso Soomaaliya. Labada wasiir ayaa isla gartay in la dardar-geliyo hirgelinta is-afgaradyada jira, lana sii ballaariyo iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga, si xiriirka istaraatiijiga ah ee labada dal loogu beddelo tallaabooyin la taaban karo oo wax ka tara nabadda iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan gobolka. items.title: Dawladda Jabuuti oo diiday in dalkeeda laga weeraro Xuutiyiinta Yemen
items.description: Dawladda Jabuuti ayaa sheegtay in aanay oggolaan doonin in dhulkeeda loo isticmaalo hawlgallo militari oo ka dhan ah kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen, sida uu BBC-da u sheegay Wasiirka Maaliyadda Jabuuti, Ilyaas Muuse Dawaale. Dawaale wuxuu sheegay in mowqifka Jabuuti aanu isbeddelin, isaga oo ka jawaabayay su’aal la weyddiiyayoo ahayd in dawladdu dib uga fiirsatay diidmadii hore ee codsi uga yimid Maraykanka oo ahaa in ciidammada Maraykanku isticmaalaan xarumaha millitari ee Jabuuti si ay u weeraraan Xuutiyiinta. “Uma malaynayo in su’aashaasi xilligan taagan tahay. Ciddii wax weerari jirtay ama naga dalban jirtay, waxaan filayaa iyaga ayaan xitaa diyaar u ahayn. ” ayuu yidhi Dawaale. Wuxuu sheegay in Jabuuti aanay doonayn in ay si millitari ah ugu lug yeelato colaadda, isla markaana ay rabto in dagaalka u dhexeeya dhinacyada kala duwan ee Yemen uu ku ekaado gudaha Yemen. “Ma doonayno cid, gaar ahaan deriskeenna, in ay millatari ahaan noogu timaaddo,” ayuu yidhi. Jabuuti waxay ku taallaa dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo Yemen ka xigta, waxayna aad ugu dhowdahay marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo ka mid ah meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee maraakiibtu isticmaalaan, iskuna xidha Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. items.title: Midowga Afrika oo walaac ka muujiyay xiisadda sii xoogaysanaysa ee Badda Cas
items.description: Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujiyay kororka colaadaha militari ee ka socda gobolka Badda Cas, gaar ahaan weerarrada lagu beegsanayo dhulka Sacuudiga iyo hanjabaadaha ku wajahan maraakiibta ganacsiga ee isticmaasha marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah. Midowga Afrika ayaa cambaareeyay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee lagu beegsanayo, sida ay bayaanka ku sheegtay, bartilmaameedyo rayid iyo kaabayaal dhaqaale oo ku yaalla Sacuudiga , iyo sidoo kale weerarrada iyo hanjabaadaha ka dhanka ah maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraysa Badda Cas. Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay wararka sheegaya isku-dayo weerarro lagu bartilmaameedsaday Makkah iyo magaalooyin kale oo barakeysan oo ku yaalla Sacuudiga . Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in goobaha barakeysan, dadka rayidka ah iyo xujeyda ama dadka cibaadada u tagaya goobahaas ay tahay in si buuxda loo ilaaliyo, isla markaana aysan marnaba noqon bartilmaameed militari. Midowga Afrika wuxuu sidoo kale dib u xaqiijiyay muhiimadda xorriyadda maraakiibta ee Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab , isagoo sheegay in arrintan loo baahan yahay in lagu ilaaliyo waafaqsanaanta sharciga caalamiga ah. Guddigu wuxuu ka digay in tallaabo kasta oo lagu carqaladeynayo ama lagu khatar gelinayo maraakiibta isticmaasha marin-biyoodkan ay saameyn ku yeelan karto waddamada ku teedsan Badda Cas, ganacsiga caalamiga ah, silsiladaha sahayda, amniga tamarta iyo dhaqaalaha dalalka Afrika. Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Geeska Afrika iyo dalalka ku yaalla xeebaha Badda Cas , maadaama Bab al-Mandab uu yahay marin istiraatiiji ah oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in dagaallada iyo iska horimaadyada ka socda Bariga Dhexe ay isu beddeli karaan colaad gobolka oo dhan ku baahda. Sida uu sheegay Midowga Afrika, haddii xaaladdu sii xumaato, saameynteedu ma ku ekaan doonto Bariga Dhexe oo keliya, balse waxay si toos ah u taaban kartaa Afrika dhinacyada amniga, xaaladda bani’aadannimo iyo dhaqaalaha . Guddiga Midowga Afrika wuxuu ku baaqay in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo weerarrada ka dhanka ah dadka rayidka ah, kaabayaasha rayidka iyo dhaqaalaha, iyo maraakiibta ganacsiga. Waxa kale oo uu ku baaqay in la dhowro xorriyadda maraakiibta iyo in si degdeg ah loo yareeyo xiisadda, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in wada-hadal iyo xalal siyaasadeed mudnaanta la siiyo si looga hortago in colaadaha sii fidaan loona ilaaliyo nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka Badda Cas.

items.title: Nin weerar ku qaaday Ilhaan Cumar oo xukun lagu riday
items.description: Nin 56 jir ah oo lagu eedeeyay inuu dareere ku buufiyay Xildhibaanad Ilhaan Cumar xilli ay kulan dadweyne ku qabanaysay magaalada Minneapolis ayaa lagu xukumay 14 bilood oo xabsi ah , kadib markii uu heshiis la gaaray xeer-ilaalinta. Ninka oo lagu magacaabo Anthony Kazmierczak ayaa sidoo kale lagu xukumay saddex sano oo kormeer ah marka uu xabsiga ka soo baxo, iyadoo shuruudaha kormeerka lagu daray inuusan wax xiriir ah la sameyn karin Ilhaan Cumar. Dhacdadu waxay dhacday 27-kii Janaayo 2026 , xilli Ilhaan ay magaalada Minneapolis ku qabanaysay kulan ay bulshada kula hadlaysay. Sida ay sheegeen markhaatiyaal, Kazmierczak ayaa ka dhex kacay dadkii kulanka fadhiyay, isaga oo adeegsanaya qalab cirbad u eg oo uu ku buufiyay dhanka Xildhibaanadda, wuxuuna ku dhawaaqay inay Minnesota kala qaybinayso. Saraakiisha amniga ee ilaalinaysay Ilhaan ayaa si degdeg ah u qabtay Kazmierczak, kadibna booliska ayay ku wareejiyeen, xildhibaanaddana wax dhaawac ahi kama soo gaarin dhacdadaas.

items.title: Qasaare ka dhashay roob dabeyl watay oo saamayn ku yeeshay danyar oo ku nool Bari
items.description: (ERGO) – Cunto yari, hoy xumo iyo dhaqaale darro saameysay ayay wajahayaan boqollaal qoys oo toddobadii bishan dhibane u noqday roob dabeylo watay oo ku dhuftay deegaanka Ceel-gaal oo hoos taga degmada Qandala ee gobolka Bari. Qoysaskan ayaa ah kuwo ay ku adag tahay in maalinkii ay helaan hal waqti oo cunto ah. Waa musiibo aan laga sii baaraan dagin oo ay ku naf waayeen dad iyo duunyo, isla markaana dumisay bollaal guri. Waxaa lagu waayay ilihii dhaqaale oo ay ku tiirsanaayeen qoysas danyar ah oo ay ku adag tahay inay ka soo kabtaan saameynta taban ee ay ku reebtay. Cabdimudalib Axmed Maxamed, waa 18 jir ay mustaqbal ka sugayaan siddeed walaalo ah oo ka yar. Qoyska waxaa u shaqeyn jiray isaga iyo hooyadiis oo geeriyootay, markii uu ku dumay gurigii ay degganaayeen. Wuxuu tilmaamay in hadda aysan laheyn ildhaqaale, ayna ku tiirsan yihiin kaalmo yar oo baahidooda aan dabuuli karin oo uga timaada dadka dariskooda ah. “Garab la’aan ayaa nagu dhacday. Waxaan hadda isku maareynaa waxay noo keenaan dadka na dhaama ee nagu hareereysan, iyaguna wax badan oo la sheego nooma ay keenin.” Cabdimudalib ayaa sheegay inay ku nool yihiin aqal cooshad ah oo dantu bidday, markii uu ka dumay hoygoodii oo ka koobnaa labo qol. Wuxuu xusay inaysan hadda heli karin dhaqaale dib loogu dhiso. Qoyska ayaa ku tiirsanaa goob ganacsi oo lagu gado dhuxusha iyo hilibka cayriin, isaga iyo hooyadiis ayaana wadajir uga shaqeyn jiray. Dhaqaalaha maalinkii ka soo gali jiray oo uu sheegay inuu ahaa $7 illaa $10 ayay ku tiirsaneyd noloshoodu. Waa da’yar la’ meel uu wax ka billaabo, ayna garabkiisa ka baxday hooyadiis, aabbahiina yahay 85 jir aan shaqeyn karin. “Awood iyo itaal lama hayo wax Ilaahay keeni doono maahee, waxaa carruurta haya caluul xanuun, waana wax u badan carruurta iyo waayeelka oo magaalada ka jira. Meeshu caafimaad malahan, mana la awoodo in meel kale aan u tagno.” Cabdimudalib ayaa tilmaamay in dhaqaale la’aan uu uga haray waxbarashada dugsiga dhexe, sanadkii 2023, haddana ay xaaladaas oo kale wajahayaan walaalihiis oo dhigan jiray iskuulka hoose iyo dhexe ee Cumar binu-cabdi casiis ee deegaanka Ceel-gaal, kaas oo ku dumay dabeylaha roobka. Waa iskuulka kaliya ee deegaanku lahaa, waxaana dhiganayay 300 oo arday. Ma jirto cid ku howlan dhisamahiisa, sida uu sheegay maamulka deegaanka. Cabdimudalib ayaa sheegay in haddii dib loo dhiso ay wali hor taallo caqabad dhanka dhaqaalaha ah, maadaama aysan awoodin bixinta boqol Doollar oo bishii ay wax ku baran jireen afar walaalihiis ah oo iskuulka dhigan jiray. Saameynta ka dhalatay roobka dabeylaha watay ma ah mid ku kooban magaalada ee waxay taabatay xoolo dhaqatada iyo dadka ku tiirsanaa xabagta geedka xijigga. Maxamuud Maxamed Cabdikariim oo ka mid ah dadka ay saameeysay ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dabeyshu wax yeeleysay ilihii dhaqaale ee qoyskiisu ku tiirsanaa oo ahaa xoolo iyo xabagta xijigga. Qoyskiisa oo ku nool miyiga ku dhow deegaanka Ceelgaal ayuu xusay in sidoo kale ay dabeyshu ka dumisay hoygii ay ku noolaayeen. “Tuuladan wax walba waa qaali oo labolaab ah ayay ka sareeyaan qiimaha ay ka joogaan Boosaaso. Waa tuulo ku taal meel fog oo gaariga ka soo baxa Boosaaso wuxuu jidka ku jiraa labo habeen. Galab hadduu ka soo baxo, habeenka dambe ayuu tagaa.” Maxamuud ayaa tilmaamay in musiibadan ay uga dhinteen 20 ari ah, sidoo kalana ay dabeyshu ka goysay geedaha xijigga oo xabagtooda uu sheegay inuu ka heli jiray sanadkii ku dhowaad kun Doollar. Ninkan oo ah aabbaha toddobo carruur ah ayaa intaas ku daray in dabeyshu ka dumisay guri deegaanka uu ku lahaa oo bishii uu ka qaadan jiray kiro $25 ah. Maareynta nolosha reerka oo uusan ka warwari jirin ayuu sheegay in hadda ay tahay caqabad uu xalkeedu ku adag yahay. Xaaladan ayuu xusay in qoyskiisa ay dhaxal siisay cunno yari. “Xoolaha iyo maydiga ayaan ku tiirsaneyn, xoolihiina dee dabeyl iyo abaartaas ayaa ku dhacday. Haddii wax naloo heli karo, miyi iyo magaalada nalooga soo gurman karo waan u baahanahay.” Maxamuud ayaa tilmaamay in roobka dabeylaha watay da’ayay lix saacadood uu ahaa mid aysan fileyn, xilliga oo jiilaal ah awgeed. Wuxuu intaas ku daray inaysan soo gaarin digniinaha la xiriira El Nino oo ah roobab dabeyl wata oo saadaashu sheegeyso inay Soomaaliya ka da’ayaan bisha tobnaad ee October illaa dhammaadka sanadkan. Dhanka kale maamulka deegaanka Ceelgaal ee gobolka Bari ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in qoysaska dhibaatadu gaartay ay wajahayaan xaalad hubanti la’aan ah oo ay adag tahay inay ka soo kabtaan. Shire Cabdullaahi Siciid oo ah guddoomiye ku xigeen ayaa xusay in maamul ahaan aysan hayn waxay ku taageeraan qoysaska dhibban. Shire ayaa tilmaamay in roobka dabeylaha wata ay ku dhinteen saddex qof,  xoolo gaaraya  saddex boqol, ayna ku ku dumeen 150 guri. Qiimeyn ay sameeyeen ayuu xusay inay ku ogaadeen in saameyntu ay gaartay saddex boqol iyo konton qoys oo iskugu jira dadka ku nool deegaanka Ceelgaal iyo miyiga ku xeeran, kuwaas oo lumiyay ilihii dhaqaale ee ay ku tiirsanaayeen oo ahaa xoolo, beero  iyo mehrado ganacsi. “Dadkii hadda waxay noqdeen isku duruuf oo wax badan isma dhaamaan. Dhulka qaar xataa hadda biyo ayaa laga dhaamiyaa oo ma gaarin roobka noo da’ay. Dhibaatooyinka noocaas ah oo awood aan loo hayn ayaa jira.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in musiibadan ay ku soo beegantay xilli adag oo aysan xoolo dhaqatadu ka soo kaban abaaro iyo jiilaal nacfi tiray xoolaha. items.title: War on Terrorism: Up Close and Personal
items.description: By Abukar Arman Twenty-five years after the morning that redefined the modern world, the attacks of September 11, 2001, remain less of a closed chapter than an enduring enigma. While the official narrative points to 19 al‑Qaida hijackers, the unanswered questions, the collective punishment of Muslim communities, the weaponization of patriotism to silence enquiries, the geopolitical aftershocks that reshaped the world order, and the ongoing secrecy surrounding classified documents demand a critical reexamination of that day’s legacy. Meanwhile, new reports, documentaries, and books that challenge the old narrative continue to appear in public space. Families of victims and independent researchers continue to question whether the full truth about the attackers’ support network has ever come to light. Key documents from the FBI’s investigation remain classified, withheld under the guise of national security. This sustained secrecy fuels justified perception of cover‑up. Demand for Investigation Last year, journalist Tucker Carlson released a documentary series—The 9/11 Files—that tore apart the official narrative. His stated objective was to push for a new, independent 9/11 commission, one “not committed to protecting politicians.” He accused U.S. intelligence agencies and the George W. Bush administration of deliberately withholding critical information from investigators and the public. One of the people that Mr. Carlson interviewed was former FBI official Mark Rossini who worked at the CIA’s “Alec Station.” He revealed that U.S. authorities had tracked two hijackers as they travelled from Dubai through Malaysia into the United States. An FBI report was blocked from circulation by CIA officials; authorities knew the suspects had arrived in Los Angeles, yet no alert was issued. Brett Eagleson, who lost his father on 9/11, told Carlson: “Our government has failed us, just as they failed us 20 years ago… they’re pouring salt on our wounds.” Former Congressman Weldon went further on Carlson’s show, saying: “The 9/11 Commission itself was a cover‑up from the start.” These kinds of claims can no longer be dismissed as conspiracy theories. After all, no one yet explained the “five dancing Israelis” who were arrested on 9/11 for filming the towers’ collapse and allegedly celebrating. Community Under Siege The most tangible and tragic legacy of 9/11 is the collective punishment inflicted upon Muslim communities worldwide. Within days of the attacks, President Bush declared a “Global War on Terrorism,” and within a few weeks the Senate passed the USA PATRIOT Act—the most draconian domestic law in U.S. history. There was no thorough debate to scrutinize that infamous bill, yet it passed in a 98-1 vote. Against that background, a ‘counterterrorism’ dragnet that, in the eyes of many, blurred the line between al‑Qaida and the global Muslim population was immediately activated. Especially in the West, Muslims became ‘legitimate targets’ of suspicion. Their identities were conflated with terrorism. This backlash was not spontaneous but fueled by a “perfect storm” of Zionist driven Islamophobia and right-wing driven xenophobia that had been brewing for decades. In the following years, many Muslims in the U.S. were incarcerated, renditioned, deported lost jobs, got ostracized, and faced surge in hate crimes. In that period, the more active a Muslim person was, the more likely he became targeted. I was one of those Muslims. Guilty till Proven Innocent In 2001, at a time when many Imams were pressured off the pulpit, I became one of a few local Muslim volunteers who were invited to fill the vacuum and start giving sermon on Fridays- a role that I am honored to say: I keep it to this day. So, my sermons were not limited to spiritual topics. As in my writings, I talked about Islamophobia, injustice, corruption, oppression, Zionism, US foreign policy and the neocon madness known as global war on terrorism. And that was enough to put me in the crosshairs of the usual suspects- FrontPage Magazine, Little Green Footballs, Jihad Watch, and the Middle East Forum. It started with periodic bullying emails and public accusations that peaked in 2007. In July of that same year, on a Saturday afternoon while driving with family, I received a phone call from an anxious friend. He told me that I was the topic of discussion in a local conservative radio program named Radio Deli hosted by Dirk Thompson. His guest was a man named Patrick Poole, a right-wing/neocon operative who used to present himself as a “counterterrorism expert.” The 3-hour program was all about me- how I was a “terrorist sympathizer” who supported Hamas and al-Shabaab. The following Saturday, that same program invited the same guest and dedicated the entire show to implicating me as a ticking bomb. Shortly after, Patrick Poole published a series of articles in FrontPage Magazine—the online arm of a Zionist, conservative organization named Freedom Center that was founded by the late David Horowitz. Every witch-hunt article they published reverberated within their network fear-mongering media. So, in due course, their orchestrated vicious accusations had severe consequences on me. I lost my job with the Columbus Public Schools, but that was not of much value to the Islamophobic network and their funders. They were after my membership of the Criminal Justice Planning Board – a board with oversight authority over all homeland security programs of Franklin County. That Board included all 20 elected officials in that county and two civilians- one African American and one immigrant who were appointed by the 3 County Commissioners. Abukar at CPD training Capitalizing on that climate of fear, Poole and his wide network started a letter campaign.  Each member of said board was flooded with letters condemning me and demanding my immediate removal and threatening well-financed campaigns to defeat each one of them in the next election should he or she fail to deliver.   At our next meeting, I was part of the agenda. Kathy Crandall, Director of the Franklin County Office of Homeland Security who sat across from me stated this on record: ‘Since a board member said Abukar must be investigated, my office has no choice but to conduct an investigation, though we have done one on him for his second nomination only a few months ago.’ Long story short, another investigation was conducted on me. The conclusion was reported in a front-page article titled Investigation Clears A Hilliard Man that was published by the Columbus Dispatch. “We did a background check and found no criminal or terrorist connections. Mr. Arman was not a person of interest,” said Don Brown—the County Administrator—to the Dispatch. That was great, but the damage was already done. I had to resign from the Franklin County Criminal Justice Board. Also, the Columbus Police Academy aborted a training program that I and a CAIR colleague used to provide to the graduating police cadets on how to engage Muslims with respect and not deny them their constitutional rights.      Muzzling Scrutiny In the decade of 2007-2017, though I had dozens of articles already published in various media outlets, any Google search on my name or one of my articles was likely to lead the searcher to various misleading articles or commentaries aimed to sustain the vicious campaign against me. In contrast, today, while the malicious articles and commentaries have subsided, the campaign to keep me in the dark continues to this day. Since October 7, 2023, due to my long stance on Palestine, the social media platform X has placed me in an algorithmic dungeon that froze my followers on 147K for the first 2 years of the genocide. Now my numbers are reduced to 143K with periodical loss of followers. That said, my story was no different than the stories of a numerous other vocal Muslims who were targeted as I have been. Many, like Dr. Sami Al-Arian, had to endure much worse experiences. Endless End Poole who made a career out of his ruthless campaign to spread Islamophobia and accuse Muslims as sleeping cells and ticking bombs has died a violent death on May 15, 2026. Poole barricaded himself inside a home after stabbing two people to death. Arkansas State Police and SWAT personnel responded to the scene. When law-enforcement made it into the house and officers attempted to arrest Poole, he resisted. During a struggle, he attempted to grab an officer’s gun, leading a second deputy to fatally shoot him. A prosecutor later ruled the shooting justified. In the meantime, the neocon lust for perpetual wars that serve the Zionist project continue. The campaign to wreck certain Muslim countries for exploitation and for paving the way for the Greater Israel project continue. That project that started at Afghanistan, followed by Iraq, Somalia, Libya, Yemen, Sudan, Syria, Lebanon, has now fell into a deep ditch in Iran. These endless U.S. wars for Israel have only proven this unintended consequence- a dominance creep that brought the empire to its knees diplomatically, economically, and militarily.    Abukar Arman ———– Arman is a Somali political analyst, writer and former Somalia Special Envoy to the United States. Arman writes extensively on Somalia and international political affairs The post War on Terrorism: Up Close and Personal appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Somalia’s Digital Iron Curtain: Who Is Making Critics Disappear?
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s battle over freedom of expression appears to be entering a new and unsettling arena: the digital space. Several prominent Somali journalists and political figures have reportedly seen their Facebook accounts suspended, removed or falsely memorialized as belonging to people who have died, triggering allegations of a coordinated campaign against critical voices. But one distinction is essential: the account disruptions are documented; responsibility for them has not been established. The Evidence: What Is Known and What Is Alleged The Somali Journalists Syndicate (SJS) reported on September 14 that journalist Farah Abdulkadir Mohamed and journalist Abdijalil Osman had their Facebook profiles falsely memorialized while both were alive. Their accounts were subsequently restored. SJS also reported that journalist Zakariye Mohamud Timacadde, whose Facebook presence reportedly reaches more than one million followers, had his Facebook page and personal profile suspended. The Syndicate further reported the removal of the Facebook pages of the presidents of Puntland and Jubaland . SJS described the incidents as part of what it considered an apparent wave of online attacks targeting Somali journalists and media organizations. It also raised concerns over alleged misuse of copyright complaints to remove critical content and reported that a person involved in such claims said he worked in communications for the Somali government. These are reported incidents and allegations; they do not, by themselves, establish that the Somali government ordered or carried out the Facebook actions. SJS said Meta’s East Africa team did not respond to its request for comment. The latest incidents also come against a broader documented record of pressure on Somali journalists. Human Rights Watch has reported intimidation, detention and prosecution of journalists and media workers by federal and regional authorities. The Federation of Somali Journalists separately reported 78 violations involving journalists and media professionals between May 2025 and May 2026, including arrests, detention, threats, assaults, harassment, abductions, censorship and interference with reporting. That broader record provides important context, but it does not establish that government authorities were responsible for the specific Facebook disruptions now under scrutiny. The most striking cases remain the false memorializations of living journalists. How were living people classified as deceased? Were fraudulent reports submitted? Were accounts compromised? Did automated moderation systems make errors? Or were multiple incidents connected? Those questions remain unanswered. There is currently no publicly established evidence showing that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud personally ordered the removals, that federal cyber-security personnel carried them out, or that his government instructed Meta to target particular journalists or political figures. That distinction matters. The reported disruptions deserve investigation, but allegations of direct government responsibility require evidence beyond the fact that the affected individuals are prominent critics or political actors. The Hassan Sheikh Question The controversy nevertheless places renewed attention on the government’s approach to freedom of expression. If federal institutions had no role in the Facebook actions, officials could help settle the matter by making that position clear and supporting an independent investigation. If government agencies did communicate with Meta concerning the affected accounts, the public deserves to know what was requested, under what authority and on what grounds. The same transparency should be expected from Meta. Account suspensions, removals and false memorializations can have serious consequences when Facebook functions as a major channel for political debate and journalism. For Somali journalists and politicians, Facebook is not merely a social-media platform. It has become an important part of the country’s public information space. When a prominent account disappears, so too can access to years of reporting, political commentary and communication with hundreds of thousands of followers. That is why the latest incidents warrant scrutiny without premature conclusions. The evidence establishes that accounts have been disrupted. It does not yet establish who was responsible. And that leaves Somalia with a question that remains unanswered: Who is making Somalia’s political voices disappear from the digital public square—and why? items.title: Gudoomiyihii ugu waqtiga dheeraa Maxkamadda Sare ee Koonfur Galbeed oo is casilay
items.description: Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Garyaqaan Axmed Cali Muuse ayaa shaaciyay in uu iska casilay xilkaasi, isagoo aan wax sabab ahi sheegin. “Laga bilaabo maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 18/9/2026, waxaan iska casilay xilka Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, anigoo ah Axmed Cali Muuse.” Ayuu Garyaqaan Axmed Cali Muuse ku sheegay warqad uu ku saxiixnaa. Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ayaa is casilaaddiisa la wadaagay Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), isagoona yiri “Waxaan si ixtiraam iyo xilkasnimo leh kugu soo gudbinayaa warqaddan is casilaaddayda rasmiga ah.” Garyaqaan Axmed Cali ayaan sheegin asbaabta uu shaqada uga tagayo aan ka ahayn, sida uu warqadda ku sheegay in uu si ikhtiyaari ah u go’aansaday inuu uga dego xilka Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare. “Waxaan go’aansaday inaan si ikhtiyaari ah uga dego xilka Gudoomiyenimada Maxkamadda Sare, laga bilaabo taariikhda la aqbalo is casilaaddan.” Ayuu yiri Garyaqaan Axmed Cali. Waxa uu sheegay in muddadii uu xafiiska joogay uu ku dadaalay madaxbannaanida garsoorka, dhowrista dastuurka iyo u adeegidda bulshada Koonfur Galbeed, wuxuuna u mahadceliyay madaxda maamulka, garsooreyaasha iyo hay’adaha kale ee maamulka wada-shaqayntii dhex martay. Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa bishii June ee sanadkii 2019 xeer Madaxweyne ku magacaabay Axmed Cali Muuse inuu noqdo Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Koonfur Galbeed. Axmed Cali Muuse ayaa noqday Gudoomiyihii labaad ee taariikhda qabta xilka Maxkamadda Sare ee Koonfur Galbeed, tan iyo markii la dhisay Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Axmed Cali Muuse ayaa sidoo kale noqonaya Gudoomiyihii ugu waqtiga dheeraa ee maamula Maxkamadda Sare ee maamulkaasi. Is casilaaddiisa ayaa ku soo beegmeysa, xilli Koonfur Galbeed ay ka taagan tahay xiisad siyaasadeed iyo mid ciidan oo u dhexeysa maamulka cusub ee Aadan Madoobe uu hoggaamiyo iyo hoggaankii hore.

items.title: Four Years Too Late: Somalia Suddenly Discovers Meritocracy
items.description: By Ahmed A. Yusuf Four years after taking office, and with its mandate drawing to a close, the Federal Government of Somalia has suddenly discovered the virtues of meritocrac y . Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre has ordered federal ministries and government agencies to begin filling senior civil-service positions through open competition, with appointments supposedly based on competence, education, experience, leadership and performance. The first phase of the exercise is scheduled to begin on September 20 and will focus on departmental directors. The process is then expected to extend to director-general positions across government institutions. The announcement would ordinarily be welcomed as a long-overdue step toward building a professional state. But the timing is impossible to ignore. Why did a government that had four years to institutionalize merit-based recruitment wait until the closing stages of its mandate to announce that qualified Somalis should finally have an equal opportunity to compete for government jobs? That is the question many citizens are likely to ask. A functioning civil service cannot be built by issuing reform directives when a government’s term is nearly over. Meritocracy is supposed to be the operating principle of government—not an election-season promise. The extraordinary timing Prime Minister Hamza says the government has spent the past four years establishing the legal and institutional foundations for public-sector reform, including laws, policies, regulations and organizational structures governing government institutions and civil servants. He has now instructed the Civil Service Commission to oversee an open competitive process and ensure that qualified civil servants receive equal opportunities to compete for vacant positions. There is nothing controversial about that principle. What is controversial is the apparent gap between what the government is now promising and what critics say has characterized appointments during its tenure. The Hassan Sheikh Mohamud administration has faced persistent criticism over allegations of nepotism, political patronage, clan-based considerations and the concentration of important government positions among politically connected individuals. Such allegations should be assessed against actual appointment records rather than political rhetoric. But if the government genuinely intends to introduce a merit-based system, it should have little difficulty demonstrating how senior appointments were made over the preceding four years. That is where the public deserves transparency. Where was meritocracy before? The question is particularly uncomfortable because the principle being announced today is not a new constitutional invention. Somalia has been struggling for decades to establish a professional, politically neutral and competent public administration. Competitive recruitment is among the most basic requirements of such a system. Yet critics argue that under the current administration, access to senior state positions has too often been influenced by political relationships, family connections and clan considerations. The allegations extend beyond civilian ministries. The same questions have been raised about senior positions within the security and military establishment, where professionalism and competence should be even less negotiable. If family members and political allies of those in power are perceived to occupy influential positions throughout government and the security sector, then simply announcing an open competition for departmental directors at the end of the government’s mandate will inevitably invite skepticism. The public is entitled to ask whether this is genuine institutional reform—or an attempt to rewrite the government’s record before it leaves office. The corruption contradiction The announcement also comes at an extraordinary moment for Somalia’s international reputation. According to Transparency International’s 2025 Corruption Perceptions Index, Somalia scored just 9 out of 100, placing it among the countries with the lowest scores globally for perceived public-sector corruption. The index measures perceptions of public-sector corruption based on assessments by experts and businesspeople. Against that backdrop, the government cannot reasonably expect the public to be satisfied with declarations alone. A country struggling at the bottom of global corruption rankings needs institutions that are visibly transparent, independently accountable and resistant to political interference. It needs recruitment systems in which a highly qualified Somali with no political connections can compete on equal terms with someone who has access to the corridors of power. It needs a security establishment where promotion is determined by professional achievement rather than political loyalty or family connections. And it needs appointments that can survive public scrutiny. The family-and-patronage question Perhaps the most sensitive issue is whether the government is prepared to apply the same standards to its own political establishment. If meritocracy is now the principle, then it should apply universally. The public should be able to examine the qualifications and appointment processes of senior officials. It should be possible to determine whether relatives and close associates of senior political figures have received government positions, and under what procedures. If those appointments were made through transparent, competitive and lawful procedures, the government should have no reason to fear scrutiny. If they were not, the government should explain why. That is the essence of institutional accountability. A civil service is not a political reward system The danger of politicized recruitment goes far beyond individual appointments. When government jobs become rewards for political loyalty, institutions gradually lose their independence. Qualified professionals become discouraged. Competent officials may find themselves competing against people whose principal qualification is proximity to power. Eventually, the state itself suffers. The consequences are visible in weak institutions, poor service delivery, corruption, declining public confidence and an administrative culture in which personal connections can become more valuable than professional qualifications. Somalia cannot build a modern state on that foundation. The Prime Minister’s real test Prime Minister Hamza’s directive therefore creates an opportunity—but also a test. If the government is serious about meritocracy, it should publish the vacancies, qualifications, selection criteria and competitive procedures. It should make the process independently verifiable and ensure that unsuccessful candidates have appropriate avenues for appeal. Most importantly, the government should demonstrate that the rules apply equally to the politically powerful and the politically powerless. The public should not have to take another government promise on faith. After four years in office, citizens have every right to ask: Where was this merit-based system when the government first took power? Why is it being introduced now? How many senior positions were filled through genuine open competition during the past four years? How many appointments involved political, family or clan considerations? And perhaps the most important question of all: Will the same standards now being promised apply to the people closest to the centres of power? Somalia needs evidence, not slogans There is nothing wrong with a government deciding to professionalize its civil service. On the contrary, Somalia desperately needs a competent, accountable and politically neutral public administration. But after four years, the announcement inevitably raises eyebrows. A government cannot spend most of its mandate operating under one set of political realities and then, as its term approaches its end, present the introduction of competitive recruitment as though it were the beginning of a new era. The Somali public is more sophisticated than that. It understands the difference between reform announced and reform implemented. It understands that meritocracy cannot exist alongside unchecked patronage. And it understands that a professional government is measured not by the speeches of its leaders but by the transparency of its institutions. If the Hassan administration truly wants to leave behind a professional civil service, it has an opportunity to prove it. But after four years, the burden of proof is no longer on the public to believe the promise. It is on the government to demonstrate that the promise is real. Somalia has heard enough declarations about reform. Now it needs receipts. Ahmed A. items.title: Khaire Accuses Hassan Sheikh Government of Failure as Somalia’s Humanitarian Crisis Deepens
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Millions of Somalis are facing hunger, displacement and a deepening humanitarian emergency while Somalia remains trapped in a political crisis over a presidency whose original constitutional mandate has expired. That contradiction has become the centerpiece of a blistering attack by former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire, who says President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government has spent too much political energy defending its hold on power and too little demonstrating that it can protect citizens facing one of the country’s most serious humanitarian crises. Khaire, a senior figure in the opposition Future Council, argues that Somalia’s leadership should be mobilizing around drought, food insecurity, displacement and the collapse of essential services rather than remaining consumed by constitutional disputes, electoral arrangements and political confrontation. His criticism comes as the United Nations estimates that 4.8 million people will need humanitarian assistance in Somalia in 2026, amid drought, conflict, displacement and severe humanitarian funding constraints. “4.8 million Somalis are today facing humanitarian hardship, and it is unfortunate that a government whose mandate has expired has no vision, plan or national agenda for rescuing these Somali people who urgently need assistance and relief,” Khaire said. The statement is more than another opposition attack on Villa Somalia. It captures the increasingly difficult question facing President Hassan Sheikh: what does political legitimacy mean when millions of citizens are struggling to survive while the country’s political institutions remain locked in dispute? Somalia’s political crisis has continued long after the expiration of the president’s original mandate, while constitutional amendments and electoral disagreements have produced competing interpretations of how the country should proceed. The resulting uncertainty has consumed much of the national political debate, even as humanitarian needs have continued to rise. A Government Consumed by Political Survival Khaire’s broader criticism is that Somalia’s humanitarian emergency has unfolded alongside a political crisis that has consumed much of the Federal Government’s attention. President Hassan Sheikh’s continued stay in office after the expiration of his original mandate has become one of the central disputes in Somali politics. Reuters reported in June that the president’s decision to remain in power after his mandate expired had contributed to violent clashes in Mogadishu between government forces and militias aligned with opposition politicians. The political dispute has also been complicated by constitutional amendments approved by Parliament in March that could delay elections and potentially extend the president’s tenure by one year. The changes were contested by opposition figures and constitutional experts, while the government defended its electoral and constitutional agenda. For Khaire, the consequence is a government increasingly preoccupied with political confrontation at precisely the moment when Somalia needs an administration focused on drought relief, food security, displacement, healthcare and economic recovery. That criticism is not limited to political rhetoric. The humanitarian system itself has warned that its capacity is shrinking as funding falls. The UN’s 2026 humanitarian plan sought $852 million to provide life-saving assistance, but humanitarian partners warned that funding shortages were already forcing reductions in operations at a time when needs remained extremely high. Four Years of Hassan Sheikh: Khaire’s Broader Indictment Khaire went beyond the immediate humanitarian crisis, accusing President Hassan Sheikh’s four years in office of being marked by what he described as lack of vision, poor planning, weak governance and corruption. He further accused the administration of political favoritism, misuse of national assets, displacement of vulnerable communities and failure to provide a coherent national development agenda. Those are political allegations made by an opposition leader, rather than independently established findings. The Federal Government has rejected similar criticisms and maintains that its political, constitutional and security programs are intended to strengthen Somalia’s state institutions. But Khaire’s argument goes to a larger question: what has the Hassan Sheikh presidency delivered after more than four years in power? For millions of Somalis facing hunger and displacement, the political argument in Mogadishu may seem distant. What matters to them is whether water arrives, whether food is available, whether children receive treatment and whether their families can survive another failed season. That is ultimately the harshest test of government performance. A government can defend its political legitimacy in Parliament and at international conferences, but legitimacy is also measured by what happens to citizens when they are most vulnerable. For Somalia’s millions in need, that test is already underway. items.title: CIRRO: Garoonka Berbera waxaan ugu magac darayaa Trump
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha maamulka Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi Cirro ayaa soo jeediyay in garoonka diyaaradaha Berbera loogu magac daro Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump, xilli uu Washington ka wado dadaal xooggan oo uu ku raadinayo aqoonsi Mareykan ah. Cirro ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Trump lagu soo dhoweyn karo inuu dhismo Trump Tower ka hirgeliyo Hargeysa, isaga oo isku dayaya inuu maamulka Mareykanka tuso waxa Somaliland diyaar u tahay inay bixiso haddii xiriirka labada dhinac sare loo qaado. Hadalladan ayuu Cirro ku sheegay wareysi uu magaalada Washington ku siiyay warbaahinta Semafor , xilli uu booqasho ku joogo Mareykanka, isla markaana uu kulamo la leeyahay mas’uuliyiin iyo xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka. Waxa uu sheegay in hadafka ugu weyn uu yahay sidii Somaliland uga heli lahayd Mareykanka aqoonsi, balse dhinacyadu sidoo kale ka wada shaqeyn karaan ganacsi, maalgashi iyo iskaashi amni inta arrinta aqoonsiga laga gaarayo go’aan. Cirro ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay Mareykanka u soo bandhigi karto dekedda Berbera, kheyraadka dabiiciga ah iyo xarumo kale oo istiraatiiji ah. “Waxba bilaash kuma bixinayno,” ayuu yiri Cirro, isaga oo tilmaamay in heshiis kasta uu ku xirnaan doono waxa dhinaca kale lagu beddelanayo. Saldhig militari Cirro ayaa sheegay inuusan meesha ka saarayn in mustaqbalka Mareykanka, Israel ama dalal kale ay helaan marin militari oo ballaaran ama heshiis saldhig. Arrintaas ayuu ku tilmaamay mid “wada-xaajood” ku xiran. “Meesha kama saarayo,” ayuu yiri, isagoo sheegay in heshiis kasta uu ku xirnaan doono waxa Somaliland beddelkeeda ka hesho, oo ay ka mid noqon karaan taageero amni iyo xoojinta ciidamadeeda. Berbera ayaa ku taalla meel muhiim ah oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya, waxaana muhiimaddeeda sare u qaaday khataraha amni iyo weerarrada sanadihii dambe ka dhacay marin-biyoodka Badda Cas. Mareykanka ayaa hore xiriir dhinaca ammaanka iyo tababarka ah ula lahaa Somaliland, balse ma laha saldhig militari oo halkaas ku yaalla, sida ay sheegtay Semafor . Israel ayaa bishii Diseembar 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland, tallaabadaas oo dowladda Soomaaliya si adag u diidday, kuna tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dalka. Midowga Afrika iyo dalal kale ayaa sidoo kale taageeray midnimada Soomaaliya. Tan iyo markaas, maamulka Somaliland ayaa sare u qaaday dadaalkiisa uu ku doonayo in dalal kale ay raacaan Israel, waxaana Cirro uu Mareykanka ku tilmaamay bartilmaameedka ugu muhiimsan ee ololahaas. Deked iyo macdan Marka laga soo tago arrimaha militari, Cirro ayaa isku dayaya inuu Washington u soo bandhigo Somaliland meel leh fursado dhaqaale, isaga oo xusay dekedda Berbera, xeebta dheer, kalluumeysiga iyo kheyraadka la rumeysan yahay inay ka mid yihiin shidaal, gaas iyo macdano. Waxa uu sheegay in aqoonsi caalami ah uu sahli karo in shirkadaha Mareykanka iyo maalgashadayaasha kale ay si weyn u soo galaan Somaliland. Waxa uu xusay dekedda iyo aagga ganacsiga xorta ah ee Berbera, xeeb dhererkeedu gaarayo qiyaastii 850 kiiloomitir, kalluumeysiga, iyo shidaal, gaas iyo macdano uu sheegay inay jiri karaan. Cirro ayaa sheegay in markii uu noqday guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka sanadkii 2005 miisaaniyadda Somaliland ay ka yareyd $50 milyan, halka hadda ay gaartay qiyaastii $500 milyan sanadkii. Waxa uu sheegay in Somaliland ay toban sano gudahood noqon karto meel “aad u hodan ah” haddii la horumariyo dhaqaalaha badda iyo kheyraadka kale. Cirro ayaa xitaa saadaaliyay in miisaaniyadda sanadlaha ah mustaqbalka gaari karto $3 bilyan ilaa $4 bilyan haddii kheyraadkaas la horumariyo. Somaliland ayaa muddo dheer ku doodi jirtay arrimo taariikhi ah iyo kuwo siyaasadeed marka ay raadineyso aqoonsi, balse hadallada Cirro waxay muujinayaan in maamulkiisu hadda diiradda saarayo waxa uu si toos ah ugu beddeli karo aqoonsigaas. Waxa uu Washington u bandhigayaa marin istiraatiiji ah, deked, kheyraad dabiici ah iyo maalgashi suurtagal ah. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa gebi ahaanba diiddan mowqifkaas, waxayna Somaliland u aragtaa qeyb ka mid ah Soomaaliya. Muqdisho waxay sidoo kale u aragtaa Berbera, xeebaha iyo kheyraadka ku jira dhulkaas inay qeyb ka yihiin dhulka iyo hantida Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Taasi waxay ka dhigeysaa dalabyada Cirro kuwo caqabado siyaasadeed iyo mid sharci ah wajahaya ka hor inta aysan dowlad ama shirkad shisheeye gelin heshiis weyn. items.description: Intii aan ku sugnaa Washington, D.C., waxaan kulamo muhiim ah la yeeshay khubaro iyo masuuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan Atlantic Council iyo Foundation for Defense of Democracies (FDD). Kulamadan waxa aan kaga wada hadalnay danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, ilaalinta marin-biyoodyada muhiimka u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah, iyo sidii loo dhisi lahaa iskaashi qoto dheer oo waara oo dhex mara labada dal. Waxaan si gaar ah u adkeeyey in Somaliland muddo ka badan saddex iyo soddon sannadood ay dhisaysay dawladnimo ku salaysan rabitaanka shacabka, dimuqraadiyad, doorashooyin xor ah iyo kala-guur siyaasadeed oo nabdoon. Waayo-aragnimadeennu waxay caddeyn u tahay in dimuqraadiyadda, dawladnimada iyo xasilloonidu ay yihiin tiirar isku xidhan oo muhiim u ah nabadda iyo horumarka gobolka. Waxaan sidoo kale iftiimiyey muhiimadda istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland iyo Dekedda Berbera, oo ku taalla mid ka mid ah marin-biyoodyada ugu muhiimsan dunida. Somaliland waxay diyaar u tahay inay Maraykanka iyo saaxiibbadiisa kala shaqayso amniga badda, xasilloonida gobolka, ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Somaliland maanta waxay Washington la wadaagaysaa farriin cad: waxaan nahay dal dimuqraadi ah, xasilloon oo leh hay’ado shaqaynaya, kuna yaalla goob istiraatiiji ah; waxaanan diyaar u nahay iskaashi ku dhisan kalsooni, dano wadaag iyo mas’uuliyad wadajir ah.

Kulamadan waxa aan kaga wada hadalnay danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, ilaalinta marin-biyoodyada muhiimka u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah, iyo sidii loo dhisi lahaa iskaashi qoto dheer oo waara oo dhex mara labada dal. Waxaan si gaar ah u adkeeyey in Somaliland muddo ka badan saddex iyo soddon sannadood ay dhisaysay dawladnimo ku salaysan rabitaanka shacabka, dimuqraadiyad, doorashooyin xor ah iyo kala-guur siyaasadeed oo nabdoon. Waayo-aragnimadeennu waxay caddeyn u tahay in dimuqraadiyadda, dawladnimada iyo xasilloonidu ay yihiin tiirar isku xidhan oo muhiim u ah nabadda iyo horumarka gobolka.
