items.title: DF oo war kasoo saartay xaaladda markabka M/V JACUAR
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda ee Soomaaliya ayaa faahfaahin ka bixisay xaaladda markabka xamuulka ah ee M/V JACUAR (IMO 9181821), kaas oo ay sheegtay inuu caariyay kaddib markii ay cilad biyo-gal ah ka dhacday qayb ka mid ah markabka gudihiisa. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in markabka uu watay calanka Saint Kitts and Nevis, isla markaana uu ka soo shiraacday Nacala Port ee Mozambique, isagoo ku sii jeeday Adabiya Port ee dalka Masar. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka wasaaradda, markabka ayaa siday qiyaastii 7,007.73 tan oo badeeco ah, waxaana saarnaa 18 shaqaale ah oo kasoo kala jeeda dalalka Hindiya, Suuriya iyo Masar. Wasaaradda Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda ayaa sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda markabka, iyadoo kaashanaysa hay’adaha kale ee ay khusayso. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay inay waddo gurmad iyo isku-duwidda hawlaha samatabixinta, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo badbaadada shaqaalaha saaran markabka iyo in si habsami leh loo maareeyo xaaladda. Wasaaradda ayaa intaas ku dartay inay bulshada iyo dhammaan dhinacyada ay khusayso la wadaagi doonto wixii war ah ee kasoo kordha xaaladda markabka. Bayaanka wasaaradda ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya si dhow ula socdaan xaaladda markabka iyo hawlaha gurmadka ee socda. The post DF oo war kasoo saartay xaaladda markabka M/V JACUAR appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: AJC was honored to meet with Somaliland President
items.description: AJC was honored to meet with Somaliland President (@PresidencySL_) Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, Foreign Minister Abdirahman Dahir Adan, Minister of Defense Mohamed Yusuf Ali Ahmed, Speaker of Parliament Yasin Haji Mohamoud, and other senior Somaliland leaders to discuss developments in the Horn of Africa, regional security, the democratic country’s strategic importance, and Somaliland’s growing relationship with Israel. The discussion also explored the significance of Israel being the first UN member state to officially recognize Somaliland as an independent and sovereign state, as well as opportunities for deeper cooperation between Somaliland and Israel. AJC’s Center for a New Middle East is committed to building trusted partnerships with leaders around the world and fostering dialogue on the issues shaping Israel, the Middle East, and beyond. AJC

items.title: Madaxweyne Firdhiye oo booqday Xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Maamulka Waqooyi Bari, Cabdiqaadir Axmed Aw-Cali (Firdhiye) ayaa Khamiistan booqday Xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Magaalada Muqdisho. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa taliska ku soo dhaweeyay Madaxweynaha Waqooyi Bari, sida uu Taliyuhu ku sheegay war qoraal ah. Taliyaha ayaa tilmaamay in ay ka wada hadleen xaaladda guud ee amniga dalka, gaar ahaan buu yiri xoojinta amniga iyo nabadgelyada deegaanada Waqooyi Bari Somaliya. “Waxaan sidoo kale ka wada hadalnay, sidii loo laba jibaari lahaa dadaalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, xasilloonida iyo badqabka shacabka iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa wada-shaqaynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, hay’adaha amniga iyo maamulka deegaanka.” Ayuu Taliyaha ku sheegay warka. Taliyaha oo warkan ku daabacay bartiisa xiriirka bulshada ayaa intaasi ku daray “Waxaan adkeynay muhiimadda ay leedahay iskaashi iyo isku-duubni lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda iyo amniga guud ee dalka.” Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa waxaa kulanka ku wehlinayay Taliyaha Ciidanka Badda, Admiral Cabdiwahaab Cabdullaahi Cumar, Taliyaha Taliska Taakuleynta ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Maxamed Maxamuud Xasan (Garabey) iyo Taliyaha Taliska Tababarada iyo Doctrine-ka ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Axmed Ciise Axmed.

items.title: Iiraan oo Trump iyo Netanyahu ku xirtay furitaanka Hormuz
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Iiraan ayaa sheegtay inaysan dib u furi doonin Marinka Hormuz ilaa Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu xilalka laga qaado Mohammad Baqer Zolqadr oo ah la-taliyaha siyaasadeed ee Hoggaamiyaha Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan ayaa sheegay in go’aanka Tehran uu qayb ka yahay jawaabta ay ka bixinayso dagaalka iyo weerarrada ay sheegtay in loo geystay dalkeeda. Zolqadr ayaa tilmaamay in Iiraan ay sii wadi doonto iska-caabbinta Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil, isagoo xiritaanka Marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo ah mid kamid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee maraakiibta shidaalka ee dunida uu ku tilmaamay waxa uu ugu yeeray “marxaladda koowaad ee aargoosiga shacabka Iiraan”. Hadallada mas’uulkan ka tirsan dowladda Iiraan ayaa xoojinaya muhiimadda istiraatiijiga ah ee uu leeyahay Marin-biyoodka Hormuz, kaas oo isku xira Gacanka Faaris iyo Gacanka Cumaan, isla markaana ah marin ay maraan tiro badan oo maraakiib ah oo qaada shidaalka iyo gaaska dabiiciga ah. Xiisadda ka taagan marinka ayaa si gaar ah walaac ugu abuurtay suuqyada tamarta, maadaama carqalad ku timaadda isu-socodka maraakiibta halkaas ay saameyn ku yeelan karto dhoofinta shidaalka ee dalalka Khaliijka iyo silsiladaha sahayda tamarta ee caalamka. Zolqadr ayaa sidoo kale xusay dadkii lagu dilay weerarradii ka dhacay Minab iyo Lamerd iyo xubno ka tirsan ciidamada milatariga Iiraan oo la dilay, isagoo sheegay in Tehran ay doonayso inay uga aargoosato. Hadalladan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Hormuz uu noqday meel si weyn diiradda loogu hayo marka laga hadlayo xiisadda u dhexeysa Iiraan, Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil, iyadoo dhaq-dhaqaaq kasta oo militari ama amni oo halkaas ka dhaca uu saameyn ku yeelan karo maraakiibta ganacsiga. Iiraan ayaa muddo dheer awood u lahayd inay saameyn ku yeelato isu-socodka maraakiibta ee marinkan, waxaana Hormuz loo arkaa marin muhiim u ah dhaqaalaha caalamka, maadaama dalal badan oo dhoofiya shidaalka ay isticmaalaan si ay wax-soo-saarkooda ugu gaarsiiyaan suuqyada caalamka. Haddii xaaladda marinku sii adkaato, saameynta ugu weyn waxay noqon kartaa mid dhaqaale iyo amni, gaar ahaan dhinaca maraakiibta ganacsiga, qiimaha tamarta iyo waddamada ku tiirsan shidaalka kasoo baxa gobolka. Si kastaba, hadalka Zolqadr waa mowqif uu sheegay mas’uul Iiraani ah, mana cadda in shuruuddani ay tahay go’aan rasmi ah oo ay si wadajir ah u qaateen dhammaan hay’adaha go’aan-qaadashada Iiraan. Xiisadda Hormuz ayaa sidaas darteed weli ah mid si dhow loola socdo, iyadoo indhaha caalamku ku wajahan yihiin tallaabooyinka ay qaadi doonaan Iiraan, Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil iyo waxa ay xaaladdu ka beddeli karto isu-socodka maraakiibta iyo suuqyada tamarta. The post Iiraan oo Trump iyo Netanyahu ku xirtay furitaanka Hormuz appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya oo si rasmi ah ula wareegtay mas’uuliyadda…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maanta waa maalin taariikhi ah oo Soomaaliya ay si rasmi ah u soo afjartay marxalad dheer oo ku saabsan ilaalinta iyo horumarinta xuquuqul insaanka, iyadoo si buuxda ula wareegtay mas’uuliyadda qaran ee xuquuqul insaanka. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in si rasmi ah loo soo gabagabeeyey hawshii Xafiiska Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, oo hoos imaan jiray UNTMIS. Geeddi-socodkan taariikhiga ah ayaa ka soo bilowday Muqdisho, isagoo soo maray dadaallo iyo wada-hadallo heer caalami ah oo ka dhacay Geneva iyo New York, kuwaas oo ay hormuud u ahayd Wasiir Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, oo ay garab taagnaayeen hawl-wadeennada kala duwan ee wasaaradda, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka. Dadaalka wadajirka ah ee hay’adaha dowladda iyo khubarada Soomaaliyeed wuxuu horseeday in la gaaro himilo qaran oo muddo dheer laga shaqeynayay, taas oo ah in Soomaaliya ay si buuxda u yeelato lahaanshaha iyo hoggaaminta ajandaha xuquuqul insaanka ee dalkeeda. “Guushan waxay ka dhalatay qorsheyn joogto ah, go’aan siyaasadeed, wada-hadal miro-dhal ah iyo dadaal qaran oo aan kala go’ lahayn,” ayay sheegtay Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka. Sidoo kale, waxaa saldhig u ahaa go’aannada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, horumarradii Soomaaliya ka gaartay Golaha Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaramada Midoobay iyo xoojinta Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaranka Soomaaliya. Shirweynihii Qaran ee Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Maarso 2025 ayaa sidoo kale door muhiim ah ka qaatay dhismaha aragti qaran oo ku salaysan hannaan ay Soomaaliya iyadu leedahay, hoggaamiso, kana mas’uul tahay. Xiritaanka Xafiiska Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya ma aha dhammaadka ilaalinta xuquuqul insaanka, balse waa bilowga marxalad cusub, sida ay sheegtay wasaaradda. “Waa marxalad ay hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed si toos ah u qaadanayaan mas’uuliyadda ilaalinta, horumarinta iyo u doodista xuquuqul insaanka muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed.” Soomaaliya waxay maanta muujisay in hay’adaha qaranku ay gaareen heer ay si madax-bannaan ugu hoggaamin karaan ajandaha xuquuqul insaanka, iyadoo iskaashiga iyo taageerada caalamiga ah loo adeegsanayo xoojinta awoodda qaranka, halkii ay beddeli lahaayeen mas’uuliyadda hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed. “Geeddigii dheeraa maanta wuxuu gaaray guul. Soomaaliya waxay si buuxda ula wareegtay mas’uuliyadda xuquuqul insaankeeda. Bog taariikhi ah ayaa xirmay, cutub cusubna waa furmay: cutub ay Soomaaliya iyadu leedahay, iyadu hoggaaminayso, iyaduna ka mas’uul tahay.” Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa maanta furaysa albaab cusub oo ku dhisan lahaanshaha qaran, hay’ado awood leh, isla-xisaabtan, sharciyad iyo ilaalinta xuquuqda muwaadiniinta. Mas’uuliyadda cusub ayaa u baahan dadaal joogto ah, hoggaan adag iyo in hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed ay si buuxda u gutaan waajibaadka dastuuriga ah, qaran iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ee xuquuqul insaanka. Xiritaanka Xafiiska Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya ma aha dhammaadka ilaalinta xuquuqul insaanka, balse waa bilowga marxalad cusub, sida ay sheegtay wasaaradda. “Waa marxalad ay hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed si toos ah u qaadanayaan mas’uuliyadda ilaalinta, horumarinta iyo u doodista xuquuqul insaanka muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed.” Soomaaliya waxay maanta muujisay in hay’adaha qaranku ay gaareen heer ay si madax-bannaan ugu hoggaamin karaan ajandaha xuquuqul insaanka, iyadoo iskaashiga iyo taageerada caalamiga ah loo adeegsanayo xoojinta awoodda qaranka, halkii ay beddeli lahaayeen mas’uuliyadda hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed. “Geeddigii dheeraa maanta wuxuu gaaray guul. items.title: Somaliland president faces backlash after tense Washington interview
items.description: WASHINGTON (Somaliguardian) — Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro arrived in Washington with a familiar message: his administration wants the United States to recognise Somaliland and sees the territory’s strategic position on the Gulf of Aden as an opportunity for a deeper American partnership. The visit offered an unusually prominent platform for that argument. On September 14, Mr Irro appeared at the Hudson Institute for a discussion titled Somaliland as a Strategic Partner in the Horn of Africa , followed by a fireside conversation with Hudson senior fellow Joshua Meservey. The event examined Somaliland’s potential role as an economic and security partner for the United States. But portions of the discussion soon attracted attention for a different reason. Clips circulating online focused on moments in which Mr Irro laughed, hesitated or gave brief answers to questions concerning Somaliland’s mineral resources and regional security. The resulting criticism has raised a broader question: can Somaliland translate its strategic advantages into a sufficiently clear case for why Washington should change its longstanding position on the territory’s status? A minerals question becomes a political moment One of the most widely discussed exchanges concerned critical minerals. Asked about resources Somaliland could potentially offer American companies, Mr Irro replied: “I’m not a geologist.” He then laughed and added: “I don’t know… maybe everything.” The exchange was brief, but the subject was not. Critical minerals have become an increasingly important component of international competition over supply chains, advanced manufacturing and national security. For Somaliland, mineral resources form part of a broader economic proposition that Hargeisa is putting before potential foreign partners. Yet there is a significant difference between geological potential and commercially established deposits. A more detailed discussion could have addressed what Somaliland has already identified, what remains to be explored and what investment opportunities could realistically be developed. Instead, the answer became one of the most circulated moments from the Washington event. That is particularly notable because Mr Irro has subsequently presented a much more expansive economic proposition to the United States. In an interview with Semafor, he said Somaliland could offer American investors access to its facilities and mineral resources, while leaving open the possibility of expanded military access. “We are not giving anything for free,” Mr Irro told the publication. His argument was that economic and strategic cooperation should produce reciprocal benefits. That represents an important evolution in Somaliland’s diplomatic pitch. The campaign is no longer based only on the territory’s historical claim to independence. It is increasingly framed around what Somaliland can offer Washington. From recognition to strategic partnership The central issue remains recognition. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 after the collapse of the Somali state and years of conflict. It has since maintained its own government, security institutions and currency, while Somalia continues to regard the territory as part of its sovereign territory. The historical argument is complicated by Somaliland’s brief independence in 1960. The former British Somaliland became independent on June 26 that year and joined the former Italian-administered territory of Somalia on July 1 to form the Somali Republic. The union later became deeply troubled, particularly during the rule of President Mohamed Siad Barre. After years of repression and conflict, Somaliland declared that it was restoring its independence in 1991. Its government argues that decades of separate political administration justify international recognition. Somalia rejects that position and continues to defend the country’s territorial integrity. Those competing claims form the backdrop to virtually every diplomatic conversation about Somaliland. At the Hudson Institute, Mr Irro attempted to distinguish Somaliland’s practical political reality from its formal international status. “Practically [Somaliland] is not part of Somalia,” he said. He also described Somaliland as theoretically part of Somalia. The distinction reflects the central paradox of Somaliland’s position: it functions as a separate political entity but remains largely outside the international system of sovereign states. For Washington, therefore, recognition would represent more than an acknowledgement of conditions on the ground. It would constitute a significant change in diplomatic policy. The Sudan exchange Another moment attracting attention involved Sudan. The question gave Mr Irro an opportunity to discuss the wider regional security environment and Somaliland’s relationship with conflicts across the Horn of Africa. Instead, he described Sudan as too far away before the discussion moved on. The exchange drew criticism because geography is one of Somaliland’s principal arguments for greater international attention. Somaliland lies along the Gulf of Aden, close to the maritime route leading towards the Bab el-Mandeb, the narrow passage connecting the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden. That location places the territory near one of the world’s most strategically sensitive maritime corridors. For Washington, the significance is potentially practical. Berbera could offer logistical and commercial opportunities for a country seeking stronger relationships across the Horn of Africa and the wider Red Sea region. For Hargeisa, the geography is therefore not simply a geographic fact. It is part of the diplomatic argument. Berbera at the centre of Somaliland’s offer Berbera has become the clearest expression of that strategy. The port gives Somaliland access to major maritime routes and has become an important component of the territory’s ambitions to develop trade and foreign investment. Mr Irro is now linking that economic proposition directly to his campaign for recognition. Semafor reported that he is offering US investors access to Somaliland’s port and mineral resources while signalling that future military access could also be negotiated. That does not amount to an announcement of a new American military base. Rather, Mr Irro has indicated that Somaliland is prepared to discuss expanded access if the arrangement produces sufficient benefits for the territory. The distinction is important. The proposal is not simply about where the United States might operate. It is about whether Somaliland can persuade Washington that a closer relationship would serve American economic and security interests while also advancing Somaliland’s quest for recognition. Israel has changed the equation The diplomatic landscape shifted significantly in December 2025, when Israel became the first UN member state to formally recognise Somaliland as an independent and sovereign state. The decision was announced by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on December 26, with both sides signing a declaration of mutual recognition. Israel said it intended to cooperate with Somaliland in areas including agriculture, health, technology and economic development. Somalia condemned the move as a violation of its sovereignty. The African Union also rejected the recognition and reaffirmed its support for Somalia’s territorial integrity. For Somaliland, however, the Israeli decision represented a diplomatic breakthrough. For the first time since its 1991 declaration of independence, a UN member state had formally recognised its sovereignty. That gave Hargeisa something it had previously lacked: a concrete example that international recognition was no longer purely theoretical. But Israel’s decision did not automatically change US policy. Washington has not followed Israel in recognising Somaliland. That leaves Somaliland facing a more difficult diplomatic task: converting the Israeli breakthrough into wider international support without assuming that other governments will reach the same conclusion. Why Washington matters most Mr Irro’s current strategy appears increasingly designed around that challenge. His message to American policymakers is that Somaliland can provide more than a historical argument. It can offer access to a strategically positioned port. It can open opportunities for American investment. It can potentially contribute to regional security. And it can serve as a partner at a time when instability around the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden has increased the strategic value of locations along those waterways. Semafor reported that Mr Irro described the United States as the “big fish” Somaliland wants to pursue and argued that earlier recognition would be preferable. That approach reflects a more transactional diplomatic pitch. Rather than asking Washington simply to recognise Somaliland because of its history or political development, Hargeisa is asking what a formal relationship could deliver for the United States. That proposition, however, creates another set of questions. What precisely would Washington gain? How significant are Somaliland’s proven natural resources? What would expanded military access actually involve? How would recognition affect US relations with Somalia? And would the strategic benefits outweigh the diplomatic consequences? Even Somaliland’s supporters see a messaging problem The criticism following the Hudson event has not come exclusively from opponents of Somaliland’s independence claim. Cameron Hudson, a former US intelligence official who has worked extensively on African affairs, criticised Mr Irro’s performance on social media. Other observers also questioned whether the president had made the most of the opportunity. More significantly, Joshua Meservey himself subsequently said Somaliland had failed to make a consistent case for why recognition was necessary. His comments followed the Hudson Institute discussion he had moderated with Mr Irro. That assessment is particularly notable because Meservey has previously argued publicly that Washington should give Somaliland’s case serious consideration. His criticism therefore points to a question of diplomatic effectiveness rather than simply disagreement over Somaliland’s desired outcome. The challenge for Hargeisa is not merely obtaining attention in Washington. It is making the argument in terms that American policymakers can connect directly to US interests. The wider dispute remains unresolved Somaliland’s campaign ultimately rests on several interconnected claims. It argues that decades of separate administration have produced a political reality distinct from Somalia. It points to its location beside the Gulf of Aden and near the Bab el-Mandeb. It highlights Berbera as a potential commercial and strategic hub. It offers investment opportunities in infrastructure and natural resources. And it argues that recognition would formalise an existing political reality rather than create a new one. Somalia sees the matter differently. Mogadishu regards Somaliland’s territory, coastline, ports and natural resources as part of Somalia and rejects unilateral recognition of the territory by foreign states. That disagreement gives the US decision a regional dimension. Recognition would not take place in isolation from Somalia’s objections or from the broader African concern over territorial integrity. Israel’s decision has already demonstrated how consequential the issue can become. A campaign entering a new phase The Hudson Institute appearance was therefore more than an awkward Washington interview. It exposed the central challenge facing Somaliland’s recognition campaign at a moment when the stakes have increased. Israel has broken the previous pattern by recognising Somaliland. Berbera has become increasingly important to Hargeisa’s economic and strategic messaging. The United States is being offered a wider menu of investment and security cooperation. And Somaliland’s leadership is now attempting to persuade Washington that recognition would be useful not only to Somaliland but also to American interests. That is a considerably more demanding argument than simply asking the world to acknowledge Somaliland’s separate political existence. For President Irro, the task ahead is to connect history, geography, economics and security into a single, concrete proposition for Washington. The question is no longer simply whether Somaliland wants recognition. It is whether the case can be made clearly enough — and with enough demonstrable strategic value — for the United States to consider changing its policy. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: WAR DEG DEG AH: Markab Xamuul ah oo kusoo caariyay Xeebaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho, 17 Sebteembar 2026: Wasaaradda Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa xaqiijisay in markabka xamuulka qaada ee M/V JACUAR (IMO 9181821) uu ku caariyay xeebaha Soomaaliya, kaddib markii ay biyo galeen qeyb ka mid ah markabka. Markabka oo watay calanka Saint Kitts and Nevis ayaa ka soo baxay Dekedda Nacala ee dalka Mozambique, isagoo ku sii jeeday Dekedda Adabiya ee dalka Masar. Markabka ayaa siday ku dhowaad 7,007.73 tan oo xamuul ah. Waxaa markabka saarnaa 18 shaqaale ah, kuwaas oo u kala dhashay Hindiya, Suuriya iyo Masar. Wasaaradda Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda ayaa sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda markabka, iyadoo la kaashanaysa hay’adaha ay khusayso, isla markaana la isku dubbaridayo howlaha gurmadka iyo samatabbixinta si loo xaqiijiyo badbaadada shaqaalaha markabka. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto wargelinta shacabka iyo dhinacyada ay khusayso, iyadoo la bixin doono xog cusub marka xaaladdu isbeddesho.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo soo gebagabeysay hawshii Xafiiska Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaramada Midoobay
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya — 17 Sebteembar 2026: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u soo gabagabeysay hawshii Xafiiska Arrimaha Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo hoos imaanayay UNTMIS/HRPG, iyadoo mas’uuliyadda arrimaha Xuquuqul Insaanka si buuxda loogu wareejiyay hay’adaha qaranka. Geeddi-socodka ayaa soo maray wada-hadallo iyo diyaar-garow heer qaran iyo heer caalami ah, oo ay ka mid ahaayeen kulamo ka dhacay Muqdisho, Geneva iyo New York. Waxaa hoggaaminayay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka XFS, Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, iyadoo ay ka qeyb qaateen maamulka Wasaaradda, agaasimeyaal, la-taliyeyaal, khubaro iyo shaqaale Soomaaliyeed. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo lahaanshaha iyo hoggaaminta qaranka ee ajandaha Xuquuqul Insaanka, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay sii xoojinayso hay’adaha u xilsaaran ilaalinta iyo horumarinta xuquuqda muwaadiniinta. Dowladdu waxay sheegtay in geeddi-socodka ay saldhig u ahaayeen horumarrada Soomaaliya ka sameysay dhinaca Xuquuqul Insaanka, go’aannada dowladda iyo xoojinta Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaranka Soomaaliya. Shirweynihii Qaran ee Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Maarso 2025 ayaa sidoo kale lagu tilmaamay inuu door ka qaatay dhismaha aragti qaran oo ku wajahan ilaalinta Xuquuqda Aadanaha. Xiritaanka xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay looma arko dhammaadka taageerada iyo shaqada Xuquuqul Insaanka, balse wuxuu calaamad u yahay marxalad cusub oo hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed ay si toos ah ugu qaadanayaan masuuliyadda ilaalinta, horumarinta iyo u doodista xuquuqda muwaadiniinta. Marxaladdan cusub waxay Soomaaliya ka doonaysaa xoojinta hay’adaha, isla-xisaabtanka, ku dhaqanka sharciga iyo gudashada waajibaadka dastuuriga ah iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ee la xiriira Xuquuqul Insaanka. Soomaaliya waxay maanta soo gabagabeysay cutub, waxayna furtay mid cusub—cutub ay hay’adaha qaranku leeyihiin, hoggaaminayaan, kana mas’uul yihiin ilaalinta Xuquuqda Aadanaha.

Xiritaanka xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay looma arko dhammaadka taageerada iyo shaqada Xuquuqul Insaanka, balse wuxuu calaamad u yahay marxalad cusub oo hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed ay si toos ah ugu qaadanayaan masuuliyadda ilaalinta, horumarinta iyo u doodista xuquuqda muwaadiniinta. Marxaladdan cusub waxay Soomaaliya ka doonaysaa xoojinta hay’adaha, isla-xisaabtanka, ku dhaqanka sharciga iyo gudashada waajibaadka dastuuriga ah iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ee la xiriira Xuquuqul Insaanka. Soomaaliya waxay maanta soo gabagabeysay cutub, waxayna furtay mid cusub—cutub ay hay’adaha qaranku leeyihiin, hoggaaminayaan, kana mas’uul yihiin ilaalinta Xuquuqda Aadanaha.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo u baxaya safar dibadda ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa lagu wadaa inuu maalmaha soo socda gaaro magaalada New York ee dalka Mareykanka, si uu uga qayb-galo shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Madaxweynaha ayaa kamid noqon doona madaxda dalalka xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee ka qayb-galaya kulamada iyo doodaha guud ee shirka, iyadoo sidoo kale la filayo inuu khudbad ka jeediyo madasha golaha guud. Ajendaha khudbadda Xasan Sheekh ayaa la filayaa inuu uga hadlo xaaladda Soomaaliya, isagoo soo bandhigi doona arrimaha la xiriira amniga, siyaasadda iyo geeddi-socodka dowlad-dhiska dalka. Waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa in Madaxweynaha uu ka hadlo horumarka ay Dowladda Federaalka sheegtay inay ka samaysay dhinacyada kala duwan iyo tallaabooyinka ay qaaday muddadii u dambeysay. Inta uu ku sugan yahay New York, Xasan Sheekh ayaa fursad u heli doona inuu kulamo la yeesho madaxda iyo mas’uuliyiinta dalalka kale ee shirka ka qayb-galaya iyo saraakiisha hay’adaha caalamiga ah. Kulamada Madaxweynaha ayaa lagu wadaa in looga hadlo xoojinta xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo beesha caalamka, iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan iyo taageerada caalamiga ah ee Dowladda Federaalka. Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sanad kasta magaalada New York ku martigeliya madaxda iyo wakiillada dalalka xubnaha ka ah ururka, kuwaas oo kaga hadla arrimaha caalamiga ah iyo xaaladaha dalalkooda. Wafdiga Soomaaliya ee shirka ka qayb-galaya ayaa la filayaa inuu ka koobnaado xubno ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka oo ay kamid yihiin wasiirro iyo xildhibaanno, kuwaas oo Madaxweynaha ku wehlin doona safarkiisa New York. Golaha Wasiirada Koonfur Galbeed oo ka shiray amniga, fatahaadaha iyo adeegyada bulshada
items.description: Baydhabo, 17 Sebtembar 2026: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa maanta shir-guddoomiyey kulanka Golaha Wasiirada Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, kaas oo looga hadlay xaaladda amniga, maamulka, fatahaadaha iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada. Golaha Wasiirada ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay xoojinta amniga deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed iyo sidii loo sii adkeyn lahaa wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha amniga iyo maamulka, si loo xaqiijiyo nabadgelyada shacabka. Sidoo kale, kulanka waxaa lagu soo qaaday u diyaar-garowga fatahaadaha iyo saameynta El Niño, iyadoo la qiimeeyey qorshayaasha loogu talagalay ka hortagga iyo yareynta saameynta fatahaadaha iyo xaaladaha cimilada, gaar ahaan deegaannada ay bulshada ugu nugushahay. Golaha ayaa sidoo kale ka dooday maamul-daadejinta iyo dardargelinta adeegyada dowladda, iyadoo xoogga la saaray sidii adeegyada aasaasiga ah loogu dhoweyn lahaa shacabka, loona xoojin lahaa hufnaanta iyo isla-xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda. Ugu dambeyn, Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa Golaha Wasiirada kula dardaarmay in la xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha dowladda, lana dardar-geliyo qorshayaasha wax looga qabanayo baahiyaha shacabka iyo horumarinta adeegyada dowladda.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo shir-guddoomiyey kulanka 7-aad ee Guddiga Joogtada
items.description: Muqdisho, 17 Sebtembar 2026: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa maanta shir-guddoomiyey kulanka toddobaadlaha ah ee 7-aad ee Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Golaha Shacabka, kaas oo lagu qabtay Xarunta Guddoonka iyo Guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa. Guddoomiyaha ayaa kulanka furitaankiisa ku bogaadiyey xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah dadaallada ay ku bixinayaan gudashada waajibaadkooda iyo dardargelinta howlaha sharci-dejinta. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu dhageystay warbixin uu soo jeediyey Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdulle (Jaabiri), taas oo ku saabsanayd Hindise Sharciyeedyada horyaalla guddiyada Golaha, marxaladaha ay marayaan, waqtiga la qorsheeyey in loo gudbiyo fadhiyada guud iyo caqabadaha u baahan in wax laga qabto. Xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ayaa intii uu kulanku socday dejiyey ajandaha iyo jadwalka kulamada guud ee Golaha Shacabka ee toddobaadka soo socda, iyagoo sidoo kale ansixiyey hadal-qoraalkii kulankii 6-aad ee Guddiga Joogtada ah. Ugu dambeyn, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa kulanka soo xiray, isagoo xubnaha guddiga ku adkeeyey inay sii xoojiyaan dadaallada ku aaddan gudashada waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah, dardargelinta howlaha sharci-dejinta iyo in shaqada Golaha Shacabka loo fuliyo si hufan oo waafaqsan qorshayaasha shaqo.

items.title: Safaaradda Mareykanka oo ka digtay khataro ka jira Doolo Zone ee Itoobiya
items.description: Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Addis Ababa ayaa soo saartay digniin amni oo ku saabsan Doolo Zone (Dollo Zone) ee ka tirsan Deegaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya, iyadoo sheegtay inay heshay xog ku saabsan khataro suurtagal ah oo loo geysan karo ajaanibta, oo ay ku jiraan muwaadiniinta Mareykanka. Safaaradda ayaa sheegtay in khatarta sii kordheysa awgeed, shaqaalaha dowladda Mareykanka aan loo oggolaan doonin inay u safraan Doolo Zone, haddii aysan helin oggolaansho gaar ah. Sidoo kale, muwaadiniinta Mareykanka ayaa lagula taliyay inaysan u safrin Doolo Zone, halka dadka ku sugan ama qorsheynaya inay tagaan deegaanka lagu boorriyay inay feejignaadaan, kana fogaadaan goobaha ay dadku ku badan yihiin iyo xaaladaha keeni kara khatar amni. Digniintan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa iyadoo Mareykanku weli Itoobiya ku qiimeynayo Heerka 3-aad ee safarka – “Reconsider Travel”, sababo la xiriira qalalaase, dambiyo, afduub, argagixiso, miinooyin dhulka lagu aasay iyo carqalado dhanka isgaarsiinta ah. Digniinta Mareykanka waxay si gaar ah u xustay Doolo Zone, taas oo ka mid ah deegaannada Soomaalida Itoobiya, iyadoo aan si faahfaahsan loo shaacin nooca khatarta ama cidda ka dambeysa hanjabaadaha la sheegay.

items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, Isaga oo ka duulaya Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Qodobka 161aad farqadda (1), Sharciga Shaqaalaha Rayid ah qodobkiisa 7aad, iyo dhammaan xeerarka, shuruucda iyo qaraarada la xiriira Shaqaalaha Rayidka ah ee Dowladdda Federaalka ah, ayuu faray dhammaan Wasiirrada iyo Mas’uuliyiinta kale ee dowladda in si buuxda oo aan dib-u-dhac lahayn loo hirgeliyo hannaanka shaqaalaysiinta iyo magacaabista ku salaysan kartida iyo mudnaanta. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Mudane Xamsa, faray Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka Dowladda in 20-Sebteembar la bilaabo wajiga 1aad ee dib-u-habaynta Agaasime Waaxeedyada maadama ay laf-dhabar u yihiin maamulka hey’adaha dowladda ayna door muuqda ka qaataan hoggaaminta, hirgalinta siyaasadda, fulinta qorsheyaasha iyo joogtaynta shaqada hey’adaha. Marka la hirgaliyo wajiga 1-aad waxaa dib-u-habayn lagu samayn doona Agaasimayaasha Guud ee hey’adaha dowladda iyada oo lagu salaynayo karti, aqoon, khibrad, hoggaamin iyo waxqabad, si loo dhiso hoggaan maamul oo xirfad leh isla-xisaabtan leh oo ka shaqeeya natiijooyin muuqda. Mudane Xamsa, ayaa sheegay in ujeeddada laga leeyahay nidaamkan ay tahay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay yeelato hoggaan maamul oo xirfad leh, joogto ah, awoodda in uu hirgaliyo siyaasadda dowladda una beddelo natiijooyin muuqda oo ay markhaati ka noqdaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa, ayaa xusay in Afartii sano ee la soo dhaafay, Xukuumadda DanQaran ay qaaday tallaabooyin muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo dhismaha, maamulka iyo tayada hay’adaha dowladda, iyada oo ujeeddadu tahay in la helo hay’ado dowladeed oo leh saldhig sharci iyo maamul adag iyo Shaqaale Rayid ah oo leh aqoon, karti iyo karaan ku filan gudashada waajibaadka saaran. “Waxaan dhidibka u taagnay tiirar sharci iyo kuwa hay’adaha ee lagama maarmaanka u ah dib-u-habaynta iyo horumarinta shaqaalaha rayidka ah, Waxa aan ansixinnay sharciyo, siyaasado, xeerar iyo qaab-dhismeedyo muhiim ah oo hagaya maamulka hay’adaha iyo shaqaalaha dowladda”. Ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre. Ugu Dambayn: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, ayaa faray dhammaan Wasaaradaha iyo Hey’adaha Dowladda In si buuxda loo hirgeliyo qaab-dhismeedyada hay’adaha ee la ansixiyey, iyada oo xilalka Agaasime Waaxeedyada lagu buuxinayo hannaan tartan furan, dhammaan shaqaalaha u qalma ee ku jira adeegga rayidka ah la siiyo fursad loo siman yahay oo ay ugu tartamaan xilalkaas, iyo In wixii xil ama jago bannaan ah ee shaqaalaha dowladda ah lagu buuxiyo hannaan tartan furan oo waafaqsan shuruucda iyo xeerarka dowladda.

items.title: U.S. Airstrike Targets Al-Shabaab Weapons Depot in Puntland’s Al-Madow Mountains
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — The United States has carried out an airstrike targeting an Al-Shabaab weapons and ammunition depot in Puntland’s Al-Madow Mountains, Puntland authorities said Thursday, as counterterrorism operations against militant networks continue in northern Somalia. In a statement dated 17 September 2026, the Puntland Government said the strike targeted a site known as Markad, in the Golis mountain range, which it described as a storage facility used by Al-Shabaab to stockpile weapons, ammunition and other military supplies. The operation was conducted in coordination with Puntland government security institutions, according to the statement. “The Puntland Government and the United States Government have confirmed the success of a counterterrorism operation conducted in the Golis Mountains of the Al-Madow area,” the statement said. Puntland said the targeted facility served as a logistical base supporting Al-Shabaab’s operations and its ability to plan and carry out attacks. The Al-Madow and wider Golis mountain ranges are strategically significant because their rugged terrain provides armed groups with remote locations that can be difficult for ground forces to access. Puntland security forces have conducted sustained operations in the broader area as part of efforts to prevent extremist groups from establishing permanent footholds. The latest strike forms part of continuing counterterrorism cooperation between Puntland and the United States. Puntland said the objective is to disrupt Al-Shabaab’s logistical networks, restrict its ability to store and move military supplies, and deny the group locations from which it can organize attacks. “The targeting of locations and facilities used by the group to support its operations is intended to place pressure on and disrupt its ability to plan and carry out attacks,” the statement said. Puntland and the United States reaffirmed their commitment to continued efforts aimed at weakening Al-Shabaab and preventing the group from establishing safe locations in northern Somalia. The Puntland statement did not provide information on casualties, the extent of damage caused by the strike, or whether senior Al-Shabaab figures were present at the targeted facility. items.title: Somali National Killed in Armed Attack in Kenya’s Migori County
items.description: MIGORI, Kenya (WDN) — A Somali national identified as Abdi Jama has reportedly been killed in an armed attack in Lolgorian, a village in Kenya’s Migori County, according to local reports. The attackers reportedly stormed the house where Abdi was staying while he was asleep and opened fire, striking him in several parts of his body. Reports further allege that the attackers mutilated his body after the shooting. The circumstances surrounding the killing remain unclear, and the details have not been independently verified. Local authorities and security agencies are expected to investigate the incident and provide further information about the identity of the attackers and their possible motive. Migori County, particularly areas involved in gold mining, has attracted a growing Somali business community in recent years. Somali traders and investors are involved in the gold trade and related commercial activities, while employing local Kenyan workers in various parts of the sector. The latest killing has therefore raised concerns within the Somali community, particularly because several Somali nationals have reportedly been killed in Lolgorian and surrounding areas in recent months under different circumstances. Sources said Abdi Jama’s body was expected to be transported to Isebania, a town near the Kenya-Tanzania border, where relatives and members of the Somali community were preparing for his burial. The reported killing has renewed calls for greater attention to the security of Somali traders and residents operating in Kenya’s gold-producing areas, where criminal networks, commercial disputes and other security risks have previously been reported. Further details are expected as Kenyan police authorities and local residents establish the circumstances surrounding the attack. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo shuruud ku xiray in maraakiibta Mareykanka ay si xor ah ku maraan Bab El-Mandeb
items.description: Ururka Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa ogolaaday in maraakiibta Mareykanka ay si nabdoon ku maraan marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb, haddii Washington ay ka fogaato inay si toos ah ugu lug yeelato dagaalka uu Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo ee kala dhexeeya Dowladda Yemen ee caalamka uu aqoonsan yahay. Telefishinka Al Jazeera ayaa ku waramay in labada dhinac ay heshiiskan gaareen, ka dib wada hadalo qarsoodi ah oo daba-yaaqadii isbuuca ay ku yeesheen Magaalada Muscat, oo Saldanada Cumaan ay garwadeen ka ahayd. Warbaahinta Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in Xuutiyiinta ay ogolaadeen in maraakiibta wata Calanka Mareykanka ama xiriirka la leh Mareykanka ay si xor ah ugu gooshaan Badda Cas iyo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb, iyadoo shuruud looga dhigayo in Washington aysan si toos ah ugu lug yeelan dhanka militariga ee dagaalka uu Sacuudiga hoggaaminayo ee ka socda Yemen. Waxaa jira warar sheegaya in Mareykanka uu Xuutiyiinta ka dalbaday inaanan sidoo kale la beegsan maraakiibta laga leeyahay amaba xiriirka la leh Dekedaha Israel, balse ay Xuutiyiinta ku adkeysteen inay ixtiraamayaan heshiiskii xabad joojinta ay labada dhinac gaareen 6-dii bishii May ee sanadkii 2025. Saraakiisha Xuutiyiinta ayaa laga soo xigtay in is fahamka Washington uusan ku saleysnayn badbaadinta Israel ama joojinta hawlgalada ka dhanka ah danaha Israel, taas oo la macno ah in hawlgalada ay taageerada ugu muujinayaan shacabka Falastiin ee ka dhanka ah amniga iyo danaha Israel ee gobolka ay sii socon karaan. Xuutiyiinta ayaa Sabtidii sheegay in dhammaan maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah oo dhan ay adeegsan karaan biyaha Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb, marka laga reebo kuwa laga leeyahay Sacuudiga. Xafiiska Siyaasadda Xuutiyiinta ayaa Axaddii Israel ku eedeeyay inay sii waddo dilalka iyo xadgudubyada ay ku sameynayso heshiiskii xabad joojinta Gaza ee la dhaqangeliyay 10-kii bishii October ee sanadkii hore. Xafiiska oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa ku baaqay in laga hortago xadgudubyada joogtada ah ee Israel iyo in la sii wado taageerada caalamiga ah ee qaddiyadda qaranimada Falastiin. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta oo toddobaadkii hore la wareegay deegaanada xeebaha dalkaasi Yemen ee ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb ayaa soo cusbooneysiin kara weeraradii ay ku hayeen maraakiibta lala xiriiriyo Dekedaha Israel, iyagoo adkeynaya in la ilaaliyo xabad joojinta Gaza.

items.title: Cirro oo ku ceeboobay wareysi lagula yeeshay Washington
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha maamulka Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa ku ceeboobay wareysi lagula yeeshay magaalada Washington, kaddib markii jawaabo uu ka bixiyay macdanta, dagaalka Suudaan iyo sababta Mareykanka looga doonayo inuu aqoonsado Somaliland ay dood ka dhaliyeen baraha bulshada iyo qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha Mareykanka. Wareysiga ayaa ka dhacay machadka Hudson Institute 14-kii September, xilli Cirro uu booqasho ku joogo Mareykanka, isaga oo olole ugu jira sidii maamulka Somaliland uu Washington uga heli lahaa aqoonsi. Hudson Institute ayaa kulanka ku tilmaamay mid looga hadlayay doorka Somaliland ee Geeska Afrika iyo muhiimaddeeda istaraatiijiyadeed. Warbaahinta Middle East Eye ayaa sheegtay in qaabka uu Cirro uga jawaabay qaar ka mid ah su’aalaha uu dhaliyay dhaleeceyn, gaar ahaan xilli Somaliland ay isku dayeyso inay Mareykanka ka dhaadhiciso inay leedahay muhiimad dhinacyada amniga, dekedaha iyo khayraadka dabiiciga ah. Mid ka mid ah su’aalaha sida weyn loo hadal hayo ayaa ku saabsaneyd macdanta muhiimka ah ee Somaliland ay sheegato in ay u soo bandhigi karto Mareykanka. Markii la weydiiyay nooca macdantaas, Cirro ayaa qoslay, isagoo sheegay inuusan ahayn khabiir cilmiga dhulka ah. “Ma garanayo… malaha wax walba,” ayuu yiri. Jawaabta ayaa timid xilli Cirro uu wareysi kale oo uu siiyay warbaahinta Semafor ku sheegay in Somaliland ay Mareykanka u soo bandhigi karto dekedo, macdan iyo suurta-galnimada wada-xaajood ku saabsan marin ama adeegyo militari, iyadoo beddelkeeda dooneysa xiriir dhow iyo aqoonsi. Semafor ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Cirro uu Washington u sheegay in “wax bilaash ah” aan la bixineyn. Hase yeeshee, tani ma ahayn markii ugu horreysay ee Cirro uu ka hadlo macdanta Somaliland. Bishii February, wuxuu Reuters u sheegay in deegaanku leeyahay macdan, shidaal iyo gaas, isagoo si gaar ah u xusay sheegashada ku saabsan kaydka lithium-ka. Su’aal kale oo dood dhalisay ayaa ku saabsaneyd dagaalka Suudaan. Markii wax laga weydiiyay colaaddaas, Cirro wuxuu sheegay in Suudaan ay “aad uga fog tahay” Somaliland, isagoo masaafadeeda tusaale ahaan ula barbar dhigay Venezuela. Ninka wareysiga qaaday ayaa markaas ku jawaabay in Suudaan aysan sidaas uga fogeyn, ka hor inta uusan u gudbin su’aal kale. Dagaalka Suudaan ayaa tan iyo 2023 u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo xoogagga Rapid Support Forces (RSF), waxaana colaadda ku lug leh dano iyo loollan goboleed oo ballaaran. Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa lagu eedeeyay inuu taageero RSF, balse Abu Dhabi ayaa beenisay eedeymahaas. Cameron Hudson, oo hore uga tirsanaa hay’adaha dowladda Mareykanka kana faallooda arrimaha Afrika, ayaa si adag u dhaleeceeyay muuqaalka Cirro ee kulanka, isaga oo qoraal uu soo dhigay X ku tilmaamay hoggaamiye ay ku adkaatay inuu gudbiyo farriintii uu Washington ula yimid. Hudson ayaa xitaa adeegsaday ereyga “African Biden” isagoo ku sifeynaya sida uu u arkay wareysiga, ulana jeeday sida madaxweynihii hore ee Mareykanka uu hadalkii uu dhibbanaa inta uusan xukunka ka degan, kadib markii ay da’da ka daba timid. Dood kale ayaa dhalatay markii Cirro la weydiiyay sababta Mareykanku u aqoonsan lahaa Somaliland. “Ficil ahaan Somaliland kama mid aha Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri, ka hor inta uusan raacin: “Mabda’a ahaan Somaliland waxay ka mid tahay Soomaaliya.” Somaliland waxay sheegatay inay Soomaaliya inteeda kale ka go’day sanadkii 1991-kii, balse dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya waxay u aragtaa qayb ka mid ah dhulkeeda, waana mowqif ay taageeraan Midowga Afrika iyo dalal badan oo caalamka ah. Israel ayaa 26-kii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland, tallaabadaas oo dowladda Soomaaliya si xooggan u cambaareysay, kuna tilmaantay mid ka dhan ah madax-bannaanideeda iyo midnimada dhuleed. Tan iyo markaas, Somaliland waxay sare u qaaday dadaallada ay ugu jirto inay hesho aqoonsiyo kale, iyadoo Mareykanka u aragta bartilmaameedka ugu muhiimsan. Cirro ayaa warbaahinta Semafor u sheegay in Somaliland ay Washington u soo bandhigi karto dekedda Berbera, khayraad dabiici ah iyo iskaashi dhinaca amniga ah, halka Mareykanka laga doonayo xiriir siyaasadeed oo ka ballaaran kan hadda jira. items.title: Puntland Delivers Food and Assistance to 200 Families in Dhinowda
items.description: Jariiban (WDN) — Puntland authorities have delivered emergency humanitarian assistance to approximately 200 vulnerable families in Dhinowda, a remote settlement in Jariiban District of Mudug Region. Government officials traveled to Dhinowda to distribute essential food supplies and cash assistance cards to households facing difficult living conditions. Similar assistance has also been delivered to Towfiiq District and surrounding settlements. Many families in Dhinowda and Towfiiq depend heavily on livestock and pastoral livelihoods. Recurrent drought, reduced access to water and pasture, and declining household incomes have increased food insecurity and placed additional pressure on vulnerable communities across the area. The intervention forms part of Puntland’s broader efforts to provide immediate relief to remote communities while addressing their longer-term development needs. The two areas were among the communities recently visited by Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni during his tour of Mudug Region, which brought renewed attention to the humanitarian and development priorities of southern Puntland. For the families receiving assistance, the immediate support provides essential food and financial relief. At the same time, the situation underscores the importance of sustained investment in water infrastructure, livestock services and resilient rural livelihoods to reduce communities’ vulnerability to future droughts and environmental pressures. items.title: Wasiirka wasaaradda tamarta iyo macdanta  oo qaabilay ururka ganacsatada Taiwan
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Tamarta Iyo Macdanta JSL , Mudane Eng. Axmed Jaamac Barre, ayaa xafiiskiisa kulan kula yeeshay Ururka Ganacsatada Taiwan ee Somaliland, oo ay hoggaaminaysay Guddoomiyaha Ururka ee Somaliland, Alyne Chen. items.title: Sanctioning Officials of the Palestinian Authority and Members of the Palestine Liberation Organization
items.description: Sanctioning Officials of the Palestinian Authority and Members of the Palestine Liberation Organization Office of the Spokesman The State Department has reported to Congress that the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) and Palestinian Authority (PA) have, once again, failed to live up to their commitments as described in the PLO Commitments Compliance Act of 1989 (PLOCCA) and the Middle East Peace Commitments Act of 2002 (MEPCA). This includes initiating and supporting actions at international organizations that undermine and contradict prior commitments in support of Security Council Resolution 242 and 338, taking actions to internationalize the Israeli-Palestinian Conflict including through the International Criminal Court (ICC) and International Court of Justice (ICJ), seeking to bypass negotiations through seeking unilateral recognition, and continuing to pay stipends to terrorists and to glorify acts of terrorism and terrorists in public pronouncements and school textbooks. As a consequence of their failure to reform, contrary to their commitments to the United States, and their ongoing activities that undermine the prospects for peace, the United States will extend sanctions that deny visas to PLO members and PA officials in accordance with section 604(a)(1) of the MEPCA. The Department has maintained the standing waiver for personnel notified to the PLO Observer Mission to the United Nations as was the case in the Department’s prior determinations. It is in our national interest to impose consequences and hold the PLO and PA accountable for glorifying terrorism.

items.title: Kadib dibadbaxyadii Koonfur Galbeed, magaalada Muqdisho oo laga difaacay xiriirka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Kadib falkii sida weyn loo cambaareeyay ee lagu gubay calanka Turkiga, waxaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimadda dalka laga taageeray xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya. Odayaasha dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed oo maanta kulan ku yeeshay magaaada Muqdisho ayaa taageero wayn u muujiyay dowladda Turkiga, iyaga oo boggaadiyay xiriirka labada dal. Kulanka ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galay odayaal dhaqameedyo, salaadiin, ugaasyo, nabaddoonno iyo waxgarad Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo si gaar ah u xusay taageerada Turkiga uu sanadihii lasoo dhaafay siiyay Soomaaliya. Qaar kamid ah odayaasha ka hadlay kulanka ayaa sheegay in taageerada Turkiga ay gaartay qaybo badan oo muhiim ah oo ay ku jiraan gargaarka bani’aadannimo, caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo adeegyada bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, odayaasha dhaqanka ayaa xusay in Soomaaliya ay muddo dheer soo martay xaalado adag, ayna muhiim ahayd taageerada caalamiga ah ee dalka loo fidiyay. “Turkiga wuxuu ka mid ahaa dalalkii si muuqata uga jawaabay baahiyaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xilligii ay dalka ka jireen macluul iyo xaalado bani’aadannimo oo aad u daran,” ayey sheegeen odayaasha dhaqanka. Waxa kale oo ay xuseen in xiriirka labada dal uu si weyn u kobcay wixii ka dambeeyay 2011-kii, xilligaas oo Muqdisho uu yimid Erdogan oo ra’iisul wasaare ah, xilligaas oo dalka ku dhufatay macluul daran oo ay ku dhinteen ku dhowaad 260 kun oo qof oo carruur u badan. Wixii markaas ka dambeeyay, Turkiga wuxuu ballaariyay gurmadkiisa bani’aadannimo iyo mashaariicda horumarineed ee uu ka fulinayay gudaha Soomaaliya. “Bulshada Soomaaliyeed ma hilmaami karto garab istaaggii dowladda iyo shacabka Turkiga ay muujiyeen xilliyadii adkaa,” ayey kulanka ka sheegeen qaar ka mid ah odayaasha dhaqanka. Taageeradaasi ayey odayaashu sheegeen inay taabatay nolosha dadka Soomaaliyeed, kana qayb qaadatay dib-u-dhiska dalka. Odayaasha ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in xiriirka labada dal uusan ku koobnayn oo keliya iskaashi rasmi ah oo ay yeeshaan dowladuhu, balse uu leeyahay dhinac bulsho oo muddo dheer soo jiray. Sidoo kale intii kulanka socday waxaa lagu soo bandhigay baaq ku aaddan in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka labada dal, iyadoo odayaashu ku adkeysteen muhiimadda iskaashi ku saleysan ixtiraam, dano wadaag iyo mashaariic wax ku ool ah oo faa’iido u leh bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Kulankan aya kusoo beegmaya, iyadoo maalmo kahor deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed ay ka dhaceen dibadbaxyo lagu taageerayay Turkiga, sidoo kalena looga soo horjeeday in meel kamid ah Soomaaliya lagu gubo calankiisa. Si kastaba, xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay si weyn u ballaartay, iyadoo labada dal ay yeesheen iskaashi dhow oo dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha bani’aadannimada ah. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale door muhiim ah ka qaata taageerada dhismaha iyo tababarka ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. The post Kadib dibadbaxyadii Koonfur Galbeed, magaalada Muqdisho oo laga difaacay xiriirka… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo beeniyay in ay weerar ku qaadeen Makka Sucuudigana eedeeyay
items.description: Madaxa Xuutiyiinte Mahdi al-Mashat ayaa diiday eedeymaha uga imaanaya Sacuudiga ee ku saabsan in Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay bartilmaameedsatay magaalada Makka, isagoo ku tilmaamay tallaabadaas “isku-day quus ah oo lagu doonayo in lagu kiciyo shucuubta [ka dhanka ah Yemen],” sida ay baahisay warbaahinta Al-Masirah. ￭ Al-Mashat ayaa sheegay in shucuubta Carabta iyo kuwa Muslimiinta ah ay si weyn u fahmeen taariikhda iyo dhaqanka dowladda Sacuudiga, wuxuuna ku eedeeyay maamulkaas inay meel-ka-dhac ku sameynayaan Kacbada, Qur’aanka Kariimka ah iyo Labada Masjid ee Barakaysan, iyagoo isla markaasna adeegsanaya hantida dadweynaha. ￭ Al-Mashat ayaa xusay in dadka reer Yemen ay diyaar u yihiin inay naftooda u huraan difaaca Guriga Barakaysan ee Kacbada, sidii ay u sameeyeen markii ay taageerayeen Masjidka Al-Aqsa, wuxuuna tilmaamay in dadka Yemen ay si joogto ah u dhigaan dibadbaxyo marka meel-ka-dhac loo geysto goobaha barakaysan ee Islaamka. ￭ “Waxay ahayd inay aad uga habboonaan lahayd maamulka Sacuudiga inay abaabulaan shucuubta Ummadda Islaamka xilligii dambiilaha Trump uu meel-ka-dhaca ku sameeyay Kacbada, uuna iska qaaday sawirro muujinaya muuqaal liidaya oo xad-gudub ku ah barakada iyo sharafta Kacbada,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha Yemen. ￭ “Qofkii hadiyad ahaan u siiyay marada lagu daboolo Kacbada Barakaysan dambiilaha Epstein, waa isla qofkaas bartilmaameedsanaya Makka iyo goobaha barakaysan ee Islaamka,” ayuu yiri al-Mashat. ￭ Wuxuuna hadalkiisa ku soo gabagabeeyay in “Been-abuurka maamulka Sacuudiga uusan mar dambe marin-habaabin karin shucuubta qarankeenna Carabta iyo Islaamka,” isagoo sidoo kale tixraacaya sheegashooyinkii hore ee Sacuudiga ee ku saabsanaa khataraha ku wajahan marin-biyoodyada caalamiga ah.

items.title: “Wareer iguma hayso haddii Indha-cadde uu madaxweyne ku xigeen ka noqdo KGS”
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan hore Maxamed Cumar Dalxa oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Shabelle TV ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan isbeddelladii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba iyo kuwa kale ee la filayo inay ka dhacaan maamulkaasi. Dalxa ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay warar maalmahan si weyn loogu faafiyay baraha bulshada, kuwaas oo sheegayay in Koonfur Galbeed markii ugu horreysay yeelaneyso Madaxweyne Ku-xigeen, ‘loona wado Jeneraal Yuusuf Maxamed Siyaad (Indhacadde)’. Waxa uu sheegay inuu arkay dad ka qaylinaya joogitaanka Jeneraal Indhacadde ee magaalada Baydhaba iyo wararka sheegaya inuu qabanayo xilka Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Dowlad-goboledka Koonfur Galbeed, maadaama ay xogtaas si wayn ugu baahday internet-ka. Prof. Maxamed Cumar Dalxa ayaa tilmaamay in aysan wax dhib ah ku haynin haddii Indhacadde loo magacaabo xilkaasi, isaga oo xusay in dadka arrintaas ka cabanaya ay aragti ka duwan ka qabaan. “Dadka qaylinaya ee dhahaya Indhacadde ayaa jooga Baydhaba, waana naqaanaa anigu uma arko nin shaqsiyad xun, Madaxweyne Ku-xigeen hadii uu KGS ka noqdo wareer iguma heyso,” ayuu yiri Prof. Maxamed Cumar Dalxa. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli haatan magaalada Baydhaba ay ka socdaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed iyo isbeddello la xiriira maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, iyadoo sidoo kale la hadal hayo qorshayaal cusub oo ku saabsan qaab-dhismeedka hoggaanka maamulkaasi. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Baydhaba ayaa waxaa haatan ka taagan xiisad culus oo ka dhalatay dhawaan isbeddalkii ka dhacay magaaladaasi, taas oo u dhexeysa madaxweyne Sheekh Aadan Madoobe iyo Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Labada dhinac ayaa marar kala duwan ku dagaalamay gudaha magaalada Baydhaba, taas oo keentay in xaalad amni ay gasho Koonfur Galbeed, iyada oo sidoo kale duqeymo xooggan ay ka dhaceen agagaarka Baydhaba. The post “Wareer iguma hayso haddii Indha-cadde uu madaxweyne ku xigeen ka noqdo KGS” appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ka xeeladeysanaya khilaafka Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Taliska Militariga Somaliya ayaa dadaal ugu jira, sidii Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ay u sii joogi lahaayeen difaacyadooda Gobolka Hiiraan, xilli khilaaf adag oo u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo siyaasiyiinta deegaanka uu ka taagan yahay gobolkaasi. Taliska ayaa ka cabsi qaba in ciidamadu ay ku milmeen xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka soo korortay gobolkaasi, isla-markaana ay ku mowqif noqdaan siyaasiyiinta, odayaasha iyo waxgaradka ka biyo diidan dib-u-doorashada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe). Gobolkan ayaa waxaa ka hawlgala cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ka soo jeeda deegaanka iyo xoogag Macawiisley ah oo ka taageera la dagaalanka Al Shabaab. Ilo wareedyo muhiim ah ayaa sheegaya in Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud uu dadaal weyn ugu jiro, sidii Ciidamada Qalabka Sida iyo Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ay baaqi ugu sii ahaan lahaayeen aagagga difaaca, si looga baaqsado in khilaafka siyaasadeed uu abuuro dib-u-dhac weyn oo ku aaddan dagaalkii lagu la jiray Al Shabaab. Siyaasiyiinta iyo dhaqanka ee beesha aqlabiyadda Gobolka Hiiraan oo maalmihii la soo dhaafay uu shir uga socday Magaalada Beledweyne ayaa ku howlan dhismaha maamul ka madaxbannaan kan Hirshabelle iyo qorista ciidamo dadka deegaanka ah, oo ka hortaga doorashada qof iyo codka ee la rabo in dhawaan laga qabto degmooyin ka tirsan gobolkaasi, si shacabku ay u soo doortaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Hirshabelle iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka. Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee halista gelinaya mustaqbalka Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa in uu khatar dhab ah ku yahay amniga dalka. Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cagey) oo wajahaya cadaadis uga imanaya Xarunta Taliska Militariga ee Muqdisho ayaa isku dayaya in uu ciidamadu ku sii hayo furimaha hore ee gobolka, iyadoo la muujinayo in ciidamadu ay ka madaxbannaan yihiin khilaafka madaxda sare ee dalka iyo kuwa deegaanka. Sarkaal ka tirsan Xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa Universaltv u sheegay in ka bixitaanka ciidamada ee fariisimahooda uu kala dhantaali karo nidaamka amarada. Sarkaalkan oo codsaday inaanan magaciisa Warbaahinta loo adeegsan ayaa intaasi ku daray in uu jiro welwel ku saabsan dheelitirka awoodeed ee gobolka, dhowr goobood oo la soo faarujiyana ay Al Shabaab siineyso gacanta sare ee goobaha dagaalka. Shabaabka ayaa ka faa’iideysan kara goobaha laga baxo, si ay dib ugu qabsadaan deegaanadii horey looga saaray. Khilaafka u dhexeeya Villa Somalia iyo hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa gaaray heerkii ugu sarreyay, taasoo saamayn karta awoodda maareynta ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo fahamsan cawaaqibka ay arrintan ku leedahay shaqada hoggaanka taliska ayaa ku foogan, sidii uu uga xeeladeysan lahaa xiisadda siyaasadeed ee gobolkaasi.
items.fullContent: Taliska Militariga Somaliya ayaa dadaal ugu jira, sidii Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ay u sii joogi lahaayeen difaacyadooda Gobolka Hiiraan, xilli khilaaf adag oo u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo siyaasiyiinta deegaanka uu ka taagan yahay gobolkaasi. Taliska ayaa ka cabsi qaba in ciidamadu ay ku milmeen xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka soo korortay gobolkaasi, isla-markaana ay ku mowqif noqdaan siyaasiyiinta, odayaasha iyo waxgaradka ka biyo diidan dib-u-doorashada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe). Gobolkan ayaa waxaa ka hawlgala cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ka soo jeeda deegaanka iyo xoogag Macawiisley ah oo ka taageera la dagaalanka Al Shabaab. Ilo wareedyo muhiim ah ayaa sheegaya in Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud uu dadaal weyn ugu jiro, sidii Ciidamada Qalabka Sida iyo Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ay baaqi ugu sii ahaan lahaayeen aagagga difaaca, si looga baaqsado in khilaafka siyaasadeed uu abuuro dib-u-dhac weyn oo ku aaddan dagaalkii lagu la jiray Al Shabaab. Siyaasiyiinta iyo dhaqanka ee beesha aqlabiyadda Gobolka Hiiraan oo maalmihii la soo dhaafay uu shir uga socday Magaalada Beledweyne ayaa ku howlan dhismaha maamul ka madaxbannaan kan Hirshabelle iyo qorista ciidamo dadka deegaanka ah, oo ka hortaga doorashada qof iyo codka ee la rabo in dhawaan laga qabto degmooyin ka tirsan gobolkaasi, si shacabku ay u soo doortaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Hirshabelle iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka. Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee halista gelinaya mustaqbalka Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa in uu khatar dhab ah ku yahay amniga dalka. Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cagey) oo wajahaya cadaadis uga imanaya Xarunta Taliska Militariga ee Muqdisho ayaa isku dayaya in uu ciidamadu ku sii hayo furimaha hore ee gobolka, iyadoo la muujinayo in ciidamadu ay ka madaxbannaan yihiin khilaafka madaxda sare ee dalka iyo kuwa deegaanka. Sarkaal ka tirsan Xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa Universaltv u sheegay in ka bixitaanka ciidamada ee fariisimahooda uu kala dhantaali karo nidaamka amarada. items.title: Puntland oo Raashin iyo Gargaar Gaarsiisay 200 Qoys oo ku Nool Dhinowda
items.description: Jariiban (WDN) — Dowladda Gobolleedka Puntland ayaa gargaar bani’aadantinimo oo degdeg ah gaarsiisay bulshada nugul ee ku nool Dhinowda, oo ah deegaan aad u durugsan ama fog oo ka tirsan Degmada Jariiban ee Gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo dadka deegaanka ay wajahayaaan culaysyo dhaqaale iyo kuwo deegaan. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Puntland ayaa gaaray Dhinowda, halkaas oo ay gargaar gaarsiiyeen ku dhowaad 200 oo qoys. Gargaarka ayaa isugu jiray raashin muhiim ah iyo kaarar lacag-caawimaad ah, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay in qoysasku ku daboolaan baahiyahooda aasaasiga ah. Dowladda Puntland ayaa sidoo kale gargaar noocan oo kale ah gaarsiisay Degmada Towfiiq iyo deegaannada ku xeeran, si loo taageero bulshooyinka kale ee wajahaya duruufaha adag ee nololleed. Dhinowda iyo Towfiiq ayaa ka mid ah deegaannada ku yaalla koonfurta Puntland, waxaana qoysas badan oo halkaas ku nool ay si weyn ugu tiirsan yihiin xoolaha. Abaaraha soo noqnoqda iyo yaraanshaha biyaha iyo daaqa ayaa hoos u dhigay dakhliga qoysaska, isla markaana kordhiyay cunto-yarida iyo nuglaanta bulshada. Gargaarkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada Dowladda Puntland ee lagu taageerayo bulshada ku nool deegaannada fogfog, iyadoo sidoo kale la doonayo in wax laga qabto saameynta ay dhibaatooyinka deegaanka ee soo noqnoqda ku leeyihiin nolosha iyo dhaqaalaha bulshada. Dhinowda iyo Towfiiq waxay ka mid ahaayeen deegaannadii uu dhawaan booqday Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, intii uu ku guda jiray safarkiisa Gobolka Mudug. Qoysaska helay gargaarka, taageeradan ayaa siinaysa gargaar degdeg ah oo dhinaca raashinka iyo dhaqaalaha ah. Hase yeeshee, xaaladda ka jirta deegaannadan waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay in la joogteeyo maalgelinta kaabayaasha biyaha, adeegyada xoolaha iyo hab-nololeedyada miyiga ee adkaysiga u leh abaaraha, si bulshada looga yareeyo nuglaanta ay u leeyihiin abaaraha iyo dhibaatooyinka deegaanka ee mustaqbalka. items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo ka warbixyay cida uu la kulmay iyo wixii ay ka wada hadleen
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro oo qoraal uu soo dhigay barta uu ku leeyahay X – waxa uu kaga war bixiyay booqashada uu ku joogo dalka Maraykanka gaar ahaan Washington D.C- waxana uu qoraalkaasi oo afka Ingriisiga ku qornaa uu ku yidhi. Intii aan ku guda jiray booqdaygii Washington, D.C., waxaan la kulmay xubno ka tirsan Koongareeska Mareykanka iyo safiirro caalami ah si aan uga wada hadalno xoojinta xiriirka Somaliland iyo Mareykanka, iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah, amniga gobolka, iyo arrimaha ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Waxaan mar kale caddeeyay doorka Somaliland ay ku leedahay inay tahay saaxiib istiraatiiji ah oo la isku halayn karo, isla markaana ka go’an tahay horumarinta danaha ay wadaagaan labada dhinac.

items.title: Puntland oo guul wayn ka sheegatay howlgal ay isla fuliyeen ciidanka Mareykanka
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Onine) – Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa lagu faah-faahiyay weerar ay si wadajir u fuliyeen ciidamada Puntland iyo Mareykanka, kaas oo ka dhacay buuraha Calmadow-Golis ee maamulkaasi. Howlgalka oo ahaa duqeyn ayaa u dhacay si guul ah, iyada oo lagu beegsaday maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, laguna burburiyay kayd hub ah oo ay kooxda ku lahayd halkaasi, sida lagu sheegay qoraalka kasoo baxay Puntand. “Dowladda Puntland iyo Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa xaqiijiyey guusha hawlgalka la-dagaallanka argagixisada oo ka dhacay buuraha Golis ee deegaanka Cal-Madow, kaas oo lagu beegsaday goob lagu magacaabo Markad, halkaas oo kooxda u ahayd kaydka hubka iyo rasaasta ee ururka Al-Shabaab,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland. Bartilmaameedka ugu wayn duqeynta ayaa ahaa in lagu burburyiyo goobtan oo ay Al-Shabaab u adeegsan jireen kaydinta hubka iyo rasaasta, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu taageero falalka argagixisada iyo in khatar lagu geliyo shacabka Puntland. “Hawlgalka, oo lagu fuliyey iskaashi iyo isku-duwid lala yeeshay hay’adaha Dowladda Puntland, ayaa lagu beegsaday xarun lagu kaydinayey hub iyo saanad ciidan oo Al-Shabaab u adeegsanaysay taageeridda hawlgalladeeda iyo khatar-gelinta amniga shacabka Puntland iyo guud ahaan Soomaaliya,” ayaa asii raaciyay. Sidoo kale, warka qoraalka ah ayaa lagu sheegay in howlgallada ay sii socon doonaan, isla markaana ujeedkooda uu yahay in lagu wiiqo Al-Shabaab. “Hawlgalkan wuxuu qayb ka yahay dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda kooxda Al-Shabaab ee waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Beegsiga goobaha iyo xarumaha ay kooxdu u adeegsato taageeridda hawlgalladeeda ayaa ah mid lagu saarayo cadaadis laguna, laguna burburinayo awooddeeda ay ku qorshayso inay fuliso weeraro,” ayaa mar kale lagu yirwarsaxaafadeedka. Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay howlgallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ayaa ka socday deegaanno ka tirsan Puntland, gaar ahaan dhulka buuraleyda ah ee Calmadow-Golis, iyadoo ciidamada Puntland iyo Mareykanka ay iska kaashanayaan bartilmaameedsiga goobaha ay kooxda ku leedahay saldhigyada iyo keydadka hubka. Horay waxay Puntland u weerartay fariisimaha muhiimka ah ee ay kooxda Daacish ku leedahay buuraha Calmadow ee gobolka Bari, kaas oo ay guullo waa wayn kasoo hoyeen ciidamada, maadaama ay xoreen dhul ballaaran. items.title: Daawo: Xamza oo maanta ku dhawaaqay isbeddallo waa wayn – Maxa dhacaya?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre oo maanta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay xafiiskiisa ayaa ku dhawaaqay isbeddallo waa wayn oo ay sameyneyso xukuumaddiisa, kuwaas oo la xiriira dib u habeynta shaqaalaha rayidka ee hay’adaha dowladda, iyada oo wajiga koowaad lagu bilaabi doono agaasime waaxeedyada wasaaradaha. Xamza ayaa faray dhammaan golihiisa wasiirrada iyo mas’uuliyiinta kale ee dowladda in si buuxda loo hirgeliyo hannaanka shaqaalaysiinta iyo magacaabista ku salaysan kartida iyo mudnaanta. “Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, Isaga oo ka duulaya Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Qodobka 161aad farqadda (1), Sharciga Shaqaalaha Rayid ah qodobkiisa 7aad, iyo dhammaan xeerarka, shuruucda iyo qaraarada la xiriira Shaqaalaha Rayidka ah ee Dowladdda Federaalka ah, ayuu faray dhammaan Wasiirrada iyo Mas’uuliyiinta kale ee dowladda in si buuxda oo aan dib-u-dhac lahayn loo hirgeliyo hannaanka shaqaalaysiinta iyo magacaabista ku salaysan kartida iyo mudnaanta,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay xafiiska Xamza Cabdi Barre. Sidoo kale, wuxuu faray guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka dowladda in 20-Sebteembar la bilaabo wajiga 1-aad ee dib-u-habaynta lagu sameynayo agaasime waaxeedyada, maadaama ay laf-dhabar u yihiin maamulka hey’adaha dowladda, ayna door muuqda ka qaataan hoggaaminta, hirgalinta siyaasadda, fulinta qorsheyaasha iyo joogtaynta shaqada hey’adaha. Waxaa kale oo uu Ra’iisul wasaaruh sheegay in marka la hirgaliyo wajiga 1-aad sidoo kale dib-u-habayn lagu samayn doono agaasimayaasha guud ee hey’adaha dowladda, iyada oo lagu salaynayo karti, aqoon, khibrad, hoggaamin iyo waxqabad, si loo dhiso hoggaan maamul oo xirfad leh isla-xisaabtan leh oo ka shaqeeya natiijooyin muuqda. Ujeedada laga leeyahay nidaamkan ayaa ah in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay yeelato hoggaan maamul oo xirfad leh, joogto ah, awoodda in uu hirgaliyo siyaasadda dowladda, una beddelo natiijooyin muuqda oo ay markhaati ka noqdaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa xusay in afartii sano ee la soo dhaafay, xukuumadda DanQaran ay qaaday tallaabooyin muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo dhismaha, maamulka iyo tayada hay’adaha dowladda, iyada oo ujeeddadu tahay in la helo hay’ado dowladeed oo leh saldhig sharci iyo maamul adag iyo Shaqaale Rayid ah oo leh aqoon, karti iyo karaan ku filan gudashada waajibaadka saaran. “Waxaan dhidibka u taagnay tiirar sharci iyo kuwa hay’adaha ee lagama maarmaanka u ah dib-u-habaynta iyo horumarinta shaqaalaha rayidka ah, Waxa aan ansixinnay sharciyo, siyaasado, xeerar iyo qaab-dhismeedyo muhiim ah oo hagaya maamulka hay’adaha iyo shaqaalaha dowladda”. ayuu raaciyay. Ugu dambayn, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha dalka, ayaa faray dhammaan wasaaradaha iyo hey’adaha dowladda in si buuxda loo hirgeliyo qaab-dhismeedyada hay’adaha ee la ansixiyey, iyada oo xilalka agaasime waaxeedyada lagu buuxinayo hannaan tartan furan, dhammaan shaqaalaha u qalma ee ku jira adeegga rayidka ah la siiyo fursad loo siman yahay oo ay ugu tartamaan xilalkaas, iyo in wixii xil ama jago bannaan ah ee shaqaalaha dowladda ah lagu buuxiyo hannaan tartan furan oo waafaqsan shuruucda iyo xeerarka dowladda. Xamza ayaa faray dhammaan golihiisa wasiirrada iyo mas’uuliyiinta kale ee dowladda in si buuxda loo hirgeliyo hannaanka shaqaalaysiinta iyo magacaabista ku salaysan kartida iyo mudnaanta. “Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, Isaga oo ka duulaya Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Qodobka 161aad farqadda (1), Sharciga Shaqaalaha Rayid ah qodobkiisa 7aad, iyo dhammaan xeerarka, shuruucda iyo qaraarada la xiriira Shaqaalaha Rayidka ah ee Dowladdda Federaalka ah, ayuu faray dhammaan Wasiirrada iyo Mas’uuliyiinta kale ee dowladda in si buuxda oo aan dib-u-dhac lahayn loo hirgeliyo hannaanka shaqaalaysiinta iyo magacaabista ku salaysan kartida iyo mudnaanta,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay xafiiska Xamza Cabdi Barre. Sidoo kale, wuxuu faray guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka dowladda in 20-Sebteembar la bilaabo wajiga 1-aad ee dib-u-habaynta lagu sameynayo agaasime waaxeedyada, maadaama ay laf-dhabar u yihiin maamulka hey’adaha dowladda, ayna door muuqda ka qaataan hoggaaminta, hirgalinta siyaasadda, fulinta qorsheyaasha iyo joogtaynta shaqada hey’adaha. Waxaa kale oo uu Ra’iisul wasaaruh sheegay in marka la hirgaliyo wajiga 1-aad sidoo kale dib-u-habayn lagu samayn doono agaasimayaasha guud ee hey’adaha dowladda, iyada oo lagu salaynayo karti, aqoon, khibrad, hoggaamin iyo waxqabad, si loo dhiso hoggaan maamul oo xirfad leh isla-xisaabtan leh oo ka shaqeeya natiijooyin muuqda. Ujeedada laga leeyahay nidaamkan ayaa ah in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay yeelato hoggaan maamul oo xirfad leh, joogto ah, awoodda in uu hirgaliyo siyaasadda dowladda, una beddelo natiijooyin muuqda oo ay markhaati ka noqdaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa xusay in afartii sano ee la soo dhaafay, xukuumadda DanQaran ay qaaday tallaabooyin muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo dhismaha, maamulka iyo tayada hay’adaha dowladda, iyada oo ujeeddadu tahay in la helo hay’ado dowladeed oo leh saldhig sharci iyo maamul adag iyo Shaqaale Rayid ah oo leh aqoon, karti iyo karaan ku filan gudashada waajibaadka saaran. “Waxaan dhidibka u taagnay tiirar sharci iyo kuwa hay’adaha ee lagama maarmaanka u ah dib-u-habaynta iyo horumarinta shaqaalaha rayidka ah, Waxa aan ansixinnay sharciyo, siyaasado, xeerar iyo qaab-dhismeedyo muhiim ah oo hagaya maamulka hay’adaha iyo shaqaalaha dowladda”. ayuu raaciyay. Ugu dambayn, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha dalka, ayaa faray dhammaan wasaaradaha iyo hey’adaha dowladda in si buuxda loo hirgeliyo qaab-dhismeedyada hay’adaha ee la ansixiyey, iyada oo xilalka agaasime waaxeedyada lagu buuxinayo hannaan tartan furan, dhammaan shaqaalaha u qalma ee ku jira adeegga rayidka ah la siiyo fursad loo siman yahay oo ay ugu tartamaan xilalkaas, iyo in wixii xil ama jago bannaan ah ee shaqaalaha dowladda ah lagu buuxiyo hannaan tartan furan oo waafaqsan shuruucda iyo xeerarka dowladda.
