items.title: Beesha Xawaadle oo go’aanno culus soo saartay iyo dhismaha HirShabelle cusub
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Beesha Xawaadle ayaa si cad uga hortimid doorashada la qorsheeyay in laga qabto maamulka HirShabelle, iyadoo dalbatay in la hakiyo doorashooyinka iyo tallaabooyinka la xiriira dhismaha maamulka HirShabelle. Go’aankan ayaa kasoo baxay kulan maalmo ka socday magaalada Beledweyne, kaas oo ay isugu yimaadeen waxgarad iyo siyaasiyiin ka tirsan beesha, waxaana diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Hiiraan iyo qaabka loo wajahayo dhismaha maamulka. War-murtiyeedka kasoo baxay kulanka ayaa lagu sheegay in aan la aqbali karin hannaan siyaasadeed oo laga hirgeliyo Hiiraan iyadoo aan heshiis laga gaarin, isla markaana aan la helin oggolaanshaha iyo ka qayb-galka bulshada deegaanka. Xoghayihii hore ee maamulka gobolka Banaadir, Xiirey Axmed Rooble oo war-murtiyeedka la wadaagay warbaahinta ayaa sheegay in beesha Xawaadle aysan taageerayn hannaan siyaasadeed oo laga sameeyo gobolka haddii aysan qayb ka ahayn bulshada reer Hiiraan. Beesha ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqday in dhismaha HirShabelle saddexaad lagu saleeyo hannaan loo dhan yahay, kaas oo dhinacyada kala duwan ay ku wada qanacsan yihiin, laguna xaqiijinayo caddaalad, matalaad iyo awood-qaybsi. “Waa in la joojiyo dhammaan doorashooyinka iyo habraacyada aan ku dhisnayn heshiiska iyo oggolaanshaha bulshada,” ayaa lagu yiri mid ka mid ah qodobada war-murtiyeedka. Waxgaradka Xawaadle ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in tabashooyinka reer Hiiraan loo baahan yahay in si dhab ah loo qaado, iyadoo xalkeedana lagu raadinayo wada-tashi iyo is-afgarad siyaasadeed, halkii la sii wadi lahaa tallaabooyin ay bulshadu ka biyo diidan tahay. War-murtiyeedka ayaa intaas ku daray in maamulka HirShabelle ee ka howlgala Hiiraan uu tixgeliyo go’aannada kasoo baxay waxgaradka, isla markaana uu isu diyaariyo geeddi-socod cusub oo lagu dhisayo maamul loo dhan yahay. Sidoo kale, beesha ayaa digniin ka bixisay wax kasta oo qalalaase ama gacan-ka-hadal ah oo ka dhasha doorasho aan heshiis lagu ahayn, iyadoo sheegtay in mas’uuliyadda wixii arrintaas kasoo baxa ay qaadi doonaan guddiga doorashooyinka. Ugu dambeyn, Xawaadle ayaa ku adkaysatay in aan la dhisi karin HirShabelle waarta iyadoo la iska indha tirayo tabashooyinka iyo rabitaanka bulshada reer Hiiraan, waxayna beesha ku baaqday in la dedejiyo hannaan cusub oo lagu dhisayo maamul ka duwan kan hadda jira. items.title: Sacuudi Carabiya oo Digniin ‘Khad Cas’ ah ka Bixisay Kadib Markii Drone Xuutiyiintu Leeyihiin Lagu Soo Riday Meel u Dhow Maka
items.description: Maka (WDN) — Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa ku dhawaaqday in amniga labada goobood ee ugu barakada badan Islaamka iyo amniga xujeydu ay yihiin “khad cas”, kadib markii ciidamada difaaca cirka Sacuudigu maalintii Salaasada burburiyeen diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo ay sheegeen inay Xuutiyiintu leeyihiin. Arintaas oo ka dhacday koonfurta magaalada Maka ka hor inta aysan gelin hawada xaddidan ee magaalada barakaysan. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga milatari ee Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo, Turki al-Malki, ayaa sheegay aroornimadii Arbacada in Sacuudi Carabiya ay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin lagama maarmaan ah oo lagaga hortegayo laguna joojinayo weerarro kale oo noocan ah. “Amniga labada goobood ee barakaysan ee Islaamka iyo badqabka xujeydu waa khad cas,” ayuu yiri al-Malki, isaga oo uga digay Xuutiyiinta in isbahaysigu qaadi doono tallaabooyin looga hortagayo khatar kasta oo soo wajahda goobahaas. Maka, oo ay ku yaallaan goobaha ugu barakada badan Muslimiinta adduunka, ayaa ah magaalada ugu barakada badan Islaamka, sidoo kalena waa xarunta xajka sannadlaha ah ee ay malaayiin Muslimiin ahi sannad kasta u soo xajiyaan. Xajkuna waa mid ka mid ah shanta tiir ee Islaamka. Sacuudiga: Tani Waa Isku Daygii Labaad ee Lagu Beegsanayo Makka Al-Malki wuxuu sheegay in dhacdadan ay tahay isku daygii labaad ee Xuutiyiintu ay ku doonayaan inay beegsadaan magaaalada Maka, isaga oo tusaalle u soo qaatay gantaal ballistic ah oo isbahaysiga Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ku rideen dhanka Makka bishii Luulyo 2017. Hase yeeshee, Xuutiyiintu waxay si adag u diideen eeddaas. Afhayeenka kooxda, Hazem al-Assad, ayaa Arbacadii qoraal uu ku daabacay barta X-  ku sheegay in sheegashada ah in Maka la beegsaday ay tahay “been duugowday” oo hore loo adeegsaday, isaga oo intaas ku daray in aanay cidna mar dambe ku qancinayn. Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka oo Cambaareeyay Weerarka Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC) ayaa cambaareeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay weerar “foosha xun” oo lagu qaaday magaalada barakaysan ee Makka, isaga oo mas’uuliyadda weerarka dusha ka saaray Xuutiyiinta. Ururka oo ay xubno ka yihiin 57 dal oo Muslimiin u badan ayaa sidoo kale cambaareeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay “gardarrada joogtada ah” ee ka dhanka ah Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. Cambaareynta OIC ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli gobolka Bariga Dhexe uu wajahayo xiisado militari oo sii kordhaya, iyadoo weerarrada kooxaha xiriirka la leh Iran ay Sacuudi Carabiya si isa soo taraysa ugu riixayaan gudaha dagaalka gobolka. Sacuudi Carabiya oo Soo Saartay Digniino Amni Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Salaasadii soo saartay digniino amni oo laga bixiyay qaybo ka mid ah dalka, oo ay ku jirto Makka iyo magaalooyin kale, kadib toddobaad ay jireen weerarro isdaba joog ah oo ay qaadeen kooxo xiriir la leh Iran. Weerarradaasi ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Xuutiyiintu ay sheegteen inay qabsadeen qaybo ka mid ah xeebaha Badda Cas ee Yemen, oo ay ku yaallaan jasiirado istiraatiiji ah oo dhinaca Bab al-Mandab ka eegaya. Bab al-Mandab waa mid ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan dunida ee maraakiibtu isticmaalaan, waxaana muhiimad gaar ah u leh ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo dhoofinta shidaalka ee gobolka. Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale toddobaadkan ku dhawaaqeen dhowr weerar oo waaweyn oo ay ku qaadeen gudaha Sacuudi Carabiya. Waxaa ka mid ahaa weerar ay Isniintii sheegeen inay ku qaadeen saldhig diyaaradeed, iyaga oo ku andacooday inuu ahaa aargoosi ay kaga jawaabayeen duqeymo cirka ah oo lagu qaaday Yemen. Maraykanka oo Digniin Safar Soo Saaray Safaaradda Maraykanka ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa kadib digniinaha amni soo saartay tallo ku aaddan in muwaadiniinta Maraykanku “dib uga fiirsadaan safarrada” ay ku tagayaan Sacuudi Carabiya. Digniinta ayaa lagu sheegay in ay jiraan khataro la xiriira weerarro ay Iran u adeegsan karto diyaaraddaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaallada, khataraha ku wajahan danaha Maraykanka, iska horimaadyo hubaysan, argagixisanimo, xannibaad safar iyo xeerarka maxalliga ah ee la xiriira isticmaalka baraha bulshada. Safaaradda ayaa sidoo kale muwaadiniinta Maraykanka uga digtay inay u safraan xuduudda Yemen, iyadoo sabab uga dhigtay khatar argagixisanimo. Xiisadda oo Saameynaysa Badda Cas iyo Dhoofinta Shidaalka Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegtay inay gacanta ku dhigeen qaybo ka mid ah xeebaha Yemen ee Badda Cas, taas oo siinaysa kooxda meel istiraatiiji ah oo ay kaga dhowaan karto Bab al-Mandab. Haddii xaaladdu sii xumaato, waxay saameyn ku yeelan kartaa isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo dhoofinta shidaalka ee Sacuudi Carabiya, gaar ahaan kuwa loo weeciyo waddooyin kale si looga fogaado marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Xuutiyiintu waxay toddobaadkan kordhiyeen hanjabaadaha iyo weerarrada ay ku sheegayaan inay ku qaadayaan Sacuudi Carabiya, iyagoo ku andacoonaya inay uga jawaabayaan duqeymaha cirka ah ee ka socda Yemen. Sacuudi Carabiya, dhankeeda, waxay sheegtay in difaaca dhulkeeda, goobaha barakaysan iyo amaanka dadka rayidka ah ay yihiin mudnaanta koowaad. Dhacdada drone-ka ee ku dhow Makka ayaa sidaas darteed kusoo beegmaysa xilli Bariga Dhexe uu wajahayo xaalad amni oo sii cakirmaysa, iyadoo dagaallada iyo iska horimaadyadu ay si isa soo taraysa ugu fidayaan xuduudaha dalalka gobolka. items.fullContent: Maka (WDN) — Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa ku dhawaaqday in amniga labada goobood ee ugu barakada badan Islaamka iyo amniga xujeydu ay yihiin “khad cas”, kadib markii ciidamada difaaca cirka Sacuudigu maalintii Salaasada burburiyeen diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo ay sheegeen inay Xuutiyiintu leeyihiin. Arintaas oo ka dhacday koonfurta magaalada Maka ka hor inta aysan gelin hawada xaddidan ee magaalada barakaysan. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga milatari ee Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo, Turki al-Malki, ayaa sheegay aroornimadii Arbacada in Sacuudi Carabiya ay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin lagama maarmaan ah oo lagaga hortegayo laguna joojinayo weerarro kale oo noocan ah. “Amniga labada goobood ee barakaysan ee Islaamka iyo badqabka xujeydu waa khad cas,” ayuu yiri al-Malki, isaga oo uga digay Xuutiyiinta in isbahaysigu qaadi doono tallaabooyin looga hortagayo khatar kasta oo soo wajahda goobahaas. Maka, oo ay ku yaallaan goobaha ugu barakada badan Muslimiinta adduunka, ayaa ah magaalada ugu barakada badan Islaamka, sidoo kalena waa xarunta xajka sannadlaha ah ee ay malaayiin Muslimiin ahi sannad kasta u soo xajiyaan. Xajkuna waa mid ka mid ah shanta tiir ee Islaamka. Sacuudiga: Tani Waa Isku Daygii Labaad ee Lagu Beegsanayo Makka Al-Malki wuxuu sheegay in dhacdadan ay tahay isku daygii labaad ee Xuutiyiintu ay ku doonayaan inay beegsadaan magaaalada Maka, isaga oo tusaalle u soo qaatay gantaal ballistic ah oo isbahaysiga Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ku rideen dhanka Makka bishii Luulyo 2017. Hase yeeshee, Xuutiyiintu waxay si adag u diideen eeddaas. Afhayeenka kooxda, Hazem al-Assad, ayaa Arbacadii qoraal uu ku daabacay barta X-  ku sheegay in sheegashada ah in Maka la beegsaday ay tahay “been duugowday” oo hore loo adeegsaday, isaga oo intaas ku daray in aanay cidna mar dambe ku qancinayn. Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka oo Cambaareeyay Weerarka Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC) ayaa cambaareeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay weerar “foosha xun” oo lagu qaaday magaalada barakaysan ee Makka, isaga oo mas’uuliyadda weerarka dusha ka saaray Xuutiyiinta. Ururka oo ay xubno ka yihiin 57 dal oo Muslimiin u badan ayaa sidoo kale cambaareeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay “gardarrada joogtada ah” ee ka dhanka ah Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. items.title: Saudi Arabia warns of ‘red line’ after Houthi drone intercepted close to holy city of Mecca
items.description: Mecca – (WDN) – The Iran-aligned militant group rejected the suggestion it had targeted Mecca, while the Organization of Islamic Cooperation condemned the attack. Saudi Arabia’s air defenses intercepted and destroyed a ⁠Houthi drone south of Mecca on Tuesday before it entered prohibited airspace over the holy city, according to a ⁠spokesperson for the ⁠Saudi-led ​military coalition which is fighting the Iran-aligned group in Yemen . The security of Islam’s two holiest sites and of pilgrims was a “red line”, ⁠coalition spokesperson Turki al-Malki said early on Wednesday, adding that the coalition would take necessary deterrent measures against the ⁠Houthis. Mecca, home to shrines sacred to Muslims worldwide, is Islam’s holiest ​city and the focal point ‌of the annual ‌hajj pilgrimage, one of the five pillars of Islam, which millions of Muslims ‌undertake each year. Malki described the incident as the second Houthi attempt to target Mecca, after what the coalition said was a ballistic missile launch in July 2017. A Houthi official rejected the claim on Wednesday, with spokesperson Hazem al-Assad writing on X: “The claims about targeting Mecca are a worn-out lie that has been used before and no longer fools anyone.” The Organization of Islamic Cooperation condemned what they called a “heinous” attack on Islam’s holy city, blaming the Houthis. The group – which is made up of 57 Muslim-majority countries decried the “ongoing aggression against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia .” Saudi Arabia issued security alerts across parts of the country on Tuesday, including in Mecca and other ‌cities, following a week of attacks by Iran-aligned fighters that have drawn the kingdom deeper into the Middle East ​war. The US embassy issued an advisory to “reconsider travel” to Saudi Arabia after the alerts in Mecca and other areas amid Houthi attacks. The advisory warns of the “risk of Iranian drone and missile targeting of American interests, armed conflict, terrorism, exit bans and local laws regarding social media activity,” adding “Do Not Travel to the Yemen border due to threat of terrorism.” The Houthis have seized control of parts of ⁠Yemen’s Red Sea coast overlooking the Bab al-Mandab, one of the ​world’s most important ​shipping straits, threatening Saudi oil ​exports rerouted from the strait of Hormuz. The group has ​announced several major ‌attacks on ​Saudi Arabia over ​the past week, including strikes on an airbase on Monday that it said were retaliation for airstrikes on Yemen. items.title: Puntland Orders Occupants to Vacate Government Land and Buildings
items.description: Galkayo (WDN) — The Puntland Government has ordered people occupying government-owned land and buildings to vacate the properties and make alternative housing arrangements, as the administration moves to reclaim and protect public assets intended for government institutions and essential public services. Puntland Minister of Public Works, Transport and Housing Farah Awad made the announcement on Wednesday in Galkayo, saying the government had completed a comprehensive inventory of vacant government land and public buildings across Puntland. According to the minister, the properties have been formally surveyed and their locations recorded using GPS technology, creating a centralized record of government-owned assets and their exact locations. Farah said the government would soon present the inventory to the Puntland Cabinet, which is expected to review the properties and establish a legal framework governing their protection, management and future use. The minister stressed that government land and buildings are public assets, not private property, and are reserved for institutions that provide services to citizens. He warned that individuals would not be permitted to occupy, settle on or otherwise appropriate government-owned land without legal authorization. The move is expected to form part of a broader effort by the Puntland administration to strengthen the management of public property, prevent illegal occupation and ensure that government institutions have adequate land and facilities from which to deliver essential services. Nevertheless, any government claim over public assets should be pursued through proper legal and institutional procedures, particularly amid continuing concerns over the illegal appropriation and transfer of public land in Mogadishu during President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration. In many parts of Puntland, government-owned properties have historically faced pressure from informal settlement, private occupation and competing claims of ownership. Such disputes can make it difficult for the government to expand schools, hospitals, administrative offices, security facilities and other public infrastructure. By documenting government properties through a formal inventory and GPS mapping, the administration appears to be seeking to establish a clearer record of public ownership and reduce future disputes. Minister Farah urged those currently occupying government-owned land and buildings to vacate the properties promptly and make alternative arrangements for accommodation, stressing that the government would not accept further unauthorized settlement on public land. The issue is likely to be particularly important in rapidly growing cities such as Galkayo, Garowe and Bosaso, where demand for land is increasing while government institutions require additional space to expand public services. The minister’s announcement also places greater emphasis on the principle that government property ultimately belongs to the public and should be preserved for public purposes. Once the inventory is presented to the Cabinet and the proposed regulations are adopted, Puntland will face the more difficult task of enforcing the new framework fairly and transparently. For the administration, however, the message is clear: government land and buildings are public assets intended to serve the public, and unauthorized occupation will no longer be treated as an acceptable use of state property. items.title: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya oo ka qaybgalay Madasha 13-aad ee Beijing Xiangshan
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta ka qaybgalay munaasabadda furitaanka Madasha 13-aad ee Beijing Xiangshan, oo ka socota magaalada Beijing ee Jamhuuriyadda Dadka Shiinaha. Madashan oo socota 15–17 Sebtembar 2026 waxaa ka qaybgalaya madaxda iyo saraakiisha difaaca, khubaro iyo wakiillo ka socda ku dhowaad 100 dal iyo hay’ado caalami ah. Hal-ku-dhigga madasha sanadkan waa “Dhisidda Is-afgarad ku saabsan Xasilloonida iyo Wadajir u Horumarinta Maamulka Amniga.” Ajandayaasha madasha waxaa ka mid ah xasilloonida istiraatiijiyadeed, amniga caalamiga ah, xal u helidda colaadaha gobollada, amniga Aasiya iyo Baasifigga, amniga badaha, iyo khataraha ka dhasha adeegsiga teknoolojiyadda cusub iyo sirdoonka macmalka ah ee dhinaca milatariga. Sidoo kale, waxaa madasha barbar socda Madasha 4-aad ee Nabadda iyo Amniga Shiinaha iyo Afrika, taas oo diiradda lagu saarayo arrimaha nabadda iyo amniga qaaradda Afrika.

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka iyo Wasaaradda Haweenka oo ka wada hadlay qoondada haweenka
items.description: Guddiga Madax-Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa maanta xarunta dhexe ee Guddiga kulan kula yeeshay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Haweenka iyo Arrimaha Qoyska, Marwo Khadiija Al-Makhsuumi, iyo masuuliyiin sare oo ay hoggaaminaysay. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray ka-qaybgalka haweenka ee doorashooyinka, gaar ahaan ilaalinta qoondada haweenka ee 30%, iyo sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa ka-qaybgalka dadka baahiyaha gaarka ah qaba ee geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka. Kulankan oo daba socday wada-tashiyo hore, ayaa labada dhinac waxay dib ugu qiimeeyeen horumarka laga sameeyay ilaalinta qoondada haweenka iyo ka-qaybgalka dadka baahiyaha gaarka ah qaba, iyadoo sidoo kale laga wada hadlay tallaabooyinka lagu sii xoojin karo arrimahaasi. Ugu dambeyn, labada dhinac ayaa isku raacay in la xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta Guddiga iyo Wasaaradda, iyadoo la dhisayo guddi heer farsamo ah oo u xilsaaran isku-dubbaridka iyo ka wada shaqeynta arrimaha ay labada dhinac iska kaashan karaan, si loo sii xoojiyo horumarka laga gaaray ka-qaybgalka haweenka iyo dadka baahiyaha gaarka ah qaba ee doorashooyinka.

items.title: Somalia: Al-Shabaab ‘stronger than ever’ despite billions spent on AU missions
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – In July, the U.S. Mission to the African Union announced that it would be cutting support for the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS). This unit provides logistical support, food rations, fuel, and medical supplies for the African Union peacekeeping mission in Somalia. The cut, which takes effect on Dec. 31, marks the end of U.S. support for the peacekeeping mission, known as the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission. After two decades of military intervention in the anarchic war-torn Horn of Africa nation – intervention overwhelmingly paid for by the U.S. government – the al Qaeda-affiliated Islamist group al-Shabab is arguably stronger than ever. Analysts who spoke with Foreign Policy said the decision by the Trump administration to cut support for UNSOS and the African Union peacekeeping mission is partly due to this questionable result. “Despite the savior rhetoric of the past two decades, the international community has neither developed a strategy to defeat al-Shabaab,” wrote Abukar Arman, a political analyst and former Somali diplomat to the United States, in an email. “Nor have they ever executed anything in a coordinated way.” In March 2007, African Union (AU) peacekeepers from Uganda were deployed to the Somali capital, Mogadishu, to prop up a fragile transitional government battling armed Islamist rebels – most notably, al-Shabab. In the years that have followed, the AU peacekeeping force has managed to push al-Shabab out of major cities and urban areas across south-central Somalia, including Mogadishu. But despite these successes, the militant group still dominates most of rural south and central Somalia. In these areas, it has morphed from a guerilla movement into something akin to a shadow state. Since 2007, the United States has provided an estimated $3.6 billion to sustain consecutive African Union peacekeeping missions in Somalia, which includes nearly $2 billion sent through U.N. support offices and close to $1.6 billion in bilateral assistance to African countries contributing troops to Somalia, according to a recent U.S. congressional research assessment from July. But “the international community has focused on propping up a mission, while al-Shabab has focused on building a state,” according to Jethro Norman, a senior researcher with the Danish Institute for International Studies. Al-Shabab has formed a parallel government in the areas that it rules, with its own judiciary courts and tax system. Within this system, al-Shabab can raise somewhere between $100 million and $150 million a year from taxation, Norman said, while the Somali government’s own tax revenue runs at a little more than $250 million, most of it from Mogadishu port customs and donor transfers. “You have an insurgency that funds itself and a government that does not,” Norman said. With its revenue, al-Shabab has prioritized providing services to civilians. One result has been the near-total eradication of drugs and crime in areas that al-Shabab governs. Since the insurgency’s inception, its leaders have understood the importance of securing grassroots legitimacy while also adroitly navigating Somalia’s often-complex clan-based society. They have garnered support from local communities, especially in rural areas, while the Somali government has been ranked the country’s most corrupt government since 2006, according to Transparency International. Even in government-controlled areas such as Mogadishu, civilians flock to the sharia courts run by al-Shabab. Norman said that for many members of Somalia’s political class, defeating al-Shabab was not obviously in their interest. Regional leaders’ cooperation with the campaign “was shallow even at its high points,” he said, because they worried that a government victory against al-Shabab would confer a legitimacy needed to remove them from office. The presence of foreign forces on Somali soil has been controversial throughout history. The AU deployment was predated by an Ethiopian military intervention in December 2006. This intervention saw thousands of Ethiopian troops invade Somalia, eventually operating under the cover of U.S. drones. The George W. Bush administration aimed to overthrow the Islamic Courts Union (ICU), a coalition of sharia courts that had seized power in Somalia and which marked the first instance in the post-9/11 era of political Islam gaining a foothold on the African continent. Members of the current AU peacekeeping force, and the two against al-Shabab that preceded it, have been implicated in allegations of widespread human rights abuses and atrocities ranging from extrajudicial killings, enforced disappearances, massacres of civilians, and even using rape as a weapon of war. These allegations span decades, and without any justice or accountability, the public has turned against the AU peacekeepers. The Somali government, too, is seen as turning a blind eye. A textbook example was the 2024 Bulo-Mareer killings, in which African Union peacekeeping troops from Uganda brutally decapitated two local farmers in the agricultural town of Bulo-Mareer. The deaths sparked protests in the town, and local residents called on AU troops to leave. Al-Shabab responded by releasing a statement condemning the attack and vowing retaliation and vengeance for the killing of the civilians; the federal government has not yet addressed the situation two years on. Al-Shabab, meanwhile, is viewed by many Somalis as defending the country from foreign subjugation and occupation, and it follows in a nationalist tradition of armed religious resistance to foreign encroachment from colonial times. The group uses that history to incentivize young men to take up arms and join the insurgency. But it’s not just nostalgia tied to the 19th century that Al-Shabab utilizes, but also the more recent memory of the “global war on terror.” “Before December 2006, al-Shabab was a small and radical component of the Islamic Courts Union,” Norman said. Then the Ethiopian intervention came, with U.S. diplomatic and intelligence backing, followed by the American airstrikes. “Al-Shabab expanded by presenting itself as the resistance, and many who joined appear to have been moved by Ethiopian conduct rather than by commitment to al Qaeda’s broader ideological project,” he said. Another burning issue is that al-Shabab has retaken nearly all the territory that it lost in a 2022-2023 Somali army campaign. During a 2025 counter-offensive, insurgents came as close as 45 kilometers to the Somali capital, Mogadishu. Their blitzkrieg-style offensive forced one of Mogadishu’s key allies, Turkey, to deploy 500 extra troops to Somalia, including drone operators. That al-Shabab has since recovered that ground underscores that after two decades of combat and consecutive interventions, the group remains a factor and a potent threat. Following the U.S. announcement of ending support for the AU peacekeeping mission in Somalia, troops have begun the process of withdrawing. Burhakaba, located in the Bay region of Somalia, was the first town to see a troop withdrawal. It has been encircled and isolated by al-Shabab since 2014. Many more towns are expected to go through similar phases of withdrawal before the Trump administration’s Dec. 31 deadline. The uncertainty is made worse by the fact that there is no one other nation that can fill the United States’ void. Turkey can only provide air support, and it doesn’t have the capacity to replace the AU peacekeepers. Al-Shabab will wait patiently until the last foreign boots leave Somali soil, said Arman, the political analyst. A recent summit held by countries currently contributing troops to the African Union peacekeeping mission in Somalia saw several governments request an 18 month to 24 month extension – signaling uncertainty around whether Somali forces will be ready to take responsibility for the country’s security when the AU troops leave. “The one thing Al-Shabaab does well is filling vacuums when they present themselves,” Arman wrote. items.title: United States Welcomes Djibouti’s Signing of the Artemis Accords
items.description: United States Welcomes Djibouti’s Signing of the Artemis Accords Office of the Spokesman September 14, 2026 The Department of State congratulates the Republic of Djibouti on joining the Artemis Accords. Djibouti is the 72nd country to sign the Accords to date, pledging its commitment to the peaceful exploration of space. Djibouti’s Ambassador to the United States Mohamed Siad Douale signed the Accords on behalf of the Republic of Djibouti on September 14, 2026. NASA Deputy Administrator Matthew Anderson and State Department Assistant Secretary for African Affairs Frank Garcia witnessed and celebrated the signing at a ceremony at the Mary W. Jackson NASA Headquarters in Washington, D.C. Djibouti most recently participated in the Department’s U.S.-Africa Technical and Regulatory Space Training Meeting in April 2026, and Djibouti’s first two satellites launched from Vandenberg Space Force Base in 2023 and 2024 respectively. The United States and seven other countries established the Artemis Accords in 2020 to serve as a set of practical principles to guide responsible space exploration. Djibouti joins the United States and 70 other nations in affirming the Accords’ principles for sustainable civil space activity. The Department of State and NASA lead the United States’ outreach and implementation of the Accords.

items.title: Shirkii golaha Wasiirrada Somaliland iyo wixii lagaga hadlay
items.description: Fadhigii 75-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada JSL oo uu Shir-guddoominayey Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi ayaa maanta ka qabsoomay Qasriga Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Qodobbada lagaga wada hadlay Fadhiga 75-aad waxa ka mid ahaa: 𝟏. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka JSL, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab, ayaa Golaha uga xog-warramay xaaladda amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka, isaga oo adkeeyey in sugidda amniga dalku uu yahay aasaaska xasilloonida, Qarannimada iyo horumarka Somaliland. Wasiirku waxa uu xaqiijiyey in guud ahaan xaaladda amni ee dalku ay wanaagsan tahay, isla markaana Hay’adaha Amniga Qaranku ay si buuxda ugu diyaarsan yihiin ilaalinta nabadda, kala dambaynta iyo midnimada qaranka, iyada oo la sii xoojinayo wada-shaqaynta Hay’adaha Qaranka ee amniga iyo feejignaanta bulshada JSL. 𝟐. 𝐐𝐚𝐛𝐲𝐨-𝐪𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐗𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐤𝐚 𝐂𝐢𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐀𝐬𝐥𝐮𝐮𝐛𝐭𝐚 𝐉𝐒𝐋: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Caddaalada JSL, Mudane Yoonis Axmed Yoonis iyo ku-xigeenka Garyaqaanka Guud, ahna ku-simaha, Mudane Garyaqaan Mubaarig Maxamuud Cabdi (Fallaag) ayaa Golaha faahfaahin ka siiyey muhimadda iyo ujeeddada Xeerka Ciidanka Asluubta JSL. Wasiirka Caddaaladda JSL waxa uu xusay in Wasaaraddu ay dhammaystirtay Xeerkan oo ah Xeer muhiim u ah Qaranka, Ciidanka Asluubtuna uu muddo dheer baahi weyn u qabay, maadaama uu yahay Xeer uu waajibiyey Dastuurka JSL qodobkiisa 124-aad. Wasiirku waxa uu iftiimiyey ujeeddada Xeerka, taasoo ah maamulka Ciidanka Asluubta, qeexitaanka qaab-dhismeedka, awoodaha, waajibaadkooda, masuuliyadaha, xuquuqaha, hannaanka dallacaadaha iyo anshax marinta xubnaha Ciidanka Asluubta. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha ka codsaday in ay soo darsaan Qabyo-qoraalka Xeerka Ciidanka Asluubta JSL, taladoodana ku biiriyaan. 𝟑. 𝐑𝐨𝐨𝐛𝐚𝐛𝐤𝐚 𝐄𝐥 𝐍𝐢ň𝐨, 𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐲𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐚𝐲 𝐤𝐮 𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐧 𝐤𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐚𝐧 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝, 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐝𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐫-𝐠𝐚𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐠𝐚 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐠𝐚 𝐛𝐚𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐲𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐲 𝐇𝐚𝐲’𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐰𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐞𝐞 𝐚𝐲 𝐤𝐡𝐮𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐬𝐨: Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa ka arrinsaday roobabka la saadaalinayo ee ka dhasha saamaynta El Niño (dhacdo cimilo), iyo khataraha ay xaaladdaasi ku yeelan karto dalka, gaar ahaan deegaanka, xoolaha, beeraha iyo bulshada nugul. Wasiirka Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada, Mudane Cabdilaahi Cismaan (Geeljire) iyo Wasiirka Horumarinta Beeraha, Mudane Aadan Geedi Qayaad ayaa Golaha ka hor jeediyey warbixinno ku saabsan saamaynta El Niño, xaaladda cimilada iyo diyaar-garowga looga baahan yahay Hay’adaha ay khusayso, si loo yareeyo khataraha fatahaadaha, daadadka iyo waxyeellada ka dhalan karta roobabka xooggan. Dawladda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ay bulshada ugu baaqaysaa feejignaan, diyaar-garow iyo wada-shaqayn, iyada oo hay’adaha ay khusayso lagu dhiirrigelinayo in ay qaadaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah ee lagula tacaalayo xaaladdan iyada ah. 𝟒. 𝐃𝐨𝐨𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚: 𝐒𝐚𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐲𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐚𝐦𝐧𝐢, 𝐝𝐡𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐞 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐠𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐜𝐬𝐢 𝐞𝐞 𝐱𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐁𝐚𝐛 𝐞𝐥-𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐛 𝐚𝐲 𝐤𝐮 𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐧 𝐤𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐨 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa maanta ka dooday saamaynta amni, dhaqaale iyo ganacsi ee xaaladda marinka Bab el-Mandeb iyo colaadaha Bariga Dhexe ayvku yeelan karaan Somaliland, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga badda, isu-socodka ganacsiga, dekedaha, iyo dhaqaalaha dalka. Goluhu waxa uu isla qaatay muhiimadda ay leedahay diyaar-garow Qaran, isku-duwidda Hay’adaha Dawladda ee ay khusayso iyo Qorshe midaysan oo lagula tacaalayo waxyeellada ka dhalan karta isbeddellada amni iyo dhaqaale ee gobolka, iyada oo la ilaalinayo xasilloonida, amniga iyo danaha mudnaanta u leh Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland.

𝐑𝐨𝐨𝐛𝐚𝐛𝐤𝐚 𝐄𝐥 𝐍𝐢ň𝐨, 𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐲𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐚𝐲 𝐤𝐮 𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐧 𝐤𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐚𝐧 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝, 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐝𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐫-𝐠𝐚𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐠𝐚 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐠𝐚 𝐛𝐚𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐲𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐲 𝐇𝐚𝐲’𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐰𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐞𝐞 𝐚𝐲 𝐤𝐡𝐮𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐬𝐨: Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa ka arrinsaday roobabka la saadaalinayo ee ka dhasha saamaynta El Niño (dhacdo cimilo), iyo khataraha ay xaaladdaasi ku yeelan karto dalka, gaar ahaan deegaanka, xoolaha, beeraha iyo bulshada nugul. Wasiirka Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada, Mudane Cabdilaahi Cismaan (Geeljire) iyo Wasiirka Horumarinta Beeraha, Mudane Aadan Geedi Qayaad ayaa Golaha ka hor jeediyey warbixinno ku saabsan saamaynta El Niño, xaaladda cimilada iyo diyaar-garowga looga baahan yahay Hay’adaha ay khusayso, si loo yareeyo khataraha fatahaadaha, daadadka iyo waxyeellada ka dhalan karta roobabka xooggan. Dawladda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ay bulshada ugu baaqaysaa feejignaan, diyaar-garow iyo wada-shaqayn, iyada oo hay’adaha ay khusayso lagu dhiirrigelinayo in ay qaadaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah ee lagula tacaalayo xaaladdan iyada ah. 𝟒. 𝐃𝐨𝐨𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚: 𝐒𝐚𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐲𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐚𝐦𝐧𝐢, 𝐝𝐡𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐞 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐠𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐜𝐬𝐢 𝐞𝐞 𝐱𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐁𝐚𝐛 𝐞𝐥-𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐛 𝐚𝐲 𝐤𝐮 𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐧 𝐤𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐨 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa maanta ka dooday saamaynta amni, dhaqaale iyo ganacsi ee xaaladda marinka Bab el-Mandeb iyo colaadaha Bariga Dhexe ayvku yeelan karaan Somaliland, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga badda, isu-socodka ganacsiga, dekedaha, iyo dhaqaalaha dalka. Goluhu waxa uu isla qaatay muhiimadda ay leedahay diyaar-garow Qaran, isku-duwidda Hay’adaha Dawladda ee ay khusayso iyo Qorshe midaysan oo lagula tacaalayo waxyeellada ka dhalan karta isbeddellada amni iyo dhaqaale ee gobolka, iyada oo la ilaalinayo xasilloonida, amniga iyo danaha mudnaanta u leh Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland.

items.title: R/W Xamza oo caddeeyey arrin la xiriirta dhaqaalaha DF ay siiso dowlad-goboleedyada
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalku aysan siyaasadeyn taageerada dhaqaale ee ay siiso dowlad-goboleedyada. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa shaaciyay in sanadkii 2025 uu ahaa sannadkii ay dhaqaalaha ugu badnaa la siiyay maamullada dalka, xilli dowlad-goboleedyada qaar uu khilaaf xooggan kala dhexeeyo dowladda dhexe. “Dowladdu ma aysan siyaasadeyn, mana siyaasadeyn doonto taageerada dhaqaale ee ay siiso dowlad-goboleedyada. Sanadka 2025 wuxuu ahaa sanadkii dhaqaalaha ugu badan la siiyey dowlad-goboleedyada,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay munaasabad lagu soo bandhigayay Warbixinta Dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya ee 2025, taas oo ay soo diyaarisay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Warbixinta ayaa lagu soo bandhigay xaaladda guud ee dhaqaalaha dalka, horumarka la sameeyay intii lagu jiray 2025 iyo dib-u-habaynta hannaanka maaliyadda qaranka, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu soo qaaday isbeddellada ku yimid taageeradii dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya ka heli jirtay dibadda. Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in inkastoo ay jireen caqabado dhaqaale oo gudaha iyo dibadda ah, haddana adkaysiga shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo dadaallada hay’adaha dowladda ay door ka qaateen sii socoshada kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa Wasaaradda Maaliyadda ku bogaadiyey dadaallada ay ku bixisay horumarinta hannaanka maaliyadda qaranka, gaar ahaan kordhinta dakhliga gudaha iyo xoojinta daah-furnaanta iyo isla-xisaabtanka. Waxa uu sidoo kale tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii wado dib-u-habaynta dhaqaalaha, lana hagaajiyo maamulka iyo maaraynta dhaqaalaha dalka, si loo xoojiyo awoodda dowladda ee dhinaca maaliyadda. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza ayaa sheegay in loo baahan yahay in la abuuro jawi ku habboon maalgashiga gudaha iyo kan dibadda, iyadoo la xoojinayo shuruucda iyo siyaasadaha hagaya dhaqaalaha iyo maalgashiga Soomaaliya. Hadalka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Dowladda Federaalku ay waddo dib-u-habayn lagu xoojinayo dakhliga gudaha iyo nidaamka maaliyadda qaranka, iyadoo sidoo kale xoogga la saarayo sidii dhaqaalaha dalka looga dhigi lahaa mid si weyn ugu tiirsan ilaha gudaha. The post R/W Xamza oo caddeeyey arrin la xiriirta dhaqaalaha DF ay siiso dowlad-goboleedyada appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Announcement of New Visa Restriction Policy Targeting Foreign Nationals Involved in Race-Based Discrimination
items.description: Announcement of New Visa Restriction Policy Targeting Foreign Nationals Involved in Race-Based Discrimination and Incitement of Imminent Violence, as well as Uncompensated Land Seizures in South Africa Press Statement Marco Rubio, Secretary of State As stated in President Trump’s Executive Order (EO) 14204, “Addressing Egregious Actions of the Republic of South Africa,” the United States remains gravely concerned about racially motivated crime and government-sponsored discrimination occurring against the Afrikaners and other minority populations in South Africa, including race-based discriminatory legislation, threats of land expropriation without compensation, and incitement of racial violence through dehumanizing chants and slogans. The South African government has not adequately addressed the previously laid out concerns and so today, I am announcing a new visa restriction policy under Section 212(a)(3)(C) of the Immigration and Nationality Act targeting foreign nationals who are responsible for, or complicit in, the enactment or implementation of laws or policies that enable uncompensated land seizures, race-based discrimination, and/or the incitement of imminent violence against members of minority ethnic or racial groups in South Africa. The United States will not allow such behavior to go unchecked. These actions directly undermine peace, economic stability, and the rule of law, and they are incompatible with the pillars of America’s foreign policy. We once again strongly urge the South African government to quickly address these egregious actions. This visa restriction policy is pursuant to Section 212(a)(3)(C) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, which authorizes the Secretary of State to render inadmissible any alien whose entry into the United States “would have potentially serious adverse foreign policy consequences for the United States.” Certain family members may also be covered by these restrictions.

items.title: China Warns Somaliland Over Support for Taiwan
items.description: MOGADISHU— China has warned Somaliland of “serious consequences” following President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, widely known as Irro, expressing support for Taiwan’s status as an independent country. The Chinese Embassy in Mogadishu said Beijing firmly opposes Somaliland’s position, reiterating that it regards Taiwan as part of China and Somaliland as part of Somalia. In a statement, the embassy accused Somaliland of violating the “One-China” principle and challenging China’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. “We firmly oppose this move,” the embassy said, urging Somaliland officials to recognize Beijing’s position on the Taiwan issue. It warned that what it described as crossing the “red line” on Taiwan could result in serious consequences. China’s ambassador to Somalia also reaffirmed Beijing’s support for Somalia’s territorial integrity, describing Somaliland as an inseparable part of Somali territory. The ambassador said China supports the Federal Government of Somalia and opposes actions aimed at dividing the country. The latest statements reflect Beijing’s continued opposition to Somaliland’s international efforts for recognition and its growing concern over ties between Somaliland and Taiwan. China has consistently maintained that Taiwan is part of its territory and has opposed any form of formal recognition of Taiwanese independence. items.title: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika oo Muqdisho ku soo gabagabeeyay kulamo ku saabsan la-dagaallanka argagixisada
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – 16 Sebtembar 2026: La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ku soo gabagabeeyay kulamo iyo wada-tashiyo muddo laba maalmood ah u dhexeeyay hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Xarunta La-dagaallanka Argagixisada ee Midowga Afrika. Kulanka gabagabada ah ayaa lagu qiimeeyay qodobadii looga hadlay kulamadii iyo wada-tashiyadii labada maalmood ee lasoo dhaafay, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada. Wafdiga Xarunta La-dagaallanka Argagixisada ee Midowga Afrika ayaa uga mahadceliyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan Xafiiska Amniga Qaranka, soo dhaweynta iyo fududeynta kulamadii ay la yeesheen hay’adaha kala duwan ee dowladda. Sidoo kale, wafdiga ayaa bogaadiyay horumarka ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka sameysay dadaallada la-dagaallanka argagixisada, iyagoo tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta iyo iskaashiga amni ee Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika. Kulamadan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga hay’adaha Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Midowga Afrika, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha.

items.title: Mursal ciise oo Taagan Albaabka Baarlamaanka Sweden
items.description: Mursal Isa oo ka tirsan xisbiga Miljöpartiet (MP) ayaa wajahaya fursad uu ku noqon karo xildhibaan ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Sweden, kaddib markii xisbigiisu dib u helay hal kursi oo ka tirsan gobolka Dalarna. Mursal Isa oo ka soo jeeda magaalada Borlänge ayaa ku jira kaalinta koowaad ee liiska musharraxiinta xisbiga, taas oo ka dhigaysa qofka hadda ugu dhow kursiga. Hase yeeshee, natiijada kama dambaysta ah waxaa go’aamin kara codadka qofka ee doorashada, iyadoo musharraxa labaad ee liiska, Maj Ardesjö oo ka soo jeeda Falun, ay sidoo kale leedahay fursad ay kaga horreyso. Isa ayaa sheegay in xaaladdu ay tahay mid aan weli la hubin, isla markaana uu sugayo natiijada codadka qofka. Miljöpartiet ayaa doorashadan ka sameeyay horumar guud ahaan Dalarna. Xisbiga ayaa dib ugu soo laabtay golaha gobolka, kaddib markii uu ka maqnaa tan iyo doorashadii 2022, waxaana sidoo kale uu kuraas ka helay golayaasha degmooyinka Avesta, Mora iyo Säter. Mursal Isa ayaa sheegay in arrimaha tamarta iyo fahamka sii kordhaya ee bulshada ee ku saabsan isbeddelka tamarta ay ka mid yihiin arrimaha uu aaminsan yahay inay gacan ka geysteen kororka taageerada xisbiga.

items.title: Dowladda oo Ka Digaysa Roobab Waaweyn oo Muqdisho ku Soo Wajahan
items.description: Muqdisho, 16 Sebteembar 2026 — Roob mahiigaan ah ayaa xalay ka da’ay qaybo badan oo ka mid ah magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo sababay in waddooyin iyo goobo kala duwan ay biyo fariistaan, iyadoo magaalada ay wajahday xaalad la xiriirta fatahaadaha iyo biyo-mareennada oo aan si wanaagsan u qaadin biyaha roobka. Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sheegay in roobabka waaweyn ee la xiriira saameynta El Niño, ee hore looga digay, aysan weli si buuxda u bilaaban, taasoo sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo haddii roobab ka culus kuwa xalay da’ay ay magaalada ku soo wajan yuhiin. Roobka xalay ka da’ay Muqdisho ayaa mar kale muujiyay nuglaanta magaalada, gaar ahaan meelaha ay biyo-mareennadu xiran yihiin ama aan lahayn nidaam ku filan oo biyaha roobka looga saaro. Xaaladda ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo digniino hore laga bixiyay khatarta roobab xooggan iyo daadad ka dhalan kara, waxaana muuqata baahida loo qabo diyaargarow, nadiifinta biyo-mareennada iyo qorshe degdeg ah oo wax looga qabto meelaha ugu nugul daadadka. Roobabkan ayaa sidoo kale dhaliyay cabashooyin ku saabsan xaaladda waddooyinka iyo adeegyada biyo-mareennada magaalada, iyadoo shacabka qaarkood ay ku qasbanaadeen inay la tacaalaan biyaha fariistay waddooyinka iyo xaafadaha. Haddii roobabka culus ee la saadaaliyay ay sii socdaan, xaaladda Muqdisho waxay u baahan kartaa tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo ka hortag iyo gurmad ah, si loo yareeyo saameynta ay daadadku ku yeelan karaan dadka, guryaha iyo waddooyinka magaalada.

items.title: IGAD oo ku baaqday maalgelin joogto ah oo AUSSOM ah, wada-hadalna uga yeertay hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaaliya
items.description: Urur-goboleedka IGAD ayaa ku baaqay in la helo maalgelin ku filan, la saadaalin karo oo joogto ah oo lagu taageerayo howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), si loo sii xoojiyo dadaallada amniga iyo xasillinta dalka. Baaqan ayaa ka soo baxay war-murtiyeedka Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada IGAD, oo 15-kii Sebteembar lagu qabtay magaalada Jabuuti. IGAD waxay sheegtay inay garab taagan tahay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dagaalka lagula jiro kooxaha argagixisada, iyadoo ammaan u jeedisay AUSSOM iyo dalalka ciidamadooda ku biiriyay howlgalka. IGAD ayaa si gaar ah ugu baaqday Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo saaxiibbada caalamka inay xaqiijiyaan maalgelin ku filan, la saadaalin karo oo waarta oo AUSSOM lagu taageero. War-murtiyeedka ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyay in la dhowro madaxbannaanida, midnimada, wadajirka dhuleed iyo madax-bannaanida siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. IGAD oo ku baaqday wada-hadal siyaasadeed oo Soomaaliya ah Golaha Wasiirrada IGAD ayaa sidoo kale bogaadiyay dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan horumarinta geeddi-socodka dimuqraadiyadda iyo dhismaha nidaam doorasho oo loo dhan yahay oo ka qaybgal ballaaran ku dhisan. IGAD waxay ugu baaqday dhinacyada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaaliyeed inay sii wadaan dadaallada lagu gaarayo hannaan doorasho oo loo dhan yahay, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo wada-tashi iyo xal siyaasadeed oo dalka u horseeda is-afgarad.

items.title: Shiinaha oo Somaliland uga digay cawaaqib culus, kadib hadal ka soo yeeray Cirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Shiinaha ayaa si kulul uga jawaabtay hadallo uu Madaxweynaha maamulka Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro, ka jeediyay dalka Mareykanka oo uu ku muujiyay taageerada uu u hayo Taiwan, iyadoo Beijing ay uga digtay Somaliland “cawaaqib culus” haddii ay sii waddo mowqifkaas. Safaaradda Shiinaha ee Soomaaliya ayaa Arbacada maanta ah sheegtay in hadallada Cirro ay jebinayaan mabda’a “hal Shiinaha”, isla markaana ay dhaawacayaan waxa Beijing ay ku tilmaantay madax-bannaanideeda iyo midnimadeeda dhuleed. “Ka gudbidda xadka arrinta Taiwan waxay horseedi doontaa cawaaqib culus,” ayay safaaraddu ku tiri bayaan ay soo saartay, iyadoo aan faahfaahin ka bixin nooca tallaabada ay qaadi karto. Shiinaha ayaa sidoo kale arrinta Taiwan si toos ah ugu xiray muranka Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland, isagoo mar kale caddeeyay taageerada uu u hayo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. “Somaliland waa qayb aan laga goyn karin dhulka Soomaaliya,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka, oo intaas ku daray in Beijing ay taageereyso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kana soo horjeeddo tallaabo kasta oo lagu kala qaybinayo dalka. Hadalkan ayaa yimid xilli Madaxweyne Cirro uu booqasho ku joogo Washington, halkaas oo Somaliland ay ka waddo dadaallo ay ku doonayso xiriir siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo dhow oo ay la yeelato Mareykanka. Cirro ayaa intii uu joogay Mareykanka sheegay in Somaliland ay garab taagan tahay Washington, isagoo sidoo kale xusay xiriirka ay la leedahay Taiwan iyo Israel. Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa Isniintii khudbad ka jeediyay Machadka Hudson ee Washington, booqashadiisii ugu horreysay ee Mareykanka tan iyo markii uu ku guuleystay doorashadii madaxtinimada Somaliland bishii November 2024. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xiriirka Somaliland iyo Mareykanka, amniga gobolka iyo dadaalka Hargeysa ee aqoonsi raadinta. Somaliland ayaa sidoo kale muddooyinkii dambe soo bandhigaysay dekedda Berbera, goobta ay ku taallo ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo muhiimadda marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, xilli ay Washington ka raadineyso xiriir dhow iyo taageero siyaasadeed. Xiriirka Taiwan Muranka cusub wuxuu salka ku hayaa xiriirka Somaliland iyo Taiwan, oo si rasmi ah u ballaartay sanadkii 2020 markii labada dhinac ay ku heshiiyeen inay xafiisyo wakiillo ka kala furtaan Hargeysa iyo Taipei. Taiwan ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in iskaashiga labada dhinac uu ka koobnaan doono kalluumeysiga, beeraha, tamarta, macdanta, caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo teknoolajiyadda. Tan iyo markaas, xiriirkooda ayaa ku fiday ganacsiga, caafimaadka, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo tababarrada xirfadaha. Beijing ayaa si joogto ah uga soo horjeedda xiriirkaas. Shiinaha wuxuu Taiwan u arkaa qayb ka mid ah dhulkiisa, wuxuuna dowladda Jamhuuriyadda Dadka Shiinaha ku tilmaamaa dowladda keliya ee sharci ahaan matasha Shiinaha. Taiwan, oo leh dowlad, ciidan iyo nidaam siyaasadeed u gaar ah, ayaa diiddan sheegashada Beijing. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa taageerta mabda’a hal Shiinaha, halka Shiinuhuna uu si joogto ah u taageero midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Dadaalka aqoonsiga Khilaafka Taiwan ayaa soo baxaya xilli Somaliland ay kordhisay dadaalladeeda diblomaasiyadeed kadib markii Israel ay bishii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland. Soomaaliya ayaa tallaabada Israel ku tilmaantay xadgudub lagu sameeyay madax-bannaanideeda iyo midnimadeeda dhuleed, halka Midowga Afrika iyo dowlado kale oo gobolka ah ay dib u xaqiijiyeen taageeradooda midnimada Soomaaliya. Xiriirka Israel iyo Somaliland ayaa intaas kadib sii ballaartay, iyadoo Cirro uu bishii June booqday Israel, labada dhinacna ay ka wada hadleen iskaashi dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo maalgashiga. Hargeysa ayaa hadda sidoo kale isku dayaysa inay Washington ka hesho xiriir ka dhow kan hadda jira, balse Mareykanka weli ma aqbalin inuu u aqoonsado Somaliland dal madax-bannaan. Aqalka Cad ayaa dhowaan sheegay in aysan waxba iska beddelin siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Somaliland, halka Cirro laftiisu uu sheegay in wada-hadallada uu Washington ka wado aysan weli dhalin ballanqaad ku saabsan aqoonsi. Digniinta cusub ee Shiinaha ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli Somaliland ay sii xoojinayso xiriirkeeda Taiwan iyo Israel, isla markaana ay Mareykanka ka raadineyso iskaashi siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo ballaaran. items.title: Madaxweyne ku xigeenka Somaliland oo ka qayb galay
items.description: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa maanta ka qayb galay Shirweynaha Horumarinta Ganacsatada yar-yar, kuwa dhexe iyo Iskaashatooyinka, oo lagu lafo-gurayo doorka ganacsiga yaryar iyo kuwa dhexe ee kobaca dhaqaalaha, abuurista shaqooyinka iyo horumarinta iawoodda dhaqaale ee bulshada. Shirweynahan oo lagu qabtay Hotel Serene Sarovar Premiere Hargeisa, ayaa waxa isugu yimid masuuliyiin ka tirsan Xukuumadda, Hay’adaha ay khusayso horumarinta ganacsiga, Ganacsatada dalka, Wakiillo ka socda iskaashatooyinka iyo qaybaha kale ee bulshada, waxa muhimmad gaar ah lagu siiyey sidii loo xoojin lahaa fursadaha ganacsi ee ay heli karaan ganacsatada yaryar iyo kuwa dhexe, isla markaana loo abuuri lahaa hannaan awood u siinaya in ay si joogto ah u kobciyaan wax-soo-saarkooda. Sidoo kale, Shirweynaha waxa lagaga hadlay caqabadaha haysta ganacsatada yar-yar iyo kuwa dhexe, fursadaha jira, sidii loo horumarin lahaa helitaanka maalgelinta, tababarro iyo aqoon kororsi yo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashatooyinka oo laf-dhabar u noqon kara horumarinta dhaqaalaha bulshada. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi oo shirka ka hadlay ayaa tilmaamay in ganacsatada yar-yar iyo kuwa dhexe ay yihiin qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dhaqaalaha dalka, maadaama ay door weyn ka qaataan abuurista fursadaha shaqo, kobcinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo kor u qaadista dhaq-dhaqaaqa dhaqaale ee bulshada. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL ayaa sidoo kale xusay in iskaashatooyinku ay yihiin hannaan muhiim u ah isku-xidhka bulshada iyo isu-geynta awoodda dhaqaale ee muwaadiniinta, gaar ahaan dadka ku hawlan wax-soo-saarka, beeraha, xoolaha, farsamada gacanta iyo adeegyada kala duwan. items.title: Heavy Rains Disrupt Traffic and Daily Activities in Mogadishu
items.description: MOGADISHU — Heavy rains that fell across Mogadishu for several hours on Wednesday disrupted traffic and slowed the movement of pedestrians and vehicles in several parts of the capital. Several major roads were affected by significant water accumulation, making it difficult for motorists and pedestrians to move through the city. Traffic congestion was reported on some roads as commuters faced challenges caused by the heavy rainfall and flooded streets. The impact of the rain also extended to key areas of the capital, including roads near Aden Adde International Airport, as well as schools and workplaces. Many residents experienced difficulties reaching their educational institutions and places of work as normal. With the rain continuing, concerns have grown that prolonged rainfall could lead to further water accumulation and worsen conditions on major roads. Residents have been urged to exercise caution, particularly when traveling through areas affected by standing water and flooding. Government authorities and municipal officials have been called upon to respond swiftly, particularly in areas where flooding has blocked major roads, in order to restore access and ease movement across the capital. items.title: Egypt Moves to Strengthen Somalia’s Military Capabilities
items.description: MOGADISHU— Egypt has reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening and developing the capabilities of the Somali National Army as Cairo and Mogadishu seek to deepen their longstanding defense and security cooperation. The Egyptian government said its efforts will focus on military training, enhancing the capacity of Somalia’s security institutions and expanding military cooperation between the two countries. The initiative is also intended to support the implementation of existing defense agreements and commitments between Egypt and Somalia. The move comes as Somalia continues its efforts to rebuild and professionalize the Somali National Army and strengthen its ability to respond to the country’s security challenges. Egypt and Somalia have stepped up bilateral cooperation in defense and security in recent years. The two governments have previously signed agreements aimed at expanding military cooperation and providing training and capacity-building support to Somali security forces. Officials from both sides have stressed the importance of further strengthening the strategic relationship between Somalia and Egypt, particularly in the areas of defense, security and military development. The renewed focus on defense cooperation comes as Somalia works to strengthen its national security institutions and develop a more capable and sustainable national military force. items.title: Beeraleyda deegaan hoostaga Afgooye oo ku najaxay adeegsiga koronto laga dhaliyo ilayska
items.description: (ERGO) – Beeraleyda deegaanka Jarran oo hoos taga degmada Afgooye ayaa wax soo saarka beerahoodu uu kordhay, markii in badan oo ka mid ah ay billaabeen in waraabka beeraha ay u adeeg sadaan tamarta cadceedda ku shaqeysa. Waxay tilmaameen in arrintan ay xoogga saareen, markii ay dhaqaale ahaan ku adkaatay iibinta joogtada ah ee shidaalka oo qiimahiisu kordhay. Tamarta cadceedda ku shaqeysa ayay xuseen inay lacagta bixiyaan marka koowaad oo ay soo gadanayaan, kadibna ay si bilaash ah ugu waraabsadaan beeraha marka kasta oo ay u baahdaan. Markii hore waxay adeegsanjireen matoorada shidaalka ku shaqeeya matoorrada, kaas oo ay boqollaal Doollar uga bixi jireen. Maxamed Nuur Isxaaq oo leh beer afar hektar ah ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in isticmaalka tamarta cadceedda uu u hor seeday in wax soo saarkiisu kordho in ka badan labo jibbaar, tan iyo markii uu soo gatay bishii Jannaayo ee sanadkan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in halkii mar oo uu waraabiyo beerta uu ku bixin jiray lacag u dhexeysa $100 illaa $150, halka maanta aysan uga bixin wax lacag ah. Dhaqaalaha oo ku yaraa darteed ayuu sheegay in dantu ku qasbi jirtay inuusan waraabin dalagyada oo biyo u baahan, taasina ay keeni jirtay in wax soo saarkiisu hoos u dhaco. Wuxuu xusay in ugu yaraan labo mar uu hadda bishii waraabiyo beertiisa, halka markii hore uu labadii bilba mar waraabin jiray. Basal, yaanyo, basbaas, ansalaato, kabsar caleen, galley iyo digir oo ah dalagyadii ugu dambeeyay oo u soo go’ay bishii June ayuu sheegay inuu ka helay faa’ido gaareysa $3,000. Sida uu xusay waa dhaqaale ka badan boqolkiiba labo boqol, markii uu adeegsan jiray matoorka ku shaqeeya shidaalka. “Markii aan waayo lacag aan ku iibsado shidaalka waxaan ku qasbanaan jiray inaan dib u dhigo waraabka, taas oo saameyn ku yeelan jirtay dalagyada, gaar ahaan xilliyada ay u baahan yihiin biyaha.” Maxamed ayaa xusay in hadda uusan ka warwarin waraabka beertiisa. Isbedelkaas waxaa u hor seeday Soollar qiimahiisu yahay $4,600. Lacagtaas oo kun ka mid ah lagu lahaa ayuu sheegay inuu iska bixiyay. Faa’idada uu ka helo dalagyada u soo go’a ayuu tilmaamay inuu ka keydsaday dhaqaale gaaraya $1,700. Sanooyin dhowr ah oo uu beeraley yahay ayuu sheegay inuusan waligiis keydsan dhaqaale intan la eg, iyadoo uu xusay in waxa soo gali jiray aysan ka badnaan jirin inuu ku maareeyo nolosha qoyskiisa oo ka kooban siddeed qof. Sababta wuxuu ku sheegay in wax soo saarkiisu yaraa, ayna badneyd lacagta uga bixi jirtay iibinta shidaalka. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in mar hore uu billaabi lahaa isticmaalka Soollarka, balse uusan fahamsaneyn muhiimadda uu leeyahay. Waa go’aan ku dhashay markii ay ku dheeri galiyeen beeraley dariskiisa ah oo uga horreysay adeegsiga tamartan. “Waxaan go’aansaday in maalgalintaan aan sameeyo, sababta oo ah waxaa ii muuqatay in mustaqbalka iga yareyn doonto qarashaadka faraha badan. Lacagta waxaan ka helay dakhli iga soo galay beeraha oo aan keydsaday.” Deegaanka Jarran ayay dadkiisu u badan yihiin beeraley ku tiirsan biyaha webiga Shabeelle. Dalagyada u soo go’a ayay u iib geeyaan suuqyada gobolada Banaadir iyo Shabeellaha Hoose. Ka faa’ideysiga tamarta cadceedda oo fahamkeedu xoogeysanayo ayaa qeyb ka qaadaneysa in beeraleyda uu ka mid yahay Maxamed Nuur ay sameeyaan kobac dhaqaale oo joogta ah, ayna xoogga saaraan iibsashada abuurka, daawooyinka nafaqada iyo sunta cayayaanka. “Beertu waxay ii tahay isha kaliya dhaqaale ee aan ku taageero qoyskeyga. Waxaan isku dayaa faa’idada inaan qeyb keydsado markasta, si aan ugu isticmaalo xaaladaha deg degga ah ama horumarinta beerteyda.” Ninkan ayaa intaas ku daray inuu qorsheynayo inuu soo gato soollar ku kacaya kummanaan Doollar, maadaama uu hadda isticmaalo mid awoodiisu yartahay. Dhanka kale Maxamed Cabdi Xasan oo muddo 15 sano ah beeraley ah. Wuxuu ka mid yahay dadka ku nool tuulada Jarran ee ka faa’ideysanaya tamarta cadceedda. Bishii Maarso ee sanadkan ayuu iibsaday Soollar, si meesha uu uga saaro kharashaad badan oo ku baxayay shidaalka. Wuxuu tilmaamay in shan bil oo uu isticmaalayo qalabkan aysan wax lacag ah uga bixin waraabka, halka markii hore uu xusay in markasta oo uu waraabinayo beerta uu soo gadan jiray shidaal qiimahiisu u dhexeeyo $300 illaa $500. Maxamed Cabdi ayaa sheegay in qalabka Soolar-ka uu ku soo iibsaday $4,500 oo shan boqol oo ka mid ah ay aheyd deyn uu iska bixiyay bishii May. “Waxa ugu weyn ee igu dhiirrigeliyay waa kharashka badan ee shidaalka iyo dhibaatada mararka qaar ka dhalan jirtay helitaanka lacagta shidaalka. Sidaas darteed waxaan raadiyay xal joogto ah oo ii sahlaya inaan beerta si wanaagsan u maareeyo. Markii aan billaabay isticmaalka Soollarka waxaan arkay in waraabkii uu fududaaday, qarashkiina uu yaraaday.” Wuxuu sheegay in hadda uu si joogto ah u waraabsado beerta, isla markaana uusan ka welwelin kororka qiimaha shidaalka ama helitaankiisa. Dalagyadii u dambeeyay waxay u soo go’een bishii June. Wuxuu ka faa’iday $3,000. Kala bar lacagtaas ayuu sheegay inuu keydsaday. Maxamed oo ah aabbaha lix carruur ah ayaa nolosha qoyska ka dabara beerta. Waa deegaan, isagoo waxbarashada carruurta iyo maareynta qoyska ku bixiya bishii lacag dhan $350, sida uu tilmaamay. Maxamed ayaa sheegay inuu ku jiro waayihiisii ugu wanaagsanaa nolosha iyo dhanka wax soo saarka beerta. “Hadana lacagtii aan ku iibsan jiray shidaalka waxaan u isticmaalaa horumarinta beerta, waxaan ku iibsadaa, abuur tayo leh, bacrimin, daawooyinka dalagga iyo waxyaabo kale oo kordhiya wax soo saarka.” Beeraleyda qaar ayaa isla soo gata qalabka Soollarka, halka kuwo kale ay kaligood soo iibsadaan. Waa mid ku xiran qofka iyo awoodiisa dhaqaale. Guddoomiyaha beeraleyda deegaanka Jarran ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in isticmaalka Soolarku uu sii kordhayo, maadaama beeraleydu ay arkeen faa’iidooyinka uu u leeyahay waraabka iyo yareynta kharashaadka. Wuxuu xusay in illaa iyo hadda ay isticmaalaan 90 beeraley ah. Waa tiro yar marka la barbar dhigo beeraleyda deegaanka. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in lagama maarmaan ay tahay in beeraleydu helaan teegeero dhanka qarashka iyo aqoonta ah, si tiro badan ay uga faa’iideystaan. “Wax-soo-saarka beeraha waxaa ka muuqda isbeddel wanaagsan. Beeraleydu waxay heleen waraab joogto ah. Waxaa loo baahan yahay maalgelin, tababar iyo taageero loo fidiyo beeraleyda si loo ballaariyo isticmaalka tamarta cadceedda.” “Waxaan rajeynaynaa in beeraha Soomaaliya ay horumar sameeyaan, beeraleyduna helaan wax-soo-saar badan iyagoo adeegsanaya tamar nadiif ah.” Cadceeddu waa mid joogta ah oo laga heli karo tamar awood leh oo looga faa’ideysan karo waraabka beeraha, balse waxaaa lagama maarmaan ah in dadku helaan xasilooni amni, maadaama ay ku adag tahay inay la guur guuraan agabkan ama ay dib u iibsadaan haddii ay wax yeelo gaarto. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in lagama maarmaan ay tahay in beeraleydu helaan teegeero dhanka qarashka iyo aqoonta ah, si tiro badan ay uga faa’iideystaan. “Wax-soo-saarka beeraha waxaa ka muuqda isbeddel wanaagsan. Beeraleydu waxay heleen waraab joogto ah. Waxaa loo baahan yahay maalgelin, tababar iyo taageero loo fidiyo beeraleyda si loo ballaariyo isticmaalka tamarta cadceedda.” “Waxaan rajeynaynaa in beeraha Soomaaliya ay horumar sameeyaan, beeraleyduna helaan wax-soo-saar badan iyagoo adeegsanaya tamar nadiif ah.” Cadceeddu waa mid joogta ah oo laga heli karo tamar awood leh oo looga faa’ideysan karo waraabka beeraha, balse waxaaa lagama maarmaan ah in dadku helaan xasilooni amni, maadaama ay ku adag tahay inay la guur guuraan agabkan ama ay dib u iibsadaan haddii ay wax yeelo gaarto. items.title: DF oo ciidamo cusub ku soo bandhigtay Baydhaba + Sawirro
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ciidamo cusub kusoo bandhigtay magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay, kuwaas oo dhammaystay tababar muddo uga socday halkaasi. Taliyaha ciidanka dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa kormeer ugu tegay ciidamadan, maadaama ay dhammaysteen tababarkood, wuxuuna u jeediyay dardaaran culus. Ugu horreyn taliyaha ayaa warbixin ka dhageystay macallimiinta iyo saraakiisha tababarka gacanta ku haya, isaga oo sidoo kale wax ka weydiiyay tababarka, noocyada tababarrada ay ciidamada qaateen iyo farsamooyinka milatari ee la baray. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ciidamada ku bogaadiyay dadaalka ay muujiyeen, wuxuuna kula dardaarmay inay noqdaan kuwo daacad ah oo u heellan gudashada waajibaadkooda qaran. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa muddooyinkan waday dadaallo lagu tayaynayo ciidamada, si ay u yeeshaan awood iyo diyaar-garow ku filan si ay u gutaan waajibaadka Qaran ee saaran. Soo bandhigidda ciidamadan ayaa kusoo aadaya, iyada oo haatan xiisad culus ay ka taagan tahay Baydhaba, taas oo u dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore e Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Xaaladda ayaa hadda deggan, inkastoo ciidamada labada dhinac ay isku horfadhiyaan goobihii laga dagaalamay, taas oo suuragal ka dhigeysa inuu mar kale qarxo dagaalka, culaysna ku noqneysa shacabka ku dhaqan halkaasi. Dagaalladan waxaa barbar socda duqeymo diyaaradeed oo qaar kamid ah saaxibada caalamiga ah ka fulinayaan aagga magaalada Baydhaba, iyada oo lala beegsanayo ciidamada ku sugan halkaas iyo maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab. The post DF oo ciidamo cusub ku soo bandhigtay Baydhaba + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Roobab magiigaan ah oo ka da’ay Muqdisho oo sameeyey isku socodka
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Roobab xooggan oo saacado badan ka da’ayay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa maanta sababay hakad iyo gaabis ku yimid isu socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka ee qaybo badan oo ka mid ah caasimadda. Waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee magaalada ayaa meelo badan waxaa fariistay biyo badan, taas oo adkeysay isu socodka gaadiidka iyo dadka. Qaar ka mid ah waddooyinka ayaa noqday kuwo ciriiri ah, iyadoo gaadiidleyda iyo dadka lugeynaya ay wajahaan caqabado ka dhashay roobka iyo biyaha waddooyinka. Saameynta roobka ayaa sidoo kale gaartay goobaha muhiimka ah ee magaalada, oo ay ka mid yihiin waddada ku dhow Garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde, goobaha waxbarashada iyo xarumaha shaqada. Dad badan ayaa ku adkaatay inay si caadi ah u gaaraan goobahooda waxbarasho iyo shaqo. Roobabkan oo weli da’aya ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in biyuhu sii fariistaan waddooyinka haddii roobku sii socdo. Dadka magaalada ayaa loogu baaqayaa inay taxaddar dheeraad ah muujiyaan, gaar ahaan marka ay marayaan waddooyinka ay biyuhu ku badan yihiin. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda iyo hay’adaha dowladda hoose ayaa looga baaqay inay si degdeg ah uga jawaabaan xaaladda, gaar ahaan meelaha ay biyuhu xireen waddooyinka muhiimka ah, si loo fududeeyo isu socodka bulshada. items.title: Turkey deports 50 Somalis amid anti-Turkey protests
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Turkey deported 50 Somali nationals to Mogadishu’s Aden Adde International Airport on Tuesday as anger over Ankara’s expanding military and economic footprint in Somalia spread through three regional states and reopened a long-simmering debate over who benefits from one of Somalia’s closest foreign partnerships. The group that landed in Mogadishu – 25 men and 25 women – is reportedly the first tranche of nearly 300 Somali nationals rounded up in recent days and held at a detention facility in Istanbul pending possible removal. Some of those facing deportation told Somali media they had committed no offense in Turkey and included university students and workers; others were reportedly suspected of involvement in irregular migration. Turkish authorities have not issued a public statement detailing the reasons for the removals or confirming the total number of Somalis facing expulsion. No official link has been established between the deportations and the protests convulsing Somalia, and Turkish officials have not commented on any connection. But the timing has fueled speculation in Mogadishu that the two are related, arriving as Somalis in Jubaland, Puntland and South West State states stage the most geographically widespread anti-Turkey demonstrations. Three regions, one grievance In Jubaland, thousands protested in Kismayo and Afmadow after a Sept. 4 drone strike hit the residence of Gen. Mahad Abdirahman Shub, a former Somali Custodial Corps commander who has opposed the federal government politically. Jubaland’s information ministry said the strike was politically motivated and injured civilians at the property, and accused Ankara of abandoning any claim to neutrality in Somalia’s internal disputes. Demonstrators burned the Turkish flag and carried images of Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan defaced with blood; banners read “We don’t need Erdoğan.” In South West State, residents around Baidoa have staged repeated protests since early August, burning the Turkish flag and accusing Turkish aircraft of strikes that they say damaged farmland, killed livestock and, in some accounts, killed civilians. In Puntland, protesters near Eyl burned the Turkish flag over the deaths of more than a dozen people described locally as fishermen, killed in August off the Nugaal coast at Garmaal and Jiifle. Local officials have demanded compensation and an explanation from Ankara, which has not publicly addressed the incident. A federal speaker urges restraint Somalia’s Lower House Speaker, Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur Jama, condemned the flag burnings as “appalling” and blamed what he called a “foreign agenda” aimed at damaging Somali-Turkish relations, saying the acts did not reflect Somali public sentiment. He urged Somalis not to let political disputes jeopardize a relationship he credited with sustaining Somalia through humanitarian, development and security support over the past decade. Jama did not name the foreign actors he held responsible. The economic backdrop The unrest unfolds against a backdrop of deepening Turkish involvement in Somalia’s economy and security architecture. Ankara operates Somalia’s largest overseas military base, Camp TURKSOM, has trained more than 15,000 Somali troops, deployed F-16 fighter jets to Mogadishu for the first time this year, and is building a missile-range facility and satellite launch site near the capital. Turkey’s state energy company began Somalia’s first offshore oil drilling campaign in April under a production-sharing agreement whose terms remain undisclosed, in waters Somali officials say may hold up to 30 billion barrels in reserves. Turkish firms also manage Mogadishu’s port and airport under long-term concessions, and the terms have drawn sustained criticism from Somalia’s own oversight bodies. Favori LLC has run Aden Adde International Airport under a 20-year concession since 2013, and Albayrak has operated Mogadishu Port since 2014. Somalia’s Auditor General, Ahmed Issa Gutale, said in August 2024 that neither company had submitted the independently audited financial statements required to verify the government’s share of revenue – a gap his office was still pressing both firms to close as recently as June 2026. A 2021 special audit found Favori had paid the government just 13% of the airport’s gross revenue that year; separately, the government received $3.1 million from airport operations in 2022, well below projections from its own financial advisers. A Eurasia Review analysis of the broader concession landscape additionally flagged an 80-year port concession at Hobyo, signed in 2024, as unusually long by industry standards, and said Parliament has not voted on the underlying Favori and Albayrak agreements. Those terms have hardened a comparison Somalis are increasingly drawing online: the United Arab Emirates, whose port, security and defense agreements with Somalia were annulled by Mogadishu in January over an unrelated sovereignty dispute involving a Yemeni separatist leader’s transit through Somaliland, has not deported Somali nationals in the aftermath. Turkey’s action this week, critics argue, sits uneasily against Ankara’s framing of itself as Somalia’s most steadfast partner. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Madaxweynaha Koonfurta Suudaan oo qaaday tillaabo walaac laga muujiyay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfurta Suudaan, Salva Kiir Mayardit , ayaa xilka ka qaaday Guddoomiyihii Guddiga Qaranka Doorashooyinka dalkaas, Professor Abednego Akok Kacuol , iyadoo ay wax ka yar saddex bilood ka harsan yihiin doorashooyinka madaxtinimada iyo baarlamaanka ee loo qorsheeyay 22-ka Diseembar 2026. Madaxweynaha ayaa xilka guddoomiyaha u magacaabay Gabriel Bol Deng Majok , oo horey u ahaa Xoghayaha Guud ee Guddiga Qaranka Doorashooyinka. Isbeddelka hoggaanka guddiga ayaa lagu dhawaaqay habeenkii Talaadada, 15-ka Sebtembar, iyadoo warbaahinta dowladda ee South Sudan Broadcasting Corporation (SSBC) laga sii daayay warka. Ilaa hadda ma jiro sabab rasmi ah oo dowladda ay ku sheegtay xil-ka-qaadista Professor Akok , taasoo arrinta ka dhigtay mid dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan waqtiga iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karto diyaar-garowga doorashada. Koonfurta Suudaan ayaa qorsheysay in doorashooyinka madaxtinimada iyo baarlamaanka la qabto 22-ka Diseembar 2026 , iyadoo dalka uu muddo dheer ku jiray marxalad ku-meel-gaar ah. Guddiga Doorashooyinka ayaa bishii Juun si rasmi ah u shaaciyay taariikhda doorashada, hase yeeshee wuxuu xilligaas sheegay inay jiraan caqabado la xiriira dhinacyada sharciga iyo dhaqaalaha. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale bishan Sebtembar bilaabay tababarka guddiyada doorashooyinka ee dowlad-goboleedyada iyo saddexda deegaan maamul, si loogu diyaargaroobo diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha. Professor Abraham Kuol Nyuon , oo cilmiga siyaasadda ka dhiga Jaamacadda Juba, ayaa sheegay in isbeddelka hoggaanka xilligan uu saameyn ku yeelan karo jadwalka diyaar-garowga doorashada. Nyuon wuxuu xusay in magacaabista Gabriel Bol Deng ay yareyn karto carqaladda ka dhalan karta isbeddelka, maadaama uu horey uga tirsanaa hoggaanka guddiga isla markaana uu aqoon u leeyahay shaqada hay’adda, hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay in guddoomiyaha cusub uu weli u baahan doono waqti uu si buuxda ula qabsado waajibaadka cusub. Mid ka mid ah hawlaha ugu muhiimsan ee guddiga doorashooyinka ayaa ah diyaarinta diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha, waxaana Guddiga uu 2-dii Sebtembar sheegay in diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaashu aysan weli bilaaban, isla markaana aysan jirin tiro rasmi ah oo cod-bixiyeyaal la diiwaangeliyay. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika oo Ka Wada Hadlay Xoojinta Amniga Xuduudaha iyo La-dagaallanka Argagixisada
items.description: Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Xuseen Qaasim Yuusuf , ayaa xarunta dhexe ee Hay’adda ku qaabilay wafdi uu hoggaaminayay Idriss Mounir Lallali , Agaasimaha Xafiiska La-dagaallanka Argagixisada ee Midowga Afrika. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha Midowga Afrika ee dhinacyada amniga, socdaalka iyo maareynta xuduudaha , iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha ay khuseyso. Qodobada muhiimka ah ee kulanka lagu gorfeeyay waxaa ka mid ahaa wadaagista xogta amniga iyo socdaalka , iyo la socodka dhaqdhaqaaqa dadka looga shakisan yahay inay ku lug leeyihiin falalka argagixisada, gaar ahaan dadka isaga gudba xuduudaha Soomaaliya. Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda ayaa sidoo kale wafdiga Midowga Afrika u soo bandhigtay horumarka ay ka samaysay xaqiijinta iyo hubinta amniga xuduudaha , iyadoo adeegsanaysa teknoolojiyadda casriga ah iyo nidaamyo dhijitaal ah oo lagu maareeyo xogta socdaalka. Nidaamyadaas ayaa lagu sheegay inay gacan ka geysanayaan hagaajinta maamulka xogta socdaalka, xoojinta socdaalka sharciga ah iyo awoodda hay’adaha dowladda ay u leeyihiin inay ogaadaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada laga yaabo inay khatar ku yihiin amniga dalka. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha gobolka ay yeeshaan wada-shaqeyn joogto ah iyo is-dhaafsi xogeed , si wax looga qabto khataraha amni ee xuduudaha isaga gudba. Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda, Xuseen Qaasim Yuusuf, ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda iskaashi dhow oo dhex mara Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha gobolka, isagoo sheegay in wada-shaqeyntu ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta dadaallada looga hortagayo argagixisada iyo dambiyada xuduudaha isaga gudba, iyadoo isla markaana la fududeynayo socdaalka sharciga ah. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo isku-xirka hay’adaha amniga iyo socdaalka ee Soomaaliya iyo kuwa gobolka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada maareynta xuduudaha, xog-is-weydaarsiga iyo ka hortagga khataraha amni ee ka dhasha dhaqdhaqaaqa sharci-darrada ah ee xuduudaha.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo Baydhabo ku Kormeeray Ciidamo Tababar ku Dhammeystay
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar , ayaa maanta magaalada Baydhabo kormeer ugu tegay ciidamo ka tirsan Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed oo tababar ku soo dhammeystay magaalada. Taliyaha ayaa kormeerkiisa ka bilaabay xerada ay ciidamada ku qaadanayeen tababarka, halkaas oo uu warbixin ka dhageystay macallimiinta iyo saraakiisha mas’uulka ka ah tababarka ciidamada. Warbixinta uu Taliyuhu ka dhageystay saraakiisha ayaa la xiriirtay heerka uu marayo tababarka, noocyada tababarrada ay ciidamada qaateen iyo farsamooyinka milatari ee lagu baray muddadii ay tababarka ku jireen. Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa sidoo kale qiimeyn ku sameeyay xaaladda ciidamada iyo heerka ay gaareen marka la eego tababarka iyo diyaar-garowga ay u leeyihiin gudashada waajibaadkooda ciidan. Kormeerkan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed uu ku doonayo in lagu xoojiyo tayada iyo awoodda ciidamada, iyadoo muhiimad la siinayo tababarro joogto ah iyo kor u qaadista xirfadaha askarta. Taliska Ciidanka XDS ayaa muddooyinkii dambe waday dadaallo lagu tayeynayo ciidamada, si loo helo ciidan leh tababar, aqoon iyo diyaar-garow ku filan oo awood u leh gudashada waajibaadka qaran ee loo igmaday. Kormeerka Baydhabo ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Taliska ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya ay wadaan qorshayaal lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada, gaar ahaan deegaanada ay dowladda dooneyso inay ku ballaariso ama ku xoojiso joogitaankeeda amni.

items.title: Shiinaha oo digniin adag u diray Somaliland
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Shiinaha ayaa ugu goodiyey in Somaliland cawaaqib-xumo la kulmi doonto, kaddib markii Madaxweyne Cirro uu ayidey Jasiiradda Taiwan, in ay tahay dalka madax bannaan. Safaaradda Shiinaha ee magaalada Muqdisho, waxa ay hoosta ka xarriiqday in Somaliland ay u aragto Gobol ka tirsan Soomaaliya, sidaasi oo kalena ay tahay Jasiiradda Taiwan. “Gobolka Somaliland wuxuu si cad u jebiyey mabda’a “Hal Shiine” (one-China principle), waana xadgudub ka dhan madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Shiinaha, si adag ayaan uga soo horjeednaa tallaabadaas…Waxaan ku boorrinaynaa siyaasiyiinta tirada yar in ay arkaan xaqiiqda jirta, ku xadgudubka xadka arrinta Taiwan waxay horseedi doontaa cawaaqib xumo daran” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay safaaradda Shiinaha ee Muqdisho. Sidoo kale safiirka Shiinaha, ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay tahay qayb aan laga goyn karin oo ka mid ah dhulka Soomaaliya. waxa uuna Shiinuhu sheegay in si adag u taageerayo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, waxa uuna xusay inuu kasoo horjeedo tallaabo kasta oo lagu kala qaybinayo dhulka Soomaaliyeed. Sikastaba, ma ahan markii ugu horeeysay oo Shiinaha uu si cad u sheego inuu kasoo horjeedo in la kala qeybiyo dhulkooda Soomaaliyeed iyo aqoonsiga Somaliland ay ka heshay Xukuumadda Talaabiib. The post Shiinaha oo digniin adag u diray Somaliland appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .
