items.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland oo khudvad taariikh ah ka jeediyay
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐊𝐡𝐮𝐝𝐛𝐚𝐝 𝐓𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐢𝐤𝐡𝐢 𝐚𝐡 𝐤𝐚 𝐣𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐲𝐞𝐲 𝐌𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐤𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐚𝐡 𝐞𝐞 𝐇𝐮𝐝𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐮𝐭𝐞, 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐨𝐧 𝐃.𝐂. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, H.E. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa khudbad taariikhi ah oo dhinacyo badan taabanaysa ka jeediyey Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Hudson Institute, Washington D.C. Machadkan oo ah Xarun Caalami ah oo Cilmi-baadhiseed, Siyaasadeed iyo Istiraatijiyadeed oo muddo dheer saameyn weyn ku leh doodaha ku saabsan amniga dalka Maraykanka, difaaca, siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda iyo nidaamka caalamiga ah; ayaa waxa hore khudbado uga jeediyey hoggaaminayeyaal iyo dad badan oo dunida magac ku leh; sida: Madaxweynihii hore ee Maraykanka Ronald Reagan, Madaxweyne ku-xigeenadii hore ee Maraykanka Mike Pence iyo Dick Cheney, Ra’iisal Wasaaraha Dalka Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu, Ra’iisal Wasaarihii hore ee Japan Shinzo Abe, Xoghayeyaashii hore ee Arrimaha Dibedda Maraykanka Henry Kissinger, George Schultz, Mike Pompeo, iwm. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha oo ku saabsanayd Somaliland oo ah lamaane (saaxiib) istiraatiiji ah oo ku yaalla Geeska Afrika (Somaliland as a Strategic Partner in the Horn of Africa), Madaxweynuhu waxa uu diiradda ku saaray aragtida Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee ku aaddan amniga Gobolka Geeska Afrika, xasilloonida Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah, ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga, iyo kaalinta ay Somaliland ka qaadan karto danaha wadajirka ah ee Maraykanka iyo xulufadiisa. Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro waxa uu sheegay in muddo ka badan soddon sano, Somaliland ay dhisatay Dawlad shaqaynaysa, Haya’do Qaran oo awood leh, dhaqaale kobcaya iyo suq xor ah. Sida oo kale, waxa uu xusay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay qabatay doorashooyin badan oo kala duwan oo u dhacay si xor iyo xalaal ah, xukunka dalkana si nabad ah loola kala wareegay. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu khudbaddiisa si cad ugu iftiimiyey in muddo ka badan labaatan sano aanu dalka Somaliland gudahiisa ka dhicin wax weerarro argagixiso ahi, Qaranka JSL-na uu ku guulaystay in uu dalka iyo xeebihiisa ka ilaaliyo xag-jirnimada iyo budh-cad badeedda. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay guulahan wax-ku-oolka ah gaadhay iyada oo aan haysan aqoonsi caalami ah. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi mar uu ka hadlayay xaqa sharci iyo ka taariikheed ee jiritaanka Qarannimada Somaliland, waxa uu yidhi: “𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮 𝗱𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗼 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘆 𝗱𝗶𝗯 𝘂 𝗯𝗲𝗱𝗲𝘀𝗵𝗼 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝘂𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗵𝗶𝗶 𝘂𝘂 𝗸𝗮 𝘁𝗮𝗴𝗮𝘆 𝗚𝘂𝗺𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗶𝗴𝘂; 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗱𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗮𝗮 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘆 𝗱𝗶𝗯 𝘂𝗹𝗮 𝘀𝗼𝗼 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝘁𝗼 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝘂𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗵𝗶𝗶 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝘂 𝗹𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗱.” “𝗗𝗼𝗼𝗱𝗱𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗱𝘂 𝗺𝗮 𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗺𝗶𝗱 𝗸𝘂 𝘀𝗮𝗮𝗯𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝗴𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗶-𝗴𝗼𝗼𝘀𝗶, 𝗯𝗮𝗹𝘀𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝘁𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆 𝗯𝘂𝗿𝗯𝘂𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗶 𝗺𝗶𝗱𝗼𝘄𝗴𝗶𝗶 𝗹𝗮𝗴𝘂 𝗵𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗼𝗼𝗯𝗮𝘆 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗱𝗶𝗯-𝘂-𝘀𝗼𝗼-𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗱𝗮𝘄𝗹𝗮𝗱𝗻𝗶𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗶, 𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗼𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗴𝘂 𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘆𝗻𝗮𝘆𝗼 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝘂𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗵𝗶𝗶 𝗴𝘂𝗺𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗰𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗺𝗸𝘂 𝗮𝗾𝗼𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗮, 𝗸𝘂𝘄𝗮𝗮𝘀 𝗼𝗼 𝗷𝗶𝗿𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝗮 𝗵𝗼𝗿 𝗺𝗶𝗱𝗼𝘄𝗴𝗶𝗶 𝟭𝟵𝟲𝟬.” Madaxweynuhu waxa uu xusay in tan iyo markii ay JSL ay dib ula soo noqotay madax-bannaanideeda, isbeddellada Juqraafi-Siyaasadeed ee ka dhacaya daafaha dunida iyo Geeska Afrika ay sii xoojiyeen is-waafajinta danaha wadaagga ah ee u dhexeeya Somaliland iyo Maraykanka. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland mar uu ka hadlayay arrimaha Soomaaliya waxa uu yidhi: “𝗗𝗮𝘄𝗹𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗦𝗼𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝘁𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆 𝗦𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗔𝘄𝗼𝗼𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗺𝘂𝘀𝗵𝗼 𝗺𝗲𝗲𝗹 𝗸𝗮 𝗯𝗮𝘅𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝗠𝘂𝗾𝗱𝗶𝘀𝗵𝗼, 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮𝗻𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝗱𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝘅𝗮𝘀𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗶-𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗚𝗼𝗯𝗼𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗚𝗲𝗲𝘀𝗸𝗮𝗔𝗳𝗿𝗶𝗸𝗮. 𝗦𝗼𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗺𝗮 𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗼𝗼 𝗸𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗳𝗮𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗺𝘂𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗱𝗮𝗱𝗸𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗱𝗮𝗹𝗸𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮; 𝗯𝗮𝗹𝘀𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗮𝘅𝗯𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗮𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗼 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝘂 𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗲𝗴𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝘂𝗯 𝘀𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗼 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗰𝘂𝗿𝘆𝗮𝗮𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗼 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱.” Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si cad u bayaamiyey amniga iyo xasilloonida ka jira Somaliland iyo sida ay Dawladda Maraykanku isugu hallayn karto Somaliland, waxana uu yidhi: “𝗠𝘂𝗱𝗱𝗼 𝟯𝟱 𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗼 𝗮𝗵, 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗸𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗻 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝘆𝗲𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗼 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗿 𝗹𝗼𝗼 𝗴𝗲𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗮𝘀𝗸𝗮𝗿𝗶 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻 𝗮𝗵; 𝗱𝗵𝘂𝗹𝗸𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗴𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗯𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗮 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗴𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗷𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗻 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗮𝗯 𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗗𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗱 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻 𝗹𝗲𝗲𝘆𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆. 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝘆 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝗻 𝗵𝗼𝘆 𝗮𝘆 𝗴𝗮𝗯𝗯𝗮𝗮𝗱 𝗸𝗮 𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗴𝘁𝗮𝗮𝗻 𝗸𝗼𝗼𝘅𝗼 𝗸𝗮 𝘀𝗼𝗼 𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗷𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗮.” Madaxweynaha Somaliland waxa uu khudbaddiisa ku dul istaagay goobta muhiimka ah ee ay ku taallo Somaliland oo ah marin-biyoodyada iyo hilinnada tamarta ugu istiraatiijisan dunida, taasi oo Maraykanka u suurto gelinaysa in uu mandaqaddan ku yeelan karo saaxiib lagu kalsoonaan karo, isla markaana siinaya awood uu ku ilaashan karo danihiisa buqcaddan muhiimka ah, isaga oo aan ku tiirsanaan hal dhinac oo keliya. Waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Somaliland ay Maraykanka u soo bandhigayso ikhtiyaar iyo saaxiib la isku hallayn karo, kaasi oo aanu haatan ku haysan xeebtan. Dhinaca kale, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si gaar ah u xusay in Aqoonsiga Israa’iil uu ka tarjumayo isbeddel cusub oo ku wajahan Geeska Afrika, iyada oo ay Dawladuhu haatan ka gudbayaan hab-dhaqankii diblomaasiyadeed ee duugoobay, iyaga oo qiimayntooda ku salaynaya danaha amni ee la wadaago. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Somaliland iyo Israa’iil ay yihiin laba dal oo dimuqraaddi ah oo ku kala yaalla labada darif ee Badda Cas, kana wada shaqaynaya xasilloonida, barwaaqada iyo amniga Gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo Bariga Dhexe. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Hudson Institute, waxa ay xoojinaysaa dedaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo himiladeeda ku aaddan in Bulshada Caalamku ay si dhab ah u fahanto sooyaalkeeda taariikheed, rabitaanka shacabkeeda, nidaamkeeda dimuqraadiga ah iyo muhiimadda juqraafiyeed iyo ta istiraatiijiyadeed ee ay Somaliland u leedahay Caalamka. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ay ahayd farriin cad oo ku socota Washington iyo saaxiibbada Somaliland: Somaliland waxa ay diyaar u tahay iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo ku dhisan dano wadaag, is-ixtiraam, nabad, amni iyo horumar waara.

Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland mar uu ka hadlayay arrimaha Soomaaliya waxa uu yidhi: “𝗗𝗮𝘄𝗹𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗦𝗼𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝘁𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆 𝗦𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗔𝘄𝗼𝗼𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗺𝘂𝘀𝗵𝗼 𝗺𝗲𝗲𝗹 𝗸𝗮 𝗯𝗮𝘅𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝗠𝘂𝗾𝗱𝗶𝘀𝗵𝗼, 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮𝗻𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝗱𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝘅𝗮𝘀𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗶-𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗚𝗼𝗯𝗼𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗚𝗲𝗲𝘀𝗸𝗮𝗔𝗳𝗿𝗶𝗸𝗮. 𝗦𝗼𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗺𝗮 𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗼𝗼 𝗸𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗳𝗮𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗺𝘂𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗱𝗮𝗱𝗸𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗱𝗮𝗹𝗸𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮; 𝗯𝗮𝗹𝘀𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗮𝘅𝗯𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗮𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗼 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝘂 𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗲𝗴𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝘂𝗯 𝘀𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗼 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗰𝘂𝗿𝘆𝗮𝗮𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗼 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱.” Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si cad u bayaamiyey amniga iyo xasilloonida ka jira Somaliland iyo sida ay Dawladda Maraykanku isugu hallayn karto Somaliland, waxana uu yidhi: “𝗠𝘂𝗱𝗱𝗼 𝟯𝟱 𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗼 𝗮𝗵, 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗸𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗻 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝘆𝗲𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗼 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗿 𝗹𝗼𝗼 𝗴𝗲𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗮𝘀𝗸𝗮𝗿𝗶 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻 𝗮𝗵; 𝗱𝗵𝘂𝗹𝗸𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗴𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗯𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗮 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗴𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗷𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗻 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗮𝗯 𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗗𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗱 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻 𝗹𝗲𝗲𝘆𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆. 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝘆 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝗻 𝗵𝗼𝘆 𝗮𝘆 𝗴𝗮𝗯𝗯𝗮𝗮𝗱 𝗸𝗮 𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗴𝘁𝗮𝗮𝗻 𝗸𝗼𝗼𝘅𝗼 𝗸𝗮 𝘀𝗼𝗼 𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗷𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗮.” Madaxweynaha Somaliland waxa uu khudbaddiisa ku dul istaagay goobta muhiimka ah ee ay ku taallo Somaliland oo ah marin-biyoodyada iyo hilinnada tamarta ugu istiraatiijisan dunida, taasi oo Maraykanka u suurto gelinaysa in uu mandaqaddan ku yeelan karo saaxiib lagu kalsoonaan karo, isla markaana siinaya awood uu ku ilaashan karo danihiisa buqcaddan muhiimka ah, isaga oo aan ku tiirsanaan hal dhinac oo keliya. Waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Somaliland ay Maraykanka u soo bandhigayso ikhtiyaar iyo saaxiib la isku hallayn karo, kaasi oo aanu haatan ku haysan xeebtan. Dhinaca kale, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si gaar ah u xusay in Aqoonsiga Israa’iil uu ka tarjumayo isbeddel cusub oo ku wajahan Geeska Afrika, iyada oo ay Dawladuhu haatan ka gudbayaan hab-dhaqankii diblomaasiyadeed ee duugoobay, iyaga oo qiimayntooda ku salaynaya danaha amni ee la wadaago. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Somaliland iyo Israa’iil ay yihiin laba dal oo dimuqraaddi ah oo ku kala yaalla labada darif ee Badda Cas, kana wada shaqaynaya xasilloonida, barwaaqada iyo amniga Gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo Bariga Dhexe. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Hudson Institute, waxa ay xoojinaysaa dedaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo himiladeeda ku aaddan in Bulshada Caalamku ay si dhab ah u fahanto sooyaalkeeda taariikheed, rabitaanka shacabkeeda, nidaamkeeda dimuqraadiga ah iyo muhiimadda juqraafiyeed iyo ta istiraatiijiyadeed ee ay Somaliland u leedahay Caalamka. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ay ahayd farriin cad oo ku socota Washington iyo saaxiibbada Somaliland: Somaliland waxa ay diyaar u tahay iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo ku dhisan dano wadaag, is-ixtiraam, nabad, amni iyo horumar waara.

items.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland oo kulan saaka la yeeshay
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐨𝐧 𝐃.𝐂. 𝐤𝐮𝐥𝐚𝐧 𝐪𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐚𝐜 𝐚𝐡 𝐤𝐮𝐥𝐚 𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐲 𝐗𝐮𝐛𝐧𝐨 𝐤𝐚 𝐭𝐢𝐫𝐬𝐚𝐧 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬-𝐤𝐚 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐤𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐒𝐚𝐟𝐢𝐢𝐫𝐫𝐨 𝐤𝐚 𝐬𝐨𝐜𝐝𝐚 𝐁𝐞𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐤𝐚 Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa Washington D.C. kulan quraac ah kula yeeshay xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka Maraykanka iyo Safiirro ka kala socda dalal ka tirsan Beesha Caalamka oo fadhigoodu yahay Washington D.C. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xidhiidhka Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka, ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga, iyo doorka muhiimka ah ee ay Somaliland ku leedahay amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa kulanka ku adkeeyey in Somaliland doonayso in loo arko dal istaraatiiji ah oo la isku hallayn karo (Reliable Strategic Partner) nabad ah, xasilloon, leh Hay’ado Dawli ah oo shaqaynaya, isla markaana ku taalla goob juqraafi-siyaasadeed muhiim u ah amniga iyo danaha wadajirka ah ee gobolka iyo caalamka.

items.title: 10 Young Women Begin Journalism Internships Across Somalia
items.description: Ten young women from three Somali universities have begun a four-month journalism internship programme, giving them an opportunity to gain practical experience and strengthen their skills in some of the country’s media organisations. The interns come from the Somali National University, Mogadishu University and Hormuud University. During the four-month programme, they will gain hands-on experience at six media organisations: SONNA, Radio Muqdisho, Somali National Television (SNTV), Astaan Media, Radio Kulmiye and Shabelle Radio & TV. The programme aims to help young women connect their university education with practical newsroom experience. Through the placements, they will have opportunities to develop their skills in reporting, media production and other areas of journalism. For the interns, the opportunity is more than just professional training. It is a chance to take an important step towards careers they have long hoped to pursue. “An opportunity we have been waiting for” Khadijo Salad Abdiqadir, a second-year student at Mogadishu University, said she is very happy to have been selected for the programme. “As women, this is an opportunity we have been hoping for. Bringing young women together, giving them opportunities and connecting them with different media organisations where we can gain valuable experience is very important to us.” Khadijo said the internship could make a significant difference in her life, particularly because she has started her placement at a media organisation where she has always wanted to work. “I hope that by the end of these four months, I will have gained confidence, practical experience and knowledge that will help me in my future career.” She also expressed her appreciation to UNDP for helping make the opportunity possible. “A step towards my dream” Faadumo Abdi Qaasin, a final-year student at the Somali National University, said the internship is an opportunity she has been looking for. “I have always been looking for an internship like this, so this opportunity is very important to me.” Faadumo hopes to use the internship to expand her knowledge and gain the practical experience she needs to pursue a career in journalism. “My dream is to become a skilled and respected journalist who can make a positive contribution to society. I hope this opportunity will be an important step towards achieving that dream.” Creating opportunities for young women The internship programme is part of Bilan Media’s efforts to support young Somali women and create opportunities for them to enter and grow within the media industry. By placing university students in different media organisations, the programme gives the interns an opportunity to learn from experienced journalists, understand professional newsroom environments and build practical skills that can support their future careers. The programme is supported by the European Union in Somalia in partnership with UNDP. For these ten young women, the next four months will be an opportunity to turn classroom knowledge into practical experience and take an important step towards building their careers in Somali journalism. Written by Farhio Mohamed Hussein, Editor-in-Chief of Bilan Media. The post 10 Young Women Begin Journalism Internships Across Somalia first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Trump oo muddo ka dib Safiir u soo magacaabay Somaliya
items.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Danjire Devin Kennington u magacaabay inuu noqdo Safiika xiga Mareykanka ee Somaliya. Magacaabista Safiirka cusub ayaa ka dhigan in Madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu buuxiyay boos diblomaasiyadeed oo bannaanaa, tan iyo bishii December ee sanadkii 2025. Safiirka cusub ayaa noqonaya Safiirkii ugu horreyay ee rasmi ee Washington u joogi doona Muqdisho, tan iyo markii Richard H. items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qayb gashay Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee Golaha Wasiirrada IGAD
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ka qayb gashay Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada Urur-Goboleedka IGAD, kaas oo maanta lagu qabtay magaalada Jabuuti ee Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali, ayaa hoggaaminayay wafdiga Soomaaliya ee ka qayb galay kulanka. Kalfadhiga waxaa sidoo kale ka qayb galay wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah IGAD, kuwaas oo diiradda saaray arrimo muhiim u ah gobolka, gaar ahaan nabadda iyo amniga, xoojinta wadajirka dalalka xubnaha ka ah ururka iyo dib-u-habaynta hay’adaha IGAD. Kulanka ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli gobolka Geeska Afrika uu wajahayo caqabado siyaasadeed, amni iyo bani’aadamnimo oo u baahan iskaashi iyo isku-duubni dheeraad ah oo dhex mara dalalka gobolka. Soomaaliya ayaa kulanka ka muujisay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo iskaashiga gobolka iyo doorka IGAD ee wax ka qabashada arrimaha saameeya nabadda, amniga iyo horumarka dalalka xubnaha ka ah ururka.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Xoojinaysa Iskaashiga Midowga Afrika ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada
items.description: Muqdisho, Sebteembar 15, 2026 — Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, ahna Ku-simaha Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Xildhibaan Cumar Cali Cabdi, ayaa maanta Muqdisho ku qaabilay wafdi ka socday Xarunta Ka-hortagga Argagixisada ee Midowga Afrika (AUCTC). Wafdiga waxaa hoggaaminayay Agaasimaha Xarunta AUCTC, Mudane Idriss Mounir Lallali, iyadoo kulanka diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika ee dhinaca la-dagaallanka iyo ka-hortagga argagixisada. Kulanka ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo awoodda hay’adaha amniga iyo ciidamada qaranka, iyadoo iskaashiga caalamiga ah iyo kan qaaradeed uu muhiim u yahay ka hortagga khataraha amni ee gobolka. Wadahadallada u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo AUCTC ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u noqon kara is-dhaafsiga khibradaha, taageerada farsamo iyo xoojinta hababka looga hortago argagixisada iyo xagjirnimada rabshadaha wata.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Bixinaysa Waxbarashada Tacliinta Sare ee Saddexda Arday ee Ku Guuleystay Tartanka Qur’aanka
items.description: Muqdisho, Sebteembar 15, 2026 — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay saddex arday oo Soomaaliyeed oo kaalmaha koowaad ilaa saddexaad ka galay tartan caalami ah oo Qur’aanka Kariimka ah oo lagu qabtay dalka Qatar. Ardayda uu Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu qaabilay ayaa kala ah Qaari Cabdiqani Cabdiqaadir Sheekh Xuseen, oo ku guuleystay kaalinta koowaad, Qaari Cabdiraxmaan Qaasim Maxamed, oo galay kaalinta labaad, iyo Qaari Cabdiraxmaan Axmed Maxamuud, oo ku guuleystay kaalinta saddexaad. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa ardayda ugu hambalyeeyay guusha taariikhiga ah ee ay Soomaaliya uga soo hoyeen tartanka caalamiga ah, isagoo ku ammaanay dadaalkooda, kartidooda iyo sida ay magaca Soomaaliya uga dhex muuqdeen tartanka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale ballanqaaday in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay bixin doonto waxbarashada tacliinta sare ee saddexda arday, si ay u sii wataan waxbarashadooda una horumariyaan aqoontooda iyo xirfaddooda. Guusha ay ardaydan ka gaareen tartanka Qur’aanka Kariimka ah ayaa loo arkaa guul sharaf u ah Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed ee ku dadaalaya barashada, xifdinta iyo fahamka Qur’aanka Kariimka ah. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa marar badan adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay taageeridda dhallinyarada, waxbarashada iyo kobcinta aqoonta, iyadoo guulaha noocan ah ay dhiirrigelin u yihiin jiilka cusub ee Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaal culus oo ka socda Yemen
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) – Dagaallo culus ayaa saacadihii lasoo dhaafay ka socday qaybo ka mid ah dalka Yemen, gaar ahaan gobolka Maarib, xilli dalkaasi uu weli wajahayo xaalad siyaasadeed iyo amni oo cakiran. Gobolka Maarib ayaa ah goobta ugu muhiimsan ee ay ciidamada dowladda Yemen ka haystaan dhulka waqooyiga dalka, waxaana halkaasi isku haya ciidamada dowladda iyo Xuutiyiinta oo muddo dheer dagaal kula jiray dowladda dhexe. Maarib ayaa labada dhinac u ah goob istiraatiiji ah, maadaama uu gobolka leeyahay goobo muhiim u ah soo saarista shidaalka iyo gaaska Yemen. Sidaas darteed, gacan ku haynta gobolka ayaa saameyn weyn ku yeelan karta awoodda dhaqaale iyo tan militari ee dhinacyada isku haya dalka. Haddii Xuutiyiintu ay awood u yeeshaan inay si buuxda ula wareegaan Maarib, arrintaasi waxay dhabar-jab weyn ku noqon kartaa dowladda Yemen, maadaama gobolka uu yahay mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay weli ku leedahay awood ciidan iyo dhaqaale. Xuutiyiinta iyo loollanka Badda Cas Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iran ayaa sidoo kale muddooyinkii dambe xoogga saarayay deegaanada ku dhow xeebaha Badda Cas, taas oo siin karta fursad ay ku sii xoojiyaan awooddooda dhanka marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Baab Al-Mandab. Dhinaca kale, dowladda Yemen waxaa taageera Boqortooyada Sacuudiga Carabiya, oo siisa taageero amni iyo mid militari, iyadoo sidoo kale duqeymo ka fulisay goobaha ay Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayaan. Xaaladda Yemen ayaa muddo dheer ahayd mid u dhaxaysa dagaal iyo kala qeybsanaan siyaasadeed, iyadoo dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay iyo Xuutiyiintu ay si gaar ah u kala maamulaan qaybo ka mid ah dalka. Soomaaliya iyo dowlado kale oo caalami ah ayaa horey ugu baaqay dhinacyada Yemen inay wada-hadal ku dhammeeyaan khilaafka. Si kastaba, dagaalka Yemen ayaa xoogaystay tan iyo 2014-kii, xilligaas oo Xuutiyiintu ay qabsadeen caasimadda Sanca, isla markaana ay meesha ka saareen dowladdii uu hoggaaminayay Madaxweyne Cabdirabbu Mansuur Hadi. Tan iyo xilligaas, Yemen waxay wajahday dagaal daba dheeraaday oo ay ku lug yeesheen dhinacyo gudaha ah iyo quwado shisheeye, taas oo dalka ka dhigtay goob muhiim u ah loollanka siyaasadeed iyo militari ee Bariga Dhexe. Xaaladda Yemen ayaa sidoo kale si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Soomaaliya, maadaama labada dal ay kala xigaan dhinaca Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas, halka marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab uu yahay mid muhiim u ah isu socodka ganacsiga iyo amniga gobolka. items.title: Hirshabeelle: Himilo, Hoggaan iyo Horumar — Fursadda Cusub ee Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe
items.description: Soomaaliya waxay muddo dheer ku jirtay geeddisocod adag oo dib loogu dhisayo nidaamka dawladnimada. Weydiintu keliya ma ahayn sida loo dhiso hay’ado dawladeed, balse sidoo kale sida loo abuuri karo nidaam siyaasadeed oo bulshada Soomaaliyeed iyo degaannadeeda si dhab ah la isugu soo dhoweyn karo. Hirgelinta nidaamka federaalku waxay ahayd mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinkii muhiimka ahaa ee dibudhiska dawladnimada, hasayeeshee weli waxaa taagan dood ku saabsan in nidaamka federaalku si buuxda ugu habboon yahay xaaladda Soomaaliya. Hayeeshee, waaya-aragnimada dawladgoboleedyada la dhisay waxay muujisay in dawladdhisiddu aysan ku ekaan karin samaynta maamul, baarlamaan iyo madaxweyne. Waxay u baahan tahay heshiis siyaasadeed, awoodqaybsi dheellitiran, kalsooni bulsho, hay’ado shaqeeya iyo hannaan ay dadka degaannadu ku dareemaan in dawladnimadu tahay mid ay wada leeyihiin. Hirshabeelle waxay ka mid tahay dawladgoboleedyada si gaar ah u muujinaya caqabadaha iyo fursadaha ku xeeran geeddisocodkaas. Hirshabeelle waxaa la aasaasay sannadkii 2016, iyadoo la isku daray gobollada Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe, xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirtay marxalad siyaasadeed oo kalaguur ah, loona baahnaa dhammaystirka geeddisocodka federaalka. Dhismaha maamulka cusub wuxuu ahaa tallaabo ka mid ah dhammaystirka nidaamka federaalaynta Soomaaliya. Hasayeeshee, bilowgii dhismaha maamulka waxaa hareeyay doodo iyo tabashooyin la xiriiray habka loo dhisay, awoodqaybsiga, matalaadda iyo sida labada gobol loogu wada abuuri lahaa dheelitirnaan siyaasadeed. Markii la dhisay Hirshabeelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Cosoble ayaa loo doortay madaxweyne, halka Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Guudlaawe) loo doortay madaxweyne-ku-xigeen. Doorashadii 17kii Oktoobar 2016 waxay ahayd tallaabo taariikhi ah, waxaase jiray diidmo toos ah oo ka imanaysay magaalada Beledweyne. Muddo kooban kaddib, waxaa soo baxay khilaaf siyaasadeed oo culus. 14kii Agoosto 2017, Madaxweyne Cosoble waxaa laga gudbiyey mooshin xil-ka-qaadis ah, waxaana 16kii Sebtembar 2017 madaxweyne loogu doortay Maxamed Cabdi Waare, kaas oo helay 75 cod. Waare wuxuu xilka qabtay xilli Hirshabeelle ay la tacaalaysay khilaaf siyaasadeed, caqabado amni iyo musiibooyin dabiici ah. Intii uu hoggaaminayay maamulka, waxaa lagu xusuustaa doorkii uu ka qaatay dhismaha hay’adaha dawladda Hirshabeelle, arrimaha amniga, dhismaha ciidanka Daraawiishta iyo doodihii ku saabsanaa dawladdhiska federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan shirarkii ka dhacay Baydhabo iyo Dhuusamareeb. Ugu danbayntii, 3dii Nofeenbar 2020 ayuu xilka ka tagay, waxaana Hirshabeelle mar kale gashay marxalad siyaasadeed oo cusub. Cosoble iyo Waare, oo labaduba ka soo jeeda Beledweyne, midkoodna ma helin taageerada beeshiisa; mar kasta Beledweyne laguma qanacsanayn habkii loo maray dhismaha Hirshabeelle. Sannadkii 2020, markii la galay dhismihii labaad ee Hirshabeelle, waxaa mar kale soo baxay weydiimo ku saabsan hoggaanka iyo awoodqaybsiga. Xilligaas, Cali-Guudlaawe, oo hore u ahaa madaxweyne kuxigeenka Hirshabeelle, ayaa loo doortay madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle. Waxaa jiray dareen ah in awoodqaybsiga iyo matalaadda aan weli si buuxda loogu heshiin; taasina waxay saamayn ku yeelatay xiriirka labada gobol iyo sida ay bulshada qaarkeed u aragto maamulka Hirshabeelle. Marka laga yimaado taariikhda iyo caqabadihii siyaasadeed ee Hirshabeelle, waxaa muhiim ah in si gaar ah loo fahmo kaalinta iyo waaya-aragnimada Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe. Guudlaawe ma aha siyaasi ku cusub siyaasadda iyo maamulka degaannada maanta ka tirsan Hirshabeelle. In ka badan 20 sannadood ayuu xiriir iyo shaqo siyaasadeed ku lahaa degaannadan, taas oo siisay waaya-aragnimo iyo faham ku saabsan bulshada, degaanka iyo caqabadaha siyaasadeed ee labada gobol. Waaya-aragnimadaas dheer waxay sidoo kale ka dhigtay siyaasi si wanaagsan u fahmi kara iskuxirka siyaasadda degaanka iyo tan heer federaal. Xilkaas wuxuu u noqday fursad uu si toos ah uga qaybqaato marxaladdii ugu horreysay ee dhismaha maamulka. Intii uu hayey xilka madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka, wuxuu kaalin ka qaatay dhismaha hay’adaha dawladda, xasilloonida labada gobol, xalinta khilaafaadka iyo dadaallada dibuheshiisiinta. Sidoo kale, muddadaas wuxuu kasbaday waaya-aragnimo ku saabsan sida loo maareeyo siyaasadda gudaha ee Hirshabeelle iyo xiriirka siyaasadeed ee kala duwan ee u dhexeeya dawladgoboleedka iyo Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Markii Hirshabeelle gashay dhismihii labaad, Guudlaawe ayaa horraantii Nofeembar 2020 loo doortay madaxweynaha dawladgoboleedka, xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirtay marxalad siyaasadeed oo adag, isla markaana dalku isu diyaarinayay doorashooyinkii federaalka. Xilligaas, khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee heer federaal waxay ahaayeen kuwo xooggan, waxaana Guudlaawe door ka qaatay dadaalladii lagu xallinayey ismariwaagii siyaasadeed ee doorashooyinka federaalka. Dhanka kale, Hirshabeelle waxay xilligaas noqotay mid ka mid ah dawladgoboleedyadii laga soo doortay xildhibaanno badan oo mucaarad ahaa, iyadoo qaar badan oo ka mid ahi aysan taageersanayn doorashadii Guudlaawe. Tani waxay muujinaysay in hoggaankiisu ka bilaabmay marxalad siyaasadeed oo aan sahlanayn, una baahnayd isku dheellitirnaan u dhexaysa siyaasadda gudaha ee Hirshabeelle iyo tan heer federaal. Dabcan, hoggaaminta dawladgoboleed habraaca dhismihiisa la isku diiddan yahay, oo ka jira dal ay bulshadiisu weli ka soo kabanayso colaado sokeeye, isla markaana ay jiraan tabashooyin siyaasadeed iyo kalsoonidarro bulsho, ma aha hawl fudud. Hoggaamiye keliya lagama filan karo inuu muddo kooban ku xalliyo dhammaan caqabadaha siyaasadeed, amni, dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee soo jiray muddo dheer. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, hoggaanka waxaa lagu qiimeeyaa sida uu uga faa’iidaysto fursadaha jira, sida uu u dhiso hay’adaha iyo sida uu caqabadaha ugu beddelo fursado horumarineed. Muddadii Cali-Guudlaawe uu xilalka ka hayey Hirshabeelle, laga soo bilaabo madaxweyne-ku-xigeen ilaa madaxweyne, waxaa jira waxyaabo la taaban karo oo lagu xusi karo. Waxaa si weyn loogu ammaanaa dhismaha xarumaha dawladda Hirshabeelle, oo ay ka mid yihiin qaar ka mid ah wasaaradaha iyo madaxtooyada Hirshabeelle, iyo waddooyin laga hirgeliyey Jowhar, Beledweyne iyo magaalooyin kale. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu tilmaamaa siyaasi xasilloon oo qunyarsocod ah, waxaana lagu ammaanaa inuu door ka qaatay in Hirshabeelle ay xiriir wanaagsan la yeelato Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Hasayeeshee, hoggaamiyuhu ma aha malaa’ig, Soomaaliduna waxay tiraahdaa: “Gaalka dil, gartana sii.” Sidaas darteed, marka laga soo tago waxqabadkiisa, waxaa jira fursado badan oo Hirshabeelle horyaallay oo aan weli si buuxda looga faa’iidaysan; arrintaasna qayb ahaan waxaa sabab u ah farsamaxumo iyo daciifnimo ka jirta fulinta hay’adaha. Madaxweyne Cali-Guudlaawe waxaa horyaalla dhowr arrimood oo mudnaan gaar ah leh, kuwaas oo go’aamin kara jihada siyaasadeed iyo mustaqbalka dawladdhiska Hirshabeelle. Marka koowaad, waxaa muhiim ah in xoogga la saaro dhismaha nabadda iyo wadajirka labada gobol. Dibuheshiisiintu waa in aysan noqon heshiis siyaasadeed oo kumeelgaar ah oo lagu gaaro duruuf gaar ah, ayse noqotaa hannaan lagu dhisayo kalsooni, is-aaminaad iyo aragti siyaasadeed oo labada dhinac si wadajir ah u leeyihiin. Haddii aan la helin heshiis siyaasadeed oo labada gobol si dhab ah ugu qanacsan yihiin, waxaa adkaan karta in Hirshabeelle yeelato xasillooni siyaasadeed oo waarta. Marka labaad, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka Hiiraan waa arrin mudan in aan la iska indho tirin. Taariikhda Hirshabeelle waxay ina baraysaa in marxaladaha siyaasadeed ee xasaasiga ahi mararka qaarkood horseedi karaan isbeddello degdeg ah oo lagu sameeyo hoggaanka Hiiraan, taas oo dhalin karta xasilloonidarro siyaasadeed oo ka duwan kuwii hore. items.fullContent: Soomaaliya waxay muddo dheer ku jirtay geeddisocod adag oo dib loogu dhisayo nidaamka dawladnimada. Weydiintu keliya ma ahayn sida loo dhiso hay’ado dawladeed, balse sidoo kale sida loo abuuri karo nidaam siyaasadeed oo bulshada Soomaaliyeed iyo degaannadeeda si dhab ah la isugu soo dhoweyn karo. Hirgelinta nidaamka federaalku waxay ahayd mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinkii muhiimka ahaa ee dibudhiska dawladnimada, hasayeeshee weli waxaa taagan dood ku saabsan in nidaamka federaalku si buuxda ugu habboon yahay xaaladda Soomaaliya. Hirshabeelle waxay ka mid tahay dawladgoboleedyada si gaar ah u muujinaya caqabadaha iyo fursadaha ku xeeran geeddisocodkaas. items.title: Mareykanka oo xaqiijiyay inuu hub dagaal geeyay hawada sare
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa markii ugu horreysay si rasmi ah u xaqiijisay in ay hawada sare geysay hub loogu tala-galay hawl-gallada dagaalka hawada sare, taas oo muujinaysa isbeddel cusub oo ku yimid awoodda milatari ee Washington ee ka baxsan jawiga Dhulka. Xoghayaha Ciidanka Cirka Mareykanka, Troy Meink ayaa sheegay in hubka hawada sare ku sugan uu muhiim u yahay ilaalinta ciidamada Mareykanka iyo ka hortagga khataraha uga iman kara dalalka ay loollanka milatari kala dhexeeyo. Meink ayaa caddeeyay in Mareykanku diyaar u yahay inuu wajaho waxa uu ku tilmaamay “khataraha isbeddelaya”, balse ma uusan shaacin nooca hubka la geeyay iyo waqtigii hawada sare loo diray. Maxaa Washington ku riixay hubka hawada sare? Hoggaamiyeyaasha milatariga Mareykanka ayaa muddooyinkii dambe sheegay in Washington ay qorshaynayso inay sii xoojiso awooddeeda milatari ee hawada sare, xilli Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ay horumarinayaan teknoolojiyado lagu weerari karo ama lagu carqaladeyn karo dayax-gacmeedyada muhiimka u ah ciidamada Mareykanka. Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sidoo kale awoodaha milatari ee hawada sare iyo nidaamyada gantaallada wax-ka-qabta ku daray qorshaha difaaca ee loo yaqaan “Golden Dome”, kaas oo loogu talagalay in Mareykanka laga ilaaliyo gantaallada iyo khataraha kale ee hawada. Heshiis caalami ah oo la saxiixay 1967-kii ayaa mamnuucaya in hubka wax gumaada lagu geeyo ama lagu keydiyo hawada sare. Si kastaba, Mareykanka, Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ayaa sannadihii dambe horumarinayay awoodo kale oo aan si toos ah uga hor imaanayn heshiiskaas, oo ay ka mid yihiin awoodda lagu bartilmaameedsan karo dayax-gacmeedyada. Dayax-gacmeedyadu waxay door muhiim ah ka ciyaaraan isgaarsiinta milatari, sirdoonka, la socodka iyo hagidda ciidamada, taas oo ka dhigaysa inay noqdaan bartilmaameed muhiim ah haddii uu dagaal ka dhex qarxo quwadaha waaweyn. Ruushka iyo Shiinaha oo kordhinaya tartanka hawada sare Madaxweyne Trump ayaa sannadkii hore soo saaray amar xoojinaya doorka Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Mareykanka, isagoo sheegay in awoodda ciidanku aysan ku koobnaan doonin oo keliya difaaca hantida Mareykanka ee hawada sare, balse ay yeelan karto awood weerar. Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Mareykanka (US Space Force), oo la aas-aasay 2019-kii, ayaa loo sameeyay ilaalinta hantida Mareykanka ee hawada sare, oo ay ku jiraan boqolaal dayax-gacmeed oo muhiim u ah isgaarsiinta iyo hawlgallada milatari. Afhayeen u hadlay ciidamada ayaa sheegay in “xakamaynta hawada sare” ay ka dhigan tahay awoodda lagu tartami karo laguna xakameyn karo goobta hawada sare, iyadoo la adeegsanayo habab waxyeello geysta iyo kuwo aan waxyeello toos ah geysan si loo carqaladeeyo, loo wiiqo ama haddii loo baahdo loo burburiyo awoodaha cadowga. Dhinaca kale, horraantii bishii Febraayo ayaa la shaaciyay in laba dayax-gacmeed oo Ruushku leeyahay ay u badan tahay inay dhexgaleen ama qabteen isgaarsiinta ugu yaraan 12 dayax-gacmeed oo Yurub leedahay tan iyo markii Ruushku duullaanka ku qaaday Ukraine 2022-kii. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale 2024-kii sheegay in Ruushku hawada sare u diray dayax-gacmeed uu Washington ku qiimeysay inuu awood u leeyahay inuu weeraro dayax-gacmeedyo kale. Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Shiinaha inuu horumarinayo oo adeegsanayo awoodo hawada sare iyo kuwa lidka-hawada sare ah, halka Ruushkana lagu tilmaamay dal hawada sare u arka goob dagaal oo muhiim u noqon karta natiijada dagaallada mustaqbalka. Horumarradan ayaa muujinaya in loollanka milatari ee quwadaha waaweyn uu si tartiib ah ugu sii fidayo hawada sare, iyadoo dayax-gacmeedyada iyo nidaamyada ku shaqeeya orbit-ka Dhulka ay noqonayaan qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qorshayaasha difaac iyo weerar ee dalalka awoodda leh. items.title: Golaha Aqalka Sare oo u yeeray wasiirka dhallinyarada iyo ciyaaraha kadibna…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Horumarinta Adeegga Bulshada, Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada, Warfaafinta iyo Dhaqanka ee Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta xafiiskooda ugu yeeray mas’uuliyiinta Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha ee XFS. Mas’uuliyiinta wasaaradda waxaa hoggaaminayay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Cali, waxaana kulanka ka qeyb-galay mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan wasaaradda. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray isla-xisaabtan iyo xog-wareysi ku saabsan hannaanka shaqo ee wasaaradda, iyadoo wasiirka si gaar ah wax looga weydiiyay qorshe-hawleedka wasaaradda iyo howlaha ay waddo. Xubnaha guddiga ayaa sidoo kale wasiirka su’aalo ka weydiiyay horumarinta ciyaaraha dalka, dhismaha iyo dayactirka garoomada isboortiga, iyo xiriirka wasaaradda iyo dowlad-goboleedyada xubnaha ka ah Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha ayaa si waafi ah uga jawaabay dhammaan su’aalihii ay xubnaha guddigu hor-dhigeen, isagoo si faahfaahsan uga hadlay howlaha iyo qorshayaasha mudnaanta u leh Wasaaradda. Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Cali ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay kaalinta wasaaraddu ku leedahay horumarinta ciyaaraha dalka, kobcinta iyo kor u qaadista xirfadaha dhallinyarada, iyo abuurista fursado ay dhallinyaradu ku horumarin karaan kartidooda iyo hal-abuurkooda. Guddoomiyaha guddiga, Senator Cismaan Maxamuud Maxamed (Dufle) oo shir guddoomiyay kulanka ayaa wasiirka uga mahadceliyay sida hufan, faahfaahsan oo togan ee uu uga jawaabay su’aalihii la hor-dhigay. Wuxuu sheegay in kulanku uu qayb muhiim ah ka yahay xoojinta isla-xisaabtanka, korjoogteynta iyo qiimeynta waxqabadka hay’adaha dowladda, iyo adkeynta wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha dowladda iyo Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. items.title: Bannaanbax lagu muujinayo taageerada loo hayo Turkiga oo ka dhacay Baydhabo (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Bannaanbaxan oo lagu taageerayo doorka Turkiga ee garab istaaga dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ayaa maanta lagu qabtay Garoonka Kubadda Cagta Dr. Ayuub ee Magaalada Baydhabo. Bannaanbaxa oo ahaa mid uu soo qaban-qaabiyay Maamulka Degmada Baydhabo ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Maamulka Gobolka Baay, kan degmada iyo bulshada qaybaheeda kala duwan. Ujeedka ayaa ahaa in Dowladda Turkiga looga mahadceliyo taageeradeeda hagar la’aaneed ee dalka iyo xiriirka adag ee ay la leedahay Dowladda Soomaaliyeed. Masuuliyiintii la hadlay dibadbaxayaasha ayaa si isku mida u sheegay in dadka reer Baydhabo iyo guud ahaanba shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay dareen iyo taageeraba u qabaan dowladda iyo shacabka Turkiga. Turkiga oo lagu tilmaamo saaxiib muhiim ah oo Somaliya ay leedahay ayaa ka taageera dhinacyada amniga, difaaca, dib-u-dhiska iyo qalabaynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, horumarinta iyo gargaarka bani’aadantinimo. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa meeshii ugu sarreysay gaaray dhowr iyo tobankii sano ee u dambeeyay. Turkiga ayaa Muqdisho ku leh saldhigga ugu weyn ee militari ee uu ku leeyahay meel ka baxsan dalkiisa, waana Xerada Militariga TURKSOM iyo dhismaha safaaradeed ee ugu weyn ee caalamka uu ku leeyahay. Turkiga oo xulafo la ah Somaliya ayaa door hoggaamineed ka qaata dhismaha iyo xoojinta ee awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, waana dowladda maalgashiga ugu ballaaran ku sameysata Somaliya. Turkiga ayaana ku howlan, sidii uu shidaal uga soo saari lahaa xeebaha dalka. Bannaanbaxa Baydhabo ayaa imanaya, ka dib markii xulafada Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ay Turkiga ku eedeeyeen in Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ay si guracan u adeegsaneyso taageeradiisa militari. Mucaaradka uu Laftagareen hoggaamiyo ayaa si adag Turkiga ugu eedeeyay in uu ka masuul ahaa duqayntii xagga cirka ee 3-dii bishan loo gaystay hoyga uu Taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan (Taliye Shub) uu ka deganaa Degmada Doolow ee Gobolka Gedo.

items.title: Sawirro: Taliye Maslax oo gaaray Masagawaa – Maxaa socda?
items.description: Masagawaa (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Guutada 77-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Korneyl Maslax Maxamuud Maxamed ayaa gaaray magaalada Masagawaa ee gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo uu kormeer iyo kuurgalid ku sameeyay xaaladda ciidanka iyo howlaha ay ka hayaan deegaanka. Taliyaha ayaa mid mid u booqday fariisimaha iyo goobaha ay Guutada 77-aad kaga sugan yihiin magaalada Masagawaa iyo deegaannada ku xeeran, isagoo indha-indheeyay xaaladda ciidanka iyo habsami-u-socodka howlaha shaqo. Intii uu ku guda jiray kormeerka, Korneyl Maslax Maxamuud Maxamed ayaa qiimeyn ku sameeyay xaaladda guud ee ciidamada iyo sida ay u gutaan waajibaadkooda amni ee loo igmaday. Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale warbixinno ka dhageystay saraakiisha iyo taliyeyaasha ururrada Guutada 77-aad ee ka howlgala Masagawaa, kuwaas oo faah-faahin ka bixiyay xaaladda ciidanka iyo howlaha ay ka wadaan halkaasi. Saraakiisha ayaa Taliyaha uga warbixiyay xaaladda amni ee deegaanka iyo howlaha ay ciidamada ka wadaan deegaannada bariga gobolka Galgaduud iyo sidoo kale adeegyada ay u hayaan bulshada ku nool deegaannadaasi. Kormeerka Taliyaha ayaa qeyb ka ah howlaha lagu qiimeynayo xaaladda ciidamada, iyadoo sidoo kale diiradda lagu saaray u kuurgalidda howlaha ka socda deegaanka iyo hubinta diyaar-garowga ciidamada. Guutada 77-aad ayaa sidoo kale door ka qaadata howlaha amni iyo howl-gallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ee ka socda deegaannada gobolka Galgaduud, iyadoo kormeerka Taliyaha uu ku qotomo xoojinta diyaar-garowga iyo gudashada waajibaadka ciidanka. items.title: Xisbiga Sheekh Shaakir oo sheegay in aargoosi looga reebay doorashada Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Ururka siyaasadeed ee Towfiiq oo uu hoggaamiyo Sheekh Shaakir ayaa si adag uga horyimid go’aanka guddiga doorashada ee looga reebay liiska ururrada loo oggolaaday inay ka qeyb galaan doorashada ku celiska ah ee maamulka Galmudug. Ururka ayaa sheegay inuusan aqbalayn go’aankaasi, isagoo caddeeyay inuu diyaar u yahay ka qeyb-galka doorashada, balse uu doonayo in hannaanka doorashada loo maro sharciga, xeerarka iyo habraacyada loo dejiyay. Towfiiq ayaa sheegay in arrinta ay si gaar ah walaac ugu abuurtay, maadaama uu ahaa ururkii horey maxkamadda uga dalbaday in dib loogu laabto doorashadii Galmudug, kadib markii uu ku dooday in la jebiyay qaar ka mid ah shuruucda iyo habraacyada doorashada. “Waxaa layaab noqotay in ururkii dalbaday saxidda doorashada uu baraha bulshada ku arko ka reebiddiisa doorashada,” ayuu yiri Towfiiq, oo wax lala yaabo ku tilmaamay go’aanka guddiga doorashada. Ururka ayaa sidoo kale xusay in guddiga doorashada ay hayaan liiska musharraxiintiisa u tartamaya labada gole, taas oo uu ku tilmaamay caddeyn muujinaysa in Towfiiq uu diyaar u ahaa ka qeybgalka hannaanka doorashada. Towfiiq ayaa guddiga doorashada ugu baaqay inay ilaaliyaan dhex-dhexaadnimada, isla markaana ay ka fogaadaan tallaabo kasta oo loo fasiran karo eex ama takoor siyaasadeed. Ururka ayaa tilmaamay in go’aanka looga reebay doorashada uu u muuqdo mid aargoosi ah oo xiriir la leh dacwaddii uu horey uga gudbiyay natiijadii doorashada. “Waxaan aaminsanahay in go’aankan uu xiriir la leeyahay dacwaddii aan horey uga gudbinnay natiijadii doorashada,” ayuu ururku sheegay, isagoo ku tilmaamay arrintaas mid aan waafaqsanayn mabaadi’da caddaaladda iyo hannaanka doorashooyinka xorta ah. Ururka Towfiiq ayaa ugu baaqay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya inuu arrinta soo farageliyo, isla markaana uu gacan ka geysto sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa u hoggaansanaanta sharciga iyo hanaan doorasho oo cadalaad ah. “Taageerayaasheena iyo bulshada reer Galmudug waxaa ugu baaqayna inay u diyaar garoobaan kulamo iyo bannaanbaxyo nabadeed oo lagu muujinayo mowqifkooda ku aaddan doorashada ay ku doonayaan inay u dhacdo si xor iyo xalaal ah,” ayuu ugu dambeyntiina ku baaqay ururka. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo sheegtay inay la wareegeen jasiirado u dhow Geeska Afrika
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegtay inay la wareegeen jasiiradaha Hanish ee u dhow Geeska Afrika. Eritrea iyo Yemen ayaa muddo isku hayay lahaanshaha jasiiradaha ku yaalla koonfurta Badda Cas. Sida ay sheegtay wakaaladda wararka AP, Xuutiyiintu waxay dib u riixeen ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee uu taageero Sacuudigu, waxayna la wareegeen gacan ku haynta aaggan muhiimka ah. Jasiiradahan ayaa ku yaalla meel u dhow xadka u dhexeeya Eritrea iyo Jabuuti. Xuutiyiinta oo la wareegay aagaggaas ayaa sidaas ugu soo dhowaaday ciidamada Mareykanka ee ku sugan Jabuuti, masaafo dhan 32 kiiloomitir. Markii Eritrea ay xornimadeeda qaadatay, waxay dagaal la gashay Yemen oo ku saabsan lahaanshaha jasiiradahaas. Intii uu socday dagaalkaas kooban, ciidamada Eritrea waxay muddo gaaban gacanta ku dhigeen jasiiradda Hanish. Hase yeeshee, muranka waxaa loo gudbiyay maxkamad caalami ah, waxaana lagu go’aamiyay in jasiiradaha aan la deggenayn, marka laga reebo goobaha kalluumeysiga, ay hoos yimaadaan maamulka Yemen. Xuutiyiinta oo tan iyo toddobaadkii hore gacanta ku hayay dekedo iyo jasiirado ku yaalla Badda Cas, ayaa sidoo kale la wareegay magaalada dekedda ah ee Waqa iyo jasiiradda Perim, ka hor intii aysan la wareegin Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan kadib marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Tallaabadan ayaa u sahashay Xuutiyiinta inay si fudud u xakameeyaan marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. items.title: Somaliland Reveals Growing Ties With Puntland
items.description: Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi “Irro” has said relations between Somaliland and Puntland have improved since 2024, citing increased cooperation on security and the movement of people and vehicles across the two administrations. Speaking about the relationship between his government and Puntland, Irro said the two sides maintain close ties and have cooperated in addressing shared security concerns, particularly terrorism and piracy. The president said Somaliland and Puntland had also worked to restore cross-border movement, which was disrupted following the fighting in Las Anod. He said traffic has since resumed along the road linking El-Dahir and Erigavo in the Sanaag region. Irro also addressed the situation in areas currently administered by the North East State, saying Somaliland would pursue a peaceful approach to resolving the dispute. He said Somaliland would adopt what he described as a “white flag” approach toward Las Anod, signalling his administration’s intention to pursue a peaceful resolution and help restore stability in the city. The comments come amid continuing political and territorial disputes over Las Anod and surrounding areas in northern Somalia. The region has remained a focal point of tensions involving Somaliland, Puntland and the emerging North East State administration. Irro’s remarks indicate that his administration intends to prioritize dialogue, security cooperation and the restoration of cross-border movement in its engagement with Puntland and communities in the disputed eastern regions. items.title: Trump oo safiir cusub u soo magacaabay Soomaaliya
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Devin Kennington u magacaabay inuu noqdo safiirka cusub ee Mareykanka u fadhiya Soomaaliya, iyadoo magacaabistan ay hadda u gudubtay Aqalka Senate-ka si loo ansixiyo. Aqalka Cad ayaa 14-kii September sheegay in Kennington, oo kasoo jeeda gobolka California, loo magacaabay xilka “Safiirka aan Caadiga ahayn iyo Wakiilka Awoodda Buuxda leh ee Mareykanka u fadhiya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya.” Kennington ma bilaabi karo shaqada safiirnimo ilaa Senate-ka Mareykanka uu ansixiyo magacaabistiisa. Haddii la xaqiijiyo, wuxuu noqon doonaa safiirkii ugu horreeyay ee si rasmi ah xilkaas u qabta tan iyo markii Richard H. Riley uu ka tagay Soomaaliya horraantii sanadkan. Riley, oo ahaa diblomaasi muddo dheer kasoo shaqeynayay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, ayaa lagu daray safiiro uu maamulka Trump dib ugu yeeray Washington bishii December 2025, xilli maamulka cusub uu dib-u-habeyn ku sameynayay wakiilladiisa diblomaasiyadeed ee dibadda. Riley wuxuu xilka safiirnimo ee Soomaaliya hayay tan iyo 2024. Safaaradda ku shaqeyneysay ku-sime Kadib bixitaankii Riley, Justin Davis ayaa xilka hoggaaminta Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho la wareegay isagoo ahaa chargé d’affaires , ama sii-hayaha xilka safiirka. Davis ayaa safaaradda hoggaaminayay muddo ku dhow siddeed bilood, xilli xiriirka Washington iyo Muqdisho uu si weyn ugu qotomo arrimaha amniga, la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada sharci-fulinta. Bishan September ayuu Davis soo gabagabeeyay shaqadiisa Soomaaliya. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho ayaa 10-kii September sheegtay in muddadii uu Davis joogay uu door ka qaatay hirgelinta mudnaanta Mareykanka ee la xiriira “la-dagaallanka argagixisada, sharci-fulinta iyo arrimaha socdaalka.” Waxaa xilka sii-hayaha safiirka kala wareegtay Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz , oo hadda ah diblomaasiga ugu sarreeya Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya inta laga sugayo in Senate-ku ansixiyo Kennington. Safaaradda ayaa sheegtay in Stevens-Klitz ay sii wadi doonto fulinta siyaasadaha maamulka Trump iyo xoojinta xiriirka Mareykanka iyo Soomaaliya. Waa kuma Devin Kennington? Kennington waa diblomaasi Mareykan ah oo khibrad badan u leh arrimaha Afrika, gaar ahaan Bariga iyo Bartamaha qaaradda. Wuxuu hore uga soo shaqeeyay Waaxda Arrimaha Afrika ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, isagoo xilal ka qabtay qeybta qaabilsan dalalka Harooyinka Waaweyn iyo Bartamaha Afrika. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu yaqaan shaqadiisa la xiriirta Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, halkaas oo uu muddo ka shaqeynayay siyaasadda Mareykanka ee dalkaas. Kennington wuxuu sidoo kale khibrad toos ah u leeyahay Geeska Afrika, kadib markii uu horay uga soo shaqeeyay Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Jabuuti, halkaas oo uu xil ka hayay qeybta qunsuliyadda. Aqalka Cad faahfaahin dheer kama bixin taariikh nololeedkiisa markii uu magacaabista shaaciyay, sidoo kalena lama sheegin goorta Senate-ka uu bilaabi doono dhageysiga magacaabistiisa. Xiriir ku tiirsan amniga Magacaabista Kennington waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli arrimaha amniga iyo la-dagaallanka kooxaha hubeysan ay weli yihiin tiirka ugu weyn ee xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Washington. Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah saaxiibada ugu muhiimsan Soomaaliya ee dhinaca amniga, wuxuuna taageero siiyaa ciidamada dowladda ee dagaalka kula jira Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Daacish. Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, ayaa sidoo kale sii wada duqeymaha cirka ee lagu beegsanayo kooxaha hubeysan gudaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo howlgalladaas lagu fuliyo iskaashi lala leeyahay dowladda federaalka. Haddii Senate-ku ansixiyo Kennington, wuxuu xilka kala wareegi doonaa hoggaanka safaaradda oo muddo bilo ah ku shaqeynaysay sii-hayayaal, isagoo noqon doona wejiga cusub ee siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya xilli ay labada dhinac ka wada shaqeynayaan amniga, siyaasadda iyo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed. Wuxuu hore uga soo shaqeeyay Waaxda Arrimaha Afrika ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, isagoo xilal ka qabtay qeybta qaabilsan dalalka Harooyinka Waaweyn iyo Bartamaha Afrika. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu yaqaan shaqadiisa la xiriirta Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, halkaas oo uu muddo ka shaqeynayay siyaasadda Mareykanka ee dalkaas. Kennington wuxuu sidoo kale khibrad toos ah u leeyahay Geeska Afrika, kadib markii uu horay uga soo shaqeeyay Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Jabuuti, halkaas oo uu xil ka hayay qeybta qunsuliyadda. Aqalka Cad faahfaahin dheer kama bixin taariikh nololeedkiisa markii uu magacaabista shaaciyay, sidoo kalena lama sheegin goorta Senate-ka uu bilaabi doono dhageysiga magacaabistiisa. Xiriir ku tiirsan amniga Magacaabista Kennington waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli arrimaha amniga iyo la-dagaallanka kooxaha hubeysan ay weli yihiin tiirka ugu weyn ee xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Washington. Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah saaxiibada ugu muhiimsan Soomaaliya ee dhinaca amniga, wuxuuna taageero siiyaa ciidamada dowladda ee dagaalka kula jira Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Daacish. Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, ayaa sidoo kale sii wada duqeymaha cirka ee lagu beegsanayo kooxaha hubeysan gudaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo howlgalladaas lagu fuliyo iskaashi lala leeyahay dowladda federaalka. Haddii Senate-ku ansixiyo Kennington, wuxuu xilka kala wareegi doonaa hoggaanka safaaradda oo muddo bilo ah ku shaqeynaysay sii-hayayaal, isagoo noqon doona wejiga cusub ee siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya xilli ay labada dhinac ka wada shaqeynayaan amniga, siyaasadda iyo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed. items.title: Trump nominates Kennington as US ambassador to Somalia
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – President Donald Trump has nominated Devin Kennington, of California, to serve as Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States to the Federal Republic of Somalia, the White House announced Monday, moving to fill a post that has sat vacant since late last year. The nomination was included in a slate of 41 names the White House sent to the Senate on September 14, covering judicial, diplomatic and agency posts. Alongside Kennington’s nomination for Somalia, the list named Wesley Hunt for ambassador to Saudi Arabia, Austin Holmes for ambassador to Haiti, and Junaid Munir, of Michigan, for ambassador to Djibouti. If confirmed, Kennington would become the first full ambassador Washington has sent to Mogadishu since Richard H. Riley departed the post in December 2025. Riley, a career diplomat who took up the Mogadishu ambassadorship in May 2024, was recalled to Washington as part of a broader wave that pulled back roughly 30 Biden-appointed chiefs of mission, leaving posts across Africa unfilled. Henry Wooster’s nomination as the next US ambassador to Kenya, announced in June, was part of the same effort to rebuild the administration’s diplomatic presence on the continent. In the interim, the US mission in Mogadishu has been run by Justin Davis, a career diplomat who has served as Chargé d’Affaires, a.i. since January 15, 2026. Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz assumed duties as deputy chief of mission in August 2026. The nomination must still clear the Senate, a process that can include committee hearings and background review. No date has yet been set for a confirmation hearing or vote. Kennington’s nomination comes as Somalia continues to face security pressure from Al-Shabaab and navigates ongoing disputes over elections and federal-state relations. It also lands as the Trump administration has signaled plans to cut funding for the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) and for African Union peacekeepers deployed against Al-Shabaab under the AUSSOM mission – a backdrop that is likely to shape the confirmation debate and, if Kennington is seated, his early agenda in Mogadishu. A confirmed ambassador would take on a lead role coordinating US policy toward Somalia, including counterterrorism cooperation, engagement with federal and regional authorities, and coordination with international partners operating in the Horn of Africa. Info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Hablaha Garxajis cadaalad bay doonayaan.
Taliyaha Ilaalada Madaxtooyada Qaranka oo gaaray deegaanka Masagawaa (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Guutada 77 ee Ciidanka Ilaalada Madaxtooyada Qaranka, Korneyl Maslax Maxamuud Maxamed ayaa booqasho shaqo ku tegay deegaanka Masagawaa ee Gobolka Galgaduud. Deegaankan ayaa waxaa degan cutub ka tirsan Guutada 77, gaar ahaan Ururka 86aad ee Aar, iyadoo sidoo kalena ay halkaasi fariisimo ku leeyihiin Ciidanka Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley. War Talaadadan ka soo baxay Taliska Guutada 77 ayaa lagu sheegay in Taliyuhu uu Masagawaa u tegay kormeer uu ugu kuurgelayo xaaladda ciidanka iyo howlaha ay ka hayaan deegaanka. “Taliyaha ayaa mid mid u booqday fariisimaha iyo goobaha ay Guutada 77aad kaga sugan yihiin magaalada Masagawaa iyo deegaanada ku xeeran, isagoo indha-indheeyay xaaladda ciidanka iyo habsami-u-socodka howlaha shaqo.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa lagu xusay “Korneyl Maslax Maxamuud Maxamed ayaa sidoo kale warbixinno ka dhageystay Saraakiisha iyo Taliyeyaasha Ururada Guutada 77aad ee ka hawlgala deegaanka, kuwaas oo ka warbixiyay xaaladda amni, howlaha ciidanka iyo adeegyada ay u hayaan bulshada ku nool deegaanada bariga Gobolka Galgaduud.” Masagawaa ayaa looga diyaargaroobayaa doorashada isku sidkan ee 30-ka bishan laga qabanayo Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Doorashada ku celiska ah ee Galmudug ayay shacabku ku soo dooranayaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Galmudug.

items.title: Ganacsatada Soomaaliya oo billaabay qorshe cusub kadib markii is-beddel uu ku yimid…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ganacsatada Soomaaliya ayaa bilaabay inay raadiyaan marinno cusub oo ay badeecooyinka dalka ku soo geliyaan, xilli walaac xooggan uu ka taagan yahay ammaanka marinnada muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab iyo Hormuz, oo ay saameeyeen dagaallada iyo xiisadaha sii xoogeysanaya ee gobolka. Arrintan ayaa soo baxday kaddib markii Xuutiyiinta Yemen, oo taageero ka hela Iran, ay qabsadeen magaalo deked muhiim ah iyo jasiirad istaraatiiji ah, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee isaga kala goosha Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Shirkadaha Soomaaliyeed ayaa muddo dheer badeecooyinka ka yimaada Aasiya dalka soo marin jiray dalalka Khaliijka, gaar ahaan Imaaraadka Carabta, Cumaan iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Hase yeeshee, xaaladda cusub ayaa ku qasabtay qaar ka mid ah ganacsatada inay tijaabiyaan safarro toos ah oo aan ku xirneyn dekedaha Khaliijka. Maareeyaha Dekedda Muqdisho, Maxamed Cali Nuur Ameeriko, ayaa sheegay in xiisadaha ka taagan Bab al-Mandab iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz ay saameyn ku yeesheen ganacsiga iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta. “Xiisadihii ugu dambeeyay ee Bab al-Mandab, iyo sidoo kale kuwa ka jira marin-biyoodka Hormuz, si taban ayay noo saameeyeen,” ayuu yiri Ameeriko. “Laakiin sidoo kale waxaan qaadnay tallaabooyin aan uga fogaaneyno carqaladdaas.” Waxa uu sheegay in maamulka dekedda iyo ganacsatada wax dhoofisa ay ka wada shaqeynayaan sidii loo heli lahaa marinno kale. “Markii ugu horreysay waxaan keenay markab sonkor si toos ah uga soo qaaday Sri Lanka,” ayuu yiri. “Tani waxay noqon kartaa istaraatiijiyad aan sameynay sababo la xiriira xiisadahan.” Tallaabadan ayaa muujineysa sida xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas iyo Khaliijka ay u beddeli karto habka ay Soomaaliya ku hesho badeecooyinka muhiimka ah, iyadoo dalka uu si weyn ugu tiirsan yahay ganacsiga badda. Dekedda Muqdisho ayaa maalin kasta qaabisha maraakiib sida raashinka, qalabka iyo badeecooyinka kale ee muhiimka u ah nolosha shacabka. Dhibaato kasta oo ku timaadda marinnada badda ayaa sidaas darteed si toos ah ama dadban u taaban karta suuqyada gudaha. Haddii maraakiibtu isticmaalaan marinno dheer ama kharash badan, waxaa kordhi kara qarashaadka gaadiidka, halka badeecooyinkuna ay dib uga dhici karaan waqtigii la filayay inay suuqyada soo gaaraan. Kabtan Cali Jemdi, oo asal ahaan kasoo jeeda Suuriya isla markaana qaada shixnado sonkor ah, ayaa wakaaladda wararka AP u sheegay in hubanti la’aanta gobolka ay walaac ku abuurtay maraakiibta isticmaasha marinnadaas. “Dhibaato ayaa halkaas ka jirta dagaalka awgiis,” ayuu yiri, isagoo ka hadlayay Gacanka Carabta iyo biyaha ku hareeraysan. “Bab al-Mandab-na sidoo kale waxaa laga yaabaa inuu dhibaato ku noqdo markabka.” Waxa uu sheegay in xaaladda amni-darro ay sii adkeyn karto gaadiidka badda iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Dhanka Yemen, dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay iyo Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa muddo 12 sano ah dagaal kula jiray Xuutiyiinta. Xiisadda cusub ayaa soo afjartay xabbad-joojin tan iyo 2022 si weyn u yareysay dagaalladii sokeeye ee dalkaas. Dagaallada soo cusboonaaday ayaa sidoo kale horseeday barakac ballaaran. Hay’adda Socdaalka Adduunka ee IOM ayaa Axaddii sheegtay in in ka badan 85,000 oo qof ay barakaceen tan iyo bilowgii bishan. In ka badan 2,000 oo qof ayaa sidoo kale gaaray Jabuuti, oo dhinaca kale ee Bab al-Mandab kaga beegan Yemen isla markaana daris la ah Soomaaliya. Isbeddellada ka socda Yemen iyo marinnada muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab iyo Hormuz ayaa sidaas darteed saameyn ka baxsan goobaha dagaalka ku yeelan kara dalalka gobolka, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay hadda isku dayeyso inay yareyso khatarta ku iman karta silsiladda sahayda iyo badeecooyinka ay dibadda kala soo degto. items.title: Yemen: Yemen conflict enters new phase as clashes move toward Bab Al-Mandab Strait
items.description: Shotlist FILE: Yemen – March 2024 (CCTV – No access Chinese mainland) 1. Various of cityscape, national flag of Yemen Sanaa, Yemen – Sept 12, 2026 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 2. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Hizam al-Asad, member, Political Bureau of Ansar Allah (Houthis): “There are no implications for the security and safety of navigation in the Red Sea, and there is no reason for concern in this regard. We assure everyone that there is no cause for concern about maritime security. Navigation is safe and stable, operating normally and smoothly, and there are no intentions in this regard.” FILE: Yemen – 2022 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 3. Various of Mayun Island in Bab al-Mandab Strait, armed soldiers on vehicles Sanaa, Yemen – Sept 12, 2026 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 4. SOUNDBITE (Arabic)Rashad Al-Wutairi, military expert (starting with shot 3): “The Israeli enemy is trying today, in various ways, to strengthen its presence near the Bab Al-Mandab Strait by building relations with Somaliland. It has also made significant moves and visits to Al Mokha and other areas. However, recent developments have weakened this strategy and undermined the plans and arrangements Israel had built.” FILE: Red Sea – 2024 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 5. Various of ships at sea Storyline Conflict in Yemen between the Houthis–officially known as Ansar Allah, and Saudi-backed government forces has entered a new phase along the western coast, with clashes moving toward the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, a key maritime route in the region. Houthis announced Friday that they had taken control of six districts in the western provinces of Taiz and Al-Hudaydah, covering about 5,400 square kilometers, in an operation that began on Sept. 3. The group also said commercial ships would not be targeted, with the exception of Saudi vessels. “There are no implications for the security and safety of navigation in the Red Sea, and there is no reason for concern in this regard. We assure everyone that there is no cause for concern about maritime security. Navigation is safe and stable, operating normally and smoothly, and there are no intentions in this regard,” said Hizam al-Asad, a member of the Political Bureau of Ansar Allah (Houthis). Yemeni government sources said that Houthis has also taken control of the Mayun Island, also known as Perim, in the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, a strategic waterway linking the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden. In response, forces loyal to Yemen’s internationally recognized government, with backing from Saudi Arabia, launched a military operation described as a “kill zone”. The operation designates areas along the western coast, including Al Mokha and Dhu Bab, as zones for intensive military strikes. “The Israeli enemy is trying today, in various ways, to strengthen its presence near the Bab Al-Mandab Strait by building relations with Somaliland. It has also made significant moves and visits to Al Mokha and other areas. However, recent developments have weakened this strategy and undermined the plans and arrangements Israel had built,” said Rashad Al-Wutairi, a military expert. The escalation is now extending beyond Yemen’s front lines, with fighting reaching areas that overlook the southern entrance to the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, one of the world’s most strategically important shipping routes. The developments are also raising concerns beyond Yemen. Egyptian government has formed a crisis cell, a high-level committee tasked with monitoring the situation along Yemen’s western coast. Egyptian government is concerned that any disruption to shipping through the Red Sea could have a direct impact on traffic through the Suez Canal, a vital artery for global maritime trade.

The operation designates areas along the western coast, including Al Mokha and Dhu Bab, as zones for intensive military strikes. “The Israeli enemy is trying today, in various ways, to strengthen its presence near the Bab Al-Mandab Strait by building relations with Somaliland. It has also made significant moves and visits to Al Mokha and other areas. However, recent developments have weakened this strategy and undermined the plans and arrangements Israel had built,” said Rashad Al-Wutairi, a military expert. The escalation is now extending beyond Yemen’s front lines, with fighting reaching areas that overlook the southern entrance to the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, one of the world’s most strategically important shipping routes. The developments are also raising concerns beyond Yemen. Egyptian government has formed a crisis cell, a high-level committee tasked with monitoring the situation along Yemen’s western coast. Egyptian government is concerned that any disruption to shipping through the Red Sea could have a direct impact on traffic through the Suez Canal, a vital artery for global maritime trade.

items.title: The Red Sea Fight Needs an African Shore
items.description: By Jonah Brody and MajGen Robert Sofge The United States (US) military presence in East Africa is well positioned to help defend the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, but its basing arrangements and host-country restrictions were designed primarily for counterterrorism rather than a maritime confrontation with Yemen’s Iran-backed political-military movement Ansar Allah, better known as the Houthis. As the war with Iran exposes the vulnerability of Red Sea commerce, Washington should develop distributed access at Berbera, in Somaliland, and Bosaso, in the semi-autonomous Somali region of Puntland. These footholds would support surveillance, maritime security, and contingency operations. Such arrangements would reduce dependence on Djibouti, bridge the operational divide between Africa Command and Central Command, and strengthen the US military’s ability to defend the chokepoint without requiring immediate recognition of Somaliland. Introduction The war between the US and Iran has opened a new maritime front along the Red Sea. As Washington and Tehran contest the Strait of Hormuz, Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis have declared a blockade of Saudi commerce through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait—the narrow waterway splitting Yemen and Djibouti that forms the southern gateway to the Red Sea. The corridor’s importance has grown for the global economy as Saudi Arabia now leans on the passage to export oil, now that the Strait of Hormuz has seized up. Ships still transit, but under enough risk that Saudi tankers now run dark and reroute . The threat reaches past Saudi Arabia: Houthi missiles have struck vessels flying non-Saudi flags and left merchant crews dead. That southern access point to the Red Sea is now contested, and the US posture there was built for an important but entirely different fight. The Counterterrorism Posture Meets a Maritime War The US military posture in East Africa is well placed but too narrowly tasked. For two decades, US Africa Command (AFRICOM) has optimized its East Africa presence for counterterrorism in Somalia : surveillance flights, strikes, special operations, and partner training against al-Shabaab, the Somalia-based al-Qaeda affiliate, and the Islamic State. That fight is necessary, and it has helped prevent al-Shabaab from overtaking the Somali capital of Mogadishu and driven the Islamic State’s Somalia branch into hiding . But while US forces in Africa, concentrated in Djibouti, sit almost exactly where a Red Sea fight would want them, their basing arrangements were built for striking and advising inland counterterrorism operations , and Djibouti’s restrictions constrain the offshore operations the Houthi threat now requires. The strategic landscape has outgrown an access architecture built for a narrower fight. Geography compounds the problem. The Bab el-Mandeb divides two US combatant commands, AFRICOM to its west and Central Command (CENTCOM)—which remains focused on the fight against Iran—to its east. Adversaries have long worked that seam. Recent public reporting from the Wall Street Journal describes Houthi technicians supplying al-Shabaab with drone and explosive-device expertise. The two groups have not merged their campaigns, but they share a common enemy. Their cooperation shows how untenable it is to treat the two shores as separate files. Djibouti Is Not Enough On the African shore, the American presence rests solely on one installation. Camp Lemonnier in Djibouti sits close to the strait —offering prime real estate for operations—but Djibouti has refused to let US forces strike Houthi positions that threaten the Bab el-Mandeb. Ironically, America’s only base in Africa cannot be used to defend the strait critical to its economic well-being. China’s only overseas base sits a few miles away, a separate reason not to stake America’s presence on one location. On the Arabian side, major CENTCOM operating locations sit well away from the chokepoint. A single base in Djibouti is not enough; Washington needs options. Build a Distributed Network at Berbera and Bosaso The near-term answer to the Houthi challenge is distributed access, and the US can build it quickly. Somaliland has offered the US the use of Berbera, which pairs one of the longest runways in Africa with a deep-water port on the Gulf of Aden. From Berbera, US forces could fly persistent surveillance over the strait; base maritime patrol and counter-drone assets; refuel and stage naval and special operations; and hold a recovery airfield on the chokepoint’s southern flank. Berbera would not win the maritime fight by itself, but it would give the US an additional, politically unencumbered foothold that Djibouti will not provide. The semi-autonomous Somali state of Puntland offers a second option. The US has agreed to expand the base at Bosaso, another Gulf of Aden port, for counterterrorism and maritime security. The deal is young and its results are unproven, but its significance is the shift it represents: the US has demonstrated a willingness to make direct security arrangements with capable sub-federal authorities when operations demand it, rather than wait on the federal government in Mogadishu. Bosaso and Berbera together would give American forces a network across the coast that matters most. Access at Berbera would also align the US with Israel, which recognized Somaliland in December and, according to Bloomberg , has established a small intelligence presence there and is exploring a base from which to monitor and strike the Houthis. Somaliland’s leaders have been guarded about hosting foreign forces, so this remains unsettled. But a shared foothold on the southern flank would knit together partners already hitting the same Iranian adversary. Access Without Immediate Recognition The US needs only enough access to improve its ability to defend the Bab el-Mandeb, and that does not require recognizing Somaliland now. Skeptics will call a base at Berbera a de facto recognition of Somaliland, even if the US does not say so in an official capacity. But access can rest on a security agreement with the Somaliland authorities that govern Berbera by dealing with them as the party in control on the ground, which avoids recognizing Somaliland as a sovereign state. That is the approach the US just took at Bosaso, where it dealt directly with Puntland’s local authorities instead of Somalia’s federal government in Mogadishu. Going around the federal government does carry real costs: strain on a fragile federal system; propaganda for al-Shabaab; and friction with the African Union, Turkey, the UAE, and Ethiopia. But two facts blunt the sovereignty charge. The federal government cannot deliver quick, reliable coastal access in a crisis. And in early 2025 Somalia itself offered the US its strategic ports, Berbera and Bosaso among them, that it does not control. The Houthi threat predates this war and will likely outlast it. The tools to manage it—runways, ports, sensors, patrol aircraft, and counter-drone systems—are available on both shores of the chokepoint. If we have learned anything from the current fight in the Persian Gulf, it is that getting the geography right in front of a full-blown crisis matters.     Source Smallwarsjournal

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo weerarro cusub ku qaaday Sacuudiga
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa qaaday weerarro cusub oo ay ku beegsanayaan gudaha Sacuudiga, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan dagaallada Yemen, isla markaana ay hakadeen dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu doonayay in dib loogu furo Marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo muhiim u ah isu-socodka shidaalka caalamka. Sida ay Reuters werisay, Xuutiyiinta ayaa Isniintii sheegay inay dhowr iyo toban gantaal iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku weerareen saldhigga cirka ee Khamis Mushait ee koonfurta Sacuudiga. Waxay sheegeen in weerarka lagu bartilmaameedsaday hangarrada diyaaradaha, nidaamyada radar-ka, runway-yada iyo bakhaarada rasaasta. Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ee ka dagaallama Yemen ayaa sheegay in weerarradaasi ay ku dhaawacmeen 13 qof oo rayid ah , halka maamulka Sacuudigu uu digniino degdeg ah ka bixiyay Khamis Mushait iyo saddex magaalo oo kale oo ku yaalla koonfurta dalka. Weerarradan ayaa imanaya iyadoo Xuutiyiintu maalmihii u dambeeyay ay ballaarinayeen dhaq-dhaqaaqooda milatari, gaar ahaan xeebaha galbeed ee Yemen ee ku teedsan Badda Cas. Saraakiil ka tirsan dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay weli si wax ku ool ah u maamulaan inta badan xeebaha galbeed ee dalka, oo ay ku jirto jasiiradda Perim , oo ku taalla afka laga galo Badda Cas. Dhanka kale, ciidamada cirka Sacuudiga iyo kuwa dowladda Yemen ayaa kordhiyay duqeymaha ay ku qaadayaan goobaha ay Xuutiyiintu maamulaan, oo ay ku jiraan deegaanada ku dhow dekedda taariikhiga ah ee Mocha . Saraakiil Yemeni ah ayaa sheegay in inkastoo Xuutiyiinta cadaadis milatari lagu hayo, haddana ay iyaguna kordhinayaan weerarrada gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga. Xiisadda ayaa sidoo kale cadaadis ku sii kordhinaysa dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga, kaddib markii weerar cirka ah oo dhacay Khamiistii uu shaqada ka joojiyay dhuumaha shidaalka ee isku xira bariga iyo galbeedka dalka. Riyadh ayaa weerarka ku eedeysay maleeshiyaad Iran taageerto oo ka howlgala Ciraaq. Dhuumahaasi oo dhererkoodu yahay ku dhowaad 1,200 kiiloomitir ayaa Sacuudigu u dhisay inuu shidaalka uga gudbiyo Gacanka una diro Badda Cas, taasoo u oggolaanaysa inuu ka fogaado Marin-biyoodka Hormuz haddii marin-biyoodkaasi halis galo. Ganacsatada shidaalka ayaa sheegay in haddii dhuumahaasi muddo dheer xirnaadaan, iyadoo Hormuz-na uu si weyn u xanniban yahay, ay suuragal tahay in saameyntu gaarto ilaa 4 boqolkiiba sahayda shidaalka adduunka . Qiimaha saliidda cayriin ayaa Isniintii kor u kacay in ka badan 4 boqolkiiba, inkastoo uu markii dambe ku soo xirnaa koror ku dhow 1 boqolkiiba. Mareykanka oo ka gaabsanaya faragelin toos ah Dagaalka cusub ee Yemen ayaa caqabad kale ku noqday madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump. Saddex ilo-wareed oo Reuters la hadlay ayaa sheegay in Washington ay ilaa hadda ka gaabsatay codsiyada Sacuudiga ee ku aaddan faragelin militari oo toos ah, iyadoo taageerada Mareykanka ay inta badan ku kooban tahay xogta sirdoonka. Trump ayaa sheegay inuu dhammaadka toddobaadkii la hadlay dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Maxamed bin Salmaan, halka Xuutiyiintuna ay Washington kala xiriireen inay Mareykanka ka fogaato dagaalka. Warbaahinta dowladda Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Maxamed bin Salmaan uu Isniintii magaalada Jeddah kula kulmay Admiral Brad Cooper, oo ah taliyaha ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Dhanka kale, rajadii laga qabay in xiisadda gobolka lagu dejiyo wada-hadal ayaa sii yaraanaysa. Cumaan ayaa qorsheynayay inuu Isniintii martigeliyo kulan ay Iran iyo dalalka Khaliijku kaga wada hadlaan sidii dib loogu furi lahaa Marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Hase yeeshee, kulanka ayaa dib loo dhigay. Trump ayaa mar kale sheegay in Iran ay diyaar u tahay heshiis degdeg ah, balse Mohsen Rezaei, oo ka tirsan Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran, ayaa hadalkaas ku tilmaamay wax mashquulinaya, isagoo sheegay inaysan jiri doonin wada-hadallo ilaa shuruudaha Iran la buuxiyo. Xiisadda badda ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo maraakiibta isticmaasha Hormuz. Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ayaa sheegtay in markabka shidaalka El Gaia , oo sita calanka Panama, uu ku dhacay miinooyin badeed isagoo marayay aag Iran ay mamnuucday oo ku yaalla koonfurta Hormuz. Hase yeeshee, Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka ayaa si degdeg ah u beeniyay sheegashadaas, isagoo sheegay in markabka uu bishii hore ku dhacay gantaal laga soo riday Iran, taasoo ka dhigtay mid aan shaqayn karin. Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Badaha ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa xaqiijisay in markabka uu waxyeello soo gaartay Sabtidii, balse ma aysan sheegin sababta, iyadoo sidoo kale sheegtay in Reuters ayaa sheegtay inaysan si degdeg ah ula xiriiri karin milkiilayaasha markabka oo ku sugan Dubai si ay u xaqiijiso wararka iska soo horjeeda. Hormuz ayaa weli ah mid ka mid ah marinnada shidaalka ee ugu muhiimsan dunida, waxaana Reuters ay sheegtay in isu-socodkiisu si weyn u hakaday tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday 28-kii Febraayo. Xuutiyiinta iyo Iran ayaa sii wada tallaabooyinka kordhinaya khatarta ku wajahan maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo sahayda tamarta caalamka.

items.title: Soomaaliya Oo Ka Qaybgalaysa Kalfadhiga Degdegga Ah Ee Wasiirrada IGAD
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali, ayaa gaaray magaalada Jabuuti, halkaas oo uu wafdiga Soomaaliya uga hoggaaminayo kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada urur-goboleedka IGAD. Kalfadhiga oo loo qorsheeyey 15-ka Sebteembar ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galaya wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda iyo wakiillo ka socda dalalka xubnaha ka ah IGAD. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xaaladda nabadda iyo ammaanka gobolka iyo arrimo la xiriira howlaha ururka. Wasiirrada ayaa la filayaa inay qiimeeyaan isbeddellada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee ka jira Geeska Afrika, xilli gobolka uu wajahayo colaado, xiisado diblomaasiyadeed iyo xaalado bani’aadannimo. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadli doonaa qodobbo hay’adeed, oo ay ku jirto xoojinta heshiiska lagu aasaasay IGAD iyo kor u qaadidda awoodda ururka ee wax ka qabashada caqabadaha gobolka. Ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya wuxuu ku soo beegmayaa xilli dalku door muuqda ku leeyahay wada-hadallada gobolka ee ku saabsan amniga, iskaashiga siyaasadeed iyo xallinta khilaafaadka, hase yeeshee, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda weli ma faahfaahin mowqifyada ama soo-jeedimaha gaarka ah ee wafdiga Soomaaliya uu shirka la tegayo. Natiijada kalfadhiga ayaa la filayaa inay muujiso sida dalalka IGAD uga jawaabayaan xaaladaha isbeddelaya ee Geeska Afrika iyo jihada dib-u-habeynta ururka. War-murtiyeedka shirka ayaa sidoo kale caddeyn kara go’aannada laga gaaro arrimaha nabadda, ammaanka iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta gobolka.
