items.title: Tareq Saleh Withdraws from Mocha as Houthis Seize Strategic Red Sea Port
items.description: Yemen (WDN) — Yemen’s western front has suffered a dramatic reversal after Houthi forces seized the strategic Red Sea port of Mocha, forcing forces commanded by Gen. Tareq Saleh to withdraw from the city and surrounding positions. Saleh, commander of Yemen’s National Resistance Forces and deputy chairman of the Presidential Leadership Council, has become the focus of conflicting reports about his whereabouts following the Houthi advance. RT reported claims that Saleh left Yemen by boat for Eritrea, but that account has not been independently confirmed. Reuters reported a different picture, saying Saleh ordered his forces to withdraw from threatened positions and establish an alternative command center in a safer location south of Mocha. The distinction is important. Reuters’ reporting points to a strategic military withdrawal and regrouping, rather than confirming that Saleh personally fled to Eritrea. A Major Reversal on the Red Sea Coast The Houthi capture of Mocha represents a major setback for the Saudi-backed Yemeni forces and a significant change in the military balance along the western coast. Reuters reported that Houthi forces seized Mocha after a rapid advance and continued moving toward the strategically important Bab al-Mandab Strait. Government forces and their allies have been withdrawing south toward Dhubab, which sits directly on the approach to the strait. The fighting has reportedly forced Saleh’s forces to abandon positions around Mocha and reorganize farther south. RT, meanwhile, has reported that Saleh’s forces suffered a rapid defeat in fighting that lasted less than 24 hours. That account, including the reported scale of the military setback, should be treated as RT’s assessment rather than an independently established fact. Where Is Tareq Saleh? The most important unresolved question is Saleh’s current location. Reports claiming that he crossed the Red Sea to Eritrea remain unverified. Reuters’ reporting instead indicates that he remained involved in directing his forces’ withdrawal and regrouping. Until Saleh, his military command or the Yemeni government provides a direct statement, claims about his personal flight to Eritrea should therefore be treated cautiously. Why Mocha Matters Mocha’s importance extends far beyond the city itself. Located on Yemen’s Red Sea coast near Bab al-Mandab, the port lies close to one of the world’s most important maritime chokepoints. The strait connects the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and the wider Indian Ocean and is critical to international shipping and energy supplies. Reuters reported that the Houthi advance toward Mocha and the nearby Hanish Islands is bringing the movement closer to a position from which it could exert greater pressure on Bab al-Mandab. If the Houthis consolidate their control over the western coastline, the consequences could extend well beyond Yemen’s civil war, affecting maritime security, commercial shipping and the wider regional balance. A Withdrawal, Not Necessarily a Collapse For Saleh, the immediate challenge is to preserve his forces and prevent the loss of the remaining strategic positions along the coast. A withdrawal does not necessarily mean the destruction of the National Resistance Forces. It may instead represent an attempt to preserve manpower and equipment and prepare for a counteroffensive. But the loss of Mocha is undeniably a major setback. The Eritrea story remains unconfirmed. What Reuters has established is that Saleh ordered a strategic withdrawal and that his forces are being pushed south by the Houthi advance. The battle for Mocha has therefore created a new strategic reality on Yemen’s western coast—and brought the Houthis significantly closer to one of the world’s most important maritime chokepoints. items.title: Somali Pirates Have The Released Hijacked Vessel
items.description: Bossaso (WDN) — Somali pirates have reportedly released a vessel they had held hostage since April, according to security sources cited by local media, highlighting the continuing vulnerability of commercial shipping in waters already facing growing security threats from piracy and the conflict in Yemen. The vessel, which was reportedly carrying 17 crew members, was released under circumstances that have not yet been fully explained. Security sources have not disclosed the ship’s name, flag, exact location of the hijacking or the precise date of its release. It also remains unclear whether the vessel was freed following negotiations, an agreement with the pirates or the payment of a ransom. No details have been provided on whether any money changed hands. The reported release was first carried by AFP, which said the vessel had been seized by Somali pirates in April. The development comes against the backdrop of a deteriorating maritime-security environment stretching from Somalia’s coastline across the Gulf of Aden and into the Red Sea. A Wider Maritime Security Crisis The resurgence of Somali piracy is unfolding alongside a separate but interconnected security crisis in Yemen, where the Houthi movement has been engaged in an escalating conflict with forces aligned with Yemen’s internationally recognized government. The Houthi conflict has had consequences far beyond Yemen’s borders. Attacks and threats against commercial shipping in and around the Red Sea have forced many vessels to reconsider traditional routes through the Bab al-Mandab Strait, one of the world’s most important maritime chokepoints. The resulting insecurity has created a complex maritime environment in which commercial vessels face risks from multiple directions. Along Somalia’s coast, piracy remains a persistent threat despite a dramatic decline from the peak of the piracy crisis more than a decade ago. Further north, the Red Sea has become increasingly exposed to missile, drone and other attacks associated with the conflict in Yemen. Together, these developments have placed the Gulf of Aden and Red Sea at the center of a broader international maritime-security challenge. Piracy Has Declined—but Not Disappeared Somali piracy reached unprecedented levels in the late 2000s and early 2010s, prompting major international naval deployments and the introduction of stronger security measures aboard commercial vessels. Those efforts dramatically reduced successful hijackings. But the underlying networks did not disappear entirely. The reported seizure of a vessel carrying 17 people in April demonstrates that pirate groups remain capable of exploiting gaps in maritime surveillance and security. The release of the vessel also raises questions about the financial incentives that continue to sustain piracy. If ransom payments were involved, the case would demonstrate that hijacking remains potentially profitable despite years of international efforts to dismantle pirate networks. For Somalia and international maritime forces, the challenge is therefore not simply preventing individual attacks. It is disrupting the criminal networks that finance, organize and profit from maritime kidnappings. The Gulf of Aden’s Strategic Importance The security of the Gulf of Aden matters far beyond Somalia and Yemen. The waterway connects the Indian Ocean to the Red Sea and provides access to the Suez Canal, making it an essential route for global trade between Asia, Europe and the Middle East. Any sustained increase in piracy or attacks on commercial shipping can raise insurance costs, disrupt supply chains and force vessels to take longer and more expensive routes around Africa. That makes the security situation along Somalia’s coastline increasingly important to international governments and naval forces. The challenge is particularly complicated because piracy and the Yemen conflict are separate security problems, even though they occur within the same strategically connected maritime region. Somalia Faces a Continuing Test For Somalia, the latest incident is a reminder that securing one of the world’s longest coastlines remains a major challenge. The country needs stronger maritime surveillance, a capable coast guard and navy, effective intelligence-sharing and closer cooperation with international naval forces. But long-term success will also depend on addressing the economic conditions that can make piracy attractive to coastal criminal networks. The reported release of the hijacked vessel is therefore welcome news for its crew, but it should not obscure the wider problem. From Somali piracy to Houthi attacks and the fighting in Yemen, the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden are becoming an increasingly contested maritime corridor. The immediate question is whether the region’s governments and international partners can prevent these separate threats from reinforcing one another—and ensure that one of the world’s most important trade routes does not become a permanent zone of insecurity. This version deliberately distinguishes Somali piracy from the Houthi-Yemen conflict while showing how both contribute to the broader security risks surrounding the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandab and Gulf of Aden. items.title: Dibad-bax ka dhacay Beledweyne oo taageero loogu muujiyay go’aanka Xasan
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Dibad-bax ballaaran oo lagu taageerayo go’aanka Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee ku aaddan kaarka JSP ee HirShabelle oo la sheegay inla siinayo Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe ayaa maanta lagu qabtay magaalada Beledweyne ee xarunta gobolka Hiiraan. Dibad-baxa ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galaya mas’uuliyiinta gobolka, kuwa degmada iyo boqolaal shacab ah, iyada oo amniga ay sugeen ciidamada ammaanka ee Beledweyne. Mas’uul sare oo ka hadlay dibad-baxa ayaa warbaahinta u sheegay inay taageerayaan xisbiga JSP iyo kaarka in la siiyo madaxweynaha HirShabelle Cali Guudlaawe oo mar kale u sharraxan xilka madaxweynaha ee maamulkaas. “Maanta waxaan isugu soo baxnay banaanbax lagu taageerayo xisbiga JSP, degmada Beledweyne annaga oo ka kooban maamulka heer gobolka, heer degmo, wasiirro, xildhibaanno. Sidoo kale waxaan taagereynaa in kaarka la siiyay madaxweynaheenna Cali Guudlaawe Xuseen, waana garab taaganahay,” ayuu yiri mid kamid ah mas’uuliyiinta ka qayb-galay dibadbaxa Beledweyne. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in diyaar garoga doorashada uu ka socda Beledweyne, isla markaana ay si wanaagsan uga qayb-geli doonaan, maadaama codadka ay dhiibaan doonan dadweynaha reer HirShabelle. “Doorashada si fiican ayay u socotaa wax dhib ah ma jiraan, waxaana leenahay xisbiga JSP ha guuleysto,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Arrintan ayaa durbo khilaaf ka dhalisay deegaannada HirShabelle, waxaana madaxweyne ku-xigeenka maamulka uusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) oo xalay hadlay uu Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ku eedeeyay inuu uga baxay ballan siyaasadeed oo uu la galay. Dabageed oo sheegay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ay horay ugu heshiiyeen, uguna ballanqaaday inuu hoggaanka HirShabelle isaga siiyo ayaa sheegay in Xasan Sheekh uu hadda waxba kama jiraan kasoo qaaday ballankaas. Dabageed ayaa sheegay in xalay kulan albaabadu u xirnaayeen oo uu la yeeshay Xasan Sheekh uu ku wargeliyay in kursigii HirShabelle aan loo hayn, sidaas darteedna uu tanaasulo. “Madaxweynaha shalay markuu isoo wacay, waxaa u qabay laba qodob midkood: Madaxweynihii ayaa ku siinayaa ee reer HirShabelle ku hoggaami oo shaqadii la wareeg, ama inuu leeyahay waxaan ku ballannay waa shaqeyn waayay, oo nin kale oo Xawaadle ah oo ilma adeer tihiin ayaa kursigii la siiyay ee la shaqee ninkaas, sidaas ayuu ku dhihi islahaa hadduu adiga ku siin waayo,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne ku xigeenka Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle. Dabageed ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Madaxweynuhu uu si cad ugu sheegay in xilka maamulka HirShabelle uu u wado Cali Guudlaawe, oo mar kale isku soo taagaya hoggaanka maamulka. “Madaxweynihii xalay waxaan kala kulmay wax uu nin fiyow oo ehel iyo mas’uul ah oo Madaxweyne Soomaaliyeed uu dhihi karo aanan u qabin. Ballankii reer abtigay waa ka baxay ee kursiga iiga doon, oo iga nabad doonee ayuu igu dhahay,” ayuu mar kale yiri Dabageed. Inkastoo weli uusan jirin war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay Villa Soomaaliya oo si cad u xaqiijinaya in heshiis kama dambeys ah laga gaaray musharraxa Madaxweynaha HirShabelle ama in Guudlaawe loo go’aamiyay inuu mar kale hoggaamiyo maamulka, haddana waxaa isa soo taraya wararka sheegay in Xasan uu kaarka JSP siinayo Guudlaawe, si mar kale loogu dhiso hoggaanka maamulka. items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo gaaray Magaalada Baydhabo (SAWIRRO)
items.description: General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka iyo wafdi Saraakiil ah oo uu hoggaaminayo ayaa Sabtidan gaaray Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Wafdiga Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo ka ambabaxay Caasimadda Muqdisho ayaa waxaa Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud ku soo dhaweeyay xubno uu ka mid yahay Taliyaha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Isaaq Aadan Berdaale. “Booqashada Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa qayb ka ah kormeero shaqo iyo dardargelinta howlaha ciidanka ee ka socda deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri war uu soo saaray Taliska Qaybta 60aad ee fadhigiisu yahay Baydhabo. Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka uu agab ciidan geeyay Baydhabo, isla-markaana loogu talagalay Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee ka hawlgala magaaladaasi iyo nawaaxigeeda. Dhanka kale ciidamo cusub oo lagu diyaariyay Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa lagu wadaa in loo daabulo Baydhabo, si ay xoojin ugu noqdaan ciidamadii ay horey dowladdu u gaysay magaaladaasi. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa isku-dubaridaya hawlgal cusub oo ciidamada ay khatarta amni uga fogeynayaan Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Maamulka cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu hoggaamiyo ayaa waxaa culeys amni ku haya ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ee ku sugan daafaha magaalada.

items.title: Maxamed Mursal iyo Shariif Xasan oo 10 qodob ka soo saaray xaaladda K/Galbeed
items.description: Muqdisho ( Caasimada Online) – Gudoomiyaashii hore ee Barlamaanka Soomaaliy, Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan iyo Shariif Xasan Sheekh Aadan ayaa maanta baaq nabadeed ka soo saaray xaaladda ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed oo ay weli ka taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee maamulkaas Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Labada mas’uul ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inay ka walaacsan yihiin xaaladda amni, midda siyaasadeed iyo bani’aadannimo ee ka taagan deegaannada Dowlad-Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, waxayna farriin u direen labada dhinac oo ay ka codsadeen inay joojiyaan dagaalka, ayna furaan wada-hadallo deg-deg ah, si looga hortago in mar kale uu dhiig ku daato Baydhaba. Sidoo kale, waxa ay wax laga xumaado ku tilmaameen dhibaatooyinka soo gaaray shacabka oo ay ka mid yihiin dhimashada, dhaawaca, barakaca qoysaska iyo carqaladeynta nolosha iyo adeegyada kale ee bulshada. “Shacabka Koonfur Galbeed waxay mudan yihiin nabad, amni iyo nolol sharaf leh, mana habboona inay noqdaan kuwa bixiya qiimaha khilaafaadka siyaasadeed,” ayay bayaankooda ku yiraahdeen Mursal iyo Shariif Xasan. Waxaa kale oo ay soo saareen 10 qodob oo lagu wajihi karo xaaladda taaan, si xal waara loogu helo khilaafka Koonfur Galbeed, waxayna ka yihiin;- 1-Si degdeg ah u joojiyaan colaadda iyo iska horimaadyada hubeysan, kana fogaadaan tallaabo kasta oo sii hurin karta xiisadda ama horseedi karta dhiig kale oo daata. 2-Mudnaanta koowaad siiyaan badbaadinta shacabka, ilaalinta naftooda iyo hantidooda, iyo fududeynta gaarsiinta gargaarka bani’aadannimo ee dadka ay dhibaatadu saameysay. 3-Khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wadahadal, is-afgarad, tanaasul iyo heshiis waara, iyadoo la dhowrayo danta guud iyo midnimada bulshada. 4-Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxaan ugu baaqaynaa inay qaadato door dhexdhexaadin, nabad-dhisid iyo isu-soo-dhoweyn, iyadoo la ilaalinayo midnimada dalka, Dastuurka Federaalka iyo xuquuqda shacabka Koonfur Galbeed. 5-Siyaasiyiinta, waxgaradka, culimada, odayaasha dhaqanka, haweenka iyo dhallinyarada waxaan ugu baaqaynaa inay door muuqda ka qaataan dejinta xiisadda, joojinta hadallada kicinaya colaadda iyo dhisidda jawi ku habboon wada-hadal iyo dib-u-heshiisiin. 6-Waxaan si gaar ah ugu mahadcelineynaa qurba-joogta ee nala soo xiriiraya, kana walaacsan xaaladda dalkooda, isla markaana raadinaya waddo nabadeed oo lagu soo afjaro khilaafka. Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa inay dadaalkooda ku xoojiyaan nabadda, isu-soo-dhawaanshaha iyo taageerada shacabka ay dhibaatadu saameysay. 7-Waxaan sidoo kale ugu baaqaynaa saaxiibbada Soomaaliya iyo Beesha Caalamka inay taageeraan dadaallada nabadeed iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta, isla markaana ay dhiirrigeliyaan wada-hadal loo dhan yahay oo lagu gaari karo xal siyaasadeed oo waara. 8-Waxaan ka codsanaynaa Beesha Caalamka inay si dhow ula socdaan xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee ka jirta deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, ayna gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta shacabka, gaarsiinta gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo ka hortagga barakac iyo dhibaato hor leh. 9-Waxaan aaminsannahay in Koonfur Galbeed aysan u baahnayn dagaal kale, balse ay u baahan tahay wada-hadal, is-afgarad iyo dib-u-heshiisiin. Khilaafka siyaasadeed waa la xallin karaa haddii ay jirto rabitaan, dulqaad iyo in danta shacabka laga hormariyo danta qofeed ama kooxeed. 10-Waxaan sidoo kale aaminsannahay in dhiig la daadiyo uusan ahayn xal siyaasadeed, ayna masuuliyad wadajir ah tahay in laga hortago wax kasta oo sii kordhin kara colaadda, barakaca iyo kala fogaanshaha bulshada. Ugu dambeyn, waxay ku booriyeen dhammaan dhinacyada inay danta shacabka ka hormariyaan danta qofeed ama kooxeed, ayna doortaan waddada wada-hadalka iyo is-afgaradka si loo soo afjaro dhibaatada jirta. “Waxaan rajaynaynaa in dadaallada wadajirka ah ee nabadda iyo dib-u-heshiisiintu ay horseedaan xal siyaasadeed oo waara, soo celinta xasilloonida, isku-duubnida iyo rajada shacabka Koonfur Galbeed,” ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay bayaanka. items.title: 7 qof oo Soomaalia h oo lagu aasay magaalada Bari ee Talyaaniga kadib markii…
items.description: Bari (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Bari ee koonfurta Talyaaniga ayaa 9-kii September lagu aasay toddoba tahriibayaal Soomaali ah oo bishii hore ku geeriyooday safar halis ah oo ay kaga soo gudbayeen badda Mediterranean-ka. Aaska ayaa ka dhacay qabuuraha Palese ee magaalada Bari, iyadoo marxuumada loo sameeyey aas waafaqsan diinta Islaamka, waxaana ka qeyb galay wakiillo ka socday bulshada Muslimiinta Talyaaniga, dowladda hoose ee Bari, qunsuliyadda Soomaaliya iyo jaaliyadda Soomaaliyeed ee dalkaas. Toddobada qof ayaa ku dhintay doon yar oo alwaax ah oo 16-kii August ka soo shiraacatay magaalada Zuwara ee galbeedka Libya, kuna sii jeeday dhinaca Yurub. Markabka gurmadka ee Life Support , oo ay maamusho hay’adda samafalka ee EMERGENCY, ayaa subaxnimadii 17-kii August gaaray doonta xilli ay ku jirtay biyaha caalamiga ah ee aagga baadigoobka iyo samatabbixinta Libya. Shaqaalaha gurmadka ayaa doonta ka helay 57 qof, balse toddoba ka mid ah ayaa durba geeriyooday. Sagaal qof oo kale ayaa u baahday gargaar caafimaad, iyadoo laba ka mid ah ay xaaladdoodu aad u liidatay sababo la xiriira neef-qabatin. Dadkaasi ayaa muddo dheer ku jiray qeybta hoose ee doonta oo ciriiri ahayd, taas oo EMERGENCY ay sheegtay inay sababtay xaaladda caafimaad ee qaar ka mid ah rakaabka. Laba qof oo xaaladdoodu halis ahayd ayaa markii dambe diyaarad ama gaadiid caafimaad loogu daadgureeyey, halka 48 qof oo kale iyo meydadka toddobada qof ay markabka Life Support ku gaareen dekedda Bari 20-kii August. Dadka la badbaadiyey waxay isugu jireen 45 rag ah iyo shan dumar ah, waxaana 29 ka mid ah ay ahaayeen carruur aan waalid ama qof mas’uul ka ah la socon. Waxaa ka mid ahaa wiil Soomaali ah oo 17 jir ah, kaas oo sheegay inuu muddo sanad ah safar ku soo jiray ka hor inta uusan Libya gaarin. Wiilka ayaa sheegay inuu qeybta hoose ee doonta kula jiray laba saaxiib oo ay isku da’ ahaayeen, midkoodna uu geeriyooday halka kan kalena xaalad caafimaad loo qaaday. Aaska toddobada qof ayaa yimid ku dhowaad saddex toddobaad kadib markii meydadkooda la keenay Bari. Hay’adaha Talyaaniga, bulshada Muslimiinta iyo jaaliyadda Soomaaliyeed ayaa iska kaashaday qabanqaabada aaska, si marxuumada loogu sameeyo aas sharaf leh oo waafaqsan caqiidadooda. Safarka bartamaha Mediterranean-ka ee ka yimaada xeebaha Libya ayaa weli ka mid ah marinnada ugu halista badan ee ay isticmaalaan tahriibayaasha doonaya inay gaaraan Yurub, iyadoo sannad kasta boqolaal qof ay ku dhintaan ama ku waayaan raadkooda badda. items.description: Xamsa oo Wasaaradaha Dowladda Ku Sameeyay Qiimeyn Waxqabad MUQDISHO, Sabti, 12 Sebteembar 2026 — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa kulan la xisaabtan iyo qiimeyn ah la yeeshay wasiirrada Xukuumadda DanQaran, iyadoo lagu eegayay heerka ay wasaaraduhu uga soo baxeen qorshayaashii iyo ballanqaadyadii ay hore u dejiyeen. Qiimeynta ayaa lagu saleeyay shaqooyinka iyo yoolalka ay wasiirradu ku heshiiyeen inay fuliyaan, iyadoo la eegayay waxyaabihii qabsoomay, caqabadihii horyimid iyo meelaha u baahan in wax laga beddelo ama la dardargeliyo. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in nidaamkan isla xisaabtanku ujeeddadiisu tahay in si joogto ah loo cabbiro waxqabadka Xukuumadda, lana ogaado sababaha keena in qaar ka mid ah qorshayaasha aan loo fulin sidii loogu talagalay. “Qorshe ayaynu samaysanay, idinka ayaa dajiyay, kadibna waan isla saxiixanay, qorshihii ayaan isla qiimeynaynaa, waxaan eegeynaa caqabadaha jira, fursadaha iyo waxyaabaha aan sixi karno,” ayuu yiri Xamsa Cabdi Barre. Markan, qiimeynta ayaa lagu soo bandhigay qaab dijitaal ah, iyadoo shaashad weyn lagu muujiyay boqolleyda natiijooyinka ay wasaaraduhu ka gaareen qorshayaashooda iyo kala sarreynta waxqabadka wasaaradaha. Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa hore u sameeyay hannaan la mid ah oo lagu qiimeeyay waxqabadka Xukuumadda DanQaran. Bishii Agoosto 2025, Xamsa ayaa daah-furay qiimeyn lagu eegayay waxyaabihii ka qabsoomay qorshaha Xukuumadda muddadii saddexda sano ahayd ee ay xilka haysay. Nidaamka qiimeynta ayaa sidoo kale la jaanqaadaya dadaallada dowladda ee ku aaddan casriyeynta maamulka iyo adeegsiga teknoolojiyadda. Istaraatiijiyadda Dowladnimada Danabaysan ee dowladda ayaa si gaar ah u qeexaysa in tiknoolojiyadda loo adeegsado hagaajinta maamulka, adeegyada dowladda iyo hababka kormeerka iyo qiimeynta. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa wasiirrada, agaasimeyaasha guud iyo shaqaalaha farsamada ku boorriyay inay dardargeliyaan howlaha qaranka, isagoo sheegay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay xukuumadda ka sugayaan waxqabad muuqda. Qiimeynta ayaa sidaas ku noqonaysa qayb ka mid ah habka dowladda ay ugu raadjoogto fulinta qorshayaasheeda, iyadoo natiijooyinka iyo caqabadaha soo baxa loo adeegsanayo dib-u-habeyn iyo sixitaan ku yimaada yoolalka wasaaradaha. The post Wasiirrada Xamsa oo Shaashad Lagu Kala Sarreysiiyay first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Trump oo diiday laba codsi oo uga yimid bin Salmaan oo wajahay xaalad halis ah
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Maxamed bin Salmaan, ayaa laba jeer oo xiriir ah Madaxweyne Donald Trump ka codsaday in Mareykanku weerarro militari ku qaado Xuutiyiinta Yemen, xilli kooxda ay si degdeg ah ula wareegeyso goobo istaraatiiji ah oo ku teedsan marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Trump ayaa diiday codsigaas, sida ay warbaahinta Axios u sheegeen laba sarkaal oo Mareykan ah, iyadoo maamulka Washington uu xilligan doonayo inuu ka fogaado inuu si toos ah uga furto dagaal kale Yemen. Codsiga Sacuudiga ayaa yimid xilli Xuutiyiintu ay horumar weyn ka sameeyeen xeebaha Badda Cas ee Yemen. Reuters ayaa maanta sheegtay in kooxda ay gaartay jasiiradda istaraatiijiga ah ee Perim, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Mayyun, kuna taalla gudaha Bab al-Mandab, kadib markii ciidamada dowladda Yemen ay halkaas isaga baxeen. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale la wareegay magaalada xeebta ah ee Dhubab, oo ka soo horjeedda jasiiradda, kadib markii ay Khamiistii qabsadeen Mokha iyo jasiiradaha Hanish. Horumarkan ayaa si weyn u xoojiyay gacanta ay kooxdu ku hayso marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka iyo dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga. Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Riyadh, maadaama Iran ay horey cadaadis ugu saartay isu-socodka maraakiibta marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Haddii Xuutiyiinta oo Tehran taageerto ay awood buuxda ku yeeshaan Bab al-Mandab, Iran iyo xulafadeeda ayaa saameyn ku yeelan kara laba ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee shidaalka iyo ganacsiga dunida. Xiisadda cusub ayaa durba saameysay suuqyada tamarta, iyadoo qiimaha shidaalka uu sare u kac weyn sameeyay toddobaadkan sababo la xiriira cabsi laga qabo in dagaallada gobolka ay carqaladeeyaan sahayda. MBS oo laba jeer wacay Trump Sida ay Axios ku warrantay, Maxamed bin Salmaan ayaa Khamiistii markii ugu horreysay Trump la hadlay xilli ciidamada Xuutiyiintu ku sii siqayeen magaalada xeebta ku taalla ee Mokha, halka ciidamada Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero ay dib u gurayeen. Dhaxal-sugaha ayaa Trump uga warbixiyay xaaladda sii xumaaneysa, balse dhowr saacadood kadib ayuu mar kale wacay, isaga oo markan si toos ah uga codsaday inuu amro ciidamada Mareykanka inay duqeymo ku qaadaan Xuutiyiinta. Trump ayaa diiday inuu ciidamada Mareykanka si toos ah dagaalka u geliyo. Hase yeeshee, sarkaal Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in Washington ay Sacuudiga siin doonto xog sirdoon oo ku saabsan Xuutiyiinta iyo macluumaad ka caawinaya bartilmaameedyada militari. Qiyaastii 200 oo askari oo Mareykan ah ayaa sidoo kale ku sugan Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo bixiya taageero aan toos uga qeyb ahayn dagaalka, sida uu sheegay sarkaalka. Taliyaha Taliska Dhexe ee ciidamada Mareykanka, Admiral Brad Cooper, ayaa Khamiistii tagay Sacuudiga si uu uga qeybgalo kulamo degdeg ah oo lagu koordinayo xaaladda, sida ay Axios u sheegeen laba ilo-wareed oo arrinta la socda. Safaaradda Sacuudiga ee Washington iyo Aqalka Cad ayaan ka hadlin warbixinta. Mowqifka Sacuudiga oo is-beddelay Codsiga cusub ee Riyadh wuxuu muujinayaa isbeddel weyn oo ku yimid mowqifkii Sacuudiga ee dhowr bilood ka hor, markii madaxda boqortooyada ay Washington u sheegeen inay iyagu awoodaan inay Xuutiyiinta la tacaalaan. Dagaalka labada dhinac ayaa dib u qarxay bishii Luulyo, kadib markii Sacuudiga uu hor istaagay diyaarad Iranian ah oo siday mas’uuliyiin sare oo Xuutiyiin ah inay ku degto Sanca. Xilligaas Maxamed bin Salmaan ayaa Trump ka codsaday taageero siyaasadeed oo ku aaddan qorshe lagu weerarayo garoonka diyaaradaha Sanca, balse wuxuu caddeeyay inuusan u baahnayn kaalmo militari oo Mareykanku bixiyo. Trump ayaa taageeray tallaabada Sacuudiga. Xuutiyiinta ayaa kadib weerarro ku qaaday maraakiib shidaal oo Sacuudiga leeyahay oo marayay Badda Cas, waxayna weerarradooda ku ballaariyeen xarumo tamareed oo ku yaalla gudaha Sacuudiga. Sacuudiga iyo xoogagga Yemen ee uu taageero ayaa iyaguna kaga jawaabay duqeymo cirka ah iyo howlgallo dhulka ah oo lagu qaaday fariisimaha Xuutiyiinta. Hase yeeshee, markii dagaalku sii xoogaystay ayay Riyadh bilowday inay Washington ka dalbato taageero sii kordheysa, taas oo ugu dambeyn gaartay codsiga ah in ciidamada Mareykanka ay si toos ah u duqeeyaan Xuutiyiinta. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay Sacuudiga u sheegay in amarka Trump uu yahay in ciidamada Mareykanka ay diiradda saaraan Iran iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz, isla markaana laga fogaado furitaanka jiho dagaal oo kale oo Yemen ah. Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan maamulka Trump ayaa sheegay in mudnaanta Washington ay tahay ilaalinta xorriyadda isu-socodka Badda Cas, iyadoo xulafada gobolka loo daayo inay hormuud ka noqdaan wax ka qabashada khilaafaadka amni ee gobolka. “Maraykanku wuxuu diiradda saaraya ilaalinta danaha aasaasiga ah ee amniga qaranka, sida xaqiijinta xorriyadda isu-socodka Badda Cas, isagoo awood siinaya saaxiibada gobolka inay hoggaamiyaan maaraynta iyo xallinta caqabadaha amni ee gobolka,” ayuu yiri sarkaalka. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Washington ay xiriir joogto ah la leedahay Sacuudiga iyo dowladda Yemen oo ku saabsan xasilloonida gobolka. The post Trump oo diiday laba codsi oo uga yimid bin Salmaan oo wajahay xaalad halis ah appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Hindisaha ABUUR oo La Daah-furay, Ardayda Soomaaliyeedna Fursad Cusub
items.description: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Daah-furay Sannad-Tacliimeedka Jaamacadaha Soomaaliya Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa 12-ka Sebtembar 2026 ka qaybgalay munaasabadda furitaanka sannad-tacliimeedka 2026/2027 ee waxbarashada sare, taas oo lagu qabtay xarunta Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed ee Muqdisho. Munaasabadda ayaa diiradda lagu saaray tayeynta waxbarashada sare, horumarinta cilmi-baarista iyo diyaarinta dhalinyaro leh aqoon iyo xirfado ay kaga qayb qaataan dib-u-dhiska dalka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in horumarka Soomaaliya uu si weyn ugu xiran yahay maalgelinta waxbarashada, kobcinta aqoonta iyo taageerada dhalinyarada. Wuxuu xusay in jaamacaduhu ay door muhiim ah ku leeyihiin soo saarista jiil awood u leh hoggaaminta iyo horumarinta dalka. Intii ay socotay munaasabadda, Madaxweynaha ayaa daah-furay Hindisaha ABUUR, oo loogu talagalay in lagu kobciyo hal-abuurka, curinta iyo xirfadaha ganacsi ee ardayda Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, wuxuu xarigga ka jaray dhismayaal cusub oo ay ka mid yihiin xarumaha kulliyadaha Jaamacadda Ummadda, xarunta guddiga caafimaadka arrimaha Carabta iyo xarunta gurmadka degdegga ah iyo daryeelka xaaladaha halista ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale dhagax-dhigay dhismaha guriga martida Jaamacadda Ummadda iyo xarun loogu talagalay hal-abuurka iyo cilmi-baarista. Dhismayaashan ayaa la sheegay in ay qayb ka yihiin qorshayaasha lagu horumarinayo kaabeyaasha waxbarashada sare, tababarrada caafimaadka iyo cilmi-baarista. Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed waxay ka mid tahay hay’adaha ugu waaweyn ee waxbarashada sare ee dalka. Qorshayaasha dowladda ee jaamacadda waxaa ka mid ah ballaarinta kaabeyaasha waxbarashada, xoojinta cilmi-baarista, horumarinta manhajyada iyo kordhinta fursadaha shaqo ee ardayda ka qalin-jabisa. Bogga rasmiga ah ee Jaamacadda Ummadda ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya in jaamacaddu bixiso barnaamijyo kala duwan oo heerka koowaad iyo labaad ah, iyadoo xoogga saarta waxbarashada, cilmi-baarista, hal-abuurka iyo adeegga bulshada. The post Hindisaha ABUUR oo La Daah-furay, Ardayda Soomaaliyeedna Fursad Cusub first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

Qorshayaasha dowladda ee jaamacadda waxaa ka mid ah ballaarinta kaabeyaasha waxbarashada, xoojinta cilmi-baarista, horumarinta manhajyada iyo kordhinta fursadaha shaqo ee ardayda ka qalin-jabisa. Bogga rasmiga ah ee Jaamacadda Ummadda ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya in jaamacaddu bixiso barnaamijyo kala duwan oo heerka koowaad iyo labaad ah, iyadoo xoogga saarta waxbarashada, cilmi-baarista, hal-abuurka iyo adeegga bulshada. items.title: Xasan Sheekh iyo Al-Issa oo Arrimo Xasaasi ah Ka Wada Hadlay
items.description: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Muqdisho ku qaabilay Madaxa Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa 11-ka Sebtembar 2026 magaalada Muqdisho ku qaabilay Xoghayaha Guud ee Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka, ahna Guddoomiyaha Golaha Culimada Muslimiinta, Dr. Mohammed bin Abdulkarim Al-Issa. Kulanka oo ka dhacay Madaxtooyada Qaranka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka, gaar ahaan arrimaha diinta, nabadda iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la dhiirrigeliyo faham dheellitiran oo ku saabsan diinta Islaamka, lana iska kaashado ka hortagga fikirka xagjirka ah iyo marin-habaabinta dhalinyarada. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa uga mahadceliyay Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka taageerada ay u muujisay midnimada iyo madaxbannaanida Soomaaliya, iyo kaalinta ay ka qaadato horumarinta bulshada. Booqashada Al-Issa ee Muqdisho ayaa ku soo beegantay xilli Soomaaliya ay xoogga saarayso doorka culimada iyo hay’adaha diinta ee wacyigelinta bulshada, xoojinta nabadda iyo ka hortagga fikirrada xagjirka ah. Intii uu ku sugnaa Muqdisho, Al-Issa wuxuu sidoo kale khudbadda Jimcaha ka jeediyay Masjidka weyn ee magaalada, isagoo salaadda hoggaamiyay, waxaana ka qaybgalay masuuliyiin, culimo iyo dadweyne badan. The post Xasan Sheekh iyo Al-Issa oo Arrimo Xasaasi ah Ka Wada Hadlay first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Abaaraha iyo Fatahaadaha Soomaaliya oo Miiska Caalamka La Saaray
items.description: Soomaaliya oo Brazil ku soo Bandhigtay Khibraddeeda Maalgelinta Cimilada Agaasimaha Fulinta Sanduuqa Qaran ee Isbeddelka Cimilada Soomaaliya, Liban Obsiye, ayaa magaalada Salvador ee dalka Brazil kaga qaybgalay shir goboleed looga hadlay sidii loo heli lahaa loona xoojin lahaa maalgelinta wax-ka-qabashada isbeddelka cimilada. Shirka oo socday saddex maalmood ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay masuuliyiin maaliyadeed iyo khubaro ka kala socday dalal Afrikaan ah iyo kuwa Latin America. Kulanka waxaa diiradda lagu saaray caqabadaha dalalku kala kulmaan helitaanka maalgelinta cimilada iyo hababka lagu kordhin karo maalgelinta gudaha iyo tan caalamiga ah. Ka qaybgalayaashu waxay is-weydaarsadeen khibrado ku saabsan isticmaalka dakhliga gudaha, iskaashiga dowladda iyo ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay, maalgelinta khataraha musiibooyinka, caymiska, curaarta qurbe-joogta iyo deymaha. Sidoo kale, waxaa la soo bandhigay qaabab kala duwan oo dalalku u maareeyaan una abaabulaan maalgelinta la xiriirta cimilada. Liban Obsiye ayaa shirka ku soo bandhigay xaaladda Soomaaliya, isaga oo sharaxay fursadaha jira, caqabadaha hortaagan helitaanka maalgelinta iyo baahida loo qabo in dhaqaalaha cimilada si wax-ku-ool ah loogu jiheeyo dalalka nugul ee si weyn u wajahaya saameynta isbeddelka cimilada. Obsiye wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay dalalka sida weyn ugu nugul dhibaatooyinka cimilada, isla markaana ay muhiim tahay in dowladda, bulshada iyo hay’adaha kale ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan xoojinta adkeysiga bulshada iyo ilaalinta nolol-maalmeedka dadka. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda iskaashiga caalamiga ah, hal-abuurka maaliyadeed iyo wadaagista khibradaha si loo helo xalal waara oo lagu taageero dalalka wajahaya abaaraha, fatahaadaha iyo dhibaatooyinka kale ee ka dhasha isbeddelka cimilada. Kulankan oo ahaa meertadii labaad ee is-weydaarsiga gobollada ee wasaaradaha maaliyadda iyo cimilada waxaa si wadajir ah u soo qabanqaabiyey Hay’adda Horumarinta Faransiiska, Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Brazil, Bangiga Horumarinta Maraykanka, iyo Machadka Dhaqaalaha Cimilada. The post Abaaraha iyo Fatahaadaha Soomaaliya oo Miiska Caalamka La Saaray first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Mas’uuliyiin katirsan dowladda oo ka qeyb galay shir muhiim ah oo ka dhacay dalka Masar
items.description: Qaahira (Raxanreeb Online)Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada xukuumadda Soomaaliya Xildhibaan Cabdikariin Cabdow Xeydar, ayaa magaalada El Alamein ee dalka Masar kaga qaybgalay Shirweynaha Caalamiga ah ee International AirShow, kaas oo ay isugu yimaadaan wasiirrada gaadiidka iyo duulista, madaxda duulista rayidka ah iyo masuuliyiinta hay’adaha maamulka hawada iyo duulimaadyada. Intii uu socday shirweynaha Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada xukuumadda Soomaaliya Xildhibaan Cabdikariin Cabdow Xeydar, ayaa kulan doceed la qaatay Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada dalka Masar Mudane Dr. Samix Xanafi. Kulanka labada masuul ayaa looga hadlay xiriirka qotada dheer ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Masar iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga iyo wax-wada-qabsiga labada dal. Sidoo kale kulanka waxaa lagu soo hadal qaaday xog ku saabsan halka uu marayo qorshaha dib-u-soo-celinta diyaaraddii Somali Airlines. Masarna waxay ballanqaadday inay Soomaaliya khibrad ahaan uga caawin doonto qorshaha horumarinta Garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde. Ugu dambeyn Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada XFS Xildhibaan Cabdikariin Cabdow Xeydar, ayaa uga mahadceliyay Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Masar garab istaagga iyo taageerada uu u fidiyo horumarinta duulista Soomaaliya The post Mas’uuliyiin katirsan dowladda oo ka qeyb galay shir muhiim ah oo ka dhacay dalka Masar appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Maxaa ka cusub qorshaha dib u dajinta ee uu maamulka gobolka Banaadir wado?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa magaalada Muqdisho, Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa mar kale qaaday tallaabo la xiriirta qorshaha dib u dajinta qoysaska ay guryahoodu saameeyeen waddo furista Obasiibooyinka ku yaalla caasimada. Muungaab ayaa maanta waaxda Xaaji-Cabdi ee degmada Gubadley ka dhagax-dhigay mashaariic adeegyo bulsho oo muhiim ah, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay deegaanka dib-u-dejinta qoysaska ay saameeyeen hawlaha waddo-furista iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha magaalada Muqdisho. Sida uu sheegay maamulka gobolka, mashaariicdan ayaa ka kooban Suuq, Masjid, Xarun Waaxeed iyo Rug Caafimaad (MCH), iyadoo sidoo kale shirkadaha korontada iyo biyaha ay ka bilaabayaan hawlaha adeeg-bixinta. Duqa Muqdisho Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) oo munaasabadda ka hadlay ayaa sheegay in mashaariicdan ay qayb ka yihiin qorshaha maamulkiisa ee lagu xaqiijinayo dib-u-dejin nidaamsan, adeegyo bulsho oo la heli karo iyo kaabayaal waara oo loogu talagalay qoysaska dib loo dejinayo. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa iyadoo la fulinayo amarka Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, waxa uu dhawaan in ka badan kun boos oo dhul ah u iibiyey qoysaska ay saameeyeen hawlaha waddo-furista iyo horumarinta caasimadda ee ka socda Muqdisho. Horay guddoomiyaha gobolka Banaadir ayaa u sheegay in si lacag-la’aan ah boosaskaas loogu wareejinayo qoysaska guryahoodu ku waayay hagaajinta xaafadaha isku-raranka ah (OBASIIBOOYINKA) ee ku yaalla caasimada. Waxaa kale oo uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in qorshaha dib-u-dejinta la sii ballaarinayo, iyadoo dhulal cusub laga iibin doono degmooyinka Daarusalaam, Kaxda iyo Garasbaaleey, si qoysas kale loo dejiyo. Si kastaba, Deegaanka Xaaji-Cabdi oo dhawaan laga xarig-jaray Dugsi Hoose iyo Dhexe oo lacag la’aan ah, ayaa waxa uu sidoo kale leeyahay adeegyada aasaasiga u ah ee nolosha, sida; biyo iyo koronto, waxaana hadda loo qorsheynayaa suuq, masaajid iyo rug caafimaad. The post Maxaa ka cusub qorshaha dib u dajinta ee uu maamulka gobolka Banaadir wado? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa iyadoo la fulinayo amarka Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, waxa uu dhawaan in ka badan kun boos oo dhul ah u iibiyey qoysaska ay saameeyeen hawlaha waddo-furista iyo horumarinta caasimadda ee ka socda Muqdisho. Horay guddoomiyaha gobolka Banaadir ayaa u sheegay in si lacag-la’aan ah boosaskaas loogu wareejinayo qoysaska guryahoodu ku waayay hagaajinta xaafadaha isku-raranka ah (OBASIIBOOYINKA) ee ku yaalla caasimada. Waxaa kale oo uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in qorshaha dib-u-dejinta la sii ballaarinayo, iyadoo dhulal cusub laga iibin doono degmooyinka Daarusalaam, Kaxda iyo Garasbaaleey, si qoysas kale loo dejiyo. Si kastaba, Deegaanka Xaaji-Cabdi oo dhawaan laga xarig-jaray Dugsi Hoose iyo Dhexe oo lacag la’aan ah, ayaa waxa uu sidoo kale leeyahay adeegyada aasaasiga u ah ee nolosha, sida; biyo iyo koronto, waxaana hadda loo qorsheynayaa suuq, masaajid iyo rug caafimaad. items.title: Machadka siyaasadda  ee Hudson Institute ayaa Somaliland ku tilmaamay…..
items.description: Machadka siyaasadda iyo cilmi-baadhista ee Hudson Institute oo fadhigiisu yahay magaalada Washington, ee dalka Maraykanka ayaa Somaliland ku tilmaantay “lamaane istaraatiiji ah oo ku yaalla Geeska Afrika”, Warbixintu waxay xustay in muhiimadda Somaliland ay marba marka dambaysa sii kordhayso, gaar ahaan marka la eego xaaladda juqraafi-siyaasadeed iyo amni ee gobolka. Hudson Institute ayaa warbixinteeda ku sheegtay in, kaddib markii Somaliland iyo Taiwan ay sameeyeen xidhiidhka diblomaasiyadeed sannadkii 2020, ay Somaliland mar kale si weyn uga soo dhex muuqatay wararka caalamka. Sidoo kale waxay tilmaantay warbixintu is mar kale isbedel weyn oo taariikhi ahi ka dhacay Geeska Afrika 26-kii December 2025, kadib markii Israel ay noqotay waddankii ugu horreeyay ee aqoonsada madaxbannaanida Somaliland tan iyo markii ay dib ula soo noqotay madaxbannaanideeda 1991-kii. Warbixinta Machadka Hudson Institute oo Wargeyska Dawan soo xigtay, wuxuu tilmaamay in dagaalka Iran, falalka amni-daradda ah ee kooxdsa Xuutiyiinta Yemen, saamaynta sii kordhaysa ee Shiinaha ee Afrika, iyo sidoo kale raadadka Ruushka iyo Iran ee Bariga Afrika ay dhammaantood muujinayaan muhiimadda istaraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland, iyada oo warbixintu sidoo kale tilmaantay in ay tahay dal si dhow ula jaanqaadaya reer Galbeedka. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi “Cirro”, ayaa booqashadiisii ugu horreysay ku jooga dalka Maraykanka tan iyo markii uu ku guulaystay doorashadii madaxtinimada ee November 2024. Waxa kale oo lagu xusay in muddada uu ku sugan yahay Washington, in Madaxweyne Cirro khudbad muhiim ah ka jeedin doonaa Hudson Institute14-ka Sebtembar, 2026, isla markaana kadib uu ka qayb-geli doono kulan wada-sheekeysi ah (fireside chat) oo uu la yeelan doono Joshua Meservey, oo ah khabiir sare oo ka tirsan machadka. Hudson Institute oo ah hay’ad cilmi baadhiseed oo xoogga saarta arrimaha siyaasadda, amniga qaranka Maraykanka, xidhiidhada caalamiga ah, dhaqaalaha, tamarta iyo tignoolajiyadda, isla markaana ah xarun cilmi-baadhiseed oo door weyn ku leh jihaynta siyaasiyiinta iyo dadka go’aamada ka gaadha Washington, marka ay Somaliland ku tilmaanto “lamaane istaraatiiji ah. Wwaa hadal xambaarsan muhiimad siyaasadeed oo muuqata, maadaama Somaliland loo arko dal leh muhiimad juqraafi oo istaraatiiji ah, xasillooni siyaasadeed iyo awood ay kaga qayb qaadan karto amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Aragtida Hudson waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa in Somaliland ay sii kordhinso miisaankeeda istaraatiiji ah, isla markaana ay muujinayso awood diblumaasiyadeed oo ka baxsan doodda aqoonsiga oo keliya, gaar ahaan marka la eego amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, amniga gobolka iyo tartanka quwadaha caalamka ee Geeska Afrika. Dhinaca kale Madaxweynaha Somaliland Abdirahman Irro ayaa Washington kaga qayb-galay marti qaad casho sharaf ah oo uu soo qabanqaabiyay Safiirka Israel ee dalka Maraykanka ambassador Yechiel Leiter. Waxaa ka soo qaybgalay diblumaasiyiin, saraakiil hore oo Mareykanka ah, iyo saaxiibbada labada dimoqraadiyad. Sidoo kale Madaxweynaha waxa kala qayb-galay martiqaadkan J. Peter Pham oo ah aqoonyahan, diblomaasi iyo khabiir Maraykan ah oo muddo dheer ka shaqaynaya arrimaha siyaasadda, amniga iyo dhaqaalaha, gaar ahaan qaaradda Afrika. Sidoo kalena ahaa Ergaygii Gaarka ahaa ee Maraykanka u qaabilsanaa Gobollada Saaxil iyo Harooyinka Waaweyn ee Afrika. Peter Pham ayaa sharaf weyn ku tilmaamay in uu ka qaybgalo kulankan qiimaha badan ee lagu maamuusay Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), iyo wafdigiisa. waxaanu yidhi “Sharaf weyn ayay ii tahay inaan caawa ka qayb galo casho uu martigeliyey Mudane Yechiel Leiter, Safiirka Israa’iil ee Maraykanka, taas oo lagu maamuusay Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), iyo wafdigiisa. Waxay ahayd fursad qiimo leh inaan goob-joog ka noqdo saaxiibtinimada sii xoogaysanaysa ee u dhexaysa labada dal ee dimuqraadiga ah, kuwaas oo ku kala yaalla gobollo istaraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah caalamka. Waa habeen xusuus mudan oo lagu xusay saaxiibtinimo, iskaashi iyo dano wadaag.”

items.title: Muxuu yahay nidaamka Xasan Sheekh ku dhawaaqay ee lagu heli doono shaqada DF?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo maanta ka qayb-galay munaasabad ka dhacday xarunta Jaamacadda Ummadda ee magaalada Muqdisho, ayaa ka hadlay arrimo la xiriira habka loo qaato shaqaalaha hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dhawaan laga gudbi doono nidaamka qabiilka ku saleysan ee shaqaaleysiinta, isagoo ku dhawaaqay barnaamij cusub oo shaqaalaha dowladda lagu qaadan doono aqoontooda, kartidooda iyo u-qalmitaankooda shaqada markaas loo xulanayo. “Qofka raba shaqada dowladda waa inuu ku helo aqoontiisa iyo awoodiisa ee uusan ku helin yaa qaraabo tihiin ama ii melee’,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynuhu. Sidoo kale, wuxuu hoosta ka xariiqay in laga gudbi doono nidaamkii hore ee shaqaale qaadashada, iyadoo meesha laga saarayo eexda iyo musuqmaasuqa. “Yaa taqaan inaan ka gudubno oo maxaa taqaanaa u gudubno ayaan rabnaa?, haddii Alle yiraahdo,” ayuu yiri mar kale yiri Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in barnaamijka cusub uu keeni doono hab loo tartamo shaqooyinka ka bannaan dowladda iyo hay’addaha gaarka loo lee yahay, isagoo xusay in nidaamkan uu yahay mid ka jira dunida kale. ‘’Haddii seek-seek ku ahayd oo ku liidatay imtixaanka oo C iyo D wadatay, waxaa laguu imaanaa marka la waayo qofka A ama B haystay, sidaas ku talagal’,’ ayuu sii raaciyay madaxweynuhu. Hadalkan ayuu madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh maanta ka sheegay Jaamacadda Ummadda oo laga daah-furay barnaamij lagu magacaabo (Abuur), kaas oo diiradda saaraya in ardayda Jaamacadaha dhammeeya laga dhiso dhinacyada aragtida iyo cilmi-baarista, si ay door ugu yeeshaan horumarka bulshada. items.title: Somalia president endorses Ali Gudlawe for Hirshabelle leader
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has chosen incumbent Hirshabelle leader Ali Gudlawe to become the next president of Hirshabelle State, making Gudlawe the only candidate competing on behalf of the ruling Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP), Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Ahmed Hagar Dabaged said on Friday. Dabaged said Mohamud had promised him years ago that he would make him the regional leader, but recently called him for a meeting and told him that he had reneged on that promise and chosen Ali Gudlawe instead to become the next president of Hirshabelle. The Hirshabelle vice president said the decision came as a surprise and a shock, particularly because of the role played by the Hawadle clan, to which he belongs and which he described as the president’s maternal uncles. Dabaged said the Hawadle clan had fully taken part in the president’s military campaign against Al-Shabaab, carrying a massive burden and suffering major setbacks, with most of its constituencies recaptured by the insurgents. He expressed dismay at the president’s decision to turn his back on his maternal uncles at a time when, according to Dabaged, they had sacrificed everything for Mohamud to consolidate power and appear strong. Dabaged said he was particularly shocked that a Somali president would renege on such a promise and turn away from his maternal uncles after the sacrifices they had made in support of him. items.title: Ciidamada oo qaaday weerar ay dib ugu qabsanayaan deegaanka Geelgub
items.description: Ciidanka Kumaandooska Gorgor ee Xoogga Dalka ayaa maalintii 2aad weerar ku haya maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ee ku sugan deegaanka Geelgub oo hoostaga Degmada Cadale ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe. Kumaandooska Gorgor ayaa waxay u muuqdaan kuwo isku dayaya in ay si buuxda u soo afjaraan joogitaanka maleeshiyadaasi ee deegaanka Geelgub, iyagoo gacan ka helaya Ciidanka Guutada 3aad, Qaybta 12-ka April ee Xoogga Dalka. Taliyaha Guutada 18aad, Qaybta 1aad ee Kumaandooska Gorgor, Korneyl Aadan Maxamed Faarax oo hawlgalka hoggaaminaya ayaa laga soo xigtay in uu socdo guluf lagu xoreynayo deegaankaasi. Qoraal ka soo baxay Taliska Guutada 18aad ee Gorgor ayaa lagu sheegay in ciidamadu ay la wareegeen saldhigyo muhiim ah oo Al Shabaab ku lahayd deegaanka. “Hawlgalka burburinta ee ka socda Shabellaha Dhexe ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalada Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay ku doonayaan in dalka looga ciribtiro kooxaha Khawaarijta, looguna soo celiyo shacabka nabad, amni iyo maamul dowladeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Shabaabka ayaa Geelgub qabsaday bishii March ee sanadkii 2025, waana intii ay socdeen weeraradii ay bishii February ka bilaabeen bariga Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe ee socday illaa bishii April ee sanadkaasi. Shabaabka ayaa xilligaasi si aan horey loo arag isugu soo fidiyay dhulkii xorta ahaa ee bariga gobolkaasi.

items.title: Madxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo la kulmay xoghayaha guud ee Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa qasriga Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay Xoghayaha Guud ee Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka, ahna Gudomiyaha hay’adda Culimada Muslimiinta, Dr. Mohammed bin Abdulkarim Al-Issa. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo fahamka saxda ah ee Diinta Islaamka, ka hortagga iyo la-dagaallanka fikirka xagjirka ah iyo xoojinta nabadda, wadajirka iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Madaxweynaha ayaa uga mahadceliyay Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka mawaaqifteeda taageridda, Midnimida iyo Madaxbnaanida Soomaliya iyo doorka ay ka qaadato horumarinta bulshada , isaga oo adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay iskaashi xooggan oo lagaga hortagayo fikradaha xagjirka ah iyo marin-habaabinta dhalinyarada. items.title: Abiy Ahmed oo billaabay in uu drone sameysto xilli uu weerar culus qorsheynayo
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa si weyn u ballaarisay awooddeeda diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, iyadoo dalka gudihiisa ka hirgelisay laba warshadood oo soo saara drones-ka, halka khubaradu ay rumeysan yihiin in ciidamada federaalka ay hadda haystaan kumannaan noocyo kala duwan ah. Horumarkan ayaa dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed siinaya awood dheeraad ah oo ay kula dagaallanto kooxaha hubeysan ee ka dagaallama gobollo dhowr ah, gaar ahaan Amxaarada, Oromada iyo Tigray. Itoobiya ayaa si weyn u ogaatay muhiimadda drone-yada intii uu socday dagaalkii Tigray ee 2020 ilaa 2022. Diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Turkiga ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaatay markii ciidamada federaalka ay dib u riixeen xoogaggii Tigray ee xilligaas ku soo dhowaaday meel qiyaastii 200 km u jirta Addis Ababa. Tan iyo markaas, Addis Ababa waxay si joogto ah u ballaarineysay awooddeeda cirka, iyadoo iibsatay drone-yo casri ah isla markaana billowday inay qaar ka mid ah gudaha dalka ku farsameyso. Bishii Maarso 2025, Abiy Ahmed ayaa xarigga ka jaray warshadda SkyWin Aeronautics Industries ee Addis Ababa, taas oo dowladda Itoobiya sheegtay inay soo saarto diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo loogu talagalay isticmaalka rayidka iyo militariga. Wakaaladda wararka dowladda Itoobiya ee ENA ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in drone-yada lagu sameeyo warshadda ay naqshadeeyeen oo dhiseen xirfadlayaal Itoobiyaan ah. Abiy ayaa sheegay in ujeeddada barnaamijku aysan ahayn in colaado la huriyo, balse lagu xoojiyo awoodda ka-hortagga khataraha. Hase yeeshee, faahfaahinta dhabta ah ee awoodda wax-soo-saarka Itoobiya ayaan weli si buuxda loo ogeyn, waxaana dowladda lagu eedeeyay inay xaddiday xogta iyo gelitaanka warshadahaas. Pieter Wezeman, oo ka tirsan Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Cilmi-baarista Nabadda ee Stockholm, SIPRI, ayaa sheegay in bandhigga drone-yada gudaha lagu sameeyay uusan kaligiis caddeyn karin heerka ay Itoobiya dhab ahaan u gaartay isku-filnaanshaha teknoolajiyadda. “Hal hool oo ay yaallaan drone-yo dhalaalaya wax badan noogama sheegayo awoodda dhabta ah ee wax-soo-saarka iyo halka teknoolajiyadda, qaybaha muhiimka ah ama qalabka diyaar u ah isku-xirka laga keenay,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sheegay inuu rumeysan yahay in qayb weyn oo ka mid ah qalabkaas dibadda laga keeno. Itoobiya ayaa hore uga iibsatay Turkiga drone-yada casriga ah ee Akinci iyo Bayraktar TB2, halka ay sidoo kale haysato Wing Loong oo Shiinuhu sameeyo iyo Mohajer-6 oo laga leeyahay Iran. Jeremy Binnie oo ka tirsan shirkadda difaaca iyo sirdoonka ee Janes ayaa sheegay in nooca SW01 ee lagu soo bandhigay warshadda SkyWin uu aad ugu egyahay drone ganacsi oo laga heli karo Shiinaha. Sida uu sheegay, haddii drone-yada noocaas ah tiro badan loo soo saaro ciidamada, waxay si weyn u kordhin karaan awoodda cutubyada dhulka ee ogaanshaha bartilmaameedyada iyo hagidda madaafiicda, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu rakibi karo bambooyin yaryar. Warshad labaad oo lagu magacaabo Aeroabay ayaa la furay dabayaaqadii 2025, waxaana lagu soo saaraa kumannaan drone oo yaryar oo hubeysan. Wim Zwijnenburg, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay drone-yada kana tirsan hay’adda PAX, ayaa sheegay in diyaaradahaas ay ku kacayaan inta u dhaxaysa $5,000 iyo $10,000 midkiiba. Intooda badan waa nooca FPV, ama First-Person View, oo duuliyaha u oggolaanaya inuu si toos ah u arko goobta ay diyaaraddu dul marayso, waxaana qaarkood lagu rakibi karaa walxaha qarxa. Qaar ka mid ah drone-yadaas waxaa lagu hago fiilooyin fibre-optic ah, taas oo adkeyneysa in lagu carqaladeeyo qalabka dagaalka elektarooniga ah. Dagaallada gudaha Ballaarinta awoodda drone-yada Itoobiya ayaa ku soo beegmeysa iyadoo dowladda federaalka ay wajahayo jabhado hubeysan oo ka dagaallamaya qaybo kala duwan oo dalka ah. Hay’adda ACLED ee la socota colaadaha ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ay 102 weerar oo drone ah ka fuliyeen gobolka Amxaarada tan iyo markii uu halkaas ka billowday kacdoonka maleeshiyada Fano bishii Abriil 2023. Drone-yada ayaa sidoo kale loo adeegsaday dagaallada ka socda Oromada, oo ah gobolka uu kasoo jeedo Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Magnus Taylor oo ka tirsan International Crisis Group ayaa sheegay in drone-yada dhowr jeer lagu eedeeyay inay sababeen dhimashada dad rayid ah. Xiisadda ugu weyn ayaa hadda markale ka taagan Tigray. Ugu yaraan 14 weerar oo drone ah ayaa sanadkan laga diiwaangeliyay gobolkaas, toddobo ka mid ahna waxay dhaceen bishii Agoosto oo keliya, xilli ay isa soo tarayaan walaacyada laga qabo inuu dib u qarxo dagaal ballaaran. ACLED ayaa sheegtay in weerarradaasi ay u muuqdeen kuwo loogu talagalay in lagu carqaladeeyo abaabulka iyo qorsheynta ciidamada Tigray, xilli maamulka gobolka lagu eedeeyay inuu waday olole askareyn qasab ah. Zwijnenburg ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Itoobiya ay Tigray u muuqdaan inay ka adeegsanayaan diyaarado militari oo waaweyn oo meel fog laga hago, kuwaas oo ridi kara gantaallo ama bambooyin hagitaan leh. Amanuel Assefa, madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Tigray People’s Liberation Front, TPLF, ayaa ku eedeeyay dowladda federaalka inay drone-yada u adeegsaneyso “in cabsi lagu abuuro shacabka, lagu bartilmaameedsado mas’uuliyiinta siyaasadda iyo militariga, laguna burburiyo bartilmaameedyo gaar ah iyo kaabayaasha muhiimka ah ee rayidka”. Edward Bach oo ka tirsan shirkadda falanqeynta khataraha ee Verisk Maplecroft ayaa sheegay in weerarrada lagu beegsanayo bakhaarada hubka iyo waddooyinka saadka ay suuragal tahay inay qeyb ka yihiin diyaargarowga howlgal militari oo cusub. Hase yeeshee, qaar ka mid ah khubarada ayaa qaba in isticmaalka drone-yadu uu sidoo kale dowladda u saamaxayo inay cadaadis militari sii waddo iyadoo aan ciidamo badan dhulka gelin. Taylor ayaa sheegay in Abiy uusan xilligan u muuqan mid doonaya inuu markale galo dagaal dhulka ah oo qaali ku noqda Itoobiya. “Abiy wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu hadda arrintan u arko dagaal daal-gelin ah, waxaana maadaama uu drone-yada u adeegsan karo isaga oo aan la kulmin iska-caabin weyn, uu xaaladdan sii wadi karaa muddo dheer,” ayuu yiri. Safiirka ayaa sheegay in Turkigu uu Soomaaliya kala shaqeynayo mashaariic la xiriira hawada sare iyo Tiknolojiyada Dayax-gacmeedyada, iyadoo labada dal ay doonayaan in iskaashiga dhinaca farsamada iyo aqoonta loo ballaariyo. Haddii qorshahan la fuliyo, Soomaaliya waxay ku biiri doontaa dalalka Afrika ee adeegsanaya tiknoolajiyadda dayax-gacmeedyada si ay uga faa’iideystaan dhinacyada isgaarsiinta, saadaasha cimilada, maaraynta khayraadka dabiiciga ah, beeraha iyo la socodka deegaanka. Sidoo kale, dayax-gacmeedku wuxuu Soomaaliya siin karaa fursado cusub oo la xiriira xog-ururinta iyo kormeerka dhulka, gaar ahaan iyadoo dalka uu leeyahay dhul ballaaran, xeeb dheer iyo khayraad dabiici ah oo u baahan xog casri ah oo joogto ah. items.title: Golaha Ammaanka oo kordhiyay cunaqabateynta hubka ee Daafuur
items.description: New York ( Raxanreeb Online) Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa si aqlabiyad ah u ansixiyay qaraar lagu kordhinayo muddada cunaqabataynta hubka ee saaran gobolka Daafuur ee dalka Suudaan. Dhammaan 15-xubnood ee Golaha Ammaanka ayaa u codeeyay qaraarka, iyadoo aan la helin cod diidmo ah. Go’aankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu xakameynayo qulqulka hubka iyo agabka militari ee gaara kooxaha hubeysan ee ka howlgala Darfur. Cunaqabataynta hubka ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah xaaladda Darfur, oo muddo dheer wajahaysay colaado iyo amni-darro. Dagaalka ka socda Suudaan ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhiyay walaaca laga qabo in hub iyo saanad militari ay gaaraan dhinacyada ku dagaallamaya gobolka. Golaha Ammaanka ayaa tallaabadan ku doonaya in la yareeyo awoodda kooxaha hubeysan ee sii wada dagaallada, isla markaana loo abuuro fursad lagu xoojiyo dadaallada lagu gaarayo xal siyaasadeed iyo nabad waarta. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa horey uga digtay xaaladda bani’aadamnimo ee sii xumaanaysa ee Suudaan, iyadoo malaayiin qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha dalka iyo dalalka deriska ah, halka colaadaha ay saameyn weyn ku yeesheen dadka rayidka ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, cunaqabataynta hubka ayaa wajahaysa caqabado ku saabsan sida loo dhaqan-gelinayo, gaar ahaan iyadoo ay jiraan eedeymo ku saabsan in hub iyo taageero militari ay weli gaaraan dhinacyada ku lugta leh dagaallada. The post Golaha Ammaanka oo kordhiyay cunaqabateynta hubka ee Daafuur appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Dawladda Soomaaliya oo ka digtay in la siyaasadeeyo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa ugu baaqay shacabka Soomaaliyeed inay ka fogaadaan falalka iyo hadallada sii xumeyn kara xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, xilli ay dalka ka socdaan dhaliilo iyo mudaharaadyo la xiriira doorka ciidamada Turkiga ee Soomaaliya. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa sheegay in calanka Turkiga aan loo qalmin in la gubo , isagoo ku boorriyay shacabka Soomaaliyeed in aan arrimaha siyaasadeed iyo khilaafaadka la xiriira dhacdooyin gaar ah loo adeegsan sidii lagu dhaawici lahaa xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Ankara. Hadalkan ayaa yimid xilli qaybo ka mid ah Soomaaliya ay ka dhaceen caro iyo dibadbaxyo ka dhashay warar iyo eedeymo la xiriira ka-qaybgalka ciidamada Turkiga ee hawlgallada milatari ee Soomaaliya . Wasiirku si toos ah uma taageerin eedeymahaas, balse wuxuu xoogga saaray muhiimadda ay leedahay in la ilaaliyo xiriirka labada dal. Turkiga ayaa muddo ka badan toban sano xiriir dhow la lahaa Soomaaliya, isagoo door weyn ka qaatay tababarka ciidamada Soomaaliyeed iyo taageerada dhanka milatariga , xilli dowladda federaalku ay dadaal ugu jirto dhismaha hay’adaha amniga iyo sidii ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si buuxda ula wareegi lahaayeen mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale ku fiday dhinacyada kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, maalgashiga, gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo horumarinta , iyadoo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca uu sannadihii dambe sii xoogaystay. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa sidaas darteed ku baaqay in khilaafaadka ama su’aalaha laga qabo arrimo gaar ah aan loo beddelin xiisad dhaawacda xiriirka labada dowladood. Hadalkiisa ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay wajaheyso xaalad amni oo xasaasi ah, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay sii wadaan howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, isla markaana socda dadaallo lagu xoojinayo awoodda iyo isku-filnaanshaha ciidamada qaranka. Xiriirka Ankara iyo Muqdisho ayaa loo arkaa mid istiraatiiji ah, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga iyo dhismaha awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga ayaa u muuqda inuu doonayo in arrimaha la isku khilaafsan yahay ee milatari ama siyaasadeed laga sooco xiriirka guud ee labada dal , si aanay xiisadaha gudaha Soomaaliya u dhaawicin iskaashiga muddada dheer ee labada dhinac.

items.title: Kooxaha Burcad-badeedd Soomaalida oo sii dayay Markab u afduubnaa
items.description: Boosaaso ( Raxanreeb Online) Kooxo burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ayaa la sheegay inay sii daayeen markab ay muddo afduub ahaan u haysteen, sida ay sheegeen ilo amni oo xogta u gudbiyay warbaahinta. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegay in markabka lagu sii daayay xaalad aan weli si rasmi ah loo faahfaahin, iyadoo aan la shaacin magaca markabka, calanka uu watay, halka lagu afduubtay iyo waqtiga saxda ah ee la sii daayay. Sidoo kale, weli ma cadda haddii sii deynta markabka ay timid kaddib wada-xaajood, heshiis ama lacag madax-furasho ah, maadaama ilaha amniga aysan bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan dhacdada. Markabka ka baxay gacanta Burcad Badeedda waxa ay kooxahaas afduubteen Bishii April ee Sannadkaan waxaana la socday 17 Rag ah sida ay ku warrantay Wakaaladda Wararka AFP oo xogtaan si kooban u faafisay. Wararka ku saabsan sii deynta markabkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan Badweynta Hindiya mararka qaar ka dhacaan weerarro iyo afduubyo loo geysto maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo kuwa kalluumeysiga. Inkasta oo burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya ay hoos u dhac weyn ku timid marka loo eego sannadihii ugu xumaa, haddana khatarta weerarrada badda ayaa weli ah arrin ay si dhow ula socdaan hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya iyo ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah. items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya oo si kulul uga hadlay gubista calanka Turkiga + Video
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Qaar kamid ah Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya oo xalay ka qeyb-galay munaasabad lagu sagootinayay Safiirka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya, Alper Aktaş, oo soo gabagabeeyay howlihiisii diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka, ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku saabsan xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee soo kordhay. Wasiirrada oo khudbado ka jeediyay madasha ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay dhacdadiid lagu gubay calanka Turkiga ee ka dhacday Jubbaland, kadib dibadbaxyo looga soo horjeeday Turkiga oo lagu meelo kamid ah maamulkaas. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa sheegay in koox gar ah aysan xumeyn karin xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Ankara, isla markaana Turkiga lagu xasuusan doono xilliga adag ee uu garab istaagay Soomaaliya. “Koox gooni ah cambaar uma yeeli karto saaxibtinimada Turkiga naga dhaxeysa, wadanka Turkiga xili adag ayay nasoo garab istaageyn waligeenana waan wada joogi doonaa,” ayuu yiri wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaliya. Sidoo kale, wasiirka gaashaandhigga Axmed Macalin Firi ayaa si adag uga falceliyay gubista calanka Turkiga, isagoo sheegay in Turkigu abaal weyn ku leeyahay dadka iyo dalka Soomaaliya. “Turkiga calankooda in lagubo mamudna nimanka careesan ee gobolada jooga iyo qolada AS ku biiray waxba kama qaadayaan Turkiga,” ayuu isna yiri Fiqi. Dhankiisa wasiirka wasaaradda tamarta iyo kheyraadka biyaha, Cabdullahi Bidhaan Warsame ayaa dhaleeceeyay dadka dhaawacaya xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, isagoo sheegay in siyaasiyiinta shisheeye u shaqeeya aysan waxba ka beddeli karin mowqifka dowladda, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Siyaasiyiin shisheeye u shaqeeyo waxba yeeli makaraan Turkiga, annaga ayaa garab taagan cidna ku badalan meyno,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Bidhaan. Hadalladan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo dhawaan dibadbaxyo ka dhan ah Turkiga ay ka dhaceen meelo kamid ah Jubbaland iyo Koonfur Galbeed, kadib markii xukuumadda Ankara lagu eedeeyay duqemyo ka dhacay aagga magaalada Baydhaba oo ay ka taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo marar kala duwan gudaha magaaladaasi. Si kastaba, Turkiga ayaa ah saaxibka koowaad ee Soomaaliya, wuxuuna gashaday abaal wayn, kadib markii usoo gurmaday xilli adag oo abaaro daran ay ka jireen meelo badan oo kamid ah dalka. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale taageerada ugu xooggan siiya Dowladda Federaalka, wuxuuna ka caawiyaa dhanka milatariga iyo dib u dhiska ciidanka Xoogga dalka. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa sheegay in koox gar ah aysan xumeyn karin xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Ankara, isla markaana Turkiga lagu xasuusan doono xilliga adag ee uu garab istaagay Soomaaliya. “Koox gooni ah cambaar uma yeeli karto saaxibtinimada Turkiga naga dhaxeysa, wadanka Turkiga xili adag ayay nasoo garab istaageyn waligeenana waan wada joogi doonaa,” ayuu yiri wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaliya. Sidoo kale, wasiirka gaashaandhigga Axmed Macalin Firi ayaa si adag uga falceliyay gubista calanka Turkiga, isagoo sheegay in Turkigu abaal weyn ku leeyahay dadka iyo dalka Soomaaliya. “Turkiga calankooda in lagubo mamudna nimanka careesan ee gobolada jooga iyo qolada AS ku biiray waxba kama qaadayaan Turkiga,” ayuu isna yiri Fiqi. Dhankiisa wasiirka wasaaradda tamarta iyo kheyraadka biyaha, Cabdullahi Bidhaan Warsame ayaa dhaleeceeyay dadka dhaawacaya xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, isagoo sheegay in siyaasiyiinta shisheeye u shaqeeya aysan waxba ka beddeli karin mowqifka dowladda, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Siyaasiyiin shisheeye u shaqeeyo waxba yeeli makaraan Turkiga, annaga ayaa garab taagan cidna ku badalan meyno,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Bidhaan. Hadalladan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo dhawaan dibadbaxyo ka dhan ah Turkiga ay ka dhaceen meelo kamid ah Jubbaland iyo Koonfur Galbeed, kadib markii xukuumadda Ankara lagu eedeeyay duqemyo ka dhacay aagga magaalada Baydhaba oo ay ka taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo marar kala duwan gudaha magaaladaasi. Si kastaba, Turkiga ayaa ah saaxibka koowaad ee Soomaaliya, wuxuuna gashaday abaal wayn, kadib markii usoo gurmaday xilli adag oo abaaro daran ay ka jireen meelo badan oo kamid ah dalka. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale taageerada ugu xooggan siiya Dowladda Federaalka, wuxuuna ka caawiyaa dhanka milatariga iyo dib u dhiska ciidanka Xoogga dalka. The post Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya oo si kulul uga hadlay gubista calanka Turkiga + Video appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Xoghayaha Guud ee Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka kala hadlay la-dagaallanka xagjirnimada
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa Qasriga Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay Xoghayaha Guud ee Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka, ahna Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Culimada Muslimiinta, Dr. Mohammed bin Abdulkarim Al-Issa. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka , iyadoo si gaar ah looga wada hadlay arrimaha la xiriira fahamka saxda ah ee Diinta Islaamka, ka hortagga fikirka xagjirka ah iyo xoojinta nabadda iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa kulanka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo dadaallada lagu la-dagaallamayo fikradaha xagjirka ah iyo marin-habaabinta dhalinyarada , isagoo tilmaamay in iskaashi xooggan oo dhinacyada dowladda, culimada iyo hay’adaha Islaamiga ah uu muhiim u yahay ka hortagga fikirrada dhaawici kara nabadda iyo midnimada bulshada. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa uga mahadceliyay Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka mowqifkeeda ku aaddan taageerada midnimada, madaxbannaanida iyo qarannimada Soomaaliya , iyo sidoo kale doorka ay ka qaadato horumarinta bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale xambaarsanaa muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada shaqeynta dhinacyada diinta, nabadda, wacyigelinta bulshada iyo ka hortagga xagjirnimada , si loo kobciyo faham diimeed oo dhexdhexaad ah, loona dhiirrigeliyo nabad iyo wadajir bulshada dhexdeeda.

items.title: Qiimaha Lagu Kireeyo Maraakiibta Shidaalka oo Gaaray Heerkii ugu sarreeyey
items.description: Qiimaha lagu kireeyo maraakiibta waaweyn ee shidaalka qaada ayaa gaaray heerkii ugu sarreeyey ee abid la diiwaangeliyo, iyadoo xiisadaha ka jira marinnada badda ee Bariga Dhexe ay kordhiyeen khatarta iyo kharashka gaadiidka saliidda. Kirada markab weyn oo saliid ka qaada Gacanka Cumaan una socda Shiinaha ayaa gaartay qiyaastii $11.50 foostadii. Tani waa heerkii ugu sarreeyey tan iyo markii la bilaabay cabbirka lagu qiimeeyo kharashka maraakiibta waaweyn ee qaada saliidda cayriin. Kororka waxaa loo aaneynayaa weerarrada lagu qaaday maraakiibta, khatarta ka jirta marin-biyoodka Hormuz iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada Xuutiyiinta ee Bab al-Mandab. Shirkadaha maraakiibta ayaa sidoo kale wajahaya caymis qaali ah iyo baahi loo qabo inay maraakiibta ka leexiyaan marinnada halista badan. Yaraanta maraakiibta diyaar u ah inay galaan safarrada khatarta leh ayaa sii kordhisay qiimaha kirada, ayadoo qaar ka mid ah milkiilayaasha maraakiibta ay ka gaabsanayaan marinnada ay weerarradu ka dhacayaan, halka kuwa aqbala safarradaas ay dalbanayaan lacag dheeraad ah oo khatarta lagu daboolayo. Kharashka sare ee gaadiidka badda wuxuu ku dambayn karaa inuu kordhiyo qiimaha shidaalka iyo badeecadaha kale ee caalamka. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in saameyntu aysan ku koobnayn Bariga Dhexe, balse ay gaartay marinnada shidaalka ee isku xira Galbeedka Afrika iyo Aasiya. Soomaaliya oo si weyn ugu tiirsan shidaalka iyo badeecadaha dibadda laga soo dejiyo ayaa laga yaabaa inay dareento kororka kharashaadka gaadiidka. Hase yeeshee, weli lama xaqiijin qiime cusub oo gudaha dalka ka dhashay arrintan, saameyntuna waxay ku xirnaan doontaa muddada ay carqaladaha badda sii socdaan.

items.title: Hindiya iyo Iiraan oo Ka Wada-hadlay Badbaadada Maraakiibta iyo Badmaaxiinta Hindiya
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Hindiya Narendra Modi ayaa Madaxweynaha Iiraan Masoud Pezeshkian kala hadlay ammaanka marin-biyoodka, xorriyadda isu-socodka ganacsiga iyo badbaadada shaqaalaha maraakiibta, xilli weerarrada gobolka ay khatar sii kordhaysa ku hayaan gaadiidka badda. Kulanka ayaa ka dhacay magaalada New Delhi, kahor shir madaxeedka hoggaamiyeyaasha BRICS. Modi ayaa ku adkaystay muhiimadda ay leedahay in marinnada badda ay furnaadaan, lana ilaaliyo maraakiibta iyo shaqaalahooda, si looga hortago carqalad ku timaadda ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Hindiya ayaa sheegtay in weerarradii dhowaan lagu qaaday maraakiibta gobolka lagu dilay ugu yaraan 10 badmaax oo u dhashay dalkaas. Dhacdooyinkan ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca New Delhi, maadaama Hindiya si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay marinnada badda ee ay ka soo gudbaan shidaalka iyo badeecadaha kale. Modi ayaa ku celiyey mowqifka Hindiya ee ah in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo diblomaasiyad. Madaxweynaha Iiraan ayaa isna ugu baaqay dalalka BRICS inay abuuraan jawi aan waddan keli ahi awood ugu yeelan karin inuu carqaladeeyo ganacsiga sharciyeysan ee dalalka kale. Amniga Hormuz, Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab wuxuu si dadban u saamaynayaa Soomaaliya, maadaama marinnadaas ay maraan shidaalka iyo badeecadaha dalka loo soo dhoofiyo. Carqalad kasta waxay kordhin kartaa kirada maraakiibta, caymiska iyo qiimaha badeecadaha ku yimaada dekedaha Soomaaliya. Kulanka Modi iyo Pezeshkian lagama gaarin heshiis cusub oo ku saabsan ammaanka marin-biyoodka ama xabbad-joojinta colaadaha gobolka. Wadahadalku wuxuu muujinayaa walaaca sii kordhaya ee laga qabo badbaadada badmaaxiinta iyo sii furnaanshaha marinnada muhiimka u ah ganacsiga caalamka.

items.title: Kaydka saliidda Sacuudiga oo gaaray heerkii ugu hooseeyey in ka badan 30 sano
items.description: Sahayda saliidda cayriin ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa bishii Agoosto hoos ugu dhacday lix milyan oo foosto maalintii, taas oo ah heerkii ugu hooseeyey muddo ka badan 30 sano, sida lagu sheegay qiimayn cusub oo ay soo saartay Hay’adda Tamarta Caalamiga ah (IEA). Tirada bishii Agoosto ayaa 2.3 milyan oo foosto maalintii ka yarayd sahaydii la diiwaangeliyey bishii Luulyo, ayadoo hoos-u-dhacani uu muujinayo culayska sii kordhaya ee saaran wax-soo-saarka iyo dhoofinta saliidda Sacuudiga, xilli ammaanka marinnada muhiimka ah ee gobolka uu sii xumaanayo. IEA ayaa hoos-u-dhaca qayb ahaan la xiriirisay weerarrada lagu qaaday xarumaha tamarta, maraakiibta iyo waddooyinka shidaalka ee ku dhow Bab al-Mandab. Weerarrada Xuutiyiinta iyo xiisadaha kale ee gobolka ayaa carqaladeeyey dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta, iyagoo sare u qaaday khatarta iyo kharashaadka gaadiidka badda. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa OPEC u gudbisay tiro ka sarreysa qiimaynta IEA, iyadoo sheegtay inay suuqa siisay 7.122 milyan oo foosto maalintii, halka wax-soo-saarkeeduna ahaa 6.238 milyan. Kala duwanaanshahan wuxuu ka dhashay hababka kala duwan ee loo cabbiro wax-soo-saarka iyo saliidda si dhab ah suuqa u gaarta. Carqalad sii dheeraata oo ku timaadda dhoofinta saliidda Sacuudiga waxay sare u qaadi kartaa qiimaha shidaalka iyo kharashaadka maraakiibta caalamiga ah. Bab al-Mandab ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah badeecadaha iyo tamarta isaga kala goosha Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Soomaaliya waxay saameynta ka dareemi kartaa kororka qiimaha shidaalka, gaadiidka iyo badeecadaha dibadda laga soo dejiyo, maadaama dhaqaalaha dalku si weyn ugu tiirsan yahay wax-soo-dejinta, hase yeeshee, weli lama xaqiijin koror gudaha Soomaaliya ka dhacay oo si toos ah loola xiriirin karo hoos-u-dhaca cusub ee sahayda Sacuudiga.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo daah-furay sannad-tacliimeedka 2026/2027 ee jaamacadaha dalka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta ka qayb galay munaasabadda furitaanka sannad-tacliimeedka 2026/2027 ee waxbarashada sare ee dalka, taasi oo ka dhacday xarunta dhexe ee Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha oo khudbad ka jeediyay munaasabadda ayaa tilmaamay in horumarka Soomaaliya uu si weyn ugu xiran yahay tayeynta waxbarashada, kobcinta aqoonta iyo maalgelinta dhallinyarada, isaga oo xusay in jaamacaduhu ay door muhiim ah ku leeyihiin diyaarinta jiil aqoon iyo xirfad u leh hoggaaminta dalka iyo ka qayb qaadashada horumarkiisa. Sidoo kale, madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa intii ay socotay munaasibaddu waxa uu daah-furay Hindisaha ABUUR, oo lagu kobcinayo hal-abuurka, curinta iyo xirfadaha ganacsi ee ardayda Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo sidoo kale xarigga ka jaray dhismayaasha cusub ee Kulliyadaha Jaamacadda, xarunta guddiga caafimaadka arrimaha Carabta iyo xarunta gurmadka degdegga ah iyo daryeelka xaaladaha halista ah Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale dhagax-dhigay dhismeyaasha guriga martida Jaamacadda Ummadda iyo dhismaha Hal-abuurka iyo cilmi baarista, kuwaasi oo ka qayb qaadanaya dadaallada lagu tayeynayo waxbarashada sare, tababarrada caafimaadka iyo cilmi-baarista dalka. Dhinaca kale, wuxuu madaxweynuhu soo hadal qaaday arrimo la xiriira habka loo qaato shaqaalaha hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya, isagoo shaaca ka qaaday in dhawaan laga gudbi doono nidaamka qabiilka ku saleysan ee shaqaaleysiinta, isagoo ku dhawaaqay barnaamij cusub oo shaqaalaha dowladda lagu qaadan doono aqoontooda, kartidooda iyo u-qalmitaankooda shaqada markaas loo xulanayo. “Qofka raba shaqada dowladda waa inuu ku helo aqoontiisa iyo awoodiisa ee uusan ku helin yaa qaraabo tihiin ama ii melee. Yaa taqaan inaan ka gudubno oo maxaa taqaanaa u gudubno ayaan rabnaa?,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynuhu. items.title: Sacuudiga oo hakiyey howlihii dhuumaha shidaalka ee Bariga-galbeed ka dib weerarii loo geystay
items.description: Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqday inay si ka hortag ah u hakisay hawlgallada dhuumaha shidaalka ee ka soo bilaabma Gobolka Bari kuna socda xeebta galbeed, kaddib markii Khamiistii lala beegsaday “weerarro dhowr ah,” kuwaas oo ay markii dambe sheegtay inay ka yimaadeen diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo laga soo qaaday Ciraaq. Talaabooyinkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha u dhexeeya Riyaad iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen. Wakaaladda Wararka Sacuudiga ee SPA, ayaa soo xigatay ilo ka tirsan Wasaaradda Tamarta oo sheegay in “dhuumaha shidaalka Bariga-Galbeed ee gobollada Riyaad iyo Madiina ay Khamiistii subaxnimadii, Sebtembar 10, 2026, la kulmeen weerarro dhowr ah, waxaana dhuumaha loo xiray si taxaddar ah, weerarraduna waxay sababeen dhaawacyo qaar ah.” Dhanka kale, wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee Sacuudiga ayaa cambaareysay weerarka ay fuliyeen dhowr diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn oo “ka soo baxay dhulka Ciraaq,” kaas oo sababay khasaare nafeed iyo mid hantiyeed , sida lagu sheegay bayaan ay wasaaraddu soo saartay.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo sheegay in ay la wareegeen dhul kihiim ah
items.description: Xuutiyiinta oo ku dhawaaqay inay la wareegeen lix degmo oo ku yaalla Taiz iyo Xudayda Afhayeenka milatariga Xuutiyiinta, Yaxya Sariic, ayaa sheegay in howlgalkii ay kooxdu billowday 3-dii Sebtembar uu ka dhacay lix degmo oo ku yaalla gobollada Taiz iyo Xudayda, iyadoo guud ahaan masaafada dhulkaas uu gaarayay 5,400 kiiloomitir oo laba jibbaaran. Wuxuu intaas ku daray, isagoo hadalkiisa ka jeediyay telefishanka Al-Masiirah, kaas oo ay la socotay waaxda kormeerka warbaahinta ee BBC, in howlgalku bartilmaameedsaday toddobo qaybood oo milatari, kuwaas oo ka koobnaa 38 guuto oo ka tirsan ciidamada dowladda ee Sacuudigu taageero. Sida uu sheegay Sariic, dagaalladu waxay sababeen in boqolaal ka tirsan ciidamadaas la dilo, la dhaawaco ama la qabto. Sariic wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada Xuutiyiintu ay intii uu dagaalku socday fuliyeen 32 hawlgal oo ka dhan ah diyaaradaha Sacuudiga, ayna soo rideen sagaal diyaaradood. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay sii daayeen tiro aan la cayimin oo maxaabiis ah oo ay ka hayeen ciidamada dowladda.
