items.title: Dagaallada cusub ee Yemen oo barakiciyey in ka badan 46,000 qof
items.description: Dagaallo culus oo dib uga qarxay Yemen ayaa sababay barakaca ugu yaraan 46,000 qof tan iyo toddobaadkii hore , iyadoo Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Socdaalka ee Qaramada Midoobay ( IOM ) ay sheegtay in tirada dadka guryahooda ka cararaya ay saacad kasta sii kordhayso . Dagaallada ayaa si gaar ah uga sii xoogaystay xeebaha galbeed ee Yemen , oo ay ku jiraan gobollada Taiz iyo Al-Hudaydah, iyadoo ciidamada Xukuumadda Yemen iyo Xuutiyiinta ay ku dagaallamayaan dhowr jiho. IOM waxay hore u sheegtay in in ka badan 18,500 qof ay barakaceen 72 saacadood gudahood , iyadoo xaaladdu si degdeg ah uga sii dartay. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kadib markii Xuutiyiintu ay qabsadeen magaalada dekedda ah ee Mocha, taas oo ku dhow marinka muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab. Wararka ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in Xuutiyiintu ay gaareen jasiiradda Mayun/Perim, taasoo ku taalla gudaha marinka Bab al-Mandab. Bab al-Mandab ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah, waxaana xaaladda ka taagan Yemen ay dhalisay walaac laga qabo in dagaalladu saameeyaan maraakiibta ganacsiga, sahayda shidaalka iyo qiimaha tamarta adduunka . Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa iyaduna qaaday duqeymo ka dhan ah goobaha Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayaan, iyadoo wararku sheegayaan in duqeymo lagu qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha ee Mocha kadib markii Xuutiyiintu la wareegeen magaalada. Xuutiyiintuna waxay sii wadeen weerarro ay ku qaadayaan bartilmaameedyo gudaha Sacuudiga ah. Hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ka digaya in dagaallada cusub ay sii xumeeyaan xaaladda bani’aadantinimo ee Yemen, halka qoysas badan oo barakacay ay gaareen goobo aysan ka jirin hoy, cunto iyo amni ku filan . IOM waxay sheegtay in qaar badan oo ka mid ah dadka hadda barakacaya ay horey dhowr jeer uga carareen guryahooda sababo la xiriira colaadda. Dagaalladan cusub ayaa sidoo kale halis gelinaya xabbad-joojintii muddada dheer jirtay, iyadoo colaadda Yemen ay u muuqato inay mar kale ku sii jeeddo weji dagaal oo ballaaran , taasoo khatar ku ah shacabka iyo amniga marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab.

items.title: Cirro oo albaabka u furay ciidamo ka socda Israa’iil
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha maamulka Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi Cirro, ayaa sheegay in maamulkiisu uu soo dhoweynayo in Israel mustaqbalka saldhig ama joogitaan ciidan ka sameysato Somaliland, isagoo arrintaas ku tilmaamay mid xoojin karta ammaanka iyo awoodda looga hortagayo khataraha gobolka. Cirro, oo wareysi siiyay warbaahinta Israel ee Yedioth Ahronoth isagoo booqasho ku jooga Washington, ayaa sheegay in xilligan aysan jirin wax joogitaan amni ama ciidan oo Israel ku leedahay Somaliland, balse uusan meesha ka saareyn in mustaqbalka arrintaasi dhacdo. “Weli ma jiro joogitaan amni oo Israel ku leedahay Somaliland, laakiin waxaa laga yaabaa inuu mustaqbalka jiro,” ayuu yiri Cirro. “Waxaan la shaqeyn doonnaa dal kasta oo saaxiib nala ah. Waxaan u baahan nahay saaxiibo dhinaca ammaanka ah, oo ay Israel ku jirto. Haddii Israel joogto, waxay noqon kartaa awood wax ka celisa khataraha. Waxaan u baahan nahay ilaalin. Kama saarayo in Israel ama Mareykanka ay joogitaan halkan ka sameystaan,” ayuu raaciyay. Cirro ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay leedahay ciidan gaaraya ku dhowaad 25,000 askari iyo ciidanka ilaalada xeebaha oo gaaraya ilaa 1,500, balse ay u baahan tahay teknoolajiyad casri ah iyo tababar dheeraad ah. “Waxaan leenahay awood ciidan oo nagu filan inaan isdifaacno, laakiin waxaa laga yaabaa inaan u baahan nahay teknoolajiyad iyo tababar,” ayuu yiri. Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa sheegay in weli aysan Israel iyo Somaliland si rasmi ah uga wada hadlin suurt-agalnimada joogitaan ciidan oo Israel ay halkaas ka sameysato, inkastoo ay jireen warar sheegaya in saraakiil amni oo Israeli ah ay horey u tageen Somaliland. Somaliland iyo ciidanka Gaza Cirro ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in maamulkiisu diyaar u yahay inuu ilaa 2,000 askari ku biiriyo ciidamo caalami ah oo la qorsheynayo inay ka qeyb qaataan howlgal la xiriira hub ka dhigista Marinka Gaza. “Haddii nala weydiisto, waan bixin karnaa. Inkastoo aanan annagu iskaa isu soo bandhigayn, haddii la i weydiisto, waa diyaar,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynuhu. Cirro ayaa sheegay in xiriirka Israel uu Somaliland u furay fursado cusub oo dhinacyada ammaanka, ganacsiga iyo dhaqaalaha ah, balse wuxuu qiray in xiriirkaasi sidoo kale abuuray khataro siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni. “Wax bilaash ah ma jiro,” ayuu yiri. “Waxaan sameysanay cadow sababtoo ah aqoonsiga, waxaana ka mid ah Soomaaliya iyo dalal ka baxsan Afrika oo Soomaaliya siiya hub, isla markaana garab istaaga kuwa naga soo horjeeda.” Waxa uu ku eedeeyay dowladda Soomaaliya iyo dalal kale inay kordhiyeen cadaadiska ka dhanka ah Somaliland, isagoo si gaar ah u soo hadal qaaday hub iyo diyaarado ay bixiyaan dalal saaxiib la ah Muqdisho. Cirro ayaa dhinaca kale sheegay in Kenya iyo Itoobiya aysan cambaareyn xiriirka Somaliland iyo Israel, isaga oo sidoo kale ku dooday in wada-hadallo qarsoodi ah ay socdaan oo lala leeyahay dalal kale oo ku saabsan suurta-galnimada aqoonsi. Dhinaca kale, dhaqdhaqaaqa Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa ku sii fidaya deegaanno ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, balse Cirro wuxuu sheegay in Somaliland aysan xilligan wax dagaal ama iska hor-imaad toos ah kala dhaxeyn Xuutiyiinta. “Yemen iyo Xuutiyiinta deris ayaan ahayn kumannaan sano, xilligan waddan ahaan wax khilaaf toos ah nagama dhaxeeyo,” ayuu yiri. The post Cirro oo albaabka u furay ciidamo ka socda Israa’iil appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ciidanka Danab iyo kuwa Jubaland oo dharbaaxo culus ku dhuftay Al-Shabaab
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Kumaandooska Danab ee Guutada 16-aad iyo kuwa Jubaland ayaa howlgal qorsheysan oo ka dhan ah kooxda Al-Shabaab ka fuliyay deegaanno ka tirsan gobolka Jubbada Hoose. Howl-galka waxaa si gaar ah looga fuliyay deegaannada Lagta Welmaarow iyo Lagta Qunbi, halkaas oo ciidamada ay ka sameeyeen how-lgallo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo ka hortagga dhaq-dhaqaaqyada Al-Shabaab. Intii uu howl-galka socday, ciidamada ayaa soo saaray miinooyin ay kooxda Al-Shabaab ku aaseen goobahaasi, kuwaas oo halis ku ahaa shacabka ku nool deegaanka iyo ciidamada howlgallada ka fulinayay. Ciidamada ayaa markii ay soo saareen miinooyinkaasi burburiyay, si looga hortago in loo adeegsado weerarro ka dhan ah dadka rayidka ah ama ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Jubaland. Sidoo kale, ciidamada iskaashanaya ayaa burburiyay fariisin ay Al-Shabaab ku lahaayeen deegaannada howl-galka laga fuliyay, iyagoo halkaasi ka saaray joogitaankii kooxda. Burburinta fariisinkaasi ayaa qeyb ka ahayd dadaallada lagu wiiqayo awoodda Al-Shabaab iyo in laga hor istaago inay saldhigyo iyo goobo ay ka abaabulaan weerarro ka sameystaan gobolka. Howl-galka ayaa sidoo kale qeyb ka ah howl-gallada milatari ee ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Jubaland ay ka wadaan deegaannada gobolka Jubbada Hoose, kuwaas oo lagu doonayo in lagu xaqiijiyo amniga. Ciidamada Danab iyo kuwa Jubaland ayaa muddooyinkii dambe waday howlgallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in kooxda laga saaro deegaannada ay weli ku leedahay joogitaan iyo in la xoojiyo amniga shacabka. The post Ciidanka Danab iyo kuwa Jubaland oo dharbaaxo culus ku dhuftay Al-Shabaab appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Biyo yari iyo nadaafad xumo ka dhalatay oo haysa qoysas barakac ku ah Gaalkacyo

Markii gargaarkii biyaha aan waynay dhibaato badan ayaa dhacday. Xerada oo dhan waa isku mid qof kan kale dhaama ma jiro. Shilin lagu iibsado waan waynay oo busaarad ayaa jirta.” Faadumo ayaa sheegtay in qoyskeeda ay biyo yarida u wehliso cunno xumo. Waxay ku tiirsan yihiin ugu badnaan nus kiilo raashin ah oo ay ka helaan qaraabo iyo daris ay u dan sheegtaan. Maalinkii aysan waxba soo galin waxay xustay in ay carruurteedu gaajo ku joogaan saacado badan. Haweenaydan ayaa sheegtay in xaaladan adag ay kali ku tahay. Carruurteedu shaqo ma gaarin aabbahoodna horay ayay u kala tageen. Waxay tilmaamtay in aysan isaga iyo ehelkiisa midna ka helin taageero, taas oo culayska ku sii badisay. Dukaamo ay macaamiil ka ahayd ayaa joojiyay dayntii ay siin jireen, markii lagu yeeshay in ka badan $400, taas oo lagu xiray in ay bixiso si ay mid kale u qaadado. Qofkii iga roon ayaan xaaladayda u sheegaa, mar wa ka waynaysaa. Aad iyo aad baa loo dhiban yahay saliid iyo khudaar midna lama helayo.” Faadumo oo horay u qaban jirtay dhar dhaqid iyo nadaafad ayaa sheegtay in ay shaqooyinkaas meesha ka baxeen. Waxay u sababaysay dadkii loo shaqayn jiray oo dhaqaale xumo ka cabanayaan, taas oo keentay in aysan nadaafada lacag ku bixin. Waxay tilmaamtay in labo mar oo midkiiba ay ka soo gashay $3 ay shaqaysay tan iyo bishii April. Haweenaydaan ayaa tilmaamtay in 100 ari ah oo noloshoodu ay ku tiirsanayd intii badan ay uga dhinteen daaq la’aan iyo cudurro isku raacay tan iyo dhamaadkii sannadkii hore. Waxaa u haray 10 neef oo cad, caano iyo iib aan midna u galin. Qoyskeeda waxaa intaas u dheer in uu horraantii bishaan ka buuxsamay suuli ay isla isticmaali jireen 5 qoys oo kale. Arntaan ayaa ku qasabtay in ay banaanka aadaan, maaddaama aysan doorasho kale haysan. “Dhibaato dhanka Suuliga ah ayaa jirta oo waa buuxsameen. Qaar ayaa dumay, kuwo kalena lama isticmaali karo, qaarna waana dumeen waana buuxsameen. Waxaan codsanaynaa in wax naloo qabto. Waxaan u baahanay in suuliyada naloo dhiso, in cunno lana siiyo oo biyo naloo keeno.” Faadumo ayaa sheegtay in musqulaha lagu hagaajiyo $150 illaa $200 oo aysan awoodin. Waxay xustay in ay ka cabsi qabaan in ay cudurro ka qaadaan duurka musqul ahaanta loo isticmaalayo. Qoyskeedu waxay horraantii sanadkaan ka soo barakaceen miyiga deegaanka Saaxa-qurun ee gobolka Mudug oo ay xoolo dhaqato ku ahaayeen. Dagaalo qabiil iyo saamaynta abaaraha ayaa ku sababay in ay xerada Ifiye maciinsadaan, balse kama helin beddel fiican. Roob la’aanta soo noqnoqotay, taageeradii hay’adaha oo yaraatay iyo faro marnaanta dhaqaale ayaa qoysas badan u horseeday xaalado adag oo aysan hayn qaab ay uga samata baxaan. Dhuux Salaad Cabdi oo qoysaskeedu ay ka mid yihiin ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in illaa 13 June ay wajahayaan oon daran. Waxaa u raacay in ay wayday shaqooyin xoogsi ah oo magaalada Gaalkacyo ay ka qaban jirtay.   Reerkeeda oo 10 qof ka kooban waxaa biyo yarida u wehliya cunno xumo. Waxay tilmaamtay in ay murug badan ku hayaan culaysyada nololeed ee isku biirsaday oo xaalad quus ah galiyay. “Raashin la’aan ayaa jirta biil ma helno, shaqooyinkii waa waynay. Mar cunno ayaan karin jiray, mar Jaad baan gadi jiray waa iska daayey markay igu go’een, dhar dhaqowgiina fursadiisii ayaa yaraatay oo arki maysid wax howl kuu dirsada dhaqale la’aanta ayaana keentay.” Dhuux ayaa sheegtay in xaaladda qoyskeedu ay marayso meeshii ugu adkayd shan sano oo ay dagan tahay xerada Dayax. Waxay tilmaamtay in ay maalin kasta lugayso ku dhawaad 2 saacadood si ay shaqooyin nadaafad ah ugu soo raadiso magaalad Gaalkacyo oo 8 km u jirta. Galabkii ayay dib u soo laabataa, iyadoo faro maran ilamaheeduna baahi ku sugayaan, taas oo niyad jab ku noqota. Dhuux ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo horraantii July ay ka xanuunsan yihiin labo carruurteeda ah. Waxay ku aragtay shuban iyo matag badan, balse ma aysan gayn isbitaal, maaddaama aysan xeradu lahayn aysanna heli karin qarash ay kuwa magaalada ugu qaado. “Aniga ilamaha waa iga xanuunsan yihiin, dad badan ayaana xeradaan jirran. Musqulihii qaar waa buuxsameen, qaarna dabaysha ayaa dumishay.” Dhuux ayaa xustay in ay cadaadis kala kulmayso dad ku leh $377 oo dayn ah. Xilliyo kala duwan ayay raashin iyo arrad-tir ku qaadatay. Waxay sheegtay in ay ugu hanjabayaan in ay xiri doonaan haddii aysan lacagtaas bixin, iyaduna aysan tabar u hayn. Haweenaydaan ayaa sheegtay in 200 oo ari ah oo ay ku dhaqanayeen miyiga gobolka Mudug ay saamaynta abaaraha ugu dhamaadeen dhowrkii sano ee u danbaysay. xeryaha barakaca ee ay soo galeen ayay sheegtay in ay kala kulmeen dhibaatooyin badan. Qoyska Dhuux waxay sanadkii 2020 ay ka soo barakceen deegaanka Xaafoodle oo qiyastii 70 km u jira Gaalkacyo, markii ay xoolihii dhaafeen. Dhanka kale Xabiibo Khaliif Maxamed oo kamid ah guddiga saddexdan xero ayaa sheegtay in ay ku adag tahay helida cunnada, adeegyada caafimaadka iyo waxbarashada biyo yaridu xaalada sii xumaysay. “Qoladii teerada biyaha bixinaysaynay qandaraaskoodii waa dhamaaday. Waxa ugu daran ee ay ku dhibaatoonayaan waa biyaha iyo musqulaha. Waxaan soo jeedinayaa in wixii loo awoodo lagu caawiyo dadkaan masaakiinta ah.” Xabiibo ayaa sheegtay in qiyaastii 500 oo carruur ah oo gaaray da’da iskuulka ay daruus la’aan ku yihiin xeryahan, taas saamayn taban ku yeelan karta mustaqbalkooda. Taageeradii hay’adaha oo yaraatay sanadihii u danbe ayaa sababtay in ay joogsadaan adeegyadii bilaashka ahaa ee ay heli jireen qoysaska barakacay. Abaaraha iyo dhaqaale xumada wadanka ka jirta ayaa xaalada sii adkeeyay, maaddama aysan dadku is caawin karin. items.title: Aljeeriya oo hawadeeda ka mamnuucday diyaaradaha Imaaraadka kadib markii…
items.description: Algiers (Caasimada Online) – Aljeeriya ayaa maanta dhaqangelisay go’aan ay diyaaradaha Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta uga mamnuucday inay adeegsadaan hawadeeda, kadib markii ay shalay jartay xiriirkii kala dhexeeyay Abu Dhabi. Go’aanka ayaa yimid xilli uu sii xoogeysanayay khilaafka u dhexeeya labada dowladood, gaar ahaan arrimaha siyaasadda iyo amniga gobolka iyo doorka Imaaraadka ee colaadaha iyo khilaafaadka ka jira dalal ka tirsan Bariga Dhexe iyo Afrika. Aljeeriya ayaa maanta oo Jimco ah dhaqan-gelisay go’aanka lagu joojiyay adeegsiga hawadeeda ee diyaaradaha Imaaraadka, kuwa rayidka ah iyo kuwa ciidamada, taas oo noqotay tallaabo kale oo muujinaysa heerka uu gaarsiisan yahay khilaafka labada dhinac. Si kastaba, tiro kooban oo diyaarado ganacsi ah ayaa loo oggolaaday inay muddo xaddidan adeegsadaan garoonka Houari Boumediene ee Aljeeriya, iyadoo fursaddaasi ay soconayso illaa dhammaadka sannadka 2026. Xiriirka Aljeeriya iyo Imaaraadka ayaa muddooyinkii dambe ahaa mid ay hareeyeen khilaafaad siyaasadeed, gaar ahaan arrimaha amniga gobolka, colaadaha ka socda dalalka Carabta iyo Afrika iyo siyaasadda Abu Dhabi ee gobolka. Aljeeriya ayaa muddo dheer ku adkeysanaysay mowqifka ah in dalalka gobolka aan lagu faragelin arrimahooda gudaha, iyadoo si joogto ah uga digtay fara-gelinta shisheeye iyo in khilaafaadka gudaha lagu xalliyo hannaan siyaasadeed. Tallaabada cusub ayaa sii xumeynaysa xiriirka labada dal, iyadoo sidoo kale muujinaysa kala fogaanshaha sii kordhaya ee mowqifyada Aljeeriya iyo Imaaraadka ee ku aaddan arrimaha siyaasadda iyo amniga gobolka. Indhaha ayaa hadda lagu hayaa tallaabooyinka xiga ee ay qaadaan labada dowladood iyo sida uu khilaafkan cusub u saameyn karo xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed. Imaaraadka ayaa horey u lumiyay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee dalal ay kamid yihiin Soomaaliya, Yemen iyo Suudaan kadib markii ay si adag uga horyimaadeen xad-gudubyada fara-gelinta Abu Dhabi. items.title: Hans Grundberg oo sheegay in dagaalka Yemen uu gaaray meel adag
items.description: Hans Grundberg, oo ah Ergeyga Qaramada Midoobey ee Yemen ayaa ka digay in Yemen ay wajaheyso khatartii ugu darneyd ee dagaal, tan iyo xabad joojintii lagu heshiiyay sanadkii 2022. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta oo weeraro ba’an ku haya Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudiga uu taageero ayaa wada guluf ay isugu fidinayaan deegaanada ku teedsan xeebaha galbeed ee dalkaasi. Hans Grundberg ayaa Xuutiyiinta ugu baaqay inay joojiyaan weerarada ay ka wadaan Yemen iyo kuwa ay ku qaadayaan dhulka Sacuudiga. Mr. Grundberg ayaa ururka reer Yemen ku booriyay inay soo afjaraan weerarada ka dhanka ah maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee ku gooshaya Badda Cas. Grundberg oo xalay ka hadlayay kulan ay Xubnaha Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobey ka yeesheen xaaladda dalkaasi ayaa sheegay in digniintii uu horey u bixiyay ay hadda isu bedeshay xaqiiqo adag. “Yemen ayaa gashay wejigii ugu darnaa, uguna khatarta badnaa ee dagaalka, tan iyo xabad joojintii ay Qaramada Midoobey ka soo shaqeysay ee la gaaray 2022.” Ayuu yiri Ergeyga Qaramada Midoobey ee Yemen. Kororkan ayuu sheegay in uu halis gelinayo nolosha dadka rayidka ah, xasilloonida gobolka iyo maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee maraya Badda Cas iyo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb. Boqolaal qof oo shacab ay ku jiraan ayaa la sheegay inay dhinteen, kumanaan kalena ay dhaawacmeen ama barakaceen, ka dib markii Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay toddobaad ka hor qaadeen weerar ballaaran oo ka dhan ah dhulka ay dowladdu ka maamusho Koonfur Galbeed Yemen. Xuutiyiinta ayaa Khamiistii si buuxda ula wareegay magaalada dekedda leh ee Mokha, oo qiyaastii 75km dhanka waqooyi uga beegan marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Marinkan ayaa ah marin istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah maraakiibta shidaalka iyo kuwa shixnadaha badeecadaha ee isugu kala goosha Asia, Yurub iyo Bariga Afrika. Carqaladaynta Bab El-Mandeb ayaa sii yareynaysa sahayda tamarta adduunka, xilli Iran ay horey u xirtay marin biyoodka dhinaca kale ku yaala ee Hormuz. Dhibaatada bani’aadantinimo ee Yemen ayaa sii xumaaneysa, iyadoo in ka badan 22 milyan oo qof ay u baahan yihiin gargaar, halka 18 milyan ay wajahayaan xaalad cunto xumo oo daran, sida ay sheegeen Saraakiisha Qaramada Midoobey. “Su’aasha hortaalla Beesha Caalamka hadda ma aha ma in dagaalka Yemen uu dib u bilaaban doono iyo in kale, balse waa sidii wax looga qaban lahaa marxalad cusub oo aad u khatar badan.” Ayuu yiri Hans Grundberg, Ergeyga Qaramada Midoobey ee Yemen. Grundberg ayaa ku baaqay in sii wado dadaalada wadajirka ah, si loo xakameeyo buu yiri colaadda, loona helo waddada loo marayo xal siyaasadeed.

items.title: DF oo shaacisay arrin ay diyaar ula tahay mucaaradka iyo mid ay si adag u diidan tahay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa xaqiijisay inay diyaar u tahay inay mucaaradka la fariisato miiska wada-hadalka, si xal looga gaaro khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee la xiriira doorashada federaalka iyo arrimaha dastuurka, balse waxay si cad uga soo horjeeddaa waxa ay ugu yeertay “isku dhacyo hubeysan iyo qalalaase.” Wasiirka Warfaafinta Soomaaliya, Cabdifitaax Qaasim Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in dowladdu aysan wax dhib ah ku qabin in mucaaradka lala yeesho wada-hadallo, isagoo xusay in labada dhinac ay horey u yeesheen kulamo dhowr ah oo looga hadlay arrimo siyaasadeed oo muhiim u ah dalka. Wuxuu sheegay in kulamadii hore lagu gaaray heshiisyo ku saabsan qaar ka mid ah qodobadii laga wada hadlay, hase yeeshee ay weli jiraan arrimo aan xal laga gaarin oo u baahan in dhinacyadu dib ugu laabtaan miiska si ay is-afgarad uga gaaraan. Wasiir Cabdifitaax ayaa sheegay in dowladda aysan dooneyn inay albaabka ka xirto mucaaradka, balse ay diyaar u tahay in laga wada-hadlo arrimaha salka u ah khilaafka siyaasadeed, gaar ahaan hannaanka doorashada federaalka ee soo socota iyo qodobbada dastuuriga ah ee ay weli isku hayaan dhinacyada siyaasadda. “Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay ahayd oo weligeed ahaan doontaa mid u furan wada-hadalka arrimaha aasaasiga ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin arrimaha dastuurka iyo doorashada federaalka ee soo socota,” ayuu yiri wasiir Cabdifitaax Qaasim, isaga oo ku adkeystay in wada-hadalku yahay waddada lagu xallin karo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed. Dhanka kale, wasiirku wuxuu sheegay in dowladda ay si cad uga soo horjeeddo isku dhacyada hubeysan, qalalaasaha iyo tallaabo kasta oo wax u dhimi karta xasilloonida dalka. Wuxuu sidoo kale mucaaradka ku eedeeyay inay mararka qaar qaadaan tallaabooyin uu sheegay inay sii hurinayaan xiisadda siyaasadeed, isagoo ku boorriyay dhinacyada inay xoogga saaraan sidii xal looga gaari lahaa qodobbada la isku hayo. Ugu dambeyntiina, wasiirku wuxuu mucaaradka ugu baaqay inay dowladda kala shaqeeyaan dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, isagoo sheegay in kala aragti duwanaanshaha siyaasadeed uu yahay arrin caadi ah, balse ay muhiim tahay in dhinacyada siyaasadda ay ku mideysnaadaan dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxaha hubeysan iyo ilaalinta xasilloonida dalka. The post DF oo shaacisay arrin ay diyaar ula tahay mucaaradka iyo mid ay si adag u diidan tahay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Bulk carrier boarded by pirates in Gulf of Aden off Yemen
items.description: Authorities have reported the hijacking of a cargo ship by suspected pirates off the coast of Yemen on Thursday, September 10. The vessel, which has been identified by UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) as the Greek-owned, Saint Vincent and Grenadines-flagged bulk carrier Glamor, was approached and then boarded by perpetrators on a skiff while some 38 nautical miles in the Gulf of Aden southwest of the town of Balhaf. UKMTO said the ship’s crew then mustered in the citadel, and the unauthorised personnel boarded the vessel but were unsuccessful in seizing control. The crew later confirmed that the unauthorised personnel have disembarked, and the vessel has resumed normal transit. UKMTO confirmed that all of Glamor’s crew are reported safe. Assets from the European Union’s Operation Atalanta naval counter-piracy task force are currently investigating the incident, which has been reported as the 25th recorded ship hijacking to occur globally since the beginning of this year. No details have been provided on the identities of the perpetrators or the organisation to which they belonged. Thursday’s hijacking occurred just off an area of Yemen not under the control of the Iran-backed Houthi terror group. Source bairdmaritim

items.title: Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda Khaliijka iyo Iiraan oo kulan muhiim ah ku yeelanaya Cumaan
items.description: Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee dalalka Khaliijka iyo wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iiraan ayaa la filayaa inay ku kulmaan magaalada Salalah ee Cumaan , iyadoo diiradda lagu saarayo sidii loo heli lahaa heshiis ku-meel-gaar ah oo lagu maareeyo maraakiibta ganacsi ee mara Marinka Hormuz . Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaal diblomaasiyadeed oo ay hormuud ka yihiin Cumaan iyo Iiraan , kuwaas oo lagu doonaya in lagu dejiyo xaaladda ka taagan marin-biyoodkan istiraatiijiga ah, kaas oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo tamarta caalamka. Sida warbixinnadu sheegayaan, qorshaha laga wada hadlayo wuxuu dhigayaa in maraakiibta soo galaysa Gacanka ay isticmaalaan marin ku yaalla biyaha Iiraan , halka maraakiibta ka baxaysa ay inta badan isticmaali doonaan dhanka biyaha Cumaan. Ujeeddadu waa in la abuuro waddo ku-meel-gaar ah oo u saamaxda maraakiibta ganacsiga inay si ammaan ah uga gudbaan Hormuz. Arrintan ayaa muhiimad gaar ah leh, maadaama isu-socodka maraakiibta ee Hormuz uu aad hoos ugu dhacay. Xog cusub ayaa muujinaysa in 7 markab oo keliya ay marinka ka gudbeen 10-kii Sebtembar, halka ka hor dagaalka ay halkaas mari jireen qiyaastii 125 markab oo ganacsi maalintii . Marinku sidoo kale wuxuu caadi ahaan qaadi jiray ku dhowaad 20% sahayda caalamka ee saliidda iyo LNG-ga . Cumaan ayaa muddo toddobaadyo ah dhex-dhexaadin ka waday Tehran iyo dhinacyada kale, ayadoo dabayaaqadii Agoosto, Cumaan iyo Iiraan ay ku heshiiyeen qaab-dhismeed ku-meel-gaar ah oo ay ku jiraan marin maraakiibta loogu talagalay iyo qorshe lagu nadiifinayo miinooyinka badda , iyadoo sidoo kale la qorsheynayo wadahadallo lagu dhisayo nidaam waara oo lagu maareeyo isu-socodka Hormuz. Si kastaba, heshiiska weli ma ahan xal kama dambeys ah, waxayna Iiraan weli ku xireysaa dib-u-furitaanka buuxa ee marinka arrimo ay ka mid yihiin xayiraadaha iyo cadaadiska Mareykanka, taas oo ka dhigaysa kulanka wasiirrada Khaliijka iyo Iran mid xasaasi ah oo laga filayo in lagu raadiyo tanaasul labada dhinac ah.

items.title: Israel’s Growing Isolation: Britain Says Human Rights Cannot Be Ignored
items.description: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh Israel’s increasingly bitter confrontation with Britain is exposing a much larger question than a dispute over trade restrictions or settlements: how far can a government go in the name of security before the international community is compelled to respond to the suffering of Palestinian civilians? Israel has accused Britain of allowing what it describes as pro-Palestinian political forces to influence government policy, as London moves toward tougher measures over Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. But Britain’s position is not difficult to understand. A government that speaks in the language of human rights cannot simply ignore allegations of mass civilian suffering, displacement, arbitrary detention, settlement expansion and restrictions on humanitarian assistance. The diplomatic dispute intensified after Britain announced measures targeting goods produced in Israeli settlements in the West Bank, alongside possible sanctions against companies, organizations and individuals involved in the construction or expansion of those settlements. London has presented the measures as part of an effort to protect the possibility of a two-state solution and respond to violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. Israel, however, has strongly rejected such measures, portraying them as politically motivated pressure against the Israeli state. The confrontation illustrates a widening divide between Israel and some of its traditional Western partners. Israel’s Human-Rights Record Under Increasing Scrutiny For Palestinians, however, the argument goes far beyond diplomatic language. They have endured years of military occupation, settlement expansion, displacement, restrictions on movement and recurring violence. Since the outbreak of the Gaza war, the humanitarian crisis has reached an extraordinary level, with widespread destruction and enormous civilian suffering. Israel has repeatedly argued that its military operations are necessary to defend its population and defeat Hamas following the October 7 attacks. That security argument cannot simply be dismissed. But neither can it provide unlimited justification for the ill treatment of an entire civilian population. The protection of Israeli civilians and the protection of Palestinian civilians are not mutually exclusive principles. Both are obligations that governments and armed forces must respect. The international criticism directed at Israel therefore cannot automatically be characterized as hostility toward Israel or hatred of Jews. Indeed, Britain’s Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, who is Jewish, has explicitly rejected that interpretation while defending his government’s position. Miliband has stressed that Britain’s policies are not based on hostility toward Israel or Jewish people, but on concerns about developments in the West Bank and the need to preserve the possibility of a negotiated political settlement. Britain has also continued to recognize Israel’s security concerns and has condemned the Hamas attacks of October 7. At the same time, London argues that Palestinians have a right to self-determination and an independent state alongside Israel. That distinction is crucial. Criticism Is Not Antisemitism Israel’s increasingly aggressive response to international criticism risks obscuring an important principle: a government’s policies can be criticized without attacking the people, religion or identity of the country involved. Criticizing settlement expansion is not an attack on Judaism. Demanding humanitarian access for Palestinians is not hostility toward Israelis. Calling for investigations into alleged violations of international humanitarian law is not an attack on the Jewish people. And supporting Palestinian statehood does not inherently mean opposing Israel’s existence. These distinctions matter at a time when legitimate criticism of government policy can too easily be portrayed as prejudice. The international community has a responsibility to reject both antisemitism and anti-Palestinian hatred while still holding governments accountable for their conduct. The Human Cost Cannot Be Ignored The most difficult issue confronting Israel is ultimately humanitarian. When homes are destroyed, civilians are killed, people are detained, families are displaced and access to food, medicine and other essential supplies is restricted, the international community cannot be expected to remain silent simply because Israel invokes national security. Security matters. But security does not erase human rights. The same principle applies to Hamas and every other armed group. The killing or kidnapping of civilians cannot be justified by political grievances, occupation or resistance. A credible international position must therefore apply the same basic standard to everyone: civilians must be protected, hostages must be released, humanitarian assistance must reach those who need it, and alleged violations must be investigated. Why Britain Is Taking a Harder Line Britain’s position reflects a growing concern that continued settlement expansion and the deteriorating humanitarian situation could make a viable two-state solution increasingly impossible. London has therefore sought to distinguish between legitimate Israeli security concerns and policies it believes undermine Palestinian political rights. The restrictions on settlement-produced goods and possible sanctions are intended, according to Britain, to place pressure on those involved in settlement activity rather than punish Israeli society as a whole. Israel’s decision to respond with diplomatic countermeasures, including restrictions involving British officials and diplomatic representation, demonstrates how rapidly the disagreement has escalated. The dispute also comes amid growing pressure from other Western governments, including European states and Canada, over Israeli policies in the occupied Palestinian territories. Israel Cannot Demand Immunity from Accountability The central issue is therefore not whether Britain has suddenly become “anti-Israel.” It is whether Israel can expect its allies to remain silent when they believe fundamental human rights and international legal principles are being violated. No country should be above scrutiny—not Israel, Britain, the United States, Palestine, Hamas or any other government or armed organization. Israel has legitimate security concerns. Israelis have the right to live without fear of terrorism and attacks on civilians. But Palestinians have equally fundamental rights: to live, to eat, to receive medical care, to remain with their families, to be protected from arbitrary violence and detention, and ultimately to determine their own political future. Those principles should not be negotiable. A Conflict That Cannot Be Solved by Force Alone The tragedy is that the longer the conflict continues, the more deeply entrenched the suffering becomes. Israel’s military power may allow it to destroy infrastructure and eliminate fighters, but military force alone cannot resolve the political question at the heart of the conflict. Likewise, Hamas cannot create Palestinian freedom by attacking Israeli civilians. The only sustainable path remains one based on security, political rights, accountability and a credible political settlement. Britain’s message is therefore broader than the immediate dispute over settlement products. It is a warning that Israel’s closest allies are increasingly unwilling to separate Israeli security from Palestinian rights. Israel may reject that pressure, and it may accuse foreign governments of political bias. But it cannot reasonably expect the world to ignore the humanitarian consequences of its policies. When civilians are killed, imprisoned, displaced and deprived of essential necessities, the international community has not only a right but a responsibility to speak. And if Britain and other countries choose to do so, Israel’s answer should not be to accuse them of abandoning Israel. It should be to confront the underlying question: How can lasting Israeli security ever be achieved without Palestinian freedom, dignity and human rights? Abdikarim H. items.fullContent: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh Israel’s increasingly bitter confrontation with Britain is exposing a much larger question than a dispute over trade restrictions or settlements: how far can a government go in the name of security before the international community is compelled to respond to the suffering of Palestinian civilians? Israel has accused Britain of allowing what it describes as pro-Palestinian political forces to influence government policy, as London moves toward tougher measures over Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. But Britain’s position is not difficult to understand. A government that speaks in the language of human rights cannot simply ignore allegations of mass civilian suffering, displacement, arbitrary detention, settlement expansion and restrictions on humanitarian assistance. The diplomatic dispute intensified after Britain announced measures targeting goods produced in Israeli settlements in the West Bank, alongside possible sanctions against companies, organizations and individuals involved in the construction or expansion of those settlements. London has presented the measures as part of an effort to protect the possibility of a two-state solution and respond to violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. Israel, however, has strongly rejected such measures, portraying them as politically motivated pressure against the Israeli state. The confrontation illustrates a widening divide between Israel and some of its traditional Western partners. Israel’s Human-Rights Record Under Increasing Scrutiny For Palestinians, however, the argument goes far beyond diplomatic language. They have endured years of military occupation, settlement expansion, displacement, restrictions on movement and recurring violence. Since the outbreak of the Gaza war, the humanitarian crisis has reached an extraordinary level, with widespread destruction and enormous civilian suffering. Israel has repeatedly argued that its military operations are necessary to defend its population and defeat Hamas following the October 7 attacks. That security argument cannot simply be dismissed. But neither can it provide unlimited justification for the ill treatment of an entire civilian population. The protection of Israeli civilians and the protection of Palestinian civilians are not mutually exclusive principles. Both are obligations that governments and armed forces must respect. The international criticism directed at Israel therefore cannot automatically be characterized as hostility toward Israel or hatred of Jews. Indeed, Britain’s Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, who is Jewish, has explicitly rejected that interpretation while defending his government’s position. Miliband has stressed that Britain’s policies are not based on hostility toward Israel or Jewish people, but on concerns about developments in the West Bank and the need to preserve the possibility of a negotiated political settlement. Britain has also continued to recognize Israel’s security concerns and has condemned the Hamas attacks of October 7. At the same time, London argues that Palestinians have a right to self-determination and an independent state alongside Israel. That distinction is crucial. Criticism Is Not Antisemitism Israel’s increasingly aggressive response to international criticism risks obscuring an important principle: a government’s policies can be criticized without attacking the people, religion or identity of the country involved. Criticizing settlement expansion is not an attack on Judaism. Demanding humanitarian access for Palestinians is not hostility toward Israelis. Calling for investigations into alleged violations of international humanitarian law is not an attack on the Jewish people. And supporting Palestinian statehood does not inherently mean opposing Israel’s existence. These distinctions matter at a time when legitimate criticism of government policy can too easily be portrayed as prejudice. The international community has a responsibility to reject both antisemitism and anti-Palestinian hatred while still holding governments accountable for their conduct. The Human Cost Cannot Be Ignored The most difficult issue confronting Israel is ultimately humanitarian. When homes are destroyed, civilians are killed, people are detained, families are displaced and access to food, medicine and other essential supplies is restricted, the international community cannot be expected to remain silent simply because Israel invokes national security. Security matters. But security does not erase human rights. The same principle applies to Hamas and every other armed group. The killing or kidnapping of civilians cannot be justified by political grievances, occupation or resistance. A credible international position must therefore apply the same basic standard to everyone: civilians must be protected, hostages must be released, humanitarian assistance must reach those who need it, and alleged violations must be investigated. Why Britain Is Taking a Harder Line Britain’s position reflects a growing concern that continued settlement expansion and the deteriorating humanitarian situation could make a viable two-state solution increasingly impossible. London has therefore sought to distinguish between legitimate Israeli security concerns and policies it believes undermine Palestinian political rights. The restrictions on settlement-produced goods and possible sanctions are intended, according to Britain, to place pressure on those involved in settlement activity rather than punish Israeli society as a whole. Israel’s decision to respond with diplomatic countermeasures, including restrictions involving British officials and diplomatic representation, demonstrates how rapidly the disagreement has escalated. The dispute also comes amid growing pressure from other Western governments, including European states and Canada, over Israeli policies in the occupied Palestinian territories. Israel Cannot Demand Immunity from Accountability The central issue is therefore not whether Britain has suddenly become “anti-Israel.” It is whether Israel can expect its allies to remain silent when they believe fundamental human rights and international legal principles are being violated. No country should be above scrutiny—not Israel, Britain, the United States, Palestine, Hamas or any other government or armed organization. Israel has legitimate security concerns. Israelis have the right to live without fear of terrorism and attacks on civilians. But Palestinians have equally fundamental rights: to live, to eat, to receive medical care, to remain with their families, to be protected from arbitrary violence and detention, and ultimately to determine their own political future. Those principles should not be negotiable. A Conflict That Cannot Be Solved by Force Alone The tragedy is that the longer the conflict continues, the more deeply entrenched the suffering becomes. Israel’s military power may allow it to destroy infrastructure and eliminate fighters, but military force alone cannot resolve the political question at the heart of the conflict. Likewise, Hamas cannot create Palestinian freedom by attacking Israeli civilians. The only sustainable path remains one based on security, political rights, accountability and a credible political settlement. Britain’s message is therefore broader than the immediate dispute over settlement products. It is a warning that Israel’s closest allies are increasingly unwilling to separate Israeli security from Palestinian rights. Israel may reject that pressure, and it may accuse foreign governments of political bias. But it cannot reasonably expect the world to ignore the humanitarian consequences of its policies. When civilians are killed, imprisoned, displaced and deprived of essential necessities, the international community has not only a right but a responsibility to speak. And if Britain and other countries choose to do so, Israel’s answer should not be to accuse them of abandoning Israel. It should be to confront the underlying question: How can lasting Israeli security ever be achieved without Palestinian freedom, dignity and human rights? Abdikarim H. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo qarka u saaran in ay qabsadaan Bab El Mendab
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) – Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee ay Iran taageerto ayaa ballaarin weyn ku sameeyay deegaannada ay ka haystaan xeebaha Badda Cas, iyagoo qabsaday magaalada dekedda leh ee Mocha, isla markaana gaaray jasiiradaha Hanish, xilli dagaallada Yemen ay dib u xoogeysanayaan. Laba ilo-wareed oo ka tirsan dowladda Yemen ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Xuutiyiintu ay gaareen Hanish, kaddib markii ay gacanta ku dhigeen Mocha, tallaabo si weyn ugu soo dhoweynaysa marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab. Horumarkan militari ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in Xuutiyiintu awood dheeraad ah u yeeshaan inay saameeyaan isu-socodka maraakiibta Badda Cas, xilli marin-biyoodka kale ee Hormuz uu isna wajahayo carqalado ka dhashay dagaalka gobolka. Dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay ayaa muujinaya in Xuutiyiintu ay hadda xoogga saarayaan qabsashada xeebaha galbeed ee Yemen, halkii ay hore awooddooda ugu urursanaayeen waqooyiga dalka. Ciidamada dowladda Yemen iyo xoogagga xulafada la ah Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inay dib uga gurteen dhowr goobood, iyadoo Xuutiyiintu ay dhanka koonfureed uga sii socdaan xeebta Badda Cas. Xuutiyiinta ayaa weerarro ku qaaday Hanish, taas oo ku qasabtay ciidamada dowladda iyo xulafadooda inay dib ugu gurtaan Dhubab, oo si toos ah ugu taalla marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, kana soo horjeedda jasiiradda Perim. Ilo-wareedyada Yemen ayaa sheegay in gacan ku haynta Dhubab iyo Perim ay muhiim u tahay cid kasta oo doonaysa inay awood weyn ku yeelato marin-biyoodka. Qabsashada Bab al-Mandab Bab al-Mandab, oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, ayaa u dhexeeya Yemen iyo dalalka Geeska Afrika ee Jabuuti iyo Eritrea. Waa marin muhiim u ah maraakiibta isaga kala gooshta Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Xuutiyiinta ayaa dhankooda sheegay in isu-socodka caalamiga ah ee Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab uusan khatar ku jirin, isla markaana hawlgalladoodu ku kooban yihiin bartilmaameedyo gaar ah. Afhayeenka Xuutiyiinta Mohammed Abdulsalam ayaa sheegay in howlgaladaasi ay sii socon doonaan inta waxa uu ugu yeeray “gardarrada” ka dhanka ah Yemen aysan joogsan. Xarunta Xuutiyiinta u qaabilsan xiriirka maraakiibta ganacsiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Badda Cas ay ammaan u tahay shirkadaha maraakiibta, marka laga reebo maraakiibta Sacuudiga oo ay hore ugu dhawaaqeen inay xayiraad saareen. Horumarka militari ee Xuutiyiinta ayaa si gaar ah walaac ugu abuuraya Sacuudi Carabiya, oo muddooyinkii dambe kordhisay dhoofinta shidaalka ay ka sameyso dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas, si ay uga fogaato dhibaatooyinka ka jira marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Haddii Xuutiyiintu awood dheeraad ah ku yeeshaan Bab al-Mandab, waxaa sii adkaan karta dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga ee u socda suuqyada caalamka, gaar ahaan Aasiya. Qiimaha shidaalka caalamka ayaa durba sare u kacay, iyadoo Brent uu Khamiistii ka sarreeyay $100 halkii foosto, xilli carqaladaha ka jira Hormuz iyo Badda Cas ay sii kordhinayaan walaaca laga qabo sahayda tamarta. Xiisadda Yemen ayaa sidoo kale dib u soo nooleyneysa cabsi laga qabo in dalkaasi uu mar kale galo dagaal baahsan, kaddib heshiis xabbad-joojin ah oo Qaramada Midoobay garwadeen ka ahayd sanadkii 2022, kaas oo si weyn u yareeyay dagaalladii socday sannadaha badan. Tarek Saleh, oo hoggaamiya ciidamo dowladda Yemen la safan kana dagaallama xeebaha galbeed, ayaa Khamiistii ku amray ciidamadiisa inay sameystaan xarun talis oo kale oo ku taalla goob ammaan ah. Tallaabadaas ayaa loo arkay calaamad kale oo muujineysa cadaadiska xooggan ee Xuutiyiintu ku hayaan ciidamadiisa, xilli jabhaddu si degdeg ah ugu sii fideyso koonfurta xeebta. Muuqaal ay Reuters xaqiijisay ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay dagaalyahanno Xuutiyiin ah oo u dabaaldegaya horumarkooda degmada Hays, oo koonfur kaga beegan Hodeidah. Pakistan oo digniin gaarsiisay Iran Dhinaca kale, Pakistan ayaa Iran gaarsiisay digniin ka timid Sacuudi Carabiya oo ku saabsan weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, iyadoo Riyadh ay doonayso in Tehran ay saameyn ku yeelato kooxda si looga hortago in dagaalku sii fido. Sarkaal sare oo Iranian ah ayaa xaqiijiyay in fariinta la gaarsiiyay Tehran, balse wuxuu sheegay in Iran aysan maamulin Xuutiyiinta. Si kastaba, ilo-wareedyo Iranian ah ayaa Reuters u sheegay in Tehran ay Xuutiyiinta ku dhiirrigelisay inay kordhiyaan weerarrada ka dhanka ah Sacuudi Carabiya, isla markaana ay u ballanqaadday taageero dheeraad ah oo dhaqaale iyo hub. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sanadkii 2023 weerarro joogto ah ku qaaday maraakiibta Badda Cas, iyagoo sheegay inay taageerayaan Falastiiniyiinta dagaalka Gaza. Weerarradaasi waxay sababeen in qaar ka mid ah shirkadaha waaweyn ee maraakiibta ay ka fogaadaan Bab al-Mandab iyo Kanaalka Suweys, iyagoo maraakiibtooda ku wareejiyay koonfurta Afrika. Kooxdu waxay magaalada Sanca qabsatay sanadkii 2014, taas oo dowladda Yemen ku qasabtay inay dhanka koonfureed u guurto. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sanadkii xigay hoggaamisay isbahaysi militari oo dagaalka ku soo galay, iyadoo ka cabsi qabtay sii xoogeysiga saameynta Iran ee Yemen. Dagaalkaas ayaa sababay mid ka mid ah musiibooyinka bani’aadannimo ee ugu waaweyn dunida. Hadda, qabsashada Mocha iyo u soo dhowaanshaha Xuutiyiinta ee Bab al-Mandab ayaa dagaalka Yemen siinaya wajigii ugu khatarta badnaa muddo sanado ah, maadaama saameyntiisa aysan ku ekaan karin Yemen iyo Sacuudi Carabiya, balse ay si toos ah u taaban karto ganacsiga, shidaalka iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta caalamka. items.title: Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta oo la wareegay gacan ku haynta magaalada istiraatiijiga ah ee Mokha
items.description: Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ayaa Khamiistii si buuxda ula wareegay gacan ku haynta Magaalada Mokha, tani oo qayb ka ah qorshaha ay isugu fidinayaan marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb. Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudiga uu taageero ayaa isaga baxay magaaladan oo leh deked muhiim ah oo ku taala Badda Cas. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay inay Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen banneeyeen magaaladaasi, ka dib culeys xoog leh oo ka soo fuulay dhanka Xuutiyiinta. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ee xiriirka la leh Iran ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay waday guluf xoogan oo dhulka ah, isla-markaana ay culeys ku saarayeen ciidamadii ka soo horjeeday ee ku sugnaa magaalada istiraatiijiga ah ee Mokha. Mokha ayaa ku taala Koonfur Galbeed Yemen, waxayna 75km dhanka waqooyi uga beegan tahay Marinka Bab El-Mandeb oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Mokha waxay ahayd gidaarkii ugu weynaa ee Xuutiyiinta ka hortaagnaa inay gaaraan marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb. Magaaladan ayaa ahmiyad weyn u leh Xuutiyiinta Yemen, maadaama ay ku dul degto Bab El-Mandeb, isla-markaana ay doonayaan inay maamulaan marinkaasi. Marinka Bab El-Mandeb ayaa muhiim u ah maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee isugu kala goosha Asia, Yurub iyo Bariga Afrika, iyadoo uu marinkan isku xiro Geeska Afrika iyo Asia. Saraakiisha Xuutiyiinta ayaa marinkan u arka inuu siinayo awood ay ku hor istaagi karaan maraakiibta shidaalka Sacuudiga ee ka gudbaya, si ay Riyadh ugu cadaadiyaan in ay joojiso fara-gelinta gudaha ee Yemen ama fara-gelinta arrimaha gudaha ee dalkaasi. Xuutiyiinta ayaa 20-kii bishii July ku dhawaaqay go’doomin badeed oo ka dhan ah Dekedaha Sacuudiga, waxayna maraakiibta boqortooyada ka mamnuuceen inay adeegsadaan Badda Cas iyo Bab El-Mandeb.

items.title: Somaliland offers to send 2,000 troops for Gaza Stabilization Force
Mucaaradka Somaliland: Ciidamada Cirro u dirayo Gaza ha kusoo furto maxaabiista Laascaanood
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Afhayeenka Xisbiga Mucaaradka Somaliland ee Kaah ayaa si kulul uga falceliyay hadalkii Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi (Cirro) ee ahaa in maamulka Somaliland uu diyaar u yahay inuu ilaa 2,000 oo askari u diro Gaza. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in ciidankaasi Somaliland ugu baahan tahay arrimo gudaha ah, gaar ahaan sidii loo soo furan lahaa maxaabiista Somaliland uga xiran magaalada Laascaanood oo haatan ah xarunta maamulka Waqooyi Bari. “Labada kun ee askari ee madaxwaynuhu sheegay inuu u dirayo Gaza, waxa looga baahi badan yahay inay soo furtaan maxaabiista inagaga xidhan Laascaanood,” ayuu yiri Afhayeenka xisbiga Kaah. Hadalka Afhayeenka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Madaxweyne Cirro uu magaalada Washington kaga qeyb-galay shirka MEAD, halkaas oo uu ka sheegay in Somaliland ay diyaar u tahay inay ciidamo ku biiriso ciidamada caalamiga ah ee loo qorsheynayo xasilinta Gaza. items.title: SHARIIF oo dhacdadii foosha xumeyd ee Ceelbaraf ku xiray daciifnimada…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa si kulul uga hadlay dilka naxdinta leh ee askari ka tirsanaa ciidamada xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed loogu geystay deegaanka Ceelbaraf, isagoo dhacdada ku tilmaamay mid ka tarjumaysa xaaladda amni iyo dowladnimo ee dalka. Shariif ayaa marka hore tacsi tiiraanyo leh u diray waalidka, qoyska, ehellada iyo dhammaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee uu ka geeriyooday marxuum Axmed Shire Xuseen. “Waxaan si adag u cambaareynayaa falkaas foosha xun ee loo geystay marxuumka,” ayuu yiri Shariif, oo sheegay in dilalka aanooyinka qabiillada ay noqdeen dhacdooyin soo noq-noqda oo sii kordhaya muddooyinkii dambe. Marxuum Axmed Shire ayaa la sheegay in loo dilay aano qabiil kaddib markii maleeshiyaad hubeysan ay ka dejiyeen mooto uu la socday, xilli uu kusii jeeday gobolka Hiiraan, halkaas oo jirdil xooggan loogu geystay markii dambena lagu toogtay, si ay sheegeen ehelladiisu. Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqay xiriirka ka dhexeeya daciifnimada dowladnimada iyo kororka fowdada, isagoo sheegay in marka ay dowladnimadu daciifto ay sii kordhaan dagaallada iyo rabshadaha u dhexeeya beelaha Soomaaliyeed. “Mar kasta oo dowladnimadeennu daciifto waxaa sii kordha fowdada iyo dagaallada beelaha,” ayuu yiri madaxweynihii hore, oo muujiyay muhiimadda in la helo dowlad caddaalad ah oo awood u leh inay badbaadiso dhiigga Soomaaliyeed ee meel kasta ku qubanaya. Sidoo kale wuxuu ugu baaqay beelaha walaalaha ah ee Soomaaliyeed inay joojiyaan “bannaysashada dhiiggooda”, isla markaana khilaafaadkooda iyo tabashooyinkooda ku xalliyaan wada-hadal. Dhacdadan ayaa fal-celin xooggan ka dhalisay baraha bulshada, iyadoo dilka Axmed Shire uu imaaayo xilli deegaanka Ceelbaraf ay horay uga dhaceen dhacdooyin la xiriira dilal loo geystay askar ka tirsan ciidamada xoogga dalka, taasoo sii xoojisay walaaca amni ee deegaanka. Hoos ka aqriso qoraalka Shariif Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raajicuun. Waa wax laga murugoodo dilka naxdinta leh ee loo geystay, Ilaahay ha u naxariistee, Axmed Shire. Waxaan tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirayaa waalidkiisa, qoyskiisa, eheladiisa, iyo dhammaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed oo uu ka geeriyooday Axmed Shire, isagana waxaan Ilaahay uga baryayaa inuu naxariistiisa ka waraabiyo. Waxaan si adag cambaareynayaa falkaas foosha xun ee loo geystay marxuumka. Aanooyinka qabiillada walaalaha ee Soomaaliyeed waxay noqotay dhacdooyin soo noqnoqda siina korordhay muddooyinkaan danbe. Mar kasta oo dowladnimadeenu daciifto waxaa sii kordha fowdada iyo dagaallada beelaha. Ilaahay waxaan ka rajaynaynaa dowlad caadil ah oo kala bedbaadisa dhiigga Soomaaliyeed ee meel kasta ku qubanaya. Beelaha walaalaha waxaan ugu baaqayaa inay joojiyaan bannaysashada dhiiggooda oo khilaafaadkooda wadahadal ku xalliyaan. items.title: Somalia parliament parliament speaker says foreign agenda behind Turkish flag burnings
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s parliament speaker, Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur Jama, has described the burning of the Turkish flag in several regions across the country as an “appalling” development that is new to Somalia, saying a foreign agenda is behind the acts. His remarks followed a wave of protests in Somalia’s Jubaland, Puntland and Southwest states, where demonstrators burned Turkish flag and images of Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan. Jama said the burnings do not represent a Somali agenda but a foreign one, linking the incidents to what he called incoming geopolitical threats facing Somalia and rejecting any suggestion that the protests reflect Somali sentiment. items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisil Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta magacaabay Xoghayaha Joogtada ee Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha oo cuskanaya qodobka 119-aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa u magacaabay Mubaarik Maxamed Axmed in uu noqdo Xoghayaha Joogtada ah ee Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza ayaa mas’uulkan kula dardaarmay hufnaan iyo hawl gudasho dhab ah, fuliyana qorshayaasha xukuumadda ee degsan. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa Maxamed Dhuuboow Maxamed u magacaabay in uu noqdo Agaasimaha guud ee Xarunta Adeegyada Mideysan ee Halmeel. Isla maanta, Golaha Wasiiradda Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo uu shir guddoomiyay Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa lagu ansixiyay Agaasimaha Guud iyo Agaasime Ku-xigeenka Guud ee Hay’adda Maalgashiga Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Magacaabista mas’uuliyiintan ayaa timid kadib soo-jeedin uu sameeyay Wasiirka Qorsheynta, Maalgashiga iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Xilalkan ayaa loo kala magacaabay Mudane Feysal Aadan Xasan oo noqonaya Agaasima Guud ee Hay’adda Maalgashiga JFS iyo Mudane Maxamed Yuusuf Maxamed oo noqonaya Agaasime Ku-xigeenka Guud ee Hay’adda Maalgashiga Soomaaliya. items.title: Hassan Sheikh Backs Ali Gudlawe as Hirshabelle Election Tensions Rise
items.description: Mogadisho (WDN) — President Hassan Sheikh Mohamoud has reportedly begun openly backing Hirshabelle President Ali Gudlawe for another term as political maneuvering intensifies ahead of the regional leadership contest. The President received a group of politicians from the Guudlaawe’s clan (Harti-Abgaal) community in Mogadishu, with discussions focusing on the forthcoming selection of Hirshabelle’s leadership. Several of those who attended are reportedly interested in competing for the presidency. According to sources familiar with the meeting, however, Hassan made clear that Villa Somalia is backing Ali Gudlawe and intends to support his candidacy through the ruling Justice and Stability Party (JSP). The President reportedly urged the politicians to abandon their ambitions and support Gudlawe, while indicating that Villa Somalia will formally declare its position in the coming days. Hassan is also expected to meet with the Ugaas of the Hawadle clan and other political figures to reiterate his support for Gudlawe. The Question Behind the Campaign The political maneuvering in Hirshabelle raises a more fundamental question: under what rules is this election supposed to take place? Somalia’s two most important electoral disputes remain unresolved—the contested constitutional amendments and the absence of a broadly accepted national election modality. Major opposition forces and several federal member states continue to challenge the constitutional process, while disagreement persists over who should determine the country’s electoral framework and how future elections should be conducted. Nevertheless, the campaigning for a preferred regional candidate risks putting the political outcome ahead of the rules governing the process. The Federal Government also maintains that the constitutional amendments are legally valid. Its opponents argue that the process lacked sufficient political consensus and did not adequately protect the federal political order. Whatever the competing interpretations, the disagreement remains politically unresolved. That matters because elections conducted under a constitutional framework rejected by major stakeholders could inherit the same legitimacy problem. Constitutional reform cannot provide a stable foundation for elections if the political actors expected to participate in those elections do not accept how the reform was adopted. The Risk of a One-Sided Election The same concern applies to the electoral modality. If the Federal Government proceeds without reaching agreement with opposition groups and federal member states, an election may be technically organized but politically contested from the outset. That could produce a familiar Somali cycle: one side declares victory, the other rejects the process, and the election becomes another source of political confrontation rather than a mechanism for resolving it. The reported effort to secure support for Gudlawe therefore comes at a sensitive moment. The immediate political question may be who leads Hirshabelle, but the larger issue is whether Somalia’s leaders can first agree on the rules under which political power is transferred. Consensus Before Candidates The reported effort to secure support for Gudlawe comes at a sensitive moment. The immediate question may be who leads Hirshabelle, but the larger issue is whether Somalia’s leaders have first agreed on the rules governing political power. Somalia does not need another election whose legitimacy is disputed before the first ballot is cast. The constitutional framework and electoral modality must be settled through broad political consensus before the country moves to determine who wins. President Hassan may have a preferred candidate, but no candidate can resolve a national crisis rooted in disputed rules. The real test is whether Somalia can agree on the rules that make an election—and its winner—legitimate. The Risk of a One-Sided Election The same concern applies to the electoral modality. If the Federal Government proceeds without reaching agreement with opposition groups and federal member states, an election may be technically organized but politically contested from the outset. That could produce a familiar Somali cycle: one side declares victory, the other rejects the process, and the election becomes another source of political confrontation rather than a mechanism for resolving it. The reported effort to secure support for Gudlawe therefore comes at a sensitive moment. The immediate political question may be who leads Hirshabelle, but the larger issue is whether Somalia’s leaders can first agree on the rules under which political power is transferred. Somalia does not need another election whose legitimacy is disputed before the first ballot is cast. The constitutional framework and electoral modality must be settled through broad political consensus before the country moves to determine who wins. President Hassan may have a preferred candidate, but no candidate can resolve a national crisis rooted in disputed rules. The real test is whether Somalia can agree on the rules that make an election—and its winner—legitimate. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo booqday guutada cusub 21aad ee Gorgor (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo Khamiistan booqday Xarunta Taliska Qaybta 1aad ee Kumaandooska Gorgor ee Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa halkaasi kula kulmay Saraakiisha iyo Ciidanka Guutada 21aad. Guutadan oo ka tirsan Qaybta 1aad ee Ciidanka Gorgor ayaa 8-dii bishii hore ee August tababar loogu soo xiray Magaalada Manisa ee Galbeedka Turkiga, waxaana daba-yaaqadii bishaasi dib loogu soo celiyay dalka. “Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa warbixinno ka dhageystay Taliska iyo Saraakiisha Ciidamada, isaga oo mid mid u booqday Xafiisyada Taliska, deegaanka ciidamada, isbitaalka qaybta iyo xarumaha saadka, isla-markaana u kuurgalay xaaladda guud ee ciidamada, adeegyada ay helaan iyo diyaargarowgooda howlaha qaranka.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Villa Somalia. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Madaxweynaha ayaa bogaadiyay doorka Ciidamada Gorgor ee difaaca dalka iyo la dagaalanka Khawaarijta, isaga oo faray in ay u diyaargaroobaan gudashada waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah, ayna ka shaqeeyaan xaqiijinta himilada shacabka Soomaaliyeed, ee ah xaqiijinta Soomaaliya xor ka ah Khawaarijta.” Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa dowladda iyo shacabka Turkiga uga mahadceliyay taageeradooda joogtada ah ee ku aaddan gacanta ay ka gaysanayaan dib-u-dhiska, tababarka iyo tayaynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, gaar ahaan dhismaha iyo horumarinta cutubyada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Kumaandooska Gorgor. Turkiga waxa uu door weyn oo muuqda ka qaataa tababarka, qalabaynta iyo xoojinta awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, taas oo fure u ah amniga, difaaca iyo ilaalinta madaxbannaanida dalka. Turkiga oo xulafo la ah Somaliya ayaa gacanta ugu weyn ka gaysta dib-u-dhiska Ciidamada Qalabka Sida.

items.title: Somali Soldier Pleads for His Life Before Reported Clan-Motivated Killing
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — A disturbing killing of a Somali military soldier has sparked widespread outrage after footage reportedly captured him pleading for his life moments before he was killed in an alleged act of clan revenge. The soldier, who was originally from Hiiraan Region, was reportedly pulled from a vehicle near the boundary between Hiiraan and Middle Shabelle and taken away by armed men. What has intensified public anger is video footage in which the soldier can reportedly be heard pleading with his captors, saying: “Uncle, please don’t kill me. I am sick, and I am a member of the Somali National Army.” The footage has generated strong reactions because it appears to show a frightened and vulnerable man appealing for mercy while identifying himself as a member of the national armed forces. According to reports, the soldier was ultimately killed in what has been described as an act of clan revenge, although the circumstances and motive have not been independently established. In the footage, the soldier makes other statements suggesting that he would not have travelled through the area had he known what awaited him. His words have since become the most painful element of the incident: a Somali soldier, reportedly aware that his life was in danger, pleading with those holding him to spare him. A Killing That Raises Bigger Questions The reported killing raises serious questions about the persistence of clan-based violence and the vulnerability of Somali citizens—even members of the national armed forces—when travelling through areas where clan tensions remain unresolved. It also underscores the weakness of the federal government and its failure to bring security and stability to the country. A man serving in the national military should not have to fear being identified, abducted and killed because of where he comes from. If the killing was indeed motivated by clan revenge, it represents more than the death of one individual. It is a reminder of how deeply clan-based retaliation continues to threaten social cohesion and undermine the authority of the state. The authorities must establish what happened, identify those responsible and ensure that the case is investigated through lawful institutions rather than allowing it to become another trigger for revenge. The most disturbing question is not simply why the soldier was killed. It is how a man could plead for his life, identify himself as a national soldier and still reportedly be denied mercy. His death should not become another forgotten episode in Somalia’s cycle of clan violence. It should become a demand for justice. items.title: Deni Highlights Xaafuun’s Maritime, Industrial and Tourism Potential
items.description: Xaafuun (WDN) — Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni has visited Xaafuun, highlighting the district’s potential to become an important center for fisheries, tourism, water infrastructure and regional economic development. During his visit, Deni toured the historic port of Xaafuun and the remains of the district’s former salt-processing factory, reflecting an industrial and maritime heritage that stretches back generations. The President also inspected a desalination plant supplying fresh water to Xaafuun and surrounding communities, as well as a local fish-processing facility whose products are sold both within Somalia and to international markets. President Deni in Xaafuun The visit underscores the economic possibilities offered by Puntland’s extensive coastline, where fisheries and fish processing could become major sources of employment and income for coastal communities if supported by investment in infrastructure, cold storage, processing facilities and export networks. But Xaafuun’s potential extends beyond fisheries. Its ancient port and historic industrial sites offer opportunities for cultural and heritage tourism. With appropriate preservation, infrastructure and international promotion, centuries-old sites along Puntland’s coastline could attract visitors interested in Somalia’s maritime history, archaeology and coastal culture. Such tourism could create employment for local residents through hotels, restaurants, transportation, tour services, handicrafts and other small businesses while generating new revenue for surrounding communities. Deni also inspected Xaafuun Airport, where he received a briefing from officials from the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Airports and the district administration. The President emphasized the importance of developing the airport to improve connectivity for Xaafuun and surrounding areas, particularly as economic and tourism activity expands. The visit highlights a broader development opportunity for Puntland: its coastline is not simply a security or fishing resource, but a potential engine for a wider blue economy and tourism industry. With investment in ports, airports, fisheries, water infrastructure and heritage sites, coastal communities such as Xaafuun could increasingly connect local resources to national and international markets. For residents, the greatest potential benefit is employment. The combination of fisheries, fish processing, maritime trade and heritage tourism could create new livelihoods while helping transform Puntland’s historic coastline into an economic asset for the communities that live along it. Nevertheless, although residents across Puntland, particularly in areas visited by the President, have applauded and welcomed his visits, what they ultimately want are tangible government services, development, and improvements in their daily lives—and that is what matters most to them. items.description: Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta yeeshay kulankooda toddobaadlaha ah, kaas oo looga hadlay warbixinno kala duwan oo la xiriira amniga, dhaqaalaha, waxqabadka Xukuumadda iyo Warbixin la xiriirta Sumadda Qaranka Soomaaliya. Kulanka oo uu guddoominayay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa Golaha looga dhageystay warbixinno faahfaahsan oo ay soo jeediyeen Wasaaradaha Amniga Gudaha iyo Gaashaandhigga, kuwaas oo ku saabsanaa xaaladda amni ee guud ahaan dalka. Wasaaradaha ayaa warbixintooda ku sheegay in ciidamada qaranku guulo muhiim ah ka gaareen dagaalladii ka dhanka ahaa Khawaarijta, kuwaas oo ka dhacay qaar ka mid ah gobollada dalka, isla markaana lagu dilay tiro ka mid ah horjoogayaashii Khawaariijta ee maleegayay dhagarta iyo dhibaateynta shacabka Soomaaliyeed, ayna kordheen tirada isdhiibayaasha iyo maxaabiista laga qabqabtay Khawaariijta. Sidoo kale, Kulanka Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa lagu soo bandhigay warbixin ku saabsan dib-u-eegista iyo qiimeynta waxqabadka Xukuumadda DanQaran, iyada oo Xukuumaddu ay gashay sanadkeedii shanaad ee ay u adeegayso shacabka Soomaaliyeed, si loo qiimeeyo horumarka laga gaaray qorshayaashii iyo waajibaadkii loo igmaday. Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa looga hadlay warbixin ku saabsan Sumadda Qaranka, taas oo ay si wadajir ah usoo jeediyeen Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska iyo Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha. Ra’iisul Wasaare Mudane Xamsa ayaa bogaadiyay shaqada ay hayaan guddiga Summadda Qaranka , isaga oo xusey in ay muhiimad weyn leedahay iswaafaqinta iyo hagaajinta astaamaha qaran, si dhammaan hay’adaha dowladda ugu suurtogasho u adeegsiga calaamado iskumid ah. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale ammaanay wasaaradda amniga iyo Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga xaqiijinta amniga guud ahaan dalka oo maraya heer lagu diirsado. “Qof aan hub la’aan socon karin ma leh caasimadda, hub lagu xaragoodo ma doonayno, hubka la wato kaliya waa in uu noqdaa mid hawlgal amni lagu xaqiijinayo, ciddii kale ee hub wadata waa in la marsiiyaa habraacyadii amniga” ayuu faray laamaha amniga Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre oo la hadlayay Golaha Wasiiradda.

items.title: DF Soomaaliya miyey aqoonsan tahay Israa’iil?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa caddeysay mowqifkeeda ku aaddan Israa’iil, iyadoo sheegtay in aysan aqoonsaneyn Israa’iil, isla markaana aysan aqbali karin in qayb ka mid ah dhulka Soomaaliya loo aqoonsado dal. Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Soomaaliya, Cabdifitaax Qaasim Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay si adag uga hortageyso tallaabo kasta oo waxyeello u geysan karta midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Wasiirka ayaa si cad u sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan aqoonsaneyn Israa’iil, sidoo kalena aysan awood u laheyn inay aqoonsato ama ictiraafto qayb ka mid ah dhulka Soomaaliya. “Israa’iil ma aha dal la aqoonsan yahay, sidaas oo ay tahayna ma ictiraafi karto qayb ka mid ah Soomaaliya. Waxaan difaaceynaa madax-bannaanideeda,” ayuu Wasiir Cabdifitaax Qaasim ku yiri wareysi uu siiyay telefishinka Al-Carabiya. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay diyaar u tahay inay qaaddo tallaabo kasta oo lagama maarmaan ah oo lagu difaacayo midnimada dalka, madax-bannaanidiisa iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Hadallada wasiirka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay weli jirto xiisad siyaasadeed oo ka dhalatay mowqifyada Israa’iil ee ku aaddan Somaliland, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay si joogto ah u diiddan tahay tallaabo kasta oo wax u dhimaysa midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida dalka. Dhammaadka sannadkii hore ayay aheyd markii Israa’iil shaacisay inay maamulka Somaliland u aqoonsatay dowlad madax-bannaan, tallaabadaas oo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay si adag uga hortimid, kuna tilmaantay mid ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. items.title: Barakicin qasab ah oo nolol xumo galisay qoysas laga saaray xeryaha Baydhabo
items.description: (ERGO) –  Cunno xumo, biyo yari, hoy la’aan iyo ganacsiyo yaryar oo ay ku tiirsanaayeen oo laga burburay ayaa isku raacday in ka badan 160 qoysas barakac ah oo July qasab looga raray xero Baydhabo ku taalla. Dadkii dhulka lahaa oo markii hore bixiyay ogolaanshaha ay ku dageen ayaa u sheegay inay si deg-deg ah uga guuraan. Waxay waayeen ilahoodii nolosha, adeegyada biyaha, caafimaadka iyo waxbarashada oo ay bilaash ku heli jireen. Cabdiraxmaan Cali Isxaaq ayaa sheegay in barakicintan ay uga baaba’day sandaqad uu bagaash iyo khudaar ku iibin jiray. Waxay u ahayd halka meel ee ay ku tiirsanaayeen. Waxaa ku adkaatay helida dhamaaan adeegyada aas-aasiga ah. “Meel bannaan ayay xaalad adag nagu haysataaa. Daruufo ayaan ku jirnaa. Dab shidkeena aad ayuu u xun yahay. Ciyaalkii jaahwareer ayaa galay. Wixii aan naftooda ku ilaalinayay ma leh. Horraan 3 waqti waa helaynay, haddase hal mar ayaa adag. Dhibaato iyo murug ayaan ku jirnaa.” Cabdiraxmaan ayaa sheegay in ganacsigiisii uu maalinkii ka heli jiray $3 illaa $5 oo ugu filnayd cunnada qoyskiisa oo 9 qof ah. Wuxuu xusay inay ku jireen nolol wanaagsan, balse hadda uusan waxba u awoodin ilmihiisa. Dukaanka ka burburay wuxuu ku billaabay $400 oo uu ka aruursaday gargaar lacag ah oo ay siin jirtay hay’ada Islamic Relief, kaas oo 3 sano ka hor go’ay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in uusan dib u billaabin karin qarash la’aanta haysa darteed. Qiyaastii $300 ayaa ugu jirtay intii aan laga burburin. Cabdiraxmaan ayaa sheegay in bishii March ee sanadkaan ay meheradiisu gubatay, balse qayb uu ka caynsaday iyo daymo uusan weli gudin uu markale ku howlgaliyay. Waxaa meesha ka baxay adeegyada biyaha, wxbarashada iyo caafimaadka oo bilaash u ahaa. Qoyskiisu waxba kama soo qaadan labo qol oo cooshad ah oo ay ku noolaayeen muddo shan sano ah oo ay deganaayeen xerada. Maacuunkii iyo gogoshii ayaa noqday wax lumay iyo wax jajabay, halka bacihii u dhisnaa oo duugoobay ay qaadasho gali waayeen. Waxay xamili la’ yihiin dhaxanta iyo qorraxda oo ay dibad-yaal u yihiin. Waxaa intaas u dheer xaalad biyo yari ah oo haysata. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in maalinkii ay yaryaraystaan 20 liitar oo ay dadka dhaama ka soo baryaan, maaddaama uusan heli karin $0.25 oo halkii jirigaan laga iibiyo ceel gaar ah. Qoyskiisa ayaa sanadkii 2022 ka soo barakacay Degmada Berdaale ee gobolka Bay, markii abaar ay ka nacfi tirtay beer 6 hektar ah oo ay ku tiirsanayd. Qoysaska la barakiciyay ayay xaaladaan ku hogaamisay caqabado hor leh oo aysan xal u hayn. Waxay ka siman yihiin daruufaha isku biirsaday. Aadan Cabdi Cali oo ka mid ah ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in tan iyo 13 July ay qoyskiisa oo 10 qof ah wajahayaan cunno xumo, biyo yari iyo hoy la’aan ah. Si culaysyadaan uu u xalliyo wuxuu joogto u raadiyaa shaqooyin xamaal ah, balse wuu ku hungoobay. Ninkaan ayaa tilmaamay in carruurtiisa oo 2 jir ugu yar yahay ay inta badan gaajo ku seexdaan, taas oo murugo ku abuurta. Dariska iyo qaraabo ay u dan-sheegtaan ayay marmar ka helaen ugu badnaan hal kiilo ama hal dollar oo ay mar dabka ku shitaan. “Markii hore saddex waqti waa karsan jirnay haddana markii ayaa dhib ah. Wax aan meeshaan ku haysano iyo meel aan wax ka billowno maleh. Bishii toddobaad illaa hadda bannaankaas ayaan joognaa. Musqul, gabbaad iyo tubbo midna kuma haysano duurkaan. Xaaladeena aad ayay u cakirin tahay.” Aadan ayaa xusay in miis yar oo khudaar uu ku iibin jiray uu ka burburay. Waxaa maalinkii ka soo galaysay ugu badnaan shan dollar oo uu u kala qaybin jiray masruufka reerka iyo qayb uu ganacsigiisa dib ugu celiyo. Ganacsigaas ayuu sheegay inuu ku aas-aasay $150 oo isugu jirtay dayn iyo qayb ay ku caawiyeen ehelkiisa, balse uu dhaafay. Xilliga barakacinta hal maalin ka hor ayuu u soo adeegay, taas oo rajo uu ka qabay inuu faa’iido badan ka heli doono. Ninkaan ayaa xusay inay khudaartii xumaatay, markii uu waayay meel uu ku iibiyo ayna qorraxdu ku dhacday. Dadkii uu ka soo qaaday ayaa joogto u soo waydiiya mana uu hayo xal uu ku bixiyo. “Daymo badan ayaa la iiga leeyahay, xaaladaana kuma bixin karo. In ka badan $200 ayaan ka qabaa, magaaladaana daruufaheedu waa badan yihiin oo shaqooyinkii aan raadiyay waan waayay. Culaysyadan murugo saa’id ah ayay nagu hayaan.” Aadan oo 44 jir ah ayaa sheegay inaysan jirin meel kale oo dhaqaale uu ka soo galo iyo cid ay taageero ka heleen. Wuxuu xusay in xaaladaan ay ku soo beegantay xilli adag oo gargaarkii hay’adaha uu meesha ka baxay. Ehelkooda miyiga degan ayuu sheegay inaysan waxba ku caawin karin oo roob yaraantu ka saamaysay oo xoolihii iyo beerihii. Aadan oo xerada Iraroog ku noolaa afartii sano ee u danbaysay ayaa tilmaamay inay ku jiraan markii ay ugu xumayd. Waxaa ka waxbarasho beelay shan carruurtiisa ah uu iskuul hoose oo bilaash ah uga dhiganay xerada. Qoyskiisa ayaa 2023 ka soo barakacay Degmada Qansax dheere ee Gobolka Bay.  Dalagii ugu danbeeyay ee uu saaray beertiisa oo 4 hektar ah ayaa biyo la’aan uga qallalay, halka 27 neef oo ari iyo lo’ ah oo xoolo uu ka lahaaana ay u dhinteen cuduro iyo saamaynta abaaraha. Dhulka qoysaskan laga saaray waxay si bilaash ah ku daganaayeen 7 sano. Guddoomiyaha xerada Iraroog Salmo Xasan Maxamed ayaa sheegay in aan wax digniin ah horay loo siin. Waxaa lau wargaliyay inay deg deg uga baxaan, maaddaama la iibinayo. “Qoysaska la barakiciyay meel banaan oo aysan waxba ku haysan ayay joogaan. Wax adeeg ah ma helaan, aad ayayna u rafaadsan yihiin. Gargaar Ilaahay ayaa bixiya, balse hay’adaha samafalka.” “Dowlada Soomaaliya iyo tan Koonfur-galbeed waxaan ka codsanaynaa in gurmad loo sameeyo dadkaan oo noloshooda la badbaadiyo.” Waxaa meesha ka baxday xarun caafimaadka oo ay ka heli jireen adeegyada dhalmada, tallaalka iyo daawooyin bilaash ah, iyadoo ay waxbarasho la’aan noqdeen in ka badan 300 carruur ah oo isugu jiray kuwo xerada Iraroog deganaa iyo kuwo ka imaan jiray meelo kale, sida ay guddoomiyuhu sheegtay. Baraagihii ay biyaha ku kaydsan jireen ayay ka yimaadeen. Barakicinta qasabka ah waa dhacdo ku soo lalaabta qoysaska xeryaha ku jira, xaaladan oo deg deg ku dhacda waxay quus u horseedaa dad markii hore wajahaya caqabado nololeed oo waayuhu badeen. items.title: Somaliland President Attends MEAD Summit as US, Israel Navigate Regional Challenges
items.description: Somaliland President Attends MEAD Summit as US, Israel Navigate Regional Challenges USA, Washington, (SomaliReport) – The fourth MEAD Summit opened in Washington on Tuesday, bringing together representatives from 24 countries for two days of discussions on Iran, Gaza, Lebanon and regional security. The September 8–9 gathering comes amid continued uncertainty over the conflict with Iran and its regional repercussions. Discussions are focusing on unresolved issues including shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, the situation in Lebanon, efforts to reach an agreement in Gaza and the future of Iran’s nuclear programme. Participants are also expected to discuss possible new regional security frameworks, energy security and the protection of vital shipping routes. The summit has attracted representatives from 12 Middle Eastern countries, including several that do not maintain diplomatic relations with Israel. Organisers say this year’s gathering has the broadest participation since the summit was established four years ago. Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi (Irro) is also attending the conference, adding a Somaliland presence to the high-level regional discussions. The closed-door forum brings together senior policymakers, government officials and security figures from the United States, Israel and countries across the region.
