items.title: Falcelin xooggan oo ka dhalatay Askari ka Tirsanaa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo lagu Diley Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe
items.description: Falcelin xooggan ayaa kasoo dhalatay fal dil ah oo ka dhacay gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, kaas oo lagu dilay askari ka tirsanaa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Askariga ayaa la sheegay inuu xilliga dhacdadu ku jiray fasax, isla markaana uu u socday gobolka Hiiraan, isagoo ku safrayay deegaan ka tirsan Shabeellaha Dhexe. Wararka laga helayo deegaanka ayaa sheegaya in askariga, oo la socday gaarigiisa, ay jidka u galeen maleeshiyaad deegaanka ah, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay gaariga kala degeen, kadibna ay dileen. Muuqaal laga duubay askariga ka hor inta aan la dilin ayaa sidoo kale la faafiyay, waxaana muuqaalkaas laga fahmayaa inuu ka hadlayay xaaladdii uu ku sugnaa iyo dadkii uu la kulmay. Si kastaba, faahfaahinta muuqaalka iyo cidda si toos ah uga dambeysay dilka ayaan weli la xaqiijin, balse goobta uu falku ka dhacay ayaa muujinaysa in askariga loo diley aano qabiil. Dhacdadan ayaa si weyn uga caraysiisay bulshada Soomaaliyeed, waxaana qaar kamid ah nabadoonnada iyo waxgaradka gobolka Hiiraan, ay sheegeen in dilka askariga uu abuuri karo xiisad hor leh haddii aan si degdeg ah oo sharci ah wax looga qaban. Nabadoon Cismaan Maxamuud, oo ka mid ah nabadoonnada gobolka Hiiraan, ayaa si adag uga hadlay dhacdada xilli wareysi siinayay Goobjoog, isagoo sheegay in falalka noocan ah ay dhalin karaan falcelinno iyo aargoosi kale, taasina ay khatar ku tahay nabadda iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Nabadoonka ayaa dowladda ugu baaqay inay si dhab ah u baarto dhacdada, isla markaana tallaabo adag oo sharci ah laga qaado cid kasta oo lagu helo inay ka dambeysay dilka askariga. Dilkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli horey loo soo diley askar ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo lagu dilay qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, taasoo dhalisay walaac ku saabsan amniga ciidamada marka ay ku safrayaan deegaanadaas.

items.title: Xaaladda maanta jirtaa waxay si weyn uga duwan tahay tii hore.
items.description: Markii Madaxweynihii aan dhisay uu keenay diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, xoojiyeyna awoodda difaaca cirka ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isla markaana Somaliland ay aqoonsi ka heshay dal leh awood nuclear ah oo miisaan istaraatiiji ah ku leh gobolka iyo caalamkaba, waxaan gaadhay go’aan ah in maanta Soomaalidu heshiin karto. Xaaladda maanta jirtaa waxay si weyn uga duwan tahay tii hore. Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxay si dhow ula socotaa burburka aragtiyihii siyaasadeed ee muddada dheer ku dhisnaa humaag iyo dhalanteedka. Waxa sidoo kale maanta si cad u muuqata in dhinac waliba wajahayo natiijadii ka dhalatay siyaasaddii iyo jidkii uu doortay. Sida maahmaahdu dhigto, “Nin walba ceesaantii ceel keentay.” Kuwii aaminsanaa in Somaliland lagu wiiqi karo arrinta Sool Bari, maanta waxay arkayaan Somaliland oo gaadhay aqoonsi caalami ah iyadoo Sool Bari maqan tahay. Waxay sidoo kale arkayaan siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda Somaliland oo gaadhay meeqaan sare iyo awoodda difaaca qaranka oo si joogto ah u kobcaysa, gaar ahaan awoodda difaaca cirka. Dhanka dhaqaalaha, Somaliland waxay leedahay mustaqbal rajo leh shanta sano ee soo socda, gaar ahaan marka la dhaqaajiyo heshiisyada Somaliland la leedahay Imaaraadka Carabta iyo Itoobiya, lana horumariyo isku-xidhka dhaqaale iyo ganacsi ee Berbera iyo Itoobiya, oo ay ku jiraan fursadaha waaweyn ee kaabayaasha gaadiidka iyo jidka tareenka. Waxaa taas barbar socda heshiisyada iyo fursadaha maalgashi ee dhinacyada macdanta iyo tamarta ee Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro uu hadda ka shaqaynayo intii uu ku guda jiro safarkiisa Maraykanka. Somaliland maanta waxay u gudbaysaa marxalad cusub oo ku dhisan kalsooni siyaasadeed, awood difaac, koboc dhaqaale iyo diblomaasiyad sii ballaadhanaysa. Sidaas darteed, waxaan aaminsanahay in maanta la gaadhay xilligii Soomaalidu nabad iyo heshiis ku wada noolaan lahayd, iyadoo dhinac kastaa aqbalayo xaqiiqada siyaasadeed, lana ixtiraamayo jiritaanka, xuduudaha iyo masiirka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland.     Sultan Abdikarin

items.title: US sends Somali asylum seeker to Guantánamo after ICE arrest
items.description: Minneapolis (Somalia Today) — US immigration authorities have transferred a Somali asylum seeker who was living legally in Minnesota to Guantánamo Bay, where he has been held for about two weeks despite having no criminal record, according to Minnesota Public Radio . Adam Abdullah, 31, told MPR News that immigration officials initially said they were deporting him to Somalia and that a stop in Cuba would only be for refuelling. Instead, he was taken to Camp 6, part of the US military detention complex at Guantánamo Bay. Abdullah came to the United States seeking asylum in 2023, obtained a work permit and Social Security number and worked as an auto mechanic in the Twin Cities. He also attended regular check-ins with US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, or ICE, MPR reported. Federal agents stopped his vehicle in St Paul on December 12, 2025, at the start of what the Trump administration called Operation Metro Surge . Abdullah said authorities never explained why he had been targeted. “When they come to me, and I ask them why you pulled me over, they say, ‘We are immigration, so give me your work permit,’” he told MPR. He said he then asked whether the agents had a warrant and why they had stopped him. “They say, ‘We don’t need a warrant; we are immigration, and we know you are Adam Abdullah,’” Abdullah said. MPR said a search of Minnesota court records found no criminal record for Abdullah, only two parking tickets issued in early 2025 for failing to move his vehicle during snow emergencies. Guantánamo instead of Somalia After his arrest, Abdullah spent about nine months moving through immigration detention facilities, first at the Freeborn County Jail in Albert Lea, Minnesota, then at a detention centre in Covington, Kentucky, and later in Louisiana. He said immigration officials eventually told him he would be returned to Somalia through Miami. “From Miami they say OK we go to Somalia, but first we go to Cuba for refuelling, then we go to some other countries to Somalia,” Abdullah told MPR. His wrists and ankles remained shackled during the hours-long journey, according to his account. But the flight did not continue to Somalia. Abdullah said he was instead taken to Camp 6 at Guantánamo, where he has remained for about two weeks. He said telephone access and opportunities for exercise were limited, although detainees were able to spend several hours together during the day. Abdullah told MPR that eight Somali nationals were being held at Guantánamo, including several detained in the Twin Cities. The Department of Homeland Security did not answer MPR’s questions about the total number of detainees at the base or why Abdullah had been arrested. His lawyer, Marc Prokosch, said communicating with Abdullah from the offshore facility had proved difficult. “Calls are limited to five to 10 minutes, and we don’t even know if they’re confidential,” Prokosch said. “And that’s the only way that we can communicate with our clients is through these phone calls that may or may not be under attorney-client confidentiality.” Camp 6 concerns President Donald Trump directed the defence and homeland security departments in January 2025 to expand migrant detention operations at Guantánamo . The order said the facility should provide additional detention space for what the administration described as “high-priority criminal aliens unlawfully present in the United States”. The use of Camp 6 for civil immigration detainees has drawn particular scrutiny because the facility is part of the military prison complex associated for more than two decades with terrorism suspects. Yumna Rizvi, a policy analyst at the Minnesota-based Center for Victims of Torture, said the choice of location risked blurring the distinction between immigration detention and terrorism. “This administration wants to conflate this threat of immigration with terrorism, so wants to create this idea that the individuals at Camp 6 are so terrible and so horrific,” Rizvi told MPR. Human Rights Watch raised separate concerns after interviewing 20 Venezuelan migrants transferred to Guantánamo in February 2025 and held there for between 11 and 16 days before being deported. The former detainees described unsanitary conditions, limited information about their legal situation and being confined to individual cells for as much as 23 hours a day, according to the Human Rights Watch report . Most said they had been held in Camp 6. The organisation said their accounts could amount to ill-treatment under international law, although none of the 20 people interviewed reported being physically assaulted by Guantánamo security personnel. “The US government has taken immigrants to Guantánamo and subjected them to incommunicado detention in appalling conditions,” said Juanita Goebertus, Human Rights Watch’s Americas director. Abdullah has not described all of the same conditions reported by the Venezuelan detainees. He told MPR that he could speak with other detainees for several hours during the day, but said telephone access and opportunities for exercise remained restricted. Legal challenge Civil liberties groups are challenging the government’s use of Guantánamo for immigration detention, arguing that federal law does not authorise authorities to transfer people detained inside the United States to the offshore military base simply to continue holding them there. The American Civil Liberties Union and other groups filed a federal lawsuit in June 2025 seeking to halt the practice. ACLU lawyer Lee Gelernt told MPR that detainees were not merely stopping at the base while awaiting onward flights. “The facts have shown that this is far from a refuelling stop, that people are being held there for weeks, not months, and also under horrible conditions,” he said. MPR reported that a federal judge in Washington had allowed the challenge to proceed and scheduled a hearing for October 14. The Department of Homeland Security said a recent flight to Guantánamo carried what it called some of the “worst of the worst” “criminal illegal aliens”. The department did not say that description applied to Abdullah. The post US sends Somali asylum seeker to Guantánamo after ICE arrest appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Labour picks Sagal Abdi-Wali for Starmer’s former seat
items.description: London, UK — Britain’s Labour Party has selected Somali-born politician Sagal Abdi-Wali to contest the parliamentary seat vacated by former prime minister Keir Starmer, putting the former child refugee in the race to represent one of Labour’s most prominent London constituencies. Abdi-Wali, 42, the leader of Camden Council, will stand in the Holborn and St Pancras by-election on October 8 after Labour confirmed her selection on Wednesday. “I am very happy that local members have put their trust in me to be Labour’s candidate in the area I’ve grown up in,” Abdi-Wali said. “This place welcomed my family as refugees and gave us hope when we needed it most. “I am so grateful to have had the opportunity to build a life here, serving our community as a councillor, school governor and community activist.” Abdi-Wali arrived in Britain from Somalia as a child refugee in the early 1990s and has lived in Camden for about 35 years. She was first elected to Camden Council in 2022 and later served as cabinet member responsible for housing before becoming council leader in May 2026. Camden Council said her appointment made her the borough’s first Black woman leader . Her political career has been closely tied to the constituency she now hopes to represent. She previously chaired the Holborn and St Pancras Constituency Labour Party and sought Labour’s nomination for the Barnet and Camden seat on the London Assembly in 2019. Starmer, then the local MP, backed her candidacy. Labour stronghold tested Labour has represented Holborn and St Pancras since the constituency was created in 1983, but its margin narrowed sharply at the 2024 general election. Starmer won 18,884 votes, or 48.9 per cent , giving him a majority of 11,572. Independent candidate Andrew Feinstein finished second with 18.9 per cent, while the Greens took 10.4 per cent. The Conservatives won 7.2 per cent, Reform UK 6.1 per cent and the Liberal Democrats 5.8 per cent. The Greens have since strengthened their position locally, making gains in Camden at council elections in May. Abdi-Wali narrowly retained her own Camden Square seat , winning 890 votes against 830 for the leading Green candidate. The by-election follows Starmer’s decision to leave Parliament after stepping down as prime minister earlier this year. He announced on September 1 that he was resigning as an MP, saying he wanted to focus on international affairs, including defence, security, trade and technology. “I think once you’ve been prime minister, it’s important to answer the question: what are you going to do next?” Starmer said when explaining his decision. “Having decided I’m going to concentrate on international affairs, I think it’s right to step down.” Greens choose challenger The Green Party is also preparing for a potentially significant contest in the constituency. Party leader Zack Polanski, a London Assembly member, is seeking the Green nomination but faces a challenge from Camden councillor Hamza Chowdhury . Chowdhury has sought to make local representation a central issue in the selection. “We don’t need another MP who arrives during an election campaign, puts out a few leaflets, makes a few promises and disappears once the votes are counted,” he said. Polanski rejected the criticism on Wednesday, saying he was “really proud” that the party was holding an open selection. “What’s happening is very simple — it’s a democratic, open selection,” he said. Feinstein, who finished second to Starmer in 2024, has said he will not contest the by-election again and has backed Polanski. Somali roots enter campaign Abdi-Wali’s Somali background became an issue in the campaign even before Labour formally selected her. Reform UK home affairs spokesman Zia Yusuf faced criticism after highlighting that she had been born in Somalia and asking on social media: “Do you understand what’s happening?” Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds described the remarks as “pretty straightforward racism”. Reform’s London mayoral candidate Laila Cunningham also distanced herself from Yusuf’s comments, saying Abdi-Wali was British and noting that she already led Camden Council. Abdi-Wali has instead presented her refugee experience as central to her connection with the borough. When she became council leader in May, she said Camden had given her family sanctuary and had “ shaped so much of who I am, what I stand for and what inspired my commitment to public service ”. Voters in Holborn and St Pancras will decide on October 8 whether she succeeds the former prime minister in the constituency he represented for more than a decade. The post Labour picks Sagal Abdi-Wali for Starmer’s former seat appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Iran Captures U.S. Underwater Drone as the Limits of Military Power Come into Focus
items.description: Tehran / Washington (WDN) — Iran’s Revolutionary Guard says it has seized a U.S.-made autonomous underwater vehicle near the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz, highlighting the increasingly sophisticated technological dimension of the confrontation between Tehran and Washington. Iranian state media identified the device as the Dive-LD, an autonomous underwater system developed by U.S. defense technology company Anduril. The platform is designed for seabed surveys, mine detection and maritime intelligence-gathering. Iranian forces said they captured the system near the approaches to the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world’s most strategically important waterways. The United States, however, disputed the significance of the seizure. The Pentagon said the device had malfunctioned more than a day before Iran claimed to have captured it and described it as an older system that was not carrying classified information or sensitive intelligence equipment. Anduril confirmed that one of its systems had been lost, noting that the equipment is designed to operate in dangerous environments where loss of a platform is a recognized operational risk. According to company information, the Dive-LD can operate for up to 10 days without returning to a base and is designed to reach depths of approximately 6,000 meters. The system has been reported to cost roughly $2.5 million. Technology Does Not Guarantee Victory The incident illustrates a broader reality of modern warfare: having superior technology and overwhelming military capabilities does not necessarily guarantee political or strategic victory. The United States possesses vastly greater military resources than Iran, including advanced aircraft, naval forces, intelligence systems and precision weapons. But a conflict with Iran would not simply be a contest of equipment. Iran would be fighting on and around its own territory, with a political narrative centered on national survival and resistance to foreign intervention. That creates a fundamentally different calculation. A foreign military can destroy infrastructure, strike military targets and deploy overwhelming force. But defeating a state determined to defend its territory can require far more than battlefield superiority. For Iran, the most powerful weapon may ultimately be neither a missile nor a drone, but the willingness of its population and security forces to endure the costs of war. The underlying message is simple: if the country is attacked, defend it—even at the cost of your life. That mentality can make military intervention extraordinarily difficult. A technologically superior force may win individual battles while still struggling to achieve the political objective that justified the war in the first place. History has repeatedly demonstrated the difference between winning battles and winning wars. The Strait of Hormuz Raises the Stakes The capture of the underwater system is particularly significant because of its location. The Strait of Hormuz is a critical passage for global energy supplies, making the waters surrounding it strategically important to both Iran and the international community. The increasing use of autonomous underwater systems demonstrates how modern militaries are attempting to gather intelligence and conduct dangerous missions without exposing personnel directly to hostile environments. But the loss of such a system also shows that technological advantages have limits. Iranian forces were able to identify and seize an American platform operating in waters they consider strategically vital, regardless of whether the device was lost because of a malfunction or deliberately captured. The Bigger Lesson for Washington The episode should therefore be viewed within a broader strategic question facing Washington: How much military force is enough to compel a determined state to surrender its political objectives? Deploying additional troops may increase America’s ability to strike targets and protect its forces. It does not automatically eliminate Iran’s capacity or willingness to resist. Iran’s geography, military infrastructure, regional networks and nationalist politics would make any prolonged confrontation vastly more complicated than a conventional demonstration of American military superiority. The United States may possess the stronger military. But military strength alone does not determine the outcome of a war. When a population believes it is fighting to defend its homeland, the political and human costs of intervention can rise dramatically. The captured Dive-LD may therefore be a relatively small incident in a much larger confrontation. Yet it offers a revealing glimpse of the broader challenge: advanced technology can provide military advantages, but it cannot guarantee victory against a determined nation fighting on its own ground. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo FAO oo xoojinaya iskaashiga horumarinta kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah
items.description: Rome, Talyaaniga – 9 Sebteembar 2026: Wasiirka Kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Xasan Aadan, ayaa magaalada Rome kulan heer sare ah kula yeeshay Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Cuntada iyo Beeraha ee Qaramada Midoobay (FAO), Dr. Qu Dongyu. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo FAO ee dhinacyada horumarinta kalluumeysiga, ilaalinta khayraadka badda iyo dardargelinta qorshayaasha la xiriira Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in horumarinta kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah ay ka mid yihiin mudnaanta dowladda Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay door muhiim ah ku leeyihiin Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka ee 2025–2029. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada hadlay Barnaamijka Isbeddelka Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo lagu doonayo in la isku xiro cilmi-baarista, xogta kalluumeysiga, maaraynta waarta ee khayraadka badda, maalgashiga, shaqo-abuurka, sugnaanta cuntada iyo horumarinta nolosha bulshooyinka ku nool xeebaha dalka. Mid ka mid ah qodobada muhiimka ah ee kulanka ayaa ahaa baahida loo qabo in Soomaaliya hesho xog cilmiyeed oo lagu kalsoonaan karo, si loo qiimeeyo khayraadka kalluunka iyo noocyada mudnaanta leh ee ku jira badaha Soomaaliya. Barnaamijka qiimeynta kaydka kalluunka ayaa la filayaa inuu kor u qaado awoodda dalka ee go’aaminta ruqsadaha kalluumeysiga, qoondada kalluunka la qaban karo, tallaabooyinka ilaalinta iyo maaraynta waarta ee khayraadka badda. Wadahadallada ayaa sidoo kale lagu falanqeeyay dardargelinta hirgelinta Nidaamka Maareynta Macluumaadka Kalluumeysiga (FIMS), kaas oo lagu hagaajinayo xog ururinta kalluunka la soo qabto, warbixinnada elektaroonigga ah, xogta maraakiibta iyo raadraaca wax-soo-saarka kalluumeysiga. Waxaa kale oo xoogga la saaray xoojinta wada-shaqeynta Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowlad-goboleedyada, si loo helo nidaam mideysan oo lagu maareeyo xogta iyo khayraadka kalluumeysiga. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay dagaalka ka dhanka ah kalluumeysiga sharci-darrada ah, jilaabashada aan la soo sheegin iyo kalluumeysiga aan nidaamsanayn, oo loo yaqaan IUU Fishing. Wasiirka Kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah ayaa FAO ka codsaday inay ballaariso taageerada farsamo ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dabagalka iyo kormeerka maraakiibta, fulinta shuruucda, diiwaangelinta doomaha iyo maraakiibta, baaritaannada dekedaha iyo wadaagga macluumaadka ee heer gobol. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo UNOPS oo kala saxiixday Heshiiska Dalka Martida loo yahay
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – 9 Sebteembar 2026: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Adeegyada Mashaariicda (UNOPS) ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ku kala saxiixday Heshiiska Dalka Martida loo yahay (Host Country Agreement). Heshiiska ayaa waxaa xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ku saxiixay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaam Cali. Dhinaca UNOPS, heshiiska waxaa saxiixa loogu soo bandhigay Agaasimaha UNOPS ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Ala’a Nemer, isaga oo matalaya Agaasimaha Fulinta ee UNOPS, Jorge Manuel Lopes Moreira da Silva. Heshiiskan ayaa si rasmi ah u nidaaminaya qaabka ay UNOPS uga hawlgasho Soomaaliya iyo hab-raacyada lagu maamulayo joogitaankeeda iyo shaqadeeda dalka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ayaa sheegtay in heshiisku uu ka tarjumayo sida Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay in hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay ee dalka ka shaqeeya lagu saleeyo heshiisyo iyo nidaamyo rasmi ah oo ixtiraamaya lahaanshaha iyo hoggaanka qaranka. Heshiiska cusub ayaa sidoo kale xoojinaya xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo UNOPS, iyadoo la filayo inuu fududeeyo howlaha hay’adda ee la xiriira taageerada mashaariicda iyo adeegyada ay ka fuliso Soomaaliya.

items.title: Wariye Xasan Gallaydh oo lagu xiray magaalada Gabiley
items.description: Gabiley, 9 Sebteembar — Booliska Somaliland ayaa galabnimadii maanta magaalada Gabiley ku xiray wariye Xasan Saleebaan Haaruun, oo loo yaqaanno Xasan Gallaydh. Wariyaha ayaa la qabtay isaga oo ku sugnaa xaflad qalin-jebin ah oo ka socotay Jaamacadda Timacadde. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in xarigga wariyaha uu la xiriiri karo warbixin uu dhowaan ka diyaariyey xaaladda nololeed iyo waxqabadka xukuumadda Somaliland. Warbixintaas ayaa lagu soo qaaday sicir-bararka, adeegga korontada, xaaladda caafimaadka iyo arrimo kale oo bulshada saameynaya. Warbixinta uu wariyuhu baahiyey ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay xarigga wariye Cabdiqani Baylood. Hase yeeshee, weli si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin in arrimahaas ay yihiin sababta rasmiga ah ee loo xiray Xasan Gallaydh. Xildhibaan Maxamed Abiib iyo masuul ka tirsan xisbiga KAAH ayaa dalbaday in xorriyaddooda dib loogu soo celiyo wariyeyaasha xiran. Waxay sidoo kale ku baaqeen in la dhowro xorriyadda saxaafadda iyo xaqa wariyeyaashu u leeyihiin inay tebiyaan arrimaha danaha guud. Booliska Somaliland weli kama soo saarin xarigga war-saxaafadeed ama faahfaahin rasmi ah. Sidaas darteed, lama oga eedda loo haysto wariyaha, saldhigga lagu hayo iyo haddii loo qorsheeyey in maxkamad la horgeeyo.

items.title: Axmed Shire oo si arxan darro ah loo dilay kadibna muuqaal laga duubay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa waxaa laga helayaa dhacdo argagax leh oo mar kale ka dhacday aagga deegaanka Ceelbaraf ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, kadib markii si arxan darro ah halkaas loogu dilay askari ka tirsanaa Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Askariga oo lagu magacaabi jiray Axmed Shire Xuseen ayaa waxaa loo dilay aano qabiil drteed, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo wareedyo deegaanka ah. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in maleeshiyaad hubeysan ay askariga kala dageen mooto uu la socday, xilli uu kusii jeeday Gobolka Hiiraan, kadibna ay sidaas ku toogteen. Kahor inta aan la dilin askariga, maleeshiyaadka hubeysan oo u abaabulnaa hab beeleed ayaa muuqaal ka duubay marxuumka, waxayna waydiiyeen su’aalo ku saabsan xaaladdiisa, isaga oo sheegay inuu xanuunsan yahay, isla markaana uu fasax kasoo qaatay furinta hore, gaar ahaan deegaanka Buurane ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, oo uu ka howlgalayay bilihii lasoo dhaafay. Maydka marxuumka ayaa ugu dambeyn maanta la geeyay degmada Buulo-Burde, iyadoo ehelladiisu ay sheegeen in jirkiisa uu go’go’ay, kadib markii jir-dil xooggan loo gaystay, taasoo sababtay in si dhib badan lagu aaso. Ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay dowladda Soomaaliya iyo HirShabelle oo ku aadan dhacdadan oo hadal-heyn badan ka dhalisay baraha bulshada. Waa markii labaad oo dhacdo noocaan oo kale ah ay ka dhaceyso aagga Ceelbaraf, waxayna ay ahayd dhammaadkii bishii December ee 2024-kii markii sidaan oo kale aano qabiil darteed halkaas loogu dilay 7 askari oo ka tirsanaa Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, kana yimid dhanka furimaha hore. Askartaas oo fasax kasoo qaatay goobihii ay ka howlgaleen, kuna sii jeeday ehelladooda, ayaa waxaa gaari kala degay maleeshiyaad beeleed, kuwaas oo indhaha ka xiray, muuqaalna ka duubay, kadibna toogasho ku fuliyay. items.title: Nearly 10 Soldiers Killed in Al-Shabaab Attack in Bardhere
items.description: BARDHERE— Nearly 10 soldiers were killed and several others wounded in an Al-Shabaab attack on a military training camp in Baardheere district, Gedo region, according to local reports. The attack began with artillery fire targeting a camp where newly recruited federal government forces were being trained. The shelling reportedly caused casualties among the troops at the facility. Al-Shabaab has claimed responsibility for the attack, although the reported number of casualties has not been independently verified. The Somali National Army command has yet to issue an official statement on the incident. The attack comes amid intensified military efforts against Al-Shabaab in Gedo. Somali Army Ground Forces Commander General Sahal had been in Baardheere in recent days as part of efforts to strengthen ongoing operations against the militant group in the region. Bardhere and other parts of Gedo have remained key areas of military activity as government forces seek to expand security operations against Al-Shabaab. items.title: JAAMAC oo arrimo xasaasi ah kala hadlay Mareykanka + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa galabta kulan miro-dhal ah la qaatay sii-hayaha safiirka xilka kasii degaya ee Mareykanka, Mudane Justin Davis, iyo sii-hayaha cusub ee Safaaradda Mareykanka, Marwo Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay arrimo xasaasi oo ay kamid yihiin xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga soo jireenka ah ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay is dhaafsadeen aragtiyo ku saabsan sidii loo sii wadi lahaa wada-shaqeynta labada dal. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale kulankooda kusoo qaaday arrimaha amniga, la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo iskaashiga hay’adaha sharci-dejinta ee labada waddan. Guddoomiye Jaamac oo madasha ka hadlay ayaa muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, gaar ahaan iskaashiga dhinaca baarlamaannada, is-dhaafsiga khibradaha iyo horumarinta awoodda hay’adaha dowliga ah. Sidoo kale, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa sii-hayaha safiirka xilka kasii degaya ee Mareykanka, Mudane Justin Davis, uga mahadceliyey adeeggiisii iyo kaalintii uu ka qaatay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka muddadii uu xilka hayay. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale si diirran u soo dhaweeyey sii-hayaha cusub ee safaaradda Mareykanka, Marwo Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz, isaga oo u rajeeyey in muddada ay xilka hayso ay sii ambaqaaddo dadaallada lagu horumarinayo xiriirka labada dal. Ugu dambeyn, labada dhinac ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la joogteeyo wada-hadallada iyo wada-shaqeynta u dhexeysa Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, iyadoo la eegayo danaha labada dhinac iyo xoojinta xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah. Kulanka ayaa kusoo dhammaaday is-afgarad ku aaddan sii wadidda iskaashiga Muqdisho iyo Washington, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray muhiimadda ay leedahay iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo xiriirka baarlamaannada. Si kastaba, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa muujisay sida ay uga go’an tahay in xiriirka labada dal loo sii horumariyo, laguna saleeyo iskaashi iyo danaha labada dhinac. items.title: Speaking for the Voiceless
items.description: Dr . Abdurahman Baadiyow I am a mother, over eighty years old, living in Mogadishu. The house they demolished was not merely a building; it was the home where I was born, where I grew up, where I lived, and where I carried the memories of my entire life. Every wall held a memory. Every corner belonged to a chapter of my life. It was my home, my history, my identity, and my refuge. I have all the documents proving that it belongs to me. Yet one night, at midnight, they knocked on my door. Imagine an elderly woman, alone and vulnerable, facing such a moment in the darkness of night, with nothing but her weakness and the documents in her hands. They told me, “ You must vacate this house. ” I asked them, “ Why ? This is my home. I was born here. I have all the documents proving that it belongs to me .” But my words fell on deaf ears, and my documents were treated as though they meant nothing. Even my age, my vulnerability, and the fact that I was an elderly woman offered me no protection. I refused to leave the home that had sheltered me for a lifetime. Then came the threat: “ If you insist, we will demolish it .” And they did. They demolished the house where I was born, the place that had carried the memories of an entire lifetime. Perhaps they saw only walls and a piece of land. They did not see what I saw. They did not see my childhood, my memories, my tears, my joys, and the years of my life contained within those walls. They did not understand that when you destroy an elderly woman’s home, you do not simply destroy a building; you tear away a piece of her life, her memory, her security, and her dignity. But the tragedy did not end with the destruction of my home. What came next was even more painful. I was told that if I wanted my land after destruction back, I would have to buy it again. I asked, “ How much ?” They answered, “ Fifteen thousand dollars .” Fifteen thousand dollars, for the land of my destroyed home where I was born, the home I say is already mine, and for which I possess documents proving my ownership. Think about the cruelty of that moment: an elderly woman being told to buy back what she believes she already owns. Imagine what that does to the heart of an eighty-year-old mother. I had already lost my home, and now I was being told that I needed money to reclaim it. So I ask myself: Where do I go? Should I go to the courts? But where are the courts? To whom can I complain? Who will listen to me? Who will protect me? I am over eighty years old. I am sick. I am alone. I have neither the strength, nor the influence, nor the money to confront those who possess power. I have nothing but my documents and my voice. Yet even my documents could not protect me, and even my voice seemed to have nowhere to go. Then I realized something even more painful than losing my home: I am voiceless. Not because I cannot speak, but because I do not know where to take my voice. I do not know which door to knock on, which institution will hear me, or which authority will stand beside me. What does it mean to be a citizen if you do not know where to turn when your rights are violated? What does the rule of law mean if the vulnerable cannot reach it? What does the state mean if an eighty-year-old woman in Mogadishu cannot find a single door to knock on in search of justice? We spend years talking about politics, presidents, elections, federalism, power-sharing, positions, and ministries. We fight over who governs, who controls power, and who occupies which office. But perhaps we have forgotten the most important question: What does the state mean to the ordinary citizen who has no power? Perhaps we have been asking the wrong question all along. The true test of a state is not who sits in the presidential palace, nor how many ministries and institutions it has. The true test is whether an elderly woman standing alone before injustice can find someone to protect her. We speak endlessly about institution-building, as though institutions were simply buildings, offices, stamps, titles, and government signs. But an institution has no meaning if it cannot protect a human being. A court that the vulnerable cannot reach is nothing more than a building. A law that cannot restrain the powerful is nothing more than words written on paper. A government that cannot protect the rights of its citizens has failed in its most basic duty. Institutions must exist for people, not for those who possess influence, wealth, or power. Our political elites and government must confront a truth that can no longer be avoided: we cannot continue building political systems around the question, “ Who gets power ?”, while refusing to ask the far more important question, “ How is that power used ?” We cannot speak endlessly about democracy, political representation, reconciliation, and state-building while ordinary citizens have nowhere to turn when they are wronged. We cannot celebrate elections, political agreements, and the distribution of government positions while an elderly citizen does not even know where to submit a complaint. And we cannot honestly claim to build a state while leaving the vulnerable to confront the powerful alone. State-building without justice is not state-building; it is simply the construction of power. And so, when every human door appears closed, this elderly mother is left with only one door to knock on: the door of Allah. She raises her trembling hands and says: “ O Allah, You see what is happening to me. You know my pain. You know that this was my home. You know that I was born there. You know that I have the documents proving my right. When no one listens to me, You listen. When no one protects me, You are my Protector. I have nowhere left to go. To You I turn. From You I seek help. To You I bring my grievance, and from You I ask for justice.” What could be more heartbreaking than an elderly citizen having nowhere to turn except to Allah ? The deepest tragedy is not simply that her house was demolished. It is that a woman who has lived more than eighty years in Mogadishu cannot identify an institution that she believes will hear her and protect her rights. And her story is not hers alone. It is the story of thousands who have no money, no influence, no political connections, and no powerful person willing to speak for them. They are hundreds of thousands who have been displaced recently in Mogadishu. They are citizens, but they are powerless. They have rights but cannot enforce them. They have voices, but no one listens. They are voiceless. We speak not because we know every detail of this case, nor because we have already decided, in legal terms, who is right and who is wrong. We speak because the principle is greater than any single dispute: every citizen deserves access to a fair, accessible, and impartial institution where they can seek justice when they believe their rights have been violated. This is not a favor. It is not charity. It is not a privilege reserved for those who have money or connections. It is a fundamental right of citizenship. So what kind of state do we want to build? A state in which the powerful can take what they want while the vulnerable are left with nothing but prayer? Or a state in which an eighty-year-old woman can stand before an institution and say, “ This is my home. These are my documents. I am asking for justice .” And someone answers her: “ Mother, we hear you. We will listen to you. We will protect your rights. ” That is the state we should build. That is the justice we should demand. But if a citizen eventually finds no door to knock on except the door of Allah, then we must stop and ask ourselves the questions we would rather avoid: What have we done to our state? What have we done to justice? And what remains of the meaning of citizenship? This mother is voiceless, but we must not become people without conscience. Her home may have been demolished, but her dignity must not be demolished with it. She may be weak before those who possess power, but her weakness must never become a justification for denying her justice. Let us speak for those who have no voice. Let us stand beside the vulnerable. Let us demand a state in which the law stands above power, justice stands above influence, and human dignity stands above every political calculation. For when the vulnerable are abandoned, they do not merely lose their voice; society itself loses its voice. When justice becomes inaccessible to the weak, the state loses its moral meaning. And when justice becomes a privilege available only to the powerful, citizenship itself becomes an empty word. We must speak for the voiceless, not because they are powerful enough to reward us, but because they are human beings deserving of justice. We must speak truth to power. We must speak it to the Mayor of Mogadishu, to the government, to the courts, to public officials, and to the President of the Republic. We must speak, not with hatred, not with personal revenge, and not for political gain, but because justice demands that the powerful be held accountable for how power is exercised. Dr. Abdurahman Baadiyow Email: abdurahmanba@yahoo.com ———- Dr. Abdurahman Baadiyow is a Professor of Modern Islamic History and a Senior Adviser for the Somali President on Peace and Reconciliation. items.title: Wasiir Cali Xoosh oo jawaab kulul siiyay madaxweyne DENI
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh) oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa si adag ugu jawaabay madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullahi Deni oo jeediyay khudbad xasaasi ah oo uu kaga hadlay khilaafka kala dhexeeya Villa Somalia. Saciid Deni ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in meesha laga saaray dastuurkii heshiiska lagu wadaa ahaa, isla markaana Puntland ay u dhaqmeyso si madax bannaan. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in cid aan ahayn Puntland aysan ka shaqeyn karin maamulkaasi, isla markaana mas’uuliyiinta kasoo jeeda Puntland ee ku jira Dowladda Federaalka ay yihiin dad shaqo tegay, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Soomaaliya Ilaahey xaalkeeda ha sahlo wixii heshiiska lagu ahaa waa la laalay dowladda Puntland-na waxay go’aan qaadatay inay dastuurkeeda iyo dowladnimadeeda iyadu ay maamulan doonto. Taas waxay keeneysaa cid aan Puntland ahayn awood uma leh dalkan inay ka shaqeyso,” ayuu yiri Deni. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray “Dadka shaqo tegay ee aan haysan sifo sharci ah oo mas’uuliyadeed yaysan dadka reer Puntland qasin”. Intaas kadib waxaa soo jawaabay wasiir Cali Xoosh oo kasoo jeedo Puntland, kaas oo ayaan darro ku tilmaamay hadalka kasoo yeeray Saciid Deni, wuxuuna xusay in arrintan muujineyso faham darro ka haysato nidaamka federaalka iyo dowladnimada. “Waa ayaan daro weyn in qof hogaan ka haya qeyb kamid ah dalka, soona noqdey wasiir iyo xildhibaan heer federaal, una tartamey hogaanka dalka, hadana leh damac siyaasadeed oo heer federaal uu bulshada lasoo hor istaago hadal oranaya masuuliyiinta reer Puntland ee xilalka ka haya heer federaal ‘Waa dad Shaqo Tagey’. Kelmadaasi waxay muujineysaa fahamdaro masuulkaas ka haysata hanaanka dowladnimada iyo nidaamka federaalka ee dalka. Waana kelmado dhaawac ku ah wadajirka iyo dareenka dowladnimada ee ka dhexeysa bulshada Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu qoraalkiisa ku yiri wasiirku. Cali Xoosh ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in arrintan aysan Deni la qabin dadka reer Puntland, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay ku suntan yihiin Soomaalinimo, isla markaana door taariikhi ah ku leeyihiin dowladnimada dalka. “Adigoo sidaas hoos ugu dhigaya kaalintii bulshada reer Puntland, isla markaana dhaawacaya dareenkii dowladnimo ee ka dhexeeyey bulshada Soomaaliyeed, hadana waxaa rabtaa in aad beri Soomaali hor timaado adigoo ka dalbanaya xil qaran. Waa maan guracan iyo garasho jaan,” ayuu raaciyay. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu Deni ku eedeeyay inay hadalladiisa ka muuqato Soomaali-nacayb, isla markaana lagu xasuusan doono “Waxa keliya oo Soomaali kugu xasuusan doonto ayaa ah abuurista naceyb, kala-qeybin, u adeegidda danaha dalal shisheeye iyo aragtiyo wiiqaya wadajirka iyo dowladnimada dalka”. items.title: Carro xoogan oo ka dhalatay askari Xoogga Dalka oo lagu dilay Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe
items.description: Askarigan oo ka tirsanaa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa si xun loogu dilay duleedka Degmada Ceelbaraf ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, gaar ahaan meel ku dhow xadka uu gobolkaasi la wadaago Gobolka Hiiraan. Askarigan iyo laba askari oo kale oo socday ayaa waxaa gaarigii ay saarnaayeen kala degay maleeshiyaad hubeysan, iyagoo ku sii jeeday Degmada Buuloburde ee Gobolka Hiiraan. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in maleeshiyadu ay sii deysay labadii askari ee kale, isla-markaana ay la hareen askarigan oo qura, kaas oo mar dambe ay u dileen aano qabiil. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in meydka askarigan oo si xun loo dilay in manta la geeyay Degmada Jalalaqsi ee Gobolka Hiiraan. Ka hor inta aanu soo bixin warka geeridiisa, maleeshiyada ayaa ka duubtay muuqaal uu ugu sheegayo in uu xanuunsanayo oo uu gaajeysan yahay, muqaalkaas oo si weyn looga daawaday baraha bulshada. Warar aan la xaqiijin ayaa sheegay in saddexda askari ay ka mid ahaayeen Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee difaaca ku leh Degmada Raage Ceelle ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe, isla-markaana ay soo qaateen fasax ay ku booqanayaan qoysaskooda. Askariga la dilay oo lagu magacabayay Axmed Shire Xuseen ayaa waxaa soo baxaya warar sheegaya in uu dhowr cisho u xirnaa maleeshiyada, ka hor inta aysan dilin. 26-kii bishii December ee sanadkii 2024 ayay ahayd, markii lix askari oo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ah gaarigii ay la socdeen looga la degay duleedka Degmada Ceelbaraf, loona dilay aano qabiil. Askartan oo fasax sharci ah ka haystay taliskooda ayaa xilligaasi ku sii jeeday Magaalada Beledweyne ee Xarunta Gobolka Hiiraan. Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa 2-dii bishii January ee sanadkii 2025 soo saartay amar lagu soo xirayo 14 eedeysane oo lala xiriiriyay dilka askartaasi. Carro xoog leh ayaa ka dhalatay dilka Axmed Shire, iyadoona la eegayo tallaabada ay qaadi doonaan Dowladda Federaalka, Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka.

items.title: More Federal Troops Head to Baidoa as Laftagareen Forces Resist Government Offensive
items.description: Baidoa (WDN) — The Federal Government is reportedly preparing to deploy additional troops to Baydhaba as fighting and political tensions intensify between forces backing South West State President Sheikh Aden Mohamed Nur (Aden Madobe) and fighters loyal to former South West President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. People familiar with the situation say the planned deployment follows a telephone conversation between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Aden Madobe focused on the deteriorating security situation around Baidoa and the activities of opposition forces. According to the sources, Hassan Sheikh has instructed the Somali National Army command to reinforce federal troops already stationed in and around the city and prepare an operation aimed at pushing opposition forces farther from positions used to organize attacks. The reported plan comes after repeated clashes around Baidoa, including a major attack on September 3 that was repelled by federal and South West forces. Aden Madobe has repeatedly accused Laftagareen-aligned forces of threatening his administration. On August 22, he also accused former government officials of establishing links with Al-Shabaab, although no independent evidence supporting those allegations has been publicly presented. The administration later called for the political dispute to be resolved through dialogue rather than fighting. This new development comes amid reports of ongoing dialogue between Laftagareen and Villa Somalia. More Troops, Same Problem The planned reinforcement raises a larger question: can additional federal troops actually resolve a conflict that is rooted in a deeply contested struggle over the political future of South West State? The Federal Government has repeatedly relied on military deployments to strengthen its position in Baidoa. Yet the continued ability of Laftagareen-aligned forces to operate around the city and launch attacks demonstrates the limits of a purely military response. These fighters are operating on familiar local terrain and presenting their campaign as a struggle to “liberate” South West State from what they portray as outside or federal control. Whether that political narrative reflects the views of the wider population remains contested, but it provides the opposition with a powerful mobilizing message. That creates a fundamental military and political problem for Mogadishu. A government can send more troops into a city, but defeating locally rooted armed forces requires more than numbers. It requires political legitimacy, local support, intelligence, sustainable logistics and a credible settlement that addresses the grievances driving the conflict. A Conflict That Cannot Be Solved by Force Alone The latest deployment could therefore intensify rather than resolve the confrontation. If federal and South West forces launch a new offensive, Laftagareen’s supporters may retreat from exposed positions while continuing to operate from surrounding areas. Repeated military campaigns could produce a cycle of attack, withdrawal and redeployment without addressing the underlying political dispute. The central question remains unresolved: who has the legitimate authority to govern South West State, and who gets to determine that legitimacy? Until that question is addressed through an inclusive political process, every new troop deployment risks becoming another temporary military solution to a fundamentally political crisis. Baidoa may soon see more soldiers, more checkpoints and more military operations. But after months of confrontation, the evidence suggests that more troops alone may not be enough to defeat a locally rooted opposition determined to keep fighting on its own ground. items.title: Wariye Hassan Gallaydh oo lagu xiray Hargeysa + Sababta
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Booliska Maamulka Somaliland ayaa maanta xiray wariye Xasan Saleebaan Haaruun oo loo yaqaano (Xasan Gallaydh), xilli uu ku sugnaa xafladda qalin jebinta Jaamacadda Timacadde ee magaalada Gebiley. Xasan Gallaydh oo caan ka ah deegaannada Somaliland ayaa loo haystaa warbixin uu dhowaan qoray, taas oo uu diiradda ku saaray arrimaha nolosha sida sicir bararka, laydhka, caafimaadka, iyo shaqada xukuumadda. Sidoo kale, wuxuu isla warbixintaas kaga hadlay xarigga loo gaystay wariye Cabdiqani Baylood oo uu ku baaqay in si deg-deg ah loo sii daayo. Dhanka kale, Falcelin xooggan ayaa ka dhalatay xarigga lagula kacay Hassan Gallaydh, waxaana cambaareeyay mas’uuliyiin iyo xisbiyada Somaliland. “Xadhigga noocan ah, ceeb iyo qiimo la’aan wax aan ahayn xukuumaduhu kama qaadan.. Waxaan ku baaqayaa in wariye Hassan Gallaydh iyo suxufiyiinta kale ba xoriyaddooda loo soo celiyo. Xadhiggina macquul maahee meesha maala rogayaa!” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Maxamed Abiib oo ka tirsan Golaha Wakiilada Somaliland. Dhankiisa, Gudoomiyaha garabka dhallinyarada heer qaran ee Xisbiga Kaah Dr Nimcaan ayaa isaguna qoraal uu soo saaray ku dhaliilay xukuumadda Cirro, wuxuuna sheegay inay caada ka dhigatay xarigga wariyeyaasha Somaliland. “Xukuumadda Xisbiga WADDANI waxay ku curatay caadana ka dhigtay xadhigga suxufiyiinta madaxbannaan, waxayna xabsiga u taxaabtay tiradii ugu badnayd ee suxufiyiina.Tani waa cabudhin iyo carjuuqdhed aan la aqbali karin,” ayuu isna yiri Dr Nimcaan. Si kastaba ha’ahaatee, Hassan Gallaydh ayaa noqonaya wariyhii 47-aad ee ay xirto xukuumadda Somaliland, iyada oo sidoo kale Wariye Baylood uu muddo laba todobaad ah si xaq-darro ah ugu xiran yahay waraysi uu qaaday. items.title: Galkacyo Mourns Elder Shot Dead on His Way to Prayer
items.description: Galkacyo (WDN) — Grief and shock have spread across Galkacyo following the killing of respected community elder and businessman Ahmed Yusuf Haameey, who was reportedly shot dead while making his way to a mosque for the Maghrib prayer. The elder was on his way to perform his evening prayers when armed men reportedly opened fire on him, striking him multiple times before fleeing the scene. He never reached the mosque. His death has left his family, friends and members of the community mourning the loss of a man known for his role as a traditional elder and his place within the Puntland community in Galkacyo. No suspects have been officially arrested, and the identities of those responsible remain unknown. The circumstances surrounding the killing have deepened the sadness and anxiety in the city. Preliminary reports have suggested that the attack may have been connected to a clan-related dispute or revenge, but authorities have not confirmed the motive or established who ordered or carried out the killing. Security forces have launched an investigation, seeking to identify the attackers and determine why Ahmed Yusuf Haameey was targeted. His killing comes against the backdrop of previous violence in Gaalkacyo linked to community disputes and clan tensions. Such killings often leave wounds that extend far beyond the immediate victim, placing entire families and communities under the shadow of fear, grief and the threat of retaliation. For those who knew him, the circumstances of Ahmed Yusuf Haameey’s death make the tragedy even more painful: a man heading to a place of prayer was met with violence instead of peace. His family is now left to mourn a life abruptly taken, while the community faces the painful question of how another elder could be killed in a city that has already endured too many cycles of violence. Authorities must now ensure that the investigation is thorough and that those responsible are brought to justice. At the same time, community leaders and residents are being urged to reject revenge and prevent grief from becoming another source of bloodshed. Ahmed Yusuf Haameey cannot be brought back. But his death must not become the reason another family receives the same terrible news. For Galkacyo, tonight is a time of mourning—not revenge. The community’s hope must be that justice will speak where violence has taken another life. WardheerNews The post Galkacyo Mourns Elder Shot Dead on His Way to Prayer appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Al-Shabaab Launches Early-Morning Assault on Government Base in Baardheere
items.description: Baardheere (WDN) — Al-Shabaab fighters launched a heavy early-morning assault on a Somali government military base in Baardheere on Wednesday, triggering mortar fire and a subsequent ground battle that residents say is still being heard across the town. Local sources said the attack began with several mortar rounds directed at the government forces’ position before Al-Shabaab fighters reportedly moved into a direct exchange of gunfire with Somali troops. Residents said sustained gunfire could be heard from different parts of Baardheere as the two sides engaged, raising fears of further escalation and possible casualties. The extent of the fighting and whether either side has gained or lost ground remained unclear as of the latest reports. There were no immediate, independently verified reports of casualties. The flow of information has been severely hampered by a communications outage in the area. Local sources said telephone and other communication services were not functioning, making it difficult to establish what is happening around the military base or verify reports from the frontline. It was not immediately clear whether the communications disruption was linked to the attack or had begun before the fighting. The assault comes as Al-Shabaab continues to demonstrate its ability to strike government and security positions in southern Somalia despite ongoing military operations by Somali forces and their international partners. Baardheere is strategically important in Gedo because of its location and its role as a government-held urban center surrounded by areas where Al-Shabaab maintains a significant presence. The latest attack underscores the continuing challenge facing Somali forces as they attempt to hold territory and protect population centers in areas where Al-Shabaab retains the capacity to launch coordinated attacks. Authorities have yet to issue a detailed account of the assault, including casualty figures, the intensity of the fighting or the current security situation inside the town. The situation remains fluid, with residents awaiting the restoration of communications and official information on whether the attack has been repelled and what damage may have been caused. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Shirka Kuuriya iyo Afrika ku Soo Bandhigtay Himiladeeda Dhaqaalaha Dijitaalka ah
items.description: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Biixi Imaan Cige, ayaa maanta khudbad muhiim ah ka jeediyay Shirka 8-aad ee Kuuriya iyo Afrika, kaas oo ka dhacay magaalada Seoul ee caasimadda Koonfur Kuuriya. Shirka sanadkan ayaa hal-ku-dhig looga dhigay “Ka Faa’iidaysiga Garaadka Macmalka ah (AI) iyadoo loo adeegsanayo horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha si loo dardargeliyo isbeddelka Afrika.” Madasha ayaa waxaa ka qeyb galay Wasiirrada Maaliyadda ee dalal badan oo Afrika ah, iyadoo diiradda lagu saaray sidii tiknoolajiyadda casriga ah, gaar ahaan Garaadka Macmalka ah, looga faa’iideysan lahaa horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo kaabeyaasha dalalka Afrika. Wasiir Biixi Imaan Cige ayaa sheegay in ay muhiim tahay in hamiga Afrika uusan ku koobnaan oo keliya qaadashada tiknoolajiyadda AI, balse loo baahan yahay in si wadajir ah loo dhiso kaabeyaasha muhiimka u ah kobaca dhaqaalaha. Waxa uu tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay horumarinta tamarta, shabakadaha fiber-optic-ka, xogta iyo awood dhaqaale oo ku dhisan isla-xisaabtan, kuwaas oo door weyn ka qaadan kara dardargelinta horumarka iyo kobaca dhaqaalaha Afrika. Wasiirka Maaliyadda ayaa sidoo kale xusay in Soomaaliya, oo ku taalla goob istiraatiiji ah, ay leedahay dhaqaale dijitaal ah oo si xawli ah u kobcaya, isla markaana dalka uu haatan haysto fursado uu ugu noqon karo albaab dijitaal ah oo Afrika u furma. Mudane Biixi Imaan Cige ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda is-dhexgalka gobolka, isagoo xusay doorka Madasha Iskaashiga Geeska Afrika (HoAI) ee lagu horumarin karo iskaashiga dhaqaale iyo isku-xirka dalalka Geeska Afrika. Shirka Kuuriya iyo Afrika ee sanadkan ayaa sidoo kale lagu xusayaa 20 sano guuradii kasoo wareegtay markii la aasaasay madashan sanadkii 2006-dii. Madasha KOAFEC ayaa muddo labaatan sano ah noqotay goob muhiim ah oo lagu xoojiyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee u dhexeeya Koonfur Kuuriya iyo dalalka Afrika, iyadoo isu keenta dowladaha, ganacsatada iyo hay’adaha horumarinta dhaqaalaha. Kulamada madashan ayaa ujeedkoodu yahay in dhinacyadu is dhaafsadaan fikrado, dhistaan iskaashi iyo xiriir dhaqaale, isla markaana ay wada raadiyaan fursado cusub oo horseedi kara horumar iyo kobac dhaqaale oo waara.

items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed oo Saxiixay Qorshaha Isbeddelka 2026–2031
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa maanta ka qeyb galay munaasabadda dib-u-daahfurka Qorshaha Isbeddelka maamulka Koonfur Galbeed (STP 2026–2031), kaas oo dib-u-eegis lagu sameeyay. Munaasabadda ayaa lagu soo bandhigay qorshaha cusub ee qeexaya jihada iyo mudnaanta Koonfur Galbeed ee shanta sano ee soo socota. Qorshahan ayaa xoogga saaraya horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, kobcinta dhaqaalaha, xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda iyo dardargelinta mashaariicda horumarineed. Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa sheegay in Qorshaha Isbeddelka ee 2026–2031 uu yahay hannaan muhiim ah oo lagu xaqiijinayo himilooyinka Koonfur Galbeed iyo horumar waara oo ka jawaaba baahiyaha shacabka. Waxa uu sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in qorshayaasha horumarineed lagu saleeyo baahiyaha dhabta ah ee bulshada, isla markaana la xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta dowladda, bulshada rayidka ah, hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay, bah-wadaagta horumarinta iyo dhammaan dhinacyada ku lugta leh hirgelinta qorshaha. Qorshaha STP 2026–2031 ayaa mudnaan siinaya xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda iyo maamulka wanaagsan, horumarinta waxbarashada iyo caafimaadka, kobcinta fursadaha dhaqaale iyo shaqo-abuurka, horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, iyo xoojinta adkeysiga bulshada si looga jawaabo caqabadaha bani’aadannimo iyo isbeddelka cimilada. Munaasabadda, oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Qorsheynta maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, ayaa waxaa ka qeyb galay xubno ka tirsan Golaha Wasiirrada, xildhibaanno, Agaasimaha Madaxtooyada, Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Baay, Guddoomiyaha Degmada Baydhabo, lataliyeyaal iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Ugu dambeyn, Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa si rasmi ah u saxiixay Qorshaha Isbeddelka Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ee 2026–2031.

items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka ah Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa shir muhiim ah la qaatay Guddiga Sare iyo Maamulka Akadeemiyadda Qaran ee Hoggaaminta (NLA), kaas oo ka shaqeeya horumarinta arrimaha hoggaaminta Soomaaliya. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa, ayaa maamulka iyo guddigan ka dhagaystay warbixin la xiriirta halka ay marayaan hawlaha NLA , waxayna guddiga soo bandhigeen in la dhammaystiray xarumihii uu ku hawlgali lahaa akadeemiyadd , la dajiyay manhajkiisa, islamarkaasna xarumo iyo jaamacado waaweyn oo caalami ah la gaareen heshiisyo isfaham ah. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa mas’uuliyiinta ku bogaadiyay shaqada baaxadda leh ee ay ka qabteen akadeemiyadda , isaga oo sheegay in uu ku soo aadday markii loogu baahi badnaa: “Waa in aan helnaa xarumo waxbarasho oo wax-ka-badel dhab ah ku sameeya nolosha dadka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo sare u qaada wacyiga qofka, badela hab fakarka qaldan, soona saara qof leh tayo hoggaamineed oo danta dalka iyo dadka ku qotanta” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaaraha oo la hadlayay xubnana uu la kulmay. Ugu dambayn, waxa uu Ra’iisul Wasaaraha XJFS kula dardaarmay xubnaha ka socda Guddiga Sare iyo Maamulka Akadeemiyadda Hoggaaminta Qaran ee (NLA) in ay la yimaadaan fikir wax looga beddelayo hab-dhaqannada bulshada ragaadiyey, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin musuqmaasuqa iyo qabyaaladda.

items.title: Congress Should Embrace Somaliland as Conservation Leader, Not Just
items.description: Somaliland’s Government Ensures That Its Fauna Remains Among the Most Diverse and Healthiest in the Horn of Africa   Somaliland’s government has embraced cheetah conservation, rescuing cubs from smugglers. Shutterstock President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi “Irro” arrived in Washington on September 5, 2026, the start of a nearly three-week visit to meet with U.S. policymakers and world leaders at the United Nations General Assembly, speak at think tanks, and meet with the Somaliland diaspora in the United States.     For the past 35 years, [Somaliland] has governed itself as an independent country with its own flag, currency, financial system, legal code, visas and passports.   Somaliland—a former British protectorate in the Horn of Africa—was independent for only five days in 1960 before an ill-fated merger with its Italian counterpart to form Somalia. In 1991, against after Somalia’s dictator waged genocide against Somaliland’s dominant Isaaq clan and as Mogadishu descended into famine and chaos, Somaliland decided it had enough and reasserted its independence. For the past 35 years, it has governed itself as an independent country with its own flag, currency, financial system, legal code, visas and passports. While Somalia continues to avoid one-man, one-vote elections, Somaliland has had eight, including one determined by 80 votes out of more than 400,000 cast. While Americans debate voter ID laws, Somaliland became the first to secure voter registration with biometric iris scans. It is home to multibillion-dollar telecom and mobile money companies, a Coca-Cola bottling franchise , and one of Africa’s prime deep-water ports .Republicans have rallied to Somaliland’s cause. In 2023, they successfully promoted Somaliland in the 2023 National Defense Authorization Act, requiring a reluctant State Department to report on relations with the would-be state. Republicans cheered first Taiwan’s outreach to Somaliland and then, on December 26, 2025, Israel’s formal recognition . Progressives, however, have been less enthusiastic for four reasons: Too many saw Somaliland as a Republican project ; they deferred to Democratic Rep. Ilhan Omar of Minnesota, who comes from a rival clan to the Isaaqs; Israel’s lone recognition and false rumors that Somaliland would host displaced Gazans antagonized pro-Palestinian leaders; and the Democrats’ platform and agenda did not prioritize the military and security arguments made for U.S. recognition. Beyond general progressivism and efforts to promote women’s empowerment, however, Democrats should have much to embrace in Somaliland’s environmentalism and conservation efforts in which, alongside Namibia and Rwanda, it has come to lead the continent. Importantly, it does so on principle and without significant tourism income or foreign aid. While critics sometimes argue that Somaliland is just a secessionist project of the United Arab Emirates, Shukri Haji Ismail Bandare, the former minister of the environment and climate change, frequently overrode Emirati pressure to release poachers and wildlife smugglers. Successive Somaliland administrations have embraced cheetah conservation especially, rescuing cubs from smugglers and dedicating thousands of acres in a new facility to rehabilitate the cat officially designated as vulnerable, the category directly below endangered. In a recent visit to the cheetah conservation area, an hour’s drive outside the capital Hargeisa, I saw multiple groups of cheetahs and met some of the veterinarians—including Americans—doing regular blood draws, scat sampling, and other medical procedures to ensure Somaliland’s fauna remains among the most diverse and healthiest in the Horn of Africa. Republicans can see in Somaliland a beachhead against extremism and Chinese encroachment; Democrats should see a beacon of democracy and environmentalism. I spoke to Irro, former President Musa Bihi, and other officials who unite on a vision to build a national park in the Horn of Africa to rival those in the Serengeti and southern Africa. The difference between drought and famine rests less on nature than on government capacity. Somaliland survives drought without famine because its democratic government protects aquifers and has cracked down on the climate-ravaging charcoal trade, from which Somalia profits by burning bushes and trees for profit even as desertification expands. The strongest U.S. foreign policy is always bipartisan. During the era of President Ronald Reagan and House Speaker Thomas “Tip” O’Neill Jr., the two leaders from different partisan polls did not always share motives and emphasizes, but they cooperated, nonetheless. Republicans can see in Somaliland a beachhead against extremism and Chinese encroachment; Democrats should see a beacon of democracy and environmentalism. Neither should look at Somaliland only through the lens of Israel-Palestinian politics or other agendas. Together, Somaliland could be the issue in which all Americans can once again find common ground. Michael Rubin Michael Rubin specializes in Iran, Turkey and the Horn of Africa. His career includes time as a Pentagon official, with field experiences in Iran, Yemen, and Iraq, as well as engagements with the Taliban prior to 9/11. Mr. Rubin has also contributed to military education, teaching U.S. Navy and Marine units about regional conflicts and terrorism. His scholarly work includes several key publications, such as “Dancing with the Devil” and “Eternal Iran.” Rubin earned his Ph.D. and M.A. in history and a B.S. in biology from Yale University.   Middle East Forum

items.title: Somalia prepares fresh troop deployment to Baidoa for operation against opposition forces
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s federal government is preparing to deploy fresh troops to Baidoa, the seat of power of Southwest State, to join an operation aimed at pushing back opposition forces stationed on the outskirts of the strategic town. The planned deployment follows a telephone conversation between Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Southwest State’s current leader, Adan Mohamed Nur, widely known as Adan Madobe. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has ordered the Somali National Army to carry out an operation aimed at driving the battle zone away from Baidoa and stabilizing the town, which opposition forces have attacked multiple times over the past three weeks. Adan Madobe is understood to be deeply concerned about the presence of forces loyal to ousted regional president Abdiasis Mohamed Hassan Laftagaren on the outskirts of Baidoa, from where they have continued to launch attacks inside the town on a weekly basis. Last week, the opposition forces entered Baidoa in an early morning attack that killed multiple people, including a regional commander, before withdrawing. Videos circulating from the town showed it transformed into a battle zone – a marked shift for a town that had enjoyed relative peace under Laftagaren before he was toppled in a federal military offensive in late March. That offensive followed a long-running political dispute between federal authorities in Mogadishu and some of the country’s regional states. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Safiirka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya oo ka tegaya Muqdisho kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa maanta kulan sagootin ah la yeeshay Safiirka Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Alper Aktaş. Safiirka ayaa booqasho sagootin ah ku tagay xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda kaddib markii uu soo gaba-gabeeyay muddadii uu Soomaaliya uga soo shaqeynayay diblomaasiyad ahaan. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga qotada dheer ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada-hadleen muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka labada dal. Wasiir Cabdisalaan Dhaay ayaa bogaadiyay dadaalkii iyo adeegii diblomaasiyadeed ee Safiir Alper Aktaş muddadii uu xilka ka hayay Soomaaliya. items.title: Booqashadda Madaxweyne Cirro ee Washington iyo Rejadda Cusub ee Aqoonsiga Somaliland ee Maraykanka”
items.description: Warbaahinta Beirut Wire, oo fadhigeedu yahay magaalada Beirut ee dalka Lubnaan, ayaa warbixin ay daabacday ku sheegtay in Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Dr. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), uu booqasho taariikhi ah ku joogo magaalada Washington ee dalka Maraykanka. Warbixintu waxay safarka Madaxweynaha ku tilmaantay mid ka mid ah safarrada diblomaasiyadeed ee ugu muhiimsan uguna miisaanka culus ee la xidhiidha dadaallada Somaliland ugu jirto ballaadhinta aqoonsigeeda caalamiga ah, isla markaana lagu dardargelinayo xoojinta iyo horumarinta xidhiidhada caalamka. Sidoo kale, warbixinta Beirut Wireoo uu soo xigtay Wargeyska Dawan, ayaa lagu sheegay in booqashada Madaxweynaha Somaliland ay ku soo beegmayso xilli qadiyadda madaxbannaanida Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay mar kale si weyn uga dhex muuqanayso fagaarayaasha waaweyn ee dunida, doodaha siyaasadeed iyo istiraatiijiyadeed ee caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan kuwa la xidhiidha mustaqbalka juqraafi-siyaasadeed ee Geeska Afrika. Sidaa darteedna, marka loo eego muhiimadda iyo duruufaha ku xeeran arrimahaas, ay booqashadani xambaarsan tahay muhiimad weyn oo ku aaddan jihaynta iyo horumarinta siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Somaliland, iyadoo sidoo kalena gacan ka geysan karta xoojinta kaalinta iyo doorka Somaliland ee arrimaha istiraatiijiga ah ee Geeska Afrika iyo guud ahaan gobolka Badda Cas. Sida lagu sheegay warbixintan Beirut Wire, booqashada Madaxweynaha Somaliland waxay xoogga saaraysaa xoojinta iyo horumarina iskaashigaga labada dal, iyadoo arrinta aqoonsiga Somaliland ee dawladda Maraykanku ay tahay mid ka mid ah yoolalka ugu muhiimsan ee safarkan. Warbixintu waxa kale oo ay tilmaantay in Madaxweynaha Somaliland iyo weftiga uu hoggaaminayaa ay diiradda saarayaan xoojinta xidhiidhka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, horumarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo dhaqaalaha, soo jiidashada maalgashiga, iyo dardargelinta dadaallada Somaliland ugu jirto ballaadhinta aqoonsigeeda caalamiga ah. Warbaahintu waxay sidoo kale xustay muhiimadda juqraafiyeed iyo doorka istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland, gaar ahaan goobta ay kaga taallo Gacanka Cadmeed. Warbixintu waxay iftiimisay in Somaliland ay leedahay xeeb dheer oo muhiimad weyn u leh amniga, ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta caalamiga ah, taas oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab el-Mandeb. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale carrabka ku adkaysay muhiimadda Dekedda Berbera iyo kaabayaasha kale ee istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland, xilli amniga iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga Badda Cas ay si weyn uga dhex muuqdaan siyaasadda iyo danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee caalamka. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, qodobada muhiimka ah ee Somaliland u soo bandhigayso Washington waxa ka mid ah awoodda iyo muhiimadda istiraatiijiga ah ee Dekedda Berbera iyo kaabayaasha kale ee ku xeeran. Xili Dekedda iyo goobaha kale ee istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland ay Maraykanka siin karaan fursado dheeraad ah oo la xidhiidha sugidda ammaanka maraakiibta ganacsiga, la socodka xaaladaha amni ee Badda Cas iyo ka hortagga khataraha amni ee ka iman kara gobolka. Waxa kale oo warbixintu xustay in iskaashi amni iyo dhaqaale oo qoto dheer oo dhex mara Somaliland iyo Maraykanka uu mustaqbalka horseedi karo taageero siyaasadeed oo sii xoogaysata, taas oo qayb ka noqon karta horumarinta dadaallada Somaliland ugu jirto helitaanka aqoonsi diblomaasiyadeed oo buuxa. Waxa kale oo warbixintu xustay in iskaashi amni iyo dhaqaale oo qoto dheer oo dhex mara Somaliland iyo Maraykanka uu mustaqbalka horseedi karo taageero siyaasadeed oo sii xoogaysata, taas oo qayb ka noqon karta horumarinta dadaallada Somaliland ugu jirto helitaanka aqoonsi diblomaasiyadeed oo buuxa. Warbixintu waxay tilmaantay in doodda Somaliland ee ku wajahan Washington aanay ku koobnayn oo keliya arrimaha siyaasadda iyo dimuqraadiyadda, balse ay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay goobta istiraatiijiga ah ee ay Somaliland ku taallo. Waxay intaas ku dartay in muhiimadda goobtan ay sii kordhayso iyadoo ay jiraan khataro amni oo la xidhiidha isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga, xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee ka jira gobolka iyo tartanka sii xoogaysanaya ee u dhexeeya quwadaha caalamiga ah. Arrimahaasina ay Somaliland ka dhigayaan goob muhiim u ah amniga iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Sidoo kale waxa lagu xusay warbixinta in Madaxweynaha ay weheliyaan xubno sare oo ka tirsan xukuumadda Somaliland, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan masuuliyiin u qaabilsan arrimaha dibadda, gaashaandhigga iyo duulista iyo sidoo kale la-taliyeyaal dhinacyada dhaqaalaha iyo siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda. ah Beirut Wire waxay tilmaantay in booqashada Madaxweynaha Somaliland ay tahay dadaal diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in Washington lagu qanciyo muhiimadda istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland u leedahay danaha Maraykanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo ilaalinta danaha gobolka. Sida ay ku warrantay Beirut Wire, ajandaha booqashada weftiga Madaxweynaha Somaliland wuxuu ku salaysan yahay afar qodob oo waaweyn, kuwaas oo kala ah: xoojinta xidhiidhka siyaasadeed ee Somaliland iyo Washington, ballaadhinta iskaashiga dhinaca amniga, soo jiidashada maalgashiga Maraykanka iyo horumarinta dadaallada Somaliland ee ku aaddan helitaanka aqoonsi caalami ah. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in la filayo in Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) iyo weftigiisu ay kulamo la yeeshaan xubno ka tirsan Aqalka Wakiillada iyo Senate-ka Maraykanka, siyaasiyiin, ganacsato iyo xubno ka tirsan qurba-joogta Somaliland. Beirut Wire waxay xustay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, oo dib ula soo noqotay madaxbannaanideedii sannadkii 1991, ay tan iyo xilligaas dhisatay hay’ado dowladeed, ciidamo amni, lacag iyo nidaam siyaasadeed oo u gaar ah. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale xustay in xaaladda diblomaasiyadeed ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay isbeddel weyn samaysay dabayaaqadii sannadkii 2025, kaddib markii dawladda Israel ay noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland. Sida warbixintu sheegtay, Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ayaa sidoo kale booqasho rasmi ah ku tagay dalka Israel, halkaas oo Somaliland ka hirgelisay xidhiidho diblomaasiyadeed oo rasmi ah, taas oo sare u qaaday dadaallada Hargeysa ugu jirto ballaadhinta aqoonsiga caalamiga ah iyo xoojinta xidhiidhada ay la leedahay dalalka dunida.

items.title: NIRA iyo NADRA Pakistan oo xoojinaya iskaashiga aqoonsiga dhijitaalka ah
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa wafdi u dirtay dalka Pakistan si ay uga faa’iideystaan khibradda dalkaas ee dhinaca aqoonsiga dijitaalka ah (Digital ID) iyo dhismaha kaabayaasha tiknoolajiyadda ee taageera adeegyada dowladda ee internet-ka. Wafdiga Soomaaliya waxaa hoggaaminaya Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Aqoonsiga iyo Diiwaangelinta Qaranka (NIRA), Cabdiwali Cali Cabdulle Timacadde, kuwaas oo maalmahan kulamo la yeeshay hay’adaha Pakistan ee ka shaqeeya nidaamyada dijitaalka ah iyo horumarinta tiknoolajiyadda. Booqashada wafdiga ayaa waxaa fududeysay Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Horumarinta ee UNDP, iyadoo wafdigu uu kulamo la yeeshay Wasaaradda Tiknoolajiyadda Warfaafinta iyo Isgaarsiinta Pakistan, Guddiga Qaranka ee Tiknoolajiyadda Warfaafinta iyo hay’ado kale. items.title: Walaac adag oo laga muujiyay iska horimaadyada ka socda Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Wasiir hore Maxamed Aadan Ibraahim Fargeeti, ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujiyey dagaallada iyo iska horimaadyada ka socda deegaanno ka tirsan Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya Koonfur Galbeed. Fargeeti ayaa sheegay in xasillooni waarta aan lagu gaari karin dagaal iyo iska horimaad, balse loo baahan yahay in dhinacyada ay khuseyso ay u istaagaan sidii loo heli lahaa xal siyaasadeed oo ku dhisan wada-hadal, isu-tanaasul iyo dib-u-heshiisiin. “Waxaan si weyn uga walaacsanahay dagaallada iyo iska horimaadyada ka socda KGS. Xasillooni waarta laguma gaari karo dagaal, balse waxay u baahan tahay wada-hadal, isu-tanaasul iyo dib-u-heshiisiin,” ayuu yiri Fargeeti. Wasiirka hore ayaa ugu baaqay dhinacyada isku haya xaaladda Koonfur Galbeed inay mudnaanta siiyaan nabadda iyo danta shacabka, isaga oo xusay in xal waara lagu gaari karo oo keliya wada-xaajood iyo is-faham siyaasadeed. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee Koonfur Galbeed ay walaac ka abuurtay shacabka iyo dhinacyada siyaasadda, iyadoo baaqyo kala duwan loo jeedinayo dhinacyada ay khuseyso inay ka fogaadaan colaadda, isla markaana ay miiska wada-hadalka isugu yimaadaan. items.title: FAO iyo SoDMA Ka Wada Hadlay U Diyaargarowga Fatahaadaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho, 9 Sebteembar — Wakiilka Hay’adda Cuntada iyo Beeraha Qaramada Midoobay (FAO), Etienne Peterschmitt, ayaa Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Qaranka (SoDMA), Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle, kala hadlay xaaladda bani’aadannimo iyo khatarta ka dhalan karta roobabka iyo fatahaadaha Soomaaliya. FAO ayaa kulanka xoogga ku saartay u diyaargarowga fatahaadaha iyo sidii loo ilaalin lahaa bulshooyinka, beeraha iyo ilaha nololeed ee ku teedsan webiyada Jubba iyo Shabeelle. Wadahadallada waxaa mudnaan gaar ah lagu siiyey xoojinta difaacyada webiyada iyo xiridda meelaha jilicsan ee ay biyuhu ka soo fatahi karaan, gaar ahaan deegaannada gobolka Hiiraan ee uu guddoomiyaha SoDMA dhowaan kormeeray. FAO iyo SoDMA ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga, digniinaha hore iyo tallaabooyinka ka hortagga ah, si loo yareeyo khasaaraha bani’aadannimo iyo waxyeellada soo gaari karta wax-soo-saarka beeraha. Hase yeeshee, kulanka laguma shaacin maalgelin cusub, qandaraas lagu dayactirayo jiinka webiyada ama digniin daadgureyn ah oo loo jeediyey bulshada ku nool goobaha khatarta ku jira.
