items.title: Cali Xoosh oo ka badbaaday mooshinkii xilka looga tuurayay – Sidee wax u dhaceen?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la laalay mooshinkii ay xildhibaanno qaar ku dalbanayeen xil-ka-qaadista Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Xukuumadda Soomaaliya, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh). Go’aanka guddoonka ayaa yimid kadib markii la hubiyay saxiixyada xildhibaannada ku lifaaqnaa qoraalka soo jeedinta, taas oo loo gudbiyay Golaha Shacabka si loo bilaabo hannaanka mooshinka ka dhanka ah wasiirka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in baaritaanka lagu sameeyay saxiixyada uu muujiyay in qaar ka mid ah xildhibaannada magacyadooda iyo saxiixyadooda lagu daray soo jeedinta ay caddeeyeen inaysan wax lug ah ku lahayn qoraalkaas. Guddoomiye Jaamac ayaa xusay in arrintaasi ay sababtay in soo jeedintu aysan buuxin shuruudihii looga baahnaa si ay golaha uga sii gudubto, sidaas darteedna guddoonku uu go’aan ka gaaray in la laalo. Waxa uu tilmaamay in qodobka 75-aad ee xeer-hoosaadka Golaha Shacabka uu qeexayo habraaca soo jeedimaha noocan ah, isla markaana uu farayo in soo jeedintu noqoto mid qoraal ah oo ay saxiixaan tirada xildhibaannada uu xeerku dhigayo. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xeer-hoosaadku siinayo guddoonka golaha awood uu ku soo celin karo ama ku laali karo soo jeedin aan waafaqsanayn habraacyada iyo shuruudaha uu dhigayo xeerku. Jaamac ayaa caddeeyay in go’aanka lagu laalay soo jeedintan uusan meesha ka saarayn xaqa dastuuriga ah ee xildhibaannada, isagoo sheegay inay mar kale soo gudbin karaan soo jeedin ku saabsan la-xisaabtanka xukuumadda, haddii ay buuxiso shuruudaha dastuurka iyo xeer-hoosaadka Golaha Shacabka. Mooshinka la laalay ee xildhibaanno qaar ka gudbiyeen Wasiir Cali Xoosh ayaa yimid kadib markii wasiirka loo jeediyay eedeymo waaweyn, kuwaas oo ay kamid yihiin inuu gabay waajibaadkii loo igmaday, gaar ahaan fulinta hawlaha wasaaradda, iyo inuu ka gaabiyay wax ka qabashada colaadaha sokeeye ee ka jira gudaha dalka. Xildhibaannadii gudbiyay ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay wasiirka inuu si joogto ah uga horyimaado nidaamka federaalka iyo awood-qaybsiga u dhexeeya dowladda dhexe iyo dowlad-goboleedyada dalka. items.title: Qarax miino oo Beledweyne ku dilay hal qof, laba kalena dhaawacay
items.description: BELEDWEYNE (Goobjoog News) — Ugu yaraan hal qof ayaa ku dhintay, laba kalena way ku dhaawacmeen kaddib markii miino dhulka lagu aasay ay saaka oo Arbaco ah ku qaraxday goob dhisme oo ku taalla xaafadda Buundo Weyn ee magaalada Beledweyne, xarunta gobolka Hiiraan. Dhacdada ayaa la sheegay inay timid xilli shaqaalaha dhismaha ay ku guda-jireen dejinta iyo hagaajinta qalabka howsha, waxaana goobta si degdeg ah uga dhashay khasaare soo gaaray dadkii goobta ku sugnaa. Ciidamada ammaanka ee dowladda federaalka iyo kuwa booliska deegaanka ayaa gaaray goobta uu falku ka dhacay, iyagoo bilaabay hawlgallo baaritaan ah si loo ogaado nuuca qaraxa iyo ciddii halkaas ku aastay miinada. Ilaa hadda ma jirto koox si rasmi ah u sheegatay mas’uuliyadda qaraxan ka dhacay magaalada Beledweyne, waxaana la filayaa in laamaha amnigu ay faahfaahin ka bixiyaan xogta rasmiga ah ee ku xeeran dhacdada.

items.title: AFRICOM oo xaqiijisay duqayn 4-tii Sebteembar lagu qaaday Al-Shabaab
items.description: Taliska Ciidamada Mareykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM) ayaa xaqiijiyey inuu 4-tii Sebteembar duqayn cirka ah ku qaaday Al-Shabaab. Duqaynta ayaa lagu fuliyey iskaashi lala yeeshay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, sida lagu sheegay bayaan rasmi ah oo talisku soo saaray. AFRICOM ayaa sheegtay in weerarku ka dhacay goob qiyaastii 175 kiiloomitir dhinaca galbeed kaga beegan magaalada Muqdisho. Taliska Mareykanka ma shaacin magaca deegaanka la duqeeyey iyo bartilmaameedka gaarka ah ee weerarka lagu qaaday. Bayaanka ayaa lagu sheegay in hawlgalkan looga gol lahaa in lagu wiiqo awoodda Al-Shabaab ee qorshaynta iyo fulinta weerarrada halista ku ah Soomaaliya, ciidamada Mareykanka iyo danahooda gobolka. AFRICOM ayaa sidoo kale ku celisay inay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso dowladda Soomaaliya. Taliska Mareykanka ma bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan khasaaraha ka dhashay duqaynta, oo ay ku jiraan tirada xubnaha Al-Shabaab ee lagu dilay ama lagu dhaawacay. Sidoo kale, lama shaacin haddii ay jiraan dad rayid ah oo waxyeello ka soo gaartay weerarka. Faahfaahinta ku saabsan nooca diyaaradaha ama hubka loo adeegsaday hawlgalkan ayaan lagu darin bayaanka. AFRICOM ayaa inta badan sheegta inay xaddiddo macluumaadka hawlgallada si loo ilaaliyo amniga ciidamada iyo hababka lagu fuliyo weerarrada. Mareykanka ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyey kordhiyey duqaymaha uu Soomaaliya kaga taageerayo ciidamada dowladda ee dagaalka kula jira Al-Shabaab. Si kastaba, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya weli kama aysan soo saarin faahfaahin dheeraad ah duqayntan iyo natiijada ka dhalatay.

Taliska Mareykanka ma shaacin magaca deegaanka la duqeeyey iyo bartilmaameedka gaarka ah ee weerarka lagu qaaday. Bayaanka ayaa lagu sheegay in hawlgalkan looga gol lahaa in lagu wiiqo awoodda Al-Shabaab ee qorshaynta iyo fulinta weerarrada halista ku ah Soomaaliya, ciidamada Mareykanka iyo danahooda gobolka. AFRICOM ayaa sidoo kale ku celisay inay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso dowladda Soomaaliya. Taliska Mareykanka ma bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan khasaaraha ka dhashay duqaynta, oo ay ku jiraan tirada xubnaha Al-Shabaab ee lagu dilay ama lagu dhaawacay. Sidoo kale, lama shaacin haddii ay jiraan dad rayid ah oo waxyeello ka soo gaartay weerarka. Faahfaahinta ku saabsan nooca diyaaradaha ama hubka loo adeegsaday hawlgalkan ayaan lagu darin bayaanka. AFRICOM ayaa inta badan sheegta inay xaddiddo macluumaadka hawlgallada si loo ilaaliyo amniga ciidamada iyo hababka lagu fuliyo weerarrada. Mareykanka ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyey kordhiyey duqaymaha uu Soomaaliya kaga taageerayo ciidamada dowladda ee dagaalka kula jira Al-Shabaab. Si kastaba, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya weli kama aysan soo saarin faahfaahin dheeraad ah duqayntan iyo natiijada ka dhalatay.

items.title: Meydadka Dagaalyahanno Al-Shabaab ah oo Laga Helay Xeebaha Galbeedka Yemen
items.description: CADAN (Goobjoog News) — Ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee loo yaqaanno National Resistance Forces (NRF) ayaa shaaciyay in meydadka dagaalyahanno Soomaali ah oo ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab laga dhex helay maleeshiyaad Xuutiyiin ah oo lagu dilay dagaallo culus oo ka dhacay deegaannada dhaca xeebaha galbeedka dalkaas. Warbixinnada laga helay saraakiisha NRF ayaa lagu sheegay in dukumentiyo, waraaqo, iyo agab laga helay goobta ay yaalleen meydadka ay muujinayaan in raggaasi ay xiriir toos ah la lahaayeen Al-Shabaab, isla markaana ay qayb ka ahaayeen dagaallada ay Xuutiyiintu kaga soo horjeedaan ciidamada dowladda Yemen. Haddii arrintan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyo, waxay noqonaysaa caddayntii ugu horreysay ee muujinaysa in iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada kooxood uu gaaray heerkii ugu sarreeyay, kaas oo ah ka-qaybgal toos ah oo dagaal oo ka tallaabay xuduudaha Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xogta ku saabsan aqoonsiga rasmiga ah ee raggan iyo ka tirsanaantooda Al-Shabaab ayaa weli ku kooban sheegashada ciidamada NRF, iyadoo aan ilaa hadda la shaacin tirada dhabta ah ee meydadka, magacyadooda, ama sawirrada dukumentiyada la sheegay in la qabtay. items.title: Dad Soomaali ah oo ayaga oo dagaalamaya lagu dilay dalka…
items.description: Cadan (Caasimada Online) — Ciidamada Yemen ee ka soo horjeeda Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in meydadka dagaalyahanno Soomaali ah oo ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab laga dhex helay xubno ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta oo lagu dilay dagaallo ka dhacay xeebaha galbeedka Yemen, arrin sii xoojineysa walaaca laga qabo xiriirka sii kobcaya ee labada kooxood. Ciidamada National Resistance Forces (NRF) ayaa sheegay in warqado aqoonsi iyo agab laga helay meydadka ay ku xaqiijiyeen in raggaasi ka tirsanaayeen Al-Shabaab, sida uu qoray wargeyska The National . NRF ayaa ku doodday in joogitaanka dagaalyahanno Al-Shabaab ah oo ka barbar dagaallamaya Xuutiyiinta uu muujinayo heer cusub oo iskaashi ah oo u dhexeeya kooxda Yemen ee taageerada ka hesha Iran iyo kooxaha hubeysan ee ka jira Geeska Afrika. Sheegashadan waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli xog badan oo bilihii lasoo dhaafay soo baxday ay tilmaamayso in Xuutiyiinta iyo Al-Shabaab ay sameysteen xiriir dhinacyada hubka, tababarka iyo tahriibinta ah oo isaga gudba Gacanka Cadmeed. Warbixin uu bishii August soo saaray machadka Century Foundation ayaa sheegtay in Xuutiyiintu ay ballaariyeen shabakado hub iyo tahriibin ah oo gaara Soomaaliya, Sudan iyo dalal kale oo ku yaalla hareeraha Badda Cas. Warbixinta ayaa xiriirka Al-Shabaab ku tilmaantay mid ka mid ah tusaalooyinka ugu cad ee muujinaya sida Xuutiyiintu ay uga gudbayaan doorkoodii koox hubeysan oo Yemen ku kooban, una raadinayaan xiriirro cusub oo ka baxsan dalkaas. Xiriir billowday 2024 Century Foundation ayaa sheegtay in Al-Shabaab ay horraantii 2024 furtay waddooyin xiriir oo ay la yeelato Xuutiyiinta, iyadoo daneyneysay hubka lidka diyaaradaha iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Sababta ugu weyn ee arrintaas ku riixeysay Al-Shabaab, sida warbixintu sheegtay, waxay ahayd nuglaanta kooxda ee weerarrada cirka ee Mareykanka iyo kuwa kale, iyo awoodda sii kordheysa ee dowladda Soomaaliya ee adeegsiga diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in kulan ay saraakiil labada dhinac ah ku yeesheen Sanca bishii March 2024, iyadoo wada-hadallo dambe lagu falanqeeyey helitaanka iyo adeegsiga diyaaradaha qarxa ee aan duuliyaha lahayn. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in saraakiil Xuutiyiin ah ay u safreen Soomaaliya si ay Al-Shabaab ugu tababaraan samaynta walxaha qarxa, wax-ka-beddelka diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo dayactirka hubka. Mid ka mid ah xogaha ugu faahfaahsan ee warbixinta Century Foundation ayaa ku saabsan Axmed Cilmi Samatar, oo ay sheegtay in ciidamada ammaanka Yemen ay ku qabteen magaalada Mukalla dabayaaqadii 2024. Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay in Samatar uu qirtay inuu ahaa xiriiriye u dhexeeya Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta, isla markaana uu fududeeyey safarro ay Soomaali ugu tageen deegaannada Xuutiyiintu maamulaan si ay u helaan tababar militari iyo mid fikir. Sida warbixintu sheegtay, Samatar wuxuu sheegay inuu fududeeyey safarka tiro gaareysa ilaa 400 oo Soomaali ah oo tababar loogu qaaday Yemen, sidoo kalena uu gacan ka geystay safarro ay injineerro Xuutiyiin ah ku tageen Jilib, oo ah xarunta ugu weyn ee Al-Shabaab ee koonfurta Soomaaliya. Hase yeeshee, Century Foundation waxay sidoo kale xustay in caddeymaha ku saabsan qaybo kala duwan oo xiriirkaas ah aysan isku heer ahayn, isla markaana weli ay yar yihiin caddeymaha muujinaya in Xuutiyiintu Al-Shabaab siiyeen hubka casriga ah ee kooxda Soomaalidu raadineyso. Machadku wuxuu sheegay in ilaa hadda aysan jirin caddeyn xooggan oo muujineysa in Al-Shabaab ay heshay gantaallada lidka diyaaradaha ama nidaamyada casriga ah ee diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ay Xuutiyiintu adeegsadaan. Dagaalka Yemen oo xoogeystay NRF waxaa hoggaamiya Jeneraal Tariq Saleh, oo ay qaraabo yihiin madaxweynihii hore ee Yemen Cali Cabdalla Saleh, waxayna kamid tahay xoogagga ka soo horjeeda Xuutiyiinta ee taageersan dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay. Dagaallada Yemen ayaa toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay mar kale xoogaystay, gaar ahaan xeebaha galbeedka, kadib sannado ay colaadda u dhexeysa Xuutiyiinta iyo ciidamada dowladda yara degganeyd. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa bishii August ka digtay in Yemen ay wajahayso khatartii ugu weynayd ee dib loogu laaban karo dagaal baaxad leh tan iyo xabbad-joojintii Qaramada Midoobay garwadeen ka ahayd ee April 2022. Xiisadda ayaa sii korortay Talaadadii, markii Xuutiyiintu weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ah ku qaadeen magaalooyin ku yaalla koonfurta Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo dhaawacay tobannaan qof, isla markaana bartilmaameedsaday xarumo tamar. Soo bixitaanka sheegashada ah in dagaalyahanno Al-Shabaab ah lagu dilay iyagoo safka Xuutiyiinta ku jira ayaa kordhineysa calaamad cusub xiriirka labada kooxood. Haddii joogitaanka dagaalyahannada la xaqiijiyo, waxay ka dhigan tahay in xiriirka muddo lagu tilmaamay hub, tahriibin iyo tababar uu gaaray heer dagaalyahanno Soomaali ah ay si toos ah uga qeyb qaadanayaan dagaalka Yemen — taas oo ah horumar ka weyn xiriirradii hore ee laga soo wariyey labada dhinac. items.title: Puntland Authorities Hunt Suspects in Killing of Gaalkacyo Businessman
items.description: GAALKACYO,— Security forces in Somalia’s Puntland state are searching for suspects accused of killing businessman Ahmed Yusuf Haamey, who was shot dead in the city of Gaalkacyo, according to an initial statement from Puntland authorities. Puntland security officials appealed for calm following the killing, warning residents against retaliation or any actions that could further threaten public security. Authorities also cautioned against targeting individuals or communities based solely on allegations that they may be linked to the suspects. Officials urged the victim’s relatives and supporters to allow security agencies to investigate the case and bring those responsible to justice. Puntland authorities said the perpetrators would be pursued wherever they went and vowed to arrest them and bring them before a court. The killing is reportedly linked to a clan-related dispute, although authorities have not provided further details about the circumstances surrounding the incident or identified any suspects. People who knew Haamey described him as a respected and peace-loving businessman who was known for helping people in need and supporting efforts to promote peace within the community. The incident has raised concerns over possible retaliatory violence in Gaalkacyo. Security authorities have urged residents to remain calm and avoid actions that could escalate tensions while investigations continue. items.title: Muxuu Xamza kala hadlay guddiga sare ee Akadeemiyadda Hoggaaminta Qaran? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta kulan gaar ah la qaatay Guddiga Sare iyo Maamulka Akadeemiyadda Qaran ee Hoggaaminta (NLA), kaas oo ka shaqeeya horumarinta arrimaha hoggaaminta Soomaaliya. Ugu horreyn Xamza ayaa maamulka iyo guddigan ka dhagaystay warbixin la xiriirta halka ay marayaan hawlaha NLA , waxayna xubnaha guddiga soo bandhigeen in la dhammaystiray xarumihii uu ku hawlgali lahaa akadeemiyadd, la dajiyay manhajkiisa, isla markaasna xarumo iyo jaamacado waaweyn oo caalami ah la gaareen heshiisyo isfaham ah. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa mas’uuliyiinta ku bogaadiyay shaqada baaxadda leh ee ay ka qabteen akadeemiyadda , isaga oo sheegay in uu ku soo aadday xilli aad loogu baahi badnaa. Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday inay muhiim tahay in sare loo qaado adeegga waxbarashada dalka, si sare loogu qaado tayada ardeyda Soomaaliyeed ee kasoo baxaya iskuulada iyo jaamacadaha dalka. “Waa in aan helnaa xarumo waxbarasho oo wax-ka-badel dhab ah ku sameeya nolosha dadka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo sare u qaada wacyiga qofka, badela hab fakarka qaldan, soona saara qof leh tayo hoggaamineed oo danta dalka iyo dadka ku qotanta” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaaraha oo la hadlayay xubnana uu la kulmay. Waxaa kale oo uu kula dardaarmay xubnaha ka socda Guddiga Sare iyo Maamulka Akadeemiyadda Hoggaaminta Qaran ee (NLA) in ay la yimaadaan fikir wax looga beddelayo hab-dhaqannada bulshada ragaadiyey, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin musuqmaasuqa iyo qabyaaladda. Kulanka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha iyo Guddiga Sare iyo maamulka Akadeemiyadda Hoggaaminta Qaran ayaa kusoo dhammaaday is-afgarad ku aaddan dardargelinta howlaha Akadeemiyadda iyo xaqiijinta qorshayaasheeda. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa haatan muhiimad gaar ah siinaysa dhismaha hay’ado tayo leh iyo soo saarista hoggaan cusub oo ku shaqeeya aqoon, hufnaan iyo masuuliyad qaran. Si kastaba, Akadeemiyadda Hoggaaminta Qaran ayaa la filayaa inay noqoto mid kaalin muuqata ka qaadata dhisidda hoggaan Soomaaliyeed oo mideeya bulshada, ilaaliya danta qaranka, isla markaana horseeda horumar iyo dowladnimo waarta. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa mas’uuliyiinta ku bogaadiyay shaqada baaxadda leh ee ay ka qabteen akadeemiyadda , isaga oo sheegay in uu ku soo aadday xilli aad loogu baahi badnaa. Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday inay muhiim tahay in sare loo qaado adeegga waxbarashada dalka, si sare loogu qaado tayada ardeyda Soomaaliyeed ee kasoo baxaya iskuulada iyo jaamacadaha dalka. “Waa in aan helnaa xarumo waxbarasho oo wax-ka-badel dhab ah ku sameeya nolosha dadka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo sare u qaada wacyiga qofka, badela hab fakarka qaldan, soona saara qof leh tayo hoggaamineed oo danta dalka iyo dadka ku qotanta” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaaraha oo la hadlayay xubnana uu la kulmay. Waxaa kale oo uu kula dardaarmay xubnaha ka socda Guddiga Sare iyo Maamulka Akadeemiyadda Hoggaaminta Qaran ee (NLA) in ay la yimaadaan fikir wax looga beddelayo hab-dhaqannada bulshada ragaadiyey, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin musuqmaasuqa iyo qabyaaladda. Kulanka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha iyo Guddiga Sare iyo maamulka Akadeemiyadda Hoggaaminta Qaran ayaa kusoo dhammaaday is-afgarad ku aaddan dardargelinta howlaha Akadeemiyadda iyo xaqiijinta qorshayaasheeda. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa haatan muhiimad gaar ah siinaysa dhismaha hay’ado tayo leh iyo soo saarista hoggaan cusub oo ku shaqeeya aqoon, hufnaan iyo masuuliyad qaran. Si kastaba, Akadeemiyadda Hoggaaminta Qaran ayaa la filayaa inay noqoto mid kaalin muuqata ka qaadata dhisidda hoggaan Soomaaliyeed oo mideeya bulshada, ilaaliya danta qaranka, isla markaana horseeda horumar iyo dowladnimo waarta. items.title: Golaha Aqalka Sare oo maanta cod aqlabiyad leh ku ansixiyay sharciga…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta cod aqlabiyad leh ku ansixiyay hindise-sharciyeedka la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo ka-hortagga afduubka. Hindise-sharciyeedkan ayaa ka mid ah xeerarka muhiimka ah ee lagu xoojinayo dadaallada Soomaaliya ee ka dhanka ah burcad-badeedda iyo afduubka, gaar ahaan dambiyada ka dhaca xeebaha iyo gudaha dalka. Kulanka Golaha Aqalka Sare ayaa lagu soo bandhigay qodobbada hindise-sharciga, kaddibna waxaa loo gudbay codeynta ansixintiisa, iyadoo xubnaha Golaha ay aqlabiyad ku meel-mariyeen. Ansixinta hindise-sharcigan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo amniga badda iyo ilaalinta xeebaha, xilli kooxaha burcad-badeedda Soomaalida ay muddooyinkii dambe kordhiyeen afduubka maraakiibta. Hindise-sharcigu ayaa sidoo kale wuxuu diiradda saarayaa ka-hortagga afduubka iyo sidii loo heli lahaa hannaan sharci oo wax looga qaban karo falalka noocan ah, iyadoo la xoojinayo awoodda hay’adaha ay khuseyso. Golaha Aqalka Sare ayaa muddooyinkii dambe ka shaqeynayay ansixinta iyo dib-u-eegista sharciyo kala duwan oo la xiriira maamulka, amniga iyo xoojinta hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, ansixinta hindise-sharciyeedkan ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo lagu dhammaystirayo hannaanka sharci ee lagula tacaalayo dambiyada la xiriira burcad-badeedda iyo afduubka, iyadoo la qeexayo mas’uuliyadaha iyo habraacyada khuseeya arrimahaas. items.title: Magaalada Muqdisho oo lagu qabtay kulan looga hadlayo dowladnimada iyo nabad-dhisidda Soomaaliya
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku qabatay madal wadahadal ah oo looga hadlayay doorka shacabka ee maamulka dalka, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo nabad-dhisidda. Kulanka oo loo bixiyay Madasha Wada-hadalka Jiilasha ee Nabad-dhisidda iyo Dowladnimada ayaa waxaa soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta, waxaana ka qeyb galay dhalinyaro, haween, wakiillo ka socda bulshada, ururrada bulshada rayidka ah iyo mas’uuliyiin dowladeed. Madashan ayaa fursad u siisay qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada inay si toos ah ula falgalaan hay’adaha dowladda, su’aalo ka weydiiyaan habka ay u shaqeeyaan hay’adaha dowliga ah, isla markaana soo bandhigaan caqabadaha hortaagan ka qeybgalka shacabka ee go’aan-qaadashada. Qodobada muhiimka ah ee diiradda lagu saaray waxaa ka mid ah dib-u-heshiisiinta, nidaamka federaalka, dowladnimada heer deegaan, helitaanka adeegyada iyo hay’adaha dowladda iyo fursadaha hoggaamineed , iyadoo si gaar ah loo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in haweenka, dhalinyarada iyo bulshada laga tirada badan yahay ay helaan fursado ay kaga qeyb qaataan dowlad-dhiska. Wadahadalladan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo nidaamka federaalka, dib loogu dhisayo kalsoonida shacabka iyo hay’adaha dowladda, iyo in laga gudbo saameynta tobannaan sano oo ay dalka ka jireen colaado iyo xasillooni-darro siyaasadeed. Ka qeybgalayaasha ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay baahida loo qabo in hay’adaha dowladdu aysan ku koobnaan oo keliya dhismaha xarumo iyo nidaamyo maamul, balse ay noqdaan kuwo si fudud loo heli karo, dadka dhageysta, isla markaana si dhab ah uga jawaaba baahiyaha bulshada . Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha ayaa sheegtay in talooyinka iyo waayo-aragnimada laga soo bandhigo madasha loo rogi doono talooyin wax-ku-ool ah oo ka caawin kara dowladda qorshayaasha la xiriira nabad-dhisidda, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo dowladnimo loo dhan yahay. Madashu waxay sidoo kale muhiimad gaar ah siisay xoojinta xiriirka u dhexeeya jiilasha kala duwan, bulshada iyo hay’adaha dowladda, iyadoo dadka ka qeybgalaya loo oggolaaday inay si toos ah uga qeyb qaataan doodaha ku saabsan mustaqbalka siyaasadeed iyo bulsho ee Soomaaliya. Ujeeddada guud ee kulanka ayaa ah in la abuuro hannaan ay qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada ku dareemaan inay cod ku leeyihiin go’aannada dalka, taas oo dowladda u aragto arrin muhiim u ah xoojinta nabadda, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya.

items.title: Maxaa looga hadlay kulanka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya iyo  Safiirka Turkiga ?
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali, ayaa maanta xarunta Wasaaradda ku qaabilay Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Alper Aktaş, oo u yimid booqasho sagootin ah kaddib markii uu soo gaba-gabeeyay muddadii uu Soomaaliya uga soo shaqeynayay diblomaasiyad ahaan. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xiriirka dhow ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, iyo iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada kala duwan. Wasiir Cabdisalaam Cali ayaa uga mahadceliyay Safiirka Aktaş shaqadii uu ka qabtay Soomaaliya iyo kaalintii uu ka qaatay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga intii uu xilka hayay. Wasiirku wuxuu sidoo kale adkeeyay xiriirka walaaltinimo ee labada dal, isagoo tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo iskaashiga labada dhinac. Dhankiisa, Safiirka Alper Aktaş ayaa soo gaba-gabeynaya waajibaadkiisii diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo kulankan uu qeyb ka ahaa munaasabadaha sagootinta ee loo sameynayo ka hor inta uusan u gudbin mas’uuliyado kale oo diblomaasiyadeed. Ugu dambeyn, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa Safiirka Turkiga u rajeeyay guul iyo horumar xilalka iyo waajibaadka uu mustaqbalka qaban doono. Kulankan ayaa mar kale muujinaya xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah iyo midka walaaltinimo ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga , oo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay iskaashigoodu ku fiday dhinacyo badan oo ay ka mid yihiin horumarinta, amniga iyo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed.

items.title: Dagaal khasaare gaystay oo ka dhacay Degmada Baardheere
items.description: Dagaalkan ayaa daba socday hoobiyeyaal ay saaka maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ku soo tuureen Degmada Baardheere ee Gobolka Gedo, taasoo keentay in ciidamadu ay ku baxaan goobihii ay hoobiyeyaashaasi ka soo tuureen. Ciidamada ayaa Shabaabka dagaal xoogan ku galay afaafka hore ee magaalada, gaar ahaan meel u dhow Buuloweyn iyo Kormarey oo lagu sheegay inay hoobiyeyaasha ka soo rideen. Wararka ayaa sheegaya inay ciidamadu si buuxda u xaqiijiyeen amniga goobihii lagu dagaalamay, isla-markaana ay ka riixeen maleeshiyadaasi. Ilo wareedyo muhiim ah ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada ay sideed askari kaga dhimatay dagaalka, toddobo kalena ay kaga dhaawacmeen. Nin Sarkaal ah oo codsaday inaanan magaciisa Warbaahinta loo adeegsan ayaa sidoo kale Unversaltv u sheegay in uu arkay meydadka 20 nin oo laga dilay maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee ka hawlgala Gobolka Gedo ayaa kuu sheegaya in Shabaabku ay ka yimaadeen dhinaca waddada ka timaada Degmada Saakow ee Gobolka Jubbada Dhexe. Dhacdadan ayaa ku soo beegmeysa, xilli Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar uu maalintii afaraad booqasho ku joogo Baardheere. Taliyaha ayaa Axaddii Baardheere u tegay, sidii halkaasi looga furi lahaa xero militari oo lagu tababaro Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Odayaasha iyo waxgaradka reer Baardheere ayaa la sheegaya in ay diidan yihiin furitaanka xeradaasi, sababtu tahay inay ka walaacsan yihiin Dowladda Federaalka oo aan la isku halayn karin.

items.title: Pakistan oo digtay kooxda Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Pakistan ayaa sheegtay inaysan jirin wax “madmadow ah” oo ku saabsan weerar lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda xubnood ee dhowaan la sameeyay “Isbahaysiga Difaaca Makkah”, isla markaana weerarka noocaas ah loo aqoonsan doono inuu yahay weerar lagu qaaday dhammaan saddexda xubnood. Wasiirka Difaaca Pakistan ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in heshiisku dhaqan geli karo kadib weerarradii Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen Sacuudiga. Hadallada Khawaja Asif ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii ciidamada Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee xulafada la ah Iran ay duqeymo isdaba joog ah oo gantaallo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah ku qaadeen Sacuudiga. Weerarradu waxay bartilmaameedsadeen magaalooyin iyo kaabayaal dhaqaale iyo tamareed, waxaana ku dhaawacmay ugu yaraan 73 qof oo rayid ah. Wasiirka Difaaca Pakistan ayaa sheegay in gardarro kasta oo ka dhan ah mid ka mid ah dowladaha xubnaha ka ah heshiiska, ama in colaadda Yemen ay ku faafto Sacuudiga, ay saameyn doonto qodobbada difaaca wadajirka ah ee heshiiskii dhowaan ay Pakistan, Sacuudiga iyo Turkigu ku kala saxiixdeen Makkah. Wuxuu muujiyay rajada ah in xiisaddu hoos u dhici doonto, balse wuxuu Xuutiyiinta uga digay inay colaadda Yemen ku fidiyaan meel ka baxsan xuduudaha dalka. The post Pakistan oo digtay kooxda Xuutiyiinta appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

Wuxuu muujiyay rajada ah in xiisaddu hoos u dhici doonto, balse wuxuu Xuutiyiinta uga digay inay colaadda Yemen ku fidiyaan meel ka baxsan xuduudaha dalka. items.title: Soomaaliya ma u diyaarsan tahay inay la wareegto mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa xaqiijisay inay awood u leedahay inay si buuxda ula wareegto mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka haddii ciidanka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ka baxaan Soomaaliya, iyadoo xustay in sannadihii u dambeeyay la sameeyay diyaargarow ballaaran oo arrintaasi la xiriira. Agaasimaha Guud ee Xarunta TUBSAN, Cali Yaasiin Gurbe ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay qaaday tallaabooyin kala duwan oo loogu diyaar-garoobayo xilliga ay ciidamada shisheeye ka wareejinayaan mas’uuliyadda amniga, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhismaha hay’adaha amniga iyo tayeynta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Gurbe ayaa tilmaamay in xaruntoodu sannadihii lasoo dhaafay ay qayb ka ahayd dadaallada lagu wajahayo waxa loogu yeero argagixisada, isagoo sheegay in howl-gallada iyo waayo-aragnimada la helay ay Soomaaliya ka caawiyeen inay yeelato awood ay si madax-bannaan ugu wajahdo caqabadaha amni ee dalka. Waxa uu xusay in ciidamada iyo hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya ay muddo dheer ku howlanaayeen la tacaalidda Al-Shabaab, taasina ay siisay khibrad dhinacyada qorsheynta iyo fulinta hawlgallada amni. Sidoo kale, Agaasimaha ayaa sheegay in dib-u-dhiska hay’adaha kala duwan ee Dowladda Federaalka, gaar ahaan kuwa amniga, uu qayb weyn ka yahay diyaar-garowga Soomaaliya ugu jirto inay si buuxda ula wareegto mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Gurbe ayaa intaas ku daray in Soomaaliya aysan ku tiirsanayn awooddeeda gudaha oo keliya, balse ay xiriir iyo iskaashi dhinaca amniga ah la leedahay dalal kala duwan oo saaxiib la ah, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay kaalin ka qaadan karaan xoojinta amniga Soomaaliya. Ugu dambeyn, Agaasimaha ayaa meesha ka saaray walaac laga qabo in bixitaanka ciidamada AUSSOM uu Soomaaliya gelin karo xaalad amni oo halis ah, isagoo ku adkeystay in dowladda ay u diyaar-garowday mas’uuliyadda amniga, isla markaana ay haysato waayo-aragnimo iyo iskaashi caalami ah oo ku filan. items.title: DF oo ku adkeysatay arrin la xiriirta bixitaanka UNTMIS
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Balcad ayaa kulan muhiim ah la qaatay wafdi ka socday xafiiska Qaramada Midoobe ee Soomaaliya UNTMIS oo uu hoggaaminayay Madaxa ku-simaha hawlgalka UNTMIS, Raisedon Zenenga. Kulanka waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb-galay madaxa kooxda siyaasadda iyo dhexdhexaadinta ee UNTMIS, Vikram Parekh, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada-hadleen arrimo la xiriira howlaha Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya. Wada-hadallada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray hannaanka kala-guurka UNTMIS iyo sidii loo sii wadi lahaa isku-duwidda iyo wada-shaqeynta u dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Qaramada Midoobay, marka la soo afjaro howl-galka UNTMIS dhammaadka sanadkan. Wasiiru-dowlaha ayaa kulanka ku muujiyay sida ay Dowladda Federaalka uga go’an tahay in hannaanka kala-guurka uu noqdo mid ay Soomaaliya hoggaaminayso oo ay Soomaalidu leedahay. Cali Balcad ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in taageerada caalamiga ah ay sii ahaato mid waafaqsan mudnaanta qaranka iyo waajibaadka dowladda Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa isla qaatay in la sii wado isku-duwidda iyo wada-shaqeynta dhow, si loo taageero xasilloonida Soomaaliya iyo horumarinta hay’adaha dowladda. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu sii xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Qaramada Midoobay, xilli uu socdo hannaanka kala-guurka UNTMIS iyo qorshayaasha lagu sii wadi doono taageerada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya. Dhammaadka UNTMIS Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa muddo dheer waday qorshe lagu soo afjarayo howlgalka siyaasadeed ee Qaramada Midoobay ee dalka, iyadoo ku doodaysa in hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed ay tahay inay si buuxda ula wareegaan shaqooyinka siyaasadeed iyo kuwa dowlad-dhiska ee muddo dheer ay taageeraysay Qaramada Midoobay. Qorshahan ayaa markii hore ku bilowday codsigii Dowladda Soomaaliya ee ahaa in la soo afjaro howlgalka UNSOM, kaas oo shaqeynayay tan iyo 2013. Kadib wada-hadallo dhex maray Muqdisho iyo Qaramada Midoobay, waxaa la isku raacay in howlgalkaas aan si kedis ah loo joojin, balse loo maro marxalad kala-guur ah. Taasi waxay horseeday in bishii Nofeembar 2024 la sameeyo UNTMIS, oo ah howlgal ku-meel-gaar ah oo loogu talagalay inuu shaqooyinkii UNSOM si tartiib ah ugu wareejiyo Dowladda Federaalka, hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed iyo kooxaha kale ee Qaramada Midoobay ee dalka ka howlgala. Sida qorshuhu yahay, UNTMIS ayaa lagu wadaa inuu gebi ahaanba soo afjaro howlgalladiisa 31-ka Oktoobar 2026. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa arrintan u aragta qayb ka mid ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo madax-bannaanida hay’adaha dowladda iyo in mas’uuliyadda arrimaha siyaasadda, dastuurka iyo dowlad-dhiska ay si toos ah ula wareegaan hay’adaha qaranka. Si kastaba, soo afjaridda UNTMIS macnaheedu ma aha in Qaramada Midoobay ay Soomaaliya ka baxayso. Hay’adaha kale ee UN-ka, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa gargaarka, horumarinta iyo bani’aadannimada, ayaa sii wadi doona howlahooda, halka waxa dhammaanaya uu yahay howlgalka siyaasadeed ee gaarka ah ee UNTMIS. The post DF oo ku adkeysatay arrin la xiriirta bixitaanka UNTMIS appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Qaramada Midoobay ka dalbanaysa taageero dheeraad ah oo ku aaddan amniga, gargaarka iyo horumarka
items.description: Soomaaliya ayaa qorshaynaysa inay ka faa’iidaysato kaalinteeda diblomaasiyadeed ee Qaramada Midoobay si ay beesha caalamka uga dalbato taageero dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan isbeddelka amniga, xaaladda bani’aadantinimo iyo qorshayaasha horumarineed ee dalka. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa furitaanka Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay , kaas oo ka furmay magaalada New York. Madaxweynaha cusub ee Golaha Guud, Khalilur Rahman oo u dhashay Bangladesh, ayaa sheegay in colaadaha, saameynta isbeddelka cimilada iyo caqabadaha horumarineed ay sii wiiqayaan kalsoonida lagu qabo hay’adaha caalamiga ah. Rahman ayaa tilmaamay lix mudnaan oo muhiim u ah kalfadhiga, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin xoojinta nabadda iyo amniga, dardargelinta horumar waara, wax ka qabashada isbeddelka cimilada, ilaalinta xuquuqda aadanaha, ka faa’iidaysiga tiknoolajiyadda iyo soo celinta kalsoonida lagu qabo nidaamka iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, António Guterres, ayaa isna ka digay culayska sii kordhaya ee hay’adaha caalamiga ah, isagoo xusay colaadaha, kala qaybsanaanta siyaasadeed, barakaca, saboolnimada, sinnaan la’aanta iyo saameynta isbeddelka cimilada. Waxa uu sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay fursadaha iyo khataraha ka dhasha horumarka degdegga ah ee sirdoonka macmalka ah. Soomaaliya, oo ka mid ah 10-ka xubnood ee la doortay ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay muddada 2025–2026 , ayaa doonaysa inay kaalinteeda diblomaasiyadeed u adeegsato sidii ay taageero caalami ah ugu heli lahayd qorshaha dalka ee la wareegidda mas’uuliyadda amniga. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa la filayaa inuu madasha Qaramada Midoobay kusoo bandhigo dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab, dadaallada lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha amniga iyo qorshaha lagu kordhinayo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ee sugidda amniga dalka. Sidoo kale, Soomaaliya waxay beesha caalamka hor dhigi doontaa baahiyaha bani’aadantinimo, gaar ahaan cunto yarida iyo barakaca , iyadoo raadineysa in la sii wado taageerada loogu talagalay soo kabashada dhaqaalaha, maalgashiga iyo dhismaha hay’adaha dowladda. Doorka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya Kaalinta Soomaaliya ee Qaramada Midoobay waxay kusoo beegmaysaa xilli Muqdisho ay sii xoojinayso doorkeeda ku aaddan nabadda iyo amniga Afrika. Soomaaliya waxaa sidoo kale loo doortay Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika (AU PSC) muddada 2026–2028 , taas oo siinaysa fursad dheeraad ah oo ay uga qaybqaadato dadaallada xalinta khilaafaadka iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya waxay weli wajahaysaa caqabado gudaha ah. Dagaalladii ka dhacay deegaanno ku dhow Baydhabo ayaa muujiyay khilaafaadka siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo xoogag xiriir la leh hoggaankii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed. Dhanka kale, Al-Shabaab ayaa weli ah khatar amni oo weyn, inkastoo ay socdaan howlgallo milatari oo ay wadaan ciidamada Soomaaliyeed iyo saaxiibadooda caalamiga ah. Khilaafaadka ku saabsan dastuurka iyo nidaamka doorashooyinka ayaa sidoo kale qayb ka ah xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo dalka uu u sii gudbayo marxaladda doorashada soo socota. Kalfadhiga Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Soomaaliya u noqon kara fursad ay arrimaheeda gudaha ugu xirto ajandaha caalamiga ah ee nabadda, dib-u-dhiska hay’adaha, horumar waara iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika . Si kastaba ha ahaatee Muqdisho waxay isku dayaysaa inay kaalinteeda sii kordhaysa ee diblomaasiyadda caalamiga ah u beddesho taageero wax-ku-ool ah oo dhinacyada amniga, gargaarka bani’aadantinimo iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha , iyadoo sidoo kale xoojinaysa mowqifkeeda ku aaddan nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka.

items.title: Qarax ka dhacay magaalada Beledweyne + Khasaaraha
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Hal qof ayaa ku dhintay, laba kalena way ku dhaawacmeen qarax miino oo saaka ka dhacay xaafadda Buundo Weyn ee magaalada Beledweyne ee gobolka Hiiraan. Qaraxa ayaa ka dhacay goob uu ka socday dhismo, waxaana sida ay sheegeen ilo kala duwan loo adeegsaday miino halkaasi lagu aasay, taas oo sababtay khasaaraha dhimashada iyo dhaawaca. items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo sheegay in Sacuudigu weerarro aargoosi ah qaaday.
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo sheegay in Sacuudigu weerarro aargoosi ah qaaday. Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay in Sacuudi Carabiya ay Talaadadii qaaday weerarro aargoosi ah, kadib weerarro ay kooxdaasi ku qaaday xarumo shidaal oo sababay dhaawaca tobannaan qof. Telefishinka Al-Masirah oo ay maamulaan Xuutiyiintu ayaa sheegay in weerarrada Sacuudigu ay ka dhaceen gobollada Taiz iyo Ma’rib. Mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga weli kama aysan hadlin wararka ku saabsan weerarrada. Hase yeeshee, horay ayay u sheegeen in weerarro ay Xuutiyiintu habeenkii qaadeen ay sababeen in si “ku-meelgaar ah” loo hakiyo shaqada xarumo shidaal, isla markaana ay ku dhaawacmeen 73 qof. Mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga ayaa markaas sheegay inay ka jawaabi doonaan weerarrada Xuutiyiinta. Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa cambaareeyay weerarrada ay Xuutiyiintu qaadeen.

items.title: Bin Zayed oo ogaa weerarkii October 7 ee Israel – Muxuu sameeyey 10 maalin ka hor?
items.description: Tel Aviv (Caasimada Online) — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa la sheegay in madaxweynaha Imaaraadka Carabta, Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, uu uga digay in Xamaas ay diyaarineysay weerar weyn qiyaastii 10 maalmood ka hor weerarkii 7-dii October 2023, sida uu Talaadadii qoray wargeyska Haaretz. Xafiiska Netanyahu ayaa si adag u beeniyey warbixintaas, isaga oo sheegay in ra’iisul wasaaruhu uusan xilligaas la hadlin madaxweynaha Imaaraadka, isla markaana uusan ka helin wax digniin ah. Sida ay Haaretz sheegtay, Mohamed bin Zayed ayaa Netanyahu u sheegay in hoggaamiyihii Xamaas ee Gaza, Yahya Sinwar, uu qorsheynayey tallaabo weyn oo dhiig badan daadin karta, qalqal gelin karta gobolka, isla markaana dhaawici karta heshiisyada Abraham Accords ee Israel la gashay qaar ka mid ah dalalka Carabta. Digniinta ayaa la sheegay inay timid intii lagu jiray wada-hadal taleefan oo socday 45 daqiiqo dabayaaqadii September 2023. Warbixinta Haaretz waxay ku saleysan tahay buug cusub oo ay qoreen saxafiyiinta Israel ee Shlomi Eldar iyo Ruth Yuval, kaas oo lagu magacaabo Kidnapped: 843 Days of Abandonment . Sida warbixintu sheegtay, Netanyahu ayaa si deggan uga jawaabay digniinta, isaga oo sheegay in Israel ay xaaladda Gaza gacanta ku hayso, islamarkaana haddii Xamaas ay wax tallaabo ah qaaddo ay u badan tahay inay ka dhacdo Daanta Galbeed ee la haysto. Xafiiskiisa ayaa arrintaas ku tilmaamay “been buur buuxa”. “Ra’iisul Wasaare Netanyahu lama uusan hadlin madaxweynaha Imaaraadka Carabta muddada la sheegay, mana uusan helin wax digniin ah,” ayaa lagu yiri jawaabta xafiiska Netanyahu. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Imaaraadka ayaan markiiba ka jawaabin codsi faallo ah oo arrintan la xiriira. Digniin kasoo bilaabatay Sinwar Haaretz ayaa sheegtay in xogta digniinta la sheegay ay asal ahaan kasoo baxday xiriirro dadban oo u dhexeeyey Xamaas iyo Israel bilihii ka horreeyey weerarka. Sida ku cad warbixinta, dhinacyada ayaa si dadban uga wada hadlayey dadka Israa’iiliyiinta ah ee Xamaas ku haysay Gaza iyo tallaabooyin lagu fududeyn karo xaaladda ka jirta Marinka Gaza. Wada-hadallada ayaa horumar sameeyey xagaagii 2023, balse markii dambe istaagay, halka Sinwar uu xiriirka ka jaray dhex-dhexaadiyeyaasha, horraantii September. Sinwar ayaa markaas la sheegay inuu si gaar ah ula kulmay mas’uul ka tirsan Fatah oo Haaretz ugu yeertay magaca qarsoon ee “Coal Eyes”, isaga oo u sheegay inuu Israel gaarsiiyo fariin ah in Xamaas diyaarineyso “yaab weyn” haddii aan horumar laga sameyn wada-hadallada. “U sheeg Israel inay filato zilzal , dhulgariir,” ayaa Sinwar lagu soo xigtay buugga. Ninka Fatah ka tirsanaa ayaa fariintaas u gudbiyey la-taliye Falastiini ah oo la shaqeynayey madaxweynaha Imaaraadka, sida warbixintu sheegtay. Kadib kulan kale oo Sinwar lala yeeshay bartamihii September, waxaa mar kale la sheegay inuu sheegay in Xamaas diyaarineyso howlgal aan caadi ahayn oo aad u weyn. Haaretz ayaa sheegtay in digniintaas ugu dambeyn loo gudbiyey hay’adda amniga gudaha Israel ee Shin Bet. Mas’uuliyiinta amniga Israel ayaa ka wada hadlay xogta, balse ma aysan u fasiran inay tilmaamayso weerar ballaaran oo dhowaan Gaza kasoo wajahan Israel. Sida warbixintu sheegtay, Mohamed bin Zayed ayaa kadib si toos ah ula xiriiray Netanyahu, maadaama uu weli ka walaacsanaa halista. Haaretz ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in madaxweynaha Imaaraadka uu arrinta la wadaagay William Burns, oo markaas ahaa agaasimaha hay’adda sirdoonka Mareykanka ee CIA. Midkoodna Mohamed bin Zayed iyo Burns si rasmi ah uma xaqiijin wada-hadalladaas la sheegay. Madaxda amniga oo aan loo sheegin Haaretz ayaa sheegtay in Netanyahu uusan digniinta Imaaraadka la wadaagin taliyihii ciidanka Israel ee xilligaas Herzi Halevi iyo madaxii Shin Bet, Ronen Bar. Labadooduba waxay wargeyska u sheegeen in Netanyahu uusan ogeysiin digniin noocaas ah. Mas’uul sare oo Shin Bet ah oo Haaretz la hadlay ayaa sheegay in haddii madaxda amnigu ogaan lahaayeen digniinta Imaaraadka, ay si ka duwan u qiimeyn kareen fariimihii hore ee Sinwar. “Haddii aan ogaan lahayn digniinahaas, waxaa suurtagal ah inay miisaan weyn siin lahayd fariintii ugu horreysay ee naga soo gaartay Sinwar,” ayuu yiri mas’uulka. “Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan isku xiriirin lahayn xogta oo aan gaari lahayn gunaanad gebi ahaan ka duwan kii aan markaas gaarnay.” Warbixintan cusub ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli wali dood xooggan ay ka taagan tahay fashilkii siyaasadeed iyo amni ee ka horreeyey weerarkii 7-dii October. Baaritaan ay sameeyeen ciidamada Israel oo la shaaciyey Febraayo 2025 ayaa lagu sheegay in ciidamadu si weyn u dhayalsadeen awoodda Xamaas, isla markaana aysan ku guuleysan inay difaacaan shacabka Israel. Shin Bet ayaa sidoo kale qirtay inuu jiray fashil dhanka sirdoonka ah, oo ay ka mid ahaayeen digniino la seegay iyo qiimeyn khaldan oo lagu sheegay in Xamaas aysan dooneyn dagaal ballaaran. Weerarkii 7-dii October, dagaalyahanno ay hoggaamineysay Xamaas ayaa gudaha u galay koonfurta Israel, halkaas oo lagu dilay qiyaastii 1,200 qof, oo intooda badan rayid ahaa, laguna qafaashay 251 qof oo loo qaaday Gaza. Weerarkaas ayaa horseeday dagaalka Israel ka billowday Gaza iyo isku dhacyo kale oo gobolka ku fiday. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Gaza ayaa sheegtay in duullaanka Israel uu tan iyo markaas dilay in ka badan 73,650 Falastiiniyiin ah. Muranka siyaasadeed ee Israel Warbixinta Haaretz ayaa timid xilli Israel isku diyaarineyso doorasho guud oo loo qorsheeyey 27-ka October, iyadoo mas’uuliyadda fashilkii 7-dii October ay noqotay arrin weyn oo ololaha doorashada ka dhex muuqata. Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore Naftali Bennett ayaa sheegay in warbixinta Haaretz ay sax tahay, inkastoo uusan faahfaahin halka uu xogtaas ka xaqiijiyey. “Warbixinta la daabacay saaka ee ah in Netanyahu loo digay 10 maalmood ka hor xasuuqii 7-da October ee ku saabsanaa qorshaha Sinwar waa sax,” ayuu Bennett ku qoray bartiisa X. Bennett ayaa Netanyahu ku eedeeyey inuu si toos ah masuul uga yahay fashilka horseeday weerarka. Gadi Eisenkot, oo horey u ahaa taliyaha ciidamada Israel kana mid ah siyaasiyiinta sida weyn ula tartamaya Netanyahu, ayaa isna sheegay in warbixintu sii xoojineyso su’aalaha ku saabsan waxa Netanyahu ogaa ka hor weerarka. Netanyahu ayaa muddo diidanaa baaqyada lagu dalbanayo guddi qaran oo madax-bannaan oo baaritaan ku sameeya fashilkii siyaasadeed iyo amni ee la xiriiray 7-dii October. Doodda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kadib markii Netanyahu uu dhowaan ku eedeeyey saraakiisha amniga inay ku guuldareysteen inay hurdada ka kiciyaan saacadihii ka horreeyey weerarka, inkastoo ay jireen calaamado muujinayey in Xamaas ay wax diyaarineyso. Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in haddii xogta loo gudbin lahaa uu si degdeg ah u amri lahaa abaabul ciidan oo ballaaran, isla markaana weerarka laga hortagi karay. Hase yeeshee, Channel 12 ayaa markii dambe sheegtay in Netanyahu uusan la hadlin madaxda ciidamada ama Shin Bet muddo ka badan laba saacadood kadib markii 6:29 subaxnimo loo sheegay in weerarku billowday. Sida ku cad jadwalkiisa rasmiga ah, Netanyahu ayaa abaabul ciidan oo buuxa amray 9:55 subaxnimo. items.title: Mareykanka oo Burburiyay Shan Markab oo Saliid ah oo Iiraan leedahay
items.description: Xiisadda u dhaxaysa Mareykanka iyo Iiraan ayaa sii xoogeysatay kadib markii Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) uu sheegay in ciidamada Mareykanku ay burburiyeen shan markab oo qaada saliidda ceyriin ee Iiraan, tallaabadaas oo lagu sheegay inay jawaab u tahay weerarro ay Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan (IRGC) isku dayeen inay ku qaadaan markab dagaal oo Mareykan ah. Sida uu sheegay CENTCOM, IRGC ayaa laba jeer isku dayday inay markabka dagaalka Mareykanka ku garaacdo gantaallo ballistic ah muddo laba maalmood gudahood ah, hase yeeshee markabka ayaa ka badbaaday weerarrada, wuxuuna sii watay howlihiisa biyaha gobolka, iyadoo aan wax askar Mareykan ah ah ku dhaawacmin ama ku dhiman. Kadib weerarradaas, ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa weeraray shan markab oo shidaal ah, ayadoo afarta markab ee Kaviz, Charminar, Horizon 1 iyo Riesco lagu bartilmaameedsaday Gacanka Cumaan, halka markabka shanaad ee Derya lagu weeraray meel u dhow Jasiiradda Kharg, oo ah goob muhiim u ah dhoofinta saliidda Iiraan. CENTCOM ayaa sheegtay in shaqaalaha maraakiibta loo sheegay inay ka degaan ka hor inta aan la weerarin, waxaana maraakiibta laga dhigay kuwo aan shaqayn karin. Mareykanku wuxuu ku dooday in maraakiibtan ay qeyb ka ahaayeen shabakad qarsoon oo Iiraan u adeegsato dhoofinta saliidda iyo soo saarista dhaqaale lagu maalgeliyo IRGC iyo kooxaha ay taageerto gobolka. Washington ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in tani aysan ahayn markii ugu horreysay ee ay maraakiib shidaal oo Iiraan ah bartilmaameedsato, iyadoo saddex markab oo kale la weeraray 5-tii Sebtembar kadib isku dayo ay IRGC ku bartilmaameedsatay maraakiib dagaal oo Mareykan ah. Dhanka kale, Iiraan ayaa sheegtay inay jawaab ka bixinayso weerarrada Mareykanka, ayadoo Warbaahinta dowladda Iiraan ay sheegtay in gantaallo lagu bartilmaameedsaday saldhig Mareykan oo ku yaalla dalka Urdun, halka Ciidamada Urdun ay sheegeen inay qabteen 18 gantaal oo ballistic ah, iyadoo laba kale ay ku dhaceen goobo aan dadku deggenayn. Xiisadda ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelanaysa amniga maraakiibta iyo ganacsiga shidaalka ee gobolka, gaar ahaan agagaarka Marinka Hormuz , oo ah marin muhiim u ah isu-socodka tamarta adduunka.

items.title: Xog: Dowladda oo ciidamo ku daabuleysa Baydhaba iyo weerar culus oo la qorsheeyey
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) — Xog ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa sheegaya in halkaasi lagu abaabulayo ciidamo cusub oo la filayo in la geeyo magaalada Baydhaba, si ay uga qayb qaataan hawlgal lagula dagaalamayo ciidamada daacadda u ah Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Ilo-wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in go’aankan uu ka dhashay wada-hadal ay xalay khadka telefoonka ku yeesheen Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, iyo Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe). Ilo-wareedyada ayaa intaas ku daraya in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka faray in loo dhaqaaqo hawlgal dagaalka looga fogeynayo, laguna xasillinayo magaalada Baydhaba. Aadan Madoobe ayaa la aaminsan yahay in uu walaac xooggan ka qabo joogitaanka ciidamada diidan jiritaanka maamulkiisa, kuwaas oo si firfircoon uga hawlgala hareeraha magaalada uu ku shaqeeyo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa la sheegayaa in uu Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda u sheegay in mucaaradka uu Laftagareen hoggaamiyo aysan diyaar u ahayn wada-hadal iyo heshiis siyaasadeed oo lagu joojinayo weerarrada ay ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen iyo Al-Shabaab ku hayaan Baydhaba, isla markaana ay lagama maarmaan tahay in loogu tago goobaha ay iska soo abaabulaan. Baydhaba ayaa toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay wajahaysay xaalad amni oo sii xumaanaysa, iyadoo dagaallo iyo iska horimaadyo soo noqnoqday ay ka dhacayeen duleedka iyo waddooyinka soo gala magaalada. Xiisadda ayaa sare u kacday markii ciidamada mucaaradka hubeysan ay dhowr jeer isku dayeen inay cadaadis militari saaraan maamulka Aadan Madoobe, halka ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ay xoojiyeen difaacyada magaalada. Xaaladda ayaa sidoo kale abuurtay cabsi laga qabo in dagaalka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya labada dhinac uu isu beddelo dagaal muddo dheer ka socda Baydhaba iyo deegaannada ku hareeraysan, iyadoo dhinacyadu ay weli isku hayaan cidda sharciyadda u leh hoggaanka Koonfur Galbeed. Aadan Madoobe, oo 22-kii bishii August shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Madaxtooyada Baydhaba, ayaa nasiib-darro ku tilmaamay in saraakiil hore uga tirsanaa dowladda ay maanta iskaashi la leeyihiin maleeshiyada Al-Shabaab. Wuxuu askarta iyo dhallinyarada u dagaallamaysa Laftagareen ugu baaqay inay dadkooda u soo laabtaan, isagoo sheegay in haddii ay ka dhega-adaygaan ay dantu keeni doonto in lagu weeraro meelaha ay joogaan. War 31-kii bishii August ka soo baxay Xarunta Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ee Baydhaba ayaa garabka mucaaradka hubeysan ee Laftagareen loogu baaqay in wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad lagu dhammeeyo wax kasta oo lagu kala aragti duwan yahay. Ciidamada mucaaradka ayaa Khamiistii, oo 3-da September ku beegnayd, weerar xooggan ku qaaday magaalada Baydhaba, inkastoo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Maamulka Aadan Madoobe ay ka hortageen inay si qoto dheer ugu soo fidaan gudaha magaalada. Weerarkan ayaa loo fasirtay in Laftagareen, saraakiisha iyo siyaasiyiinta Koonfur Galbeed ee ay isku aragtida yihiin ay xalka u arkaan waddo aan wada-hadal ahayn. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qorshuhu wuxuu yahay in cutubyada ciidamada ee loo wado Baydhaba ay kuwa horey fariisimaha ugu lahaa bannaanka magaalada iska kaashadaan hawlgal dagaalka looga fogeynayo magaaladaasi. items.title: 12 dal oo qorsheynaya xayiraado ganacsi oo la xiriira deegaannada Israa’iil ka dhistay Daanta Galbeed
items.description: Faransiiska, Boqortooyada Midowday, Canada iyo sagaal dal oo kale ayaa ku dhawaaqay qorsheyaal ay ku soo rogi doonaan ama ku tixgelin doonaan xayiraado heer qaran ah oo lagu xakameynayo ganacsiga badeecadaha ka yimaada deegaannada Israa’iil ka dhistay Daanta Galbeed ee la haysto . 12-ka dal ayaa kala ah Faransiiska, Britain, Canada, Denmark, Spain, Finland, Ireland, Iceland, Norway, Poland, Portugal iyo Sweden . Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee dalalkan ayaa sheegay in ballaarinta deegaannada Israa’iil iyo rabshadaha ay geystaan dadka deggan deegaannadaas ay gaareen heer aan hore loo arag. Dalalkan ayaa sheegay inay doonayaan inay qaadaan tallaabooyin heer qaran ah oo lagu xaddidayo ganacsiga la xiriira deegaannada Israa’iil, halka qaar kalena ay taageerayaan in tallaabooyin noocaas ah laga qaado heerka Midowga Yurub. Qaar ka mid ah dowladahan ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay weli qiimeynayaan tallaabooyin dheeraad ah oo waafaqsan nidaamyadooda qaran. Wasiirradu waxay ku adkeysteen in xalka laba dowladood uu yahay mid muhiim u ah in la gaaro nabad waarta oo caddaalad ah. Waxay sidoo kale kasoo horjeesteen tallaabo kasta oo horseedi karta in dhul Falastiini ah lagu daro Israa’iil ama Falastiiniyiinta si khasab ah looga barakiciyo deegaannadooda. Bayaan wadajir ah oo ay soo saareen ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqay dowladda Israa’iil inay joojiso ballaarinta deegaannada la dhisayo, isla markaana lala xisaabtamo dadka deggan deegaannadaas ee lagu eedeeyo weerarro iyo rabshado ka dhan ah Falastiiniyiinta. Dhanka kale, 12-ka dal ayaa sheegay inay aqoonsan yihiin walaacyada amni ee Israa’iil, waxayna cambaareeyeen weerarkii Hamas ee 7-dii Oktoobar , iyagoo haddana ku celiyay taageeradooda ku aaddan dhismaha dowlad Falastiini ah oo madax-bannaan, dimuqraadi ah oo shaqayn karta , taas oo si nabad iyo amni ah ula noolaata Israa’iil, iyadoo lagu saleynayo xuduudo ay labada dhinac ku heshiiyaan oo caalami ahaan la aqoonsan yahay. Tallaabadan diblomaasiyadeed ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay sii kordhayaan walaacyada caalamiga ah ee ku saabsan ballaarinta deegaannada Israa’iil ee Daanta Galbeed , iyadoo dalal badan ay wadaan dadaallo cusub oo lagu ilaalinayo fursadda xal siyaasadeed oo laba dowladood ah. Bayaankan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya in arrinta ganacsiga badeecadaha ka yimaada deegaannada Israa’iil ay sii noqonayso mid muhiim u ah siyaasadda dibadda ee dalal badan oo Yurub ah iyo Canada, iyadoo dowladahaasi ay doonayaan inay cadaadis siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale ku muujiyaan mowqifkooda ku aaddan ballaarinta deegaannada.

items.title: Tirada dhimashada Falastiiniyiinta Qasa oo gaartay in ka badan 73,600
items.description: Tirada Falastiiniyiinta lagu dilay Marinka Gaza tan iyo 7-dii Oktoobar 2023 ayaa gaartay ugu yaraan 73,658 qof , halka 174,622 qof ay ku dhaawacmeen, sida ay sheegtay xogta Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Gaza ee la shaaciyay 7-dii Sebtembar 2026. Sida ay sheegeen ilaha caafimaadka, isbitaallada Gaza ayaa 24-kii saac ee ka horreeyay warbixinta helay 7 qof oo dhintay , shan ka mid ahna ay ahaayeen dhimashooyin cusub, halka laba qof ay u geeriyoodeen dhaawacyo hore, ayadoo sidoo kale la diiwaangeliyay 30 qof oo dhaawacmay . Xogta ayaa sidoo kale muujineysa in tan iyo xabbad-joojintii dhaqan gashay 11-kii Oktoobar 2025 , ay Gaza ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 1,352 Falastiiniyiin ah , halka 4,511 qof ay dhaawacmeen, waxaana laga soo saaray burburka 826 meyd ah . Ilo caafimaad ayaa sheegay in weli ay jiraan dad ku hoos jira burburka dhismayaasha iyo waddooyinka, iyadoo kooxaha gurmadka iyo ambalaasyadu ay dhibaato kala kulmaan gaarsiinta meelaha ay ku jiraan. Dagaalka iyo weerarrada ayaa weli sababaya dhimasho inkastoo xabbad-joojinta 2025 ay joojisay dagaalladii waaweynaa, waxaana Reuters ay 6-dii Sebtembar werisay in weerarro ka dhacay Gaza lagu diley dad rayid ah, oo ay ku jireen carruur, iyadoo dhinaca Israa’iil uu sheegay in qaar ka mid ah weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsaday xubno ka tirsan Hamas. Warbixin cusub oo soo baxday 8-dii Sebtembar ayaa tirada dhimashada ka dhigtay 73,662 , halka dhaawacyaduna gaareen 174,627 , taasoo muujineysa in khasaaraha bani’aadannimo uu weli sii kordhayo.

Xogta ayaa sidoo kale muujineysa in tan iyo xabbad-joojintii dhaqan gashay 11-kii Oktoobar 2025 , ay Gaza ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 1,352 Falastiiniyiin ah , halka 4,511 qof ay dhaawacmeen, waxaana laga soo saaray burburka 826 meyd ah . Ilo caafimaad ayaa sheegay in weli ay jiraan dad ku hoos jira burburka dhismayaasha iyo waddooyinka, iyadoo kooxaha gurmadka iyo ambalaasyadu ay dhibaato kala kulmaan gaarsiinta meelaha ay ku jiraan. Dagaalka iyo weerarrada ayaa weli sababaya dhimasho inkastoo xabbad-joojinta 2025 ay joojisay dagaalladii waaweynaa, waxaana Reuters ay 6-dii Sebtembar werisay in weerarro ka dhacay Gaza lagu diley dad rayid ah, oo ay ku jireen carruur, iyadoo dhinaca Israa’iil uu sheegay in qaar ka mid ah weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsaday xubno ka tirsan Hamas. Warbixin cusub oo soo baxday 8-dii Sebtembar ayaa tirada dhimashada ka dhigtay 73,662 , halka dhaawacyaduna gaareen 174,627 , taasoo muujineysa in khasaaraha bani’aadannimo uu weli sii kordhayo.

items.title: Who is Sagal Abdi-Wali, tipped for Starmer’s former seat?
items.description: London, UK — Somali-born British politician Sagal Abdi-Wali has emerged as a leading contender to become Labour’s candidate in the Holborn and St Pancras by-election, potentially putting a former child refugee on course to succeed former prime minister Keir Starmer in Parliament. Abdi-Wali, 42, leads Camden Council and has deep political and community ties to the north London constituency. Labour opened the contest after Starmer announced on September 1 that he was stepping down as an MP, ending 11 years representing the seat. Party members are due to choose their candidate on September 9, with British media identifying Abdi-Wali among the leading contenders . If selected, she could face Green Party leader Zack Polanski, who is contesting the seat as his party seeks to build on gains made in Camden during May’s local elections. From Somalia to Camden Abdi-Wali was born in Somalia in 1984 and came to Britain with her family as a child refugee in the early 1990s, as civil war engulfed the country. Her family settled in Camden, where she grew up and has lived for more than three decades. Writing about her background in 2019, Abdi-Wali described Camden as the place that became home after her family fled Somalia. “Camden has been my home since I moved here with my family as a child refugee, fleeing war-torn Somalia,” she wrote . Before entering elected politics, Abdi-Wali worked in local government and spent more than a decade involved in community organisations. Her public record includes work as a charity volunteer and trustee, a governor at local schools and involvement with Somali community organisations. Companies House records show that she previously served as a director of the Council of Somali Organisations and later held roles with Voluntary Action Camden. Rise through Labour Abdi-Wali’s involvement in Labour politics predates her election to Camden Council. In 2019, she sought Labour’s nomination for the Barnet and Camden seat on the London Assembly. Starmer, then MP for Holborn and St Pancras, endorsed her during the selection contest, although Anne Clarke ultimately won the nomination. By 2020, Abdi-Wali was chair of the Holborn and St Pancras Constituency Labour Party, the local party organisation in the constituency Starmer represented. She also backed Starmer during his successful campaign for the Labour leadership, pointing to his constituency work and human rights background. Abdi-Wali moved into elected local government in 2022, winning a Camden Square council seat for Labour. She later joined Camden’s cabinet and took responsibility for housing, including work on council homes, repairs and neighbourhood services. At the May 2026 local elections, she narrowly retained her Camden Square seat, receiving 890 votes against 830 for the highest-polling Green candidate. Later that month, councillors chose her to lead Camden Council, making her the borough’s first Black woman leader . Her profile has also grown within the national Labour Party. Abdi-Wali has chaired Labour’s National Women’s Committee, placing her within one of the party’s main internal representative bodies. Battle for Starmer’s seat Holborn and St Pancras has been represented by Labour for decades, with Starmer holding the constituency from 2015 until his resignation. But the coming by-election presents a more competitive test than Labour has traditionally faced in the seat. The Greens made substantial gains in Camden’s May council elections, while Polanski is seeking to turn that momentum into a parliamentary breakthrough. Abdi-Wali’s long association with the borough could therefore become a significant part of her case for the Labour nomination. She has spent most of her life in Camden and has served there as a community activist, Labour organiser, councillor, cabinet member and council leader. Her possible candidacy has also attracted national attention beyond Labour. Reform UK’s home affairs spokesman Zia Yusuf faced criticism after drawing attention to Abdi-Wali’s Somali origins while commenting on the possibility of her succeeding Starmer. Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds called the intervention “straightforward racism”, while figures within Reform also criticised Yusuf’s remarks. For Abdi-Wali, the Labour selection represents another step in a political career rooted in the same part of London where her family settled after fleeing Somalia more than three decades ago. Whether that journey reaches the House of Commons will first be decided by Labour members in Holborn and St Pancras when they choose their candidate on Wednesday. items.title: Deni Draws a Line: Puntland Steps Away as Somalia’s Political Deadlock Deepens
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni has announced that Puntland has cancelled all agreements previously reached with Somalia’s Federal Government and will independently manage its affairs, until Somali political leaders reach a settlement acceptable to all sides. Deni said Puntland would no longer operate under political arrangements it considers invalid or superseded, while remaining part of the broader Somali political process. “Every agreement between us and the Federal Government has been cancelled. We will operate independently until Somalis reach an agreement. The Puntland people in Mogadishu are simply employees who came for work,” Deni said. The announcement follows nearly a year of increasingly unproductive negotiations involving the Federal Government, opposition groups and several federal member states. Despite repeated meetings and mediation efforts, the political leadership has failed to reach a durable agreement on elections, constitutional changes and the rules governing the country’s next political transition. What Puntland Is Changing Deni’s announcement does not amount to a declaration of independence. Instead, Puntland is signaling that it will conduct its political and administrative affairs without relying on agreements with the Federal Government that it has now declared cancelled. In practical terms, Puntland intends to manage its internal administration, institutions and political affairs on its own terms while the wider national dispute remains unresolved. Deni also indicated that Puntland officials and representatives working in Mogadishu should be understood primarily as employees serving in their professional capacities, rather than as evidence that Puntland remains politically bound by the Federal Government. The distinction is important. Puntland is not saying it has left Somalia. It is saying that, until a national political agreement is reached, it will not accept Mogadishu unilaterally determining its political or administrative affairs. A Political Process Going Nowhere Somalia’s political crisis has increasingly become a problem of institutional paralysis. The country remains divided over fundamental questions: What electoral system should be used? What constitutional framework should govern the transition? Who has the authority to amend the Constitution? And how can an election be considered legitimate if major political forces and federal member states reject the process? For months, opposition leaders and federal member states have negotiated with the Federal Government without producing an agreement capable of resolving these disputes. The result is a political process that generates meetings, statements and committees but little tangible progress. Several federal member states have increasingly challenged Mogadishu’s approach to the transition, while opposition groups have demanded guarantees that electoral and constitutional processes will not be controlled by the incumbent administration. The longer the impasse continues, the greater the risk that Somalia’s federal system will be shaped by unilateral decisions rather than negotiated consensus. Why Deni’s Decision Matters Against this backdrop, Deni’s announcement establishes a clear political and administrative boundary between Puntland and the Federal Government. Puntland has previously suspended or severed cooperation with Mogadishu over disagreements concerning federalism, constitutional changes and the country’s political direction. The latest move reinforces that position by rejecting agreements Deni says previously bound the two sides. Importantly, Puntland is not declaring secession from Somalia. Deni’s position is that Puntland will remain part of the Somali political framework while refusing to accept decisions from Mogadishu that it considers unilateral or inconsistent with federal principles. In other words, Puntland is stepping back from political dependence on Mogadishu—not from Somalia itself. The Cost of Failed Negotiations The prolonged talks have produced diminishing returns. Instead of resolving the central disputes, they have deepened mistrust between Mogadishu and the federal member states and reinforced opposition concerns that the political transition is being shaped by competing interests rather than a shared national framework. A functioning federal system cannot depend on one side imposing decisions while expecting the other to accept them. Likewise, an election is unlikely to command broad legitimacy when major political actors disagree over the rules before voting begins. The constitutional dispute makes the situation even more serious. If Somalia cannot agree on the rules governing elections, institutions and the distribution of political authority, the country risks entering another transition in which the legality of the process itself becomes the central dispute. Puntland’s Calculated Position Deni’s decision can be viewed as a calculated response to what Puntland considers a dysfunctional political process.Rather than declaring independence, Puntland has chosen to manage its affairs independently, withdraw from agreements it considers no longer valid, and wait for a national political settlement. That position leaves room for renewed cooperation. If Somalia’s political leaders eventually reach an agreement that Puntland accepts, Deni has indicated that Puntland can reconsider its position within that broader framework. The dispute therefore remains fundamentally political. Puntland is demanding that its constitutional and political interests be included in any national settlement rather than accepting arrangements imposed without its agreement. Somalia Needs Agreement, Not Endless Negotiation The fundamental problem is no longer the absence of dialogue. Somalia has had dialogue for nearly a year. The problem is the failure to turn dialogue into agreement. The country cannot remain indefinitely trapped between competing constitutional interpretations, disputed electoral plans and negotiations that repeatedly end without a settlement. Puntland’s latest decision is therefore a warning to Mogadishu: federal member states cannot simply be expected to remain bound by political arrangements they believe have been unilaterally altered or abandoned. At the same time, Puntland has left the door open to a national settlement. Deni has not declared secession. He has instead said Puntland will manage its affairs independently while waiting for Somali leaders to agree on the country’s political future. The real challenge now lies with Somalia’s political leadership: end the cycle of inconclusive negotiations, agree on the constitutional and electoral rules, and rebuild a federal political framework in which Puntland and the other federal member states have a genuine place at the table. Until that happens, Puntland’s decision to step back from Mogadishu may be less a rejection of Somalia than a demand that Somalia finally agree on how its federal system is supposed to work. items.title: Confusion and Fear Grip Nairobi as Kenya Intensifies Immigration Crackdown
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) — Confusion and anxiety spread across Nairobi as Kenyan security and immigration authorities intensified a crackdown on foreign nationals believed to be living in the country without valid immigration status, following a recent directive from President William Ruto calling for the removal of undocumented foreigners. The enforcement operation was particularly visible on the streets of Nairobi, where foreign nationals reportedly became increasingly cautious about leaving their homes amid uncertainty over who was being targeted and what legal status was required to avoid arrest or deportation. A significant number of those seen attempting to leave Kenya were reportedly nationals of Burundi, with some beginning overland journeys back to their country while others sought assistance from their respective embassies to facilitate their departure. The operation also caused concern within Nairobi’s Somali community, particularly in Eastleigh, where some Somalis without valid immigration documents reportedly remained inside their homes, fearing that the crackdown could affect them. Questions Over the Scope of the Crackdown The operation has raised questions about how President Ruto’s directive was being interpreted and whether enforcement agencies were adequately distinguishing between foreigners without lawful immigration status and nationals of countries covered by regional arrangements. The uncertainty has been particularly pronounced among members of the East African Community (EAC), which includes Kenya and Somalia. Some members of the Somali community expressed surprise over reports that immigration enforcement was being applied broadly, arguing that citizens of EAC member states may be entitled to specific rights and protections under regional agreements. The Kenyan government has reportedly instructed security and immigration authorities to halt deportation measures targeting nationals of EAC member states, adding another layer to the confusion surrounding the operation and raising questions about how the initial directive was implemented. Fear in Eastleigh : The Question of Enforcement and Regional Rights In Eastleigh, one of Nairobi’s largest Somali-populated neighborhoods, the impact was particularly noticeable. Some residents reportedly chose not to leave their homes, fearing encounters with security or immigration officers and uncertainty over how their individual status would be assessed. For many, the concern was not simply whether they possessed the required documentation. It was the possibility of detention, questioning or deportation before their circumstances were properly examined. The episode has exposed the difficulties that can arise when a broad immigration directive is implemented without sufficiently distinguishing between different categories of foreign nationals. Kenya has a legitimate interest in enforcing its immigration laws and addressing irregular migration. But enforcement must remain consistent with the country’s legal and regional obligations. The operation highlights the importance of distinguishing between undocumented migrants, people whose permits have expired, asylum seekers, refugees and nationals of EAC member states who may benefit from regional mobility arrangements. A blanket approach risks creating unnecessary fear among residents and could undermine confidence among foreign communities that contribute significantly to Kenya’s economy. An Uneasy Day in Nairobi The reported decision to halt deportation measures involving EAC nationals may ease some immediate concerns, but the operation has already unsettled communities across Nairobi. Kenya has the right to enforce its immigration laws, but enforcement must be targeted, lawful and proportionate, with individuals assessed according to their actual immigration status and the protections applicable to them under Kenyan and regional law. For Nairobi’s foreign communities, including its large Somali population, the events served as a stark reminder of how quickly a government immigration directive can affect ordinary lives. The central issue is not whether Kenya should enforce its immigration laws—it is whether those laws are being applied accurately, consistently and within the legal framework governing the people they affect. items.title: U.S. Steps Back as Somalia’s Election Deadlock Deepens
items.description: Mogadishu(WDN) — The United States is reassessing its engagement with Somalia as Washington signals that Somali leaders must take primary responsibility for resolving the country’s deepening political crisis, amid nearly a year of failed negotiations over elections, constitutional changes and the next political transition. Justin Davis, the U.S. Chargé d’Affaires in Mogadishu, is completing his tenure after taking over the embassy in January 2026. U.S. diplomats say Washington is placing greater emphasis on mutual responsibility, with Somalia expected to determine its own political future. Davis has previously said that Somalia’s future belongs to its people and leaders and that the United States does not intend to decide how Somalis choose their government. The message comes as the Federal Government, opposition groups and three federal member states remain deeply divided over the country’s electoral and constitutional framework. No Deal After Nearly a Year of Talks Despite months of negotiations and mediation, t he political actors have failed to resolve the most basic questions surrounding the transition: What electoral system should Somalia use? Who has the authority to organize the vote? What constitutional rules should govern the process? And can an election be legitimate if major opposition forces and federal member states reject the framework? The government has pushed ahead with its electoral agenda, while opposition groups and federal member states have demanded a broader political agreement before the process moves forward. The result is a growing contradiction: Somalia is discussing elections without agreement on the rules under which they will be held. The constitutional dispute has made the situation even more complicated, with disagreements over who can amend the Constitution, how changes should be approved and whether the process has sufficient political consensus. U.S. Focus Remains Security Washington continues to prioritize the fight against Al-Shabaab, security cooperation, counterterrorism financing and migration. American diplomats have also warned that political divisions could undermine Somalia’s security efforts. But the United States appears increasingly unwilling to take ownership of Somalia’s political settlement. The shift comes after international mediation efforts repeatedly failed to produce an agreement between the government, opposition and federal member states. Meanwhile, Turkey, China and the United Arab Emirates are expanding their political, economic and strategic engagement with Somalia, creating an increasingly competitive external environment. The immediate challenge, however, remains inside Somalia.The country does not lack dialogue. It lacks agreement. items.fullContent: Mogadishu(WDN) — The United States is reassessing its engagement with Somalia as Washington signals that Somali leaders must take primary responsibility for resolving the country’s deepening political crisis, amid nearly a year of failed negotiations over elections, constitutional changes and the next political transition. Justin Davis, the U.S. Chargé d’Affaires in Mogadishu, is completing his tenure after taking over the embassy in January 2026. U.S. diplomats say Washington is placing greater emphasis on mutual responsibility, with Somalia expected to determine its own political future. Davis has previously said that Somalia’s future belongs to its people and leaders and that the United States does not intend to decide how Somalis choose their government. The message comes as the Federal Government, opposition groups and three federal member states remain deeply divided over the country’s electoral and constitutional framework. No Deal After Nearly a Year of Talks Despite months of negotiations and mediation, t he political actors have failed to resolve the most basic questions surrounding the transition: What electoral system should Somalia use? Who has the authority to organize the vote? What constitutional rules should govern the process? And can an election be legitimate if major opposition forces and federal member states reject the framework? The government has pushed ahead with its electoral agenda, while opposition groups and federal member states have demanded a broader political agreement before the process moves forward. The result is a growing contradiction: Somalia is discussing elections without agreement on the rules under which they will be held. The constitutional dispute has made the situation even more complicated, with disagreements over who can amend the Constitution, how changes should be approved and whether the process has sufficient political consensus.
