items.title: Switzerland plans to deport injured Somali, rights group says
items.description: Zurich, Switzerland — A Swiss human rights group on Monday called on Swiss authorities to halt the planned deportation of a seriously injured Somali man, saying he was still awaiting medical treatment after suffering multiple skull fractures and a traumatic brain injury. Zurich-based Augenauf said Swiss authorities planned to forcibly return the man to Mogadishu via Istanbul on Thursday, September 10, despite his surgery at Zurich University Hospital following an attack around two weeks ago. According to the group, two flatmates assaulted him at an underground asylum accommodation centre where Swiss authorities had placed him. He suffered multiple skull fractures, a brain injury and damage to his eyes. Augenauf said Swiss authorities had prevented two further operations scheduled for the week beginning September 7 from going ahead. The organisation did not provide details of the legal basis for the deportation or the man’s current immigration status. His lawyer has demanded a suspension of the removal, Augenauf said. The man has lived in Switzerland for 11 years and is the father of three children living elsewhere in Europe. The dispute also involves Somalia’s Immigration and Citizenship Agency, which issued the man with a provisional travel document, or laissez-passer, required for his return. Augenauf alleged that the agency issued the document without taking his medical condition into account and said the photograph on it did not resemble him. Swiss migration authorities say they can obtain temporary travel documents from countries of origin when people facing removal do not possess recognised passports or other valid travel documents. Medical safeguards The case comes amid scrutiny of safeguards surrounding forced deportations from Switzerland. In July, Switzerland’s National Commission for the Prevention of Torture called for improvements in medical assessments of whether people were fit to travel during forced removals by air. It also raised concerns about restraints, the provision of medication and continuity of medical care after arrival. The commission’s findings focused particularly on people with mental illnesses, but also addressed broader medical safeguards during compulsory removals. It monitored 46 forced returns by special flight in 2025, as well as 11 other compulsory air transfers. Switzerland’s State Secretariat for Migration says authorities forcibly remove only a small proportion of people ordered to leave the country and can arrange medical assistance where necessary to prevent risks to their health. Augenauf said two other Somali nationals had filed criminal complaints over previous deportations, which lawyers and Swiss human rights organisations considered to involve “massive violations of Swiss and international law”. The group said authorities had “put the lives of those affected at serious risk” and that it had raised the cases with the commander of Zurich cantonal police and the National Commission for the Prevention of Torture. It urged Somali authorities to intervene in the latest case and to “refuse to readmit any sick or injured persons”. Pressure over returns The dispute comes as European governments increase pressure on Somalia to improve cooperation over the return of nationals ordered to leave. The European Union tightened visa rules for Somali citizens in June after concluding that Somalia’s cooperation on readmissions remained insufficient. The EU called for improvements in the identification of Somali nationals, the issuance of emergency travel documents, and the organisation of voluntary and forced returns. The measures largely ended multiple-entry visas, extended the standard visa-processing period from 15 to 45 days and removed some exemptions for holders of diplomatic and service passports. Switzerland, which is part of the Schengen area but is not an EU member, adopted the restrictions on August 12. The Swiss government said the measures aimed to improve cooperation with Somalia on the readmission of citizens required to leave the country. At the end of June, 57 Somali nationals in Switzerland faced orders to leave. The latest dispute also follows efforts by Bern and Mogadishu to deepen cooperation on migration and returns. Somalia Today reported last year that representatives of Somalia’s Immigration and Citizenship Agency visited Switzerland in July 2025 as the two sides expanded cooperation, including Swiss support for passport-control equipment and training. Augenauf described Switzerland’s combination of support and tougher visa measures as a “carrot and stick” approach towards Somalia. The planned September 10 deportation has now renewed attention on how Swiss authorities carry out removals and how Somalia cooperates on readmissions when a person facing return is seriously injured. items.title: Somali Soldiers Detained in Ethiopia, Raising Sensitive Questions Over Border Crossing
items.description: JIJIGA (WDN) — The reported detention of nearly 230 Somali soldiers after they crossed into Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State has raised sensitive questions about border security, military protocols and the circumstances under which armed personnel from one country can enter another without the documentation normally required for international travel. According to regional sources, the soldiers were intercepted after entering Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State from Somalia and were subsequently transferred to Jijiga for questioning. The incident is particularly sensitive because those detained are reportedly serving members of Somalia’s armed forces—not ordinary civilian travelers. Their presence inside another country therefore raises questions extending beyond immigration procedures to military authorization, border security and relations between the two neighboring states. According to reports, the soldiers were recruited from Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State and later became members of Somalia’s security forces. The soldiers reportedly told authorities that they were on leave and had entered the region to visit their families. However, Ethiopian authorities are said to have detained them and transferred them to Jijiga, where they remain under investigation. The circumstances have prompted questions about how a large group of serving soldiers could cross an international border without the appropriate authorization or travel documentation. For ordinary civilians, international travel generally requires passports, visas or other recognized documentation depending on the countries involved. For serving military personnel, however, crossing an international border carries an additional layer of responsibility because their movement can have security and diplomatic implications. From Doollo and Qoraxay to Jijiga The soldiers were reportedly intercepted in areas near Doollo and Qoraxay after crossing from Somalia. Sources further claim that the group had received military training at Hananbuure in Galmudug, reportedly in preparation for operations against Al-Shabaab. The reports have also linked the recruitment of the soldiers to an official identified as Khaalid, who is said to have previously served as head of intelligence in Jubaland before moving into Somalia’s federal military leadership. Those claims have not been independently verified and require clarification from the relevant authorities. If confirmed, however, the movement of such a large number of serving soldiers across an international border would raise questions about who authorized their travel, whether Ethiopian authorities were notified, and whether any bilateral security arrangements governed their movement. Why the Incident Is Politically Sensitive The incident comes against a complicated political and security backdrop involving Somalia, Ethiopia, Jubaland and Somalia’s federal authorities. The Somali-Ethiopian border is not simply an administrative boundary. It is a strategically sensitive security frontier where armed groups, security forces, local communities and political interests intersect. The reported entry of nearly 230 Somali soldiers therefore carries a significance that would be very different from a group of civilians crossing the border to visit relatives. The central question is not simply whether the soldiers possessed visas. It is whether a foreign military force can cross into another sovereign country without prior authorization and without triggering established military and diplomatic protocols. Even if the soldiers genuinely intended only to visit their families while on leave, their status as members of Somalia’s armed forces makes the episode considerably more sensitive. A large group of uniformed or serving personnel crossing an international border without the knowledge or approval of the host country could easily be interpreted as a security matter rather than an ordinary immigration issue. A Question of Sovereignty and Protocol The case also highlights the importance of clear military-to-military and government-to-government communication along the Somalia-Ethiopia border. If soldiers were legitimately traveling on leave, authorities would be expected to have mechanisms for verifying their identities and status and determining whether their movement complied with applicable border and security arrangements. If, however, they crossed without authorization, the incident raises a more serious question about command responsibility: who permitted them to leave Somalia, and who was responsible for ensuring that they did not cross an international border without the necessary clearance? Those questions cannot be answered through speculation alone. As of now, neither Somalia’s Federal Government nor Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State has publicly provided a detailed account explaining why the soldiers crossed the border, what authorization they possessed, why they were detained, or what will happen to them. The soldiers are reportedly being held at the Garab Case military facility in Jijiga while authorities investigate the circumstances of their entry. Until the two governments provide an official explanation, significant questions will remain unanswered. But one point is already clear: when nearly 230 serving soldiers cross from one country into another, the issue is far more consequential than an ordinary visa violation. It touches military discipline, national sovereignty, border security and the delicate political relationship between Somalia and Ethiopia. items.title: The Somali operatives behind Al-Shabaab-Houthi ties
items.description: Mogadishu, Somalia — Two Somali operatives have emerged as key figures in the expanding relationship between Al-Shabaab and Yemen’s Houthis, helping facilitate weapons procurement, military training and contacts across the Gulf of Aden, according to separate investigations. Jibril Yahya Ali, known as Gacaamey or “One-Armed”, operated in Yemen as an Al-Shabaab liaison with Houthi commanders. Sheikh Ahmed Elmi Samatar later became a more senior envoy involved in weapons requests and training arrangements. Their roles are detailed in a Wall Street Journal investigation and a separate Century International report , which provide some of the clearest accounts of how contacts between the two militant groups developed. US and Somali officials have also described growing cooperation involving weapons, drone technology and military training. Jibril, the Yemen liaison Jibril had moved between Somalia and Yemen for years and was 38 when he was killed in eastern Yemen in February. According to the Journal, he studied veterinary medicine in Yemen before running a charity in Mogadishu and owning a foreign-exchange outlet and an import-export company. Gunshot wounds left him with scars that earned him the nickname Gacaamey, roughly meaning “one-armed”, although he had both arms. Matt Bryden, a former United Nations official who monitored arms flows to Somalia, told an intelligence briefing in June that Jibril had travelled clandestinely between Somalia and Yemen and served as Al-Shabaab’s liaison with Houthi commanders from at least 2023. The Houthis provided him with a furnished apartment in Sanaa, and he attended official Houthi functions, according to the briefing cited by the Journal. A document reviewed by the newspaper also showed that Houthi authorities had issued him a Yemeni passport under an assumed identity. His role went beyond maintaining contacts. The Journal said an arms dealer introduced Jibril to Houthi weapons suppliers, after which he helped procure military-grade weapons for Al-Shabaab and arrange their shipment to Somalia. A Yemeni intelligence assessment reviewed by the newspaper described him as an important figure in strengthening relations between the groups through weapons transfers and exchanges of military expertise. Front companies allegedly disguised weapons as civilian cargo before moving them through Mukalla and other Yemeni ports. Fishing vessels and speedboats then carried the shipments across the Gulf of Aden to poorly monitored stretches of Somalia’s northern coastline. Networks subsequently moved the weapons south towards Al-Shabaab combat units. Samatar, the senior envoy Al-Shabaab expanded the channel in 2024 by sending Sheikh Ahmed Elmi Samatar to Yemen, according to the Journal. The newspaper described Samatar as a more senior representative who worked alongside Jibril and presented Houthi officials with a detailed list of weapons sought by Al-Shabaab. The list included shoulder-fired anti-aircraft missiles, 107mm Katyusha rockets, Dragunov sniper rifles, explosive attack drones, anti-tank missiles and US-made night-vision equipment. A US military intelligence official told the Journal that Al-Shabaab had sought advanced weapons from the Houthis in addition to rifles, machine guns and ammunition. Its report said Yemeni security forces detained him in the southern port city of Mukalla. Bryden told the Journal that Al-Shabaab appointed another representative in Yemen to replace him. Subsequent reporting has documented continued weapons negotiations, training and direct contacts between the two groups. The accounts of Jibril and Samatar show how individual intermediaries helped establish channels across the Gulf of Aden that grew from arms transactions into broader cooperation involving weapons, training and military expertise. items.title: Turkiga oo Soomaaliya ku wareejiyay nidaamka casriga ah ee ALKAR
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa helay nidaam cusub oo hoobiye casri ah oo lagu magacaabo ALKAR 120mm, kaas oo ay soo saarto shirkadda difaaca ee Turkiga ee ASELSAN, taas oo muujinaysa tallaabo cusub oo lagu xoojinayo qalabka iyo awoodda madaafiicda ciidamada Soomaaliya. Tan ayaa noqonaysa markii ugu horreysay ee nidaamkan casriga ah lagu arko agabka milatari ee ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo helitaankiisu uu qayb ka yahay iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca ee sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Ankara. ALKAR 120mm wuxuu ka duwan yahay hoobiyeyaasha caadiga ah, maadaama uu yahay nidaam casri ah oo ku shaqeeya hagitaan iyo xakameyn dhijitaal ah, waxaana loogu talagalay in lagu rakibo gaadiidka taatikada ah ama kuwa gaashaaman ee ciidamada. Nidaamku wuxuu leeyahay awood otomaatig ah oo lagu hagaajiyo dhuunta hoobiyaha, nidaam lagu maareeyo laguna xakameeyo rasaasta iyo hab dib-u-celin ah, taas oo u oggolaanaysa in hawl-gallada madaafiicda loo fuliyo si nidaamsan oo dhaqso badan. Xogta shirkadda ASELSAN ayaa tilmaamaysa in ALKAR uu leeyahay dhuun cabbirkeedu yahay 120mm, halka masaafada ugu badan ee uu rasaasta gaarsiin karo ay ku dhowdahay 8.18 kiiloomitir. ALKAR ayaa sidoo kale loogu tala-galay inuu si degdeg ah ugu diyaar garoobo furista rasaasta, iyadoo nidaamku awood u leeyahay inuu goobta ka dhaqaaqo wax ka yar 10 ilbiriqsi gudahood. Arrintan ayaa sare u qaadaysa dhaq-dhaqaaqa ciidamada iyo badbaadadooda marka ay dhacaan weerarro jawaab ah. Helitaanka qalabkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli iskaashiga milatari ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu sii ballaaranayo, gaar ahaan dhinacyada tababarka, qalabaynta iyo dib-u-dhiska ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed. Nidaamka ALKAR 120mm ayaa sidaas Soomaaliya ugu biiraya qalabka casriga ah ee loo adeegsan karo taageerada madaafiicda, iyadoo awooddiisa iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqiisa laga faa’iideysan karo hawl-gallada ciidamada ay ka wadaan goobaha ay kula dagaallamayaan kooxda Al-Shabaab. The post Turkiga oo Soomaaliya ku wareejiyay nidaamka casriga ah ee ALKAR appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sayga madaxweynaha Tanzania oo geeriyooday iyo Xasan Sheekh oo…
items.description: Dar es Salaam (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Tanzania ayaa xaqiijisay geerida Hafidh Ameir Hassan oo ahaa sayga Madaxweynaha dalkaas, Samia Suluhu Hassan. Hafidh ayaa ahaa qof si weyn uga fogaaday siyaasadda iyo warbaahinta, isagoo inta badan ku mashquuli jiray noloshiisa gaarka ah iyo hawlihiisa caadiga ah. Maadaama uu qabay Madaxweynaha Tanzania, waxaa loogu yeeri jiray “First Gentleman of Tanzania”, oo ah magaca loo isticmaalo ragga ay qabaan haweenka haya xilka madaxweynaha. Hafidh iyo Madaxweyne Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa isku dhalay afar carruur ah. Geeridiisa kaddib, waxaa isa soo tarayay dhambaallada tacsida ee loo dirayay qoyska Madaxweynaha Tanzania. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa tacsi u diray dhiggiisa Tanzania, Samia Suluhu Hassan, isagoo sheegay inuu murugada la qeybsanayo qoyska iyo shacabka dalkaas. Qoraal uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku baahiyay bartiisa X ayuu ku yiri: “Aniga oo ku hadlaya magaca shacabka iyo dowladda Soomaaliya, waxaan halkan tacsi tiiraanyo leh uga diraynaa walaasheen, Madaxweyne Samia Suluhu Hassan. Waxaan la qaybsanaynaa xanuunka iyo murugada ay dareemayaan qoyska madaxtooyada iyo dhammaan shacabka Tansaaniya.” Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya ay xilligan adag garab taagan tahay Tansaaniya, isagoo muujiyay garab-istaagga dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay la wadaagayaan qoyska Madaxweynaha Tanzania. items.title: Wasiirka Qorsheynta oo Qaabilay Ku-simaha Wakiilka UNHCR ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Wasiirka Qorsheynta, Maalgashiga iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamuud Cabdiraxmaan Sheekh Faarax (Beenebeene), ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Ku-xigeenka Wakiilka Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Qaxootiga (UNHCR) ee Soomaaliya, ahna Ku-simaha Wakiilka, Marwo Jing Song. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee ka dhexeeya Wasaaradda Qorsheynta iyo UNHCR, gaar ahaan dhinacyada qorsheynta, isku-duwidda, kormeerka iyo qiimeynta barnaamijyada hay’adda, si ay ula jaanqaadaan mudnaanta ku xusan Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka (NTP). Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca xogta iyo caddaymaha, iyadoo ujeedadu tahay in la taageero qorsheynta iyo go’aan-qaadashada ku saleysan xog sugan. Wasiirka iyo Ku-simaha Wakiilka UNHCR ayaa isku raacay in la horumariyo qaab iskaashi oo cusub, kaas oo si cad u qeexaya meelaha mudnaanta leh, hababka isku-duwidda iyo doorarka labada dhinac, si loo sii xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta loona taageero hirgelinta mudnaanta horumarineed ee qaranka. Sidoo kale, kulanka ayaa lagu gorfeeyay qabanqaabada kulan gaar ah oo lagu maamuusayo 75-guurada Axdiga Qaxootiga ee 1951, kaas oo la qorsheeyay in la qabto inta uu socdo Kalfadhiga Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNGA).

Sidoo kale, kulanka ayaa lagu gorfeeyay qabanqaabada kulan gaar ah oo lagu maamuusayo 75-guurada Axdiga Qaxootiga ee 1951, kaas oo la qorsheeyay in la qabto inta uu socdo Kalfadhiga Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNGA).

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Suudaan oo Wadahadallo Laba Geesood ah ku Yeeshay Qaahira
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaam Cali, ayaa magaalada Qaahira kula kulmay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Suudaan, Mudane Muxyadiin Saalim. Kulanka ayaa ka dhacay hareeraha Kalfadhiga 166-aad ee Caadiga ah ee Golaha Jaamacadda Carabta, kaas oo ka socda magaalada Qaahira ee caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda Carabta ee Masar. Labada Wasiir ayaa ka wada hadlay xoojinta xiriirka laba geesoodka ah ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Suudaan, iyadoo sidoo kale ay is dhaafsadeen aragtiyo ku saabsan xaaladaha iyo isbeddellada ka socda gobolka. Kulanka ayaa lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal, iyadoo Wasiirradu ay dib u xaqiijiyeen taageerada ay u hayaan madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo xorriyadda siyaasadeed ee dalalkooda. Wadahadalladan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso xiriirkeeda dalalka gobolka iyo waddamada xubnaha ka ah Jaamacadda Carabta.

items.title: The Problem Is Deeper Still: Somalia’s Crisis of Political Character and Adverse Selection
items.description: A Rejoinder to “Much Worship, Little Morality” and “The Problem Is Not a Lack of Worship—It Is the Absence of Accountability” By Aweys O. Mohamoud, PhD The recent exchange between Dr Abdurahman Baadiyow and Dayib Sh. Ahmed raises one of the most consequential questions Somalis can ask themselves after more than three decades of state collapse, conflict, fragmentation and repeated attempts at reconstruction: why, after everything we have endured and everything we have tried, do we continue returning to substantially the same political difficulties? Baadiyow begins with a disturbing paradox. Somalia is an overwhelmingly Muslim society in which religious observance remains highly visible, yet the moral consequences one might reasonably expect from that devotion—honesty, justice, compassion, restraint, trustworthiness and concern for the common good—are frequently difficult to discern in public and political life. His question, “What is wrong with us?”, therefore directs attention towards the gulf between worship and moral character. Somalia, he argues, requires leaders whose faith produces morality, whose morality produces integrity, whose integrity produces trust, and whose trust ultimately helps build functioning institutions. Dayib Ahmed’s rejoinder moves the discussion in another important direction. Perhaps, he suggests, the question should not merely be “What is wrong with us?” but “What happened to us?” Decades of violence, displacement, institutional collapse, unresolved grievances and impunity cannot simply be removed from the explanation of contemporary Somali behaviour. Nor can the country’s difficulties be reduced to deficiencies of individual morality. Somalia requires accountability, reconciliation, enforceable laws and institutions capable of restraining the abuse of power. A functioning state cannot depend upon the fortunate accident that whoever occupies public office happens to be a good person. Dayib therefore moves the argument from personal morality towards the structures surrounding power: how leaders are chosen, what constrains them, what consequences follow misconduct, and how institutions can prevent the weaknesses of individuals from becoming weaknesses of the state. There is considerable truth in both arguments, and I see little reason to choose between them. But perhaps there is another question sitting somewhere between Baadiyow’s concern with character and Dayib’s concern with accountability and institutions. What if Somalia’s prolonged catastrophe has produced a political environment that does not merely tolerate destructive human traits but, in important respects, selects for, rewards and reproduces them? What if part of our difficulty is not simply that destructive people sometimes reach positions of authority, but that the rules—formal and informal—governing our competition for power have gradually made certain destructive characteristics politically advantageous? If that possibility has merit, then the Somali predicament may involve something deeper than either individual moral failure or institutional weakness considered separately. It may involve a relationship between character, political selection and institutions, each continuously reinforcing the others. What Has Our History Been Rewarding? I would hesitate to conclude that there is something inherently wrong with Somalis. Greed, arrogance, envy, hatred, dishonesty, prejudice, fear, insecurity and lust for power are not Somali inventions. They belong to the human condition. Every society contains people capable of generosity and greed, humility and arrogance, compassion and cruelty, honesty and deceit, restraint and domination. The useful comparative question is therefore not whether these destructive characteristics exist among Somalis—they obviously do, just as they exist everywhere else—but what our historical and political environment has done with them. Which characteristics have helped people survive, accumulate influence, capture resources, defeat competitors and acquire political office? Conversely, what has happened to those exhibiting restraint, fairness, humility, tolerance and an unwillingness to manipulate communal identities for political advantage? Somalia’s recent history has exposed successive generations to dictatorship, state collapse, civil war, displacement, militia rule, violent extremism, poverty, institutional weakness, political fragmentation and fierce competition over resources and public office. It would be extraordinary if decades of such experiences had left political behaviour untouched. Under prolonged conditions of insecurity, behaviours that are socially destructive over the long term may nevertheless become individually rational over the short term. Suspicion may appear safer than trust. Kinship solidarity may offer greater immediate protection than abstract citizenship. Political aggression may outperform compromise. Patronage may secure loyalty more rapidly than impartial administration. Ruthlessness may defeat restraint. Manipulation may defeat honesty. Accumulating power may appear safer than surrendering it. What begins as adaptation to insecurity can gradually become habit; what becomes habitual can acquire social legitimacy; and what acquires legitimacy can eventually become embedded in political practice. At that point we are confronting something more complicated than individual moral failure. We are confronting a selection problem. Every political system selects. It determines, formally and informally, what kinds of people are attracted to public office, which behaviours help them reach it, which behaviours enable them to remain there, and what happens to people who refuse to play according to those rules. Suppose a political marketplace disproportionately rewards lust for power, domination, unrestrained ambition, corruption, exploitation, narcissism, contempt, vindictiveness, deceit, tribal mobilisation and intolerance. What kinds of personalities will gradually become overrepresented within that marketplace? And what happens to someone displaying the opposite characteristics—service-mindedness, respect for autonomy, disciplined ambition, integrity, fairness, humility, empathy, mercy, truthfulness, solidarity and tolerance? The uncomfortable possibility is that the second person may be morally better equipped to govern Somalia while being politically less equipped to capture power within the system Somalia has created. This is what I would describe as adverse political selection. The danger is that such selection can become self-reinforcing. Weak institutions encourage destructive political competition; destructive political competition rewards those most capable of succeeding within it; those who succeed may then manipulate or further weaken institutions to preserve their advantage; weakened institutions deepen insecurity and distrust; insecurity increases dependence upon clan, factional and personal networks; and those networks further obstruct the development of impartial institutions. Around the circle we go. Greed becomes the accumulation of public resources. Lust for power becomes an inability to imagine political life outside office. Domination becomes exclusion. Unrestrained ambition becomes willingness to bend institutions towards personal survival. Corruption becomes patronage. Tribalism becomes a technology of political mobilisation. Suspicion becomes strategy. Dishonesty becomes tactical communication. Vindictiveness becomes the punishment of opponents. These are no longer merely private defects of character. Once combined with political authority, they become institutional forces. This is why political character matters so profoundly. Power is a multiplier of character. The arrogance of a private citizen may damage a handful of relationships; the arrogance of a president may affect appointments, constitutional arrangements, security policy and national reconciliation. An ordinary person’s greed has limited reach; the greed of someone controlling substantial public resources can impoverish thousands. A citizen’s prejudice is morally objectionable; the prejudice of somebody controlling the machinery of government can reshape the state itself. Consequently, the question of character cannot simply be dismissed as moral sermonising. Nor, however, can character substitute for institutions. The challenge is to understand how the two interact. Why Leadership Must Be the Immediate Point of Intervention If destructive tendencies have become widespread across society, there is very little that can realistically be done to transform an entire population in the short term. Moral and cultural transformation is generational work. Somalia cannot postpone state-building until millions of citizens have undergone some collective moral reformation. The immediate intervention must therefore occur where individual behaviour has the greatest multiplier effect: among the political elite and those entrusted with public authority. This does not absolve ordinary citizens. items.title: BREAKING NEWS: Southwest Reconciliation Efforts Gain Momentum as Laftagareen Signals Path Toward Political Settlement
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) — A potentially significant breakthrough has emerged from renewed efforts to resolve the political and security crisis in Somalia’s Southwest State, raising fresh hopes that a peaceful settlement could finally bring an end to the bloodshed and suffering in Baidoa. WardheerNews has learned that senior Somali lawmakers from Southwest State, led by former Speaker of the House of the People Dr. Mohamed Mursal Sheikh Abdirahman, have held direct talks in Nairobi with former Southwest President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen as part of an intensive reconciliation initiative. The discussions have focused on one urgent objective: finding a political compromise capable of ending the confrontation and protecting civilians who have borne the heaviest cost of the conflict. The parliamentary delegation had previously met President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Speaker Abdulkadir M. Nur (Jaamac) to explore a peaceful and sustainable solution to the crisis in Southwest State. The message emerging from the consultations is increasingly clear: there can be no lasting solution through military confrontation alone. Southwest State’s civilian population has endured displacement, insecurity, food shortages and severe disruption as political tensions have escalated, particularly in Baidoa and surrounding areas. The latest reconciliation effort therefore carries significance far beyond the political ambitions of individual leaders. It is ultimately about stopping further suffering and preventing the conflict from becoming even more deeply rooted in society. Laftagareen Offers a Possible Exit Laftagareen has continued to maintain that he remains the legitimate president of Southwest State, arguing that he was removed through the use of federal military power rather than defeated through a legitimate electoral process. He has also rejected the authority of Aadan Mohamed Nur (Aadan Madoobe) as the legitimate leader of Southwest State. But despite those longstanding differences, Laftagareen has reportedly put forward a proposal that could open the door to a negotiated settlement. Laftagareen’s position is that both sides should be prepared to relinquish their competing claims to the presidency and agree on a neutral transitional figure acceptable to all parties. Under the proposal, the interim leader would oversee a broader reconciliation process, work toward separating the forces aligned with the rival camps and help establish the security conditions necessary to restore stability in Baidoa and across Southwest State. For a conflict that has increasingly threatened to become entrenched, the proposal represents a potentially important opening. Mursal Emerges as a Possible Bridge Those involved in the discussions reportedly view former Speaker Dr. Mohamed Mursal Sheikh Abdirahman as a figure capable of bridging the divide. His role in facilitating the reconciliation initiative and his political and military background could potentially make him acceptable to competing sides. That possibility, if confirmed through further consultations, could provide the process with something it has desperately needed: a mediator trusted enough to bring adversaries into the same political room without requiring either side to surrender its dignity. The objective should not be to produce another political winner and loser. It should be to produce a settlement in which Southwest State wins. A Conflict That Has Become Too Dangerous to Continue The crisis in Baidoa has already taken on social and clan dimensions, increasing the danger that a political dispute could evolve into a much broader conflict. Every additional week of confrontation risks more displacement, deeper community divisions, greater humanitarian suffering and further bloodshed. That is why the latest reconciliation initiative deserves serious national attention. The immediate priorities should be straightforward: Stop the fighting. Separate the rival forces. Protect civilians. Open an inclusive political dialogue. And establish a credible reconciliation process in which all sides can participate on equal terms. A Chance to Turn the Page The emerging talks offer something Southwest State has desperately needed: a reason for hope. The people of Baidoa and surrounding communities not have to choose between rival political authorities while living under the shadow of armed confrontation. Nor should Somalia accept another cycle in which political disagreements are settled through military force, only for the resulting grievances to produce another conflict year later. Southwest State needs a political settlement built on compromise, reconciliation and mutual recognition—not another military victory. The proposed transitional arrangement may not solve every disagreement overnight. But if the parties are genuinely prepared to compromise, it could provide the bridge toward a broader political settlement and a return to stability. For now, the most encouraging development is that dialogue appears to be replacing confrontation as the preferred path forward. After months of fear, displacement and uncertainty, that alone is reason for optimism. The people of Southwest State have suffered enough. The opportunity now before Somalia’s political leaders is not simply to negotiate a political agreement—it is to stop the bloodshed, restore hope and give Baidoa a chance to breathe again. Peace may finally have a door open in Nairobi. The challenge now is for all sides to walk through it. items.title: Israel Places Somaliland Under Its Highest Travel Warning—Despite Growing Ties
items.description: Hargeisa (WDN) — In a striking contradiction, Israel has placed Somaliland under Level 4 travel warning, the highest and most severe category in its national travel advisory system, effectively advising its citizens to stay away from the territory. Under the warning, Israeli citizens are prohibited from traveling to Somaliland, while Israelis already there are being urged to leave immediately. The advisory also warns against entering or even transiting through areas classified under Level 4. The decision places Somaliland among destinations Israel considers to present an extremely serious security risk, signaling that Israeli authorities do not consider travel or continued civilian presence there sufficiently safe. A Remarkable Diplomatic Contradiction The warning is drawing particular attention because Somaliland has increasingly presented itself as a friendly partner of Israel and has publicly expressed support for closer relations with the Israeli state. Israeli flags have also appeared at public events in Somaliland, symbolizing what supporters describe as an increasingly warm relationship between the two sides. Yet the latest Israeli security assessment sends a very different message. Somaliland may be welcoming Israel—but Israel is warning its citizens to stay away from Somaliland. That contrast has raised questions about how the two sides perceive the security environment and whether Somaliland’s diplomatic outreach has translated into greater confidence from Israel itself. The Level 4 designation is not an ordinary travel caution. It represents the most severe category of Israel’s travel-warning system and reflects an assessment that the security risks are sufficiently serious to warrant a prohibition on travel. For Israeli citizens already inside a Level 4 area, the recommendation to leave adds another layer of urgency. The advisory therefore goes beyond warning travelers to exercise caution. It effectively says: do not go—and if you are already there, get out. The development inevitably raises a politically sensitive question. If Somaliland has gone out of its way to demonstrate friendship toward Israel, why does Israel now classify Somaliland among destinations carrying its highest security warning? The answer may lie less in diplomatic relations than in Israel’s independent assessment of security threats in the region. A government can maintain friendly political relations with a territory while simultaneously determining that conditions there pose unacceptable risks to its citizens. The contrast is nevertheless striking. Somaliland’s public embrace of Israel and Israel’s decision to place Somaliland under its highest travel warning represent two very different assessments of the relationship’s security environment. The advisory does not necessarily indicate a breakdown in diplomatic ties. But it does demonstrate that political friendship does not automatically translate into a favorable security assessment. For Somaliland, which has sought to portray its relationship with Israel as evidence of growing international engagement, the Level 4 warning is an uncomfortable development. It raises a difficult question that Somaliland authorities will inevitably face: why does a territory presenting itself as a safe and welcoming partner to Israel remain classified by Israel itself as one of the places its citizens should not visit? For now, the answer lies in Israel’s security assessment—and the contradiction speaks louder than the diplomatic symbolism. It represents the most severe category of Israel’s travel-warning system and reflects an assessment that the security risks are sufficiently serious to warrant a prohibition on travel. For Israeli citizens already inside a Level 4 area, the recommendation to leave adds another layer of urgency. The advisory therefore goes beyond warning travelers to exercise caution. It effectively says: do not go—and if you are already there, get out. The development inevitably raises a politically sensitive question. If Somaliland has gone out of its way to demonstrate friendship toward Israel, why does Israel now classify Somaliland among destinations carrying its highest security warning? The answer may lie less in diplomatic relations than in Israel’s independent assessment of security threats in the region. A government can maintain friendly political relations with a territory while simultaneously determining that conditions there pose unacceptable risks to its citizens. The contrast is nevertheless striking. Somaliland’s public embrace of Israel and Israel’s decision to place Somaliland under its highest travel warning represent two very different assessments of the relationship’s security environment. The advisory does not necessarily indicate a breakdown in diplomatic ties. But it does demonstrate that political friendship does not automatically translate into a favorable security assessment. For Somaliland, which has sought to portray its relationship with Israel as evidence of growing international engagement, the Level 4 warning is an uncomfortable development. It raises a difficult question that Somaliland authorities will inevitably face: why does a territory presenting itself as a safe and welcoming partner to Israel remain classified by Israel itself as one of the places its citizens should not visit? For now, the answer lies in Israel’s security assessment—and the contradiction speaks louder than the diplomatic symbolism. items.title: Qoysaska 10 Pakistani ah oo lagu haysto Soomaaliya oo ku hanjabay arrin yaab leh
items.description: Karachi (Caasimada Online) – Qoysaska 10 badmaax oo Pakistani ah oo muddo ka badan afar bilood ay burcad-badeed ku haystaan Soomaaliya ayaa bannaanbax ka dhigay magaalada Karachi, iyagoo dowladda Pakistan ka dalbaday inay degdeg u soo dayso eheladooda. Qoysaska ayaa sheegay inay qaadi doonaan tallaabooyin kale, oo ay ku jirto cunto-ka-soomid, haddii dowladda Pakistan aysan jawaab cad ka bixin dadaallada lagu sii deynayo badmaaxiinta. Tobanka Pakistani-ga ah ayaa ka mid ahaa shaqaalaha markabka shidaalka qaada ee MT Honour 25 , oo ku diiwaangashan calanka Palau, kaas oo burcad-badeed ay 21-kii April ka qabsadeen meel ka baxsan xeebaha Puntland. Mudada ay gacanta burcad-badeedda ku jiraan ayaa hadda ku dhow 140 maalmood, iyadoo qoysaskoodu dhowr jeer ka codsadeen dowladda Pakistan inay dadajiso sidii loo sii deyn lahaa. “Afarta bilood iyo bar waa muddo dheer, waana daalnay hadda,” ayay tiri Ambreen Yousuf, oo seygeeda Syed Hussain Yousuf uu ahaa injineerka labaad ee markabka. “Taasi waa sababta aan maanta bannaanbaxa ugu soo baxnay. Waxaan dowladda ka codsanayaa inay sida ugu dhaqsaha badan oo nabad ah noogu soo celiso tobanka Pakistani. Qoysaskoodu aad bay u walaacsan yihiin,” ayay tiri. Bannaanbaxa ayaa dhacay wax ka yar laba toddobaad kadib markii Ra’iisul Wasaare ku-xigeenka Pakistan Ishaq Dar uu magaalada London kula kulmay Xoghayaha Guud ee Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Badaha (IMO), Arsenio Dominguez, isaga oo ka dalbaday hay’adda “faragelin degdeg ah oo wax ku ool ah” si loo dedejiyo soo celinta badmaaxiinta. Dar ayaa sidoo kale bishii August guddoomiyey kulan heer sare ah oo looga hadlay arrintan, wuxuuna saraakiisha Pakistan faray inay kordhiyaan xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee ay la leeyihiin dowladda Soomaaliya, hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo dhinacyada kale ee gacan ka geysan kara sii deynta badmaaxiinta. Hase yeeshee, qoysaska bannaanbaxa dhigay ayaa sheegay in aan loo soo gudbin xog ku filan oo ku saabsan halka ay marayaan dadaalladaas. Waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in muddo ku dhow bil iyo bar aysan wax xiriir ah la yeelan badmaaxiinta la haysto. “Ku dhowaad 140 maalmood ayaa laga joogaa, welina wax war ah kama hayno dadkeenna,” ayay tiri Mahwish Yasir, oo seygeeda Yasir Khan uu ka mid yahay badmaaxiinta la haysto. “Xiriirkii noogu dambeeyey wuxuu ahaa bil iyo bar ka hor. Wixii markaas ka dambeeyey haba yaraatee lama aanan hadlin.” Mahwish ayaa sheegtay in xiriir la’aantaasi ay qoysaska gelisay walaac weyn, maadaama aysan ogeyn xaaladda caafimaad ee badmaaxiinta iyo duruufaha ay ku nool yihiin. Waxay ka digtay in haddii dowladda aysan siin jawaab cad, qoysasku ay billaabi doonaan cunto ka soomid. “Haddii dowladdu weli jawaab na siin weydo, tallaabada noogu dambeysa waxay noqon doontaa inaan cunto-joojin sameyno,” ayay tiri. Ayesha Ameen, oo seygeeda Ameen bin Shams uu sidoo kale ka mid yahay dadka la haysto, ayaa sheegtay in maqnaanshaha dheer ee aabbayaasha uu saameyn ku yeelanayo carruurta. “Tani waa gabadheyda afar jirka ah, waxaana sidoo kale leeyahay wiil siddeed bilood jira. Waxaan maanta waddooyinka fadhiyaa,” ayay tiri. “Idinka ayaa ii sheegaya saameynta ay arrimahan oo dhan ku yeelanayaan maskaxda carruurtan yar.” Dowladda Pakistan ayaa sheegtay inay waddo dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu sii deynayo badmaaxiinta. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Pakistan ayaa hore u sheegtay in milkiilaha markabka iyo mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliya ay xiriir la leeyihiin burcad-badeedda, iyadoo Islamabad ay codsatay in shaqaalaha markabka loo xaqiijiyo cunto, biyo la cabo iyo waxyaabaha kale ee aas-aasiga ah. Saraakiisha Pakistan ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in howlgal xoog ah oo lagu soo furto badmaaxiinta uu noqon karo mid adag, maadaama markabka uu sido shixnad khatar keeni karta. Obaidullah Khan, oo walaalkiis Rafiullah Khan uu ka mid yahay dadka la haysto, ayaa sheegay in walaalkiis uu ahaa qofka keliya ee dhaqaale ahaan mas’uulka ka ahaa qoyskiisa, oo ay ku jiraan saddex carruur ah. “Meel walba ayaan gargaar u raadinaynaa,” ayuu yiri. “Dowladdu haba yaraatee nagalama soo xiriirin. Ugu yaraan ha noo sheegaan maalin, bil ama toddobaad. Kaliya ha noo sheegaan goorta ay dadkeennu soo noqonayaan.” Qoysasku waxay sheegeen in waxa ugu adag ee ay hadda wajahayaan ay tahay hubanti la’aanta ku saabsan xaaladda eheladooda, iyadoo aysan muddo dheer helin wax war ah oo toos ah. “Codsigeenna keliya waa: fadlan dadkeenna sida ugu dhaqsaha badan noogu soo daaya,” ayay tiri Ayesha Ameen. “Intee in le’eg ayaad weli samirkeenna tijaabin doontaan?” The post Qoysaska 10 Pakistani ah oo lagu haysto Soomaaliya oo ku hanjabay arrin yaab leh appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wadahadalo lagu soo afjarayo collaadda Koonfur Galbeed oo ka dhacay Nairobi
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) — Rajo cusub ayaa soo baxaysa kaddib markii ay dardar yeesheen dadaallada lagu doonayo in xal siyaasaddeed iyo mid nabadeed loo helo xiisadda amni iyo siyaasaddeed ee ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, iyada oo ay muuqata fursad cusub oo lagu soo afjari karo colaadda iyo dhibaatada muddada dheer ka taagnayd magalaada Baydhabo iyo deegaanda ka ag dhow. War ay heshay WardheerNews ayaa sheegaya in xildhibaano ka soo jeeda Koonfur Galbeed, oo uu hoggaaminayo Guddoomiyihii hore ee Golaha Shacabka Dr. Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan, ay magaalada Nairobi wadahadallo toos ah kula yeesheen madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen), kulamadaasi oo qayb ka ah dadaallo xooggan oo dib-u-heshiisiin ah. Wadahadallada ayaa si gaar ah loogu gorfeeyay hal ujeeddo oo muhiim ah: in la helo tanaasul siyaasaddeed oo soo afjara, iska horimaadka, isla markaana badbaadin kara shacabka oo noqday kuwa ugu badan ee ay colaaddani saameysay. Fursad Cusub oo Nabadeed Ergada baarlamaanka ayaa horey kulamo ula yeeshay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), iyagoo kala hadlay sidii loo heli lahaa xal waara oo nabaddeed oo lagu soo afjaro xiisadda Koonfur Galbeed. Farriinta ka soo baxaysa wada-tashiyada ayaa xoojineysa: in collaad iyo awood ciidan lagu gaari karin xal waara. Shacabka Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan dadka ku nool Baydhabo iyo deegaannada ku xeeran, ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay wajahaya barakac, amni-darro, cunto yari iyo jahawareer nololleed oo ka dhashay sii xumaanshaha xaaladda siyaasaddeed. Sidaas darteed, dadaallada cusub ee dib-u-heshiisiintu ma aha arrin ku kooban kulamo siyaasaddeed, balse waxa muhiim ah in la joojiyo dhibaatada shacabka, lana hor istaago in khilaaf siyaasadeed uu isu beddelo colaad bulshada dhexdeeda xididdo ku yeelata. Laftagareen ayaa weli ku adkeysanaya in uu yahay madaxweynaha sharciga ah ee Koonfur Galbeed, isaga oo ku dooddaya in xilka looga qaaday awood ciidan oo federaal ah, halkii looga adkaan lahaa hannaan doorasho oo sharci ah. Sidoo kale, waxa uu diiddan yahay in Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) loo aqoonsado hoggaamiyaha sharciga ah ee Koonfur Galbeed. Hase yeeshee, inkastoo ay jiraan khilaafaad siyaasaddeed oo qoto dheer, Laftagareen ayaa la sheegay in uu soo bandhigay fikrad keeni karta in dhinacyadu isugmiiska wada-hadalka. Soo jeedintiisa ayaa ah in labada dhinac ay ka tanaasulaan sheegashada madaxtinnimada, isla markaana lagu heshiiyo shaqsi dhex-dhexaad ah oo loo xil saaro hoggaaminta marxalad ku-meel-gaar ah oo ay dhammaan dhinacyadu ku qanacsan yihiin. Sida qorshuhu dhigayo, hoggaanka ku-meel-gaarka ah wuxuu dusha ka saari karaa hawsha dib-u-heshiisiinta, kala fogeynta ciidamada ay kala taageeraan dhinacyada is haya, iyo abuurista jawi amni oo u saamaxaya Baydhabo iyo guud ahaan Koonfur Galbeed inay dib ugu soo laabtaan xasillooni. Haddii qorshahan uu helo taageero siyaasadeed oo ballaaran, wuxuu noqon karaa fursad muhiim ah oo lagu jebiyo wareegga colaadda iyo is-aaminaad-darrada. Dadka ku lugta leh dadaallada dib-u-heshiisiinta ayaa la sheegay inay Dr. Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan u arkaan shaqsi awood u leh inuu hormuud ka noqon karo isku xirta dhinacyada isku haya Koonfur Galbeed. Khibraddiisa siyaasaddeed iyo doorkiisa uu ka qaadanayo dadaallada socda ayaa suuragal ka dhigi kara in ay dhinacyadu wada aqbali karaan. Haddii arrintan lagu heshiiyo, Mursal wuxuu noqon karaa qofka loo baahan yahay si labada dhinac loogu keeno hal miis, iyadoo aan midkoodna dareemin in laga adkaaday ama sharaftiisa siyaasadeed la dhaawacay. Ujeeddadu ma aha in la abuuro guuleyste iyo guuldarreyste cusub. Ujeeddadu waa in la helo heshiis ay Koonfur Galbeed iyo shacabkeedu ku guuleystaan. Xiisadda Baydhabo waxay durba yeelatay dhinacyo bulsho iyo kuwo beelleed, taas oo sare u qaadaysa khatarta ah in khilaaf siyaasadeed uu isu beddelo colaad ka ballaaran loollanka madaxda. Toddobaad kasta oo dagaal ama iska horimaad siyaasaddeed sii socdaa wuxuu keeni karaa barakac hor leh, kala fogaansho bulsho, dhibaato bani’aadamnimo iyo dhiig dambe oo daata. Taasi waa sababta dadaalladan cusub ee dib-u-heshiisiintu u yihiin kuwo xasaasi ah oo mudan in si dhab ah loo taageero. Waxa ugu horreeya ee loo baahan yahay waa: In dagaalka la joojiyo. Ciidamada la kala fogeeyo. Shacabka la ilaaliyo. Wadahadal loo dhan yahay la furo. Lana dhiso hannaan dib-u-heshiisiin oo lagu kalsoonaan karo, kaas oo dhammaan dhinacyadu si siman uga qayb qaadan karaan. Fursad Lagu Soo Afjaro Bogga Colaadda Wadahadallada Nairobi waxay Koonfur Galbeed siinayaan waxa ay muddada dheer u baahnayd: rajo cusub. Dadka Baydhabo iyo deegaannada ku xeeran ma mudna inay ku noolaadaan cabsi iyo hub, iyagoo lagu khasbayo inay kala doortaan maamullo siyaasadeed oo iska soo horjeeda. Soomaaliyana ma awooddo inay mar kale gasho wareeg ah in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xalliyo awood ciidan, kaddibna dhaawacyada ka dhasha ay abuuraan colaad cusub sannado kadib. Koonfur Galbeed waxay u baahan tahay heshiis siyaasadeed oo ku dhisan tanaasul, dib-u-heshiisiin iyo is-aqbalid, ee uma baahna guul ciidan oo dhinac keliya u soo hoyata. Heshiiska ku-meel-gaarka ah ma xallin karo dhammaan khilaafaadka hal maalin gudaheed. Hase yeeshee, haddii dhinacyadu si dhab ah ugu diyaar garoobaan tanaasul, wuxuu noqon karaa buundada looga gudbo khilaafka looguna tallaabo xasillooni iyo heshiis siyaasadeed oo waara. Waxa ugu farxadda badan ee hadda muuqda ayaa ah in wada-hadalku uu bilaabayo inuu beddelo iska horimaadka, halka miiska siyaasadduna uu dib uga horreynayo goobta dagaalka. Kaddib bilo ay shacabka Koonfur Galbeed ku jireen cabsi, barakac iyo hubanti la’aan, tallaabadan cusub waxay soo celin kartaa kalsoonidii iyo rajadii laga qabay in xal nabadeed la heli karo. Shacabka Koonfur Galbeed dhib ku filan ayay soo mareen. Fursadda maanta hor taalla hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaaliyeed ma aha oo keliya inay heshiis siyaasaddeed gaaraan; waa inay joojiyaan dhiigga daadanaya, soo celiyaan rajada shacabka, ayna Baydhabo siiyaan fursad ay mar kale ugu neefsato nabad iyo xasillooni. Nabadda waxay u muuqataa inay albaab ka heshay wada hadal. Waxa hadda loo baahan yahay waa in dhammaan dhinacyadu ay si geesinimo leh uga soo gudbaan albaabkaas, una socdaan dhinaca heshiis, cafis iyo dib-u-heshiisiin. Koonfur Galbeed waxay u baahan tahay nabad, Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay heshiis, shacabka Baydhabo-na waxay mudan yihiin fursad ay mustaqbalkooda ku dhistaan iyagoo aan ka baqayn dagaal iyo kala qaybsanaan. Hase yeeshee, inkastoo ay jiraan khilaafaad siyaasaddeed oo qoto dheer, Laftagareen ayaa la sheegay in uu soo bandhigay fikrad keeni karta in dhinacyadu isugmiiska wada-hadalka. Soo jeedintiisa ayaa ah in labada dhinac ay ka tanaasulaan sheegashada madaxtinnimada, isla markaana lagu heshiiyo shaqsi dhex-dhexaad ah oo loo xil saaro hoggaaminta marxalad ku-meel-gaar ah oo ay dhammaan dhinacyadu ku qanacsan yihiin. Sida qorshuhu dhigayo, hoggaanka ku-meel-gaarka ah wuxuu dusha ka saari karaa hawsha dib-u-heshiisiinta, kala fogeynta ciidamada ay kala taageeraan dhinacyada is haya, iyo abuurista jawi amni oo u saamaxaya Baydhabo iyo guud ahaan Koonfur Galbeed inay dib ugu soo laabtaan xasillooni. Haddii qorshahan uu helo taageero siyaasadeed oo ballaaran, wuxuu noqon karaa fursad muhiim ah oo lagu jebiyo wareegga colaadda iyo is-aaminaad-darrada. Dadka ku lugta leh dadaallada dib-u-heshiisiinta ayaa la sheegay inay Dr. Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan u arkaan shaqsi awood u leh inuu hormuud ka noqon karo isku xirta dhinacyada isku haya Koonfur Galbeed. Khibraddiisa siyaasaddeed iyo doorkiisa uu ka qaadanayo dadaallada socda ayaa suuragal ka dhigi kara in ay dhinacyadu wada aqbali karaan. Haddii arrintan lagu heshiiyo, Mursal wuxuu noqon karaa qofka loo baahan yahay si labada dhinac loogu keeno hal miis, iyadoo aan midkoodna dareemin in laga adkaaday ama sharaftiisa siyaasadeed la dhaawacay. Ujeeddadu ma aha in la abuuro guuleyste iyo guuldarreyste cusub. Ujeeddadu waa in la helo heshiis ay Koonfur Galbeed iyo shacabkeedu ku guuleystaan. Xiisadda Baydhabo waxay durba yeelatay dhinacyo bulsho iyo kuwo beelleed, taas oo sare u qaadaysa khatarta ah in khilaaf siyaasadeed uu isu beddelo colaad ka ballaaran loollanka madaxda. Toddobaad kasta oo dagaal ama iska horimaad siyaasaddeed sii socdaa wuxuu keeni karaa barakac hor leh, kala fogaansho bulsho, dhibaato bani’aadamnimo iyo dhiig dambe oo daata. Taasi waa sababta dadaalladan cusub ee dib-u-heshiisiintu u yihiin kuwo xasaasi ah oo mudan in si dhab ah loo taageero. Waxa ugu horreeya ee loo baahan yahay waa: In dagaalka la joojiyo. Ciidamada la kala fogeeyo. Shacabka la ilaaliyo. Wadahadal loo dhan yahay la furo. Lana dhiso hannaan dib-u-heshiisiin oo lagu kalsoonaan karo, kaas oo dhammaan dhinacyadu si siman uga qayb qaadan karaan. Fursad Lagu Soo Afjaro Bogga Colaadda Wadahadallada Nairobi waxay Koonfur Galbeed siinayaan waxa ay muddada dheer u baahnayd: rajo cusub. Dadka Baydhabo iyo deegaannada ku xeeran ma mudna inay ku noolaadaan cabsi iyo hub, iyagoo lagu khasbayo inay kala doortaan maamullo siyaasadeed oo iska soo horjeeda. Soomaaliyana ma awooddo inay mar kale gasho wareeg ah in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xalliyo awood ciidan, kaddibna dhaawacyada ka dhasha ay abuuraan colaad cusub sannado kadib. Koonfur Galbeed waxay u baahan tahay heshiis siyaasadeed oo ku dhisan tanaasul, dib-u-heshiisiin iyo is-aqbalid, ee uma baahna guul ciidan oo dhinac keliya u soo hoyata. Heshiiska ku-meel-gaarka ah ma xallin karo dhammaan khilaafaadka hal maalin gudaheed. Hase yeeshee, haddii dhinacyadu si dhab ah ugu diyaar garoobaan tanaasul, wuxuu noqon karaa buundada looga gudbo khilaafka looguna tallaabo xasillooni iyo heshiis siyaasadeed oo waara. Waxa ugu farxadda badan ee hadda muuqda ayaa ah in wada-hadalku uu bilaabayo inuu beddelo iska horimaadka, halka miiska siyaasadduna uu dib uga horreynayo goobta dagaalka. Kaddib bilo ay shacabka Koonfur Galbeed ku jireen cabsi, barakac iyo hubanti la’aan, tallaabadan cusub waxay soo celin kartaa kalsoonidii iyo rajadii laga qabay in xal nabadeed la heli karo. Shacabka Koonfur Galbeed dhib ku filan ayay soo mareen. Fursadda maanta hor taalla hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaaliyeed ma aha oo keliya inay heshiis siyaasaddeed gaaraan; waa inay joojiyaan dhiigga daadanaya, soo celiyaan rajada shacabka, ayna Baydhabo siiyaan fursad ay mar kale ugu neefsato nabad iyo xasillooni. Nabadda waxay u muuqataa inay albaab ka heshay wada hadal. Waxa hadda loo baahan yahay waa in dhammaan dhinacyadu ay si geesinimo leh uga soo gudbaan albaabkaas, una socdaan dhinaca heshiis, cafis iyo dib-u-heshiisiin. Koonfur Galbeed waxay u baahan tahay nabad, Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay heshiis, shacabka Baydhabo-na waxay mudan yihiin fursad ay mustaqbalkooda ku dhistaan iyagoo aan ka baqayn dagaal iyo kala qaybsanaan. items.title: Somalia Calls on International Community for Support in Fight Against Piracy
items.description: MOGADISHU— Somalia’s Federal Government has warned that federal member states that fail to comply with the country’s national framework for maritime security will be held accountable, as Mogadishu moves to strengthen cooperation with international partners to counter piracy and illegal fishing along the country’s coastline. In a statement issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Federal Government said it intends to seek support from the United Nations Security Council for operations aimed at combating piracy and other maritime threats that have emerged along the coast of Puntland. The government pointed to the recent release of the MV Lutuf as an example of international cooperation in Somalia’s maritime security efforts, saying the operation was conducted with the assistance of Turkish forces deployed off the Somali coast. “Somalia’s maritime security cooperation is implemented in coordination with the Federal Government and is based on cooperation with the federal member states under a unified national security framework with clear accountability,” the ministry said. The government also reiterated that illegal fishing and violations of Somalia’s maritime laws would not be permitted. “Somalia’s marine resources are governed by Somali law, while illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing constitutes a violation of Somalia’s sovereign rights as recognized under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS),” the statement said. The Federal Government’s warning comes as tensions continue between Mogadishu and Puntland over maritime security arrangements and agreements between Somalia and Turkey. Puntland has previously said it does not recognize or intend to comply with certain agreements and arrangements reached by the Federal Government with Turkey concerning maritime security and the protection of Somalia’s territorial waters. The latest statement from Mogadishu underscores the Federal Government’s push for a coordinated national approach to maritime security, while reaffirming its authority over Somalia’s territorial waters and marine resources. The government said cooperation with international partners would remain central to efforts to combat piracy, illegal fishing and other maritime threats along Somalia’s coastline. items.title: Ciidanka Danab oo Fashiliyay Koox Shabaab ah oo Miinooyin Diyaarinaysay Gobolka Jubada Hoose
items.description: Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamiga ah, ayaa hawlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyay deegaanka u dhow Harboole ee degmada Afmadow, Gobolka Jubada Hoose. Sida lagu sheegay war kasoo baxay ciidamada, hawlgalka ayaa lagu beegsaday xubno ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab oo ku howlanaa diyaarinta iyo aasidda miinooyinka nooca loo yaqaan IED-yada, kuwaas oo la qorsheeyay in lagu waxyeelleeyo waddooyinka ay isticmaalaan gaadiidka rayidka ah. Ciidamada Danab ayaa ku guuleystay inay carqaladeeyaan qorshaha kooxdaasi, iyadoo hawlgalku qayb ka yahay dadaallada socda ee lagu sugayo ammaanka shacabka iyo isku socodka gaadiidka ee deegaannada Gobolka Jubada Hoose. War-saxaafadeedka ciidamada laguma sheegin faahfaahin ku saabsan khasaaraha ka dhashay hawlgalka. Gobolka Jubada Hoose ayaa muddo dheer ahaa goob ay ka socdaan hawlgallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kuwa saaxiibada la ah ay sii wadaan cadaadiska militari ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda kooxda. Deegaannada miyiga iyo kaymaha gobolka ayaa kooxda hore ugu adeegsan jirtay saldhigyo ay ka qorsheeyaan weerarro iyo falal amni-darro, gaar ahaan waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee isku xira deegaannada Jubada Hoose iyo xuduudda Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. Hawlgalka ugu dambeeyay ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda Khawaarijta, laguna xoojinayo ammaanka shacabka, ganacsiga iyo isu socodka bulshada ee koonfurta dalka.

DF Soomaaliya iyo Kenya oo wada-hadallo cusub yeeshay, kuna heshiiyay…
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Soomaaliya iyo Kenya ayaa qaaday tallaabo cusub oo lagu xoojinayo isku xirka kaabayaasha labada dal, kaddib markii ay ku heshiiyeen in la dardar-geliyo qorshe lagu sii ballaarinayo waddada muhiimka ah ee Isiolo-Mandera, iyadoo la doonayo in isku xirnaanta laga sii ambaqaado gudaha Soomaaliya. Qorshahan ayaa la filayaa inuu abuuro marin cusub oo dhinacyada ganacsiga, isgaarsiinta iyo amniga ah, kaas oo Soomaaliya iyo Kenya ka dhigi kara kuwo si dhow isugu xiran, isla markaana qayb ka noqon kara isku socodka iyo ganacsiga gobolka Geeska Afrika. Is-afgaradka ayaa soo baxay kaddib kulan Nairobi ku dhex-maray safiirka Soomaaliya ee Kenya, Jabril Cabdulle iyo xoghayaha joogtada ah ee wasaaradda waddooyinka Kenya, Joseph Mbugua, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada-hadleen sidii mashruuca loo gaarsiin lahaa Soomaaliya. Labada mas’uul ayaa isla qaatay in la sameeyo guddi farsamo oo ay si wadajir ah u dhisayaan Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. Guddiga ayaa qaabilsan dardar-gelinta wada-hadallada ku saabsan ku biirista Soomaaliya ee Horn of Africa Gateway Development Project (HoAGDP), oo ay maalgeliso Bangiga Adduunka. Sidoo kale, waxaa la isku raacay in la qabto kulan heer sare ah oo ay ka qeyb-galaan labada dal, kaas oo diiradda lagu saari doono qorshayaasha hirgelinta iyo tallaabooyinka xiga ee mashruuca. Safiir Jabril Cabdulle ayaa soo dhaweeyay qorshaha Soomaaliya loogu dari lahaa mashruuca, isaga oo sheegay in uu wax weyn ka tari karo xiriirka dhaqaale iyo isku socodka labada dal. “Mashruucan wuxuu fududeyn doonaa ganacsiga xuduudaha, wuxuu horumarin doonaa isku xirka fiber-optic-ga gobolka, wuxuuna furi doonaa fursado dhaqaale oo badan oo ay ka faa’iideystaan bulshada labada dal,” ayuu yiri safiirka. Mashruuca HoAGDP ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh waddada Isiolo-Mandera, oo muddo sanado ah laga shaqeynayay dhismaheeda iyo casriyeynteeda, hase yeeshee caqabado dhinaca amniga iyo hirgelinta ah ayaa saameeyay qaybo ka mid ah qorshaha. Bangiga Adduunka ayaa sanadkii 2020 ansixiyay $750 milyan oo loogu tala-galay mashruuca HoAGDP, kaas oo qayb weyn oo ka mid ah qorshihiisu yahay horumarinta waddo dhererkeedu gaarayo 740 kiiloomitir oo isku xiraysa Isiolo iyo Mandera. Qorshaha hore wuxuu ahaa in la casriyeeyo 365 kiiloomitir oo waddadaas ah iyo 30 kiiloomitir oo waddooyin kale ah oo ku xirma, iyadoo mashruuca lagu dari doono kaabayaal fiber-optic ah, xarumaha xuduudaha iyo nidaamyo lagu fududeynayo ganacsiga iyo maamulka xuduudaha. Si kastaba, amniga ayaa weli ah mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn ee ku xeeran mashruuca, gaar ahaan deegaannada waqooyi-bari Kenya. items.title: Dalag biyo la’aan awgeed u qalalay oo hubanti la’aan cunno biday beeraleyda Afgooye
items.description: (ERGO) – Beeraleyda deegaannada Mareerey, Jambaluul iyo Shukurow oo dhanka waqooyi bari kaga beegan degmada Afgooye ayaa wajahaya nolol xumo ka dhalatay dalagyo waraab la’aan uga qasaaray. Farxiya Cabdullaahi Cabdi ayaa sheegtay in ay ka baaba’een khudaar dhowr nooc ah iyo raashin ay filaysay in ay u soo go’aan billowgii bishaan Agoosto. Qasaarahaas wuxuu meesha ka saaray ishii kali ahayd ee nolol-maalmeedka ay uga soo saari jirtay carruurteeda oo lagu furay. Qarash badan ayaa uga baxay abuurka, waraabka iyo falida beerta. Ma awoodo in ay tacab kale galiso, maaddaama welli ay biyo la’aantii jirto ayna gacan maran tahay. Waxaa baaba’day rajadii ay ka qabtay in ay sii wadato wax soo saarkeeda. “Biyihiii wabiga waa gureen, ceelalna kuma yaallaan meeshaan. Dalagaas waxaaan beeranay May xilligaan in uu noo bislaado ayay ahayd, laakiin ma suuragalin.” Faxiya ayaa sheegtay in beertu u ahayd halka meel ee ay ku tiirsanayd nolosha qoyskeeda oo 13 qof ah. Waxay hadda awoodi la’yihiin in ay joogto u helaan biyo iyo cunno ku filan. dalaga qayb ayay iibsan jirtay qaarna reerkaa isticmaali jireen. Sida kali ah ee ay hal mar cunno ku helaan waa dayn ay ka soo qaadato dukaamo ay macaamiil la tahay oo mararka qaar looga soo diido, ama in ay u dan sheegato qaraabo ay ugu badnaan ka hesho $1 oo aan wax fiican u goyn qoyskeeda oo badan. Waxaa ku adkaatay in ay raashin iibsadaan, daymaha in ay bixiso iyo in ay carruurteeda u hesho biyo waxay sheegtay in 20 liitir la iibiyo $0.25, taas oo awoodeeda ka baxsan. Wax yar oo dariska dhaama ku caawiyaan ayay isku celceliyaan. “Xaalada jirta darteed waxaan maalinkii wax ka karsanaa hal mar. Wax soo saarka beerta ayaa naga caawin jiray raashinka iyo kharashaadka kale ee carruurta. Dalagii markuu qasaaray waxaan waayay dhaqaalihii aan ku tiirsanayn.” Faraxiyo ayaa sheegtay in ay ka waxbarasho beeleen 4 carruur ah oo dugsi Qur’aan u dhigan jiray. Waxay 3 bil bixin waysay min $5 oo laga qaadi jiray, taas oo sababtay in la soo eryo horraantii Ogoosto. Haweenaydaan ayaa sheegtay in ay waydiimo badan kala kulmayso dad ku leh lacag $500 oo ay ku bixisay dalagyadii ka qasaaray. Waxaa intaas u wehliya $180 oo raashin, biyo iyo arrad-tir ay carruurta ugu soo qaadanaysay dhowrkii bil ee u danbaysay. “Rajadii aan lahaa ayaa luntay. Dhibaatooyinka na haysta waxaa ugu daran cunnada, carruurta oo waxbarashadii ka haray iyo lacagtii aan beerta galiyay oo la ii haysto. Waxaan filayay faa’iido aan qoyska ku maareeyo, beerashadana ku sii wado, balse iima suuragalin.” Farxiya ayaa sheegtay in aysan lahayn xirfad ay ku shaqaysato si ay carruurteeda cunno ugu hesho. Waxay nolosheeda oo dhan ahayd beeraley ahayd. Xaaladaan adag ayay la qabsan la’yihiin. Biyo yaraanta wabiga ayaa saamayn xoogan ku yeelatay beeralayda ku nool jiinkiisa oo muddo dheer ku tiirsanaa. Waxay gadan la’yihiin shidaalka qaaliga ah si ay ugu waraabsadaan beeraha, taas oo hoos u dhigtay wax soo saarkoodii. Maxamed Xasan Cumar oo ka mid ah beeraleyda qasaaruhu gaaray ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in aysan waxba uga badbaadin dalagyo isugu jiraay galey, masago digir, yaanyo, qare iyo khudaar kale oo beertiisa oo 3 hektar ah uu galiyay bishii shanaad ee sanadkaan. Ninkaan ayaa xusay in uu ku bixiyay dhaqaale badan, isagoo rajaynayay in uu ka heli doono lacag ka badan kharashkii uu geliyay si uu ugu daboolo baahiyaha qoyskiisa iyo daymihii uu galay, balse taasi aysan u hirgalin. “Waxyaaabihii aan ku tiirsanayn ayaan waynay,ganacsiyo ma lihin. Waxaa iga galay qiyaastii $900 oo aanan waxba ka hayn. Raashin iyo khudaar ayaan beeray waa qallaleen. Awal waa cuni jirnya suuqana waa gaysan jirnay.” Maxamed ayaa sheegay in qasaarahaan uu dhinac kasta ka saameeyay nolosha qoyskiisa oo ka kooban 16 qof. Wuxuu xusay in aysan si joogto ah u heli karin cunno ku filan iyo biyo ay isticmaalaan. Waxay biyaha dayn uga soo qaataan ceel gaar ah oo halkii caag la iibiyo $0.25. Raashin min 20 kiilo oo bur, bariis, sonkor iyo digir ah oo uu soo amaahday horraantii Ogoosto ayay hal mar karsadaan maalinkii si uu waqti dheer u gaar siiyo. Toddobaatan dollar oo raashinkaas ah iyo $200 oo horay loogu lahaa ayuu mar kasta waydiiyaa mulkiilaha dukaanku, balse ma bixin karo xilligaan. Maxamed ayaa sheegay in beero ku yaalla deegaanno ka durugsan uu shaqooyin falid ah ka raadiyay, balse uusan waxba ka soo helin. Wuxuu xusay in xaaladaan ay ku sababtay in maalmaha qaar aan dabka loo shidin carruurtiisa oo yar yar u badan. “Waxaan awoodi waayay in aan helo biyaha, cuntada iyo waxbaarashada carruurta. Waxaa nagu dhacay dhaqaale xumo waxkasta oo aan ku noolayn meesha ayay ka baxeen.” Maxamed ayaa sheegay in tan iyo bishii July ay daruus la’aan guriga u joogaan 8 carruur ah Qur’aanka u baranayay. Wuxuu bixin waayay isku darka $40 oo ah qarashkii uu bisha ka dhiibi jiray. Waxbarasho la’aanta ilmihiisa waxay ku haysaa murug, balse xal uma helayo. Dhaqaale xumada ku dhacday waxay sidoo kale saamaysay walaashiis dhimirka ka xanuunsan iyo shan carruur ah oo ay dhashay. Wuxuu xusay in ay nolol xumo wajahayaan, markii uu u awoodi waayay $50 iyo raashin uu bishii siin jiray. Waxay hadda ku tiirsan yihiin dawarsi. Qoyskiisu waxay waligood deganaayeen deegaanka Shukurow ee gobolka Shabeelaha hoose. Beerta oo aabbihiis uu ka dhaxlay ayay ku tiirsanaayeen in ka badan 20 sano, balse qasarahaan ayaa jahwareer galiyay hab nololeedkoodii. Gudoomiyaha iskaashatada beeralayda Dan-wadaag oo dadkaan ay ka tirsan yihiin Cabdi Maxamed Cabdullaahi ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dhibaatadaan ay muujinayso baahida loo qabo in si wadajir ah wax looga qabto biyo la’aanta iyo dayaca kanaallada waraabka. “Arimahaas dartood waxaaa yaraaday faa’iidooyinkii laga heli jiray wax soo saarka.  Iskaashato ahaan waxaan raadinayna xal waraab joogto ah lagu heli karo.” Cabdi ayaa sheegay in caqabadda waraabku waqti dheer soo jirtay, balse ay hadda gaartay heerkii ugu xumaa. Biyaha wabiga oo yaraaday, kannaallada oo muddo dheer aan la dayac-tirin iyo dhaqaale yari beeralayda isku raacday ayuu xusay in ay xaalada sii adkaysay.
