Labada xul ayaa sidoo kale tartanka ku soo bandhigi doona kartidooda iyo xirfadahooda ciyaareed, iyadoo tartankan loo arko mid kaalin muhiim ah ka qaadan kara horumarinta iyo kobcinta ciyaartoyda da’da yar ee Soomaaliyeed. Xiriirka Soomaaliyeed ee Kubadda Cagta ayaa sheegay in ka-qaybgalka Soomaaliya uu qayb ka yahay dadaallada lagu horumarinayo kubadda cagta dalka, gaar ahaan tartamada loogu talagalay ciyaartoyda da’yarta ah. Xiriirka oo uu hoggaamiyo Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Soomaaliyeed ee Kubadda Cagta, Cali Cabdi Maxamed (Cali Shiine) ayaa mudnaan siinaya horumarinta jiilka cusub iyo abuurista fursado ay ciyaartoydu ugu gudbi karaan heerarka sare ee kubadda cagta. Tartanka African Schools Football Championship ayaa sidoo kale fursad u noqonaya ciyaartoyda Soomaaliyeed inay helaan is-dhexgal iyo khibrad caalami ah, iyagoo la kulmaya ciyaartoy da’yar oo ka kala socda dalal kale oo qaaradda Afrika ah. Si kastaba, ka-qaybgalka labada xul ayaa loo arkaa bilow muhiim ah oo Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso joogitaankeeda tartamada kubadda cagta ee qaaradda, iyadoo la rajeynayo in ciyaartoydan da’yarta ah ay mustaqbalka noqdaan xiddigo matala xulka qaranka Soomaaliya. items.title: Towfiiq Rejects Galmudug Repeat-Election Timetable, Questions Credibility of Electoral Commission
items.description: Dhuusamareeb, Somalia (WDN) — The Towfiiq Political Association, led by Sheikh Shakir Ali Hassan, has rejected the timetable announced for repeat elections to Galmudug’s local councils and House of Representatives, arguing that the schedule does not comply with Somalia’s National Elections Law. Towfiiq was the political organization that brought the earlier Galmudug election dispute before the Supreme Court. The party says the court’s ruling, which annulled the contested election, makes it essential that the replacement process be conducted under credible and legally compliant conditions. The latest dispute, however, goes beyond the election calendar. Towfiiq is also calling for the disbandment of the current electoral commission, arguing that the same officials who oversaw the annulled process should not be entrusted with running another electoral cycle. What Towfiiq Is Claiming According to Towfiiq, the timetable announced by unilaterally established Independent Electoral Commission by President Hassan schedules the repeat elections between September 10 and 30, leaving political parties and candidates insufficient time to complete the required electoral procedures. The political association says the deadlines for candidate registration, submission of candidate lists and the campaign period do not provide adequate time under the National Elections Law. Towfiiq has called on the commission to reconsider the timetable and align it with the statutory requirements governing registration, nominations and campaigning. The organization also says the electoral commission itself should be dissolved and replaced. Its argument is that an institution whose previous electoral process ended with a Supreme Court annulment should not automatically be allowed to administer the replacement election. Towfiiq has further called for an election that is transparent, free and fair, with equal preparation time and opportunity for all participating parties and candidates. The significance of Towfiiq’s position extends beyond the number of days allocated to the electoral calendar. The central issue is institutional credibility. A repeat election is intended to resolve a disputed electoral process. If the same institution whose administration of that process was challenged remains responsible for the rerun, questions about the credibility of the new election are likely to persist. That does not, by itself, establish that the commission would necessarily repeat the problems of the previous election. But it creates a legitimate political question about whether a fresh electoral process should also involve a fresh institutional framework. The Supreme Court’s annulment has already placed the previous process under significant legal scrutiny. The credibility of the rerun will therefore depend not only on when it is held, but also on who administers it and whether competing political actors trust the process. The Risk of Repeating the Same Crisis Towfiiq’s rejection creates another challenge for Galmudug’s electoral authorities. If the commission proceeds with the existing timetable and remains in charge, Towfiiq and other critics could continue to question the legitimacy of the process. If the commission revises the timetable or agrees to broader institutional changes, it could help address some of those concerns—but could also delay an election that authorities are seeking to organize quickly. The key question is therefore no longer simply whether Galmudug will hold a repeat election. It is whether the repeat election will be sufficiently lawful, credible and trusted to prevent another cycle of political and legal disputes. Towfiiq’s position is unequivocal: an election annulled by the Supreme Court should not simply be rerun under the same institutional arrangements without addressing the failures that brought the original process into question. Whether the electoral authorities accept that argument will be an important test of Galmudug’s ability to restore confidence in its electoral system. items.title: Civilian Casualties Reported After Shelling Near Jannaale in Lower Shabelle
items.description: JANNALE, Somalia (WDN) — A civilian was reportedly killed and four others wounded after artillery shells struck the village of Dag-wariiri, near Jannaale in Somalia’s Lower Shabelle region, early Wednesday, according to local sources. The sources said the dead was a boy, while those wounded included a woman and three boys. The reported shelling also damaged a community water well or water tank, a house and a vehicle. Livestock belonging to local residents were also reportedly killed, although the number of animals could not immediately be confirmed. Ugandan forces serving under the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) operate in parts of Lower Shabelle alongside Somali government forces fighting Al-Shabaab. Local sources attributed the shelling to Ugandan forces, but there has been no independent confirmation that Ugandan troops were responsible. The circumstances surrounding the incident remain unclear. There is no confirmed information about the intended target, why the area was shelled, or whether the bombardment was directed at an identified Al-Shabaab position. The reported civilian casualties and damage could not independently be verified. The incident highlights a recurring danger for civilians living in Somalia’s conflict zones: when artillery, airstrikes or drone operations are conducted near populated areas, the consequences can fall on people who have no role in the fighting. Even when military forces are targeting suspected militants, inaccurate intelligence, misidentified targets, weapons malfunction or the proximity of civilian homes can turn a military operation into a tragedy for local communities. For residents of areas such as Lower Shabelle, where government and international forces are fighting Al-Shabaab, the distinction between the battlefield and civilian life can be dangerously thin. The reported death of a child and injuries to a woman and three other boys underscore the human cost of that reality. Military operations against Al-Shabaab are an essential part of Somalia’s security campaign, but the protection of civilians must remain a central obligation. Whenever civilians are killed or injured in an artillery or aerial operation, the responsible authorities should establish what happened, identify the intended target, determine whether the operation complied with applicable rules, and explain the findings publicly where security considerations permit. For communities living in conflict areas, accountability is not simply a legal principle. It is essential to maintaining public trust. The reported shelling in Dag-wariiri remains subject to verification. But whether the responsible weapon came from artillery, a drone or another military platform, the larger concern is the same: civilians should not become collateral casualties in Somalia’s fight against Al-Shabaab. items.title: Mareykanka oo qaatay siyaasad cusub oo halis ah oo ka dhan ah IIRAAN
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Xiisadda u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa gashay weji cusub, kadib markii maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu sheegay inuu dejiyay qorshe militari oo jawaab adag looga bixinayo weerarrada lagu qaado maraakiibta isticmaala marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Qorshahan oo ay warbaahinta Axios sheegtay in loogu magac daray “tanker-for-tanker” ayaa dhigaya in Washington ay bartilmaameedsan karto maraakiib shidaal oo ay leedahay dowladda Iran, haddii ciidamada Tehran ay weeraraan ama waxyeello u geystaan maraakiib ganacsi oo maraya marin-biyoodkaasi. Tallaabadan ayay Axios sheegtay inay ka duwan tahay habkii hore ee Mareykanka uu uga falcelin jiray khataraha ka jira Hormuz. Halkii uu xoogga saari lahaa oo keliya ilaalinta maraakiibta ganacsiga, Washington ayaa hadda la sheegay inay doonayso in hantida Iran loo adeegsado bartilmaameedyo jawaab militari. Warbaahinta ayaa sidoo kale xustay in ciidamada Mareykanka ay intii lagu jiray weerarradii ugu dambeeyay beegsadeen laba markab oo shidaal ah oo ay leedahay dowladda Iran. Weerarradaasi ayaa qayb ka ahaa howlgal ballaaran oo lagu qaaday bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla Iran, iyadoo tirada goobaha la weeraray lagu qiyaasay ku dhowaad 100 bartilmaameed. Isbeddelkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xaaladda amni ee Hormuz ay sii xumaanayso. Laba markab oo shidaal siday oo ay leedahay Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa lagu weeraray meel ku dhow marin-biyoodka, waxaana la sheegay in lagu dhuftay waxyaabo qarxa xilli ay halkaasi marayeen, inkastoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin cidda ka dambeysay dhacdada. Iran ayaa iyaduna qaaday weerarro kale oo lagu beegsaday saldhigyo iyo danaha Mareykanka ee gobolka, taasoo sare u qaadday cabsi laga qabo in iska horimaadka labada dal uu ka baxo xadka weerarrada xaddidan, isla markaana uu isu beddelo dagaal ballaaran oo saameeya dalal iyo marinno muhiim ah oo gobolka ku yaalla. Muhiimadda Hormuz ayaa xaaladda ka dhigaysa mid si gaar ah xasaasi u ah, maadaama uu yahay marin muhiim u ah dhoofinta tamarta caalamka, halkaas oo maalin kasta ay maraan malaayiin fuusto oo shidaal ah. Inkastoo, dhaq-dhaqaaqa maraakiibta ganacsiga ayaa si weyn hoos ugu dhacay, iyadoo cabsi laga qabo amni-darrada sii kordheysa. Haddii Washington ay dhaqan-geliso oo ay sii waddo siyaasadda “tanker-for-tanker”, weerar lagu qaado markab shidaal ama ganacsi ayaa yeelan kara jawaab toos ah oo lagu beegsado markab ay leedahay Iran. Arrintan ayaa abuuri karta wareeg cusub oo aargoosi militari ah, waxayna kordhin kartaa khatarta ah in Hormuz uu noqdo goob dagaal oo saameyn weyn ku yeelata isu-socodka maraakiibta iyo qiimaha shidaalka ee suuqyada caalamka. items.title: Gorfayn: Halgan iyo Hoggaan: Taariikhnololeedkii Sheekh Maxamed Xaaji Yuusuf
items.description: Buugga Halgan iyo Hoggaan waxaa la daabacay Julaay 2026. Waxa uu ka koobanyahay 244 bog. Afartanka bog ee u danbeeya waxaa ku qoran faallooyin ay soo gudbiyeen asxaabtii Sheekha. Waxa ay uga hadleen shaqsiyaddiisa wixii ay ka yaqaanneen. Labada boqol ee kale waxaa lagu soo koobay waraysiyo sheekha laga qaaday waqtiyo kala duwan. Buugga waxaa qoray wiil uu sheekhu dhalay oo la yiraahdo Cabdiraxmaan Sheekh Maxamed Xaaji Yuusuf. Cabdiraxmaan waxa uu sheegtay in uusan buuga ku darin wax isaga ka yimid. Wax Alla waxa laga helo labadaas boqol ee bog waa erayadii sheekha oo qoraal loo rogay sida uu nagu yiri Cabdiraxmaan. Waraysiyada salka u ah buugga waa laba qeybood. Qeyb waxaa qaaday Dr Cumar warsame. Buuggu waxa uu tilmaamay in la duubay intii u dhaxaysay Jannaayo 2013 ilaa Juun 2013. Waa waraysiyo qaatay 14 fadhi. Qeybta labaad waxaa duubay Sheekh Cabdullaahi Faarax Taano 2001dii. Sida uu qoruhu sheegay waxa ay ahaayeen laba cajalood. Xogtaas waxa aan ka fahannay in codka sheekha la duubay oo haddii loo baahdo la heli karo. Buugga inta aad akhrinayso ma ogaan kartid xogta lagu siiyay waraysiga ay ku jirto. Tusaale, ma midkii 2001dii baa mise waa kuwii danbe? Lama xusin. Sida laga fahmi karo ciwaanyaraha, buuggu waxa uu ka warramayaa taariikhnololeedkii sheekha. Laakiin Sheekh ma uusan ahayn sheekh ka mid ah culimada Soomaaliyeed e waxa uu ahaa siyaasi xil weyn qabtay go’aannadiisiina ay saamayn waartay oo dhib iyo dheefba leh ku yeelatay dad badan iyo deegaan dhan. Taas ayaa xiiso gaar ah u yeeleysa buugga dadka taariikhda jecelna ku qasbeysa in ay dheegtaan. Buuggu waxa uu ka kooban yahay 8 cuutub. Shanta cutub ee hore, oo qaadatay 88 bog oo buugga ah, waxa ay ka hadlayaan noloshii sheekha dhalashadiisii ilaa uu jaamacad ka baxay iyo shaqooyinkii uu qabtay ilaa burburkii dalka. Waa qeybta xambaarsan qeybta hore ee ciwaanka (Halgan). Sidaa darteed ereyga “halgan” ee ciwaanka ku jira ha u qaadan mid hubeysan oo hoggaan lagu gaaray ee halgankii nolosha iyo waxbarashada ee sheekhu galay. Malaha “harjad” ayaa ku habbooneyd baan is iri. Cashirro badan oo dedaalka sheekha, himiladiisii iyo ragannimadiisii tuseysa ayaa ku muush ka ah. Buuggu waxa uu ku qoranyahay luuqad fudud. Akhriskiisu waa sahal, fartiisu waa fariid, sida uu isu heystana waa heer sare. Tifaftir toolmaan ayaa lagu sameeyay. Habqoraalkiisu ceeb ma leh. Qeybta hore ee buugga waxaa ku jiro dhacdooyin uu si kooban u xusay sheekhu oo sawir naga siinayaa xaaladdii dalka iyo dadka. Tusaale, 1969kii mar uu ku soo laabtay dalka isaga oo Masar ka yimid waxaa uu yiri. “… Waxa aad akaysay aqoonyahanno jaamacado ka soo laabtay oo wada baaga muudda ah oo huteellada wada fadhiya. Qofkii kugu arka baasaboor  una maleeya inaad dibadda ka timid wuxuu ku moodayay in kheyrkii oo dhan laguu dhammeystiray.” Arrintaasi waxa ay na baraysaa in dhibta shaqa-la’aanta ee maanta taagan iyo dhoof jacaylku uu ahaa mid waqti dheer jiray. Sheekhu waxa uu ardaynimo ugu baxay Masar 20/11/1965. Habeenkii bixitaanka marka uu ka hadlayay waxa uu yiri: " “Waxaa xusid mudan in maalintii aan diyaaradda raacaynay, raggii kale ee aan wada soconnay ay wada xirnaayeen jaakad ama suud sida loo yaqaan…. Ma aannan helin. Ma ahayn mid qaali ah laakiin ninka aan tabar hayn ama gacan-qabasho helin culays ayay ku ahayd”. Ilaa maanta qofka soomaaliga ah markii uu dhoofayo waxa uu jecelyahay in uu xirto suud. Waxa aad arkaysaa arday tigidkiisa la qaaraamay oo waalidkiis ku qasbaya in ay suud deyn ah u qaadaan ama ehelka kale ku dhiba in suud loo iibiyo. Sida ka muuqata hadalka sheekha waa arrin waa hore ku biirtay dhaqanka Soomaalida. Sheekhu waxaa uu xusay arrimo badan oo yaab leh oo uu marqaati ka ahaa. Dhaqamadii siyaasadda ee dalka ka jiray ayuu wax badan innooga sheegay. Degmada Luuq waxaa ka jiray saddex xisbi: Leegada, xisbiga Great iyo Digil iyo Mirifle. nin kii madaxda ka ahaa xisbiga Great ayaa booskii banneeyay. Dabadeed xisbigu waxa uu codsaday in la raadiyo nin Marreexaan ah oo suuq leh oo booska loo magacaabo. Sheekh Maxamed oo magaalada xer ku ahaa ayaa booskii loo cimaamaday. Waa dhaqan muujinaya in waxa maanta jira ay yihiin mid waa hore soo bilowday. Dhacdo kale oo i cajabgelisay waxa ay dhacday 1990kii. Isbuucyo uun ka hor burburkii dalka. Markaan sheekh Maxamed waxa uu ka tirsanyahay ururkii Itixaad. Waa koox culima ah oo dar Alle u midowday. Dalkii oo sii burburaya ayaa u muuqday. Qaar ka mid ah culimadaas ayaa u arkay in dagaalka socdo uu u dhaxeeyo Habargidir mucaarad ah iyo Marreexaan muxaafid ah. In intooda labadaas qabiil shiraan oo dalka xal u keenaan ayay ku fikireen. Sheekha oo arrintaas ka warramayo waxa uu yiri: “Dhanka culimada waxaa billowday fadhiyo la isaga waraysanayo xaaladda uu galay dalku. Fadhiyadaas waxa ay ka billowdeen dhallinyaro wadaaddo ah oo isugu jireay Marreexaan iyo Habargidir… Waxa ay isugu yeereen culimo ka soo kala jeeda labada beelood oo ay ka mid ahaayeen Sheekh xasan Daahir Aweys iyo Sheekh Aadan sheekh Cabdullaahi.” Sheekh Maxamed waxa uu sheegay in uu shirkii ka sheegay in dagaalku uusan ku koobnayn labada beelood ee shireysa sidaa darteed loo baahanyahay in loo yeero culimada Soomaaliyeed oo dhan. Waa dhacdo muujineysa heerka qabiilku gaarsiisanyahay soomaalida dhexdeeda. Dagaalkii dalka oo dhan ka socday ee u dhaxeeyay dowlad Soomaali u dhantahay iyo jamhado qabiilooyin ka koobnaa ayay culimadii u arkeysay mid laba jifo u dhaxeysa. Sawirka aan nolosha ka haysanno oo dhan ayaaba naga khaldan! Xogo badan iyo sheekooyin xiisa leh ayaa buugga sidaa ugu dhex xardhan. Laakiin meesha dhegta loo wada taagayo ee la is leeyahay xogo malab ama dacar mid ah ayaa loogu tagayaa waa qeybta danbe ee ciwaanka buugga “Hoggaan”. Waa qeybta uu sheekha kaga sheekeeyay imaaraddii Gedo ee uu madaxda ka ahaa 1992-1997. Ha yeeshee buuggu ma sido wax cusub oo loo riyaaqo. 98% waxaa la dhihi karaa waa buunbuunin iyo sheegasho aan caddeymo wadan ama ugu yaraan aysan la socon wax awal naga qarsoonaa oo xog ah. Qeybtaas waxaa aad loogu dheeraaday wax qabadkii Itixaad ee xagga amniga, waxbarshada iyo dhaqaalaha. Laakiin buuggu ma sido wax ka badan intii dadku wada ogaa. Tusaale ahaan, in iskoollo iyo maddaaris furnaayeen dadku wuu wada arki karay oo ardayda direyska xiran ayaa caddayn ugu filnayd. Buugga waxaan ka filaynay caddaad iyo caddeymo, sida “waxaan furnay iskoollo. Shantii sano ee aan xukunnay waxaa la diiwaan geliyaay 10 kun oo arday. Miisaaniyaddu waxa ay ahayd 300 oo kun. Laba nobol oo macallin ayaan shaqo siinney” iyo erayo la mid ah oo xog dheeraad ah noogu daro intii ay indhaheennu arkayeen. Nasiibdarro buuggu arrimahaas waba noogama kordhin. Qeybta danbe buugga ayaan ku dheeraan doonnaa waayo waa mid saamayn nagu leh. Sidoo kale sheekha waxa uu ku daray 14 bog oo ciwaan looga dhigay “garnaqsi”. Maadaama akhrisyaasha uu u gardhigtay wixii nooga baxay ayaan uga jawaabaynaa. Marka hore aan caddeeyo eedda iyo dhaliilaha aan taabaneyno in aysan sheekha naftiisa ku saabsanayn. Waxa lagu dhaggan yahay waa ururkii Itixaad. Sheekha madaxda ururka ayuu ka mid ahaa. Edda intiisa ayuu ku yeelan sida wanaagga uu intiisa ugu leeyahay. Wax isaga ku gaar ah oo weerar ama dhaleecyn ah ma jiraan. Allaha u danbidhaafo oo janno ha siiyo. Sheekhu garta uu dhigtay waxaa ka mid ahaa in uu gobolka ka dhigay nabad Soomaaliya ka tacajubtay. Bogga 144 waxa uu ku yiri: “Ururkii Itixaad kuma koobnayn dacwada iyo tacliinta oo keliya balse laamo u xilsaarnaa sugidda amniga gobolka. Taasina waxay sabatay in gobolku nabdoonaado kana badbaado isbaarooyinkii dadka lagu baaran jiray ee ka jiray inta badan ee gobollada dalka”. Waa hubaal in Gedo aan laga aqoon isbaaro ilaa la soo gaaray 1999kii. Balse ma ahayn mid uu Itixaad keenay. Itixaad waxa uu ka talinayay Beledxaawo iyo Luuq keliya. Doolow waxaa ka joogay ciidan yar laakiin maamulka waxaa haystay Xasandeer oo lid ku ahaa. Inta kale ee gobolka nabad ayaa ka jirtay si la mid ah sidii nabad u ahaayeen Luuq iyo Beledxaawo. Lagama aqoon isbaaro. Lama arki jirin mooryaan qoryo sidata oo suuqa wareegeysa. Intaan ogahay dadka lagu dilay dhinaca uu Itixaad xukumay ayaa ka badnaa intii lagu dilay dhinaca uusan xukumin. Haddaba sidee sheekhu ku sheegan karaa in uu Gedo nabad ka dhigey? Sow ma habboonayn in uu hadalka ku koobo deeggaannadii uu xukumay? Cidna ma inkiri karto wanaaggii uu Itixaad ka sameeyay deegaannadii uu xukumay. Si faahfaahsan waxaan uga hadlay buugga Halgankii Gunnimadoonka. Laakiin nabadda guud ee Gedo ka jirtay Itixaad sabab uma ahayn. Yaa sabab u ahaa dood kale oo aan halkaan boos u ahayn. Inta aad akhrinayso buugga, waxaad dareemeysaa in looga jawaabayo dhaliilo uu horay u tabiyay buugga Hangankii Gunnimadoonka. Ciwaannada qaar waa kuwii buugga aan xusnay, warka ku qoranna waa jawaab toos ah loogu talagalay in looga jawaabo su’aal ciwaankaasu siday. Waa ciwaanka leh “Dagaalka ma laga baaqsan karay”? Buugga Halgankii Gunnimadoonka su’aashaas ayuu keenay. Waxa uu si aad uga niqaashay in ay suuragal noqon lahayd in laga baaqsado in Xabashidu Gedo soo weerarto. Geeso badan ayuu wixii jiray ka istaagay. Taxliil, tacliilin iyo naqdin ka dibna waxaa uu ku gunaanaday in dagaalka laga baaqsan karay haddii la qaadi lahaa tallaabooyin uu buugu xusay. Buuggan hadda aynu gorfeyno isla su’aashaas ayuu keenay. Laakiin, walow looga hadlay 17 bog, jawaabtu ma noqon taxliilin iyo waaqaca oo dhinacyo badan la eego. Beddelkeeda waxaa la taxay shirar uu urur qabtay iyo dedaal uu u galay in uu bulshada deegaanka soo dhowaysto. Gunaanadkii jawaabtuna waxa ay noqotay in Itixaad doonayay in uu dadka xukumo isaga oo taageero ka hasyta laakiin ay SNF iyo Itoobiya middaa diiddanayd oo ay Xabashidu sidaa ku timid sidaa awgeedna aysan suuragal ahayn in dagaalka laga baaqsado. Bogga 176 ee buugga waxaa lagu yiri khulaasada: “Ma laga baaqsan karay dagaalka? Waxaan ku soo xiriyaa shirkan oo, sidoo kale, marag u noqonaya in mar walba maamulka wadaaddu u taagnaayeen xalraadinta iyo inaan gobolka loo horseedin amnidarro, bulshadana loo ilaaliyo waxqabadka muuqda iyo horumarka ay hiigsanaysay.” Sida ka muuqato khulaasada kore, sheekhu waxa uu ku dooday in colaadda laga baaqsan lahaa haddii reer Gedo taageeri lahaayeen maamulkii Itixaad. Haddaba taasi sax maaha. Marnaba Xabashida iyo gaaladii gadaal ka taagnayd ma daayeen gobolka inta Itixaad maamulayay. Taasi waxaa caddayn ugu filan hadallada ku xusan buugga dhexdiisa. Bogga 156 ee buugga waxaa ku qoran sidatan: “Tigreegu waxay dareemeen iftiinka Islaamiga ah ee baxaya kuna fidiya meel ka baxsan Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhankooda. Sidoo kale waxay garowsadeen in haddii uu sii fido dhaq-dhaqaaq ka curtay Gedo uu horseedi karo helitaan dowlad Soomaaliyeed. Arrintaasi waxau ku caddayd warbixinno laga qorayay Gedo, kuwaas oo nuxurkoodu ahaa: Haddii aan hadda wax laga qaban hawlaha ka socda Gedo, Geeska Afrika waxaa ka dhalan doona dowlad Islaami ah oo mayal adag. Taasina waxay keeni kartaa in danaha reer Galbeedka ee Geeska Afrika ay ciriiri galaan”. Bogga xiga ayaa sii waday sababta Tigeeru u soo weeraray Gedo waxaana ku qoran: “Tigreegu waxa xukuma Kaniisadda Orthodox oo ah tan ugu xagjirsan Kaniisadaha… Sidaas darteed ma aysan oggolaan karin curashada maamul Islaami ah oo ay deris wadaag yihiin”. Akhriste bal halkaas dul istaag oo gartaas nala naq. Maamulka sidaa u fahansanaa cadaawadda Tigreega, asii aan hayn awood uu isaga difaaco, halkii uu raadin lahaa jid looga baaqsado dagaal lala galo, waqtigii geliyay daandaansi hor leh haddana ku doodaya waan isku daynay in dagaalka laga baaqsado laakiin dhinaca naga soo horjeeday ayaa diiday, ma wax la qaadan karaa? Sidee dagaalka ku baaqan lahaa haddii ay SNF meesha ka bixi lahayd illeen colaadda Tigreegu waxa uu ahaa maamul col la ah oo sii xoogaysanyee? Laga yaabo in aad is tiraahdo sidee col ula ahaa ama u daandaansaday urur Itoobiya. Isla buuga dhexdiisa ayuu sheekhu ku qirayaa in xiriir la laahyeen ururkii Itixaad ee dagaalka kula jiray maamulkii Tigreega. Bogga 196 waxaa ku qoran: “Eedda ah inaad xiriir la lahaydeen al-Itixaad al-Islaami, gaar ahaan qaybta ka hawlgalaysay deegaannada Soomaalida ee Itoobiya, waa sax.” Haddaba dowlad mar kuu qabta cadaawad diimeed; Mar kuu qabta cadaawad dhuleed; mar kalana aad taageeraysid, si aan gabbasho lahayn, jamhad dagaal kula jirta, sideed uga baaqsan kartay weerarkeeda? Akhristoow adiga ayaan kuu daayay jawaabta balse aan ka jawaabo midda aad maanka ku hayso ee ah maxaa kaloo furnaa? Jawaabtaas oo faahfaahsan waxaad ugu noqon kartaa buugga Halgankii Gunnimadoonka. Iyada oo kooban, dadka qaba in dagaalka laga baaqsan karay waxa ay ku doodayaan waxa ay ahayd in la qaato taladii urur weynihii Itixaad ee ahayd meelna yaannan ku yeelan ciidan hubeysan. Culimadii reer Waqooyi-galbeed iyo kuwii reer Waqooyi-bari waxa ay fahmeen in aysan dhulkooda ka difaaci karin dal kale oo soo weeraray. Sidaa darteed waxa ay diideen in Itixaad xeryo ciidan ku yeesho dhulkooda. Laascaanood ayaa u danbaysay oo bil ka hor duullaankii Gedo ayaa la kala diray ciidan aan hub haysan oo xeryo lagu tababbari jiray. AUNtee Sheekh Cabdinaasir Xaaji Axmed oo ka warhelay in Xabashidu ku soo duuleyso ayaa kala diray si uu dadkiisa iyo deegaankiisa u badbaadiyo. Intii uu sheekh Cabdinaasir gartay ayay madaxdii Itixaadkii Gedo garan waayeen. Sheekhu waxa uu sheegay in madaxdii Itixaad soo amreen in uu dhallinyarada kala diro 1992. Bogga 138 waxa uu ku yiri: “Jabbuuti waxaa laga soo saaray go’aan ahaa in mucaskarka Gedo uu ka baxo Luuq. go’aankaas ma uusan noqon mid aan ku qanacno wuxuuna ka mid ahaa waxyaabihii dhaliyay khilaafka.” Mar kale 1993kii ayaa sheekh Maxamed lagu wargeliyay in uu u hoggaansamo amarka madaxda sare oo uu kala diro dhallinyarada labada goorba wuu diiday. Bogga 140 waxa uu ku yiri: “Markii uu soo baxay go’aankii lagu kala dirayay dhammaan ciidamadii al-Itixaad al-Islaami ee ku kala baahsanaa gobollada dalka, qaybta Gedo waxaa naloo soo diray Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan Sheekh Cumar Axmed iyo Sheekh Cabdiwaaxid Xaashi Xasan. Waxay la yimaadeen laba qodob oo kala ahaa: in amiirka [sheekh Maxamed Xaaji Yuusuf] iyo ku xigeenkiisa [macallin Maxamuud macallin Nuur] xilka laga qaado [iyo] in la kala diro ciidamada.” Sheekh Maxamed waxa uu sheegay in labadiiba ay diideen sababtana bogga 141 ayuu faahfaahiyay. Laakiin nuxurku waa in uusan u hoggaasamin amarkii ka soo baxay madaxdiisa. Haddii uu maalintii u hoggaansami lahaa amarkii madaxdiisa, Gedo waxa ay u badbaadi lahayd sidii ay u badbaadeen gobolladii kale ee dalka. Amar diiddadii waxay dhalisay dhibaatada ilaa maanta afka lagu difaacayo. Doodba ma jirteen haddii go’aankii ururka la fuliyo 1993kii. Waxaa yaab leh in sheekh Maxamed u aqoonsanaa dhulka Soomaaligalbeed dhul Itoobiya. Sida aan soo sheegnay, buuggu waa codkii sheekha oo qoraal loo rogay. Haddaba waxa ku qoran waxa ay noo yihiin erayadii sheekha. Buugga dhexdiisa ugu yaraan shan jeer ayaa lagu qoray erayo tilmaamaya in sheekhu dhulkaas u aqoonsanaa dhul Itoobiya. Bogga 20aad sheekha oo ka warramayo deegaan Dooloow u dhow oo uu xernimo u tagay waxa uu yiri: “Markii aan Dooloow imid, ayaa la ii sheegay in sheekh Ilkadahab iyo xertiisii ay aadeen dhanka Laba-Shillindi, oo ah carro Itoobiya. Waxay u dhowdahay webi la yiraahdo Webeyd, waxayna ka tirsan tahay gobolla Afdheer oo ka mid ah deegaanka Soomaalida ee Itoobiya.” Bogga 144 mar uu sheekha ka sheekaynayay horumarkii ururkiisu keenay waxa uu yiri: “Dabayshaas barakaysan waxay sidoo kale gaartay deegaannada deriska la ah gobolka Gedo sida Soomaalida Itoobiya”. Bogga 196 laba jeer ayay ku timid “deegaannada Soomaalida ee Itoobiya”. Dadka aamminsan qaddiyadda Soomaaligalbeed marnaba dhulkaas iyo dadkaas uma arkaan Itoobiyaan. Sinnaba kuma noqon karaan Itoobiyaan. In dhulka soomaaligalbeed tilmaan looga dhigo “ee Itoobiya” waa gef weyn oo aan fasir lahayn. Akhristoow garnaqsi ayuu buuggu noo dhiibtaye sidee qof dhulkaas u yaqaan dhul Itoobiya ugu doodi karaa xoreynta dhulkaas ayaan qeyb ka ahaa? Haddii aadan magaca keliya xorayn karin sidee xeryo ciidan ugu oodday in aad dhul xoreyso? Haddii aad dadkaas iyo deegaankaas u taqaan Itoobiyaan maxay ahayd xilka kaa saarnaa oo aad colaadda u soo jiidatay?  Buuggu qeybta garnaqsiga waxa kale uu ku keenay eedaymo uu sheegay in horay loogu jeediyay oo ku jawaabayo. Waxaa ka mid ahaa waxa ay cuskadeen xukunnada ay fulin jireen. Laakiin waxa uu doortay sheekhu ama qoraha buugga ayaa xushay kuwo jawaabtooda aysan dood badan ku jirin. Tusaale, wuxuu ka jawaabay waxa ay u daliishadeen khidmad ay ka qaadi jireen baabuurta xamuulka ah. Taasu dad badan dood kama qabin waa arrin maangal ah oo la fahmi kar sababta khidmada loo qaaday dabcan diintana qiil looga waayi maayo. Jawaabaha laga sugayay ee aan la soo hadalqaadin waxaa ka mid ahaa: waxa ay u cuskadeen raggii Soomaaliyeed ee baabuur ay dhaceen awgii Itixaad uu ugu wareejiyay Kiinya. Buugga meelna loogama soo qaadin arrintaa. Waxaa muuqato in la xushay intii ururka sawir fiican ka bixin lahayd. Magacyada raggaas iyo sida ay wax u dhaceen ugu noqo buugga Hangankii Gunnimadoonka. Eed kale oo uusan ka jawaabin waa in dad badan ay qabaan in Itixaad uu laba sharci ku kala dhaqi jiray ciidankiisa iyo shacabka uu xukumo. Markii ciidanku danbi galo sharciga masaalixada iyo xeer jajabka ayaa la cuskan jiray. Markii shacabku danbi galo oraahdu waxay ahayd “Kitaabka Alle wax aan ahayn ku kala bixi maayo”. Taasi hadal la iska yiri ma aha. Intii u dhaxaysay 1992 iyo 1996, danbe kale iska daaye, dilalka uu ciidanku geystay tobon ayay kor u dhaafeen. Waxan raadiyay in helo qof oo ka mid ah oo inta maxkamad la keenay shareecadu waxay siiso la mariyay. Buugga Halgankii Gunnimadoonka oo rag badan oo Itixaadkii Gedo ah ay akhriyeen si weynna u naqdiyeen tabtaas ayaan ugu qoray waxaana raaciyay qofkii haya hal kiis Allaha ka dhigee ha noo jawaabo. Ilaa maanta jawaabtaas waan sugaynaa. Sheekha oo ka jawaabaya dilalka ay geysteen ciidankii uu xukumay bogga 201 waxa uu ku yiri: “Qodob labaad ee gaabis ama ilduuf ku dhacay wuxuu ahaa in ay jireen falal dhacay dagaallada ka hor. Ma ahayn kuwo ku talagal ah ama go’aan la qaatay balse waxaa geystay niman dhallinyaro ah oo degdegay oo islahaa wax wanaajiya, hase yeeshee waxay khilaafeen mabda’a tadarujka iyo qiimeynta maslaxada. Dhallinyaradu waxay na galiyeen magao badan. Qaar waan bixinnay, qaarna iyadoo wax nagu dhimman yihiin ayaa duullaankii Tigreegu dhacay.” Waxa sheekhu ul jeedo gaabis iyo ilduuf dhacay ma in aan tallaabo laga qaadin baa? Maamul, dowlad, jamhad iyo cid walba oo meel ka arrimisa oo xubnaheedu danbi galayaan waa dabiici. Ma jirto cid ku eedaynayso Itixaad maxay danbi u galeen. Eeddu waxa ay tahay markii ay danbi galeen maxay u qaadin tallaabo ciqaabeed muuqato. Magbaan bixinney? Magta waxaa lagu samirsiiyay dadkii qofku ka baxay e qofkii danbiga geystay meeday wixii lagu sameeyay? Magta xaggee lagu go’aamiyay? Maxkamad mise xafiisyada madaxda? Ma ahayd mag dhammaystiran mise waxay ahayd afka dufan isu marin? Ugu yaraan, hal kiis oo aan ka warqabo waxa uu ahaa afka dugan isu marin. Nin la dilay aabbihii ayaa lagu yiri annagu lama macaamilmo qabiilo. Waxaan wax siinnaa qofka dhintay caa’iladiisa. Adaa carruurta u weyn. Waxaan kuu haynaa laba boqol oo kun oo shilin soomaali ah! Markii uu diiday jawaabtu waxay noqotay “cirka warmo u jar”. Waqtiga uu Itaxaad tobon qof oo uu dilay mago ka dhiibayo, dhinaca kale ee gobolka waxaa ka jiery qisaas xukunka lagu ridi jiray bannaan dadku daawanayo (fulinta qisaasta ma aha). Hal dil ayaa Garbahaarreay ka dhacay qisaas ayaa lagu dhammeeyay. Dhawr dil oo Baardheere ka dhacday qisaas iyo mag ayaa lagu dhammeeyay hadba midkii ay doorteen dadka wax laga dilay. Dhinaca Itixaad mag keliya ayaa ka jirtay illeen cidda wax dilaysay ciidanka ururka ayuu ahaaye. Dilalka aan kor ku sheegnay waxa ay dhaceen intii nabadda lagu jiray. Markii ay bannaanka tageen, waxa ay billaabeen dhabbagal iyo socoto gowrac. Dhawr dil oo si foolxun ay u filyeen ayaa jiray. Sheekha oo arrintaas ka hadlayo waxa uu yiri (bogga 191): “Sidoo kale, waxaa jiray rag iyaguna caan ahaa oo ku baxay gacanta wadaaddada. Waxaa ka mid ahaa Bile Shuuke Macallin Cabdi, Cabdulwahaab Cabdullaahi Warsame iyo Xasan Jaamac Falaxfalax. Labada nin ee hore waxaa la dilay markii wadaaddada laga saaray magaaloyinka oo ay miyiga galeen. Waxaan caddaynayaa inuusan jirin go’aan aniga iga soo baxay ama si guud maamulka Itixaad ee Gedo lagu gaaray in la laayo raggaas. Falka waxaa gaystay dhallinyaro caraysan, waana go’aan iyaga u gaar ah”. Waxa ay dilaan go’aan iyaga u gaar ah miyaa guusha ay keenanna waa mid madaxdu sheegato? Haddii uu sheekhu qaadan lahaa amarkii la siiyay 1993dii dhallinyaradu dariiqa ma istaagteen raggaasna ma aysan dileen. Go’aanka kala dirista ciidanka Itixaad sababtii ugu weynayd ayaaba ahayd in aan la xakamayn karin dhallinyarada jannadoonka ah. Ninkii go’aanka diiday masuuliyadda wixii ka dhashay ma diidi karo. Laba cidna kuma eedayn sheekh Maxamed inuu amarka dilka bixiyay waxa loo haysto waa in ururkii Itixaad uusan arrintaas canbaarayn, iska beriyeelin waxna ka oran oo uu ka aammusay. Aammusku waa aqbalaad sida la wada ogyahay. Waxa aan ka hadlayno waa rag shacab ahaa oo iyaga safar ah inta baabuur lagala degay la gowracay oo midkood meydkiisa qashin lagu dhex tuuray oo xataa aas ay quuri waayeen. Sheekhu wuu karay in uu yiraahdo amarka ma bixin laakiin wuu kari waayay inuu raaciyo “waan ka xumahay in la dilo” ama uu tuso wax uun dareen ah oo muujinayo inuu ka xumaa dilka raggaas iyo intii la midka ahayd. Halkii uu oran lahaa waa gef weyn oo ururka ka dhacay eeddii waxa uu saaray willasha uu ku amray duurka gala oo dhuumalaysi dagaallama. Sheekhu garnaqsiga waxa uu ku daray in aysan SNF garab ordin oo ay u daayeen aadidda shirarka dibadda sida Itoobiya iyo Kiinya. Sheegshadaan meel adag ma haysato. SNF waa saddex xaraf laakiin markii la sheego dadka waxaa ku soo dhacayo qabiilo Marreexaan la yiraahdo. Waxay ahayd summad qabiil iyo deegaan. Sidaas oo kale ayay Soomaalidu u wada sidatay summado dhawr xaraf ah ka kooban. Bogga 195 waxaa ku timid: “shirarka matalaadda gobolka Gedo wax ku sheegta SNF oo keliya ayaa jirta”. Haddaba, mar la tagayo shirarka dibadda, SNF waxay wax ku raadinaysay in ay matasho qabiilo weyn oo dhul ballaaran deggan. Sidaas darteed, waxa la qeybsanayo wax weyn in laga siiyo ayay ku doodeysay. Jawaabaha ay helayeen waxa ay ahayd in uusan jirin deegaan buuxa oo ay ka taliyaan oo gobolka qeybo badan uu Itixaad haysto SNF-na aan waxba laga weydiineyn. Dhinaca kale Itixaad ixtiraam uu hayo SNF ugama harin shirarka dibadda ee dhawr arrimood ayaa diidayay. Kow cidda qabanaysay Itixaad boos uma oggolayn. Laba, Itixaad qudhiisa shirarkaas waxa ay u arkayeen kuwo baaddil ah oo ay gaalo dabada ka riixayso in laga qaybgalana ay tahay diin la’aan. In xaalku sidaas ahaa waxaa noo caddaynaya isla buuggan. Shirkii Adis 1993 waxaa lagu heshiiyay in Soomaaliya oo dhan maamul isku nooc ah loo dhiso. Markii SNF isku dayday in ay fuliso go’aankii Adis 1993, Itixaad waa diiday. Sababtu waxay ku taallaa bogga 152-53: “Qodobaddaas waxaa lagu soo saaray qoraal. Hase yeeshee dhaqan gelintooda waxaa is-hortaagay maamulkayaga wadaaddada. Aniga mooyee, xunihii kale ee guddiga fulinta ayaa ka horyimid. Guddiga fulintu dooddoodu waxay ahayd “waa inay ka bari noqdaan gaalada”. Sida aad arki karto madaxdii Itixaad waxay taagan yihiin SNF gaalada ha ka bari noqoto si aan maamul ula wadaagno. Maamulka meesha yaallo waa midkii UNISOM soo dhistay. Haddii SNF laga rabo in ay ka bari noqoto UNISOM sidee Itixaad ku dhihi karaa shirarka dibadda SNF ayaan ku xurmaynay? Sidee uga bari noqon lahaayeen iyaga oo addeecaya go’aannadii ka soo baxay shirkii UNISOM. Buugga waxaa ku yimid meelo sidii ay wax u jireen aan loo tebin. Aan soo qaadanno qabashadii Luuq. Waa markii Itixaad Luuq uu ka saaray Caydiid. Ciidanka Itixaad waxaa lagu soo xoojiyay malleeshiyaad Marreexaan ah sida ku qoran bogga 134. Mar haddii magaalada la qabtay qorshuhu waxa uu ahaa in loo jeesto xagga Baardheere iyo Kismaayo.  Sheekha waxa uu sheegay in ay ciidanka ku yiraahdeen qofkii raba ha nala joogo kii rabana halkii uu ka yimid ha aado. Haddaba sidaas fudud wax uma dhicin. Tegiddu shardi ayuu ku xiray Itixaad. Shardigu waxa uu ahaa in qofkii tegaya laga reebayo qoriga uu sito. Qofkii raba in uu qoriga haysto saddex akhtiyaar ayaa midkood ayaa la siiyey: kow, aan kaa iibinno (qiimo aad uga hooseeyay midkii suuqa); aan kuu hayno oo waa danbe u soo laabo (is-aammin ma jirin) ama hayso oo naga mid noqo (urur aadan rabin ku biir) . Intaas qofkii aan ku qancin qoriga ha dhigo oo ha baxo. U fiirsno dadka ikhiyaarka laga qaaday ee la leeyahay qori lama bixi kartaan waa ciidankii gurmadka ugu yimid. Ujeedku waxa uu ahaa in qof sita uusan dib ugu laaban dhinaca SNF. Si go’aankaas loo fuliyo Itixaad waxa uu amar ku bixiyay in uusan ka gudbin qof ciidankii SNF ah oo qori sita. Buundada ayay dhigeen ciidan baara. Dabcan waa is weji yaqaannay oo dad wada dhashay ayay ahaayeen. Xogtan ma ahayn mid qarsoon. Waraysi aan ka qaaday, hadda ka hor, ciidankii SNF ee sidaas ay ku dhacday iyo qaar ka tirsanaa Itixaad oo goobjoog ahaa ayaan ka xaqiijiyay. Xogtaas oo faahfaahsan meel kale ayaan ku qoray oo Eebbe idinkii dhowaan la faafin doonaa. Halkaan waxaa naga quseeyo in sida sheekhu dhigay aysan arrintaas u dhicin. Buuggu, waxa kale oo si aan kutagal ahayn, uga marqaatikacayaa qaar ka mid ah dhaliilaha ururka loo jeediyay. Tusaale, waxaa lagu eedeeyay in ururku ahaa mid aan sawiran karin waxa ka dhalanaya tallaabooyinka uu qaadayo. Matalan, weerarkii kowaad ka dib, shir madaxdii Itixaad ku yeesheen Gedo waxaa lagu go’aamiyay in ururku la wareego lixda degmo ee gobolka muddo lix bilood ah “ujeedku wuxuu ahayd in degmo kasta taliskii loogu talagalay la wareego”. Bogga 158 iyo bogga 194 go’aan lagu xusay. Bal u fiirso dhibka uu abuuray go’aankaan. Buugga dhexdiisa sheekhu waxa uu noogu sheegay in ciidankiisu ahaa qiyaastii 600. Awood ay ku difaacaan Luuq ma aysan hayn. Markaas waxa dagaalka kula jiro waa Amxaaro keliya. Hal askari oo Marreexaan lama joogin. Halkii laga fogaan lahaa wax walba oo Marreexaan iyo Amxaaro isu soo dhowayn kara, waxaa la qaatay go’aan ah in gobolka lala wada wareegno. Dadkii awal lagu kicinayay Hawiye shaar wadaad soo xirtay ayaa dhulkii idinka qaadanayo ayaa weerar lagu qaaday. Weerarkii kowaad Buurdhuubo ayay ku qabsadeen. Dadka ay dileen waxaa ka mid ahaa Macallin Diiriye imaamkii masaajidka jaamaca ee magaalada. Waxaa ka dhashay in Marreexaan isku shubo Doolow oo Amxaaro garab hesho. Ninka aad go’aansatay in aad kala wareegto masaajidka uu imaamka ka yahay, xafiiska booliska uu xukumo, degmada uu maamulo ama meel kale oo uu madax ka yahay sideed ugu fikirtay in uu gacmaha laabto oo uusan kula dagaallamin? Wiilka 20 jirka ah ee aabbihii oo jooga meeshii ku dhashay, ku barbaaray, ku dhaqmay si maasajidka uu imaamka ka ahaa looga qaato 30 xabbo lagu dhiftay sidee loogu fikiray in uu gacmaha laabto oo uusan kula dagaallamin. Eedda ma isagaa leh mise adiga gurigiisa ku weeraray adoo xukun doon ah? Maxaa looga waayay dad shirka fadhiyay qaar yiraahda dagaal “Amxaaro ayaa nagu furan ee mid qabiilo yaannan isku furin. Waar dadkaan yaannan ku riixin in ay Amxaaro kaalmo u doontaan.” Qofkii las ocday taariikhdii jamhadihii dalka qabsaday wuu garan lahaa sida weerar lagu qaado dad meel deggan ay u horseedi lahayd Amxaaro xeryo u furto. Wacyi la’aanta haysay dadka go’aankaas gaaray waxaa kuugu filan in ay ku fikirayeen in dagaalka ay maalgelin doonaan qurbajoogta. Bogga 158 waxaa uu sheekhu ku yiri: “Ugu danbayn waxaa la isla qaatay in muddo lix bilood ah maamulka lagu baahiyo gobolka. Waxaa billowday abaabul iyo diyaargarow, waxaana farriin ka helnay jaaliyadaha dibadda oo oranaysay wixii taakulo ah ee aad u baahan tihiin waan idiin haynaa ee dhankiinna qorshe la imaada. Laakiin markii danbe waxaan caddaatay in jaaliyaduhu aysan hayn wax lagu fuliyo qorshihii aan dejinnay.” Horay waxaan u soo marnay sheekha oo leh in aan jirno waxaa diiddana Itoobiya u adeegaysa reer Galbeedka. Halkaan dagaal lagu qabsado gobol dhan ayaa lagu fikirayay in laga helo jaaliyado ku nool dalal col kula ah. Ma jiri karin lacag ururin bannaan lala imaan karay oo Itixaad lagu taageeri karay. Dadku waxa uu ahaa mid waddamada uu joogo ku cusub oo ama xamaal ku nool ama ceyr. Dalkii qax iyo colaado ayaa ka taagnaa oo qof walba oo qurbaha joogay qoysas dhan baa dul saarnaa. Xaggee ka keeni karaan qarash lagu galo dagaal intaas la eg la isma weydiin. Sidii caadada u ahayd, iyaga oo aan xaajada dhinacyo badan ka joogsan ayay ku sheekeysteen ciidan nagu filan waan haysannaa haatanna gurmad baa Xamar nooga yimid. Wixii qarash ah ee aan u baahanno jaaliyadaha ayaa diyaar ah. Gobolka oo dhan aan qabsanno oo aan maamulkeenna ku soo rogno lix bilood gudahood. Allaahu Akbar! Allaahu Akbar! Shirku noo xiran! Taasi waxay dhashay in iyaga oo weli shacabka Buurdhuubo dagaal kula jira intii hore ee ay haysteen lagala wareego sagaal bilood ka dib! Qormada oo dheeraatay aan ku soo xiro, buuggan waxa uu xoojiyay eedaymihii jiray e kama uusan jawaabin. Dooddan waxa ay ahaan doontaa mid taagan, inta laga helayo madax Itixaad ah oo kudhac leh oo tiraahda ‘gef baa naga dhacay, waana ka xunnahay wixii naga dhacay’. Inta la taaganyahay dadkii ururku laayay masuul kama aynaan ahayn ee dhallinyaro caraysan baa laysay; dad degaan ah weerar kuma aynaan qaadin, iyada oo la qiranayo in go’aan gole shuuro ah lagu gaaray in degmo walba la qabsado; inta dooddu tahay imaanshaha Amxaaro wax shaqo ah kuma lihin, iyada oo aan isla oggolnahaye in haddii uusan ururku ciidan hubaysan Gedo ku haysan lahayn aysan weligeed Amxaaro soo aaddeen, meel la isaga soo dhowaado ma jiri doonto! WQ: Ibraahin Aadan Shire Aqoonyahan iyo Taariikhyahan
items.fullContent: Buugga Halgan iyo Hoggaan waxaa la daabacay Julaay 2026. Waxa uu ka koobanyahay 244 bog. Afartanka bog ee u danbeeya waxaa ku qoran faallooyin ay soo gudbiyeen asxaabtii Sheekha. Waxa ay uga hadleen shaqsiyaddiisa wixii ay ka yaqaanneen. Labada boqol ee kale waxaa lagu soo koobay waraysiyo sheekha laga qaaday waqtiyo kala duwan. Buugga waxaa qoray wiil uu sheekhu dhalay oo la yiraahdo Cabdiraxmaan Sheekh Maxamed Xaaji Yuusuf. Cabdiraxmaan waxa uu sheegtay in uusan buuga ku darin wax isaga ka yimid. Wax Alla waxa laga helo labadaas boqol ee bog waa erayadii sheekha oo qoraal loo rogay sida uu nagu yiri Cabdiraxmaan. Waraysiyada salka u ah buugga waa laba qeybood. Qeyb waxaa qaaday Dr Cumar warsame. Buuggu waxa uu tilmaamay in la duubay intii u dhaxaysay Jannaayo 2013 ilaa Juun 2013. Waa waraysiyo qaatay 14 fadhi. Qeybta labaad waxaa duubay Sheekh Cabdullaahi Faarax Taano 2001dii. Sida uu qoruhu sheegay waxa ay ahaayeen laba cajalood. Xogtaas waxa aan ka fahannay in codka sheekha la duubay oo haddii loo baahdo la heli karo. Buugga inta aad akhrinayso ma ogaan kartid xogta lagu siiyay waraysiga ay ku jirto. Tusaale, ma midkii 2001dii baa mise waa kuwii danbe? Lama xusin. Sida laga fahmi karo ciwaanyaraha, buuggu waxa uu ka warramayaa taariikhnololeedkii sheekha. Laakiin Sheekh ma uusan ahayn sheekh ka mid ah culimada Soomaaliyeed e waxa uu ahaa siyaasi xil weyn qabtay go’aannadiisiina ay saamayn waartay oo dhib iyo dheefba leh ku yeelatay dad badan iyo deegaan dhan. Taas ayaa xiiso gaar ah u yeeleysa buugga dadka taariikhda jecelna ku qasbeysa in ay dheegtaan. Buuggu waxa uu ka kooban yahay 8 cuutub. Shanta cutub ee hore, oo qaadatay 88 bog oo buugga ah, waxa ay ka hadlayaan noloshii sheekha dhalashadiisii ilaa uu jaamacad ka baxay iyo shaqooyinkii uu qabtay ilaa burburkii dalka. Waa qeybta xambaarsan qeybta hore ee ciwaanka (Halgan). Sidaa darteed ereyga “halgan” ee ciwaanka ku jira ha u qaadan mid hubeysan oo hoggaan lagu gaaray ee halgankii nolosha iyo waxbarashada ee sheekhu galay. Malaha “harjad” ayaa ku habbooneyd baan is iri. Cashirro badan oo dedaalka sheekha, himiladiisii iyo ragannimadiisii tuseysa ayaa ku muush ka ah. Buuggu waxa uu ku qoranyahay luuqad fudud. Akhriskiisu waa sahal, fartiisu waa fariid, sida uu isu heystana waa heer sare. Tifaftir toolmaan ayaa lagu sameeyay. Habqoraalkiisu ceeb ma leh. Qeybta hore ee buugga waxaa ku jiro dhacdooyin uu si kooban u xusay sheekhu oo sawir naga siinayaa xaaladdii dalka iyo dadka. Tusaale, 1969kii mar uu ku soo laabtay dalka isaga oo Masar ka yimid waxaa uu yiri. “… Waxa aad akaysay aqoonyahanno jaamacado ka soo laabtay oo wada baaga muudda ah oo huteellada wada fadhiya. Qofkii kugu arka baasaboor  una maleeya inaad dibadda ka timid wuxuu ku moodayay in kheyrkii oo dhan laguu dhammeystiray.” Arrintaasi waxa ay na baraysaa in dhibta shaqa-la’aanta ee maanta taagan iyo dhoof jacaylku uu ahaa mid waqti dheer jiray. Sheekhu waxa uu ardaynimo ugu baxay Masar 20/11/1965. Habeenkii bixitaanka marka uu ka hadlayay waxa uu yiri: " “Waxaa xusid mudan in maalintii aan diyaaradda raacaynay, raggii kale ee aan wada soconnay ay wada xirnaayeen jaakad ama suud sida loo yaqaan…. Ma aannan helin. Ma ahayn mid qaali ah laakiin ninka aan tabar hayn ama gacan-qabasho helin culays ayay ku ahayd”. Ilaa maanta qofka soomaaliga ah markii uu dhoofayo waxa uu jecelyahay in uu xirto suud. Waxa aad arkaysaa arday tigidkiisa la qaaraamay oo waalidkiis ku qasbaya in ay suud deyn ah u qaadaan ama ehelka kale ku dhiba in suud loo iibiyo. Sida ka muuqata hadalka sheekha waa arrin waa hore ku biirtay dhaqanka Soomaalida. Sheekhu waxaa uu xusay arrimo badan oo yaab leh oo uu marqaati ka ahaa. Dhaqamadii siyaasadda ee dalka ka jiray ayuu wax badan innooga sheegay. Degmada Luuq waxaa ka jiray saddex xisbi: Leegada, xisbiga Great iyo Digil iyo Mirifle. nin kii madaxda ka ahaa xisbiga Great ayaa booskii banneeyay. Dabadeed xisbigu waxa uu codsaday in la raadiyo nin Marreexaan ah oo suuq leh oo booska loo magacaabo. Sheekh Maxamed oo magaalada xer ku ahaa ayaa booskii loo cimaamaday. Waa dhaqan muujinaya in waxa maanta jira ay yihiin mid waa hore soo bilowday. Dhacdo kale oo i cajabgelisay waxa ay dhacday 1990kii. Isbuucyo uun ka hor burburkii dalka. Markaan sheekh Maxamed waxa uu ka tirsanyahay ururkii Itixaad. Waa koox culima ah oo dar Alle u midowday. Dalkii oo sii burburaya ayaa u muuqday. Qaar ka mid ah culimadaas ayaa u arkay in dagaalka socdo uu u dhaxeeyo Habargidir mucaarad ah iyo Marreexaan muxaafid ah. In intooda labadaas qabiil shiraan oo dalka xal u keenaan ayay ku fikireen. Sheekha oo arrintaas ka warramayo waxa uu yiri: “Dhanka culimada waxaa billowday fadhiyo la isaga waraysanayo xaaladda uu galay dalku. Fadhiyadaas waxa ay ka billowdeen dhallinyaro wadaaddo ah oo isugu jireay Marreexaan iyo Habargidir… Waxa ay isugu yeereen culimo ka soo kala jeeda labada beelood oo ay ka mid ahaayeen Sheekh xasan Daahir Aweys iyo Sheekh Aadan sheekh Cabdullaahi.” Sheekh Maxamed waxa uu sheegay in uu shirkii ka sheegay in dagaalku uusan ku koobnayn labada beelood ee shireysa sidaa darteed loo baahanyahay in loo yeero culimada Soomaaliyeed oo dhan. Waa dhacdo muujineysa heerka qabiilku gaarsiisanyahay soomaalida dhexdeeda. Dagaalkii dalka oo dhan ka socday ee u dhaxeeyay dowlad Soomaali u dhantahay iyo jamhado qabiilooyin ka koobnaa ayay culimadii u arkeysay mid laba jifo u dhaxeysa. Sawirka aan nolosha ka haysanno oo dhan ayaaba naga khaldan! Xogo badan iyo sheekooyin xiisa leh ayaa buugga sidaa ugu dhex xardhan. Laakiin meesha dhegta loo wada taagayo ee la is leeyahay xogo malab ama dacar mid ah ayaa loogu tagayaa waa qeybta danbe ee ciwaanka buugga “Hoggaan”. Waa qeybta uu sheekha kaga sheekeeyay imaaraddii Gedo ee uu madaxda ka ahaa 1992-1997. Ha yeeshee buuggu ma sido wax cusub oo loo riyaaqo. 98% waxaa la dhihi karaa waa buunbuunin iyo sheegasho aan caddeymo wadan ama ugu yaraan aysan la socon wax awal naga qarsoonaa oo xog ah. Qeybtaas waxaa aad loogu dheeraaday wax qabadkii Itixaad ee xagga amniga, waxbarshada iyo dhaqaalaha. Laakiin buuggu ma sido wax ka badan intii dadku wada ogaa. Tusaale ahaan, in iskoollo iyo maddaaris furnaayeen dadku wuu wada arki karay oo ardayda direyska xiran ayaa caddayn ugu filnayd. Buugga waxaan ka filaynay caddaad iyo caddeymo, sida “waxaan furnay iskoollo. Shantii sano ee aan xukunnay waxaa la diiwaan geliyaay 10 kun oo arday. Miisaaniyaddu waxa ay ahayd 300 oo kun. Laba nobol oo macallin ayaan shaqo siinney” iyo erayo la mid ah oo xog dheeraad ah noogu daro intii ay indhaheennu arkayeen. Nasiibdarro buuggu arrimahaas waba noogama kordhin. Qeybta danbe buugga ayaan ku dheeraan doonnaa waayo waa mid saamayn nagu leh. Sidoo kale sheekha waxa uu ku daray 14 bog oo ciwaan looga dhigay “garnaqsi”. Maadaama akhrisyaasha uu u gardhigtay wixii nooga baxay ayaan uga jawaabaynaa. Marka hore aan caddeeyo eedda iyo dhaliilaha aan taabaneyno in aysan sheekha naftiisa ku saabsanayn. Waxa lagu dhaggan yahay waa ururkii Itixaad. Sheekha madaxda ururka ayuu ka mid ahaa. Edda intiisa ayuu ku yeelan sida wanaagga uu intiisa ugu leeyahay. Wax isaga ku gaar ah oo weerar ama dhaleecyn ah ma jiraan. Allaha u danbidhaafo oo janno ha siiyo. Sheekhu garta uu dhigtay waxaa ka mid ahaa in uu gobolka ka dhigay nabad Soomaaliya ka tacajubtay. Bogga 144 waxa uu ku yiri: “Ururkii Itixaad kuma koobnayn dacwada iyo tacliinta oo keliya balse laamo u xilsaarnaa sugidda amniga gobolka. Taasina waxay sabatay in gobolku nabdoonaado kana badbaado isbaarooyinkii dadka lagu baaran jiray ee ka jiray inta badan ee gobollada dalka”. Waa hubaal in Gedo aan laga aqoon isbaaro ilaa la soo gaaray 1999kii. Balse ma ahayn mid uu Itixaad keenay. Itixaad waxa uu ka talinayay Beledxaawo iyo Luuq keliya. Doolow waxaa ka joogay ciidan yar laakiin maamulka waxaa haystay Xasandeer oo lid ku ahaa. Inta kale ee gobolka nabad ayaa ka jirtay si la mid ah sidii nabad u ahaayeen Luuq iyo Beledxaawo. Lagama aqoon isbaaro. Lama arki jirin mooryaan qoryo sidata oo suuqa wareegeysa. Intaan ogahay dadka lagu dilay dhinaca uu Itixaad xukumay ayaa ka badnaa intii lagu dilay dhinaca uusan xukumin. Haddaba sidee sheekhu ku sheegan karaa in uu Gedo nabad ka dhigey? Sow ma habboonayn in uu hadalka ku koobo deeggaannadii uu xukumay? Cidna ma inkiri karto wanaaggii uu Itixaad ka sameeyay deegaannadii uu xukumay. Si faahfaahsan waxaan uga hadlay buugga Halgankii Gunnimadoonka. Laakiin nabadda guud ee Gedo ka jirtay Itixaad sabab uma ahayn. Yaa sabab u ahaa dood kale oo aan halkaan boos u ahayn. Inta aad akhrinayso buugga, waxaad dareemeysaa in looga jawaabayo dhaliilo uu horay u tabiyay buugga Hangankii Gunnimadoonka. Ciwaannada qaar waa kuwii buugga aan xusnay, warka ku qoranna waa jawaab toos ah loogu talagalay in looga jawaabo su’aal ciwaankaasu siday. Waa ciwaanka leh “Dagaalka ma laga baaqsan karay”? Buugga Halgankii Gunnimadoonka su’aashaas ayuu keenay. Waxa uu si aad uga niqaashay in ay suuragal noqon lahayd in laga baaqsado in Xabashidu Gedo soo weerarto. Geeso badan ayuu wixii jiray ka istaagay. Taxliil, tacliilin iyo naqdin ka dibna waxaa uu ku gunaanaday in dagaalka laga baaqsan karay haddii la qaadi lahaa tallaabooyin uu buugu xusay. Buuggan hadda aynu gorfeyno isla su’aashaas ayuu keenay. Laakiin, walow looga hadlay 17 bog, jawaabtu ma noqon taxliilin iyo waaqaca oo dhinacyo badan la eego. Beddelkeeda waxaa la taxay shirar uu urur qabtay iyo dedaal uu u galay in uu bulshada deegaanka soo dhowaysto. Gunaanadkii jawaabtuna waxa ay noqotay in Itixaad doonayay in uu dadka xukumo isaga oo taageero ka hasyta laakiin ay SNF iyo Itoobiya middaa diiddanayd oo ay Xabashidu sidaa ku timid sidaa awgeedna aysan suuragal ahayn in dagaalka laga baaqsado. Bogga 176 ee buugga waxaa lagu yiri khulaasada: “Ma laga baaqsan karay dagaalka? Waxaan ku soo xiriyaa shirkan oo, sidoo kale, marag u noqonaya in mar walba maamulka wadaaddu u taagnaayeen xalraadinta iyo inaan gobolka loo horseedin amnidarro, bulshadana loo ilaaliyo waxqabadka muuqda iyo horumarka ay hiigsanaysay.” Sida ka muuqato khulaasada kore, sheekhu waxa uu ku dooday in colaadda laga baaqsan lahaa haddii reer Gedo taageeri lahaayeen maamulkii Itixaad. Haddaba taasi sax maaha. Marnaba Xabashida iyo gaaladii gadaal ka taagnayd ma daayeen gobolka inta Itixaad maamulayay. Taasi waxaa caddayn ugu filan hadallada ku xusan buugga dhexdiisa. Bogga 156 ee buugga waxaa ku qoran sidatan: “Tigreegu waxay dareemeen iftiinka Islaamiga ah ee baxaya kuna fidiya meel ka baxsan Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhankooda. Sidoo kale waxay garowsadeen in haddii uu sii fido dhaq-dhaqaaq ka curtay Gedo uu horseedi karo helitaan dowlad Soomaaliyeed. Arrintaasi waxau ku caddayd warbixinno laga qorayay Gedo, kuwaas oo nuxurkoodu ahaa: Haddii aan hadda wax laga qaban hawlaha ka socda Gedo, Geeska Afrika waxaa ka dhalan doona dowlad Islaami ah oo mayal adag. Taasina waxay keeni kartaa in danaha reer Galbeedka ee Geeska Afrika ay ciriiri galaan”. Bogga xiga ayaa sii waday sababta Tigeeru u soo weeraray Gedo waxaana ku qoran: “Tigreegu waxa xukuma Kaniisadda Orthodox oo ah tan ugu xagjirsan Kaniisadaha… Sidaas darteed ma aysan oggolaan karin curashada maamul Islaami ah oo ay deris wadaag yihiin”. Akhriste bal halkaas dul istaag oo gartaas nala naq. Maamulka sidaa u fahansanaa cadaawadda Tigreega, asii aan hayn awood uu isaga difaaco, halkii uu raadin lahaa jid looga baaqsado dagaal lala galo, waqtigii geliyay daandaansi hor leh haddana ku doodaya waan isku daynay in dagaalka laga baaqsado laakiin dhinaca naga soo horjeeday ayaa diiday, ma wax la qaadan karaa? Sidee dagaalka ku baaqan lahaa haddii ay SNF meesha ka bixi lahayd illeen colaadda Tigreegu waxa uu ahaa maamul col la ah oo sii xoogaysanyee? Laga yaabo in aad is tiraahdo sidee col ula ahaa ama u daandaansaday urur Itoobiya. Isla buuga dhexdiisa ayuu sheekhu ku qirayaa in xiriir la laahyeen ururkii Itixaad ee dagaalka kula jiray maamulkii Tigreega. Bogga 196 waxaa ku qoran: “Eedda ah inaad xiriir la lahaydeen al-Itixaad al-Islaami, gaar ahaan qaybta ka hawlgalaysay deegaannada Soomaalida ee Itoobiya, waa sax.” Haddaba dowlad mar kuu qabta cadaawad diimeed; Mar kuu qabta cadaawad dhuleed; mar kalana aad taageeraysid, si aan gabbasho lahayn, jamhad dagaal kula jirta, sideed uga baaqsan kartay weerarkeeda? Akhristoow adiga ayaan kuu daayay jawaabta balse aan ka jawaabo midda aad maanka ku hayso ee ah maxaa kaloo furnaa? Jawaabtaas oo faahfaahsan waxaad ugu noqon kartaa buugga Halgankii Gunnimadoonka. Iyada oo kooban, dadka qaba in dagaalka laga baaqsan karay waxa ay ku doodayaan waxa ay ahayd in la qaato taladii urur weynihii Itixaad ee ahayd meelna yaannan ku yeelan ciidan hubeysan. Culimadii reer Waqooyi-galbeed iyo kuwii reer Waqooyi-bari waxa ay fahmeen in aysan dhulkooda ka difaaci karin dal kale oo soo weeraray. Sidaa darteed waxa ay diideen in Itixaad xeryo ciidan ku yeesho dhulkooda. Laascaanood ayaa u danbaysay oo bil ka hor duullaankii Gedo ayaa la kala diray ciidan aan hub haysan oo xeryo lagu tababbari jiray. AUNtee Sheekh Cabdinaasir Xaaji Axmed oo ka warhelay in Xabashidu ku soo duuleyso ayaa kala diray si uu dadkiisa iyo deegaankiisa u badbaadiyo. Intii uu sheekh Cabdinaasir gartay ayay madaxdii Itixaadkii Gedo garan waayeen. Sheekhu waxa uu sheegay in madaxdii Itixaad soo amreen in uu dhallinyarada kala diro 1992. Bogga 138 waxa uu ku yiri: “Jabbuuti waxaa laga soo saaray go’aan ahaa in mucaskarka Gedo uu ka baxo Luuq. go’aankaas ma uusan noqon mid aan ku qanacno wuxuuna ka mid ahaa waxyaabihii dhaliyay khilaafka.” Mar kale 1993kii ayaa sheekh Maxamed lagu wargeliyay in uu u hoggaansamo amarka madaxda sare oo uu kala diro dhallinyarada labada goorba wuu diiday. Bogga 140 waxa uu ku yiri: “Markii uu soo baxay go’aankii lagu kala dirayay dhammaan ciidamadii al-Itixaad al-Islaami ee ku kala baahsanaa gobollada dalka, qaybta Gedo waxaa naloo soo diray Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan Sheekh Cumar Axmed iyo Sheekh Cabdiwaaxid Xaashi Xasan. Waxay la yimaadeen laba qodob oo kala ahaa: in amiirka [sheekh Maxamed Xaaji Yuusuf] iyo ku xigeenkiisa [macallin Maxamuud macallin Nuur] xilka laga qaado [iyo] in la kala diro ciidamada.” Sheekh Maxamed waxa uu sheegay in labadiiba ay diideen sababtana bogga 141 ayuu faahfaahiyay. Laakiin nuxurku waa in uusan u hoggaasamin amarkii ka soo baxay madaxdiisa. Haddii uu maalintii u hoggaansami lahaa amarkii madaxdiisa, Gedo waxa ay u badbaadi lahayd sidii ay u badbaadeen gobolladii kale ee dalka. Amar diiddadii waxay dhalisay dhibaatada ilaa maanta afka lagu difaacayo. Doodba ma jirteen haddii go’aankii ururka la fuliyo 1993kii. Waxaa yaab leh in sheekh Maxamed u aqoonsanaa dhulka Soomaaligalbeed dhul Itoobiya. Sida aan soo sheegnay, buuggu waa codkii sheekha oo qoraal loo rogay. Haddaba waxa ku qoran waxa ay noo yihiin erayadii sheekha. Buugga dhexdiisa ugu yaraan shan jeer ayaa lagu qoray erayo tilmaamaya in sheekhu dhulkaas u aqoonsanaa dhul Itoobiya. Bogga 20aad sheekha oo ka warramayo deegaan Dooloow u dhow oo uu xernimo u tagay waxa uu yiri: “Markii aan Dooloow imid, ayaa la ii sheegay in sheekh Ilkadahab iyo xertiisii ay aadeen dhanka Laba-Shillindi, oo ah carro Itoobiya. Waxay u dhowdahay webi la yiraahdo Webeyd, waxayna ka tirsan tahay gobolla Afdheer oo ka mid ah deegaanka Soomaalida ee Itoobiya.” Bogga 144 mar uu sheekha ka sheekaynayay horumarkii ururkiisu keenay waxa uu yiri: “Dabayshaas barakaysan waxay sidoo kale gaartay deegaannada deriska la ah gobolka Gedo sida Soomaalida Itoobiya”. Bogga 196 laba jeer ayay ku timid “deegaannada Soomaalida ee Itoobiya”. Dadka aamminsan qaddiyadda Soomaaligalbeed marnaba dhulkaas iyo dadkaas uma arkaan Itoobiyaan. Sinnaba kuma noqon karaan Itoobiyaan. In dhulka soomaaligalbeed tilmaan looga dhigo “ee Itoobiya” waa gef weyn oo aan fasir lahayn. Akhristoow garnaqsi ayuu buuggu noo dhiibtaye sidee qof dhulkaas u yaqaan dhul Itoobiya ugu doodi karaa xoreynta dhulkaas ayaan qeyb ka ahaa? Haddii aadan magaca keliya xorayn karin sidee xeryo ciidan ugu oodday in aad dhul xoreyso? Haddii aad dadkaas iyo deegaankaas u taqaan Itoobiyaan maxay ahayd xilka kaa saarnaa oo aad colaadda u soo jiidatay?  Buuggu qeybta garnaqsiga waxa kale uu ku keenay eedaymo uu sheegay in horay loogu jeediyay oo ku jawaabayo. Waxaa ka mid ahaa waxa ay cuskadeen xukunnada ay fulin jireen. Laakiin waxa uu doortay sheekhu ama qoraha buugga ayaa xushay kuwo jawaabtooda aysan dood badan ku jirin. Tusaale, wuxuu ka jawaabay waxa ay u daliishadeen khidmad ay ka qaadi jireen baabuurta xamuulka ah. Taasu dad badan dood kama qabin waa arrin maangal ah oo la fahmi kar sababta khidmada loo qaaday dabcan diintana qiil looga waayi maayo. Jawaabaha laga sugayay ee aan la soo hadalqaadin waxaa ka mid ahaa: waxa ay u cuskadeen raggii Soomaaliyeed ee baabuur ay dhaceen awgii Itixaad uu ugu wareejiyay Kiinya. Buugga meelna loogama soo qaadin arrintaa. Waxaa muuqato in la xushay intii ururka sawir fiican ka bixin lahayd. Magacyada raggaas iyo sida ay wax u dhaceen ugu noqo buugga Hangankii Gunnimadoonka. Eed kale oo uusan ka jawaabin waa in dad badan ay qabaan in Itixaad uu laba sharci ku kala dhaqi jiray ciidankiisa iyo shacabka uu xukumo. Markii ciidanku danbi galo sharciga masaalixada iyo xeer jajabka ayaa la cuskan jiray. Markii shacabku danbi galo oraahdu waxay ahayd “Kitaabka Alle wax aan ahayn ku kala bixi maayo”. Taasi hadal la iska yiri ma aha. Intii u dhaxaysay 1992 iyo 1996, danbe kale iska daaye, dilalka uu ciidanku geystay tobon ayay kor u dhaafeen. Waxan raadiyay in helo qof oo ka mid ah oo inta maxkamad la keenay shareecadu waxay siiso la mariyay. Buugga Halgankii Gunnimadoonka oo rag badan oo Itixaadkii Gedo ah ay akhriyeen si weynna u naqdiyeen tabtaas ayaan ugu qoray waxaana raaciyay qofkii haya hal kiis Allaha ka dhigee ha noo jawaabo. Ilaa maanta jawaabtaas waan sugaynaa. Sheekha oo ka jawaabaya dilalka ay geysteen ciidankii uu xukumay bogga 201 waxa uu ku yiri: “Qodob labaad ee gaabis ama ilduuf ku dhacay wuxuu ahaa in ay jireen falal dhacay dagaallada ka hor. Ma ahayn kuwo ku talagal ah ama go’aan la qaatay balse waxaa geystay niman dhallinyaro ah oo degdegay oo islahaa wax wanaajiya, hase yeeshee waxay khilaafeen mabda’a tadarujka iyo qiimeynta maslaxada. Dhallinyaradu waxay na galiyeen magao badan. Qaar waan bixinnay, qaarna iyadoo wax nagu dhimman yihiin ayaa duullaankii Tigreegu dhacay.” Waxa sheekhu ul jeedo gaabis iyo ilduuf dhacay ma in aan tallaabo laga qaadin baa? Maamul, dowlad, jamhad iyo cid walba oo meel ka arrimisa oo xubnaheedu danbi galayaan waa dabiici. Ma jirto cid ku eedaynayso Itixaad maxay danbi u galeen. Eeddu waxa ay tahay markii ay danbi galeen maxay u qaadin tallaabo ciqaabeed muuqato. Magbaan bixinney? Magta waxaa lagu samirsiiyay dadkii qofku ka baxay e qofkii danbiga geystay meeday wixii lagu sameeyay? Magta xaggee lagu go’aamiyay? Maxkamad mise xafiisyada madaxda? Ma ahayd mag dhammaystiran mise waxay ahayd afka dufan isu marin? Ugu yaraan, hal kiis oo aan ka warqabo waxa uu ahaa afka dugan isu marin. Nin la dilay aabbihii ayaa lagu yiri annagu lama macaamilmo qabiilo. Waxaan wax siinnaa qofka dhintay caa’iladiisa. Adaa carruurta u weyn. Waxaan kuu haynaa laba boqol oo kun oo shilin soomaali ah! Markii uu diiday jawaabtu waxay noqotay “cirka warmo u jar”. Waqtiga uu Itaxaad tobon qof oo uu dilay mago ka dhiibayo, dhinaca kale ee gobolka waxaa ka jiery qisaas xukunka lagu ridi jiray bannaan dadku daawanayo (fulinta qisaasta ma aha). Hal dil ayaa Garbahaarreay ka dhacay qisaas ayaa lagu dhammeeyay. Dhawr dil oo Baardheere ka dhacday qisaas iyo mag ayaa lagu dhammeeyay hadba midkii ay doorteen dadka wax laga dilay. Dhinaca Itixaad mag keliya ayaa ka jirtay illeen cidda wax dilaysay ciidanka ururka ayuu ahaaye. Dilalka aan kor ku sheegnay waxa ay dhaceen intii nabadda lagu jiray. Markii ay bannaanka tageen, waxa ay billaabeen dhabbagal iyo socoto gowrac. Dhawr dil oo si foolxun ay u filyeen ayaa jiray. Sheekha oo arrintaas ka hadlayo waxa uu yiri (bogga 191): “Sidoo kale, waxaa jiray rag iyaguna caan ahaa oo ku baxay gacanta wadaaddada. Waxaa ka mid ahaa Bile Shuuke Macallin Cabdi, Cabdulwahaab Cabdullaahi Warsame iyo Xasan Jaamac Falaxfalax. Labada nin ee hore waxaa la dilay markii wadaaddada laga saaray magaaloyinka oo ay miyiga galeen. Waxaan caddaynayaa inuusan jirin go’aan aniga iga soo baxay ama si guud maamulka Itixaad ee Gedo lagu gaaray in la laayo raggaas. Falka waxaa gaystay dhallinyaro caraysan, waana go’aan iyaga u gaar ah”. Waxa ay dilaan go’aan iyaga u gaar ah miyaa guusha ay keenanna waa mid madaxdu sheegato? Haddii uu sheekhu qaadan lahaa amarkii la siiyay 1993dii dhallinyaradu dariiqa ma istaagteen raggaasna ma aysan dileen. Go’aanka kala dirista ciidanka Itixaad sababtii ugu weynayd ayaaba ahayd in aan la xakamayn karin dhallinyarada jannadoonka ah. Ninkii go’aanka diiday masuuliyadda wixii ka dhashay ma diidi karo. Laba cidna kuma eedayn sheekh Maxamed inuu amarka dilka bixiyay waxa loo haysto waa in ururkii Itixaad uusan arrintaas canbaarayn, iska beriyeelin waxna ka oran oo uu ka aammusay. Aammusku waa aqbalaad sida la wada ogyahay. Waxa aan ka hadlayno waa rag shacab ahaa oo iyaga safar ah inta baabuur lagala degay la gowracay oo midkood meydkiisa qashin lagu dhex tuuray oo xataa aas ay quuri waayeen. Sheekhu wuu karay in uu yiraahdo amarka ma bixin laakiin wuu kari waayay inuu raaciyo “waan ka xumahay in la dilo” ama uu tuso wax uun dareen ah oo muujinayo inuu ka xumaa dilka raggaas iyo intii la midka ahayd. Halkii uu oran lahaa waa gef weyn oo ururka ka dhacay eeddii waxa uu saaray willasha uu ku amray duurka gala oo dhuumalaysi dagaallama. Sheekhu garnaqsiga waxa uu ku daray in aysan SNF garab ordin oo ay u daayeen aadidda shirarka dibadda sida Itoobiya iyo Kiinya. Sheegshadaan meel adag ma haysato. SNF waa saddex xaraf laakiin markii la sheego dadka waxaa ku soo dhacayo qabiilo Marreexaan la yiraahdo. Waxay ahayd summad qabiil iyo deegaan. Sidaas oo kale ayay Soomaalidu u wada sidatay summado dhawr xaraf ah ka kooban. Bogga 195 waxaa ku timid: “shirarka matalaadda gobolka Gedo wax ku sheegta SNF oo keliya ayaa jirta”. Haddaba, mar la tagayo shirarka dibadda, SNF waxay wax ku raadinaysay in ay matasho qabiilo weyn oo dhul ballaaran deggan. Sidaas darteed, waxa la qeybsanayo wax weyn in laga siiyo ayay ku doodeysay. Jawaabaha ay helayeen waxa ay ahayd in uusan jirin deegaan buuxa oo ay ka taliyaan oo gobolka qeybo badan uu Itixaad haysto SNF-na aan waxba laga weydiineyn. Dhinaca kale Itixaad ixtiraam uu hayo SNF ugama harin shirarka dibadda ee dhawr arrimood ayaa diidayay. Kow cidda qabanaysay Itixaad boos uma oggolayn. Laba, Itixaad qudhiisa shirarkaas waxa ay u arkayeen kuwo baaddil ah oo ay gaalo dabada ka riixayso in laga qaybgalana ay tahay diin la’aan. In xaalku sidaas ahaa waxaa noo caddaynaya isla buuggan. Shirkii Adis 1993 waxaa lagu heshiiyay in Soomaaliya oo dhan maamul isku nooc ah loo dhiso. Markii SNF isku dayday in ay fuliso go’aankii Adis 1993, Itixaad waa diiday. Sababtu waxay ku taallaa bogga 152-53: “Qodobaddaas waxaa lagu soo saaray qoraal. Hase yeeshee dhaqan gelintooda waxaa is-hortaagay maamulkayaga wadaaddada. Aniga mooyee, xunihii kale ee guddiga fulinta ayaa ka horyimid. Guddiga fulintu dooddoodu waxay ahayd “waa inay ka bari noqdaan gaalada”. Sida aad arki karto madaxdii Itixaad waxay taagan yihiin SNF gaalada ha ka bari noqoto si aan maamul ula wadaagno. Maamulka meesha yaallo waa midkii UNISOM soo dhistay. Haddii SNF laga rabo in ay ka bari noqoto UNISOM sidee Itixaad ku dhihi karaa shirarka dibadda SNF ayaan ku xurmaynay? Sidee uga bari noqon lahaayeen iyaga oo addeecaya go’aannadii ka soo baxay shirkii UNISOM. Buugga waxaa ku yimid meelo sidii ay wax u jireen aan loo tebin. Aan soo qaadanno qabashadii Luuq. Waa markii Itixaad Luuq uu ka saaray Caydiid. Ciidanka Itixaad waxaa lagu soo xoojiyay malleeshiyaad Marreexaan ah sida ku qoran bogga 134. Mar haddii magaalada la qabtay qorshuhu waxa uu ahaa in loo jeesto xagga Baardheere iyo Kismaayo.  Sheekha waxa uu sheegay in ay ciidanka ku yiraahdeen qofkii raba ha nala joogo kii rabana halkii uu ka yimid ha aado. Haddaba sidaas fudud wax uma dhicin. Tegiddu shardi ayuu ku xiray Itixaad. Shardigu waxa uu ahaa in qofkii tegaya laga reebayo qoriga uu sito. Qofkii raba in uu qoriga haysto saddex akhtiyaar ayaa midkood ayaa la siiyey: kow, aan kaa iibinno (qiimo aad uga hooseeyay midkii suuqa); aan kuu hayno oo waa danbe u soo laabo (is-aammin ma jirin) ama hayso oo naga mid noqo (urur aadan rabin ku biir) . Intaas qofkii aan ku qancin qoriga ha dhigo oo ha baxo. U fiirsno dadka ikhiyaarka laga qaaday ee la leeyahay qori lama bixi kartaan waa ciidankii gurmadka ugu yimid. Ujeedku waxa uu ahaa in qof sita uusan dib ugu laaban dhinaca SNF. Si go’aankaas loo fuliyo Itixaad waxa uu amar ku bixiyay in uusan ka gudbin qof ciidankii SNF ah oo qori sita. Buundada ayay dhigeen ciidan baara. Dabcan waa is weji yaqaannay oo dad wada dhashay ayay ahaayeen. Xogtan ma ahayn mid qarsoon. Waraysi aan ka qaaday, hadda ka hor, ciidankii SNF ee sidaas ay ku dhacday iyo qaar ka tirsanaa Itixaad oo goobjoog ahaa ayaan ka xaqiijiyay. Xogtaas oo faahfaahsan meel kale ayaan ku qoray oo Eebbe idinkii dhowaan la faafin doonaa. Halkaan waxaa naga quseeyo in sida sheekhu dhigay aysan arrintaas u dhicin. Buuggu, waxa kale oo si aan kutagal ahayn, uga marqaatikacayaa qaar ka mid ah dhaliilaha ururka loo jeediyay. Tusaale, waxaa lagu eedeeyay in ururku ahaa mid aan sawiran karin waxa ka dhalanaya tallaabooyinka uu qaadayo. Matalan, weerarkii kowaad ka dib, shir madaxdii Itixaad ku yeesheen Gedo waxaa lagu go’aamiyay in ururku la wareego lixda degmo ee gobolka muddo lix bilood ah “ujeedku wuxuu ahayd in degmo kasta taliskii loogu talagalay la wareego”. Bogga 158 iyo bogga 194 go’aan lagu xusay. Bal u fiirso dhibka uu abuuray go’aankaan. Buugga dhexdiisa sheekhu waxa uu noogu sheegay in ciidankiisu ahaa qiyaastii 600. Awood ay ku difaacaan Luuq ma aysan hayn. Markaas waxa dagaalka kula jiro waa Amxaaro keliya. Hal askari oo Marreexaan lama joogin. Halkii laga fogaan lahaa wax walba oo Marreexaan iyo Amxaaro isu soo dhowayn kara, waxaa la qaatay go’aan ah in gobolka lala wada wareegno. Dadkii awal lagu kicinayay Hawiye shaar wadaad soo xirtay ayaa dhulkii idinka qaadanayo ayaa weerar lagu qaaday. Weerarkii kowaad Buurdhuubo ayay ku qabsadeen. Dadka ay dileen waxaa ka mid ahaa Macallin Diiriye imaamkii masaajidka jaamaca ee magaalada. Waxaa ka dhashay in Marreexaan isku shubo Doolow oo Amxaaro garab hesho. Ninka aad go’aansatay in aad kala wareegto masaajidka uu imaamka ka yahay, xafiiska booliska uu xukumo, degmada uu maamulo ama meel kale oo uu madax ka yahay sideed ugu fikirtay in uu gacmaha laabto oo uusan kula dagaallamin? Wiilka 20 jirka ah ee aabbihii oo jooga meeshii ku dhashay, ku barbaaray, ku dhaqmay si maasajidka uu imaamka ka ahaa looga qaato 30 xabbo lagu dhiftay sidee loogu fikiray in uu gacmaha laabto oo uusan kula dagaallamin. Eedda ma isagaa leh mise adiga gurigiisa ku weeraray adoo xukun doon ah? Maxaa looga waayay dad shirka fadhiyay qaar yiraahda dagaal “Amxaaro ayaa nagu furan ee mid qabiilo yaannan isku furin. Waar dadkaan yaannan ku riixin in ay Amxaaro kaalmo u doontaan.” Qofkii las ocday taariikhdii jamhadihii dalka qabsaday wuu garan lahaa sida weerar lagu qaado dad meel deggan ay u horseedi lahayd Amxaaro xeryo u furto. Wacyi la’aanta haysay dadka go’aankaas gaaray waxaa kuugu filan in ay ku fikirayeen in dagaalka ay maalgelin doonaan qurbajoogta. Bogga 158 waxaa uu sheekhu ku yiri: “Ugu danbayn waxaa la isla qaatay in muddo lix bilood ah maamulka lagu baahiyo gobolka. Waxaa billowday abaabul iyo diyaargarow, waxaana farriin ka helnay jaaliyadaha dibadda oo oranaysay wixii taakulo ah ee aad u baahan tihiin waan idiin haynaa ee dhankiinna qorshe la imaada. Laakiin markii danbe waxaan caddaatay in jaaliyaduhu aysan hayn wax lagu fuliyo qorshihii aan dejinnay.” Horay waxaan u soo marnay sheekha oo leh in aan jirno waxaa diiddana Itoobiya u adeegaysa reer Galbeedka. Halkaan dagaal lagu qabsado gobol dhan ayaa lagu fikirayay in laga helo jaaliyado ku nool dalal col kula ah. Ma jiri karin lacag ururin bannaan lala imaan karay oo Itixaad lagu taageeri karay. Dadku waxa uu ahaa mid waddamada uu joogo ku cusub oo ama xamaal ku nool ama ceyr. Dalkii qax iyo colaado ayaa ka taagnaa oo qof walba oo qurbaha joogay qoysas dhan baa dul saarnaa. Xaggee ka keeni karaan qarash lagu galo dagaal intaas la eg la isma weydiin. Sidii caadada u ahayd, iyaga oo aan xaajada dhinacyo badan ka joogsan ayay ku sheekeysteen ciidan nagu filan waan haysannaa haatanna gurmad baa Xamar nooga yimid. Wixii qarash ah ee aan u baahanno jaaliyadaha ayaa diyaar ah. Gobolka oo dhan aan qabsanno oo aan maamulkeenna ku soo rogno lix bilood gudahood. Allaahu Akbar! Allaahu Akbar! Shirku noo xiran! Taasi waxay dhashay in iyaga oo weli shacabka Buurdhuubo dagaal kula jira intii hore ee ay haysteen lagala wareego sagaal bilood ka dib! Qormada oo dheeraatay aan ku soo xiro, buuggan waxa uu xoojiyay eedaymihii jiray e kama uusan jawaabin. Dooddan waxa ay ahaan doontaa mid taagan, inta laga helayo madax Itixaad ah oo kudhac leh oo tiraahda ‘gef baa naga dhacay, waana ka xunnahay wixii naga dhacay’. Inta la taaganyahay dadkii ururku laayay masuul kama aynaan ahayn ee dhallinyaro caraysan baa laysay; dad degaan ah weerar kuma aynaan qaadin, iyada oo la qiranayo in go’aan gole shuuro ah lagu gaaray in degmo walba la qabsado; inta dooddu tahay imaanshaha Amxaaro wax shaqo ah kuma lihin, iyada oo aan isla oggolnahaye in haddii uusan ururku ciidan hubaysan Gedo ku haysan lahayn aysan weligeed Amxaaro soo aaddeen, meel la isaga soo dhowaado ma jiri doonto! WQ: Ibraahin Aadan Shire Aqoonyahan iyo Taariikhyahan

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo booqday Xerada Militariga Maslax (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa maanta booqasho ku tegay Xerada Militariga Maslax ee duleedka Magaalada Muqdisho. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa war qoraal ah ku sheegay in Taliyuhu uu booqasho iyo kormeer shaqo ku tegay xeradaasi. “Taliyaha Ciidanka, isaga oo ka duulaya howlaha mudnaanta u leh ciidanka iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa adeegyada taakulaynta, ayaa indha-indheeyay xarumaha iyo goobaha loogu talagalay taageerada iyo taakulaynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Saraakiisha Taliska Taakulaynta, oo uu ugu horreyo Sareeye Guuto Maxamed Maxamuud Garabey ayaa Taliyaha warbixin ka siiyay howlaha ugu dambeeyay ee taliska, qorsheyaasha casriyeynta iyo horumarinta adeegyada taakulaynta iyo qorshaha lagu soo kordhinayo xarumo cusub oo casri ah, si loo xoojiyo waxqabadka Taliska Taakulaynta.” Kormeerka Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Xerada Maslax ayaa imanaya, iyadoo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Booliska Sida Gaarka ah u tababaran ee Haramcad ay hawlgal ka dhan ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ka wadan deegaanka Basra oo ku yaala xadka Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Shabellaha Dhexe. Xerada Maslax ayaa ah xarun ciidan, laguna tababaro Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, waana saldhig militari oo muhiim u ah amniga caasimadda iyo nawaaxigeeda.

items.title: Trump Administration Launches Foundry School to Build the Workforce Behind America’s Manufacturing Comeback
items.description: Trump Administration Launches Foundry School to Build the Workforce Behind America’s Manufacturing Comeback Office of the Spokesperson On Thursday, September 3, the Trump Administration will launch Foundry School, a national program to train the entrepreneurs, engineers, technicians, and industrial leaders needed to rebuild American manufacturing. Vice President JD Vance will headline the launch event. Foundry School is a project of Pax Silica , the Department’s flagship multilateral initiative to secure trusted global supply chains for the technologies that will define the next century. President Trump’s reindustrialization agenda has already brought trillions of dollars in industrial investment to American soil. Foundry School will focus on turning that investment into jobs. American manufacturers will need an estimated 3.8 million skilled workers by 2033 in semiconductors, defense, energy, and beyond, and Foundry School exists to make sure Americans fill those jobs. The program will put American workers first by equipping them with the skills needed to bring manufacturing jobs home and build careers in industries critical to our nation’s economic security. The launch event, which begins at 8:20 a.m. at the Donald J. Trump Institute of Peace , will feature remarks by senior Administration officials, university leaders and industry executives, as well as a photo opportunity. Foundry School was announced as a Pax Silica initiative by Under Secretary Helberg at the Pax Summit on June 25, 2026. Announced as a workforce development partnership with Stanford University, Foundry School is anchored in a first-of-its-kind advanced manufacturing curriculum for American students developed by Stanford that also features keystone lectures provided by seven universities with which Stanford has collaborated. Those universities are Arizona State University, Georgia Tech, Ohio State University, Penn State, the University of Cincinnati, the University of Kansas, and Vanderbilt University. Across these eight campuses, the program will run 17 sessions, each taught by founders and CEOs from advanced manufacturing enterprises. These leaders will be drawn from the United States and Pax Silica participants, including the Republic of Korea, Japan, Taiwan, and India, covering everything it takes to build and run a world-class manufacturing enterprise. It is a single course to ensure that the American workforce benefits from America’s industrial renaissance.

items.title: Somalia: Armed militias seize election centers in Beledweyne
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Armed militias seized centers designated for voter registration in Beledweyne on Tuesday, as Somalia’s electoral commission set September 30 for Hirshabelle municipal and parliamentary elections, intensifying opposition to the planned vote, Caasimada Online news website reported on Tuesday. Some of the militias, speaking to local media, said they oppose the elections being conducted by the government-appointed electoral commission. They said they would not accept a vote in which only one favored candidate is allowed to contest while all other candidates are banned, arguing that the process mirrors such an arrangement. The Somali federal government has not yet taken any action against the militias. The seizure comes as Hawadle clan politicians strongly oppose the planned Hirshabelle election, saying the process is not fair. They are also demanding their turn at the presidency of the Hirshabelle regional administration. The competing objections have placed the planned elections under heightened political tension in Beledweyne, where the seizure of the registration centers has directly disrupted locations designated for the electoral process. The militias’ opposition centers on what they describe as a process that favors one candidate while excluding others, while Hawadle politicians are challenging the fairness of the Hirshabelle election and pressing for their turn at the regional presidency. With the electoral commission having scheduled the Hirshabelle municipal and parliamentary elections for September 30, the dispute over the process remains unresolved, while the Somali federal government has yet to take action against the militias. items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo shaacisay in Itoobiya ay heli karto marin-badeed haddii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad) ayaa shaaciyay in Itoobiya ay heli karto marin la isku halayn karo oo ay badda uga soo gasho Soomaaliya. Cali Balcad ayaa sheegay in arrintaas lagu gaari karo heshiisyo ganacsi oo labada dal faa’iido u leh, iyadoo lagu fulinayo awoodda iyo madax-bannaanida Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wasiiru-dowlaha oo wareysi siiyay wargeyska Asharq Al-Awsat ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya uu ku salaysan yahay bayaankii Ankara ee labada dal ay kala saxiixdeen sanadkii 2024, kaas oo labada dhinac ku waajibinaya inay ixtiraamaan madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya. “Heshiiskaasi waa saldhigga xiriirka labada dal,” ayuu yiri Wasiiru-dowlaha, isagoo sidoo kale sheegay in is-afgaradkii ay Itoobiya iyo Somaliland kala saxiixdeen uusan hadda lahayn muhiimad weyn. Balcad ayaa tilmaamay in natiijada wada-hadalladii Ankara ay muujinayso in baahida Addis Ababa ee marin-badeed lagu xallin karo waddo ganacsi iyo diblomaasiyadeed, halkii loo adeegsan lahaa heshiisyo ay Muqdisho u aragto inay wax u dhimayaan madax-bannaanideeda. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay inuusan u arkin muhiim in waqti badan lagu bixiyo doodda ku saabsan xaaladda is-afgaradkii Itoobiya iyo Somaliland, isagoo tilmaamay in bayaanka Ankara iyo wada-xaajoodyada cusub ay yihiin qaabka hadda lagu wajahayo arrinta marin-badeedka Itoobiya. Cali Balcad ayaa xaqiijiyay in Soomaaliya ay Itoobiya kala shaqeyn karto sidii loo heli lahaa xal ku saabsan baahideeda marin-badeed, kaasi oo ku imaanaya wada-hadal iyo heshiis labada dhinac ah oo ixtiraamaya madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, hadalka wasiirka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli is-afgaradkii Itoobiya iyo Somaliland uu weli yahay arrin xasaasi ah oo saameyn ku leh xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya, iyadoo Muqdisho ay ku adkeysanayso in heshiis kasta oo la xiriira marin-badeedka Addis Ababa lagu gaaro iyadoo Soomaaliya ay qayb ka tahay. The post DF Soomaaliya oo shaacisay in Itoobiya ay heli karto marin-badeed haddii… appeared first on Caasimada Online .
