items.title: Masuuliyiin hore oo ciidanka Laftagareen ku booqday duleedka Baydhabo (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Xasan Cabdiqaadir Maxamed, Afhayeenkii hore ee Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed iyo masuuliyiin kale ayaa maanta duleedka Magaalada Baydhabo ku booqday ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ee halkaasi ku sugan. Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed ayaa sheegay in masuuliyiin sare oo uu hoggaaminayo Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Xasan Cabdiqaadir Maxamed ay kormeer dhiirigelin ah ugu taggeen Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ee fariisamaha ku leh buu yiri hareeraha Baydhabo. “Wafdiga oo ay qayb ka ahaayeen Afhayeenka Dowladda iyo Gudoomiyeyaasha Baydhabo iyo Waajid ayaa ciidanka ku amaanay geesinimada iyo adkeysiga ay muujinayaan, iyagoo ku dhiirigeliyay sii xoojinta halganka dib-u-xoreynta Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayuu yiri Ugaas Xasan Cabdi. Ugaas Xasan Cabdi ayaa bartiisa xiriirka bulshada ku sheegay “Masuuliyiintu waxay sidoo kale ciidanka kula dardaarmeen ilaalinta shacabka iyo sii wadidda hawlgalada ka dhanka ah maleeshiyaadka Salbalaar iyo Af-Balaar.” Tani waa farriin diidmo ah oo garabka mucaaradka ee Laftagareen uu hoggaamiyo ay ku qaadacayaan baaqa Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu ugu jeediyay in wada hadal lagu dhameeyo wax kasta oo lagu kala aragti duwan yahay. Koonfur Galbeed ayaa waxaa ka taagan loolan siyaasadeed iyo mid ciidan oo u dhexeeya maamulka cusub iyo hoggaankii hore. Laftagareen ayaa Khamiistii ku celiyay in uu weli yahay Madaxweynaha sharciga ah ee Koonfur Galbeed, xoogna ay dib ugu qabsan doonaan Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Kenya oo Suuq Cusub Furaya
items.description: Somalia and Kenya Push for Stronger Trade and Investment Ties Somalia and Kenya are seeking to deepen economic cooperation, with trade facilitation, investment and regional integration at the centre of discussions between senior officials from the two countries.Somalia’s Minister of Commerce and Industry, Ambassador Gamal Mohamed Hassan, is scheduled to meet Kenya’s Cabinet Secretary for Investments, Trade and Industry, Lee Kinyanjui, in Addis Ababa on September 3, according to information released by the Somali side.The talks are expected to focus on reducing obstacles to cross-border commerce and creating a more predictable environment for businesses operating between Somalia and Kenya. Key areas include the movement of goods, customs procedures, border operations and opportunities for investment. The two sides are also expected to examine cooperation in agriculture, livestock, fisheries, manufacturing, logistics and services.The discussions come as Somalia works to translate its membership in the East African Community (EAC) into practical economic benefits. Somalia became a full EAC member in March 2024, joining Kenya and seven other regional states in the bloc.The EAC’s Customs Union provides a framework for freer movement of goods within the region, while its Common Market framework covers the movement of goods, people, labour, services and capital. For Somalia and Kenya, the potential benefits are significant because the two countries already have longstanding commercial links. Earlier in 2026, Kenya’s government said trade relations with Somalia had strong potential for further growth following Somalia’s entry into the EAC.Data cited during the Somalia–Kenya Trade Week in Nairobi showed that Kenyan exports to Somalia increased by 89.7 percent between 2020 and 2023, although they declined by 19 percent in 2024. Kenyan imports from Somalia also recorded major fluctuations during the same period. Somalia has recently intensified efforts to remove trade barriers and improve access to regional markets. In June, Minister Gamal said the government was working with neighbouring countries, including Kenya, Ethiopia and Djibouti, to make cross-border trade easier and safer for Somali businesses.The discussions also come as Somalia moves toward implementing the African Continental Free Trade Area. The AfCFTA Secretariat said in August that Somalia intended to deposit its ratification instrument with the African Union in September 2026, a step that would make Somalia the agreement’s 50th State Party. The broader objective is to move beyond agreements and turn regional integration into tangible opportunities for businesses and consumers.For Somali traders, progress on customs procedures, border systems, logistics and market access could reduce the costs and delays associated with moving goods between the two countries.For Kenya, stronger economic ties with Somalia could provide additional opportunities for exports, investment and access to Somali markets. The outcome of the discussions in Addis Ababa is therefore likely to be closely watched by businesses on both sides, particularly as Somalia seeks to use its EAC and AfCFTA membership to expand regional and continental trade. The post Soomaaliya iyo Kenya oo Suuq Cusub Furaya first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Magaalada Muqdisho oo ka go’ay Gaaska cuntada lagu karsado, qiimihiisana uu kordhay 42%
items.description: Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa laga dareemayaa gabaabsi ku yimid gaaska cuntada lagu karsado, iyadoo haamaha yar ee laga heli karo suuqyada ay qiimahoodu sare u kaceen boqolkiiba 42%, sida ay sheegeen dadka adeegsada. Kororka qiimaha iyo yaraanta gaaska ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay qoysas badan, maqaayado iyo hoteello ku tiirsan gaaska. Gaaska oo horey muhiim ugu ahaa nolol-maalmeedka shacabka ayaa hadda noqday mid adag in la helo. Lama shaacin sababta rasmiga ah ee keentay yaraanta gaaskan cusub, balse arrintan ayaa shacabka ku soo beegantay xilli ay horeyba u jireen culaysyo dhinaca qiimaha nolosha ah.

Lama shaacin sababta rasmiga ah ee keentay yaraanta gaaskan cusub, balse arrintan ayaa shacabka ku soo beegantay xilli ay horeyba u jireen culaysyo dhinaca qiimaha nolosha ah.

items.title: Culimada Soomaaliyeed oo soo dhaweeyay tallaabadii Muungaab
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Midowga Golayaasha Culimada Soomaaliyeed oo maanta soo saaray bayaan culus ayaa si weyn usoo dhaweeyay qorshaha dib u dejinta ee uu ku dhawaaqay guddoomiyaha maamulka gobolka Banaadir, ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab). Duqa Muqdisho ayaa maalin kahor sheegay in tallaabadan la fulinayo iyadoo la raacayo amarka iyo jihaynta Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo faraysa in hawlaha qurxinta caasimaddu ay barbar socoto ilaalinta xuquuqda iyo karaamada muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed Sidoo kale, wuxuu timaamay in 1,058 boos oo dhul ah uu maamulka u iibiyey dadka ay saameeyeen hawlaha jid-bixinta, kuwaas oo si lacag la’aan ah loogu wareejinayo qoysaska guryahoodu ku waayay hagaajinta xaafadaha isku-raranka ah (OBASIIBOOYINKA) ee caasimada. Intaas kadib warsaxaafadeed maanta kasoo baxay Midowga Golayaasha Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa lagu taageeray tallaabada guddoomiyaha gobolka, iyadoo culimadu sheegeen in arrintan ay u arkaan mid looga jawaabayo talooyinkii iyo dardaarankii ay ugu jeediyeen maamulka, gaar ahaan baaqii ahaa in loo turo dadka danyarta ah iyo qoysaska nugul ee duruufaha adag ku nool, lana dhowro karaamadooda iyo xuquuqdooda muwaadinimo. Culimada ayaa si gaar ah u bogaadiyay dhulka ay dowladda hoose ee Xamar ka diyaarisay degmada Gubadley, kaas oo loogu talagalay in dib-u-dejin loogu sameeyo shacabka ay saameeyeen qorshayaasha dowladda ee la xiriira horumarinta caasimadda. “Waxaan si gaar ah u soo dhoweynaynaa qorshaha dowladda hoose ee Xamar ugu diyaarisay deegaanka Gubadley ilaa kun boos oo la dejinayo muwaadiniinta ay saameeyeen hawlaha dib-u-qaabaynta, iyadoo Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Md. Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), uu ballan qaaday in goobaha cusub laga hirgelinayo adeegyada aasaasiga u ah bulshada, sida biyaha, korontada, waxbarashada iyo adeegyada caafimaadka,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka culimada. Sidoo kale, waxaa la sii raaciyay “Waxaan sidoo kale dardaaran ugu jeedinaynaa Maamulka Gobolka in dib-u-dejinta lagu saleeyo xaqiijin iyo diiwaangelin dhab ah oo lagu ogaanayo dadka sida dhabta ah u deggenaa goobaha ay saameeyeen hawlaha dib-u-qaabaynta, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo dadka nugul iyo qoysaska aan haysan awood ay ku raadsadaan xuquuqdooda”. Midowga Golayaasha Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidoo kale ugu mahadceliyay Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir tallaabada wanaagsan ee uu qaaday, waxaana uu ku boorriyay in hirgelinteeda lagu saleeyo caddaalad, hufnaan, sinnaan iyo daryeelka dadka nugul. Dhanka kale, culimada ayaa baaq u diray dhammaan dadka Soomaaliyeed oo ay ka dalbadeen in ay u dheg-nuglaadaan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo, laguna qurxinayo caasimadda dalka, ayna si mas’uuliyad iyo wadajir leh uga qaybqaataan qorshayaasha lagu horumarinayo bilicda, nadaafadda iyo amniga. Ugu dambayn, Midowga Golayaasha Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa ku boorriyay ganacsatada, maalgashadayaasha iyo hay’adaha samafalka in ay iska kaashadaan wax u qabashada danyarta Soomaaliyeed ee dib-u-dejinta loo samaynayo, iyo bulshada qaybaheeda nugul ee gargaarka u baahan. The post Culimada Soomaaliyeed oo soo dhaweeyay tallaabadii Muungaab appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dawladda Soomaaliya oo qirtay ciidamada lagu qabtay gudaha Itoobiya in ay tababar ku soo dhamaysteen Somalia
items.description: La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka ee Soomaaliya Aweys Xaaji Yuusuf ayaa xaqiijiyay in la sheegay in tirada aan la shaacin ee ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed (SNA) ee dhawaan tababar ku qaatay Xananbuure, Galmudug ay u gudbeen Dowlad Goboleedka Soomaalida Itoobiya. Sarkaalka kama uusan hadlin tirooyinka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wuxuu sheegay in ciidamadu ay fasax u joogeen inay booqdaan qoysaskooda iyo qaraabadooda ka dib markay dhammeeyaan tababarkooda. Wuxuu raaciyay: “Haddii ay jiraan arrimo kale, waan idiin sheegi doonnaa (warbaahinta).” Qoritaankan ay soo bandhigtay NSA-da Soomaaliya waa mid cusub oo lagu ammaano, laakiin waxay u badan tahay inay ka jawaabto su’aalo badan. Ma Soomaaliya ciidamo ka qortay Dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya iyadoo oggolaansho ka haysata mas’uuliyiinta gobolka iyo kuwa federaalka? Haddii aysan ahayn, sidee bay Addis Ababa uga jawaabi doontaa?

items.title: Fartaag oo la kulmay Wasiirada Amniga ee Dowlad Goboleedyada qaarkood
items.description: Wasiirka Amniga Somaliya, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil Fartaag ayaa Arbacadan Magaalada Muqdisho kula kulmay Wasiirada Amniga ee Dowlad Goboleedyada Koonfur Galbeed, Hirshabelle, Galmudug iyo Waqooyi Bari. Wasiir Fartaag ayaa bartiisa Facebook ku daabacay “Waxaan maanta la kulmay Wasiirada Amniga ee Dowlad Goboleedyada Koonfur Galbeed, Galmudug, Hirshabelle iyo Waqooyi-Bari, kuwaas oo Magaalada Muqdisho u jooga ka qeybgalka Shirweynaha Qaran ee Amniga Gudaha, oo 1–2 Sebteembar 2026 ka socda Muqdisho, loogana hadlayo xoojinta amniga gudaha, isku-xirka hay’adaha amniga iyo dardargelinta wada-shaqeynta Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedyada.” Shirweynaha Amniga Qaranka oo Talaadadii ku furmay Caasimadda Muqdisho ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xoojina amniga, horumarinta laamaha amniga iyo iskaashiga Hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Dowlad Goboleedyada. Shirka ayaa looga gol leeyahay adkeynta xasilloonida dalka iyo isku-duwidda laamaha amniga, iyadoo uu geba-gabo ku dhow yahay Hawlgalka AUSSOM.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Jaamacadda UDST ee Qatar oo Heshiis Iskaashi ku Gaaray Horumarinta Tacliinta Farsamada
items.description: DOHA (Goobjoog News) — Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Jaamacadda Sayniska iyo Tiknoolajiyadda ee Doha (UDST) ayaa magaalada Doha ku kala saxiixday heshiis is-afgarad ah oo lagu horumarinayo tacliinta farsamada iyo tababarrada xirfadeed ee Soomaaliya. Heshiiskan ayaa xoogga saaraya diyaarinta barnaamijyo waxbarasho oo wadajir ah, tababarka macallimiinta, hubinta tayada waxbarashada iyo kobcinta hay’adaha tacliinta sare ee dalka. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa iska kaashan doona maadooyinka muhiimka ah ee ay ka mid yihiin tiknoolajiyadda macluumaadka, nidaamyada xogta, injineernimada dhismaha, farsamada korontada, tamarta la cusboonaysiin karo iyo maaraynta adeegyada caafimaadka. Qorshaha heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale waxaa ka mid ah in gudaha Soomaaliya laga hirgeliyo machad waxbarasho oo ay si wadajir ah u taageeraan Soomaaliya iyo Jaamacadda UDST, kaas oo bixin doona barnaamijyo tacliin iyo tababbarro farsamo. Heshiiskan ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu horumarinayo tayada waxbarashada iyo diyaarinta dhalinyaro xirfad leh oo ka jawaabi kara baahida sii kordheysa ee suuqa shaqada iyo horumarinta dalka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, weli lama shaacin goobta rasmiga ah ee machadka laga dhisayo, miisaaniyadda mashruuca, jadwalka howlgalka iyo faahfaahinta kale ee muhiimka ah.

items.title: Shirkii golaha Wasiirrada ee maanta iyo wixii lagaga wada hadlay
items.description: Fadhigii 74-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland oo uu Shir-guddoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), oo uu wehelinayo Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi ayaa maanta ka qabsoomay Qasriga Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Qodobbada ugu muhiimsan ee lagaga wada hadlay Fadhiga 74-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada JSL waxa ka mid ahaa: 1. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐐𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka JSL, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab, ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay xaaladda amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka, isaga oo adkeeyey in amniga Qaranku uu yahay Tiirka koowaad ee xasilloonida iyo horumarka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isla markaana ay Xukuumaddu si joogto ah u xoojinayso feejignaanta iyo wada-shaqaynta ka dhaxaysa Hay’adaha Amniga Qaranka. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u xaqiijiyey in guud ahaan ammaanka dalku uu wanaagsan yahay, Hay’adaha Amniguna ay si buuxda ugu diyaarsan yihiin ilaalinta qarannimada, nabadda iyo kala dambaynta dalka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. 2. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐡𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiiru-Dawlaha Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha JSL, Mudane Ismaaciil Mawliid Cabdilaahi ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay xaaladda guud ee Dhaqaalaha Dalka, isaga oo sheegay in Wasaaraddu ay dedaal badan gelisay dib-u-habaynta iyo casriyeynta Nidaamka Maamulka Maaliyadda Qaranka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in Wasaaraddu ay hirgelisay nidaam cusub oo electronic ah oo lagu xoojinayo laguna casriyeynayo dhammaan Dukumentiyada leh qiimaha lacageed, sida: Liisamada, Ruqsadaha iyo Shahaadooyinka. Wasiirku waxa uu si guud u iftiimiyey ujeeddooyinka iyo faa’iidooyinka uu nidaamkani u leeyahay Qaranka JSL. 3. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐡𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐌𝐚𝐜𝐢𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Dalxiiska Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Xasan Nuur ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada siiyey warbixin la xidhiidha xaaladda Shidaalka iyo Maciishadda dalka, isbeddellada qiimeyaasha suuqa, sabbaynta suuqa isku-beddelka sarrifka lacagaha, kor-joogtaynta iyo hubinta kaydka shidaalka dalka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in korodhka qiimaha shidaalka iyo maciishaddu ay tahay dhacdo caalami ah oo saamaysay suuqyada dunida oo dhan, taasoo salka ku haysa xaaladaha amni ee ka jira Bariga Dhexe. 4. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐊𝐮𝐛𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐠𝐭𝐚 𝐞𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha JSL, Mudane Axmed-Yaasiin Maxamed Faarax ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay habsami-u-socodka Horyaalka Kubadda Cagta ee Gobollada Dalka, iyo qorshaha Wasaaradda ee la xidhiidha dayactirka iyo horumarinta garoommada ciyaaraha ee Gobollada. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in dhawaan dalka, gaar ahaan Hargeysa, lagu qaban doono Orodka Badh-Mahratoonka Caalamiga ah oo la filayo in ay sannadkan ka soo qayb galaan orodyahanno ka kala imanaya ilaa 11 dal. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in arrintani ay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland u horseedayso fursad muhiim ah oo lagu horumarinayo ciyaaraha fudud laguna xoojinayo xidhiidhka caalamiga ah ee dhinaca ciyaaraha.

𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐐𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka JSL, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab, ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay xaaladda amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka, isaga oo adkeeyey in amniga Qaranku uu yahay Tiirka koowaad ee xasilloonida iyo horumarka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isla markaana ay Xukuumaddu si joogto ah u xoojinayso feejignaanta iyo wada-shaqaynta ka dhaxaysa Hay’adaha Amniga Qaranka. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u xaqiijiyey in guud ahaan ammaanka dalku uu wanaagsan yahay, Hay’adaha Amniguna ay si buuxda ugu diyaarsan yihiin ilaalinta qarannimada, nabadda iyo kala dambaynta dalka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. 2. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐡𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiiru-Dawlaha Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha JSL, Mudane Ismaaciil Mawliid Cabdilaahi ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay xaaladda guud ee Dhaqaalaha Dalka, isaga oo sheegay in Wasaaraddu ay dedaal badan gelisay dib-u-habaynta iyo casriyeynta Nidaamka Maamulka Maaliyadda Qaranka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in Wasaaraddu ay hirgelisay nidaam cusub oo electronic ah oo lagu xoojinayo laguna casriyeynayo dhammaan Dukumentiyada leh qiimaha lacageed, sida: Liisamada, Ruqsadaha iyo Shahaadooyinka. Wasiirku waxa uu si guud u iftiimiyey ujeeddooyinka iyo faa’iidooyinka uu nidaamkani u leeyahay Qaranka JSL. 3. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐡𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐌𝐚𝐜𝐢𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Dalxiiska Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Xasan Nuur ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada siiyey warbixin la xidhiidha xaaladda Shidaalka iyo Maciishadda dalka, isbeddellada qiimeyaasha suuqa, sabbaynta suuqa isku-beddelka sarrifka lacagaha, kor-joogtaynta iyo hubinta kaydka shidaalka dalka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in korodhka qiimaha shidaalka iyo maciishaddu ay tahay dhacdo caalami ah oo saamaysay suuqyada dunida oo dhan, taasoo salka ku haysa xaaladaha amni ee ka jira Bariga Dhexe. 4. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐊𝐮𝐛𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐠𝐭𝐚 𝐞𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha JSL, Mudane Axmed-Yaasiin Maxamed Faarax ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay habsami-u-socodka Horyaalka Kubadda Cagta ee Gobollada Dalka, iyo qorshaha Wasaaradda ee la xidhiidha dayactirka iyo horumarinta garoommada ciyaaraha ee Gobollada. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in dhawaan dalka, gaar ahaan Hargeysa, lagu qaban doono Orodka Badh-Mahratoonka Caalamiga ah oo la filayo in ay sannadkan ka soo qayb galaan orodyahanno ka kala imanaya ilaa 11 dal. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in arrintani ay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland u horseedayso fursad muhiim ah oo lagu horumarinayo ciyaaraha fudud laguna xoojinayo xidhiidhka caalamiga ah ee dhinaca ciyaaraha.

items.title: Xildhibaan Saadaam: DF waxay Puntland ku abuurtay burcad-badeed
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online ) – Xildhibaan Saadaam Maxamuud Cabdi oo ka tirsan Mudanayaasha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aaddan xaaladda Maamul-goboleedka Puntland, gaar ahaan khilaafka culus ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo maamulkaasi Xildhibaanka oo laga soo doorto deegaannada Puntland ayaa eedeymo waa wayn u jeediyay dowladda dhexe, wuxuuna sheegay inay faragelin ku sameysay xaaladda amni ee Puntland, ayna Puntland ka abuurtay kooxo uu ku tilmaamay jabhado noqday burcadbadeed. Saadaam ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in Puntland ay qaaday tallaabooyin looga hortagayo burcadda, isla markaana ciidamada ammaanku ay gacanta ku dhigeen qaar kamid ah kooxahaasi, welina socda howlgalka lagu baacsanayo. “Dowladda Federaalka ayaa jabhado nagu abuurtay jabhadihii qaybtii la qabtay maahee intii kale ayaa badda galay,” ayuu yiri xildhibaan Saadaam. Xildhibaanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamadii horay looga diiwaangeliyay Puntland ay dhibaatooyin ka wadaan halkaasi, isla markaana ay isku beddeleen burcad-badeed, sida uu ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyay warbaahinta. “Ciidamo sow lagama diiwaangelinayn Puntland? Kuwaas ayaa burcad-badeed noqday waana lala dagaalamayaa,” ayuu sii raaciyay xildhibaanku. Eedeymaha uu jeediyay xildhibaan Saadaam ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay xeebaha Soomaaliya ka jiraan howlgallo ka dhan ah burcad-badeedda, kuwaas oo mar kale qaar dib uga soo cusboonaaday qeybo kamid ah xeebaha dalka. Si kastaba, hadalka xildhibaanka ayaa muujinaya sida uu u sii xoogeysanayo khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Villa Somalia iyo Puntland, iyadoo weli ay taagan yihiin kala aragti duwanaansho ku saabsan arrimaha la xiriira nidaamka federaalka iyo qaabka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka dalka. The post Xildhibaan Saadaam: DF waxay Puntland ku abuurtay burcad-badeed appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ciidankii taabacsanaan Lafta-gareen oo duqeyn lala beegsaday
items.description: Naaxo ( Raxanreeb Online) Ciidamadii taabacsanaa madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed ee Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen ayaa heegan sare lagu geliyay fariisimahooda ku yaalla duleedka magaalada Baydhaba. Wararka ayaa waxa ay intaas ku darayaan in xalay diyaarado ay madaafiic ku garaaceen deegaanka Naaxo, oo ku dhow fariisimaha ciidamada Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed. Ilaa hadda lama xaqiijin cidda lahayd diyaaradda iyo bartilmaameedkii ay duqeyntu ku wajahneyd, sidoo kalena ma cadda khasaaraha ka dhashay madaafiicda la sheegay in lagu garaacay deegaanka. Xaaladda duleedka magaalada Baydhaba ayaa hadda kacsan, iyadoo ciidamada Daraawiishta lagu soo warramayo inay heegan ku jiraan. items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed oo qaabilay Odayaasha Dhaqanka (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa maanta Madaxtooyada Magaalada Baydhabo ku qaabilay Odayaasha Dhaqanka Koonfur Galbeed. “Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray doorka muhiimka ah ee Odayaasha Dhaqanka ay ka qaadanayaan qabsoomidda gogosha dib-u-heshiisiinta, nabadaynta iyo xoojinta wadajirka bulshada reer Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada. Maamulka Aadan Madoobe ayaa Isniintii ku baaqay wada hadal iyo is faham lagu xallinayo xiisadaha siyaasadadeed kuwa amni ee ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan Baydhabo iyo nawaaxigeeda. “Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo kaalinta dhaqanka iyo Odayaasha Dhaqanka, gaar ahaan dadaalada lagu doonayo in lagu dhiso is faham, nabad iyo midnimo waarta oo dhex marta bulshada Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed oo intaasi ku daray “Odayaasha Dhaqanka ayaa dhankooda la wadaagay Hoggaamiyaha aragtiyo iyo talooyin ku aaddan, sidii loo dardargelin lahaa geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada, loona xoojin lahaa nabadda iyo wadajirka dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed.” Aadan Madoobe ayaa waxaa kulanka ku wehlinayay Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Wasiiru Dowlaha Madaxtooyada, Agaasimaha Guud Madaxtooyada iyo Afhayeenka Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Aadan Madoobe ayaa doonaya in fursad la siiyo wada hadalka, si loo dhameeyo khilaafka taagan iyada oo aanu wax dhiig ah daadan, isagoona Odayaasha Dhaqanka u arka kuwo gacan ka gaysan kara isu soo dhaweynta dhinacyada.

items.title: Maamulka gobolka oo qaaday tallaabo farxad-gelisay reer Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka gobolka Banaadir ayaa xalay qaaday tallaabo culus oo farxad-gelisay reer Muqdisho, kadib markii uu ku dhawaaqay in la bilaabay dhismaha waddada suuqa Bakaaraha ee magaalada Muqdisho. Dhismaha waddadan ayaa waxaa horay u saameeyay roobabkii ka da’ay magaalada Muqdisho oo hakad-geliyay, iyada oo haatan maamulka gobolka Banaadir uu dhismo ku bilaabay, si wax looga qabto dhibaatada ka taagan waddadaas. Mas’uuliyiinta gobolka ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in waddadan lagu soo celin doono sidii ay ahaan jirtay bariisamaadkii, isla markaana lagu sameyn dib u dayactir, maadaama ay halbowle u tahay isku socodka ganacsiga, dadka iyo gaadiidka. “Waxaan rabnaa inaan ka howlgalno waddada Bakaaraha oo aan dhisno, kuna soo celino sidii bariisamaadkii ay ahaan jirtay Shirkadda Docol oo aan siinay mashruucaas iyadana waxay ballan qaaday in muddo isbuuc ah ay ku dhisto waddadaas,” ayuu yiri mas’uul sare oo ka tirsan maamulka gobolka Banaadir. Dhanka kale, maamulka gobolka ayaa sheegay in muddo kooban lagu soo gabagabeyn doono dhismaha waddada, isla markaana ay xirnaan doonto muddadaas, maadaama shaqo adag laga qabanayo isgoyska Bakaaraha. Maamulka ayaa sidoo kale shacabka ugu baaqay inay dulqaad muujiyaan muddada todobaadka ah ee ay socoto dhismaha waddada, isla markaana ay la shaqeeyaan hay’adaha ay khusayso si loo fududeeyo howlaha dhismaha iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha magaalada. “Reer Banaadir waxaan mar kale uga cudur daaraneynaa culayskii ay horay ula kulmeen iyo hadda oo aan rabno in maainta Sabtida ah aan xirno waddadan oo ay culays kala kulmi doonaan inay maalmahaan kooban dulqaataan innagy iyaga u shaqeynaa oo aan adeegayaal u nahay,” ayuu raaciyay. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ee uu hoggaaminayo Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) ayaa horay u sheegay in ololahiisa ku aadan hormarinta caasimada iyo bilic soo celinteeda uu sii socon doono, iyadoo la adkeynayo fulinta awaamiirta la xiriirta nadaafadda guud ee magaalada Muqdisho. The post Maamulka gobolka oo qaaday tallaabo farxad-gelisay reer Muqdisho appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay hawlgalka deegaanka Basra
items.description: Hawlgalka la doonayo in maleeshiyada Al Shabaab lagaga saaro deegaanka Basra oo u dhexeeya Magaalooyinka Afgooye iyo Balcad ayaa maanta galay toddobaadkii labaad, iyadoo weli maleeshiyada ay ka dagaalameyso deegaankaasi. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Booliska Sida Gaarka ah u tababaran ee Haramcad ayaa Arbacadii hore hawlgalo goos goos ah ka bilaabay deegaankaasi, inkastoo dagaalka ay ku wajahayaan Shabaabka uu xoogeystay Sabtidii, ka dib markii ay weerar ballaaran ku ekeeyeen fariisimaha iyo godadka ay horey uga qoteen agagaarka jiinka Webiga Shabelle ee deegaankaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada oo taageero ka helaya diyaaradaha dagaalka ee saaxiibada caalamiga ah ay sii wadaan gulufka militari ee ay maleeshiyada Shabaabka uga saarayaan godadka ay ka dhex dagaalamayaan. Khubarada dhanka militariga ayaa dhalleeceynaya qaabka uu hawlgalku u socdo, oo ay u arkaan in aanu ahayn mid sax ah, iyagoo ku doodaya in Shabaabka culeys laga saarayo oo keliya dhinaca Muqdisho, isla-markaana aanu wax cadaadis ah ka haysan jihooyinka Afgooye iyo Balcad ama Wanlaweyn iyo Qalimow. Khubarada ayaa ku talinaya in Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka uu isku xiro ciidamada haatan hawlgalka ka wada Basra iyo kuwa kale ee ku kala sugan Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Shabellaha Dhexe, si Shabaabka aysan wax gurmad ah uga helin bannaanka deegaanka Basra. Basra oo Shabaabka laga sifeeyo waxay muhiim u tahay sugidda amniga ee duleedka Muqdisho iyo deegaanada ku xeeran ee hoostaga Labada Shabelle. Basra oo ku taala xadka Gobolada Shabellooyinka, isla-markaana xiriirisa Balcad iyo Afgooye ayaa leh mihiimad weyn oo istiraatiiji ah. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa qorsheynaya in marka uu hawlgalka guuleysto ay ciidamadu saldhigyo joogta ah ka sameystaan deegaankaasi, si looga hortago in kooxaha hubeysan ay dib ugu soo laabtaan. Ma jirto cid sheegi karta goorta la soo geba-gabeen doono hawlgalka, balse hawlgalada sanadihii u dambeeyay laga sameeyay deegaanka ayaa ku soo idlaaday natiijo la’aan.

Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada oo taageero ka helaya diyaaradaha dagaalka ee saaxiibada caalamiga ah ay sii wadaan gulufka militari ee ay maleeshiyada Shabaabka uga saarayaan godadka ay ka dhex dagaalamayaan. Khubarada dhanka militariga ayaa dhalleeceynaya qaabka uu hawlgalku u socdo, oo ay u arkaan in aanu ahayn mid sax ah, iyagoo ku doodaya in Shabaabka culeys laga saarayo oo keliya dhinaca Muqdisho, isla-markaana aanu wax cadaadis ah ka haysan jihooyinka Afgooye iyo Balcad ama Wanlaweyn iyo Qalimow. Khubarada ayaa ku talinaya in Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka uu isku xiro ciidamada haatan hawlgalka ka wada Basra iyo kuwa kale ee ku kala sugan Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Shabellaha Dhexe, si Shabaabka aysan wax gurmad ah uga helin bannaanka deegaanka Basra. Basra oo Shabaabka laga sifeeyo waxay muhiim u tahay sugidda amniga ee duleedka Muqdisho iyo deegaanada ku xeeran ee hoostaga Labada Shabelle. Basra oo ku taala xadka Gobolada Shabellooyinka, isla-markaana xiriirisa Balcad iyo Afgooye ayaa leh mihiimad weyn oo istiraatiiji ah. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa qorsheynaya in marka uu hawlgalka guuleysto ay ciidamadu saldhigyo joogta ah ka sameystaan deegaankaasi, si looga hortago in kooxaha hubeysan ay dib ugu soo laabtaan. Ma jirto cid sheegi karta goorta la soo geba-gabeen doono hawlgalka, balse hawlgalada sanadihii u dambeeyay laga sameeyay deegaanka ayaa ku soo idlaaday natiijo la’aan.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka oo xaqiijiyey arrin la hadal hayey
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Saraakiil amni oo Mareykan iyo Soomaali ah ayaa bixiyey faahfaahin cusub oo muujineysa inuu sii xoogeysanayo xiriirka u dhexeeya kooxda Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen, kaas oo hadda ku lug leh hub, tababar ciidan iyo xiriir toos ah oo dhex mara labada dhinac. Baaritaan uu daabacay wargeyska Wall Street Journal ayaa lagu sheegay in xiriirka labada kooxood uu si weyn u kobcay tan iyo ugu yaraan 2023, iyadoo shaqsiyaad Soomaali ah ay door muhiim ah ka qaateen isku xirka Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta ay Iran taageerto. Saraakiil Mareykan, Soomaali iyo Yemeniyiin ah oo wargeysku la hadlay ayaa sheegay in labada dhinac ay iska kaashadeen helitaanka hubka, tababarrada iyo khibradaha militariga, inkastoo ay jiraan kala duwanaansho weyn oo dhinaca fikirka iyo madhabta ah. Al-Shabaab waa koox Sunni ah oo xiriir la leh Al-Qaacida, halka Xuutiyiintu ay yihiin dhaqdhaqaaq inta badan ka soo jeeda madhabta Shiicada Zaydi. Taliyaha ciidamada Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, General Dagvin Anderson, ayaa sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay helayso hub iyo tababbarro casri ah, halka Xuutiyiintuna ay isku dayayaan inay ballaariyaan saameyntooda juqraafiyeed. “Arrintani ma aha oo keliya dhibaato goboleed. Waxay leedahay saameyn caalami ah,” ayuu Anderson u sheegay Wall Street Journal . Cabdullaahi Maxamed Cali Sanbalooshe, oo hore u soo noqday agaasimaha hay’adda sirdoonka Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegay in cadaawadda labada kooxood ay u qabaan reer Galbeedka iyo Israel ay sahashay inay dhinac iska dhigaan khilaafaadkooda fikirka. “Waxay neceb yihiin reer Galbeedka, waxayna neceb yihiin Israel,” ayuu yiri. Soomaali dhex-dhexaadinayey labada kooxood Baaritaanka ayaa magacaabay Jibriil Yaxye Cali, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaanay Gacaamey, inuu ahaa mid ka mid ah shaqsiyaadka ugu muhiimsan ee isku xira Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta. Jibriil ayaa si joogto ah ugu kala gooshi jiray Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, waxaana lagu sheegay inuu ahaa wakiilka Al-Shabaab ee xiriirka la lahaa saraakiisha Xuutiyiinta. Wargeysku wuxuu sheegay, isagoo soo xiganaya xog sirdoon iyo dokumiintiyo uu arkay, in Jibriil uu ka shaqeyn jiray soo iibinta hubka militari iyo sidii hubkaas loogu soo rari lahaa Soomaaliya. Sannadkii 2024, Al-Shabaab ayaa Yemen u dirtay wakiil kale oo ka sareeyey Jibriil, Sheekh Axmed Cilmi Samatar, si uu ula shaqeeyo. Samatar ayaa Xuutiyiinta hor dhigay liis hub ah oo Al-Shabaab ay dooneysay, waxaana ku jiray gantaallada garabka laga rido ee diyaaradaha lagula dagaallamo, gantaallada Katyusha ee 107mm, qoryaha shiishka, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee qaraxyada qaada, gantaallada lidka taankiyada iyo qalabka habeenkii wax lagu arko ee Mareykanka lagu sameeyo. Sarkaal ka tirsan sirdoonka militariga Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyey in Al-Shabaab ay Xuutiyiinta ka dalbatay hub casri ah, marka lagu daro qoryaha fudud, kuwa darandoorriga u dhaca iyo rasaasta. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda Yemen ayaa Samatar xiray Janaayo 2025, balse markii dambe waxaa lagu sii daayey maxaabiis ay dowladda Yemen iyo Xuutiyiintu is-weydaarsadeen. Kadib wuxuu dib ugu laabtay Soomaaliya. Jibriil ayaa dhankiisa sii waday isku dubbaridka hubka illaa 12-kii Febraayo, markaas oo lagu dilay duqeyn Mareykan ah, sida ay sheegeen laba ilo-wareed oo Mareykan ah oo xog ogaal u ahaa howlgalka. Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka, CENTCOM, ayaa dhinaciisa sheegay inuusan howlgalkaasi ahayn mid ay ciidamadiisu fuliyeen. Al-Shabaab ayaa markii dambe Yemen u magacaabatay wakiil kale oo sii wada xiriirkaas. Hubka oo si qarsoodi loo soo geliyo Soomaaliya Sida uu sheegay wargeysku, shirkado magac-u-yaal ah oo laga sameeyey Yemen ayaa hubka u ekaysiin jiray badeecooyin rayid ah, ka hor inta aan laga soo marin dekedda Mukalla iyo goobo kale. Hubka ayaa kadib lagu soo gudbin jiray Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo la adeegsanayo doomaha dheereeya iyo maraakiibta kalluumeysiga. Marka uu gaaro xeebaha waqooyiga Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan meelaha aan si weyn loo ilaalin, shabakado maxalli ah ayaa hubka u sii gudbin jiray cutubyada Al-Shabaab ee ku sugan koonfurta Soomaaliya, sida uu sheegay sarkaalka sirdoonka militariga Mareykanka. General Axmed Cabdullaahi Sheekh, oo hore u soo noqday taliye ka tirsan ciidamada gaarka ah ee Soomaaliya ee Danab, ayaa muujiyey walaac ku saabsan waxa Al-Shabaab ay ku qorsheyneyso awoodaha cusub ee ay heleysay. “Ma aqaan waxa qorshahoodu yahay, laakiin waxaa hubaal ah in wax socdaan,” ayuu u sheegay wargeyska. Dagaalyahanno tababar loogu qaaday Yemen Xiriirka Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta kuma eka oo keliya hubka, waxaana xogta cusub ay muujineysaa inuu sidoo kale gaaray dhinaca tababarka militariga. Ugu yaraan 100 dagaalyahan oo Al-Shabaab ah ayaa loo qaaday Yemen si ay tababar uga helaan Xuutiyiinta, sida uu sheegay sarkaalka sirdoonka militariga Mareykanka. Dagaalyahannada ayaa la baray farsamooyin lagu sameeyo miinooyin waddooyinka la geliyo oo ka awood badan kuwii hore, iyo sida loo isticmaalo hub casri ah. Tababarayaal ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale u safray Soomaaliya, halkaas oo ay dagaalyahannada Al-Shabaab ku bareen adeegsiga diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Koox dagaalyahanno Al-Shabaab ah ayaa sanadkan saddex bilood ku qaatay gobolka Saada ee Yemen, halkaas oo lagu baray isku-xiridda diyaaradaha drone-ka iyo nidaamyada loo yaqaan FPV, kuwaas oo qofka duulinaya u oggolaanaya inuu si toos ah u arko muuqaalka kamaradda drone-ka. Xogtan ayaa la jaanqaadaysa baaritaan ay dhowaan sameysay hay’adda Century International, kaas oo sheegay in inta u dhexeysa 120 ilaa dhowr boqol oo dagaalyahan Al-Shabaab ah ay tababarro ka heleen Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Baaritaankaas ayaa sheegay in tababarradu ay ku jireen isticmaalka hubka fudud, sameynta walxaha qarxa iyo isticmaalka aasaasiga ah ee diyaaradaha drone-ka. Waxa kale oo uu sheegay in injineerro militari oo Xuutiyiin ah ay tageen koonfurta Soomaaliya si ay Al-Shabaab uga caawiyaan sameynta qaraxyada, wax-ka-beddelka diyaaradaha drone-ka iyo dayactirka hubka. Si kastaba, Century International waxay sheegtay inaan weli la helin caddeymo xooggan oo muujinaya in Xuutiyiintu Al-Shabaab ku wareejiyeen awoodahooda ugu casrisan, sida gantaallada heerka sare ah iyo tiknoolajiyadda diyaaradaha weerarka qaada. Wafdi Xuutiyiin ah oo tegay degmada Jilib Xiriirka ayaa sanadkan u muuqda inuu galay heer cusub, kadib markii xubno labada kooxood ah ay yeesheen xiriir toos ah. Wafdi afar xubnood ka koobnaa oo ka socday Xuutiyiinta ayaa bishii June ka soo tallaabay Gacanka Cadmeed, kadibna gaaray magaalada Jilib ee gobolka Jubbada Dhexe, oo ah xarunta ugu weyn ee Al-Shabaab ay ka maamusho deegaannada koonfurta Soomaaliya. Ilo sirdoon oo gobolka ah ayaa sheegay in kulanka looga hadlay sidii labada dhinac isaga kaashan lahaayeen dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo Israel ay ka sameyso Berbera. Xuutiyiinta ayaa ka walaacsan in dekedda Berbera loo isticmaali karo saldhig lagula socdo dhaqdhaqaaqyada Yemen ama laga fuliyo weerarro ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta. Wafdiga Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale madaxda Al-Shabaab u ballanqaaday hub iyo tababbarro ka casrisan kuwa hadda jira, sida lagu sheegay warbixin sirdoon oo Wall Street Journal ay aragtay. Israel ayaa bishii December 2025 si rasmi ah u aqoonsatay Somaliland inay tahay dal madax-bannaan, iyadoo noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee sidaas sameeya tan iyo markii Somaliland ay 1991 ku dhawaaqday inay ka go’day Soomaaliya. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si xooggan u diidday aqoonsigaas, waxayna ku adkeysatay in Somaliland ay weli qeyb ka tahay dhulka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Hoggaamiyaha Xuutiyiinta, Cabdul-Malik Al-Xuuti, ayaa tan iyo markaas ku hanjabay in kooxdiisu beegsan doonto joogitaan kasta oo Israel ay ku yeelato Somaliland. Xiriirka oo isu beddelaya mid istaraatiiji ah Xogta sirdoonka ayaa sidoo kale sheegeysa in Xuutiyiintu ay doonayaan inay Al-Shabaab ka caawiso rakibidda qalab raadaar ah oo lagula socon karo maraakiibta isaga kala goosha biyaha u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Yemen. La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka Soomaaliya, Aweys Yuusuf Axmed, ayaa sheegay in xiriirka Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta uu taariikh ahaan ahaa mid ku saleysan ganacsi iyo dano ku-meel-gaar ah, balse xaaladaha cusub ee gobolka ay suuragal tahay inay wax ka beddeleen xiriirkaas. “Dhaqan ahaan, xiriirka Xuutiyiinta iyo Al-Shabaab wuxuu ahaa mid gebi ahaanba ku saleysan wax-is-weydaarsi,” ayuu Aweys u sheegay Wall Street Journal . “Laakiin taasi macnaheedu ma aha inaanay jirin arrimo cusub oo soo kordhay kadib dagaalkii Iran iyo Mareykanka, kuwaas oo yeelan kara muhiimad istaraatiiji ah.” Xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee labada kooxood ayaa walaac gaar ah ku abuuraya Soomaaliya iyo dalalka kale ee gobolka, maadaama iskaashiga hubka, tababarka iyo xog-isdhaafsiga uu Al-Shabaab siin karo awoodo cusub, halka Xuutiyiintuna ay Soomaaliya uga faa’iideysan karaan inay saameyntooda ku fidiyaan dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed. La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka Soomaaliya, Aweys Yuusuf Axmed, ayaa sheegay in xiriirka Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta uu taariikh ahaan ahaa mid ku saleysan ganacsi iyo dano ku-meel-gaar ah, balse xaaladaha cusub ee gobolka ay suuragal tahay inay wax ka beddeleen xiriirkaas. “Dhaqan ahaan, xiriirka Xuutiyiinta iyo Al-Shabaab wuxuu ahaa mid gebi ahaanba ku saleysan wax-is-weydaarsi,” ayuu Aweys u sheegay Wall Street Journal . “Laakiin taasi macnaheedu ma aha inaanay jirin arrimo cusub oo soo kordhay kadib dagaalkii Iran iyo Mareykanka, kuwaas oo yeelan kara muhiimad istaraatiiji ah.” Xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee labada kooxood ayaa walaac gaar ah ku abuuraya Soomaaliya iyo dalalka kale ee gobolka, maadaama iskaashiga hubka, tababarka iyo xog-isdhaafsiga uu Al-Shabaab siin karo awoodo cusub, halka Xuutiyiintuna ay Soomaaliya uga faa’iideysan karaan inay saameyntooda ku fidiyaan dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed. items.title: Somalia NSA confirms troops crossed into Ethiopia region
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s National Security Adviser, Aways Haji Yusuf, on Tuesday confirmed for the first time that an undisclosed number of Somali National Army (SNA) troops who recently completed a Saudi Arabia-funded training program in Hanaanbure, Galmudug, have crossed into Ethiopia’s Somali region. Yusuf said the soldiers, who had undergone more than a year of training, were granted leave to visit their families and that the federal government is aware of their presence in the region for that purpose. “If there are other issues, we will let you (media) know,” Yusuf told reporters. Defection Reports Preceded the Admission The confirmation comes days after multiple Somali media outlets, including outlets based in Ethiopia’s Somali region, reported that dozens of soldiers – part of a cohort of 3,000 trained at Hananbure – had defected and were subsequently captured by regional forces before being taken to Jigjiga. Reported figures for the number involved have varied widely across outlets, with some citing 300, others 180, and others as high as 900. None of these figures has been independently confirmed, and it remains unclear whether the soldiers defected or were simply on approved leave to visit their families, as the government maintains. Analyst: Admission “Likely to Generate More Questions” A Nairobi-based Horn of Africa analyst with Sahan Research described the National Security Adviser’s admission as “refreshing and commendable, but likely to generate more questions.” “Did Somalia recruit forces from the Somali Regional State of Ethiopia with permission from regional and federal authorities? If not, how will Addis Ababa respond?” the analyst asked. A Backdrop of Strained Ties The episode unfolds against a backdrop of strained relations between Mogadishu and Addis Ababa in recent years, with the two governments aligned to separate geopolitical camps. Ethiopia has increasingly sided with the United Arab Emirates, including in its support for the Rapid Support Forces in Sudan, while Somalia has increasingly aligned itself with Saudi Arabia and Turkey. items.title: Daniel iyo Labada Hooyo: Xaqiiqada Sheekada
items.description: Sheekada Daniel iyo Labada Hooyo: Maxaa Xaqiiqo Ah, Maxaase Aan La Xaqiijin? Qoraal si weyn loogu faafinayo baraha bulshada ayaa sheegaya in wiil lagu magacaabo Daniel uu maxkamad dhexdeeda ku doortay haweeneydii soo korisay, halkii uu ka dooran lahaa hooyadii dhashay, kaddib markii baaritaan DNA ah lagu xaqiijiyay xiriirka dhiigga.Sida sheekada lagu baahiyay, Daniel ayaa maxkamadda ka sheegay inuu og yahay in DNA-gu caddeeyay in Isabella ay tahay hooyadiisa bayooloji, balse uu doortay María , oo la sheegay inay soo korisay muddo 17 sano ah. Qoraalka ayaa ku xardhan hadallo dareen leh oo lagu sheegay inuu Daniel ka jeediyay gudaha maxkamadda. Waxaa ka mid ah fikradda ah in hooyonimadu aysan ku koobnayn qofka ilmaha dhalay, balse ay sidoo kale ku dhisan tahay daryeelka, korinta iyo joogitaanka nolosha ilmaha.Si kastaba, ma jirto caddayn madax-bannaan oo lagu xaqiijin karo in dhacdadan ay dhab ahaan ka dhacday maxkamad , ama in Daniel, Isabella iyo María ay yihiin dad dhab ah oo ku lug lahaa kiis noocan ah. Raadinta ilo warbaahineed iyo ilo rasmi ah lagama helin warbixin lagu kalsoonaan karo oo xaqiijinaysa kiis maxkamadeed oo leh magacyadan iyo faahfaahinta lagu sheegay qoraalka. Sidoo kale, lama helin diiwaan maxkamadeed ama warbixin hay’ad rasmi ah oo caddeynaysa in DNA lagu sameeyay Daniel, in Isabella ay tahay hooyadiisa bayooloji ama in maxkamad ay go’aan ka gaartay cidda uu la noolaanayo.Sidaa darteed, hadallada loo nisbeeyay Daniel iyo dhacdooyinka lagu sheegay qoraalka waa in loo arkaa sheegasho baraha bulshada ku faaftay oo aan weli si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin , halkii loo soo bandhigi lahaa dhacdo dhab ah. Sheekadu waxay taabanaysaa dood dhab ah oo ku saabsan farqiga u dhexeeya hooyonimada bayoolojiga ah iyo tan ku dhisan daryeelka iyo korinta , balse taasi kaligeed ma caddeyneyso in kiiska Daniel uu dhab yahay.Qoraalka Facebook-ga ee la bixiyay ayaa ah halka ugu weyn ee sheekadan laga soo qaatay, waxaana muhiim ah in aan loo adeegsan caddayn keliya oo lagu xaqiijinayo dhacdo maxkamadeed.Ilaa laga helo dukumenti maxkamadeed, warbixin rasmi ah ama warbaahin lagu kalsoonaan karo oo xaqiijisa dhacdada, lama xaqiijin karo in Daniel uu 17 sano kaddib maxkamad ku doortay hooyadii korsatay halkii uu ka dooran lahaa hooyadii dhashay . The post Daniel iyo Labada Hooyo: Xaqiiqada Sheekada first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee xaaladda Beledweyne kadib..
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Gudoomiyaha degmada Beledweyne ee Gobolka Hiiraan Cumar Cismaan Calasow ayaa faah-faahin ka bixiyay xaaladda magaaladaasi, kadib markii shalay maleeshiyaad hubeysan ay carqaladeeyeen amniga goobaha loo asteeyay inay ka dhacaan doorashooyinka HirShabelle. Maleeshiyaadka oo sheegay inay diidan yihiin hannaanka wax loo wado ayaa sheegtay inay la wareegeen xarunta doorashada, ayna kasoo horjeedaan hannaanka loo maamulayo doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Golaha Wakiilada iyo Deegaanka. “Dadka deegaanka oo hubaysan ayaa nahay, waxaan la wareegnay goobtii doorashadda loogu talagalay, dagaal ayaan ka xignaa in Beledweyne doorasho ku sheeg ay ka dhacdo, Xasan Sheekh waxaan la soconaa in kaarka uu siiyay Cali Guudlaawe,” ayuu yiri hoggaamiye u hadlay maleeshiyaadka. Intaas kadib, waxaa soo jawaabay guddoomiyaha degmada Beledweyne oo beeniyay in lala wareegay xarumaha doorashada, wuxuuna shaaca ka qaaday xaaladda guud ee magaalada ay tahay mid nabdoon oo deggan. Cumar Cismaan Calasow oo wareysi siiyay Universal Tv ayaa sidoo kale xusay in diiwaangelinta doorashada ay u socoto sidii loogu talagalay, isla markaana reer Beledweyne ay diyaar u yihiin inay ka qayb-galaan doorashada. “Wax hadda aan ognahay oo qalalaase ah oo ka jira Beledweyne ma laha laamaha amniga ayaana sugayo amniga dadka is diiwaangelinayo,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Calasow. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Bulshada reer Beledweyne doorasho ayay rabaan waxayna diyaar u yihiin doorashada ka dhacday dhammaan degmooyinka Soomaaliya inay ka qayb-qaataan”. Arrintan ayaa kusoo aadeyso, iyada oo shalay guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka uu shaaciyay in 30-ka bisha Sebtember loo asteeyey doorashada Golaha Wakiillada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka ee Maamulka HirShabelle. Jadwalku wuxuu sidoo kale dhigayaa in 2-da Sebtember la shaaciyo liiska hordhaca ah ee diiwaanka codbixiyeyaasha, halka 15-ka Sebtember la asteyn doono lana shaacin doono xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta. The post Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee xaaladda Beledweyne kadib.. appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Tirada dhimashada daadadkii Nepal oo kor u dhaaftay 1,000, kumannaan weli la la’yahay
items.description: Tirada dadka ku dhintay daadad xooggan oo ku dhuftay Nepal ayaa kor u dhaaftay 1,000 qof , halka in ka badan 3,900 qof weli la la’yahay, sida ay sheegeen hay’adaha gurmadka musiibooyinka ee dalkaasi. Qayb weyn oo ka mid ah dadka la la’yahay ayaa la rumeysan yahay inay yihiin shaqaale ka howlgalayay mashaariicda korontada biyaha laga dhaliyo ee ku teedsan webiga Trishuli , gaar ahaan meelaha u dhow xadka Nepal iyo Tibet. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in in ka badan 600 shaqaale ah ay ku jireen nidaamyo tunnel ah oo hoos mara dhulka markii daadadku ku dhufteen goobaha korontada. Kooxaha samatabbixinta ayaa hawada ku shubaya qaar ka mid ah tunnelada, iyagoo rajeynaya in dad weli nool laga heli karo gudaha. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Nepal, Balendra Shah , ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan 279 qof laga soo badbaadiyay goobaha ay daadadku saameeyeen, iyadoo ciidamada Nepal iyo Shiinaha ay hormuud ka yihiin hawlgallada gurmadka. Khubaro iyo kooxo ka kala socda Hindiya, Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo Australia ayaa sidoo kale ka qeyb qaadanaya baaritaanka iyo qiimeynta burburka. Koox samatabbixin ah ayaa gudaha u gashay mid ka mid ah tunnelada ku xiran warshad koronto-biyood, balse markii dambe way ka soo baxday kaddib markii aysan helin dad nool. Qoysaska dadka la la’yahay ayaa dowladda ku cadaadinaya in la dedejiyo hawlgallada, maadaama waqtigu sii yaraanayo. Nepal ayaa si weyn ugu tiirsan tamarta laga dhaliyo biyaha, waxaana dalka ka socda mashaariic badan oo koronto-biyood ah. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in ugu yaraan 11 mashruuc oo dhameystiran ama dhismayaal ku jiray ay waxyeello ka soo gaartay daadadka. Khabiir tunnel-dhisid oo Australian ah, Arnold Dix , oo talo siinayay mas’uuliyiinta Nepal, ayaa sheegay in xoogga daadadku si weyn u beddelay dhulka, taasoo adkeyneysa in la helo meelaha laga galo tunnelada. Sida uu sheegay, samatabbixiyeyaashu marka hore waa inay ogaadaan halka ay ku yaallaan xarumaha korontada ee burburay, kaddibna ay bilaabaan inay ka saaraan dhagxaanta iyo qashinka xannibaya waddooyinka. Dix ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in weli ay jirto rajo ah in qaar ka mid ah dadka la la’yahay ay nool yihiin, maadaama tunneladu ay dadka gudaha ku jira ka ilaalin karaan qayb ka mid ah saameynta daadadka. Dhanka kale, masiibadu waxay keentay dhibaato weyn oo ku saabsan aqoonsiga meydadka . Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Nepal ayaa sheegtay in keliya qiyaastii 4 boqolkiiba meydadkii ku dhowaad 900-ka ahaa ee la helay si rasmi ah loo aqoonsaday. Degmada Chitwan, ku dhowaad 300 meyd ayaa webiyadu ka soo qaadeen goobihii ay daadadku ku dhufteen. Maadaama goobaha lagu kaydiyo meydadku ay buuxsameen, maamulka ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah meydadka si ku-meel-gaar ah loo aasayo, iyadoo kooxaha caafimaadku qaadayaan muunado DNA ah si loo xaqiijiyo aqoonsiga. Qoysaska ayaa loo ballanqaaday in meydadka eheladooda loo soo celin doono marka baaritaanka DNA-ga lagu xaqiijiyo aqoonsigooda. Mas’uuliyiinta Nepal ayaa sheegay in daadadkan ay yihiin musiibo aan caadi ahayn, iyadoo burburka ka dhashay uu si weyn u saameeyay waddooyinka, xarumaha korontada iyo kaabayaasha kale. Ra’iisul Wasaare Shah ayaa sidoo kale digniin ka bixiyay khataraha sii kordhaya ee ka jira gobolka Himalaya, isagoo arrintan la xiriiriyay isbeddelka cimilada iyo baahida loo qabo in caalamku si weyn uga shaqeeyo sidii loo caawin lahaa dalalka buuraha ah ee nugul. Hawlgalka samatabbixinta ayaa weli socda, iyadoo kooxaha gurmadku ay wajahaan dhagxaan waaweyn, dhoobo, burbur iyo waddooyin xirmay , halka kumannaan qoys ay sugayaan war ku saabsan halka ay ku dambeeyeen eheladooda.

Mas’uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in ugu yaraan 11 mashruuc oo dhameystiran ama dhismayaal ku jiray ay waxyeello ka soo gaartay daadadka. Khabiir tunnel-dhisid oo Australian ah, Arnold Dix , oo talo siinayay mas’uuliyiinta Nepal, ayaa sheegay in xoogga daadadku si weyn u beddelay dhulka, taasoo adkeyneysa in la helo meelaha laga galo tunnelada. Sida uu sheegay, samatabbixiyeyaashu marka hore waa inay ogaadaan halka ay ku yaallaan xarumaha korontada ee burburay, kaddibna ay bilaabaan inay ka saaraan dhagxaanta iyo qashinka xannibaya waddooyinka. Dix ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in weli ay jirto rajo ah in qaar ka mid ah dadka la la’yahay ay nool yihiin, maadaama tunneladu ay dadka gudaha ku jira ka ilaalin karaan qayb ka mid ah saameynta daadadka. Dhanka kale, masiibadu waxay keentay dhibaato weyn oo ku saabsan aqoonsiga meydadka . Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Nepal ayaa sheegtay in keliya qiyaastii 4 boqolkiiba meydadkii ku dhowaad 900-ka ahaa ee la helay si rasmi ah loo aqoonsaday. Degmada Chitwan, ku dhowaad 300 meyd ayaa webiyadu ka soo qaadeen goobihii ay daadadku ku dhufteen. Maadaama goobaha lagu kaydiyo meydadku ay buuxsameen, maamulka ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah meydadka si ku-meel-gaar ah loo aasayo, iyadoo kooxaha caafimaadku qaadayaan muunado DNA ah si loo xaqiijiyo aqoonsiga. Qoysaska ayaa loo ballanqaaday in meydadka eheladooda loo soo celin doono marka baaritaanka DNA-ga lagu xaqiijiyo aqoonsigooda. Mas’uuliyiinta Nepal ayaa sheegay in daadadkan ay yihiin musiibo aan caadi ahayn, iyadoo burburka ka dhashay uu si weyn u saameeyay waddooyinka, xarumaha korontada iyo kaabayaasha kale. Ra’iisul Wasaare Shah ayaa sidoo kale digniin ka bixiyay khataraha sii kordhaya ee ka jira gobolka Himalaya, isagoo arrintan la xiriiriyay isbeddelka cimilada iyo baahida loo qabo in caalamku si weyn uga shaqeeyo sidii loo caawin lahaa dalalka buuraha ah ee nugul. Hawlgalka samatabbixinta ayaa weli socda, iyadoo kooxaha gurmadku ay wajahaan dhagxaan waaweyn, dhoobo, burbur iyo waddooyin xirmay , halka kumannaan qoys ay sugayaan war ku saabsan halka ay ku dambeeyeen eheladooda.

items.title: Puntland oo ku dhowaaqday go’aanno amni oo culus iyo in ay la wareegi doonto….
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Puntland ayaa soo saartay go’aanno cusub oo lagu adkeynayo ammaanka gobolka Bari, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin xakameynta hubka sharci-darrada ah, dardargelinta dagaalka kooxaha argagixisada, la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo tahriibka, iyo mamnuucidda gaadiidka hubka lagu rakibi karo ee aan fasaxa haysan. Go’aannadan ayaa kasoo baxay shir amni oo ka dhacay magaalada Boosaaso oo uu guddoomiyay madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, kaas oo ay ka qeyb galeen xubno ka tirsan Golaha Xukuumadda iyo Golaha Wakiillada, saraakiisha ciidamada, hay’adaha amniga iyo madaxda gobolka Bari iyo degmada Boosaaso. Shirka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray xaaladda amniga gobolka Bari, xoojinta howl-gallada ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada, xakameynta hubka sharci-darrada ah, burcad-badeedda, tahriibka iyo kahortagga colaadaha beelaha. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in la dardargelinayo dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada ee ka jira deegaannada Puntland, iyadoo hay’adaha amniga lagu amray inay sii xoojiyaan howl-gallada iyo tallaabooyinka lagu sugayo amniga. Waxaa sidoo kale la adkeeyay mamnuucidda in hub sharci-darro ah lagu dhex qaato magaalooyinka Puntland. Dowladda Puntland ayaa sheegtay inay la wareegi doonto hub kasta oo sharci-darro ah oo la qabto, halka hay’adaha amniga iyo kuwa caddaaladda lagu amray inay tallaabo sharci ah ka qaadaan dadka lagu helo iibinta, soo gelinta ama isticmaalka hubkaas. Go’aannada waxaa kale oo lagu mamnuucay in gudaha Puntland la keeno gaadiid loo adeegsan karo in lagu rakibo hub ama qalab ciidan, haddii aan oggolaansho laga helin taliska ciidamada oo uu saxiixo madaxweynaha Puntland. Hay’adaha amniga ayaa sidoo kale awood loo siiyay inay la wareegaan gaadiid kasta oo noocaas ah oo si sharci-darro ah lagu soo geliyo deegaannada Puntland. Puntland waxay dhinaca kale mamnuucday in askari aan ku jirin howl-gal rasmi ah uu hub la dhex maro magaalooyinka, iyadoo sidoo kale la faray ciidamada inay la wareegaan hubka loo adeegsado dagaallada beelaha iyo inay tallaabo sharci ah ka qaadaan dadka ku lug yeesha hurinta ama ka qeybgalka colaadahaas. Burcad-badeedda iyo tahriibka Shirka ayaa muhiimad gaar ah siiyay sugidda amniga badda iyo ilaalinta xeebaha Puntland. Hay’adaha amniga ayaa lagu amray inay si buuxda u fuliyaan go’aannada dowladda ee la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo tahriibka, isla markaana ay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka looga hortagayo falalkaas. Waxaa si gaar ah loo faray ciidamada iyo hay’adaha kale ee amniga inay la dagaallamaan cid kasta oo lagu helo inay ku lug leedahay burcad-badeednimo. Puntland ayaa sidoo kale amartay in laga hortago soo gelinta, iibinta iyo isticmaalka noocyada kala duwan ee daroogada iyo khamriga. Go’aannada shirka kuma koobneyn oo keliya arrimaha amniga, waxaana sidoo kale lagu soo qaaday dhaqaalaha iyo kor u qaadista dakhliga dowladda. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in la xoojinayo dakhliga dowladda, gaar ahaan dakhliga kasoo xarooda xeebaha iyo marsadaha. Waxaa sidoo kale la qorsheeyay qabashada shirweynayaal maalgashi iyo ganacsi oo Puntland ah, kuwaas oo lagu dhiirrigelinayo maalgashiga gudaha iyo kan dibadda. Hay’adda Tayo-dhowrka Puntland ayaa lagu amray inay kordhiso shaqadeeda, iyadoo tallaabo sharci ah laga qaadi doono cid kasta oo ganacsata dawooyin ama raashin aan tayadooda la hubin. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale lagu go’aamiyay in la hirgeliyo qorshaha ballaarinta waddooyinka iyo bilicda magaalada Boosaaso. Puntland waxay sheegtay in arrintan lagu saleyn doono qorshaha guud ee horumarinta magaalada, ama Master Plan-ka , oo maamulka degmada Boosaaso uu horey u gudbiyay. Go’aannadan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshe ay Puntland ku sheegtay inay ku dooneyso isku mar xoojinta ammaanka, dhaqaalaha, nidaamka magaalada Boosaaso iyo ilaalinta xeebaha gobolka Bari. items.title: Waxa aan jeclaan lahaa fursad aan ku soo guto Xajka Wasiirka waxbarashada Hindiya oo aan Muslkm ahayn
items.description: Axaddii, isagoo khudbad ka jeedinayay kulan ka dhacay gobolka Karnataka ee bartamaha Hindiya, Basavaraj Roy Reddy, oo ah Wasiirka Waxbarashada Sare, ayaa amaanay Islaamka, isaga oo ku tilmaamay “diin wanaagsan”. Hadalkaas ayaa dhaliyay muran siyaasadeed. Xisbiga mucaaradka ah ee BJP ee ayaa dowladda ka dalbaday inay wasiirka xilka ka qaaddo ama uu raalli-gelin ka bixiyo hadalka uu jeediyay, gaar ahaan bulshada Hinduuga. Reddy ayaa markii dambe caddeeyay hadalkiisa, isaga oo yiri: “Maxaa ka qaldan arrintaas? Waxaan kaliya sheegay in diinta Islaamka ay leedahay fikrado wanaagsan oo sarreeya. Marnaba ma aanan oran diimaha kale way ka liitaan.” Si kastaba ha ahaatee, hoggaamiyaha BJP, R Ashok, ayaa dalbaday in Roy Reddy uu hadalkiisa ka laabto, isla markaana uu raalli-gelin aan shuruud lahayn uu ka siiyo dadka Hinduuga ah, maadaama uu sheegay in hadalku dhaawacay dareenkooda diimeed. Xigashada Sawirka, ANI Hadalka Basavaraj Roy Reddy iyo sharraxaaddiisa Isagoo khudbad ka jeedinayay kulan ka dhacay magaalada Kokanor ee degmada Koppal, Roy Reddy ayaa yiri: “Waxaan rabaa inaan sheego in Islaamku yahay diin ka wanaagsan diimaha oo dhan. Waxay ku dhisan tahay bini’aadantinimo.” Isaga oo iska hadlayay, ayuu yiri: “Ma aado macbudyo ama goobo cibaado, laakiin waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan helo fursad aan ugu yaraan hal mar nolosheyda ku soo guto Xajka.” Xitaa kadib markii hadalkiisa uu dhaliyay muran siyaasadeed, wuxuu u muuqday inuu weli ku adkeysanayo mowqifkiisa. Isagoo bayaan uu ku sharraxayo hadalkiisa soo saaray, ayuu yiri: “Haddii aan Islaamka ugu yeeray diin wanaagsan, maxaa ka qaldan arrintaas?” Raalli-gelin aan shuruud lahayn sii dadka Hinduuga ah” Sida lagu sheegay warbixin uu qoray wargeyska maalinlaha ah ee The Deccan Chronicle, Ashok wuxuu sheegay in haddii Roy Reddy uu diido inuu raalli-gelin bixiyo, markaas madaxa gobolka, DK Shivakumar, uu wasiirka ka saaro golaha wasiirrada. Ashok wuxuu sheegay in dalka uu hadda arkayo wejiga dhabta ah ee siyaasadda Xisbiga Congress-ka iyo siyaasaddiisa”. Wuxuu sheegay in BJP aysan oggolaan doonin wax tanaasul ah oo ku saabsan karaamada iyo ixtiraamka dadka Hinduuga ah, iyadoo loo eegayo siyaasadda cod-raadinta ku saleysan. Isagoo ka jawaabaya hadalkaas, guddoomiyaha BJP ee gobolka ahna xildhibaan BY Vijender ayaa yiri: “Hadalkaasi mustaqbalka wuxuu dhibaato u keeni doonaa Roy Reddy laftiisa.” Vijender ayaa si jees-jees ah u yiri, haddii tani ay tahay rabitaanka Roy Reddy, waa inuu “Islaamka qaataa oo uu Maka u guuraa.” Hoggaamiyaha BJP Mahesh Tanjankai, oo la hadlay ANI, ayaa yiri: “Runtii waa wax laga xishoodo in qof ku dhex nool diinta Hinduuga uu hadallo noocaas ah yiraahdo.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waxa uu sheegay gabi ahaanba waa khalad. Xisbiga Bharatiya Janata Party wuu cambaareynayaa hadalkan, Roy Reddy-na waa inuu dib uga fiirsadaa mowqifkiisa.” Wuxuu sii raaciyay: “Haddii aad sidaas u jeceshahay Islaamka, markaas ka tag. Tegitaankaagu waxyeello uma geysan doono Hinduuga.” Waa kuma Basavaraj Roy Reddy? Roy Reddy waa wasiir ka tirsan Xisbiga Congress-ka, kana soo jeeda deegaanka Yelabuga ee degmada Koppal. Lix jeer ayaa loo doortay xildhibaan. Wuxuu hore u ahaa Wasiirka Waxbarashada Sare iyo Wasiirka Guriyeynta. Wuxuu ka tirsan yahay bulshada Lingayat, wuxuuna taageeraa in Lingayatism loo aqoonsado diin gaar ah oo ka duwan Hinduuga.

items.title: Kenya aviation workers end strike that disrupted flights, officials say
items.description: Nairobi, (Reuters) – Kenya’s aviation ‌workers have called off a strike that disrupted flights at its main international and other airports, Transport Minister Davis Chirchir and aviation workers union head, Moss Ndiema, said on Tuesday. The strike, mostly ​by air traffic controllers on Sunday and Monday, disrupted several flights into and ​out of the main Jomo Kenyatta International Airport and delays spilt ⁠over to regional airports in East Africa and beyond. The union, the airport and civil ​aviation authorities, and low-cost airline Jambojet signed a return to work agreement to end the ​strike while negotiations on all outstanding issues continue, they said in joint statement. “We have looked at various issues … with very clear guidelines … on how we are going to deal with the three CBAs (collective ​bargaining agreements) which have been suspended since 2015,” Chirchir said on Tuesday. Ahead of the ​strike, the Kenya Aviation Workers’ Union (KAWU) had said their action stemmed from long-running grievances involving the ‌Kenya Civil ⁠Aviation Authority, airports operator Kenya Airports Authority (KAA), and Kenya Airways’  low-cost subsidiary Jambojet. “We are simply calling off our strike action and pleading with our members to begin the process of normalising operations, restoring services,” Ndiema told a press conference. “For those who are on ​duty, we are asking ​them to begin ⁠clearing flights.” KAWU Secretary General Ndiema had said previously that the union wanted court-backed intervention, citing the lack of a collective bargaining ​agreement at the Civil Aviation Authority, delayed salary reviews, a dispute ​over union ⁠dues at KAA, and what he described as victimisation of union members at Jambojet. Passengers at the main Nairobi airport earlier reported waiting for hours for updates as the disruption stretched into ⁠a ​second day on Monday. Airlines operating routes to and from ​airports in Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, Uganda, Somalia and Mauritius were forced to cancel and reschedule flights due to ​the disruption in Nairobi. The union, the airport and civil ​aviation authorities, and low-cost airline Jambojet signed a return to work agreement to end the ​strike while negotiations on all outstanding issues continue, they said in joint statement. “We have looked at various issues … with very clear guidelines … on how we are going to deal with the three CBAs (collective ​bargaining agreements) which have been suspended since 2015,” Chirchir said on Tuesday. Ahead of the ​strike, the Kenya Aviation Workers’ Union (KAWU) had said their action stemmed from long-running grievances involving the ‌Kenya Civil ⁠Aviation Authority, airports operator Kenya Airports Authority (KAA), and Kenya Airways’  low-cost subsidiary Jambojet. “We are simply calling off our strike action and pleading with our members to begin the process of normalising operations, restoring services,” Ndiema told a press conference. “For those who are on ​duty, we are asking ​them to begin ⁠clearing flights.” KAWU Secretary General Ndiema had said previously that the union wanted court-backed intervention, citing the lack of a collective bargaining ​agreement at the Civil Aviation Authority, delayed salary reviews, a dispute ​over union ⁠dues at KAA, and what he described as victimisation of union members at Jambojet. Passengers at the main Nairobi airport earlier reported waiting for hours for updates as the disruption stretched into ⁠a ​second day on Monday. Airlines operating routes to and from ​airports in Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, Uganda, Somalia and Mauritius were forced to cancel and reschedule flights due to ​the disruption in Nairobi. items.title: RECOGNITION: Somaliland President Heading To Washington For First U.S. Visit
items.description: Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi is expected to travel to Washington in the coming days for his first visit to the United States since taking office, as his government pushes for broader international recognition. The trip comes months after Israel became the first UN member state to formally recognize Somaliland as an independent country in December 2025. Abdullahi subsequently visited Israel in June, meeting President Isaac Herzog and Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana, while Somaliland also opened an embassy in Jerusalem. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 and has operated for decades with its own government and institutions, but remains unrecognized by most of the international community. The upcoming Washington visit is expected to give Somaliland an opportunity to make its case for U.S. recognition directly to the Trump administration. President Donald Trump previously said he was not yet prepared to recognize Somaliland and wanted to study the issue. Somaliland, however, holds significant strategic importance because of its location on the Horn of Africa near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and major Red Sea shipping routes. Israel and Somaliland have already moved to deepen cooperation in security, agriculture, water, health and economic matters following the establishment of formal relations. (YWN World Headquarters – NYC)

items.title: Ciidamada Mareykanka oo Kismaayo ka sameeyey diyaar-garow militari + Sawirro
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Mareykanka ee ka howlgala Geeska Afrika ayaa tababar militari oo ballaaran ku sameeyey magaalada Kismaayo, kaas oo lagu tijaabiyey sida ciidamada ku sugan saldhigga ay isaga difaaci karaan weerar iyo sida gurmad degdeg ah loogu keeni karo haddii xaalad amni ay soo wajahdo. Tababarka oo dhacay 18-kii Agoosto waxaa ka qeyb galay ciidamada Mareykanka ee loo yaqaan East African Response Force (EARF) , kuwaas oo hoostaga taliska ciidamada isku dhafka ah ee Mareykanka ee Geeska Afrika — Combined Joint Task Force-Horn of Africa. Militariga Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in tababarka lagu qabtay xarunta amniga ee Kismaayo, islamarkaana la isku daray laba xaaladood oo muhiim ah: difaaca saldhigga marka weerar lagu soo qaado iyo in ciidamo gurmad ah si degdeg ah loogu diro saldhig dibadda ah oo wajahaya xaalad halis ah. Ujeeddada ugu weyn ayaa ahayd in la hubiyo sida ciidamada gurmadka iyo kuwa horey ugu sugan Kismaayo ay uga wada shaqeyn karaan xaalad degdeg ah, iyadoo la tijaabiyey isgaarsiinta, difaaca saldhigga, madaafiicda iyo gurmadka caafimaadka. Sarkaal ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka oo lagu magacaabo Austin Doughty ayaa sheegay in ciidamada gurmadka markii ay yimaadeen Kismaayo si degdeg ah loogu dhex daray nidaamka difaaca saldhigga. “Waxaan hubinnay in ciidamada lagu daro howlgallada ilaalada, madaafiicda si sax ah loo diyaariyo, isla markaana la sameeyo qorshe iyo kala wareejin howleed,” ayuu yiri Doughty. Waxa uu sheegay in xiriirka iyo wada-xiriirka ciidamada kala duwan uu ahaa qeybta ugu muhiimsan ee lagu xaqiijinayey guusha howlgalka. Gurmad marka saldhig la weeraro East African Response Force waa ciidan Mareykanku u diyaariyey inuu muddo kooban gudaheed uga jawaabo xaaladaha degdegga ah ee ka dhaca Bariga Afrika, gaar ahaan meelaha ay ku sugan yihiin ciidamada ama danaha Mareykanka. Lieutenant Ethan White oo hoggaaminayey qeyb ka mid ah ciidamada tababarka galay ayaa sheegay in layligu tijaabiyey awoodda ay ciidamadu ugu gurman karaan saldhig wajahaya weerar culus. “Tababarkan wuxuu muujiyey awoodda aan u leenahay inaan si dhaqso ah u xoojino goob laga yaabo inay cadowgu ku xoog bato,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sheegay in ciidamada gurmadka ay wateen khubaro hagta duqeymaha diyaaradaha, dhaqaatiir iyo ciidamo madaafiicda adeegsada, si ay u buuxiyaan baahida ka dhalan karta weerar ama xaalad kale oo degdeg ah. Ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale lagu tababaray sida ay ula qabsanayaan saldhig aysan horey u aqoon, arrintaas oo militariga Mareykanku sheegay inay muhiim tahay maadaama ciidamada gurmadka mararka qaar diyaarado looga dejiyo goob aysan horey uga howlgelin. White ayaa sheegay in caqabadda ugu weyn marka ciidan lagu daadiyo meel cusub ay tahay inuusan aqoon goobaha muhiimka ah, waddooyinka gudaha saldhigga iyo hab-raacyada ay isticmaalaan ciidamada halkaas jooga. Sidaas darteed, ciidamadii yimid Kismaayo ayaa la baray nidaamka saldhigga iyo sida ciidamada joogtada ah uga falceliyaan weerarro, dhaawacyo badan iyo xaaladaha kale ee degdegga ah. Gurmadka dhaawacyada Tababarka waxaa sidoo kale qeyb muhiim ah ka ahaa gurmadka caafimaadka haddii weerar uu sababo dhaawacyo badan. Sgt. Dana Raush oo ah sarkaal caafimaad oo ka tirsan East African Response Force ayaa sheegay in ciidamada gurmadka ay marka ay goob cusub tagaan marka hore bartaan hab-raacyada caafimaad iyo kuwa amni ee halkaas ka jira. “Waxaan eegnaa sida aan awooddeena ugu kordhin karno tan ciidamada halkaas jooga, sababtoo ah ugu dambeyn waxaan nahay ciidan awood dheeraad ah ku biirinaya kuwa goobta jooga,” ayay tiri. Intii uu tababarku socday, ciidamada gurmadka iyo kuwa Kismaayo joogay ayaa si wadajir ah uga jawaabay weerarro la jilay, iyagoo tijaabiyey nidaamyada loo adeegsan lahaa haddii xaalad dhab ah ay dhacdo. Militariga Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in tababarku uu sidoo kale fursad siiyey ciidamada labada dhinac inay hagaajiyaan isku-duwidda iyo qorshaha lagu xoojinayo saldhigga haddii xaalad degdeg ahi timaado. White ayaa tababarka ku tilmaamay mid guuleystay, isaga oo sheegay in ciidamada gurmadka ay muujiyeen inay diyaar u yihiin in waqti kooban lagu geeyo goob kasta oo loogu baahdo. items.title: Iiraan oo sheegtay inay duqeysay saldhigga Sheekh Ciise ee Baxrayn
items.description: Xiisadda militari ee u dhexeysa Iiraan iyo Mareykanka ayaa si weyn uga sii dartay, kaddib markii ciidamada Iiraan ay sheegeen inay weerar ballaaran oo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah ku qaadeen saldhigga Sheikh Isa Air Base ee dalka Baxrayn, oo ay ku sugan yihiin ama adeegsadaan ciidamada Mareykanka. Weerarka ayaa yimid saacado kaddib markii Mareykanku uu qaaday duqeymo cusub oo ka dhan ah bartilmaameedyo militari oo Iiraan ku yaalla. Militariga Iiraan ayaa sheegay in weerarka, oo ay ku tilmaameen qayb ka mid ah hawlgallo aargoosi ah, lagu bartilmaameedsaday xarumaha radar-ka iyo meelaha ay isugu yimaadaan ciidamada Mareykanka ee saldhigga Sheekh Ciise. Warbaahinta Iran waxay sheegtay in weerarka loo adeegsaday diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo weerar ah, Baxrayn dhankeeda waxay sheegtay in nidaamyadeeda difaaca cirka ay qabteen oo burburiyeen diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Iiraan , iyadoo mas’uuliyiintu dadka ugu baaqeen inay isdejiyaan oo ay raacaan tilmaamaha amniga. Weerarka Baxrayn wuxuu qayb ka yahay is-weydaarsi weerarro ah oo gobolka ka socda, iyadoo Iiraan ay sheegtay inay sidoo kale weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku qaaday goobo ay ku sugan yihiin ciidamada Mareykanka ee Jordan iyo Ciraaq , halka Jordan ay sheegtay inay soo ridday 10 ka mid ah 13 gantaal oo Iran ay ku soo tuurtay hawadeeda. Saddexda kale waxay ku dhaceen goobo ka baxsan xarumaha dadka ku badan yihiin, sida ay sheegeen ciidamada Jordan. Dhanka Mareykanka, Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka, CENTCOM , ayaa sheegay inuu dhammeystiray duqeymo cusub oo lagu qaaday bartilmaameedyo la xiriira Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan. Bartilmaameedyada uu Mareykanku sheegay waxaa ka mid ahaa nidaamyada difaaca cirka, radarro, qalab iyo xarumo badeed, awoodaha miino-dhigista iyo xarumaha isgaarsiinta. Is-weydaarsiga cusub ayaa kusoo beegmay xilli xiisadda Marinka Hormuz ay sii xoogeysaneyso, iyadoo Marinkani uu yahay waddo muhiim u ah maraakiibta shidaalka iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah, waxaana cabsi laga qabaa in dagaalka sii fidaya uu carqaladeeyo isu-socodka maraakiibta iyo sahayda tamarta. Xiisadda ayaa durba kor u riixday qiimaha shidaalka, iyadoo Brent crude uu Arbacadii gaaray in ka badan $95 halkii foosto.

items.title: Klaus-Michael Kühne Leaves Behind a Fortune Designed to Serve Others
items.description: Berlin (WDN) — Klaus-Michael Kühne, one of Germany’s wealthiest businessmen, has died at the age of 89, leaving behind an estimated $49 billion fortune and a remarkable legacy designed to extend far beyond his lifetime. Kühne, who had no children, built his vast wealth across logistics, maritime shipping, aviation, chemicals and real estate, with the global logistics giant Kühne+Nagel at the heart of his business empire. But perhaps the most enduring chapter of his legacy will not be measured by the companies he controlled or the billions he accumulated. It will be measured by what happens to that wealth after his death. A substantial portion of Kühne’s fortune is ultimately intended to pass into the hands of the Kühne Foundation, a Switzerland-based charitable organization established to preserve and direct his wealth toward philanthropic purposes. Rather than allowing his fortune to become primarily a family inheritance, Kühne structured his succession so that his wealth could continue supporting charitable causes for generations. The arrangement means that the fortune he spent decades building is not simply disappearing with its owner. Instead, it is being transformed into an enduring philanthropic resource—one intended to continue helping people in need long after Kühne is gone. During his lifetime, Kühne remained deeply involved in the direction of his business empire, particularly Kühne+Nagel. He also held significant interests in major companies including Hapag-Lloyd, Lufthansa and Brenntag, making him one of the most influential figures in Germany’s corporate landscape. His death marks the end of an extraordinary business career, but not necessarily the end of his influence. For many wealthy individuals, the ultimate question is what happens to their fortune after they are gone. Kühne appears to have answered that question differently: his wealth was not meant simply to enrich the next generation; it was structured to become a lasting instrument of public benefit. That may prove to be his most significant legacy. Businesses can eventually be sold, fortunes can rise and fall, and names can fade from corporate headlines. But wealth placed into a durable philanthropic institution can continue serving communities, supporting humanitarian causes and helping vulnerable people for generations. Kühne’s story therefore offers a powerful lesson about the meaning of wealth. The true measure of a fortune may not be how much one accumulates, but how much good it continues to do after its owner is gone. If his succession plan is carried out as intended, billions of dollars accumulated during one extraordinary lifetime will continue working for others—potentially turning a personal fortune into a permanent source of assistance for people in need. Klaus-Michael Kühne may have left this world, but the wealth he built is designed to keep serving it. items.title: Clan conflict over resources in Sanag leaves families displaced and bereft
items.description: (ERGO) – Hundreds of families displaced by clan conflict in Dawaco area in Somaliland’s Sanag region are facing hard living conditions after losing their livelihoods and property in the violence. The conflict, which began on 25 July following a dispute over grazing land, has killed seven people and displaced 600 families. The chairman of Dawaco, Abdi Askar Guled, said the fighting came during a difficult dry season, when communities were already facing economic hardship caused by recurring droughts. Those displaced have sought refuge in Badhan and other rural areas, where many are staying with relatives. They are unable to return home because the conflict remains unresolved and their property has been destroyed. Leyla Mohamed Jama, 43, a single mother of 11, is struggling to meet basic needs after her home and small business were destroyed by fire during the conflict. The family left behind their 20 goats when they fled – she doesn’t know what happened to them. Her business selling cooked food and assorted goods had earned her $10 to $15 a day and was the family’s main source of income. The family initially fled on foot after the fighting began around 4 o’clock in the early morning. They managed to get a lift in a vehicle that took them to Badhan, about 130 kilometres away. “Our situation is very difficult. We used to cook three meals a day, but now we struggle to manage even one meal. I was the only person working in the family, but I’ve now been displaced and no one is earning an income for us,” Leyla said. The 11-member family hosting Leyla and her children is also poor and survives on limited support from relatives abroad. The two families – comprising 23 people – share two small rooms made of metal sheets, forming a cramped and inadequate shelter. Leyla said the family can’t afford a $4 water drum and struggles to obtain even a 20-litre container a day for drinking and cooking. They have little water for bathing and washing clothes and depend partly on the family hosting them. Her children have stopped attending school and Koranic classes because she can no longer afford their education fees. She used to pay $80 a month for five children. “I am deeply worried about having my children staying at home. They see other children going to school and Koranic classes and ask me why I am not sending them. I’m very concerned about their lack of education, but I can’t afford the fees. We are already struggling to meet their basic needs,” she said. She has not been able to find work in Badhan despite looking for cleaning, sweeping and laundry jobs. She has no one to turn to for support. Adna Adan Ahmed, another displaced mother, said her family had also been severely affected. She is raising four children following her divorce. Her shop – their source of livelihood – and iron-sheet home were among the property burned in Dawaco. She estimated losing goods worth $2,000. She has no money to return or rebuild her home and business even if peace were restored. Her family misses their three meals a day, and has struggled for a month to obtain enough food to cook. Her food credit has run out due to a $300 debt that she can’t repay. “At best, I am now able to provide my children with food only once a day,” Adna said. She can only rely on cooked food offered irregularly by poor neighbours. The conflict has left many displaced families without the means to support themselves. The Dawaco chairman said the local administration had limited resources to assist them and had informed the Sanag regional administration of their worsening situation. He said the local administration had provided the displaced families with water delivered by tankers, while local communities had collected food to support them. However, both the displaced families and those hosting them remained vulnerable. “Their nutritional status, living conditions and health are all poor, and their biggest challenge is getting enough food. I call on the Somali people and humanitarian organisations to provide whatever support they can to these vulnerable families who were forced to flee their homes because of insecurity,” the chairman told Radio Ergo. Repeated clan conflicts continue to disrupt the lives of thousands of families who have yet to recover from economic losses caused by drought and conflict.
