items.title: Joint Statement on Penrhyn Port Project
items.description: Joint Statement on Penrhyn Office of the Spokesperson The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America, Cook Islands, and New Zealand on the announcement of the Penrhyn Port Project. Begin Text The United States, the Cook Islands, and New Zealand intend to partner to deliver a major port upgrade on the island of Penrhyn in the northern Cook Islands, senior representatives announced today. Cook Islands Prime Minister Mark Brown, New Zealand Foreign Minister Winston Peters, and U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau announced the project in Palau ahead of the Pacific Islands Forum Leaders Meeting. The United States and New Zealand intend to co-fund the project. The U.S. Department of State, working with Congress, will contribute US$50 million (approximately $NZ84 million) and New Zealand will contribute $NZ17.5 million (approximately US$10 million). New Zealand will implement the project in close coordination with the Cook Islands and the United States. “This is a positive and hugely significant initiative that demonstrates the strength of New Zealand’s partnerships with both the Cook Islands and the United States,” Mr. Peters says. “We are very pleased to be able to partner with the United States and the Cook Islands Governments to deliver this development priority for the Cook Islands, drawing on New Zealand’s experience in infrastructure delivery across the Pacific.” “This project underscores the United States’ strong commitment to our partners in the Pacific and builds on the Critical Minerals Framework the United States and the Cook Islands signed earlier this year,” Deputy Secretary Landau says. “It also highlights our historic ties to Penrhyn atoll, where U.S. personnel constructed Penrhyn’s port and airstrip over 80 years ago. Through transformational infrastructure initiatives such as this, we are making the United States and our partners safer, stronger, and more prosperous.” “This port is a lifeline for Tongareva allowing for safer landings, better access to services, and stronger connections between our Pa Enua and the world. This wharf upgrade complements our new domestic shipping investments and our own efforts in improving transport connections for our Pa Enua. We thank the United States and New Zealand for partnering with us to deliver on a priority our people have themselves identified,” Prime Minister Brown says. Penrhyn (also called Tongareva) is the northernmost island in the Cook Islands, and its port is at the village of Omoka. Upgraded port facilities will deliver safety and security benefits, as well as expand transport links and economic opportunities for the northern Cook Islands.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Qatar oo Kala Saxiixday Heshiis Lagu Dhisayo Jaamacadda Tiknoolajiyada Soomaaliya
items.description: DOXA — Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Dowladda Qatar ayaa magaalada Doxa ku kala saxiixday heshiis iskaashi oo saldhig u noqonaya dhismaha Jaamacadda Tiknoolajiyada Soomaaliya (TUS University). Heshiiska ayaa dhexmaray Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Soomaaliya iyo Jaamacadda Doxa ee Sayniska iyo Tiknoolajiyada (UDST), iyadoo jaamacadda Qatar ay Soomaaliya ka taageeri doonto hirgelinta mashruuca cusub. Jaamacadda Tiknoolajiyada Soomaaliya ayaa bixin doonta waxbarasho farsamo iyo mid xirfadeed oo tayo sare leh. Jaamacadda UDST ayaa kaalin muhiim ah ka qaadan doonta diyaarinta manhajka, tayeynta macallimiinta, hubinta tayada iyo nidaamka shahaadaynta. Wajiga koowaad ee mashruucan ayaa diiradda lagu saari doonaa takhasusyo ay ka mid yihiin tiknoolajiyada, cilmiga badaha, duulista, batroolka, injineernimada, tamarta iyo maaraynta caafimaadka. Mashruucan ayaa la filayaa inuu gacan ka geysto kobcinta aqoonta iyo xirfadaha dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana soo saaro xirfadlayaal dabooli kara baahiyaha sii kordhaya ee suuqa shaqada. Heshiiska ayaa qayb ka ah Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka 2025–2029, kaas oo lagu horumarinayo tayada waxbarashada iyo xirfadaha looga baahan yahay suuqa shaqada. Waxaa sidoo kale mudnaan la siin doonaa tababbarka macallimiinta Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo mustaqbalka noqon doona maamulka iyo xoogga tacliin-bixinta ee jaamacadda cusub. Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Soomaaliya ayaa uga mahadcelisay Dowladda iyo shacabka Qatar taageerada iyo iskaashiga joogtada ah ee ay la garab taagan yihiin Soomaaliya. Munaasabadda saxiixa heshiiskan waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa Wasiirka Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Soomaaliya, Safiirka Soomaaliya u fadhiya Qatar iyo mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka socday Jaamacadda UDST.

items.title: Xasan oo shir muhiim ah uga qeyb-galay Belgrade + Sawirro
items.description: Belgrade (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ka qayb-galay shirka dalalka dhex-dhexaadka ah oo maanta ka furmay magaalada Belgrade ee dalka Serbia, halkaas oo uu khudbad ka jeediyay. Madaxweynaha ayaa shirka kusoo bandhigay caqabadaha amni, siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale ee dunidu wajahayo, isaga oo tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo iskaashiga iyo wada-shaqeynta caalamiga ah. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in caqabadaha maanta jira oo ay kamid yihiin colaadaha, argagixisada, xiisadaha juqraafi-siyaasadeed iyo isbeddelka cimilada ay u baahan yihiin xalal wadajir ah oo ku dhisan iskaashi caalami ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay xaaladda Soomaaliya, isagoo soo bandhigay horumarka laga sameeyay dalka iyo dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ku bixinayso xasilloonida, dib-u-dhiska iyo horumarinta dalka. Sidoo kale wuxuu uga mahadceliyay bahwadaagta caalamiga ah taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiyaan Soomaaliya, isagoo xusay in taageeradaasi ay muhiim u tahay dadaallada lagu horumarinayo amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo dowladnimada dalka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa adkeeyay in Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay ku dhaqanka mabaadii’da dhaq-dhaqaaqa dalalka dhex-dhexaadka ah, gaar ahaan dhowrista madax-bannaanida, midnimada dhuleed, caddaaladda iyo sinnaanta. Ugu dambeyntiina, Madaxweynaha ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo hab nabadeed, wuxuuna ku baaqay in la xoojiyo iskaashiga dalalka si wax looga qabto caqabadaha amni, siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo kuwo kale ee dunida ka jira. items.title: Cosoble oo soo jeediyay in xilka laga qaado Cabdikariin kadib qaladaadkii Galmudug
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee HirShabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Cosoble ayaa si weyn u dhaliilay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan, isagoo dalbaday in xilka laga qaado. Cali Cosoble ayaa wax la aqbali karin ku tilmaamay in Cabdikariin uu weli yahay guddoomiyaha guddiga doorashooyinka, xilli uu ku eedeeyay inuu baalmaray xeerarka doorashooyinka ee dalka. “Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan ayaa weli ah guddoomiyaha guddiga doorashooyinka, iyadoo Maxkamadda Sare sheegtay inuu baalmaray xeerka doorashooyinka,” ayuu yiri Cosoble. Madaxweynihii hore ee HirShabelle ayaa sheegay in haddii guddoomiyaha guddiga uusan is-casilin ay tahay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay qaaddo tallaabo xilka looga qaadayo. “Ninkaas hadduu is-casili waayay, waa in dowladda ka qaado xilka,” ayuu hadalkiisa sii raaciyay. Cali Cosoble ayaa sidoo kale Dowladda Federaalka ugu baaqay inay wax ka qabato arrinta guddiga doorashooyinka, isagoo sheegay inaan loo baahnayn in khilaaf kale oo siyaasadeed laga abuuro HirShabelle xilli weli xal laga gaarin xaaladda ka dhalatay doorashooyinka Galmudug. “Iyadoo aan la xallin Galmudug ayuu haddana rabaa inuu qaso Hirshabeelle. Kuma qanci meyno doorasho uu ninkaas ku lug leeyahay,” ayuu yiri Cosoble. Hadalka Cali Cosoble ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay taagan yihiin doodo siyaasadeed oo la xiriira hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka, gaar ahaan madax-bannaanida iyo kalsoonida lagu qabo guddiga doorashooyinka, iyadoo Maxkamadda Sare ay dhawaan sheegtay in guddiga uusan si waafaqsan sharciga doorashooyinka u maamulin doorashooyinkii isku sidkanaa ee Galmudug. Arrintaas ayaa keentay in Maxkamaddu buriso natiijooyinkii kasoo baxay Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka ee Galmudug, ayna go’aamiso in dib loogu celiyo doorashooyinkaasi. items.description: The President of the Republic of Somaliland, H.E. Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi (Irro), today paid a working visit to the Kidney Dialysis Unit at Hargeisa General Hospital, where 12 new dialysis machines have been added to strengthen kidney treatment services. During the visit, President Irro inspected the newly introduced services and received a detailed briefing from hospital officials. He also met with patients receiving dialysis treatment, speaking to them individually about their health conditions and the quality of services they are receiving. The President said his administration had responded seriously to the concerns and complaints raised by kidney patients, emphasizing that patient care and the expansion of kidney dialysis services would receive special priority under the government’s health-sector development policies. The addition of the 12 new machines forms part of the President’s commitment to improving kidney dialysis services across Somaliland’s hospitals and ensuring access to essential equipment, medicines, and other services required by patients whose lives depend on regular dialysis treatment.President Irro stressed that healthcare is a national responsibility, reaffirming his government’s commitment to ensuring that every citizen has access to quality healthcare services. He further emphasized that improving healthcare services is not merely about addressing current needs, but also about building a sustainable health system capable of serving both present and future generations.The President also announced that additional dialysis machines will be delivered to Borama and Burco hospitals, while a dedicated kidney dialysis unit is expected to be established at Erigavo Hospital in the near future. The initiative reflects the government’s broader vision of measuring national development through tangible improvements in services that directly affect people’s lives, particularly in the healthcare sector, while creating a lasting impact on the well-being, care, and safety of Somaliland’s citizens. https://qarannews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/89e17c6a076c403cbd65fa47e6d29ddb_1788180718951.mp4

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Belgrade Fariin Adag Ka Jeediyay
items.description: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Belgrade uga qaybgalaya shir xusaya 65 sano ee Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dalalka Aan Isbahaysiga Ahayn Taariikhda daabacaadda: 1-da Sebtembar 2026, 2:21 PM EAT Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Belgrade ee dalka Serbia uga qaybgalaya kulan heer sare ah oo lagu xusayo 65-guuradii shirkii ugu horreeyay ee Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dalalka Aan Isbahaysiga Ahayn (Non-Aligned Movement – NAM).Kulanka ayaa ka socda Belgrade laga bilaabo 1-da ilaa 2-da Sebtembar 2026, iyadoo Soomaaliya uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh hoggaaminayo wafdigeeda. Sida ay xaqiijisay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya , madaxweynaha ayaa Belgrade gaaray, waxaana halkaas ku soo dhaweeyay mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Serbia. Shir xusaya taariikhda Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dalalka Aan Isbahaysiga Ahayn Munaasabaddan ayaa lagu xusayaa shirkii ugu horreeyay ee Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dalalka Aan Isbahaysiga Ahayn oo magaalada Belgrade lagu qabtay 1961-kii. Dowladda Serbia ayaa sheegtay in kulanka sanadkan uu fursad u yahay in dib loo eego dhaxalka dhaqdhaqaaqa iyo muhiimadda ay maanta leeyihiin mabaadi’diisa, gaar ahaan iskaashiga caalamiga ah, sharciga caalamiga ah iyo ilaalinta nidaamka dhinacyada badan ee caalamka. Dowladda Serbia ayaa sheegtay in kulanka ay ka qaybgalayaan wakiillo iyo madax sare oo ka socda dalalkii taariikh ahaan qaybta ka ahaa dhaqdhaqaaqa iyo xubnaha hadda ka tirsan Troika-da NAM.Madaxweynaha Serbia, Aleksandar Vučić, ayaa 1-da Sebtembar furay kulanka ka socda Palace of Serbia, isagoo sheegay in Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dalalka Aan Isbahaysiga Ahayn uu weli muhiim u yahay iskaashiga dhinacyada badan ee caalamka. Soomaaliya oo xoogga saaraysa madaxbannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya waxay sheegtay in ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee heer madaxweyne uu muujinayo sida ay dowladda Federaalka uga go’an tahay mabaadi’da aasaasiga ah ee Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dalalka Aan Isbahaysiga Ahayn.Mabaadi’daas waxaa ka mid ah ixtiraamka madaxbannaanida dalalka, midnimada dhuleed iyo in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo hab nabadeed. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu kulanka ka jeedin doono mowqifka Soomaaliya, isla markaana uu yeelan doono kulamo laba geesood ah oo ka baxsan shirka. Faahfaahinta rasmiga ah ee khudbadda madaxweynaha ee ku saabsan arrimaha amniga, argagixisada, isbeddelka cimilada iyo horumarka Soomaaliya ayaan weli si buuxda uga muuqan warbixinta rasmiga ah ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee la heli karo waqtiga la qorayo. Labada dhinac waxay ka wada hadleen xoojinta xiriirka labada dal, iskaashiga amniga iyo fursadaha dhaqaale, gaar ahaan dhinacyada saliidda iyo gaaska, waxbarashada iyo ganacsiga. Sida laga soo xigtay dowladda Serbia, xiriirka labada dal wuxuu leeyahay taariikh dheer oo ku xiran waayihii Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dalalka Aan Isbahaysiga Ahayn, taas oo Belgrade u aragto saldhig lagu sii horumarin karo xiriirka Soomaaliya. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo kaga hadlay caqabadaha dunida ka jira Shirka Dalalka Dhex-dhexaadka ah
items.description: Belgrade, Serbia – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta ka qayb galay Shirka Dalalka Dhex-dhexaadka ah ee ka furmay magaalada Belgrade ee dalka Serbia. Madaxweynaha ayaa khudbad uu ka jeediyay shirka ku soo bandhigay caqabadaha amni, siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale ee dunida maanta horyaalla, isaga oo xusay in colaadaha, argagixisada, xiisadaha juqraafi siyaasadeed iyo isbeddelka cimiladu ay u baahan yihiin iskaashi iyo wadajir caalami ah. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa shirka ka hor jeediyay horumarka Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka ee ku aaddan xasilloonida, dib u dhiska iyo horumarinta dalka, isaga oo uga mahadceliyay bahwadaagta caalamiga ah taageerada ay siiyaan Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha ayaa adkeeyay in Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay mabaadii’da Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dalalka Dhex-dhexaadka ah, gaar ahaan dhowrista madaxbannaanida, midnimada dhuleed, caddaaladda, sinnaanta iyo xallinta khilaafaadka.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Xaqiijisay in Mareykanku Weli Taageersan Yahay Soomaaliya Midaysan
items.description: Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad), ayaa shaaciyay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay dowladda Mareykanka si joogto ah ugala hadasho arrimaha ku saabsan madax-bannaanida dhuleed, amniga iyo xoojinta xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee labada dal. Wareysi uu siiyay wargeyska Asharq Al-Awsat, ayuu Cali Balcad ku sheegay in Muqdisho ay si dhab ah u wajahayso doodaha soo baxaya ee la xiriira suuragalnimada in Washington ay wax ka beddesho siyaasaddeeda ku aaddan Somaliland. Wuxuu tilmaamay in inkastoo ay jiraan xubno ka tirsan Kongareeska Mareykanka oo ku baaqaya isbeddel siyaasadeed, haddana loo baahan yahay in si cad loo kala saaro ololaha siyaasadeed, wararka saxaafadda iyo go’aannada rasmiga ah ee maamulka Mareykanka. Wasiiru-dowlaha ayaa hoosta ka xariiqay in Mareykanku uu weli aqoonsan yahay madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, oo ay Somaliland qayb ka tahay. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu taageersan yahay Soomaaliya midaysan, maadaama dalku uu Mareykanka u leeyahay muhiimad istiraatiiji ah oo la xiriirta la-dagaallanka argagixisada, amniga marin-biyoodyada iyo xasiloonida guud ee Geeska Afrika. Ugu dambeyntii, Cali Balcad ayaa ku dooday in danaha fog ee Mareykanka ay ku jirto Soomaaliya xasiloon oo midaysan, halkii la dhiirrigelin lahaa kala-qaybsanaan cusub oo saameysa gobolka Geeska Afrika, xilli gobolku uu horeyba u wajahayo xaalado nugul. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli doodaha ku saabsan mustaqbalka xiriirka Washington iyo maamulka Somaliland ay si weyn ugu soo noqnoqdeen fagaarayaasha siyaasadda ee dalka Mareykanka.

items.title: Ujeedka kulan ay yimaadeen DF, Dowlad-goboleedyada iyo hay’adaha samafalka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka (SoDMA), Mudane Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle ayaa maanta guddoomiyay kulan heer sare ah oo looga hadlay xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee dalka iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada ka shaqeeya gurmadka iyo maareynta musiibooyinka. Shirka oo ahaa mid muhiim ah ayaa waxaa ka qeyb-galay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka, wasiirrada arrimaha gargaarka ee Dowlad-goboleedyada, wakiillo ka socday Qaramada Midoobay, hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo kuwa maxalliga ah iyo bah-wadaagta bani’aadannimada. Inta uu socday kulanka waxaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta isku-duwidda howlaha gargaarka, dardargelinta gurmadka bani’aadannimo iyo sidii loo mideyn lahaa dadaallada lagu caawinayo dadka Soomaaliyeed ee ay saameeyeen musiibooyinka iyo xaaladaha bani’aadannimo, gaar ahaan diyaar-garowga, digniinta hore iyo ka jawaabista khataraha la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada iyo saameynta laga filayo El Niño 2026. Waxaa kale oo kulanka lagu falanqeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in Dowladda Federaalka, Dowlad-goboleedyada, hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay iyo bah-wadaagta kale ay si dhow uga wada shaqeeyaan ka hortagga musiibooyinka, diyaar-garowga iyo wax ka qabashada xaaladaha degdegga ah. Guddoomiye Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle oo khudbad ka jeediyay madasha ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay iskaashi iyo isku-duwid mideysan, si loo hubiyo in gargaarka iyo adeegyada bani’aadannimo ay si hufan oo degdeg ah ku gaaraan dadka u baahan. Sidoo kale wuxuu tusaale ka bixiyay baahida loo qabo in la xoojiyo awoodda hay’adaha dowladda ee maareynta musiibooyinka iyo gurmadka degdegga ah. Ka qeybgalayaashu waxay isku raaceen muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo awoodda iyo hababka isku-duwidda heer Dowlad-goboleed, si digniinaha hore loogu beddelo tallaabooyin degdeg ah, loona hubiyo in kheyraadka, gargaarka iyo taageeradu waqtigooda gaaraan bulshooyinka nugul. Si kastaba, kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo wada shaqeynta Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo bah-wadaagta bani’aadannimada, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in si wadajir ah looga jawaabo caqabadaha bani’aadannimo ee dalka ka jira, loona diyaargaroobo xaaladaha mustaqbalka. Dhanka kale, Hay’adda SoDMA ayaa maanta soo saartay warsaxaafadeed ay ku xoojinayso diyaar-garowga dalka, iyadoo laga digayo saameynta la filayo ee El Niño inta lagu jiro bilaha Oktoobar iyo December (OND) ee xilli-roobaadka Deyrta 2026. items.description: Ku dhowaad 30 sano kadib dilkii fannaankii caanka ahaa ee hip-hop-ka Tupac Shakur, maxkamad ku taalla gobolka Nevada ee dalka Mareykanka ayaa Duane “Keffe D” Davis, oo 63 jir ah, ku heshay dambi ah inuu door ku lahaa dilka fannaanka. Xeerbeegtida maxkamadda Clark County ayaa muddo ku dhow saddex saacadood ka tashatay kiiska, ka hor inta aysan go’aamin in Davis uu yahay dambiile, waxaana lagu helay hal dacwad oo ah dil darajada koowaad ah, iyadoo loo adeegsaday hub halis ah, kaddib maxkamad socotay 11 maalmood. Davis, oo hore uga tirsanaa hoggaanka kooxda burcadda ah ee South Side Compton Crips ee magaalada Los Angeles, ayaa lagu eedeeyay inuu abaabulay weerarkii lagu dilay Tupac Shakur 7-dii Sebtembar 1996. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa sheegay in sababta weerarka ay salka ku haysay dagaal dhacay saacado ka hor dilka, kaas oo dhex maray xubno ka tirsanaa kooxda Shakur iyo wiil uu Davis adeer u ahaa. Tupac Shakur ayaa xilligaas magaalada Las Vegas u joogay inuu daawado ciyaar feerka culus ah oo uu ka qaybgalayay Mike Tyson, waxaana Saacado kadib markii uu dhacay iska horimaadkii casino-ga, Shakur uu saarnaa BMW uu waday Marion “Suge” Knight, oo ahaa aasaasihii shirkadda Death Row Records. Markii ay marayeen meel nalka taraafikadu yaallo, waxaa dhinacooda soo istaagay Cadillac cad, waxaana gaarigaas laga furay rasaas,Tupac, oo markaas 25 jir ahaa, ayaa dhowr xabbadood ku dhaceen, halka Suge Knight uu isaguna dhaawacmay. Fannaanka ayaa lix maalmood kadib u geeriyooday dhaawacyadii soo gaaray, taasoo dhalisay mid ka mid ah kiisaskii dil ee ugu caansanaa ee muddo dheer aan xal loo helin gudaha Mareykanka. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa maxkamadda u sheegay in Davis uu hubka helay, kooxdiisana abaabulay, kadibna uu hubka u dhiibay qof ku jiray kursiga dambe ee Cadillac-ka, kaas oo lagu eedeeyay inuu rasaasta ku furay Shakur. Davis ayaa ahaa qofkii keliya ee ka mid ahaa dadka ku jiray Cadillac-ka habeenka dilka ee weli nool. Kiiska ayaa muddo tobannaan sano ah hakad ku jiray, iyadoo baarayaasha ay la tacaalayeen caddeymo aan ku filnayn. Hase yeeshee, arrintu waxay dib u soo cusboonaatay kadib markii Davis uu 2019-kii soo saaray buug uu kaga hadlay noloshiisa iyo waayihiisii kooxaha burcadda ah. Sidoo kale, Davis ayaa sannado badan wareysiyo uu bixiyay kaga hadlayay xiriirkiisa dhacdadii dilka Tupac, waxaana hadalladaas ay noqdeen qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dacwadda. Dacwad-oogaha Binu Palal ayaa xeerbeegtida hor dhigay muuqaallo iyo hadallo hore oo Davis laga duubay, isagoo ku dooday in hadalladaasi yihiin qirashooyin muujinaya inuu ku lug lahaa qorshaha dilka. qareenka Davis, Michael Sanft, ayaa arrintaas si weyn uga hor yimid, waxaana uu uxuu sheegay in hadallada uu Davis hore u bixiyay ay ahaayeen sheekooyin iyo been-abuur uu qayb ahaan ugu talagalay inuu buuggiisa suuq geeyo. Difaaca ayaa sidoo kale ku dooday in aysan jirin caddeyn kale oo Davis si toos ah ugu xiriirinaysa dilka marka laga reebo hadalladiisa. Davis ayaa ugu dambeyn lagu helay dambi, inkastoo uu horey u sheegay inuusan dambiile ahayn, Kadib markii xukunka lagu dhawaaqayna, wuxuu garsooraha u sheegay inuu qorsheynayo inuu racfaan ka qaato go’aanka maxkamadda. Davis waxaa lagu wadaa in 13-ka Oktoobar 2026 la horgeeyo maxkamadda si loogu dhawaaqo xukunkiisa, waxaana uu wajihi karaa xabsi daa’in iyada oo aan loo oggolaan sii-dayn sharci ah. Tupac Shakur wuxuu ka mid ahaa fanaaniintii ugu saameynta badnaa taariikhda hip-hop-ka, waxaana heesihiisa kamid ahaa “California Love” iyo “All Eyez on Me” oo dunida oo dhan caan ka noqday, waxaana uu door weyn ku lahaa loollankii xilligaas ka dhex jiray fanaaniinta hip-hop-ka ee East Coast iyo West Coast. Dilkiisa ayaa muddo dheer ahaa arrin dhalisay su’aalo, mala-awaal iyo baaritaanno badan. Laakiin go’aanka cusub ee maxkamadda Nevada ayaa noqonaya tallaabo weyn oo lagu xallinayo mid ka mid ah kiisaskii ugu caansanaa ee taariikhda muusikada Mareykanka. Ku dhowaad 30 sano kadib geeridii Tupac Shakur, magaca fannaanka ayaa weli ku jira taariikhda hip-hop-ka, halka xukunka Duane “Keffe D” Davis uu hadda noqonayo wejiga cusub ee kiiska dilka oo muddo dheer dunida ku mashquuliyay.

items.title: Dowladda iyo mucaaradka oo gaaray is-afgarad iyo guddi cusub oo la dhisayo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dhinacyada mucaaradka ayaa beesha caalamka la wadaagay nuqul ka mid ah soo jeedin iyo is-afgarad hordhac ah oo ku saabsan sameynta hannaan doorasho oo ay labada dhinac ku wada qanacsan yihiin. Soo jeedintan ayaa ku saleysan in la dhiso guddi farsamo oo diyaariya qaabka doorashada, ka hor inta aysan madaxda dowladda iyo hoggaanka mucaaradka yeelan kulan rasmi ah oo lagu gaaro heshiis siyaasadeed. Is-afgaradka labada dhinac ayaa diiradda saaraya sidii loo mideyn lahaa aragtiyaha kala duwan ee ku saabsan hannaanka doorashada, iyadoo lagu saleeynayo soo jeedimihii ay kala keeneen Dowladda Federaalka, Golaha Mustaqbalka, Nabad iyo Nolol iyo Golaha Midnimada Qaran. Guddiga farsamada ee la qorsheynayo ayaa laga sugayaa inuu diyaariyo hannaan doorasho oo ku dhisan mabaadi’da doorasho qof iyo cod ah, nidaam xisbiyo badan leh iyo hal guddi qaran oo doorasho, iyadoo sidoo kale la tixgelinayo nidaamka awood-qaybsiga 4.5. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa xaqiijisay in mar walba diyaar u tahay in la gaaro heshiis doorasho oo ay ku wada qanacsan yihiin dhinacyada siyaasadda, kaas oo waafaqsan midnimada iyo mabaadi’da guud ee dalka. Mas’uul sare oo ka tirsan dowlada oo codsaday in aan magaciisa la xigan ayaa sheegay in dowladda aysan ka tanaasuleyn mabaadi’da ay ku adkeysanayaan ee doorashada qof iyo codka ah, nidaamka xisbiyada iyo hal guddiga qaran ee doorashooyinka, balse ay diyaar u tahay in laga wada-hadlo arrimaha farsamada sida muddada iyo qaab-dhismeedka guddiga. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay inay suurtagal tahay in wax laga beddelo qaar ka mid ah xubnaha guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka, kadib doodaha ay mucaaradku ka muujiyeen kalsoonida iyo hannaanka magacaabista xubnaha guddiga. Arrimahan ayaa imanaya xilli beesha caalamku ay waddo dadaallo lagu soo afjarayo khilaafka u dhexeeya dowladda iyo mucaaradka ee ku saabsan nooca doorashada dalka ka dhaceysa, iyadoo safaaradda Turkiga ay ka qeyb qaadatay fududeynta wada-hadallada labada dhinac. The post Dowladda iyo mucaaradka oo gaaray is-afgarad iyo guddi cusub oo la dhisayo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Italy Expands Police Training Support for Somalia
items.description: Italy expands police training and security support for Somalia Italian Ambassador Pier Mario Daccò Coppi says Rome will deepen its cooperation with Somalia on police training, institutional development and efforts to prevent violent extremism. MOGADISHU, September 1, 2026 — Italy has pledged to strengthen its support for Somalia’s security institutions, with an emphasis on police training, stabilisation and government-led projects in communities affected by conflict.Speaking at Somalia’s National Internal Security Conference in Mogadishu, Italian Ambassador Pier Mario Daccò Coppi described the gathering as an important opportunity to bring together the political and institutional leadership of the internal security sector The two-day conference brings together representatives of the federal government and federal member states to discuss security governance, institutional coordination and the supervisory role of the Ministry of Internal Security.Daccò Coppi said Somalia was making important progress in institution-building and stabilisation, although the process remained gradual. Longstanding police and security cooperation The ambassador described relations between Italy and Somalia as a historic partnership that had endured the instability and conflict of Somalia’s recent past. He said Italy’s policy was guided by support for Somalia’s sovereignty, territorial integrity, security and stabilisation. The two countries have maintained a defence cooperation framework since 2013. The Italian Carabinieri began training members of the Somali Police Force’s Darwish units in Djibouti in 2014. According to the Italian Ministry of Defence, the MIADIT programme trained 3,100 Somali police personnel over its first 10 years. The courses cover law enforcement, stability policing and responses to high-risk security incidents. Italian Ministry of Defence Italy also participates in three European Union operations linked to Somalia: EUTM Somalia, EUCAP Somalia and Operation Atalanta.EUTM supports military training, EUCAP helps strengthen civilian law-enforcement capacity, and Atalanta focuses on maritime security and counter-piracy operations. Five-year police training framework Daccò Coppi highlighted a memorandum signed in Mogadishu on July 3, 2026, by Somali Internal Security Minister Abdullahi Sheikh Ismail Fartag and Italian Interior Minister Matteo Piantedosi.The memorandum creates a government-to-government framework for vocational and academic police training, train-the-trainer programmes, study visits, exchanges and the sharing of professional expertise.It also establishes a joint working group responsible for coordinating implementation, reviewing progress and planning future activities.The framework will remain in force for an initial five years and may be renewed through the written consent of both governments. Somalia’s Ministry of Internal Security The ambassador said a further agreement on police training was expected to follow. He added that broader cooperation between the two countries’ police institutions would support efforts against transnational organised crime, irregular migration and terrorism. No date or detailed terms for the expected follow-up agreement were announced. Preventing violent extremism Daccò Coppi argued that force and legislation alone were not sufficient to counter violent extremism.He said security measures should be accompanied by efforts to address social and economic conditions that can contribute to radicalisation.The ambassador connected this approach to the Towards Peace and Stability in Somalia , or TPSS, programme launched by Italy and the Federal Government of Somalia.Under the initiative, Somali authorities identify priority interventions, while Italy provides funding for projects intended to strengthen services and stability in vulnerable areas. Health projects in three districts Somalia’s Office of the Prime Minister selected health projects in three districts: Afmadow in Jubaland Harardhere in Galmudug Adale in Hirshabeelle In Adale, the programme will rehabilitate and bring Sheikh Ahmed Gabyow Hospital into operation. The district has a population of approximately 100,000 people, including internally displaced communities.The TPSS programme has an initial budget of €3.82 million. It is financed by Italy and implemented by the Somali Prime Minister’s Office. Italian Agency for Development Cooperation Daccò Coppi said he hoped the conference would strengthen institutional coordination and improve the capabilities of Somalia’s security forces.He said the long-term objective was for Somali institutions to assume full responsibility for national security through the lawful, legitimate and accountable use of force. The post Italy Expands Police Training Support for Somalia first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: DF oo shaacisay sababta hor-taagan imaanshaha ciidanka Masar ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa faahfaahin ka bixisay sababta wali u hirgeli la’yahay qorshaha ciidamada Masar loogu soo daabulayo Soomaaliya, iyadoo sheegtay in caqabadda ugu weyn ay tahay maalgelinta, saadka iyo dhammeystirka habraacyada hawlgalka ee howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad)ayaa sheegay in Masar ay weli diyaar u tahay inay ciidamadeeda ka mid noqdaan Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), isla markaana dib-u-dhaca uusan la xiriirin isbeddel ku yimid mowqifka Qaahira. “Masar waxay si cad u muujisay inay diyaar u tahay inay ciidamadeeda soo dirto,” ayuu Cali Balcad u sheegay wargeyska Sacuudiga ka soo baxa ee Asharq Al-Awsat , wareysi la daabacay Axaddii. Waxa uu tusaale u soo qaatay booqasho uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu tagay ciidamo Masaari ah oo loo diyaarinayey howlgalka Soomaaliya, isagoo taas ku tilmaamay caddeyn muujineysa in Qaahira ay weli ka go’an tahay qorshaha. “Dhibaatadu ma aha in Masar aysan lahayn go’aan siyaasadeed ama diyaar-garow,” ayuu yiri. Wasiiru Dowlaha ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Masar lagu soo daabulayo Soomaaliya iyadoo la raacayo qorshayaasha ay ku heshiiyeen Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan jadwalka kala wareejinta ciidamada, saadka iyo shuruudaha kale ee hawlgalka. Waxa uu sidoo kale tilmaamay in dhibaatada dhaqaale ee haysata AUSSOM ay qayb ka tahay waxyaabaha hakiyey qorshaha, isagoo sheegay in Soomaaliya ay dooneyso in arrimaha harsan sida ugu dhaqsaha badan loo dhammeystiro. Qorshe muddo dheer hakad ku jira Masar waxay ka mid tahay dalalka loo xushay inay ciidamo ku biiriyaan AUSSOM, oo billowgii 2025 beddelay howlgalkii hore ee Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya. Qorshayaasha Qaramada Midoobay ayaa dhigaya in 1,091 askari oo Masaari ah ay Soomaaliya yimaadaan, kuwaas oo qayb ka noqonaya dib-u-habeyn lagu sameynayo qaab-dhismeedka ciidamada AUSSOM, xilli ciidamada Burundi laga saarayo howlgalka. Midowga Afrika ayaa bishii Febraayo mar kale xaqiijiyey in Masar diyaar u tahay inay ciidamo ku biiriso howlgalka, wuxuuna ku baaqay in la dedejiyo imaatinkooda iyadoo dhinaca kale la dhameystirayo bixitaanka ciidamada Burundi iyo cutub boolis ah oo ka socda Ghana. Diyaar-garowga ciidamada Masar ayaa socday muddo ka badan hal sano, balse ilaa hadda ciidamadii loo qorsheeyey Soomaaliya ma aysan soo gaarin. Imaatinka ciidamada Masar ayaa sii xoojinaya xiriirka amni iyo milatari ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Qaahira, kaas oo sanadihii dambe si weyn u kordhay. Masar waxay Soomaaliya siisay taageero militari iyo tababbar, iyadoo labada dowladood ay sidoo kale xoojiyeen xiriirkooda siyaasadeed. Marka ay yimaadaan, ciidamada Masar ayaa la filayaa inay la shaqeeyaan cutubyada kale ee AUSSOM iyo ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya ee dagaalka kula jira Al-Shabaab, isla markaana ay qayb ka qaataan qorshaha tartiib-tartiib masuuliyadda amniga loogu wareejinayo hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya. Dhaqaale yari haysata AUSSOM Dib-u-dhaca ciidamada Masar ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo AUSSOM muddo la tacaalaysay hubanti la’aan ku saabsan sida loo maalgelinayo howlgalkeeda. Howlgalka ayaa si weyn ugu tiirsan taageerada saadka ee Qaramada Midoobay, oo ay ka mid yihiin raashinka, shidaalka, diyaaradaha, daad-gureynta caafimaadka, gaadiidka iyo adeegyo kale oo muhiim u ah ciidamada ka howlgala Soomaaliya. Sanad-maaliyadeedka 2025-2026, AUSSOM waxay u baahnayd ku dhowaad 190 milyan oo dollar oo loogu talagalay lacagaha ciidamada dalalka ku deeqay, hase yeeshee Midowga Afrika wuxuu xaqiijiyey oo keliya qiyaastii 120 milyan oo dollar oo ballanqaadyo ah. Dhibaatada maalgelinta ayaa kasii dartay kadib markii Mareykanka uu muujiyey inuusan taageeri doonin sii wadista nidaamka Qaramada Midoobay ee lagu maalgeliyo taageerada saadka AUSSOM wixii ka dambeeya dhammaadka 2026. Midowga Afrika ayaa marar badan ku baaqay in howlgalka Soomaaliya loo helo dhaqaale joogto ah oo la isku halleyn karo, isagoo ka digay in maalgelin la’aantu dhaawici karto awoodda AUSSOM ee ay ku sii waddo howlgalkeeda. Arrimahan ayaa dhacaya xilli ciidamada AUSSOM ay weli taageerayaan ciidamada Soomaaliya ee dagaalka kula jira Al-Shabaab, halka dowladda federaalka ay isku dayeyso inay si tartiib ah ula wareegto masuuliyadda buuxda ee amniga dalka. items.title: Türkiye pledges continued security and economic support for Somalia
items.description: Turkish Ambassador Alper Aktaş says Ankara will maintain its support for Somali security forces while expanding cooperation in energy, fisheries and other strategic sectors. MOGADISHU, September 1, 2026 — Türkiye has pledged to continue supporting Somalia’s security institutions, counterterrorism operations and long-term economic development as the country works towards greater self-sufficiency.Addressing Somalia’s National Internal Security Conference in Mogadishu, Turkish Ambassador Alper Aktaş said the country had made visible security progress, although significant challenges and uncertainties remained.Aktaş said his more than two and a half years in Somalia had allowed him to witness changes in Mogadishu firsthand. “Just a few years ago, Mogadishu was associated with major explosions, instability and persistent conflict,” he said. “Today, we speak of rising skyscrapers, ambitious development projects and genuine hope.” Training for Gorgor and Haramcad units The ambassador said Türkiye-trained Gorgor special forces continued to take part in operations against terrorist groups.He added that Türkiye was also training specialised Haramcad units within the Somali Police Force.According to Aktaş, more than 1,000 personnel have been trained and are helping respond to security threats in Somali cities. He did not provide a breakdown of the personnel, the period covered by the figure or their current deployments.Türkiye opened its largest overseas military base in Mogadishu in 2017 and provides training to both the Somali military and police. Air support for security operations Aktaş said Türkiye had increased its air assets in Somalia at the request of Somali authorities to support operations on the ground.He said the additional support was already contributing to counterterrorism efforts. However, he did not identify the aircraft involved, disclose their number or provide independently verifiable information about their operational impact.Further information from the Somali and Turkish authorities would therefore be needed to establish the scope and results of the deployment. Connecting security with economic development The ambassador argued that security gains would not be sustainable without economic progress. He linked Türkiye’s security engagement to its growing involvement in Somalia’s energy, fisheries and infrastructure sectors.Aktaş referred to the continuing work of the Çağrı Bey deep-sea drilling vessel, planned fisheries initiatives and a proposed spaceport project.The Çağrı Bey arrived off Mogadishu in April 2026 to begin Türkiye’s first overseas deep-sea oil exploration project. The planned well is expected to reach a depth of 7,500 metres, while the drilling operation was projected to last about 10 months.The operation follows an intergovernmental energy agreement signed in March 2024 covering the exploration, evaluation, development and production of oil and gas in Somalia’s offshore and onshore areas. Exploratory drilling does not, however, guarantee the discovery of commercially recoverable oil. The results of the well, the possible size of any reserves and the eventual financial benefits for Somalia have not yet been announced. Commitment to continued partnership Aktaş said international partners should maintain their assistance as Somalia moves towards greater self-reliance. “Türkiye remains fully committed to doing its part,” he said. He concluded by thanking Somalia’s security institutions and described the country as a second home for himself and his family.His remarks presented Türkiye’s engagement as a broad partnership spanning security, defence, energy and economic development. Some proposed initiatives, particularly the spaceport, still require further official details concerning financing, implementation agreements and timelines. The post Türkiye pledges continued security and economic support for Somalia first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Talyaaniga oo shacab dabar go’aya – Maxaa dhacaya 2050?
items.description: Roma (Caasimada Online) – Tirada dadka ku nool Talyaaniga ayaa la filayaa inay hoos u dhacdo ku dhowaad afar milyan oo qof marka la gaaro 2050, arrintaas oo cadaadis weyn saari karta dhaqaalaha dalka iyo nidaamka daryeelka bulshada, sida ay Isniintii ka digtay hay’adda tirakoobka qaranka ee ISTAT. Saadaasha cusub ee hay’adda, oo gaareysa ilaa 2080, ayaa muujineysa in dadka Talyaaniga ay ka yaraan doonaan 58.9 milyan oo qof oo ay ahaayeen bilowgii 2025, una dhici doonaan qiyaastii 55 milyan sannadka 2050. Haddii isbeddelka hadda socda uu sii jiro, ISTAT waxay saadaalisay in tirada dadka dalka ay hoos ugu sii dhici doonto 45.8 milyan marka la gaaro 2080. Dhibaatada ugu weyn ayaa ah in Talyaanigu uusan oo keliya lumin doonin dad, balse sidoo kale uu si degdeg ah u duqoobayo, iyadoo tirada dadka shaqeeya ay hoos u dhacayso halka dadka hawlgabka ah ay sii badanayaan. Ra’iisul Wasaare Giorgia Meloni ayaa markii ay xilka qabatay 2022 sheegtay in kordhinta dhalmada ay ka mid noqon doonto mudnaanta ugu weyn ee dowladdeeda, hase yeeshee dadaalladaas ayaan ilaa hadda wax weyn ka beddelin hoos-u-dhaca dhalmada. Dhalmada Talyaaniga ayaa si joogto ah hoos ugu dhacaysay tan iyo 2008. Sannadkii hore waxaa dalka ku dhashay qiyaastii 355,000 oo carruur ah, waana tiradii ugu hooseysay ee la diiwaangeliyo tan iyo mideyntii Talyaaniga sanadkii 1861-kii. ISTAT waxay sheegtay in tirada dhalmada sannadlaha ah la filayo inay si guud u degganaato ilaa 2030, ka hor inta aysan mar kale hoos u dhicin, iyadoo sannadka 2050 la saadaalinayo in dalka ay ku dhalan doonaan qiyaastii 335,000 oo carruur ah. Tirada dhimashada oo sii kordheysa Dhanka kale, tirada dhimashada ayaa sii kordheysa sababo la xiriira gabowga bulshada. Qiyaastii 652,000 oo qof ayaa dhintay sannadkii hore, halka dhimashada sannadlaha ah la saadaalinayo inay gaarto heerkii ugu sarreeyay oo ah 869,000 qof sannadka 2058. Kororka dhimashada ayaa qayb ahaan la xiriira jiilkii tirada badnaa ee dhashay sannadihii ka dambeeyay Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka, kuwaas oo hadda si tartiib tartiib ah u gaaraya da’da waayeelnimada. Saadaasha ISTAT ayaa sidoo kale muujineysa isbeddel weyn oo ku imaanaya qaab-dhismeedka bulshada Talyaaniga. Dadka da’doodu tahay 65 sano iyo wixii ka weyn, oo sanadkii 2025 ahaa 24.7 boqolkiiba dadweynaha, ayaa la filayaa inay gaaraan 34.5 boqolkiiba marka la gaaro 2050. Isla muddadaas, dadka da’doodu u dhexeyso 15 iyo 64 sano, kuwaas oo loo arko dadka ugu muhiimsan suuqa shaqada, ayaa hoos uga dhici doona 63.4 boqolkiiba ilaa 55.3 boqolkiiba. Taasi waxay ka dhigan tahay in mustaqbalka ay jiri doonaan shaqaale tiro ahaan sii yaraanaya oo laga doonayo inay taageeraan bulsho ay sii kordhayaan dadka hawlgabka ah iyo kuwa u baahan adeegyada caafimaadka iyo daryeelka. ISTAT waxay ka digtay in isku darka shaqaale yaraanta iyo tirada dadka hawlgabka ah ee sii kordheysa ay keeni doonaan “caqabadaha cusub ee nidaamka dhaqaalaha iyo daryeelka bulshada”. Hoos-u-dhaca dadweynaha sidoo kale si isku mid ah uma saameyn doono dhammaan gobollada Talyaaniga. Koonfurta dalka, oo dhaqaale ahaan ka liidata waqooyiga, ayaa la filayaa inay wajahdo khasaaraha ugu weyn. Dadka koonfurta Talyaaniga ayaa saadaasha lagu sheegay inay ka yaraan doonaan 19.7 milyan sanadkii 2025 una dhici doonaan 16.7 milyan sannadka 2050. Gobollada waqooyiga iyo bartamaha dalka ayaa iyaguna dad lumin doona, balse hoos-u-dhaca halkaas ka dhacaya ayaa la filayaa inuu ka yaraado kan ka dhacaya koonfurta. Isbeddelladan ayaa sii xoojinaya walaaca muddo dheer ka jiray Talyaaniga iyo dalal kale oo badan oo Yurub ah, kuwaas oo wajahaya dhalmo hooseysa, bulsho sii gabowda iyo su’aalo isa soo taraya oo ku saabsan sida loo sii maalgelin karo nidaamyada hawlgabka, caafimaadka iyo adeegyada bulshada mustaqbalka. Dadka da’doodu tahay 65 sano iyo wixii ka weyn, oo sanadkii 2025 ahaa 24.7 boqolkiiba dadweynaha, ayaa la filayaa inay gaaraan 34.5 boqolkiiba marka la gaaro 2050. Isla muddadaas, dadka da’doodu u dhexeyso 15 iyo 64 sano, kuwaas oo loo arko dadka ugu muhiimsan suuqa shaqada, ayaa hoos uga dhici doona 63.4 boqolkiiba ilaa 55.3 boqolkiiba. Taasi waxay ka dhigan tahay in mustaqbalka ay jiri doonaan shaqaale tiro ahaan sii yaraanaya oo laga doonayo inay taageeraan bulsho ay sii kordhayaan dadka hawlgabka ah iyo kuwa u baahan adeegyada caafimaadka iyo daryeelka. ISTAT waxay ka digtay in isku darka shaqaale yaraanta iyo tirada dadka hawlgabka ah ee sii kordheysa ay keeni doonaan “caqabadaha cusub ee nidaamka dhaqaalaha iyo daryeelka bulshada”. Hoos-u-dhaca dadweynaha sidoo kale si isku mid ah uma saameyn doono dhammaan gobollada Talyaaniga. Koonfurta dalka, oo dhaqaale ahaan ka liidata waqooyiga, ayaa la filayaa inay wajahdo khasaaraha ugu weyn. Dadka koonfurta Talyaaniga ayaa saadaasha lagu sheegay inay ka yaraan doonaan 19.7 milyan sanadkii 2025 una dhici doonaan 16.7 milyan sannadka 2050. Gobollada waqooyiga iyo bartamaha dalka ayaa iyaguna dad lumin doona, balse hoos-u-dhaca halkaas ka dhacaya ayaa la filayaa inuu ka yaraado kan ka dhacaya koonfurta. Isbeddelladan ayaa sii xoojinaya walaaca muddo dheer ka jiray Talyaaniga iyo dalal kale oo badan oo Yurub ah, kuwaas oo wajahaya dhalmo hooseysa, bulsho sii gabowda iyo su’aalo isa soo taraya oo ku saabsan sida loo sii maalgelin karo nidaamyada hawlgabka, caafimaadka iyo adeegyada bulshada mustaqbalka. items.title: Somalia Sets September 30 for Galmudug, Hirshabelle Elections
items.description: Electoral commission announces fresh polls for two federal member states following court ruling that annulled Galmudug’s previous results. Mogadishu – Somalia’s Independent National Electoral and Boundaries Commission has scheduled September 30, 2026, as polling day for local council and parliamentary elections in Galmudug and Hirshabelle. The commission released separate electoral timelines for both federal member states on Tuesday, marking a significant step toward completing the country’s ongoing regional election process. The decision comes after Somalia’s Supreme Court annulled Galmudug’s previous election results on August 23, citing irregularities in the electoral process. This ruling forced the federal member state to conduct fresh polls, adding pressure on the electoral commission to deliver credible and transparent elections within a compressed timeframe. Hirshabelle, meanwhile, will proceed with its scheduled elections as originally planned. Galmudug’s electoral calendar begins on September 10, when the commission will designate polling centers and voting stations. Political associations must submit their candidate lists by September 20, followed by the accreditation of party agents and observers on September 26. The shortened timeline reflects the urgency of completing the process after the court’s intervention. Campaign activities will conclude on September 28, two days before polling day. Hirshabelle’s electoral process started earlier, with the publication of a preliminary voter register on September 2. The commission will subsequently establish polling stations, register voters, distribute voter cards, and verify candidate lists. Political associations will announce their candidates on September 22, followed by the accreditation of party agents and observers. Campaigning will end on September 28. “These elections represent an important opportunity for citizens in Galmudug and Hirshabelle to exercise their democratic rights,” a senior electoral official told this reporter on condition of anonymity. The official emphasized the commission’s commitment to transparency and fairness. The elections hold broader significance for Somalia’s political stability. Federal member state elections are crucial for establishing legitimate regional administrations that can partner with the federal government on security, development, and constitutional reform. Any delays or disputes could undermine progress toward the national elections scheduled for 2027. Both elections will proceed simultaneously on September 30, with results expected shortly thereafter. The post Somalia Sets September 30 for Galmudug, Hirshabelle Elections first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Hay’adaha caalamiga ah oo xaqiijiyay in in ka badan 23,000 oo Itoobiyaan qaxooti iyo magangalyo-doon ahi ay ku suganyihiin Soomaaliya
items.description: Ku dhowaad 155,000 oo Itoobiyaan ah oo qaxooti iyo magangalyo-doon ah ayaa hadda ku sugan dalalka deriska la ah Itoobiya, iyadoo in ka badan 23,000 oo ka mid ah ay ku nool yihiin Soomaaliya, sida lagu sheegay xog cusub oo ay soo saartay Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Qaxootiga ee UNHCR. Sida ku cad warbixin ay UNHCR soo saartay 28-ka Agoosto 2026, xogta la ururiyey ilaa dhammaadka Luulyo 2026 ayaa muujinaysa in guud ahaan 155,000 Itoobiyaan ah ay qaxooti ama magangalyo-doon ahaan ugu kala nool yihiin lix dal oo deris la ah Itoobiya. Suudaan ayaa ayaduna martigelinaysa tirada ugu badan, iyadoo halkaas ay ku sugan yihiin 63,954 Itoobiyaan ah, halka Kenya ay qaabishay 43,348 qof. Soomaaliya ayaa kaalinta saddexaad kaga jirta dalalka martigeliya qaxootiga Itoobiyaanka ah, iyadoo tirada dadkaasi ay gaareyso 23,645 qof. Dhanka kale, Jabuuti waxaa ku sugan 15,310 Itoobiyaan ah, halka Koonfurta Suudaan ay martigelinayso 8,484 qof. Eritrea ayaa iyaduna diiwaangelisay 15 Itoobiyaan ah. Tiradan ayaa soo baxaysa xilli barakaca dadka uu weli yahay arrin weyn oo saameyn ku leh Itoobiya iyo guud ahaan gobolka Geeska Afrika. Colaado, amni-darro iyo masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah ayaa ka mid ah sababaha ugu waaweyn ee dadka ku qasbaya inay ka guuraan deegaanadooda ama ay ka gudbaan xuduudaha dalalka. UNHCR waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Itoobiya gudaheeda ay ku nool yihiin ku dhowaad 1.1 milyan oo qaxooti iyo magangalyo-doon ah, kuwaas oo kasoo kala jeeda dalal dhowr ah. Koonfurta Suudaan ayaa ah dalka ay kasoo jeedaan dadka ugu badan ee qaxootiga ah ee Itoobiya ku sugan, waxaana tiradooda lagu sheegay 483,769 qof. Waxaa ku xiga Soomaalida oo tiradoodu gaareyso 362,091 qof, halka Eritreans-ku ay yihiin 171,362 qof, Sudanese-kuna ay gaarayaan 97,985 qof. Waxaa sidoo kale Itoobiya ku nool tirooyin ka yar oo qaxooti ah oo ka yimid dalalka Kenya iyo Yemen, kuwaas oo kala ah 5,674 Kenyan ah iyo 2,507 Yemeni ah. Marka laga yimaado qaxootiga iyo dadka magangalyo-doonka ah, UNHCR waxay sheegtay in Itoobiya ay leedahay ku dhowaad 1.9 milyan oo qof oo gudaha dalka ku barakacay. Qiyaastii 1.7 milyan oo qof ayaa barakacay sababo la xiriira colaado iyo amni-darro, halka ku dhowaad 173,000 qof ay ku barakaceen masiibooyin dabiici ah. UNHCR waxay sidoo kale diiwaangelisay 996 qof oo Itoobiyaan ah oo dalkooda dib ugu soo laabtay sannadka 2026, sida ku cad xogta muddada warbixintu daboolayso. Xogtan ayaa muujinaysa baaxadda barakaca iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa dadka ee ka jira Geeska Afrika, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay dalalka gobolka ee martigeliya kumannaan Itoobiyaan ah oo ka cararay xaalado kala duwan oo ka jira dalkooda.

items.title: Al-Shabaab-Houthi alliance poses a new threat to the U.S. and its allies
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – On a balmy evening, Jibril “One-Armed” Yahya Ali and his new bride set out for a honeymoon drive along the beach outside al-Ghaydah, Yemen . Jibril, a Somali, and his Yemeni wife had met through a mutual acquaintance, an arms dealer who helped Jibril buy military-grade weapons from Yemen ’s Houthi rebels. Jibril would then smuggle the arms to al-Shabaab, an Islamist insurgent group fighting to overthrow the government in Somalia. The budding alliance benefited both sides. Al-Shabaab, the world’s richest al Qaeda wing, had cash but needed weapons and training. The Houthis had sophisticated arms and tech know-how, but coveted money and a new perch for attacks against the West. The exchange also made Jibril a target . On Feb. 12, four months after Jibril married Budoor Murshid, the couple took the Toyota Corolla on their sunset drive. Budoor’s phone rang. They parked, and Budoor stepped outside to take the call. Moments later, a U.S. missile slammed through the car roof. Rather than explode, it sliced up the Corolla like a weaponized can opener. Jibril died instantly. A friend spirited Budoor away. The airstrike was an opening shot in the American effort to disrupt the unlikely alliance between two implacable U.S. foes: al-Shabaab militants who have been fighting in Somalia for two decades, and the Houthi rebels, longtime beneficiaries of weapons and training from Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. For the U.S., Jibril’s death came too late to stop the chain of events he helped set in motion. The Houthis and al-Shabaab had been sectarian adversaries until Jibril and others brokered a partnership that now threatens to further destabilize the Middle East and energy markets worldwide. Their home countries, Yemen and Somalia, sit on opposite shores of the Gulf of Aden , through which 12% of the world’s seaborne oil passed before the Iran war. With the Strait of Hormuz all but closed by Iranian forces, the gulf could serve as an escape route for Middle East oil. Except the Houthis have come to the aid of their allies in Tehran, attacking Saudi-linked oil tankers with missiles and drones in the Red Sea. Since at least 2023, Jibril had served as a liaison between the two militant groups, united in their hatred of America and Israel, according to U.S., Somali and Yemeni officials. Jibril was killed two weeks before the U.S. began the war with Iran. He never saw his legacy—how two U.S.-designated terrorist groups, locked in a marriage of convenience, inherited a strategic maritime pinch-point that empowers them to threaten the global oil trade in a time of crisis. “You have al-Shabaab, al Qaeda’s largest and most lucrative affiliate, gaining access to more sophisticated weapons and training,” U.S. Gen. Dagvin Anderson, commander of American forces in Africa, told The Wall Street Journal. “On the other side, the Houthis are extending their geographic reach, gaining a foothold that could further destabilize one of the world’s most critical economic chokepoints,” he said. “This isn’t just a regional problem. It has global implications.” Two American sources familiar with the operation confirmed it was a U.S. airstrike that killed Jibril. U.S. Central Command, in charge of American forces in the Middle East, said it wasn’t a military operation. A Central Intelligence Agency spokesperson declined to say whether the spy service was behind the killing. Yemen’s ambassador to the U.S. declined an interview request. Houthi officials didn’t respond to written questions about the group’s relationship with al-Shabaab. Budoor couldn’t be reached for comment. Enemy of my enemy The Houthis, predominantly Shia Muslims, and al-Shabaab, which adheres to Sunni Islam, are among the hundreds of millions divided by a seventh-century schism over who was the rightful successor to the Prophet Muhammad. The sectarian split still flares into violence in spots from Afghanistan to Iraq to Syria. Common enemies, however, now unite the Houthis and al-Shabaab. “They hate the West, they hate Israel,” said Abdulaahi Mohamed Ali, a former Somali intelligence chief. Yemen’s Counter-Terrorism Service described Jibril as “one of the key figures in strengthening ties between the Houthis and al-Shabaab through the exchange of expertise and coordination, particularly in facilitating the transfer of weapons and military equipment,” according to an internal assessment reviewed by the Journal. Jibril moved clandestinely between Somalia and Yemen, operating as al-Shabaab’s liaison with Houthi command, according to Matt Bryden, a former United Nations official who monitored arms flows to Somalia. Bryden outlined Jibril’s life and death in a closed-door intelligence briefing in June attended by U.S. special-operations personnel and East African government officials. Jibril, 38 years old when he died, had studied veterinary medicine in Yemen and ran a charity in Mogadishu, Somalia’s capital. He owned a foreign-exchange outlet and an import-export firm. He bore scars from gunshot wounds. His injuries earned him the nickname Gacaamey—roughly translated as one-armed—despite his having both limbs. The Houthis provided Jibril with a furnished apartment in San’a, the rebel-controlled Yemeni capital, according to the briefing, and he attended official functions. The rebels issued him a phony but convincing Yemeni passport under an assumed name, according to a document viewed by the Journal. In 2024, al-Shabaab dispatched a more senior envoy, Sheikh Ahmed Elmi Samatar, to work alongside Jibril. Samatar presented the Houthis with a lengthy weapons wish list, viewed by the Journal, which included shoulder-fired antiaircraft missiles, 107 mm Katyusha rockets, Dragunov sniper rifles, explosive attack drones, antitank missiles and U.S. night-vision gear. A U.S. military intelligence official confirmed that al-Shabaab sought advanced weaponry from the Houthis, in addition to rifles, machine guns and ammunition. Yemeni government officials arrested Samatar in January 2025 and later released him in a prisoner exchange with the Houthis, according to the briefing. Samatar returned to Somalia, leaving Jibril to press al-Shabaab’s interests in Yemen. Jibril continued to broker arms shipments, and al-Shabaab dispatched two weapons experts to Yemen to assist him. After Jibril’s killing, al-Shabaab picked a replacement in Yemen to continue the work, Bryden said. Jibril’s wife is on the run, he said. Front companies in Yemen disguise the shipments as civilian products and move them to Mukalla and other ports, the Yemeni intelligence report said. The weapons cross the Gulf of Aden in speedboats or fishing vessels and are transferred ashore on poorly monitored sections of coastline in northern Somalia, according to the U.S. military-intelligence official. They are transported to al-Shabaab combat units in southern Somalia, where the insurgents’ activities are concentrated. In April 2025, the U.S. destroyed two unflagged boats entering Somali waters from Yemen, carrying what U.S. Africa Command described as advanced conventional weapons. It isn’t clear what items on the lengthy al-Shabaab wish list have reached the militants in Somalia. But the idea that al-Shabaab might acquire attack drones or other arms capable of striking U.S. and Somali bases from the air makes both militaries nervous. “I don’t know what their plans are, but there’s definitely something cooking,” said Brig. Gen. Ahmed Abdullahi Sheikh, a former commander of Somali special forces. Complicating security concerns was Israel’s decision in December to recognize the independence of Somaliland, a region within the northwest of Somalia’s acknowledged borders that declared itself a separate country in 1991. Somaliland could provide Israel access to Berbera, a Red Sea port city with a runway so long that NASA once rented it as an emergency landing strip for the space shuttle. Berbera could give the Israelis another position where they could monitor and attack their Houthi enemies. Michael Milshtein, a former senior Israeli intelligence officer, said the Houthis were front of mind when Israel recognized Somaliland as an independent nation. “Military deployment in Somaliland gives you a very strong position to confront the Houthis,” he said. The Israeli government didn’t respond to requests for comment. In a televised speech this month, Houthi leader Abdul Malik al-Houthi said the group was closely monitoring Israeli actions in Somaliland, which he alleged were aimed at controlling the Gulf of Aden, the Bab al-Mandeb strait and the Red Sea. “We will move at any time to target any activity or presence of the Israeli enemy in Somaliland,” al-Houthi said. Traffic stop In June, a four-person Houthi delegation set sail from Yemen, crossed the Gulf of Aden and came ashore in southern Somalia. The men trekked through the bush to meet with their counterparts in Jilib, the de facto capital of al-Shabaab-held territory, according to a regional intelligence source. The Houthis sought to coordinate the disruption of Israeli activities in Berbera, fearing the port would serve as Israel’s permanent platform for surveillance and attacks on Yemen, according to the briefing and the intelligence source. The Houthis promised al-Shabaab leaders more advanced weapons and training, according to a report, viewed by the Journal, from one of the regional intelligence source’s agents. Al-Shabaab fighters regularly travel to Yemen for Houthi training to build more lethal roadside bombs as well as operate advanced weaponry. At least 100 al-Shabaab fighters have made the trip, the U.S. military-intelligence official said. The U.N. reported last year that al-Shabaab sends classes of about 30 militants to learn marksmanship, antiaircraft operations and techniques for making more lethal booby-trap bombs. In 2024, the first batch of trainees completed a pre-travel course that included religious education and advice on how to endure limited family communications while overseas, according to information gathered by the regional intelligence source. There was a goodbye ceremony and motivational speeches for the departing militants. In his June briefing, Bryden said a group of al-Shabaab fighters spent three months this year in Sa’dah, Yemen, studying drone assembly and systems that allow operators to see the view from drone cameras as if they were in a cockpit. Houthi trainers also travel to Somalia to coach al-Shabaab on drone operations, the U.S. military official said. Al-Shabaab, which pays in cash, can well afford the Houthi goods and services. The militant group brings in at least $100 million a year extorting money from Somali businesses and passersby at roadside checkpoints and the port of Mogadishu, according to a U.S. intelligence assessment. Al-Shabaab also exploits artisanal gold mines along the northern Cal Madow Mountains, according to Abdullahi, the former Somali commander. The U.S. military has conducted some 40 airstrikes against al-Shabaab targets in Somalia this year, compared with 41 for all of 2025, according to U.S. Africa Command. For the Houthis, gaining a southern perch in Somalia overlooking commercial traffic through the Gulf of Aden is as important as cash from al-Shabaab. “Traditionally, the relations between Houthis and al-Shabaab were purely transactional,” Awes Yusuf Ahmed, Somalia’s national security adviser, said in an interview. “That doesn’t mean there aren’t some new factors added after the Iran-U.S.A. war which can be of strategic importance.” Among the Houthis’ aspirations, according to the briefing, is securing al-Shabaab’s help deploying radar to monitor ships in the waters they share.

A Central Intelligence Agency spokesperson declined to say whether the spy service was behind the killing. Yemen’s ambassador to the U.S. declined an interview request. Houthi officials didn’t respond to written questions about the group’s relationship with al-Shabaab. Budoor couldn’t be reached for comment. Enemy of my enemy The Houthis, predominantly Shia Muslims, and al-Shabaab, which adheres to Sunni Islam, are among the hundreds of millions divided by a seventh-century schism over who was the rightful successor to the Prophet Muhammad. The sectarian split still flares into violence in spots from Afghanistan to Iraq to Syria. Common enemies, however, now unite the Houthis and al-Shabaab. “They hate the West, they hate Israel,” said Abdulaahi Mohamed Ali, a former Somali intelligence chief. Yemen’s Counter-Terrorism Service described Jibril as “one of the key figures in strengthening ties between the Houthis and al-Shabaab through the exchange of expertise and coordination, particularly in facilitating the transfer of weapons and military equipment,” according to an internal assessment reviewed by the Journal. Jibril moved clandestinely between Somalia and Yemen, operating as al-Shabaab’s liaison with Houthi command, according to Matt Bryden, a former United Nations official who monitored arms flows to Somalia. Bryden outlined Jibril’s life and death in a closed-door intelligence briefing in June attended by U.S. special-operations personnel and East African government officials. Jibril, 38 years old when he died, had studied veterinary medicine in Yemen and ran a charity in Mogadishu, Somalia’s capital. He owned a foreign-exchange outlet and an import-export firm. He bore scars from gunshot wounds. His injuries earned him the nickname Gacaamey—roughly translated as one-armed—despite his having both limbs. The Houthis provided Jibril with a furnished apartment in San’a, the rebel-controlled Yemeni capital, according to the briefing, and he attended official functions. The rebels issued him a phony but convincing Yemeni passport under an assumed name, according to a document viewed by the Journal. In 2024, al-Shabaab dispatched a more senior envoy, Sheikh Ahmed Elmi Samatar, to work alongside Jibril. Samatar presented the Houthis with a lengthy weapons wish list, viewed by the Journal, which included shoulder-fired antiaircraft missiles, 107 mm Katyusha rockets, Dragunov sniper rifles, explosive attack drones, antitank missiles and U.S. night-vision gear. A U.S. military intelligence official confirmed that al-Shabaab sought advanced weaponry from the Houthis, in addition to rifles, machine guns and ammunition. Yemeni government officials arrested Samatar in January 2025 and later released him in a prisoner exchange with the Houthis, according to the briefing. Samatar returned to Somalia, leaving Jibril to press al-Shabaab’s interests in Yemen. Jibril continued to broker arms shipments, and al-Shabaab dispatched two weapons experts to Yemen to assist him. After Jibril’s killing, al-Shabaab picked a replacement in Yemen to continue the work, Bryden said. Jibril’s wife is on the run, he said. Front companies in Yemen disguise the shipments as civilian products and move them to Mukalla and other ports, the Yemeni intelligence report said. The weapons cross the Gulf of Aden in speedboats or fishing vessels and are transferred ashore on poorly monitored sections of coastline in northern Somalia, according to the U.S. military-intelligence official. They are transported to al-Shabaab combat units in southern Somalia, where the insurgents’ activities are concentrated. In April 2025, the U.S. destroyed two unflagged boats entering Somali waters from Yemen, carrying what U.S. Africa Command described as advanced conventional weapons. It isn’t clear what items on the lengthy al-Shabaab wish list have reached the militants in Somalia. But the idea that al-Shabaab might acquire attack drones or other arms capable of striking U.S. and Somali bases from the air makes both militaries nervous. “I don’t know what their plans are, but there’s definitely something cooking,” said Brig. Gen. Ahmed Abdullahi Sheikh, a former commander of Somali special forces. Complicating security concerns was Israel’s decision in December to recognize the independence of Somaliland, a region within the northwest of Somalia’s acknowledged borders that declared itself a separate country in 1991. Somaliland could provide Israel access to Berbera, a Red Sea port city with a runway so long that NASA once rented it as an emergency landing strip for the space shuttle. Berbera could give the Israelis another position where they could monitor and attack their Houthi enemies. Michael Milshtein, a former senior Israeli intelligence officer, said the Houthis were front of mind when Israel recognized Somaliland as an independent nation. “Military deployment in Somaliland gives you a very strong position to confront the Houthis,” he said. The Israeli government didn’t respond to requests for comment. In a televised speech this month, Houthi leader Abdul Malik al-Houthi said the group was closely monitoring Israeli actions in Somaliland, which he alleged were aimed at controlling the Gulf of Aden, the Bab al-Mandeb strait and the Red Sea. “We will move at any time to target any activity or presence of the Israeli enemy in Somaliland,” al-Houthi said. Traffic stop In June, a four-person Houthi delegation set sail from Yemen, crossed the Gulf of Aden and came ashore in southern Somalia. The men trekked through the bush to meet with their counterparts in Jilib, the de facto capital of al-Shabaab-held territory, according to a regional intelligence source. The Houthis sought to coordinate the disruption of Israeli activities in Berbera, fearing the port would serve as Israel’s permanent platform for surveillance and attacks on Yemen, according to the briefing and the intelligence source. The Houthis promised al-Shabaab leaders more advanced weapons and training, according to a report, viewed by the Journal, from one of the regional intelligence source’s agents. Al-Shabaab fighters regularly travel to Yemen for Houthi training to build more lethal roadside bombs as well as operate advanced weaponry. At least 100 al-Shabaab fighters have made the trip, the U.S. military-intelligence official said. The U.N. reported last year that al-Shabaab sends classes of about 30 militants to learn marksmanship, antiaircraft operations and techniques for making more lethal booby-trap bombs. In 2024, the first batch of trainees completed a pre-travel course that included religious education and advice on how to endure limited family communications while overseas, according to information gathered by the regional intelligence source. There was a goodbye ceremony and motivational speeches for the departing militants. In his June briefing, Bryden said a group of al-Shabaab fighters spent three months this year in Sa’dah, Yemen, studying drone assembly and systems that allow operators to see the view from drone cameras as if they were in a cockpit. Houthi trainers also travel to Somalia to coach al-Shabaab on drone operations, the U.S. military official said. Al-Shabaab, which pays in cash, can well afford the Houthi goods and services. The militant group brings in at least $100 million a year extorting money from Somali businesses and passersby at roadside checkpoints and the port of Mogadishu, according to a U.S. intelligence assessment. Al-Shabaab also exploits artisanal gold mines along the northern Cal Madow Mountains, according to Abdullahi, the former Somali commander. The U.S. military has conducted some 40 airstrikes against al-Shabaab targets in Somalia this year, compared with 41 for all of 2025, according to U.S. Africa Command. For the Houthis, gaining a southern perch in Somalia overlooking commercial traffic through the Gulf of Aden is as important as cash from al-Shabaab. “Traditionally, the relations between Houthis and al-Shabaab were purely transactional,” Awes Yusuf Ahmed, Somalia’s national security adviser, said in an interview. “That doesn’t mean there aren’t some new factors added after the Iran-U.S.A. war which can be of strategic importance.” Among the Houthis’ aspirations, according to the briefing, is securing al-Shabaab’s help deploying radar to monitor ships in the waters they share.

items.title: SNA brobes video of soldiers suffocating bound Al-Shabaab suspect
items.description: Somalia’s military opened a preliminary investigation on Tuesday after a video circulated online appeared to show members of the Somali National Army (SNA) abusing a man in custody during an operation against Al-Shabaab, the SNAF Command said in a statement, adding that the footage contravenes its Code of Conduct and the laws of armed conflict. The probe lands at a sensitive moment for Somalia’s armed forces, which are locked in an intensifying offensive against Al-Shabaab across multiple regions. Any confirmed breach of prisoner-of-war protections could complicate ties with international partners who fund and train SNAF units, and would test the military’s willingness to discipline its own ranks publicly. The footage, widely shared on social media, shows uniformed men believed to be Somali soldiers surrounding a young man who appears to be in custody. The men are seen placing a plastic bag over the prisoner’s head, apparently suffocating him, triggering widespread condemnation online. The SNAF Command said the investigation would determine the circumstances of the incident and identify those responsible. “The SNAF Command strongly warns all personnel against engaging in such conduct,” the military said in its statement. The statement did not name any soldiers shown in the video, nor did it disclose where or when the incident occurred. It also did not clarify the identity or current condition of the man seen being held. Officials said personnel found to have violated prisoner-of-war protections or broader human rights standards would face both legal and military disciplinary action. “Firm legal and military disciplinary action will be taken against anyone found to have violated the laws of armed conflict, the rights of prisoners of war or human rights,” the statement said. Rights monitors and international law experts have indirectly noted that mistreatment of detainees during counter-insurgency operations can undermine both battlefield legitimacy and cooperation with foreign backers, according to [source/report, if available]. The SNAF has not said whether any soldiers have been arrested or suspended pending the outcome of the investigation. The case comes as Somali government troops and allied fighters continue offensives against Al-Shabaab in multiple regions, part of a broader campaign to reclaim territory from the militant group. The post SNA brobes video of soldiers suffocating bound Al-Shabaab suspect first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Guddiga doorashooyinka oo jadwal cusub u soo saaray Galmudug iyo HirShabeelle
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (GMDQS) ayaa 30-ka Sebtember 2026 u asteeyey doorashada ku-celiska ah ee Golaha Wakiillada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka ee dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, kadib go’aankii Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale isla 30-ka Sebtember u asteeyey doorashada isku-sidkan ee HirShabeelle, oo markii hore loo qorsheeyey 20-kii Agoosto balse dib loo dhigay. Jadwalka cusub ee Galmudug wuxuu dhigaya in 10-ka Sebtember la asteeyo lana shaaciyo xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta, halka 20-ka Sebtember la shaacin doono liiska musharrixiinta ururrada siyaasadda. Ururrada siyaasadda ayaa 22-ka Sebtember soo gudbin doona liiska wakiilladooda goobaha codbixinta, halka 26-ka Sebtember aqoonsi la siin doono wakiilladaas iyo korjoogtada doorashada. Ololaha doorashada ayaa xirmaya 28-ka Sebtember, waxaana codbixinta ku-celiska ah la qabanayaa 30-ka Sebtember. Doorashada Galmudug ayaa dib loo qabanayaa kadib markii Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya ay 24-kii Agoosto laashay natiijadii doorashadii Golaha Wakiillada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka ee dhacday 30-kii Luulyo. Maxkamadda ayaa go’aamisay in doorashadaas aan loo maamulin loona qaban si waafaqsan Dastuurka iyo Sharciga Doorashooyinka dalka, sidaas darteedna natiijadeedu aysan sharci ahaan ansax ahayn. Waxay guddiga doorashooyinka ku amartay inuu waqtiga ugu dhow ee macquulka ah dib u qabto doorashada, iyadoo la raacayo dastuurka iyo shuruucda dalka. Maxkamaddu waxay sidoo kale go’aamisay in hay’adaha Galmudug ee hadda jira ay sii wadaan shaqada inta laga soo dooranayo hay’ado cusub oo ku yimaada hannaan waafaqsan sharciga. Guddiga doorashooyinka ayaa laba maalmood kadib sheegay inuu aqbalay xukunka Maxkamadda Sare, isla markaana uu fulinayo go’aanka, waxaana jadwalka cusub uu hadda xaqiijinayaa in codbixinta la qaban doono dhammaadka Sebtember. Doorashada HirShabeelle Dhanka HirShabeelle, guddiga ayaa sidoo kale 30-ka Sebtember u asteeyey doorashada Golaha Wakiillada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka. Jadwalku wuxuu dhigaya in 2-da Sebtember la shaaciyo liiska hordhaca ah ee diiwaanka codbixiyeyaasha, halka 15-ka Sebtember la asteyn doono lana shaacin doono xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta. Diiwaangelinta iyo qeybinta kaararka codbixiyeyaasha ayaa la qorsheeyey 16-ka Sebtember, halka maalinta xigta la soo gudbin doono lana xaqiijin doono liiska musharrixiinta Golaha Wakiillada iyo goleyaasha degmooyinka. Guddiga ayaa 19-ka Sebtember shaacin doona liiska kama dambaysta ah ee codbixiyeyaasha, halka 22-ka Sebtember la shaacin doono liiska musharrixiinta ururrada siyaasadda. Ururrada ayaa 24-ka Sebtember soo gudbin doona wakiilladooda goobaha codbixinta, waxaana aqoonsi la siin doonaa wakiillada iyo korjoogtada 26-ka Sebtember. Ololaha ayaa xirmaya 28-ka Sebtember. Doorashada HirShabeelle ayaa markii hore loo asteeyey 20-kii Agoosto, sida ku cad jadwal uu guddigu soo saaray 25-kii Luulyo, balse guddiga ayaa 19-kii Agoosto ku dhawaaqay dib-u-dhigis. Guddiga ayaa markaas sheegay inuu muddo laba toddobaad gudahood ah ku soo saari doono jadwal cusub. “Guddigu wuxuu ku wargelinayaa ururrada siyaasadda, shacabka reer HirShabeelle iyo daneeyeyaasha kale ee doorashooyinka HirShabeelle inay u diyaargaroobaan si ay u gutaan kaalintooda kaga aaddan ka-qaybgalka doorashooyinka,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka guddiga. Jadwallada cusub waxay ka dhigan yihiin in Galmudug iyo HirShabeelle ay labaduba codbixin geli doonaan 30-ka Sebtember, iyadoo Galmudug dib loogu celinayo doorasho ay Maxkamadda Sare burisay natiijadeedii hore, halka HirShabeelle ay qabaneyso doorasho markii hore dib loo dhigay. The post Guddiga doorashooyinka oo jadwal cusub u soo saaray Galmudug iyo HirShabeelle appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Shirweynaha Qaran ee Amniga Gudaha Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho ka Furmaya
items.description: Shirweynaha Qaran ee Amniga Gudaha Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ka furmay magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo shirkan diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta amniga gudaha dalka, horumarinta hay’adaha amniga iyo sidii loo sii adkeyn lahaa iskaashiga hay’adaha kala duwan ee dowladda. Shirweynaha waxaa ka qeybgalaya saraakiil iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan masuuliyiinta iyo saraakiisha laamaha amniga, kuwaas oo kulankan uga wada hadlaya xaaladda amniga gudaha iyo qorshayaasha lagu horumarinayo hay’adaha amniga. Ajandayaasha shirkan ayaa waxaa ka mid ah xoojinta wada shaqeynta hay’adaha dowladda iyo laamaha amniga, si loo helo isku-duwid wanaagsan oo lagu wajaho caqabadaha amni ee dalka ka jira, loona adkeeyo xasilloonida iyo nabadgelyada Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, waxaa la filayaa in shirweynaha lagu soo bandhigo talooyin iyo qorshayaal la xiriira horumarinta awoodda hay’adaha amniga, tayeynta howlaha ay bulshada u hayaan iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa doorka hay’adaha dowladda ee sugidda amniga gudaha. Shirweynaha ayaa loo qorsheeyay in si rasmi ah uu u furo Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur, iyadoo khudbadda furitaanka lagu wada sugayo in lagu iftiimiyo muhiimadda ay leedahay iskaashiga hay’adaha dowladda iyo mideynta dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga dalka. Kulankan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha amniga iyo awoodda dowladda, iyadoo amniga gudaha uu weli yahay mid ka mid ah arrimaha ugu muhiimsan ee u baahan isku-duwid iyo wada shaqeyn joogto ah. Shirweynaha Qaran ee Amniga Gudaha ayaa noqonaya madal ay mas’uuliyiinta dowladda, saraakiisha amniga iyo dhinacyada kale ee ay khuseyso kaga arrinsadaan sidii loo horumarin lahaa hannaanka amniga gudaha, loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga hay’adaha, loona gaarsiin lahaa dalka xasillooni iyo amni waara.
