items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo weli Shabaab kula dagaalamaya deegaanka Basra
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa iska caabin kala kulmaya xubno ka tirsan dagaal-yahanada Al Shabaab, oo weli ka dhex dagaalamaya godad ay ka qoteen deegaanka Basra, gaar ahaan qarka uu maro Webiga Shabelle ee deegaankaasi. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo kaashanaya Booliska Sida Gaarka ah u tababaran ee Haramcad ayaa Axaddii maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ka saaray inta badan dhufeysyadii ay ku lahaayeen hawdka ku xeeran deegaanka Basra, waxayna shalay illaa xalay fiidkii ay la tacaalayeen dagaal-yahanada ku harsan godadka ku yaala jiinka webiga. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadu ay Talaadadan sii wadaan gulufka dagaal ee la doonayo in ay ku soo afjaraan joogitaanka Al Shabaab ee deegaanka. Ciidamada oo dhanka cirka ay ka taageerayaan diyaaradaha dagaalka ee saaxiibada caalamiga ah ayaa ku foogan, sidii ay Shabaabka uga saari lahaayeen godadka ay gabaadka ka dhiganayaan. Hawlgalkan ayaa daba dheeraan kara, haddii Shabaabka wajahaya cadaadiska militari ay gurmad ka helaan dibadda deegaankaasi. Deegaankan oo dhaca xadka Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Shabellaha Dhexe ayaa u dhexeeya Magaalooyinka Afgooye iyo Balcad. Muhiimadda ay leedahay meesha Basra ku taala awgeed, waxay muddo dheer ahayd marin ay kooxaha hubeysan u adeegsadaan in ay isaga kala gudbaan Labada Shabelle. La wareegitaanka ciidamada ee Basra ayaa sahleysa in la adkeeyo ammaanka duleedka Magaalada Muqdisho iyo in xasillooni lagu soo dabaalo deegaanada ku teedsan caasimadda ee Labada Shabelle.

items.title: Somalia oo hogaaminaysa shir Addis Ababa ka dhacaya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Soomaaliya ayaa bishan hoggaaminaysa shir muhiim ah oo looga hadlayo ganacsiga iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee dalalka Geeska Afrika, kaas oo diiradda lagu saari doono sidii loo horumarin lahaa isku-xirka ganacsiga iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha gobolka. Shirka oo ay ka qeyb-galayaan dalalka Geeska Afrika ayaa lagu wadaa in lagu gorfeeyo arrimaha la xiriira fududeynta isu-socodka ganacsiga, dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga iyo xoojinta iskaashiga dhaqaale ee dalalka gobolka. Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya, Jamaal Maxamed Xasan ayaa guddoomin doona shirka, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay dooneyso inay muujiso doorkeeda ku aaddan horumarinta xiriirrada ganacsi iyo isku-xirka fursadaha maalgashi ee Geeska Afrika. Wasiir Jamaal ayaa horay magaalada Addis Ababa uga qeyb-galay kulamo looga hadlayay xoojinta iskaashiga ganacsiga, horumarinta maalgashiga iyo kobcinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha Soomaaliya. Kulamadaas ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo qaaday muhiimadda fududeynta ganacsiga, horumarinta warshadaha gudaha iyo sidii loo abuuri lahaa jawi ku habboon maalgashiga gaarka loo leeyahay. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sanadkan xoogga saartay dadaallada lagu soo jiidanayo maalgashiga gudaha iyo dibadda, iyadoo wasaaradda ganacsiga iyo warshaduhu ay waday kulamo lala yeeshay ganacsatada gudaha iyo wafdiyo ganacsi oo ka socda dalal kala duwan. Shirka ka dhacaya Addis Ababa ayaa Soomaaliya u noqon kara fursad ay ku soo bandhigto fursadaha ganacsi, khayraadka dalka iyo meelaha maalgashigu ka samayn karo, iyadoo sidoo kale ka xoojinaysa xiriirka dhaqaale ee dalalka gobolka. Soomaaliya ayaa rajaynaysa in iskaashiga ganacsi ee Geeska Afrika uu gacan ka geysan karo kobaca dhaqaalaha, kordhinta wax-soo-saarka iyo abuurista fursado cusub oo ganacsi oo ay ka faa’iideystaan shacabka gobolka. items.title: Markab shiidaal siday oo lagu duqeeyay marinka Hormus
items.description: Taliska Hawlgallada Badaha ee Ingiriiska ayaa sheegay in markab shidaal oo marayay marinka Hormuz “la beegsaday”, iyada wax yar ka hor ilo wareedyo aan rasmi ahayn oo ku sugan Iraan ay sheegayn in saddex gantaal laga soo riday xeebaha koonfureed ee dalkaasi. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, markabka shidaalka ayaa la beegsaday “xilli uu marayay dhammaadka marinka Hormuz”. Hay’adda Hawlgallada Ganacsiga Badda ee Ingiriiska ayaa sheegtay in duqeyntu ay ka dhacday meel 31 kiiloomitir dhanka bari ka xigta gobolka Khasab ee Cumaan, iyadoo markabka lagu beegsaday “saddex gantaal oo aan la aqoonsan”. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan wax war ah oo sheegaya in weerarka uu sababay dhimasho ama dhaawac. Waxa ay isla hay’addu shaacisay sniintii shil kale oo badeed, kaas oo ka dhacay Badweynta Hindiya Axaddii, 30-ka Agoosto.

items.title: Shirkad Maraykan ah oo la wareegaysa shidaalka Venezuela, Shiinaha iyo Ruushkana laga riixayo
items.description: Shirkad shidaal oo Maraykan ah ayaa lagu wadaa inay la wareegto qaar ka mid ah goobaha shidaalka ee muhiimka ah ee Venezuela, kuwaas oo horey uga hoos shaqeyn jiray shirkado laga leeyahay Shiinaha iyo Ruushka, taas oo qayb ka ah heshiis ballaaran oo dhinaca shidaalka ah oo uu Madaxweyne Donald Trump ku dhawaaqay. Sida ay laba sarkaal oo Maraykan ah u sheegeen Reuters, North American Blue Energy Partners, oo loo soo gaabiyo NABEP, ayaa la wareegi doonta maamulka qaar ka mid ah goobaha shidaalka, iyadoo heshiiskan uu shirkadaha Maraykanka siinayo fursad weyn oo ay ku galaan warshadaha shidaalka Venezuela, isla markaana hoos u dhigaya doorkii ay muddo dheer ku lahaayeen shirkadaha Shiinaha iyo Ruushka. NABEP ayaa horey loo oran jiray shirkad uu lahaa maalqabeenka Maraykanka Harry Sargeant, balse hadda waxaa gacanta ku haya ganacsade reer Venezuela ah Alejandro Betancourt. Betancourt ayaa xaqiijiyay heshiiska, isaga oo sheegay in Venezuela ay leedahay kheyraad dabiici ah oo aad u badan iyo awood aan weli si buuxda loo isticmaalin, isla markaana heshiiskan uu fursaddaas u rogi doono faa’iido ay helaan dadka Venezuela iyo Maraykankaba. Sida xogta saraakiisha Maraykanka lagu sheegay, NABEP waxaa loo dhiibay 14 heshiis oo cusub, kuwaas oo ka mid ah qorshe ay shirkaddu ugu dambayn maamuli doonto 17 mashruuc oo shidaal ah gudaha Venezuela. Shanta ka mid ah 14-ka goobood ee cusub ayaa horey uga howlgalayay shirkado Shiinaha laga leeyahay, halka hal goob ay maamuli jirtay shirkad Ruush ah. Shirkadaha Shiinaha ee horey uga howlgalayay goobahaas waxaa ka mid ahaa China Concord Resources, Sinopec iyo China National Petroleum Corporation, iyadoo China Concord Resources ay Maraykanku cunaqabateeyay sanadkii 2019 sababo la xiriira arrimo la xiriiray Iiraan. Heshiiskan wuxuu sidoo kale siinayaa dowladda Maraykanka awood iyo saameyn aan caadi ahayn oo ku saabsan shirkadda NABEP. Shirkaddu waxay yeelan doontaa awoodda hawlgalka, laakiin dowladda Maraykanka waxaa loo oggolaanayaa xuquuq u dhiganta 35 boqolkiiba saamiga shirkadda, waxaana Washington sidoo kale loo siinayaa mudnaan ay ku heli karto 20 boqolkiiba wax-soo-saarka shirkadda iyadoo lagu iibsanayo qiimaha kharashka. Aqalka Cad ayaa intaas ku daray in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Maraykanka loo oggolaaday xuquuqda koowaad ee ay ku iibsan karto 80-ka boqolkiiba ee kale ee wax-soo-saarka NABEP. Sidoo kale, Maraykanka ayaa yeelanaya awood uu ku diido go’aamada qaar ee guddiga maamulka shirkadda, waxaana la dejiyay shuruud ah in inta badan xubnaha guddigu ay noqdaan muwaadiniin Maraykan ah. Heshiiskan ayaa imanaya xilli maamulka Trump uu si weyn u doonayo inuu kordhiyo doorka Maraykanka ee kheyraadka shidaalka Venezuela. Toddobaadkii hore, Trump ayaa sheegay in Maraykanku helay fursad uu ku galo qayb ka mid ah kaydka shidaalka Venezuela ee la xaqiijiyay, kaas oo lagu qiyaasay ku dhowaad 64 bilyan oo foosto. Sida uu Trump sheegay, Maraykanka ayaa hadda helaya malaayiin foosto oo shidaal ah oo laga soo saarayo Venezuela, kuwaas oo loo dirayo warshadaha sifeynta shidaalka ee Texas iyo Louisiana iyo meelo kale oo dalka ah. Heshiiskan ayaa sidoo kale taabanaya qaar ka mid ah mashaariic horey lala xiriiriyay shakhsiyaad siyaasadeed iyo ganacsi oo awood ku lahaa Venezuela. Saraakiisha Maraykanka ayaa sheegay in laba mashruuc ay horey uga howlgalayeen shirkado xiriir la lahaa Alex Saab, oo ahaa ganacsade si dhow ula xiriiray madaxweynihii hore ee Venezuela Nicolas Maduro, Saab-na hadda wuxuu ku jiraa gacanta dowladda Maraykanka. Haddii qorshahan si buuxda loo hirgeliyo, wuxuu Venezuela ka dhigi karaa meel muhiim ah oo uu ka muuqdo loollanka dhaqaale iyo istaraatiijiyadeed ee u dhexeeya Maraykanka, Shiinaha iyo Ruushka, iyadoo shidaalka Venezuela uu noqonayo mid si weyn ugu xiran danaha dhaqaale iyo juqraafi-siyaasadeed ee Washington.

items.title: Puntland oo Boosaaso ku qabatay rag iyo dumar loo heysto dambiyo culus
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada ammaanka Puntland ayaa howl-gallo ay ka sameeyeen magaalada Boosaaso ku soo qabtay dad isugu jira rag iyo dumar oo lagu eedeeyay ka ganacsiga hubka sharci-darrada ah iyo walxaha maanka-dooriya, gaar ahaan xashiishka. Booliska Boosaaso ayaa sheegay in dadka la qabtay looga shakisan yahay inay ku lug lahaayeen falal wax u dhimaya amniga, iyagoo caddeeyay in kiiskooda loo gudbin doono maxkamadda si loo marsiiyo habraacyada sharciga. Saraakiisha ammaanka ayaa sheegay in howl-galka lagu soo qabtay hub iyo waxyaabo kale oo la xiriira eedeymaha loo haysto dadkaasi, kuwaas oo uu ku jiro bam-gacmeed. Boolisku waxay sheegeen in baaritaanno dheeraad ah lagu hayo halka uu ka yimid hubka la qabtay, cidda soo gelisay magaalada Boosaaso iyo ujeeddada laga lahaa isticmaalka qalabkaasi. Sidoo kale, hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa baaraya haddii ay jiraan shaqsiyaad kale oo ku lug leh kiiskan, kuwaas oo aan weli gacanta lagu dhigin ama baxsad ah. Puntland ayaa muddooyinkii dambe kordhisay howl-gallada lagu beegsanayo dadka lagu tuhunsan yahay ka ganacsiga hubka sharci-darrada ah iyo maandooriyaha, iyadoo falalkaasi loo arko kuwo saameyn ku leh amniga iyo xasilloonida bulshada. Gobolka Bari ayaa horey dhowr jeer loogu qabtay maandooriyeyaal kala duwan, oo ay ka mid yihiin khamriga laga soo geliyo dhinaca Itoobiya, waxaana dadkii lagu qabtay falalkaasi loo gudbiyay maxkamadaha gobolka. Maamulka Puntland ayaa sheegay inuu sii wadi doono howl-gallada ka dhanka ah falalka amni-darrada ah, iyadoo dadka lagu eedeeyo dambiyada noocaas ah loo gudbinayo hay’adaha garsoorka si loo qaado tallaabo waafaqsan sharciga. Sidoo kale, hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa baaraya haddii ay jiraan shaqsiyaad kale oo ku lug leh kiiskan, kuwaas oo aan weli gacanta lagu dhigin ama baxsad ah. Puntland ayaa muddooyinkii dambe kordhisay howl-gallada lagu beegsanayo dadka lagu tuhunsan yahay ka ganacsiga hubka sharci-darrada ah iyo maandooriyaha, iyadoo falalkaasi loo arko kuwo saameyn ku leh amniga iyo xasilloonida bulshada. Gobolka Bari ayaa horey dhowr jeer loogu qabtay maandooriyeyaal kala duwan, oo ay ka mid yihiin khamriga laga soo geliyo dhinaca Itoobiya, waxaana dadkii lagu qabtay falalkaasi loo gudbiyay maxkamadaha gobolka. Maamulka Puntland ayaa sheegay inuu sii wadi doono howl-gallada ka dhanka ah falalka amni-darrada ah, iyadoo dadka lagu eedeeyo dambiyada noocaas ah loo gudbinayo hay’adaha garsoorka si loo qaado tallaabo waafaqsan sharciga. items.title: Jadwalka doorashada ku celiska ee Galmudug oo la soo saaray
items.description: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa saqdii dhexe ee xalay soo saaray jadwalka doorashada ku celiska ah ee Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Guddiga Doorashooyinka ayaa sheegay in doorashada ku celiska ah ee Golaha Wakiilada iyo Golaha Deegaanka ee Galmudug ay dhici doonto 30-ka bishan September. Taariikhaha muhiimka ah ee jadwalka doorashada:- 1. Astaynta iyo shaacinta xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta 10-ka September 2. Shaacinta liiska musharaxiinta ururada siyaasadda 20-ka September 3. Soo gudbinta liiska wakiilada ururada siyaasadda ee goobaha codbixinta 22-ka September 4. Aqoonsi siinta wakiilada ururada iyo korjoogtada 26-ka September 5. Xiritaanka golaha doorashada 28-ka September 6. Maalinta doorashada 30-ka September 2026. Guddiga Doorashooyinka ayaa jadwalkan soo saaray, ka dib markii guddigu uu 26-kii bishii August aqbalay go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare Dalka ay 24-kii bishaasi ku laashay natiijada doorashadii qof iyo codka ee 30-kii bishii July laga qabtay deegaanada Galmudug.

items.title: Somalia’s Hassan Sheikh Mohamud agrees to hold elections in 7 Months
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has agreed to hold elections within seven months and accepted some of the opposition’s demands, following mediation by the country’s international partners aimed at ending a long-running dispute over elections and the wider political crisis, Somali Stream reported on Monday. The negotiations, which have proceeded mostly indirectly in recent weeks, saw Mohamud alter key language in his latest response to the opposition’s demands. Notably, he changed the description of the international partners’ role from “mediation” to “facilitation.” The president also insisted on retaining the phrase “election of the federal government,” while apparently declining to give a clear timeline for when the presidential vote would occur. He removed wording committing to holding the presidential election specifically within seven months, even as he broadly accepted that elections overall would take place within that period. Mohamud further struck out an opposition demand that the international community serve as guarantors of the talks, replacing it with language designating international partners as “observers” – a role limited to monitoring whether legal procedures are followed in the upcoming elections. No technical matters have yet been agreed upon by either side, though the president has accepted the broader principle that the country should proceed to elections and that he should reach a political settlement with the opposition. The two sides have also not reached agreement on the size of a taskforce they have agreed in principle should be formed to manage the upcoming elections, nor on a timetable. In his message, Mohamud urged international mediators to convey to the opposition that he is ready to hold elections. Some observers view the shift as a softening of Mohamud’s position, after he had earlier insisted his term was extended by one additional year under a parliamentary constitutional change, with elections to follow only after that. The apparent concession comes amid sustained pressure from the international community, including neighboring countries, as well as mounting economic strain on his government following reduced international financial support. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Ecuador’s Lesson for Africa: When Government Serves Citizens, Not Political Elites
items.description: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi The contrast between Ecuador and Somalia raises a question that is uncomfortable but increasingly unavoidable: What happens when political power is treated as a public trust and what happens when government becomes an avenue for political patronage, weak accountability and private enrichment? The question has acquired new urgency following the extraordinary case of former Ecuadorian President Lenín Moreno, who was convicted by an Ecuadorian court on August 28, 2026, in a major bribery case linked to the construction of the country’s largest hydroelectric project, Coca Codo Sinclair. Moreno, who served as Ecuador’s president from 2017 to 2021 and previously served as vice president from 2007 to 2013, was sentenced to five years in prison and permanently barred from holding public office. His wife, daughter, two brothers and a sister-in-law were also convicted as accomplices. According to prosecutors, approximately $76.1 million in alleged bribes was moved through fraudulent consulting contracts connected to the $2-billion Coca Codo Sinclair project. Investigators said the money was routed through offshore companies and accounts, with more than $1 million allegedly reaching Moreno and members of his family while he was vice president. Moreno has consistently denied wrongdoing and argued that he neither signed nor supervised the contracts at the center of the case. The significance of the Moreno case goes beyond the former president himself. It demonstrates something fundamental about governance: a former president can be investigated, prosecuted and convicted when institutions are prepared to follow the evidence—even when the defendant once occupied the highest office in the country. That is the real lesson for Africa. Ecuador is certainly not a corruption-free country, nor should it be portrayed as a perfect model of governance. It has suffered serious political and institutional problems. But the Moreno case illustrates the importance of having institutions capable of holding powerful people accountable. The issue is not that Ecuador has eliminated corruption. It is that corruption allegations can eventually reach the courtroom. That distinction matters enormously. Across parts of Africa, the relationship between political office and personal enrichment has often become disturbingly blurred. Where institutions are weak, public resources can become political currency, government contracts can become vehicles for patronage, and state land and assets can be transferred with limited transparency. The result is a devastating paradox: Countries become poorer while political elites become richer. The Hassan Sheikh Mohamud Question Somalia presents a particularly important case. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud entered national politics against the backdrop of a country devastated by decades of conflict and institutional collapse. Yet his political career has repeatedly been accompanied by allegations and controversies involving corruption, abuse of office, state assets and patronage. These allegations can’t be distinguished carefully from proven criminal conduct because in Somalia the Judiciary and the Parliament are in the pockets of the Presidential office. In 2014, Reuters reported on allegations involving President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and the handling of recovered Somali state assets. A U.N. monitoring report alleged that individuals connected to his government had used the Central Bank as a personal “slush fund,” while the president and his government disputed the allegations. The following year, Somali lawmakers filed a motion seeking to remove Hassan from office, accusing him of abuse of office. The allegations were political accusations, not a criminal conviction, and Hassan denied wrongdoing and the motion was dismissed as the MPs were bribed. That history matters—not because it proves current corruption, but because it demonstrates why independent oversight of Somalia’s presidency is not optional. More recently, Hassan’s government has faced increasingly intense political controversy over constitutional changes, electoral arrangements and the extension of presidential power. Reuters reported in June 2026 that Hassan remained in office after the expiration of his term amid constitutional changes that could permit an extension, triggering clashes between government forces and opposition-linked militias in Mogadishu. This is precisely where the comparison with Ecuador becomes uncomfortable. The Moreno case demonstrates that political power does not have to provide permanent immunity from accountability. The Somali experience demonstrates how difficult accountability becomes when political institutions themselves are deeply contested. A government cannot credibly demand public trust while simultaneously weakening the institutions that are supposed to scrutinizeit. The Real Question Is Not How Rich a President Becomes There have been political allegations and media claims concerning the wealth and business interests of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and people close to him. Such claims should be investigated rather than repeated as established fact. The fundamental question is therefore not whether the president is wealthy. It is much more important: Can the president publicly account for his assets? Can senior officials explain their financial interests? Can Parliament independently investigate allegations? Can prosecutorsinvestigate the presidency without political interference? Can courts act against powerful individuals without fear? If the answer to those questions is yes, the country has the beginnings of accountable government. If the answer is no, then corruption becomes almost impossible to distinguish from government itself. That is the danger facing Somalia. When the State Becomes the Prize Somalia possesses enormous economic potential: a vast coastline, fisheries, livestock, agricultural resources, ports and a strategic position connecting the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean. Yet millions of Somalis continue to struggle with poverty, displacement, insecurity and inadequate public services. The question therefore becomes painfully simple: If the country possesses enormous strategic and economic resources while ordinary citizens remain impoverished, where are the benefits going? This question should not be directed exclusively at Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. Somalia’s governance crisis is much larger than one president. It is a structural problem involving weak oversight, political patronage, fragmented institutions, contested federal authority and inadequate mechanisms for holding powerful officials accountable. When control of the state becomes the principal route to wealth and influence, elections themselves can become battles over access to resources rather than competing visions for national development. That is how corruption becomes more than a financial crime. It becomes a form of social destruction. What Ecuador Shows Somalia The most important lesson from Ecuador is not that its politicians are cleaner than Somalia’s politicians. It is that institutions can eventually become stronger than political personalities. Lenín Moreno was once Ecuador’s president. He is now a convicted former president after a judicial process that examined allegations of bribery surrounding a major national infrastructure project. He maintains his innocence and can challenge the ruling, but the case nevertheless demonstrates that political office does not necessarily provide permanent protection from prosecution. That is precisely the culture Somalia needs to build. Presidents come and go.  Governments change. Political parties rise and fall. But courts, auditors, parliaments, anti-corruption institutions, independent media and transparent financial systems must survive every political transition. Institutions must be stronger than individuals. For Somalia, that means mandatory asset declarations for senior officials, independent audits of public finances, transparent government procurement, protection of public land and state assets, genuine parliamentary oversight and judicial independence. It also means investigating allegations regardless of who is accused. If the accused is a president, investigate. If the accused is a minister, investigate. If the accused is an opposition politician, investigate. If the accused is a businessman connected to government, investigate. The evidence—not political loyalty must determine the outcome. That is the real meaning of good governance. The Ultimate Test of Leadership Somalia does not lack resources. It lacks sufficiently strong institutions capable of ensuring that those resources benefit the public. A poor country does not necessarily remain poor because it lacks wealth. It can remain poor because its institutions allow wealth, opportunity and public power to flow upward—from citizens to the politically connected. The Moreno case offers Somalia and the wider African continent a powerful reminder: being president is not supposed to be a license to escape accountability. The ultimate test of a president is therefore not how much wealth he accumulates while holding office. It is whether ordinary citizens become safer, richer, healthier and more hopeful because he occupied that office. And perhaps the most important question for Somalia is this: If Ecuador can put a former president on trial, can Somalia build institutions strong enough to investigate its own political elite—regardless of who sits in Villa Somalia? items.title: Guddiga doorashooyinka oo Shaaciyay Jadwalka Cusub ee Doorashooyinka Isku-sidkan ee Hirshabeelle
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-banaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (GMDQS) ayaa si rasmi ah u soo saaray jadwalka cusub ee doorashooyinka isku-sidkan ee Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee Dowlad-Goboleedka Hirshabeelle. Ka dib markii guddigu dib u dhigay doorashadii qorsheysnayd 20-ka Agoosto 2026, iyadoo loo cuskaday waajibaadka shaqo ee Qodobka 10aad ee Sharciga GMDQS iyo Qodobka 18aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka. Sida ku cad jadwalka rasmiga ah, Geedi-socodka doorashada ayaa bisha Sebtembar 2026. Waxaa 2-da Sebtembar lagu bilaabayaa shaacinta liiska hordhaca ah ee diiwaanka codbixiyaha, halka 15-ka Sebtembar la astayn doono goobaha codbixinta. Diiwaangalinta iyo qaybinta kaararka codbixiyaha ayaa bilaabanaysa 16-ka Sebtembar, waxana ku xigi doona 17-ka Sebtembar soo gudbinta liiska musharixiinta golaha wakiillada iyo deegaanka. Liiska kama-dambaysta ah ee codbixiyayaasha ayaa la faafin doonaa 19-ka Sebtembar, halka 22-ka Sebtembar la shaacin doono liiska rasmiga ah ee musharixiinta ururrada siyaasadda. Tallaabooyinka lagu soo gabagabeynayo hawsha ayaa iyaguna mid ka mid ah mid ku xigi doona, iyadoo 24-ka Sebtembar lagu dhex muujin doono soo gudbinta wakiillada ururrada ee goobaha codbixinta, ka dibna 26-ka Sebtembar aqoonsi rasmi ah lagu siin doono wakiillada iyo korjoogtada. Ololaha doorashada ayaa si rasmi ah u xirmi doona 28-ka Sebtembar, iyadoo maalinta u dambaysa ee codeynta oo ah Maalinta Doorashada loo mudeeyay 30-ka Sebtembar 2026. Guddigu wuxuu ku baaqay in ururrada siyaasadda, shacabka Hirshabeelle, iyo dhammaan daneeyeyaasha ay isu diyaariyaan ka-qaybgalka doorashadan xasaasiga ah.

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo Shaaciyay Jadwalka Doorashada Ku-celiska Ah ee Galmudug
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-banaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (GMDQS) ayaa si rasmi ah u shaaciyay jadwalka doorashada ku-celiska ah ee isku-sidkan ee Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee Dowlad-Goboleedka Galmudug. Warkan ayaa yimid ka dib markii guddigu u hoggaansamay go’aankii Maxkamadda Sare ee JFS (SUM:MSF/DD/BX/ 1/2026) ee soo baxay 24-kii Agoosto 2026, iyadoo loo cuskaday Qodobka 10aad ee Sharciga GMDQS iyo Qodobka 18aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka. ​Sida ku xusan jadwalka rasmiga ah ee guddigu soo saaray, hawlaha doorashada ayaa ka bilaaban doona 10-ka Sebtembar 2026 oo lagu dhawaaqi doono astaynta iyo shaacinta xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta. Waxaa 20-ka Sebtembar ku xigi doonta shaacinta liiska musharixiinta ururrada siyaasadda, halka 22-ka Sebtembar loo mudeeyay soo gudbinta liiska wakiillada ururrada siyaasadda ee goobaha codbixinta. ​Qeybaha dambe ee geedi-socodka ayaa sii socon doona 26-ka Sebtembar oo aqoonsi rasmi ah la siin doono wakiillada ururrada iyo korjoogtada, ka hor inta uusan ololaha doorashadu si rasmi ah u xirmin 28-ka Sebtembar 2026. Geedi-socodkan oo dhan ayaa lagu soo gabagabeyn doonaa Maalinta Doorashada ku-celiska ah oo loo mudeeyay 30-ka Sebtembar 2026.

Warkan ayaa yimid ka dib markii guddigu u hoggaansamay go’aankii Maxkamadda Sare ee JFS (SUM:MSF/DD/BX/ 1/2026) ee soo baxay 24-kii Agoosto 2026, iyadoo loo cuskaday Qodobka 10aad ee Sharciga GMDQS iyo Qodobka 18aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka. ​Sida ku xusan jadwalka rasmiga ah ee guddigu soo saaray, hawlaha doorashada ayaa ka bilaaban doona 10-ka Sebtembar 2026 oo lagu dhawaaqi doono astaynta iyo shaacinta xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta. Waxaa 20-ka Sebtembar ku xigi doonta shaacinta liiska musharixiinta ururrada siyaasadda, halka 22-ka Sebtembar loo mudeeyay soo gudbinta liiska wakiillada ururrada siyaasadda ee goobaha codbixinta. ​Qeybaha dambe ee geedi-socodka ayaa sii socon doona 26-ka Sebtembar oo aqoonsi rasmi ah la siin doono wakiillada ururrada iyo korjoogtada, ka hor inta uusan ololaha doorashadu si rasmi ah u xirmin 28-ka Sebtembar 2026. Geedi-socodkan oo dhan ayaa lagu soo gabagabeyn doonaa Maalinta Doorashada ku-celiska ah oo loo mudeeyay 30-ka Sebtembar 2026.

items.title: Somali MPs file no-confidence motion against interior minister
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somali lawmakers on Monday tabled a motion of no-confidence against Interior Minister Ali Yusuf Hosh, the first such motion filed against a government official since parliament elected a new speaker several weeks ago. The motion, signed by 60 members of parliament, will be reviewed by the speaker before being presented to the House for debate expected within 48 hours, according to MP Abdirahman Agawayne, a lawmaker regarded as a key supporter of the current administration. Agawayne said the MPs behind the motion had held long-standing grievances against the minister that had gone unaddressed, prompting them to pursue his removal from office. The filing comes weeks after several Somali media outlets, including Somali Stream’s “Geedi Fadhi” podcast, reported that the new speaker of parliament, Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, had told a group of MPs he would help them oust Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre if they tabled a motion of no-confidence against him. On the same day the interior minister’s motion was filed, MP Mohamed Ibrahim Moalimu said a separate motion against Mogadishu Mayor Hassan Mohamed Hussein Mungab was also under way. The flurry of activity suggests a resumption of a parliamentary practice that had been dormant for four years, during which the previous speaker declined to accept no-confidence motions. It marks a return to two decades of Somali parliamentary tradition in which MPs have regularly used such motions to seek the removal of prime ministers and speakers from office. items.title: TRUMP oo sheegay in Iiraan si rasmi ah looga adkaaday
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa qoraal cusub oo xasaasi ah oo ku saabsan xaaladda Iran ku baahiyay bartiisa Truth Social, isagoo hadalkiisa ku muujiyay in Tehran ay wajahday xaalad aad u adag. Trump ayaa qoraalkiisa ku sheegay in Iran si rasmi ah looga adkaaday, isla markaana dalkaasi uu waayay awooddii ciidan iyo dhaqaale ee uu horey u lahaa. “Iran si rasmi ah ayaa looga adkaaday. Waa dhimatay. Ma haystaan ciidan badeed, ciidan cirka ah ama lacag qaran, ma bixiyaan mushaharka askarta iyo booliiska, sicir-bararkuna wuxuu gaaray 300 boqolkiiba,” ayuu Trump ku qoray Truth Social. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa intaas ku daray in hoggaanka Iran uu ku jiro xaalad jahawareer ah, isagoo ku andacooday in madaxda dalkaasi aysan awood u lahayn inay si buuxda u matalaan Iran. Hadallada Trump ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay kasii dareyso xiisadda Washington iyo Tehran, isla markaana ay labada dhinac markale is-weydaarsanayaan weeraro. Xiisadda sii xoogeysaneysa ayaa sidoo kale la xiriirta xaaladda Marinka Hormuz, iyadoo Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) uu sheegay inuu qaaday “tallaabo xaddidan” oo ka dhan ah ciidamo uu ku eedeeyay inay miinooyin dhigayeen, kuwaas oo khatar degdeg ah ku ahaa marinkaasi. Tallaabada Mareykanka ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli Iran ay sii waddo jawaabaha militari ee ay ka bixinayso cadaadiska iyo weerarrada Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisa, iyadoo Tehran ay sheegtay inay weerartay saldhigyo milatari oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay dalka Urdun. Ciidamada Urdun ayaa dhankooda sheegay inay ka hortageen siddeed gantaal oo la soo riday saacadihii hore ee Isniinta, taasoo muujineysa in xiisadda ay ka gudubtay xuduudaha Iran iyo Mareykanka. Xiisadda ayaa sidoo kale saameysay Imaaraadka Carabta, iyadoo telefishinka dowladda Iran uu sheegay in ciidamada Iran ay diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerareen saldhig ciidan oo ku yaalla dalkaasi. Weerarada iyo jawaabaha militari ee labada dhinac ayaa sii kordhinaya walaaca laga qabo in colaadda ay ku faafto dalal kale oo gobolka ah, gaar ahaan kuwa martigeliya saldhigyada iyo ciidamada Mareykanka. Xaaladda ayaa sidoo kale sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo amniga Marinka Hormuz, oo ah marin muhiim u ah isu-socodka shidaalka iyo ganacsiga caalamka, iyadoo sii socoshada xiisadda ay saameyn ku yeelan karto amniga gobolka iyo suuqyada tamarta. The post TRUMP oo sheegay in Iiraan si rasmi ah looga adkaaday appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Taliska ciidanka xoogga oo baaraya tacaddi ay askar kula kaceen maxbuus dagaal
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa shaaciyay inuu bilaabay baaris hordhac ah oo lagu sameynayo muuqaal baraha bulshada lagu faafiyey oo muujinaya tacaddi loo geystay maxbuus dagaal. Taliska ayaa sheegay in baaritaanka uu ku saabsan yahay xubno ka tirsan ciidanka xoogga oo la sheegay inay faafiyeen muuqaalka, kaas oo muujinaya tacaddiga loo geystay maxbuus dagaal, xilli uu socday howl-gal ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab. Bayaan kasoo baxay Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga ayaa lagu sheegay in falka muuqaalka lagu arkayo iyo fal kasta oo la mid ah ay si cad uga hor imaanayaan xeerarka anshaxa, nidaamka ciidanka iyo shuruucda dagaalka ee ciidamada Soomaaliya. Taliska ayaa ciidamada uga digay inay ku kacaan falal noocan oo kale ah, isagoo caddeeyay in si adag loola xisaabtami doono cid kasta oo lagu helo inay ku xad-gudubtay xeerarka iyo anshaxa ciidanka. “Waxaa tallaabo sharci iyo mid ciidan oo adag laga qaadi doona xubin kasta oo lagu helo inuu ku xad-gudbay xeerarka dagaalka, xuquuqda maxaabiista iyo xuquuqda aadanaha,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay muhiim tahay in ciidamada ay dhowraan xeerarka iyo nidaamka u degsan howl-gallada milatari, gaar ahaan ilaalinta xuquuqda maxaabiista dagaalka. Bayaankan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli baraha bulshada lagu baahiyey muuqaal muujinaya askar tacaddi u geysanaya maxbuus dagaal oo lagu qabtay howl-gal ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab. The post Taliska ciidanka xoogga oo baaraya tacaddi ay askar kula kaceen maxbuus dagaal appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyey dalka Serbia
items.description: Belgrade (Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa gelinkii dambe ee maanta gaaray magaalada Belgrade ee dalka Serbia, halkaasi oo ay si diiran ugu soo dhoweeyeen mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Serbia. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa inta uu ku sugan yahay dalka Serbia, waxa uu kulan muhiim ah la qaadan doonaa dhiggiisa dalkaasi, Mudane Aleksandar Vučić, iyaga oo ka wada hadli doona xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo danaha labo geesoodka ah ee labada waddan. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa qayb ka ah madax ka socota dowlaha caalamka, kuwaasi oo lagu casuumay ka qayb galka Shirka heerka sare ah ee lagu xusayo 65-guurada Shirkii Koowaad ee dhaqdhaqaaqa dalalka aan isbahaysiga ahayn (Non-Aligned Movement), kaasi oo lagu qabtay magaalada Belgrade sannadkii 1961-kii. The post Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyey dalka Serbia appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo booqasho ku tegay Serbia
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa gelinkii dambe ee maanta gaaray magaala madaxda Serbia ee Belgrade. Villa Somali ayaa sheegtay in muddada Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda uu ku sugan yahay Caasimadda Belgrade uu kulan muhiim ah la qaadan doono dhiggiisa dalkaasi, Aleksandar Vučić. “Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa inta uu ku sugan yahay dalka Serbia, waxa uu kulan muhiim ah la qaadan doonnaa dhiggiisa dalkaasi, Mudane Aleksandar Vučić, iyaga oo ka wada hadli doona xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo danaha labo geesoodka ah ee labada waddan.” Ayaa lagu yiri war caawa ka soo baxay Villa Somalia. Warka ayaa waxa kaloo lagu yiri “Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa qayb ka ah madax ka socota dowlaha caalamka, kuwaasi oo lagu casuumay ka qayb galka shirka heerka sare ah ee lagu xusayo 65-guurada Shirkii Koowaad ee dhaqdhaqaaqa dalalka aan isbahaysiga ahayn (Non-Aligned Movement), kaasi oo lagu qabtay Magaalada Belgrade sanadkii 1961-kii.” Xiriirka Somaliya iyo Serbia oo xoogeysanayay sanadihii u dambeeyay ayaa hadda maraya heer wanaagsan, waana xiriir ku dhisan iskaashi ay leeyihiin labada dowladood. Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa 1-dii bishii September ee sanadkii hore booqasho rasmi ah ku tegay dalkaasi.

items.title: DEG DEG AH: NISA iyo saaxiibada caalamka oo howlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyay Daniga Baalow
items.description: Shabeellaha Hoose: Howlgal qorsheysan oo ay iska kaashadeen Ciidamada Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) iyo saaxiibada caalamka ayaa goor dhow ka dhacay deegaanka Daniga Baalow ee Gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Howlgalka ayaa lagu beegsaday gaari ay la socdeen maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda shabaab, kaas oo la sheegay in uu siday qaraxyo iyo hub. Wararka hordhaca ah ayaa tilmaamaya in howlgalka lagu gaarsiiyay kooxda Khawaarijta khasaare xooggan, iyadoo sidoo kale la bartilmaameedsaday gaadiid iyo agab ay maleeshiyaadku adeegsanayeen. Howlgalkan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda kooxda Shabaab iyo in laga hortago falalka ay khatarta ku gelinayaan amniga shacabka iyo guud ahaan dalka. Deegaanka Daniga Baalow ayaa horey uga mid ahaa goobaha ay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa ammaanka ka fuliyeen howlgallo ka dhan ah kooxda Al-Shabaab. Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan khasaaraha iyo natiijada howlgalka ayaa la filayaa inay soo baxdo marka ay hay’adaha ammaanku soo saaraan xog rasmi ah.

items.title: Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka Arrimaha Bulshada ee Degmada Hodan oo lagu xiray Muqdisho
items.description: Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka Arrimaha Bulshada ee Degmada Hodan, Maxamed Cabdiqaadir Maxamuud ayaa lagu xiray Magaalada Muqdisho. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka looga yeeray Xarunta Hay’adda Dembi Baarista (CID) ee Muqdisho, ka dibna loo sheegay in uu xarig yahay. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in loo haysto eedeymo la xiriira wax is daba marin iyo lacago laga lunsaday ganacsato, iyadoo faah-faahin intaasi ka baxsan aan laga ogayn kiiskiisa. Gudoomiyaha Degmada Hodan, Cali Axmed Faarax (Cali Fahle) ayaa iska fogeeyay eedeymo ku aaddan in uu isagu ka masuul yahay xarigga Kuxigeenkiisa. “Waxaan baraha bulshada ku arkay dad sheegaya in Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka Degmada Hodan uu u xiran yahay aniga, oo ah Gudoomiyaha Degmada Hodan ama arrimo la xiriira maamulka degmada. Waxaan caddeynayaa in uusan aniga ii xirneyn, sidoo kalena arrimaha Maamulka Degmada Hodan looma xirin.” Ayuu yiri Gudoomiyaha Degmada Hodan. Gudoomiyaha ayaa galabta bartiisa Facebook ku daabacay “Cidda ama hay’adda uu u xiran yahay wax xog ah kama hayo. Arrimaha sharciga waxaa iska leh hay’adaha cadaaladda ee ay khusayso.” Maxamed Cabdiqaadir Maxamuud, Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka Arrimaha Bulshada ee Degmada Hodan ayaa xilka la wareegay 15-kii bishii September ee sanadkii 2025, markaas oo uu bedelay Cabdixamiid Cabdikariin Xuseen.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo u baxay safar dibadeed oo dalal dhowr ah uu ku tegayo
items.description: Belgrade (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa gelinkii dambe ee maanta gaaray magaalada Belgrade ee dalka Serbia, halkaas oo si diiran ugu soo dhoweeyeen mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Serbia. Madaxweynaha ayaa inta uu ku sugan yahay dalka Serbia waxa uu kulamo la qaadan doona madaxda dalkaasi, waxaana ugu muhiimsan kulan uu la qaadan doono dhiggiisa Serbia, Aleksandar Vučić. Labada Madaxweyne ayaa ka wada-hadli doona xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Serbia, gaar ahaan dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo danaha laba geesoodka ah ee labada dal. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa qayb ka ah madax ka socota dowlaha caalamka, kuwaasi oo lagu casuumay ka qayb-galka shirka heerka sare ah ee lagu xusayo 65-guurada shirkii koowaad ee dhaq-dhaqaaqa dalalka aan isbahaysiga ahayn (Non-Aligned Movement), kaasi oo lagu qabtay magaalada Belgrade sannadkii 1961-kii. Shirka ayaa waxaa ka qeyb-galaya madax iyo mas’uuliyiin ka socda dowlado kala duwan oo caalamka ah, iyadoo diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta iskaashiga iyo mabaadi’da dhaqdhaqaaqa dalalka aan isbahaysiga ahayn. Booqashada Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Serbia ayaa qeyb ka ah safar uu ku marayo qaar ka mid ah dalalka Yurub, iyadoo Seerbiya ay tahay halka uu ka bilaabanayo safarkiisa. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa inta uu ku sugan yahay Yurub la filayaa inuu yeesho kulamo kale oo uu kula qaato madax iyo mas’uuliyiin caalami ah, iyadoo safarkiisu uu ku soo beegmayo xilli dowladda Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. items.title: Somalia’s Civil Aviation at a crossroads: Can aviation infrastructure not be used as political weapons?
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s civil aviation sector is being presented as an area in need of greater international support, but a more fundamental question must be addressed first: can Somalia’s aviation infrastructure be trusted to serve the public impartially, or can it be used by the Federal Government as a political instrument against regions and communities that disagree with Mogadishu? That question deserves serious attention as the United Nations considers expanding its technical cooperation with Somalia’s Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation. Director General Omar Afrah recently met with Sadozai, Acting Assistant Secretary-General of the United Nations and Head of the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS). Their discussions focused on strengthening cooperation in civil aviation, including technical assistance, institutional capacity-building, training, airport safety and security, and the development of systems consistent with international aviation standards. Those objectives are important. Somalia desperately needs a modern, safe and professionally managed civil aviation system. But infrastructure and technical capacity alone will not create a credible aviation sector. Institutional independence, political neutrality and equal access must be at the heart of any international investment. The recent experience of Doolow Airport in Gedo Region provides a troubling example. The airport remained closed for approximately two years amid the political confrontation between Mogadishu and the Jubaland administration. Its prolonged closure severely restricted civilian mobility in a region where residents depend heavily on air transport, particularly for access to specialized medical treatment in Mogadishu. The consequences of such a policy are not borne by politicians sitting in government offices. They are borne by ordinary citizens—patients seeking medical care, mothers traveling with children, students, traders, elderly people and families separated by distance. When an airport serving an entire population can remain closed for two years because of a political dispute between governments, civil aviation ceases to be merely a transportation issue. It becomes a question of human rights and governance. The reopening of Doolow Airport only recently should therefore prompt the United Nations and other international partners to ask difficult questions about how aviation authorities are exercising their powers. If the international community is genuinely committed to rebuilding Somalia’s civil aviation system, it should insist on safeguards ensuring that airports cannot be selectively opened, closed or restricted as a means of political pressure. Civil aviation should not depend on whether a regional administration agrees with the policies of the Federal Government. Nor should access to medical care, commerce and family travel become collateral damage in political disputes between Mogadishu and the federal member states. Aviation Assistance Must Come with Accountability The UN-supported effort to strengthen Somalia’s aviation institutions includes legitimate priorities: improving airport safety, upgrading aviation systems, training personnel, strengthening operational capacity and preparing Somali institutions to assume greater responsibility for aviation management. But there is a missing component that deserves equal attention: accountability. Before international resources are invested in expanding the authority and capacity of Somalia’s aviation institutions, international partners should ensure that those institutions operate according to clear, transparent and politically neutral rules. There should be publicly understood criteria governing the closure of airports, suspension of flights and restrictions on air transport. Such decisions should be based on genuine safety, security or technical considerations—not political disagreements. Otherwise, strengthening the aviation bureaucracy without strengthening institutional safeguards could simply provide the government with a more powerful mechanism for controlling civilian movement. The lesson from Doolow is difficult to ignore. An airport is not merely a runway. It is a lifeline. For communities separated from Somalia’s major hospitals, markets and administrative centers by hundreds of kilometers of difficult terrain, air transport can mean the difference between receiving emergency treatment and dying before reaching a hospital. For traders, it can mean the difference between maintaining a livelihood and losing access to markets. And for families, it can determine whether they can travel safely and affordably across a country already divided by insecurity and political fragmentation. The UN Has an Opportunity—and a Responsibility The United Nations has spent years supporting Somalia’s institutional development. Its aviation assistance can make an important contribution to the country’s recovery, but that assistance should not be measured simply by the number of trained officials, upgraded systems or improved airports. The ultimate test is whether ordinary Somalis can use those airports freely, safely and without political discrimination. The UN should therefore make political neutrality and civilian access central components of its aviation support. International partners should monitor how aviation powers are exercised and encourage transparent mechanisms through which communities and regional administrations can challenge politically motivated restrictions. Somalia does not need an aviation system that merely meets international technical standards. It needs an aviation system that respects its people. The reopening of Doolow Airport after two years should not simply be celebrated as a restoration of air services. It should also serve as a warning about what happens when essential civilian infrastructure becomes entangled in political warfare. If the UN truly wants to help rebuild Somalia’s civil aviation sector, it should ensure that no government—regardless of who occupies the presidential palace—can turn the country’s airports and airspace into political muscle. Aviation must connect Somalia, not divide it. And the right to travel should never depend on political loyalty. items.title: Puntland’s Unpaid Civil Servants: Why Is the Government Silent?
items.description: Garowe (WDN ) — Puntland’s civil servants are facing an increasingly painful question: why has the government failed to pay their salaries for months while public funds continue to be spent on other priorities? Government employees are reportedly owed up to seven months of salaries, making this one of the most serious and prolonged salary crises Puntland’s civil service has experienced in years. The salary crisis facing Puntland’s civil servants reportedly began as early as September 2023. Since then, unpaid salaries and other outstanding employment entitlements have continued to accumulate, leaving many government employees struggling for years without receiving the full compensation they are owed. What began as delayed payments has evolved into a prolonged hardship for civil servants and their families, raising growing concerns about the government’s failure to honor its basic obligations to the people who keep its institutions running. The situation is becoming even more troubling as civil servants increasingly seek answers from the government. If a government employee formally asks why his or her salary has not been paid, the government should have a clear, transparent and documented answer. Instead, the apparent absence of a satisfactory explanation is fueling frustration among employees who depend on their monthly salaries to support their families. A Simple Question the Government Must Answer The question from civil servants is not complicated: Where is our salary, and why has the government failed to pay it? These employees have already performed their duties. Their salaries are not political donations or discretionary benefits. They are compensation for services rendered to the government and the public. Puntland’s own budget framework reportedly establishes a hierarchy for salary payments, placing security personnel first, civil servants second and political officeholders—including ministers and parliamentarians—last. If that provision is being followed, civil servants should have a reasonable expectation that their salaries will be protected within the government’s financial planning. But the reality appears dramatically different. According to available information, civil servants have received only two salary payments during 2026, reportedly corresponding to the two major Islamic holidays, while substantial arrears remain outstanding. The unpaid salaries are estimated at approximately $500,000 per month. Seven months of arrears would therefore amount to roughly $3.5 million. That figure is significant—but it is also small when compared with reported government revenues of approximately $10 million per month. This raises an unavoidable question: If Puntland is collecting millions of dollars in revenue every month, why can it not find approximately half a million dollars to pay the people who run its government? The most revealing test of governance may now be how the administration responds when civil servants begin demanding answers. A civil servant who asks why salaries have not been paid should not be treated as disloyal, troublesome or politically motivated. Demanding one’s legally earned salary is not political activism. It is an employment right. A responsible government that serves its people should welcome such questions and respond with facts: the government’s revenues, expenditures, salary obligations, outstanding arrears and the timetable for clearing them. If there is a genuine revenue shortfall, the government should explain it. If funds have been redirected to urgent security requirements, the government should disclose that. If expenditures on travel, chartered aircraft, overseas delegations or other non-essential activities have taken priority over salaries, citizens have a right to know. Silence only deepens suspicion. The Ministry of Finance Under Scrutiny The controversy inevitably places the Puntland Ministry of Finance under scrutiny. Critics increasingly portray the ministry as operating less like an independent institution responsible for protecting public finances and more like an “ATM” for the presidency, with spending decisions allegedly driven by executive priorities rather than the approved budget. That is a serious allegation and one that requires evidence and accountability—not political rhetoric. The appropriate response is therefore transparency. Puntland should publish a clear account of its monthly revenues and expenditures and explain why salary obligations have accumulated while other government expenses continue to be funded. The Auditor General’s reported identification of approximately $12 million in outstanding employee-related obligations makes the demand for transparency even more urgent. For a senior government official, several months without a salary may be an inconvenience. For a low-paid civil servant, it can be catastrophic. Seven months without regular income means unpaid rent, mounting debts, school fees, food insecurity and families forced to depend on relatives and informal borrowing. The result is predictable: demoralization, absenteeism and declining public services. A government cannot reasonably demand that its employees remain committed and productive while simultaneously failing to honor the most basic obligation of an employer—paying them on time. A Civil Service Without a Collective Voice The prolonged crisis also exposes another institutional weakness: Puntland’s civil servants appear to lack a strong, independent collective mechanism through which they can defend their employment rights. The creation of a lawful and politically independent civil servants’ labor union or professional association could provide an important safeguard. Such a body could give government employees a legitimate platform to ask questions about salaries, employment conditions and budget compliance without turning every workplace grievance into a political confrontation. Civil servants should not have to remain silent simply because they fear that demanding their salaries could be interpreted as opposition to the government. The Government owes its employees an answer.  Ultimately, this is not simply a dispute over payroll. It is a question of governance. Puntland’s government has a responsibility to explain how public money is collected, allocated and spent. Civil servants have a right to know why their salaries have not been paid, particularly when the government’s budget reportedly places their payments ahead of ministers and members of parliament. If a civil servant sends a message asking, “Why have you not paid my salary?”, the appropriate response from government should not be intimidation, silence or political labeling. It should be an answer. Where is the money? Where did it go? Who decided the priorities? And when will the salaries be paid? Those are legitimate questions. And the longer the government refuses to answer them, the more the salary crisis becomes a test not of Puntland’s finances—but of its commitment to accountability, good governance and the dignity of the people who serve the state. items.fullContent: Garowe (WDN ) — Puntland’s civil servants are facing an increasingly painful question: why has the government failed to pay their salaries for months while public funds continue to be spent on other priorities? Government employees are reportedly owed up to seven months of salaries, making this one of the most serious and prolonged salary crises Puntland’s civil service has experienced in years. The salary crisis facing Puntland’s civil servants reportedly began as early as September 2023. Since then, unpaid salaries and other outstanding employment entitlements have continued to accumulate, leaving many government employees struggling for years without receiving the full compensation they are owed. What began as delayed payments has evolved into a prolonged hardship for civil servants and their families, raising growing concerns about the government’s failure to honor its basic obligations to the people who keep its institutions running. The situation is becoming even more troubling as civil servants increasingly seek answers from the government. If a government employee formally asks why his or her salary has not been paid, the government should have a clear, transparent and documented answer. Instead, the apparent absence of a satisfactory explanation is fueling frustration among employees who depend on their monthly salaries to support their families. A Simple Question the Government Must Answer The question from civil servants is not complicated: Where is our salary, and why has the government failed to pay it? These employees have already performed their duties. Their salaries are not political donations or discretionary benefits. They are compensation for services rendered to the government and the public. Puntland’s own budget framework reportedly establishes a hierarchy for salary payments, placing security personnel first, civil servants second and political officeholders—including ministers and parliamentarians—last. If that provision is being followed, civil servants should have a reasonable expectation that their salaries will be protected within the government’s financial planning. But the reality appears dramatically different. According to available information, civil servants have received only two salary payments during 2026, reportedly corresponding to the two major Islamic holidays, while substantial arrears remain outstanding. The unpaid salaries are estimated at approximately $500,000 per month. Seven months of arrears would therefore amount to roughly $3.5 million. That figure is significant—but it is also small when compared with reported government revenues of approximately $10 million per month. This raises an unavoidable question: If Puntland is collecting millions of dollars in revenue every month, why can it not find approximately half a million dollars to pay the people who run its government? The most revealing test of governance may now be how the administration responds when civil servants begin demanding answers. A civil servant who asks why salaries have not been paid should not be treated as disloyal, troublesome or politically motivated. Demanding one’s legally earned salary is not political activism. It is an employment right. A responsible government that serves its people should welcome such questions and respond with facts: the government’s revenues, expenditures, salary obligations, outstanding arrears and the timetable for clearing them. If there is a genuine revenue shortfall, the government should explain it. If funds have been redirected to urgent security requirements, the government should disclose that. If expenditures on travel, chartered aircraft, overseas delegations or other non-essential activities have taken priority over salaries, citizens have a right to know. Silence only deepens suspicion. The Ministry of Finance Under Scrutiny The controversy inevitably places the Puntland Ministry of Finance under scrutiny. Critics increasingly portray the ministry as operating less like an independent institution responsible for protecting public finances and more like an “ATM” for the presidency, with spending decisions allegedly driven by executive priorities rather than the approved budget. That is a serious allegation and one that requires evidence and accountability—not political rhetoric. The appropriate response is therefore transparency. Puntland should publish a clear account of its monthly revenues and expenditures and explain why salary obligations have accumulated while other government expenses continue to be funded. The Auditor General’s reported identification of approximately $12 million in outstanding employee-related obligations makes the demand for transparency even more urgent. For a senior government official, several months without a salary may be an inconvenience. For a low-paid civil servant, it can be catastrophic. Seven months without regular income means unpaid rent, mounting debts, school fees, food insecurity and families forced to depend on relatives and informal borrowing. The result is predictable: demoralization, absenteeism and declining public services. A government cannot reasonably demand that its employees remain committed and productive while simultaneously failing to honor the most basic obligation of an employer—paying them on time. A Civil Service Without a Collective Voice The prolonged crisis also exposes another institutional weakness: Puntland’s civil servants appear to lack a strong, independent collective mechanism through which they can defend their employment rights. The creation of a lawful and politically independent civil servants’ labor union or professional association could provide an important safeguard. Such a body could give government employees a legitimate platform to ask questions about salaries, employment conditions and budget compliance without turning every workplace grievance into a political confrontation. Civil servants should not have to remain silent simply because they fear that demanding their salaries could be interpreted as opposition to the government. The Government owes its employees an answer.  Ultimately, this is not simply a dispute over payroll. It is a question of governance. Puntland’s government has a responsibility to explain how public money is collected, allocated and spent. Civil servants have a right to know why their salaries have not been paid, particularly when the government’s budget reportedly places their payments ahead of ministers and members of parliament. If a civil servant sends a message asking, “Why have you not paid my salary?”, the appropriate response from government should not be intimidation, silence or political labeling. It should be an answer. Where is the money? Where did it go? Who decided the priorities? And when will the salaries be paid? Those are legitimate questions. And the longer the government refuses to answer them, the more the salary crisis becomes a test not of Puntland’s finances—but of its commitment to accountability, good governance and the dignity of the people who serve the state. items.title: Aden Madobe Escalates Political Offensive Against Laftagareen Amid Intensifying Fighting in Baidoa
items.description: Baidoa (WDN) — In a striking escalation of South West State’s political crisis, President Aden Mohamed Nur (Aden Madobe) has convened an extraordinary cabinet meeting and accused former South West leader Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen of collaborating with Al-Shabaab—an allegation that   would represent a dramatic escalation in the political confrontation surrounding Baidoa. According to a statement issued after the meeting, the Southwest cabinet claimed to have identified evidence of cooperation between Laftagareen and Al-Shabaab and said it now considers the former regional president to be associated with the militant group. The allegation was announced by the Southwest administration’s spokesperson following the meeting, but no independently verifiable evidence was publicly presented to substantiate the claim. The timing of the accusation is particularly striking. Aden Madobe’s administration is operating in the midst of an increasingly bitter political and military confrontation with forces loyal to Laftagareen, whose supporters reject the circumstances under which Aden Madobe came to power in Baidoa and maintain that Laftagareen remains the legitimate political figure favored by sections of the local population. Rather than resolving the dispute through political engagement, the latest declaration appears to open a new front: an attempt to transform a deeply contested political struggle into an accusation of terrorism. From political dispute to terrorism allegation The development comes after weeks of escalating tensions around Baidoa. Forces loyal to Laftagareen have reportedly demonstrated sufficient strength to launch repeated attacks against positions in and around the city, despite the presence of Federal Government security forces supporting Aden Madobe. The persistence of these attacks raises uncomfortable questions about the extent of federal control and the durability of the security arrangements protecting the Southwest administration. For roughly two weeks, according to reports, the Federal Government has attempted to reach Laftagareen through negotiations. Those efforts have reportedly failed, with Laftagareen refusing to enter the proposed talks. Against that backdrop, the decision by Aden Madobe’s administration to publicly link Laftagareen to Al-Shabaab could be interpreted as an effort to undermine his political standing and discredit the forces challenging the current administration. That interpretation remains political analysis rather than an established fact. What is clear, however, is that the language has moved from political confrontation to criminal and terrorist accusations, dramatically raising the stakes. A battle for legitimacy The crisis in Baidoa is no longer simply about who controls government offices. It has become a struggle over political legitimacy, territorial authority and the future of Southwest State. Aden Madobe’s administration insists that it represents the lawful authority in Baidoa. Its opponents argue that the political transition that brought him to power lacked genuine popular legitimacy and was imposed with the backing of federal forces. The repeated attacks in and around Baidoa suggest that the dispute cannot be resolved by military deployments alone. Even with federal forces supporting the administration, Laftagareen-aligned fighters have continued to demonstrate the ability to challenge security positions and maintain pressure around the city. That reality makes the latest accusations particularly consequential. If the Federal Government and the Southwest administration possess credible evidence linking Laftagareen to Al-Shabaab, that evidence should be presented publicly and subjected to independent scrutiny. An accusation of terrorism cannot substitute for evidence, particularly when it is made in the middle of a political and military struggle. Conversely, if the allegations cannot be substantiated, they risk further poisoning an already dangerous confrontation and making a negotiated political settlement even more difficult. For now, Baidoa remains caught between competing claims of legitimacy, armed confrontation and increasingly inflammatory political rhetoric. The extraordinary cabinet meeting may have produced a forceful political statement, but it has not answered the central question facing Southwest State: Will Baidoa resolve its crisis through evidence, dialogue and a legitimate political process—or will accusations, armed force and external military backing determine who governs? items.title: Mogadishu launches resettlement plan for over 1,000 families
items.description: Mogadishu (Somalia Today) — Mogadishu authorities have launched the first phase of a resettlement programme for more than 1,000 families being relocated as part of efforts to open new roads, improve informal neighbourhoods and modernise the capital. Mayor of Mogadishu and Banadir Governor Hassan Mohamed Hussein Muungaab announced the programme during an inspection of the allocated site in Gubadley district. More than 1,000 families will be resettled in the area, where authorities plan to provide essential services including clean water, electricity, a mosque, health centre, market and public school. The initiative is designed to ensure that families required to move for road construction and neighbourhood improvement projects are provided with a more organised residential environment and access to basic services. It also adds a social dimension to Muungaab’s ambitious redevelopment drive, which has focused on reopening roads, improving public spaces and upgrading neighbourhoods across Mogadishu. Rather than treating relocation as a separate consequence of redevelopment, the Banadir administration is seeking to make resettlement part of the wider urban improvement programme. Muungaab said the initiative would continue as the administration expands development projects across the capital. Wider programme planned Authorities have identified additional areas where land can be allocated to families who need to relocate as new roads are opened and informal neighbourhoods are reorganised. The approach reflects the practical challenges facing Mogadishu as the rapidly growing capital seeks to improve roads, sanitation, housing and other basic infrastructure after decades of largely unplanned urban expansion. Opening roads in densely built neighbourhoods inevitably requires some homes and structures to be moved, particularly in areas that developed without formal urban planning. Muungaab’s administration has pushed ahead with those projects while seeking to provide affected families with alternative land and services, an approach that could help balance the capital’s development needs with the interests of residents. The resettlement programme therefore represents more than a housing initiative. It forms part of a broader attempt to replace congested and poorly serviced settlements with better-planned communities connected to roads, schools, markets, health facilities and utilities. Changing Mogadishu Mogadishu has seen a visible acceleration in road construction, neighbourhood upgrading and improvements to public spaces under Muungaab, who has made the physical transformation of the capital a central priority of his administration. The latest initiative strengthens that agenda by linking infrastructure development with improvements in living conditions for families directly affected by the changes. For a city that has expanded rapidly with limited planning for decades, the challenge is not simply to build roads but to reorganise neighbourhoods in a way that makes them safer, cleaner and easier to serve. By combining necessary relocation with planned resettlement, Muungaab’s administration is seeking to show that Mogadishu’s transformation can improve both the city’s infrastructure and the lives of the people who live in it. items.title: Road Traffic Accidents Rise in Puntland
items.description: Cawsane, Sanag Region (WDN) — Two young sisters were killed and their father injured in a tragic road accident today along the newly constructed road linking Eldaahir and Erigavo, in the Cawsane area of Sanaag. The victims, Bushro Mohamed Dheeg and Aamino Mohamed Dheeg, were sisters who died in the crash involving a Probox vehicle. Their father, Mohamed Dheeg, was also injured and is receiving medical attention. The tragedy adds to growing concerns over the increasing number of road traffic accidents reported across Puntland in recent months. Many of the crashes have reportedly been attributed to inexperienced drivers, poor infrastructure, lack of regulations raising renewed questions about driver training, enforcement of traffic regulations and road safety awareness. The expanding road network has improved connectivity between communities, but the rise in traffic has also brought greater risks where safety measures and driver discipline have failed to keep pace. For the families involved, however, the statistics offer little comfort. Two young lives have been lost, a father has been injured, and another family has been left to mourn a tragedy that could perhaps have been prevented. items.title: Sawirro: Isbitaalka Dalmar oo ka qeyb galay Bandhigga KOBAC Expo 2026
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Isbitaalka takhasusiga iyo tacliimiga ah ee Dalmar ayaa ka qeyb galay carwada ama Bandhigga Waxbarashada KOBAC Expo 2026, oo muddo laba cisho ah ka socday Beerta Banaadir ee magaalada Muqdisho. Bandhiggan, oo la qabanayey siddeeddii sano ee la soo dhaafay, ayaa waxaa ka faa’iideysta ardayda dhammeystay dugsiyada sare ee dalka, jaamacadaha, xarumaha lagu barto xirfadaha gacanta, isbitaallada iyo ganacsatada dalka keenta agabka waxbarashada. Waxaa sanad walba soo qabanqaabisa Xarunta KOBAC ee Tababarka, La-Talinta iyo Wacyigelinta, oo uu aasaasay Macallin Kobac, oo ah shaqsi u dhaqdhaqaaqa arrimaha bulshada. “Ujeeddada bandhiggan waa inaan isku xirno ardayda iyo hay’adaha u adeegaya. Waxaa sanadkan ka qeyb galaya in ka badan 30 jaamacadood oo talooyin iyo waxqabadkoodaba u soo bandhigaya ardayda. Sidoo kale, waxaa ka qeyb galaya isbitaallo baaritaanno iyo talooyin ka siinaya ardayda caafimaadka mustaqbalkooda. Waxaa kaloo ka qeyb galaya iskuullada lagu barto xirfadaha kala duwan iyo hay’ado kale oo ka shaqeeya arrimaha waxbarashada,” ayuu yiri Ustaad C/raxmaan Ibraahim Cilmi (Macallin Kobac), oo ah Guddoomiyaha Bandhigga KOBAC Expo, kana hadlayey munaasabadda furitaanka bandhiggan oo ay ka qeyb galeen kumannaan arday oo u diyaar-garoobaya inay sanadkan ku biiraan jaamacadaha dalka. Guddoomiyaha guud ee Isbitaalka takhasusiga iyo tacliimiga ah ee Dalmar, Prof. Dr. Abdirisak Ahmed Dalmar, ayaa sheegay inay ku faraxsan yihiin ka qeybgalka Bandhigga Waxbarashada KOBAC, isagoo xusay in iyagoo ka duulaya baahida caafimaad iyo duruufaha ka jira dalka ay go’aansadeen inay baaritaannada dhinaca caafimaadka ka caawiyaan ardayda sanadkan ka soo baxday dugsiyada sare ee dalka, iskuna diyaarinaya inay u gudbaan waxbarashada heerka jaamacadeed. Isbitaalka Dalmar, oo qeyb ka ahaa carwadan, ayaa halkaas u diray koox ka kooban dhaqaatiir iyo kalkaaliyeyaal caafimaad, kuwaas oo muddadii labada cisho ahayd ee ay socotay carwadu baaritaanno kala duwan iyo la-talin bilaash ah u sameynayey ardayda ka soo qeyb gashay bandhiggan ee ka cabanayey xanuunno kala duwan. Kuwa baaritaanno dheeraad ah u baahnaa waxaa loo dirayey xarumaha isbitaalka, iyadoo adeegyada ay u baahan yihiin loogu sameeyey qiimo-dhimis gaareysa 50%. Qaar ka mid ah ardaydii soo booqday goobta ay ka howlgalayeen kooxda ka socotay Isbitaalka Dalmar ayaa u mahadceliyey maamulka isbitaalka, gaar ahaan dhaqaatiirtii iyo kalkaaliyeyaashii halkaasi ku sugnaa, sida hufan ee ay u soo dhoweeyeen iyo adeegyadii ay u baahnaayeen ee ay ugu qabteen. Isbitaalka takhasusiga iyo tacliimiga ah ee Dalmar (Ex-Al-Nuur Eye Hospital) waa isbitaalkii ugu horreeyey noociisa ee laga furo Koonfurta iyo Bartamaha Soomaaliya sanadkii 2002, xilli ay jireen duruufo aad u adag oo dhaqaatiirta qurbaha ku maqnaa badankood ku qasbay inay ku soo dhiirran waayaan dalka. Shaqada isbitaalka maalin qudha ma joogsan muddadii 24-ka sano ahayd ee uu jiray, waxaana adeegyada isbitaalka ka faa’iideystay tobannaan kun oo qof. Isbitaalka takhasusiga ah ee Dalmar waa isbitaal casri ah oo ka kooban qeybaha bukaan-socodka oo leh takhasusyo kala duwan, bukaan-jiifka, sheybaarka, raajada, gargaarka degdegga ah, daaweynta iyo qalliinka indhaha, sifeynta kelyaha, caafimaadka iyo qurxinta ilkaha (Dentistry), qeybta daryeelka gaarka ah ee xooggan (ICU), dhalmada, qalliinnada guud iyo qeybo kale. Isbitaalka takhasusiga ah ee Dalmar waa isbitaal casri ah oo ka kooban qeybaha bukaan-socodka oo leh takhasusyo kala duwan, bukaan-jiifka, sheybaarka, raajada, gargaarka degdegga ah, daaweynta iyo qalliinka indhaha, sifeynta kelyaha, caafimaadka iyo qurxinta ilkaha (Dentistry), qeybta daryeelka gaarka ah ee xooggan (ICU), dhalmada, qalliinnada guud iyo qeybo kale. items.title: Xildhibaan Odowaa oo weerar ku qaaday Xasan Sheekh: Xoog ayuu ku jooga Villa Somalia
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Odowaa ayaa weerar afka ah ku qaaday Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isagoo ku eedeeyay inuu awood sharci-darro ah ku sii joogo xilka madaxweynaha, isla markaana muddadii xilkiisu dhammaatay. Odowaa ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay afaafka hore ee baarlamaanka oo uu kula hadlay warbaahinta, wuxuuna si adag u sheegay in muddada xilka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ay dhammaatay, taas oo ahayd afar sano. “Xasan Sheekh teendhadaas ayaan ku soo doorannay. Markii aan soo doorannay, afar sano ayaan soo doorannay. Afartii sano way dhammaatay. Madaxweynaha xoog ayuu Madaxtooyadda ku joogaa,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Odowaa. Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Wixii intaas ka badan xoog ayaa la yiraahda, xooggana waqti ayuu iska leeyahay, dhibaato ma leh.” Xildhibaanka ayaa sidoo kale isbarbar dhigay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo, isagoo sheegay in muddadii halka sano ahayd ee Farmaajo uu ku darsaday u socon weysay, ayna sidaas oo kale ku dambeyn doonto muddo kororsiga Xasan Sheekh “Farmaajo intaan dhihi jiray ayaan leeyahay Xasan, wuxuu ku joogaa xoog,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Odowaa. Hadalka Odowaa ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirto marxalad siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah, isla markaana ay jiraan khilaafaad xooggan oo u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah, kaasi oo ku saabsan hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo jihada siyaasadeed ee dalka. Odowaa ayaa horey isaga casilay xilkii Xoghayaha Guud iyo xubinnimadii Xisbiga Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP), oo uu ka tirsanaa muddo ka badan 10 sano. Xildhibaanka ayaa is-casilaaddiisa ku sababeeyay kala aragti duwanaansho muddo kala dhexeysay isaga iyo Guddoomiyaha Xisbiga JSP, ahna Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Hadalladiisa cusub ayaa muujinaya in khilaafka siyaasadeed ee labada dhinac uu isu beddelay mucaaradad xooggan. The post Xildhibaan Odowaa oo weerar ku qaaday Xasan Sheekh: Xoog ayuu ku jooga Villa Somalia appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Koonfur Galbeed Oo Ansixisay Dib-u-eegista Miisaaniyadda 2026
items.description: Golaha Wakiillada DKGS oo Ansixiyey Dib-u-eegista Miisaaniyadda 2026 Golaha Wakiillada Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah u ansixiyey Dib-u-eegista Miisaaniyadda Sanad-Maaliyadeedka 2026, ka dib dood iyo falanqeyn dheer oo ay ka yeesheen qodobbada iyo qorshaha miisaaniyadda. Baydhabo – Wasiirka Maaliyadda Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Xuseen Maxamed Xaaji, ayaa maanta Golaha Wakiillada horgeeyey Dib-u-eegista Miisaaniyadda Sanad-Maaliyadeedka 2026, isagoo khudbad ka jeediyey muhiimadda ay miisaaniyaddu u leedahay qorsheynta iyo fulinta mudnaanta Dowladda. Kaddib dood iyo falanqeyn dheer oo ay Xubnaha Golaha Wakiilladu ka yeesheen qodobbada iyo qorshaha Dib-u-eegista Miisaaniyadda, Golaha Wakiillada ayaa si rasmi ah u ansixiyey dib-u-eegista. Tallaabadani waxay qayb ka tahay habraacyada caadiga ah ee maareynta maaliyadda, taasoo u oggolaanaysa dowladda inay dib u eegto qiyaasaha dakhliga gudaha, deeqaha iyo kharashaadka si ay ula jaanqaadaan xaaladda dhaqaale ee hadda jirta . Dib-u-eegista Miisaaniyaddu waa tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu cusboonaysiinayo qiyaasaha dakhliga gudaha, deeqaha iyo kharashaadka Dowladda, si ay ula jaanqaadaan xaaladda dhaqaale, baahiyaha jira iyo mudnaanta Dowladda inta ka harsan sanad-maaliyadeedka 2026. Tani waxay muhiim u tahay hubinta in kheyraadka loo qoondeeyo si hufan oo loogu tala galay mashaariicda horumarineed iyo adeegyada bulshada. Kaddib ansixinta, Wasiirka Maaliyadda, Mudane Xuseen Maxamed Xaaji, ayaa uga mahadceliyey Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Dr. Mahad Maxamed Sheekh Xasan, Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka 1-aad, Mudane Aadan Xasan Maxamed, iyo dhammaan Xubnaha Golaha Wakiillada, dooddii, talooyinkii iyo taageeradii ay ka muujiyeen Dib-u-eegista Miisaaniyadda. Wasiirku waxa uu sidoo kale si gaar ah ugu mahadceliyey Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Maaliyadda, Mudane Cali Cabdi Aadan, iyo Agaasimaha Waaxda Miisaaniyadda, Mudane Cabdicasiis Macallim Xuseen, dadaalkooda, hawlkarnimadooda iyo doorkii muhiimka ahaa ee ay ka qaateen diyaarinta iyo soo gudbinta Dib-u-eegista Miisaaniyadda Sanad-Maaliyadeedka 2026. Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed waxay sii waddaa dadaalladeeda lagu xoojinayo maamulka maaliyadda iyo hufnaanta hay’adaha, iyadoo Wasaaradda Maaliyaddu ka go’an tahay in Dib-u-eegista Miisaaniyadda loo fuliyo si hufan, daahfuran oo mas’uuliyad leh, iyadoo la ilaalinayo mudnaanta Dowladda iyo danta guud. The post Koonfur Galbeed Oo Ansixisay Dib-u-eegista Miisaaniyadda 2026 first appeared on Radio Dalsan .
