items.title: Hoggaamiyaasha Shiinaha iyo Ruushka oo maanta ku kulmaya Shir Muhiim ah oo ka Dhacaya Kyrgyzstan
items.description: Madaxda Ruushka iyo Shiinaha, Vladimir Putin iyo Xi Jinping , ayaa maanta ku kulmaya caasimadda Kyrgyzstan ee Bishkek, halkaas oo ay ka dhacayaan shir madaxeedka sannadlaha ah ee Ururka Iskaashiga Shanghai (SCO) . Kulankan ayaa waxaa ka qeybgalaya in ka badan toban hoggaamiye, waxaana ajandaha shirka diiradda lagu saarayaa iskaashiga dhaqaale, amniga iyo xiriirka caalamiga ah. Shirka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ay sii xoojinayaan xiriirkooda siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale, iyagoo si joogto ah ugu baaqaya in dunidu u gudubto nidaam ay awooddu ku kala qaybsan tahay dalal badan, halkii uu hal dal ama koox dalal ah si weyn ugu talin lahaa. Inkastoo Ururka Iskaashiga Shanghai uu si rasmi ah u caddeeyo inuusan ahayn isbahaysi militari oo ka dhan ah dalal kale, haddana Moscow iyo Beijing waxay shirka u adeegsadaan inay ku soo bandhigaan aragtidooda ku saabsan nidaamka cusub ee caalamka iyo waxa ay u arkaan faragelinta reer Galbeedka. Putin iyo Xi ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay si weyn u kordhiyay iskaashiga labada dal, gaar ahaan dhinacyada tamarta, ganacsiga, militariga iyo siyaasadda caalamiga ah. Ruushka oo wajahaya cadaadis iyo cunaqabateyn kaga imaanaya dalalka reer Galbeedka ayaa Shiinaha u arka suuq muhiim ah oo uu u dhoofiyo tamartiisa iyo badeecooyinkiisa, halka Beijing ay Moscow u aragto saaxiib istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah loollanka awoodaha caalamka. Shirka waxaa sidoo kale ka qeybgalaya Madaxweynaha Iiraan Masoud Pezeshkian , kaas oo la filayo inuu kulan gaar ah la yeesho Vladimir Putin. Iiraan waxay xubin buuxda ka noqotay Ururka Iskaashiga Shanghai sanadkii 2023, waxaana Tehran iyo Moscow ka dhexeeya xiriir dhow oo dhinacyada militariga iyo siyaasadda ah, halka Iran iyo Shiinahana ay leeyihiin xiriir xooggan oo dhinaca tamarta iyo ganacsiga ah. Kulanka Pezeshkian iyo Putin ayaa sidaas darteed yeelan kara muhiimad gaar ah marka la eego xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee Bariga Dhexe. Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu ka qeyb galo shirka, inkastoo Turkigu uusan ahayn xubin buuxda oo SCO ah. Ururka ayaa hadda leh 10 xubnood oo rasmi ah , halka 15 dal oo kale ay yihiin waddamo xiriir la leh ururka oo loo yaqaan “partners in dialogue”. Waxaa kamid ah Sacuudiga iyo Qatar. Hindiya iyo Pakistan oo labaduba xubno buuxa ka ah SCO ayaa iyaguna ka qeybgalaya kulanka. Ururka Iskaashiga Shanghai wuxuu sheegtaa inuu matalo ku dhowaad 40 boqolkiiba dadka dunida iyo qiyaastii 25 boqolkiiba dhaqaalaha caalamka , taasoo muujineysa miisaanka dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed ee dalalka ku mideysan ururkan. Sannadkan ayaa sidoo kale ku beegan 25 sano guuradii aasaaska SCO , taasoo shirka siinaysa muhiimad dheeraad ah. Kulanka Bishkek ayaa sidoo kale dhacaya xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo loollanka dhaqaale ee u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Shiinaha. Xoghayaha Maaliyadda Mareykanka Scott Bessent ayaa sheegay in Washington ay dooneyso in dalalka G20 ay dib u eegaan shuruudaha ganacsi ee ay la leeyihiin Shiinaha. Bessent wuxuu si gaar ah u dhaleeceeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay dheelitir la’aanta ganacsi ee Shiinaha, isagoo sheegay in Beijing ay isku dayeyso inay dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale ee gudaha kaga gudubto dhoofinta badeecooyin badan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee kulanka Putin iyo Xi Jinping ee Bishkek ayaa noqonaya mid si weyn isha loogu hayo, iyadoo la filayo in labada hoggaamiye iyo madaxda kale ay ka hadlaan amniga, ganacsiga, tamarta iyo mustaqbalka nidaamka caalamiga ah.

Kulanka Pezeshkian iyo Putin ayaa sidaas darteed yeelan kara muhiimad gaar ah marka la eego xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee Bariga Dhexe. Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu ka qeyb galo shirka, inkastoo Turkigu uusan ahayn xubin buuxda oo SCO ah. Ururka ayaa hadda leh 10 xubnood oo rasmi ah , halka 15 dal oo kale ay yihiin waddamo xiriir la leh ururka oo loo yaqaan “partners in dialogue”. Waxaa kamid ah Sacuudiga iyo Qatar. Hindiya iyo Pakistan oo labaduba xubno buuxa ka ah SCO ayaa iyaguna ka qeybgalaya kulanka. Ururka Iskaashiga Shanghai wuxuu sheegtaa inuu matalo ku dhowaad 40 boqolkiiba dadka dunida iyo qiyaastii 25 boqolkiiba dhaqaalaha caalamka , taasoo muujineysa miisaanka dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed ee dalalka ku mideysan ururkan. Sannadkan ayaa sidoo kale ku beegan 25 sano guuradii aasaaska SCO , taasoo shirka siinaysa muhiimad dheeraad ah. Kulanka Bishkek ayaa sidoo kale dhacaya xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo loollanka dhaqaale ee u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Shiinaha. Xoghayaha Maaliyadda Mareykanka Scott Bessent ayaa sheegay in Washington ay dooneyso in dalalka G20 ay dib u eegaan shuruudaha ganacsi ee ay la leeyihiin Shiinaha. Bessent wuxuu si gaar ah u dhaleeceeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay dheelitir la’aanta ganacsi ee Shiinaha, isagoo sheegay in Beijing ay isku dayeyso inay dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale ee gudaha kaga gudubto dhoofinta badeecooyin badan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee kulanka Putin iyo Xi Jinping ee Bishkek ayaa noqonaya mid si weyn isha loogu hayo, iyadoo la filayo in labada hoggaamiye iyo madaxda kale ay ka hadlaan amniga, ganacsiga, tamarta iyo mustaqbalka nidaamka caalamiga ah.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qayb-gashay shir gaar ah oo Midowga Afrika ka yeeshay xallinta khilaafaadka
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa magaalada Luanda ee dalka Angola uga qaybgalaya Kalfadhiga 21-aad ee Gaarka ah ee Madaxda Dalalka iyo Dawladaha Midowga Afrika. Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa sidii dalalka Afrika ay u xoojin lahaayeen ka-hortagga iyo xallinta khilaafaadka, iyadoo madaxda qaaraddu ay ka wada hadlayaan caqabadaha amni iyo siyaasadeed ee weli saameeya qaaradda. Ajendaha shirka waxaa sidoo kale qayb weyn ka ah sidii Afrika ay u heli lahayd maalgelin joogto ah oo lagu taageero nabadda iyo amniga, iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya hay’adaha Midowga Afrika iyo bahwadaagta caalamiga ah. Madaxda Afrika ayaa la filayaa inay xoogga saaraan baahida loo qabo in khilaafaadka qaaradda lagu wajaho hannaan wadajir ah, iyadoo la xoojinayo dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed, ka-hortagga colaadaha iyo dhismaha hay’ado awood u leh inay si wax-ku-ool ah uga jawaabaan dhibaatooyinka amni. Soomaaliya ayaa shirka ku biirinaysa waayo-aragnimadeeda ku aaddan garab-istaagga Afrika, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu dhisayo nabad iyo xasillooni waarta. Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Saalax Axmed Jaamac ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in guulaha laga gaaro sugidda amniga lagu xoojiyo hindisayaasha qaran ee nabadda iyo xasilloonida. Ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee madashan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya doorka ay dowladda federaalku doonayso inay ka qaadato doodaha qaaradda ee ku saabsan nabadda, amniga iyo xal u helidda khilaafaadka. Kalfadhiga Luanda ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli qaaradda Afrika ay weli wajahdo khilaafaadyo siyaasadeed iyo colaado ka jira qaybo ka mid ah dalalka qaaradda, taasoo sare u qaadaysa muhiimadda ay leedahay in Midowga Afrika iyo dowladaha xubnaha ka ah ay yeeshaan istiraatiijiyad mideysan oo ku wajahan nabadda iyo amniga Afrika.

items.title: Bankiga Adduunka oo diiday dhowr been oo Kheyre uu ka sheegay dhaqaalaha dalka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xog cusub oo uu soo bandhigay Bankiga Adduunka ayaa meesha ka saartay qaar ka mid ah sheegashooyin uu dhawaan jeediyay ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya Xasan Cali Kheyre, kuwaas oo la xiriiray xaaladda dhaqaalaha dalka iyo sida dowladda u maareysay maalgelinta mashaariicda horumarinta. Bankiga Adduunka ayaa sheegay in heerka lacag-bixinta mashaariicda Soomaaliya uu gaaray 29.4% sanad-maaliyadeedka 2026, halka uu ahaa ku dhowaad 24% sanadkii 2025. Bankiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in heerkan uu Soomaaliya ka dhigay mid ka mid ah dalalka ugu sarreeya Bariga iyo Koonfurta Afrika marka la eego sida lacagaha loogu sii daayo mashaariicda horumarineed ee socda. Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu noqotay dood siyaasadeed oo ka dhalatay hadallo uu dhowaan Kheyre ka jeediyay xaaladda dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya. Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ayaa sheegay in in ka badan 500 milyan oo dollar oo loogu talagalay horumarinta Soomaaliya aan la isticmaalin sanadihii 2024 iyo 2025, isaga oo arrintaas ku xiriiriyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay “maamul-xumo iyo musuq-maasuq”. Kheyre ayaa sheegay in 73% lacag ka badan 330 milyan oo dollar oo la qoondeeyay 2024 aan la isticmaalin, halka 70% lacag ka badan 407 milyan oo dollar oo la heli karay 2025 ay sidoo kale harsanayd. Jawaabta Bankiga Adduunka Hase yeeshee, Bankiga Adduunka, oo ka jawaabay fal-celin ay arrintan ka weydiisay warbaahinta Dawan Media, ayaa sharaxaad ka duwan taas bixiyay, isaga oo caddeeyay in lacagaha aan weli laga bixin mashaariicda socda aysan si toos ah uga dhignayn lacago lumay ama si xun loo maareeyay. Mashaariicda horumarinta badankood ayaa soconaya dhowr sano, waxaana lacagaha loo sii daayaa marxalado kala duwan iyadoo lagu saleynayo halka uu marayo mashruuca, qandaraasyada la fuliyay iyo jadwalka shaqooyinka loo qorsheeyay. Sidaas darteed, lacag mashruuc loo ansixiyay sanad gaar ah khasab ma aha in dhammaanteed isla sanadkaas la isticmaalo. Bankiga ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in habka uu u xisaabiyo heerka lacag-bixinta uu ka duwan yahay qaabka uu Kheyre u adeegsaday dooddiisa. Heerka Bankiga Adduunka wuxuu cabbirayaa inta lacag ah ee sanadkii laga bixiyay dhammaan lacagaha ka harsan mashaariicda socda, halkii laga qaadan lahaa in lacag kasta oo sanad gaar ah la ansixiyay ay tahay in isla sanadkaas gebi ahaanba la kharash gareeyo. Bankiga ayaan sidoo kale xaqiijiyey in lacagaha aan weli la bixin aysan caddeyn u aheyn musuq-maasuq ama fashil maamul. Jawaabta Dowladda Federaalka Wasiirka Qorsheynta, Maalgashiga iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya, Maxamuud Beenebeene, ayaa Sabtidii xogta Bankiga Adduunka u adeegsaday inuu ku taageero jawaabtii dowladda ee hadallada Kheyre. “Xogta Bankiga Adduunka waxay xoojinaysaa wixii aan horay uga sheegay sheegashooyinka ra’iisul wasaarihii hore Xasan Cali Kheyre,” ayuu Beenebeene ku yiri qoraal uu ku daabacay bartiisa X. Wasiirka ayaa tilmaamay kororka heerka lacag-bixinta ee 24% ilaa 29.4%, isaga oo sheegay in lacagaha aan weli la bixin aysan la macno ahayn in la lunsaday ama dowladda ay ku fashilantay maareyntooda. “Doodda dhaqaalaha waa inay ku dhisnaataa xaqiiqooyin, ee ma aha fasiraado siyaasadeed,” ayuu yiri. Xogta Bankiga Adduunka ayaa sidoo kale ka hor imaanaysa sheegasho kale oo Kheyre uu ka sameeyay dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya, taas oo ahayd in dhaqaaluhu 3% hoos u dhacay sanadkii 2025. Warbixinta Bankiga ayaa taa beddelkeeda muujisay in dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu dhab ahaantii kobcay 3% sanadkii 2025, inkastoo kobacaasi uu ka hooseeyay 4.1% oo la diiwaangeliyay sanadkii 2024. Farqigaasi wuxuu ka dhigan yahay in kobaca dhaqaalaha uu gaabisay, balse uusan dhaqaaluhu hoos u dhicin ama yaraannin, sida uu Kheyre sheegay. Bankiga Adduunka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in amaahda la siiyo ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay ay sii korodhay sanadkii 2025, inkastoo kororkeedu gaabis ahaa, taas oo iyaduna ka duwan sawirkii Kheyre ka bixiyay xaaladda amaahda dalka. Si kastaba, warbixintu waxay taageertay qaar ka mid ah walaacyada laga muujiyay xaaladda guud ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan cunno-yarida sii xumaaneysa, hoos u dhaca gargaarka dibadda, saameynta cimilada iyo caqabadaha amni ee weli culayska saaraya dhaqaalaha dalka. items.title: Iran oo weerartay saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe iyo dagaalka oo dib u qarxay
items.description: Amman (Caasimada Online) – Iran ayaa gantaallo ballistic ah ku weerartay laba saldhig oo ciidamada Mareykanku ku leeyihiin Jordan, iyadoo sheegtay in tallaabadan ay jawaab u tahay duqeyn Mareykanku ka geystay jasiiradda Larak ee koonfurta Iran. Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ee IRGC ayaa sheegtay inay weerar isku dhaf ah oo gantaallo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah ku qaaday saldhigyada King Hussein iyo Al Azraq, oo ay ku sugan yihiin ciidamo Mareykan ah. Reuters ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in IRGC ay sheegatay weerarrada labada saldhig. IRGC ayaa howlgalka ugu magac dartay “Ciqaabta Gardarrada”, waxayna sheegtay in weerarradu burburiyeen kaabayaal farsamo iyo kuwa dayactirka, iyo goobo ay diyaaradaha dagaalka ku sugnaayeen. Ma jiro weli xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo muujineysa baaxadda khasaaraha ay Iran sheegatay. Warbaahinta Mareykanka oo soo xiganeysa ilo rasmi ah ayaa sheegtay in ku dhowaad dhammaan gantaalladii kusoo socday ciidamada Mareykanka la qabtay, isla markaana aan ilaa hadda la soo sheegin wax saameyn weyn ah. Axios ayaa sidoo kale ku warrantay in Iran ay adeegsatay gantaallo ballistic ah. “Gardarrada iyo dambiyadu xal uma noqon doonaan quusta cadowga ee isku dayga lagu wiiqayo awoodda Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Marinka Hormuz, weerar kastana waxaa looga jawaabi doonaa jawaab ka sii burbur badan,” ayay IRGC ku tiri bayaankeeda. Weerarka Iran ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii ciidamada Mareykanku duqeeyeen laba goobood oo gantaallada laga rido oo ku yaalla jasiiradda Larak, oo ku dhow Marinka Hormuz. Sarkaal Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in ciidamada IRGC lagu arkay iyagoo isku diyaarinaya inay gantaallo u adeegsadaan gelinta miinooyin badeed gudaha marinka muhiimka ah, taas oo Washington ay sheegtay inay sababtay weerarka. Warbaahinta Iran ayaa sheegtay in weerarka Mareykanka lagu dilay laguna dhaawacay askar ka tirsan IRGC iyo dad rayid ah, inkastoo Tehran aysan shaacin tiro rasmi ah. Ilaalada Kacaanka ayaa markaas ballanqaaday “jawaab iyo ciqaab”. Duqeynta Larak ayaa noqotay weerarkii ugu horreeyay ee la og yahay ee Mareykanku gudaha Iran ka fuliyo tan iyo dabayaaqadii July, xilli dagaalka labada dhinac uu toddobaadyadii dambe galay xaalad hakad iyo iska horimaadyo goos-goos ah. Xiisadda ugu weyn ayaa hadda ku wareegsan Marinka Hormuz, oo ah marin istaraatiiji ah oo kahor dagaalka ay mari jirtay ku dhowaad shan meelood meel shidaalka dunida. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegay in miinooyinkii ku jiray marinnada caalamiga ah ee Hormuz la qarxiyey ama laga saaray, isagoo Iran uga digay in markab kasta oo isku daya inuu miinooyin cusub dhigo la burburin doono. Tehran, dhinaceeda, waxay ku adkeysaneysaa inay weli awood u leedahay inay xakameyso isu-socodka marinka, waxayna diidday sheegashada Washington ee ah in Hormuz si buuxda dib loogu furay maraakiibta caalamiga ah. Mareykanka iyo Israel ayaa dagaalka Iran bilaabay 28-kii February, iyadoo Tehran ay jawaab uga bixisay weerarro ay ku qaaday Israel iyo saldhigyo ay ciidamada Mareykanku ku leeyihiin dalal dhowr ah oo gobolka ah. Dagaalka oo hadda dhaafay lix bilood ayaa sababay dhimashada kumannaan qof, barakaca malaayiin kale iyo carqalad weyn oo ku timid ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka shidaalka ee Marinka Hormuz. Weerarrada cusub ee Larak iyo Jordan ayaa muujinaya dib u soo xoogeysiga iska horimaadka tooska ah ee Washington iyo Tehran, xilli dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in dib loogu furo Hormuz aysan weli dhalin heshiis. Reuters ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in IRGC ay sheegatay weerarrada labada saldhig. IRGC ayaa howlgalka ugu magac dartay “Ciqaabta Gardarrada”, waxayna sheegtay in weerarradu burburiyeen kaabayaal farsamo iyo kuwa dayactirka, iyo goobo ay diyaaradaha dagaalka ku sugnaayeen. Ma jiro weli xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo muujineysa baaxadda khasaaraha ay Iran sheegatay. Warbaahinta Mareykanka oo soo xiganeysa ilo rasmi ah ayaa sheegtay in ku dhowaad dhammaan gantaalladii kusoo socday ciidamada Mareykanka la qabtay, isla markaana aan ilaa hadda la soo sheegin wax saameyn weyn ah. Axios ayaa sidoo kale ku warrantay in Iran ay adeegsatay gantaallo ballistic ah. “Gardarrada iyo dambiyadu xal uma noqon doonaan quusta cadowga ee isku dayga lagu wiiqayo awoodda Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Marinka Hormuz, weerar kastana waxaa looga jawaabi doonaa jawaab ka sii burbur badan,” ayay IRGC ku tiri bayaankeeda. Weerarka Iran ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii ciidamada Mareykanku duqeeyeen laba goobood oo gantaallada laga rido oo ku yaalla jasiiradda Larak, oo ku dhow Marinka Hormuz. Sarkaal Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in ciidamada IRGC lagu arkay iyagoo isku diyaarinaya inay gantaallo u adeegsadaan gelinta miinooyin badeed gudaha marinka muhiimka ah, taas oo Washington ay sheegtay inay sababtay weerarka. Warbaahinta Iran ayaa sheegtay in weerarka Mareykanka lagu dilay laguna dhaawacay askar ka tirsan IRGC iyo dad rayid ah, inkastoo Tehran aysan shaacin tiro rasmi ah. Ilaalada Kacaanka ayaa markaas ballanqaaday “jawaab iyo ciqaab”. Duqeynta Larak ayaa noqotay weerarkii ugu horreeyay ee la og yahay ee Mareykanku gudaha Iran ka fuliyo tan iyo dabayaaqadii July, xilli dagaalka labada dhinac uu toddobaadyadii dambe galay xaalad hakad iyo iska horimaadyo goos-goos ah. Xiisadda ugu weyn ayaa hadda ku wareegsan Marinka Hormuz, oo ah marin istaraatiiji ah oo kahor dagaalka ay mari jirtay ku dhowaad shan meelood meel shidaalka dunida. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegay in miinooyinkii ku jiray marinnada caalamiga ah ee Hormuz la qarxiyey ama laga saaray, isagoo Iran uga digay in markab kasta oo isku daya inuu miinooyin cusub dhigo la burburin doono. Tehran, dhinaceeda, waxay ku adkeysaneysaa inay weli awood u leedahay inay xakameyso isu-socodka marinka, waxayna diidday sheegashada Washington ee ah in Hormuz si buuxda dib loogu furay maraakiibta caalamiga ah. Mareykanka iyo Israel ayaa dagaalka Iran bilaabay 28-kii February, iyadoo Tehran ay jawaab uga bixisay weerarro ay ku qaaday Israel iyo saldhigyo ay ciidamada Mareykanku ku leeyihiin dalal dhowr ah oo gobolka ah. Dagaalka oo hadda dhaafay lix bilood ayaa sababay dhimashada kumannaan qof, barakaca malaayiin kale iyo carqalad weyn oo ku timid ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka shidaalka ee Marinka Hormuz. Weerarrada cusub ee Larak iyo Jordan ayaa muujinaya dib u soo xoogeysiga iska horimaadka tooska ah ee Washington iyo Tehran, xilli dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in dib loogu furo Hormuz aysan weli dhalin heshiis. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo warbixin ka dhageystay Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, ahna Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Mudane Dr. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta warbixin guud ka dhageystay Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, taas oo la xiriirtay xaaladda guud ee ciidanka, howlgallada socda iyo qorshayaasha horumarinta ciidamada. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa Madaxweynaha ka warbixiyay howlgalladii ugu dambeeyay ee lagu ciribtirayay cadowga umadda Soomaaliyeed ee Shabaab iyo guulaha laga gaaray sugidda amniga dalka. Sidoo kale, Taliyaha ayaa Madaxweynaha la wadaagay qorshayaasha dhow iyo kuwa fog ee lagu horumarinayo, laguna casriyeynayo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, si ay u yeeshaan awood buuxda oo ay ku xaqiijiyaan amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Ugu dambeyn, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku amray Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka in ay laba jibbaaraan howlgallada lagu ciribtirayo Shabaab, isla markaana la dardargeliyo dadaallada lagu casriyeynayo laguna horumarinayo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay si buuxda u gutaan waajibaadkooda qaran ee difaaca dalka, sugidda amniga iyo ilaalinta shacabka Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Somalia, Qatar discuss bilateral ties, sovereignty in Doha
items.description: Doha (Somalia Today) — Somalia and Qatar discussed threats to international trade and maritime navigation on Sunday as Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre met his Qatari counterpart in Doha and delivered a written message from President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud to Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani. Hamza held talks with Qatar’s Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani during an official visit, according to a statement from the Somali prime minister’s office. The two sides reviewed Somalia’s social and economic situation, recent developments in the country and the federal government’s efforts to strengthen security, stability and state institutions. They also discussed regional and international issues, including security, peace and international cooperation, as well as challenges that could disrupt international trade and maritime navigation. Qatar’s foreign ministry said Hassan Sheikh’s written message concerned bilateral relations and ways to strengthen them. Sheikh Mohammed praised Somalia’s recent progress and government efforts in several areas, while reaffirming Qatar’s interest in strengthening bilateral cooperation, according to the Somali statement. Hamza thanked Qatar for its support for Somalia’s sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity, as well as its assistance in other sectors. Neither government announced a new agreement following the talks. Sovereignty support Somalia’s statement highlighted Qatar’s support for the country’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, an issue that has taken on greater diplomatic significance since Israel recognised Somaliland in December 2025. Israel became the first country to formally recognise Somaliland, the self-declared republic in northwestern Somalia, as an independent state. Somalia rejected the decision as a violation of its sovereignty and territorial integrity. Qatar also opposed the move, describing it as a “dangerous precedent” and reaffirming its support for Somalia’s unity and territorial integrity. Doha said the recognition undermined Somalia’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. The position has featured in subsequent contacts between the two governments. During a telephone call with Hassan Sheikh in February, Sheikh Tamim reaffirmed Qatar’s support for Somalia’s legitimate state institutions, security and stability, and the preservation of its territorial unity. Qatar has also supported development projects in Somalia, including major road infrastructure linking Mogadishu with Afgoye and Jowhar. Sunday’s Somali delegation included Foreign Minister Abdisalam Abdi Ali and Education, Culture and Higher Education Minister Farah Sheikh Abdulkadir, as well as Somalia’s ambassador to Qatar and senior officials from the prime minister’s office and foreign ministry. The post Somalia, Qatar discuss bilateral ties, sovereignty in Doha appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maxaa ka cusub dagaalka ka socda duleedka Muqdisho?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa waxaa laga helayaa dagaallo culus oo maanta iyo shalay ka dhacay duleedka magaalada Muqdisho, gaar ahaan aagga deegaanka Basra oo dhaca waddada xiriirisa magaalooyinka Balcad iyo Afgooye oo ka kala tirsan labada Shabeelle. Dagaalladan ayaa ka dhashay howlgallo saf-ballaaran oo ay ciidamada dowladda ku qaadeen fariisimo ay Al-Shabaab ku leeyihiin aagga deegaankaas oo ah dhul beereed aad u ballaaran, waxaana kadib xigay iska hor imaadyo toos ah oo dhex-maray labada dhinac, kuwaas oo sababay khasaare xooggan. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa looga hadlay howlgalladii ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhacay Basra iyadoo wasaaraddu sheegtay in weerarradaasi lagu dilay maleeshiyaad ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab iyo horjoogayaal sare, balse ma shaacin tirada rasmiga ah ee maleeshiyaadka iyo horjoogayaasha lagu dilay howlgallada ka socda halkaasi. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in saanad milatari iyo hub ay kasoo furatay maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta ee ku sugnaa halkaasi. “Ciidamada Qalabka Sida Soomaaliyeed ayaa howlgal ballaaran oo lagu baacsanayo maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab ka wada duleedka deegaanka Basra, oo ku yaalla xadka u dhexeeya gobollada Shabeellaha Dhexe iyo Shabeellaha Hoose. Intii uu socday howlgalka, ciidamadu waxay dileen maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, oo ay ku jireen laba horjooge. Waxay sidoo kale kale ka furteen hubkii ay wateen,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, waxaa qoraalka lagu sheegay in howlgallada ay weli socdaan, isla markaana Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ay ku daba jiraan firxadka maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab, si looga sifeeyo deegaannada ku teedsan Basra, loona xaqiijiyo amniga iyo badqabka shacabka. “Natiijada rasmiga ah ee howlgalka ayaa lala wadaagi doonaa bulshada marka uu soo gabagaboobo,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri qoraalka Wasaaradda. Dhanka kale, dowladda Soomaaiya ayaa bogaadisay geesinimada, naf-hurnimada iyo dadaalka Ciidamada Qalabka Sida Soomaaliyeed ee ku hawlan xaqiijinta amniga dalka. Waxay sidoo kale caddeysay in howlgallada lagu ciribtirayo maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab, laguna xoreynayo deegaannada dalka, ay sii socon doonaan ilaa shacabka laga dulqaado khatarta argagixisada. Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa xoojisay howlgallada ka socda labada Shabelle, iyada oo jab culus lagu gaarsiiyay khawaarijta. The post Maxaa ka cusub dagaalka ka socda duleedka Muqdisho? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia and Turkey Celebrate Victory Day in Mogadishu
items.description: Somalia and Türkiye Mark 104th Anniversary of Victory Day in Mogadishu MOGADISHU, Somalia Somalia’s Minister of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation, Ali Yusuf Ali (Xoosh) , attended a ceremony in Mogadishu marking the 104th anniversary of Türkiye’s Victory Day , commemorating the military victory of August 30, 1922, which played a decisive role in Türkiye’s struggle for independence.The ceremony, organized by the Embassy of Türkiye in Mogadishu , brought together senior Somali government officials, diplomats and representatives from both countries.Minister Xoosh conveyed congratulations to the government and people of Türkiye, describing the occasion as an important national milestone that reflects the country’s history, unity and struggle for independence.According to Somalia’s Ministry of Interior, Xoosh praised Türkiye’s progress in strengthening its military capabilities, defense industry, economy and technology. He also highlighted Türkiye’s growing role in international efforts aimed at promoting peace and security.The minister particularly commended Türkiye for its continued support to Somalia in areas including state-building, security, military training and capacity-building, institutional development and efforts to strengthen stability . He described relations between Somalia and Türkiye as being based on friendship, mutual trust and strategic cooperation, while reaffirming the Federal Government of Somalia’s commitment to further strengthening bilateral ties.Türkiye marks Victory Day every year on August 30 in remembrance of the victory at the Battle of Dumlupınar in 1922. The battle was a decisive phase of the Turkish War of Independence and contributed to the establishment of the Republic of Türkiye.The Turkish Presidency’s Communications Directorate says the Great Offensive began on August 26, 1922, while the decisive Battle of Dumlupınar ended in victory on August 30. The anniversary is now one of Türkiye’s major national commemorations. The 2026 ceremony in Mogadishu comes as Somalia and Türkiye continue to deepen cooperation, particularly in security and defense, as well as economic development and institutional capacity-building.The event therefore served both as a commemoration of a defining moment in Türkiye’s modern history and as a reflection of the increasingly close strategic relationship between Mogadishu and Ankara.   The post Somalia and Turkey Celebrate Victory Day in Mogadishu first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somaliland and Afar diaspora engagement in the United States
items.description: It is truly encouraging to see members of the Somaliland and Afar diaspora communities in the United States engaging with one another, participating in each other’s community events, and strengthening relationships through dialogue and cooperation. As someone who has consistently advocated for greater engagement between Somalilanders and the Afar people, I am particularly pleased to see this taking place. Our communities are neighbors in the Horn of Africa, and geography, history, trade, security, and regional stability give us important shared interests. Our relationship should be founded on mutual respect, understanding, peaceful coexistence, and practical cooperation. It should never be directed against another community. Rather, it should focus on identifying areas where our peoples can work together for their mutual benefit and for the peace and prosperity of the wider Horn of Africa. What we are witnessing in Ohio is a positive example of the important role diaspora communities can play in building bridges that extend beyond borders. I sincerely welcome this engagement and hope to see Somaliland and Afar communities continue strengthening their relationship, identifying shared interests, and working side by side both in the diaspora and in the Horn of Africa. Neighbors in the Horn of Africa, partners in peace, cooperation, and shared prosperity.

items.title: Soomaaliya Iyo Türkiye Oo Muqdisho Ku Xusay Maalinta Guusha
items.description: MOGADISHU — Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta Soomaaliya Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh) ayaa magaalada Muqdisho kaga qaybgalay munaasabad lagu xusayay 104-guurada Maalinta Guusha iyo Maalinta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Türkiye , taas oo 30-ka Agoosto sannad kasta lagu xuso guushii muhiimka ahayd ee dagaalkii 1922. Munaasabadda waxaa soo qabanqaabisay Safaaradda Türkiye ee Muqdisho , waxaana ka qaybgalay Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya Bihi Iimaan Cige, Wasiirka Kalluumeysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga Axmed Xasan Aadan, Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, diblomaasiyiin iyo wakiillo ka socday hay’adaha Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye. Sida ay maanta baahisay warbaahinta Türkiye, munaasabadda waxaa lagu bilaabay akhrinta Qur’aanka Kariimka ah, kaddibna waxaa la qaaday heesaha qaranka labada dal. Wasiir Xoosh ayaa hambalyo u diray dowladda iyo shacabka Türkiye, isagoo munaasabadda ku tilmaamay mid xambaarsan xusuusta taariikhda iyo halgankii horseeday dhismaha Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye. Sida lagu sheegay qoraalka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Soomaaliya, Xoosh wuxuu sidoo kale bogaadiyay horumarka Türkiye ee dhinacyada ciidamada, warshadaha difaaca, dhaqaalaha iyo tiknoolajiyadda. Wuxuu sheegay in iskaashiga labada dal uu si gaar ah uga muuqdo dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska, amniga, tababarka iyo tayeynta ciidamada iyo horumarinta hay’adaha dowladda. Munaasabadda ayaa ku soo beegantay maalinta Türkiye looga dabaaldego 30-ka Agoosto Zafer Bayramı , ama Maalinta Guusha. Maalintan waxaa lagu xusaa guushii ciidamadii uu hoggaaminayay Mustafa Kemal Atatürk ay ka gaareen dagaalkii Dumlupınar ee 30-kii Agoosto 1922, kaas oo qayb muhiim ah ka ahaa Dagaalkii Xorriyadda ee Türkiye. Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Madaxtooyada Türkiye waxay sheegtay in guushaasi ay waddada u furtay aasaaska Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye. Sannadkan ayaa ah 104-guuradii dhacdadaas. Wasaaradda Difaaca Türkiye waxay xustay in weerarkii weynaa uu billowday 26-kii Agoosto 1922, halka dagaalkii go’aamiyay guusha uu Dumlupınar ku soo dhammaaday 30-kii Agoosto. Maalinta Guusha ayaa sidoo kale sanadkan si heer qaran ah looga xusay Türkiye. Madaxweynaha Türkiye Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa 30-kii Agoosto ka qaybgalay xuska lagu qabtay Anıtkabir, halkaas oo lagu maamuusay Mustafa Kemal Atatürk iyo ciidamadii ka qaybqaatay halgankii qaranka. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay si gaar ah ugu xoogaystay dhinacyada amniga, tababarka ciidamada, horumarinta hay’adaha dowladda iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale. Hadalka Wasiir Xoosh ee munaasabadda ayaa muujinaya sida dowladda Soomaaliya u aragto Ankara inuu yahay saaxiib istiraatiiji ah oo qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha iyo amniga Soomaaliya. Munaasabadda Muqdisho waxay sidaas ku noqotay mid isku keentay xuska taariikhda Türkiye iyo muujinta xiriirka sii xoogaysanaya ee u dhexeeya labada dowladood. The post Soomaaliya Iyo Türkiye Oo Muqdisho Ku Xusay Maalinta Guusha first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somalia’s govt, Al-Shabaab battle for Basra in second week
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s federal government forces and Al-Shabaab militants remained locked in intense fighting for a second consecutive week over the town of Basra, roughly an hour’s drive northwest of the capital, with no significant change in ground control reported by either side. Both the federal government and Al-Shabaab claimed to have inflicted heavy casualties on the other during the fighting, though none of the claims have been independently verified. A Gateway Town Basra’s importance lies less in its size than in its position on the map. The town sits on a road that links Bal’ad and Afgoye, both in the Shabelle Valley regions, towns that each host river-crossing bridges considered critical to Mogadishu’s security. Control of Basra effectively means control of movement along that corridor. Security analysts and residents believe the town functions as one of the main points through which militants infiltrate the capital. The terrain plays a role: the stretch of land along the Shabelle River near Basra borders Mogadishu’s Daynile district, a proximity that has allowed fighters to slip into neighborhoods on the capital’s outskirts, at night and, on occasion, even in daylight. A Familiar Pattern The current battle for Basra fits a pattern that has repeated itself for more than a decade. Somali security forces have captured the town more than a dozen times since 2011, the year Al-Shabaab withdrew from Mogadishu itself. Each time, however, troops have withdrawn from Basra after capturing it rather than holding the town for an extended period, allowing militants to return. That cycle has fed a recurring question among Somalis watching the conflict: after nearly two decades of fighting meant to degrade and ultimately defeat Al-Shabaab, how secure can the capital be when a town an hour’s drive away remains contested ground, changing hands again and again rather than staying under lasting government control. As of this week, the fighting in Basra continues, with both sides dug in and neither claiming a decisive breakthrough. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Go’aanka Koonfur Galbeed ka qaadatay Lafta-gareen oo dhaliyay falcelin xooggan
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Falcelin xooggan iyo hadal-heyn ayaa ka dhalatay go’aan maanta kasoo baxay Golaha Wasiirrada Koonfur Galbeed kadib markii ay liiska argagixisada ku dareen Madaxweynihii hore ee maamulkaas Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen iyo ciidamadiisa oo hadda dagaal kula jira maamulka uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe). Golaha Wasiirrada Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya oo shir aan caadi ahayn ka yeeshay dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay ayaa sheegay in loo adeegsaday qaraxyo, ayna si wdajir ah u fuliyeen ciidamada Lafta-gareen iyo kooxda Al-Shabaab. Sidoo kale, golaha ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Lafta-gareen iyo ciidamadiisa ay ku dareen liiska argagixisada, kadib qiimeyn ay ku sameeyeen sheegashadiisii ku aadaneyd weerarradii ay maalmo kahor kusoo qaadeen magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. “Goluhu markii uu si qoto dheer u falanqeeyay wareysigii uu bixiyay Cabdicasiis kaas oo uu ku sheegay in ciidamadiisu iyo kooxda Al-Shabaab ay si nabad ah u wada joogaan, ugana wada nool yihiin goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin iyo ficillada ay wada sameeyeen wuxuu goluhu si rasmi ah ugu aqoonsaday horjooge Lafta-gareen isaga iyo maleeshiyaadkiisa inay yihiin argagixiso si rasmi ah ugu biiray ulana midoobay Khawaarijta,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Dhanka kale, golaha ayaa farriin u diray dowladda Soomaaliya oo ay ka codsadeen inay xoojiso taageerada amni ee ay siiso Koonfur Galbeed, waxayna soo jeediyeen in si isku mid ah loola dagaalamo Lafta-gareen iyo Al-Shabaab. Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay go’aanka Koonfur Galbeed ka qaadatay Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen? Mukhtaar Cismaan: “Go’aanka iyo bayaanka kasoo baxay Golaha Wasiirada waa tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida Koonfur Galbeed”. Mubaarak Axmed “Haddii aad leedahay Laftagareen waa horjooge Al-Shabaab heshiis la ah, maxaa tallaabo ah oo laga qaaday? Laftagareen maanta Kenya ayuu joogaa—haddii hadalkaagu run yahay, caddeynta soo bandhig, sharcigana mari”. Cali Yare: “Shir aan caadi ahayn ku lahaa dadka Soomaaliyeed ee walaalaha ah ha’isku laynina”. Ismaaciin Warsame: Waan soo dhaweynayaa go’aanka dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, waana inay fulisaa amarkeeda”. Xuseen Daacad: “Noosoo gurmadeey miyey mareysaa falaari gilgilasho kaalama xarto”. Cabdifitaax Qaboobe: “Waa fuusto weyn inta aan lagu riixin asagaa isku riixay horjooge Laftagareen”. The post Go’aanka Koonfur Galbeed ka qaadatay Lafta-gareen oo dhaliyay falcelin xooggan appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Turkiye, Somalia forces free cargo vessel hijacked by pirates
items.description: Turkish and Somali forces have freed a cargo ship held captive by pirates off the coast of Somalia’s semi-autonomous Puntland state, according to authorities. In a statement on X on Saturday, the Somali Ministry of Defence said that “14 pirates” died in the operation to free the Cameroon-flagged MV Latuf. Four of their boats were also destroyed, it said. The Defence Ministry said that “sustained pressure from the forces ultimately compelled the remaining pirates to abandon the vessel”, allowing the forces to take control of the ship. The rescue operation was conducted under a defence cooperation agreement between Somalia and Turkiye, aimed at strengthening maritime security, protecting Somalia’s coastline and combating piracy, it said. The Somali Defence Ministry did not provide details about any casualties or the wellbeing of the ship’s crew. A local elder, Abdullahi Warsame, from the Jiifle community in the Godob Jiraan district of Puntland’s Nugal region, told The Associated Press news agency that the vessel and its crew had been freed. The MV Latuf left the Turkish Port of Tekirdag in late July. It was hijacked on August 17 in waters off the coast of the Nugal region of Puntland, a semi-autonomous federal state in northeastern Somalia. According to the Marine Traffic website, the cargo ship has continued its voyage to its reported destination in Dar-es-Salaam in Tanzania. Piracy was rampant off the coast of Somalia in the 2000s, peaking in 2011, before being curbed by international naval deployments and new protection measures for commercial shipping. But attacks have surged since April, with at least 15 attacks off the coast of Somalia this year, the highest since 2013, according to figures from the International Maritime Organization. At least five cargo ships have been held hostage, the last of which was seized on August 20 off the coast of Yemen. Al Jazeera.

items.title: Much Worship, Little Morality: What Is Wrong with Us?
items.description: Dr. Abdurahman Baadiyow There is a profound question that should touch both our hearts and our minds: How is it possible for a society so deeply attached to its religion to remain, for more than thirty years, trapped in collapse, conflict, division, poverty, misgovernance, and statelessness? Somalia presents a tragic example of the enormous gap between the worship we perform and the morality and conduct that our worship is supposed to produce. For more than three decades, the country’s political leaders have repeatedly reproduced the same political and social practices that contributed to the collapse of the state, while failing to build a functioning, legitimate, just, and citizen-oriented government. And yet Somalia is not a society without religion. Our mosques are full. We fast during Ramadan. We perform our prayers. Somali women widely observe the hijab. Thousands of Somalis travel to Mecca every year to perform ʿUmrah and Hajj. Religion is deeply embedded in our lives, our identity, and our culture. Yet a question inevitably rises from within: What is wrong with us? How is it possible that our mosques are full, our prayer rows are long, the Qur’an is recited, fasting is observed, and Hajj and ʿUmrah are performed—yet we remain unable to reconcile with one another, establish justice, protect the public interest, resist corruption, or build a functioning state? How is it possible that we are a nation blessed with vast territory, a rich coastline, abundant livestock, natural resources, a large population, and a strategically important geographic location, yet we have repeatedly failed even to feed ourselves adequately, while millions of our people depend on humanitarian assistance? How did a society that claims to place its trust in Allah come to fail so profoundly in making productive use of the resources Allah has bestowed upon it? Is the problem that we worship too little? Or is the deeper problem that we have understood worship as an end in itself, rather than as a means of cultivating good individuals and building a good society? Islam is built upon faith, worship, and morality. Worship is not an empty set of repeated movements; it is a process of disciplining and cultivating the soul. Prayer is meant to restrain a person from wrongdoing. Fasting is meant to teach self-control and God-consciousness. Zakat is meant to cultivate compassion and social awareness. Hajj is meant to strengthen brotherhood, equality, and mutual tolerance. Every act of worship should leave a visible mark on a person’s character and conduct. If prayer does not produce justice, if fasting does not produce self-restraint, if Hajj does not produce brotherhood, and if worship does not produce honesty and responsibility, then what benefit has our worship brought us? Worship that produces no moral transformation is like milk that has been churned repeatedly but from which no butter is produced. There is movement; there is effort; there may even be a powerful outward appearance of religiosity, but the expected result is nowhere to be seen. The Qur’an praises our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ with a profound description: “Indeed, you are of a great moral character.” (Qur’an 68:4). If our Prophet ﷺ was praised for his character, why do we sometimes measure our religiosity by how much we pray, how often we fast, or how many times we perform Hajj and ʿUmrah, rather than asking ourselves: Have we become more honest? Have we become more just? Have we become more compassionate? Have we become people who can be trusted? Do we love our brother what we love for ourselves? The Qur’an describes Muslims in these terms: “You are the best nation brought forth for humanity: you enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and believe in Allah.” (Qur’an 3:110). This is not an honor granted merely by carrying the name Muslim. It is a moral and social responsibility. It requires a community that enjoins what is right (al-maʿrūf), forbids what is wrong (al-munkar), upholds justice, rejects oppression, and stands with the vulnerable. So where are we today? Somalia has spent decades fighting itself. We have attempted countless agreements, held countless conferences, undertaken numerous state-building initiatives, and developed countless plans. Yet, time and again, we return to the same place. Clan-based politics, narrow interests, corruption, abuse of power, mistrust, and fragmentation continue to undermine the existence of the nation. What is most painful is that the problem does not exist only in politics; it reaches deep into the moral fabric of our society and its leadership. The person standing beside you in the mosque today may be the same person who takes away your rights tomorrow. A person who recites the Qur’an may at times participate in oppression or corruption. Someone who speaks to people in the name of religion may sometimes remain silent in the face of injustice. This is where we must have the courage to look honestly at ourselves. Has religion failed? Or have we failed to understand and practice religion sincerely? I believe the greatest problem is not Islam itself, but the gap between what we profess to believe and how we live. And this brings us back to leadership. Somalia will not be transformed simply by having more people who worship but lack moral character. It needs leaders of integrity and character. It does not need merely more institutions; it needs leadership capable of making those institutions function justly. It does not need merely more reconciliation conferences; it needs leaders capable of creating forgiveness, justice, and trust among the people. It does not need mere resources; it needs leadership capable of transforming those resources into public prosperity and national development. Leadership is the missing link. Genuine leadership is what transforms faith into morality, morality into action, action into institutions, and institutions into a functioning state. It is leadership capable of placing the national interest above personal ambition, clan interest, factional loyalty, and attachment to office. Therefore, the search for exceptional leadership must become our first priority. We need a generation of leaders who understand that public office is a responsibility, power is a trust, public wealth is a right that must never be violated, and justice is a duty that cannot be negotiated away. We need leaders whose faith produces morality; whose morality produces integrity; whose integrity produces trust; whose trust produces institutions; and whose institutions build a state. Ultimately, the question is not simply: “Are we Muslims? The deeper question is: “Has Islam transformed us?” Has our worship made us more just, more honest, more compassionate, more responsible, and more committed to serving society? Or have we become satisfied with the outward appearance of worship while losing the spirit and purpose through which worship was meant to transform us? And perhaps the most difficult question of all is this: Is our worship leading us toward success in this world and the Hereafter, or do we need to relearn how worship becomes morality, and how morality becomes a way of life? Perhaps Somalia’s transformation will not begin with another conference, another election, or another constitution. Perhaps it will begin in the heart of the individual, in the character of the leader, and in a proper understanding of the relationship between faith, worship, and social responsibility. items.title: DF oo xog cusub ka soo saartay qodista shidaalka iyo in si ka duwan sidii la filayey ay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Batroolka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka qodista shidaalka iyo gaaska ee Turkigu ka wado badda Soomaaliya uu ku socdo xawaare ka sarreeya sidii markii hore loo qorsheeyay, isla markaana suurta-gal ay tahay in la soo gabagabeeyo dhammaadka bisha September. Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Batroolka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Aadan, oo la hadlay Wakaaladda Wararka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed ee SONNA, ayaa sheegay in qodista ceelka Curad-1 ay hadda gaartay qiyaastii 3,000 oo mitir, isla markaana howshu si degdeg ah u socoto iyadoo aanay jirin wax caqabado farsamo ah. Qorshihii hore ayaa ahaa in qodista la soo gabagabeeyo bisha October, balse Cabdulqaadir ayaa sheegay in xawaaraha hadda lagu shaqeynayo uu horseedi karo in howsha la dhammeeyo bil ka hor waqtigaas. “Waxaa suurta-gal ah in la dhammeeyo dhammaadka September. October ayaa markii hore loo asteeyay waqtiga la soo gabagabeynayo,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in ilaa hadda aan la diiwaangelin wax shil ah ama cilad farsamo ah, isla markaana howlgalka loo fulinayo si waafaqsan heerarka badbaadada iyo farsamada. Qiyaastii 470 ilaa 480 qof ayaa ka shaqeynaya markabka qodista iyo maraakiibta kale ee taageeraya howlgalka, iyadoo muwaadiniinta Turkigu ay ka yihiin ku dhowaad 20 boqolkiiba shaqaalaha. Markabka casriga ah ee qodista badda qotada dheer ee Çağrı Bey ayaa qodista ka wada ceelka Curad-1, oo ku yaalla meel qiyaastii 370 kiiloomitir ka baxsan xeebta Muqdisho. Qorshuhu waa in qodista laga sii dhaadhaco ilaa 4,000 oo mitir oo ka hooseeya gunta badda, iyadoo guud ahaan ceelka la doonayo inuu gaaro qoto dhan 7,500 oo mitir. Howlgalkan ayaa ah markii ugu horreysay ee Turkigu howlgal qodis shidaal oo badda qoto dheer ah ka sameeyo meel ka baxsan biyihiisa. Markabka Çağrı Bey waxaa taageeraya maraakiibta Altan, Korkut iyo Sancar, halka ciidamada badda Turkiguna ay qeyb ka yihiin sugidda ammaanka maraakiibta ku howlan mashruuca. Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa bishii Maarso 2024 kala saxiixday heshiis dowladeed iyo is-afgarad ku saabsan iskaashiga shidaalka iyo gaaska, waxaana bishii July xigay heshiis wax-soo-saar wadaag ah oo daboolaya saddex xirmood oo shidaal baaris ah oo ku yaalla badda Soomaaliya. Markabka cilmi-baarista seismic-ka ee Oruç Reis ayaa markii dambe xog saddex-geesood ah ka ururiyay dhul-badeed gaaraya 4,464 kiiloomitir oo isku wareeg ah oo ka tirsan saddexda xirmood. Kadib ku dhowaad toddobo bilood oo sahanno iyo falanqeyn xogeed ah, ceelka Curad-1 ayaa loo doortay goobta ugu horreysa ee qodista, kadib markii la helay qaab-dhismeedyo dhuleed oo muujiyay rajo laga qabo jiritaanka shidaal ama gaas. Çağrı Bey oo lagu dhisay Kuuriyada Koonfureed sanadkii 2024 ayaa dhererkiisu yahay 228 mitir, wuxuuna awood u leeyahay inuu qodo ilaa 12,000 oo mitir. Natiijada kasoo baxda qodista Curad-1 ayaa door weyn ka qaadan doonta qiimeynta awoodda shidaal iyo gaas ee ku jirta badda Soomaaliya. Haddii qodistu xaqiijiso kayd ganacsi ahaan loo soo saari karo, waxay sidoo kale gogol-xaar u noqon kartaa in iskaashiga tamarta ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu u gudbo marxalad cusub. items.title: Baidoa Tense as Federal Forces Reinforce Contested Administration
items.description: Baidoa (WDN) — The Federal Government of Somalia has deployed additional security forces from Mogadishu to Baidoa, deepening an already volatile confrontation over the political future of South West State and raising fears that the federal authorities are preparing for a prolonged military standoff with forces loyal to former South West President Abdiasis Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. The reinforcements were reportedly flown into Baidoa strengthen security around key government installations and protect the administration headed by Sheikh Adan Mohamed Nur (Adan Madoobe), whose installation has been fiercely contested by Laftagareen and his supporters. Adan Madobe and Hassan Sheikh The deployment comes as forces aligned with Laftagareen are reportedly moving toward Baidoa, bringing the two sides closer to a potentially dangerous confrontation. At the heart of the dispute is a fundamental question of political legitimacy: who has the authority to govern South West State? Laftagareen and his supporters reject the federal government’s attempt to impose a new political order in the state, while Mogadishu has sought to portray the forces aligned with the former president as an armed threat to national security. There is, however, no independent confirmation that Laftagareen’s forces have been formally designated as a terrorist organization. A Political Dispute Becoming a Military Confrontation The arrival of additional federal forces illustrates the increasingly militarized nature of Somalia’s political disputes. Instead of resolving the crisis through an inclusive political process involving South West’s communities and political stakeholders, the confrontation is increasingly being shaped by the movement of troops and the control of strategic installations. Critics of the federal government argue that Mogadishu is using national security forces to protect a political arrangement that lacks broad legitimacy among sections of the South West population. They contend that the federal government is effectively treating a political dispute as a security problem. Laftagareen, meanwhile, has positioned himself as the defender of South West’s political autonomy and has vowed to resist what his supporters describe as federal encroachment. For his supporters, the struggle is not simply about one politician retaining power. It is portrayed as a broader fight over whether South West State should determine its own political leadership without coercion from Mogadishu. The most troubling dimension of the crisis is the potential human cost. Baidoa has already experienced years of insecurity, displacement and humanitarian hardship. Turning the city into the center of another armed confrontation could further destabilize the region, disrupt humanitarian operations and place civilians directly in the path of competing forces. It would also raise questions about the government’s priorities at a time when Somalia faces severe security challenges elsewhere. Every additional federal soldier deployed to defend a contested political authority is a soldier unavailable for the broader fight against Al-Shabaab. The government therefore faces a difficult strategic dilemma: can it afford to spend scarce military resources defending a disputed political arrangement while large parts of the country remain vulnerable to insurgent attacks? A Test of Federalism The Baidoa a confrontation may ultimately become one of the most consequential tests of Somalia’s federal system. If political disagreements between Mogadishu and the federal member states are repeatedly settled through military deployments rather than negotiation, Somalia risks transforming federalism into a permanent contest for control of territory and armed force. Laftagareen’s determination to resist the federal government’s pressure has already demonstrated that deploying more troops does not necessarily translate into political legitimacy. Conversely, military resistance alone cannot provide a sustainable political settlement. The only durable solution is likely to require a negotiated process in which the people of South West State have a meaningful voice in determining their political future. For now, however, Baydhaba is witnessing the dangerous collision of political legitimacy, federal authority and military power. And as more troops arrive, the question is no longer simply who controls the government buildings in Baidoa. The larger question is whether Somalia’s federal system can survive another political crisis in which guns increasingly threaten to replace dialogue. items.title: Somaliland Stands by Israel Alliance
items.description: Somaliland Stands by Israel Alliance Despite offers of substantial financial aid from Qatar and Saudi Arabia, the East African nation’s president has refused to abandon the strategic partnership established with Jerusalem last year view 1 comments Somaliland army (Photo: Republic of Somaliland) When Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, known as “Irro,” arrived in Jerusalem for a state visit last June, he delivered more than diplomatic pleasantries. According to foreign reports, his trip came amid intense behind-the-scenes pressure from Arab nations, led by Qatar and Saudi Arabia , attempting to derail the young alliance between his country and Israel. The relationship began making history in December 2025, when Israel became the first UN member state to formally recognize Somaliland as an independent, sovereign nation. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and President Irro signed the groundbreaking agreement, which culminated in the June 2026 state visit that included the opening of Somaliland’s embassy in Jerusalem and the signing of a comprehensive strategic partnership. The public embrace of Israel triggered swift backlash across the Arab world. Qatar , which serves as a patron to the Somali government in Mogadishu, condemned the move as a “dangerous precedent.” Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Egypt quickly joined in criticizing Israel’s diplomatic breakthrough in the region. Foreign sources report that an unprecedented pressure campaign was launched against Hargeisa, Somaliland’s capital, aimed at freezing or reversing the budding relationship with Jerusalem. A senior Qatari delegation reportedly offered massive financial packages for security and infrastructure development in exchange for Somaliland turning its back on Israel. President Irro stood firm. He forcefully rejected the pressure and made clear to intermediaries that relations with Israel represent a closed national decision not open to negotiation. The message from Hargeisa was unambiguous: sovereignty cannot be purchased, regardless of the sum offered. This steadfast position was on display during the official reception ceremony at the President’s Residence in Jerusalem. President Isaac Herzog and First Lady Michal Herzog welcomed President Irro and First Lady Fardowsa Mohamed Roble in a formal ceremony, followed by a state meeting and joint statements to the press. Kobi Gidon / GPO Somaliland parade In February, Somaliland’s first ambassador to Israel, Dr. Mohamed Hagi, presented his credentials to President Herzog at the President’s Residence. The ambassador announced that President Irro would soon visit Israel officially, emphasizing that the partnership would be strategic and encompass multiple sectors. Ambassador Hagi detailed that bilateral relations would include cooperation in security, energy, science, and agriculture. He noted that Somaliland’s citizens deeply appreciate Israel’s pioneering recognition—both in 1960 and again now. The strategic significance of this alliance extends far beyond symbolism. Somaliland sits along the Gulf of Aden and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait—a critical shipping route constantly threatened by Houthi terrorism from Yemen. For Israel, this represents a strategic foothold facing Red Sea threats; for Somaliland, international recognition is an existential asset. The Israel-Somaliland alliance continues to generate geopolitical reverberations. While regional powers pour enormous sums and deploy veiled threats to isolate Israel, one nation sitting astride the world’s most strategic chokepoint has simply refused to blink or succumb to financial temptation. During celebrations marking Somaliland’s 35th independence anniversary, featuring an impressive military parade in Hargeisa, the president received a symbolic gesture: a traditional Jewish menorah presented by the Israeli delegation. President Irro shared that he had spoken by phone with Prime Minister Netanyahu, who offered congratulations to him and his people on their independence day.     Source click here

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and President Irro signed the groundbreaking agreement, which culminated in the June 2026 state visit that included the opening of Somaliland’s embassy in Jerusalem and the signing of a comprehensive strategic partnership. The public embrace of Israel triggered swift backlash across the Arab world. Qatar , which serves as a patron to the Somali government in Mogadishu, condemned the move as a “dangerous precedent.” Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Egypt quickly joined in criticizing Israel’s diplomatic breakthrough in the region. Foreign sources report that an unprecedented pressure campaign was launched against Hargeisa, Somaliland’s capital, aimed at freezing or reversing the budding relationship with Jerusalem. A senior Qatari delegation reportedly offered massive financial packages for security and infrastructure development in exchange for Somaliland turning its back on Israel. President Irro stood firm. He forcefully rejected the pressure and made clear to intermediaries that relations with Israel represent a closed national decision not open to negotiation. The message from Hargeisa was unambiguous: sovereignty cannot be purchased, regardless of the sum offered. This steadfast position was on display during the official reception ceremony at the President’s Residence in Jerusalem. President Isaac Herzog and First Lady Michal Herzog welcomed President Irro and First Lady Fardowsa Mohamed Roble in a formal ceremony, followed by a state meeting and joint statements to the press. Kobi Gidon / GPO Somaliland parade In February, Somaliland’s first ambassador to Israel, Dr. Mohamed Hagi, presented his credentials to President Herzog at the President’s Residence. The ambassador announced that President Irro would soon visit Israel officially, emphasizing that the partnership would be strategic and encompass multiple sectors. Ambassador Hagi detailed that bilateral relations would include cooperation in security, energy, science, and agriculture. He noted that Somaliland’s citizens deeply appreciate Israel’s pioneering recognition—both in 1960 and again now. The strategic significance of this alliance extends far beyond symbolism. Somaliland sits along the Gulf of Aden and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait—a critical shipping route constantly threatened by Houthi terrorism from Yemen. For Israel, this represents a strategic foothold facing Red Sea threats; for Somaliland, international recognition is an existential asset. The Israel-Somaliland alliance continues to generate geopolitical reverberations. While regional powers pour enormous sums and deploy veiled threats to isolate Israel, one nation sitting astride the world’s most strategic chokepoint has simply refused to blink or succumb to financial temptation. During celebrations marking Somaliland’s 35th independence anniversary, featuring an impressive military parade in Hargeisa, the president received a symbolic gesture: a traditional Jewish menorah presented by the Israeli delegation. President Irro shared that he had spoken by phone with Prime Minister Netanyahu, who offered congratulations to him and his people on their independence day.     Source click here

items.title: Fierce Fighting Near Balcad Highlights Somalia’s Struggle to Dislodge Al-Shabaab
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Heavy fighting has erupted in Basra, near Balcad in Middle Shabelle, after Somali government forces launched an assault on an Al-Shabaab position in a strategically important area linking central and southern Somalia. The fighting reportedly involved repeated exchanges of heavy weapons, while government forces are said to have deployed drones against Al-Shabaab positions. Casualties have reportedly been sustained by both sides, although the number of dead and wounded has not been independently verified. Basra’s importance lies in its location. The area sits along a key corridor connecting Balcad and Afgooye, close to routes linking Mogadishu with Middle and Lower Shabelle. Al-Shabaab has maintained a presence in this wider area for years, allowing the group to exert pressure over movement between major towns. The security situation along the Balcad–Jowhar corridor illustrates the extent of the government’s limited control. Despite Jowhar being the capital of Hirshabelle and relatively close to Mogadishu, security concerns have made road travel difficult, with government officials frequently relying on air transport to reach the city. That reality underscores a fundamental weakness in Somalia’s security and state-building effort: The government continues to struggle to wage a strategically coordinated and militarily organized campaign against extremist group, undermining efforts to restore security and stability across the country and guarantee safe movement between its own administrative centers. Rather than relying on haphazard, sporadic, and un-sustained clashes here and there. The real test is what happens after the fighting The assault on Basra is significant, but capturing a position is only the beginning. Somalia has repeatedly faced the challenge of consolidating military gains after Al-Shabaab is pushed out. Without a sustained security presence, effective local administration and protection for civilians, territory seized during an offensive can quickly become vulnerable to infiltration or renewed attacks. Al-Shabaab has spent years establishing networks across parts of southern Somalia. Its ability to operate from surrounding areas means that government forces can face a difficult choice between maintaining newly captured positions and defending other vulnerable fronts. This makes the battle for Basra more than a contest over a single settlement. Control of the surrounding roads and communities will determine whether any government advance has lasting strategic value. The latest offensive therefore raises several critical questions: Can government forces hold the territory if they succeed in taking it? Can they secure the roads linking Balcad, Jowhar and Afgooye? And can the government establish enough security to allow civilians and businesses to return to normal life? For now, the fighting offers another stark reminder of the gap between military offensives and effective territorial control. Somalia does not merely need to capture territory from Al-Shabaab. It needs the capacity to hold it, govern it and protect it. Until that happens, every battlefield victory risks becoming temporary—and every withdrawal risks giving Al-Shabaab another opportunity to return. items.title: Galmudug’s Fragile Stability Shatters Again, Just Days After Supreme Court Election Ruling
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (WDN) — Galmudug’s already fragile political stability has come under renewed strain, just two days after Somalia’s Supreme Court annulled the disputed July 30 elections, with a fresh confrontation now unfolding between the regional parliament and the Galmudug leadership. In a dramatic development, security forces were reportedly deployed around the residence of Mohamed Ali Gacal, Speaker of the Galmudug Parliament, in Dhusamareeb, as he was preparing to convene a parliamentary session. Sources in the regional capital said Gacal had been planning to formally open the parliamentary session and potentially advance a motion targeting the administration of Galmudug President Ahmed Abdi Kariye, Qoor Qoor. The deployment of security forces has heightened fears that the political dispute could escalate into a broader institutional and security confrontation. The timing could hardly be more revealing. Only two days earlier, the Supreme Court annulled the results of Galmudug’s elections for parliament and local councils, ruling that the July 30 polls had violated Somalia’s Constitution and electoral law. The court ordered that the elections be conducted again, while allowing the existing institutions to remain in place until new representatives are elected. Instead of producing political calm, the ruling appears to have opened another chapter in Galmudug’s increasingly unstable political landscape. A crisis within a crisis The confrontation between Gacal and Qoor Qoor is unfolding against the backdrop of a much broader dispute over how Galmudug’s political institutions and electoral process have been managed. Gacal has previously expressed dissatisfaction with the way the Federal Government handled the Galmudug elections, signaling growing divisions between regional institutions and Mogadishu. The reported deployment of security forces at the Speaker’s residence now takes that political disagreement into a far more dangerous territory. If security forces are being used to prevent the head of the regional legislature from carrying out his constitutional responsibilities, the incident raises fundamental questions about the independence of Galmudug’s institutions and the rule of law. The authorities have not publicly provided a definitive explanation for why the forces were deployed, who ordered them to surround the Speaker’s residence, or whether the operation was directly connected to the planned parliamentary session. The Supreme Court ruling has not settled the crisis The court’s decision was expected to provide a legal framework for resolving the disputed elections. Instead, the speed with which a new confrontation has emerged demonstrates how deeply fractured Galmudug’s political system has become. The annulled election was already controversial. Now, rather than concentrating on implementing the court’s decision and preparing a credible new electoral process, the regional leadership appears to be facing another institutional showdown. The danger is that political disputes in Galmudug can quickly acquire a security dimension. Dhusamareeb has witnessed repeated political tensions in recent years, and the deployment of armed personnel around political leaders risks turning disagreements that should be settled through parliament, courts and dialogue into confrontations on the streets. For Galmudug, the immediate question is no longer simply who won an election that the Supreme Court has already annulled. It is whether the region’s political actors can respect the court’s ruling, preserve the independence of its institutions and prevent another political dispute from becoming a security crisis. Two days after the Supreme Court closed one disputed chapter, Galmudug appears to have opened another. The speed of the latest deterioration is a sobering reminder of just how fragile political stability remains in the state—and how easily a constitutional dispute can become a confrontation involving armed forces. items.title: Shaqaalaha DF Soomaaliya oo lagu soo rogay amar culus
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xisaabiyaha guud ee dowladda, Maxamed Maxamuud Cabdulle oo maanta warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa mar culus dul-dhigay dhammaan shaqaalaha dowladda Soomaaliya, kaas oo la xiriira qaadashada Kaarka Aqoonsiga Qaranka ee NIRA. Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud ayaa wasaaradaha, hay’adaha iyo xafiisyada Dowladda Federaalka ku wargeliyay in la hirgelinayo isku-xirka nidaamka mushahar-bixinta dowladda (Payroll/SFMIS) iyo nidaamka Aqoonsiga NIRA. Sida lagu sheegay qoraalka wajiga koowaad ee hirgelinta nidaamkan, waxaa la soo xuli doonaa shan hay’adood oo lagu fulin doono tijaabada hordhaca ah (Pilot Test), taas oo bilaaban doonta bisha 1 Oktoobar ee sanadkan 2026. Sidoo kale, natiijada tijaabada kadib, nidaamka waxa si tartiib-tartiib ah loogu ballaarin doonaa dhammaan hay’adaha kale ee dowladda, iyadoo dhaqangelinta buuxda la qorsheynayo bisha 31 Diseembar ee 2027. Ujeedka ugu wayn ee barnaamijkan ayaa ah in la xaqiijiyo xogta saxda ah ee shaqaalaha dowladda Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo lagu saleynayo aqoonsiga rasmiga ah, waxana sidoo kale la xoojin doonaa hufnaanta shaqada iyo isla xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda. “Hirgelinta nidaamkan waxaa looga gol leeyahay xaqiijinta aqoonsiga iyo saxnaanta xogta shaqaalaha dowladda, xoojinta hufnaanta iyo isla-xisaabtanka mushahar-bixinta, iyo hubinta in mushaharka dowladda la siiyo shaqaalaha xaqa u leh oo keliya,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Sidaas darteed, hay’ad kasta waxaa laga codsanayaa in ay dib u hubiso xogta shaqaalaheeda ku jira nidaamka mushahar-bixinta, isla markaana ku wargeliso shaqaalaha aan weli haysan Aqoonsiga Qaranka inay si degdeg ah isaga diiwaangeliyaan Hay’adda NIRA”. Dhinaca kale, xisaabiyaha guud ee qaranka ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in shaqaalaha aan qaadan kaarka NIRA uu saameyn doono nidaamka cusub, gaar ahaan mushaar-bixinta oo lagu xiri doono Kaarka Aoonsiga NIRA. “Marka isku-xirkan si rasmi ah loo dhaqan-geliyo, shaqaale aan haysan Aqoonsiga Qaranka ee NIRA ama aan xogtiisa lagu xaqiijin nidaamka, wuxuu saameyn doonaa Nidaamka Mushahar-bixinta Hay’adda,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Ugu dambeyn waxaa farriin loo diray dhammaan hay’adaha dowladda oo laga codsaday in ay arrintaan siiyaan mudnaan gaar ah, ayna dhammaystiraan hubinta xogta iyo diiwaangelinta shaqaalahooda, si looga fogaado dib-u-dhac ama caqabad ku yimaada nidaamka hufnaanta Maaliyadda. The post Shaqaalaha DF Soomaaliya oo lagu soo rogay amar culus appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Pheromone Maxxing:Rag Ka Taga Qubayska Si Ay U Soo Jiitaan Dumaraka.
items.description: Dhaqan cusub oo baraha bulshada, gaar ahaan TikTok, ku faafaya ayaa qaar ka mid ah ragga ku dhiirrigelinaya inay iska dhaafaan qubayska iyo carfiska si ay u xoojiyaan waxa ay ugu yeeraan “pheromone maxxing” fikrad ku dhisan in urta dabiiciga ah ee jirku ay kordhin karto soo jiidashada qofka. Dadka raacaya isbeddelkan ayaa qaarkood sheegaya inaysan isticmaalin deodorant, ay dib u dhigaan qubayska ama ay xirtaan dhar dhidid leh, iyagoo aaminsan in sidaas lagu ilaalin karo “natural musk”, oo ay u arkaan inuu yahay ur dabiici ah oo qofka kale soo jiidan kara. Warbixinno dhowaan laga qoray isbeddelkan ayaa sidoo kale xusay sheegashooyin ka sii daran, oo ay ku jirto cabbidda kaadida qofka si loo kordhiyo saameyntaas. Laakiin cilmi-baaristu ma taageerayso fikradda ah in qofku iska dhaafo nadaafadda si uu u noqdo mid soo jiidasho badan. Pheromones waa walxo kiimiko ah oo noocyo badan oo xayawaan ah isticmaalaan si ay u gudbiyaan calaamado la xiriira taranka, deegaanka ama dhaqanka. Dhibaatadu waxay tahay in saynisyahannadu aysan weli si cad u xaqiijin jiritaanka pheromone bani’aadam oo gaar ah oo si joogto ah u kicisa soo jiidashada galmada ama dabeecad gaar ah. Scientific American ayaa hore u soo bandhigtay cilmi-baarista ku saabsan urta jidhka iyo pheromones-ka dadka, iyadoo xustay in urta jidhku saameyn ku yeelan karto sida dadka isu arkaan, balse aan la helin caddayn muujinaysa jawaab dabeecadeed oo xooggan oo joogto ah oo ay keento hal walax kiimiko ah oo bani’aadamku soo saaro. Mid ka mid ah walxaha sida weyn loo baaray waa androstadienone (AND) , oo inta badan laga helo dheecaannada ragga, gaar ahaan dhididka kilkilaha. Walaxdan ayaa muddo loo arkayay inay noqon karto musharrax pheromone-ka ragga. Hase yeeshee, dib-u-eegis cilmiyeed oo lagu daabacay Physiology & Behavior bishii Janaayo 2025 ayaa dib u eegtay daraasado badan oo ku saabsan androstadienone. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay sheegeen in natiijooyinka daraasadaha ay yihiin kuwo aan isku mid ahayn, hababka cilmi-baaristuna aysan weli lahayn heer isku mid ah oo lagu go’aamin karo saameynteeda. Sidaas darteed, waxay ku soo gabagabeeyeen in aan weli la xaqiijin in androstadienone loo aqoonsan karo pheromone galmo oo bani’aadam ah. Taasi macnaheedu ma aha in urta dabiiciga ah ee qofku aysan wax saameyn ah ku lahayn soo jiidashada . Cilmi-baaristu waxay muujisay in dadka ay dareemi karaan oo ay ka falcelin karaan urta jidhka dadka kale. Laakiin saameyntaas ayaa aad uga murugsan fikradda ah in hal “pheromone” uu qofka kale si toos ah uga dhigo mid soo jiita. Qaybta ugu walaaca badan ee isbeddelkan waa talada ku saabsan cabbidda kaadida . Ma jiro caddayn cilmiyeed oo muujinaysa in cabbidda kaadidu kordhiso pheromones-ka ama soo jiidashada qofka. Hay’adda Poison Control waxay sheegtay in kaadidu ka kooban tahay biyo iyo walxo qashin ah oo jirku soo saaray, ayna jiri karaan bakteeriyo; sidaas darteed laguma talinayo in la cabo. Cabbitaankeedu wuxuu keeni karaa lallabbo, matag ama shuban. Dhakhaatiirta Cleveland Clinic-na waxay sidoo kale beeniyeen fikradda ah in kaadidu tahay walax nadiif ah ama daawo, iyagoo xusay in cabbiddeedu ay dib ugu soo celin karto jirka milix iyo walxo qashin ah, isla markaana ay xaaladaha qaarkood ka sii dari karto fuuqbaxa. “Pheromone maxxing” wuxuu qayb ka yahay dhaqdhaqaaq ballaaran oo internetka ka jira oo loo yaqaan “looksmaxxing” , kaas oo dhalinyarada ku dhiirrigeliya farsamooyin kala duwan oo ay ku doonayaan inay sare ugu qaadaan muuqaalka iyo soo jiidashada qofka. Isbeddelkan cusub wuxuu fikraddaas ka soo wareejinayaa muuqaalka oo keliya, wuxuuna xoogga saaraya urta dabiiciga ah ee jirka. Si kastaba, waxa hadda la xaqiijin karo waa in cilmi-baaristu aysan taageerin sheegashada ah in ka tagista qubayska ama deodorant-ku ay qofka ka dhigayaan mid si gaar ah u soo jiita dadka kale . Caddaynta ku saabsan pheromones-ka bani’aadamka ayaa weli aan go’aan kama dambeys ah laga gaarin, halka cabbidda kaadidana aysan lahayn faa’iido cilmiyeed la xaqiijiyay. Marka la eego xogta hadda la hayo “pheromone maxxing” wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu ka badan yahay isbeddel baraha bulshada ku dhisan iyo fasiraad la buunbuuniyay oo cilmi-baaris aan weli go’aan laga gaarin , halkii uu ahaan lahaa hab cilmi ahaan loo xaqiijiyay oo lagu kordhiyo soo jiidashada. Laakiin cilmi-baaristu ma taageerayso fikradda ah in qofku iska dhaafo nadaafadda si uu u noqdo mid soo jiidasho badan. Pheromones waa walxo kiimiko ah oo noocyo badan oo xayawaan ah isticmaalaan si ay u gudbiyaan calaamado la xiriira taranka, deegaanka ama dhaqanka. Dhibaatadu waxay tahay in saynisyahannadu aysan weli si cad u xaqiijin jiritaanka pheromone bani’aadam oo gaar ah oo si joogto ah u kicisa soo jiidashada galmada ama dabeecad gaar ah. Scientific American ayaa hore u soo bandhigtay cilmi-baarista ku saabsan urta jidhka iyo pheromones-ka dadka, iyadoo xustay in urta jidhku saameyn ku yeelan karto sida dadka isu arkaan, balse aan la helin caddayn muujinaysa jawaab dabeecadeed oo xooggan oo joogto ah oo ay keento hal walax kiimiko ah oo bani’aadamku soo saaro. Mid ka mid ah walxaha sida weyn loo baaray waa androstadienone (AND) , oo inta badan laga helo dheecaannada ragga, gaar ahaan dhididka kilkilaha. Walaxdan ayaa muddo loo arkayay inay noqon karto musharrax pheromone-ka ragga. Hase yeeshee, dib-u-eegis cilmiyeed oo lagu daabacay Physiology & Behavior bishii Janaayo 2025 ayaa dib u eegtay daraasado badan oo ku saabsan androstadienone. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay sheegeen in natiijooyinka daraasadaha ay yihiin kuwo aan isku mid ahayn, hababka cilmi-baaristuna aysan weli lahayn heer isku mid ah oo lagu go’aamin karo saameynteeda. Sidaas darteed, waxay ku soo gabagabeeyeen in aan weli la xaqiijin in androstadienone loo aqoonsan karo pheromone galmo oo bani’aadam ah. Taasi macnaheedu ma aha in urta dabiiciga ah ee qofku aysan wax saameyn ah ku lahayn soo jiidashada . Cilmi-baaristu waxay muujisay in dadka ay dareemi karaan oo ay ka falcelin karaan urta jidhka dadka kale. Laakiin saameyntaas ayaa aad uga murugsan fikradda ah in hal “pheromone” uu qofka kale si toos ah uga dhigo mid soo jiita. Qaybta ugu walaaca badan ee isbeddelkan waa talada ku saabsan cabbidda kaadida . Ma jiro caddayn cilmiyeed oo muujinaysa in cabbidda kaadidu kordhiso pheromones-ka ama soo jiidashada qofka. Hay’adda Poison Control waxay sheegtay in kaadidu ka kooban tahay biyo iyo walxo qashin ah oo jirku soo saaray, ayna jiri karaan bakteeriyo; sidaas darteed laguma talinayo in la cabo. Cabbitaankeedu wuxuu keeni karaa lallabbo, matag ama shuban. Dhakhaatiirta Cleveland Clinic-na waxay sidoo kale beeniyeen fikradda ah in kaadidu tahay walax nadiif ah ama daawo, iyagoo xusay in cabbiddeedu ay dib ugu soo celin karto jirka milix iyo walxo qashin ah, isla markaana ay xaaladaha qaarkood ka sii dari karto fuuqbaxa. “Pheromone maxxing” wuxuu qayb ka yahay dhaqdhaqaaq ballaaran oo internetka ka jira oo loo yaqaan “looksmaxxing” , kaas oo dhalinyarada ku dhiirrigeliya farsamooyin kala duwan oo ay ku doonayaan inay sare ugu qaadaan muuqaalka iyo soo jiidashada qofka. Isbeddelkan cusub wuxuu fikraddaas ka soo wareejinayaa muuqaalka oo keliya, wuxuuna xoogga saaraya urta dabiiciga ah ee jirka. Si kastaba, waxa hadda la xaqiijin karo waa in cilmi-baaristu aysan taageerin sheegashada ah in ka tagista qubayska ama deodorant-ku ay qofka ka dhigayaan mid si gaar ah u soo jiita dadka kale . Caddaynta ku saabsan pheromones-ka bani’aadamka ayaa weli aan go’aan kama dambeys ah laga gaarin, halka cabbidda kaadidana aysan lahayn faa’iido cilmiyeed la xaqiijiyay. Marka la eego xogta hadda la hayo “pheromone maxxing” wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu ka badan yahay isbeddel baraha bulshada ku dhisan iyo fasiraad la buunbuuniyay oo cilmi-baaris aan weli go’aan laga gaarin , halkii uu ahaan lahaa hab cilmi ahaan loo xaqiijiyay oo lagu kordhiyo soo jiidashada.
