items.title: Ciidamo xoojin ah oo la geeyay Magaalada Baydhabo (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka ayaa maanta ciidamo kale oo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Gorgor, waxay gaysay Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Ciidamadan ayaa waxaa lagu soo dhaweeyay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud, iyagoona la socday diyaarad ka timid dhinaca Caasimadda Muqdisho. Saraakiisha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee fadhigoodu yahay Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa kuu sheegaya in ciidamadan ay kordhin cusub u noqon doonaan ciidamada kale ee ku sugan duleedyada magaaladaasi. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa taageero buuxda siineysa maamulka cusub ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee uu madaxda u yahay Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), kaas oo wajahaya mucaaradad xoog leh oo kaga imaneysa Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo ciidamada taabacsan ay culeys amni ku hayaan magaaladaasi. Dhanka kale Taliyaha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Isaaq Aadan Berdaale iyo Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Isaaq Maxamed Isaaq (Koosaar) ayaa Sabtidan isla shir guddoomiyay kulan looga hadlayay dib-u-habaynta ciidamada, amniga iyo difaaca Baydhabo. Kulanka oo ay ka qaybgaleen Saraakiil uu ka mid yahay Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Baay, Korneyl Mukhtaar Maxamed Dugudow ayaa diiradda lagu saaray, sidii Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ay wada-shaqayn dhow u yeelan lahaayeen, loona adkayn lahaa difaaca magaalada. Xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo midka ciidan ee ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed, una u dhexeeya maamulka hadda jira iyo hoggaankii hore ayaa si taban u saameynaya xasilloonida Baydhabo, bacdamaa ay Baydhabo tahay Xarunta KMG Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Beeraleyda Shabeellaha Hoose oo Dowladda u Gudbiyay Cabashooyin La Xiriira Howlgallada Amniga
items.description: Wasiirka Beeraha iyo Waraabka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xildhibaan Maxamed Cabdi Xayir (Maareeye), Wasiiru Dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Cumar Cali Cabdi iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka, Sareeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, ayaa kulan la yeeshay qaar ka mid ah beeraleyda gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Beeraleyda ayaa mas’uuliyiinta u gudbiyay cabashooyin ku saabsan dhibaatooyin ay sheegeen in kooxda Al-Shabaab ay ku hayso deegaannadooda, iyo sidoo kale waxyeellooyin ka dhashay qaar ka mid ah howlgalladii amni ee dhowaan ka dhacay gobolka. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa dhageystay cabashooyinka beeraleyda, iyagoo ballanqaaday in arrimaha la diiwaangelin doono lana gaarsiin doono hay’adaha ay khuseyso si loo baaro. Waxay sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyeen muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta shacabka, hantidooda iyo wax-soo-saarka beeraha inta ay socdaan howlgallada amniga.

items.title: Turkigu waa gumaysi casriyaysan:  Is bar bardhiga caruurta Somalia iyo Somalia
items.description: Turkigu waa gumaysi casriyaysan oo doonaaya in uu baahida iyo dawlad laanta ka jirta Somalia uu kaga faa’iidaysto arimo dhaqaale. 35 sano ayay beesha caalmku caawinaysay Somalia wali lama arag dal caruurta gaajoonaysa calankiisa ku soo sawira arinkaasi oo ah wax aan la aqbqli karin. Caruurta Somalia gaajo ma hayso ee waxa haysa dawlad xumo, madaxda Somalia ee dalkooda ka iibinaaya ee lacagta ka qaadnaaya gumaysiga Turkiga waa in ay caruurtooda u tudhaan oo dalkooda dhistaan. Sawiradani waa caruur ka kid ah caruurta dugsiyada Hargeisa Somaliland oo abaal marin la siinaayo Waxa aad eegtaan sida ay isu maamulaan ee Caruurtooda u dhisaan dadka reer Somaliland , caruurta reer Somaliland ayaa hela waxbarasho, amaan iyaga oo hiigsanaaya mustaqbalka in ay noqdaan kuwa dalkooda iyo dadkooda anfacaan. Dawlada Turkigu waxa ay doonysàa in ay Somaliland dhib u geysato si loo baryo arinkaasi oo shicbi ka iyo dawlada Somaliland ka diideen. Dadka reer Somalia waa in ay Turkiga iska saaraan oo ka xoroobaan cuntada lagu gumausanaayo dalkoodana lagu qaadanaayo. Waa in ay ku daydaan dawladda iyo shicibka Somaliland ee xorta ah.

items.title: Somali Senator Calls for Elections
items.description: Senator, a member of the Upper House of Somalia’s Federal Parliament, has staged a protest inside the chamber, declaring that his term has expired and accusing the government of operating illegally. The Senator, who represents Puntland, claimed that the government no longer has the authority to pass new laws and that its only legitimate role is to consult on preparations for elections. The protest, though carried out by a single senator, has highlighted the growing political tension between the Federal Government of Somalia and the Puntland administration. Senator Qaybdiid, a former member of the constitutional review and monitoring committee, was elected to the Upper House in 2016. The Senator argued that the parliamentary term has ended, and the President’s term expired on 15 May 2026. According to him, the government cannot create new legislation and must instead focus on consultations to prepare for elections. He accused President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of overstepping his constitutional duties, stating: “The President no longer holds a valid mandate. He was given a four-year term, and that time has now passed.” Puntland has officially declared that it no longer recognises Hassan Sheikh Mohamud as president, arguing that he lacks the legal authority to lead the federal government. The administration has also called on international partners and donors to engage directly with Puntland until a legitimate federal structure is established. This development comes amid deep political divisions, with Puntland describing Somalia as being in a “transitional period,” while the federal government insists that constitutional amendments have extended presidential terms until 2027. The post Somali Senator Calls for Elections first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Xildhibaan Aqalka Sare Ah Oo Dalbaday Doorasho
items.description: Xildhibaan, oo ka tirsan Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, ayaa ku mudaaharaaday gudaha Aqalka Sare, isagoo ku andacoonaya in muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday isla markaana dowladdu si sharci-darro ah u waddo hawlaheeda. Xildhibaanku wuxuu sheegay in aan la haynin sharci cusub oo ay ku shaqeeyaan, isla markaana awooddu ay ku jirto wada-tashiyo diyaarinta doorashada, balse aanay dhalin karin saarka qaranka. Mudaaharaadkan keli ahaanta ah ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu soo kordhiyay xiisadda siyaasadeed ee u dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Puntland, kuwaas oo ku muransan ansaxnimada dastuuriga ah iyo habka doorashooyinka. Xildhibaan Qaybdiid ayaa horey uga mid ahaa xubnaha guddiga dib u eegista iyo la socodka dastuurka, waxaana la doortay Aqalka Sare sanadkii 2016 . Xildhibaanku waxa uu sheegay in muddo-xileedkii Baarlamaanku uu dhammaaday, halka muddo-xileedkii Madaxweynuhu uu dhammaaday 15-kii Maajo 2026. Sida uu sheegayo, dowladda ma samayn karto sharciyo cusub, waxayna u baahan tahay in la yeesho wada-tashiyo lagu diyaariyo doorasho. Xildhibaan Qaybdiid ayaa ku eedeeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh inuu ka gudbay waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah, isagoo sheegay in madaxweynuhu aanu haynin mas’uuliyad joogto ah oo dalka ah, waxaana loo dhiibay waqti afar sano ah oo hadda dhammaaday. Puntland ayaa si rasmi ah u sheegtay inay aqoonsan tahay Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud “madaxweyne hore”, iyadoo ku andacootay inuusan lahayn sharci awood u siinaysa inuu u adeegsato xilka Madaxtooyada Federaalka . Xiisaddani waxay soo kordheyso xilli ay jiraan isku-dhacyo ku aaddan kala qaybsanaanta siyaasadeed, iyadoo Puntland ay sheegtay in dalku yahay meel kala-guur ah, halka dowladda federaalkuna ay ku adkaysanayso in isbeddellada dastuuriga ah ay kordhiyeen waqtiga xilka ilaa 2027. The post Xildhibaan Aqalka Sare Ah Oo Dalbaday Doorasho first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Ray Dalio: Waxaynu Galnay Dagaal Adduun!
items.description: Ray Dalio waa maalgashade bilyaneer ah, oo reer Maraykan ah. Sida oo kale waa qoraa caan ah oo wax ka qora arrimaha ganacsiga, nolosha iyo siyaasadda. Isaga oo kaashanaya khibraddiisa dhanka maalgashiga, wuxuu qormadan ku sheegayaa inay dunidu gashay dagaal adduun: Marka hore wanaag ayaan idiin rajaynayaa waayahan adag. Marka xiga sawirka aan ku sawirayo qormadani maaha ka aan doonayo inuu dhab noqdo, balse waa sawirka aan aamminsanahay inuu run yahay, aniga oo ka duulaya waxyaabaha aan bartay iyo waxay i tusayaan tilmaamayaasha  aan adeegsanayo si aan arrimaha ugu eego si mawduuci ah. Maadaama aan ahay maalgashade dhaqaalaha guud ee caalamiga ah muddo ka badan konton sanno, waxaan u baahday muddadaas inaan daraaseeyo arrimihii saameeyay suuqyada shantii boqol ee sanno ee ugu danbeeyay, si aan u ogaado sida aan ula dhaqmayo waxyaabaha halista ah ee ii soo dhowaada. Waxa ii muuqata dadka badankoodu inay diiradda saaraan waxyaabaha ilqabadka leh ee xilligan dhacaya, sida waxa ka socda Iiraan, iyo inay arrinkaas la falgalaan; balse waxa ka qarsoon wax ka wayn, ka muhiimsan, oo ka waqti dheer waxa taagan. Waxa ka qarsoon arrimaha riixaya dhacdooyinka jira, iyo dhacdooyinka la filayo inay yimaaddaan . Waxa ugu muhiimsan maanta inaynu garanno dagaalka u dhexeeya Maraykanka, Israa’iil iyo Iiraan inuu yahay qayb ka mid ah dagaal caalami ah oo aynu galnay, kaas oo aan dhammaanayn dhowaan. Hubaashii xaalka uu ku danbaynayo marrinka Hurmus wuxuu saamayn wayn ku yeelanayaa dhammaan dacallada dunida. Taas waxa ka muhiimsan maamulka marrinka miyaa laga wareejin doonaa Iiraan? Dawladahee ayaa se u diyaarsan inay intaas oo dhiig iyo dhaqaale ah ku bixiyaan xaqiijinta arrinkaas? Weydiimaha kale ee meesha ku jiraa waxay yihiin Iiraan ma sii xejisan doontaa awoodda ay u leedahay inay waxyeello gaadhsiiso deriskeeda iyada oo adeegsanaysa gantaallada, iyo inay ku hanjabto  hubka nugliyeerka ah? Maraykanku se tiro ciidan ah oo intee leeg  ayuu dirayaa? Maxay se samayn karaan? Dhammaan arrimahan taagani waa muhiim, balse waxay dadka ka jeedinayaan arrimaha waaweyn ee muhiimka ah dhab ahaan. Si kale haddii aan u dhigo, dadka badankoodu waxay u janjeedhaan inay yeeshaan ogaalkan taaganta, waayo filashadoodu imika ayay ku jaango’an tahay. Sicirka suuqyadana waxa jaangooya filashada ah: dagaalkani waqti dheer ma soconayo, marka uu dhammaadana xaalku caadigiisii ayuu ku soo noqonayaa. Cidna kuma baraarugsana xaqiiqada ah inaynu joogno heerarkii bilawga ee dagaal adduun oo aan dhowaan dhammaanayn. Aniguna maadaama aan xagashaas duwan wax ka arko, waxaan doonayaan inaan qormadan idiinku sharraxo arrimahaas waaweyn. Arrimaha waaweyn ee jira ee aan doonayo inaynu ku baraarugno waxay yihiin: 1) Dagaal adduun ayaynu galnay oo aan dhowaanahan dhammaanayn. Inkasta oo qodobkan loo arki karo buunbuunin, haddana muran kuma jiro inaynu ku nool nahay caalam isku xidhiidhsan, oo ay ka socdaan dhawr dagaal oo hubaysani. Tusaale ahaan: dagaalka Ruushka-Yugrayn-Yurub-Maraykanka; dagaalka Yaman-Suudaan-Sucuudiga-Imaaraadka oo ay  lugta kula jiraan Kuwayd, Masar, Urdun, iyo dalal kale; iyo dagaalka Maraykanka-Israa’iil-Khaliijka-Iiraan. Inta badan dagaalladan waxa ku jira dawlado nugliyeer leh oo waaweyn. Sida oo kale dagaalo waaweyn oo aan hubaysnayn ayay dhammaan dalalku ku jiraan, sida dagaallo ganacsi, kuwo dhaqaale, kuwo tignoolajiyadeed iyo kuwo juqasiyaasadeed. Loollanadan oo laysku daray waxay ka dhigan yihiin dagaal adduun oo kalaasig ah, oo u dhigma “dagaalladii adduunka” ee hore. Tusaale ahaan, dagaalladii adduunka ee hore waxay ka koobnaayeen dagaallo xidhiidhsan oo ay dhammaan dawladuhu cagaha la soo galeen, iyaga oo aan lahayn taariikh bilaw oo cad, ama ogaysiis dagaal oo rasmi ah. Dagaalladaas hore waxay isugu biyashubteen dagaal adduun oo dhammaan dalalka saameeyay, taasi waa sida ay u socdaan dagaallada imiku. 2) Ahmiyadda fahanka isbahaysiyada iyo xidhiidhka dhinacyada Way fududahay inaynu aragno isbahaysiyada caalamka iyo sida ay garabyadu isu raacsan yihiin, innaga oo ka tixraacayna heshiisyada iyo gaadhaanbuurtooda rasmiga ah, iyo codayntooda Qaramada Midoobay, iyo baaqyada hoggaankooda, iyo falalka ay sameeyaan. Tusaale ahaan, qofku wuu arki karaa sida ay isu raacsan yihiin Shiinaha iyo Ruushku, ama sida ay u wada socdaan Ruushka, Iiraan, Kuuriyada Waqooyi iyo Kuubba. Waxaynu aragnaa sida ay garabyadani uga soo horjeedaan inta badan Maraykanka iyo Yugrayn, oo iyaguna la socda badanka dawladaha Yurub, iyo Israa’iil, dawladaha Khaliijka, Jabbaan iyo Ustareeliya. Isbahaysidani waa muhiim marka la doonayo in la fahmo tallaabooyinka ay qaadayaan dhinacyadani, iyo marka la doonayo in la fahmo waxa dhacaya iyo waxay u badan tahay inay dhacaan. Tusaale ahaan, waxaynu taas ka arki karnaa sida uu uga muuqdo habdhaqanka Shiinaha iyo Ruushka ee Qaramada Midoobay, ee arrinka la xidhiidha furista marinka Hurmus. Tusaale labaad, in kasta oo la yidhaahdo Shiinuhu si gaar ah ayuu ugu dhibban yahay xidhnaanta Marinka Hurmus, balse taasi dhab maaha,  waayo xidhiidhka iskaashi ee ka dhexeeya Shiinaha iyo Iiraan ayaa u saamaxaya inuu gudbo shidaalka u socda Shiinuhu, sida oo kale xidhiidhka uu Shiinuhu la leeyahay  ayaa u fududaynaya inuu shidaal ka helo Ruushka. Sida oo kale Shiinuhu wuxuu leeyahay ilo tamareed oo kale (sida dhuxusha iyo tamarta cadceedda). Waxa kale oo xusuusin mudan inuu Shiinuhu isticmaasho 80-90% waxsoosaarka shidaal ee Iiraan, taas oo xoojinaysa xidhiidhka ka dhexeeya labadooda. Iyada oo arrimahaas sare oo dhan maanka lagu hayo, waxay u muuqataa inay Shiinaha iyo Ruushku yihiin labada guulayste ee dhanka dhaqaalaha iyo juqasiyaasadeedka ee dagaalkan. Dhinaca shidaalka iyo tamartana, Maraykanka ayay libtu dhankiisa xigtaa, waayo waa dawlad tamarta dhoofisa. Siyaabo kaladuwan ayaa loo qiyaasi karaa isbahaysiyada caalamka ka jira, iyada oo laga arki karo kaydka codaynta ee Qaramada Midoobay, xidhiidhada ganacsiga, iyo heshiisyada waaweyn ee ay wada galeen. 3) Ahmiyadda isbarbardhigga xaaladaha taariikheed iyo kuwa imika jira. Diraasaynta xaaladaha taariikheed iyo barbardhigooda kuwa la midka ah ee imika jiraa, waa arrin ay dad dhif ahi sameeyaan, balse aniga waxay ii leedahay ahmiyad weyn, idinkana inay sidaas oo kale idiin tahay ayaa laga yaabaa. Tusaale ahaan, inaga oo baadhayna dhawr xaaladood oo hore oo kuwa imika la mid ah, iyo innaga oo maangalka adeegsanayna, waxa cad Maraykanka (oo ah awoodda gacanta ku haysa nidaamka caalamka tan iyo sannadkii 1945) in natiijadiisa dagaalka Iiraan (oo ah awood dhexe), iyo heerka hantida iyo agabka ciidanka ee uu ku bixindoono ama ku dhiigbixi doono, ama siduu u difaaco ama u difaaci waayayo xulafadiisa, ay u kuurgalayaan dawlado kale, waxaanu si weyn u saamayn doonaa sida loo beddelayo nidaamka caalamka. Taasna waxa ka sii muhiimsan, waxaynu ognahay dagaalka ay Maraykanka-Israaiil-iyo dawladaha Khaliijku ay kula jiraan Iiraan, inuu saamayn weyn ku yeelan doonaa dawladaha kale iyo waxay samayn doonaan (gaar ahaan dawlaha Aasiya iyo kuwa Yurub); taasina waxay raad weyn ku yeelan doontaa qaabka loo beddelayo nidaamka caalamka. Isbeddeladaasi waxay u dhacayaan qaabab ay marar hore u dhaceen. Tusaale ahaan, marka taariikhda la diraaseeyo waxa si fudud loo qeexi karaa imbiraadooriyadihii aad isu balaadhiyay, waxaana la samayn karaa tusayaal caddaynaya heerka isbalaadhintooda, iyo sida ay isbalaadhintaasi ugu noqotay goljilic. Imika waxay socda marka la eegana, waxa la baadhi karaa sida uu Maraykanku u socdo, kaas oo imika ku leh  in u dhexaysa 750 illaa 800 oo saldhig ciidan ah 70 illaa 80 dawladood, halka Shiinuhu uu ka leeyahay hal saldhig oo keliya. Awoodiisa quban dhammaan dacallada dunidu waxay Maraykan ku tahay xil culus iyo goljilic. Sida oo kale waxa cad dawladaha aadka isu balaadhiyay inaanay geli karin dagaal guulaystay oo laba jabhadood iyo ka badan ah, taasina waa ta laga shakisan yahay inuu Maraykanku awood u leeyahay inuu geli karo dagaal jabhad kale ah, sida Eeshiya ama Yurub. Tani waxay igu riixaysaa inaan ka fikiro wuxuu uga dhigan yahay dagaalkan socda ee Iiraan guurguurka (dynamics) Aasiya iyo Yurub, iyo guurguurka Bariga Dhexe. Tusaale ahaan, layaab ma noqonayso haddii la arko dhibaatooyin ka curta Aasiya, kuwaas oo tijaabinaya ama daaha ka faydaya heerka diyaargarawga Maraykanka ee waajihidda caqabadaha. Tani way ku adkaan doontaa Maraykanka sababta oo ah xilka culus, dhiigbaxa iyo dadaalkiisa oo  ku urursan Bariga Dhexe, iyo sida ay shacbiga Maraykanku uga soo horjeedaan dagaalka Iiraan, iyada oo ay waxyari ka hadhsan yihiin doorashooyinkii cusboonaysiinta ee kalabadhka teeramka, taasina waxay ka dhigaysaa dagaal jabhad kale ah mid aan waaqici ahayn.  Guurguurkani wuxuu keeni karaa in la fisho inay dawlado kale fiirsanayaan guurguurka u dhexeeya Maraykanka iyo Iiraan, kadibna ay xisaabo kale isku gaystaan, habdhaqankoodana ay u beddelaan hab qaabaynaya nidaamka caalamka. Tusaale ahaan, waa maangal hoggaamiyayaasha dalalka ay saldhigyada Maraykanku ku yaalaan, kuwaas oo filaya inuu Maraykanku difaaci doono, inay  casharro habdhaqankooda beddela kala soo baxaan markay arkaan sida ay arrimuhu  ku yihiin dawladaha Bariga Dhexe ee ay saldhigyada Maraykanku ku yaallaan, ee laga filayo inuu Maraykanku difaaco. Sida oo kale, qofku wuu fahmi karaa dawlad kasta oo u dhow marin ahmiyad istaraatiiji ah leh, ama dalkeeda ay ku yaallaan saldhigyada Maraykanku, ahna qayb caalamka ah oo uu loolan weyni ka dhici karo, sida Aasiya, oo uu ka dhici karo loolanka Maraykanka iyo Shiinuhu, inay casharro kala soo baxayaan natiijada dagaalka Iiraan. Waxaan idiin caddaynayaa inuu fikirka noocan ahi hadda ka dhexsocdo hoggaamiyaaasha caalamka, waxa imika socdaana marar hore oo oo xilligan u dhigma ayay dhaceen. Xisaabahan ay rogrogayaan madaxda caalamku waa qayb ka mid ah taxane duug ah, oo ah tallaabooyinka keena dagaallada waaweyn, kuwaas oo hore u dhacay imikana dhacaya. MEERTADA WEYN EE LOOLLANKA caalamiga ahi waa 13 tallaabo oo taxane ah, oo aan filayo inaynu hadda marayno tallaabadii 9aad. Waa kuwan tallaabooyinka taxanaha loollanka caalamiga ahi: 1. Hoosudhac ayaa ku yimaadda xoogga dhaqaale iyo ka milatari ee awoodda caalamiga ah ee jirta (sida Maraykan), marka loo eego awoodda caalamiga ah ee soo kacaysa (sida Shiinaha); markay labadaas awoodood isu soo dhowaadaanna waxay ku loolamayaan dhaqaalaha iyo milatariga. 2. Waxaa kordha dagaallada dhaqaale, sida cunaqabataynta maaliyadeed iyo go’doominta ganacsi. 3. Waxa samaysma isbahaysiyo dhaqaale, kuwo ciidan iyo kuwo fikirtooyo (aydhiyoolajiyadeed). 4. Waxa kordha dagaallada wakaaladeed. 5. Waxa kordha culaysyada maaliyadeed, isdhinka miisaaniyadeed iyo daynta; gaar ahaan dawladaha horseedka ah ee ku talaxtagay isbalaadhinta maaliyadeed. 6. Waxa kordha xuurtaysiga xukuumadaha ee warshadaha halbawlaha ah iyo tubaha badeecadgudbinta. 7. Waxa la hubeeyaa marinada cidhiidhiga ah ee ganacsiga. 8. Waxa la dhisaa tignoolajiyad dagaal oo cusub oo xooggan. 9. Waxa kordha loollanada masraxyada kaladuwan leh ee isku waqtiga ah. 10. Arrimaha gudaha dawladuhu waxay amraan in madaxda dalka loo hoggaansamo, waxaana la cabudhiyaa ciddi mucaarid ku ah dagaallada iyo siyaasadaha la xidhiidha. Waayo sida uu madaxweyne Lincoln ka soo xigtay Injiil: “guriga dhexdiisa qaybsani ma taagnaanayo” gaar ahaan marka xaalad dagaal lagu jiro. 11. Waxa dhaca dagaallo toos ah oo u dhexeeya awoodaha waaweyn. 12. Waxa kordha cashuuraha, qaadashada daymaha, iyo daabacaadda lacagaha; waxa kale oo la xakameeyaa sarifka lacagaha qalaad, raasamaalka, waxaana la sameeyaa faramaroojin lacageed si dagaallada loo maalgeliyo, xaladaha qaarna waxa la xidhaa suuqyada. 13. Gunaanadka hal dhinac ayaa guulaysta, waxaanu gacanta ku dhigaa nidaamka caalamka ee cusub, nidaamkaas oo ah mid uu guulaystuhu qaabaynayo. Tilmaamayaal badan ayaan hayaa oo sheegaya inaynu marayno marxalad ka mid meertada weyn ee loollanka, oo ay burburayaan nidaamkii lacagta, qaar ka mid ah nidaamyadii siyaasadda ee gudaha, iyo nidaamkii juqasiyaasadeed ee caalamku. Tilmaamahani waxay sheegayaan inaynu ku jirno marxalad kalaguur ah oo qarka h saaran marxaladda dagaalka tooska ah. Waa marxalad  si weyn ugu eg xilligii 1913-1914 iyo 1938-1939 ee ka horreeyay dagaalladii koowaad iyo labaad ee adduunka.  Tilmaamuhu waa kuwo hagayaal ah, balse maaha kuwo biyakamadhibcaan ah, oo goor iyo goob cayiman saadaalin kara. Tusaale ahaan, taariikhda waxaynu ka barannay guud ahaan inaanay dagaalladu lahayn xilli cayiman oo ay bilawdaan (marka laga reebo marar ay jiraan dhacdooyin dagaal oo waaweyn, oo ay ku xigaan bayaanno dagaal oo caddaan ahi, sida dilkii dhaxalsuge Feerdinaan, iyo duulaankii Jarmalku ku qaaday Boolaan, iyo duqayntii Biiral Haarbor). Waxa kale oo aynu ka barannay inay loollanada dhaqaale, kuwa maaliyadeed iyo kuwa milatari ay bilaabmaan iyada oo aan dagaal toos ahba lagu dhawaaqin.  Dagaallada waaweyn waxa inta badan ka horreeya dhaqdhaqaaqyo iyo saansaamo ay ka mid yihiin: 1) dhammaadka kaydka hubka iyo dhiiigbaxa dhaqaale; 2) tandhaafka miisaaniyadaha, daymaha, daabacaadda lacagaha iyo xeerarka raasamaalku; 3) u kuurgalka dawladaha tartanka kula jiraa ay ku sameeyaan dawladaha dagaalamaya, iyaga oo casharro kala soo baxaya goljilicdooda iyo baraha awoodooda; 4) dawladda horseedka ee isbalaadhinta xaddhaafka ah samaysay oo isku dayda inay awood ku waajahdo dagaallo jabhado kaladuwan ah. Dhammaan tilmaamahani waa muhiim, halbeegyada aan saaray si aan xaalka caalamka u daraaseeyaana waxay i siinayaan natiijooyin walaac leh. Taariikhda meertada weyn ee loollanka inaga oo ka tilmaanqaadanayna marka marxaladdan la marayo loollanku wuu sii xoogaysanayaa ee ma yaraanayo. Sidaa darteed, dhacdooyinka soo socda waxa saamayn ku leh qaabka uu noqdo dagaalka Maraykanka iyo Iiraan. Tusaale ahaan, waxa jirta kalsooni la’aan ay dawladuhu ka qabaan inuu Maraykanku difaaci doono, sida oo kale waxa kordhay ogaalka dalalka ee ah inuu hubka nugliyeerka ahi yahay awood difaac iyo mid weerar oo weyn. Arrimahani waxay ku riixayaan madaxda dawladaha inay ka hadlaan helista hubka nugliyeerka ah, iyo inay dhistaan kaydad kale oo hub ah, gaar ahaanna gantaallada iyo nidaamyada difaaca gantaallada. Mar kale aan ku celiyo e, ma lihi arrimuhu waxay si mahurto ah ugu socdaan dhanka dagaal caalami ah oo caam ah, waayo ma hubo waxa dhacaya, sida oo kale waxaan rajaynayaa caalam nabdoon oo ku dhisan xidhiidhka ah ‘‘aynu wada dheefno’’, iyo in aanay xaaladuhu u durkin dhinaca ‘‘aynu wada khasaarno’’. Laakiin heerkan aynu marayno, oo ka mid ah meertada weyn ee loollanka,  oo ah heerka ka horreeya dagaallada waaweyn ee tooska ah, duruufaha ay ka mid yihiin khilaafyada waaweyn oo xal loo waayo, ayaa keena in loo gudbo heerka xiga ah oo ah xalka cunfiga ah. Sida oo kale waxaan rumaysanahay inuu nidaamkii caalamku isbeddelay. Waxaynu ka gudubnay nidaam caalami ah oo ku dhisan xeerar, oo uu hoggaaminayo Maraykanka iyo xulafadiisu (sida Ururka Toddobada ah), waxaynan galnay nidaam caalami ah oo ku dhisan xeerkii kaynta ee ahaa “awoodda ayaa xaqa samaysa”. Waxa meesha ka baxday awoodii calanwalaynaysay, ee nidaamka ilaalinaysay, taasina waxay keenaysaa inaynu filanno dagaallo badan. Qof kasta oo taariikhda si dhab ah u daraaseeyaa wuu garan karaa inuu nidaamkii caalamku imika noqday sidii uu ahaa xilliyadii ka horreeyay dagaalkii labaad ee adduunka 1945. 4) Dawladda ugu awoodda weyn ma guulaysato, balse waxa guulaysata dawladda ugu adkaysiga badan. Dagaallada dawladda ugu awoodda weyni ma guulaysato, balse waxa guulaysata dawladda aan isdhiibin, ee xanuunka dagaalka u adkaysata muddada ugu dheer. Tusaale ahaan, markii uu Shiinuhu soo galay dagaalkii Kuuriya ee ka dhanka ahaa Maraykanka, xilligaas Shiinuhu wuxuu lahaa awood aad u yar, Maraykankuna wuxuu ahaa dawlad nugliyeer ku hubaysan. Waxa la sheegaa inuu xilligaas madaxweynihii Shiinaha ee Maw uu yidhi, “cadawgu ina ma dili karo dhammaanteen”, wuxuu uga jeeday cadawgu ma guulaysanayo inta ay jirto cid dagaalka sii wadaysaa. Sidaas oo kale waxaynu casharro kan la mid ah ka baran karnaa dagaalladii Fiidnaam, Ciraaq iyo Afgaanistaan.  In kasta oo uu Maraykanku yahay dawladda ugu awoodda badan caalamka, balse sida oo kale waa awoodda ugu weyn, ee dhinaca kalena ugu isbalaadhinta badan, ee ugu laciifsan inay muddo dheer xanuunka dagaalka u dulqaadato. 5) Wax kastaa waxay ku socdaan jidka meertada weyn ee loollanka Loollanka dunida ka jira waxa riixaya shan awoodood oo waaweyn: 1. Lacagta, daynta, iyo dhaqaalaha oo ku wareegaya meertooyin waaweyn oo ah nidaam iyo fawdo maaliyadeed. 2. Burburka nidaamyada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa bulsho, sababta oo ah faraqyo waaweyn oo hantiyeed iyo kuwa qiyam ayaa samaysma. 3. Burburka nidaamyada gobol iyo kuwa caalamiga ah, sababta oo ah faraqyo waaweyn oo hantiyeed iyo kuwa qiyam ayaa samaysma. 4. Horumar weyn oo dhanka tignoolajiyadda ah ayaa la sameeyaa, kaas oo loo adeegsado dhanka nabadgalyada ama dagaalka. Horumarkaas tignoolajiyadeed waxa ka samaysma xunbooyin maaliyadeed oo aakhirka gudha. 5. Waxa kordha masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah sida abaaraha, fatahaadaha iyo cudurrada faafa. Imika waxa adduunka ka socda ama la filayaa  5 loollan, oo shanta sanno ee socda aan filayo inay sii xoogaysanayaan: waa dagaalka weyn ee u dhexeeya Maraykanka, Israa’iil iyo Iiraan, kaas oo sii kordhaya dhinacyadana dhiigbax iyo dhaqaale burbur ku ah; iyo dagaalka aan tooska ahayn ee u dhexeeya Ruushka iyo Naato ee Yugrayn ka socda, kaas oo aan filayo inuu sii balaadhan doono filasho ah 30-40%; iyo taagtaagga ka jira Taywaan ee u dhexeeya  Maraykanka iyo Shiinaha, kaas oo filashada korodhkiisu tahay 30-40% figtiisana gaadhi doona 2028; iyo filashada dagaal milatari oo la xidhiidha Kuuriyada Waqooyi kaas oo filashadiisu tahay 40-50%; ugu danbayntiina taagtaagga ka jira Badda Shiinaha ee Koonfureed ee u dhexeeya Shiinaha, Filibiin iyo Maraykanka, kaas oo filashada korodhkiisu yahay 30%. Shanta sanno ee soo socda dagaalada la filayo mid ka mid ahi inuu qarxaa waxay ka badan tahay 50%.
items.fullContent: Ray Dalio waa maalgashade bilyaneer ah, oo reer Maraykan ah. Sida oo kale waa qoraa caan ah oo wax ka qora arrimaha ganacsiga, nolosha iyo siyaasadda. Isaga oo kaashanaya khibraddiisa dhanka maalgashiga, wuxuu qormadan ku sheegayaa inay dunidu gashay dagaal adduun: Marka hore wanaag ayaan idiin rajaynayaa waayahan adag. Marka xiga sawirka aan ku sawirayo qormadani maaha ka aan doonayo inuu dhab noqdo, balse waa sawirka aan aamminsanahay inuu run yahay, aniga oo ka duulaya waxyaabaha aan bartay iyo waxay i tusayaan tilmaamayaasha  aan adeegsanayo si aan arrimaha ugu eego si mawduuci ah. Maadaama aan ahay maalgashade dhaqaalaha guud ee caalamiga ah muddo ka badan konton sanno, waxaan u baahday muddadaas inaan daraaseeyo arrimihii saameeyay suuqyada shantii boqol ee sanno ee ugu danbeeyay, si aan u ogaado sida aan ula dhaqmayo waxyaabaha halista ah ee ii soo dhowaada. Waxa ii muuqata dadka badankoodu inay diiradda saaraan waxyaabaha ilqabadka leh ee xilligan dhacaya, sida waxa ka socda Iiraan, iyo inay arrinkaas la falgalaan; balse waxa ka qarsoon wax ka wayn, ka muhiimsan, oo ka waqti dheer waxa taagan. Waxa ka qarsoon arrimaha riixaya dhacdooyinka jira, iyo dhacdooyinka la filayo inay yimaaddaan . Waxa ugu muhiimsan maanta inaynu garanno dagaalka u dhexeeya Maraykanka, Israa’iil iyo Iiraan inuu yahay qayb ka mid ah dagaal caalami ah oo aynu galnay, kaas oo aan dhammaanayn dhowaan. Hubaashii xaalka uu ku danbaynayo marrinka Hurmus wuxuu saamayn wayn ku yeelanayaa dhammaan dacallada dunida. Taas waxa ka muhiimsan maamulka marrinka miyaa laga wareejin doonaa Iiraan? Dawladahee ayaa se u diyaarsan inay intaas oo dhiig iyo dhaqaale ah ku bixiyaan xaqiijinta arrinkaas? Weydiimaha kale ee meesha ku jiraa waxay yihiin Iiraan ma sii xejisan doontaa awoodda ay u leedahay inay waxyeello gaadhsiiso deriskeeda iyada oo adeegsanaysa gantaallada, iyo inay ku hanjabto  hubka nugliyeerka ah? Maraykanku se tiro ciidan ah oo intee leeg  ayuu dirayaa? Maxay se samayn karaan? Dhammaan arrimahan taagani waa muhiim, balse waxay dadka ka jeedinayaan arrimaha waaweyn ee muhiimka ah dhab ahaan. Si kale haddii aan u dhigo, dadka badankoodu waxay u janjeedhaan inay yeeshaan ogaalkan taaganta, waayo filashadoodu imika ayay ku jaango’an tahay. Sicirka suuqyadana waxa jaangooya filashada ah: dagaalkani waqti dheer ma soconayo, marka uu dhammaadana xaalku caadigiisii ayuu ku soo noqonayaa. Cidna kuma baraarugsana xaqiiqada ah inaynu joogno heerarkii bilawga ee dagaal adduun oo aan dhowaan dhammaanayn. Aniguna maadaama aan xagashaas duwan wax ka arko, waxaan doonayaan inaan qormadan idiinku sharraxo arrimahaas waaweyn. Arrimaha waaweyn ee jira ee aan doonayo inaynu ku baraarugno waxay yihiin: 1) Dagaal adduun ayaynu galnay oo aan dhowaanahan dhammaanayn. Inkasta oo qodobkan loo arki karo buunbuunin, haddana muran kuma jiro inaynu ku nool nahay caalam isku xidhiidhsan, oo ay ka socdaan dhawr dagaal oo hubaysani. Tusaale ahaan: dagaalka Ruushka-Yugrayn-Yurub-Maraykanka; dagaalka Yaman-Suudaan-Sucuudiga-Imaaraadka oo ay  lugta kula jiraan Kuwayd, Masar, Urdun, iyo dalal kale; iyo dagaalka Maraykanka-Israa’iil-Khaliijka-Iiraan. Inta badan dagaalladan waxa ku jira dawlado nugliyeer leh oo waaweyn. Sida oo kale dagaalo waaweyn oo aan hubaysnayn ayay dhammaan dalalku ku jiraan, sida dagaallo ganacsi, kuwo dhaqaale, kuwo tignoolajiyadeed iyo kuwo juqasiyaasadeed. Loollanadan oo laysku daray waxay ka dhigan yihiin dagaal adduun oo kalaasig ah, oo u dhigma “dagaalladii adduunka” ee hore. Tusaale ahaan, dagaalladii adduunka ee hore waxay ka koobnaayeen dagaallo xidhiidhsan oo ay dhammaan dawladuhu cagaha la soo galeen, iyaga oo aan lahayn taariikh bilaw oo cad, ama ogaysiis dagaal oo rasmi ah. Dagaalladaas hore waxay isugu biyashubteen dagaal adduun oo dhammaan dalalka saameeyay, taasi waa sida ay u socdaan dagaallada imiku. 2) Ahmiyadda fahanka isbahaysiyada iyo xidhiidhka dhinacyada Way fududahay inaynu aragno isbahaysiyada caalamka iyo sida ay garabyadu isu raacsan yihiin, innaga oo ka tixraacayna heshiisyada iyo gaadhaanbuurtooda rasmiga ah, iyo codayntooda Qaramada Midoobay, iyo baaqyada hoggaankooda, iyo falalka ay sameeyaan. Tusaale ahaan, qofku wuu arki karaa sida ay isu raacsan yihiin Shiinaha iyo Ruushku, ama sida ay u wada socdaan Ruushka, Iiraan, Kuuriyada Waqooyi iyo Kuubba. Waxaynu aragnaa sida ay garabyadani uga soo horjeedaan inta badan Maraykanka iyo Yugrayn, oo iyaguna la socda badanka dawladaha Yurub, iyo Israa’iil, dawladaha Khaliijka, Jabbaan iyo Ustareeliya. Isbahaysidani waa muhiim marka la doonayo in la fahmo tallaabooyinka ay qaadayaan dhinacyadani, iyo marka la doonayo in la fahmo waxa dhacaya iyo waxay u badan tahay inay dhacaan. Tusaale ahaan, waxaynu taas ka arki karnaa sida uu uga muuqdo habdhaqanka Shiinaha iyo Ruushka ee Qaramada Midoobay, ee arrinka la xidhiidha furista marinka Hurmus. Tusaale labaad, in kasta oo la yidhaahdo Shiinuhu si gaar ah ayuu ugu dhibban yahay xidhnaanta Marinka Hurmus, balse taasi dhab maaha,  waayo xidhiidhka iskaashi ee ka dhexeeya Shiinaha iyo Iiraan ayaa u saamaxaya inuu gudbo shidaalka u socda Shiinuhu, sida oo kale xidhiidhka uu Shiinuhu la leeyahay  ayaa u fududaynaya inuu shidaal ka helo Ruushka. Sida oo kale Shiinuhu wuxuu leeyahay ilo tamareed oo kale (sida dhuxusha iyo tamarta cadceedda). Waxa kale oo xusuusin mudan inuu Shiinuhu isticmaasho 80-90% waxsoosaarka shidaal ee Iiraan, taas oo xoojinaysa xidhiidhka ka dhexeeya labadooda. Iyada oo arrimahaas sare oo dhan maanka lagu hayo, waxay u muuqataa inay Shiinaha iyo Ruushku yihiin labada guulayste ee dhanka dhaqaalaha iyo juqasiyaasadeedka ee dagaalkan. Dhinaca shidaalka iyo tamartana, Maraykanka ayay libtu dhankiisa xigtaa, waayo waa dawlad tamarta dhoofisa. Siyaabo kaladuwan ayaa loo qiyaasi karaa isbahaysiyada caalamka ka jira, iyada oo laga arki karo kaydka codaynta ee Qaramada Midoobay, xidhiidhada ganacsiga, iyo heshiisyada waaweyn ee ay wada galeen. 3) Ahmiyadda isbarbardhigga xaaladaha taariikheed iyo kuwa imika jira. Diraasaynta xaaladaha taariikheed iyo barbardhigooda kuwa la midka ah ee imika jiraa, waa arrin ay dad dhif ahi sameeyaan, balse aniga waxay ii leedahay ahmiyad weyn, idinkana inay sidaas oo kale idiin tahay ayaa laga yaabaa. Tusaale ahaan, inaga oo baadhayna dhawr xaaladood oo hore oo kuwa imika la mid ah, iyo innaga oo maangalka adeegsanayna, waxa cad Maraykanka (oo ah awoodda gacanta ku haysa nidaamka caalamka tan iyo sannadkii 1945) in natiijadiisa dagaalka Iiraan (oo ah awood dhexe), iyo heerka hantida iyo agabka ciidanka ee uu ku bixindoono ama ku dhiigbixi doono, ama siduu u difaaco ama u difaaci waayayo xulafadiisa, ay u kuurgalayaan dawlado kale, waxaanu si weyn u saamayn doonaa sida loo beddelayo nidaamka caalamka. Taasna waxa ka sii muhiimsan, waxaynu ognahay dagaalka ay Maraykanka-Israaiil-iyo dawladaha Khaliijku ay kula jiraan Iiraan, inuu saamayn weyn ku yeelan doonaa dawladaha kale iyo waxay samayn doonaan (gaar ahaan dawlaha Aasiya iyo kuwa Yurub); taasina waxay raad weyn ku yeelan doontaa qaabka loo beddelayo nidaamka caalamka. Isbeddeladaasi waxay u dhacayaan qaabab ay marar hore u dhaceen. Tusaale ahaan, marka taariikhda la diraaseeyo waxa si fudud loo qeexi karaa imbiraadooriyadihii aad isu balaadhiyay, waxaana la samayn karaa tusayaal caddaynaya heerka isbalaadhintooda, iyo sida ay isbalaadhintaasi ugu noqotay goljilic. Imika waxay socda marka la eegana, waxa la baadhi karaa sida uu Maraykanku u socdo, kaas oo imika ku leh  in u dhexaysa 750 illaa 800 oo saldhig ciidan ah 70 illaa 80 dawladood, halka Shiinuhu uu ka leeyahay hal saldhig oo keliya. Awoodiisa quban dhammaan dacallada dunidu waxay Maraykan ku tahay xil culus iyo goljilic. Sida oo kale waxa cad dawladaha aadka isu balaadhiyay inaanay geli karin dagaal guulaystay oo laba jabhadood iyo ka badan ah, taasina waa ta laga shakisan yahay inuu Maraykanku awood u leeyahay inuu geli karo dagaal jabhad kale ah, sida Eeshiya ama Yurub. Tani waxay igu riixaysaa inaan ka fikiro wuxuu uga dhigan yahay dagaalkan socda ee Iiraan guurguurka (dynamics) Aasiya iyo Yurub, iyo guurguurka Bariga Dhexe. Tusaale ahaan, layaab ma noqonayso haddii la arko dhibaatooyin ka curta Aasiya, kuwaas oo tijaabinaya ama daaha ka faydaya heerka diyaargarawga Maraykanka ee waajihidda caqabadaha. Tani way ku adkaan doontaa Maraykanka sababta oo ah xilka culus, dhiigbaxa iyo dadaalkiisa oo  ku urursan Bariga Dhexe, iyo sida ay shacbiga Maraykanku uga soo horjeedaan dagaalka Iiraan, iyada oo ay waxyari ka hadhsan yihiin doorashooyinkii cusboonaysiinta ee kalabadhka teeramka, taasina waxay ka dhigaysaa dagaal jabhad kale ah mid aan waaqici ahayn.  Guurguurkani wuxuu keeni karaa in la fisho inay dawlado kale fiirsanayaan guurguurka u dhexeeya Maraykanka iyo Iiraan, kadibna ay xisaabo kale isku gaystaan, habdhaqankoodana ay u beddelaan hab qaabaynaya nidaamka caalamka. Tusaale ahaan, waa maangal hoggaamiyayaasha dalalka ay saldhigyada Maraykanku ku yaalaan, kuwaas oo filaya inuu Maraykanku difaaci doono, inay  casharro habdhaqankooda beddela kala soo baxaan markay arkaan sida ay arrimuhu  ku yihiin dawladaha Bariga Dhexe ee ay saldhigyada Maraykanku ku yaallaan, ee laga filayo inuu Maraykanku difaaco. Sida oo kale, qofku wuu fahmi karaa dawlad kasta oo u dhow marin ahmiyad istaraatiiji ah leh, ama dalkeeda ay ku yaallaan saldhigyada Maraykanku, ahna qayb caalamka ah oo uu loolan weyni ka dhici karo, sida Aasiya, oo uu ka dhici karo loolanka Maraykanka iyo Shiinuhu, inay casharro kala soo baxayaan natiijada dagaalka Iiraan. Waxaan idiin caddaynayaa inuu fikirka noocan ahi hadda ka dhexsocdo hoggaamiyaaasha caalamka, waxa imika socdaana marar hore oo oo xilligan u dhigma ayay dhaceen. Xisaabahan ay rogrogayaan madaxda caalamku waa qayb ka mid ah taxane duug ah, oo ah tallaabooyinka keena dagaallada waaweyn, kuwaas oo hore u dhacay imikana dhacaya. MEERTADA WEYN EE LOOLLANKA caalamiga ahi waa 13 tallaabo oo taxane ah, oo aan filayo inaynu hadda marayno tallaabadii 9aad. Waa kuwan tallaabooyinka taxanaha loollanka caalamiga ahi: 1. Hoosudhac ayaa ku yimaadda xoogga dhaqaale iyo ka milatari ee awoodda caalamiga ah ee jirta (sida Maraykan), marka loo eego awoodda caalamiga ah ee soo kacaysa (sida Shiinaha); markay labadaas awoodood isu soo dhowaadaanna waxay ku loolamayaan dhaqaalaha iyo milatariga. 2. Waxaa kordha dagaallada dhaqaale, sida cunaqabataynta maaliyadeed iyo go’doominta ganacsi. 3. Waxa samaysma isbahaysiyo dhaqaale, kuwo ciidan iyo kuwo fikirtooyo (aydhiyoolajiyadeed). 4. Waxa kordha dagaallada wakaaladeed. 5. Waxa kordha culaysyada maaliyadeed, isdhinka miisaaniyadeed iyo daynta; gaar ahaan dawladaha horseedka ah ee ku talaxtagay isbalaadhinta maaliyadeed. 6. Waxa kordha xuurtaysiga xukuumadaha ee warshadaha halbawlaha ah iyo tubaha badeecadgudbinta. 7. Waxa la hubeeyaa marinada cidhiidhiga ah ee ganacsiga. 8. Waxa la dhisaa tignoolajiyad dagaal oo cusub oo xooggan. 9. Waxa kordha loollanada masraxyada kaladuwan leh ee isku waqtiga ah. 10. Arrimaha gudaha dawladuhu waxay amraan in madaxda dalka loo hoggaansamo, waxaana la cabudhiyaa ciddi mucaarid ku ah dagaallada iyo siyaasadaha la xidhiidha. Waayo sida uu madaxweyne Lincoln ka soo xigtay Injiil: “guriga dhexdiisa qaybsani ma taagnaanayo” gaar ahaan marka xaalad dagaal lagu jiro. 11. Waxa dhaca dagaallo toos ah oo u dhexeeya awoodaha waaweyn. 12. Waxa kordha cashuuraha, qaadashada daymaha, iyo daabacaadda lacagaha; waxa kale oo la xakameeyaa sarifka lacagaha qalaad, raasamaalka, waxaana la sameeyaa faramaroojin lacageed si dagaallada loo maalgeliyo, xaladaha qaarna waxa la xidhaa suuqyada. 13. Gunaanadka hal dhinac ayaa guulaysta, waxaanu gacanta ku dhigaa nidaamka caalamka ee cusub, nidaamkaas oo ah mid uu guulaystuhu qaabaynayo. Tilmaamayaal badan ayaan hayaa oo sheegaya inaynu marayno marxalad ka mid meertada weyn ee loollanka, oo ay burburayaan nidaamkii lacagta, qaar ka mid ah nidaamyadii siyaasadda ee gudaha, iyo nidaamkii juqasiyaasadeed ee caalamku. Tilmaamahani waxay sheegayaan inaynu ku jirno marxalad kalaguur ah oo qarka h saaran marxaladda dagaalka tooska ah. Waa marxalad  si weyn ugu eg xilligii 1913-1914 iyo 1938-1939 ee ka horreeyay dagaalladii koowaad iyo labaad ee adduunka.  Tilmaamuhu waa kuwo hagayaal ah, balse maaha kuwo biyakamadhibcaan ah, oo goor iyo goob cayiman saadaalin kara. Tusaale ahaan, taariikhda waxaynu ka barannay guud ahaan inaanay dagaalladu lahayn xilli cayiman oo ay bilawdaan (marka laga reebo marar ay jiraan dhacdooyin dagaal oo waaweyn, oo ay ku xigaan bayaanno dagaal oo caddaan ahi, sida dilkii dhaxalsuge Feerdinaan, iyo duulaankii Jarmalku ku qaaday Boolaan, iyo duqayntii Biiral Haarbor). Waxa kale oo aynu ka barannay inay loollanada dhaqaale, kuwa maaliyadeed iyo kuwa milatari ay bilaabmaan iyada oo aan dagaal toos ahba lagu dhawaaqin.  Dagaallada waaweyn waxa inta badan ka horreeya dhaqdhaqaaqyo iyo saansaamo ay ka mid yihiin: 1) dhammaadka kaydka hubka iyo dhiiigbaxa dhaqaale; 2) tandhaafka miisaaniyadaha, daymaha, daabacaadda lacagaha iyo xeerarka raasamaalku; 3) u kuurgalka dawladaha tartanka kula jiraa ay ku sameeyaan dawladaha dagaalamaya, iyaga oo casharro kala soo baxaya goljilicdooda iyo baraha awoodooda; 4) dawladda horseedka ee isbalaadhinta xaddhaafka ah samaysay oo isku dayda inay awood ku waajahdo dagaallo jabhado kaladuwan ah. Dhammaan tilmaamahani waa muhiim, halbeegyada aan saaray si aan xaalka caalamka u daraaseeyaana waxay i siinayaan natiijooyin walaac leh. Taariikhda meertada weyn ee loollanka inaga oo ka tilmaanqaadanayna marka marxaladdan la marayo loollanku wuu sii xoogaysanayaa ee ma yaraanayo. Sidaa darteed, dhacdooyinka soo socda waxa saamayn ku leh qaabka uu noqdo dagaalka Maraykanka iyo Iiraan. Tusaale ahaan, waxa jirta kalsooni la’aan ay dawladuhu ka qabaan inuu Maraykanku difaaci doono, sida oo kale waxa kordhay ogaalka dalalka ee ah inuu hubka nugliyeerka ahi yahay awood difaac iyo mid weerar oo weyn. Arrimahani waxay ku riixayaan madaxda dawladaha inay ka hadlaan helista hubka nugliyeerka ah, iyo inay dhistaan kaydad kale oo hub ah, gaar ahaanna gantaallada iyo nidaamyada difaaca gantaallada. Mar kale aan ku celiyo e, ma lihi arrimuhu waxay si mahurto ah ugu socdaan dhanka dagaal caalami ah oo caam ah, waayo ma hubo waxa dhacaya, sida oo kale waxaan rajaynayaa caalam nabdoon oo ku dhisan xidhiidhka ah ‘‘aynu wada dheefno’’, iyo in aanay xaaladuhu u durkin dhinaca ‘‘aynu wada khasaarno’’. Laakiin heerkan aynu marayno, oo ka mid ah meertada weyn ee loollanka,  oo ah heerka ka horreeya dagaallada waaweyn ee tooska ah, duruufaha ay ka mid yihiin khilaafyada waaweyn oo xal loo waayo, ayaa keena in loo gudbo heerka xiga ah oo ah xalka cunfiga ah. Sida oo kale waxaan rumaysanahay inuu nidaamkii caalamku isbeddelay. Waxaynu ka gudubnay nidaam caalami ah oo ku dhisan xeerar, oo uu hoggaaminayo Maraykanka iyo xulafadiisu (sida Ururka Toddobada ah), waxaynan galnay nidaam caalami ah oo ku dhisan xeerkii kaynta ee ahaa “awoodda ayaa xaqa samaysa”. Waxa meesha ka baxday awoodii calanwalaynaysay, ee nidaamka ilaalinaysay, taasina waxay keenaysaa inaynu filanno dagaallo badan. Qof kasta oo taariikhda si dhab ah u daraaseeyaa wuu garan karaa inuu nidaamkii caalamku imika noqday sidii uu ahaa xilliyadii ka horreeyay dagaalkii labaad ee adduunka 1945. 4) Dawladda ugu awoodda weyn ma guulaysato, balse waxa guulaysata dawladda ugu adkaysiga badan. Dagaallada dawladda ugu awoodda weyni ma guulaysato, balse waxa guulaysata dawladda aan isdhiibin, ee xanuunka dagaalka u adkaysata muddada ugu dheer. Tusaale ahaan, markii uu Shiinuhu soo galay dagaalkii Kuuriya ee ka dhanka ahaa Maraykanka, xilligaas Shiinuhu wuxuu lahaa awood aad u yar, Maraykankuna wuxuu ahaa dawlad nugliyeer ku hubaysan. Waxa la sheegaa inuu xilligaas madaxweynihii Shiinaha ee Maw uu yidhi, “cadawgu ina ma dili karo dhammaanteen”, wuxuu uga jeeday cadawgu ma guulaysanayo inta ay jirto cid dagaalka sii wadaysaa. Sidaas oo kale waxaynu casharro kan la mid ah ka baran karnaa dagaalladii Fiidnaam, Ciraaq iyo Afgaanistaan.  In kasta oo uu Maraykanku yahay dawladda ugu awoodda badan caalamka, balse sida oo kale waa awoodda ugu weyn, ee dhinaca kalena ugu isbalaadhinta badan, ee ugu laciifsan inay muddo dheer xanuunka dagaalka u dulqaadato. 5) Wax kastaa waxay ku socdaan jidka meertada weyn ee loollanka Loollanka dunida ka jira waxa riixaya shan awoodood oo waaweyn: 1. Lacagta, daynta, iyo dhaqaalaha oo ku wareegaya meertooyin waaweyn oo ah nidaam iyo fawdo maaliyadeed. 2. Burburka nidaamyada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa bulsho, sababta oo ah faraqyo waaweyn oo hantiyeed iyo kuwa qiyam ayaa samaysma. 3. Burburka nidaamyada gobol iyo kuwa caalamiga ah, sababta oo ah faraqyo waaweyn oo hantiyeed iyo kuwa qiyam ayaa samaysma. 4. Horumar weyn oo dhanka tignoolajiyadda ah ayaa la sameeyaa, kaas oo loo adeegsado dhanka nabadgalyada ama dagaalka. Horumarkaas tignoolajiyadeed waxa ka samaysma xunbooyin maaliyadeed oo aakhirka gudha. 5. Waxa kordha masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah sida abaaraha, fatahaadaha iyo cudurrada faafa. Imika waxa adduunka ka socda ama la filayaa  5 loollan, oo shanta sanno ee socda aan filayo inay sii xoogaysanayaan: waa dagaalka weyn ee u dhexeeya Maraykanka, Israa’iil iyo Iiraan, kaas oo sii kordhaya dhinacyadana dhiigbax iyo dhaqaale burbur ku ah; iyo dagaalka aan tooska ahayn ee u dhexeeya Ruushka iyo Naato ee Yugrayn ka socda, kaas oo aan filayo inuu sii balaadhan doono filasho ah 30-40%; iyo taagtaagga ka jira Taywaan ee u dhexeeya  Maraykanka iyo Shiinaha, kaas oo filashada korodhkiisu tahay 30-40% figtiisana gaadhi doona 2028; iyo filashada dagaal milatari oo la xidhiidha Kuuriyada Waqooyi kaas oo filashadiisu tahay 40-50%; ugu danbayntiina taagtaagga ka jira Badda Shiinaha ee Koonfureed ee u dhexeeya Shiinaha, Filibiin iyo Maraykanka, kaas oo filashada korodhkiisu yahay 30%. Shanta sanno ee soo socda dagaalada la filayo mid ka mid ahi inuu qarxaa waxay ka badan tahay 50%.

items.title: Somalia’s Mobile Data Prices Rank Among Africa’s Cheapest
items.description: Somalia’s mobile data prices remain among the lowest in Africa, and at times undercut those in Kenya, Ethiopia and parts of Europe. The affordability stems from a crowded, competitive telecom market rather than any single dominant operator. Multiple private companies operate across the country, each vying for customers on price. Industry researchers and telecom analysts point to this competition, now reinforced by a modernized regulatory framework, as the driving force behind the trend. Why This Story Matters Now Affordable internet access has become central to how Somalis communicate, trade and access services, especially given limited fixed-line infrastructure. As a result, mobile data pricing carries outsized economic weight. Meanwhile, many wealthier nations with more centralized telecom sectors continue to charge consumers significantly more for the same gigabyte of data. How Competition Drove Prices Down Somalia’s telecom sector never developed a state monopoly. Instead, more than a dozen private operators have competed for market share over the past two decades. As a result, providers have repeatedly cut prices to attract and retain customers. This dynamic contrasts sharply with markets like Ethiopia’s, where a long-standing state monopoly has kept prices comparatively high. Analysts describe Somalia’s early market growth as a case where the absence of central oversight after 1991 initially let private operators build networks and compete on price largely unchecked. However, that regulatory vacuum has since closed considerably, and competition now operates within a formal framework rather than in its absence. [QUOTE: Direct quote from a Somali telecom industry analyst or National Communications Authority official on what drives the country’s low data prices] A Comparison With Regional Neighbours Multiple international surveys have placed Somalia among the cheapest countries globally for mobile data. In several of these rankings, Somalia’s average cost per gigabyte has come in lower than Kenya, Djibouti and Ethiopia. However, prices vary between operators and packages, so individual consumers may see different rates depending on the plan chosen. Actual Operator Prices: Hormuud, Somtel and Kenya’s Safaricom Broad rankings tell part of the story. Operator-level pricing shows a more detailed picture. Hormuud Telecom, Somalia’s largest carrier with roughly 45 percent market share, reports that the average customer pays about $0.50 for 1GB of data and 40 minutes of calls. A newer bundled plan, launched alongside a smartphone financing scheme in 2026, offers 7GB of data and 280 minutes weekly for $18 to $36 a month, depending on the repayment term. Somtel, Somalia’s second-largest operator with close to 30 percent market share, prices a 220GB monthly bundle at $50 through its Somaliland network, equivalent to roughly $0.23 per gigabyte. That places Somtel’s bulk pricing below Hormuud’s average daily rate, though the two plans differ in structure. Hormuud’s figure reflects typical daily spending, while Somtel’s reflects a large prepaid monthly allowance. In Kenya, Safaricom, the country’s dominant carrier, prices a standard weekly 1GB bundle at KSh 250, or roughly $1.93. That is close to four times Hormuud’s average per-gigabyte rate and more than eight times Somtel’s bulk rate. Operator Country Bundle Approx. Price Approx. Cost per GB Hormuud Telecom Somalia 1GB daily average $0.50 $0.50 Somtel Somalia 220GB monthly $50 ~$0.23 Safaricom Kenya 1GB weekly KSh 250 (~$1.93) ~$1.93   Therefore, Somalia’s two largest operators both undercut Kenya’s market leader on a per-gigabyte basis, with Somtel’s bulk pricing showing the widest gap. However, the comparison is not perfectly like-for-like: Hormuud’s figure is an average daily spend, while Somtel’s is a large monthly allowance, and Kenya’s smaller operators, such as Telkom and Airtel, offer their own discounted bulk bundles that were not included here. Verified current pricing for Somalia’s other operators, including Telesom and Golis, was not available at publication. The Regulatory Backdrop Has Shifted Somalia’s telecom sector operated in a near-total regulatory vacuum for close to two decades after the central government’s collapse in 1991. That gap has since closed. Somalia’s National Communications Authority was established under a 2012 law that was signed into force in 2017, and it has built out a substantial regulatory framework since 2018. In May 2026, the International Telecommunication Union named Somalia the world’s top performer in telecommunications regulatory reform for the 2007 to 2024 period. The country’s regulatory maturity score rose from 0.0 to 77.5 percent over that span, the largest gain recorded globally, moving Somalia into the ITU’s Generation 3 (G3) category. The ITU describes G3 as a stage focused on enabling investment, protecting consumers and strengthening market competition. Several concrete measures underpin that shift. The National Communications Authority enforces a Unified Licensing Framework covering mobile operators, infrastructure providers and internet services. It has also introduced interconnection rules that require competing operators to link their networks, along with consumer protection regulations covering pricing transparency and service quality. The Federal Parliament has additionally passed cybersecurity legislation that empowers the authority to oversee digital infrastructure. What It Means for Consumers For everyday users, low data costs translate into wider access to mobile money, news and communication tools. Meanwhile, the same market conditions have also fueled Somalia’s high mobile money adoption rates, which rank among the highest in the world. Therefore, the low cost of data is closely tied to broader shifts in how Somalis manage daily transactions and access information. Somalia mobile data prices among Africa’s cheapest – AFP via Getty images The post Somalia’s Mobile Data Prices Rank Among Africa’s Cheapest first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Daawo: Xaadoole oo raali-gelin buuxda siiyay xildhibaankii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Cismaan Xaadoole iyo Xildhibaan Maxamed Cali Cumar (Caana-nuug), oo ka wada tirsan Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta heshiis buuxa ku gaaray magaalada Muqdisho, kadib markii ay horay isku dhaafsadeen hadallo kulul. Labada Xildhibaan ayaa marar badan iska weeraray warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada, iyadoo khilaafkoodu gaaray heer ay dhex-maraan hadallo xanaf leh. Xaadoole oo hadalka ku horreeyay ayaa raalligelin siiyay Xildhibaan Caana-nuug), waxaana uu tilmaamay in siyaasadda ay la gashay meel xasaasi ah, taasina ay sababtay hadalladii iyo is-mariwaagii dhex maray labada dhinac. “Tolka labada dhinac waa ehelkayga gef ayaan naga dhacay raalli ahow xildhibaankayga, qaraabadana raalli ha’ahaato. Siyaasadda haddii la wad-wado warku meel ayuu ku boodaa ee cafis iyo masaamax,” ayuu yiri Xaadoole. Intaas kadib, waxaa hadalka qaatay Xildhibaan Maxamed Cali Cumar (Caana-nuug), kaas oo sheegay inuu aqbalay raalligelinta Xildhibaan Xaadoole. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay in khilaafkii dhex maray labada dhinac markii horeba ay warbaahintu si weyn u buunbuunisay, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Waxaa kale oo uu carrabka ku dhuftay in hadda ay ka gudbeen wixii hore u dhacay, isla markaana ay is-cafiyeen isaga iyo Xaadoole, isaga oo dadka iyo ehellada labada dhinac ugu baaqay inay ogaadaan in khilaafkii la soo afjaray. “Bani’aadamka naf iyo shaydaan ayaa kala geeya waxyaabihii yaryaraa ee annaga na dhex-maray oo Media-yaha ay aad u buun buuniyeen hadda waxaan rabaa in dadkaygii iyo qaraabadii uu kasoo jeeday iyo tolkii aan kasoo jeeday ay ogaadaan inaan is-cafinay waxbana aan isku qabin,” ayuu isna yiri Caana-nuug. Heshiiska labada Xildhibaan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli haatan magaalada Muqdisho ay ka taagan yihiin dood iyo walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo dhulalka oo ay isku hayaan dowladda iyo mucaaradka. The post Daawo: Xaadoole oo raali-gelin buuxda siiyay xildhibaankii… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Siyaasadda haddii la wad-wado warku meel ayuu ku boodaa ee cafis iyo masaamax,” ayuu yiri Xaadoole. Intaas kadib, waxaa hadalka qaatay Xildhibaan Maxamed Cali Cumar (Caana-nuug), kaas oo sheegay inuu aqbalay raalligelinta Xildhibaan Xaadoole. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay in khilaafkii dhex maray labada dhinac markii horeba ay warbaahintu si weyn u buunbuunisay, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Waxaa kale oo uu carrabka ku dhuftay in hadda ay ka gudbeen wixii hore u dhacay, isla markaana ay is-cafiyeen isaga iyo Xaadoole, isaga oo dadka iyo ehellada labada dhinac ugu baaqay inay ogaadaan in khilaafkii la soo afjaray. “Bani’aadamka naf iyo shaydaan ayaa kala geeya waxyaabihii yaryaraa ee annaga na dhex-maray oo Media-yaha ay aad u buun buuniyeen hadda waxaan rabaa in dadkaygii iyo qaraabadii uu kasoo jeeday iyo tolkii aan kasoo jeeday ay ogaadaan inaan is-cafinay waxbana aan isku qabin,” ayuu isna yiri Caana-nuug. Heshiiska labada Xildhibaan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli haatan magaalada Muqdisho ay ka taagan yihiin dood iyo walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo dhulalka oo ay isku hayaan dowladda iyo mucaaradka. items.title: Xoogsato laga hor istaagay shaqadooda oo Baydhabo ku wajahaya nolol xumo
items.description: (ERGO) – Jamaal xasan Maxamed wuxuu qoyskiisa oo toban ah u awoodi la’ yahay cunno ku filan tan bishii Luulyo. Wuxuu ka mid ah yahay boqollaal rag ah oo iyaga iyo reerahooda ay wajahayaan dhaqaale xumo markii shaqadoodii laga hor istaagay. Ninkan ayaa sheegay inay Kooxda Shabaab diideen shaqadiisa oo ahayd gurida ciidda guryaha lagu dhiso, taas oo uu ka dooni jiray bannaanka magaalada una ahayd isha nololeed. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay shaqo la’aan ku dhacday dhan kasta ka saamaysay qoyskiisa. Shabaab ayaa lacago dheerad ah ku soo rogay mulkiilayaasha gawaarida ciidda qaada, kuwaas oo awoodi waayay bixinteeda. Arrintaas darteed, ayay sheegeen in looga mamnuucay shaqadooii xoogsiga ee ay ka dhacsan jireen biilka carruurtooda. Jamaal wuxuu ka mid yahay dadka barakac ah ee ka shaqayn jiray qodista ciidda dhismaha, taas oo laga qodi jiray boholo ku yaalla duleedka Baydhabo, kadibna lagu qaadi jiray gawaarida iska-rogaha ah si loogu iib-geeyo magaalada. Ninkan ayaa sheegay in shaqo la’aantu ay sababtay in qoyskiisu ay wajahaan cunto yari daran. Wuxuu tilmaamay in ay kaalmo yar ka helaan dad ay u dan-sheegtaan, taas oo uu xusay inaysan ku filnayd qoyskiisa oo ballaaran. “Xaaladeenna nololeed waa mid aad u adag, markii hore shaqo ayaan haysanay. Ciiddii hadda dad duurka ku jira ayaa diiday. Markii hore biilka meel ayuu noo saarnaa hadda marka guri joog ayaan noqonay. Dhibaato weyn ayaa haysa.” Jamaal wuxuu intaas ku daray in shaqadiisii maalinlaha ahayd uu ka heli jiray $7 ilaa $10 oo joogta ah taas oo ugu filnayd saddex waqti oo cunto ah. Wuxuu ahaa qofka kaliya ee reerka u dhaqdhaqaaqi jiray, waxaana hadda meesha ka baxay dakhligii uu qoysku ku tiirsanaa. Qoyska jamaal waxaa dhibaatooyinka ay la halgamayaan ka mid ah biyo yari. Waxaa ku adag inay iibsadaan 20-ka litar oo lagu shubto $0.25 xerada Deg-umur oo ay deggan yihiin. Sida uu sheegay, isaga iyo xaaskiisa ayaa ceel-gacmeed gaar loo leeyahay oo loo socdo hal saac ah ka soo barya hal labaatanle oo aan ku filnayn reerkiisa. Ninkan oo 50 jir ah ayaa sheegay inay ku soo furmeen culeysyo isbiirsaday, kuwaas oo uu maarayn la’ yahay. Wuxuu tilmaamay inaysan xaaladdan oo kale horey u soo maray isla markaana ay ku soo beegantay xilli uusan u sii diyaar garoobin. Waxaa culeyska ku haya quud u helidda carruurtiisa oo uu xusay inay la qabsan la’ yihiin dabkooda oo dansan iyo inaysan helin raashin deeqa. “Markii hore seddex jeer ayaan wax karsan jirney laakiin hadda hal mar ayaan wax karsanaa. Halka wakhti ayaaba sida lagu helo dhib ah. Halka wakhti waxan ku helnaa magaalada ayaan aadaa walaal dadka ayaa baryaa.” Jamaal ayaa sheegay in seddex ka mid ah carruurtiisa laga soo eryey iskuul iyo dugsi Qur’aan bishan, markii uu awoodi waayay $30 oo uu bishii ka dhiibayay, hadda waa guri joog aan wax duruus ah qaadan. Tani waxay ku keentay rajo beel mustaqbalkooda ah. Qoyska jamaal ayaa 2022 ka soo barakacay Degmada Berdaale ee Gobolka Bay. Waxay ka soo tageen beer 5 hiktar ah, markii ay nacfi tirtay roob yari uu sheegay inay deegaanka ka jirtay dhawr xilli oo isku xigay. Ragga carrada ka xamaalan jiray ayaa wajahaya saamayn isku mid ah. Nuuradiin Macalin Aadan wuxuu sheegay inuu maarayn la’ yahay nolosha qoyskiisa oo sideed ah. Ninkan ayaa ka fursan waayay inuu dhex wareego xaafadaha magaalada isaga dadka waydiisanaya kaalmo. Marka uu soo waayo ayuu sheegay inay deriska habeennada qaar ay ka helaan raashin bisil oo ay isugu soo daraan. Waxaa u dheer baahiyaha kale ee qoyska oo ku soo wada furmay. “Biyaha waxaan ku heli jirney marka aan lacagtay joornaatiga ah soo qaato. $0.25 ayaan ku dhaansan jirney. Hadda marka in deriska loo tago oo albaabada aan garaacno oo jirgaankoo biyo ah ama 10 litar aan weydiisano. Hadda jirgaanka ayaaba noo genbiyay oo aan haysan.” Nuuradiin ayaa sheegay muddo afar sano ah inay nolosha qoyskiisa ku tiirsanayd dhaqaalaha uu ka heli jiray ciid qodista oo u dhaxeeyay 7 ilaa 10 doollar, balse hadda uu faro maran yahay. Wuxuu tilmaamay inuusan wax kayd ah horey meel u dhigan, taas oo saamaynta ku xoojisay. Wuxuu intaas ku daray inuusan lahayn xirfad kale oo uu ku shaqeeyo. Subax walba wuxuu u baxa raadinta shaqo xamaal ah, balse ma helo. Wuxuu sheegay inay isaga iyo qoyskiisa ay hadda ku sugan yihiin xaalad quus ah. Wuxuu xusay inay sidoo kale culays ku heyso deyn $35 ah, oo looga kala leeyahay dugsi Qur’aanka iyo iskuul isku gaartay labo bilood. Wuxuu sheegay in dukaan uu raashin ka amaahanayay looga diiday markii loo sheegya in buugiisii la xiray. Ninkan oo barakac ku ah xerada Doygaab oo mudo laba sano ah ayaa weli leh rajo ah inuu shaqadiisii dib ugu laabto balse ma hubo goor ay noqon iyadoo culeyska dhaqaale ee haysta ay uu sii kordhayo marba marka ka danbaysa. “Hadda welwelka i hayo – xaafada iyo nolosheenna – ayaan aad uga fikirayaa. Middeeda kale Ilaah shaqo ha noo bixiyo. Waxaa hadda dhibaato nagu haysa inta aan shaqada ka harney deyn badan ayaan galney. Carruurta noloshooda ayaa qiiqiil naga-shay.” Nuuradiin ayaa sheegay inay hayso sidoo kale hoy xumo markii dabayl xooggan ka dumisey buush ay gabbaadsan jireen. Hadda waxay bannaan-yaal u yihiin dhaxanta iyo fallaaraha cadceedda. Ninkan ayaa xusay in mulkiilayaasha gawaarida ay isku dayeen inay si dhuumalaysi ah ku shaqeeyaan, hasa ahaate ay ku guul-daraysteen, markii ay Shabaab afduubteen saddex gawaari. Arrintaas waxay sababtay in kuwii kale ay u cabsadaan naftooda iyo hantidooda. Qoyska Nuuradiin waxay sanadkii 2024 ka soo barakaceen deegaanka Goof-gaduud Buurey ee hoostaga Baydhabo, markii jilaal ba’an uu nacfi tirtay beer Afar hektar ah oo ay noloshoodu ku tiirsaneyd. Cabdinaasir Cabdi Cali oo ka mid ah guddi ay gaadiidlaydan ku midaysan yihiin ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegey in arrintan saameyn weyn ku yeelatey qoysaskooda, kuwaas oo ilaa iyo hadda aan helin beddel kale oo ay noloshooda ka maareeyaan. “Runtii caqabado waa weyn ayaan xilligan na haysata lacago xaqdhaaf ah oo nagula soo rogey taas oo is keeni weydey. Marka hadda xitaa waxaa jira gaadiid oo u xiran Alshabaab oo lacagooyinkaas iyo waxyaabahaas dartood loo haysto.” Cabdinaasir ayaa xusay in qoysas badan oo noloshooda ka maareyn jirey qodista carrada iyo rarkeeda ay wajahayaan hubanti la’aan. Wuxuu tilmaamay gaari kasta lagu waajibiyay bishii 200 doollaar, taas oo aysan awoodin. Wuxuu codsaday si degdeg ah loo xalliyo cabashadooda. Qoysaska soo barakacay oo aan lahayn ilo kale oo dhaqaale oo sugan, waxay had iyo jeer u nugul yihiin saamaynta ka dhalata shaqo la’aanta, taas oo u horseeda khalkhal ku yimaada hab-nololeedkooda. items.title: Somalia Participates in East African Education Conference
items.description: Somalia’s Deputy Minister of Education, Culture and Higher Education has led the Somali delegation to the Second Regional Education Conference of the East African Community (EAC), held from 25–28 August 2026 at Safari Park Hotel in Nairobi, Kenya. The conference brought together over 600 delegates, including ministers, senior officials, development partners, civil society organizations, academics and other stakeholders committed to advancing education in the region. This second conference marked a significant step in addressing the education challenges facing the region and strengthening cooperation among EAC member states. The Somali delegation actively participated in discussions focused on improving and reforming education, with education identified as a crucial pillar for integration, development and the future of the East African region. Delegates reviewed progress made on the outcomes of the First Regional Education Conference, held in Arusha, Tanzania, in August 2024. Participants agreed on joint measures to accelerate transformation, enhance quality and advance education across the region. Key issues discussed included: Education financing: Delegates agreed on the need to increase education funding across all EAC states. Teacher training: The importance of strengthening teacher training and professional development was emphasized. Harmonization of education systems: A decision was made to create a common education framework to facilitate the movement of students and teachers across member states. The Somali delegation shared the country’s experiences and lessons learned, reaffirming Somalia’s commitment to regional integration and educational development. The post Somalia Participates in East African Education Conference first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Soomaaliya Oo Ka Qayb Gashay Shirka Waxbarashada Bariga Afrika
items.description: Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Dhaqanka iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Soomaaliya ayaa hoggaamiyay wafdiga Soomaaliya ee ka qaybgalay Shirka Labaad ee Waxbarashada Gobolka ee Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC), kaas oo 25-28 Agosto 2026 lagu qabtay Hotel Safari Park ee magaalada Nairobi, Kenya . Shirka waxaa ka qaybgalay in ka badan 600 oo mas’uuliyiin ah oo ay ku jiraan wasiirro, saraakiil sare, bah-wadaagta horumarinta, ururrada bulshada rayidka ah, aqoonyahanno iyo daneeyayaal kale . Shirkan labaad ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo muhiim ah oo looga jawaabayo caqabadaha waxbarasho ee gobolka iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga waxbarasho ee bulshada Bariga Afrika . Wafdiga Soomaaliya ayaa kaga qayb qaatay doodaha shirka, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saaray horumarinta iyo dib-u-habaynta waxbarashada gobolka, iyadoo waxbarashada loo aqoonsaday tiir muhiim u ah is-dhexgalka, horumarka iyo mustaqbalka bulshada Bariga Afrika . Shirka waxaa lagu qiimeeyay horumarkii laga sameeyay qodobadii kasoo baxay Shirkii Koowaad ee Waxbarashada Gobolka EAC, oo lagu qabtay Arusha, Tanzania, Agosto 2024 . Ka qaybgalayaashu waxay isla meel dhigeen tallaabooyin wadajir ah oo lagu dardargelinayo isbeddelka, tayeynta iyo horumarinta waxbarashada gobolka . Arrimaha muhiimka ah ee shirka laga hadlay waxaa ka mid ah: Maalgelinta waxbarashada: Ka qaybgalayaashu waxay isku raaceen in la kordhiyo maalgelinta waxbarashada iyadoo loo dhan yahay dhammaan dalalka EAC . Tababarka macallimiinta: Waxaa la xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo tababarka macallimiinta iyo horumarinta xirfadooda . items.title: Daawo: Muuse Suudi oo si yaab leh uga hadlay xiisadda dhulka ee ka taagan Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Senator Muuse Suudi Yalaxow oo ka tirsan Golaha Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ka hadlay xiisadda ka dhalatay dhulalka magaalada Muqdisho, taas oo maalmihii lasoo dhaafay sii xoogeysaneysay, iyadoo ay barbar socoto barakac iyo cabashooyin kasoo yeeraya shacabka ku nool qaar kamid ah degmooyinka Gobolka Banaadir. Muuse Suudi ayaa si weyn u difaacay qorshaha dowladda ee la xiriira dhulalka ku yaalla caasimadda, isagoo sheegay in tallaabooyinka dowladda ay qeyb ka yihiin qorshe lagu horumarinayo, laguna qurxinayo magaalada Muqdisho. Sidoo kale wuxuu tilmaamay haddii la horumarinayo caasimada ay lama huraan tahay in dib-u-habeyn iyo qorsheyn laga sameeyo dhulalka, gaar ahaan Obasiibooyinka ku yaalla gudaha magaalada Muqdisho. “Dhulka haddii la qurxinaayo barakicin miyaa?” ayuu ku jawaabay Senator Muuse Suudi oo wax laga weydiiyay dhulboobka ka socda Muqdisho. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli magaalada Muqdisho ay ka taagan yihiin dood iyo walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan burburinta ay dowladdu ka waddo xaafado ka tirsan magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo qaar kamid ah shacabka ay ka cabanayaan in tallaabooyinkaasi ay saameyn ku yeeshaan guryahooda iyo deegaanada ay ku noolaayeen, maadaama la galiyay cagafyo, lana burburiyay. Dowladda ayaa ku doodeyso in qorshaheeda uu yahay in la hagaajiyo dhulalka Obasiibooyinka, si loo qurxiyo, looguna furo waddooyin waa wayn. Waxaa kale oo ay shaaca ka qaaday in dhulalkaas loo sharciyeynayo dadkii lahaa, dibna loogu wareejinayo. “Waxaan rabaa hal mid inaan caddeeyo dhulka Obasiibada ah dadkii deganaa ayaa loo sharciyeynayaa Madaxweynaha waxa uu nagu ogyahay waa taas. Qof document haysto dhulkeeda waa lama taabtaan daraadna annaga iyo culumada ayaan ka wada-hadalnay,” ayuu horay u yiri Duqa Muqdisho. Si kastaba, xiisadda dhulalka ee ka taagan caasimada ayaa haatan gaartay meeshii ugu sarreysay, iyadoo qaylo dhaanta ka dhalatay burburinta ay waddo dowladda si weyn looga dareemay magaalada caasimada ah ee Muqdisho. The post Daawo: Muuse Suudi oo si yaab leh uga hadlay xiisadda dhulka ee ka taagan Muqdisho appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: One Swim That Could Save a Life: Children in Mogadishu Learning Water Safety.
items.description: At Liido Beach in Mogadishu, a group of children are spending two days a week learning swimming and water-safety skills as part of a free campaign aimed at reducing child deaths caused by drowning. The programme is designed for children under the age of 15, including both boys and girls. Participants are taught how to swim, how to avoid dangers in the water, and the proper ways to assist someone who has fallen into the water without putting themselves at risk. Asha Geesdiir, who leads the campaign, said the programme was created in response to concerns about the number of children drowning along Mogadishu’s beaches, particularly during school holidays when families frequently visit the coast. “During the training, children are taught important safety techniques, such as not attempting to grab someone who is drowning directly, because a person in panic may put the rescuer at risk,” Asha said. She explained that instead of approaching a drowning person directly, children are taught how to use safety equipment and apply appropriate water-rescue techniques. The programme does not focus only on children. Parents who attend are also given safety information to help them understand the risks their children face when visiting the beach without swimming and water-safety skills. Leylo Hussein, who sells life jackets at Liido Beach, said many children enter the sea without using safety equipment. “Many times, I have witnessed children losing their lives in the sea. Some of these children leave their parents without their knowledge and enter the water without wearing life jackets,” Leylo said. Parents who bring their children to the training welcomed the initiative, saying that learning to swim and understanding water safety gives children skills that could save their lives. “Teaching children about water safety and preventing drowning is very important. I brought two of my children here, a girl and a boy, and I hope they will learn to swim well and that the instructor will help them,” said Leylo, one of the parents attending the training. Drowning: A Particular Risk for Children The campaign comes at a time when global attention is focused on preventing deaths caused by drowning. In 2021, the United Nations officially recognised 25 July as World Drowning Prevention Day, aimed at raising public awareness and promoting efforts to reduce drowning deaths. Drowning does not only occur in the sea. It can also happen in rivers, swimming pools and other bodies of water. Children are among those most vulnerable to drowning, particularly when they cannot swim or do not have adequate supervision or access to safety equipment. Those involved in the campaign believe that teaching children to swim, raising awareness among parents and promoting the use of safety equipment are important measures that can help reduce child deaths caused by drowning. They are calling on parents to encourage their children to learn how to swim and to closely supervise them whenever they visit beaches or other places where there is water. By Maryan Abdiqani Hussein, Bilan Media   The post One Swim That Could Save a Life: Children in Mogadishu Learning Water Safety. first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somalia to Issue New Currency for First Time in 35 Years
items.description: Somalia is preparing to issue new Somali shilling banknotes for the first time in 35 years, with the central bank confirming that preparations have reached an advanced stage. The move comes at a time when traders in Mogadishu have begun rejecting old banknotes due to their deteriorating condition, and the government is seeking to restore monetary sovereignty. The initiative is significant as it represents a major step toward rebuilding the country’s financial system. Parliament is currently reviewing laws for a Currency Board to strengthen monetary authority, while the central bank is finalising regulations for reserve management and foreign exchange. These efforts aim to restore public confidence in the national currency and reduce reliance on the US dollar, which has dominated Somalia’s economy for decades. There are several reasons behind the urgency of this plan. The current shilling notes have severely deteriorated, with some reportedly tied together with string or elastic bands to keep them intact. In April 2026, traders in Mogadishu began refusing old banknotes, making it difficult for many people particularly low-income households to pay for basic goods. The move also comes amid declining international support. The United States has announced it will end funding for the African Union mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) by 2027, increasing pressure on the government to strengthen its domestic institutions and reduce reliance on foreign aid. Restoring the Somali shilling, however, is not without challenges. It will require rebuilding public trust while strengthening banks and financial institutions. The Somali economy has long been heavily dollarised, with the US dollar used for trade, savings, and mobile money transactions. items.title: Soomaaliya Oo Diyaarinaysa Lacag Cusub 35 Sano Kadib
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa qorsheynaysa inay soo saarto lacag cusub oo Shilling Soomaali ah, taasoo ah markii ugu horreysay muddo 35 sano ah, iyadoo Baanka Dhexe uu sheegay in diyaar-garowgu uu gaaray heer sare . Go’aankan ayaa imaanaya xilli ay ganacsatada Muqdisho ay diideen inay aqbalaan Shilling-ka Soomaaliyeed sababtoo ah xaaladdiisa oo sii xumaatay , iyadoo dowladdu ay qorsheynayso dib-u-soo-celinta madax-bannaanida maaliyadeed. Qorshahan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo weyn oo ay dowladdu uga dhowaanayso dib-u-dhiska nidaamka maaliyadeed, iyadoo Baarlamaanku uu dib u eegayo sharciyada Guddiga Lacagta (Currency Board) si loo xoojiyo awoodda maaliyadeed . Baanka Dhexe ayaa sidoo kale dhammeeynaya sharciyada ku saabsan maareynta keydka iyo sarifka lacagaha qalaad, taasoo qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo kalsoonida dadweynaha . Waxaa jira sababo badan oo keena in qorshahan loo baahdo. Shilling-ka hadda jira ayaa si weyn u xumaaday, waxaana la sheegay in qaar ka mid ah lacagaha lagu xidho xargo ama laastiko si ay u sii jiraan . Ganacsatada Muqdisho ayaa bilaabay diidmada lacagaha duugga ah bishii Abriil 2026, taasoo keentay in dad badan ay ku adkaato inay bixiyaan waxyaabaha aasaasiga ah, gaar ahaan kuwa dakhligoodu hooseeyo . Dhanka kale, Soomaaliya waxay wajahaysaa taageero caalami oo yaraata, iyadoo Maraykanku uu sheegay inuu joojin doono taageerada loo fidiyo howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM laga bilaabo 2027 . Tani waxay sii kordhinaysaa cadaadiska ku saabsan in dowladdu ay xoojiso hay’adaheeda gudaha oo ay yareyso ku-tiirsanaanta taageerada dibadda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dib-u-soo-celinta Shilling-ka Soomaaliyeed ma aha mid fudud, waxayna u baahan tahay in la dhiso kalsoonida dadweynaha, iyadoo la xoojinayo bangiyada iyo hay’adaha maaliyadda . Dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya ayaa muddo dheer ku tiirsanaa doolarka Maraykanka, kuasoo loo adeegsado ganacsiga, keydka, iyo bixinta lacagta mobilada . The post Soomaaliya Oo Diyaarinaysa Lacag Cusub 35 Sano Kadib first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Itoobiya oo qaaday tallaabo ka dhan ah lix shirkad oo ka dhisan Soomaaliya
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Bankiga Dhexe ee Itoobiya ayaa digniin ka soo saaray toddobo shirkadood oo xawaalado Soomaali ah, isaga oo sheegay in shirkadahaasi aysan haysan oggolaansho ay adeegyada lacag-dirista uga bixiyaan gudaha Itoobiya. Bankiga Qaranka Itoobiya (NBE) ayaa Jimcihii soo saaray digniintan, taas oo qayb ka ah tallaabo ballaaran oo uu kaga digayo shirkadaha lacagaha dira ee aan ruqsadda haysan iyo shabakadaha xawaaladaha sharci-darrada ah. Shirkadaha Soomaalida ee lagu magacaabay digniinta ayaa kala ah Amal Express, Amana Express, Bakaal Money Transfer, Jubba Express, Ramad Pay/Ramada Pay (Kaah), Taaj Financial Service iyo Tawakal Money Services . Toddobadan shirkadood ayaa ka mid ah 17 hay’adood oo NBE uu sheegay inaysan fasax u haysan inay adeegyada xawaaladaha ka bixiyaan Itoobiya. Si kastaba, digniinta bankiga waxay si gaar ah ugu saabsan tahay adeegyada lacagaha loo diro Itoobiya. Taas macnaheedu ma aha in shirkadahan aysan sharci ama ruqsad ku haysan Soomaaliya ama dalal kale oo ay ka howlgalaan. Halista macaamiisha Bankiga Dhexe ee Itoobiya ayaa sheegay in adeegsiga shirkadaha lacag-dirista ee aan ruqsadda haysan iyo xawaaladaha sharci-darrada ah uu macaamiisha gelin karo halis dhaqaale iyo mid sharci. “Lacagaha lagu kala diro shirkadaha aan la oggolaan iyo xawaaladaha sharci-darrada ah waxay sababi karaan khasaare dhaqaale, dib-u-dhac ku yimaada lacag-bixinta iyo xannibaad lagu sameeyo akoonnada,” ayuu bankigu yiri. NBE ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dadka lacagaha dira iyo kuwa qaata, oo ay ku jiraan qoysaska loo soo diro lacagaha, ay wajihi karaan tallaabooyin sharci iyo kuwo maamul oo waafaqsan shuruucda Itoobiya. Bankiga ayaa sheegay inuu hore digniino uga soo saaray shirkadaha lacag-dirista ee aan shatiga haysan iyo shabakadaha xawaaladaha sharci-darrada ah, wuxuuna dadka Itoobiyaanka ah ee dibadda ku nool iyo guud ahaan shacabka ugu baaqay inay isticmaalaan oo keliya adeegyada rasmiga ah ee la oggol yahay. NBE ayaa tilmaamay in xilligan ay kordhayaan lacagaha dibadda laga soo diro, sidaas darteedna ay muhiim tahay in macaamiishu xaqiijiyaan xaaladda sharci ee shirkadda ay adeegsanayaan ka hor inta aysan lacag dirin ama qaadan. items.title: Howlgal ka dhan ah sidii looga hor-tagi lahaa Burcad-badeeda oo laga tashanayo
items.description: Boosaaso (Raxanreeb Online) Xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo marin-biyoodka Gacanka Cadmeed ayaa mar kale wajahaya walaac dhinaca amniga badda ah, kaddib markii ay kordheen weerarrada iyo isku-dayada lagu beegsanayo maraakiibta ganacsiga. Hay’adaha la socda amniga maraakiibta ayaa muujinaysa in 13 dhacdo oo la xiriira burcad-badeednimo laga diiwaangeliyey Soomaaliya toddobadii bilood ee ugu horreeyay sanadkan 2026. Tiradani waxay la mid tahay wadarta dhacdooyinkii laga diiwaangeliyey labada sano ee 2024 iyo 2025. Dib-u-soo-kabashada burcad-badeedda ayaa si gaar ah u soo shaacbaxday tan iyo bishii Abriil, xilligaas oo dhowr markab lagu afduubtay ama lagu weeraray xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Badaha ee IMO ayaa bishii Luulyo sheegtay in 44 shaqaale markab ah lagu hayay afduub gudaha biyaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo ay saarnaayeen saddex markab oo la afduubtay. Arrintan ayaa walaac cusub ku abuurtay dalalka iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee maraakiibtoodu ka shaqeeyaan Badweynta Hindiya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah ayaa muddo dheer door weyn ka qaatay yareynta burcad-badeednimadii Soomaaliya, balse khatarta cusub waxay imaanaysaa xilli ciidamada badda qaarkood ay sidoo kale ku mashquulsan yihiin amniga Badda Cas iyo marinno kale oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka. Haddaba waxaa soo baxaya baahi loo qabo in la xoojiyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya, ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah iyo hay’adaha ilaaliya maraakiibta ganacsiga. Ujeeddadu waa in la kordhiyo wadaagga xogta, kormeerka badda iyo awoodda looga hortagayo weerarrada ka dhanka ah maraakiibta. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, khubaradu waxay tilmaamayaan in xaaladda maanta aysan weli la mid ahayn heerkii ugu sarreeyay ee burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya sanadihii 2009 ilaa 2011, markaas oo weerarradu ay gaareen boqolaal dhacdo sanad kasta. The post Howlgal ka dhan ah sidii looga hor-tagi lahaa Burcad-badeeda oo laga tashanayo appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .
