items.title: Lafta-gareen oo ka qeyliyey qorshe laga damacsan yahay
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen, oo weli sheegta inuu yahay madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, ayaa si adag uga horyimid eedeymo maleeshiyada taabacsan loogu xiriiriyay Al-Shabaab, isaga oo Midowga Afrika iyo howlgalka AUSSOM uga digay inay ku lug yeeshaan khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo midka militari ee ka taagan maamulka. War-saxaafadeed Khamiistii kasoo baxay xafiis Laftagareen uu weli ugu yeero “Madaxtooyada Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed” ayaa walaac looga muujiyay qoraal ay Guddiga Midowga Afrika soo saartay 21-kii Agoosto, kaas oo la sheegay inuu daba socday codsi dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya u gudbisay AUSSOM oo la xiriira xaaladda amni ee Koonfur Galbeed. Laftagareen iyo garabkiisa ayaa si buuxda u diiday eedeymaha ciidamadooda oo ay ugu yeereen “Daraawiishta” la xiriirinaya kooxda Al-Shabaab. Qoraalka ayaa lagu sheegay in ciidamadaasi yihiin ciidan “si sharci ah loo dhisay”, isla markaana loo igmaday ilaalinta shacabka, hay’adaha dowladda, amniga iyo nidaamka dastuuriga ah ee Koonfur Galbeed. “Ku tilmaamidda ciidamadaas ‘maleeshiyaad xiriir la leh Al-Shabaab’, iyadoo aysan jirin caddeyn si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyay, waxay halis gelinaysaa shacabka iyo ciidamada ammaanka, waxayna dhaawici kartaa kalsoonida lagu qabo AUSSOM,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli dowladda federaalka iyo dhinaca Laftagareen ay isku hayaan xaaladda Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo khilaafka siyaasadeed uu marar dhowr ah isku beddelay iska horimaad hubeysan. AUSSOM oo loo digay Qoraalka ayaa si gaar ah uga digay in khilaafka siyaasadeed ee gudaha Soomaaliya lagu dhex daro dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Garabka Laftagareen ayaa sheegay in khilaafaadka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, hannaan dastuuri ah iyo heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, halkii loo adeegsan lahaa awood militari. Waxa uu ka digay in adeegsiga awood militari oo lagu gaarayo ujeeddooyin siyaasadeed ay sii hurin karto rabshadaha, barakaca iyo kala qeybsanaanta bulshada. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in Laftagareen iyo maamulkiisa ay soo dhoweynayaan waxa ay ku tilmaameen “tilmaanta cad” ee ku jirta qoraalka Midowga Afrika ee ah in AUSSOM ay ilaaliso dhex-dhexaadnimadeeda, kana fogaato ku lug lahaanshaha khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee gudaha Soomaaliya. Waxay ugu baaqeen Midowga Afrika iyo AUSSOM inay marka hore sameeyaan baaritaan madax-bannaan oo lagu xaqiijinayo xaqiiqooyinka, ka hor inta aysan taageerin ama qeyb ka noqon wax howlgal militari ah. Digniin ku saabsan Baydhaba Laftagareen ayaa si gaar ah uga digay tallaabo militari oo ka dhacda Baydhaba iyo deegaannada ku dhow, isagoo sheegay in howlgal kasta oo halkaas laga fuliyo uu keeni karo duqeyn, barakac ama waxyeello soo gaarta dadka rayidka ah. “Dhammaan howlgalladu waa inay si buuxda ugu hoggaansamaan sharciga caalamiga ah ee bani’aadannimada, waajibaadka ilaalinta rayidka iyo xeerarka hawlgalka AUSSOM,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Garabka Laftagareen ayaa sidoo kale dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya AUSSOM, Midowga Afrika, Qaramada Midoobay iyo saaxiibada caalamka ugu baaqay inaysan ku tiirsanaan xog aan la xaqiijin ama eedeymo ay siyaasadi dabada ka riixeyso. Waxa uu sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu bixiyo xogta uu hayo, isla markaana uu ka qeyb-galo baaritaan madax-bannaan oo lagu xaqiijinayo xaqiiqooyinka. Qoraalka ayaa nuqullo loo diray madaxda Midowga Afrika iyo AUSSOM, Qaramada Midoobay, dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalka, Midowga Yurub, safaaradaha Mareykanka, Britain iyo Turkiga iyo urur-goboleedka IGAD. Waxaa xusid mudan in qoraalka loo soo saaray magaca “Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed” iyo “Xafiiska Madaxweynaha” , inkastoo Laftagareen uu hadda dibad-joog ku yahay Nairobi, islamarkaana uu weli ku adkeysanayo sheegashada ah inuu hayo sharciyadda madaxtinimada Koonfur Galbeed. items.title: Dawladda Somaliland oo dalka Qatar ka diiday in ay wada hadal la furto Somalia isla markaana joojiso xidhiidhka Israel
items.description: Ilo wareedyo lagu kalsoonyahay ayaa sheegaya in wafdi heer sare ah oo ka socda Qatar ay booqdeen Hargeysa iyagoo doonaya inay ku qanciyaan Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Cirro inuu dib u bilaabo wadahadallada Soomaaliya iyo inuu ka fogaado xidhiidhka sii kordhaya ee Israa’iil. Waftigu waxay bixiyeen maalgelin amni iyo kaabayaal oo muhiim ah oo qayb ka ah hawlgalka la soo jeediyay, sida ay ilo wareedyadu sheegeen. Somaliland way diiday habkaas, iyadoo caddeysay inaysan ku laaban doonin wadahadallo furan oo ay la yeelan doonto Soomaaliya ama aysan wax ka beddeli doonin xidhiidhkeeda istaraatiijiyadeed si ay u hesho kaalmo dhaqaale. Waxana ay Somaliland ku adkaystay in xidhiidhka Somaliland iyo Israa’iil aanay sinba waxba isga bedeli doonin oo ay Israel ay ahaan doonto saaxiib mihiim ah oo ay Somaliland leedahay.

Waxana ay Somaliland ku adkaystay in xidhiidhka Somaliland iyo Israa’iil aanay sinba waxba isga bedeli doonin oo ay Israel ay ahaan doonto saaxiib mihiim ah oo ay Somaliland leedahay.

items.title: TURKIGA oo war soo saaray kadib eedeyntii PUNTLAND
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga ayaa markii ugu horreysay si rasmi ah uga hadashay dhacdooyinka amni ee ka socda xeebaha Puntland, xilli maamulka Puntland uu Ankara ku eedeeyay inay ka dambeyso duqeymo dhowaan ka dhacay gobolka Nugaal oo ay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 13 qof. Wasaaradda ayaa Khamiistii sheegtay in Taliska Ciidamada Wadajirka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu taageero siinayo hay’adaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo aan si cad u sheegin in ciidamada Turkigu ay fuliyeen duqeymaha lagu muransan yahay. “Taliska Ciidamada Wadajirka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga wuxuu sii wadaa taageerada uu ku horumarinayo awoodda Soomaaliya ee la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo burcad-badeedda, iyadoo la raacayo heshiisyada ay labada dal kala saxiixdeen,” ayay wasaaraddu ku tiri bayaan kooban . Waxay intaas ku dartay in “taageerada lagama maarmaanka ah” la siinayo hay’adaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo arrinta lagala shaqeynayo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga, gaar ahaan dhacdada ka dhacday biyaha Soomaaliya. Bayaanka Turkiga ma uusan faahfaahin nooca taageerada uu siinayo dowladda Soomaaliya, mana uusan si toos ah uga jawaabin eedeynta Puntland ee ah in ciidamada Turkigu fuliyeen duqeymaha. Hase yeeshee qoraalka ayaa u muuqda qirasho howl-gal. Hadalkan ayaa ah jawaabtii ugu caddeyd ee Ankara kasoo baxda tan iyo markii ay billowdeen su’aalaha ku saabsan cidda ka dambeysa weerarrada ka dhacay xeebaha Nugaal. Puntland oo Turkiga eedeysay Wasiir ku-xigeenka amniga Puntland, Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf Dujaana, ayaa BBC Somali u sheegay in maamulkiisu aaminsan yahay in Turkigu ka dambeeyo laba duqeyn oo dhimasho sababay. Dujaana ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya inay qeyb ka tahay arrimaha socda, inkastoo uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyay oo Ankara ama Muqdisho si toos ah ugu xiraya weerarrada. “Anagu burcad-badeed waan la-dagaallameynaa, laakiin qofku xuquuq buu leeyahay. Qofka la iska ma dili karo,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sheegay in Puntland ay hayso “caddeymo” la xiriira dhaqdhaqaaqyada Turkiga ee markabka la afduubtay iyo xeebaha ku hareeraysan, balse eedeymahaas weli si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Illaa hadda ma jirto dowlad, ciidan ama koox si rasmi ah u sheegatay mas’uuliyadda duqeymaha. Weeraro dhimasho sababay Duqeyntii ugu horreysay ayaa dhacday 18-kii Agoosto, maalin kaddib markii burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ay afduubteen markabka M/V LUTUF oo ku gooshayay calanka Cameroon. Afar qof ayaa lagu dilay, laba kalena waa lagu dhaawacay weerar ka dhacay agagaarka Garmaal, kaddib markii doon yar ay kasoo laabatay dhinaca markabka la afduubtay. Wararkii hore ayaa dadka la dilay qaarkood ku tilmaamay burcad-badeed, balse ehelladooda iyo dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah ay ahaayeen kalluumeysato. Duqeyn labaad ayaa 23-kii Agoosto ka dhacday deegaanka Jiifle ee degmada Godob-Jiraan, waxaana duqa deegaanka uu BBC-da u sheegay in sagaal qof lagu dilay. Qof deegaanka ah oo goobta tegay ayaa sheegay inuu arkay siddeed meyd oo si xun u gubtay, isagoo sheegay in qaar ka mid ah dhalinyarada doonta saarneyd deegaanka looga yaqaanay kalluumeysato. Si kastaba, ma uusan xaqiijin karin sababta ay badda ugu jireen ama in dhammaan dadka doonta saarnaa ay xiriir la lahaayeen burcad-badeedda. Markabka hubka siday M/V LUTUF ayaa la afduubtay 17-kii Agoosto meel qiyaastii 3.5 mayl-badeed u jirta xeebta Marraya ee degmada Eyl. Sarkaal Soomaali ah ayaa wakaaladda AP u sheegay in markabku siday hub laga keenay Turkiga, qalab isgaarsiin iyo nidaamyo dayax-gacmeed oo ku sii jeeday xarun tababar milatari oo Turkigu ku leeyahay Muqdisho. Markabka waxaa saarnaa 10 shaqaale ah oo ay ku jiraan lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Georgian ah iyo laba Serbian ah oo ilaalo ahaan u shaqeynayay. AP ayaa sidoo kale werisay in maraakiib, diyaarado qumaatiga u kaca iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Turkigu ay la socdeen dhaq-dhaqaaqa markabka kaddib afduubka. Burcad-badeedda ayaa la sheegay inay dalbadeen lacag madaxfurasho ah oo gaareysa ku dhowaad laba milyan oo dollar. Doorka dowladda federaalka Su’aalaha ku saabsan duqeymaha ayaa sii xoogeysanaya kaddib markii wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Cumar Cali Cabdi, uu 22-kii Agoosto sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay ka warqabto howlgallo milatari iyo duqeymo ka socda xeebaha Puntland. Waxa uu sheegay in dowladda ay diyaarineyso “warbixin dhameystiran”, balse ma uusan magacaabin cidda fulineysa weerarrada. Cumar Cali Cabdi ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in haddii howlgal milatari oo ka dhan ah burcad-badeedda laga fulinayo xeebaha Soomaaliya, dowladda federaalka ay tahay hay’adda sharci ahaan mas’uulka ka ah fasaxa howlgalkaas. Turkiga ayaa Soomaaliya ku leh joogitaan milatari oo ballaaran, wuxuuna Muqdisho ku leeyahay mid ka mid ah xarumaha tababarka milatari ee ugu waaweyn ee uu dibadda ku leeyahay. Labada dal ayaa sidoo kale 2024 kala saxiixday heshiis difaac iyo iskaashi dhaqaale oo muddo 10 sano ah, kaas oo Ankara kaalin weyn ka siinaya dhismaha iyo tababarka ciidamada badda Soomaaliya iyo sugidda xeebaha dalka. Bayaanka cusub ee Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga ayaa xaqiijinaya in Ankara taageero ka bixinayso dhacdada ka taagan biyaha Soomaaliya, balse weli kama jawaabayo su’aasha ugu weyn ee taagan: cidda fulisay duqeymaha dhimashada sababay ee Puntland. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Dalalka Gobolka oo Ku Heshiiyay Xoojinta Iskaashiga Amniga Badda
items.description: Soomaaliya, Itoobiya, Jabuuti iyo Yemen ayaa magaalada Nairobi ku yeeshay shir laba maalmood socday oo looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga amniga badda iyo sidii si wadajir ah wax looga qaban lahaa khataraha ka jira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Shirka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray burcad-badeednimada, tahriibinta dadka iyo dambiyada abaabulan ee ka dhaca marin-biyoodka gobolka. Dalalka ka qeybgalay ayaa isku raacay in la xoojiyo wadaagga xogta amniga iyo sirdoonka, isla markaana la abuuro xiriir toos ah oo u dhexeeya hay’adaha sharci-fulinta iyo ciidamada ilaalada xeebaha, si khataraha loo ogaado loogana hortago ka hor inta aysan saameyn ku yeelan maraakiibta iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Shirka waxaa fududeysay Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Daroogada iyo Dambiyada (UNODC), waxaana taageeray Midowga Yurub, INTERPOL, Hay’adda Badaha Caalamiga ah (IMO) iyo IGAD. Si kastaba, heshiiska ka soo baxay kulanka ayaa hadda ah is-afgarad heer hawleed ah, mana jirto weli faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan heshiis sharciyeed oo buuxa, xarun mideysa xog-wadaagga, miisaaniyadda ama jadwal cad oo lagu dhaqan-gelinayo qorshayaasha la isku raacay. Iskaashigan ayaa muhiim u noqon kara Soomaaliya iyo dalalka ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, maadaama gobolka uu yahay marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta caalamiga ah.

items.title: DF oo ciidamo cusub ku tababaraysa Bakool + Qorshaha
items.description: Waajid (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamo ka tirsan xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa tababar ciidan uga socda xero ku taalla degmada Waajid ee gobolka Bakool, iyadoo la filayo inay ka qayb qaataan howl-gallada amni ee ka socda deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed marka ay soo dhameystaan tababarkooda. Ciidamadan ayaa lagu wadaa in loo diyaariyo hawlo militari oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo tababarka uu qayb ka yahay qorshaha lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada dowladda ee ku sugan gobollada koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. Saraakiil ka tirsan xoogga dalka ayaa gaaray xerada, halkaas oo ay ku sameeyeen kormeer ku saabsan habka tababarka ciidamada iyo goobaha ay ku qaadanayaan casharrada militari. Intii uu socday kormeerka, saraakiisha ayaa sidoo kale warbixinno ka dhageystay macallimiinta iyo tababarayaasha mas’uulka ka ah ciidamada, iyagoo xog ka helay heerka ay marayaan diyaarinta iyo tababarka askarta. Tababarkan ayaa ku soo aadaya xilli Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay xoogga saareyso dhismaha iyo tayeynta ciidamada qaranka, si ay si weyn ugu diyaar garoobaan qaadista mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Qorshaha ayaa sidoo kale la xiriira marxaladda kala-guurka amniga Soomaaliya, iyadoo ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ay si tartiib ah ugu wareejinayaan ciidamada Soomaaliyeed masuuliyadda amniga goobaha ay hadda ka howlgalaan. Dowladda ayaa horey u qaaday tallaabooyin la xiriira diyaarinta cutubyo cusub oo ciidamada xoogga, iyadoo Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh uu bishan tababar ugu soo xiray ciidamo lagu soo tababaray deegaanka Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud, kuwaas oo loogu tala-galay xoojinta howl-gallada amniga. items.title: Sidee Guddoomiye Jaamac Muqdisho ugu maamuuseen dalal Carbeed? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa ka qeyb-galay kulan qado sharaf ah oo ay ku maamuuseen safiirrada dowladaha Carabta u fadhiya Soomaaliya. items.title: Itoobiya oo dood yaab leh u cuskanaysa doonisteeda marin-badeedka
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa faah-faahin ka bixiyay sababaha ay Itoobiya u raadineyso helitaanka marin-badeed, iyadoo sheegtay in arrintu aysan ku koobnayn baahida gaadiidka iyo ganacsiga. Xildhibaan Fethi Mahdi oo ah ku-xigeenka Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Xidhiidhka Dibadda iyo Arrimaha Nabadda ee Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka Itoobiya ayaa sheegay in doonista marin-badeedku ay Itoobiya u leedahay dhinacyo dhaqaale, sharci iyo taariikhi ah. Fethi ayaa ku dooday in xaaladda hadda jirta ay caqabad ku tahay horumarka dhaqaale ee dalka iyo isku xirka Itoobiya iyo suuqyada caalamka. Xildhibaanka ayaa sheegay in daraasado uu ku sheegay inay sameeyeen Qaramada Midoobay ay muujinayaan in dalalka aan bad lahayn ay lumin karaan illaa 25 boqolkiiba wax-soo-saarkooda gudaha marka loo eego dalalka leh marin toos ah oo badeed. Ku dhowaad 95 boqolkiiba badeecadaha Itoobiya laga soo dejiyo ama loo dhoofiyo ay hadda maraan hal deked, taas oo uu sheegay inay dalka ku kacdo kharash gaaraya illaa 2 bilyan oo dollar sannadkii oo la xiriira adeegyada dekedaha, sida uu sheegay Fethi. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay in kharashka badan ee ku baxa adeegyada dekedaha iyo gaadiidka uu saameyn ku yeesho dhaqaalaha Itoobiya, wuxuuna xusay inuu sare u qaado sicir-bararka, caqabad ku noqdo dhoofinta, isla markaana yareeyo fursadaha shaqo abuurka. Fethi ayaa dooddiisa ku saleeyay taariikhda Itoobiya, isagoo xusay xiriirkii boqortooyadii Aksum ay la lahayd Badda Cas iyo dekedii qadiimiga ahayd ee Adulis, taas oo uu sheegay inay caddeyn u tahay xiriirkii taariikhiga ahaa ee Itoobiya iyo marin-biyoodkaas. Wuxuu ku dooday in Itoobiya ay taariikh ahaan lahayd xiriir badeed, isla markaana marin-badeedka dalka laga qaaday iyadoo aan loo marin hannaan uu ku tilmaamay mid sharci ah. Hadalkan ayaa qeyb ka ah doodda Addis Ababa ee ku saabsan baahida ay u qabto marin ay si toos ah uga gaarto badda. Dhinaca sharciga caalamiga ah, xildhibaanku wuxuu tixraacay Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay ee Sharciga Badda (UNCLOS), oo uu sheegay inuu ka hadlayo xuquuqda dalalka aan bad lahayn ee la xiriirta helitaanka marin ay uga gudbaan dhulka dalalka kale si ay u gaaraan badda. Fethi ayaa sidoo kale soo hadal qaaday Bayaanka Siyaasadeed ee Awaza, kaas oo lagu ansixiyay shirkii saddexaad ee Qaramada Midoobay ee Dalalka Horumarkoodu Yaryahay ee aan Badda Lahayn, laguna qabtay dalka Turkmenistan. Wuxuu sheegay in Itoobiya ay arrinta marin-badeedka kala hadleyso dalalka deriska ah iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah, iyadoo uu xusay in Addis Ababa ay dooneyso in arrintan lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo heshiisyo nabadeed oo labada dhinacba faa’iido u leh. Si kastaba, xildhibaanka ayaa ku adkeystay in Itoobiya aysan doonisteeda marin-badeed u arkin arrin ku kooban danaha dalka oo keliya, balse uu ku tilmaamay fursad lagu horumarin karo dhaqaalaha Geeska Afrika iyo xiriirka ganacsi ee dalalka gobolka. “Helitaanka marin-badeedku waa arrin ku saabsan horumarinta gobolka, kobcinta dhaqaalaha gobolka iyo xaqiijinta is-dhexgalka gobolka,” ayuu yiri Fethi, oo ku celiyay muhiimadda ay Addis Ababa u aragto badda. Hadallada xildhibaanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Itoobiya ay sannadihii u dambeeyay si xooggan u muujinaysay baahideeda ku aaddan helitaanka marin-badeed, gaar ahaan iyadoo ay tahay mid ka mid ah dalalka ugu dadka badan Afrika ee aan lahayn xeeb. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda si cad uga soo horjeedda heshiis kasta oo ay Itoobiya ku raadineyso marin-badeed ku saleysan dhulka Soomaaliya. items.title: Dhul-gariir M6.0 ah oo ka dhacay Gacanka Cadmeed, meel u dhow xeebaha Puntland
items.description: Dhul-gariir xooggan oo cabbirkiisu ahaa 6.0 Magnitude ayaa saqdii dhexe ee xalay ka dhacay Gacanka Cadmeed, qiyaastii 145 KM waqooyi ka xigta degmada Caluula ee gobolka Bari. Sida xogta Hay’adda Sahanka Juqraafiyeedka Mareykanka (USGS) ay sheegtay dhul-gariirku wuxuu dhacay 12:07 habeenimo ee 28-ka Agoosto, waqtiga Soomaaliya, waxaana xudduntiisu ku taallay badda hoosteeda, iyadoo qoto-dheeraanta lagu qiyaasay ku dhowaad 10 KM. Warbixinno la helayo ayaa sheegaya in gariirka laga dareemay qaybo ka mid ah Soomaaliya iyo Yemen. USGS-na waxay diiwaangelisay heer gariir oo gaaraya (4) marka loo eego cabbirka Mercalli, taas oo keeni karta in dadka gudaha dhismayaasha ku jira ay si cad u dareemaan gariirka, isla markaana ay ruxmaan albaabada, daaqadaha iyo walxaha qaarkood. Ilaa hadda lama soo sheegin khasaare dhimasho, dhaawac ama burbur dhisme oo ka dhashay dhul-gariirka, waxaana xuddunta gariirku ku taallay meel badda ah oo ka fog goobaha dadku ku badan yihiin. Dhul-gariirkan ayaa ah dhacdo muhiim ah marka loo eego dhaqdhaqaaqa dhulka ee gobolka, iyadoo 25-kii Juun 2026 uu isla aagga Caluula ka dhacay dhul-gariir kale oo cabbirkiisu ahaa 5.1 Magnitude, kaas oo sidoo kale ku dhacay qiyaastii 10 KM badda hoosteeda.

items.title: Qoysas nugul oo ku xoolo beelay roob la’aanta oo ku biiray xero ku taalla Gaalkacyo
items.description: (ERGO) – In ka badan labo boqol oo qoys oo ka soo barakacay miyiga gobolka Mudug markii roob la’aan ay ka laysay xoolo ay dhaqanayeen ayaa nolol xumo aad u liidata ku wajahaya xeryo ku yaalla magaalada Gaalkacyo oo ay ku biireen labadii bil ee la soo dhaafay. Fardowso Nuur Maxamed oo ka mid ah waxay sheegtay inay cunno, biyo iyo hoy u la’dahay carruurteeda oo lix ah tan iyo bishii Abriil oo ay soo gaartay xerada Xoriyo. Waxay tilmaantay in ay ku tiirsan yihiin wax ay ku caawiyaan dadkii xerada sii deganaa oo aan iyaguna wax wayn dhaamin. Maalmaha qaar oo ay wayso wax taageero ah ayay sheegtay in ay ku qasbanaadaan in ay qatooyo ku joogaaan. Waxay tilmaantay in xerada ay yimaadeen iyaga oo gacan maran aysanna ka aqoon magaalada dad  ay caawinaad ka dalbadaan. “Cuntada mar waan helnaa, marna waan weynaa. Xalay carruurtayda casho uma karin, mana hayo wax aan siiyo. Gaajo ayay la ooyayaan, aniguna wax aan u qabto ma awoodo. Shaqo ma lihi, mana jiro aabbe u shaqeeya oo noloshooda ka kafaala qaada.” “Waxa keliya ee aan sameeyo waa inaan guri-guri u wareego anigoo baryaya si aan u helo wax ay carruurtaydu cunaan.” Fardawso oo kaligeed korisa carruurta oo lagu furay aanan lagu daryeelin ayaa sheegtay in xaaladda ilmaheeda ay ka sii darayso marba marka ka dnbaysa. Waxay xustay in ay qarka u saaran yihiin nafaqo darro maaddaama aysan inta badan helin cunno ku filan oo nafaqo leh. Waxay tilmaantay in ay isku dayday in magaalada ay dayn uga raadiso caano iyo khudaar ay siiso balse ganacsatadu ay u diidaan in ay daynsiiyaan maaddaama aysan aqoon u lahayn.  Sidoo kale waxay sheegaty in xerada ay ka jirto qandho aysan aqoon iyo hargan daran kuwaas oo dhamaan ilmaha kaga dhacay una sii nugleeyay xaaladda. Waxay sheegtay in qandhada haysa carruurteeda ay uga shakisay malaariyo ka dhalatay keeno xerada ka jirta, balse aysan hayn dhaqaaale ay ku gayso goob caafimaad. Waxay intaas ku dartay in ay wajahayaan hoy la’aan oo iyada iyo carruurteeda ay seexdaan buush yar oo aan wada qaadin kana samaysan calalo iyo qoryo aan dhaxan iyo qorrax toonna celin karin. “Hoygeenna waa buush aan amni lahayn. Tuugo ayaa xerada timaad qofkii wax xadaya gadaal ayuu ka daloolin karaa buushka wuuna soo geli karaa. Sidaas darteed habeenkii oo dhan waan soo jeednaa annagoo ka baqayna in nala soo dhaco ama carruurta nala waxyeelleeyo.” Fardawso ayaa sheegtay in qoyskeeda uu ka soo barakacay miyiga deegaanka Saaxaqurun ee gobolka mudug markii 50 ari ah oo ay dhaqanayeen ahaana waxa kaliya ee ay ku tiirsaneed noloshooda uu ku dhaafay daaq la’aan ka dhalatay roob yari jirtay saddex sano. Waxay tilmaamay in si ay uga saarto xaaladda adag carruurteeda ay maalinta oo dhan ku wareegto magaalada iyada oo raadinaysa cid ay u qabato shaqooyin nadaafad ah. Waxay inta badan soo laabataa iyada oo aan waxba helin. Waxay u sababaysay in dadku aysan u lahayn aqoon, si sahlana aysan ku siinayn shaqada.   Haweenaydaan oo ah 43 saddex jir nolosheeda oo dhan ku soo qaadatay xoolodhaqasho ayaa sheegtay in xilligaan ay reerkeedu wajahayaan nolol xumaddii ugu darnayd ee ay abid mutaan. waxay intaas raacisay in ay filaysay markii ay xerada imaanaysay in ay heli doonto gargaar balse illaa iyo wadda aysan helin. Xoolodhaqatada ku nool gobolka Mudug ayaa intooda badan ka siman nolol xumada ka dhalatay roob yarida soo laalaabatay oo meesha ka saartay xoolihii ay dhqanayeen. Waxay ku qasbanaadeen in ay ku biiraan xeryaha halkaas oo ay ku haystaan dhibaatooyin isbiirsaday. Xaawo Aadan Diirshe oo ka mid ah waxay sheegtay in muddo labo bil ah oo ay joogto xerada Xoriyo ay carruurteeda u la’adahay cunno iyo hoy ku filan. Waxay xustay in markii ugu horraysay nolosheeda ay caawinaad waysiisato dadka magaalada deggan kuwaas oo aan si joogto ah wax u siin. Waxay tilmaantay in ilmaheeda oo ka  ugu yar jiro afar sano ay mararka qaar qatooyo ku joogaan habeen iyo maalin. Waxay intaas ku dartay in korinta ilmaha ay kali ku noqotay markii saddex sano ka hor uu aabahii reerku u geeriyooday cudur aysan aqoon. Dhanka kale waxay intaas ku dartay in dhibaato xooggan ay ku qabaan helidda biyaha. Sababta ayaa ah in hal tubbo oo xerada oo dhan laga cabayay ay go’an tahay muddo bil iyo bar ah markii dadka xerada deggan ay bixin waayeen lacagta biyaha. “Biyaha ayaan dayn badan ku leenahay. Tan iyo markii aan soo degnay, lacagtii biyaha waa la bixin waayay, waxaana maalin walba nagu cadaadiya xafiiska biyaha.” “Mar waa la jaraa, marna waa la xiraa. Dhowr maalmood ayaan biyaha isticmaali la’nahay, dayntuna way badan tahay, mana hayno awood aan ku bixino.” Xaawo ayaa sheegtay in markii ay imanaysay xerada ay filaysay in ay heli doonto nolol dhaanta tii ay ku jireen, balse ay ku hungowday damacaas. Haweenaydaan oo ah 39 jir ayaa sheegtay in sidoo kale aysan lahayn xirfad ay magaalada uga shaqaysan karto si ay xaaladda adag uga saarto carruurteeda. Waxay sheegtay in nolol xumada ay u dheertay dhibaato ay ku qabto daymo ay labaddii sano ee la soo dhaafay ku yeesheen dukaammo ku yalala magalada Gaakacyo oo ay raashin ka amaahan jirtay. Waxay xustay in dadka yimid ay dulsaar ku noqdeen kuwii horay u daganaa ayna dhamaantood isla galeen duruuf isku mid ah. Waxay ka dayrisay sida ay noqon karato xaaladda dadkaan haddii aysan si degdeg ah u helin gargaar. Roob la’aanta ku soo noqnotay gobolada dhexe ee Soomaliya ayaa sabab u noqday in kumanaan qoys ay galaan duruufo nololeed oo adag, markii ay xoolaha oo ahaa ishooda dhaqaale ay ka dhamaadeen. items.fullContent: (ERGO) – In ka badan labo boqol oo qoys oo ka soo barakacay miyiga gobolka Mudug markii roob la’aan ay ka laysay xoolo ay dhaqanayeen ayaa nolol xumo aad u liidata ku wajahaya xeryo ku yaalla magaalada Gaalkacyo oo ay ku biireen labadii bil ee la soo dhaafay. Fardowso Nuur Maxamed oo ka mid ah waxay sheegtay inay cunno, biyo iyo hoy u la’dahay carruurteeda oo lix ah tan iyo bishii Abriil oo ay soo gaartay xerada Xoriyo. Waxay tilmaantay in ay ku tiirsan yihiin wax ay ku caawiyaan dadkii xerada sii deganaa oo aan iyaguna wax wayn dhaamin. Maalmaha qaar oo ay wayso wax taageero ah ayay sheegtay in ay ku qasbanaadaan in ay qatooyo ku joogaaan. Waxay tilmaantay in xerada ay yimaadeen iyaga oo gacan maran aysanna ka aqoon magaalada dad  ay caawinaad ka dalbadaan. “Cuntada mar waan helnaa, marna waan weynaa. Xalay carruurtayda casho uma karin, mana hayo wax aan siiyo. Gaajo ayay la ooyayaan, aniguna wax aan u qabto ma awoodo. Shaqo ma lihi, mana jiro aabbe u shaqeeya oo noloshooda ka kafaala qaada.” “Waxa keliya ee aan sameeyo waa inaan guri-guri u wareego anigoo baryaya si aan u helo wax ay carruurtaydu cunaan.” Fardawso oo kaligeed korisa carruurta oo lagu furay aanan lagu daryeelin ayaa sheegtay in xaaladda ilmaheeda ay ka sii darayso marba marka ka dnbaysa. Waxay xustay in ay qarka u saaran yihiin nafaqo darro maaddaama aysan inta badan helin cunno ku filan oo nafaqo leh. Waxay tilmaantay in ay isku dayday in magaalada ay dayn uga raadiso caano iyo khudaar ay siiso balse ganacsatadu ay u diidaan in ay daynsiiyaan maaddaama aysan aqoon u lahayn.  Sidoo kale waxay sheegaty in xerada ay ka jirto qandho aysan aqoon iyo hargan daran kuwaas oo dhamaan ilmaha kaga dhacay una sii nugleeyay xaaladda. Waxay sheegtay in qandhada haysa carruurteeda ay uga shakisay malaariyo ka dhalatay keeno xerada ka jirta, balse aysan hayn dhaqaaale ay ku gayso goob caafimaad. Waxay intaas ku dartay in ay wajahayaan hoy la’aan oo iyada iyo carruurteeda ay seexdaan buush yar oo aan wada qaadin kana samaysan calalo iyo qoryo aan dhaxan iyo qorrax toonna celin karin. “Hoygeenna waa buush aan amni lahayn. Tuugo ayaa xerada timaad qofkii wax xadaya gadaal ayuu ka daloolin karaa buushka wuuna soo geli karaa. Sidaas darteed habeenkii oo dhan waan soo jeednaa annagoo ka baqayna in nala soo dhaco ama carruurta nala waxyeelleeyo.” Fardawso ayaa sheegtay in qoyskeeda uu ka soo barakacay miyiga deegaanka Saaxaqurun ee gobolka mudug markii 50 ari ah oo ay dhaqanayeen ahaana waxa kaliya ee ay ku tiirsaneed noloshooda uu ku dhaafay daaq la’aan ka dhalatay roob yari jirtay saddex sano. items.title: Waxa aad u sii badanaysa dhimashada dadkii uu daadku qaaday ee dalka Nepal
items.description: Booliiska dalka Nepal ayaa sheegay in ilaa 09:00 subaxnimo waqtiga maxalliga ah ee Jimcaha maanta ah, in 475 qof ay ku dhinteen daadadkii dhobata watay ee Arbacadi ku dhuftay degmada Rasuwa ee dalkaas. In ka badan 550 qof ayaa la la’ayahay, kadib 48 saacadood o ay daadadkaas ku dhufteen dalka, tiradaas oo la filayo inay intaas ka sii badato. Cabsi kale ayaa jirta oo adda waxay ka cabsi qabaan in, kadib saacado badan oo roob culus ah, harada ka samaysantay burburka dhexdiisa ay qararka jabsato, taasina ay maalmaha soo socda ay sababto dhimasho hor leh. Booliisku waxay intaas ku dareen in howlgallada samatabbixinta iyo baadi-goobka dadka ay weli socdaan, iyadoo sidoo kale dadaallo lagu doonayo in “waddooyinka xanniban laga furo” ay ka socdaan goobaha ay daadadku saameeyeen. Samatabbixiyeyaasha ku sugan aaggaas ayaa lagu amray inay hadda joojiyaan hawlgallada, sida ay sheegayaan wararka ka soo baxaya warbaahinta dowladda Shiinaha. In ka badan 550 qof ayaa la soo sheegay inay ku maqan yihiin dhinaca Tibet ee xadka — 260 ka mid ah waa ajaanib, oo ay ku jiraan dalxiiseyaal u socday buurta barakaysan ee Kailash ee Tibet.T

items.title: Laftagareen warns AU against role in South West dispute
items.description: Nairobi, Kenya — Former president of Somalia’s South West State Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen warned the African Union mission in Somalia on Thursday against becoming involved in his dispute with the federal government. In a statement issued under the banner of the “Office of the President of South West State”, Laftagareen also rejected allegations that forces loyal to him had links to Al-Shabaab. He expressed concern over an African Union Commission memorandum dated August 21 concerning what his camp described as a federal government request to the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) over the security situation in the region. The statement cited the memorandum by reference number CPAPS/B3/779.26 but did not include a copy. It was therefore unclear precisely what Mogadishu had requested from AUSSOM or how the African Union Commission had characterised the forces involved. Laftagareen resigned as president on March 30 after federal troops took control of Baidoa, South West State’s administrative capital. His camp has since continued to challenge the new administration and again presents itself as the region’s legitimate government. Regional lawmakers elected Sheikh Aden Mohamed Nur Madobe, a former speaker of Somalia’s lower house of parliament, as South West president on June 10. He won 88 of the 90 votes cast. Al-Shabaab allegations Laftagareen’s statement categorically rejected allegations linking his Darawish forces to Al-Shabaab, describing them as legally constituted regional security forces tasked with protecting civilians, public institutions and the constitutional order. “Describing these forces as ‘militias affiliated with Al-Shabaab’, without independently verified evidence, endangers civilians and security personnel,” the statement said, adding that such claims risked undermining public confidence in AUSSOM. The dispute over the identity of the fighters has become particularly sensitive since heavy fighting erupted in Baidoa on August 17. Federal troops drove Laftagareen-aligned fighters from the city after hours of clashes described by residents as the fiercest since March. Somalia’s defence ministry said its forces killed about 30 attackers after fighters using explosive-laden vehicles attacked government positions before dawn. Reuters said it verified footage showing federal troops fighting from an armoured vehicle and wounded civilians being carried through the streets. Federal and South West officials later accused Laftagareen-aligned fighters of operating alongside Al-Shabaab during the assault, an allegation his supporters have denied. “South West State warns against conflating Somalia’s internal political disagreements with the legitimate fight against terrorism,” Laftagareen’s statement said. It called for disputes between Mogadishu and federal member states to be resolved through dialogue, constitutional processes and an inclusive political framework, warning that the use of military force to pursue political objectives could fuel further violence and displacement. AUSSOM neutrality Laftagareen’s camp said the August 21 AU memorandum contained a clear instruction that AUSSOM should remain politically neutral and impartial and avoid involvement in Somalia’s internal political disputes. It urged the African Union and AUSSOM to “undertake an independent verification of the facts before supporting or participating in any military action”. The statement also warned against operations that could result in “violence, bombardment, displacement or harm to civilians in Baidoa and its surrounding areas”. It said that any operation must comply with international humanitarian law, civilian protection obligations, and AUSSOM’s rules of engagement. AUSSOM supports Somali security forces in their fight against Al-Shabaab while helping protect civilians, stabilise recovered areas and gradually transfer security responsibilities to Somali forces. The UN Security Council has authorised the mission to operate in support of Somalia’s security transition. At the same time, the African Union has stressed cooperation with the federal government and troop-contributing countries. Laftagareen’s statement called on AUSSOM troop-contributing countries, the African Union, United Nations and other international partners not to rely on “unverified information or politically motivated allegations”. His camp said it was ready to share relevant information and participate in an independent fact-finding process. items.title: Dhulgariir xooggan oo ku dhuftay xeebaha Puntland
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dhulgariir xooggan oo cabbirkiisu yahay 6.0 ayaa saqdii dhexe ee Jimcaha ka dhacay badda Gacanka Cadmeed, meel qiyaastii 145 kiiloomitir waqooyi kaga beegan degmada Caluula ee gobolka Bari, ayada oo la sheegayo in laga dareemay deegaano halkaas ka tirsan. Hay’adda Sahanka Dhulka ee Mareykanka ee USGS ayaa sheegtay in dhulgariirku dhacay 12:07 habeenimo waqtiga Soomaaliya, isla markaana xaruntiisu ahayd meel badda hoosteeda ah oo qoto dheerkeedu gaarayo ku dhowaad 10 kiiloomitir. Xarunta dhulgariirka ayaa ku taalla biyaha u dhexeeya waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, waxaana sidoo kale dhacdada xaqiijisay xarunta Jarmalka ee GFZ, oo diiwaangelisay dhulgariir cabbirkiisu yahay 6.0 isla waqtigaas. Dhulgariirka ayaa sidoo kale ku beegnaa qiyaastii 165 kiiloomitir waqooyi-galbeed kaga beegan deegaanka Bareeda, halka uu ku dhowaad 209 kiiloomitir koonfur-bari kaga beegnaa magaalada Mukalla ee Yemen. USGS ayaa soo saartay digniin heer Green PAGER ah, taas oo muujineysa in ay hooseyso suurtagalnimada dhimasho badan ama khasaare dhaqaale oo weyn. Khariidadda qiimeynta gariirka ee hay’adda ayaa muujisay in gariirka ugu xooggan ee laga filan karo deegaannada ku dhow uu gaarayo heerka IV ee cabbirka Modified Mercalli, kaas oo guud ahaan lagu tilmaamo gariir fudud. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan warar rasmi ah oo sheegaya dhimasho, dhaawac ama burbur weyn oo ka dhashay dhulgariirka, gaar ahaan deegaannada xeebaha waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, xogta la heli karo ma muujineyso khatar tsunami oo ka dhalatay dhulgariirka. In kasta oo cabbirka 6.0 uu yahay dhulgariir awood u leh inuu sababo gariir xooggan, haddana xarunta dhacdadan oo ku taalla meel ka baxsan xeebaha ayaa yareysay khatarta degdegga ah ee ku wajahan deegaannada dadku ku badan yahay. Maamulka Puntland weli kama soo saarin war rasmi ah oo ku saabsan khasaaraha ama saameynta dhulgariirka. Xarunta dhulgariirka ayaa ku taalla biyaha u dhexeeya waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, waxaana sidoo kale dhacdada xaqiijisay xarunta Jarmalka ee GFZ, oo diiwaangelisay dhulgariir cabbirkiisu yahay 6.0 isla waqtigaas. Dhulgariirka ayaa sidoo kale ku beegnaa qiyaastii 165 kiiloomitir waqooyi-galbeed kaga beegan deegaanka Bareeda, halka uu ku dhowaad 209 kiiloomitir koonfur-bari kaga beegnaa magaalada Mukalla ee Yemen. USGS ayaa soo saartay digniin heer Green PAGER ah, taas oo muujineysa in ay hooseyso suurtagalnimada dhimasho badan ama khasaare dhaqaale oo weyn. Khariidadda qiimeynta gariirka ee hay’adda ayaa muujisay in gariirka ugu xooggan ee laga filan karo deegaannada ku dhow uu gaarayo heerka IV ee cabbirka Modified Mercalli, kaas oo guud ahaan lagu tilmaamo gariir fudud. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan warar rasmi ah oo sheegaya dhimasho, dhaawac ama burbur weyn oo ka dhashay dhulgariirka, gaar ahaan deegaannada xeebaha waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, xogta la heli karo ma muujineyso khatar tsunami oo ka dhalatay dhulgariirka. In kasta oo cabbirka 6.0 uu yahay dhulgariir awood u leh inuu sababo gariir xooggan, haddana xarunta dhacdadan oo ku taalla meel ka baxsan xeebaha ayaa yareysay khatarta degdegga ah ee ku wajahan deegaannada dadku ku badan yahay. Maamulka Puntland weli kama soo saarin war rasmi ah oo ku saabsan khasaaraha ama saameynta dhulgariirka. items.title: Puntland accuses Turkey of deadly strikes after ship hijack
items.description: Garowe, Somalia — Puntland, Somalia’s semi-autonomous northeastern federal member state, has accused Turkey of carrying out deadly, unclaimed air strikes along its coast after Somali pirates hijacked a cargo ship carrying Turkish military supplies. Abdirahman Yusuf Dujana, Puntland’s deputy security minister, told BBC Somali that the regional administration believed Turkey was responsible for two strikes that have killed at least 13 people in the Nugaal region. Dujana also accused Somalia’s federal government of involvement, but did not provide independently verifiable evidence linking either Ankara or Mogadishu to the attacks. No government, military force or armed group has publicly claimed responsibility. “We fight piracy, but people have rights. You cannot simply kill someone,” Dujana told the BBC. Turkey’s Defence Ministry said on Thursday that the Somali-Turkish Task Force Command was providing support to Somali authorities over the incident, but did not say whether Turkish forces had carried out the strikes. “The Somali Turkish Task Force Command continues its support for developing Somalia’s capacity to combat terrorism and piracy within the framework of the agreements signed between the two countries,” the ministry said in a brief statement . “In this context, necessary support is being provided to the Somali authorities, in coordination with our Ministry of Foreign Affairs, regarding the incident that occurred in Somali territorial waters.” The ministry did not specify what support Turkey was providing or address Puntland’s accusation that Turkish forces carried out the strikes. Dujana said Puntland had evidence supporting its accusation, including information about Turkish activity around the hijacked ship and the surrounding coast. “We have evidence,” he said. Somalia Today could not independently verify Puntland’s allegations. Two deadly strikes The first reported strike came on August 18, a day after pirates seized the Cameroon-flagged M/V LUTUF off Puntland. The strike reportedly killed four people and wounded two near Garmaal after a small boat returned to shore from the direction of the hijacked vessel. Initial reports described those killed as suspected pirates. Relatives and some residents disputed that account, saying some of the victims were fishermen. The Associated Press, citing a Somali official who spoke on condition of anonymity, reported that the boat had delivered khat to the pirates before heading back to shore, when an air strike hit it. AP said it could not independently establish who carried out the attack or whether those killed had been involved in the hijacking. A second deadly strike on August 23 near Jiifle in Godob-Jiraan district killed nine people, the local mayor told BBC Somali. A resident who visited the site said he saw eight badly burnt bodies. He said some of the young men aboard the boat were known locally as fishermen, but could not establish why they had been at sea or whether everyone on board had links to piracy. Reports said the pirates had moved the LUTUF towards the Jiifle area before the attack. Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni later criticised the killings, saying suspected pirates should face legal proceedings rather than be killed without due process. Hijacked arms ship Pirates seized the LUTUF on August 17 about 3.5 nautical miles off Marraya in Puntland’s Eyl district and steered it towards the Nugaal coast. A Somali official told AP that the vessel was carrying Turkish weapons, communications equipment and satellite systems destined for a Turkish military training facility in Mogadishu. The ship’s 10-member crew included six Indians, one Turkish national, one Georgian and two Serbian security guards. The official also told AP that Turkish-owned vessels, helicopters and drones had been monitoring the area after the hijacking. Somalia Today reported on Monday that the pirates had demanded about $2 million for the ship’s release, according to sources. It remained unclear whether formal ransom negotiations had begun or whether any party had agreed to pay. Dujana said Puntland remained committed to fighting piracy but that operations had become more difficult because the hijackers were holding crew members hostage. “The people they are holding hostage must not be harmed,” he said. Federal role questioned The controversy has also raised questions over what Somalia’s federal government knew about the operations. State Minister for Defence Omar Ali Abdi said on August 22 that Mogadishu was aware of military operations and strikes taking place off Puntland and was preparing a comprehensive report. “If military operations are taking place along Somalia’s coast against pirate groups, the federal government is the institution legally responsible for making decisions on such matters,” he told reporters. He did not identify the force carrying out the strikes or say whether the federal government had authorised the attacks now under dispute. Turkey has a major military role in Somalia. Under a 10-year defence and economic cooperation agreement signed in 2024, Turkey agreed to help Somalia build, train and equip its naval forces and strengthen maritime security against piracy, illegal fishing and other threats. Ankara also operates a large military training facility in Mogadishu. Dujana said the longstanding political dispute between Puntland and the federal government had made cooperation against piracy more difficult. He also said Puntland was investigating criminal networks suspected of supporting pirate groups and had detained people from outside the region carrying GPS equipment and computers used to track vessels hundreds of miles offshore. Asked whether Al-Shabaab or Islamic State militants had links to the current piracy activity, Dujana said Puntland had no evidence directly connecting either group to the incidents. Piracy resurges The dispute comes amid the most serious resurgence of Somali piracy in years. The International Maritime Organization said on August 24 that pirates and armed robbers were holding six vessels and more than 90 seafarers in the region, prompting Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez to call for urgent international action. “We cannot allow the resurgence of piracy in the Gulf of Aden and surrounding waters to go unaddressed,” he said. The International Maritime Bureau said Somali pirates were responsible for 94 per cent of crew members taken hostage worldwide during the first half of 2026, despite an overall decline in global piracy incidents. Dujana said Puntland had forces capable of confronting pirates on land and at sea, but called for renewed international naval support similar to the cooperation deployed when Somali piracy was at its peak. Somalia Today sought further clarification from Turkish officials on whether Turkish forces carried out the strikes, and from Somalia’s defence and information ministries on whether the federal government had authorised them. We had not received a response as of publication. The post Puntland accuses Turkey of deadly strikes after ship hijack appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: A landmark moment for Somalia’s democracy and rule of law
items.description: Somalia’s Supreme Court decision to annul Galmudug’s parliamentary and local council elections may, at first, look like a setback for the country’s transition towards direct democracy. It could prove to be something more important. The significance of the August 24 ruling lies not simply in the cancellation of an election, but in the institutional sequence that followed. A disputed vote was challenged in court, the country’s highest court found that the process had breached the constitution and electoral law, and the electoral commission accepted the judgment. For a country seeking to rebuild democratic institutions after decades of indirect elections and political bargaining, that matters. The July 30 vote was Galmudug’s first direct election for both its regional parliament and local councils. A total of 197,971 voters cast ballots across 11 districts. But the Supreme Court ruled that the commission had not administered or conducted the elections in accordance with the constitution and electoral law. It annulled the results and ordered fresh elections. Democracy depends on more than casting ballots. Elections must follow agreed rules, those rules must be enforceable, and the institutions administering them must remain subject to the law. Galmudug has provided an important test of that principle. Beyond the ballot Somalia has invested considerable political capital in moving towards one-person, one-vote elections after decades in which indirect systems and elite negotiations have largely determined political representation. Giving citizens the power to choose their representatives directly is an important democratic goal. But participation alone cannot establish the legitimacy of an election. The process through which votes are cast, counted and challenged matters as much as the final result. That is what makes the Supreme Court ruling significant. Political organisations that disputed the Galmudug elections took their grievances to the judiciary. The court considered the challenge and concluded that the violations were serious enough to invalidate the results. The central question was therefore no longer which political organisation had won, but whether the election through which it claimed victory complied with the law. The court decided that it did not. That distinction is fundamental to constitutional democracy: elections decide who governs, but the law determines whether the process through which power is obtained is valid. Judicial authority The ruling also matters because major electoral disputes in Somalia have often become wider political confrontations, producing competing claims of legitimacy, prolonged negotiations and pressure for settlements outside established institutions. Courts provide another route, but only if their judgments carry consequences. The Supreme Court exercised that authority by overturning an election whose results had already been announced. The National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission then accepted the judgment , citing the Supreme Court’s constitutional role and the supremacy of the law, and said it would announce a date for fresh elections. Compliance with a court ruling should be routine in any functioning constitutional system. But in Somalia’s developing electoral framework, respect for judicial authority carries wider importance. An electoral commission needs independence to conduct elections without political interference. That independence cannot place its actions beyond judicial review. The same principle applies to governments, political organisations and candidates. The law cannot bind political actors only when its consequences suit them. Constitutional moment The judgment has already generated unusually strong reactions from Somali political figures who see consequences extending far beyond Galmudug. Former foreign minister Ahmed Isse Awad described it as a milestone for constitutional government and praised the Supreme Court judges for what he called a “bold and brave decision”. He said the ruling could “set Somalia on the path to constitutionalism and the rule of institutions”. He urged the judges to “remain steadfast” in safeguarding the independence of the judiciary. Awad went further, comparing the decision with major historical turning points in European constitutional history. Such comparisons are sweeping. One court judgment cannot by itself establish constitutional government or guarantee an independent judiciary. But the broader issue he raises is important. The lasting value of the Galmudug ruling will depend on whether it represents the beginning of a pattern in which courts can scrutinise politically sensitive decisions, rule against powerful institutions and expect their judgments to be implemented. That standard must apply regardless of who benefits from a particular judgment. A judiciary that is celebrated when it rules against one political camp but attacked when it rules against another would not represent the constitutionalism being demanded today. The real measure of judicial independence will come when future judgments are politically inconvenient to governments, opposition groups or other powerful actors — and are respected nonetheless. A precedent tested The immediate focus will now turn to when Galmudug votes again and which political organisation will prevail. The broader precedent is more important. If electoral grievances can be channelled through credible legal processes, examined by courts and resolved through binding judgments, Somalia will have strengthened an important part of its democratic architecture. The decision also puts electoral administrators on notice that serious violations can carry the most consequential remedy available: cancellation of an election. Political organisations should take a lesson from it too. Where genuine legal grounds exist, judicial challenges offer an alternative to turning every electoral disagreement into a broader political crisis. For voters, the principle is equally straightforward. Casting a ballot should come with the expectation that the election itself complies with the rules governing it. The rerun test The Galmudug ruling is therefore an opportunity, not yet a democratic victory. Its importance will ultimately be determined by what happens next. The electoral commission cannot treat the judgment simply as an instruction to select another polling date. It must address the shortcomings that led the Supreme Court to invalidate the first election and organise a rerun that can withstand legal scrutiny. The eventual winners need more than the largest number of votes. They need a result produced through a process whose legality can withstand challenge. Somalia’s transition towards direct elections will inevitably encounter disputes, administrative failures and institutional weaknesses. Democratic progress does not require pretending those problems do not exist. It requires institutions capable of identifying them, providing remedies and correcting them. That is what gives the Galmudug decision the potential to become a landmark moment. Not because an election was overturned, or because one political organisation benefited from the judgment, but because an electoral result was subjected to the law and the institutions involved accepted the court’s authority. Whether this becomes a lasting advance for constitutionalism will depend on what follows. If Galmudug returns to the polls through a process that meets the standards the Supreme Court demanded, the annulment of one flawed election may ultimately strengthen Somalia’s democratic development more than allowing it to stand ever could. items.title: The Wajir Windward and Leeward Divide: A Mountain of Political Power, Resources, and Unequal Development
items.description: By Osman Ali Hassan Wajir County can be understood through the simple but powerful image of a mountain divided into a windward side and a leeward side. On a mountain, the windward side receives the greater force of the wind and usually more rainfall, while the leeward side lies in the shadow of the mountain and often receives much less moisture. The difference between the two sides can therefore become a useful metaphor for understanding political representation, government resources, public institutions, social services, economic opportunities, and development within Wajir County. In this comparison, Wajir North, Wajir East, Wajir Central, Tarbaj, and Eldas can be viewed as forming the windward side, while Wajir South represents the leeward side. The purpose of this comparison is not to suggest that geography alone determines political or economic outcomes. Rather, it provides a simple way of describing how residents may perceive the distribution of political influence, government institutions, public investment, and social services across the county. Wajir County is geographically large, socially diverse, and economically challenged. Its people have historically depended heavily on pastoralism, livestock, small-scale trade, public employment, humanitarian assistance, and other activities suited to an arid and semi-arid environment. Because of the size of the county, distance between settlements and administrative centers can have a major effect on access to government services. A government office located in Wajir town may technically serve the entire county, but physical distance, transportation costs, road conditions, communication difficulties, and the concentration of economic activity around the county headquarters can make access much easier for some residents than for others. This is where the windward and leeward mountain comparison becomes meaningful. The windward side represents the part of the county that appears to receive greater political visibility, institutional concentration, administrative attention, and economic activity, while the leeward side represents the part that many residents perceive as being further from the center of political and government power. Kenya political map highlighting urban settlements The political geography of Wajir County makes this comparison especially important. The county contains several constituencies and wards with different levels of political representation and different geographical circumstances. Wajir North, Wajir East, Wajir Central, Tarbaj, and Eldas are positioned in this metaphorical windward zone, while Wajir South occupies the leeward position. In political terms, representation is not simply a matter of the number of elected leaders. It is also about the location of political institutions, the influence exercised by political leaders, the ability of communities to communicate their needs to decision-makers, and the extent to which government programs become visible in different parts of the county. The windward side in this comparison appears particularly powerful because it contains Wajir town, the principal urban and administrative center of the county. Wajir town is not simply another settlement. It is the place where many of the county’s major administrative, commercial, political, educational, financial, and social activities are concentrated. Government offices, businesses, banks, nonprofit organizations, transport services, educational institutions, and other service providers naturally tend to establish themselves where there is a larger concentration of population and economic activity. Once these institutions become concentrated in one location, they can attract even more economic activity and employment. This creates a cycle in which the center becomes increasingly important while distant areas remain dependent on the center. This process can be compared to rainfall falling on the windward side of a mountain. When rain falls repeatedly on the windward slope, vegetation can grow, settlements can expand, and economic activity can become more sustainable. On the leeward side, however, the rain shadow can create a drier environment. In the same way, when government institutions, private businesses, nonprofit organizations, financial services, and political offices are concentrated around Wajir town and surrounding windward constituencies, residents in those areas may experience a greater immediate presence of government and economic opportunity. Residents of Wajir South may have to travel much farther to reach some services, offices, markets, financial institutions, educational opportunities, or administrative centers.The comparison becomes even more powerful when considering the political leadership associated with the windward side. The windward political structure, as described by this metaphor, benefits from a concentration of several forms of representation and political influence. The county governor is a countywide leader, but the location of the county headquarters and much of the county administration in Wajir town naturally gives the urban center significant institutional importance. The woman representative provides another countywide political voice in the National Assembly. A nominated Member of Parliament also contributes to the wider political representation associated with the county. These positions do not constitutionally belong to one side of the county, because their mandates are intended to serve the whole county or the wider national constituency. Nevertheless, from the perspective of residents, the physical and political concentration of leaders and institutions can create the perception that some communities are closer to political power than others. Wajir South, in the leeward position, presents a different picture in this metaphor. Its principal parliamentary representation is through its elected Member of Parliament, while the Deputy Governor is another important political figure associated with the county administration. Again, the Deputy Governor serves the entire county rather than one constituency, and therefore it would be inaccurate to treat that office as constitutionally belonging exclusively to Wajir South. This distinction between formal representation and practical access is extremely important. A community can be constitutionally represented and still feel politically marginalized. Representation on paper does not automatically guarantee equal access to public resources. A Member of Parliament may speak for a constituency, a governor may administer an entire county, and a national government may establish projects for the benefit of all citizens. Yet the real test of equality is whether residents can see and experience government services in their daily lives. A government that exists mainly through offices in a distant town may feel remote to a person living many kilometers away. The deeper question concerns whether political representation translates into roads, health facilities, schools, water systems, markets, financial services, employment opportunities, administrative offices, security services, and other forms of development. If Wajir South has the largest land area among the areas being compared, distance itself becomes a development challenge. Government services designed around a centralized administrative model may work relatively well for people living close to Wajir town, but they can become expensive and difficult to access for people living in distant rural communities. A resident may need transportation simply to obtain a government document, access a financial institution, attend a medical appointment, pursue an educational opportunity, or interact with an administrative office. The cost of transportation, food, accommodation, and lost working time can turn an apparently free government service into an expensive undertaking. Population also matters. A large population creates greater demand for schools, hospitals, water, roads, markets, security, administrative services, youth programs, employment opportunities, and social protection. If population growth is not matched by investment, communities can experience pressure on existing facilities. A health center may become overcrowded. A school may lack classrooms. Water points may be insufficient. Roads may remain difficult to use during certain seasons. Young people may have few opportunities to acquire technical skills or find employment. Women may face difficulties reaching maternal and reproductive health services. Traders may have limited access to credit and reliable markets. These problems become more serious when the communities are far from the county’s administrative and commercial center. Read more: The Wajir Windward and Leeward Divide Osman A. items.title: Maamulka Jubaland oo soo saaray digniin ku saabsan…
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada ee Jubaland ayaa soo saartay digniin ku saabsan roobab iyo fatahaado laga cabsi qabo inay ka dhacaan deegaanada maamulka, gaar ahaan laga bilaabo horraanta bisha October 2026. Wasaaraddu waxay bulshada ugu baaqday inay xilli hore usii diyaar garoobaan xaaladda, iyadoo la sameeyo qorsheyaal looga hortagayo khasaaraha ka dhalan kara roobabka xooggan iyo fatahaadaha. Wasiirka Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada Jubaland, Caydiid Suleymaan Xaashi ayaa sheegay in saadaasha cimiladu muujinayso khatar la xiriirta roobabka xilliga deyrta, kuwaas oo la filayo inay si xooggan uga da’aan qaybo ka mid ah Soomaaliya. Digniintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli hay’adaha cimilada iyo gargaarku ay ka digayaan khatar sii kordheysa oo fatahaado ah inta u dhexeysa bilaha October iyo December 2026. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale xusay in xaaladaha El Niño ay sare u qaadi karaan roobabka ka da’aya Geeska Afrika, taas oo kordhin karta khatarta fatahaadaha iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karaan bulshada ku nool deegaanada nugul. Caydiid ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in saadaasha ay tilmaamayso in illaa 12 degmo oo maamulka Jubaland ah ay si gaar ah ugu nuglaan karaan roobabka xooggan iyo fatahaadaha. Wuxuu dadka ku nool hareeraha webiyada, dhulka hoose iyo meelaha biyo-mareennada ah ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan goobaha halista ah, isla markaana ay horey ugu diyaar garoobaan u guurista meelaha ammaan ah haddii xaalad degdeg ah soo wajahdo. Saadaasha cimilada gobolka ayaa sidoo kale muujinaysa in Soomaaliya ay ka mid noqon karto meelaha laga filayo roobab ka sarreeya celceliska xilliga October ilaa December, iyadoo khatarta fatahaaduhu si gaar ah uga jirto deegaanada ku teedsan webiyada Jubba iyo Shabeelle. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in ku dhowaad 1.8 milyan oo qof ay suuragal tahay inay saameyn ku yeeshaan roobabka iyo fatahaadaha la saadaalinayo, halka in ka badan 351,000 qof ay wajihi karaan barakac haddii fatahaado waaweyn dhacaan. Waxa kale oo uu xusay in ku dhowaad 45 xarumood oo caafimaad iyo 10 iskuul ay halis geli karaan. Ugu dambeyntiina, maamulka Jubaland ayaa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ku eedeeyay inay ka gaabisay wax ka qabashada xaaladda, iyadoo wasiirku sheegay in Jubaland aysan helin taageeradii ay ka filaysay xilligii abaarta. Wuxuu sidoo kale beesha caalamka ugu baaqay in taageerada loogu tala-galay maamulka si toos ah loo gaarsiiyo Jubaland. items.title: UN Report Warns Al-Shabaab Is Adapting Rather Than Retreating
items.description: New York (WDN)- A New United Nations Security Council assessment warns that Al-Shabaab is changing the way it operates in Somalia, reducing the number of attacks around Mogadishu while concentrating more heavily on strategically important areas across the country. The assessment, contained in the Monitoring Team’s 38th report, S/2026/651, published on August 10, 2026, covers developments through June 9. While the overall short-term threat posed by Al-Qaida and ISIS was assessed as broadly unchanged, the report identifies a notable shift in Al-Shabaab’s operational pattern. Rather than relying on large numbers of attacks, the group appears to be moving toward fewer, more targeted and strategically selected operations, particularly in Hirshabelle, Lower and Middle Juba, Lower Shabelle and Galmudug. The change comes amid intensified military pressure from Somali forces and their international partners. Several senior Al-Shabaab figures responsible for explosives and financial operations were reportedly killed between December 2025 and February 2026. However, the group’s leader, Ahmed Diriye, also known as Abu Ubaidah, remains active and is believed to be operating in southern Somalia. The report also points to a decline in Al-Shabaab’s revenue from Mogadishu, which reportedly fell from an estimated $12–15 million per month to approximately $5–9 million. Despite the decline, the United Nations considers the group’s financial network resilient enough to sustain its operations. Growing Links with Yemen Perhaps the most significant warning in the report concerns Al-Shabaab’s reported links with militant networks in Yemen, including Al-Qaida in the Arabian Peninsula (AQAP) and the Houthis. According to information provided by UN member states, Al-Shabaab members reportedly traveled by sea to Yemen and met AQAP operatives in Shabwah and Ma’rib to discuss operational experience and logistics. Some were subsequently reported to have had contact with Houthi representatives. The report cites claims that between 150 and 400 Al-Shabaab fighters may have received training from the Houthis. The UN makes clear, however, that these figures are based on information provided by member states and do not represent independent verification by the United Nations of every reported training activity. If sustained, such links could expose Al-Shabaab to new military expertise, logistical networks, technology and operational methods developed in Yemen. The concern is particularly serious because Yemen has become an arena for advanced drone warfare, missile technology, electronic warfare and maritime operations. Any transfer of such capabilities across the Gulf of Aden could create new security risks for Somalia and the wider Horn of Africa. The report also indicates that Al-Shabaab is attempting to strengthen its military capabilities, including longer-range and more accurate artillery and technology designed to disrupt drones. The group’s reported interest in drone-jamming technology suggests that it is adapting to the growing use of drones and aerial surveillance by Somali forces and their partners. This points to an emerging technological contest: government forces are expanding their ability to monitor and strike Al-Shabaab from the air, while the militant group is seeking ways to evade, disrupt or neutralize those capabilities. A More Resilient Threat The UN assessment presents a picture that is more complicated than a simple decline in Al-Shabaab’s strength. The group has suffered significant leadership losses, its revenues in Mogadishu have declined, and its attacks around the capital have decreased. Yet it retains an operational leadership, a functioning financial system and the ability to conduct targeted attacks. More importantly, its reported external connections appear to be expanding. The overall picture is therefore one of adaptation rather than defeat. Al-Shabaab may be deliberately reducing high-volume attacks while concentrating its resources on carefully selected targets and seeking new capabilities beyond Somalia’s borders. The report suggests that measuring the group’s strength solely by the number of attacks in Mogadishu could therefore be misleading. The more important indicators may now be its intelligence networks, financial resilience, ability to select strategic targets, cross-border relationships and capacity to adapt to modern military technology. For Somalia and its international partners, the warning is clear: a quieter Al-Shabaab is not necessarily a weaker Al-Shabaab. items.title: U.S. Disrupts China-Linked Cyber Campaign Targeting Critical Infrastructure
items.description: Washington (WDN) – The U.S. government says it has disrupted a long-running cyber operation linked to China-backed actors that targeted sensitive American government agencies and critical infrastructure. The operation allegedly used two hacking platforms, QScan and QTRouter, to scan networks, exploit vulnerabilities and conceal the origin of malicious traffic. U.S. authorities seized internet infrastructure associated with the platforms, significantly disrupting the network. According to the FBI and U.S. Justice Department, targets included the Departments of Justice, Energy, and Health and Human Services, NASA, the Federal Reserve, the U.S. Senate and the National Institutes of Health, as well as companies in the United States and South Korea. The infrastructure had reportedly been active since at least 2018, suggesting a sustained campaign rather than a series of isolated attacks. Investigators say the network also targeted hospitals, telecommunications providers, utilities, financial institutions and defense contractors—raising concerns about the potential impact on national security and essential services. U.S. authorities identified the network as QTFY and linked the operation to Nanjing Xinjiuwei Network Technology Company, a China-based firm that Washington says has connections to Chinese security and military customers. Beijing has not accepted responsibility for the allegations and has routinely rejected U.S. accusations of state-linked cyber operations. The scale of the activity was substantial. The FBI said QScan alone conducted more than two million vulnerability scans and exploitation attempts in 2024. Investigators also linked the operation to the exploitation of vulnerabilities in Check Point Quantum Gateway devices and the theft of sensitive information from hundreds of U.S. organizations. The U.S. seizure of the platforms’ internet addresses is intended to cripple the attackers’ ability to communicate with and operate their malicious infrastructure. But officials acknowledge that disrupting one network does not eliminate the broader threat: sophisticated cyber actors can rebuild infrastructure and return under new identities. The episode highlights the increasingly dangerous nature of cyber conflict. What was once largely associated with stealing information has evolved into a potential threat to power grids, hospitals, telecommunications networks, financial systems and government institutions. The confrontation also underscores the growing cyber rivalry between Washington and Beijing, with both sides repeatedly accusing the other of digital espionage and malicious cyber activity. For the United States, the latest operation is therefore more than a successful takedown. It is a reminder that cybersecurity has become a frontline of national security—and that protecting critical infrastructure requires constant vigilance against adversaries capable of operating quietly for years before being exposed. The FBI said QScan alone conducted more than two million vulnerability scans and exploitation attempts in 2024. Investigators also linked the operation to the exploitation of vulnerabilities in Check Point Quantum Gateway devices and the theft of sensitive information from hundreds of U.S. organizations. The U.S. seizure of the platforms’ internet addresses is intended to cripple the attackers’ ability to communicate with and operate their malicious infrastructure. But officials acknowledge that disrupting one network does not eliminate the broader threat: sophisticated cyber actors can rebuild infrastructure and return under new identities. The episode highlights the increasingly dangerous nature of cyber conflict. What was once largely associated with stealing information has evolved into a potential threat to power grids, hospitals, telecommunications networks, financial systems and government institutions. The confrontation also underscores the growing cyber rivalry between Washington and Beijing, with both sides repeatedly accusing the other of digital espionage and malicious cyber activity. For the United States, the latest operation is therefore more than a successful takedown. It is a reminder that cybersecurity has become a frontline of national security—and that protecting critical infrastructure requires constant vigilance against adversaries capable of operating quietly for years before being exposed. items.title: Goobaha loo asteeyay doorashada HirShabelle oo la shaaciyay
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa soo saaray jadwalka goobaha loo asteeyay doorashooyinka isku-sidkan ee Golayaasha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle. Doorashooyinka ayaa ka qabsoomi doona 12 degmo oo ku kala yaalla gobollada Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe, iyadoo degmooyinkaas ay qeyb ka yihiin qorshaha guud ee diyaarinta hannaanka doorashada HirShabelle, sida uu shaaciyay guddiga. Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa loo asteeyay lix degmo oo kala ah Beledweyne, Jalalaqsi, Buulo Burde, Matabaan, Jawiil iyo Farlibaax, halka lixda degmo ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ay yihiin Jowhar, Balcad, Warsheekh, Cadale, Mahadaay iyo Raage Ceelle. Guddiga ayaa horey u soo saaray jadwalka guud ee doorashada HirShabelle, kaas oo qeexaya marxaladaha kala duwan ee geeddi-socodka doorashada iyo tallaabooyinka la xiriira diyaarinta codbixinta. Tallaabada hadda la qaaday ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshaha lagu diyaarinayo xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta, iyadoo guddigu si rasmi ah u caddeeyay degmooyinka loo asteeyay inay ka dhacaan doorashooyinka. Doorashooyinka isku-sidkan ayaa loogu tartamayaa xubnaha Golayaasha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada HirShabelle, iyadoo guddigu sheegay in hannaanka doorashada lagu maamulayo jadwal iyo habraacyo rasmi ah oo uu soo saaray. Shaacinta 12-ka degmo ayaa ah tallaabo muhiim ah oo loo qaaday diyaarinta doorashada HirShabelle, iyadoo la filayo in guddigu uu si rasmi ah u shaacin doono xilliga ay qabsoomeyso doorashada kadib markii dib u dhac ku yimid jadwalkii hore ee doorashada. items.title: Soomaaliya oo kalfadhiga aan caadiga ahayn  ee OIC ku xaqiijisay…
items.description: Jeddah (Caasimada Online) – Wasiir Ku-xigeenka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Maxamed Cali (Nadaara) oo hoggaaminayay wafdi ka socday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ka qeyb-galay Kalfadhiga 23-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC). Kalfadhiga oo lagu qabtay magaalada Jeddah ayaa looga hadlay xaaladda Falastiin, gaar ahaan Qudus Al-Shariif iyo arrimo kale oo khuseeya dalalka xubnaha ka ah ururka. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa kulanka mar kale ku xaqiijisay garab-istaagga iyo taageerada ay u hayso shacabka Falastiin, iyadoo ku baaqday in la gaaro xal caddaalad ah, waara oo waafaqsan sharciga caalamiga ah iyo qaraarrada khuseeya ee Qaramada Midoobay. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale ku adkeysatay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu taageerayo shacabka Falastiin iyo sidii loo heli lahaa xal waara oo wax ka qabta xaaladda ka jirta dhulka Falastiin. Intii uu socday kalfadhiga, Ismaaciil Ould Cheikh Ahmed oo ka socday Dowladda Mauritania ayaa loo doortay Xoghayaha Guud ee cusub ee Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka, isaga oo xilka hayn doona muddada u dhexeysa 2027 iyo 2032. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa ugu hambalyeysay Xoghayaha Guud ee cusub xilka loo doortay, iyadoo sidoo kale bogaadisay adeegga iyo hoggaamintii Xoghayaha Guud ee xilka ka sii degaya, Xuseen Ibraahim Taha. Soomaaliya ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegtay inay ka go’an tahay xoojinta midnimada iyo iskaashiga dalalka Islaamka iyo in la taageero tallaabooyinka wadajirka ah ee lagu horumarinayo danaha iyo maslaxadda ummadaha Islaamka. items.title: Puntland Accuses Türkiye of Conducting Airstrikes off Somalia’s Nugaal Coast
items.description: Puntland authorities have accused Türkiye of carrying out airstrikes off the coast of Somalia’s Nugaal region following the hijacking of the M/V LUTUF, a vessel reportedly transporting Turkish-made weapons and military equipment. Puntland’s Deputy Minister of Security, Abdirahman Yusuf Dujaana, told BBC Newsday and BBC Somali that the regional administration believed Türkiye was responsible for the strikes. He also alleged that Somalia’s Federal Government was involved in the developments surrounding the vessel and the subsequent operation. The Turkish government told the BBC that it had no information about the reported strikes. Other reports, however, indicated that Turkish naval vessels, helicopters and unmanned aerial vehicles had been observed near the hijacked ship. Somalia’s Federal Government said it had been informed of the operation in advance. It disputed claims that those killed in the strikes were fishermen and raised the possibility that they were members of the suspected pirate group holding the M/V LUTUF and other internationally registered vessels. The competing accounts have not been independently verified. The number and identities of those killed, as well as the circumstances surrounding the reported strikes, remain unclear. The post Puntland Accuses Türkiye of Conducting Airstrikes off Somalia’s Nugaal Coast appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Aqalka Sare oo digniin u direy 20 Senator – Maxaa lagu haystaa?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Xeer-hoosaadka, Anshaxa, Xasaanadda iyo Daryeelka Senatorada Golaha Aqalka Sare ayaa maanta digniin rasmi ah u diray 20 Senator. Senatoradan ayaa guddigu sheegay inay ka maqnaayeen fadhiyada golaha, kaasi oo u dambeeyay kulankii 1-aad ee Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Golaha Aqalka Sare oo qabsoomay 26-kii August 2026. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in digniintan loo diray Senatoradaasi kadib markii ay ka maqnaadeen kulanka, iyadoo lagu wargeliyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in xubnaha Aqalka Sare ay si joogto ah uga soo qeyb-galaan fadhiyada golaha, isla markaana ay gutaan waajibaadkooda xubinimo. “Guddiga oo gudanaya waajibaadka loo igmaday ayaa digniin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan ka maqnaanshaha fadhiyada Golaha u jeediyay Senatorada ku xusan lifaaqa, iyadoo uu guddigu xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay joogteynta ka qaybgalka fadhiyada Golaha iyo gudashada waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee loo igmaday,” ayaa lagu yiri digniinta kasoo baxday guddiga. Guddigu wuxuu xusay in waajibaadka Senatorada uu waafaqsan yahay faqradda 3-aad ee qodobka 14-aad ee xeer-hoosaadka Golaha Aqalka Sare, isagoo xubnaha ku boorriyay inay si buuxda uga soo qeyb-galaan kulamada soo socda. Sidoo kale, guddiga ayaa Senatorada ay khuseyso uga digay inay ka maqnaadaan kulamada golaha, isagoo caddeeyay in haddii aysan u hoggaansamin digniinta la siiyay laga qaadi doono tallaabooyin anshax. Senatorada digniinta loo diray waxaa ka mid ah Cabdi Axmed Dhuhulow (Dhagdheer), Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Maxamuud (Faroole), Cabdisamad Yuusuf Maxamed (Abwaan), Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Cismaan, Daahir Ayaanle Saciid, Dr. Xuseen Maxamed Daahir iyo Fartuun Cabdulqaadir Faarax Karama. Waxaa sidoo kale liiska ku jira Farxaan Cali Maxamuud, Farxaan Cali Xuseen, Xasan Daahir Yare, Xasan Idow Maxamed (Kobac), Leyla Axmed Ismaaciil, Maryan Faarax Kahiye, Cabdi Cabdullaahi Xaashi (Goley), Prof. Cabdi Ismaaciil Samatar, Saciid Sayid Shirwac, Samiira Maxamed Xaaji, Axmed Maxamed Saciid, Cabdulxakiim Macallin Axmed Maalin iyo Saalax Axmed Jaamac.
