items.title: Deegaanka xeebaha Puntland oo uu Turkigu ku xasuuqay dad Kaluumaysato ah Iyo Puntland oo dhaleecaysay Turkiga
items.description: Puntland ayaa Turkiga ku eedeeysay inuu ka dambeeyo duqeymo aan weli cidina sheegan oo maalmihii lasoo dhaafay ka dhacay xeebaha gobolka Nugaal, kaddib markii burcad-badeed Soomaali ahi afduubteen markabka M/V Lutuf. Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf Dujaana, oo ah wasiir ku-xigeenka amniga Puntland, ayaa wareysi uu siiyay BBC Newsday iyo BBC Somali ku sheegay in Puntland ay Turkiga ku eedeyneyso duqeymahaas. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku eedeeyay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya inay qeyb ku leedahay waxa socda. Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf uma uusan soo bandhigin BBC-da caddeyn si madax-bannaan u xaqiijineysa cidda fulisay duqeymaha, mana jirto illaa hadda dowlad, ciidan ama koox si rasmi ah u sheegatay mas’uuliyaddooda. “Anagu burcad-badeed waan la dagaallameynaa, laakiin qofku xuquuq buu leeyahay. Qofka la iska ma dili karo,” ayuu BBC-da u sheegay. Xigashada Sawirka, Abdirahman Yusuf Dujana Qoraalka sawirka, Wasiir ku-xigeenka amniga Puntland, Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf Dujaana. Duqeymaha ayaa billowday kaddib markii burcad-badeeddu 17-kii Agoosto afduubteen markabka M/V Lutuf oo ku gooshayay calanka Cameroon. Sarkaal Soomaali ah ayaa wakaaladda wararka AP u sheegay in markabku siday hub laga keenay Turkiga iyo qalab isgaarsiin iyo dayax-gacmeed, kuwaas oo ku sii jeeday xarun tababar milatari oo Turkigu ku leeyahay Muqdisho. Burcad-badeedda ayaa markabka iyo shaqaalihii saarnaa u soo jiheeyay xeebaha gobolka Nugaal. 18-kii Agoosto, afar qof ayaa lagu soo warramay inay ku dhinteen, laba kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen duqeyn ka dhacday agagaarka Garmaal, kaddib markii doon yar ay xeebta kusoo laabatay iyadoo kasoo laabatay dhinaca markabka la afduubtay. Wararkii hore qaarkood ayaa dadka dhintay ku tilmaamay rag looga shakisan yahay burcad-badeednimo. Eheladooda iyo qaar kamid ah dadka deegaanka ayaa taas beeniyay, iyagoo sheegay in qaar kamid ah dadka dhintay ay ahaayeen kalluumeysato. 23-kii Agoosto ayaa duqeyn kale oo dhimasho sababtay laga soo sheegay deegaanka Jiifle ee degmada Godob-Jiraan. Duqa degmada ayaa BBC Somali u sheegay in sagaal qof lagu dilay duqeyntaas. Qof deegaanka ah oo goobta tegay ayaa BBC-da u sheegay inuu arkay siddeed meyd oo si xun u gubtay. Waxa uu sheegay in qaar kamid ah dhalinyarada doonta saarneyd deegaanka looga yaqaanay kalluumeysato, hase yeeshee uusan xaqiijin karin sababta ay badda ugu jireen iyo in dhammaan dadka saarnaa ay xiriir la lahaayeen burcad-badeedda. Xigashada Sawirka, Anadolu via Getty Images Qoraalka sawirka, Ciidamada Booliska Badda Puntland (PMPF) oo roondo ka wada xeebaha Puntland, iyagoo ka hortagaya weerarrada burcad-badeedda ee dhowaanahan kusoo kordhay xeebaha Puntland, Soomaaliya. Markabka M/V Lutuf ayaa la sheegay in maalmo kahor loo soo wareejiyay dhinaca deegaankaas. Illaa hadda cidina ma sheegan mas’uuliyadda labada duqeyn. Mar ay BBC horay wax uga weydiisay Turkiga eedeymaha madaniga ah ee la xiriirinayay duqeymaha, sarkaal ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga ayaa sheegay in Ankara aysan wax xog ah ka hayn weerarradaas. Hadda, Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf oo Puntland metelaya ayaa si toos ah Turkiga ugu eedeeyay duqeymahaas. “Caddeymo waan haynaa,” ayuu yiri, isagoo sheegay in Puntland ay hayso xog la xiriirta dhaqdhaqaaqyada Turkiga ee markabka iyo xeebaha ku hareeraysan. BBC-du si madax-bannaan uma xaqiijin karto eedeymahaas. Hadalkiisa ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli su’aalo kale laga qabo waxa dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay ka ogtahay howlgallada. Xigashada Sawirka, Telefishinka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed Qoraalka sawirka, Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Cumar Cali Cabdi. 22-kii Agoosto, wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Cumar Cali Cabdi, ayaa warbaahinta maxalliga ah u sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay ka warqabto howlgallo milatari iyo duqeymo ka socda xeebaha Puntland. Waxa uu sheegay in dowladda ay diyaarineyso “warbixin dhameystiran”. Cumar Cali Cabdi ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in haddii howlgal milatari oo ka dhan ah burcad-badeedda laga fulinayo xeebaha Soomaaliya, dowladda federaalka ay tahay maamulka sharci ahaan mas’uulka ka ah fasaxa howlgalkaas. Ma uusan sheegin cidda fulineysa duqeymaha. Sidaas darteed waxaa weli taagan su’aalo muhiim ah: yaa duqeymaha fulinaya, dowladda federaalku ma iyadaa amartay kuwaan hadda socda, maxaase dedaal ah oo laga sameeyay ilaalinta nolosha dadka rayidka ah? Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf ayaa sheegay in khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka uu adkeeyay dagaalka ka dhanka ah burcad-badeedda. Waxa uu dowladda federaalka ku eedeeyay inay ku lug leedahay arrimaha socda, balse wax caddeyn madax-bannaan oo lagu xaqiijin karo uma uusan soo bandhigin BBC-da. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in Puntland ay baareyso shabakado dambiilayaal ah kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay taageeraan burcad-badeedda. Waxa uu sheegay in Puntland ay qabatay dad dibadda ka yimid oo watay qalabka GPS-ka iyo kombiyuutarro loo adeegsanayay la socodka maraakiibta boqollaal mayl u jirta xeebaha. Mar la weydiiyay in Al-Shabaab ama kooxda isku magacawda Dowladda Islaamka ee IS ay xiriir la leeyihiin burcad-badeedda, waxa uu sheegay in Puntland aysan hadda hayn caddeyn si toos ah kooxahaas ugu xiriirineysa dhacdooyinka socda. Inkasta oo ay Puntland ka cabaneyso duqeymaha, waxay ay sidoo kale sheegtay inay sii xoojin doonto dagaalka ka dhanka ah burcad-badeedda. Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf ayaa sheegay in Puntland ay leedahay ciidamo iyo qalab ay burcad-badeedda kula dagaallami karto berriga iyo baddaba, balse howlgalladu ay adkaanayaan maadaama shaqaalahii maraakiibta afduub ahaan loo haysto. “Dadka ay afduubka u haystaan waa in aysan wax dhibaato ahi soo gaarin,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu dalbaday taageero caalami ah oo dhinaca badda ah, isagoo xusay iskaashigii hore ee Puntland iyo ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah xilligii hore ee dagaalka burcad-badeeddu cirka isku shareeray. BBC-du waxay jawaab iyo faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka dalbatay Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho iyo xafiiska saraakiisha ciidamada Turkiga. BBC-du waxay sidoo kale la xiriirtay Wasaaradaha Gaashaandhigga iyo Warfaafinta ee dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo weydiisay cidda fulineysa duqeymaha, in dowladda federaalku amartay iyo jawaabta ay ka bixineyso eedeymaha Puntland.

Hadda, Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf oo Puntland metelaya ayaa si toos ah Turkiga ugu eedeeyay duqeymahaas. “Caddeymo waan haynaa,” ayuu yiri, isagoo sheegay in Puntland ay hayso xog la xiriirta dhaqdhaqaaqyada Turkiga ee markabka iyo xeebaha ku hareeraysan. BBC-du si madax-bannaan uma xaqiijin karto eedeymahaas. Hadalkiisa ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli su’aalo kale laga qabo waxa dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay ka ogtahay howlgallada. Xigashada Sawirka, Telefishinka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed Qoraalka sawirka, Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Cumar Cali Cabdi. 22-kii Agoosto, wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Cumar Cali Cabdi, ayaa warbaahinta maxalliga ah u sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay ka warqabto howlgallo milatari iyo duqeymo ka socda xeebaha Puntland. Waxa uu sheegay in dowladda ay diyaarineyso “warbixin dhameystiran”. Cumar Cali Cabdi ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in haddii howlgal milatari oo ka dhan ah burcad-badeedda laga fulinayo xeebaha Soomaaliya, dowladda federaalka ay tahay maamulka sharci ahaan mas’uulka ka ah fasaxa howlgalkaas. Ma uusan sheegin cidda fulineysa duqeymaha. Sidaas darteed waxaa weli taagan su’aalo muhiim ah: yaa duqeymaha fulinaya, dowladda federaalku ma iyadaa amartay kuwaan hadda socda, maxaase dedaal ah oo laga sameeyay ilaalinta nolosha dadka rayidka ah? Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf ayaa sheegay in khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka uu adkeeyay dagaalka ka dhanka ah burcad-badeedda. Waxa uu dowladda federaalka ku eedeeyay inay ku lug leedahay arrimaha socda, balse wax caddeyn madax-bannaan oo lagu xaqiijin karo uma uusan soo bandhigin BBC-da. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in Puntland ay baareyso shabakado dambiilayaal ah kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay taageeraan burcad-badeedda. Waxa uu sheegay in Puntland ay qabatay dad dibadda ka yimid oo watay qalabka GPS-ka iyo kombiyuutarro loo adeegsanayay la socodka maraakiibta boqollaal mayl u jirta xeebaha. Mar la weydiiyay in Al-Shabaab ama kooxda isku magacawda Dowladda Islaamka ee IS ay xiriir la leeyihiin burcad-badeedda, waxa uu sheegay in Puntland aysan hadda hayn caddeyn si toos ah kooxahaas ugu xiriirineysa dhacdooyinka socda. Inkasta oo ay Puntland ka cabaneyso duqeymaha, waxay ay sidoo kale sheegtay inay sii xoojin doonto dagaalka ka dhanka ah burcad-badeedda. Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf ayaa sheegay in Puntland ay leedahay ciidamo iyo qalab ay burcad-badeedda kula dagaallami karto berriga iyo baddaba, balse howlgalladu ay adkaanayaan maadaama shaqaalahii maraakiibta afduub ahaan loo haysto. “Dadka ay afduubka u haystaan waa in aysan wax dhibaato ahi soo gaarin,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu dalbaday taageero caalami ah oo dhinaca badda ah, isagoo xusay iskaashigii hore ee Puntland iyo ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah xilligii hore ee dagaalka burcad-badeeddu cirka isku shareeray. BBC-du waxay jawaab iyo faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka dalbatay Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho iyo xafiiska saraakiisha ciidamada Turkiga. BBC-du waxay sidoo kale la xiriirtay Wasaaradaha Gaashaandhigga iyo Warfaafinta ee dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo weydiisay cidda fulineysa duqeymaha, in dowladda federaalku amartay iyo jawaabta ay ka bixineyso eedeymaha Puntland.

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo u jeedsanaya dhismaha ciidamada
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa u jeedsanaya tababarka iyo xoojinta awoodda ee ciidamada ka hawlgala deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed. Hoggaamiyaha la doortay ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa doonaya inuu salka u dhigo maamulkiisa, taasna wuxuu ogyahay inay ku xiran tahay in maamulku uu yeesho ciidan ku filan oo ilaaliyaha xuduudaha gudaha ee Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose, Baay iyo Bakool. Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa garowsan in khatartii asalka ahayd ee Al Shabaab ay u dheer tahay ciidamada deegaanka ee ka biyo diidan is bedelkii siyaasadeed ee ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Maamulka cusub ee Aadan Madoobe ayaa waxaa jug ku noqotay ciidamo ka tirsanaa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed oo horey ugu goostay dhinaca Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen), kuwaas oo maanta culeys amni ku haya maamulkiisa, isla-markaana dhaqdhaqaaq ka wada hareeraha magaalada uu ku shaqeeyo ee Baydhabo. Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa riixaya qorshe ay Dowladda Federaalka iyo xulafadeeda Turkiga ay ku tababarayaan ciidamo cusub, oo qayb ka noqda howlaha sugidda amniga iyo la dagaalanka kooxaha argagixisada. Weerarkii 17-kii bishan ay ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Laftagareen ka gaysteen magaaladaasi Baydhabo ayaa Aadan Madoobe u diiday in uu hurdada ku raaxeysto, isagoona bilaabay in uu dhinaciisa ka qabto howlaha socda ee dib-u-habaynta iyo xoojinta lagu sameynayo ciidamada, si loo adkeeyo amniga Baydhabo iyo guud ahaanba deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed. Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ayaa Baydhabo ka wada qorista iyo soo xulista dhallinyaro cusub, oo ay tahay in loo tababaro Ciidanka Qaybta 60aad ee Xoogga Dalka iyo Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Aadan Madoobe uu amar ku bixiyay in sidoo kale dhallinyarada laga qoro Magaalooyinka Afgooye iyo Xudur ee Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Bakool. Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee laga leeyahay tallaabadan ayaa ah in la kordhiyo tirada askarta, si loo helo ciidan ka jawaabi kara xaaladaha degdegga ah, isla-markaana xasilliya deegaanada maamulka. Ilo wareedyo muhiim ah ayaa sheegaya in Villa Somalia uu mowqifkeedu yahay in Aadan Madoobe laga taageero, sidii uu u gudan lahaa waajibaadkiisa shaqo. Dowladda Federaalka waa u muhiim amniga iyo deganaanshaha Koonfur Galbeed, maadaama Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Federaalka ee ka imanaya deegaanada saddexda gobol ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ay gacan ka gaysan karaan dib u doorashada Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Doorashooyinka Heer Federaal ee dalka, gaar ahaan madaxtinimada ayaa waxay ku tiirsan tahay codadka Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ee laga soo doorto Dowlad Goboleedyada xubnaha ka ah Dowladda Federaalka. Aadan Madoobe ayaa hiigsanaya xaqiijinta amniga iyo xoojinta awooddiisa siyaasadeed ee deegaanada maamulka.

items.title: Laascaanood anaga ayaa Somaliland Ka soo jarnay
items.description: Laascaanood anaga ayaa Somaliland Ka soo jarnay, Iminkana anaga ayaa ku celin karna,waxaanan diyaar u nahay Wada hadal. Hadaladaasi waxa ay ka soo yeedheen Wasiirul Dawlaha Arrimaha Dibada Somaliya Cali Balcad oo aan xukuumadda uu sheeganayaa ayna wada maamulin ama ka talin tuulooyinka ku hareeraysan magaaladda Muqdisho. Waxa sido oo kale xaqiiq ah in magaaladda Kaalkacayo oo uu ka soo jeedo aanu ka talin qayb ka mid ah taasi oo Madaxweynaha isaga xilka u magacaabay uu todobaadkii hore uu booqan kari waayay oo loo diiday qaybta ugu mihiimsan magaaladda Kaalkacayo. Maanta ma jirto wax la yidhaa dawladda Somalia oo ay aqoonsanyihiin dadkeedu waana dawlad fashilantay.

items.title: Dhacdo ka dhacday gudaha Saldhigga Waaberi iyo Booliska Muqdisho oo ka hadlay
items.description: Taliska Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa war ka soo saaray dhacdo caawa fiidkii ka dhacday Saldhigga Boolisa Degmada Waaberi. Taliska ayaa waxba kama jiraan ku tilmaamay wararka sheegaya in gudaha Saldhigga Degmada Waaberi lagu dilay qof, isla-markaana laga soo saaray meyd. “Waa waxba kama jiraan wararka sheegaya in gudaha Saldhigga Booliska Waaberi ee Caasimadda lagu dilay qof, isla-markaana meyd laga soo saaray. Warkaasi waa been abuur aan sal iyo raad lahayn.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka taliska. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Abbaaro 20:50 ayaa xabad/ baalooto ka dhacday qoriga uu sitay mid ka mid ah askarta ka howlgasha saldhigga, ka dib markii eedeysane Farxaan Ibraahim Abshir uu qoriga la qabsaday askariga.” Taliska ayaa xusay in xabaddu ay si lama filaan ah uga dhacday qoriga uu watay askarigaasi, isla-markaana ay garabka uga dhacday eedeysanaha oo dhaawiciisu uu ku sheegay mid fudud. “Xabad si lama filaan ah uga dhacday qoriga ayaa garabka ka haleeshay eedeysanaha, oo ah haatan dhaawac fudud. Dhacdadaasi wax dhimasho ah kama dhalan, mana jirto meyd laga soo saaray Saldhigga Booliska Waaberi.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka oo intaasi ku daray “Waxaa socda baaritaan la xiriira dhacdadaasi.” Dhanka kale wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in xabadda laga maqlay saldhigga, wax yar uun ka dib, markii la keenay qof shacab ah oo la soo xiray. Dadweyne ayaa soo xuumay afaafka hore ee Saldhigga Booliska Waaberi, ka dib markii xabadda la maqlay iyo buuq xigay oo xagga saldhiggaasi ka imanayay. Ma cadda, waxa uu yahay eedeysanaha uu talisku sheegay in uu qoriga la qabsaday askariga iyo illaa iyo inta uu eedeysane yahay, laakiin askarta ayaa kuu sheegeysa in markaas uun la soo xiray.

items.title: Somali Prime Minister Embarks on Official Visit to Qatar
items.description: MOGADISHU — Prime Minister of the Federal Government of Somalia, Hamza Abdi Barre, has departed for Qatar following an official invitation from the Qatari government. The visit aims to strengthen the longstanding relations and strategic cooperation between Somalia and Qatar, with particular emphasis on economic cooperation, investment and social development. During his stay in Qatar, Prime Minister Barre is expected to hold high-level meetings with senior Qatari officials. The discussions will focus on expanding bilateral cooperation and exploring new opportunities that serve the shared interests of both countries. The visit forms part of the Federal Government of Somalia’s broader diplomatic efforts to deepen its international partnerships and strengthen its engagement with countries around the world. items.title: Somaliland eyes Djibouti model of leasing out bases in bid to gain recognition”
Xisbiga Xasan Sheekh oo caddeeyay mowqifkiisa go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) oo ka hadlay xukunka Maxkamadda Sare ayaa shaaciyay inuu ixtiraamayo isla markaana aqbalayo xukunka maxkamadda ay ka soo saartay dacwaddii la xiriirtay doorashada Galmudug. JSP oo ka mid ahaa ururradii siyaasadeed ee ka qayb-galay doorashadii isku-sidkaneyd ee Goleyaasha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee Galmudug ka qabsoontay 30-kii July 2026 ayaa sheegay in mabaadi’diisa ay udub-dhexaad u tahay aaminsanaanta sarraynta sharciga iyo madax-bannaanida hay’adaha garsoorka. “Mabaadi’da uu ku shaqeeyo Ururka waxaa udub-dhexaad u ah aaminsanaanta sarraynta sharciga, madaxbannaanida hay’adaha garsoorka iyo in khilaafaadka ka dhasha doorashooyinka lagu xalliyo hannaan sharci oo dastuur ah,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Xisbiga uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee JSP. Sidoo kale, JSP ayaa caddeeyay inuu intii lagu guda jiray marxaladdii doorashada uu raacay xeerarka iyo habraacyada doorashooyinka dalka, gaar ahaan doorashadii ka dhacday Galmudug. Xisbiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay ka qayb-galka doorashooyinka ku celiska ah, isagoo xusay in uu u hoggaansami doono dastuurka, xeerarka doorashooyinka iyo xeerarka kale ee khuseeya hannaanka doorashada. “Ururku wuxuu sidoo kale caddeynayaa inuu si waafaqsan dastuurka, xeerarka Doorashooyinka iyo xeerarka kale ee ku shaqada leh, diyaar u yahay ka qaybgalka doorashooyinka ku celiska ah ee Goleyaasha Deegaanka iyo kuwa Wakiillada ee Dawlad Goboleedka Galmudug,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Ugu dambeyntiina, JSP ayaa u mahadceliyay xubnihiisa, hawl-wadeennadiisa iyo shacabka reer Galmudug ee taageeray, wuxuuna ugu baaqay inay u diyaar garoobaan ka qayb-galka doorashada ku-celiska ah, iyagoo sii laba-jibaari doona dadaalkooda iyo hawl-karnimadooda. “Ururku wuxuu idinka codsanayaa in mar labaad loo diyaar garoobo ololaha iyo ka qayb-galka doorashada ku-celiska ah ee loo balansanyahay, isla-markaaana si laban-laabaan dadaalkii iyo hawl-karnimadii ay muujiseen muddadii lagu jiray hawlaha doorashada.” War-saxaafadeedka JSP ayaa imanaya xilli guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka ay shaaciyeen inay aqbaleen go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare, isla markaana ay qabanayaan doorasho ku celis ah, si loo saxo qaladaadkii horey u dhacay ee cabashada ka keeneen xisbiyadii ka qeyb-galay doorashooyinka. Maxkamadda Sare ayaa 24-kii bishaan ku dhowaaqay in maxkamaddu ay laashay natiijada doorashooyinkaas, iyadoo shaaca ka qaaday in aan loo maamulin, loona qaban si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka dalka. “Maxkamaddu waxay go’aamisay in doorashooyinkii isku sidkanaa ee Golaha wakiilada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka ee 30-kii Luulyo ka dhacay Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug aan loo maamulin, loona qaban si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka dalka, sidaas darteedna ay tahay natiijadeeda mid aan sax ahayn oo waxba kama jiraan ah,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka, Baashe Yuusuf Axmed. items.title: UK oo shuruud adag ku xirtay sii wadidda taageerada DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Britain ayaa ku boorrisay madaxda Soomaaliya inay dardar geliyaan wada-hadallada siyaasadeed isla markaana horumar ka sameeyaan qorshaha ay Soomaalidu kula wareegayso masuuliyadda amniga, iyadoo sheegtay in labada arrimood ay muhiim u yihiin sii jiritaanka kalsoonida iyo taageerada beesha caalamka. Farriintan ayaa waxaa Muqdisho ka gudbisay Wasiirka Horumarinta iyo Afrika ee Britain, Kirsty McNeill, oo Talaadadii booqashadeedii ugu horreysay ku timid Soomaaliya, halkaas oo ay kula kulantay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay dowladda Britain, McNeill ayaa madaxda Soomaalida ku dhiirrigelisay inay yeeshaan wada-hadallo wax-ku-ool ah oo xoojiya midnimada dalka, horseeda horumar siyaasadeed, isla markaana lagu dhiso heshiis ku saabsan mustaqbalka Soomaaliya. London ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in horumarka laga gaaro wada-hadallada siyaasadeed iyo qorshaha kala-guurka amniga uu muhiim u noqon doono go’aannada laga gaarayo taageerada mustaqbalka ee Britain ay siiso ciidamada Soomaaliya, taas oo loo sii mariyo Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya ee UNSOS. Khilaafka doorashada Baaqan ayaa imanaya xilli dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka ay weli isku hayaan qaabka loo qabanayo doorashada soo socota iyo cidda maamuleysa. Labada dhinac waxay taageersan yihiin in Soomaaliya u gudubto doorasho dadweyne, balse waxay ku kala aragti duwan yihiin habka loo fulinayo iyo qaab-dhismeedka hay’adaha doorashada. Dowladda federaalka ayaa dooneysa doorasho qof iyo cod ah oo dalka oo dhan ka dhacda, taas oo musharraxiintu uga qeybgalayaan iyagoo ka socda xisbiyo siyaasadeed oo diiwaangashan. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed, oo ah isbahaysi mucaarad ah oo ay ku jiraan Puntland iyo Jubbaland, ayaa dhinaciisa soo jeediyay nidaam ku-meel-gaar ah oo sii ilaalinaya habka awood-qeybsiga beelaha ee 4.5, balse shacabka siinaya fursad ay si toos ah ugu doortaan wakiilladooda. Waxaa kale oo dhinacyadu isku khilaafsan yihiin maamulka doorashada iyo in dowlad-goboleedyadu yeeshaan guddiyo doorasho oo u gaar ah, kuwaas oo ka barbar shaqeeya guddiga heer federaal. Wada-hadalladii u dhexeeyay dowladda iyo mucaaradka ayaa 20-kii July ku dhammaaday heshiis la’aan, kadib markii lagu kala aragti duwanaaday qodobadaas. Khilaafka ayaa sii xoogaystay markii Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed uu soo jeediyay in la dhiso gole loo dhan yahay oo si ku-meel-gaar ah u maamula go’aannada la xiriira dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka ilaa laga gaarayo heshiis ballaaran. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa 1-dii August diiday soo-jeedintaas, isagoo sheegay in Soomaaliya ay tahay inay ilaaliso hay’adaha dowladeed ee la dhisay tan iyo markii laga baxay xilligii ku-meel-gaarka ahaa, halkii dib loogu noqon lahaa nidaam kale oo ku-meel-gaar ah. Ilaa hadda ma jiro heshiis siyaasadeed oo dhameystiran oo ay dowladda iyo mucaaradka ka gaareen arrimaha doorashada. Taageerada amniga Intii ay joogtay Muqdisho, McNeill ayaa sidoo kale la kulantay masuuliyiin ka tirsan UNSOS iyo Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya ee AUSSOM. Waxay bogaadisay dadaalka iyo khasaaraha ay ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Midowga Afrika u galeen dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab. Britain ayaa sheegtay inay diyaar u tahay inay taageero dheeraad ah u fidiso ciidamada Soomaaliya iyada oo loo marayo UNSOS, oo bixiya adeegyo saadka iyo taageero kale oo aan hub ahayn oo muhiim u ah howlgallada amniga. Taageerada ay Britain maalgeliso ee loo maro UNSOS waxaa ka mid ah raashin, teendhooyin, agab caafimaad iyo adeegyada daad-gureynta dhaawacyada. Hase yeeshee, mustaqbalka nidaamka taageerada caalamiga ah ee ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo AUSSOM ayaa wajahaya hubanti la’aan dhaqaale. Mareykanka ayaa hore u muujiyay inuusan taageeri doonin in laga bilaabo 2027 la sii wado taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee AUSSOM, inkastoo Washington aysan kasoo horjeedin in la kordhiyo muddada hawlgalka Midowga Afrika laftiisa. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sidoo kale billowday dhimista qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaheeda rayidka ah iyo diyaarinta iibinta hanti ay leedahay, iyadoo ay sii kordhayso walaaca ku saabsan dhaqaalaha lagu maalgeliyo howlgalka iyo taageerada amniga Soomaaliya. Xaaladdaas awgeed, Britain ayaa ku adkeysatay in horumar laga sameeyo wada-hadallada siyaasadeed iyo qorshaha Soomaalidu kula wareegayso masuuliyadda amniga uu muhiim u yahay xaqiijinta taageerada mustaqbalka ee London. Britain wax ballanqaad dhaqaale oo cusub kuma aysan dhawaaqin intii ay socotay booqashada McNeill. The post UK oo shuruud adag ku xirtay sii wadidda taageerada DF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wax’yaabihii lagaga wada hadlay shirkii golaha wasiiradda Somaliland
items.description: Fadhigii 73-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, oo uu shir-guddoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa maanta ka qabsoomay Qasriga Madaxtooyada JSL. Golaha Wasiirrada JSL waxa ay Fadhigii 73-aad ku lafa-gureen xaaladaha Amni, Ganacsiga iyo Waxbarashada dalka, iyada oo warbixinno muhiim ah laga dhegaystay Wasaaradaha Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka, Ganacsiga iyo Dalxiiska, iyo Waxbarashada, Barbaarinta iyo Sayniska. 𝟏. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab, ayaa Golaha la wadaagay xaaladda guud ee amniga dalka, isaga oo sheegay in guud ahaan dalka ay ka jirto xasillooni iyo amni sugan. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in shaqaaqooyinkii dhawaan ka dhacay deegaanno ka mid ah Gobollada Awdal iyo Selel ay haatan soo afjarmayaan, isla markaana deegaannadaasi ay ka jirto nabad iyo xasillooni. Sidoo kale, Wasiirku waxa uu faahfaahiyey dedaallada ay Xukuumaddu hormuudka ka tahay ee lagu xoojinayo nabadda, wada-noolaanshaha, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo is-afgaradka bulshada ku dhaqan deegaannadaasi. Wasiirku waxa uu si adag u adkeeyey in deegaannadii ay shaqaaqooyinku ka dhaceen aan gebi ahaanba loo oggolayn qof shacab ah ama koox ah oo aan ka tirsanayn Hay’adaha Amniga in ay sidato hub, nooc kasta oo uu yahayba. Waxa kale oo uu xusay in Ciidamada Amnigu amar ku qabaan in ay tallaabo sharciga waafaqsan ka qaadaan cid kasta oo arrintaas ku xad-gudubta, isla markaana ay hubka kala wareegaan. 𝟐. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐐𝐢𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐒𝐡𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐒𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐫𝐤𝐚 𝐌𝐚𝐜𝐢𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 Wasiirka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Dalxiiska, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Xasan Nuur, ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada siiyey warbixin ku saabsan korodhka qiimaha shidaalka iyo saamaynta uu ku yeeshay nolosha bulshada, sicirka maciishadda iyo sarrifka Shillinka Somaliland. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha Wasiirrada u sheegay in dalka uu soo gaadhay shidaal badan oo batrool ah, halka naaftaduna ay soo socoto, taasi oo wax weyn ka beddeli doonta korodhka qiimaha shidaalka iyo xasillinta sicirka suuqa shidaalka. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u sheegay tallaabooyinka ay Wasaaraddu waddo, oo ay ka mid yihiin la socodka suuqyada, wada-shaqaynta ganacsatada shidaalka, hubinta helitaanka shidaalka iyo ka hortagga korodhka aan salka ku hayn xaaladda dhabta ah ee suuqa. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in Wasaaraddu ay sii wadi doonto xasilinta suuqa, ilaalinta awoodda wax-iibsiga bulshada iyo yaraynta culayska dhaqaale ee ka dhasha isbeddellada qiimaha shidaalka. 𝟑. items.title: When blessing becomes a ballot: Elders, Fātiḥa, and the Democratic Deficit in Garissa
items.description: By Abdullahi Abdi There is a Somali proverb whose wisdom should trouble anyone concerned about the direction of electoral politics in Garissa: Hal xaaraan ahi nirig xalaal ah ma dhasho . Loosely rendered, this means that an unlawfully acquired she-camel cannot give birth to a lawful calf. Its political meaning is compelling. A fundamentally defective process cannot be sanitised merely by producing a desirable outcome. If the procedure by which political authority is allocated is opaque, exclusionary, and unaccountable, the legitimacy of what emerges from it will always remain open to question. That is precisely the difficulty confronting the increasingly institutionalised practice of elder-mediated political selection in Garissa, and more broadly, in parts of northern Kenya. The problem is not the existence of elders. Somali society has for centuries relied on them for mediation, reconciliation, communal deliberation, and the settlement of disputes. Nor is there anything objectionable about elders expressing political preferences; they are citizens, and they possess the same constitutional rights to political expression and association as everyone else. The problem arises when moral authority quietly becomes political jurisdiction, when consultation becomes selection, and when endorsement hardens into an informal veto over another citizen’s constitutional right to seek elective office. In Garissa, this problem takes on an especially sensitive dimension through the invocation of al-Fātiḥa, the opening surah of the Qur’an, during political settlements. The Fātiḥa occupies a sacred place in Islam, and its religious significance is not in question here. What deserves examination is its deployment within an inherently political process, in which candidates may be asked to defer their ambitions, accept an elders’ settlement, give their blessing to another candidate, and allow him to proceed carrying what is presented as the collective blessing of the clan. Many candidates comply, not necessarily because an electoral contest has demonstrated that another candidate commands greater popular support, nor because delegates have rejected them in a transparent nomination, but because refusing an arrangement sanctified by elders and sealed with the solemn invocation of the Fātiḥa can carry enormous moral and communal weight. The candidate, in other words, is confronted with something far more formidable than an ordinary political negotiation. He is not merely being asked whether he will withdraw. Implicitly, he may also be facing a much harder question: will he defy the elders, disturb clan unity, and appear to walk away from an understanding solemnised through a religious invocation? That distinction matters enormously. The Fātiḥa must not become an electoral instrument This argument has to be stated with care. The objection is neither to the Qur’an nor to the recitation of the Fātiḥa; it is to the conversion of religious reverence into political leverage. Sacred practice should not become a substitute for democratic procedure. Where candidates voluntarily pray together after reaching a genuinely consensual political agreement, that is entirely their right. But where religious solemnity becomes intertwined with an opaque selection mechanism, in a manner that makes dissent morally or socially prohibitive, an important boundary has been crossed. A political decision has, in effect, acquired a religious aura. The danger here is not subtle. A candidate who challenges an ordinary political decision can simply say the procedure was unfair. A candidate confronting a decision clothed in clan authority and solemnised through the Fātiḥa occupies a far more difficult position, because political disagreement can then be read socially as disrespect for elders, repudiation of communal consensus, or even irreverence toward a solemn undertaking. Yet disagreeing with elders about who should contest an election is not disagreement with Islam. Refusing to abandon one’s candidacy is not sacrilege. And the Fātiḥa, sacred to Muslims regardless of clan, political party, or candidate, should never be allowed to function as the seal of an unofficial electoral tribunal. Who gave the elders jurisdiction? The constitutional question is, in the end, remarkably straightforward. Article 1 of the Constitution of Kenya vests all sovereign power in the people of Kenya, exercised directly or through democratically elected representatives, and Article 38 guarantees every citizen’s right to make political choices and, subject to constitutional requirements, to be a candidate for public office. Parliament has enacted laws regulating political parties and nominations, and parties themselves operate under constitutions, nomination rules, and statutory obligations. Where, then, does an informal council of elders derive the authority to decide that one qualified citizen should proceed while another withdraws? There is no constitutional electoral college of clan elders, no statutory “Garissa Council of Candidate Selection,” no independent returning officer, ordinarily no register establishing who constitutes the electorate in these processes, no predetermined rules on evidence, quorum, or appeal, and often no clear answer to the most elementary democratic question of all: who selected the selectors? Age deserves respect. Experience deserves consideration. Neither, by itself, constitutes an electoral mandate. Contrast this with institutionalized nomination processes Consider, by comparison, the presidential nomination processes of the Democratic and Republican parties in the United States, invoked here not as a democratic ideal but as an example of procedural institutionalisation. Those systems are far from perfect; they have been criticised for the influence of money, party establishments, and complicated delegate rules. But the crucial distinction is institutional visibility: candidates know the rules, voters participate in primaries and caucuses, delegates are allocated according to published procedures, and results are announced and open to scrutiny by journalists and rival campaigns alike. Disputes can be contested under established party rules and applicable law. Most importantly, the identity of those empowered to participate, and the mechanism through which their votes acquire significance, is ascertainable before the contest even begins. One need not regard the American primary system as a model to recognise the elementary principle involved: a nomination process worthy of democratic legitimacy must have knowable rules and identifiable decision-makers. The Garissa elders’ model frequently offers the inverse. Who participates, how those participants were selected, what criteria they apply, and whether their deliberations involve voting, consensus, or predetermined clan arithmetic may all be unclear, and whether particular elders hold undisclosed relationships with candidates may be impossible for the public to establish at all. When the decision finally emerges, the electorate is presented with something approaching a fait accompli: the elders have spoken, the Fātiḥa has been recited, and the clan has supposedly decided. That is not an electoral college, a primary election, or a party nomination convention. It is political gatekeeping operating largely outside the institutional safeguards normally associated with democratic choice. The difference between advice and veto This distinction must be preserved. An elder possesses every right to say, “After considering the candidates, I believe Candidate A is best suited to represent our community.” Ten elders may say the same thing; a hundred may do so; that is political participation, plain and simple. But saying, “We have selected Candidate A; Candidate B must therefore withdraw, and the clan must now rally behind our decision,” is a qualitatively different proposition. The first seeks to persuade the electorate. The second seeks, in effect, to narrow the electorate’s choices before the electorate has spoken. The first is an exercise of political speech; the second approximates an assertion of political jurisdiction. The Constitution protects the former. It provides no obvious foundation for the latter. The fiction of voluntary withdrawal Defenders of negotiated democracy may respond that nobody physically prevents the unsuccessful aspirant from contesting, and that candidates who defer do so voluntarily. That argument rests on an excessively narrow conception of coercion. Somali social organisation attaches considerable importance to kinship solidarity, elder authority, reputation, and communal obligation, and a candidate who proceeds against an elders’ decision may find himself accused of dividing the clan or facilitating a rival community’s victory; add the solemn invocation of the Fātiḥa, and the moral pressure becomes still more powerful. The law should therefore distinguish between formal freedom and substantive freedom: a candidate may technically remain free to contest while facing social sanctions so formidable that exercising that freedom becomes extraordinarily costly, and a resignation signed under such pressure remains, on paper, a resignation, without settling the harder question of how freely the underlying choice was actually made. From popular sovereignty to gatekeeper sovereignty There is an even more dangerous consequence to all this. When aspiring politicians learn that political survival depends principally on satisfying a handful of gatekeepers rather than persuading thousands of ordinary citizens, accountability begins flowing in the wrong direction: instead of asking what the people of Garissa want, the rational politician asks what the elders who control the endorsement want, and that small shift transforms incentives across the board. Manifestos become secondary to negotiations; public debate gives way to private bargaining; and women and young people, who make up enormous portions of the electorate, find themselves particularly marginal to a process dominated by elderly men. The voter retains the ballot but loses influence over the menu from which the ballot chooses. That is disenfranchisement by filtration rather than prohibition, and it is no less real for being harder to name. Secrecy creates its own legitimacy crisis Any institution exercising consequential political power should be capable of answering elementary questions about itself: how were the elders appointed, how many participated, and were women and young people represented? What criteria determined the preferred candidate, and were all candidates measured against the same ones? What mechanisms exist for the disclosure of financial interests, political commitments, promised appointments, or other conflicts capable of influencing the decision? Was there a vote, and if so, was the decision unanimous, and if not, where is the dissent recorded? What mechanism exists for appeal? These questions should not be regarded as disrespectful to elders. They are the minimum questions democracy asks of anyone who claims the authority to make consequential decisions on behalf of others. Accountability is not an insult. Transparency is not rebellion. And asking an elder to explain the basis on which he purports to determine the political future of thousands of citizens is not an abandonment of Somali culture; it is citizenship. “Hal xaaraan ahi nirig xalaal ah ma dhasho” Here the Somali proverb returns with particular force. Hal xaaraan ahi nirig xalaal ah ma dhasho: an illegitimate beginning cannot easily produce a legitimate end. The wisdom is profoundly compatible with the constitutional doctrine of procedural fairness: modern public law recognises something Somali customary wisdom understood in its own idiom long ago, that the legitimacy of an outcome cannot be fully detached from the legitimacy of the process that produced it. A fair candidate emerging from an unfair procedure does not retrospectively make the procedure fair. A competent governor selected through an opaque arrangement does not validate opacity. A peaceful outcome does not necessarily establish democratic legitimacy. And the invocation of a sacred text cannot cure procedural defects in what remains, at bottom, an essentially political process. The Fātiḥa may bless people. It cannot confer electoral jurisdiction where the Constitution has conferred none. Democracy includes the right to lose Competitive elections are frequently criticised for dividing Somali communities, and they certainly can. But democracy was never designed to eliminate disagreement; it provides a peaceful mechanism through which disagreement can be expressed and resolved. A citizen possesses no constitutional right to win an election, but a qualified citizen holds political rights that cannot simply be displaced because an informal gathering believes another person should proceed unopposed. There is dignity even in electoral defeat: a candidate who receives twenty per cent of the vote has learned something real about his support, just as a candidate receiving seventy per cent has acquired demonstrable political legitimacy. The electorate, in either case, has spoken. By contrast, when five, fifteen, or fifty individuals negotiate a candidacy behind closed doors and subsequently announce that “the community has decided,” an obvious question arises: when, exactly, did the community vote? Reform the institution rather than destroy it Garissa need not choose between Somali tradition and constitutional democracy; that is a false dichotomy. Put simply: Somali consensus is not incompatible with democracy; unaccountable gatekeeping is. Elders remain indispensable repositories of social memory, mediation experience, and communal legitimacy, and their contribution to reconciliation and political dialogue should continue. But their role should be consultative rather than dispositive. If negotiated nominations are genuinely preferred, then democratise them. Create a transparent delegate system; publish the eligibility rules; establish an identifiable electoral college representing settlements and communities, with women, youth, professionals, persons with disabilities, religious scholars, and businesspeople among them. Set nomination criteria before candidates present themselves. Require disclosure of conflicts of interest. Use secret ballots where appropriate, publish results, and establish a mechanism for complaints and appeals. Then let candidates decide, freely, whether to participate. Such a system would not destroy Somali consensus politics; it would rescue it from the accusation of being a mechanism through which a few people appropriate the political agency of the many. And crucially, religious observance should remain exactly what it is: sacred. The Fātiḥa should unite believers before God, not become an instrument through which one candidacy acquires a moral sanctity denied to another. Garissa must decide who has the right to decide Ultimately, this controversy is not about elders, nor about one clan, one candidate, or one election. It concerns the location of political sovereignty. If sovereignty belongs to the people, then political processes must begin from that proposition rather than merely acknowledge it on election day. Elders can advise, mediate, and persuade. They can endorse, reconcile candidates after bitter contests, and bring to bear the wisdom accumulated through generations of Somali political experience. But they should not constitute an unelected electoral college whose decisions acquire binding political force through secrecy, social pressure, and religious solemnisation. The ballot belongs to the citizen. The Fātiḥa belongs to the sacred realm of faith. Neither should be appropriated to legitimise an opaque political bargain. Garissa cannot credibly demand transparency from governors, parliamentarians, and county officials while exempting from scrutiny the very process through which those leaders are first elevated; we cannot condemn unaccountable power after an election while tolerating unaccountable power before it. The Constitution’s answer is unambiguous: sovereign power belongs to the people. Somali wisdom supplies an equally powerful warning: Hal xaaraan ahi nirig xalaal ah ma dhasho. If we want legitimate leaders, we must begin with legitimate processes. Abdullahi Abdi Email: abdulomar55@gmail.com ——– Abdullahi writes on Somali governance, political economy, and democratic institutions. A citizen possesses no constitutional right to win an election, but a qualified citizen holds political rights that cannot simply be displaced because an informal gathering believes another person should proceed unopposed. There is dignity even in electoral defeat: a candidate who receives twenty per cent of the vote has learned something real about his support, just as a candidate receiving seventy per cent has acquired demonstrable political legitimacy. The electorate, in either case, has spoken. By contrast, when five, fifteen, or fifty individuals negotiate a candidacy behind closed doors and subsequently announce that “the community has decided,” an obvious question arises: when, exactly, did the community vote? Reform the institution rather than destroy it Garissa need not choose between Somali tradition and constitutional democracy; that is a false dichotomy. Put simply: Somali consensus is not incompatible with democracy; unaccountable gatekeeping is. Elders remain indispensable repositories of social memory, mediation experience, and communal legitimacy, and their contribution to reconciliation and political dialogue should continue. But their role should be consultative rather than dispositive. If negotiated nominations are genuinely preferred, then democratise them. Create a transparent delegate system; publish the eligibility rules; establish an identifiable electoral college representing settlements and communities, with women, youth, professionals, persons with disabilities, religious scholars, and businesspeople among them. Set nomination criteria before candidates present themselves. Require disclosure of conflicts of interest. Use secret ballots where appropriate, publish results, and establish a mechanism for complaints and appeals. Then let candidates decide, freely, whether to participate. Such a system would not destroy Somali consensus politics; it would rescue it from the accusation of being a mechanism through which a few people appropriate the political agency of the many. And crucially, religious observance should remain exactly what it is: sacred. The Fātiḥa should unite believers before God, not become an instrument through which one candidacy acquires a moral sanctity denied to another. Garissa must decide who has the right to decide Ultimately, this controversy is not about elders, nor about one clan, one candidate, or one election. It concerns the location of political sovereignty. If sovereignty belongs to the people, then political processes must begin from that proposition rather than merely acknowledge it on election day. Elders can advise, mediate, and persuade. They can endorse, reconcile candidates after bitter contests, and bring to bear the wisdom accumulated through generations of Somali political experience. But they should not constitute an unelected electoral college whose decisions acquire binding political force through secrecy, social pressure, and religious solemnisation. The ballot belongs to the citizen. The Fātiḥa belongs to the sacred realm of faith. Neither should be appropriated to legitimise an opaque political bargain. Garissa cannot credibly demand transparency from governors, parliamentarians, and county officials while exempting from scrutiny the very process through which those leaders are first elevated; we cannot condemn unaccountable power after an election while tolerating unaccountable power before it. The Constitution’s answer is unambiguous: sovereign power belongs to the people. Somali wisdom supplies an equally powerful warning: Hal xaaraan ahi nirig xalaal ah ma dhasho. If we want legitimate leaders, we must begin with legitimate processes. items.title: UN Scales Back Somalia Operations as International Support Wanes
items.description: Mogadishu(WDN) — The United Nations has begun reducing personnel and preparing to dispose of part of its operational assets in Somalia, as the UN Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) faces growing financial pressures and uncertainty over the future of international security assistance. At least 10 civilian staff members working with the AU-UN communications team have reportedly been notified that their contracts will end on September 10, with further reductions expected. UNSOS is also preparing to dispose equipment that includes of vehicles, generators, medical equipment, computers, containers and other assets used to support international security operations in Somalia. The developments come as the United States has indicated that it will not continue financing UNSOS after the current mandate of the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) expires on December 31, 2026. The looming reduction in international logistical support raises difficult questions about Somalia’s ability to assume full responsibility for national security after years of substantial international assistance. The government of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has repeatedly emphasized the expansion and professionalization of Somalia’s security forces. On August 16, President Hassan reportedly graduated more than 3,000 newly trained soldiers at Xananbuure, declaring that Somalia was increasingly prepared to take greater responsibility for its own security. Yet the reduction of international support exposes a deeper challenge: building a larger security force is not the same as building a self-sustaining national security system. If AUSSOM remains deployed in parts of Somalia beyond the current transition period, questions remain over who will finance the logistics that UNSOS has provided—including transportation, medical support, supplies, equipment and other essential services. The UN drawdown therefore comes at a critical moment for Somalia. After years of international military, financial and logistical support, the country’s recovery strategy is increasingly being tested by whether its government can translate international assistance into durable national institutions capable of standing on their own. For critics of the Hassan administration, the developments are evidence of a broader failure to convert years of international backing into meaningful national recovery, institutional capacity and sustainable security. The withdrawal of external support could expose that weakness at precisely the moment Somalia is expected to assume greater responsibility for its own future. items.title: Muxuu yahay sharciga cusub ee uu ansixiyay BF Soomaaliya?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa xarunta golaha ku yeeshay Kalfadhiga 8-aad, kulankiisa 7-aad, waxaana shir-guddoominayey Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo uu wehliyo Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay ajandayaal dhowr ah oo ay ka mid yihiin ansixinta hindise-sharciyeedka wax-ka-beddelka qaybtiisa 6-aad ee Sharciga Iibka Qaranka iyo akhrinta labaad ee Hindise-sharciyeedka Dembiyada Kufsiga iyo Anshax-xumada Kale. Xildhibaanada Golaha ayaa ansixiyey hindise-sharciyeedka wax-ka-beddelka qaybtiisa 6-aad ee Sharciga Iibka Qaranka, iyadoo cod loo qaaday. Waxaa oggolaaday 136 Xildhibaan, lix Xildhibaan ayaa diiday, halka laba Xildhibaan ay ka aamuseen. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa ku dhawaaqay natiijada codbixinta, isagoo sheegay in hindise-sharciyeedka uu helay codka aqlabiyadda Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka. Dhinaca kale, Golaha Shacabka ayaa akhrinta labaad marsiiyey Hindise-sharciyeedka Dembiyada Kufsiga iyo Anshax-xumada Kale, kaas oo ay Xildhibaanadu dood adag ka yeesheen qodobbadiisa. Doodda Xildhibaanada ayaa socotay dhowr saacadood, waxaana si gaar ah looga hadlay qodobbada ku jira hindise-sharciyeedka iyo arrimaha la xiriira dembiyada kufsiga iyo anshax-xumada kale. Ugu dambeyn, Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sheegay in ka-doodista qodobbada Hindise-sharciyeedka Dembiyada Kufsiga iyo Anshax-xumada Kale ay sii socon doonto kulanka xiga. Waxa uu sidoo kale Xildhibaanada uga mahadceliyey gudashada waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah, isagoo faray Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Shacabka inuu mar kale xaadiriyo Xildhibaanada, si loo kala ogaado kuwa kulanka dhammeystay, kuwa yimid balse fasax la’aan ka baxay iyo kuwa fasaxa qaatay. items.title: Somaliland Education Minister Vows Action After Students Charged to Access Exam Results
items.description: Hargeisa (WDN) – Somaliland’s Minister of Education and Science, Prof. Ismaaciil Ducaale Yuusuf, has expressed disappointment over students being charged to access the results of this year’s national examinations, saying the fees overshadowed what should have been a moment of celebration. The minister said many students and parents were unable to access the online results after Telesom’s Aqoonmaal service reportedly required a payment of $0.40 to view individual examination results. “We are disappointed that, on a day when we should have been celebrating with our students, many parents and students were unable to access their examination results because of the charge,” the minister said. Prof. Ismaaciil pledged that the ministry would investigate the matter and hold accountable anyone responsible for imposing the fee. He said students should not have been required to pay simply to receive the results of examinations they had worked hard to complete. The minister also announced alternative arrangements to ensure that students can obtain their results without relying on Telesom’s paid service. Results have been made available through examination offices in Somaliland’s regions and districts, where students can check their scores directly. Schools have also been provided with the results. The controversy comes as thousands of Somaliland students receive their national examination results—a milestone that was expected to be marked with pride and celebration. Despite the dispute over the online access fee, the ministry’s alternative arrangements are intended to ensure that every student can receive the results they have earned without financial barriers standing between them and this important moment. items.title: How vaccine access is protecting children in Somaliland
items.description: For families in rural Somaliland, getting children vaccinated once meant long journeys and difficult choices. Now, improved vaccine storage at a community health facility is bringing lifesaving immunizations closer to home, strengthening local healthcare, and helping communities respond when outbreaks occur. For years, every time one of her children needed a vaccination, Fatima faced a difficult choice. “I had to leave my livestock and spend most of the day traveling,” she says. The local clinic in Ismael Hussein, a rural community in Somaliland’s Burao District, lacked reliable refrigeration. Most routine vaccines need to be kept between 36°F and 46°F. If they become too hot (or, for some vaccines, too cold), they can become less effective. Reliable refrigeration helps ensure children receive vaccines that have been stored safely. This meant that Fatima and others like her were forced to travel to a facility with reliable refrigeration if they wanted to get their children vaccinated. The nearest facility was more than 20 miles away — a long, arduous journey taken on foot both ways. Like many families in her community, Fatima depends on livestock to support her household. Time spent traveling meant less time caring for her animals and her three children. Long journeys, harsh weather, and uncertainty made every visit difficult, especially as ongoing conflict increased the risk of violence for women and girls. Why vaccine access matters in Somaliland The health clinic in Ismael Hussein is a central hub for the community, but previously lacked the facilities needed to store and distribute vaccines safely. Across Somaliland, many families in remote communities face similar barriers. Long distances, limited infrastructure, and shortages of essential medical supplies make healthcare difficult to access. Too often, children miss routine vaccinations, leaving them at risk of preventable diseases. “When children miss routine vaccinations, diseases that can be prevented through vaccination spread more easily, putting lives and communities at risk,” says Dr. Abdikadir Ore, CARE Somalia’s senior health and nutrition advisor. For decades, routine immunization coverage in Somalia was below 50 percent, meaning that fewer than half of Somalians were protected against a wide variety of preventable illnesses. Ongoing conflict, displacement, lack of access to vaccines, and disrupted healthcare infrastructure had led to Somalia having some of the lowest vaccination rates in the world . In 2019, more than 1.5 million Somalian children under the age of five had never received any vaccination at all. The consequences have been significant. By mid-June 2026, Somaliland’s Ministry of Health had recorded more than 1,600 cases of measles , a highly contagious, vaccine-preventable disease caused by a virus. At least eight people have died from the outbreak so far, underscoring the importance of timely access to routine immunization. A major vaccination initiative called “the Big Catch-Up” was launched in 2022 by the Federal Ministry of Health and Human Services in collaboration with UNICEF and WHO. By July 2025, the initiative helped support a 28 percent increase in fully vaccinated Somalian children. A clinic ready to protect children While at the clinic, Fatima’s children didn’t just get vaccinated. They also received a nutrition assessment and basic checkups to make sure they’re growing strong. Today, Fatima only needs to walk about half a mile to vaccinate her child. “Now the vaccine is here, the nurse is ready, and I can return home the same day,” she says with a smile. That change became possible when CARE International, Luxembourg Aid & Development, and the Somaliland Ministry of Health came together to support the Ismael Hussein Health Facility with new refrigerators and cold-chain equipment. The robust blue refrigerator provide regular immunization services close to home for members of their community. Powered by solar energy, the specialized unit can hold about 70 liters of vaccines and has separate storage space for ice packs. An external digital display lets health workers monitor the system, ensuring everything stays safely preserved and ready for use. Health workers at the clinic have also received training to strengthen vaccine management and improve their ability to respond quickly to disease outbreaks. The improvements proved especially valuable during the recent measles outbreak in Burao. “Before the vaccine storage system was restored, our ability to provide vaccination services was limited,” says Xamda, who oversees services at the Ismael Hussein Health Facility. “Having safe and effective vaccines available at the clinic meant we could protect children immediately and help stop the disease from spreading further. This investment has strengthened both our routine vaccination services and our ability to respond during emergencies.” Stronger health services, healthier communities The solar-powered refrigerator is small enough to fit into a corner of the clinic, but it has made a huge difference to the community. Between May and July 2026, the facility administered more than 2,600 vaccine doses, including 1,395 measles vaccinations. Other routine immunizations now available include vaccinations against All of those vaccinations are made possible thanks to the blue box that now sits on a raised wooden platform inside the clinic. “Families now trust that vaccines will be available when they come to the clinic,” Xamda says. When families come in to get their children vaccinated, health workers make notes in the clinic’s vaccine register, which helps them monitor community vaccination status and compliance in line with the suggested immunization schedule in Somaliland. It also makes it easier for them to remind families when to come back for booster shots and other scheduled vaccines. “As a result,” Xamda adds, “more parents are returning for follow-up vaccinations, ensuring their children receive full protection and helping keep the wider community safe.” For Fatima, the impact is both practical and personal. Sitting inside the health facility beside the refrigerator that now stores lifesaving vaccines, she cradles her youngest child while other families arrive for their appointments. Seeing neighbors and friends accessing healthcare close to home brings her a sense of relief that once seemed out of reach “When my children need vaccinations, I know I can get them nearby,” she says. “I no longer have to choose between caring for my children and caring for my animals. It has brought us peace of mind and a healthier future for our children.” Looking beyond the next outbreak Families line up at the health clinic for checkups, vaccinations, nutrition assessment and support, and other care. The benefits extend beyond routine immunization. When measles cases appeared in Burao, the health facility was ready. Vaccine doses were available, trained health workers responded quickly, and outreach activities helped protect children before the outbreak spread further. “The response showed what is possible when local health facilities have the resources they need,” says Nimco, a health worker at the facility. “Vaccines are now closer to the community, and families are better protected against future outbreaks.” For families in Ismael Hussein, the restored vaccine storage system represents much more than new equipment. It means children can receive lifesaving vaccinations close to home, parents no longer have to choose between protecting their livelihoods and protecting their children’s health, and communities are better prepared to respond when disease outbreaks occur. “This project is about much more than refrigerators and vaccines,” says Ummy Dubow, CARE Somalia Country Director. “It is about ensuring that children in remote communities have the same opportunity to grow up healthy as any other child. By strengthening local health services and bringing care closer to families, we are helping communities build a healthier and more resilient future.” Care

items.title: UN Winds Down Prison Support in Somalia Amid Deepening Financial Crisis
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — The United Nations has reportedly ended its longstanding support to Somalia’s prisons, citing a severe funding shortfall that has left the organization struggling to sustain its operations in the country. According to a statement from the UN office in Somalia, financial assistance previously provided to Somali prisons has been discontinued after the organization was informed that expected contributions from wealthy donor countries were no longer available. The UN office is also preparing for a broader operational wind-down, including further staff reductions and the eventual closure of parts of its operations in Somalia. Some employees have already been notified that their contracts will end and that salaries will not be available beyond September 2026, raising fresh concerns about the future of UN-supported programs in the country. The development comes at a particularly difficult moment for Somalia, where prisons and other public institutions remain heavily dependent on international assistance. The withdrawal of support represents more than a budgetary setback. It is a stark reminder of Somalia’s continuing dependence on external funding and the growing strain on the international system that has supported the country for years. For a nation still struggling to rebuild its institutions and establish sustainable security and governance, the prospect of shrinking international assistance carries a troubling message: the lifeline on which many critical state services have depended is beginning to disappear. items.title: Xogta kulan maanta ka dhacay Villa Somalia oo madaxweyne Xasan Shekeh uu la yeeshay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaranka, Dr. Maryan Qaasim Axmed. Guddoomiyaha ayaa Madaxweynaha warbixin ka siisay halka uu marayo dhismaha iyo hawlgelinta guddiga, waxqabadkii lixdii bilood ee la soo dhaafay iyo dadaallada lagu dhisayo hay’ad qaran oo madax-bannaan, hufan, isla markaana lagu kalsoonaan karo. Kulanka waxaa sidoo kale looga hadlay caqabadaha horyaalla Guddiga, xoojinta wada-shaqaynta hay’adaha dowladda, iyo sidii loo heli lahaa taageerada lagama maarmaanka u ah in Guddigu si madax-bannaan oo wax-ku-ool ah u guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Guddoomiye Maryan ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ilaalinta iyo horumarinta xuquuqda aadanaha, xoojinta isla-xisaabtanka iyo ku dhaqanka sharciga iyo dhismaha hay’ado qaran oo waara oo ilaaliya xuquuqda iyo karaamada shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Isla maanta, Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaranka, Dr. Maryan Qaasim Axmed ayaa la kulantay Wasiirka Qoyska iyo Xuquuqul Insaanka, Marwo Khadiijo Maxamed Al-Maqsuumi. Kulanka Guddoomiyaha iyo Wasiirka oo ahaa is-xog-wareysi ayaa waxay uga wada-hadleen sidii loo horumarin lahaa, loona xoojin lahaa ilaalinta iyo dhowrista xuquuqul insaanka Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada-hadlay waajibaadka iyo shaqooyinka horyaalla hay’adahooda iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa wada-shaqeynta iyo iskaashiga ku aaddan horumarinta xuquuqda aadanaha iyo ilaalinta xuquuqaha muwaadiniinta. Kulanka ayaa kusoo dhammaaday is-afgarad ku aaddan muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta labada dhinac, si loo sii horumariyo ilaalinta iyo dhowrista xuquuqul insaanka Soomaaliya. items.title: Gaalkacyo: Shir Amni oo Looga Hadlay Khilaafka Beelaha
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Raxanreeb Online): Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Mudug, G/sare Maxamuud Muuse Bille Fardafuul, ayaa maanta ka qeyb galay shir amni oo uu shir-guddoominayay Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidanka Daraawiishta/Difaaca Puntland, Gen. Aadan Cabdi Xaashi. Shirka oo lagu qabtay Hoolka Shirarka Taliska Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Mudug ayaa waxaa ka qeyb galay madaxda heer gobol iyo heer degmo ee Puntland iyo Galmudug, Hoggaanka CID-da Puntland, G/sare Maxamuud C/Xakiin, Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Galmudug G/sare Cali Muuse, taliyayaasha ciidanka isku-dhafka ah ee Gobolka Mudug iyo saraakiil kale oo ka tirsan laamaha amniga. Kulanka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray xaaladda amni ee Gaalkacyo, gaar ahaan sidii xal looga gaari lahaa khilaafka u dhexeeya beelaha Cabdalle Surre (Dir) iyo Sheekhaal, kaas oo dhawaan iska horimaad ku dhexmaray xaafadda Hormar ee magaalada. Shirka waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb galay khubaro amni oo heer Puntland iyo heer gobol ah, iyo masuuliyiin ka tirsan dhinacyada amniga, maamulka gobolka iyo degmada ee Galmudug. Kulanka ayaa kusoo dhammaaday jawi xasiloon, iyadoo mas’uuliyiintu muujiyeen rajo ah in dadaallada socda ay horseedi doonaan xal waara oo lagu soo celiyo nabadda iyo wada-noolaanshaha labada beelood. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in xal kasta lagu saleeyo sharciga, kala dambeynta iyo nidaamka dowladnimada, si looga hortago soo noqoshada colaadaha iyo khilaafaadka amni ee magaalada. items.description: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa shaacisay natiijada imtixaanka shahaadiga fasalka 8aad ee sanad-dusgsiyeedka 2025/2026. Sida lagu sheegay xogta rasmiga ah ee natiijada, imtixaanka waxaa u fariistay 18,103 arday, kuwaas oo isugu jiray wiilal iyo gabdho. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in 1,685 arday ay ka baaqdeen imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee fasalka 8aad ee sanad-dusgsiyeedka 2025/2026. items.title: 6 Milyan oo Soomaali ah oo Wajahaya Gaajo Ba’an, WFP oo Digniin Soo Saartay
items.description: Iyadoo Soomaaliya ay wajahayo abaar sii xoogeysanaysa iyo xaalad cunto-yari oo saameysay malaayiin qof, Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Soomaaliya Saalax Axmed Jaamac iyo Wasiirka Boqortooyada Midowday u qaabilsan Horumarinta iyo Afrika, Kirsty McNeill, ayaa booqday bakhaar ay hay’adda WFP ku leedahay magaalada Muqdisho. Labada mas’uul ayaa halkaasi lagu tusay raashin iyo agab kale oo gargaar ah oo loogu talagalay qoysaska ay abaartu saameysay, waxaana sidoo kale lagu warbixiyay nidaamka WFP u adeegsato diiwaangelinta iyo xaqiijinta dadka ka faa’iideysanaya gargaarka. Nidaamka ayaa qof kasta oo gargaar qaadanaya looga diiwaangelinayaa xogtiisa biometric-ga, kadibna waxaa la siinayaa kaar la xaqiijiyay oo ay aqoonsan yihiin hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay ee ka qeybgalaya nidaamka. Tallaabadan ayaa looga gol leeyahay in la kordhiyo isla-xisaabtanka iyo in laga hortago in hal qof uu gargaar isku mid ah ka helo hay’ado kala duwan. Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Saalax Axmed Jaamac ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah goobaha sida weyn ay abaartu u saameysay ay yihiin deegaano nabdoon, isaga oo xusay in amni-darradu aysan ahayn sababta ugu weyn ee xaaladda halkaasi ka jirta. Waxa uu dhibaatada ku sababeeyay isbeddello cimilo iyo abaaro isdaba joog ah oo muddo dhowr xilli ah socday, kuwaas oo wiiqay awoodda qoysaska iyo bulshooyinka ay ugu soo kaban lahaayeen dhibaatooyinka. Sidoo kale, Saalax Axmed Jaamac ayaa sheegay in dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay bisha soo socota si rasmi ah u daahfuri doonto mashruuca kaydinta raashinka ee Jowhar, kaas oo qayb ka ah qorshe lagu xoojinayo awoodda dalka ee kaydinta iyo maaraynta raashinka iyo sahayda bani’aadannimo. Booqashada wasiirka UK ayaa ahayd tii ugu horreysay oo ay Soomaaliya ku timaaddo tan iyo markii ay xilka qabatay. Dowladda UK ayaa sheegtay in booqashadeeda ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu qiimeynayo sida gargaarka bani’aadannimo uu u gaarayo dadka ay saameeyeen abaarta iyo cunto-yaridu. WFP ayaa sheegtay in ku dhawaad 6 milyan oo qof, oo u dhiganta qiyaastii saddex meelood meel dadka Soomaaliya, ay hadda wajahayaaan heerar halis ah oo gaajo ah ama ka sii daran. Ku dhawaad 2 milyan oo qof ayaa la sheegay inay ku jiraan xaalad cunto-yari oo degdeg ah. Dhanka carruurta, Soomaaliya waxay sidoo kale wajahaysaa mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka nafaqo-darrada ugu daran dunida. Qiyaastii 1.88 milyan oo carruur ah oo da’doodu ka yar tahay shan sano ayaa la filayaa inay la kulmaan nafaqo-darro ba’an inta lagu jiro sannadka 2026, halka ku dhawaad 493,000 carruur ah ay u baahan doonaan daaweyn nafaqo-darro daran. Xaaladda waxaa sii adkeeyay abaaro soo noqnoqday, barakac, sare u kaca qiimaha cuntada iyo hoos u dhac ku yimid dhaqaalaha loo heli jiray gargaarka bani’aadannimo. WFP ayaa sheegtay in dhaqaalaha ay hadda haysato uu u saamaxayo inay caawiso kaliya qiyaastii hal qof 10-kii qof ee u baahan taageerada, iyadoo hay’addu u baahan tahay 193.8 milyan oo dollar si ay u sii waddo gargaarka naf-badbaadinta ah illaa Janaayo 2027. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale ka digtay in qoysaska ay abaartu hore u wiiqday ay wajihi karaan dhibaatooyin kale bilaha soo socda, iyadoo la filayo xaalado qalalan oo sii socda illaa Oktoobar, kadibna ay kordhi karto khatarta fatahaadaha xilliga Deyrta ee u dhexeeya Oktoobar iyo Diseembar. WFP ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya ka bilowday Qorshaheeda Istaraatiijiga ah ee 2026–2030, kaas oo isku xiraya gargaarka degdegga ah ee cuntada iyo nafaqada iyo qorshayaal muddo dheer ah oo lagu xoojinayo adkeysiga bulshada, isku-filnaanshaha iyo nidaamyada dowladda.

Qiyaastii 1.88 milyan oo carruur ah oo da’doodu ka yar tahay shan sano ayaa la filayaa inay la kulmaan nafaqo-darro ba’an inta lagu jiro sannadka 2026, halka ku dhawaad 493,000 carruur ah ay u baahan doonaan daaweyn nafaqo-darro daran. Xaaladda waxaa sii adkeeyay abaaro soo noqnoqday, barakac, sare u kaca qiimaha cuntada iyo hoos u dhac ku yimid dhaqaalaha loo heli jiray gargaarka bani’aadannimo. WFP ayaa sheegtay in dhaqaalaha ay hadda haysato uu u saamaxayo inay caawiso kaliya qiyaastii hal qof 10-kii qof ee u baahan taageerada, iyadoo hay’addu u baahan tahay 193.8 milyan oo dollar si ay u sii waddo gargaarka naf-badbaadinta ah illaa Janaayo 2027. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale ka digtay in qoysaska ay abaartu hore u wiiqday ay wajihi karaan dhibaatooyin kale bilaha soo socda, iyadoo la filayo xaalado qalalan oo sii socda illaa Oktoobar, kadibna ay kordhi karto khatarta fatahaadaha xilliga Deyrta ee u dhexeeya Oktoobar iyo Diseembar. WFP ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya ka bilowday Qorshaheeda Istaraatiijiga ah ee 2026–2030, kaas oo isku xiraya gargaarka degdegga ah ee cuntada iyo nafaqada iyo qorshayaal muddo dheer ah oo lagu xoojinayo adkeysiga bulshada, isku-filnaanshaha iyo nidaamyada dowladda.

items.title: Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo maanta u ambabaxay dalka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta safar shaqo ugu ambabaxay dalka Qatar, kadib casuumaad rasmi ah oo uu ka helay dowladda Qatar. Booqashada Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ku qotonta xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Qatar, iyadoo labada dal ay leeyihiin xiriir dhow oo dhinacyo badan taabanaya. Inta uu ku sugan yahay dalka Qatar, Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza ayaa kulamo la qaadan doona madaxda ugu sarreysa dowladda Qatar, isaga oo kala hadli doona arrimo ay labada dhinac daneynayaan. Wada-hadallada ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saari doonaa xoojinta iskaashiga dhaqaale, maalgashiga iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ah qorshayaasha iskaashiga labada dal. Sidoo kale, booqashada ayaa lagu wadaa in looga hadlo fursadaha cusub ee lagu ballaarin karo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Qatar, gaar ahaan dhinacyada horumarinta, maalgashiga iyo xiriirka labada dowladood. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii dambe waday dadaallo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka, iyadoo Qatar ay ka mid tahay dalalka sida dhow ula shaqeeya Soomaaliya. Safarka Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza ee Qatar ayaa sidaas darteed qeyb ka ah dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee lagu sii xoojinayo xiriirrada istiraatiijiga ah, iyadoo la filayo in kulamada uu halkaasi ku yeelan doono ay kasoo baxaan is-afgaradyo iyo iskaashi cusub. items.title: Maamule lagu afduubtay magaalada Beledweyne
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Beledweyne ee xarunta gobolka Hiiraan ayaa maanta lagu afduubtay maamulaha xarun lagu tababaro macallimiinta, iyadoo ilaa hadda aan si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin cidda ka dambeysay dhacdada. Qofka la afduubtay ayaa lagu magacaabaa Xasan Cali Cabdikariin oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Xasan Good, waxaana koox aan weli la aqoonsan ay ka kaxeysatay gudaha magaalada Beledweyne. Afduubka ayaa dhaliyay hadal-heyn xooggan oo ka dhex taagan bulshada magaalada, iyadoo aan weli la ogeyn cidda fulisay, sababta ka dambeysa iyo goobta loo kaxeeyay Xasan Cali Cabdikariin. Ilo kala duwan ayaa sheegay in dadaallo lagu raadinayo halka uu ku sugan yahay maamulaha la afduubtay ay socdaan, balse illaa hadda ma jirto cid si rasmi ah u sheegatay mas’uuliyadda dhacdada. Afduubyada ka dhaca gobolka Hiiraan ayaa mararka qaar lala xiriiriyaa khilaafaadyo iyo isqab-qabsiyo beeleed, hase yeeshee weli lama xaqiijin in dhacdadan cusub ay xiriir la leedahay arrimo noocaas ah ama kiisas hore uga dhacay Beledweyne. Illaa hadda ma jiro wax war ah oo kasoo baxay hay’adaha amniga magaalada Beledweyne, maamulka gobolka Hiiraan iyo dowlad-goboleedka HirShabeelle oo ku saabsan afduubka iyo cidda loo maleynayo inay ka dambeyso. Si kastaba, dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli bulshada Beledweyne ay walaac ka muujinayaan xaaladda amni ee magaalada, iyadoo la filayo in hay’adaha amnigu ay sii wadaan baaritaanka iyo dadaallada lagu raadinayo Xasan Cali Cabdikariin. The post Maamule lagu afduubtay magaalada Beledweyne appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: U.S. rescuers assist Colombia after earthquake
items.description: U.S. rescuers assist Colombia after earthquake By ShareAmerica   On the heels of saving lives in the June Venezuelan earthquakes, U.S. first responders jumped into action after the August 10 earthquake in Colombia, once again showing American resolve in response to tragedy. Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) technical advisers from the Fairfax County and Los Angeles County fire and rescue departments deployed to support Colombian USAR teams in and around the most affected cities of Cali and Pereira. The 7.4 magnitude earthquake killed more than 300 people, toppled buildings and destroyed homes across a large swath of western Colombia. The State Department’s USAR teams contributed to over 365 lives saved by assessing the stability of affected buildings and critical infrastructure, ensuring coordination among international and national USAR teams and supporting the Colombian-led operations. Members of the L.A. County Fire Department’s urban search and rescue team (USA-02) survey damage in Cali, Colombia. (State Dept.) The teams deployed as part of a U.S. Department of State Disaster Assistance Response Team (DART) and have trained for years to meet International Search and Rescue Advisory Group standards. After the Venezuela earthquake in June, the Fairfax and Los Angeles teams worked in shifts for 140 hours straight, rescuing survivors alongside international teams. In response to the earthquake in Colombia, the United States has provided $26.5 million in food, water, basic hygiene, shelter and health assistance through relief organizations aiming to reach thousands of people, often in remote locations. The United States also partnered with Starlink to connect emergency responders and humanitarian aid groups to high-speed internet to facilitate delivery of assistance to hard-hit, isolated communities. The DART also collaborated with the Department of War to deliver 220,000 pounds of supplies, including drinking water, water storage containers and basic hygiene items like soap. The State Department pre-positions the supplies at a warehouse in Miami to quickly respond to disasters in the hemisphere. U.S. Air Force airmen unload supplies in Bogota, Colombia, August 15 to assist Colombia’s earthquake response. (U.S. Air Force/Staff Sergeant Christopher Bermudez)
