items.title: Christian Wins Umrah Trip for Muslim Neighbour
items.description: In Egypt, a Christian man has given away a free Umrah trip he won in an online Quran competition. He handed the prize to his Muslim neighbour of more than twenty years. Mina entered the contest himself after watching his neighbour, known as Um Ali, try repeatedly to win the pilgrimage. He submitted the correct answer between 50 and 60 times to raise his chances. When he won, he passed the Umrah trip directly to her instead of keeping it for himself. The gesture has drawn attention across Egyptian social media as a rare example of interfaith solidarity. Christian-Muslim relations in Egypt are often framed around tension or coexistence in the abstract. This story offers a concrete, personal example instead. That is part of why it has resonated so widely. Neighbours for Two Decades Mina and Um Ali have lived next door to each other for over 20 years. He describes her as his older sister. The term reflects the closeness built over two decades of daily life in the same neighbourhood. Um Ali had entered the Quran competition multiple times herself, hoping to win the Umrah trip. However, she had not succeeded. Mina noticed her repeated attempts and decided to try on her behalf, despite not sharing her faith. How Mina Won the Umrah Trip The competition required participants to submit correct answers to Quran-based questions. Mina entered the same correct answer between 50 and 60 times to improve his odds of selection. As a result, he was declared the winner. He then informed Um Ali of the outcome and transferred the prize to her name. A Gift Rooted in Friendship Mina’s decision to hand over the prize surprised many who heard about it online. He did not request payment or public recognition in return. Meanwhile, Um Ali is now preparing to travel for Umrah, a pilgrimage she had wanted to complete for years. The trip includes travel to Mecca and Medina in Saudi Arabia. Exact travel dates have not been confirmed publicly. Interfaith Gestures in Egyptian Communities Egypt is home to the Middle East’s largest Christian population. Most Egyptian Christians belong to the Coptic Orthodox Church. Muslim-Christian relations in the country have included both periods of tension and everyday acts of neighbourliness like this one. This account has not been independently verified beyond reports circulating online. Neither Mina nor Um Ali has given a formal media interview at the time of publication. The post Christian Wins Umrah Trip for Muslim Neighbour first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: 20 Senator oo aan fasax rasmi ah haysan oo ka maqnaa kulankii Aqalka Sare
items.description: MUQDISHO — Xafiiska Hab-dhowrka Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo saaray liiska 20 Senator oo ka maqnaa kulankii 1-aad ee Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Aqalka Sare, kuwaas oo, sida lagu sheegay qoraalka, aan haysan fasax rasmi ah oo maqnaanshahooda sabab uga dhiga. Qoraalka Xafiiska Hab-dhowrka oo ku taariikhaysan 26-ka Agoosto 2026 ayaa lagu sheegay in xubnaha ka maqnaa kulanka ay ka mid yihiin Cabdi Axmed Dhuhulow (Dhagdheer), Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Maxamuud (Farole), Cabdisamad Yuusuf Maxamed (Abwaan), Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Cismaan, Daahir Ayaanle Saciid, Dr. Xuseen Maxamed Daahir, Farxaan Cali Maxamuud, Fartuun Cabdulqaadir Faarax Karama, Farxaan Cali Xuseen, Xasan Daahir Yare, Xasan Idow Muxumed (Kobac), Leyla Axmed Ismaaciil, Maryan Faarax Kahiye, Cabdi Cabdullaahi Xaashi (Goley), Prof. Cabdi Ismaaciil Samatar, Saciid Sayid Shirwac, Samiira Maxamuud Xaaji, Axmed Maxamed Saciid, Cabdihakim Macallin Axmed Maalin iyo Saalax Axmed Jaamac. Xafiiska Hab-dhowrka ayaa xusay in dhammaan 20-ka Senator ay kulanka ka maqnaayeen iyaga oo aan haysan fasax rasmi ah. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Aqalka Sare uu bilaabay Kalfadhiga 8-aad, iyadoo xaadirista iyo ka qaybgalka kulamada ay qayb muhiim ah ka yihiin gudashada waajibaadka xubnaha Aqalka Sare.

items.title: Aadan Lafta-gareen:  In walaalkey uu Al-Shabaab yahay caddeyn haloo keeno
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Aadan Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen), oo ay walaalo yihiin Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, ayaa markii ugu horreysay ka hadlay xiisadda siyaasadeed ee u dhexeysa walaalkiis iyo dowladda dhexe, taas oo isku bedashay gacan ka hadal. Aadan Lafta-gareen oo ah Xildhibaan ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ayaa maanta warbaahinta kula hadlay afaafka hore ee xarunta Baarlamaanka, waxaana wax laga weydiiyay xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed. Xildhibaanka ayaa walaalkiis Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ka difaacay eedeymaha la xiriira Al-Shabaabnimada ee loo jeediyay, kaddib weerarradii uu kusoo qaaday magaalada Baydhaba, oo ah xarunta KMG aha ee Koonfur Galbeed. “Ninkii walaalkey Al-Shabaab ku tilmaamay, isaga ayaa laga rabaa inuu caddeyn keeno,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Aadan Lafta-gareen. Sidoo kale, waxaa su’aal laga weydiiyay sida uu u arko hoggaanka cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed iyo haddii uu ku qanacsan yahay isbeddelkii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. “Horta qanaca aniga ma aha, shacabka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa laga rabaa inay jawaabta bixiyaan. Aniga xildhibaan ayaan ahay, go’aankaygana meel ma jiro,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Koonfur Galbeed ayaa xilligan wajahaysa xaalad siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo xasaasi ah, iyada oo dhinacyada ku loollamaya hoggaanka maamulka ay isu diyaarinayaan iska horimaadyo horleh xilli aan weli xal rasmi ah laga gaarin khilaafka ka dhashay tallaabooyinkii ay horay u qaaday Dowladda Federaalka. Xaaladdan ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo in khilaafka uu saameyn ku yeesho amniga iyo xasilloonida deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. items.title: Masuuliyiin maanta la dhaariyay Iyo Madaxweynaha oo ka hadlay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa maanta hortiisa lagu dhaariyey xubno ka mid ah Golaha Wasiirada ee Qaranka JSL iyo xubin ka tirsan Guddida Diwaangalinta iyo Ansixinta Asxaabta Qaranka kuwaas oo uu dhawaan Madaxweynaha JSL u magacaabay Xilalka Qaranka. Munaasibadda Dhaarta Dastuuriga ah ee Masuuliyiinta loo magacaabay Xilalka Qaranka, waxa Madaxweynaha ku wehelinayey Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee JSL ahna Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Dastuuriga ah, Mudane Aadan Xaaji Cali Axmed. items.title: Galmudug Electoral Commission Accepts Supreme Court Ruling Annulment Election Results
items.description: MOGADISHU— Galmudug’s disputed electoral commission has announced that it will accept and comply with a ruling by the Supreme Court of Somalia annulling the results of the regional election. In a statement issued on Wednesday, the commission said it respected the court’s judgment and would take the necessary steps to ensure its full implementation. The Supreme Court had earlier invalidated the election results and ordered a review of the electoral process. The ruling sparked renewed political debate and uncertainty over the future of elections in Galmudug. The commission’s decision to comply with the judgment could pave the way for a renewed electoral process. Further details are expected regarding the implementation of the court’s ruling and the next steps to be taken by the commission and other political stakeholders. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Dib-u-eegis ku Samaynaysa Heerarka Tayada Jaamacadaha Dalka
items.description: Guddiga Qaranka ee Tacliinta Sare ee Soomaaliya ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ka furay kulan wada-tashi ah oo soconaya laba maalmood, kaas oo ay la yeelanayaan madaxda jaamacadaha dalka, laguna lafo-gurayo siyaasadda, istaraatiijiyadda, iyo heerarka cusub ee lagu qiimayn doono tayada tacliinta sare ee dalka. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Qaranka ee Tacliinta Sare, Maxamuud Axmed Jimcaale, ayaa shaaciyay in la diyaariyay ilaa 200 oo qodob iyo halbeegyo adag oo lagu cabbiri doono tayada jaamacadaha. Nidaamkan cusub ayaa ka koobnaan doona is-qiimayn ay jaamacadaha qudhoodu samaynayaan, booqashooyin kormeer iyo xaqiijin ah oo guddigu ku tagayo xarumaha waxbarashada, iyo hubin qoto-dheer oo lagu samaynayo sax ahaanshaha shahaadooyinka iyo isu-dhiggooda tacliimeed. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, guddigu wali ma uusan shaacin xilliga rasmiga ah ee heerarkan cusubi ay dhaqan-gali doonaan, nooca tallaabooyinka sharciga ah ee laga qaadi doono jaamacadaha ku guuldarraysta inay buuxiyaan shuruudaha qiimaynta, iyo in natiijooyinka kama-dambaysta ah ee jaamacadaha loo soo bandhigi doono bulshada guud.

items.title: Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya oo Dardargelinaya Xeerka Maqaamka Dastuuriga ah ee Caasimadda Muqdisho
items.description: Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inuu ku guda-jiro qorshe lagu dardargelinayo doodaha iyo meelmarinta sharciga qeexaya maqaamka gaarka ah iyo xaqa dastuuriga ah ee Caasimadda Muqdisho, kaas oo muddo dheer horyaallay hay’adaha sharci-dejinta ee dalka. Xildhibaannada iyo guddiyada ku hawlan arrintan ayaa xoogga saaraya sidii xal waara loogu heli lahaa maqaamka siyaasadeed, maamul, iyo dhaqaale ee Gobolka Banaadir, iyadoo la eegayo xuquuqda ay dadka ku nool caasimaddu u leeyihiin inay helaan matalaad siyaasadeed oo dhammeystiran iyo gole deegaan oo si toos ah loo doorto. Dardargelinta sharcigan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay isa soo tarayeen baaqyada ka imaanaya qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada rayidka ah, siyaasiyiinta, iyo maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, kuwaas oo ku baaqayay in la soo afjaro xaaladda hubanti-la’aanta ah ee muddada dheer hortaagnayd in caasimaddu hesho xuquuq la mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada dalka. Meelmarinta xeerkan ayaa la filayaa inay waddada u xaarto habraac sharci oo sugan oo lagu maareeyo dakhliga, awood-qaybsiga, iyo amniga caasimadda, iyada oo Baarlamaankuna uu ku guda-jiro kalfadhiyadii ugu dambeeyay ee looga doodi lahaa shuruucda masiiriga ah ee dalka.

items.title: WHO iyo Midowga Afrika oo ku baaqay isku-filnaansho caafimaad oo Afrika yeelato
items.description: Hoggaamiyeyaasha Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) iyo Midowga Afrika (AU) ayaa ku baaqay in dalalka Afrika ay xoojiyaan isku-filnaanshahooda dhinaca caafimaadka, si qaaraddu uga gudubto ku-tiirsanaanta maalgelinta iyo adeegyada caafimaad ee dibadda. Baaqan ayaa ka soo baxay kulanka 76-aad ee Guddiga Gobolka Afrika ee WHO oo ka socda magaalada Addis Ababa ee Itoobiya, kaas oo ay ka qeybgalayaan wasiirrada caafimaadka Afrika iyo madaxda hay’adaha caafimaadka ee heer gobol iyo heer caalami. Agaasimaha Gobolka Afrika ee WHO, Maxamed Yacub Janabi, ayaa sheegay in Afrika ay sannad kasta ku bixiso ku dhawaad 7 bilyan oo doollar kharashaadka la xiriira bukaannada dibadda loogu diro daaweyn. Janabi ayaa tilmaamay in loo baahan yahay in la horumariyo xarumaha caafimaadka ee Afrika, lana isku xiro bukaannada Afrika iyo khubarada caafimaad ee qaaradda, si maalgelinta caafimaadku ugu sii nagaato gudaha Afrika. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf, ayaa isna sheegay in Afrika ay u baahan tahay inay kordhiso wax-soo-saarka gudaha, gaar ahaan tallaallada iyo dawooyinka, isla markaana ay maalgelin badan ku sameyso cilmi-baarista iyo hal-abuurka caafimaadka. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in isku-filnaanshaha caafimaadku uu yahay arrin muhiim u ah mustaqbalka qaaradda, iyadoo dalalka Afrika ay wajahaan cudurro dillaaca, isbeddelka cimilada iyo colaado saameeya adeegyada caafimaadka. Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo jawaab ka soo saaray go’aankii Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa Banaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa jawaab rasmi ah ka bixiyay go’aankii dhawaan kasoo baxay Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka oo laashay natiijadii kasoo baxday doorashooyinkii isku sidkanaa ee Dowlad-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee Galmudug. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Baashe Yuusuf Axmed ayaa 24-kii bishaan ku dhowaaqay in maxkamaddu ay laashay natiijada doorashooyinkaas, isaga oo shaaca ka qaaday in aan loo maamulin, loona qaban si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka dalka. “Maxkamaddu waxay go’aamisay in doorashooyinkii isku sidkanaa ee Golaha wakiilada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka ee 30-kii Luulyo ka dhacay Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug aan loo maamulin, loona qaban si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka dalka, sidaas darteedna ay tahay natiijadeeda mid aan sax ahayn oo waxba kama jiraan ah” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Baashe. Sidoo kale, Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka ayaa amartay Guddiga Doorashada Qaranka in uu dib ugu laabto doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Galmudug, isaga oo ku qabanayo waqtiga ugu dhow ee macquulka ah. Intaas kadib Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo maanta soo jawaabay ayaa soo dhaweeyay go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare, wuxuuna shaaciyay inuu aqbalay xukunka ay sooo saartay Maxkamaddu. Waxaa kale oo uu guddigu sheegay inuu dib ka shaacin doono xilliga la qabanayo doorashada ku celiska ah ee Galmudug, si loo saxo khaladaadkii horay u dhacay ee ay cabashada ka keeneen qaar kamid ah ururradii ka qayb-galay doorashooyinkaasi. Si kastaba, Go’aankan xasaasiga ah ee ay gaartay Maxkamadda Sare ayaa saameyn weyn ku yeeshay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Galmudug, waxaana ka dhalatay fal-celin aan caadi ahayn, maadaama uu xukunka soo baxay xilli adag oo uu dalku jiro xaalad kala guurka ah. items.title: Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug oo laga qabanayo doorasho ku celis ah
items.description: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa maanta xaqiijiyay inay doorasho ku celis ah ka qabanayaan deegaanada Galmudug, ka dib markii Maxkamadda Sare Dalka ay Isniintii diiday natiijada doorashadii qof iyo codka ee 30-kii bishii July laga qabtay deegaanada Galmudug. Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Garyaqaan Baashe Yuusuf Axmed ayaa waxba kama jiraan ku tilmaamay doorashada ka dhacday Galmudug, ka gadaal markii ay u caddaatay in habka loo maamulay doorashadaasi aanu waafaqsanayn sharciga, iyadoona uu garsoorku go’aamiyay in doorashada dib loogu noqdo. Guddiga Doorashooyinka ayaa aqbalay go’aanka ka soo baxay Maxamadda Sare ee lagu buriyay natiijada doorashada iyo in lagu laabto doorashada. “Guddigu waxa uu muddayn doonnaa xilliga la qabanayo doorashada ku celiska ah ee Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug.” Ayuu guddigu ku sheegay warsaxaafadeed. Ururada Siyaasadda ayaa mar kale ku tartami doona Doorashooyinka Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo tan Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Galmudug. Go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ayaa waxa uu ka dambeeyay, markii Urur Siyaasadeedka Towfiiq uu horgeeyay dacwad ah in doorashada lagaga shubtay.

items.title: UK backs Somalia’s path to security and political progress
items.description: The UK has reaffirmed its long-term commitment to Somalia during the first visit to the country by the minister for Development and Africa, Kirsty McNeill MP. During her visit, the minister met President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and discussed Somalia’s political and security priorities and the need for progress towards a credible and sustainable transition to Somali-led security. The minister encouraged leaders from across Somalia to engage in constructive dialogue that strengthens national unity, advances political progress and helps build consensus on Somalia’s future, underlining that continued progress on political dialogue and a security transition will be critical to maintaining international confidence and support. The minister reaffirmed that the UK remains a committed partner to Somalia, working alongside Somali leaders and communities in support of a more stable, secure and prosperous future for the Somali people. They also discussed Somalia’s humanitarian challenges and the importance of building greater resilience to future shocks. Last year, the UK reached more than 950,000 people with humanitarian and climate resilience support. Visiting a World Food Programme (WFP) warehouse in Mogadishu, the minister saw first-hand how UK support is reaching people affected by drought and food insecurity. She heard how the UK is working with the Federal Government of Somalia, UN and civil society partners to strengthen systems, deliver lifesaving support and help communities build their resilience, with a particular focus on women and girls. The minister also met leaders from the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) and the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), recognising the efforts and sacrifices of Somali Security Forces and African Union troops in supporting Somalia’s security objectives. The UK stands ready to provide further support for Somali forces through UNSOS, which plays a vital role in sustaining Somalia’s hard-won security gains against al-Shabaab. Progress on political dialogue between all Somali leaders and on plans for Somalia’s security transition will be important in confirming future support. Our existing support to UNSOS provides essential non-lethal assistance, including food rations, tents, medical supplies and casualty evacuation. The UK remains a committed partner to Somalia, working with the Federal Government of Somalia, the African Union, United Nations, civil society and other partners. Gov.uk

items.title: War ka soo baxay ICE oo dhaliyey shakiga qorshe halis oo ka dhan ah Ilhaan Cumar
items.description: Washington ( Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Kastamka Mareykanka ee ICE ayaa diiday inay bixiso dokumentiyo la xiriira eedeymo muddo dheer loo jeedinayey xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar, iyadoo sheegtay in shaacinta xogtaasi ay carqaladeyn karto “tallaabooyin sharci fulineed”. Jawaabta ICE ayaa dhalisay su’aalo cusub oo ku saabsan in ay jiraan baaritaanno ama tallaabooyin sharci oo socda ama la qorsheynayo, balse hay’addu ma aysan sheegin in Ilhaan Cumar lafteedu ay tahay qof si rasmi ah baaritaan loogu hayo. Codsiga xogta ayaa la xiriiray eedeymo ku saabsan guurkii Ilhaan Cumar ee 2009-kii ay la gashay Axmed Nuur Saciid Cilmi. Dadka eedeymaha u jeediya xildhibaanka ayaa muddo dheer ku doodaya in guurkaasi la xiriiray arrimo socdaal, iyagoo sidoo kale ku andacoonaya in Cilmi uu ahaa walaalkeed. Ilhaan Cumar ayaa marar badan beenisay eedeymahaas, mana jiro go’aan maxkamadeed ama caddeyn rasmi ah oo xaqiijisay in Axmed Nuur Saciid Cilmi uu yahay walaalkeed ama in guurka lagu galay khiyaano socdaal. Warbaahinta Just the News ayaa bishii Janaayo codsatay dokumentiyo kasta oo ICE ay ka hayso baaritaanno la xiriira eedeymahaas, iyadoo adeegsaneysa sharciga xorriyadda macluumaadka ee Mareykanka, Freedom of Information Act (FOIA). ICE ayaa jawaabteeda ku sheegtay inay gebi ahaanba haynayso xogta la codsaday, iyadoo adeegsaneysa qodobka 7(A) ee sharciga FOIA. “Shaacinta xog kasta oo jawaab u ah codsigan waqtigan waxaa si macquul ah loo filan karaa inay farageliso tallaabooyinka sharci fulineed,” ayay ICE ku tiri jawaabteeda. Qodobka ay ICE adeegsatay ayaa u oggolaanaya hay’adaha dowladda inay qariyaan xog loo ururiyey ujeeddooyin sharci fulineed haddii sii deynteedu waxyeello u geysan karto habraac socda ama si macquul ah loo filayo inuu dhaco. Tilmaamaha Wasaaradda Cadaaladda Mareykanka ayaa sheegaya in adeegsiga qodobka 7(A) uu u baahan yahay jiritaanka tallaabo sharci fulineed oo socota ama si dhab ah loo filayo, isla markaana hay’addu ay qiimeyso in shaacinta xogtu wax u dhimi karto tallaabadaas. Hase yeeshee, taas macnaheedu ma aha in Ilhaan Cumar lafteeda baaritaan dembiyeed lagu hayo. Tallaabada sharci ee ICE ay tilmaamayso waxay la xiriiri kartaa qof kale, dhinac kale oo kiiska ka mid ah ama arrin kale oo ku jirta dukumentiyada la codsaday. Armstrong Williams, oo falanqeeya siyaasadda Washington, ayaa sheegay in erayada ay ICE adeegsatay ay mudan yihiin in fiiro gaar ah loo yeesho, balse wuxuu ka digay in diidmada xogta loo fasirto caddeyn dembi. Markii la weydiiyay in jawaabta ICE ay muujin karto baaritaan federaal ah oo socda oo ku lug leh xubin ka tirsan Congress-ka, Williams wuxuu sheegay in dadka la xiriira arrimaha la baarayo ay tahay inay arrinta si dhab ah u qaataan, isaga oo ka gaabsaday inuu gaaro gunaanad cad. “Waxaan u maleynayaa in Ilhaan iyo qof kasta oo arrimahan la xiriira ay haystaan sabab weyn oo ay uga walaacaan,” ayuu yiri Williams. “Intaas ayaan ku ekaanayaa.” Arrintan ayaa dib u soo nooleysay muran sannado badan hareeyey taariikhda guurka Ilhaan Cumar, oo ah xildhibaan Dimoqraadi ah oo Minnesota ku matasha Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka. Ilhaan Cumar waxay si joogto ah u diidday sheegashada ah inay walaalkeed guursatay ama guurkaas loo sameeyey si loogu fududeeyo qof kale arrimaha socdaalka Mareykanka. Ilaa hadda, wax dacwad ah laguma soo oogin Ilhaan Cumar oo la xiriirta eedeymahan, mana jiraan caddeymo maxkamadeed oo lagu xaqiijiyey sheegashada ugu weyn ee ah in Cilmi uu ahaa walaalkeed. Diidmada ICE ee bixinta dokumentiyada ayaa sidaas darteed muhiimad gaar ah leh, laakiin kaligeed ma caddeyneyso eedeymaha loo jeediyey xildhibaanka, mana xaqiijineyso in dowladda federaalka Mareykanka ay baaritaan rasmi ah ku heyso Ilhaan Cumar. Markii la weydiiyay in jawaabta ICE ay muujin karto baaritaan federaal ah oo socda oo ku lug leh xubin ka tirsan Congress-ka, Williams wuxuu sheegay in dadka la xiriira arrimaha la baarayo ay tahay inay arrinta si dhab ah u qaataan, isaga oo ka gaabsaday inuu gaaro gunaanad cad. “Waxaan u maleynayaa in Ilhaan iyo qof kasta oo arrimahan la xiriira ay haystaan sabab weyn oo ay uga walaacaan,” ayuu yiri Williams. “Intaas ayaan ku ekaanayaa.” Arrintan ayaa dib u soo nooleysay muran sannado badan hareeyey taariikhda guurka Ilhaan Cumar, oo ah xildhibaan Dimoqraadi ah oo Minnesota ku matasha Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka. Ilhaan Cumar waxay si joogto ah u diidday sheegashada ah inay walaalkeed guursatay ama guurkaas loo sameeyey si loogu fududeeyo qof kale arrimaha socdaalka Mareykanka. Ilaa hadda, wax dacwad ah laguma soo oogin Ilhaan Cumar oo la xiriirta eedeymahan, mana jiraan caddeymo maxkamadeed oo lagu xaqiijiyey sheegashada ugu weyn ee ah in Cilmi uu ahaa walaalkeed. Diidmada ICE ee bixinta dokumentiyada ayaa sidaas darteed muhiimad gaar ah leh, laakiin kaligeed ma caddeyneyso eedeymaha loo jeediyey xildhibaanka, mana xaqiijineyso in dowladda federaalka Mareykanka ay baaritaan rasmi ah ku heyso Ilhaan Cumar. items.title: Somalia electoral commission accepts Galmudug election rerun
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s electoral commission said Wednesday it has accepted a Supreme Court ruling ordering a rerun of the Galmudug municipal and regional parliamentary elections held on July 30, after the court found irregularities in the vote that it said could not be corrected. The commission said it had reviewed the Supreme Court’s August 24 decision and accepted its obligation to comply with the ruling, the law and the principle of the supremacy of law, describing the legal process as the proper means of resolving electoral disputes arising from the results. The commission said it would announce a new timetable for the Galmudug elections at a later date. The decision follows an announcement by Somalia’s Supreme Court Chief Justice, Bashe Yusuf, who said this week that the Galmudug elections must be held again. The court had received complaints from some of the parties that participated in the elections, alleging fraud, irregularities and vote-rigging. After considering the complaints, the court found irregularities that it determined could not be corrected and consequently nullified the outcome, paving the way for a rerun. The ruling has triggered sharply divided reactions across Somali political circles. Some have alleged that the Supreme Court decision is part of an effort by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government to demonstrate to the international community that elections conducted and administered by the government are transparent and that electoral disputes can be addressed through the country’s legal institutions. Others have described the decision as a positive step toward strengthening the rule of law, with some comparing it to England’s Glorious Revolution as an example of a broader advance in the authority of law and institutions. The electoral commission has not yet announced a date for the new Galmudug vote. It said the timetable would be issued later. The rerun will follow the Supreme Court’s determination that the irregularities identified in the July 30 election could not be corrected, putting the conduct and administration of the next Galmudug vote under renewed attention as Somalia moves to implement the court’s decision. items.title: Daawo: Wasiir Fiqi oo si kulul ugu jawaabay Sheekh Shariif
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo maanta ka qayb-galay munaasabad ka dhacday magaalada Muqdisho ayaa si adag ugu jawaabay Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo dhawaan weeraray Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka. Shariif ayaa ku eedeeyay ciidamada inay si toos ah uga qayb-qaadanayaan howlaha barakicinta iyo burburinta guryaha shacabka magaalada Muqdisho, tallaabadaas oo uu ku tilmaamay mid laga xumaado oo aan loo dulqaadan karin. “Waxa soo kordhay waxaa weeyey Ciidanka Madaxtooyada oo si toos ah uga qayb-qaadanaya barakicinta, waxaa kale oo la arkaayay cagaf-cagafyadii Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo dhulka lagu duminaayo,” ayuu yiri Sheekh Shariif. Intaas kadib, waxaa hadalka Shariif ka jawaabay Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi, isagoo sheegay in siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ah ee dhaliilaya dowladda ay ku sugan yihiin Muqdisho halka deegaannadoodii ay gacanta ku hayaan Al-Shabaab. “Nimanka ciidankeenna daba dhigtay ee mucaaradka ah ee Jasiira fadhiya kuwaas waa ceebeysan yihiin tuulooyinkoodiina Al-Shabaab ayaa haysta,” ayuu ku jawaabay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Soomaaliya. Waxaa kale oo uu kusii daray “Ciidankeenna shaqo adag ayuu qabtay waa mahadsan yihiin iyaga horay u taagan difaaca dalka iyo dadka Soomaaliyeed”. Si kastaba, hadalka Fiqi ayaa markale bannaanka soo dhigay loollanka adag ee u dhexeeya dowladda iyo mucaaradka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay adeegsanayaan hadallo kulul oo la xiriira amniga, maamulka iyo xaaladda ay ku sugan yihiin. shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Hadalkan ayaa sidoo kale sii xoojinaya doodaha iyo muranka siyaasadeed ee ka dhashay howlaha burburinta ka socda magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo mucaaradka iyo dowladda ay si weyn ugu kala aragti duwan yihiin habka loo wajahayo arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka dalka. The post Daawo: Wasiir Fiqi oo si kulul ugu jawaabay Sheekh Shariif appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: DF oo xog cusub ka bixisay qorshaha lacagta cusub
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa qaaday tallaabooyin hor leh oo lagu doonayo in dib loogu soo celiyo shilinka Soomaaliga, kadib in ka badan 30 sano oo dhaqaalaha dalka uu si weyn ugu tiirsanaa dollarka Mareykanka. Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya (CBS) ayaa sheegay in diyaar-garowga dib loogu soo celinayo lacagta qaranka uu marayo heer sare, iyadoo la diyaarinayo qaab sharci iyo nidaam lacageed oo lagu xaqiijinayo in shilinka cusub yeesho kalsooni iyo xasillooni. Warbixin uu Bankiga Dhexe ee 2025 ayaa sheegtay in howlaha ugu muhiimsan ay ka mid yihiin isbeddello sharci oo saldhig u noqonaya nidaamka loo yaqaan Currency Board Arrangement (CBA) , wax-ka-beddelka sharciga Bankiga Dhexe oo horyaalla baarlamaanka iyo xeerar cusub oo ku saabsan maamulka kaydka lacagaha qalaad. “Mid ka mid ah mudnaantii ugu weynayd 2025 waxay ahayd sii wadista qorshaha dib loogu soo celinayo shilinka Soomaaliga iyadoo la hirgelinayo nidaamka Currency Board Arrangement,” ayuu Bankiga Dhexe ku yiri warbixintiisa. Nidaamka CBA ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu ilaaliyo xasilloonida lacagta cusub, iyadoo awoodda lagu soo saarayo shilinka lagu xiriirinayo kayd lacageed oo lagu taageero. Dowladda ayaa u aragta nidaamkan mid muhiim u ah dhisidda kalsoonida lacagta qaranka xilli dollarku weli si weyn uga taliyo dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya. Bankiga Dhexe ma uusan soo saarin waraaqo lacageed oo cusub tan iyo burburkii dowladda dhexe 1991-kii. Wixii markaas ka dambeeyey, dollarka Mareykanka ayaa si tartiib ah u noqday lacagta ugu weyn ee lagu kala iibsado badeecadaha, lagu kaydsado hantida, laguna qiimeeyo adeegyada dalka. Xitaa adeegyada lacagaha mobilada, oo maanta laf-dhabar u ah macaamilka maalinlaha ah ee Soomaaliya, ayaa inta badan ku shaqeeya dollar. Bankiga Dhexe ayaa sheegay in dib u soo celinta shilinka aysan kaliya ahayn arrin astaan qaran ah, balse ay tahay qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qorshaha lagu soo celinayo awoodda dowladda ee siyaasadda lacagta. “Dib u soo celinta shilinka Soomaaliga waxay weli tahay ujeeddo qaran oo muhiim ah oo lagu doonayo in lagu soo celiyo madax-bannaanida lacagta, lagu xoojiyo kalsoonida lacagta gudaha, laguna kordhiyo waxtarka siyaasadda lacagta muddada dhexe,” ayuu Bankigu sheegay. Lacagta cusub ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inay fududeyso macaamillada qiimaha yar, gaar ahaan dadka aan si buuxda u isticmaalin Bankiyada ama adeegyada lacagaha mobilada. Bankiga Dhexe wuxuu sheegay in arrintani ay gacan ka geysan karto kordhinta ka-qaybgalka nidaamka maaliyadeed ee dadka dakhligoodu hooseeyo iyo bulshooyinka aan helin adeegyada maaliyadeed ee rasmiga ah. Qorshuhu wuxuu sidoo kale ku xiran yahay helitaanka maalgelin ku filan. Bankiga Dhexe ayaa sheegay inuu xoojiyey dadaallada lagu raadinayo maalgelinta mashruuca beddelka lacagta, isla markaana uu wadatashiyo la yeeshay dowlad-goboleedyada si heshiis guud looga gaaro qaabka loo fulinayo. Dhanka sharciga, wax-ka-beddel lagu sameeyey sharciga Bankiga Dhexe ayaa loo gudbiyey baarlamaanka, iyadoo taageero farsamo laga helayo Sanduuqa Lacagta Adduunka ee IMF. Wax-ka-beddelladaas ayaa la doonayaa inay sharciyeeyaan nidaamka CBA, isla markaana xoojiyaan madax-bannaanida Bankiga Dhexe, hannaankiisa maamul, daahfurnaanta iyo isla-xisaabtanka. Bankiga ayaa sidoo kale diyaarinaya xeerarka lagu maamulayo sarifka lacagaha qalaad iyo nidaamka lagu soo saarayo warbixin toddobaadle ah oo muujineysa xaaladda maaliyadeed ee CBA, taas oo loogu talagalay in lagu ilaaliyo daahfurnaanta iyo kalsoonida nidaamka cusub. Haddii qorshuhu hirgalo, waxay noqon doontaa isku daygii ugu weynaa ee Soomaaliya ay dib ugu soo celineyso lacag qaran oo si buuxda loo maamulo tan iyo burburkii hay’adihii dowliga ahaa 1991-kii. Si kastaba, qorshuhu ma tilmaamayo in dollarka si degdeg ah meesha looga saarayo. Dowladda ayaa marka hore diiradda saaraysa sidii shilinka cusub loogu abuuri lahaa kalsooni, looguna heli lahaa nidaam sharci, kayd lacageed iyo hannaan maamul oo ka hortaga in lacagta cusub ay wajahdo dhibaatooyinkii burburiyey shilinkii hore. items.title: Gudiga doorashooyinka Galmudug oo aqbalay go’aankii maxkamadda
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (GMDQS) ayaa war-saxaafadeed ka soo saaray go’ankii ay dhawaan maxkamadda sare ku laashay doorashooyinkii Galmudug. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa u dhignaa sidatan: “saga oo fulinaya awoodi hiisa Dastuuriga ah, kuna dhaqmaya Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Sharciga Dhisidda Guddiga iyo Sharcigal Ururada iyo Xisbiyada, Habraacyada, Xeer-nidamiyeyaasha iyo tilmaamaha sharciga waxaa uu u taagan yahay mabaadi’da hirgelinta doorashooyin xor, xalaal ah, hufan oo ay muwaadiniinta si siman uga wada qeyb-galaan. Kadib marki uu helay GMDQS, nuqulka go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ee summaddiisu tahay SUM: MSF/DD/1/2026 iyo SUM: MSF/DD/BX/1/2026, kuna taariikhaysan 24 Agoosto 2026, ee ku saabsan natiijada doorashooyinkii isku- sidkanaa ee Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada ee Dowlad-Gobaleedka Galmudug ee qabsoomay 30 Luulyo 2026. Guddigu waxa uu soo saaray qodobadan hoos kuxusan: – 1. items.title: U diyaar garawga socdaalka madaxweynaha Somaliland ee dalka Maraykanka oo bilaabmay
items.description: Warbaahinta The Africa Report, ayaa shaacisay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay si rasmi ah u bilowday diyaar-garowga booqashadii ugu horreysay ee Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ku tago Maraykanka, kadib markii Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Maraykanku siisay fiisaha Toddobaadkan. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa la filayaa inuu Washington booqdo bisha September, iyadoo socdaalkiisa loo arko fursad muhiim ah oo Somaliland ku xoojin karto xidhiidhka ay la leedahay Maraykanka iyo taageerada ay ka raadinayso Washington. Sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta The Africa Report oo Wargeyskas DAWAN soo xigtay, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Dr. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro ayaa inta uu ku sugan yahay waddanka Maraykanka diiradda saari doona arrimo la xidhiidha iskaashiga dhinaca amniga gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo Bariga Dhexe, gaar ahaan amniga, ilaalinta maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo sugidda xasiloonida marinnada muhiimka ah ee isku xidha Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale lagu xusay in Madaxweyne Dr. Cabdiraxmaan Cirro inta uu ku sugan yahay Maraykanka, la filayo inuu ku soo bandhigo muhiimadda iyo doorka istaraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland ku leedahay gobolka iyo sugidda amniga marinnada muhiimka ah ee ganacsiga caalamiga ah oo ay khatar ku hayaan kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee ay taageerto Iiraan. Arrintan ayay Warbixintu ku tilmaanay inay qayb weyn ka qaadanayso dadaallada Somaliland ku doonayso inay ku xoojiso iskaashiga amni, dhaqaale iyo diblomaasiyadeed ee ay la leedahay Washington, gaar ahaan sidii Maraykanku u aqoonsan lahaa madaxbannaanideeda. The Africa Report waxay intaa ku dartay in Somaliland ay Mareykanka siinayo caawimo ku aaddan sugidda amniga marinnada maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah oo ay khatarta ku hayaan xulafada Xuutiyiinta ee ay taageerto Iiraan, isagoo rajeynaya inuu ugu dambeyntii helo aqoonsiga Mareykanka ee madaxbannaanida Somaliland. Waxaana lagu yidhi “Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Dr. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) wuxuu Mareykanka siinayaa caawimo ku aaddan sugidda marinnada maraakiibta Badda Cas ee ay khatarta ku hayaan xulafada Xuutiyiinta ee ay taageerto Iiraan, isagoo rajeynaya inuu ugu dambeyntii helo aqoonsiga Mareykanka ee madaxbannaanida Somaliland,” ayaa lagu yidhi warbixinta. Andres Loretdemola, ayaa martiqaad rasmi ah ka helay toddobaadkii hore Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Somaliland si uu u booqdo si loo dhiso Rugta Ganacsiga ee Mareykanka ee Somaliland. Dhanka kale, warbixinta ayaa lagu sheegay in ay socdaan qorshayaal ballaadhan oo lagu xoojinayo xidhiidhka dhaqaale ee Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, iyadoo Mr. Andres Loretdemola oo ah aasaasaha aasaasaha hay’adda la-talinta khatarta juqraafiyeed ee Washington ee Tatari Trends uu toddobaadkii hore martiqaad rasmi ah ka helay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Somaliland si uu u booqdo Hargeysa, isla markaana loo dhiso Rugta Ganacsiga Mareykanka ee gudasha Somaliland. Sida ay tilmaanay warbixintu, martiqaadkan ayaa la xidhiidha qorshe lagu dhisayo Rug Ganacsi oo Maraykan ah oo Somaliland ka hawlgasha, taas oo la filayo inay door ballaadhan ka qaadato kobcinta xidhiidhka ganacsi, maalgashi iyo iskaashi ballaadhan oo dhaqaale ee ka dhexeeya Somaliland iyo Maraykanka. Booqashada Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Dr. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Xukuumadda Somaliland ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo xidhiidhkeeda Washington, iyadoo si weyn diirrada u saaraysa inay isku darto iskaashiga amniga gobolka, fursadaha dhaqaale, maalgashi iyo ajandaha diblomaasiyadeed ee ku saabsan aqoonsiga Madax-bannaanida Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland.

items.title: Shirka isku xidhka magaalooyinka geeska Africa
items.description: Wasiirka Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Khadar Xuseen Cabdi, ayaa ka qayb galay furitaanka Shirka Saddexaad ee East Africa City Corridors Dialogue (EACC), kaas oo shalay si rasmi ah uga furmay magaalada Hargeysa, laguna gorfeeyay isku-xidhka magaalooyinka, horumarinta Kooridhoorrada iyo sidii fursadaha dhaqaale ee gobolka loogu beddeli lahaa horumar iyo barwaaqo wadaag ah. Wasiir Khadar Xuseen Cabdi oo hadal ka jeediyay madasha furitaanka ayaa si diirran u soo dhaweeyay wufuudda caalamiga ah ee ka soo qayb galay shirkan, kuwaas oo isugu jiray wasiirro, maayarro iyo wakiillada magaalooyinka ku teedsan Kooridhoorrada Somaliland iyo Itoobiya, masuuliyiinta sare ee dawladda, bah-wadaagta horumarinta, wakiillada ganacsatada gaarka loo leeyahay, jaamacadaha iyo bulshada rayidka ah. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in shirka oo halku-dhiggiisu yahay “From Connectivity to City Prosperity” uu muhiim u yahay sidii waddooyinka, dekedaha iyo xuduudaha loogu beddeli lahaa ganacsi, shaqo-abuur, maalgashi iyo fursado dhaqaale oo wax ku ool ah. Waxa uu tilmaamay in xilli amni-darro iyo caqabado kala duwan ay carqaladaynayaan ganacsiga caalamka, korna u qaadayaan kharashaadka gaadiidka iyo caymiska, ay Geeska Afrika muhiim u tahay inuu ka faa’iidaysto goobtiisa juqraafiyeed si uu u abuuro adkaysi dhaqaale, fursado cusub iyo barwaaqo ku dhisan wadajir. Wasiir Khadar Xuseen Cabdi ayaa sheegay in Kooridhoorka Berbera uu Somaliland u yahay mudnaan istiraatiiji ah, iyadoo xukuumaddu doonayso in ay si weyn u horumariso marinkan muhiimka ah, si kor loogu qaado kobaca dhaqaalaha gobolka oo tartan leh, kaas oo xoojinaya ganacsiga, soo jiishada maalgashiga, shaqo abuurka, isla markaana faa’iido u horseeda dalalka gobolka, magaalooyinka iyo bulshada Geeska Afrika. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Khadar Xuseen Cabdi waxa uu xusay in horumarinta Kooridhoorka Berbera ay u baahan tahay iskaashi xooggan oo u dhexeeya Somaliland iyo Itoobiya, gaar ahaan dib-u-bilaabista wada-hadallada farsamo ee heer dawladaha ee ku saabsan ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka. “Danaha dhaqaale ee aynu wadaagno waa in loo beddelaa heshiisyo wax-ku-ool ah,” ayuu yidhi Wasiirku, isaga oo tilmaamay in Somaliland ay Kooridhoorka u aragto fursad wadaag ah oo ay ka faa’iidaysan karaan ganacsatada labada dhinac. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in hadafku yahay in la horumariyo nidaam dhaqaale oo isku xidhan, kaas oo isku keena Dekedda Berbera, Aagga Dhaqaalaha Berbera, Kooridhoorka Berbera, magaalooyinka Somaliland iyo suuqyada Itoobiya. Waxa uu soo jeediyay in la sameeyo madal ganacsi oo isku xidha ganacsatada, shirkadaha gaadiidka, adeeg-bixiyeyaasha saadka, hawl-wadeennada dekedaha, hay’adaha maaliyadeed iyo maalgashadayaasha Somaliland iyo Itoobiya. Madashan, sida uu sheegay, waxay gacan ka geysan kartaa aqoonsiga caqabadaha jira, dhisidda iskaashiyo cusub iyo soo jeedinta xalal wax-ku-ool ah oo kor loogu qaadayo hufnaanta iyo tartanka Kooridhoorka. Dhanka kale, Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Somaliland ay muddo ka badan toban sano lahayd Guddiga Horumarinta Kooridhoorka Berbera, isaga oo sheegay in marka ay xaaladdu saamaxdo la qorshaynayo in loo gudbo dhismaha Maamulka Kooridhoorka Berbera, oo ay taageeraan xarumo xuduudeed oo adeegyo badan lagu bixiyo, nidaamyada dabagalka xamuulka iyo guddiyo hawlgal oo wadajir ah. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada ayaa sidoo kale uga mahadceliyay Imaaraadka Carabta iyo DP World maalgashiga ay ku sameeyeen Dekedda Berbera iyo guud ahaan Kooridhoorka. Waxa uu sheegay in magaalooyinka ku teedsan Kooridhoorku ay u baahan yihiin qorshayn magaalo oo istiraatiiji ah, kaabayaal ku filan iyo jawi u saamaxaya maalgashiga iyo koboca ganacsiga, si ay si buuxda uga faa’iidaystaan fursadaha dhaqaale ee ka dhalanaya horumarinta Kooridhoorka. Wasiir Khadar ayaa ka qaybgalayaasha ku dhiirrigeliyay inay doodaha shirka ku saleeyaan xalal wax-ku-ool ah, isla markaana si wadajir ah loo aqoonsado caqabadaha hortaagan Kooridhoorrada iyo tallaabooyinka looga gudbi karo. Waxa uu sheegay in Xukuumadda Somaliland ay hiigsanayso Kooridhoor isku xidha dalal, magaalooyin iyo bulshooyin, xoojiya xidhiidhka dadka iyo dadka, isla markaana ka qayb qaata xasilloonida iyo is-dhexgalka gobolka. Ugu dambayn, Wasiirka Madaxtooyadu waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyay in xilli isbeddello waaweyni ka socdaan Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika ay lagama maarmaan tahay in juqraafiyadda loo beddelo isku-xidhnaan, isku-xidhnaantana loo beddelo fursad dhaqaale, fursadda dhaqaale-na loo beddelo barwaaqo wadaag ah. Wasiir Khadar Xuseen Cabdi ayaa hadalkiisa ku soo gabagabeeyay isagoo si rasmi ah u iclaamiyay furitaanka Shirka Wadahadalka Kooridhoorrada Magaalooyinka Bariga Afrika (EACC).

Waxa uu soo jeediyay in la sameeyo madal ganacsi oo isku xidha ganacsatada, shirkadaha gaadiidka, adeeg-bixiyeyaasha saadka, hawl-wadeennada dekedaha, hay’adaha maaliyadeed iyo maalgashadayaasha Somaliland iyo Itoobiya. Madashan, sida uu sheegay, waxay gacan ka geysan kartaa aqoonsiga caqabadaha jira, dhisidda iskaashiyo cusub iyo soo jeedinta xalal wax-ku-ool ah oo kor loogu qaadayo hufnaanta iyo tartanka Kooridhoorka. Dhanka kale, Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Somaliland ay muddo ka badan toban sano lahayd Guddiga Horumarinta Kooridhoorka Berbera, isaga oo sheegay in marka ay xaaladdu saamaxdo la qorshaynayo in loo gudbo dhismaha Maamulka Kooridhoorka Berbera, oo ay taageeraan xarumo xuduudeed oo adeegyo badan lagu bixiyo, nidaamyada dabagalka xamuulka iyo guddiyo hawlgal oo wadajir ah. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada ayaa sidoo kale uga mahadceliyay Imaaraadka Carabta iyo DP World maalgashiga ay ku sameeyeen Dekedda Berbera iyo guud ahaan Kooridhoorka. Waxa uu sheegay in magaalooyinka ku teedsan Kooridhoorku ay u baahan yihiin qorshayn magaalo oo istiraatiiji ah, kaabayaal ku filan iyo jawi u saamaxaya maalgashiga iyo koboca ganacsiga, si ay si buuxda uga faa’iidaystaan fursadaha dhaqaale ee ka dhalanaya horumarinta Kooridhoorka. Wasiir Khadar ayaa ka qaybgalayaasha ku dhiirrigeliyay inay doodaha shirka ku saleeyaan xalal wax-ku-ool ah, isla markaana si wadajir ah loo aqoonsado caqabadaha hortaagan Kooridhoorrada iyo tallaabooyinka looga gudbi karo. Waxa uu sheegay in Xukuumadda Somaliland ay hiigsanayso Kooridhoor isku xidha dalal, magaalooyin iyo bulshooyin, xoojiya xidhiidhka dadka iyo dadka, isla markaana ka qayb qaata xasilloonida iyo is-dhexgalka gobolka. Ugu dambayn, Wasiirka Madaxtooyadu waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyay in xilli isbeddello waaweyni ka socdaan Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika ay lagama maarmaan tahay in juqraafiyadda loo beddelo isku-xidhnaan, isku-xidhnaantana loo beddelo fursad dhaqaale, fursadda dhaqaale-na loo beddelo barwaaqo wadaag ah. Wasiir Khadar Xuseen Cabdi ayaa hadalkiisa ku soo gabagabeeyay isagoo si rasmi ah u iclaamiyay furitaanka Shirka Wadahadalka Kooridhoorrada Magaalooyinka Bariga Afrika (EACC).

items.title: Xiddig Soomaali ah oo ka cayaaraya horyaalka Serie A, kadib markii ay soo iibsatay…
items.description: Roma (Caasimada Online) – Ciyaaryahanka da’da yar ee asal ahaan Soomaaliga ah Amar Fatah ayaa ku biiray kooxda Lecce ee ka ciyaarta horyaalka heerka koowaad ee Talyaaniga ee Serie A, isaga oo ka soo wareegay kooxda Faransiiska ee Troyes. Lecce ayaa 25-kii Agoosto 2026 dhammeystirtay heshiiska 22 jirkan, iyadoo lacagta ay kula wareegtay lagu sheegay 1.4 milyan oo euro. Amar Fatah ayaa kooxda cusub u saxiixay heshiis soconaya illaa 30-ka June 2029. Tallaabadan ayaa Fatah siinaysa fursad uu kaga ciyaaro mid ka mid ah shanta horyaal ee ugu waaweyn Yurub, kadib dhowr sano oo uu khibrad ka soo urursaday horyaallada Sweden, Belgium, Netherlands iyo Scotland. Fatah, oo ku dhashay magaalada Solna ee dalka Sweden, ayaa asal ahaan Soomaali ah, wuxuuna u ciyaaraa garabka bidix ee weerarka, inkasta oo uu yahay ciyaaryahan lugta midig ku wanaagsan. Waxaa uu kasoo baxay nidaamka da’yarta ee AIK, ka hor inta uusan bishii Agoosto 2022 ugu wareegin Troyes heshiis ku kacay 4.7 milyan oo euro. Hase yeeshee, fursadaha uu ka helay kooxda Faransiiska ayaa koobnaa, waxaana inta badan sannadihii uu Troyes ka tirsanaa lagu amaahiyay kooxo kale si uu waayo-aragnimo dheeraad ah u helo. Qeybtii labaad ee xilli-ciyaareedkii 2022-23 ayuu amaah ugu biiray kooxda Lommel SK, ka hor inta uusan dib ugu laaban Troyes. Xilli-ciyaareedkii 2024-25 waxaa loo diray kooxda Willem II ee Netherlands, halka sanadkii xigay uu amaah ku qaatay Dundee United ee Scotland. Fatah ayaa Troyes dib ugu laabtay dhammaadkii May 2026, balse wax ka yar saddex bilood kadib ayuu si rasmi ah uga tegay kooxda, isaga oo markan heshiis joogto ah ugu wareegay Lecce. Qiimaha suuqa ee ciyaaryahanka ayaa ka hor heshiiskan lagu qiyaasayay 800,000 oo euro, halka qiimihii ugu sarreeyay ee horay loo gaarsiiyay uu ahaa 1.5 milyan oo euro. Ku biiristiisa Lecce ayaa sidoo kale xiiso gaar ah u leh taageerayaasha kubadda cagta Soomaaliya, maadaama Fatah uu leeyahay dhalashada Sweden iyo Soomaaliya, isla markaana uu weli yahay ciyaaryahan da’yar oo horumar weyn sameyn kara. Fatah ayaa heerarka da’yarta u matalay Sweden, balse asalkiisa Soomaaliyeed ayaa ka dhigaya ciyaaryahan ay sidoo kale isha ku hayn karaan taageerayaasha xulka Soomaaliya marka la eego mustaqbalkiisa heerka caalamiga ah. Hadda waxa uu wajahayaa tartan cusub oo ka adag kuwii hore, iyadoo Serie A ay hoy u tahay qaar ka mid ah kooxaha iyo difaacyada ugu awoodda badan Yurub. Lecce ayaa rajaynaysa in xawaaraha, farsamada iyo awoodda Fatah ee garabka bidix ay kooxda siin doonaan doorasho weerar oo dheeraad ah xilli-ciyaareedka cusub. Heshiiska cusub ayaa sidoo kale u noqonaya Fatah fursad uu ku helo xasillooni kadib dhowr xilli oo xiriir ah oo uu amaah ugu kala wareegayay kooxo kala duwan, iyadoo mustaqbalkiisa ugu yaraan saddexda sano ee soo socda uu hadda yaallo Talyaaniga. The post Xiddig Soomaali ah oo ka cayaaraya horyaalka Serie A, kadib markii ay soo iibsatay… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Agaasimaha hay’adda CIA-da oo safar qarsoodi ah ku tegay dal aan laga fileyn
items.description: Moscow (Caasimada Online) – Agaasimaha Hay’adda Sirdoonka Mareykanka ee CIA, John Ratcliffe, ayaa Talaadadii booqasho lama filaan ah ku tegay magaalada Moscow, sida ay xaqiijiyeen saraakiil Mareykan ah, waana safarkiisii ugu horreeyay ee si rasmi ah loo ogaado inuu ku tago caasimadda Ruushka. Ujeeddada rasmiga ah ee safarka Ratcliffe ayaan markiiba la shaacin, balse wuxuu ku soo beegmay xilli Washington ay isku dayeyso inay xal u hesho dagaalka Ruushka iyo Ukraine, iyadoo sidoo kale ay socdaan dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo la xiriira dagaalka Iran. Booqashada ayaa si gaar ah isha loogu hayaa kadib markii sirdoonka Mareykanka uu helay xog muujineysa in Ruushku sameynayo diyaargarow horudhac ah oo la xiriira suurta-galnimada abaabul ciidan oo cusub oo ka dhaca Ukraine, isla markaana Moscow ay ka fikirayso tallaabooyin lagu tijaabin karo sida NATO uga falcelin karto cadaadis ama dhaqdhaqaaq ciidan oo cusub. Maxay tahay ujeedada? Falanqeeyayaal ayaa sheegay in Ratcliffe laga yaabo inuu Moscow u tegay inuu fariin toos ah gaarsiiyo Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin. Beth Sanner, oo hore u soo noqotay ku-xigeenka Agaasimaha Sirdoonka Qaranka Mareykanka ee dhinaca isku-duwidda howlaha, ayaa sheegtay in ujeeddadu noqon karto in Kremlin-ka loo caddeeyo in Washington ay la socoto qorshayaasha Moscow. “Waxay noqon kartaa in lagu yiraahdo, ‘Waan ognahay waxa aad ku fikiraysaan inaad sameysaan, waana inaad ka waantowdaan,’” ayay tiri Sanner. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in safarku la xiriiri karo dadaallada xabbad-joojinta Iran iyo suurta-galnimada in dhinac kale lagu soo daro wada-hadallada, iyadoo aan meesha laga saari karin in Ratcliffe uu kala hadlo Moscow taageerada Kremlin-ka ee Tehran, xilli Mareykanku kordhiyay cunaqabateynta uu saarayo Iran. Diyaarad nooca Boeing C-17 Globemaster ah ayaa baraha lagula socdo duulimaadyada lagu arkay iyadoo ka soo duushay Riga ee Latvia kuna degtay garoonka caalamiga ah ee Vnukovo ee Moscow. Garoonkaas ayaa muddo dheer loo adeegsaday mas’uuliyiinta sare ee ajnabiga ah ee booqda caasimadda Ruushka. Afhayeenka Kremlin-ka Dmitry Peskov ayaa wariyeyaasha u sheegay subaxnimadii Talaadada inuusan wax xog ah ka hayn diyaaradda ku degtay garoonka abbaaraha 10-ka subaxnimo waqtiga Moscow. Peskov wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay inaan toddobaadkan la qorsheyn wax kulan ah oo dhexmara Kremlin-ka iyo wakiillo ka socda maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump. Ratcliffe ayaa Moscow ku sugnaa qiyaastii afar saacadood ka hor inta uusan ka dhoofin magaalada. Hay’adda CIA-da ayaa ka gaabsatay inay faallo ka bixiso safarka, halka CBS News ay hore u baahisay war ku saabsan booqashada. Xiriirka Washington iyo Moscow Xiriirka Washington iyo Moscow ayaa weli lahaa marinno wada-xiriir oo shaqeynaya inkastoo labada dowladood ay si weyn ugu kala aragti duwan yihiin dagaalka Ukraine, taageerada Mareykanka ee Kyiv iyo cunaqabateynta lagu soo rogay Ruushka. Madaxweyne Trump ayaa hore Putin ugu qaabilay Alaska kulan diiradda lagu saarayay dagaalka Ukraine, halka maamulkiisu uu sidoo kale ku guuleystay sii deynta saddex qof oo Ruushku haystay. Safarka Ratcliffe ayaa sidoo kale xusuusinaya dhacdo dhacday bilo ka hor duullaankii Ruushka ee Ukraine. Agaasimihii hore ee CIA William Burns, oo mar soo noqday safiirka Mareykanka ee Ruushka, ayaa Moscow booqday bishii November 2021. Burns ayaa xilligaas Putin uga digay inuu weeraro Ukraine, isagoo soo bandhigay xog sirdoon oo Mareykanku ka helay qorshaha Moscow ee duullaan ballaaran. Ruushka ayaa Ukraine weeraray bishii February 2022. Ratcliffe, oo ka mid ah saraakiisha sida dhow ula shaqeeya Trump, ayaa noqonaya mas’uulkii ugu dambeeyay ee Mareykan ah ee Moscow booqda, kadib safarro dhowr ah oo uu halkaas ku tegay Steve Witkoff, oo ah ergayga madaxweynaha ee wada-hadallada nabadda Ruushka iyo Ukraine. Jared Kushner iyo Josh Gruenbaum ayaa sidoo kale Witkoff ku weheliyay mid ka mid ah safarradaas, iyagoo kulan la yeeshay Putin. Bishii March 2025, wax yar kadib markii Trump xilka la wareegay, Ratcliffe iyo madaxa Hay’adda Sirdoonka Dibadda ee Ruushka Sergei Naryshkin ayaa yeeshay wada-hadalkoodii ugu horreeyay ee telefoon. Labada mas’uul ayaa markaas ka wada hadlay iskaashi ku saabsan arrimo ay labada dhinac dan wadaag ka leeyihiin, waxayna isku raaceen inay sii wadaan xiriir joogto ah si loo yareeyo khatarta iska horimaad toos ah oo dhex mara labada quwadood. Kremlin-ka ayaa muhiimad gaar ah siinayay sii jiritaanka xiriirka u dhexeeya hay’adaha sirdoonka labada dal, xitaa markii xiriirka siyaasadeed ee Washington iyo Moscow uu aad u xumaaday. Rustam Churyakov, oo madax ka ah xarun cilmi-baaris sirdoon oo fadhigeedu yahay Moscow, ayaa sheegay in hay’adaha sirdoonku mararka qaar awoodaan inay si ka dabacsan siyaasiyiinta uga wada hadlaan arrimaha xasaasiga ah. “Mareykanku wuxuu Ukraine taageerayay tan iyo bilowgii dagaalka, marka laga eego aragtida dowladdeenna waa dhinac naga soo horjeeda, laakiin saraakiisha hay’adaha sirdoonka waxay si ka xor ah siyaasiyiinta uga wada hadli karaan arrimo badan,” ayuu yiri Churyakov. Marka la eego hab-maamuuska Ruushka, Naryshkin ayaa ah dhigga rasmiga ah ee Ratcliffe, waxaana la filayaa inuu door muhiim ah ku yeesho kulamada uu madaxa CIA-du Moscow ku yeelan karo. Haddii Ratcliffe uu la kulmay ama la kulmo Putin, Naryshkin ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu goob joog ka noqdo. Churyakov ayaa sheegay in arrimaha miiska u saaran Moscow iyo Washington aysan ku koobnayn Ukraine. “Arrimo badan ayaa ku ururay xiriirka Ruushka iyo Mareykanka, mana aha Ukraine oo keliya; waxaa jira Latin America, Iran iyo China,” ayuu yiri. Rustam Churyakov, oo madax ka ah xarun cilmi-baaris sirdoon oo fadhigeedu yahay Moscow, ayaa sheegay in hay’adaha sirdoonku mararka qaar awoodaan inay si ka dabacsan siyaasiyiinta uga wada hadlaan arrimaha xasaasiga ah. “Mareykanku wuxuu Ukraine taageerayay tan iyo bilowgii dagaalka, marka laga eego aragtida dowladdeenna waa dhinac naga soo horjeeda, laakiin saraakiisha hay’adaha sirdoonka waxay si ka xor ah siyaasiyiinta uga wada hadli karaan arrimo badan,” ayuu yiri Churyakov. Marka la eego hab-maamuuska Ruushka, Naryshkin ayaa ah dhigga rasmiga ah ee Ratcliffe, waxaana la filayaa inuu door muhiim ah ku yeesho kulamada uu madaxa CIA-du Moscow ku yeelan karo. Haddii Ratcliffe uu la kulmay ama la kulmo Putin, Naryshkin ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu goob joog ka noqdo. Churyakov ayaa sheegay in arrimaha miiska u saaran Moscow iyo Washington aysan ku koobnayn Ukraine. “Arrimo badan ayaa ku ururay xiriirka Ruushka iyo Mareykanka, mana aha Ukraine oo keliya; waxaa jira Latin America, Iran iyo China,” ayuu yiri. items.title: Ciidanka qaranka ayaa  gacanta ku dhigay saddex xubnood oo ka tirsan maleeshiyaadka Sool Barri.
items.description: Saddexdii xubnood ee ka tirsanaa maleeshiyaadka Sool Barri ee Ciidanka Qaranka JSL ku qabtay Gobolka Sanaag ayaa lagu qabtay hawlgal qorshaysan oo ka dhacay deegaanka Jiidali. Sida xogta la helay sheegtay, ciidanku waxay heleen xog ku saabsan dhaqdhaqaaqa kooxda iyo qorshe lagu bartilmaameedsan lahaa dadka rayidka ah, gaar ahaan xoolo-dhaqatada deegaanka. Saddexda nin ayaa gacanta lagu dhigay iyagoo hubaysan, waxaana markii dambe loo gudbiyey magaalada Ceerigaabo, xarunta Gobolka Sanaag, halkaas oo ay hadda gacanta ugu jiraan ciidamada Somaliland. Sultan Abdikarim

items.title: Saraakiisha oo Baydhabo ka bilaabay qorista dhallinyaro ka mid noqoneysa ciidamada
items.description: Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa waxaa laga bilaabay qorista dhallinyaro cusub oo loo qaadanayo inay ka mid noqdaan Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ay ku howlan yihiin qorista iyo soo xulista dhallinyarada la doonayo in la qarameeyo. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in dhallinyaradan lagu wado in ay ku biiraan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Booliska Gaarka ee Koonfur Galbeed ama Ciidanka Daraawiishta, si ay kordhin cusub ugu noqdaan Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in Saraakiisha ku foogan qorista dhallinyaradan ay diiradda saarayaan inay noqdaan muwaadiniin aan lahayn diiwaan dembi, isla-markaana aan horey uga soo mid noqon ururada hubeysan ee dalka ka dagaalama ee Al Shabaab iyo Daacish. Xogaha hoose ee la helayo ayaa sheegaya in soo xulista dhallinyarada loo qaadanayo askarta lagu ballaarin karo deegaanada kale ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Qorshaha lagu qorayo dhallinyarada loo qaadanayo shaqada ciidamada ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalada lagu xoojinayo amniga, difaaca dalka iyo dib-u-dhiska Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. Tani ayaa ku soo aadeysa, xilli xasaasi ah oo caqabado amni uu wajahayo maamulka cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed ee uu hoggaamiyo Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe). Aadan Madoobe ayaa juhdi badani ku bixinaya, sidii uu si buuxda ugu gudan lahaa waajibaadkiisa shaqo, isagoo ku xisaabtamaya taageerada joogtada ah ee Dowladda Federaalka. Aadan Madoobe ayaa xiriirka dhow ee uu la leeyahay madaxda sare ee dalka iyo taageerada siyaasadeed iyo midda amni ee Villa Somalia u adeegsanaya in uu ku xoojiyo howlaha horyaalla maamulkiisa.

items.title: Galmudug oo jawaab culus ka bixisay tallaabadii Saciid Deni
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Galmudug ayaa jawaab deg-deg ah ka bixiyay tallaabadii uu maanta qaaday Madaxweynaha Puntland, Mudane Saciid Cabdullahi Deni oo booqasho ku tegay deegaanka Dhinawda ee Gobolka Mudug, iyada oo Galmudug ay sheegtay in deegaankaas uu hoostago maamulkeeda. Guddoomiye ku xigeenka labaad ee Baarlamaanka Galmudug, Marwo Faadumo Cabdi Cali (Faadumo Faandhe) oo shir jaraa’id ku qabatay gudaha magaalada Dhuusamareeb ayaa si adag uga hadashay booqashada ay maanta wafdiga Madaxweynaha Puntland ku tegeen deegaanka Dhinawda, halkaas oo si diirran loogu soo dhaweeyay, kadibna kormeer sameeyay. Faadumo Faandhe oo si caro leh ugu jawaabtay Madaxweyne Saciid Deni ayaa ku dooday in deegaanka Dhinawda uu ka tirsan yahay Galmudug, isla markaana ay iyagu metalaan shacabka deegaankaasi. “Hadal kuma jiro shakina kuma jiro Dhinawda Galmudug ayaa iska leh, waxaana caddeyn u ah kuraasta aan ku fadhino,’ ayay tiri Faatuma Faandhe. Sidoo kale, waxa ka jawaabtay hadalka kasoo yeeray Saciid Deni oo ujeedka safarkiisa ku sheegay inuu qayb ka yahay dadaallada Puntland ee ku aaddan u kuurgelidda xaaladda nololeed iyo xoojinta nabadda, isagoo ku dhawaaqay in Garoowe lagu qaban doono gogol nabadeed, si loo xoojiyo nabadda, wada-noolaanshaha iyo isku-xirnaanta bulshada Towfiiq iyo Dhinawda ee Mudug. “Haddii nabad laga shaqeynaayo meeshaas waxaa la rabaa dadka nabadda ka shaqeynaayay iyo dadka kale inay isla soo xiriiraan. Hoggaamiye Deni waxaan rabnaa inaan u sheegno haddii uu rabo inuu heshiisiiyo labada beelood maamulka Galmudug hasoo maro,” ayuu sii raacisay. Booqashada Saciid Deni ayaa dhalisay caro xoogan, waxaana horay uga fal-celiyay Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Cagaweyne oo ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, lagana soo doorto Galmudug, isaga oo Madaxweynaha Puntland ku eedeeyay inuu colaad ka huriyo bariga Gobolka Mudug. “Soomaalidu waxay tiraahdaa, ‘Ratigii raran ku gubtay baa yaqaan wuxuu geel ugu sheekeeyo.’ Saciidow, niman ilma-adeeradaa ah baa qaraabo dirirtay ee ka joog colaadda aad Bariga Mudug ka waddid. Dab baad ku ciyaareysaan,” ayuu qoraalkiisa ku yiri Xildhibaanku. Waxaa kale oo uu kusii daray “Haddii ay waxqabad kaa tahay, dadka aad matasho ee ku dhiban deegaannada Puntland, gaar ahaan deegaannada Kulub iyo Garacad oo ay saameeyeen isbeddelka cimilada, xoolo-dhaqatada iyo kalluumeysatadana leh, wax u qabso. Deegaankaas dadkiisa ayaa u tashanaya, una jooga. Wabillaahi Towfiiq”. Si kastaba, madaxda Galmudug ayaa horay uga digay in Saciid Deni uu booqdo Dhinawda balse dhegaha ayuu ka fureystay, wuxuuna maanta isku soo sawiray bacaadka ku sii fidaya magaaladaasi oo ka tirsan Gobolka Mudug. items.title: Trump oo sheegay in dhammaan miinooyinka laga saaray Marinka Hormuz
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump ayaa caawa sheegay in miinooyinka laga nadiifiyay marin biyoodka Hormuz ee Gobolka Bariga Dhexe. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Marinka Hormuz laga saaray amaba la qarxiyay dhammaan miinooyinkii yaalay. Madaxweynaha ayaa waxa uu sheegay in Ciidanka Badda Mareykanka ay xaqiijiyeen in biyaha caalamiga ah ee Marinka Hormuz laga nadiifiyo dhammaan waxyaabaha qarxa. Madaxweyne Trump ayaa bartiisa Truth Social ku sheegay in Ciidamada Mareykanka ee Space Force ay kormeerayaan marin biyoodka oo dhan. Trump ayaa sheegay in Iran lagu wargeliyay in maraakiibteeda iyo doomaheeda isku daya inay miinooyin cusub dhigaan Hormuz in si degdeg ah loo burburin doono. Marinka Hormuz oo ku yaala afka ciriiriga ah ee Gacanka Faaris ayaa ku xirmay duulaankii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay 28-kii bishii February ku qaadeen dalkaasi Iran. Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa bartamihii bishii June gaaray heshiis is afgarad ah oo lagu soo afarayo dagaalka, iyadoo la soo celinayo xorriyaddii socdaalka maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Hormuz, ha yeeshee labada dal ayaa bishii July sii waday duqaymihii ay is dhaafsanayeen, iyadoona marinka istiraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz uu yahay goobta ugu weyn ee xiisaddu ka taagan tahay. Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqday cunaqabatayn xoogan, oo lagu beegsanayo ku dhawaad 60 shakhsi, shirkadaha iyo maraakiibta xiriirka la leh Dekedaha Iran. Wasiirka Maaliyadda Mareykanka, Scott Bessent ayaa sheegay in cunaqabatayntan looga gol leeyahay in Iran laga jaro xiriirada dhaqaale ee caalamka, isagoona dalalka uga digay inay xiriir ganacsi la yeeshaan Tehran. “Hadafkayagu waa inaan caalamka oo dhan ka jarno dhammaan xiriirrada dhaqaale ee sii wada jiritaanka nidaamkan keli-taliska ah, illaa ay Tehran keligeed iska taagto.” Ayuu yiri Scott Bessent. Bessent ayaa sheegay in cunaqabatayntu ay sidoo kale saameynayso shabakado ay Washington ku eedeysay inay ka caawinayaan Iran in ay soo saarto dakhli saliid, inay hesho hub iyo inay sameyso hawlgalo internet-ka ah. Dowladda Iran ayaa sheegtay in cunaqabataynta cusub ee Mareykanka ay tahay mid fashilmi doonta, isla-markaana ay diyaarisay qorsheyaal ay kaga gaashaamaneyso.

Marinka Hormuz oo ku yaala afka ciriiriga ah ee Gacanka Faaris ayaa ku xirmay duulaankii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay 28-kii bishii February ku qaadeen dalkaasi Iran. Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa bartamihii bishii June gaaray heshiis is afgarad ah oo lagu soo afarayo dagaalka, iyadoo la soo celinayo xorriyaddii socdaalka maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Hormuz, ha yeeshee labada dal ayaa bishii July sii waday duqaymihii ay is dhaafsanayeen, iyadoona marinka istiraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz uu yahay goobta ugu weyn ee xiisaddu ka taagan tahay. Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqday cunaqabatayn xoogan, oo lagu beegsanayo ku dhawaad 60 shakhsi, shirkadaha iyo maraakiibta xiriirka la leh Dekedaha Iran. Wasiirka Maaliyadda Mareykanka, Scott Bessent ayaa sheegay in cunaqabatayntan looga gol leeyahay in Iran laga jaro xiriirada dhaqaale ee caalamka, isagoona dalalka uga digay inay xiriir ganacsi la yeeshaan Tehran. “Hadafkayagu waa inaan caalamka oo dhan ka jarno dhammaan xiriirrada dhaqaale ee sii wada jiritaanka nidaamkan keli-taliska ah, illaa ay Tehran keligeed iska taagto.” Ayuu yiri Scott Bessent. Bessent ayaa sheegay in cunaqabatayntu ay sidoo kale saameynayso shabakado ay Washington ku eedeysay inay ka caawinayaan Iran in ay soo saarto dakhli saliid, inay hesho hub iyo inay sameyso hawlgalo internet-ka ah. Dowladda Iran ayaa sheegtay in cunaqabataynta cusub ee Mareykanka ay tahay mid fashilmi doonta, isla-markaana ay diyaarisay qorsheyaal ay kaga gaashaamaneyso.

items.title: Pakistan-Somalia defence pact: Is Islamabad preparing to send troops? What we know
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Pakistan and Somalia have struck their broadest defence agreement in more than three decades, sending army, navy and air force commanders into direct talks in Rawalpindi and reopening a military relationship last defined by the bloodshed of the 1993 Battle of Mogadishu. But despite weeks of speculation over how far that relationship will go, officials on both sides have been explicit about one point: no Pakistani combat troops are being sent to Somalia. The distinction matters. It separates a story about training academies and naval liaison officers from one about foreign soldiers on Somali soil – and, so far, the record supports only the former. What was actually signed The current phase of cooperation began on Aug. 4, when Somalia’s Defence Minister, Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, and his Pakistani counterpart, Khawaja Muhammad Asif, signed a memorandum of understanding in Islamabad. Somalia’s Ministry of Defence said the pact covers counterterrorism cooperation, military training programmes and the exchange of military expertise, within a broader framework for defence capacity building between the two countries’ armed forces. What followed was not the usual quiet aftermath of a diplomatic signing. Two days later, Fiqi led a full defence delegation — including Rear Admiral Abdiwahab Abdullahi Omar, commander of the Somali Navy and Coast Guard — to Pakistan’s General Headquarters in Rawalpindi for a direct meeting with Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, Pakistan’s Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces. Reporting from Pakistan Today, drawing on a statement from Pakistan’s Inter-Services Public Relations directorate, described talks covering “evolving regional security dynamics and measures to further enhance bilateral defence and security cooperation.” Fiqi’s delegation did not stop there. According to the Rio Times and Somalia Today, the Somali minister also met Admiral Naveed Ashraf, Pakistan’s Chief of Naval Staff, for talks on Indian Ocean maritime security and the rebuilding of Somalia’s navy and coast guard, and Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmed Baber Sidhu, who offered training and institutional support to the Somali Air Force. The delegation went on to tour Pakistan’s National Defence University and Global Industrial & Defence Solutions, the state-owned company that markets Pakistani military equipment abroad. “This is an institutional relationship rather than a deployment,” the Rio Times noted in its account of the visit, adding that the composition of the Somali delegation – service chiefs rather than junior liaison officers – was “a heavier composition than a training discussion requires.” The question of troops, addressed directly Multiple outlets that have covered the agreement in detail have converged on the same conclusion: nothing in the public record authorizes a Pakistani troop presence in Somalia. The Rio Times reported plainly that “no base, port access or permission to deploy combat forces has been announced.” The defence-specialist outlet Defence Security Asia went further, writing that “the memorandum does not publicly confirm Pakistani deployments, permanent facilities, weapons transfers or basing access,” and cautioned that “expansive claims about an immediate strategic realignment” remain premature. Prof. Basim Raza of the NUST Institute of Policy Studies, speaking to Sputnik, said the memorandum does not authorize a permanent Pakistani military base in Somalia, and that the more immediate reality is likely to run in the opposite direction – Somali officers travelling to Pakistan for instruction, rather than Pakistani forces travelling to Somalia. Raza described the arrangement as asymmetrical: Pakistan supplying formal training in intelligence-led counterterrorism, special operations, logistics and communications, while Somalia contributes local intelligence and operational knowledge of the region. He cautioned against describing the pact as a confirmed plan to secure the Bab el-Mandeb strait, calling that framing premature. The most detailed scrutiny of the deployment question has come, notably, from Indian commentary – where any expansion of Pakistan’s military footprint draws close attention. Gurjit Singh, a former Indian ambassador to Ethiopia, Djibouti and the African Union, examined the relationship for Firstpost and concluded that Pakistan is “unlikely to send large numbers of troops to fight Al-Shabaab.” He argued instead that training, military advice, defence equipment sales and possible air and naval cooperation are the more realistic paths for Pakistan’s role to expand. Somalia Today, reporting on Singh’s analysis, was direct on the underlying fact pattern: “There is no Pakistani military base in Somalia. There has been no confirmed agreement granting the Pakistan Navy permanent access to a Somali port, nor any announced deployment of Pakistani combat forces.” The unconfirmed jet deal Running alongside the training relationship is a reported, unconfirmed arms deal. Multiple Somali and regional media outlets reported in February that Mogadishu was advancing talks to acquire up to 24 Pakistani JF-17 Thunder Block III fighter jets , a package other outlets have valued at roughly $900 million. Neither government has confirmed a signed contract, and analysts stress the reported deal sits outside the August memorandum itself. Were it finalized, Defence Security Asia noted, it would become Somalia’s largest defence purchase in decades, requiring pilot training, airbase rehabilitation, weapons integration and financing well beyond what has so far been disclosed. Why Pakistan is interested now The timing is not incidental. Pakistan’s outreach to Mogadishu came days before Islamabad joined Saudi Arabia and Türkiye in signing the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, part of a broader push by Pakistan’s military leadership – spearheaded by Field Marshal Munir – to build security relationships across the Gulf, the Red Sea and now the Horn of Africa. Somalia, sitting on the Gulf of Aden approaches to the Bab el-Mandeb strait, offers Islamabad a foothold in one of the world’s busiest and most contested shipping corridors, at a moment when piracy off the Somali coast has returned to its highest level in a decade. Singh’s analysis for Firstpost frames the move in exactly these terms: not simply another training agreement, but a chance for Pakistan to use defence diplomacy to build a wider strategic role linking the Gulf, the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean. Pakistan already has deep military relationships with Saudi Arabia and Türkiye – and Türkiye, whose parliament recently extended its own Somalia military mission to 2028, remains by far Somalia’s most deeply embedded foreign military partner, running a major training facility in Mogadishu. Pakistan’s arrival does not replace that relationship; it adds another layer to an increasingly crowded field of foreign security partners inside Somalia. India is watching The agreement has registered in New Delhi. Asked about it on Aug. 7, Indian foreign ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said India was following developments between Somalia and Pakistan “closely,” pointing to India’s own defence and development ties across Africa. India has conducted anti-piracy patrols in the Gulf of Aden since 2008 and treats maritime security off Somalia as a standing national interest rather than a distant concern. Pakistan is India’s principal regional rival and a significant Indian Ocean naval power in its own right, which is why New Delhi’s attention has been drawn less to any single deployment and more to the cumulative pattern – army, navy and air force engagement running in parallel, alongside a reported fighter-jet negotiation. Somalia, for its part, has continued to describe the relationship in narrower terms. Days after the Rawalpindi meetings, Fiqi met Pakistan’s ambassador to Somalia, Aqsa Nawaz, to discuss implementing the August memorandum – talks that centred, according to reports, on training, capacity-building and the development of the Somali Air Force, with Admiral Ashraf reaffirming Pakistan’s commitment to strengthening defence ties. Somalia has also kept its relationship with India itself on a separate, cordial track: Somalia’s foreign minister met India’s external affairs minister in New Delhi in January to discuss cooperation on trade, education and health. The bottom line Every element of the Pakistan-Somalia defence relationship that has been publicly confirmed – the August memorandum, the Rawalpindi meetings with all three of Pakistan’s service chiefs, the tour of Pakistani defence institutions, the reported jet talks – points toward training, institution-building, equipment sales and maritime cooperation, not the deployment of Pakistani combat troops. That has not stopped the relationship from being read, particularly in New Delhi, as a meaningful strategic shift: a sign that Pakistan is extending its military reach into the Horn of Africa for the first time since its costly UN peacekeeping role in Somalia in the early 1990s. Whether that reach eventually includes Pakistani boots on Somali ground will depend on decisions neither government has yet made public. Somali Guardian will continue to track official statements from Mogadishu and Islamabad and will update this report if that changes. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Cagaweyne oo u digay Saciid Deni: Dab ayaad ku ciyaareysaa
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Cagaweyne oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka, lagana soo doorto Galmudug, ayaa si kulul uga hadlay booqashadii uu maanta Madaxweynaha Puntland ku tegay deegaanka Dhinawda ee Gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo si diirran loogu soo dhaweeyay. Deegaankan ayaa maamul ahaan hoostaga Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Saciid Deni ayaa ujeedka safarkiisa ku sheegay inuu qayb ka yahay dadaallada Puntland ee ku aaddan u kuurgelidda xaaladda nololeed, xoojinta nabadda iyo isu-soo-dhawaanshaha bulshada ku nool degmada Towfiiq iyo deegaanka Dhinawda ee Gobolka Mudug. Xildhibaan Cagaweyne oo ka falceliyay booqashada wafdiga Madaxweynaha Puntland ayaa uga digay inuu colaad ka huriyo bariga Mudug, isaga oo tilmaamay in Saciid Deni uu ku ciyaarayo dab, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Soomaalidu waxay tiraahdaa, ‘Ratigii raran ku gubtay baa yaqaan wuxuu geel ugu sheekeeyo.’ Saciidow, niman ilma-adeeradaa ah baa qaraabo dirirtay ee ka joog colaadda aad Bariga Mudug ka waddid. Dab baad ku ciyaareysaan,” ayuu qoraalkiisa ku yiri Xildhibaanku. Sidoo kale, wuxuu kula taliyay haddii uu doonayo inuu wax ka qabto xaaladda dadka, inuu xoogga saaro deegaannada Puntland, gaar ahaan Kulub iyo Garacad, oo ay saameeyeen isbeddelka cimilada. Waxa uu sheegay in deegaannadaasi ay ka jiraan xaalado nololeed oo adag, kuwaas oo saameeyay xoolo-dhaqatada iyo kalluumeysatada ku nool deegaannadaasi, kuwaas oo uu xusay inay u baahan yihiin in loo gurmado. “Haddii ay waxqabad kaa tahay, dadka aad matasho ee ku dhiban deegaannada Puntland, gaar ahaan deegaannada Kulub iyo Garacad oo ay saameeyeen isbeddelka cimilada, xoolo-dhaqatada iyo kalluumeysatadana leh, wax u qabso. Deegaankaas dadkiisa ayaa u tashanaya, una jooga. Wabillaahi Towfiiq,” ayuu mar kale yiri Cabdiraxmaan Cagaweyne. Dhinaca kale, waxaa arrintan ka falceliyay qaar ka mid ah dadka isticmaala baraha bulshada, oo siyaabo kala duwan uga hadlay booqashada Saciid Deni uu ku tegay deegaanka Dhinawda ee Gobolka Mudug ee maamulka Galmudug. Maxamed Cali: “Xukuumadda Madaxweyne Qoor Qoor taariikh madow ayay ku noqon doontaa in iyaga oo weli xilka haya la qaato qaybo ka mid ah dhulweynaha Galmudug. Tagitaanka Hoggaamiye Deni ee Dhinawda waxaa loo fasiran karaa in Dhinawda ay hoos tagto maamulka Puntland, taas oo noqon karta arrin taariikhi ah oo Deni u reebaysa dadkiisa.” Xuseen Macallin Cabdullaahi: “Deegaankan dadka deggan Galmudug saamigooda ayay ku leeyihiin. Deniyow, yuusan waqti kaaga lumin, attention seeker baad tahaye.” Hoodo Xayinimo: “Deniyow, Galmudug waad u bareertay ee adkeysi u yeelo. Dhinawda waa Galmudug.” Iimaan Indhacadde: “Welcome Dhinawda, Madaxweyne. Waxqabad iyo horumar bay kaa rabtaa.” Cumar Cilmi: “Dowladda Puntland markan iyadaa faragelin bilowday.” Si kastaba, horay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Galmudug ayaa uga digay in Deni uu booqdo Dhinawda balse dhegaha ayuu ka fureystay, wuxuuna maanta isku soo sawiray bacaadka ku sii fidaya magaaladaasi oo ka tirsan Gobolka Mudug. The post Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Cagaweyne oo u digay Saciid Deni: Dab ayaad ku ciyaareysaa appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka oo Nairobi Kaga Wada Hadlay Xoojinta Iskaashiga Amniga
items.description: Mas’uuliyiin sar-sare oo ka kala socda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa magaalada Nairobi ee Kenya ku yeeshay kulan looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga amniga iyo difaaca, gaar ahaan taageerada Mareykanka ee ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Wadahadallada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray kordhinta taageerada la siiyo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ka mid yihiin tababarka, qalabeynta iyo xoojinta ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Danab. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada hadlay taageerada dhinaca cirka iyo wadaagga xogaha sirdoonka, kuwaas oo door muhiim ah ka qaata howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo sugidda amniga deegaannada ay ciidamada Soomaaliya kala wareegeen kooxda. Kulanka ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo qorshe ay si tartiib ah ugu xoojinayso awoodda ciidamadeeda, si mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka loogu wareejiyo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa muddo dheer kamid ahayd saaxiibbada ugu muhiimsan ee Soomaaliya ka taageera la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo dhismaha hay’adaha amniga. items.title: Kenya oo guul ka sheegatay dagaal ay la gashay Shabaab
items.description: Wajeer (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada ammaanka ee dowladda Kenya ayaa maanta ka hortegay weerar gaadmo ah oo maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab ay ka fuliyeen duleedka magaalada Wajeer ee gobolka Waqooyi Bari, kaas oo uu xigay dagaal foolka fool ah oo u dhexeeyay labda dhinac. Weerarka ayaa dhacay xilli ciidamada ammaanka ay howlgal roondo ah ka wadeen deegaanka oo ku dhow xadka Soomaaliya iyo Kenya, halkaas oo ay ciidamada kula kulmeen koox ka tirsan Al-Shabaab oo rasaas ku furtay ciidamadii ku jiray howlgalka. Saraakiisha ammaanka ayaa sheegay inay si weyn uga hortageen weerarka, isla markaana la fashiliyay, maadaama la helay xogta maleeshiyada weerarka soo qaaday oo illaa iyo hadda aan la ogeyn tiradooda rasmiga ah. Mas’uul ka tirsan maamulka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Kenya ay ku guuleysteen inay dib u celiyaan xubnihii weerarka soo qaaday, kuwaas oo markii dambe u baxsaday dhanka hawdka iyo xuduudda Soomaaliya, halkaas oo ay la sheegay inay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen. Kadib dhacdadan, ciidamada ammaanka ee Kenya ayaa sare u qaaday heegankooda, iyagoo bilaabay howlgallo baaritaanno ah iyo baadi-goob looga gol leeyahay in lagu raadiyo maleeshiyaadkii weerarka qaaday iyo cidda ka dambeysay abaabulka weerarka. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay sare u kacayaan weerarrada iyo isku dhacyada la xiriira Al-Shabaab ee ka dhacaya gobollada Waqooyi Bari Kenya, gaar ahaan Wajeer, Mandera iyo Gaarisa, kuwaas oo dhammaantood ku dhow xadka Soomaaliya. Ciidamada Kenya ayaa sidoo kale ka cabsi qaba in weerarradan ay qayb ka yihiin dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ay maleeshiyaadku ku doonayaan inay ku tijaabiyaan awoodda ciidamada iyo meelaha ay ka jiraan nuglaanta amni, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan howlgallada lagu baacsanayo xubnaha Al-Shabaab ee ka howlgala xadka Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. Xaaladda deegaanka ayaa hadda lagu soo warramayaa inay deggan tahay, waxaana weli socda howlgallo ay ciidamada ammaanka ku xaqiijinayaan amniga, halka sidoo kale la baarayo haddii weerarka uu sababay wax khasaare ama dhaawac ah oo soo gaaray dhinaca Al-Shabaab. items.title: Somaliland oo shaacisay natiijada imtixaanaadka shahaadiga ee fasallada 12-aad iyo 8-aad
items.description: Maamulka Somaliland ayaa maanta shaaciyay natiijada imtixaanaadka shahaadiga ah ee fasallada 12-aad ee dugsiyada sare iyo fasallada 8-aad ee dugsiyada dhexe. Imtixaanka Dugsiga Sare: Waxaa imtixaanka galay 16,078 arday, waxaana ku guuleystay 16,051 arday, taas oo u dhiganta 99.8%. Halka 27 arday, oo ah 0.2%, ay ku harayaan imtixaanka. Imtixaanka waxaa galay 25,954 arday, waxaana gudbay 25,860 arday, oo u dhiganta 99.6%. Waxaa sidoo kale ku haray 94 arday, taas oo ah 0.4%. Natiijooyinkan ayaa muujinaya heer aad u sarreeya oo ah tirada ardayda ku guuleysatay imtixaanaadka shahaadiga ah ee sanadkan, iyadoo ku dhowaad dhammaan ardaydii gashay labada imtixaan ay u gudbeen heerka xiga ee waxbarashada. Waalidiinta, macallimiinta iyo ardayda guuleysatay ayaa loo hambalyeeyay, halka ardayda aan ku guuleysan imtixaanka loo rajeeyay inay fursad kale uga faa’iideystaan horumarinta waxbarashadooda.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha oo Muqdisho Ka Daah-furay Madasha Isku-xirka Ganacsiga
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho si rasmi ah uga furay Madasha Isku-xirka Ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha. Madasha waxaa ka qeyb galay wasiirro ka tirsan Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, safiirrada Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, Rugta Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliyeed, Rugta Ganacsiga Afrika iyo Shiinaha, iyo ganacsato iyo maalgashadayaal ka kala socday labada dal. Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka ayaa shirkadaha iyo maalgashadayaasha Shiinaha ugu baaqay inay ka faa’iideystaan fursadaha maalgashi ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, wax-soo-saarka, kalluumaysiga, beeraha, tamarta, gaadiidka iyo saadka. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in iskaashiga ganacsi ee labada dal uu fursad u yahay soo jiidashada maalgashiga shisheeye, abuurista shaqooyin cusub iyo kobcinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha. Madasha ayaa sidoo kale loogu talagalay in ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa Shiinaha ay si toos ah isugu xirmaan, loona abuuro fursado iskaashi oo ka gudba wada-hadallada una gudba maalgashi dhab ah iyo mashaariic wax-ku-ool ah oo gudaha Soomaaliya laga hirgeliyo. Haddii fursadahaas si wanaagsan loo hirgeliyo, iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha wuxuu si gaar ah muhiim ugu noqon karaa kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, kalluumaysiga, beeraha, tamarta iyo gaadiidka, oo kamid ah meelaha Soomaaliya ay weli u baahan tahay maalgashi ballaaran.
