items.title: Puntland oo Shaacisay Qorshe Maalgashi oo $1.78 Bilyan ah
items.description: Garoowe (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Puntland ayaa shaacisay Qorshaha Horumarinta Puntland ee 4-aad (2026–2030), kaas oo lagu qorsheeyay in lagu maalgeliyo guud ahaan $1.78 bilyan afarta sano ee soo socota. Qorshahan ayaa diiradda lagu saaraya sidii Puntland loo gaarsiin lahaa dhaqaale kobcaya, shaqo-abuur, adeegyo bulsho oo tayo leh iyo isku-filnaansho, iyadoo bartilmaameedku yahay in la gaaro horumar muuqda marka la gaaro sannadka 2030. Qorshaha ayaa ku dhisan shan tiir oo waaweyn, kuwaas oo kala ah: Maamul loo dhan yahay, caddaalad iyo amni. Horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo shaqo-abuurka. Horumarinta adeegyada bulshada iyo isku-filnaanshaha aadanaha. La-qabsiga isbeddelka cimilada. Xoojinta awoodda iyo adkeysiga bulshada. Qorshaha ayaa la sheegay in ay si wadajir ah uga qeyb qaateen Dowladda Puntland, bulshada rayidka ah iyo UNDP, iyadoo la isku dayay in qorshuhu ka tarjumayo baahiyaha iyo mudnaanta bulshada. Waddooyin iyo kaabayaal dhaqaale Mid kamid ah mashaariicda ugu waaweyn ayaa ah 3G Corridor-ka Garacad–Gaalkacyo–Galdogob, kaas oo loo qorsheeyay lacag dhan $302 milyan, iyadoo waddadu dhererkeedu yahay ku dhowaad 300km. Sidoo kale, $125 milyan ayaa loogu talagalay dhismaha ku dhowaad 400km oo waddooyin cusub ah iyo dayactirka 500km oo waddooyin kale ah. Kalluumaysiga iyo wax-soo-saarka gudaha Qorshaha ayaa sidoo kale xoogga saaraya kordhinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo abuurista warshado. Waxaa kamid ah: $10 milyan oo loogu talagalay warshado lagu farsameeyo kalluunka oo laga dhiso Bareda, Eyl iyo Garacad. $3 milyan oo loogu talagalay dhismaha warshad lagu farsameeyo hilibka. $600,000 oo loogu talagalay dhismaha saddex xarumood oo caanaha lagu farsameeyo. Haddii qorshahan si buuxda loo fuliyo, Puntland waxay rajaynaysaa in maalgelinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo adeegyada bulshada ay kordhiyaan shaqo-abuurka, ganacsiga iyo isku-filnaanshaha dhaqaalaha. Si kastaba, caqabadda ugu weyn waxay noqon doontaa helitaanka $1.78 bilyan iyo awoodda lagu fulinayo mashaariicda, maadaama qorshe horumarineed uu natiijo dhab ah yeelanayo keliya marka maalgelintiisa iyo hirgelintiisu noqdaan kuwo joogto ah. items.title: Shirweynaha Somaliya iyo Shiinaha oo ka furmay Magaalada Muqdisho (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Shirweynaha Xiriirka Ganacsiga ee Somaliya iyo Shiinaha ayaa maanta ka furmay Magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoona qabsoomiddiisa ay iska kaashadeen Wasaaradda Ganacsiga & Warshadaha Somaliya iyo Rugta Ganacsiga Shiinaha. Raysal Wasaare Kuxigeenka Somaliya, Saalax Axmed Jaamac ayaa furay shirweynaha, waxaana ka qaybgalay xubno ka socda shirkadaha waaweyn ee ganacsiga ee dalkaasi Shiinaha. “Madasha ayaa waxaa ka soo qaybgalay Wasiiro ka tirsan Xukuumadda Federaalka Somaliya, Safiirka Somaliya ee Shiinaha iyo kan Shiinaha ee Somaliya, Rugta Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliyeed, Rugta Ganacsiga Afrika iyo Shiinaha iyo ganacsato iyo maalgashadeyaal ka kala socda Somaliya iyo Shiinaha.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ay soo saartay Xukuumadda Federaalka. Warka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay “Raysal Wasaare Kuxigeenka ayaa ku dhiirigeliyay shirkadaha iyo maalgashadeyaasha Shiinaha in ay ka faa’iideystaan fursadaha maalgashi ee Somaliya, gaar ahaan kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, wax soosaarka, kalluumeysiga, beeraha, tamarta, gaadiidka iyo saadka, isaga oo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in iskaashiga ganacsi uu horseedo shaqo abuur iyo kor u qaadista wax soosaarka gudaha.” Soddon xubnood oo metelaya dhowr iyo labaatan shirkadood oo laga leeyahay Shiinaha ayaa ka soo qaybgalay shirweynaha, iyagoo qiimeynaya fursadaha maalgashi ee ka bannaan gudaha Somaliya. Dowladda Somaliya ayaa shirweynahan ka leh qorshe lagu ballaarinayo xiriirka ganacsi iyo maalgashi ee Somaliya iyo dalalka shisheeye, iyadoo la kordhinayo badeecadaha ama wax soosaarka dalka ee loo iibgeeyo suuqyada caalamka. Shiinaha waa dalka ugu weyn ee maalgashiga ku sameeya dalalka Afrika, wuxuuna dhisaa kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha sida waddooyin, dekedo, garoomada diyaaradaha iyo tareeno.

items.title: DENI oo qaaday tallaabo ka caraysiisay Galmudug + Sawirro
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Puntland, Mudane Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa maanta booqasho ka caraysiisay Galmudug ku tegay deegaanka Dhinawda ee Gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo si diirran loogu soo dhaweeyey. Saciid Deni ayaa kormeer shaqo ku tegay deegaankan oo hoostaga Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, waxaana ujeedka safarkiisa uu ku sheegay inuu qayb ka yahay dadaallada Puntland ee ku aaddan u kuurgelidda xaaladda nololeed, xoojinta nabadda iyo isu-soo-dhawaanshaha bulshada ku nool degmada Towfiiq iyo deegaanka Dhinawda ee Gobolka Mudug. Madaxweyne Saciid Den ayaa sidoo kale ku dhawaaqay in magaalada Garoowe lagu qaban doono gogol nabadeed, kaas oo uu isaguna ka qaybgelayo, si loo xoojiyo nabadda, wada-noolaanshaha iyo isku-xirnaanta bulshada Towfiiq iyo Dhinowda ee gobolka Mudug. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in Puntland ay diyaar u tahay wax ka qabashada saameynta isbeddelka cimilada ee deegaanka Dhinawda, gaar ahaan bacaadka ku fiday qaybo ka mid ah deegaanka. Dhinaca kale, arrintan ayaa dhalisay fal-celin xooggan, iyada oo siyaabo kala duwan looga falceliyay booqashada Saciid Deni ku tegay deegaanka Dhinawda, iyada oo dadka qaar ay sheegeen inuu u bareeray dhulka Galmudug. Maxamed Cali: “Xukuumada Madaxwayne Qoor Qoor tariikh madow ayey ku noqon doonta in ayagoo wali xilka haya la qaato qaybo kamid ah dhulwaynaha Galmudug. Tagitaanka Hoggaamiye Deni ee Dhinawda waxaa loo fasiran karaa in Dhinawda ay hoos tagto maamulka Puntland, taas oo noqon karta arrin taariikhi ah oo Deni u reebaysa dadkiisa”. Xuseen Macallin Cabdullahi: “Deegaankaan dadka degagan Galmudug saamigooda ku leeyihiin Daniyow yuu waqti kaaga lumin attention seeker tahaye”. Hoodo Xayinimo: ” Deniyow Galmudug waad u bareertay ee adkeysi u yeelo. Dinawda waaa Galmudug”. Imaan Indhacadde: “Welcome Dinawda Madaxweyne waxqabad iyo hormar-bey ka rabataa,” Cumar Cilmi: “Dowlada Puntland markaan iyadaa fara gallin bilowday”. Si kastaba, horay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Galmudug ayaa uga digay in Deni uu booqdo deegaankan, balse dhagaha ayuu ka fureystay, wuxuuna maanta isku soo sawiray baacadka kusii baahaya magaaladaasi oo ka tirsan Gobolka Mudug. The post DENI oo qaaday tallaabo ka caraysiisay Galmudug + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: DEG-DEG: Cabdirashiid Janan oo Kenya Ka Dalbaday Xilal iyo Isbeddello Jubbaland ah
items.description: Nairobi (Raxanreeb Online): Taliyihii hore ee Sirdoonka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee gobolka Gedo, Cabdirashiid Janan, oo dhawaan u wareegay dhinaca Jubbaland, ayaa la sheegay inuu gaaray magaalada Nairobi ee dalka Kenya. Sida xogaha laga helayo Nairobi ay tilmaamayaan, Janan ayaa Jubbaland ka dalbaday xil Xildhibaan Federaalka ah, xil Wasiir oo ka tirsan Jubbaland iyo dalabyo kale, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay qeyb ka yihiin heshiis la xiriira arrimo siyaasadeed iyo amni. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in qaar kamid ah dalabyada Janan aysan weli si buuxda u aqbalin Madaxtooyada Jubbaland, iyadoo la sheegay inuusan weli kulan fool-ka-fool ah la yeelan Madaxweynaha Jubbaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Madoobe). Dhanka kale, Jubbaland ayaa la filayaa in toddobaadkan ay bilowdo diiwaangelinta ciidamada ku sugnaa Gedo ee horey ula safnaa Dowladda Federaalka, si loogu daro ciidamada maamulka Jubbaland. Haddii qorshahan uu hirgalo, wuxuu wax ka beddeli karaa isku-dhafka ciidamada iyo saameynta siyaasadeed ee ka jirta gobolka Gedo. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Dowladda Federaalka, Puntland iyo Jubbaland ay ku kala aragti duwan yihiin arrimaha siyaasadda, amniga iyo doorashooyinka dalka, iyadoo dhinacyadu ay wadaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo ciidan oo la xiriira marxaladda doorashada federaalka ee soo socota. Si kastaba, sheegashada ah in Dowladda Federaalka looga guuleystay loollanka siyaasadeed iyo ciidan ee Puntland iyo Jubbaland waa qiimeyn siyaasadeed, mana aha xaqiiqo si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyay. The post DEG-DEG: Cabdirashiid Janan oo Kenya Ka Dalbaday Xilal iyo Isbeddello Jubbaland ah appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Suspected Al-Shabaab Fighters Retreat After Clashing With KDF
items.description: WAJIR — Kenya Defence Forces troops repelled an attack by suspected Al-Shabaab militants near the Kenya–Somalia border on Saturday evening, local officials said. The confrontation occurred on 22 August in Konton, Wajir County, as troops stationed at a nearby military camp conducted a mobile patrol. An unknown number of suspected militants reportedly opened fire on the patrol, prompting an immediate response from the soldiers. The ensuing exchange forced the assailants to retreat towards Somalia, according to a local official. No casualties were reported among the Kenyan troops, all of whom returned safely following the confrontation. It was not immediately clear whether the attackers suffered any casualties. Security agencies have heightened surveillance across the area and launched an investigation to establish the attackers’ identities, numbers and movements. The incident comes amid mounting concern over militant activity along Kenya’s border with Somalia. Security officials believe a recent series of attacks in Mandera, Garissa and Lamu counties may be aimed at testing the preparedness of Kenyan forces and identifying vulnerabilities at security installations. The latest confrontation follows a deadly attack in Mandera County on 28 July, in which six Kenyan security personnel were killed. The victims included five officers from the Special Operations Group and one member of the National Police Reserve. items.title: Taariikh Nololeedkii Nabi Muxammad ﷺ: Agoon Noqday Rasuul Dunida Gaadhay
items.description: W/Q Cabdikariim Xaaji Cabdi Buux Taariikhda aadamaha waxaa ku yar shakhsiyaad saamayn qoto dheer oo waarta ku yeeshay dunida sida Nabi Muxammad ﷺ . Taariikhdiisu waa mid si gaar ah u xusuus mudan, ma aha oo keliya sababta oo ah wuxuu noqday hoggaamiye diimeed iyo shakhsiyad taariikhi ah oo saamayn weyn leh, balse sidoo kale waxay ku bilaabatay nolol ay hareeyeen agoonnimo iyo duruufo adag, halkii ay ka bilaaban lahayd maal, mansab, waxbarasho rasmi ah ama awood. Carruurnimadii Agoonimada Nabi Muxammad ﷺ wuxuu ku dhashay Makah qarnigii lixaad, wuxuuna ka dhashay qabiilka Quraysh. Aabbihii, Cabdullaahi bin Cabdil-Muddalib, wuxuu geeriyooday ka hor dhalashadiisa. Sidaas darteed, Nabi Muxammad ﷺ wuxuu dunida yimid isagoo aabbihii ka geeriyooday. Hooyadii, Aamina bint Wahab, ayaa daryeeshay sannadihii ugu horreeyay ee noloshiisa, balse waxay geeriyootay isagoo qiyaastii lix jir ah. Intaas kaddib, waxaa daryeelay awoowgiis Cabdul-Muddalib, markii uu isaguna geeriyoodayna waxaa masuuliyaddiisa qaaday adeerkii Abuu Daalib. Sidaas darteed, Nabi Muxammad ﷺ wuxuu yaraantiisii si dhab ah u soo maray xaaladda agoonimada. Wuxuu garanayay waxa ay tahay in ilmuhu ku koro isaga oo aan haysan daryeelkii iyo garabkii labada waalid. Qur’aanka Kariimka ah ayaa markii dambe xusuusiyay marxaladdaas noloshiisa: “Miyuusan ku helin adigoo agoon ah, dabadeedna ku hoyin?” — Qur’aanka Kariimka ah, 93:6 Qoyskii iyo Nolashii Nabi Maxamed Nabad iyo Naxariis Korkiis Nabi Muxammad ﷺ wuxuu ahaa ilmaha keliya ee uu dhalay Cabdullaahi bin Cabdil-Muddalib iyo Aamina bint Wahab. Sidaas darteed, ma uusan lahayn walaalo ay isku aabbe iyo isku hooyo yihiin. Sidoo kale, kutubta taariikhda iyo siirada ah laguma xuso walaalo aabbe wadaag ah oo si la hubo uga haray Cabdullaahi, maadaama uu geeriyooday ka hor dhalashada Nabi Muxammad ﷺ. Hase yeeshee, Nabi Muxammad ﷺ wuxuu lahaa walaalo nuujin iyo barbaarin ah, taas oo ka dhalatay dhaqankii Carabta ee xilligaas, kaas oo ahaa in carruurta loo diro haween kale si ay u nuujiyaan una soo barbaariyaan. Waxaa ka mid ahaa: Xamza bin Cabdil-Muddalib — adeerkii Nabi Muxammad ﷺ, sidoo kalena walaalkiis nuujinta ka ahaa Thuwaybah. Abuu Salama, Cabdullaahi bin Cabdil-Asad — walaalkiis nuujinta ka ahaa Thuwaybah. Cabdullaahi bin Al-Xaarith — walaalkiis nuujinta ka ahaa Xaliimo Sa’diyah. Aniisah bint Al-Xaarith — walaashiis nuujinta ka ahayd Xaliimo Sa’diyah. Shaymaa, Hudhaafa bint Al-Xaarith — walaashiis nuujinta ka ahayd Xaliimo Sa’diyah. Nabi Muxammad ﷺ wuxuu sidoo kale ka tirsanaa qoys ballaaran oo dhinaca awoowgiis Cabdul-Muddalib ah. Adeerradiisa iyo eeddadiisa waxaa ka mid ahaa shakhsiyaad caan ah sida Xamza, Abuu Daalib, Al-Cabbaas, Abuu Lahab iyo Safiyyah. Sidaas awgeed, waxaa muhiim ah in la kala saaro labada arrimood: Nabi Muxammad ﷺ ma uusan lahayn walaalo dhalasho oo buuxa, balse wuxuu lahaa qaraabo badan iyo dhowr walaalo nuujin ah. Carruurnimo Aan Waxbarasho Rasmi ah Lahayn Arrin kale oo ka mid ah dhinacyada cajiibka ah ee nolosha Nabi Muxammad ﷺ waxay ahayd inuusan helin waxbarasho rasmi ah oo la mid ah tan culimada, faylasuufyada ama hoggaamiyeyaasha aqoonta ku soo caan baxay. Dhaqanka Islaamiga ah wuxuu Nabi Muxammad ﷺ ku tilmaamaa Ummiy, taas oo inta badan lagu fasiray inuusan aqrin ama qorin. Ma uusan tegin dugsi rasmi ah ama madrasad diimeed, mana uusan lahayn shahaadooyin waxbarasho oo uu ka soo qaatay xarun aqooneed. Hase yeeshee, markii uu gaaray qiyaastii 40 sano jir, Nabi Muxamed ﷺ  waxaa bilaabmay inuu helo waxyiga Alle oo uu u keenayay Malagga Jibriil. Waxyigii ugu horreeyay wuxuu ku bilaabmay amarka: “Akhri magaca Rabbigaa ee abuuray.” Dhacdadaasi waxaay ahayd bilowgii soo degista Qur’aanka Kariimka ah iyo bilaabashadii risaladii Nabi Muxammad ﷺ. items.title: Ciidamada Somaliland oo qabsaday hub iyo gaadiid dagaal
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Milateriga Somaliland ayaa howl-gallo amni ka fuliyay gobollada Awdal iyo Salal ee galbeedka Somaliland, halkaas oo ay ku qabteen hub iyo gaadiid gaashaaman oo ay haysteen dhinacyadii ku lug lahaa colaadaha beeleed ee dhowaan ka dhacay deegaannadaasi. Ciidamada ayaa intii ay howl-gallada wadeen gacanta ku dhigay hub iyo gaadiid dagaal oo ay sheegeen in si sharci-darro ah loo haystay, waxaana qaar ka mid ah gaadiidkaasi lagu soo bandhigay goob ay ciidamada ku sugan yihiin. Taliska ciidamada Somaliland ayaa sheegay inaan loo oggolaan doonin dadka shacabka ah inay si sharci-darro ah u haystaan hub ama gaadiid dagaal, iyagoo xusay in tallaabo laga qaadi doono cid kasta oo lagu helo arrimahaasi. Saraakiisha ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay amar ku qabaan inay si adag uga hortagaan cid kasta oo hub la soo baxda ama isku dayda inay dib u huriso colaadaha beeleed ee ka taagan qaybo ka mid ah galbeedka Somaliland. Howl-galladan ayaa kusoo beegmaya kaddib markii dhinacyadii ku dagaallamay Awdal iyo Salal ay jebiyeen heshiis nabadeed oo ay horay u gaareen, kaas oo dhigayay in la ilaaliyo xabbad-joojinta, isla markaana laga fogaado tallaabo kasta oo horseedi karta dib u soo noqoshada dagaalka. Sida uu dhigayay heshiiskaasi, ciidamada ayaa loo xilsaaray inay qaadaan tallaabooyin lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda, oo ay ka mid yihiin hub ka dhigista dadka sida sharci-darrada ah u haysta hubka iyo ka hortagga fal kasta oo dib loogu hurin karo colaadda. Colaadda ka taagan deegaannada galbeedka Somaliland ayaa bilaabatay bishii November 2025, kaddib markii uu khilaaf ka dhashay bandhig la xiriiray buugga Xeer Ciise oo ay beesha Ciise doonaysay in lagu qabto magaalada Saylac, balse ay si adag uga soo horjeesteen beelaha Gadabuursi. Khilaafkaasi ayaa markii dambe isu beddelay iska horimaadyo hubeysan oo sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac, waxaana dhowr jeer la isku dayay in dhinacyada la kala dhex dhigo si loo soo afjaro colaadda. Inkasta oo la gaaray heshiisyo dhowr ah oo lagu doonayay in lagu soo celiyo nabadda, haddana qaar ka mid ah heshiisyadaasi ma aysan sii waarin, iyadoo marar kale ay dib u qarxeen iska horimaadyo u dhexeeyay dhinacyadii dirirtu dhex martay. Howl-gallada cusub ee ciidamada Somaliland ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu doonayo in hubka looga qaado dhinacyada isku haya colaadda, isla markaana lagu xaqiijiyo in heshiisyadii nabadeed ee la gaaray si dhab ah loo dhaqan-geliyo. Xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa hore u sheegtay inaan loo dulqaadan doonin cid kasta oo isku dayda inay dib u bilowdo dagaal beeleed ama si sharci-darro ah u haysata hub iyo gaadiid dagaal, iyadoo ciidamada lagu amray inay ka hortagaan fal kasta oo khatar gelin kara amniga deegaannada Awdal iyo Salal. The post Ciidamada Somaliland oo qabsaday hub iyo gaadiid dagaal appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia Eyes Libyan Livestock Market, but Distance, Security and Cost Could Derail the Plan
items.description: Mogadishu-(WDN) — Somalia is exploring Libya as a potential new destination for its livestock exports, as the two countries seek to expand trade and deepen economic ties. But while the proposal offers an attractive new market on paper, security risks, the enormous maritime distance and the cost of transporting livestock through the Suez Canal could make the route commercially difficult to justify. The proposal was discussed during a meeting between Somalia’s ambassador to Libya and officials from the General Union of Libyan Chambers of Commerce, where the Somali side highlighted investment and trade opportunities, particularly the country’s livestock sector. If implemented, the arrangement could give Somali livestock exporters access to a potentially important North African market while providing Libya with an additional source of sheep, goats and other livestock. For Somalia, the attraction is obvious. Livestock remains one of the country’s most important economic sectors, supporting millions of livelihoods and generating substantial export revenues. More than 20 million sheep and goats were reportedly exported from Somalia between 2018 and 2024, underscoring the scale of the industry. But turning Libya into a major destination presents a very different logistical challenge from serving Somalia’s traditional livestock markets in the Gulf. The Geography Problem The most obvious obstacle is distance. A maritime shipment from Somalia to Libya would require a long voyage around the Horn of Africa and through the Red Sea and Suez Canal before reaching the Mediterranean. The route would involve additional sailing time, fuel, port charges, canal fees, insurance and other logistical expenses. For livestock exporters, time is money—and, in this case, time can also mean animal welfare and additional operating costs. Every additional day at sea increases expenditure on feed, water, veterinary supervision and crew, while also increasing the risks associated with transporting live animals over long distances. The Suez Canal presents another unavoidable cost. Ships using the canal must pay transit fees, adding another layer of expense to an already lengthy journey. This raises a fundamental commercial question: Can Somali livestock compete in Libya after absorbing the cost of one of the world’s longest and most expensive livestock shipping routes? The answer may depend heavily on market prices, vessel capacity, economies of scale and whether Libya is prepared to offer favorable import arrangements. There is also a second major concern: security. Libya remains politically and militarily fragmented, with competing authorities, armed groups and persistent instability despite years of international efforts to stabilize the country. For a livestock exporter, the risks do not end when a vessel reaches the Mediterranean. Ports, customs facilities, quarantine centers, roads and distribution networks all require predictable security and functioning institutions. A commercially viable livestock trade requires more than a willing buyer. It requires reliable ports, transparent customs procedures, veterinary certification, quarantine facilities, secure transportation corridors and a stable regulatory environment. Any disruption along that chain could quickly turn a profitable shipment into a financial loss. A Market Worth Exploring—but Not at Any Cost Despite these obstacles, Libya should not necessarily be dismissed as a potential market. The proposed trade could generate opportunities well beyond the sale of live animals, including shipping, veterinary services, quarantine facilities, animal feed, meat processing, cold-chain logistics and related agricultural services. The two sides have also discussed strengthening links between business communities, exchanging economic delegations and identifying new investment opportunities. But Somalia should approach the proposal with commercial realism rather than diplomatic enthusiasm alone. Before committing exporters to the Libyan market, authorities and businesses would need to conduct a detailed feasibility assessment covering shipping costs, Suez Canal fees, insurance, voyage duration, port charges, animal mortality risks, veterinary requirements, quarantine regulations, security conditions and final market prices. The crucial issue is not whether Libya needs livestock or whether Somalia has livestock to sell. The real question is whether Somali livestock can reach Libya at a price that remains competitive after the extraordinary cost of getting there. If the numbers do not work, diplomatic agreements and trade delegations will not make the route commercially viable. Somalia therefore has an opportunity—but also a warning. Opening Libya as a market could diversify Somalia’s livestock exports. But unless the logistics, security and economics are carefully addressed, the long journey from the Somali coast, through the Suez Canal and into the Mediterranean could consume the very profit the trade is intended to generate. items.title: U.S. Implements Operation Economic Outcast Sanctioning Iran’s Military Activities, Cyber Threats, and Illicit Oil Trade
items.description: Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesperson Today, the United States took sweeping action against multiple entities, individuals, and vessels enabling the Iranian regime’s destabilizing activities. Such activities include attacks against U.S. forces and allies in the region, illicit weapons procurement, cyber intrusions into American infrastructure, and the movement of energy products whose sale funds terrorism globally The measures target Iranian military officials responsible for procuring weapons and directing attacks against U.S. servicemembers and regional partners, Iran-based entities that gathered intelligence for targeting U.S. forces and allies, and a procurement ring supplying Iran’s military and missile programs. They also target a regime-directed cyber group responsible for extensive intrusions into U.S. critical infrastructure. Finally, we are targeting a sprawling group of shippers and brokers moving Iranian petroleum as well as petroleum and petrochemical products through the UAE, China, Singapore, and Europe to bankroll the U.S.-designated Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps-Qods Force (IRGC-QF) and other regime elements. The cyber component of today’s action was carried out in close coordination with the FBI, which announced last week indictments against eight Iranian nationals tied to a hacking campaign that compromised U.S. energy companies, defense contractors, healthcare institutions, and government offices at the local, state, and federal levels. Last week, the Department of State’s Rewards for Justice program offered a reward of up-to-$10 million for information on five of these individuals conducting malicious cyber activity against U.S. critical infrastructure on behalf of the Iranian government — reflecting the seriousness with which the United States treats threats to its digital infrastructure and reinforcing that those who attack American systems, wherever they are located, will be pursued and held accountable. The United States will continue to disrupt, expose, and dismantle Iran’s military and proliferation activities, procurement schemes, malicious cyber operations, and illicit oil trade that sustains the regime’s malign behavior. We call on the international community to join us in holding these actors to account. The Department of State targets are being designated pursuant to Executive Order (E.O.) 13846, which authorizes and reimposes certain sanctions with respect to Iran, and E.O. 13949, which targets certain persons with respect to the conventional arms activities of Iran. The Department of the Treasury targets are being designated pursuant to E.O. 13382, which targets proliferators of weapons of mass destruction and their means of delivery; E.O. 13694, as amended, which targets malicious cyber-enabled activities; E.O. 13902, which targets certain sectors of the Iranian economy, and E.O. 13224, as amended, a counterterrorism authority. For more information about today’s actions, see the RFJ website , the Department of State’s fact sheet and Treasury’s press release .

items.title: Somalia Plans New Drone and Military Bases While Political Instability Deepens
items.description: Mogadishu – (WDN)— The Federal Government of Somalia is reportedly preparing to establish military bases and drone command centers in three strategically important cities across central and southern Somalia, as part of efforts to strengthen its security capabilities and prepare for any further reduction or eventual withdrawal of African Union forces under AUSSOM. The plan reportedly includes deploying units of the Somali National Army, particularly the Gorgor special forces, to areas in South West State where Ethiopian troops are currently providing security. The objective is to enable Somali forces to assume greater responsibility for securing key population centers and strategic locations. The proposed drone facilities is said to provide local forces with surveillance, reconnaissance and intelligence capabilities, to reduce dependence on Mogadishu for operational support. The government has also increased the use of drones at night to monitor conflict zones and other strategically important areas. On paper, the strategy represents an important effort to strengthen Somalia’s national security architecture. A stronger Somali military, better intelligence capabilities and greater operational independence are essential if the country is to assume full responsibility for its security. But drones, military bases and armed forces cannot solve a political crisis. The government is attempting to expand its military and technological capabilities at a time when Somalia is facing an unprecedented constitutional and electoral confrontation. Disputes over the constitutional order, the electoral framework, federal-state relations and the legitimacy of the political process remain unresolved. More fundamentally, the government is operating under a contested and expired mandate, making the question of political legitimacy inseparable from the question of national security. The deeper crisis is therefore not simply whether the Somali Army has enough drones, bases or weapons. It is whether the institutions commanding those forces possess the constitutional and political legitimacy required to deploy them. This distinction is critical. A government can acquire sophisticated surveillance technology, establish military installations and deploy elite forces across the country, but none of these measures can substitute for constitutional consensus, credible elections, accountable institutions and public trust. The security challenge is further complicated by the continuing controversy over land and property in Mogadishu and other parts of the country. The large-scale appropriation, demolition and alleged commercialization of public and privately occupied land have become one of the defining controversies surrounding the current administration. For thousands of ordinary Somalis, the issue is not abstract constitutional theory. It is the loss of homes, displacement of families and the feeling that state institutions have been used against citizens rather than to protect them. That creates a dangerous contradiction: the government is investing in more powerful instruments of coercion while its political legitimacy and public confidence remain deeply contested. Military power is most effective when it operates within a legitimate constitutional order. Without that foundation, even a well-equipped army risks becoming entangled in political disputes that it was never designed to resolve. The proposed drone network may therefore strengthen Somalia’s capacity to confront Al-Shabaab and other security threats, but it cannot resolve the country’s constitutional crisis. Nor can it settle disputes between the Federal Government and Federal Member States, determine the legitimacy of electoral arrangements, or restore public confidence damaged by allegations of corruption and land grabbing. Somalia needs both security and legitimacy. It needs a capable national army, but it also needs institutions that command public confidence. It needs drones to protect its citizens, but it also needs a political system that protects their constitutional rights. As the country approaches another decisive political moment, the central question should not simply be how many drones Somalia possesses or how many military bases it can establish. The more consequential question is whether those capabilities will serve a constitutional state whose authority derives from a credible political process—or become instruments of a government struggling to defend its legitimacy after its mandate has expired. Weapons can secure territory. Drones can provide intelligence. Armies can fight insurgencies. But none of them can manufacture constitutional legitimacy, democratic consent or public trust. Those must be earned through law, accountability and a credible electoral process. items.title: Somaliland Moves to Disarm Tribal Militias as Tensions Persist in the West
items.description: Hargeisa –(WDN)— Somaliland authorities have launched security operations in the Awdal and Salal regions, seizing weapons and military vehicles from groups involved in recent clan fighting, in a renewed effort to prevent armed militias from re-emerging and reigniting conflict. The military displayed some of the vehicles and weapons recovered during the operations, warning that civilians and clan groups will not be permitted to maintain illegal stockpiles of weapons or operate military vehicles outside the authority of the state. Military commanders said they had been instructed to take firm action against anyone who openly carries weapons or attempts to revive the recent clan conflict in western Somaliland. The operations follow the breakdown of a recently negotiated peace agreement between the communities involved in the fighting. The agreement called for a ceasefire, the withdrawal of armed groups and an end to actions that could trigger a renewed confrontation. Under the arrangement, security forces were tasked with helping maintain peace and preventing armed groups from using weapons to restart hostilities. The conflict in western Somaliland began in November 2025, after a dispute over a planned public presentation in Zeila concerning the Xeer Ciise , a traditional customary legal code of the Issa community. The proposed event was opposed by other communities living in the area, eventually contributing to a broader confrontation. The latest military operations are intended to remove weapons from the hands of rival groups and demonstrate that peace agreements will be backed by state authority rather than left to the goodwill of armed factions. A Different Approach to Clan Conflict The crackdown also highlights a fundamental difference between Somaliland’s approach to armed clan disputes and the situation in much of Somalia, where weapons are widely available and clan-based armed groups can operate with considerable freedom. In Mogadishu, for example, firearms are widely visible and weapons are reportedly traded openly in parts of the capital’s markets. Across Somalia, political and clan disputes frequently become intertwined with armed mobilization, making it difficult for the state to establish a monopoly over the use of force. Somaliland’s authorities, by contrast, have sought to maintain a policy that tribal militias cannot simply roam the country carrying heavy weapons or operate independently of the state. That policy has been a major element of Somaliland’s relative security and stability over the years. Whatever the political disputes surrounding Somaliland, its authorities have generally treated the uncontrolled proliferation of clan militias as a direct threat to state authority and public security. The current operations in Awdal and Salal therefore carry significance beyond the immediate dispute. They represent an attempt to prevent a temporary clan confrontation from developing into a permanent armed structure in which communities maintain their own military forces. The challenge, however, is not simply to confiscate weapons. Lasting peace will depend on whether the authorities can combine disarmament with credible political dialogue, impartial law enforcement and mechanisms for resolving the underlying grievances that produced the conflict in the first place. Somaliland’s government has repeatedly warned that it will not tolerate attempts to restart clan warfare or the illegal possession of weapons and military vehicles. For communities that have already experienced violence, the message is straightforward: peace agreements cannot survive if armed factions remain free to rearm. The success of the latest campaign will ultimately be measured not by the number of weapons displayed at military headquarters, but by whether those weapons remain out of the hands of clan militias—and whether Awdal and Salal can finally move beyond the cycle of confrontation that has threatened their communities. items.title: Deni Breaks His Silence on Nugaal Coast Strikes, Demands Law Over Force
items.description: Garowe –(WDN)— Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni has spoken publicly for the first time about the airstrikes reported along the coast of Nugaal, expressing regret over how the operations were carried out and insisting that suspected criminals must be dealt with through the law rather than force outside established legal procedures. Speaking at a public gathering in Jariiban, Mudug region, Deni addressed the deteriorating security situation in Puntland, including the strikes reported in recent days against locations allegedly linked to suspected Somali pirates. “We are not satisfied with what happened. I am deeply saddened by it,” Deni said, stressing that anyone accused of committing a crime should be subjected to a lawful process rather than being dealt with through extrajudicial measures. His remarks come amid growing uncertainty over who carried out the strikes, who authorized them and what intelligence was used to identify the targets. The attacks have generated considerable concern among coastal communities, particularly after reports that civilians and fishermen may have been caught up in the operations. Deni’s intervention adds a new political dimension to an already murky episode. While Puntland has previously voiced concern over the reported strikes, the president’s latest comments appear to draw a clear line between combating piracy and the methods used to pursue suspected perpetrators. His message was that criminal activity cannot be an excuse for abandoning due process. But Deni also acknowledged a deeper problem confronting Puntland: the involvement of local young people in activities allegedly linked to piracy. He urged traditional elders and community leaders to take greater responsibility for addressing the issue before it becomes more difficult to contain. “If we fail to deal with the young men, it will become a problem,” Deni warned, emphasizing that those involved are members of the local communities and require a clear strategy rather than simply military action. The president argued that responsibility cannot rest solely with security agencies. Families, elders and community leaders, he said, must work together to prevent young people from becoming involved in piracy and other forms of insecurity. His comments come at a particularly sensitive moment. The reported strikes have raised unanswered questions about the presence and activities of foreign military assets along Puntland’s coastline. Puntland has demanded greater clarity over the operations, while Turkey has said it has no information regarding the reported strikes. That denial has only added to the uncertainty surrounding the incident. For coastal communities, however, the issue is becoming increasingly immediate. Fishing families fear that military operations targeting suspected pirates could turn legitimate fishing grounds into dangerous zones, particularly if intelligence is inaccurate or civilian vessels are mistaken for hostile targets. Deni’s remarks therefore appear to send two messages simultaneously: Puntland will not tolerate piracy, but neither will it accept the use of force as a substitute for justice. The unanswered questions remain significant. Who ordered the strikes? Who supplied the intelligence? Who identified the targets? Were the operations authorized by Somali authorities? And, most importantly, were the people hit actually pirates—or innocent civilians caught in the crossfire? Until those questions are answered, the mystery surrounding the Nugaal coastline strikes is unlikely to disappear. For now, Deni has made his position clear: crime must be confronted, but justice must not be bombed out of existence. items.title: Ciidamada Laftagareen oo caqabad ku noqon kara qorshaha lagu furayo Xerada Manaas
items.description: Ciidamada Mucaaradka Koonfur Galbeed ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa laga cabsi qabaa inay la wareegaan Xeradii Militariga Manaas ee Gobolka Baay, taas oo caqabad ku noqon karta qorshaha socda ee dib loogu furayo xeradaasi. Xeradan oo 30km dhinaca waqooyi galbeed uga beegan Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa waxay ku taallaa jidka weyn ee ka baxa magaaladaasi ee aada Degmooyinka Qansaxdheere iyo Diinsoor. Xerada ayaa dhacda goob istiraatiiji ah oo xakameysa ama suurtagelisa in lala socdo dhaqdhaqaaqa gaadiidka iyo ciidamada ee u kala gooshaya Degmooyinka Gobolka Baay iyo gobolada deriska la ah. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in qaar ka mid ah ciidamada taageersan Ex Madaxweyne Cabdicasiis Laftagareen ay ku sugan yihiin meel u dhow Xerada Manaas. Xerada Manaas ayaa xilligii Dowladdii Dhexe ahayd mid ka mid ah xeryaha ugu weyn ee lagu tababaro Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Gobolada Koonfureed, waxaana goobta deganaa guutooyin ka tirsan militariga. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud iyo Taliyaha Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee TURKSOM ee duleedka Magaalada Muqdisho, General Sebahattin Kalkan ayaa 2-dii bishan tegay Magaalada Baydhabo, iyaga oo waday qorshe dib loogu furayay xeradaasi iyo xeryo kale oo ku yaala Gobolka Baay, iyadoona uu ujeedku yahay in la helo xeryo cusub oo lagu tababaro ciidamada, si Somaliya ay uga gudubto baahida ciidan iyo ku tiirsanaanta Ciidanka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Saraakiisha Xarunta Taliska Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Baydhabo ayaa kuu sheegaya in ay jirto cabsi laga qabo in taageereyaasha Laftagareen ay qabsadaan Xerada Manaas amaba ay deggaan hareeraheeda. Saraakiisha ayaa ku waramaya in tani ay dhibaato ku noqon karto dadaalada dib loogu furayo xeradaasi, oo la doonayo in lagu tababaro ciidamada, si loo soo saaro ciidamo cusub oo ka qayb qaata difaaca dalka. Xeradan ayaa la doonaya in si gaar ah loogu tababaro cutubyada ku biiraya Ciidanka Qaybta 60aad ee Xoogga Dalka ee maleeshiyada Al Shabaab kula dagaalamaya Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose, Baay iyo Bakool. Qaybtan ayaa waxay illaa iyo hadda ka kooban tahay Saddex Guuto, oo kala ah Guutooyinka 6aad, 8aad iyo 9aad oo ka hawlgala Gobolada Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, kuwaas oo taliska laga xukumo uu ku yaalo Magaalada Baydhabo. Turkiga oo ah saaxiibka ugu weyn ee Dowladda Federaalka ka taageera arrimaha amniga, dhismaha Ciidamada Qalabka Sida iyo tayayntooda ayaa hadda Villa Somalia kala shaqeynayay, sidii dib loogu furi lahaa Xerada Manaas, waxayna arrintan ku soo aadeysaa xilli xasaasi ah oo dhibaatooyin amni iyo kuwo siyaasadeed ay ka jiraan Koonfur Galbeed. Ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen ayaa la sheegaa inay si firfircoon u joogaan deegaanada qaar ee ku xeeran Magaalada Baydhabo, oo ay ku yaallaan xarumaha uu maamulku ku shaqeeyo.

items.title: Wasiirka arimaha guduhu xilka uu la dhamaysanayaa madaxweynaha
items.description: WASIIRKA ARRIMAHA GUDUHU XILKA WUU LA DHAMAYSANAYAA C/CIRRO EE BEENTA DADKA KA DAAYA SIYAASIYIINTOOW. Sideedaba wasaaradda arrimaha guduhu waa meeshii ugu hadalhaynta iyo dhaleecaynta badnayd intay Somaliland jirtay wasiiradii soo maray qaarbbaa iska casilay markay qayladii waraabeyaasha siyaasiga ah xamiliwaayeen. Wasaaraddu waa halbawlihii waddanka waxa ka socota shaqo adag oo culayskeeda leh, wasiirkan maanta jooga iyo kii ka horreeyayba waxay la kulmeen dagaallo lagu wiiqayo aqoonsiga kuwaas oo ay dabada ka wadaan dawlado waaweyn oo adeegsanaya soomaliya iyo Jabuuti oo si qaawan ula dagaallamaya S/land. Waxay qaybta ugu weyn ee dagaalka abaabulaya siyaasiyiin iyo qurbbojoog danaysteyaal ah oo aan cidna u naxayn. Dadka reer S/land waxa la gudboon inaanay cadowga codbaahiye u noqonin oo ay madaxdooda ixtiraamaan, cabdalle maxamad carab inta Cirro uu joogo wuu joogayaa, waana nin shaqadiisa ka adag oo duruufo adag dalka kala dabbaashay ee hallala shaqeeyo. MAHADSANID. CABDI BACAW. GUUL ALLE. LONDON.

items.title: COSOBLE oo dalbaday in hal arrin la weydiiyo Kheyre ka hor inta aan xil lagu aaminin
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee HirShabelle Cali Cabdullaahi Cosoble ayaa weerar siyaasadeed oo culus ku qaaday Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya Xasan Cali Kheyre, isaga oo sheegay in Kheyre ay tahay inuu marka hore ka jawaabo rikoodhkiisii xukuumadeed ka hor inta aanu isu soo bandhigin inuu xal u hayo dhibaatooyinka dalka. Cosoble ayaa qoraal uu daabacay kaga jawaabay maqaal uu dhowaan Kheyre ku sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan awoodin “muddo kale oo hanti luntay”, kaas oo Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore si weyn ugu dhaliilay xaaladda dhaqaale iyo hab-maamulka dowladda hadda jirta. Kheyre ayaa qoraalkiisa ku baaqay in hoggaamiyeyaasha lagu qiimeeyo natiijooyinka ay keenaan, halkii lagu saleyn lahaa ballanqaadyada ay sameeyaan. Cosoble ayaa sheegay inuu mabda’aas ku raacsan yahay Kheyre, balse wuxuu ku adkeystay in isla halbeeggaas lagu dabaqo dadka mar kale doonaya inay Soomaaliya hoggaamiyaan. “Halbeeggaas waa inuu si isku mid ah u khuseeyaa kuwa doonaya inay mar kale Soomaaliya hoggaamiyaan,” ayuu Cosoble ku yiri qoraalkiisa. Waxa uu xusay in Kheyre uu Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya ahaa intii u dhaxeysay 2017 iyo 2020, isaga oo sheegay in ka hor inta aanu isu soo bandhigin inuu xal u yahay dhibaatooyinka Soomaaliya ay tahay in la qiimeeyo waxqabadkiisii muddadaas. Cosoble ayaa si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqay arrimo ay kamid yihiin amniga, awoodda dowladda iyo federaalka, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay qeyb ka yihiin meelaha ay tahay in lagu qiimeeyo rikoodhkii Kheyre. Weerarkiisa ayaa si toos ah u rogaya doodda uu Kheyre ku furay dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isaga oo Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore weydiinaya inuu isaguna isla xisaabtanka uu madaxda kale ka dalbanayo ku dabaqo xilligii uu awoodda hayey. Khilaaf hore oo labada dhinac ah Weerarka cusub wuxuu sidoo kale dib u soo nooleynayaa taariikh siyaasadeed oo hore uga dhexeysay Cosoble iyo Kheyre. Cosoble ayaa ahaa madaxweynihii ugu horreeyey ee HirShabelle, waxaana xilka loo doortay bishii Oktoobar 2016. Baarlamaanka HirShabelle ayaa 14-kii Agoosto 2017 xilka kaga qaaday mooshin kalsooni kala noqosho ah, wax ka yar sanad kadib markii la doortay. Kheyre ayaa xilligaas ahaa Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya. Maalmo kadib xil-ka-qaadistiisa, Cosoble wuxuu si cad ugu eedeeyey Kheyre inuu ka dambeeyey dadaalladii xilka looga qaaday, isagoo markaas sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay faragelin ku sameysay arrimaha HirShabelle. Eedeyntaas waxay qeyb ka ahayd khilaaf ballaaran oo xilligaas ka dhex jiray dowladda federaalka iyo qaar kamid ah maamul-goboleedyada. Warbixin uu markii dambe soo saaray Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa xustay eedeymo ay madaxda qaar ee dowlad-goboleedyadu u jeediyeen xubno ka tirsan dowladda federaalka oo ku saabsan isku-dayo lagu wiiqayo maamulladooda. Cosoble ayaa hadda dooddaas hore ku dhex daraya qiimeyntiisa hoggaamineed ee Kheyre, inkastoo qoraalkiisa cusub uu ka ballaaran yahay khilaafkii HirShabelle oo uu diiradda saarayo guud ahaan waxqabadkii xukuumaddii uu Kheyre hoggaaminayey. ‘Natiijooyinka ha lagu qiimeeyo’ Kheyre ayaa maqaal uu 18-kii Agoosto qoray ku sheegay in xaaladda dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya ay sii xumaatay, isaga oo dowladda hadda jirta ku eedeeyey maamul-xumo, musuqmaasuq iyo awood-darro hay’adeed. Waxa uu ku dooday in guusha dowlad lagu cabbiro waxa shacabka caadiga ahi ka dareemaan noloshooda iyo jeebkooda, wuxuuna sheegay inuu isaguna diyaar u yahay in halbeeggaas lagu qiimeeyo haddii uu mar kale dalka hoggaamiyo. Cosoble ayaa taas ku soo celiyey Kheyre. Waxa uu sheegay in haddii Kheyre doonayo in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay madaxda ku qiimeeyaan natiijooyinka, ay marka hore tahay in isla su’aasha la weydiiyo: maxay ahaayeen natiijooyinkii saddexdii sano iyo dheeraadka ahayd ee uu Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ahaa? Cosoble ayaa cinwaanka qoraalkiisa ku sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan awoodin “muddo kale oo hoggaan fashilmay”, isagoo si ula kac ah uga hor keenay weedha Kheyre ee ahayd in dalku aanu awoodin “muddo kale oo hanti luntay”. Weerarka ayaa imanaya xilli loollanka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya uu sii xoogeysanayo, isla markaana siyaasiyiinta hore xilalka u soo qabtay ay mar kale bilaabayaan inay soo bandhigaan aragtidooda ku aaddan hoggaanka dalka. The post COSOBLE oo dalbaday in hal arrin la weydiiyo Kheyre ka hor inta aan xil lagu aaminin appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha oo Muqdisho ku yeeshay Madal Ganacsi iyo Maalgashi
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho si rasmi ah uga furay Madasha Isku-xirka Ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, oo ay soo qaban-qaabisay Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha. Madasha waxaa ka qeyb galay wasiirro ka tirsan Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, safiirrada Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, Rugta Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliyeed, Rugta Ganacsiga Afrika iyo Shiinaha, iyo ganacsato iyo maalgashadeyaal ka kala socday labada dal. Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka ayaa ugu baaqay shirkadaha iyo maalgashadayaasha Shiinaha inay ka faa’iideystaan fursadaha maalgashi ee ka jira Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, wax-soo-saarka, kalluumaysiga, beeraha, tamarta, gaadiidka iyo saadka. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sheegtay in iskaashiga ganacsi ee Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha uu yahay fursad lagu soo jiidan karo maalgashi shisheeye, lagu abuuri karo shaqooyin cusub, laguna kobcin karo wax-soo-saarka gudaha. Madashan ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u noqon karta in ganacsatada labada dal ay si toos ah isugu xirmaan, isla markaana la abuuro iskaashi ganacsi oo ka gudba heerka hadallada una gudba maalgashi iyo mashaariic wax-ku-ool ah oo gudaha Soomaaliya laga hirgeliyo. Soomaaliya oo leh xeeb dheer, dhul beereed, kheyraad dabiici ah iyo baahi weyn oo loo qabo kaabayaal dhaqaale ayaa doonaysa inay dalka ka dhigto meel ay maalgashadayaasha caalamiga ah ka helaan fursado ganacsi oo cusub.

Madasha waxaa ka qeyb galay wasiirro ka tirsan Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, safiirrada Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, Rugta Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliyeed, Rugta Ganacsiga Afrika iyo Shiinaha, iyo ganacsato iyo maalgashadeyaal ka kala socday labada dal. Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka ayaa ugu baaqay shirkadaha iyo maalgashadayaasha Shiinaha inay ka faa’iideystaan fursadaha maalgashi ee ka jira Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, wax-soo-saarka, kalluumaysiga, beeraha, tamarta, gaadiidka iyo saadka. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sheegtay in iskaashiga ganacsi ee Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha uu yahay fursad lagu soo jiidan karo maalgashi shisheeye, lagu abuuri karo shaqooyin cusub, laguna kobcin karo wax-soo-saarka gudaha. items.title: Nabadda Soomaaliya oo si toos ah ugu xiran amniga iyo xasilloonida dalal kale oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Cutubka Booliska Nigeria ee howl-galka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), Ibraahim Laba ayaa sheegay in nabadda iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya ay si dhow ugu xiran yihiin amniga guud ee qaaradda Afrika. Ibraahim Laba oo hoggaamiya cutubka 13-aad ee booliska Nigeria ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay magaalada Muqdisho, oo ciidamada dalkiisa ay qeyb uga yihiin howl-galka AUSSOM. Cutubka booliska Nigeria ayaa ka howl-gala saldhigga Al-Jazeera II ee Muqdisho, halkaas oo ay sidoo kale ku sugan yihiin ciidamada Uganda ee qeybta ka ah howl-galka Midowga Afrika. “Annaga oo Nigerian ah, waxaan ognahay inaanan weligeen nabad dhab ah ka heli karin dalkeenna haddii Soomaaliya aysan nabad helin,” ayuu yiri Kormeere Sare Ibraahim Laba. Taliyaha ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Nigeria ay Soomaaliya u joogaan inay gacan ka geystaan sugidda amniga, ilaalinta kala dambeynta, roondooyinka wadajirka ah ee ay la sameeyaan ciidanka booliska Soomaaliyeed iyo ilaalinta xarumaha iyo shaqaalaha AUSSOM iyo Qaramada Midoobay. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay in amniga dalalka Afrika uu yahay mid isku xiran, isla markaana khataraha amni ee ka jira Soomaaliya ay si toos ah ama si dadban u saameyn karaan dalalka kale ee gobolka iyo qaaradda. Ibraahim Laba ayaa tilmaamay in iskaashiga u dhexeeya ciidamada dalalka Afrika ee qeybta ka ah AUSSOM iyo hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya uu muhiim u yahay sidii loo gaari lahaa xasillooni waarta. “Ciidamadeenna waxay si gaar ah uga qeyb qaataan roondooyinka iyo howlaha amniga, waxayna si wadajir ah ula shaqeeya booliska Soomaaliyeed si loo xoojiyo amniga goobaha muhiimka ah ee Muqdisho,” ayuu yiri Taliyaha cutubka booliska Nigeria ee howl-galka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Taliyaha ayaa xusay inuu si shaqsi ah u hoggaamiyay qaar ka mid ah roondooyinka laga sameeyay qeybo ka mid ah Muqdisho, isagoo tilmaamay in ciidamada ay doonayaan inay gaaraan goobaha ay adag tahay in si joogto ah loo tago. Howlaha booliska Nigeria ayaa qeyb ka ah taageerada AUSSOM ay siiso dowladda Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xoojinta hay’adaha amniga iyo sare u qaadista awoodda booliska Soomaaliyeed ee sugidda amniga iyo ilaalinta shacabka. Hadallada taliyaha ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada gudaha, iyadoo AUSSOM ay door muhiim ah ka qaadanayso taageerada hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya iyo diyaarinta ciidamada dalka si ay mustaqbalka si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga. items.title: DF oo soo gaba-gabeysay taageeradii ay ka heli jirtay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah u soo gaba-gabeysay howlihii UNTMIS ee taageerada dhinacyada caddaaladda iyo adeegyada xabsiyada. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Soomaaliya, Xasan Macallin Maxamuud ayaa ka qeyb-galay kulan lagu soo xirayay barnaamijkii taageerada ee Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee KMG ah ee Soomaaliya (UNTMIS). Kulanka waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb-galay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowlad-goboleedyada, wakiillo ka socday Qaramada Midoobay iyo UNTMIS, hay’adaha caddaaladda iyo asluubta iyo bah-wadaagta taageerta Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Caddaaladda ayaa uga mahadceliyay Qaramada Midoobay, UNTMIS iyo bah-wadaagta kale taageerada ay Soomaaliya ka siiyeen horumarinta hay’adaha caddaaladda iyo adeegyada xabsiyada. Xasan Macallin ayaa sidoo kale xusay kaalinta ay taageeradaasi ka qaadatay dhismaha awoodda hay’adaha dowladda iyo xoojinta ku dhaqanka sarreynta sharciga, isagoo tilmaamay in horumarka la gaaray uu muhiim u yahay nidaamka caddaaladda dalka. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in soo afjaridda howlihii UNTMIS ay Soomaaliya u tahay marxalad muhiim ah oo lagu sii xoojinayo mas’uuliyadda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, taas oo u baahan in la sii amba-qaado dadaallada lagu horumarinayo hay’adaha qaranka. Wuxuu adkeeyay in aqoonta, khibradda iyo awoodda hay’adaha la horumariyay intii ay UNTMIS ka shaqeynaysay Soomaaliya ay noqon doonaan saldhig lagu sii horumariyo nidaamka caddaaladda iyo adeegyada xabsiyada dalka. Ugu dambeyntiina, Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay inay sii waddo horumarinta nidaamka caddaaladda, xoojinta hay’adaha qaranka iyo ka faa’iideysiga horumarradii laga sameeyay intii ay UNTMIS ka shaqeynaysay Soomaaliya. items.title: DEG-DEG: Madaxweyne Deni oo Gaaray Dhinowda, Xiisadna Ka Dhalatay
items.description: Mudug (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Dowladda Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa gaaray deegaanka Dhinowda ee bariga Gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo uu ku marayo socdaal la xiriira xaaladda deegaanka iyo bulshada. Dhinowda ayaa kamid ah deegaannada ay si weyn u saameeyeen isbeddelka cimilada iyo bacaadka, iyadoo qaybo badan oo deegaanka ah uu bacaad daboolay, taasoo saameyn ku yeelatay nolosha dadka iyo deegaanka. Dhinowda ayaa sidoo kale kamid ahayd deegaannadii ay ka dhacday doorashadii qof iyo cod ee Puntland. Dhanka kale, socdaalka Madaxweyne Deni ayaa dhaliyay muran siyaasadeed iyo maamul, iyadoo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Galmudug ay cambaareeyeen booqashada, isla markaana ay sheegeen in deegaanka Dhinowda uu ka tirsan yahay Galmudug. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Puntland iyo Galmudug ay weli isku hayaan maamulka iyo xuduudaha qaybo kamid ah Gobolka Mudug, taasoo mararka qaar dhalisa xiisado siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni. items.title: The President of the University of Hargeisa welcomed a delegation of researchers from Israeli
items.description: The President of the University of Hargeisa, Dr. Mohamed Ahmed Sulub, welcomed a delegation of researchers from Israeli universities. The delegation was led by Prof. Zohar Amar of Bar-Ilan University and included Dr. Yaron Serri of the Open University of Israel 🇮🇱 and Mr. Elron Zabatani of Ariel University. Vice President for Academic Affairs, Dr. Fuad Abdi Obsiye, also attended the meeting. The discussions focused on academic and research collaboration, including opportunities for joint projects and knowledge sharing. (Wow) During their visit, the researchers worked with the University of Hargeisa Biodiversity Center to conduct field research across different parts of Somaliland. Their work examined traditional medicinal practices, ethnopharmacological knowledge, related markets, and the diversity and distribution of incense-producing plants. The visit marks an important step toward expanding international research partnerships, academic exchanges, and collaborative biodiversity research between the University of Hargeisa and the participating Israeli universities.

items.title: UPDATE: Ciidamada Turkiga oo Si Dhow ula Socda Markabka M/V LUTUF
items.description: Xeebaha Puntland (Raxanreeb Online): Ciidamada Turkiga ayaa weli si dhow ula socda markabka M/V LUTUF, oo ay kooxo burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ka afduubteen xeebaha Puntland, iyadoo wararku sheegayaan in markabku siday qalab isgaarsiineed iyo agab kale oo loogu talagalay howlaha Turkiga ee Soomaaliya. Sida xogaha la helayo tilmaamayaan, laba markab oo laga leeyahay Turkiga ayaa ku dhowaaday goobta uu markabka LUTUF ku sugan yahay, halka diyaarado helicopter ah iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo Turki ah ay sameeyeen kormeer dhanka cirka ah. M/V LUTUF, oo ku safraya calanka Cameroon, ayaa la sheegay in 17-kii Agoosto 2026 lagu qabsaday meel u dhow xeebta Marraya ee degmada Eyl, kadib markii siddeed nin oo hubeysan ay la wareegeen. Markabka ayaa markii dambe loo kaxeeyay dhinaca xeebaha Nugaal. Waxaa la sheegay in xilliga afduubka ay saarnaayeen 10 shaqaale ah, oo ay ku jiraan lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Joorjiyaan ah iyo laba ilaalo oo Serbian ah. Dowladda Hindiya ayaa horey u sheegtay in badmaaxiinta Hindida ah ay badqabaan, iyadoo xaaladdooda si dhow loola socdo. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kaddib markii la sheegay in doon yar oo sahay u geysay kooxaha markabka haysta ay dib ugu laabatay xeebta, waxaana xigay duqeyn cirka ah oo lagu soo warramay in lagu dilay afar qof, halka laba kalena lagu dhaawacay. Si kastaba, cidda fulisay duqeynta weli si rasmi ah looma xaqiijin, mana cadda in dhammaan dadka la beegsaday ay ka tirsanaayeen burcad-badeedda gacanta ku haysa M/V LUTUF. Xaaladda markabka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada Turkiga ayaa weli ah kuwo xasaasi ah, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo tallaabada xigta ee laga qaadi doono xeebaha Nugaal. items.title: Iskaashi-La’aanta DFS iyo Maamullada oo Firaaqo Amni u Furay Soo Laabashada Burcad-Badeedda
items.description: Kala-qaybsanaanta siyaasadeed iyo wada-shaqeyn la’aanta u dhaxaysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowlad-goboleedyada ayaa loo arkaa sababta ugu weyn ee fursadda u siisay kooxihii burcad-badeedda inay dib uga soo kiciyaan howlgalladoodii marin-biyoodka dalka, sida lagu sheegay falanqayn cusub oo ay soo saartay Kooxda Caalamiga ah ee Xasaradaha (ICG). Tan iyo bishii Abriil, kooxahan ayaa gacanta ku dhigay ilaa lix markab oo ganacsi, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah roondooyinkii ilaalada badda loo leexiyay goobo kale sababo la xiriira xaaladaha amni ee waqooyiga dalka iyo maraakiibta oo marinnadoodii u weeciyay dhanka koonfureed. items.title: Turkiga oo Iska Fogeeyay Duqeyntii Ka Dhacday Xeebaha Puntland ee Lagu Dilay Sagaalka Qof
items.description: Dowladda Turkiga ayaa shaacisay inaysan wax xog ah ama war ah ka haynin duqeymo dhanka cirka ah oo ka dhacay xeebaha maamul-goboleedka Puntland, halkaas oo lagu dilay dad isugu jiray kalluumeysato iyo shakhsiyaad looga shakisan yahay inay ka tirsanaayeen kooxaha burcad-badeedda Soomaalida. Sarkaal ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Turkiga ayaa u sheegay warbaahinta in dowladdiisu aysan waxba ka ogeyn weerarrada ay diyaaradaha dagaalku ka fuliyeen xeebaha Puntland. Duqeymahan ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay ka socday aagga lagu haysto markabka xamuulka qaada ee MV Latuf, kaas oo la sheegay inuu u rarnaa dalka Turkiga ka hor inta aysan burcad-badeeddu gacanta ku dhigin. Dhanka kale, Maamulka Puntland ayaa si adag u cambaareeyay duqeyntaas oo shalay deegaanka Jiifle ee hoos yimaada Godobjiraan ee Gobolka Nugaal ku dishay 9 qof. Wasiir ku-xigeenka Warfaafinta Puntland, Bile Maxamuud Qabowsade, ayaa sheegay in dilalka noocan ah ee aan maxkamad la horgeyn ay ka horimaanayaan shuruucda caalamiga ah, isagoo ku adkeeyay in xitaa haddii dadkaasi dambiilayaal ahaayeen ay ahayd in loo maro habraac sharci ah. Weerarradan cirka ah ayaa cabsi xooggan ku beeray dadka shacabka ah ee ku nool tuulooyinka iyo xeebaha ku dhow goobaha la garaacay, waxaana la soo warinayaa in qoysas badan ay ka barakaceen guryahoodii iyaga oo ka baqaya in duqeymo kale ay haleelaan.

items.title: Sawirro: Madal isku xiraysa Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha oo laga furay Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-Xigeenka Soomaaliya, Mudane Saalax Axmed Jaamac ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u furay Madasha Isku-xirka Ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, taas oo ka furantay magaalada Muqdisho. Furitaanka madasha ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay wasiirro ka tirsan Xukuumadda Soomaaliya, Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Shiinaha iyo kan Shiinaha ee Soomaaliya, Rugta Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliyeed, Rugta Ganacsiga Afrika iyo Shiinaha, iyo ganacsato iyo maalgashadeyaal ka kala socda Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha. Mudane Saalax Axmed Jaamac ayaa ku dhiirrageliyey shirkadaha iyo maalgashadeyaasha Shiinaha in ay ka faa’iidaystaan fursadaha maalgashi ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, waxsoosaarka, kalluumaysiga, beeraha, tamarta, gaadiidka iyo saadka. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray muhiimadda ay leedahay in iskaashiga ganacsi uu horseedo shaqo-abuur iyo kor u qaadista waxsoosaarka gudaha. Si kastaba, Madashan ayaa qayb ka ah hindisayaasha Xukuumadda Dan Qaran ku ballaarinayso xiriirka ganacsi iyo maalgashi ee Soomaaliya iyo dalalka caalamka, lagu na abuurayo xiriir toos ah oo dhex mara ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed iyo suuqyada caalamka, iyada oo sidoo kale xoogga la saarayo kordhinta badeecadaha Soomaaliyeed ee loo dhoofiyo suuqyada dibadda. Sidoo kale, Madasha ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh sidii loo abuuri lahaa xiriir toos ah oo dhex mara ganacsatada labada dal, loogana wada hadli lahaa caqabadaha hortaagan maalgashiga iyo sidii loo heli lahaa fursado cusub oo ganacsi. Shiinaha ayaa ka mid ah dalalka muhiimka u ah dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo labada dhinac ay muddo dheer lahaayeen xiriir diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashi dhinacyo kala duwan ah. Ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidoo kale si weyn ula macaamila suuqyada Shiinaha, halka badeecooyin badan oo Soomaaliya laga isticmaalo ay kasoo galaan dalkaas. items.title: Ciidamo cusub oo ku biiray ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Laftagareen
items.description: Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Xasan Cabdiqaadir Maxamed, Afhayeenkii hore ee Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed iyo xubno kale ayaa duleedka Magaalada Baydhabo ku soo bandhigay ciidamo cusub oo ku biiraya ciidamada taageersan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Ciidamadan ayaa waxaa la sheegay inay ka yimaadeen Degmada Doolow ee Gobolka Gedo, isla-markaana ay ka qayb qaadanayaan hawlgalka lagu xoreynayo Magaalada Baydhabo. Xasan Cabdiqaadir Maxamed, Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga ee Maamulkii Cabdicasiis Laftagareen ayaa laga soo xigtay in ciidamadan ay ku shaqeynayaan amarka Madaxweyne Laftagareen. Saraakiisha iyo siyaasiyiinta deegaanka ee la safan Laftagareen ayaan aqoonsaneyn doorashadii 10-kii bishii June ka dhacday Magaalada Baydhabo ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) loogu doortay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Mucaaradka ayaa waxay ku doodayaan in Laftagareen uu weli yahay Madaxweyne Koonfur Galbeed, isla-markaana xoog looga qaaday xilka, xoogna ay dib ugu soo celinayaan.

items.title: Villa Somalia Bows to Court Ruling as Galmudug Heads Back to Polls
items.description: MOGADISHU—Somalia’s Federal Government has agreed to rerun parliamentary and local council elections in Galmudug after the Supreme Court annulled the results of the regional polls held on 30 July 2026, according to reports. The decision was reportedly made at a high-level meeting chaired by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud on Monday night. Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre, the Director of the National Intelligence and Security Agency, the Secretary-General of the Justice and Solidarity Party, the Minister of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation, and other senior officials attended the meeting. The Supreme Court ruled on Monday that the simultaneous elections for Galmudug’s House of Representatives and local councils had not been conducted in accordance with Somalia’s Constitution and electoral laws. The Court declared that the results had no legal validity. It also ordered the Independent National Electoral and Boundaries Commission to organise fresh elections within the earliest practicable timeframe, in full compliance with the Constitution and applicable electoral legislation. Reports from the meeting indicate that the Federal Government is preparing to implement the ruling. An official timetable and further details on the procedures for the new elections are expected to be announced in the coming days. items.title: Bankiga Adduunka oo shirkad Kenyan ah ka mamnuucay mashaariicda Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Bangiga Adduunka ayaa shirkadda teknoolojiyadda ee Kenya laga leeyahay ee Webmasters Kenya Limited ka mamnuucday inay ka qayb qaadato mashaariicda uu maalgeliyo Bangiga muddo aan ka yarayn shan sano. Go’aanka ayaa yimid kaddib baaritaan lagu sameeyay habraacyadii la xiriiray laba mashruuc oo Bangiga Adduunku ka maalgeliyay Soomaaliya, iyadoo guddiga cuna-qabateynta Bangiga uu sheegay in shirkadda iyo mas’uulkeeda, James Ayugi lagu helay wax isdaba marin ama khiyaano. Sida lagu sheegay natiijada baaritaanka, Webmasters Kenya Limited ayaa si khaldan u sheegtay in laba khabiir oo muhiim ah ay diyaar u yihiin inay ka shaqeeyaan qandaraasyo hoos yimaada mashaariicda Soomaaliya. Bangiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in shirkaddu ay adeegsatay taariikh-nololeedyada ama CV-yada khubaradaas iyada oo aan oggolaansho laga haysan, taasoo qayb ka noqotay sababaha loo qaaday tallaabada cuna-qabateynta ah. Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah ula xiriirtay mashruuca Somali Core Economic Institutions and Opportunities Project (SCORE) iyo Somalia Capacity Advancement, Livelihoods and Entrepreneurship through Digital Uplift (SCALED-UP), kuwaas oo lagu taageerayay horumarinta dhaqaalaha, adeegyada dijitaalka ah iyo abuurista fursadaha shaqo ee Soomaaliya. Mashruuca SCORE ayaa Soomaaliya lagu maalgeliyay lacag gaaraya 3.3 milyan oo dollar, iyadoo Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Soomaaliya loo xilsaaray hirgelinta iyo maamulka mashruuca. Sannadkii 2018-kii, shirkado ay Webmasters Kenya Limited ka mid ahayd ayaa loo doortay qandaraas lagu horumarinayay nidaamyada otomaatiga ah ee adeegyada ganacsiga, kaas oo qiimihiisu ahaa 330,000 oo dollar. Bangiga Adduunka ayaa sheegay in intii uu socday baaritaanka, shirkadda iyo James Ayugi ay ku guuldarreysteen inay si buuxda uga jawaabaan codsiyo la xiriiray dukumiintiyo iyo xog ay dalbatay waaxda u qaabilsan hufnaanta iyo baaritaannada Bangiga. Guddiga Cuna-qabateynta Bangiga Adduunka ayaa, kaddib markii uu qiimeeyay natiijooyinka baaritaanka wuxuu go’aamiyay in Webmasters Kenya Limited iyo James Ayugi laga mamnuuco dhammaan hawl-gallada Bangiga muddo aan ka yarayn shan sano. Mamnuucistan ayaa sidoo kale ka dhigan in James Ayugi uusan muddada xayiraaddu socoto noqon karin qandaraasle-hoosaad, la-taliye, adeeg-bixiye ama ka-faa’iideyste mashaariic uu maalgeliyo Bangiga Adduunka. Bangiga Adduunka ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay in go’aanka cuna-qabateynta lala wadaagi doono hay’adaha kale ee maaliyadeed ee caalamiga ah ee qaybta ka ah heshiiska wadaagista cuna-qabateynta, si ay u qiimeeyaan in xayiraadda lagu dabaqo hawl-galladooda. Bangiga Adduunka ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay in go’aanka cuna-qabateynta lala wadaagi doono hay’adaha kale ee maaliyadeed ee caalamiga ah ee qaybta ka ah heshiiska wadaagista cuna-qabateynta, si ay u qiimeeyaan in xayiraadda lagu dabaqo hawl-galladooda. items.title: Madaxweyne  Cirro oo hambalyo iyo bogaadin u dirayaa dhammaan ardayda  Somaliland ee ku guulaysatay Imtixaannadii…
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), waxa uu hambalyo iyo bogaadin u dirayaa dhammaan ardayda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee ku guulaysatay Imtixaannadii Shahaadiga ahaa ee fasalka 8-aad ee Dugsiyada Dhexe iyo fasalka 4-aad ee Dugsiyada Sare. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu ardayda ku ammaanay dadaalkooda, adkaysigooda iyo guusha ay gaadheen, isaga oo si gaar ah u hambalyeynaya Waalidiinta iyo Macallimiinta muddada dheer la soo dedaalay ardayda. Sida oo kale, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu bogaadinayaa Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Barbaarinta iyo Sayniska JSL iyo Xafiiska Imtixaannada Qaranka oo iyagu kaalin weyn ka qaatay diyaarinta, hirgelinta, sixitaanka iyo soo saarista natiijooyinka Imtixaannada Shahaadiga ah. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu ardayda gudubtay kula dardaarmay in guusha ay maanta gaadheen aanay ahayn dhammaadka safarka aqoonta, balse ay tahay bilowga marxalad cusub oo u baahan dadaal, kalsooni, hal-abuur iyo himilo sare, isaga oo u rajeeyey mustaqbal wacan oo ay aqoontooda ugu adeegaan dalkooda iyo dadkooda Somaliland.

items.title: Could Turkish Become Somalia’s Second Language?
items.description: The Turkish language in Somalia is growing fast. An estimated 100,000 Somalis can now speak it. That number keeps rising, according to language educators in Mogadishu. Turkish-run schools are expanding across the capital. Meanwhile, business ties with Turkish companies are fueling new demand for the language. The Big Question: The rise of the Turkish language in Somalia raises a real question: Could it eventually replace Arabic as the country’s default second language? An estimated 100,000 Somalis can now speak Turkish. That number is growing fast, according to language educators in Mogadishu. Turkish-run schools are expanding across the capital. Meanwhile, business ties with Turkish companies are fueling new demand for the language. Arabic remains Somalia’s official second language under the constitution. However, some educators now believe Turkish could eventually rival it. The trend reflects a broader shift in Turkish-Somali relations over the past decade. Turkish Schools Take Root in Mogadishu Turkish-run Maarif schools now operate in both Mogadishu and Hargeisa. Together, they teach Turkish alongside English and Arabic. More than 1,000 students attend these schools. As a result, many graduates leave fluent in three languages instead of two. Business Ties Drive Demand Turkish companies have expanded steadily across Mogadishu in recent years. Consequently, many young Somalis are learning Turkish for work, not just school. Interpreters and business graduates are increasingly finding jobs with these firms. Meanwhile, many other students study Turkish specifically to qualify for university admission in Turkey. Could Turkish Rival Arabic? Arabic still holds constitutional status as Somalia’s second language. Still, some language experts argue Turkish is closing the gap. If current trends continue, they say, Turkish could become the most-taught second language in Somali schools. That would mark a significant shift in the country’s linguistic landscape. For now, the claim remains a prediction, not a settled fact. But the numbers behind it are real, and growing. items.title: Madaxweyne Siciid Deni oo gaaray Dhinowda iyo muran ka dhashay maamulka deegaanka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa gaaray deegaanka Dhinowda ee bariga gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ay si weyn u saameeyeen abaaraha iyo isbeddelka cimiladu. Dhinowda ayaa wajahaysa xaalad deegaan oo adag, iyadoo bacaadku uu aasay qaybo badan oo deegaanka ah, taas oo saameyn ku yeelatay nolol-maalmeedka dadka iyo xoolaha. Dhibaatooyinka noocan ah ee deegaanka Dhinowda horey ayaa loo soo tabiyay. Booqashada Deni ayaa sidoo kale yeelatay dhinac siyaasadeed iyo maamul, maadaama Dhinowda ay ka mid ahayd deegaannadii ay Puntland ka qabatay doorashooyin qof iyo cod ah. Warar soo baxay ayaa sheegaya in mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Galmudug ay cambaareeyeen socdaalka, iyagoo ku doodaya in deegaanka uu ka tirsan yahay Galmudug. Sidaas darteed, socdaalka Deni wuxuu isku darayaa arrin deegaan iyo mid siyaasadeed: dhinaca koowaad waa xaaladda adag ee dadka Dhinowda ka haysata isbeddelka cimilada iyo bacaadka, halka dhinaca kalena uu taagan yahay muranka ku saabsan cidda maamul ahaan u leh deegaanka.

items.title: Khutbaddii Jumcaha Oo Isu Beddeshay Geeri Lama Filaan Ah
items.description: Imaam Marooko ah oo ku dhintay Mimbarka isagoo Khutbadda Jumcaha dhex marinaya Imaam ka tirsan Masjidka Umar Ibn Al-Khattab ee dalka Morocco ayaa ku dhintay isagoo khutbaddii Jumcaha dhex marinaya, ka dib markii uu ku sugnayd mimbarka, taasoo keentay in dad badan ay ka fekeraan lama filaanimada nolosha iyo caqiidada Islaamka ah ee ah in dhimashadu ay imaan karto daqiiqad kasta. Dhacdadan xanuunka badan ayaa dhacday maalinta Jumcaha intii lagu guda jiray khutbadda, markii imaamku uu si lama filaan ah u dhintay isagoo mashquul ku ahaa waajibaadkiisa diineed. Sida lagu sheegay warar kala duwan, imaamka ayaa hadlaya mawduuca dhimashada iyo aakhiro markii uu bilaabay inuu akhriyo Kalimah-e-Shahada ka hor inta uusan dhiman. Dhacdadani waxay dad badan ka dhigtay inay ka fekeraan nolosha, waana mid ay dadku u arkaan dhimasho wanaagsan oo ay Muslimiintu ku dhiman karaan xaalad cibaado ah. Goobta dhacdada masaajidiinta ayaa ku soo dhaqaaqay si ay u caawiyaan imaamka, balse hawlaha badbaadinta ayaa ku fashilmay. Dhacdadani waxay si weyn u saamaysay bulshada deegaanka, gaar ahaan maadaama ay dhacday meel quduus ah oo cibaado ku jirto, taasoo ka dhigtay mid muhiim u ah dadka Muslimiinta ah si ay uga fekeraan ujeeddada nolosha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waa muhiim in la xuso in qaar ka mid ah wararka laga helay internet-ka uu sheegay in dhacdadan ay tahay mid dhacday, balse ay jiraan raad-raacyo sheegaya in imaamka uusan dhiman ee uu kaliya yaabay. Sida ay sheegtay hay’adda AFP Fact Check, imaamka sawirka ah ee lagu faafiyay baraha bulshada ma uusan dhiman, waxaanu ku nool yahay oo wuxuu hadhow mar kale khudbadaha ka jeediyay masjidka . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, warbaahinta ayaa sheegay in imaam kale uu ku dhintay Taroudant, Morocco, intii lagu guda jiray khutbadda Jumcaha . Dhacdadani waxay ummadda Muslimiinta ah u tahay xasuusin muhiim ah oo ku saabsan dhimashada iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in la diyaar garow, maadaama ay imaan karto daqiiqad kasta oo qofku cibaadaysan yahay ama u adeegayo dadka kale. The post Khutbaddii Jumcaha Oo Isu Beddeshay Geeri Lama Filaan Ah first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Dowladda Somaliya oo hub iyo rasaas gaysay Baydhabo
items.description: Dowladda Somaliya ayaa saad u gaysay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ee ka hawlgala Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in diyaarad sidday hub iyo rasaas ay saacadihii u dambeeyay ka degtay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud, ka dib markii ay ka timid dhanka Caasimadda Muqdisho. Ciidamada Militariga iyo Booliska Gaarka ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa helaya qalab iyo saad ay ku xoojinayaan dadaalada ay ku xaqiijinayaan amniga iyo difaaca Baydhabo. Militariga ayaa Baydhabo u jooga inay gacan siiyaan Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed, Booliska iyo Xoogaga Nabad Sugidda ee qaabilsan sugidda amniga ee gudaha magaalada. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa waxaa ka go’an in taageero buuxda la siiyo maamulka uu madaxda ka yahay Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), kaas oo 10-kii bishii June loo doortay jegada Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Villa Somalia ayaa sare u qaadday taageerada maamulka cusub ee Aadan Madoobe, ka dib dagaalkii uu dhiigga badani ku daatay ee 17-kii bishan ka dhacay magaaladaasi. Ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Laftagareen oo xilligaasi magaalada ku soo qaaday weerar ballaaran ayaa waxaa ka dhashay cabsi iyo qalqal amni oo laga dareemay Baydhabo oo dhan.

items.title: UN Begins Reducing Its Presence in Somalia
items.description: The United Nations has begun reducing its presence in Somalia, downsizing its staff and planning to sell some assets of the UNSOS support mission. The move comes at a time when funding shortages are affecting support for the African Union mission in Somalia (AUSSOM). Meanwhile, the UNTMIS mission is expected to gradually transfer its responsibilities to Somali authorities and the UN country team by October 2026. This transition is significant as it represents a major shift in the UN’s engagement in Somalia, coinciding with financial constraints affecting international support. The United States, the largest contributor to UNSOS, has announced it will end its funding by December 31, 2026. This has prompted UNSOS to issue asset disposal notices for vehicles, generators, computers and other equipment. Economic crisis affects UN presence in Somalia The UNTMIS mission, which transitioned from UNSOM in November 2024, will continue until October 31, 2026, allowing for a phased handover of responsibilities to Somali authorities. The Somali government has stated it is ready to take on greater security responsibility, with President Hassan Sheikh recently graduating over 3,000 soldiers. Somalia Faces Change in UN Presence However, the UN withdrawal is not yet complete, and uncertainty remains over the future of AUSSOM and who will fund the African troops in Somalia. The UN has warned that funding cuts could impact the humanitarian situation, with 3.8 million people internally displaced within Somalia. The post UN Begins Reducing Its Presence in Somalia first appeared on Radio Dalsan .
