Dalabka madax-furashada ayaan weli si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin, balse wuxuu kusoo aadayaa iyadoo xaaladda M/V LUTUF ay sii jiitamayso, isla markaana falalka burcad-badeednimada Soomaalida ay si muuqata dib ugu soo xoogeysanayaan xeebaha Soomaaliya, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo biyaha ku dhow Yemen. M/V LUTUF, oo wata calanka Cameroon, ayaa 17-kii Agoosto lagu qafaashay meel qiyaastii 3.5 mayl-badeed u jirta Marraya oo ka tirsan degmada Eyl ee Puntland. Siddeed nin oo hubeysan ayaa la sheegay inay markabka fuuleen, kadibna u jiheeyeen dhinaca xeebaha gobolka Nugaal. Markabka waxaa saarnaa 10 qof oo shaqaale ah, kuwaas oo kala ah lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Georgian ah iyo laba Serbian ah oo ilaalo ahaan u saarnaa. Sarkaal Soomaali ah, oo codsaday in aan la magacaabin, ayaa sheegay in markabku siday hub, qalabka isgaarsiinta iyo qalabka dayax-gacmeedka oo ku wajahnaa xarunta tababarka ciidamada Turkiga ee Muqdisho ee TURKSOM. Dowladda Turkiga si rasmi ah ugama hadlin faahfaahinta shixnadda. Dhacdadan ayaa yeelatay xasaasiyad dheeraad ah maadaama shixnadda lagu sheegay qalab militari. Wararka soo baxay maalmo kadib qafaashada ayaa sheegay in laba markab oo laga leeyahay Turkiga ay ku dhowaadeen goobta lagu hayey LUTUF, halka diyaarado helikobtarro iyo drones ah ay la socdeen dhaqdhaqaaqa markabka. 18-kii Agoosto, doon yar oo qaad u geysay kooxda haysata markabka ayaa dib ugu laabatay xeebta, waxaana wax yar kadib halkaas ka dhacay duqeyn lagu dilay afar qof laguna dhaawacay laba kale. Ilaa hadda si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin cidda fulisay weerarkaas iyo in dadka la dilay ay xiriir la lahaayeen kooxdii markabka qabsatay. Burcad-badeednimada oo dib usoo laabatay Kiiska LUTUF ma aha dhacdo gooni ah. Saddex maalmood kadib, 20-kii Agoosto, lix nin oo hubeysan ayaa qabsaday markabka shidaalka M.T. Sibu 1, xilli uu marayey meel qiyaastii 136 mayl-badeed bari kaga beegan magaalada Al Mukalla ee Yemen, kadibna waxay usoo jiheeyeen dhinaca xeebaha Puntland. Sibu 1 waxaa saarnaa 20 shaqaale ah, oo 16 ka mid ah ay yihiin Hindi. Markabka ayaa sidoo kale horey cunaqabateyn uga saarneyd dowladda Mareykanka, oo ku eedeysay inuu qeyb ka ahaa maraakiib loo adeegsado dhoofinta shidaalka Iran si looga baxsado cunaqabateynta. Qabsashada Sibu 1 waxay tirada maraakiibta ganacsiga ee burcad-badeedda Soomaalida qabsadeen tan iyo 21-kii Abriil gaarsiisay lix: Honor 25, Sward, Eureka, Asana, LUTUF iyo Sibu 1. Honor 25 ayaa la qabsaday 21-kii Abriil, Sward 26-kii Abriil, Eureka 2-dii May, halka Asana la qabsaday 17-kii July. Dhammaadkii July, howlgalka Midowga Yurub ee ATALANTA wuxuu sheegay in afarta markab ee ugu horreeyey weli lagu hayey meel u dhow xeebaha waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya, iyadoo tobannaan shaqaale ah ay gacanta ugu jireen burcad-badeedda. Tani waxay muujineysaa in waxa markii hore loo arkayey weerarro goos-goos ah ay hadda isu beddelayaan hannaan joogto ah oo dib u soo celinaya walaacii muddo ka badan toban sano ka hor ka jiray xeebaha Soomaaliya. Hay’adda International Maritime Bureau ayaa sheegtay in qeybtii hore ee 2026 dunida laga diiwaangeliyey 38 dhacdo oo burcad-badeednimo iyo weerarro hubeysan oo ka dhacay badda, oo shan ka mid ahi ahaayeen qafaalasho markab. Burcad-badeedda Soomaalida ayaa mas’uul ka ahaa 94% shaqaalihii maraakiibta ee dunida afduub ahaan loo haystay muddadaas. Soo noqoshada burcad-badeednimada waxaa loo aaneynayaa dhowr arrimood oo is biirsaday. Waxaa ka mid ah hoos u dhaca joogitaanka ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah, maraakiib dagaal oo loo weeciyey xiisadaha ka jira Badda Cas iyo Bariga Dhexe, iyo kooxaha burcad-badeedda oo mar kale awood u yeeshay inay helaan dhaqaale, doonyo iyo shabakado dhulka ka taageera. Ganacsi horey u sameeyey boqolaal milyan Dalabka ku dhow labada milyan ee dollar ee hadda laga soo sheegayo LUTUF wuxuu dib u xusuusinayaa qaabkii ganacsi ee burcad-badeedda Soomaalida xilligii ay ugu xoogga badnaayeen. Daraasad ballaaran oo Bankiga Adduunka, Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Daroogada iyo Dambiyada – UNODC – iyo INTERPOL ay soo saareen 2013, laguna magacaabay Pirate Trails , ayaa lagu qiyaasay in intii u dhexeysay Abriil 2005 iyo Diseembar 2012 lacag u dhexeysa $339 milyan iyo $413 milyan lagu bixiyey madax-furashada maraakiib ay burcad-badeeddu ka qabsadeen Soomaaliya iyo Geeska Afrika. Mudadaas waxaa la qafaashay 179 markab, waxaana burcad-badeednimadu isu beddeshay ganacsi abaabulan oo ay ka qeyb qaataan ragga weerarka fulinaya, maalgeliyeyaasha bixiya kharashka howlgalka, dadka sahayda keena, waardiyeyaasha xeebaha iyo kuwa wada wada-xaajoodyada madax-furashada. Lacagta ugu badan ma aysan ku ekaan ragga hubeysan ee markabka fuula. Baaritaanka Pirate Trails wuxuu muujiyey in lacagaha madax-furashada loo kala gudbin jiray shabakado ballaaran, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah maalgeliyeyaasha iyo qabanqaabiyeyaasha ay qaadan jireen saamiga ugu weyn. Lacagahaas ayaa kadib loo marin jiray lacag caddaan ah, xawaalado iyo ganacsiyo kale. Celceliska madax-furashada markabkiiba ayaa 2011 iyo 2012 gaarayey qiyaastii $4.9 milyan, taas oo muujineysa heerka dhaqaale ee ay burcad-badeednimadu gaartay xilligii ugu sarreeyey. Burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya ayaa si weyn hoos ugu dhacday wixii ka dambeeyey 2012, kadib markii la kordhiyey ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah, maraakiibta ganacsigu qaateen ilaalo hubeysan iyo tallaabooyin amni oo adag, halka ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo kuwa maamul goboleedyaduna cadaadis saareen saldhigyadii xeebaha. Hase yeeshee, dhacdooyinka isdaba-joogga ah ee 2026 ayaa hadda abuuraya cabsi ah in kooxihii iyo shabakadihii ganacsigan saldhigga u ahaa ay mar kale helayaan fursad ay dib ugu soo nooleeyaan nidaamkii qafaalashada maraakiibta iyo dalabka madax-furashada ee muddo sanado ah halista weyn ku ahaa marinnada ganacsiga ee ku dhow Soomaaliya. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo kulan dhiirrigelin ah la qaatay 10-ka arday ee ugu sarreeyay imtixaanka fasalka 12-aad
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta Muqdisho kulan dhiirrigelin iyo bogaadin ah la qaatay 10-kii arday ee kaalmaha ugu sarreeya ka galay imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee fasalka 12-aad ee dugsiyada sare ee dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa ardayda ugu hambalyeeyay guusha ay gaareen, isaga oo ku ammaanay dadaalkooda, adkaysigooda iyo natiijada wanaagsan ee ay ka soo hooyeen imtixaanka. Wuxuuna kula dardaarmay inay sii wadaan dadaalka waxbarasho. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in arday kasta oo doonaya inuu waxbarashadiisa jaamacadeed ku sii wato gudaha dalka loo diyaarin doono fursad waxbarasho oo bilaash ah, si loo dhiirrigeliyo ardayda hibada iyo aqoonta leh. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay qorsheyneyso hirgelinta jaamacad dowladeed oo cusub oo si gaar ah u bixin doonta waxbarashada Teknoolojiyadda, taas oo loogu talagalay in dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed loo abuuro fursado waxbarasho oo tayo leh, gaar ahaan kuwa xiiseynaya culuumta casriga ah iyo tiknoolajiyadda. Kulanka ayaa noqonaya mid lagu dhiirrigelinayo ardayda Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay inay xoogga saarayso horumarinta waxbarashada iyo kobcinta jiilka cusub ee dalka hoggaamin doona.

items.title: Shariif oo weeraray ciidamada DF: Waa fuleey oo ka cararay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii KMG ahayd Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa si adag uga hadlay tallaabooyinka ay dowladda federaalka ka waddo magaalada Muqdisho, gaar ahaan howlaha barakicinta iyo duminta guryaha ay degan yihiin shacabka. Sheekh Shariif ayaa si gaar ah u weeraray Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka oo ay ku jiraan Ciidanka Madaxtooyada oo uu ku eedeeyay inay si toos ah uga qayb-qaadanayaan howlaha barakicinta iyo burburinta guryaha shacabka. “Waxa soo kordhay waxaa weeyey Ciidanka Madaxtooyada oo si toos ah uga qayb-qaadanaya barakicinta, waxaa kale oo la arkaayay cagaf-cagafyadii Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo dhulka lagu duminaayo,” ayuu yiri Sheekh Shariif. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in arrintan ay tahay mid laga xumaado, wuxuuna saraakiisha iyo ciidamada dowladda ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan ka qayb-qaadashada tallaabooyinka lagu beegsanayo dadka shacabka ah. Sheekha ayaa sidoo kale su’aal geliyay sababta ciidanka dowladda loogu adeegsanayo shacabka, xilli uu weli dalka ka socdo dagaal ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, isla markaana qaar ay kasoo baxeen ciidamada. “War dadka xabadaha loogu talagalay kuwaan ma aha ee Shabaab maxaa usoo carartay marka la hortaagan yahay Khawaarijta? Marka la xabadeynayo shacabka geesi ayaa tahay, laguma celin karo, waa dadnimo xumo,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay Muqdisho ka taagan tahay xiisad muran badan dhalisay oo la xiriirta howlaha burburinta, kadib markii uu howlgalka kusii fiday xaafado horleh oo ku yaallo magaalada Muqdisho. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xaaladdu waxay u muuqataa inay faraha kasii baxayso, iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan dhibaatooyinka ay shacabka magaalada Muqdisho kala kulmayaan barakicinta iyo burburinta guryaha ee isku marka socda. items.title: Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika oo Soomaaliya ka Daahfuray Mashruuc $19 Milyan ah oo Looga Hortagayo Khataraha Cimilada
items.description: Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika (AfDB) ayaa Soomaaliya ka daahfuray wejiga cusub ee Mashruuca Maalgelinta iyo Adkeysiga Khataraha Masiibooyinka (ADRiFi), kaas oo lagu maalgelinayo ku dhawaad $19 milyan. Mashruucan oo ay iska kaashanayaan Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika, Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Qaranka (SoDMA) iyo Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Soomaaliya, ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xoojinta awoodda Soomaaliya ee ka hortagga iyo maaraynta dhibaatooyinka ka dhasha isbeddelka cimilada. ADRiFi wuxuu si gaar ah u taageerayaa diyaar-garowga iyo ka-hortagga saameynta abaaraha soo noqnoqda, fatahaadaha iyo musiibooyinka kale ee la xiriira cimilada, kuwaas oo si weyn u saameeya bulshada xoolo-dhaqatada iyo beeralayda Soomaaliyeed. Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika ayaa sheegay in maalgelintan ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu dhisayo adkeysiga bulshada iyo kaabayaasha dalka, si Soomaaliya ay si wanaagsan uga jawaabto khataraha cimilada ee mustaqbalka. Mashruuca ayaa si wadajir ah u fulin doona AfDB, SoDMA iyo Wasaaradda Maaliyadda, iyadoo faahfaahin dheeraad ah laga sugayo jadwalka maalgelinta, deegaannada mudnaanta la siin doono iyo tirada dadka sida tooska ah uga faa’iidaysan doona. Daahfurka mashruucan ayaa Soomaaliya u noqon kara fursad lagu xoojiyo nidaamyada digniinta hore, diyaar-garowga musiibooyinka iyo taageerada bulshada nugul xilliyada ay dhacaan abaaraha iyo fatahaadaha.

items.title: Heshiis Laga Gaaray Khilaafkii Golaha Shacabka, Mucaaradka oo Dib ugu Soo Laabanaya Fadhiyada Baarlamaanka
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), iyo guddi matalayay xildhibaannada mucaaradka ayaa gaaray heshiis lagu soo afjarayo khilaafkii sababay kala-qaybsanaanta iyo hakadka ku yimid shaqada baarlamaanka. Heshiiska ayaa yimid kaddib kulan ay yeesheen labada dhinac, kaas oo looga hadlay tabashooyinka xildhibaannada mucaaradka iyo sidii dib loogu soo celin lahaa habsami-u-socodka fadhiyada Golaha Shacabka. Labada dhinac ayaa isla qaatay in hoggaanka Golaha Shacabku ilaaliyo dhex-dhexaadnimada siyaasadeed, isla markaana xildhibaannada loo oggolaado inay si xor ah uga hadlaan arrimaha qaranka, shuruucda iyo howlaha baarlamaanka. Sidoo kale, heshiiskan ayaa horseedaya in xildhibaannadii horey u qaadacay fadhiyada Golaha Shacabka ay dib ugu soo laabtaan shaqada baarlamaanka, si loo dardargeliyo doodaha iyo ansixinta sharciyada horyaalla Golaha. Si kastaba, heshiiska ayaa diiradda saaraya hagaajinta shaqada gudaha ee Golaha Shacabka, mana xallinayo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee waaweyn ee dalka, gaar ahaan kuwa la xiriira doorashooyinka, wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka iyo muddo-xileedyada hay’adaha dowladda. Heshiiskan ayaa haddii si buuxda loo dhaqan-geliyo la filayaa inuu yareeyo khilaafka gudaha Golaha Shacabka, isla markaana dib u soo celiyo joogteynta fadhiyada iyo howlaha sharci-dejinta.

Si kastaba, heshiiska ayaa diiradda saaraya hagaajinta shaqada gudaha ee Golaha Shacabka, mana xallinayo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee waaweyn ee dalka, gaar ahaan kuwa la xiriira doorashooyinka, wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka iyo muddo-xileedyada hay’adaha dowladda. items.title: Dhammaadkii Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe kadib 30 sano
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israel ay la galeen Iran wuxuu astaan u noqon karaa dhammaadka nidaam siyaasadeed iyo amni oo Washington ay muddo ka badan 30 sano ku maamulaysay Bariga Dhexe, sida uu qabo falanqeeyaha caanka ah ee siyaasadda gobolka Marc Lynch. Lynch, oo ah professor ka tirsan Jaamacadda George Washington, ayaa maqaal dheer oo uu ku qoray Foreign Affairs ku doodaya in dagaalka Iran uusan ahayn oo keliya colaad kale oo gobolka ka qaraxday, balse uu bannaanka soo dhigay daciifnimo muddo dheer ku soo urureysay siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe. Nidaamkaas wuxuu si weyn u soo xoogaystay kaddib Dagaalkii Khaliijka ee 1991, markaas oo Mareykanku noqday awoodda dibadda ee ugu weyn gobolka. Washington waxay dhistay saldhigyo ciidan oo waaweyn, waxay xoojisay xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka Khaliijka, waxay difaac xooggan siisay Israel, iyadoo isla markaasna isku dayaysay inay xakameyso Iran iyo awoodaha kale ee kasoo horjeeda nidaamka ay hoggaamineysay. Muddo dheer, qaabkaas wuxuu Mareykanka siiyay saameyn aan cid kale kula tartami karin gobolka. Laakiin Lynch wuxuu aaminsan yahay in dagaalkii ugu dambeeyay ee Iran uu dhaawac weyn u geystay tiirarkii uu nidaamkaasi ku taagnaa. Dammaanaddii amniga oo su’aal gashay Muddo tobanaan sano ah, mid ka mid ah sababaha ugu waaweyn ee dowladaha Khaliijka xiriirka dhow ula lahaayeen Mareykanka waxay ahayd dammaanadda Washington ee ah inay ilaalin karto ammaankooda, marin-biyoodka gobolka iyo dhaqaalaha tamarta. Dagaalka Iran ayaa dammaanaddaas geliyay imtixaankii ugu adkaa. Iran waxay awood u yeelatay inay weerarro ka fuliso gobolka, halka Mareykankuna uusan si buuxda u xaqiijin karin ammaanka xulafadiisa ama joogteynta marin-biyoodka muhiimka u ah ganacsiga iyo shidaalka dunida. Lynch wuxuu ku doodaya in arrintaasi dhaawacday fikraddii muddada dheer jirtay ee ahayd in joogitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka iyo saldhigyadiisa gobolka ay yihiin dammaanad buuxda oo amni. Taasi macnaheedu ma aha in Sacuudiga, Imaaraadka, Qatar ama dowladaha kale ee gobolka ay xiriirka u jarayaan Washington. Mareykanka weli wuxuu leeyahay awood ciidan oo aan dal kale oo dibadda ahi kula tartami karin gobolka, xiriir dhaqaale oo qoto dheer iyo iskaashi difaac oo tobanaan sano soo jiray. Hase yeeshee, Lynch wuxuu qabaa in dowladahaas ay sii yaraaneyso diyaar u ahaanshahooda inay siyaasaddooda dibadda si buuxda ula jaanqaadaan Washington. Taa beddelkeeda, waxay doonayaan inay albaabada u furnaadaan dhinacyo kala duwan — Mareykanka, Shiinaha, Ruushka iyo quwado kale — iyagoo arrin kasta ku eegaya danahooda gaarka ah. Waa isbeddel si tartiib ah usoo socday sannado badan, balse dagaalka Iran ayaa ka dhigay mid si cad loo arki karo. Xadgudubka Israel iyo dhibaatada Falastiin Qodob kale oo muhiim u ah doodda Lynch waa xiriirka Mareykanka iyo Israel. Washington waxay sanado badan isku dayaysay inay Israel iyo dowladaha Carabta u dhisto iskaashi siyaasadeed iyo mid amni, iyadoo heshiisyadii Abraham Accords ay qayb muhiim ah ka ahaayeen qorshahaas. Ujeeddadu waxay ahayd in la abuuro nidaam goboleed ay Israel iyo dowladaha Carabta si dhow uga wada shaqeeyaan amniga, iyadoo Iran loo arko khatarta ugu weyn ee wadajirka ah. Laakiin dagaalka Gaza iyo colaadaha kale ee Israel ka waddo gobolka ayaa qorshahaas si weyn u dhaawacay. Lynch wuxuu aaminsan yahay in Mareykanku muddo dheer yareystay muhiimadda ay arrinta Falastiin weli ku leedahay bulshada iyo siyaasadda Carabta. Taageerada ballaaran ee Washington ay siiso Israel ayaa sidoo kale dhaawacday kalsoonidii Mareykanka ee qaybo badan oo gobolka ah, gaar ahaan xilli ay sii kordhayeen dhimashada iyo burburka Gaza. Dagaalka Iran ayaa markaas kusoo biiray xaalad horey u dhaawacnayd. Halkii Washington ay abuuri lahayd nidaam ay Israel iyo dalalka Carabta si wadajir ah uga hortagaan Iran, gobolka wuxuu galay marxalad ay dowladuhu doonayaan inay iska ilaaliyaan dagaallo waaweyn oo ku khasba inay si buuxda dhinac ula safaan. Ma Shiinaha ayaa beddelaya Mareykanka? Si kastaba, dhammaadka nidaamkii uu Mareykanku hoggaaminayay macnaheedu ma aha in Shiinaha ama Ruushku si fudud booskiisa ula wareegayaan. Lynch wuxuu sheegayaa in waxa soo baxaya ay u badan tahay xaalad ka duwan middaas. Bariga Dhexe wuxuu u sii socdaa nidaam ay awooddu ku kala firdhisan tahay, dowladaha gobolkuna ay helayaan xorriyad dheeraad ah oo ay ku go’aansadaan cidda ay arrin kasta kala shaqeynayaan. Mar waxay Washington la shaqeyn karaan, marna Beijing ama Moscow, halka arrimo kale ay si toos ah ugala xaajoon karaan Tehran ama dowladaha kale ee gobolka. Taas waxaa tusaale u ah dadaallada dalalka Khaliijka ay sannadihii dambe ku doonayeen inay yareeyaan xiisadda Iran, iyagoo isla waqtigaas sii wada xiriirkooda difaac ee Mareykanka. Sidaas darteed, gobolka cusub ma noqonayo mid Mareykanka laga saaray. Wuxuu noqonayaa mid Mareykanku weli ku leeyahay awood iyo saameyn aad u weyn, balse aanu kaligiis dejin karin xeerarka siyaasadda gobolka. Maxaa xiga? Lynch wuxuu xaaladda maanta la barbar dhigaa qalalaasihii Suez ee 1956, kaas oo calaamad u noqday hoos u dhaca awooddii Britain iyo France ee Bariga Dhexe. Boqortooyooyinkaas hal maalin kuma dhammaan, mana aysan lumin dhammaan saameyntooda isla markiiba. Laakiin dhacdadii Suez waxay bannaanka soo dhigtay xaqiiqo cusub: awooddoodii hore uma sii jiri karin sidii ay ahayd. Sidaas oo kale, Lynch wuxuu qabaa in dagaalka Iran laga yaabo inuu noqdo dhacdadii si cad u muujisay in nidaamkii Mareykanku gobolka ka dhisay aanu dib ugu laaban karin sidii hore. Taasi weli waa dood, mana aha xaqiiqo la isla oggol yahay. Mareykanku wuxuu weli haystaa saldhigyo, xulufo, awood dhaqaale iyo ciidan oo aad u ballaaran, mana muuqato quwad kale oo hadda diyaar u ah inay si buuxda u beddesho. Laakiin su’aasha Lynch soo bandhigayo ma aha cidda beddeli doonta Mareykanka. Waxay tahay in Washington ay aqbali karto Bariga Dhexe aysan iyadu maamulin. Haddii aysan taas aqbalin, ayuu ku doodayaa, isku dayga lagu ilaalinayo nidaamkii hore wuxuu sii dhalin karaa dagaallo, kharash iyo xasillooni-darro cusub. Haddii Washington ay aqbasho xaqiiqada cusub, Mareykanku wuxuu weli gobolka ku yeelan karaa saameyn weyn — laakiin isagoo ka mid ah quwado dhowr ah oo tartamaya, halkii uu ahaan lahaa awoodda keliya ee dejisa jihada Bariga Dhexe oo dhan. items.title: Puntland: Lacagaha Madaxfurashada Waxay Xoojinayaan Shabakadaha Burcad-badeedda
items.description: Wasaaradda Kalluumeysiga iyo Kheyraadka Badda Puntland ayaa sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto kororka weerarrada burcad-badeedda ee ka dhacay xeebaha iyo biyaha Puntland. Waxa ay sheegtay in xog horudhac ah ay muujinayso in dhinacyo dibadda ah ay isku dayayaan inay dhaqaale ku taageeraan oo dib u hawlgeliyaan shaqsiyaad iyo shabakado horey burcad-badeednimo ula xiriiray. Puntland waxay sheegtay in arrintan ay saameyn ku yeelan karto amniga iyo sumcadda Puntland, isla markaana ay ka leexin karto dadaallada socda ee lagula dagaallamayo kooxaha argagixisada. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in hay’adaha amniga iyo kuwa ilaaliya amniga badda ay baarayaan xogtan, ayna tallaabo ka qaadi doonaan cid kasta oo lagu helo inay ku lug leedahay amni-darrada badda. Dhanka kale, Puntland waxay si gaar ah ugu baaqday milkiilayaasha maraakiibta, shirkadaha maraakiibta iyo caymisyada inaysan si toos ah ula xaajoon burcad-badeedda ama bixin madax-furasho, iyadoo sheegtay in lacagahaasi ay sii xoojinayaan shabakadaha burcad-badeedda. Wasaaradda ayaa ugu dambeyn ugu baaqday bulshada xeebaha, shirkadaha ka howlgala badda iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah inay la shaqeeyaan Puntland si looga hortago burcad-badeedda loona ilaaliyo maraakiibta iyo isu-socodka badda.

items.title: Kenya oo 50% dhimaysa Qiimaha Abuurka Galleyda laga bilaabo Sebtembar
items.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya, William Ruto, ayaa ku dhawaaqay in dowladda ay 50% hoos u dhigi doonto qiimaha abuurka galleyda laga bilaabo bisha Sebtembar 2026, si loo dhiirrigeliyo beeraleyda loona kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka cuntada. Ruto oo hadalkan ka sheegay munaasabad ka dhacday Taita Taveta ayaa sheegay in qiimaha bacda abuurka galleyda uu ka degi doono 300 Shilin Kenya ah ilaa 150 Shilin, taas oo beeraleyda siinaysa fursad ay ku heli karaan abuur jaban. Sidoo kale, dowladda Kenya waxay 500 Shilin ka dhimeysaa qiimaha bacda 50kg ee bacriminta, taas oo hadda ku kacda 2,500 Shilin, waxaana laga dhigi doonaa 2,000 Shilin. Isbeddelkan ayaa la filayaa inuu dhaqan galo labada toddobaad ee soo socda. Go’aankan ayaa yimid xilli Kenya ay wajahday wax-soo-saar galley oo hoos u dhacay, kadib roobabkii oo aan si wanaagsan u da’in meelo badan. Ruto ayaa beeraleyda ugu baaqay inay ka faa’iideystaan roobabka la filayo bilaha Sebtembar iyo Oktoobar si loo kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka loona xoojiyo sugnaanta cuntada dalka.

items.title: The Republic of Somaliland, Taiwan, and Israel’s relations represent more than shared democratic values.
items.description: The Republic of Somaliland, Taiwan, and Israel’s relations represent more than shared democratic values. They point toward an emerging strategic alignment among three democratic nations positioned at critical maritime crossroads, with the United States as a natural and indispensable strategic partner. As former President Tsai Ing-wen stated, “Somaliland and Taiwan are bonded by shared democratic values and freedoms.” Taiwan’s current president, William Lai Ching-te, has also called for cooperation with like-minded countries, including the United States, toward a “non-red Somaliland coastline.” #Israel has taken the most significant diplomatic step by formally recognizing Somaliland as an independent and sovereign state. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu described the move as being in the spirit of the Abraham Accords and pledged expanded cooperation in agriculture, health, technology, and the economy. During President Cirro’s 2026 visit to Israel, Netanyahu further highlighted Somaliland’s strategic position at the opposite end of the Red Sea, adjacent to the Bab el-Mandeb, one of the world’s most important maritime gateways. The strategic geography is compelling. Taiwan is central to the security of the Indo-Pacific. Israel is a key U.S. partner in the Middle East. Somaliland sits at the gateway between the Gulf of Aden, Bab el-Mandeb, the Red Sea, and the Indian Ocean. Together, these relations connect three strategically vital regions and create an emerging network of democratic partnerships around some of the world’s most important maritime corridors. For #Washington, Somaliland should therefore be viewed not simply through the question of recognition but as a potential strategic partner in democracy, maritime security, freedom of navigation, counterterrorism, and the protection of global trade routes. The Somaliland-Taiwan-Israel relations demonstrate how shared democratic values can evolve into strategic cooperation. The opportunity now is for the United States to recognize Somaliland’s strategic value and engage accordingly. Abdirashid Ibrahim

items.title: Midowga Culimada oo taageeray xaqa DF u leedahay maamulka dhulka danta guud
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Midowga Golayaasha Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa taageeray xaqa dowladda ay u leedahay maamulka iyo dib-u-habeynta dhulalka danta guud ee Muqdisho, balse ku adkeystay in aan lagu xadgudbin hantida gaarka ah ee milkiyaddeeda sharci ahaan sugan tahay. Mowqifkan ayaa kasoo baxay kulan ay magaalada Muqdisho ku dhexmaray hoggaanka culimada, Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir iyo Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray muranka dhulka iyo cabashooyinka sii kordhaya ee ka dhashay howlaha dowladda ee ka socda qeybo ka mid ah caasimadda. Kulanka oo ka dhacay xarunta Dowladda Hoose ee Xamar ayaa waxaa dhinaca dowladda uga qeyb galay Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho Xasan Maxamed Xuseen Muungaab iyo Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka Sheekh Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen sidii loo kala saari lahaa dhulka danta guud iyo hantida gaarka loo leeyahay. Bayaanka ay kulanka kadib soo saareen culimada ayaa lagu sheegay in Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir iyo Wasaaradda Awqaafta ay aqbaleen talooyinkii culimadu hore uga soo jeediyeen muranka dhulka, gaar ahaan ilaalinta milkiyadda gaarka ah ee sharciyaddeedu sugan tahay. Maamulka ayaa sidoo kale ballanqaaday in aan la oggolaan doonin in lagu xadgudbo dhul si gaar ah loo leeyahay, isla markaana lala xisaabtami doono cid kasta oo ku kacda fal noocaas ah. Dhankooda, culimada ayaa si cad u aqoonsaday awoodda dowladda ee dhulalka danta guud, iyagoo sheegay inay “garwaaqsanyihiin in dowladdu xaq u leedahay maamulidda, bixinta iyo dib-u-habaynta dhulalka danta guud iyo oobasiibooyinka,” haddii arrintaas loo fulinayo si waafaqsan maslaxadda guud, lana tixgelinayo dadka nugul iyo kuwa taagta daran. Qodobkan ayaa muhiim u ah muranka hadda ka taagan Muqdisho, maadaama dowladda ay ku dooddo in qeybo badan oo ay dadka ka rareyso ay yihiin dhul dadweyne ama hanti dowladeed, halka dadka qaarkood ay sheeganayaan inay haystaan dukumiintiyo muujinaya lahaanshaha dhulka. Culimadu waxay sidoo kale soo dhaweeyeen guddi Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir u xil saaray xallinta cabashooyinka iyo khilaafaadka dhulka, kaas oo ay xubno ka yihiin qeybaha bulshada iyo culimada. Saddexda dhinac ayaa ku heshiiyey inay joogteeyaan wada-tashiga iyo wada-shaqeynta arrimahan. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa horey u sheegay in uu mar walba diyaar u yahay dhegeysiga iyo xal-u-helidda cabashada muwaaddiniinta, arrintaas oo ay u xil saaran yihiin Guddiyo heer Maamul ah (sida Guddiga Xalinta Khilaafaadka Dhulka), iyo guddiyo gaar ah oo ay ku jiraan Culumaa’udiinka iyo bulshada qeybaheeda kale. The post Midowga Culimada oo taageeray xaqa DF u leedahay maamulka dhulka danta guud appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Iiraan oo lagu casuumay isbaheysiga difaac ee Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Iran ayaa ka fiirsaneysa martiqaad ay sheegtay inay heshay oo ku saabsan inay ku biirto Heshiiska Wadajirka ah ee Difaaca Makka, kaas oo bishan ay wada saxiixdeen Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan, xilli Bariga Dhexe uu wajahayo isbeddel weyn oo dhinaca amniga ah. Mehdi Rahimi, madaxa wakaaladda wararka rasmiga ah ee baarlamaanka Iran, ayaa wareysi uu Axaddii siiyay telefishinka Al Mayadeen ku sheegay in Tehran loo soo gudbiyay martiqaad ay kaga mid noqon karto heshiiska, isla markaana madaxda Iran ay hadda qiimeynayaan arrintaas. “Iran waxay heshay martiqaad ay ugu biireyso Heshiiska Makka, arrintana waa la baarayaa,” ayuu yiri Rahimi. Waxa uu soo dhaweeyay dadaallada ay dowladaha gobolka ku doonayaan inay ku dhistaan hannaan amni oo ay iyagu leeyihiin, isaga oo sheegay in Iran muddo dheer ku baaqeysay in dalalka Bariga Dhexe ay yareeyaan ku tiirsanaanta quwadaha dibadda. Rahimi ayaa sheegay in dagaalkii dhowaan lala galay Iran uu dalalka gobolka tusay, sida uu hadalka u dhigay, in Mareykanku uusan awoodin inuu bixiyo ammaanka uu muddo dheer u ballanqaaday xulafadiisa. Si kastaba, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran weli si rasmi ah uma xaqiijin martiqaadka, sidoo kalena Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan midkoodna kama hadlin in Tehran si rasmi ah loogu casuumay heshiiska. Heshiis difaac oo cusub Heshiiska Wadajirka ah ee Difaaca Makka waxaa 7-dii Agoosto magaalada Makka ku kala saxiixday Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif. Qodobka ugu muhiimsan heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood, taas oo la barbar dhigay mabda’a ku jira qodobka shanaad ee heshiiska NATO. Inkasta oo faahfaahinta sida ay dalalku militari ahaan uga jawaabi doonaan weerar noocaas ah aysan weli si buuxda u caddayn, heshiiska ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo muhiim ah oo ay saddexda dowladood ku doonayaan inay ku xoojiyaan iskaashigooda difaaca iyo awoodda ay iskaga celin karaan khataraha gobolka. Iran markii hore walaac kama muujin dhismaha isbahaysigan. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran Esmail Baghaei ayaa 10-kii Agoosto sheegay in Tehran aysan “sabab ay uga walaacdo” u arkin heshiiska cusub. Mowqifkaas ayaa hadda u muuqda mid sii xoogeysanaya, haddii ay xaqiiqo noqoto in Iran lafteeda loo fidiyay fursad ay kaga mid noqon karto isbahaysiga. Ku biirista Iran waxay si weyn wax uga beddeli lahayd muuqaalka heshiiska. Saddexda dal ee hadda ku jira ayaa xiriir amni oo xooggan la leh dalalka reer Galbeedka, halka Iran ay tobannaan sano khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo mid militari kula jirtay Mareykanka. Erdogan oo albaabka furay Madaxweyne Erdogan ayaa horay u caddeeyay in Ankara aysan dooneyn in heshiisku ku ekaado Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Wareysi qoraal ah oo 12-kii Agoosto lagu daabacay wargeyska Sacuudiga ee Asharq Al-Awsat , Erdogan ayaa sheegay in himilada laga leeyahay heshiiska ay tahay in mustaqbalka ay ku soo biiraan dalal kale oo gobolka ah. “Aragtideennu kuma koobna saddexda dal,” ayuu yiri Erdogan. “Waxaan rajeyneynaa inuu ballaarto, waxaana suuragal ah in maalin uun ay soo baxaan duruufo ku habboon in dhammaan dalalka gobolka ay ku midoobaan dalladdiisa.” Madaxweynaha Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale diiday in heshiiska loo arko tallaabo si toos ah uga dhalatay dagaalkii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay la galeen Iran, isaga oo sheegay in fikradda iskaashiga saddex-geesoodka ah ay muddo soo jirtay, lagana wada hadlay kulamo hore oo dhexmaray dalalka saxiixay iyo dowlado kale. Hase yeeshee, heshiiska ayaa la saxiixay xilli dagaalka Iran uu si weyn u beddelay xisaabta amni ee gobolka. Dagaalka oo billowday 28-kii Febraayo ayaa dhaawacay kalsoonidii ay qaar ka mid ah dalalka Khaliijku ku qabeen dalladda amni ee Mareykanka, gaar ahaan markii jawaabihii militari ee Iran ay saameeyeen dalal martigeliya saldhigyo Mareykan ah. Taasi waxay sare u qaaday doodda ku saabsan in dowladaha gobolka ay dhistaan hannaan amni oo aan gebi ahaanba ku tiirsaneyn Washington. Farqiga Iran iyo Masar Doodda ku saabsan ballaarinta heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigtay kala duwanaanshaha siyaasadeed ee ka dhex jira dowladaha gobolka. Inkasta oo Erdogan uu si furan uga hadlay in dalal kale lagu soo daro, warbaahinta Middle East Eye ayaa bishan sheegtay in Sacuudi Carabiya ay diidday dadaal Turkigu ku doonayay in Masar laga dhigo xubin ka mid ah heshiiska. Saddex ilo-wareed oo Sacuudi ah ayaa sheegay in Riyadh aysan dooneyn in Masar lagu daro heshiiska “ugu yaraan hadda”, iyagoo arrinta ku sababeeyay caro sii kordheysa oo Sacuudigu ka qabo siyaasadaha dowladda Madaxweyne Abdel Fattah el-Sisi iyo su’aalo la iska weydiinayo miisaanka istiraatiijiyadeed iyo militari ee Qaahira. Haddii Iran ugu dambeyn lagu daro halka Masar ay bannaanka ka sii joogto, waxay taasi noqon kartaa calaamad muujineysa sida xulafeysiga Bariga Dhexe uu dib ugu qaabeynayo xiriirro hore oo muddo dheer loo arkayay kuwo joogto ah. Go’aanka ay Tehran ka gaarto martiqaadka ayaa sidaas darteed noqon kara mid ka weyn ku biirista heshiis difaac oo keliya. Waxa uu tilmaami karaa jihada uu u socdo hannaan cusub oo amni oo gobolka ah, kaas oo dalalka Bariga Dhexe ay isku dayayaan inay iyagu door weyn ka ciyaaraan dammaanad-qaadka ammaankooda, xilli kalsoonida lagu qabo nidaamkii amni ee uu Mareykanku hoggaaminayay ay sii wiiqmeyso. The post Iiraan oo lagu casuumay isbaheysiga difaac ee Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xoogaga Laftagareen oo u muuqdo kuwo culeyska ku kordhinaya Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ay dhaqdhaqaaq ka wadaan duleedka magaaladaasi. Ciidamadan ayaa waxay isugu jiraan ciidamo ka goostay Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed iyo maleeshiyaad qaab beeleed u abaabulan oo ka biyo diidan is bedelkii maamul iyo amni ee 30-kii bishii March ka dhacay Baydhabo, meeshana looga saaray maamulkii uu madaxda ka ahaa Cabdicasiis Laftagareen, waxaana hoggaaminaya saraakiil iyo masuuliyiin ka tirsanaa maamulkaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadan ay wax aad mooddo abaabul ka wadaan deegaanada dhaca duleedka waqooyi ee Baydhabo, sida Ceeldoon iyo Haabare. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa barro kontorool ku leh Burjeed iyo aagga Ceeldoon, waxayna ka mid yihiin goobaha laga ilaaliyo amniga Baydhabo. Dhanka kale maleeshiyaad qabaa’il, isla-markaana la safan Laftagareen ayaa la sheegay in Axaddii shalay lagu arkay nawaaxiga Xeradii Militariga Manaas oo 30km jihada waqooyi galbeed uga beegan Magaalada Baydhabo. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in maleeshiyadu ay ka timid dhinaca Degmada Waajid ee Gobolka Bakool. Saraakiisha Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ee ku sugan Baydhabo ayaa waxaa muuqato in ay la socdaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada ka jira daafaha magaalada, tiiyoo aysan weli qaadin wax tallaabo ah. Dhaqdhaqaaqyadan ayaa cabsida ku kordhinaya shacabka ku nool Baydhabo oo cabsidii ugu weyneyd dareemay 17-kii bishan, markaas oo magaalada ay weerar ballaaran ku qaadeen taageereyaasha Laftagareen. Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo Sabtidii shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Madaxtooyada Baydhabo ayaa ciidamada ka soo horjeeda ugu baaqay inay u soo laabtaan dadkooda, haddii kalena lagu weerari doono meelaha ay joogaan. Xoogaga u daacadda ah Laftagareen ayaa culeys amni ku haya Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Questionable Data Representation Reflects a Failure in Governance
items.description: By Nur H. Gure (Nurdiin) Former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire has delivered a compelling critique of Somalia’s economic condition . His primary contention that ineffective governance, fragile property rights, and institutional collapse hinder the generation, protection, and investment of Somali wealth is significant and largely correct. The fundamental challenge for Somalia has never been a lack of entrepreneurial drive, but rather a deficiency in the institutions required to safeguard the fruits of that entrepreneurship. Let me therefore be clear about what this article is not. It is not a defense of the incumbent government. Informal taxation, opaque public finances, contested land administration, shallow credit markets, and weak implementation capacity are genuine and long-standing issues. The outgoing government must remain accountable for its record on each of these matters. However, precisely because accountability is so critical, it must be grounded in accurate evidence. In his economic opinion piece published by Dawan Africa website, Khaire misrepresents several key figures from the World Bank report he cites, conflates measures of change with absolute levels, presents projections as observed outcomes, and attributes specific causal explanations to data that do not support such conclusions. These are not minor technicalities. Statistics belong to the public record. A political class that treats numbers as tools for persuasion rather than facts to be verified cannot credibly promise a new culture of accountability. Governments must be held responsible for their actions; those seeking to replace them must be held responsible for the accuracy of their claims. Economic Growth Decelerated Without Entering a Contraction Khaire notes that Somalia’s real GDP growth was contracting by 3 percent in 2025. However, the World Bank’s Somalia Economic Update 2026 ; World Bank reports the contrary, stating that real GDP grew by an estimated 3 percent in 2025, a decrease from the 4.1 percent recorded in 2024. As population growth offset most of this expansion, real GDP per capita remained largely stagnant. While this reflects weak and insufficient performance, it does not constitute a 3 percent reduction. (World Bank, 2026, pp. vi and 3.) Former Prime Minister Hassan A. Khaire This distinction is significant. An economy may expand even as households stay impoverished, prices rise, and per capita income fails to gain ground. In fact, this provides a more precise depiction of Somalia in 2025. Such criticism does not necessitate labeling a slowdown as a recession; the underlying reality is sufficiently concerning. The inflation data is also chronologically inaccurate. Khaire claims that inflation reached 6 percent, doubling from the previous year. However, the World Bank reports national headline inflation at 3.7 percent for 2025, compared to 3.3 percent in 2024. The 6 percent figure is actually a projection for 2026, rather than the recorded result for 2025. While Banadir and Jubaland did experience inflation exceeding 5.5 percent, creating genuine pressure on households, a national forecast for a future year cannot be used as a current measure, presented as the observed national rate for another. (World Bank, 2026, pp. vi, 4 and 16.) Khaire further states that household purchasing power fell by 5.7 percent and that 2025 represented the weakest year for business output and profit in a decade. However, his article provides no table, page reference, survey, or methodology to support either claim, and the Economic Update’s headline indicators do not report a 5.7 percent measure of household purchasing power. If a different dataset is being referenced, it should be identified. Assertions provided with decimal precision require sources of equal specificity. Credit Growth Differs from the Total Volume of Credit The same issue is evident in Khaire’s analysis of the banking sector. He states that business credit ‘collapsed from 30 percent in 2022 to just 14 percent in 2025. However, the World Bank’s data refers to the annual growth rate of private-sector credit. Credit growth slowed from nearly 30 percent in 2022-23 to 14 percent in 2025. Consequently, private credit did not collapse to 14 percent; it continued to expand, but at a slower rate. Other indicators within the same report reinforce that distinction. Commercial banks’ loan-to-deposit ratios rose above 30 percent in 2025, up from levels in the mid-20s during previous years. Capital adequacy stood at 16.6 percent, exceeding the regulatory minimum, while non-performing loans remained stable at approximately 2-3 percent. Furthermore, bank profitability recovered from a loss in 2024 to reported earnings before taxes and zakat of US$9.6 million. The report characterizes the banking system as generally sound. (World Bank, 2026, pp. 8-9.) This does not imply that Somalia possesses a sufficient credit system. On the contrary, credit to the private sector stands at approximately 5 percent of GDP, which is among the lowest levels globally, and lending is primarily concentrated in trade, construction, and real estate. The more significant and accurate critique is that while financial intermediation is expanding, it is doing so from an extremely shallow base and remains inaccessible to much of the productive economy. Khaire is accurate in noting that banks’ cash holdings decreased from 40 percent to 35 percent of total assets over the year. However, a reduced cash ratio does not, on its own, demonstrate that land-sale proceeds were moved abroad or that such transfers triggered a banking liquidity crisis. While the World Bank highlights significant cash outflows and a Central Bank cash-export limit of US$15 million per bank—factors that warrant Investigation does not link these outflows to the purported land transactions. That causal connection must be substantiated through transaction records rather than inferred through political means. Moreover, Khaire alleges unlawful land seizures, the transfer of proceeds abroad, the existence of sixteen informal checkpoints between Afgooye and Mogadishu, and a US$320 charge per container at Mogadishu port. While these claims may warrant investigation, his article fails to identify any responsible actors, land records, contracts, invoices, court findings, banking transactions, or independent evidence sufficient to establish them as settled facts. The food-import data highlights the distinction between a confirmed statistic and an unverified explanation. According to the World Bank, food imports decreased by 2.5 percentage points compared to the previous year. However, the organization situates this decline within the framework of diminishing foreign aid, a reduction in direct imports by aid agencies, and softened household demand. It does not credit the decrease to the purported US $320 port arrangement. (World Bank, 2026, pp. 6-7.) Port fees and checkpoints may exist, and unlawful land transfers may have occurred. However, demonstrating their existence is merely the first step; proving that they caused specific fluctuations in bank liquidity, food imports, or national inflation is a separate challenge. Serious accountability requires establishing these causal links, requiring both evidence of the conduct and evidence of the claimed economic effect. Khaire’s most politically significant claim is that 73 percent of the more than US$330 million allocated in 2024 and 70 percent of the more than US$407 million allocated in 2025 remained unspent. However, the article does not clarify which projects are included in these totals, the specific dates the data were retrieved, the designated implementation periods, or whether the term “allocated” denotes donor commitments, signed financing agreements, budget appropriations, available disbursements, or actual cash expenditures. Those categories are not interchangeable. A multi-year commitment does not represent funds sitting idle in a government account. Project disbursements are contingent upon procurement processes, safeguarding compliance, verified milestones, donor conditions, security access, and the performance of implementing agencies. Delayed disbursement may reflect weak state capacity a significant governance failure without proving that officials stole or deliberately withheld the funds. There is, however, official evidence of significant under-execution. The World Bank’s federal fiscal table shows actual capital spending of approximately US$75 million against a 2025 budget of US$182 million an execution rate of roughly 41 percent, resulting in a gap of about 59 percent. Furthermore, the Bank notes that limited capacity to implement infrastructure projects has kept Somali public investment among the lowest in the region. (World Bank, 2026, pp. 9-10 and 14-15.) That is a grave finding for which the government must be held accountable. However, this dataset differs from Khaire’s cross-institutional totals and does not validate his 70-73 percent calculation. To ensure that calculation is auditable, he should publish the project list, funding instrument, commitment date, amount legally available, amount disbursed, amount spent, and the institution responsible for every delay. A percentage presented without a transparent denominator creates an appearance of precision while concealing what is actually being measured. The Official Record Is Already Sufficiently Damning Correcting Khaire’s figures fails to present a favorable image of the outgoing administration. According to the same World Bank report, real per capita income remained largely stagnant, poverty reduction efforts stalled, and inflation increased. Furthermore, the fiscal balance shifted from a surplus of 0.1 percent of GDP in 2024 to a deficit of 0.4 percent in 2025, while domestic revenue continued to stay below the government’s own medium-term target. More critically, social-benefit spending plummeted to approximately 0.1 percent of GDP in 2025, the lowest level recorded in the report, coinciding with a decline in humanitarian assistance and intensifying food insecurity. The population facing acute food insecurity was estimated at 6.5 million in February-March 2026, increasing from 4.6 million during the same period in 2025. Administration and security continued to consume nearly half of budget allocations, while public investment remained exceptionally low. (World Bank, 2026, pp. vi, 10, 13 and 16.) These findings warrant rigorous scrutiny and demonstrate why exaggeration is unnecessary. A balanced explanation must account for the broader forces identified by independent assessments. The World Bank attributes the 2025 slowdown primarily to declining humanitarian and security assistance, drought conditions, and rising living costs. The IMF’s latest Somalia staff report Similarly, the IMF identifies foreign-aid cuts, security pressures, political tensions, and climate shocks as major risks. None of this absolves the government. While a government cannot avert every drought or force donors to sustain aid, it remains responsible for building resilience, developing water infrastructure, ensuring social protection, managing fiscal priorities, executing projects, coordinating the economy, and managing the quality of its response. Accountability entails distinguishing between what the government directly caused and what it failed to mitigate, and what lay substantially beyond its control. Somali Deserves a Unified Standard of Truth Khaire’s core argument remains compelling: economic success must be measured by the lived experiences of citizens, rather than through diplomatic rhetoric or headline GDP figures. National growth can occur even as households struggle. Public revenue may increase while citizens are subjected to arbitrary taxation. Credit can expand while the majority of entrepreneurs are still excluded. Furthermore, development commitments can rise even as local communities witness minimal improvement. But that argument gains strength rather than losing it when the figures are presented accurately. State that the economy grew by 3 percent, then elaborate on why that performance was insufficient. Note that credit expanded by 14 percent, then clarify why a credit stock amounting to approximately 5 percent of GDP remains entirely inadequate. Mention that food imports declined, then illustrate the specific forces that drove that reduction. Assert that development execution is weak, then release the portfolio and pinpoint the responsible institutions. The opposition has no less an obligation to tell the truth. Every exaggerated statistic provides the incumbent with an opportunity to dismiss legitimate criticism. Every unsupported allegation weakens those that can be proven. And every misleading comparison makes it easier for those in power to avoid answering the questions that matter. As Khaire warns, Somalia cannot afford another term of squandered wealth. However, it equally cannot afford another political generation that permits economic statistics to be manipulated by electoral incentives. A nation’s wealth is reflected not only in its land, businesses, infrastructure, natural resources, and human capital, but also in the integrity of its information through which citizens judge those who govern them. Anyone who compromises that integrity, whether within the government or during the pursuit of power, weakens it the very institutions he promises to build. Somalia has had enough of that. Nur H. Somalia Economic Update, Edition No. 11: Navigating Shocks, Powering Growth . May 2026. World Bank. Somalia’s Growth Continues, But Shocks and Aid Cuts Intensify Risks to Jobs and Livelihoods . Press release, 13 May 2026. International Monetary Fund. Somalia: Fourth Review Under the Extended Credit Facility Arrangement and Request for Augmentation of Access . However, the World Bank’s Somalia Economic Update 2026 ; World Bank reports the contrary, stating that real GDP grew by an estimated 3 percent in 2025, a decrease from the 4.1 percent recorded in 2024. As population growth offset most of this expansion, real GDP per capita remained largely stagnant. While this reflects weak and insufficient performance, it does not constitute a 3 percent reduction. (World Bank, 2026, pp. vi and 3.) This distinction is significant. An economy may expand even as households stay impoverished, prices rise, and per capita income fails to gain ground. In fact, this provides a more precise depiction of Somalia in 2025. Such criticism does not necessitate labeling a slowdown as a recession; the underlying reality is sufficiently concerning. The inflation data is also chronologically inaccurate. Khaire claims that inflation reached 6 percent, doubling from the previous year. However, the World Bank reports national headline inflation at 3.7 percent for 2025, compared to 3.3 percent in 2024. The 6 percent figure is actually a projection for 2026, rather than the recorded result for 2025. While Banadir and Jubaland did experience inflation exceeding 5.5 percent, creating genuine pressure on households, a national forecast for a future year cannot be used as a current measure, presented as the observed national rate for another. (World Bank, 2026, pp. vi, 4 and 16.) Khaire further states that household purchasing power fell by 5.7 percent and that 2025 represented the weakest year for business output and profit in a decade. However, his article provides no table, page reference, survey, or methodology to support either claim, and the Economic Update’s headline indicators do not report a 5.7 percent measure of household purchasing power. If a different dataset is being referenced, it should be identified. Assertions provided with decimal precision require sources of equal specificity. He states that business credit ‘collapsed from 30 percent in 2 022 to just 14 percent in 2025. However, the World Bank’s data refers to the annual growth rate of private-sector credit. Credit growth slowed from nearly 30 percent in 2022-23 to 14 percent in 2025. Consequently, private credit did not collapse to 14 percent; it continued to expand, but at a slower rate. Other indicators within the same report reinforce that distinction. Commercial banks’ loan-to-deposit ratios rose above 30 percent in 2025, up from levels in the mid-20s during previous years. Capital adequacy stood at 16.6 percent, exceeding the regulatory minimum, while non-performing loans remained stable at approximately 2-3 percent. Furthermore, bank profitability recovered from a loss in 2024 to reported earnings before taxes and zakat of US$9.6 million. The report characterizes the banking system as generally sound. (World Bank, 2026, pp. 8-9.) This does not imply that Somalia possesses a sufficient credit system. On the contrary, credit to the private sector stands at approximately 5 percent of GDP, which is among the lowest levels globally, and lending is primarily concentrated in trade, construction, and real estate. The more significant and accurate critique is that while financial intermediation is expanding, it is doing so from an extremely shallow base and remains inaccessible to much of the productive economy. Khaire is accurate in noting that banks’ cash holdings decreased from 40 percent to 35 percent of total assets over the year. However, a reduced cash ratio does not, on its own, demonstrate that land-sale proceeds were moved abroad or that such transfers triggered a banking liquidity crisis. While the World Bank highlights significant cash outflows and a Central Bank cash-export limit of US$15 million per bank—factors that warrant Investigation does not link these outflows to the purported land transactions. That causal connection must be substantiated through transaction records rather than inferred through political means. Moreover, Khaire alleges unlawful land seizures, the transfer of proceeds abroad, the existence of sixteen informal checkpoints between Afgooye and Mogadishu, and a US$320 charge per container at Mogadishu port. While these claims may warrant investigation, his article fails to identify any responsible actors, land records, contracts, invoices, court findings, banking transactions, or independent evidence sufficient to establish them as settled facts. The food-import data highlights the distinction between a confirmed statistic and an unverified explanation. According to the World Bank, food imports decreased by 2.5 percentage points compared to the previous year. However, the organization situates this decline within the framework of diminishing foreign aid, a reduction in direct imports by aid agencies, and softened household demand. It does not credit the decrease to the purported US $320 port arrangement. (World Bank, 2026, pp. 6-7.) Port fees and checkpoints may exist, and unlawful land transfers may have occurred. However, demonstrating their existence is merely the first step; proving that they caused specific fluctuations in bank liquidity, food imports, or national inflation is a separate challenge. Serious accountability requires establishing these causal links, requiring both evidence of the conduct and evidence of the claimed economic effect. Khaire’s most politically significant claim is that 73 percent of the more than US$330 million allocated in 2024 and 70 percent of the more than US$407 million allocated in 2025 remained unspent. However, the article does not clarify which projects are included in these totals, the specific dates the data were retrieved, the designated implementation periods, or whether the term “allocated” denotes donor commitments, signed financing agreements, budget appropriations, available disbursements, or actual cash expenditures. Those categories are not interchangeable. A multi-year commitment does not represent funds sitting idle in a government account. Project disbursements are contingent upon procurement processes, safeguarding compliance, verified milestones, donor conditions, security access, and the performance of implementing agencies. Delayed disbursement may reflect weak state capacity a significant governance failure without proving that officials stole or deliberately withheld the funds. There is, however, official evidence of significant under-execution. The World Bank’s federal fiscal table shows actual capital spending of approximately US$75 million against a 2025 budget of US$182 million an execution rate of roughly 41 percent, resulting in a gap of about 59 percent. Furthermore, the Bank notes that limited capacity to implement infrastructure projects has kept Somali public investment among the lowest in the region. (World Bank, 2026, pp. 9-10 and 14-15.) That is a grave finding for which the government must be held accountable. However, this dataset differs from Khaire’s cross-institutional totals and does not validate his 70-73 percent calculation. To ensure that calculation is auditable, he should publish the project list, funding instrument, commitment date, amount legally available, amount disbursed, amount spent, and the institution responsible for every delay. A percentage presented without a transparent denominator creates an appearance of precision while concealing what is actually being measured. The Official Record Is Already Sufficiently Damning Correcting Khaire’s figures fails to present a favorable image of the outgoing administration. According to the same World Bank report, real per capita income remained largely stagnant, poverty reduction efforts stalled, and inflation increased. Furthermore, the fiscal balance shifted from a surplus of 0.1 percent of GDP in 2024 to a deficit of 0.4 percent in 2025, while domestic revenue continued to stay below the government’s own medium-term target. More critically, social-benefit spending plummeted to approximately 0.1 percent of GDP in 2025, the lowest level recorded in the report, coinciding with a decline in humanitarian assistance and intensifying food insecurity. The population facing acute food insecurity was estimated at 6.5 million in February-March 2026, increasing from 4.6 million during the same period in 2025. Administration and security continued to consume nearly half of budget allocations, while public investment remained exceptionally low. (World Bank, 2026, pp. vi, 10, 13 and 16.) These findings warrant rigorous scrutiny and demonstrate why exaggeration is unnecessary. A balanced explanation must account for the broader forces identified by independent assessments. The World Bank attributes the 2025 slowdown primarily to declining humanitarian and security assistance, drought conditions, and rising living costs. The IMF’s latest Somalia staff report Similarly, the IMF identifies foreign-aid cuts, security pressures, political tensions, and climate shocks as major risks. None of this absolves the government. While a government cannot avert every drought or force donors to sustain aid, it remains responsible for building resilience, developing water infrastructure, ensuring social protection, managing fiscal priorities, executing projects, coordinating the economy, and managing the quality of its response. Accountability entails distinguishing between what the government directly caused and what it failed to mitigate, and what lay substantially beyond its control. Somali Deserves a Unified Standard of Truth Khaire’s core argument remains compelling: economic success must be measured by the lived experiences of citizens, rather than through diplomatic rhetoric or headline GDP figures. National growth can occur even as households struggle. Public revenue may increase while citizens are subjected to arbitrary taxation. Credit can expand while the majority of entrepreneurs are still excluded. Furthermore, development commitments can rise even as local communities witness minimal improvement. But that argument gains strength rather than losing it when the figures are presented accurately. State that the economy grew by 3 percent, then elaborate on why that performance was insufficient. Note that credit expanded by 14 percent, then clarify why a credit stock amounting to approximately 5 percent of GDP remains entirely inadequate. Mention that food imports declined, then illustrate the specific forces that drove that reduction. Assert that development execution is weak, then release the portfolio and pinpoint the responsible institutions. The opposition has no less an obligation to tell the truth. Every exaggerated statistic provides the incumbent with an opportunity to dismiss legitimate criticism. Every unsupported allegation weakens those that can be proven. And every misleading comparison makes it easier for those in power to avoid answering the questions that matter. As Khaire warns, Somalia cannot afford another term of squandered wealth. However, it equally cannot afford another political generation that permits economic statistics to be manipulated by electoral incentives. A nation’s wealth is reflected not only in its land, businesses, infrastructure, natural resources, and human capital, but also in the integrity of its information through which citizens judge those who govern them. Anyone who compromises that integrity, whether within the government or during the pursuit of power, weakens it the very institutions he promises to build. Somalia has had enough of that. Somalia Economic Update, Edition No. 11: Navigating Shocks, Powering Growth . May 2026. World Bank. Somalia’s Growth Continues, But Shocks and Aid Cuts Intensify Risks to Jobs and Livelihoods . Press release, 13 May 2026. International Monetary Fund. Somalia: Fourth Review Under the Extended Credit Facility Arrangement and Request for Augmentation of Access . items.title: Al-Shabaab ayaa u muuqata inay wax ka beddeshay qaabka ay uga hawlgasho Soomaaliya….
items.description: Warbixin cusub oo loo gudbiyey Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in al-Shabaab ay u muuqato inay wax ka beddeshay qaabka ay uga hawlgasho Soomaaliya, iyadoo yareysay tirada weerarrada balse xoogga saartay hawlgallo si gaar ah loo qorsheeyey loona bartilmaameedsaday. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale soo bandhigtay sheegashooyin ku saabsan xiriirka Al-Shabaab ay la leedahay Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo Al-Qaacida ee Jaziiradda Carabta, tababar la sheegay in boqolaal dagaalyahan loo fidiyey iyo isku dayga kooxda ee helitaanka qalab casri ah oo ay kaga hortagto diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Dukumentigan oo tirsigiisu yahay S/2026/651, lana daabacay 10-kii Agoosto 2026, waa warbixintii 38-aad ee Kooxda Dabagalka Cunaqabateynta ee Qaramada Midoobay, taas oo baarta dhaqdhaqaaqyada Daacish, Al-Qaacida iyo kooxaha xiriirka la leh. Mid ka mid ah qodobbada ugu muhiimsan warbixinta ayaa ah in Al-Shabaab ay u muuqato inay ka leexatay weerarradii tirada badnaa ee la arkay sannadkii 2025. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, kooxda waxay qaadday weerarro ka yar kuwii hore gudaha Muqdisho iyo deegaannada ku dhow, iyadoo hawlgalladeeda ay si weyn ugu urureen Hirshabeelle, Jubada Hoose, Jubada Dhexe, Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Galmudug. Qaramada Midoobay waxay arrintan ku tilmaantay u wareegid “hawlgallo bartilmaameed iyo istiraatiijiyad leh”. Tani waxay muujin kartaa in kooxda ay isku dayeyso inay si taxaddar leh u doorato bartilmaameedyada iyo waqtiga weerarrada, xilli ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadooda ay kordhiyeen duqeymaha iyo hawlgallada ka dhanka ah hoggaanka kooxda. Warbixintu ma faahfaahin noocyada bartilmaameedyada ay Al-Shabaab mudnaanta siinayso ama heerka uu isbeddelkan saameeyey awooddeeda guud. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadooda ay horumar ka sameeyeen wiiqidda hoggaanka Al-Shabaab. Cabdullaahi Cismaan Maxamed Caddow, oo loo yaqaannay Injineer Ismaaciil, ayaa la sheegay in la dilay bishii Diseembar 2025. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay inuu mas’uul ka ahaa hawlgallada qaraxyada macmalka ah ee kooxda. Cabdullaahi Xasan Cabdi Cosoble, oo lagu naaneysi jiray Cabdullaahi Wadaad, kana shaqeynayey arrimaha maaliyadda, ayaa la dilay bishii Janaayo. Maxamed Sahal Idl, oo loo yaqaannay Abuu Usaama, loona magacaabay inuu beddelo, ayaa isna la dilay bishii Febraayo. Inkasta oo khasaarahaas la gaarsiiyey hoggaanka kooxda, warbixintu waxay sheegtay in hoggaamiyaha Al-Shabaab, Axmed Diiriye, uu weli firfircoon yahay, laguna tuhunsan yahay inuu ku sugan yahay koonfurta Soomaaliya.

items.title: Xasan o ballan qaad u sameeyay ardaydii kaalmaha hore ka galay Imtixaanka shahaadiga
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta kulan gaar ah la qaatay ardayda kaalmaha hore ka galay imtixaanka shahaadiga fasalka 12-aad ee sanad-dugsiyeedka 2025 2026-ka, isagoo u sameeyay ballan qaad la xiriira waxbarashada jaamacadda. Ujeedkan kulankan oo ka dhacay xarunta Villa Somaaliya ahaa mid dhiirrigelin iyo bogaadin ah, kaas oo uu Madaxweynuhu la qaatay 10-kii arday ee kaalmaha ugu horreeya ka galay imtixaanka shahaadiga ah dugsiyada sare. Ugu horreyn Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa hambalyo iyo bogaadin u jeediyay ardayda, isaga oo ku ammaanay dadaalkooda, adkaysigooda iyo natiijada wanaagsan ee ay ka soo hooyeen imtixaanka, waxa uuna kula dardaarmay in ay sii laba-jibaaraan dadaalkooda waxbarasho. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa ardayda u ballanqaaday in arday kasta oo daneynaya in uu dalka gudhiisa ka sii wato waxbarashadiisa uu heli doono fursad waxbarasho oo bilaash ah, si loo dhiirrigeliyo haldoorka aqoonta iyo jiilka cusub ee dalka hoggaamin doona. items.title: Wasiirka caafimaadka oo xadhigga ka jaray qaybta qalliinka ee cusbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Xuseen Bashiir Xirsi, ayaa xadhigga ka jaray qaybta qalliinka ee Cusbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa, taas oo la dayactiray lana qalabeeyey. Dayactirkan ayaa suurto-gelinaysa in bukaanno badan ay helaan adeegyo qalliin oo tayo leh, isla markaana kor loo qaado hufnaanta, tayada iyo awoodda adeegyada qalliinka ee Cusbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka Iyo Maamulka Cusbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa ayaa mahadnaq iyo bogaadin u jeediyay dhammaan hay’adaha, shirkadaha iyo cid kasta oo ka qayb qaadatay hirgelinta mashruucan muhiimka ah, kaas oo faa’iido weyn u leh bulshada iyo horumarinta adeegyada caafimaadka.

items.title: Former Presidents Condemn Mogadishu Evictions as Hundreds of Families Are Reportedly Displaced
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s former presidents Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed Farmaajo and Sharif Sheikh Ahmed have strongly condemned the forced displacement of residents in Mogadishu’s Tookiyo neighborhood, describing the destruction of homes and removal of families as a deeply troubling abuse of state power. Their statements came after government security forces reportedly carried out an early-morning operation in Tookiyo, Yaqshiid district, forcing residents from their homes and demolishing properties amid a long-running dispute over land ownership. Farmaajo, in a statement issued Sunday evening, described the continued displacement of residents and what he called the unchecked seizure of land in the capital as a serious national tragedy. He condemned the reported demolition of homes occupied by children, women, elderly people and vulnerable families, saying such actions were incompatible with basic human dignity and compassion. Farmaajo called on President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud to immediately halt what he described as the forced displacement of civilians and the misuse of government institutions and security forces against citizens. “There can be no justification for forcibly removing Somali citizens from their homes in the darkness of night and destroying their property in front of them while using national forces,” Farmaajo said. He expressed solidarity with families whose homes were destroyed and residents who were displaced, saying their rights and dignity must be protected. Sharif Sheikh Ahmed also issued a strongly worded statement, expressing deep sadness over the operation and accusing the government of using national security forces in a manner that harmed the very citizens they were established to protect. He said the operation had reportedly displaced hundreds of families and resulted in the destruction or loss of civilian property. “The National Army was established to protect the dignity and rights of citizens, not to displace them or seize their property,” Sharif said. He warned that using security forces against civilians could severely damage public confidence in state institutions and deepen fear among families living in the capital. Sharif also said reports of deaths, injuries and property losses had emerged from the operation, although he did not provide specific figures or independent evidence to substantiate the extent of the casualties. A Human Cost Beyond the Land Dispute At the center of the controversy is a dispute over land that has become part of a much wider and increasingly painful debate over property rights and displacement in Mogadishu. Government authorities have previously argued that some disputed areas constitute public land that must be recovered and protected in the public interest. Residents, however, maintain that they have longstanding claims to the properties and question the legality and manner of their removal. The former presidents argue that regardless of the government’s position on land ownership, any seizure or demolition must follow clear legal procedures, due process and independent judicial review. The events in Tookiyo have therefore raised concerns that what begins as a land dispute can quickly become a humanitarian crisis when heavily armed forces are deployed against families. For residents who have lost their homes, the issue is no longer simply about land titles. It is about shelter, security, dignity and the fear of becoming displaced in their own city. The confrontation comes amid growing tensions over land administration, security and governance in Mogadishu. Critics of the government argue that forced evictions risk creating new internally displaced families and deepening public resentment toward state institutions. Such grievances could also have wider security consequences in a country where militant groups have historically exploited public anger and distrust of government authorities. Sharif urged residents of Mogadishu to remain united and defend their rights, while emphasizing the need for accountability and respect for the law. At the same time, establishing the full facts remains essential. The government has yet to provide a comprehensive public account of the operation, including its legal basis, the number of families affected, the extent of property destruction and any casualties. What happened in Tookiyo is therefore more than a dispute over land. It is a painful test of whether Somalia’s institutions can resolve property conflicts through law and justice rather than force—and whether the state can protect citizens from becoming displaced by the very authorities entrusted with protecting them. items.title: Federal judge vacates Trump policy that suspended processing of immigration visas from 75 countries
items.description: A federal judge in New York has vacated a Trump administration policy that suspended the processing of visas from 75 countries , including Afghanistan, Iran, Russia and Somalia, whose nationals the Trump administration deemed likely to require public assistance in the United States. U.S. District Judge Jeannette Vargas, an appointee of former President Joe Biden, set aside the policy Friday as “contrary to law and in excess of statutory authority.” Secretary of State Marco Rubio exceeded his authority by issuing the policy, which “runs afoul” of the Immigration and Nationality Act by mandating “the refusal of visas to eligible applicants without any basis in law,” the judge ruled. Judge says power lies with consular officers Vargas said the policy also undermines the congressional requirement that puts consular officers at the forefront of any visa decision. “Congress imbued these officers with exclusive authority and discretion to determine if an immigrant is eligible for a visa based upon review of specific and detailed criteria set forth in the statute,” she wrote. “The Policy, which categorically prohibits the issuance of immigrant visas based upon the nationality of the applicant, represents a direct abrogation of this statutory scheme.” The policy was challenged by two nonprofit organizations along with 11 individuals, including six whose family members had been refused visas. The remaining five are outside the country and had filed “employment-based petitions” to come to the United States. Advocates say keeping families apart is cruel “We welcome this ruling because, at its heart, this case is about keeping families together,” said Anna Gallagher, the executive director of CLINIC, a national nonprofit that provides training, resources, and support to a network of immigration legal service providers and was one of the plaintiffs. “Catholic social teaching calls us to uphold the dignity of every person and recognize the family as the foundation of society,” she said in a statement. “This decision affirms both those values and the rule of law, allowing families to once again move forward toward reunification.” Another plaintiff is African Communities Together, a Harlem-based nonprofit. One of its leaders called the ruling “a tremendous victory for the rule of law.” “This unlawful and racist ban caused immeasurable harm, cruelly keeping families and loved ones apart,” Diana Konate, deputy executive director for policy and advocacy, said in a statement. “Today, we are elated to tell our community members: this ban is no more.” Trump expands his anti-immigration agenda President Donald Trump has imposed a growing list of  immigration and travel bans  mostly for people from Africa, Asia and Latin America. The State Department said Saturday that the Trump administration is “protecting the American people by upholding the highest standards of screening and vetting of visa applicants,” and that it would not comment on pending litigation. At the time the policy was issued, the State Department said it had instructed consular officers to halt immigrant visa applications from the 75 countries in accordance with a broader order in November that tightened rules around potential immigrants who might become “public charges.” Relying on Council of Economic Advisers data, the State Department said that more than 30 percent of households with immigrants from these countries received some form of public assistance. A separate notice sent to all U.S. embassies and consulates said that non-immigrant visa applicants also should be “fully vetted and screened” for the possibility that they might seek public benefits in the United States. The cable, a copy of which was obtained by The Associated Press, noted several times that the applicant must prove they won’t apply for public benefits while in the U.S., and that consular officers who suspect the applicant might apply should require them to fill out a form proving their financial bona fides. The ruling is the latest example of the courts upending Trump’s immigration agenda. In June, a federal judge struck down a Trump administration policy that made it harder for immigrants from dozens of countries to enter and stay in America — affecting elements like asylum, work permits, green cards, and citizenship applications. That judge said the policy threw countless immigrants’ lives “into indeterminate legal limbo,” and accused the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services of ignoring the law. items.title: Speaker Jama Wins Praise for Reuniting Somalia’s Divided Parliament
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — New Speaker of Somalia’s House of the People Abdulqadir Mohamed Nur Jama has achieved what many considered an extremely difficult task; beginning to reunite a parliament that had become deeply divided into opposing political camps. Speaker Jama made reconciliation within the House a priority. His efforts have brought the leadership of the House and opposition lawmakers to the negotiating table, producing an agreement aimed at restoring cooperation and allowing Parliament to function more independently and effectively. The latest round of talks between Speaker Jama and a committee representing opposition MPs was said to have concluded in a calm and constructive atmosphere, with both sides emphasizing dialogue, parliamentary unity and institutional responsibility. The agreement covers several key principles: Parliamentary Neutrality The two sides agreed that the House must remain neutral toward all political sides and that its internal rules and procedures must be fully respected. The principle is significant given the political divisions that have increasingly affected parliamentary proceedings. A neutral speakership could help restore confidence among MPs who have questioned whether the institution has been operating fairly. Restoring Unity The parties also agreed to strengthen unity, cooperation and coordination among members of Parliament, allowing the House to effectively carry out its core responsibilities of legislation, representation and oversight of government institutions. The agreement further reaffirmed every MP’s right to express political opinions and differing views freely, in accordance with the House’s rules of procedure. Returning to the Chamber Another important commitment concerns attendance. Speaker Jama and opposition lawmakers agreed to work together to ensure that MPs return to parliamentary sessions and participate in proceedings in accordance with the House’s rules. The agreement could mark an important step toward ending a period in which political divisions had increasingly threatened the normal functioning of the legislature. An Unusually Fast Political Achievement What makes Speaker Jama’s initiative particularly noteworthy is the speed with which progress has been made. Speaker Jama has moved from assuming office to opening direct dialogue with MPs from the opposing political camp and securing agreement on principles designed to restore parliamentary cooperation. That is no small achievement in a political environment where disagreements have frequently hardened into institutional paralysis.vRather than allowing existing divisions to deepen, Jama appears to have chosen dialogue, neutrality and reconciliation as the foundation of his speakership. The challenge now is implementation. The credibility of the agreement will ultimately depend on whether all sides honor their commitments and allow Parliament to function as an independent national institution. Speaker Jama and the opposition representatives have called on all MPs to protect the dignity and integrity of Parliament, strengthen unity within the House and place the national interest and the interests of the Somali people above political divisions. For a Parliament that has spent considerable time divided, Speaker Jama deserves recognition for attempting what many regarded as nearly impossible—and for making tangible progress in less than two weeks. His real test, however, will be turning this initial breakthrough into a lasting culture of parliamentary cooperation and independence.
