items.title: Puntland Demands Answers Over Coastal Airstrikes, Raising Questions About Turkey’s Role in Somalia
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland has for the first time formally addressed a series of airstrikes along the Nugaal coast , demanding that the governments responsible explain why the attacks were carried out and who authorized them. The Puntland administration condemned the resurgence of piracy along Somalia’s coastline but said it was investigating information suggesting that newly emerging pirate networks may be receiving support from “forces outside Puntland.” Puntland also said airstrikes conducted on August 18 and 20 near Garmaal caused damage to fishermen and their property. The administration warned that attacks carried out without coordination with local authorities could undermine security cooperation between Puntland and its international partners. The unusually strong statement comes amid growing questions over the role of foreign governments in Somalia’s internal security operations—and particularly over Turkey’s expanding military and political footprint in the country. Questions Over Turkey’s Expanding Role Although Puntland did not publicly identify the country responsible for the airstrikes, the timing has intensified scrutiny of Turkey’s activities in Somalia. Turkey has developed one of the most extensive military and strategic relationships with Mogadishu, including a major military training presence and deepening defense cooperation with the Federal Government. Critics increasingly argue that Ankara’s approach toward Somalia resembles that of a neo-colonial power: negotiating directly with the central government, expanding its military footprint, pursuing strategic interests, and increasingly operating in areas where federal-state relations remain politically contested. The concern is not simply about military cooperation. It is about who has the authority to conduct military operations on Somali territory, who is consulted, and whether Somalia’s federal institutions and regional administrations are being treated as genuine partners or bypassed altogether. For Puntland, the reported strikes raise precisely that question. The controversy follows the reported hijacking of the M/V LUTUF off the coast of Eyl. Reports surrounding the vessel alleged that it was carrying weapons and communications equipment destined for a Turkish-operated training facility in Mogadishu. Those reports have not been independently established, and Puntland has not publicly accused Turkey of carrying out the airstrikes. Nevertheless, the sequence of events has generated speculation about the relationship between the alleged piracy resurgence, foreign military activity along Somalia’s coastline, and Turkey’s expanding security interests in the country. Puntland has demanded a clear explanation of who carried out the strikes and what their objectives were. That demand is significant. A foreign military operation affecting Puntland’s territory and civilians without transparent coordination risks deepening already serious tensions between Mogadishu and the federal member states. Sovereignty at the Center of the Dispute The broader issue is Somalia’s sovereignty. International security partnerships are intended to strengthen Somalia’s ability to protect its territory, combat terrorism and suppress piracy. But those partnerships can become politically destabilizing when foreign powers appear to exercise military authority without adequate consultation with the Somali institutions directly affected. Puntland’s warning that such actions could damage security cooperation should therefore not be dismissed as a routine political statement. It points to a deeper problem: Somalia cannot build a functioning federal state if foreign military partners are allowed to choose their counterparts, conduct operations and pursue strategic interests without a transparent national framework. Turkey’s growing influence makes the issue particularly sensitive. Ankara presents its relationship with Somalia as a partnership based on mutual interests and sovereignty. Critics, however, increasingly question whether the balance of that relationship is genuinely equal. The reported strikes also come as piracy appears to be re-emerging along parts of Somalia’s coastline, reviving fears that criminal networks could once again establish operational bases. Puntland has condemned the renewed piracy and says it is investigating the forces allegedly supporting the new groups. But the response to piracy must not create another security problem. If fishermen and civilians are caught in military operations, if local authorities are excluded from security decisions, or if foreign actors conduct strikes without adequate transparency, the result could be greater instability rather than greater security. The immediate priority, therefore, is accountability. Who ordered the strikes? Who carried them out? What intelligence justified them? Were Puntland authorities informed? And what was the legal basis for the operation? Until those questions are answered, speculation will continue—and so will concerns that foreign military influence in Somalia is expanding faster than the country’s own institutions can control it. For Puntland, the message is increasingly clear: security cooperation must not become a license for foreign powers to operate above Somalia’s federal political framework. items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo maanta la kulmay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa maanta Qasriga Madaxtooyada kulan kula yeeshay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada, Professor Yaasiin X. Maxamuud (Faratoon), General Mahad Cambaashe, Siyaasiyad Fahiima Yusuf Quuje, Guddoomiyaha Guddida Nabadda Qaranka, Cabdulqaadir Jirde, Wasiirro iyo Masuuliyiin ka tirsan Xukuumadda, kulankaasi oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta gogosha nabadda, midnimada iyo wadajirka bulshada Somaliland. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu mar kale xaqiijiyey in laga bilaabo maalintii loo dhaariyey xilka Qaranka (12.12.2024), mudnaanta koowaad ee Xukuumaddiisu ay tahay ilaalinta nabadda, xasilloonida iyo walaalaynta shacabka Somaliland, min bari ilaa galbeed, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyey in wixii khilaaf iyo xurguf ah ee jira lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, is-afgarad iyo walaalnimo waarta. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si gaar ah ugu mahad naqay Siyaasiyad Fahiima Yusuf Quuje, isaga oo uga mahad naqay ku soo noqoshada dalkeeda iyo sida ay ugu soo hiratay ciiddeeda iyo calankeeda, taasoo wax ka tari karta gogosha nabadda iyo walaalaynta bulshada JSL ee bariga Gobolka Sool. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu ku boorriyey dhammaan qaybaha bulshada in ay ka wada shaqeeyaan nabadda iyo isku duubnida Qaranka, maadaama Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay tahay hoy iyo dal ay wada leeyihiin dhammaan muwaadiniinteedu, midnimadeeda iyo nabaddeeduna tahay masuuliyad Qaran oo wada saaran.

items.title: Liban Shuluq Rebukes Opposition as Galmudug Election Race Intensifies
items.description: Galkacyo (WDN) — Galmudug presidential candidate Liban Ahmed Hassan, widely known as Liban Shuluq, has delivered a pointed rebuke to opposition forces challenging the Federal Government’s election strategy, urging them to abandon confrontation and accept what he described as the proper political path to power. Liban Shuqul , is a businessman associated with the Qat trade and is reported to have business ties to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. Liban Shuluq is already being presented by Villa Somalia as the next and the only president of Galmudug, long before a credible and competitive electoral process has taken place. His candidacy leaves no room for genuine competition, reinforcing the believe that the outcome has effectively been decided in advance. This comes as no surprise to anyone who has closely followed Somali politics and Villa Somalia’s political conduct: while publicly engaging in rhetoric about a fair one-person, one-vote system, President Hassan Sheikh is anointing and positioning his candidates before elections are even held. Speaking in Galkayo at a farewell ceremony for outgoing Galmudug President Ahmed Abdi Kariye Qoor-Qoor, Liban Shuluq praised the president for what he described as a record of service and for putting the interests of his people ahead of personal political ambitions. But the most striking part of Liban’s remarks was his direct attack on opponents of the Federal Government, particularly those rejecting the electoral process being advanced by Mogadishu. Liban accused opposition figures of seeking power through confrontation rather than through elections, delivering a message that is aligned with the political narrative emerging from Villa Somalia. “Two years ago, people were telling me that the president’s term had expired and asking why I was not fighting. My message to the opposition is: be patient. If you insult and attack the national leadership, you are only hurting yourselves,” Liban said. His comments come as President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government pushes ahead with a controversial electoral roadmap that opposition leaders have rejected as one-sided and designed to favor candidates supported by Villa Somalia. Critics argue that the model is reproducing the political spectacle witnessed in Baidoa, where the electoral process has been fiercely disputed and opposition forces have accused the Federal Government of manipulating the process to ensure the victory of its preferred candidate. Hirshabelle is also expected to follow the same trajectory, raising fears among opposition groups that a broader pattern is emerging: elections formally presented as democratic contests but structured in a manner that virtually guarantees victory for candidates acceptable to Villa Somalia. The message emerging from Galmudug is increasingly clear: what President Hassan Sheikh wants is what will happen. By openly backing and politically elevating his preferred candidate, Villa Somalia is seen as exerting overwhelming influence over a process that should belong to the people and institutions of Galmudug. An election cannot credibly be described as free or fair when one candidate is effectively declared the winner before the vote is held. The Bigger Political Battle Liban’s remarks expose the widening divide between two competing visions for Somalia’s political future. Villa Somalia and its allies insist that the country must move forward with elections under the existing framework. The opposition, meanwhile, argues that the process must first be renegotiated to guarantee political neutrality and prevent the Federal Government from using state institutions to engineer favorable outcomes. The battle over Galmudug could therefore become much larger than a contest between individual candidates. It may serve as another test of whether Somalia’s emerging electoral system can produce a genuinely competitive political outcome—or whether elections will increasingly become mechanisms for confirming candidates already favored by those controlling the machinery of government. With Baidoa still casting a long shadow and Hirshabelle potentially next in line, Galmudug may now be the next major arena in Somalia’s escalating struggle over who controls the electoral process—and ultimately who controls the country’s political future. items.title: Kharashka lagu raaco baabuurta Baydhabo iyo Muqdisho oo qaaliyoobay
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegaya inuu kordhay qiimaha lagu raaco gaadiidka rakaabka ee isugu kala goosha Baydhabo iyo Muqdisho, xilli ay xiisad amni ka jirto magaaladaasi. Dadka deegaanka qaarkood ayaa isaga baxaya magaalada, taasoo saamayn ku yeelatay qiimaha lagu raaco gaadiidka yaryar ee ka shaqeeya waddada xiriirisa Magaalooyinka Baydhabo iyo Muqdisho. Mashquul iyo saxmad ayaa illaa Khamiistii laga dareemayay Boosteejada Aargada ee xaafadda Idaada ee laga raaco gaadiidka aada dhinaca Caasimadda Muqdisho. Qiimaha caadiga ah ee muddo dheer ay dadku ku raaci jireen baabuurta ayaa ahaa soddon dollar ($30), halka hadda ay dadku ku raacayaan konton dollar ($50), waana koror aad u weyn oo ku dhow laba laab. Aadan Cali Isaaq oo ka mid ah dadka deegaanka ee ka barakacay magaalada ayaa sheegay in reer Baydhabo ay farriimo cabsi gelin ah uga imanayaan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, kuwaas oo dadka ku khasbaya buu yiri inay isaga baxaan magaalada. “Dadka teleefanada ayaa laga soo wacayaa, qaarkoodna moobeelada ayaa farriimo loogu soo dirayaa oo la leeyahay ka baxa magaalada, ka hor inta aanan gubin.” Ayuu yiri Aadan Cali oo Universaltv la hadlay. Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo maanta dib ugu laabtay Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa wax nasiib darro ah ku tilmaamay in saraakiil dhan oo horey uga tirsanaa dowladda ay maanta iskaashi la leeyihiin maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, isla-markaana ay kala shaqeynayaan weerarada ka dhanka ah qaranka. “Koley Dowladda Soomaaliyeed iyo Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ayaa la xisaabtami doona dadka waxaas sameynaya.” Ayuu yiri Aadan Madoobe oo intaa raaciyay “Tan kale walaalnimada iyo wanaagga weli managa dhammaanin, dhallinyarada la khalday waxaan uga digaynaa in la dhumiyay, ayna ka waan-toobaan, dadkoodana ay u soo noqdaan.” Aadan Madoobe ayaa ku hanjabay in haddii dadkaasi aysan waxba ka bedelin xaaladdooda ay keeni doonto in lagu weeraro goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin. “Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed iyo Dowladda Federaalkaba way iska difaacayaan dadkaasi, difaac keliya ma ahanee ,meelahooda ayay ugu tagayaan weliba, haddii uu Ilaahay yiraahdo.” Ayuu yiri Aadan Madoobe oo shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Madaxtooyada Baydhabo.

items.title: Daawo: Jubbaland oo tallaabo xasaasi ah qaaday kadib heshiiskii Cabdirashiid Janan
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Dowlad-goboleedka Jubaland ayaa maanta bilowday diiwaangelinta ciidamada Darawiishta ee haatan ku sugan duleedka magaalada Beled Xaawo ee gobolka Gedo. Ciidamada ayaa lagu sameynayaa xog diiwaangelin rasmi ah, iyada oo macluumaadka laga ururinayo lagu keydinayo Data Center-ka dowladda, si loo helo xog mideysan oo ku saabsan ciidamada ku sugan goobaha kala duwan ee Jubaland. Tallaabada oo ah mid xasaasi ah ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli maamulka Axmed Madoobe uu dhawaan heshiis la gaaray Cabdirashiid Xasan Nuur (Janan) oo ahaa Taliyihii Nabad Sugidda dowladda dhexe ee gobolka Gedo. Maxay ka dhigan tahay tallaabada Jubbaland? Xogta la keydinayo ayaa la xiriirta ciidamada iyo goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin, iyadoo nidaamkan loogu talagalay in Jubbaland ay si rasmi ah ula socoto ciidamada ka howlgala deegaanada maamulkaasi. Jubbaland ayaa muddooyinkii dambe xoogga saareysay sidii loo dhisi lahaa nidaam casri ah oo lagu maamulo ciidamada, loona sameeyo xog rasmi ah oo fududeysa qorsheynta amniga iyo howlaha ciidanka. items.title: Clan Fighting Erupts in Western Lughaya, Awdal Region
items.description: Lughaya, Awdal (WDN)— Fighting has erupted in areas west of Lughaya district in Somalia’s Awdal region, with clashes reportedly beginning early this morning and continuing throughout the day. According to Awdal Media, the fighting involves members of the Bahabar Muuse sub-clan of the Gadabuursi and armed groups affiliated with the Ciise clan. Residents contacted by the outlet reported casualties and other losses on both sides, although the exact number of dead and wounded remains unclear as fighting continues and access to the affected areas remains difficult. The latest clashes are not an isolated incident. The dispute has reportedly been simmering since last year, with recurring tensions between the communities gradually deepening and creating an increasingly volatile security environment in western Lughaya. Residents said the area had witnessed heightened armed mobilization and increased movement of fighters in recent days, raising fears that the longstanding dispute could escalate into a wider clan conflict. The renewed fighting highlights the fragility of local security arrangements in parts of Awdal, where unresolved disputes, armed mobilization and competition over territory and resources can quickly turn local tensions into wider violence. The immediate priority is preventing further escalation and protecting civilians caught in the fighting. Without a credible mediation effort involving respected traditional elders, local authorities and other stakeholders, the latest clashes risk deepening grievances that have already persisted for more than a year. The full scale of the casualties and damage remains unknown, and further developments are expected as information emerges from the affected communities. items.title: Isbahaysi milatari oo ka mid tahay Somalia oo Muqdisho ka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimada Soomaaliya waxaa si rasmi ah uga bilaabatay munaasabadda daahfurka mashaariicda Isbahaysiga Milatari ee Islaamka ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada (IMCTC) ka fulinayo Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta dadaallada ka dhanka ah xagjirnimada iyo argagixisada. Mashaariicdan waxaa ugu horreeya Barnaamijka Wariyaasha Nabadda, oo lagu xoojinayo doorka warbaahinta iyo wariyeyaasha ee ka hortagga xagjirnimada iyo argagixisada, iyadoo sidoo kale xoogga la saarayo kor u qaadista nabadda, wacyigelinta bulshada iyo faafinta farriimaha ka hortagga fikirka xagjirka ah. Munaasabadda waxaa ka qeybgalaya wasiirro ka tirsan Xukuumadda Soomaaliya, oo ay ka mid yihiin Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi, Wasiirka Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Xasan Macallin Maxamuud iyo Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag). Sidoo kale, waxaa munaasabadda goobjoog ka ah qaar ka mid ah taliyeyaasha ciidamada, safiirro, wakiillo ka socda Isbahaysiga IMCTC iyo Saaxiibada Caalamka. Barnaamijkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo awoodda hay’adaha dowladda iyo bulshada ee ka hortagga argagixisada iyo xagjirnimada oo xlligan muhiim u ah dalkeenna. Waxaa kale oo skaashigan caalamiga ah uu yahay qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dadaalladaas, iyadoo IMCTC ay Soomaaliya kala shaqeyso arrimo la xiriira xoojinta awoodaha iyo iskaashiga dhinaca la-dagaallanka argagixisada. Si kastaba, mashaariicda maanta la daahfuray ayaa la filayaa inay door wayn ka qaataan sare u qaadista wacyiga bulshada iyo xoojinta kaalinta warbaahinta ee ka hortagga faafitaanka fikirka xagjirka ah, iyadoo la siinayo wariyeyaasha aqoon iyo agab ay si masuuliyad leh uga warbixiyaan arrimaha la xiriira nabadda iyo amniga. Daahfurka mashaariicdan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya inuu sii xoogeysanayo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo IMCTC, iyadoo dhinacyada ay doonayaan in dadaallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada lagu saleeyo hannaan isku dhafan oo ay qeyb ka yihiin hay’adaha amniga, warbaahinta iyo bulshada. items.title: Puntland iyo Galmudug oo kala dhex galay kooxihii ku dagaalamay Gaalkacyo
items.description: Maamulada Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Puntland iyo Galmudug ayaa gelinkii dambe ee Sabtidan kala qaaday labadii maleeshiyo beeleed ee maanta ku dagaalamay magaaladaasi. Maamulada ayaa ciidamo isku dhaf ah kala dhex dhigay labada dhinac, iyagoona ku dadaalaya soo celinta xasilloonida magaalada. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Hay’adda NISA ay qayb ka yihiin ciidamada kala dhex galay dhinacyada, si xaaladda loo dejiyo. Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada ay u suurtagashay inay kooxihii ku dagaalamay xaafadda Horumar ama Buulo Bacley ay ka raraan barrihii ay ku sugnaayeen, si looga hortago isku dhac dambe. Dagaalkan ayaa daba socdo nin horaantii bishan lagu dilay afaafka hore Saldhigga Booliska Miir, wuxuuna dagaalku uu ka qarxay magaalada, markii maleeshiyo ku heyb ah ninka la dilay ay damceen inay nin kale aano ahaan ugu dilaan xaafadda Horumar, balse isku daygaasi oo fashilmay uu kiciyay xiisad iyo dagaalka maanta ku dhex maray xaafadda Buulo Bacley oo ka mid ah xaafadaha kala qaybiya labada maamul ee Galmudug iyo Puntland ee ka jira magaaladaasi. Dagaalka oo socday dhowr saacadood oo xiriir ah ayaan weli la sheegin khasaaraha dhabta ah ee uu gaystay, laakiin dadka deegaanka ayaa kuu sheegaya in dhimasho iyo dhaawacba uu jiro.

Abaaraha daba dheeraaday ayaa si gaar ah u saameeyay dadka ku tiirsan xoolaha iyo beeraha, halka roobabka xooggan ee xilliyada qaar da’a ay sababeen fatahaado waxyeello u geysta dadka ku nool hareeraha wabiyada iyo dhulka hoose. items.title: Garsoore Mareykan ah oo laashay hakintii fiisooyinka 75 dal oo Soomaaliya ku jirto
items.description: Garsoore ka tirsan Maxkamadda Federaalka Mareykanka ee Manhattan, Jeannette Vargas, ayaa Jimcihii 21-ka Agoosto 2026 laashay siyaasaddii maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ee hakisay hab-socodka bixinta fiisooyinka muhaajiriinta ee muwaadiniinta 75 waddan, oo ay Soomaaliya ka mid tahay. Garsoore Vargas ayaa go’aamisay in siyaasadda uu Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanku soo saartay Janaayo, ayna dhaqan-gelisay Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Marco Rubio, ay ahayd mid “si cad uga hor imaanaysa sharciga” isla markaana ka baxsan awoodda sharci ee xoghayaha. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in sharciga socdaalka Mareykanku awoodda go’aaminta fiisaha u dhiibay saraakiisha qunsuliyadaha, kuwaas oo ay tahay inay codsade kasta si gaar ah u qiimeeyaan. Sidaa darteed, in si guud loo joojiyo fiisooyinka iyadoo lagu salaynayo dhalashada qofka ayaa maxkamaddu u aragtay inay ka hor imanayso nidaamka uu Kongareeska dejiyay. Siyaasadda la laalay ayaa saameysay muwaadiniinta 75 waddan oo ku kala yaalla Afrika, Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe, Latin America, Balkans iyo Caribbean-ka. Dowladda Mareykanka waxay markii hore ku sababaysay hakinta walaac la xiriira in qaar ka mid ah dadka dalalkaas ka imaanaya ay mustaqbalka ku tiirsanaan karaan adeegyada iyo kaalmada dowladda Mareykanka. Soomaaliya ayaa ka mid ah dalalka ay go’aanka maxkamaddu si toos ah u saameyn karto, gaar ahaan dadka Soomaalida ah ee sugayay ama qorsheynayay fiisooyinka muhaajiriinta ee Mareykanka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, go’aankan macnaheedu ma aha in dhammaan xayiraadaha socdaalka ee Mareykanka laga qaaday muwaadiniinta Soomaaliya.

items.title: Somalia moves to block Somaliland precedent after speaker’s TRNC gesture, clarifies Cyprus stance
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A single sentence of gratitude, posted by Somalia’s newly elected parliament speaker to an official of a government Somalia does not recognize, has forced Mogadishu into a four-day diplomatic scramble – and handed critics fresh ammunition against the federal government’s own case for territorial sovereignty. Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, Speaker of the House of the People of Somalia’s Federal Parliament and a figure popularly known online as “Jama TikTok,” recently thanked the speaker of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (TRNC) assembly for congratulating him on his election. It took his own government four days, and a formal ministry statement, to say the post did not reflect Somali foreign policy. “I extend my sincere thanks to H.E. Dr. Ziya Öztürkler, Speaker of the Assembly of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, for his kind congratulations on my election as Speaker of the House of the People of the Federal Parliament of Somalia,” Nur wrote on X. “I deeply appreciate this thoughtful gesture.” The post quickly drew condemnation from senior Somali political figures, who said it risked legitimizing a disputed entity that most of the international community, including Somalia, does not recognize. Former Federal Minister of Planning and International Cooperation Abdirahman Abdishakur and former National Security Adviser Hussein Sheikh Ali were among the most prominent critics, both describing the move as naive and diplomatically damaging. “This is the consequence of installing an illegitimate, inexperienced and handpicked individual in one of the highest offices of the state,” Abdishakur wrote on X, calling the post “a reckless departure from Somalia’s established foreign-policy position on a highly sensitive international dispute” that “risks undermining Somalia’s own argument for sovereignty and territorial integrity.” The episode quickly spread across Somali social media, where supporters of Somaliland’s push for independence, along with political opponents of the federal government, seized on it as evidence of inconsistency in Mogadishu’s positioning. The timing amplified the sensitivity: the federal government is already at odds with Israel over its recent recognition of Somaliland, and Mogadishu has been working to rally international backing against any further recognition of the breakaway northern territory. Four days after the post went viral, Somalia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Friday moved to shut the controversy down. In a formal statement, the ministry said its position on Cyprus “remains unchanged” and continues to be guided by the UN Charter and UN Security Council Resolutions 541 (1983) and 550 (1984) – recognizing only the Republic of Cyprus, not the TRNC that Nur had thanked. Crucially, the ministry was explicit that Nur’s post carried no institutional weight: “The referenced personal communication post does not reflect, and shall not be interpreted as, any change in the foreign policy of the Federal Republic of Somalia. It does not constitute recognition of any separate entity in the northern part of Cyprus, and no decision has been taken by the Federal Government to alter its established position.” That position puts Mogadishu at odds with Turkey – Somalia’s closest ally, the TRNC’s only backer, and a government widely seen as wielding significant influence over the newly elected speaker of Somalia’s parliament. Analysts see internal rift over Cyprus policy Rashid Abdi, a Nairobi-based analyst on the Horn of Africa with Sahan Research, said the four-day gap between the controversy erupting and the government’s formal response pointed to friction within Mogadishu over how closely to align with Turkey on the Cyprus question. “It took Somalia four days to formally respond and clarify its position on Cyprus,” Abdi said. “This is likely an indication of internal friction between the pro-Turkey camp who favour relations with TRNC and those who prefer Somalia to stay out of Cyprus and maintain traditional international consensus.” Abdi said broader geopolitical calculations by Ankara were likely at play, describing what he characterized as an active push by Turkey for wider international recognition of the TRNC. He said elements sympathetic to Turkey view a closer Mogadishu-TRNC relationship as reinforcing Somalia’s strategic partnership with Ankara while cutting against the emerging ties between Israel and Somaliland, and as a way to preempt any move by Cyprus or Greece to formally recognize Somaliland. Abdi said that after Somalia’s Foreign Ministry issued its clarification, a coordinated Turkish social media campaign emerged in defense of Nur, with some accounts, in his characterization, going further to praise the speaker’s post as a “bold, principled stance” and to argue Somalia should reverse course and formally recognize the TRNC. “Much more than being an inadvertent, genuine mistake, it now looks like Jama’s post was intended to trigger precisely what is now happening – a foreign policy debate on Somalia’s traditional position on Cyprus,” Abdi said, adding that the controversy’s timing, coinciding with Somalia and Turkey marking 15 years of what both governments describe as a “strategic partnership,” was, in his assessment, unlikely to be coincidental. Abdi said the fallout has also created visible strain inside the federal government, with pro-Turkey accounts on X directing criticism at Foreign Ministry State Minister Ali Balcad and Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre. According to Abdi’s account, both officials are alleged by these online critics to have pushed for the removal of Nur’s original post – an allegation Somali Guardian has not independently verified and which neither Balcad’s nor Barre’s offices have publicly addressed. Abdi further suggested, by his own characterization, that the two officials may also have faced outreach from Cypriot and European diplomats over the episode. Observers have long speculated that Greece and Cyprus could follow Israel in extending recognition to Somaliland. Some analysts argue that the parliament speaker’s TRNC message – regardless of intent – sets a precedent that could make it easier for Cyprus and Greece, both close allies of Israel, to justify a similar move toward Somaliland, which they say is why Mogadishu moved quickly to both clarify its Cyprus position and press for the post’s removal. “The escalating Israel-Turkey rivalry in the wider Mediterranean/Levant theatre is now rapidly converging with the competition over the Red Sea/Gulf of Aden,” Abdi said. Neither Nur’s office nor Turkey’s government had issued a public response to the Somali Foreign Ministry’s statement as of publication. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Somaliland Waxay Rabtaa In ay Gacan Ka Geysato Sugidda Amniga Badda Cas
items.description: Warbixin ay soo saartay warbaahinta caalamiga ah ee The Economist ayaa iftiimisay qorshaha Xukuumadda Somaliland ee ku aaddan inay door muuqda ka qaadato sugidda amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Warbixintu waxay tilmaamaysaa in Somaliland ay doonayso inay caalamka tusto muhiimaddeeda juqraafiyeed iyo istaraatiijiyadeeda wax ku oolka ah, iyadoo xoojinaysa doorkeeda amni, ganacsi iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Sida lagu sheegay warbixintan oo Wargeyska Dawan soo xigtay, Somaliland waxay ku taallaa meel istaraatiiji ah oo ku dhow marinka Bab el-Mandeb, oo ah marin-biyood muhiim ah oo isku xidha Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Waxa kale oo warbixinta lagu xusay in goobta istaraatiijiga ah ee ay ku taallo ay ka dhigaysaa Somaliland meel si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah amniga maraakiibta iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan xilli Badda Cas ay wajahayso khataro amni oo ka imanaya colaadaha Yemen iyo weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo maraakiibta. Sidoo kale, warbixinta ayaa si weyn u ammaantay siyaasadda iyo hoggaaminta madaxweynaha Somaliland, Dr. Cabdiraxmaan Cirro, waxaana lagu yidhi “Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi waa hoggaamiye leh himilo siyaasadeed oo weyn. Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro oo ah diblomaasi 68 jir ah, waxaa Bishii Diseembar 2024 loo dhaariyay madaxweynaha Somaliland, oo ah jamhuuriyad madax-bannaan tan iyo sannadkii 1991. Intii uu Cirro xilka hayey, Israel waxay 26-kii Diseembar 2025 si rasmi ah u aqoonsatay Somaliland, iyadoo noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee sidaas sameeya. Tallaabadaasi waxay Somaliland u ahayd horumar diblomaasiyadeed oo taariikhi ah, kadib tobannaan sano oo ay raadineysay aqoonsi caalami ah.” Warbixintu waxa kale oo ay intaasi raacisay “Adduunku wuxuu Somaliland iska indho-tirayay muddo 35 sano ah,” ayuu Cirro u sheegay The Economist. Hadalkani wuxuu muujinayaa himiladiisa ah in Somaliland aanay mar dambe noqon meel caalamku iska indho-tiro, balse ay hesho dareenka, tixgelinta iyo kaalinta istaraatiijiga ah ee ay mudan tahay, gaar ahaan marka la eego muhiimadda ay u leedahay amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka.” Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta The Economist, Somaliland waxay aaminsan tahay in goobta ay ku taallo ay leedahay muhiimad istaraatiiji ah oo aan la iska indho-tiri karin, marka laga hadlayo Xeebteeda dheer, gaar ahaan magaalada Berbera oo ku taalla Gacanka Cadmeed. Taas oo ay warbixintu xustay in ay Somaliland siinayso fursad ay door muuqda kaga qaadato amniga badda, ganacsiga iyo saadka gobolka. Xilli amniga Badda Cas uu noqday arrin caalami ah. “Somaliland waxay doonaysaa inay isu muujiso qayb ka mid ah xalka sugidda amniga Badda Cas, iyadoo ka faa’iidaysanaysa juqraafiyaddeeda iyo xasilloonideeda. Haddii ay noqoto lamaane lagu kalsoonaan karo oo dhinacyada amniga badda iyo ganacsiga ah, taasi waxay kordhin kartaa miisaankeeda diblomaasiyadeed. Sidoo kale Dekedda Berbera oo ah mid ka mid ah hantida ugu muhiimsan ee Somaliland. Maalgashiga iyo horumarinta dekedda, oo ay qayb weyn ka tahay iskaashiga Somaliland, Imaaraadka Carabta iyo DP World, ayaa Berbera ka dhigay xarun muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo isku-xidhka gobolka iyo suuqyada ganacsiga Caalamiga ah. Taasina waxay Somaliland siinaysaa fursad ay isku hal mar kaga faa’iidaysato ganacsi, maalgashi, saadka iyo iskaashi amni,” ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay warbixinta The Economist.

items.title: mamulaha school ka Oo Ardayda Lacag Ku Siinaya Xaadirista Dugsiga hoose& sare
items.description: Detroit oo ardayda lacag siinaya xaadirista dugsiga Dugsiyada Dadweynaha Detroit ayaa sanad dugsiyeedka 2026-27 ballaariyay barnaamijka dhiirrigelinta xaadirista, iyadoo ardayda dugsiyada sare loo siinayo $100 toddobaad kasta oo ay si buuxda u xaadiraan, halka ardayda fasallada 6aad ilaa 8aad ay heli karaan $50 toddobaadkii. Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalka degmada ay ku doonayso inay ku yareyso maqnaanshaha joogtada ah ee ardayda. Barnaamijka oo la yiraahdo “Perfect Attendance Pays” a yaa markii hore diiradda saarayay ardayda dugsiyada sare, balse natiijooyin ay degmadu sheegtay ayaa horseeday in lagu daro ardayda dugsiyada dhexe. Ujeeddadu waa in ardayda lagu dhiirrigeliyo inay fasallada joogaan, xilli maqnaanshaha joogtada ahi uu weli caqabad ku yahay waxbarashada Detroit. Sanad dugsiyeedkii hore, ku dhawaad 12,800 oo arday oo dhigta dugsiyada sare ayaa helay ugu yaraan hal kaar Visa ah oo qiimihiisu yahay $100, halka qaar ka mid ah ardaydu ay heleen ilaa $1,000. Barnaamijkii 2025-26, ardayda dugsiyada sare waxay heli kareen $100 marka ay si buuxda uga soo qaybgalaan shan maalmood oo dugsi ah. Haddii ay buuxiyaan dhammaan 10-ka wareeg ee loo qorsheeyay, lacagta ay heli karaan waxay gaari kartay $1,000. Degmadu waxay caddeysay in lacagtu tahay kaar Visa ah, oo aan loo bixin lacag caddaan ah. Shuruudaha barnaamijku waa kuwo adag. Ardaygu waa inuu xaadiraa dhammaan saacadaha waxbarashada ee maalinta si uu u helo abaalmarinta wareeggaas, iyadoo maqnaansho cudurdaar leh iyo mid aan cudurdaar lahayn labadaba ay ka reebayaan ardayga inuu helo lacagta wareeggaas. Degmada ayaa sheegtay in barnaamijku uu horey u muujiyay natiijooyin wanaagsan. Kormeeraha guud ee Detroit Public Schools Community District, Nikolai Vitti, ayaa sheegay in dhiirrigelinta dhaqaale ay saameyn wanaagsan ku yeelatay xaadirista ardayda dugsiyada sare. Laakiin maamulka degmada ma doonayo in lacag bixinta loo arko xalka keliya. Detroit waxay sidoo kale maalgelin ku samaynaysaa gaadiidka ardayda, shaqaale la socda xaadirista iyo adeegyo kale oo lagu doonayo in lagu yareeyo caqabadaha ardayda ka hor istaaga inay si joogto ah dugsiga u yimaadaan. items.title: Puntland oo shaacisay natiijada imtixaanka shahaadiga fasalka 12-aad
items.description: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Dowlad-goboleedka Puntland ayaa shaacisay xogta natiijada imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee fasalka 12-aad. Imtixaanka waxaa sanadkan u fariistay 8,923 arday, kuwaas oo 8,205 arday, oo u dhiganta 92%, ay ku guuleysteen imtixaanka. Dhanka kale, 718 arday, oo ah 8% tirada guud ee ardayda imtixaanka gashay, ayaa ku dhacay imtixaanka. Sidoo kale, 35 arday ayaa laga reebay imtixaanka kadib markii lagu helay arrimo sababay in laga baabi’iyo natiijadooda. Natiijadan ayaa muujinaysa in inta badan ardaydii u fariisatay imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee fasalka 12-aad ay ku guuleysteen, iyadoo heerka guushu uu gaaray 92 boqolkiiba.

items.title: Ciidanka deegaanka Wargaadhi oo sheegay inay dileen horjooge ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab
items.description: Ciidanka deegaanka Wargaadhi ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa sheegay inay howlgal ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ka sameeyeen deegaan ka tirsan gobolka, halkaas oo ay sheegeen inay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen xubno ka tirsan kooxda. Ciidanka ayaa sheegay in howlgalka lagu dilay Cabdullaahi Maxamuud Odowaa, oo loo yaqaannay Faadhuud, kaas oo ay ku tilmaameen horjooge kooxda u qaabilsanaa ururinta waxa ay ugu yeerto Zakawaadka. Sida ay sheegeen ciidanka, Cabdullaahi Maxamuud Odowaa oo da’diisu ahayd 57 sano ayaa kooxda ku biiray sanadkii 2009, waxaana lagu dilay deegaanka Tawakal. Ciidanka deegaanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in howlgalkan ay ka qayb qaateen Faarax Ismaan Raage iyo Jacfar Axmed Dhuxul, kuwaas oo ka tirsan ciidanka, iyagoo sheegay inay horjoogaha ku dileen goob ay kooxda maamusho. Ciidamada deegaanka ayaa ku eedeeyay horjoogaha in uu door ku lahaa dhibaatooyin iyo cadaadis ay sheegeen in lagu hayay shacabka ku nool deegaanada uu ka howlgali jiray. Howlgalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli la sheegay in maalmahan dambe ay sii xoogeysteen howlgallada lagu baadi-goobayo xubnaha iyo horjoogayaasha Al-Shabaab ee ku sugan qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Ka Digeysa Saameynta Fatahaadaha Roobabka Dayrta
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta guddoomiyey kulankii ugu horreeyey ee Guddiga Qaran ee Maareynta Khataraha Masiibooyinka, kaas oo looga hadlay xaaladda abaaraha ka jira dalka iyo diyaar-garowga fatahaadaha laga cabsi qabo inay ka dhashaan roobabka Dayrta ee la filayo inay dhawaan ka da’aan qaybo ka mid ah dalka. Kulanka ayaa lagu soo bandhigay warbixinno ku saabsan xaaladda abaaraha, u diyaar-garowga xaaladaha degdegga ah iyo qorshayaasha lagu yareynayo saameynta fatahaadaha, gaar ahaan meelaha ku dhow wabiyada iyo dhulka hoose ee halista ugu jira inay daadadku saameeyaan. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa guddiga faray in la xoojiyo wacyigelinta bulshada, gaar ahaan dadka ku nool hareeraha wabiyada iyo dhulka biyo-mareennada ah, si looga feejignaado khataraha fatahaadaha iyo xaaladaha kale ee degdegga ah. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in si hufan loo isku dubbarido howlaha gurmadka, lana abaabulo hay’adaha dowladda, deeq-bixiyeyaasha, ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed iyo bulshada, si loo taageero dadka ay saameeyeen abaaraha iyo fatahaadaha soo noqnoqda. Guddiga Qaran ee Maareynta Khataraha Masiibooyinka ayaa soo bandhigay qorshayaal la xiriira ka jawaabista masiibooyinka iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa diyaar-garowga dalka, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo badbaadinta shacabka iyo yareynta khasaaraha ka dhalan kara fatahaadaha iyo abaaraha. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa ugu dambayn faray guddiga inay dardar geliyaan isku-duwidda howlaha gurmadka iyo wacyigelinta bulshada, si looga hortago khasaaraha ka dhalan kara xaaladaha dabiiciga ah ee dalka soo wajihi kara.

items.title: Somalia and UNDP Strengthen Cooperation on National Financing
items.description: Somalia’s Minister of Finance, Biixi Imaan Cige, has held talks with UNDP Somalia Resident Representative Christophoros Politis during a visit to the Ministry of Finance in Mogadishu, with discussions focusing on strengthening cooperation and improving financing plans for the country’s development priorities. The meeting comes as Somalia continues efforts to strengthen its public financial system and coordinate different sources of financing to support national development programmes. A key focus of the discussions was the Integrated National Financing Framework, known as INFF. The ministry and UNDP discussed the implementation of the INFF, coordination among government institutions and the development of financing plans aligned with Somalia’s national priorities. The INFF is designed to help governments coordinate domestic and international sources of finance and align them with national development objectives. UNDP says more than 80 countries are developing or implementing such frameworks as part of efforts to strengthen sustainable financing systems. Somalia has been working with UNDP on the development of its own financing framework, with the process intended to identify additional financing opportunities and improve coordination between government institutions and development partners. The framework could also help Somalia identify potential financing from domestic resources, international partners and the private sector, while linking those resources more closely to national development priorities. Direct Quote: “The INFF provides a strategic framework to identify financing opportunities, strengthen coordination and align financing with the country’s development priorities,” UNDP has said in relation to Somalia’s financing efforts. The two sides also discussed opportunities to expand UNDP’s technical support to the Federal Government of Somalia, particularly in areas linked to development programmes, financing strategies and institutional coordination. Christophoros Politis recently took up his role as UNDP Somalia’s Resident Representative. UNDP has described him as an international development professional with more than two decades of experience working on development, governance and programmes in fragile and conflict-affected settings. Indirect Quote: UNDP has indicated that its continued partnership with Somalia is intended to support the country’s development priorities while strengthening institutions and improving their capacity to mobilise and manage financial resources. The meeting highlights the growing importance of coordinated financing as Somalia seeks to expand domestic revenue, attract investment and secure resources for national development programmes. For the government, strengthening coordination between public institutions and development partners remains a key part of efforts to ensure that available financing is directed towards the country’s most pressing priorities. items.title: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo UNDP oo xoojinaya iskaashiga
items.description: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Biixi Imaan Cige, ayaa maanta Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay Wakiilka cusub ee UNDP Soomaaliya, Christophoros Politis, oo booqday xarunta Wasaaradda Maaliyadda, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xoojinta iskaashiga iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa qorshayaasha maalgelinta dalka. Kulanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto sidii loo horumarin lahaa nidaamka maaliyadeed ee dalka, loo isku xiri lahaa ilaha kala duwan ee maalgelinta, loona heli lahaa dhaqaale ku filan qorshayaasha horumarineed ee dowladda. Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah qorshaha Isku-xirka Maalgelinta Qaranka, oo loo yaqaan Integrated National Financing Framework, INFF. Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo UNDP ayaa kulanka diiradda ku saaray qaab-dhismeedka INFF, isku-duwidda hay’adaha dowladda iyo horumarinta qorshayaal maalgelin oo ku wajahan mudnaanta qaranka. INFF waa hannaan ay dowladuhu u adeegsadaan isku dubbaridka ilaha maalgelinta gudaha iyo kuwa dibadda, si dhaqaalaha loogu waafajiyo qorshayaasha horumarinta qaranka. UNDP waxay sheegtay in in ka badan 80 dal ay qaadanayaan ama hirgelinayaan habkan, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la isku waafajiyo siyaasadaha maaliyadeed, maalgashiga iyo yoolalka horumarineed. Soomaaliya ayaa horay ula shaqeysay UNDP diyaarinta INFF, iyadoo Wasaaradda Maaliyaddu sheegtay in qaab-dhismeedkan uu gacan ka geysan karo isku xirka maalgelinta dowladda iyo fursadaha ka iman kara waaxda gaarka loo leeyahay. UNDP ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in nidaamku ka caawin karo Soomaaliya inay aqoonsato fursadaha maalgelinta iyo meelaha laga heli karo kheyraad dheeraad ah. Xigasho toos ah: “INFF wuxuu bixinayaa hannaan istiraatiiji ah oo lagu aqoonsado fursadaha maalgelinta, lagu xoojiyo isku-duwidda, laguna waafajiyo maalgelinta mudnaanta horumarineed ee dalka,” ayay UNDP ka soo xigatay la-taliyaha sare ee maalgelinta cimilada ee Wasaaradda Maaliyadda. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay fursadaha lagu sii xoojin karo taageerada farsamo ee UNDP ay siiso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan barnaamijyada horumarineed iyo qorsheynta maalgelinta. Christophoros Politis ayaa ah Wakiilka cusub ee UNDP Soomaaliya. Wuxuu xilka la wareegay bishan Agoosto, waxaana hay’addu sheegtay inuu leeyahay in ka badan 20 sano oo waayo-aragnimo ah oo ku saabsan horumarinta, dowlad-dhiska iyo maareynta barnaamijyada dalalka nugul iyo kuwa kasoo kabanaya colaadaha. Xigasho dadban: UNDP ayaa sheegtay in iskaashiga Soomaaliya uu qayb ka yahay dadaallada lagu taageerayo mudnaanta horumarineed ee dalka iyo dhismaha hay’ado awood u leh inay si wanaagsan u maareeyaan ilaha dhaqaale. Kulanka ayaa muujinaya in maaliyadda gudaha, maalgelinta horumarinta iyo taageerada farsamo ee hay’adaha caalamiga ah ay weli yihiin qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dadaallada Soomaaliya ugu jirto xoojinta dhaqaalaha iyo fulinta qorshayaasha qaranka. Kulanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto sidii loo horumarin lahaa nidaamka maaliyadeed ee dalka, loo isku xiri lahaa ilaha kala duwan ee maalgelinta, loona heli lahaa dhaqaale ku filan qorshayaasha horumarineed ee dowladda. Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah qorshaha Isku-xirka Maalgelinta Qaranka, oo loo yaqaan Integrated National Financing Framework, INFF. Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo UNDP ayaa kulanka diiradda ku saaray qaab-dhismeedka INFF, isku-duwidda hay’adaha dowladda iyo horumarinta qorshayaal maalgelin oo ku wajahan mudnaanta qaranka. INFF waa hannaan ay dowladuhu u adeegsadaan isku dubbaridka ilaha maalgelinta gudaha iyo kuwa dibadda, si dhaqaalaha loogu waafajiyo qorshayaasha horumarinta qaranka. UNDP waxay sheegtay in in ka badan 80 dal ay qaadanayaan ama hirgelinayaan habkan, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la isku waafajiyo siyaasadaha maaliyadeed, maalgashiga iyo yoolalka horumarineed. Soomaaliya ayaa horay ula shaqeysay UNDP diyaarinta INFF, iyadoo Wasaaradda Maaliyaddu sheegtay in qaab-dhismeedkan uu gacan ka geysan karo isku xirka maalgelinta dowladda iyo fursadaha ka iman kara waaxda gaarka loo leeyahay. UNDP ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in nidaamku ka caawin karo Soomaaliya inay aqoonsato fursadaha maalgelinta iyo meelaha laga heli karo kheyraad dheeraad ah. Xigasho toos ah: “INFF wuxuu bixinayaa hannaan istiraatiiji ah oo lagu aqoonsado fursadaha maalgelinta, lagu xoojiyo isku-duwidda, laguna waafajiyo maalgelinta mudnaanta horumarineed ee dalka,” ayay UNDP ka soo xigatay la-taliyaha sare ee maalgelinta cimilada ee Wasaaradda Maaliyadda. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay fursadaha lagu sii xoojin karo taageerada farsamo ee UNDP ay siiso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan barnaamijyada horumarineed iyo qorsheynta maalgelinta. Christophoros Politis ayaa ah Wakiilka cusub ee UNDP Soomaaliya. Wuxuu xilka la wareegay bishan Agoosto, waxaana hay’addu sheegtay inuu leeyahay in ka badan 20 sano oo waayo-aragnimo ah oo ku saabsan horumarinta, dowlad-dhiska iyo maareynta barnaamijyada dalalka nugul iyo kuwa kasoo kabanaya colaadaha. Xigasho dadban: UNDP ayaa sheegtay in iskaashiga Soomaaliya uu qayb ka yahay dadaallada lagu taageerayo mudnaanta horumarineed ee dalka iyo dhismaha hay’ado awood u leh inay si wanaagsan u maareeyaan ilaha dhaqaale. Kulanka ayaa muujinaya in maaliyadda gudaha, maalgelinta horumarinta iyo taageerada farsamo ee hay’adaha caalamiga ah ay weli yihiin qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dadaallada Soomaaliya ugu jirto xoojinta dhaqaalaha iyo fulinta qorshayaasha qaranka. items.title: Somali forces have learned the secrets of criminal investigation
items.description: Somali Security Forces Complete Crime Investigation Training Somali police officers and personnel from the National Intelligence and Security Agency have completed a year-long advanced training programme focused on modern crime investigation and crime scene management. The training was designed to strengthen the ability of security institutions to collect, preserve and assess evidence needed for reliable criminal investigations. The programme comes as Somalia continues efforts to strengthen the investigative capacity of its security and justice institutions. The training was supported by the United States government and delivered by international experts specialising in criminal investigation and forensic science. Over the course of 12 months, participating officers were trained in modern techniques for investigating crimes and examining crime scenes. They also learned procedures for collecting evidence and ensuring that material recovered from crime scenes remains properly preserved. The training included methods for verifying information considered important to criminal investigations, with an emphasis on professional procedures that can help investigators establish facts and build reliable cases. International specialists with expertise in criminal investigation and forensic science led the programme, introducing participants to investigative techniques and evidence-handling practices used in professional crime investigations. The closing ceremony was attended by the Acting U.S. Ambassador to Somalia, the Commander of the Somali Police Force, the Director of the National Intelligence and Security Agency and the Chairman of the Armed Forces Court. Direct Quote: “Evidence recovered from a crime scene is fundamental to a reliable investigation, and it must be collected, preserved and handled professionally and in accordance with the law.” Officials at the ceremony stressed the importance of ensuring that security institutions and the judiciary have personnel with the technical knowledge and investigative skills needed to properly handle evidence. Indirect Quote: Officials said the officers who completed the programme are now better prepared to investigate crime scenes, collect and preserve evidence and contribute to investigations that can withstand legal scrutiny. The training is also expected to strengthen cooperation between security agencies and judicial institutions, particularly in cases where evidence gathered during investigations is later presented before courts. Participants have now been prepared to apply their training in the field, including examining crime scenes, documenting evidence, protecting the integrity of collected material and verifying information relevant to criminal cases. The programme highlights the role of international cooperation in strengthening Somalia’s investigative capabilities, particularly in forensic investigation and evidence management. items.title: Ciidamada Soomaaliyeed Oo Bartay Sirta Dambi-baarista
items.description: Ciidamada Soomaaliyeed oo dhameystay tababar dambi-baaris Saraakiil iyo ciidamo ka kala tirsan Booliska Soomaaliyeed iyo Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka ayaa soo gabagabeeyay tababar heer sare ah oo muddo hal sano ah socday, kaas oo lagu barayay baarista dambiyada iyo hababka casriga ah ee loo baaro goobaha ay falalku ka dhacaan. Tababarka ayaa lagu xoojiyay awoodda hay’adaha amniga ee ururinta caddeymaha iyo diyaarinta baaritaanno lagu kalsoonaan karo. Tababarkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu horumarinayo awoodda dambi-baarista Soomaaliya, xilli hay’adaha amniga iyo garsoorku ay u baahan yihiin khubaro si sax ah u maareyn karta caddeymaha laga helo goobaha dambiyada. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa tababarka ku hirgelisay taageero ay ka heshay Dowladda Mareykanka. Muddo 12 bilood ah, ciidamada ayaa lagu barayay farsamooyin casri ah oo la xiriira baarista dambiyada, baaritaanka goobaha ay dambiyadu ka dhacaan iyo habka saxda ah ee loo ururiyo caddeymaha. Waxa kale oo lagu tababaray ilaalinta caddeymaha si aan loo lumin ama loo beddelin xogta muhiimka ah, iyo hababka lagu xaqiijiyo macluumaadka loo adeegsanayo baaritaannada dambiyada. Tababarka waxaa bixiyay khubaro caalami ah oo ku takhasusay baarista dambiyada iyo cilmiga dambi-baarista, iyadoo xoogga la saaray habraacyo ay adeegsadaan hay’adaha casriga ah ee baarista dambiyada. Munaasabadda lagu soo xirayay tababarka waxaa ka hadlay Sii-hayaha Safiirka Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya, Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, Taliyaha Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka iyo Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. Xigasho toos ah: “Caddeymaha laga helo goobta dambiga waa saldhigga baaritaan lagu kalsoonaan karo, waana muhiim in si xirfad iyo sharci waafaqsan loo ururiyo, loo ilaaliyo loona maareeyo.” Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in kor u qaadista aqoonta iyo xirfadaha dambi-baarista ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta xiriirka ka dhexeeya hay’adaha amniga iyo garsoorka, gaar ahaan marka kiisaska loo gudbinayo maxkamadaha. Xigasho dadban: Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa tilmaamay in ciidamadan loo diyaariyay inay si cilmi iyo xirfad ku dhisan uga shaqeeyaan goobaha dambiyada, iyagoo ilaalinaya hannaanka sharci ee caddeymaha iyo xogta laga helo baaritaannada. Saraakiisha tababarka dhameystay ayaa hadda loo diyaariyay inay ka shaqeeyaan baaritaannada dambiyada, ururinta iyo ilaalinta caddeymaha, iyo xaqiijinta xogta muhiimka u ah kiisaska. Tababarkan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya doorka iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee lagu horumarinayo awoodda hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dambi-baarista iyo maaraynta caddeymaha. The post Ciidamada Soomaaliyeed Oo Bartay Sirta Dambi-baarista first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Shabaab u badan ajaaniib oo soo buux dhaafiyay deegaan muhiim ah iyo dhaq dhaqaaq…
items.description: Janaale (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya deegaanka Janaale ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa sheegaya in halkaasi laga dareemayo dhaqdhaqaaq ciidan, kadib markii maleeshiyaad badan oo ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab lagu arkay tuulooyin dhowr ah oo hoostaga deegaanka. Ilo-wareedyo lagu kalsoon yahay oo la hadlay Caasimada Online ayaa sheegay in maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab, oo ay ku jiraan dagaalyahanno ajaanib ah, ay soo buuxiyeen tuulooyinka Ugunji, Deg-Wariiri iyo Busleey oo ku yaalla agagaarka Janaale. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in tiro badan oo maleeshiyaadkaas ah la geeyay Ugunji iyo Deg-Wariiri, kuwaas oo qaarkood la sheegay inay yihiin ajaanib u badan Kenyan iyo Itoobiyaan. Sidoo kale, ilaha ayaa Caasimada Online u sheegay in kooxda ay dhufeysyo iyo godad ka qodatay deegaano u dhexeeya Ugunji iyo Deg-Wariiri, gaar ahaan nawaaxiga tuulada Busleey, taas oo muujineysa inay halkaasi ka sameysaneyso fariisimo difaac. Maleeshiyaadka lagu arkay deegaanadaas ayaa la sheegay inay ku hubeysan yihiin qoryaha culus iyo gaadiid dagaal, islamarkaana tiradooda lagu qiyaasayo boqolaal dagaalyahan oo isku fidiyay tuulooyinka ku dhow Janaale. Dadka deegaanka qaarkood ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in maleeshiyaadka la geeyay halkaasi ay ku jiraan dhalinyaro aad u da’yar, kuwaas oo qaarkood ay sheegeen inay ka yar yihiin 18 sano. Caasimada Online si madax-bannaan uma xaqiijin karto tirada dagaalyahannada iyo da’dooda. Xiisad iyo dhaqdhaqaaq ciidan Deegaanka Janaale waxaa ku sugan ciidamada howlgalka AUSSOM, gaar ahaan ciidamada Uganda, kuwaas oo ay sidoo kale deegaanka kula sugan yihiin ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Wararka laga helayo deegaanka ayaa sheegaya in maalmihii ugu dambeeyay ay kordheen dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa AUSSOM, xilli laga cabsi qabo in Al-Shabaab ay isku daydo inay sii ballaariso joogitaankeeda tuulooyinka ku dhow Janaale. Ilo-wareedyo deegaanka ah ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa AUSSOM laga yaabo inay saacadaha ama maalmaha soo socda qaadaan howlgallo ka dhan ah fariisimaha cusub ee kooxda. Ma jiro illaa hadda war rasmi ah oo dowladda ama AUSSOM ay kasoo saareen qorshe howlgal oo ka dhan ah maleeshiyaadka lagu arkay deegaanadaas. Janaale ayaa muddo sanado ah waxaa saldhigyo ku lahaa ciidamada Uganda ee ka tirsan howlgalka Midowga Afrika iyo ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya, iyadoo deegaanka iyo tuulooyinka ku hareereysan ay marar badan ka dhaceen dagaallo u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo Al-Shabaab. Dadka oo bilaabay barakac Dhinaca kale, cabsi ayaa soo wajahday dadka ku nool qaar ka mid ah tuulooyinka ay maleeshiyaadku tageen, iyadoo wararku sheegayaan in qoysas ay bilaabeen inay ka baxaan guryahooda. Hase yeeshee, dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay qaar ka mid ah shacabka ku amartay inaysan ka bixin deegaanadooda, taas oo sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo in dadka rayidka ah ay ku dhex go’doomaan haddii dagaal ka qarxo halkaasi. Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa muddo dheer ka mid ahaa gobollada ay Al-Shabaab ku leedahay joogitaanka xooggan, inkastoo ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Midowga Afrika ay gacanta ku hayaan magaalooyinka iyo deegaano muhiim ah. Bilihii iyo sannadihii dambe, kooxda ayaa marar kala duwan dib isugu abaabushay qeybo ka mid ah koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo isku dayday inay cadaadis saarto fariisimaha ciidamada dowladda iyo waddooyinka isku xira magaalooyinka muhiimka ah. Janaale ayaa muddo sanado ah waxaa saldhigyo ku lahaa ciidamada Uganda ee ka tirsan howlgalka Midowga Afrika iyo ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya, iyadoo deegaanka iyo tuulooyinka ku hareereysan ay marar badan ka dhaceen dagaallo u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo Al-Shabaab. Dadka oo bilaabay barakac Dhinaca kale, cabsi ayaa soo wajahday dadka ku nool qaar ka mid ah tuulooyinka ay maleeshiyaadku tageen, iyadoo wararku sheegayaan in qoysas ay bilaabeen inay ka baxaan guryahooda. Hase yeeshee, dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay qaar ka mid ah shacabka ku amartay inaysan ka bixin deegaanadooda, taas oo sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo in dadka rayidka ah ay ku dhex go’doomaan haddii dagaal ka qarxo halkaasi. Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa muddo dheer ka mid ahaa gobollada ay Al-Shabaab ku leedahay joogitaanka xooggan, inkastoo ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Midowga Afrika ay gacanta ku hayaan magaalooyinka iyo deegaano muhiim ah. Bilihii iyo sannadihii dambe, kooxda ayaa marar kala duwan dib isugu abaabushay qeybo ka mid ah koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo isku dayday inay cadaadis saarto fariisimaha ciidamada dowladda iyo waddooyinka isku xira magaalooyinka muhiimka ah. items.title: Kumaandooska Danab oo hawlgal u aaday Gobolka Baay
items.description: Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka ayaa maanta hawlgal ka sameeyay deegaanka Yaaq-doomaar oo hoostaga Degmada Buurhakaba ee Gobolka Baay. Ciidanka Ururka 161aad, Guutada 16aad ee Kumaandooska Danab oo inta badan ka hawlgala Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose ayaa ka gudbay xadka labada gobol, iyagoona hawlgal ka sameeyay deegaankaasi Yaaq-doomaar. “Hawlgalkan oo ahaa mid qorsheysan ayaa lagu beegsaday goobo ay Khawaarijtu u adeegsan jireen gabaad iyo isku-abaabul. Intii uu hawlgalku socday waxaa ciidamada isku soo dhiibay xubin ka tirsan kooxda Khawaarijta ah ee Al Shabaab.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Taliska Danab. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Ciidamada Kumaandooska Danab ayaa sidoo kale burburiyay goobihii bartilmaameedka ahaa. Ujeeddada hawlgalkan ayaa ahayd wiiqidda dhaqdhaqaaqyada Khawaarijta iyo xoojinta amniga deegaanada Gobolka Baay.” Taliska ayaa warka ku sheegay in Kumaandooska Danab ay sii wadi doonaan hawlgalada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo difaaca shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Hawlgalkan ayaa imanaya, xilli Militariga Itoobiya ee ka tirsan AUSSOM ay dhawaan ka baxeen Buurhakaba, isla-markaana ay xaalado amni ka jiraan Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay.

items.title: Pregnancy Can Temporarily Reshape a Mother’s Brain
items.description: Pregnancy does more than change a woman’s body. New research shows that it can also temporarily reshape the brain, with MRI scans revealing widespread changes during pregnancy and in the months following childbirth. Scientists say these changes may reflect the brain adapting to the physical, hormonal and emotional demands of becoming a mother. The findings are important because they challenge the idea that pregnancy affects only the visible parts of the body. What researchers sometimes describe as a reduction in brain volume does not mean the brain has been damaged or that a woman is becoming less intelligent. Instead, scientists believe the changes are part of neuroplasticity , the brain’s ability to reorganize itself in response to major changes. A large longitudinal study of first-time mothers found that the volume of gray matter in the brain decreased during pregnancy and then partially increased after childbirth. Researchers described the pattern as U-shaped, suggesting that some of the changes associated with pregnancy may be reversible. Another study published in Nature Neuroscience followed one woman through pregnancy with 26 MRI scans , beginning three weeks before conception and continuing for two years after childbirth. The researchers observed widespread changes in gray matter and cortical thickness, while some measures of white matter connectivity increased during pregnancy. The findings suggest that the brain is not simply losing tissue. Instead, it may be undergoing a complex process of remodeling as hormone levels change and the body prepares for motherhood. Direct quote: Researchers have described pregnancy as a period of significant “neuroplasticity” , in which the brain adapts to major hormonal and physiological changes. Some of the areas affected are involved in social understanding, emotions, memory, attention and interactions with other people. Earlier research also found changes in brain regions associated with social cognition and the relationship between mothers and their babies. Indirect quote: Scientists say this remodeling may help prepare the brain for the demands of caring for a newborn, although the precise purpose of every change remains unclear. The changes do not necessarily end when the baby is born. Research tracking mothers after childbirth has found that the brain continues to change during the first weeks and months, with some measures beginning to recover while others remain altered for longer periods. The research offers a broader picture of pregnancy: it is not simply a period in which the body grows to accommodate a baby. The brain itself appears capable of adapting to the transition into motherhood. The post Pregnancy Can Temporarily Reshape a Mother’s Brain first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

Uurku wuxuu si ku meel gaar ah u beddelaa maskaxda hooyada
items.description: Cilmi-baarisyo cusub ayaa muujinaya in uurku aanu ku koobnayn isbeddellada muuqda ee jirka haweeneyda, balse uu sidoo kale si weyn u beddeli karo qaab-dhismeedka maskaxda inta lagu jiro uurka iyo bilaha ka dambeeya dhalmada. Saynisyahannadu waxay isbeddelladan ku arkeen baaritaanno MRI oo lagu sameeyay haween uur leh, iyagoo doonaya inay fahmaan sida maskaxdu ula qabsato hooyonimada. Arrintan ayaa muhiim u ah fahamka waxa ku dhaca haweeneyda marka ay u gudubto marxaladda hooyonimada. Isbeddelka loo yaqaan “maskaxda oo yaraata” ma aha calaamad muujinaysa in maskaxdu dhaawacantay ama in haweeneydu caqligeeda luminayso. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay u arkaan qayb ka mid ah habka dabiiciga ah ee maskaxdu isu habayso, kaas oo loo yaqaan neuroplasticity . Daraasad dheer oo lagu sameeyay haween markii ugu horreysay hooyo noqonaya ayaa muujisay in mugga maadada cawlka ee maskaxdu uu hoos u dhici karo inta uurku socdo, ka dibna qayb ahaan dib ugu soo laaban karo bilaha dhalmada ka dambeeya. Qaabkan ayaa cilmi-baarayaasha tusay in maskaxdu aysan si joogto ah u luminayn unugyo, balse ay samaynayso dib-u-habayn la xiriirta isbeddellada hormoonnada iyo baahiyaha cusub ee hooyada. Daraasad kale oo lagu daabacay Nature Neuroscience sannadkii 2024 ayaa si gaar ah u raacday hal haweeney oo uur lahayd, taas oo martay 26 baaritaanno MRI ah , laga bilaabo saddex toddobaad ka hor uurka ilaa laba sano kadib dhalmada. Baaritaannadu waxay muujiyeen hoos u dhac ballaaran oo ku yimid maadada cawlka iyo dhumucda qaar ka mid ah qaybaha maskaxda, halka isku-xirka maadada cad uu kordhay intii uurku socday. Xigasho toos ah: “Uurku waa marxalad aad u weyn oo neuroplasticity ah,” ayay cilmi-baarayaashu ku tilmaameen xaaladda maskaxda hooyada, iyagoo xusay in isbeddellada hormoonnada ay qayb weyn ka yihiin dib-u-habaynta maskaxda. Isbeddellada ugu badan waxaa laga helay qaybo maskaxda ka mid ah oo ku lug leh fahamka bulshada, dareenka, feejignaanta iyo xiriirka qofka uu la leeyahay dadka kale. Daraasad hore ayaa sidoo kale heshay in qaar ka mid ah isbeddellada maadada cawlka ay ku beegmeen meelaha maskaxda ee ka jawaaba ilmaha hooyada. Xigasho dadban: Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay sheegeen in dib-u-habayntani laga yaabo inay maskaxda ka caawiso la-qabsiga daryeelka ilmaha iyo marxaladda cusub ee hooyonimada, inkastoo aan weli si buuxda loo fahmin shaqada isbeddel kasta. Daraasado kale oo la sameeyay xilliga dhalmada ka dib ayaa muujiyay in isbeddellada maskaxdu ay sii socdaan toddobaadyada iyo bilaha ugu horreeya. Qaar ka mid ah cabbirrada maskaxda ayaa bilaabay inay soo kabtaan kadib dhalmada, taasoo muujinaysa in maskaxdu ay si firfircoon uga jawaabto marxaladaha kala duwan ee uurka iyo hooyonimada. Sidaa darteed, marka la yiraahdo uurku “maskaxda ayuu beddelaa”, micnaheedu ma aha in hooyadu wax ka lumayso. Waxa cilmi-baaristu tilmaamayso ayaa ah in maskaxdu ay awood u leedahay inay dib isu habayso si ay ula jaanqaaddo mid ka mid ah isbeddellada ugu waaweyn ee nolosha qofka. items.title: SOMALIA: Local Forces Eliminate Senior Al-Shabaab Commander in Middle Shabelle
items.description: MOGADISHU — Local defense forces in the Wargaadhi area of the Middle Shabelle region have killed a senior Al-Shabaab operative during a targeted raid in the village of Tawakal. The deceased commander, 57-year-old Abdullahi Mohamud Odowaa, known by the alias Faadhuud, managed the militant group’s financial extortion network, overseeing forced revenue collection under the guise of religious taxation. Odowaa, who joined the insurgent organization in 2009, was a prominent figure in the area and held long-standing responsibility for the systematic intimidation of local populations. The operation was carried out inside militant-controlled territory by two members of the local defense forces, identified as Farah Isman Raage and Ja’far Ahmed Dhuxul, who infiltrated the sector to carry out the strike. The elimination of Odowaa marks a continuation of escalated security operations across Middle Shabelle, where local and allied forces have intensified targeted actions against key Al-Shabaab figures in recent days. items.title: Abiy oo doonaya inuu noqdo madaxweyne awood leh
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed ayaa damacsan inuu noqdo madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee Itoobiya ee leh awood buuxda, taas oo qeyb ka ah qorshe ballaaran oo lagu doonayo in wax looga beddelo nidaamka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Qorshaha Abiy ayaa ah in dastuurka Itoobiya lagu daro qodob dhigaya in madaxweynaha dalka la dooran karo laba jeer oo min lix sano ah. Arrintan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshaha wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka Itoobiya. Sidoo kale, qorshahan waxaa ka mid ah in wax laga beddelo awoodda baarlamaanka ee magacaabista ra’iisul wasaaraha, maadaama nidaamka hadda jira uu siinayo ra’iisul wasaaraha awoodda ugu badan ee fulinta, halka madaxweynuhu leeyahay awood xaddidan. Sida xoguhu tilmaamayaan, Abiy ayaa doonaya in Itoobiya ay ka gudubto nidaamka baarlamaaniga ah ee hadda jira, laguna beddelo nidaam madaxweyne oo siinaya madaxtooyada awood ballaaran, sida ka jira dalal badan oo caalamka ah. Haddii qorshahan hirgalo, wuxuu isbeddel weyn ku keeni karaa qaabka awoodda siyaasadeed loogu kala qeybsan yahay Itoobiya, iyadoo madaxtooyadu yeelan doonto awood ka ballaaran tan ay hadda leedahay. Dhanka kale, waxaa la sheegay in dowladda Itoobiya ay qaaday tallaabooyin lagu xakameynayo doodaha iyo mucaaradka ka dhalan kara dib-u-eegista dastuurka. Tallaabooyinkaas waxaa ka mid ah in wax laga beddelo awoodaha ismaamullada, gaar ahaan kuwa la xiriira awoodda ay u leeyihiin inay go’aan ka gaaraan xiriirka ay la leeyihiin dowladda federaalka. Maxaa isbeddelaya? Nidaamka hadda jira, awoodda fulinta Itoobiya waxay inta badan ku urursan tahay ra’iisul wasaaraha, halka madaxweynaha uu leeyahay door u badan matalaad iyo astaan qaran. Qorshaha cusub ayaa meesha ka saari doona qaabkan, iyadoo madaxweynaha loo wareejinayo awood fulineed oo ballaaran. Haddii madaxweynaha uu yeesho awoodda magacaabista xukuumadda iyo jihaynta siyaasadda fulinta, Itoobiya waxay ka guureysaa nidaamkii baarlamaaniga ahaa ee muddo dheer lagu yaqaanay. Tani waxay beddeli kartaa xiriirka u dhexeeya madaxweynaha, baarlamaanka, xisbiyada siyaasadeed iyo dowlad-goboleedyada. Waxa kale oo ay dhalin kartaa in doorashada madaxtinimadu noqoto tartanka siyaasadeed ee ugu weyn dalka. Baarlamaanka oo luminaya awoodda? Mid ka mid ah qodobbada ugu xasaasiga ah waa kaalinta baarlamaanka. Haddii awoodda magacaabista ra’iisul wasaaraha ama qaabkii hore ee xukuumad-dhiska laga saaro, waa in la is weydiiyaa halka ay ku dambeyn doonto awoodda sharci-dejinta ee baarlamaanka. Nidaam madaxweyne oo caafimaad qaba wuxuu u baahan yahay kala-sarrayn cad oo u dhexeysa awoodaha fulinta, sharci-dejinta iyo garsoorka. Haddii madaxweynaha uu helo awood ballaaran, baarlamaanku waa inuu yeeshaa awood dhab ah oo uu ku kormeero xukuumadda iyo miisaaniyadda, halka garsoorkuna uu ahaado mid madax-bannaan. Haddii awoodda lagu ururiyo madaxtooyada iyadoo hay’adihii kale la daciifinayo, isbeddelka dastuurku wuxuu noqon karaa mid dhalinaya awood-maroorsi, halkii uu ka abuuri lahaa nidaam hay’adeed oo dheellitiran. Federaalka Itoobiya oo wajahaya imtixaan Qodobka kale ee xasaasiga ah waa xiriirka u dhexeeya dowladda dhexe iyo ismaamullada Itoobiya. Dalka wuxuu leeyahay nidaam federaal ah oo awood gaar ah siiya maamul-goboleedyada, iyadoo arrimaha qowmiyadaha iyo ismaamulku ay yihiin qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qaab-dhismeedka siyaasadeed. Haddii isbeddelka cusub uu xaddido awoodihii dastuuriga ahaa ee ismaamullada, waxaa dhalan kara dood ku saabsan mustaqbalka federaalka Itoobiya. Tani waxay noqon kartaa arrin ka culus magaca madaxweynaha ama ra’iisul wasaaraha, sababtoo ah waxay taabaneysaa sida awoodda loogu qeybinayo Addis Ababa iyo gobollada. Itoobiya waa dal leh kala duwanaansho qowmiyadeed iyo siyaasadeed oo aad u weyn. Sidaas darteed, isbeddel kasta oo awoodda dhexe xoojinaya wuxuu u baahan yahay wadatashi ballaaran si uusan u dhalin dareen ah in xarunta dhexe ay awood ka qaadaneyso maamul-goboleedyada. Sidoo kale, qorshahan waxaa ka mid ah in wax laga beddelo awoodda baarlamaanka ee magacaabista ra’iisul wasaaraha, maadaama nidaamka hadda jira uu siinayo ra’iisul wasaaraha awoodda ugu badan ee fulinta, halka madaxweynuhu leeyahay awood xaddidan. Sida xoguhu tilmaamayaan, Abiy ayaa doonaya in Itoobiya ay ka gudubto nidaamka baarlamaaniga ah ee hadda jira, laguna beddelo nidaam madaxweyne oo siinaya madaxtooyada awood ballaaran, sida ka jira dalal badan oo caalamka ah. Haddii qorshahan hirgalo, wuxuu isbeddel weyn ku keeni karaa qaabka awoodda siyaasadeed loogu kala qeybsan yahay Itoobiya, iyadoo madaxtooyadu yeelan doonto awood ka ballaaran tan ay hadda leedahay. Dhanka kale, waxaa la sheegay in dowladda Itoobiya ay qaaday tallaabooyin lagu xakameynayo doodaha iyo mucaaradka ka dhalan kara dib-u-eegista dastuurka. Tallaabooyinkaas waxaa ka mid ah in wax laga beddelo awoodaha ismaamullada, gaar ahaan kuwa la xiriira awoodda ay u leeyihiin inay go’aan ka gaaraan xiriirka ay la leeyihiin dowladda federaalka. Maxaa isbeddelaya? Nidaamka hadda jira, awoodda fulinta Itoobiya waxay inta badan ku urursan tahay ra’iisul wasaaraha, halka madaxweynaha uu leeyahay door u badan matalaad iyo astaan qaran. Qorshaha cusub ayaa meesha ka saari doona qaabkan, iyadoo madaxweynaha loo wareejinayo awood fulineed oo ballaaran. Haddii madaxweynaha uu yeesho awoodda magacaabista xukuumadda iyo jihaynta siyaasadda fulinta, Itoobiya waxay ka guureysaa nidaamkii baarlamaaniga ahaa ee muddo dheer lagu yaqaanay. Tani waxay beddeli kartaa xiriirka u dhexeeya madaxweynaha, baarlamaanka, xisbiyada siyaasadeed iyo dowlad-goboleedyada. Waxa kale oo ay dhalin kartaa in doorashada madaxtinimadu noqoto tartanka siyaasadeed ee ugu weyn dalka. Baarlamaanka oo luminaya awoodda? Mid ka mid ah qodobbada ugu xasaasiga ah waa kaalinta baarlamaanka. Haddii awoodda magacaabista ra’iisul wasaaraha ama qaabkii hore ee xukuumad-dhiska laga saaro, waa in la is weydiiyaa halka ay ku dambeyn doonto awoodda sharci-dejinta ee baarlamaanka. Nidaam madaxweyne oo caafimaad qaba wuxuu u baahan yahay kala-sarrayn cad oo u dhexeysa awoodaha fulinta, sharci-dejinta iyo garsoorka. Haddii madaxweynaha uu helo awood ballaaran, baarlamaanku waa inuu yeeshaa awood dhab ah oo uu ku kormeero xukuumadda iyo miisaaniyadda, halka garsoorkuna uu ahaado mid madax-bannaan. Haddii awoodda lagu ururiyo madaxtooyada iyadoo hay’adihii kale la daciifinayo, isbeddelka dastuurku wuxuu noqon karaa mid dhalinaya awood-maroorsi, halkii uu ka abuuri lahaa nidaam hay’adeed oo dheellitiran. Federaalka Itoobiya oo wajahaya imtixaan Qodobka kale ee xasaasiga ah waa xiriirka u dhexeeya dowladda dhexe iyo ismaamullada Itoobiya. Dalka wuxuu leeyahay nidaam federaal ah oo awood gaar ah siiya maamul-goboleedyada, iyadoo arrimaha qowmiyadaha iyo ismaamulku ay yihiin qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qaab-dhismeedka siyaasadeed. Haddii isbeddelka cusub uu xaddido awoodihii dastuuriga ahaa ee ismaamullada, waxaa dhalan kara dood ku saabsan mustaqbalka federaalka Itoobiya. Tani waxay noqon kartaa arrin ka culus magaca madaxweynaha ama ra’iisul wasaaraha, sababtoo ah waxay taabaneysaa sida awoodda loogu qeybinayo Addis Ababa iyo gobollada. Itoobiya waa dal leh kala duwanaansho qowmiyadeed iyo siyaasadeed oo aad u weyn. Sidaas darteed, isbeddel kasta oo awoodda dhexe xoojinaya wuxuu u baahan yahay wadatashi ballaaran si uusan u dhalin dareen ah in xarunta dhexe ay awood ka qaadaneyso maamul-goboleedyada. items.title: Turkey/Cyprus/Somalia – A brief update & analysis
items.description: Turkey/Cyprus/Somalia – A brief update & analysis The controversy triggered by new Somali Speaker Abdikadir Mohamed Nur aka Jama TikTok by implicitly endorsing the northern part of Cyprus – which calls itself Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (TRNC) – as a sovereign state is not dying down, at least not any time soon. And this despite the Somali MFA issuing a statement to clarify Somalia recognises only one Cyprus. In fact, the row is taking on an intriguing dimension and bleeding into the wider geopolitical ferment in the Mediterranean and Red Sea arenas. There is now a coordinated Turkish campaign to defend the Somali Speaker and even praise him for taking a bold principled stance. Some even suggest Somalia owes it to Turkey to now join the Speaker and reverse its policy on Cyprus, extend formal recognition to TRNC. Much more than being an inadvertent, genuine mistake, it now looks like Jama’s post was intended to trigger precisely what is now happening – a foreign policy debate on Somalia’s traditional position on Cyprus. It is significant and not coincidental the issue is emerging at a time when Somalia and Turkey are marking 15 years of ‘strategic partnership.’ More importantly, it is generating significant friction inside the FGS. Some Turkish posts on X are now directing their fire at MFA State Minister Ali Balcad and PM Hamza Barre – both alleged to have been behind pressure on Jama to delete the post acknowledging TRNC. The two officials likely must have also come under pressure from Cyprus and European diplomats. It took Somalia 4 days to formally respond and clarify its position on Cyprus. This is likely an indication of internal friction between the pro-Turkey camp who favour relations with TRNC and those who prefer Somalia to stay out of Cyprus and maintain tradition international consensus. There are wider geopolitical factors driving Turkish calculations and campaign to seek more international recognition for TRNC. Pro-Turkey groups claim or believe a strong Mogadishu-TRNC relationship reinforces the strategic partnership with Ankara and undercuts Israel-Somaliland ties. They also claim it would pre-empt any attempt by Cyprus and Greece to extend formal recognition to Somaliland Israel is a close ally of both Greece and Cyprus and the three states recently unveiled a new strategic alliance. For Israel, Cyprus and Greece form part of its strategic Mediterranean periphery and TRNC – a territorial fragmentation of its ally – poses a major challenge. The escalating Israel-Turkey rivalry in the wider Mediterranean/Levant theatre is now rapidly converging with the competition over the Red Sea/Gulf of Aden. Rashid Abdi

items.title: Wasiir Fiqi iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee IMCTC oo Muqdisho Ka Daah-furay Hindisaha “Saxafiga Nabadda” SAWIRO
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Isbahaysiga Milatari ee Dalalka Islaamka ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada (IMCTC), Sarreeye Gaas Maxamed Bin Saciid Al-Mageedi, ayaa si rasmi ah Muqdisho uga daah-furay hindisaha “Saxafiga Nabadda” oo uu hirgelinayo Isbahaysiga. Hindisahan ayaa diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta awoodda warbaahinta, kor u qaadista wacyiga bulshada, ka hortagga xagjirnimada iyo dacaayadda kooxaha argagixisada, iyo dhisidda dhaqanka nabadda, dhexdhexaadnimada iyo wada-noolaanshaha bulshada. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa sheegay in khibradda Soomaaliya ay muujisay in la-dagaallanka argagixisadu u baahan yahay iskaashi dhinacyo badan leh, isagoo tilmaamay in warbaahintu leedahay door istiraatiiji ah oo ku aaddan qaabaynta fahamka bulshada, ka hortagga marin-habaabinta iyo faafinta farriimaha nabadda. Wasiirka ayaa ka qeybgalayaasha tababarka ugu baaqay inay si wanaagsan uga faa’iideystaan aqoonta iyo khibradaha lagu gudbinayo hindisaha “Saxafiga Nabadda”, si ay gacan uga geystaan ka hortagga fikirka xagjirka ah iyo dacaayadda argagixisada. Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa sidoo kale uga mahadceliyay Isbahaysiga Milatari ee Dalalka Islaamka taageerada iyo tababarrada uu Soomaaliya siiyay, isagoo si gaar ah u xusay taageerada joogtada ah ee Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ay ku bixiso dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo argagixisada iyo xagjirnimada. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay in maalgelinta warbaahin masuul ah ay tahay maalgelin lagu sameynayo nabadda, xasilloonida iyo mustaqbalka bulshada, isagoo tilmaamay muhiimadda ay warbaahintu u leedahay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga Soomaaliya. items.title: DEG-DEG: Puntland oo Cambaareysay Duqeymaha Xeebaha Nugaal
items.description: Garoowe (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Puntland ayaa cambaareysay duqeymo lagu soo warramay in maraakiib dagaal oo caalami ah ay ka geysteen xeebaha gobolka Nugaal , kuwaas oo lagu beegsaday kalluumeysato iyo hanti ay leeyihiin dadka deegaanka. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in duqeymihii ka dhacay deegaanka Garmaal 18-ka iyo 20-ka Agoosto 2026 ay sababeen khasaare soo gaaray dad rayid ah iyo doonyo ay lahaayeen kalluumeysatada deegaanka. Maamulka Puntland ayaa dalbaday in cidda ka dambeysay duqeymaha ay si rasmi ah isu caddeyso , isla markaana ay sharaxaad ka bixiso sababta iyo ujeeddada weerarrada. Puntland ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in falalka noocan ah ay caqabad ku noqon karaan isku-dubbaridka howlgalada lagula dagaallamayo burcad-badeednimada , iyadoo ku baaqday in hawlgallada badda lagu saleeyo wada-shaqeyn iyo is-dhexgal lala yeesho maamulka deegaanka. Dhanka kale, waxaa jira warar sheegaya in markab lagu soo warramay inuu sido qalab milatari oo xiriir la leh Türkiye uu ku jiro xaalad xasaasi ah, kaddib markii kooxaha gacanta ku haya markabka lagu soo warramay inay heleen farriimo ku saabsan inaysan xiriir la yeelan Puntland, sawirro ka qaadin ama aysan gelin qaybaha hoose ee markabka. Hase yeeshee, qodobadan dambe weli ma haystaan xaqiijin rasmi ah oo madax-bannaan , sidoo kalena ma jiro war rasmi ah oo caddeynaya nooca qalabka uu markabku sido ama cidda si dhab ah u maamusha. Xaaladda ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo xeebaha Soomaaliya ay ka jiraan dhaqdhaqaaqyo la xiriira burcad-badeednimo, maraakiib ganacsi iyo howlgallada amniga badda , taasoo sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo in dhacdooyinkani saameeyaan amniga iyo kalluumeysiga dadka deegaanka.
