items.description: Xeebaha Soomaaliya (Raxanreeb Online): Markab ganacsi oo ku gooshayay calanka Kamaruun, balse ay leedahay shirkad laga leeyahay Türkiye, ayaa lagu afduubtay biyaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo la sheegay inuu xambaarsanaa qalab isgaarsiineed iyo qalab ciidan oo casri ah. Xogaha hordhaca ah ayaa sheegaya in xilliga markabka la afduubtay ay saarnaayeen 10 qof, oo kala ahaa lix Hindi ah, laba u dhashay Georgia, hal Turki ah iyo laba Serbian ah. Dhinaca kale, kooxaha afduubayaasha ah ayaa la sheegay inay ahaayeen siddeed qof, kuwaas oo la wareegay gacan-ku-haynta markabka. Warar aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin ayaa sheegaya in qaar kamid ah qalabka uu markabku siday loo waday deegaanno ay kamid yihiin Laascaanood iyo Lawyacado, iyadoo la tuhunsan yahay in loo adeegsan lahaa hurinta xiisado ka dhaca Somaliland. Hase yeeshee, xogtan ku saabsan halka hubka loo waday iyo ujeeddada loo adeegsan lahaa weli ma hayso xaqiijin rasmi ah oo ka soo baxday dowladda Soomaaliya, maamulka Somaliland, dowladda Türkiye ama hay’adaha ammaanka badda. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli xeebaha Soomaaliya ay dib uga soo cusboonaadeen falalka burcad-badeednimada, iyadoo maraakiib dhowr ah lagu soo warramay inay ku sugan yihiin ama ku wajahan yihiin xeebaha Puntland. items.title: Sheekh Aadan Madoobe oo ku laabtay Baydhaba kadibna diray hanjabaad culus
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) oo maalmahan safar shaqo ku joogay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa maanta dib ugu soo laabtay magaalada Baydhaba, isaga oo farriin culus kasoo saaray dagaalkii dhowaan ka dhacay gudaha magaaladaasi. Aadan Madoobe iyo wafdigiisa ayaa si diirran loogu soo dhoweeyey Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati Gaduud, iyadoo soo dhoweynta ay ka qeyb galeen guddoonka Golaha Wakiilada Koonfur Galbeed, wasiiro, xildhibaano, saraakiisha amniga iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada magaalada Baydhaba. Ugu horreyn Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiilada Mudane Mahad Maxamed Sheekh ayaa Madaxweynaha siiyey warbixin guud oo ku saabsan xaaladda deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, wuxuuna sheegay in xaaladda amniga ay tahay mid wanaagsan, isagoo xusay in weerarkii ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen dhawaan ku soo qaadeen magaalada Baydhaba lagu gaarsiiyey jab xooggan. Sidoo kale, guddoomiyaha ayaa tilmaamay dadaallada ay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa amniga Koonfur Galbeed ugu jiraan sugidda amniga, ilaalinta shacabka iyo ka hortagga falalka kooxaha Khawaarijta. Intaas kadib Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa uga mahadceliyey shacabka iyo mas’uuliyiinta Koonfur Galbeed sida diirran ee loogu soo dhoweeyey magaalada Baydhaba isagoo ku bogaadiyey ciidamada qalabka sida iyo dhammaan hay’adaha amniga dadaallada ay ugu jiraan difaaca shacabka iyo xasilloonida deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. Aadan Madoobe ayaa sidoo kale hanjabaad u diray madaxda maamulkii hore oo haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada duleedka Baydhaba, isaga oo ku hanjabay in meeshooda ay ku weerari doonaan, isaga oo lamid dhigay Al-Shabaab. Waxaa kale oo uu farriin u diray dhalinyaradala qalday ee ku jira safafka Khawaarijta, isagoo ugu baaqay inay ka soo laabtaan fikirka qaldan, iskuna soo dhiibaan dowladdooda, si ay uga mid noqdaan dadaallada lagu dhisayo dowladnimada iyo nabadda. Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa caddeeyay in maamulkiisa uu diyaar u yahay soo dhaweynta cid kasta oo ka soo laabata marin-habaabinta, isla markaana dooneysa inay qayb ka noqoto nabadda, dowladnimada iyo horumarka dalka. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu ugu baaqay shacabka magaalada Baydhaba in aysan ku kadsoomin ama qaadan dacaayadaha iyo baraha bulshada lagu faafinayo ee lagu cabsi gelinayo shacabka magaalada, isagoo xusay in shacabka Koonfur Galbeed ay mudan yihiin nabad, xasillooni iyo nolol ammaan ah. The post Sheekh Aadan Madoobe oo ku laabtay Baydhaba kadibna diray hanjabaad culus appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Jaamacad Maraykan Ah Oo Mamnuucday Durag, Bonnado Iyo Kabaha somalida
items.description: Jaamacadda Tuskegee oo soo rogtay xeer cusub oo labiska ardayda Jaamacadda Tuskegee University ee dalka Maraykanka ayaa soo rogtay xeer cusub oo ku saabsan labiska ardayda, iyadoo mamnuucay in ardaydu soo galaan fasallada iyo hoolalka cuntada iyagoo xiran bonnado, durag ama kabo jiif. Jaamacadda ayaa sidoo kale ka filaysa ardayda inay ka fogaadaan labis aad u muujiya, gaar ahaan goobaha tacliinta iyo xafladaha rasmiga ah, iyadoo looga gol leeyahay in ardayda loogu diyaariyo shaqada ka hor inta aynaan ka qalin jebin. Xeerkan cusub ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxa uu soo kordhiyay dood ku saabsan sida ay jaamacaduhu ugu diyaariyaan ardayda mustaqbalka shaqo, iyo haddii labiska ardaydu uu saameyn ku yeelan karo diyaargarowgooda xirfadeed. Madaxweynaha jaamacadda, Dr. Mark A. Brown, ayaa sheegay in ujeeddadu tahay in ardayda loo diyaariyo adduunka xirfadeed ka hor inta aynaan ka qalin jebin. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in ardayda laga filayo inay yeeshaan dhar shaqo oo ku habboon kulanmada, bandhigyada iyo munaasabadaha kale ee rasmiga ah. Dadka taageeraya xeerkan ayaa sheegay in jaamacaduhu ay tahay inay ardayda ugu diyaariyaan filashooyinka goobta shaqada, oo ay ku jirto sida ay u soo bandhigaan naftooda. Jaamacaddu waxay caddaynaysaa in ardayda aan laga filayn inay dhar shaqo xirtaan maalin kasta, laakiin farriintu waa mid cad: Tuskegee waxay doonaysaa in ardaydu u labistaan mustaqbalka shaqo ee ay doonayaan ka hor inta aynaan ka bixin xerada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dadka qaarkood ayaa ka digay in xeerkani uu si xad dhaaf ah u xakameyn karo xorriyadda ardayda ama uu saameyn ku yeelan karo kuwa aan awoodin inay soo iibsadaan dhar cusub. Dooddan ayaa sii socota, iyadoo jaamacaddu ay ku adkaysanayso in xeerku yahay mid loogu talagalay in loola caawiyo ardayda inay ku guuleystaan mustaqbalkooda xirfadeed. The post Jaamacad Maraykan Ah Oo Mamnuucday Durag, Bonnado Iyo Kabaha somalida first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: QM: Saddexdii Soomaali ah Mid Ayaa Wajahaya Cunto-yaraan
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in xaaladda bani’aadantinimo ee Soomaaliya ay sii xumaanayso, iyadoo qiyaastii saddexdii qof ee Soomaali ah mid ka mid ah uu wajahayo cunto-yaraan. Warbixinta ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay si weyn hoos ugu dhaceen kaalmihii caalamiga ahaa ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo la sheegay in taageeradii dibadda ay hoos u dhacday ku dhowaad 80%, taas oo saameyn ku yeelatay barnaamijyada gargaarka iyo dadka nugul. Sida ay baahisay Al Jazeera, Soomaaliya waxaa ku nool ku dhowaad 19 milyan oo qof, waxaana sii kordhaya walaaca laga qabo xaaladda cunto iyo bani’aadantinimo ee dalka. Hoos u dhaca maalgelinta gargaarka ayaa si gaar ah u saameynaya dadka ku tiirsan gargaarka cuntada, caafimaadka, biyaha iyo adeegyada kale ee aasaasiga ah, xilli dalka uu sidoo kale wajahayo saameynta abaaraha, isbeddelka cimilada iyo barakaca. Xaaladdan ayaa muujinaysa caqabadda weyn ee Soomaaliya ka haysata inay ka gudubto ku-tiirsanaanta gargaarka dibadda, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay inay doonayso in dhaqaalaha dalka la xoojiyo lana gaaro isku-filnaansho dhaqaale. The post QM: Saddexdii Soomaali ah Mid Ayaa Wajahaya Cunto-yaraan appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Dagaal Beeleed  Ka dhacay Xaafadda Buula Bacley ee Gaalkacyo
items.description: Gaalkacyo: Dagaal u dhexeeya laba maleeshiyo beeleed ayaa ka dhacay xaafadda Buula Bacley ee magaalada Gaalkacyo, iyadoo xaalad cabsi leh ay ka jirto deegaankaasi. Dagaalka ayaa la sheegay inuu ka dhashay xiisad u dhexeysa labada dhinac oo hore dhowr jeer dirir ugu dhex martay deegaanka. Wararka la helayo ayaa tilmaamaya in dagaalku sababay khasaare isugu jira dhimasho iyo dhaawac, iyadoo ugu yaraan hal qof la xaqiijiyay inuu ku dhintay. Dad ku dhaawacmay iska horimaadka ayaa la geeyay xarumaha caafimaadka ee magaalada Gaalkacyo si loogu dabiibo dhaawacyada soo gaaray. Dadka ku nool xaafadda Buula Bacley ayaa wajahaya cabsi xooggan, kaddib markii muddo ku dhow hal saac saacadood ay halkaasi ka socotay rasaas. Maleeshiyaadka dagaallamaya ayaa horay dirirro ugu dhex mari jireen deegaannada bariga gobolka Mudug, iyadoo xiisaddii u dhexeysay labada dhinac ay hadda u muuqato inay magaalada Gaalkacyo soo gaartay. Maamullada ka jira magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa wada dadaallo lagu doonayo in lagu qaboojiyo xiisadda, laguna kala dhexgalo labada dhinac si loo joojiyo dagaalka loogana hortago in uu sii fido. Xaaladda magaalada ayaa weli ah mid kacsan, waxaana dadka deegaanka ay ugu baaqayaan dhinacyada dagaallamaya in ay si degdeg ah u joojiyaan colaadda, isla markaana la ilaaliyo badqabka shacabka.

items.title: Hayat Market oo ku guuleystay abaal-marinta Supermarket ka ugu adeegga wanaagsan
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa waxaa lagu qabtay munaasabad lagu bixinayay abaal-marinta sanadlaha ah ee (Somali Bussines Awards) oo la gudoonsiinayey ganacsiyada iyo shirkadaha Soomaaliyeed ee sanadkan lagu qiimeeyay waxqabadkooda, adeegyada ay bulshada u fidiyaan iyo kaalinta ay kaga jiraan kobcinta dhaqaalaha dalka. Hayat Market ayaa abaal-marintan heshay kaddib cod-bixin ay sameeyeen bulshada Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo dadka loo bandhigay fursad ay ku qiimeeyaan ganacsiyada iyo adeegyada ay u arkaan kuwa ugu wanaagsan. Natiijada cod-bixinta ayaa muujisay in Hayat Market uu ka mid noqday goobaha ganacsi ee bulshada sida weyn u isticmaasho, taasoo ugu dambeyn sababtay in loo doorto suuqa ugu wanaagsan dalka. Qiimeynta lagu sameeyay Hayat Market ayaa xoogga lagu saaray adeegyada uu suuqu u fidiyo bulshada, helitaanka badeecooyin kala duwan iyo sida uu uga jawaabo baahiyaha maalinlaha ah ee dadka ku nool Muqdisho. Suuqyada casriga ah ayaa door weyn ku leh nolosha bulshada, maadaama ay hal goob ku soo uruuriyaan adeegyo iyo badeecooyin badan oo qofku u baahan yahay, taasoo yareyneysa waqtiga iyo dadaalka uu ku bixinayo raadinta adeegyada kala duwan. Hayat Market ayaa muddooyinkii dambe si weyn uga dhex muuqday suuqa ganacsiga Muqdisho, isagoo ballaariyay adeegyada uu bulshada siiyo iyo goobaha uu ku leeyahay caasimadda oo gaaraya illaa shan xarumood oo waaweyn. Tani waxay ka dhigtay Hayat Market goob ay si joogto ah u booqdaan dad badan oo doonaya inay hal meel ka helaan waxyaabaha kala duwan ee ay u baahan yihiin. Ballaarinta laamaha suuqa ayaa sidoo kale fududeysay in adeegyada Hayat Market ay gaaraan qaybo badan oo magaalada ah taasoo sare u qaadday xiriirka uu suuqu la leeyahay macaamiisha. Cod-bixinta noocan ah waxay ganacsiyada siin kartaa fursad ay ku ogaadaan sida macaamiishoodu u arkaan adeeggooda, tayada badeecooyinkooda iyo heerka ay ku qanacsan yihiin. Sanadkii hore ee 2025 ayey aheyd markii sidan oo kale Suuqa Hayat Market uu ku guuleystay Abaalmarinta SuperMarket-ka ugu fiicnaa sanadkii 2024 ee ganacsiyada Soomaalidu ku leedahay Sideeda wadan ee ku bahoobay ururka Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC) kuwaasoo kala ah: Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Congo, Soomaaliya, Tanzania, Burundi, Kenya, Rwanda, Koonfurta Suudaan & Uganda. items.title: Muqdisho oo laga daahfuray mashaariicda Isbahaysiga Milatari Islaamka ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada
items.description: Waxaa maanta si rasmi ah magaalada Muqdisho uga bilaabatay munaasabadda daahfurka mashaariic uu Isbahaysiga Milatari ee Islaamka ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada (IMCTC) ka fulinayo Soomaaliya. Mashaariicdan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee ku howlan ka hortagga argagixisada iyo xagjirnimada, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo wacyigelinta bulshada iyo doorka hay’adaha kala duwan. Mashruuca ugu horreeya ee munaasabadda lagu daahfurayo ayaa ah Barnaamijka Wariyaasha Nabadda, kaas oo lagu xoojinayo doorka warbaahinta iyo wariyeyaasha ee ka hortagga xagjirnimada iyo argagixisada, iyo sidoo kale kor u qaadista nabadda, isku-xirka bulshada iyo wacyigelinta dadweynaha. Munaasabadda ayaa waxaa ka qeybgalaya wasiirro ka tirsan Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, oo ay ka mid yihiin Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi, Wasiirka Caddaaladda Xasan Macallin Maxamuud iyo Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag). Sidoo kale waxaa goobta ku sugan qaar ka mid ah taliyeyaasha ciidamada, safiirro, wakiillo ka socda Isbahaysiga IMCTC iyo Saaxiibada Caalamka. Daahfurka mashaariicdan ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, warbaahinta iyo wacyigelinta bulshada, iyadoo warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed lagu dhiirrigelinayo inay door firfircoon ka qaadato ka hortagga fikirka xagjirka ah iyo faafinta farriimaha nabadda.

items.title: DEG-DEG: Hindiya oo Xaqiijisay Badqabka 22 Badmaax oo Saaran Maraakiib Puntland Lagu Hayo
items.description: Puntland (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Hindiya ayaa sheegtay in ay badqabaan 22 badmaax oo Hindi ah oo saaran laba markab oo lagu soo warramay in burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ay u soo jiideen xeebaha Puntland. Maraakiibta ayaa kala ah MV Lutuf, oo ku gooshaya calanka Kamaruun, iyo MT Siba, oo ku diiwaangashan calanka Eritrea. Labada markab ayaa maalmahan lagu arkayay xeebaha Puntland, kaddib markii ay gacanta u galeen kooxo burcad-badeed Soomaali ah. Dowladda Hindiya ayaa sheegtay in ay xaaladda kala hadashay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo si dhow ula socota xaaladda badmaaxiinta u dhashay dalka Hindiya. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli xeebaha Puntland laga soo sheegay dhacdooyin la xiriira burcad-badeednimo iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyo maraakiib, iyadoo sidoo kale dhawaan la sheegay in doonyo lagu beegsaday deegaanka Garmaal ee gobolka Nugaal. Mas’uuliyadda dhacdooyinkaasi weli si rasmi ah looma xaqiijin, iyadoo Dowladda Türkiye aysan ilaa hadda si rasmi ah uga hadlin eedeymaha la xiriira weerarradii lagu soo warramay xeebaha. Hindiya ayaa kamid ah dalalka sida weyn ula socda arrimaha burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya, maadaama muwaadiniin Hindi ah ay ka shaqeeyaan maraakiib badan oo mara Badweynta Hindiya, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. Xogta ku saabsan badqabka 22-ka badmaax ayaa ah tan ugu muhiimsan ee hadda la xaqiijiyay, halka faahfaahinta ku saabsan cidda gacanta ku haysa maraakiibta iyo tallaabada xigta ay weli sugayaan war rasmi ah. items.title: Somaliland oo aqoonsi ka dalbtay Griiga iyo Qubris
items.description: Warbaahinta ka soo baxda Qubrus ayaa baahisay in Somaliland ay u jeedisay Qubrus iyo Giriiga codsi ku saabsan in ay dib u eegaan xaaladda Somaliland, isla markaana ay ka fiirsadaan sidii loo xoojin lahaa xiriirka siyaasadeed ee labada dhinac. Arrintan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Somaliland ay sii waddo dadaalladeeda diblomaasiyadeed ee ay ku raadinayso aqoonsi caalami ah Codsigan ayaa kusoo aadaya kadib dood siyaasadeed oo ka dhalatay arrimaha Qubrus, gaar ahaan kadib hadallo iyo qoraallo la xidhiidhay mowqifka Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan Qubrus, taas oo keentay in Somaliland ay fursad u aragto sidii ay dunida ugu soo bandhigi lahayd aragtideeda ku saabsan qadiyadda aqoonsiga Somaliland ayaa sheegtay in aqoonsigeedu uu abuuri karo fursado cusub oo dhinacyada diblomaasiyadda, dhaqaalaha iyo amniga ah, iyadoo ku boorrisay Qubrus iyo Giriiga in ay si istiraatiiji ah u eegaan xaaladda Somaliland iyo doorkeeda gobolka Geeska Afrika. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay Somaliland sii waddo ololaheeda caalamiga ah ee ku aaddan helitaanka aqoonsi rasmi ah, iyadoo raadinaysa taageero siyaasadeed oo ka timaadda dalal kala duwan oo caalamka ah. Dhanka kale, Qubrus iyo Giriiga ayaa hore ugu dhowaa mowqifka Qaar Ka midaa Midowga Yurub ee taageeraya midnimadii dhimatay ee Soomaaliya Siyaasaddu ma laha saaxiib joogto ah, balse waxay leedahay dano joogto ah.” Haddii Somaliland ay hesho xiriir rasmi ah ama taageero siyaasadeed oo ka timaadda dalal Yurub ah sida Qubrus ama Giriiga, waxay noqon kartaa tallaabo muhiim u ah dadaalladeeda aqoonsi raadinta, maadaama labada dal ay ku leeyihiin saameyn gudaha Midowga Yurub iyo siyaasadda Bariga Mediterranean-ka

items.title: Dagaal ka socdo Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Xarunta Gobolka Mudug
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa sheegaya in iska horimaad uu ka socdo magaaladaasi, isla-markaana uu u dhexeeyo laba maleeshiyo beeleed. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in labada maleeshiyo uu iska horimaadka ku dhex marayo xaafadda Horumar, oo sidoo kale ay dadku u yaqaanaan Buulo Bacley. Dagaalkan ayaa daba socdo nin horaantii bishan lagu dilay afaafka hore Saldhigga Booliska Miir oo ku yaala dhinaca ay maamusho Puntland. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in maleeshiyaad hubeysan ay saaka isku dayeen inay aargudasho ahaan ugu dilaan nin kale oo ku sugnaa xaaafadda Horumar oo ka mid ah xaafadaha kala qaybiya labada dhinac ee Galmudug iyo Puntland. Isku daygaas dil oo fashilmay ayaa kiciyay xiisad iyo dagaalka dhex maraya labada dhinac. Magaalada ayaa waxaa weli laga maqlayaa rasaasta, iyadoo aan si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin khasaaraha ka dhashay. Iska horimaadkan ayaa hakad geliyay isu socodka waddooyinka ay dadku isaga kala gudbaan ee koonfurta iyo waqooyiga Gaalkacyo. Ma jirto cid kala dhex gashay dhinacyada, waxaase socda dadaalo lagu dejinayo xaaladda.

items.title: Qubrus oo jawaab ka soo saartay tallaabadii DF kadib arrintii uu sameeyey Jaamac
items.description: Nicosia (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Qubrus ayaa soo dhoweysay bayaanka ay Soomaaliya Jimcihii ka soo saartay murankii ka dhashay qoraal uu Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ku magacaabay maamulka waqooyiga jasiiraddaas “Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga ee Waqooyiga Qubrus”. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Qubrus, Theodoros Gotsis, ayaa wakaaladda wararka Qubrus ee CNA u sheegay in Nicosia ay soo dhoweyneyso xaqiijinta Muqdisho ee ah in mowqifkeeda ku aaddan arrinta Qubrus uusan waxba iska beddelin, isla markaana uu ku saleysan yahay Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay iyo go’aannada Golaha Ammaanka. “Soomaaliya waxay mar kale xaqiijisay ixtiraamka buuxa ee ay u hayso madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Qubrus, iyadoo la raacayo sharciga caalamiga ah iyo go’aannada khuseeya ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay,” ayuu yiri Gotsis. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in Qubrus ay muhiimad gaar ah siineyso ilaalinta madax-bannaanida iyo xuduudaha dalalka, isaga oo tilmaamay in Nicosia ay isla mabda’aas ka fileyso dowladaha kale. “Ku-dhaqanka sharciga caalamiga ah, Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay iyo ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dhammaan dowladaha waa mabda’ joogto ah oo siyaasaddeenna arrimaha dibadda ah,” ayuu yiri. “Waa mabda’ aan si joogto ah u dabaqno, isla markaana aan fileyno in si la mid ah loogu dabaqo dalkeenna,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Gotsis ayaa sheegay in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Qubrus ay sii wadi doonto dadaalladeeda diblomaasiyadeed ee ay ku ilaalineyso danaha, maqaamka caalamiga ah iyo xuquuqda madaxbannaanida dalkaas. Jawaabta Nicosia ayaa timid saacado kadib markii Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ay caddeysay in qoraalkii Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur aanu waxba ka beddelin siyaasadda rasmiga ah ee Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan Qubrus. Muranka ayaa billowday kadib markii Guddoomiye Jaamac uu 17-kii Agoosto qoraal uu soo dhigay bartiisa X ugu mahadceliyay Ziya Öztürkler oo ugu hambalyeeyay doorashadiisa, isaga oo Öztürkler ku tilmaamay “Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga ee Waqooyiga Qubrus”. Qoraalkaas oo markii dambe laga saaray barta X ayaa hadal-hayn ka dhaliyay Qubrus, maadaama magaca uu adeegsaday Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka uu yahay magaca rasmiga ah ee maamulka ay Turkiga taageerto ee waqooyiga jasiiradda. Mowqifka rasmiga ah ee Muqdisho Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa Jimcihii sheegtay in qoraalkaasi ahaa xiriir shaqsiyeed, isla markaana aan loo fasiran karin inuu yahay isbeddel ku yimid siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee dalka. “Qoraalka xiriirka shaqsiga ah ee la tixraacayo kama tarjumayo, loomana fasiran karo wax isbeddel ah oo ku yimid siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya,” ayay tiri wasaaraddu. “Ma aha aqoonsi loo fidiyay wax maamul gaar ah oo ka jira waqooyiga Qubrus, mana jirto wax go’aan ah oo Dowladda Federaalka ay ku beddeshay mowqifkeedii hore,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Muqdisho waxay sidoo kale dib u xaqiijisay inay ixtiraamayso “madax-bannaanida, xorriyadda, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed” ee Jamhuuriyadda Qubrus, iyadoo si gaar ah u xustay qaraarrada Golaha Ammaanka ee tirsigoodu yahay 541 iyo 550. Qaraarka 541, oo la ansixiyay 1983, ayaa ku baaqaya in dalalka caalamku aysan aqoonsan dowlad kale oo Qubrus ka jirta marka laga reebo Jamhuuriyadda Qubrus, halka qaraarka 550 uu sii xoojiyay mowqifkaas. Jasiirad muddo dheer kala qaybsan Waqooyiga Qubrus ayaa ku dhawaaqay madax-bannaani 1983, balse Turkiga ayaa weli ah dalka keliya ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsan. Jasiiradda Qubrus waxay kala qaybsaneyd tan iyo 1974, markii ciidamada Turkiga ay galeen waqooyiga kadib afgambi ay taageertay dowladdii milatariga ee Giriigga. Jamhuuriyadda Qubrus ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa maamusha koonfurta, halka maamulka Turkish Cypriot-ka uu gacanta ku hayo waqooyiga. Ciidamo nabad-ilaalin ah oo Qaramada Midoobay ah ayaa ilaaliya aag kala qeybiya labada dhinac. Arrintan ayaa ku soo beegmeysa xilli Qaramada Midoobay ay waddo dadaal cusub oo lagu doonayo in dib loogu bilaabo wada-hadallada xal loogu raadinayo kala qeybsanaanta Qubrus, kadib markii wadahadalladii waaweynaa ee ugu dambeeyay ay burbureen 2017. Xoghayaha Guud ee QM Antonio Guterres ayaa bishii July booqday jasiiradda, isaga oo la kulmay hoggaamiyeyaasha labada dhinac si loo qiimeeyo suuragalnimada dib u bilaabidda wada-xaajoodyada. Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay taageereyso xal “nabad ah, wada-hadal ku yimaada oo waara” oo laga gaaro arrinta Qubrus, kaas oo lagu gaaro hannaan ay hoggaamineyso Qaramada Midoobay. The post Qubrus oo jawaab ka soo saartay tallaabadii DF kadib arrintii uu sameeyey Jaamac appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Puntland condemns reported Turkish airstrike that killed 4 civilian fishermen in Garmaal
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Puntland authorities have strongly condemned an airstrike near Garmaal on Somalia’s northeastern coast that killed four people and wounded two others, saying the victims were civilian fishermen and warning that attacks against civilians could seriously damage cooperation between Puntland’s security agencies and international partners fighting piracy. The Puntland Ministry of Security, in a statement issued Friday, said the government opposed military strikes by international forces against civilians and their property in coastal areas where hijacked vessels are being held. Puntland called on the government responsible for the operation to provide an immediate explanation of the motive behind the strikes reported around Garmaal on August 19 and 20. The ministry did not identify the country involved. The statement comes amid mounting scrutiny of an airstrike that followed the August 17 hijacking of the Cameroon-flagged cargo vessel M/V LUTUF off Puntland. According to reporting based on a Somali official, the vessel was seized near Marraya in Puntland’s Eyl district and was subsequently taken toward the Nugaal coast near Garmaal in Dangoroyo district. The LUTUF was reportedly carrying Turkish weapons, communications equipment and satellite equipment destined for a Turkish military training facility in Mogadishu. Its 10-member crew included six Indians, one Turkish national, one Georgian and two Serbian security guards, according to the Somali official cited by the Associated Press. Deadly strike followed the hijacking The sequence of events has placed the strike under intense scrutiny. The pirates who seized the LUTUF were believed to be members of a group previously linked to the April hijacking of the M/V Sward . After taking control of the vessel, they reportedly moved it toward the coast near Garmaal. Turkish-owned vessels subsequently approached the area, while Turkish helicopters and drones were reported to have monitored the hijacked ship. On Tuesday, according to the Somali official cited by AP, a small boat carrying a number of men approached the hijacked vessel and delivered khat. After the boat returned toward the shore, an airstrike followed, killing four men and wounding two others. Initial reports described those killed as suspected pirates. Subsequent local accounts, however, identified them as fishermen, while Puntland authorities said the victims were civilians. Other reporting has noted that the identities and affiliations of those killed have not been independently established. That distinction is central to the controversy. If the victims were indeed civilians with no role in the hijacking, the strike would represent a grave incident involving the protection of coastal communities already living alongside a resurgent piracy threat. Puntland authorities have therefore framed the episode not only as a civilian-safety issue but also as a potential threat to the cooperation that underpins international counter-piracy efforts. Turkey blamed, but responsibility remains disputed Former Somali Foreign Minister Abdisaeed Muse Ali said Thursday that Turkey was responsible for the strike and accused Ankara of carrying out a “ massacre ” of civilians. Turkey has not publicly confirmed responsibility for the airstrike, according to reporting available as of Saturday. The Associated Press has likewise reported that the actor behind the airstrike remained unconfirmed and that the affiliation of the four men killed had not been independently established. That uncertainty has become a defining feature of the incident: reports have increasingly associated the operation with Turkey because of the presence of Turkish vessels, helicopters and drones around the hijacked LUTUF , as well as the Turkish military cargo aboard the vessel. But the available evidence does not yet amount to an official Turkish admission of responsibility. Puntland warns of wider consequences For Puntland, the episode reaches beyond the deaths themselves. The Ministry of Security warned that attacks against civilians or their property in coastal areas could undermine the relationship between Puntland security institutions and foreign partners assisting in the campaign against piracy. The warning comes as Somalia faces a renewed wave of maritime insecurity. The LUTUF hijacking was followed by another major incident in the Gulf of Aden, underscoring growing concerns about the return of Somali piracy and the security risks facing commercial shipping in waters around Somalia and Yemen. Puntland has sought international assistance in confronting piracy while simultaneously asserting responsibility for the security of its coastal communities. The government’s latest statement therefore reflects a difficult balance: supporting international efforts to recover hijacked vessels while insisting that military operations must not turn innocent fishermen and other civilians into casualties. The status of the LUTUF , its crew and its cargo remains unclear, while the circumstances surrounding the deadly strike continue to generate competing accounts. For now, Puntland is demanding answers. The central question is no longer simply how the LUTUF was hijacked or how the pirates will be forced to release it. It is whether the military response to the hijacking killed the very people Puntland says were never part of the piracy operation in the first place – and, if so, who ordered the strike and why. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Unrecognised Somaliland calls on Cyprus, Greece to recognise it
items.description: The internationally unrecognised ‘Republic of Somaliland’ has called on both Cyprus and Greece to consider recognising it , after the new parliament speaker of Somalia, the country from which it has broken away, referred to the ‘Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus’ in a now deleted social media post. “The Republic of Somaliland stands with the Republic of Cyprus and Greece against aggression from Somalia and Turkey. The failed state of Somalia’s parliament speaker’s engagement with the speaker of northern Cyprus raises significant questions,” its authorities wrote in a post on social media. They added that following Somali Parliament Speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur’s reference to the ‘TRNC’, “ Greece and Cyprus should take a fresh, strategic look at the Republic of Somalilan d”. “Recognising Somaliland would create new opportunities for diplomatic, economic, and security cooperation, while strengthening a shared position against Somalia and Turkish aggression,” they said. Nur had accepted a telephone call from Turkish Cypriot ‘parliament speaker’ Ziya Ozturkler after being elected as parliament speaker earlier this month, and wrote in a subsequent social media post that he wished to “ extend by sincere thanks to [the] speaker of the assembly of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus , for his kind congratulations”. The post has since been deleted, with Somalia’s foreign ministry on Friday stressing that “its position on the Cyprus issue remains unchanged and continues to be guided by the charter of the United Nations and thee relevant resolutions of the United Nations security council”. It added that it “ reaffirms its full respect for the sovereignty, independence, unity, and territorial integrity of the Republic of Cyprus, in accordance with international law ”. Somalia has long had political ties to Turkey, with Nur having said on Friday that “over the past 15 years, the relationship between Somalia and Turkey, which began with humanitarian aid in 2011, is today undergoing strategic projects , a relationship built on brotherhood, mutual respect, and shared interest”. “Cooperation is prominent in the areas of security, education, health, development, economic infrastructure, and humanitarian aid,” he added. Last month, Turkey’s parliament approved a bill submitted by President Recep Tayyip Erdogan to extend the permanent presence of Turkish troops in Somalia until July 2028 . According to Turkish public broadcaster TRT, those troops will “continue supporting [Somalia] in combating terrorism, piracy, and other threats”, while the Somali government had “sought continued Turkish military assistance under a defence and cooperation framework agreement”. With Somalia being largely aligned with Turkey in this sense, regional rival Israel took the decision in December last year to recognise the otherwise internationally unrecognised ‘Republic of Somaliland’ , which administers the northern third of what is otherwise internationally considered to be the territory of the Federal Republic of Somalia. No country followed Israel in recognising Somaliland, with the Republic of Cyprus’ foreign ministry having said in December that it “aligns itself with the European Union’s call for respect to the unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity of the Federal Republic of Somalia ”. It also said that it “underscores its position that Somaliland remains an integral part of the Federal Republic of Somalia”. Earlier, the European external action service – the European Union’s equivalent to a foreign ministry – had said that it “reaffirms the importance of respecting the unity, the sovereignty, and the territorial integrity of the Federal Republic of Somalia” . “This is key for the peace and stability of the entire Horn of Africa region. The EU encourages meaningful dialogue between Somaliland and the federal government of Somalia to resolve longstanding differences,” he said Source Cyprus mail

items.title: PUNTLAND oo qoraal adag ka soo saartay weerar lagu tuhunsan yahay TURKIGA
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Puntland ayaa markii ugu horreysay si faahfaahsan uga hadashay duqeymo maalmihii lasoo dhaafay ka dhacay xeebaha gobolka Nugaal, iyadoo dalbatay in dowladaha ka dambeeyay weerarradaas ay sharaxaad degdeg ah ka bixiyaan, xilli ay dib u soo xoogeysanayaan falalka burcad-badeednimada ee xeebaha Soomaaliya. War-saxaafadeed ay Jimcihii soo saartay Wasaaradda Amniga iyo DDR-ta Puntland ayay ku sheegtay inay si adag u cambaareyneyso dib u soo cusboonaanshaha burcad-badeednimada, waxayna sheegtay inay baaritaan gaar ah ku heyso xog muujineysa in waxa socda aysan ku koobneyn kooxo burcad-badeed ah oo maxalli ah. Puntland ayaa sheegtay inay hayso xog tilmaameysa inay jiraan “awoodo ka baxsan Puntland” oo qeyb ka ah howl-gallada cusub ee burcad-badeedda, isla markaana ay jiraan mas’uuliyiin siyaasadeed iyo kuwo dhaqaale oo, sida ay hadalka u dhigtay, gabaad siinaya kooxahaas. Maamulka ma uusan magacaabin awoodaha ama mas’uuliyiinta uu ku tuhunsan yahay arrintan, mana uusan soo bandhigin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo caddeyneysa eedeynta. Puntland ayaa dhinaca kale sheegtay inay ka go’an tahay la dagaallanka burcad-badeednimada, isla markaana ay diyaar u tahay inay la shaqeyso dowladaha ku hawlan ciribtirka kooxaha qafaasha maraakiibta. Hase yeeshee, maamulka ayaa si adag uga hor yimid qaabka loo fulinayo qaar ka mid ah howl-gallada ka socda xeebaha gobolka Nugaal. Duqeymo muran dhaliyay “Dowladda Puntland waxay ka soo horjeeddaa duqeymaha ay maraakiibta dagaalka ee caalamiga ah ku beegsanayaan dadka shacabka ah iyo hantidooda ee deegaannada dhow xeebaha lagu haysto maraakiibta u afduuban burcad-badeedka,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in weerarrada noocaas ahi dhaawici karaan iskaashiga u dhexeeya hay’adaha ammaanka maamulka iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah ee ka qeyb qaata dagaalka burcad-badeednimada, isla markaana ay waxyeello kasoo gaari karto dad rayid ah oo aan ku lug lahayn falalka burcad-badeedda. Maamulka ayaa si gaar ah u xusay duqeymo 18-kii iyo 20-kii Agoosto ka dhacay deegaanka Garmaal ee gobolka Nugaal, isagoo sheegay in lagu beegsaday dad kalluumeysato ah iyo hantidooda. Puntland waxay dowladaha ay maraakiibtoodu ku lug lahaayeen howl-galladaas ugu baaqday inay “jawaab degdeg ah” ka bixiyaan ujeeddada duqeymaha. War-saxaafadeedka Puntland ma magacaabin waddan gaar ah oo fuliyay weerarrada. Arrintan ayaa soo baxday maalmo kadib markii markabka xamuulka qaada ee M/V LUTUF , oo sita calanka Cameroon, ay koox hubeysan la wareegtay 17-kii Agoosto meel u dhow xeebaha degmada Eyl. Hay’adda UK Maritime Trade Operations ayaa sheegtay in siddeed nin oo hubeysan ay fuuleen markabka meel qiyaastii afar mayl-badeed koonfur kaga beegan Mareeya, kadibna ay la wareegeen gacan-ku-heyntiisa. Xogta markabka M/V LUTUF Warbixin ay Associated Press daabacday Khamiistii ayaa lagu sheegay in markabka LUTUF uu siday hub iyo qalab isgaarsiineed iyo satellite ah oo ku wajahnaa xarun tababar oo Turkigu ku leeyahay Muqdisho. Sarkaal Soomaali ah oo AP la hadlay ayaa sheegay in markabka ay saarnaayeen 10 qof oo kala ahaa lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Georgian ah iyo laba ilaalo Serbian ah. Sida AP ay werisay, kooxdii afduubatay markabka ayaa la rumeysan yahay inay xiriir la leedahay kooxdii bishii Abriil afduubatay markabka MV SWARD, waxaana LUTUF loo kaxeeyay dhinaca xeebta Garmaal ee degmada Dangorayo. Laba markab oo ay leeyihiin shirkado Turki ah ayaa kadib kusoo dhowaaday markabka la afduubtay, halka diyaarado helicopter ah iyo drones Turkish ah ay la socdeen aagga, sida uu sarkaalka Soomaaliga ah u sheegay AP. Maalintii xigtay, doon yar ayaa la sheegay in ay u tagtay markabka, waxaana kadib dhacay duqeyn lagu dilay afar qof laguna dhaawacay laba kale. AP waxay sheegtay in aysan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin cidda fulisay duqeynta iyo in dadka la dilay ay si toos ah ugu lug lahaayeen afduubka markabka. Dowladda Turkiga sidoo kale wax war rasmi ah kama aysan soo saarin dhacdada. Caasimada Online ayaa 18-kii Agoosto horey u baahisay in afar nin ay ku dhinteen duqeyn ka dhacday agagaarka Garmaal, iyadoo wararkii xilligaas jiray qaarkood ay ragga ku tilmaameen burcad-badeed, halka dadka deegaanka qaarkood ay ku adkeysteen inay ahaayeen dad rayid ah. Hadalkan cusub ee Puntland ayaa hadda si rasmi ah u taageeraya sheegashada ah in dad kalluumeysato ah lagu beegsaday duqeymaha, iyadoo maamulka uu dalbaday in cidda ka dambeysay ay sharaxdo sababta iyo ujeeddada howl-gallada. Xiisaddan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli burcad-badeednimada xeebaha Soomaaliya ay markale sare u kacday sanadkan. Bishii Abriil waxaa muddo toddobaad gudihiis ah la afduubtay dhowr markab, oo ay ku jiraan MT HONOUR 25 iyo MV SWARD, halka howlgalka Midowga Yurub ee Atalanta uu dabayaaqadii Luulyo sheegay inuu la socday afar kiis oo afduub ah oo weli socda. Kooxaha burcad-badeedda ayaa sannado badan ku dhowaa inay meesha ka baxaan, kadib howl-gallo ay iska kaashadeen ciidamada Soomaalida, maraakiibta caalamiga ah iyo shirkadaha ganacsiga badda. Hase yeeshee, weerarrada cusub ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in shabakadaha burcad-badeedda ay mar kale dib isu abaabulayaan, iyadoo Puntland ay hadda sheegtay in baaritaankeeda uu gaarayo cid kasta oo gudaha iyo dibadda ah oo laga yaabo inay taageerto ama fududeyso howl-galladaas. items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo difaacay deegaanka Cali Ganey ee Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ayaa fashiliyay isku day ay Al Shabaab dooneysay inay ku qabsato deegaanka Cali Ganey ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Dagaal-yahano ka tirsan Al Shabaab, lana sheegay qayb ka mid ah kuwoodii 2-dii bishan qabsaday deegaanka Teedaan ayaa Jimcihii u jiheystay dhinaca Cali Ganey, iyadoo uu ujeedkoodu ahaa in ay la wareegaan deegaankaasi, oo aanay xilligaasi joogin ciidamada. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ay laba jeer jidka u galeen maleeshiyadaasi, ka hor inta aysan deegaankaasi soo gaareen ciidamo uu hoggaaminayo Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cagey). Ciidamada ayaa haatan si buuxda ugu sugan deegaanka Cali Ganey oo ka mid ah deegaanada ay ku soo barakaceen dadkii dhawaan ka soo cararay dagaaladii horaantii bishan ka dhacay deegaanada u dhexeeya Magaalooyinka Maxaas iyo Matabaan. Qoysas fara-badan oo ka cararay dagaalada ka dhacay deegaanada Suullaay, Xasan Raqay, Sulmo, Xagar iyo aagga Teedaan ayaa badbaado u raadsaday deegaanada Cali Ganey iyo Hees. Qoysaskan ayaan guryahooda dib ugu soo laaban, bacdamaa ay weli baqdintu ka jirto deegaanada u dhexeeya Maxaas iyo Teedaan. Ciidamada ayaa waxay diyaargarow ugu jiraan, sidii ay dib ugu qabsan lahaayeen deegaanka istiraatiijiga ah ee Teedaan.

items.title: Itoobiya oo Dastuurkeeda ka Saartay Qodobkii Ogolaanayay Gooni-u-goosadka Ismaamullada
items.description: Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa wax-ka-beddel taariikhi ah ku samaysay qaar ka mid ah qodobbada ugu xasaasisanaa dastuurka dalkaas, iyada oo gabi ahaanba meesha ka saartay Qodobkii 39-aad oo ahaa midka u oggolaanayay ismaamullada qowmiyadaha dalkaas inay ka go’i karaan Itoobiya inteeda kale haddii ay doortaan. Tallaabadan, oo dhalisay doodo adag iyo falcelinno kala duwan, ayaa ugu dambeyn la meelmariyay, waxaana marka uu si rasmi ah u dhaqangalo meesha ka bixi doonta fursaddii sharciyeed ee ismaamulladu u lahaayeen inay ku go’aan. Wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka kuma koobnaan kaliya gooni-u-goosadka, balse waxaa sidoo kale si rasmi ah loogu aqoonsaday afafka Amxaariga, Oromada, Soomaaliga, Tigreega, iyo Canfarta inay noqdaan luuqadaha shaqada ee heer federaal, taas oo meesha ka saaraysa caddaalad-darradii iyo cadaadiskii luuqadeed ee hore u haystay shaqalaha iyo bulshooyinka aan Amxaariga ku hadlin. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Ahmed, ayaa dadaal xooggan geliyay sidii dib-u-habayn loogu samayn lahaa qodobbada dastuurka ee la aaminsanaa inay awood xad-dhaaf ah siinayeen dowlad-goboleedyada dalkaas. Qorshaha xukuumadda dhexe ayaa salka ku haya in la yareeyo awoodaha gaarka ah ee maamullada, laguna qasbo inay si dhow oo toos ah ula shaqeeyaan dowladda federaalka si loo adkeeyo midnimada qaranka. Itoobiya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay la daalaadhacaysay xasarado siyaasadeed iyo isku-dhacyo qowmiyadeed, waxaana sannadkii 2020 dalkaas ka qarxay dagaal kharaar oo u dhexeeyay Dowladda Federaalka iyo Maamulka Tigray. Dagaalkaas, oo ka dhashay khilaaf ku saabsanaa dib-u-dhigistii doorashooyinka xilligii cudurka Covid-19, ayaa sababay khasaare naf iyo maalba leh, burbur baahsan, iyo barakac ballaaran, taas oo dowladda ku dhalisay inay dib u eegto nidaamka federaalka qowmiyadaha ku dhisan.

items.title: UNICEF Oo Ka Digtay In Ka Badan 600 Oo Xarumo Oo Caafimaad Ay Halis Ugu Jiraan Inay Xirmaan Soomaaliya
items.description: Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Carruurta ee UNICEF ayaa ka digtay dhibaato xooggan oo ku soo fool leh qaybta caafimaadka Soomaaliya, ka dib markii 205 xarumood oo caafimaad iyo nafaqo ah ay dalka ka xirmeen dhimista ku timid maalgashiga gargaarka bani’aadannimo awgeed. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in wadarta xarumaha xirmi kara ay gaari karto ilaa 618 haddii aan si degdeg ah wax looga qaban dhaqaale-yaraanta baahsan ee jirta, taas oo si toos ah u waxyeellaynaysa carruurta u baahan baaritaanka, daaweynta, iyo adeegyada ka-hortagga ah. Dhimista ku timid adeegyada aasaasiga ah ayaa dhalisay in lixdii bilood ee ugu horreeyay sannadkan 2026 la diiwaangeliyo koror 32% ah oo ku yimid carruurta xaaladdoodu aadka u daran tahay ee la dhigay xarumaha xasilinta nafaqo-darrada. UNICEF waxay caddaysay in kororkani aanu ka dhalan oo keliya xanuunno kordhay, balse uu salka ku hayo xarumahii hore u qaban jiray baaritaannada heerka bilowga ah oo la xiray, taas oo hooyooyinka ku qasbeysa safarro dhaadheer, carruur badanna ay xarumaha waaweyn gaaraan xilli ay xaaladdoodu aad u sii xumaatay. Guud ahaan baaxadda adeegyada caafimaadka iyo nafaqada ee dalka ayaa hoos u dhacday 30%, iyadoo ku dhowaad hal milyan oo carruur ah oo shan sano ka yar, gabdho dhallinyaro ah, iyo haween ay halis ugu jiraan inay waayaan daryeel caafimaad. Sidoo kale, ku dhowaad 1.9 milyan oo carruur Soomaaliyeed ah ayaa la saadaalinayaa inay wajahaan nafaqo-darro sannadkan, kuwaas oo ku dhowaad nus milyan ka mid ahi ay qabaan nafaqo-darro daran oo u baahan gurmad daaweyn oo degdeg ah. Xaaladdan bani’aadannimo ee cakiran ayaa waxaa sii kicinaya abaaro ka jira qaybo ka mid ah waqooyiga dalka, colaadaha, barakaca joogtada ah, dalagyada beeraha oo yaraaday, iyo kororka qiimaha nolosha. items.title: Ciidanka Dowladda oo Hawlgallo ka Fuliyay Deegaanno ka Tirsan Shabeellaha Dhexe
items.description: Ciidanka Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa labadii toddobaad ee u dambeeyay hawlgallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ka fuliyay deegaanno ka tirsan gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, gaar ahaan Daaru-nimca iyo Tawakal, sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadu ay hawlgalladaasi ku dileen horjooge ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo lagu kala magacaabo Xasan Xuseen Xurshow ana Xasan Garab-dheere. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka, horjoogayaasha la dilay ayaa ka qayb ahaa maleeshiyaadkii ka dagaallamayay deegaannada Caddadley, Cadnaan-leexey iyo Daaru-nimca, kuwaas oo dhammaantood ku yaalla gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in weerarrada ay ciidamada dowladda fuliyeen mid ka mid ah uu ahaa mid ay si gaar ah u beegsadeen maleeshiyaadkii waday hawlgallada, iyadoo mid ka mid ah horjoogayaasha lagu dilay halka mid kalena lagu dhaawacay. Dhanka kale, Ciidamada Dowladda ayaa mar kale weerar ka fuliyay deegaanka Tawakal, halkaas oo lagu dilay horjooge kale oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab, kaas oo lagu magacaabi jiray Cabdullaahi Faadhuud. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa bogaadisay ciidamada xoogga dalka oo ay sheegtay inay ka dhanka yihiin argagixisada, iyadoo xustay in Ciidamada Dowladda ay door muuqda ka qaadanayaan dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab.

items.title: Wararkii u dambeeyey wada-hadallada DF iyo mucaaradka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Ururrada Bulshada Rayidka Soomaaliyeed, Cismaan Muxuyadiin Shaatax ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan khilaafka weli u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka. Shaatax oo ka qeyb-galay dood-cilmiyeed looga hadlayay xaaladda guud ee dalka ayaa si gaar ah u taabtay wada-hadallada u dhexeeya dowladda iyo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo weli aan laga gaarin heshiis siyaasadeed. Guddoomiyaha ayaa ka digay in haddii labada dhinac ay ku guuldarreystaan inay heshiis ka gaaraan khilaafka taagan ay Soomaaliya wajahdo xaalad kale oo halis ah, taas oo saameyn ku yeelan karta xasilloonida dalka. “Haddii ay heshiin waayaan mucaaradka iyo dowladda waa arrin khatarteeda leh, waxaa xoogeysanaysa faragelinta shisheeye ee lagu hayo dalkeenna, waxaa sii xoogeysanayo inay mugdi sii gasho midnimadeenna,” ayuu yiri Shaatax. Wuxuu sheegay in sii socoshada khilaafka siyaasadeed ay fursad u abuuri karto dhinacyo shisheeye oo doonaya inay saameyn ku yeeshaan arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya. Shaatax ayaa farriin u diray Villa Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka, isaga oo ugu baaqay labada dhinac inay muujiyaan tanaasul iyo dabacsanaan siyaasadeed, isla markaana ay mudnaanta koowaad siiyaan danaha dalka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Annaga ka bulsho rayid ahaan rajo ayaan ka qabnaa inay heshiiyaan, waxaana rabnaa in heshiiskooda uu noqdo mid aan wax ku leenahay,” ayuu yiri, isagoo tilmaamay in bulshada rayidka ah ay dooneyso inay qeyb ka noqoto geeddi-socodka heshiiska. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in heshiiska la gaarayo uusan noqon mid kaliya lagu xalliyo khilaafka hadda taagan, balse uu noqdo mid wax ka qabta sababaha keena khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee soo noqnoqda. “Midda labaad waxaan rabnaa in heshiiskaas lagu xalliyo waxa hadda taagan, isla markaana uu noqdo mid lagu heshiiyo in afar sano kadib aysan arrimahan oo kale mar kale nagu soo laaban,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Khilaafka Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka ayaa inta badan salka ku haya arrimaha dastuurka, doorashooyinka iyo hannaanka siyaasadeed ee dalka, iyadoo dhinacyada mucaaradka ay dhowr jeer dhaliileen qaar ka mid ah tallaabooyinka dowladda. Bulshada rayidka ah ayaa horey ugu baaqday dowladda iyo mucaaradka inay yeeshaan wadatashi dhab ah oo lagu gaaro heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, kaas oo ilaalinaya xasilloonida dalka iyo midnimada shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Soomaaliya ayaa xilligan ku jirta marxalad siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah, iyadoo indhaha shacabka ay ku sii jeedaan dadaallada lagu doonayo in lagu soo afjaro khilaafka, waxaana wada-hadallada socda garwadeen ka ah wakiillo ka tirsan beesha caalamka oo fadhigoodu yahay magaalada Muqdisho. The post Wararkii u dambeeyey wada-hadallada DF iyo mucaaradka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweynaha Iran: Waxaa wanaagsan in dagaalka la soo afjaro hadda oo aan xukunka heyno
items.description: Madaxweynaha Iran Masoud Pezeshkian ayaa sheegay in la joogo waqtigii la soo afjari lahaa dagaalka Mareykanka, maaddaama Tehran ay Washington kala joogto meel “awood” leh. Pezeshkian ayaa yiri: “Waxaa wanaagsan in dagaalka maanta la soo afjaro, xilli aan heyno xukunka oo aan leennahay sharaf, isla markaana dunida oo dhan ay qirayso guusheenna, ayna carrabka ku adkeynayso in Mareykanku, si ka baxsan dhammaan xeerarka, uu weeraray iskuulladeenna, isbitaalladeenna iyo kaabayaasheenna, isla markaana dunidu ay neceb tahay.” Madaxweynaha Iran ayaa sidoo kale natiijadii wadahadalladii Iran iyo Mareykanka, kuwaas oo horseeday in la saxiixo Is-afgaradkii Islamabad, ku tilmaamay “guul weyn”. Wuxuu sheegay in heshiiska “si midnimo iyo isfaham leh loogu ansixiyay Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka, dhammaan xubnihii golaha ee arrintan ku lug lahaa ay si adag u difaaceenna.” Pezeshkian ayaa sidoo kale dhaliilay dadka uu sheegay inay “dibadda ka fadhiyaan” oo “aan garanayn waxa ay dowladdu ku guda jirto, xaaladda baarlamaanku ku jiro iyo waxa taliyayaashu ku jiraan.” Pezeshkian ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in hadalladiisu aysan ka dhignayn in Iran ay isu dhiibayso gardarro kasta oo iman karta: “Sinnaba uguma jilicsanaan doonno cagajuglaynta, arrintaasna shaki kuma jiro. Waxaan la hor istaagi doonnaa ilaa neeftayada ugu dambaysa, waxaana siin doonnaa jawaab burburinaysa.”

items.title: Ciidamada Turkiga oo wali ku hareeraysan markab hub u siday Soomaaliya
items.description: MUQDISHO — Ciidamada Turkiga ayaa wali si dhow ula socda markabka M/V LUTUF, oo ay burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ka afduubteen xeebaha Puntland, xilli markabka la sheegay inuu siday hub iyo qalab isgaarsiineed oo ku socday xarunta tababarka ciidamada Turkiga ee Muqdisho. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in laba markab oo ay leeyihiin dhinaca Turkiga ay ku dhowaadeen goobta uu ku sugnaa markabka la afduubtay, halka diyaarado helicopter ah iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo Turki ah ay hawada ka sameeyeen kormeer. Markabka LUTUF, oo sita calanka Cameroon, ayaa 17-kii Agoosto lagu qabsaday meel u dhow xeebta Marraya ee degmada Eyl, waxaana la sheegay in siddeed nin oo hubeysan ay la wareegeen. Markabka ayaa markii dambe loo kaxeeyay dhanka xeebaha Nugaal. Sida ay sheegayaan wararka, markabka waxaa saarnaa 10 shaqaale ah, oo ay ku jiraan lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Joorjiyaan ah iyo laba ilaalo oo Serbian ah. Xogihii ugu dambeeyay ee laga helay dhinaca Hindiya ayaa tilmaamaya in badmaaxiinta Hindida ah ay badqabaan. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kadib markii la sheegay in doon yar oo qaad u geysay kooxaha markabka haysta ay dib ugu laabatay xeebta, ka dibna ay dhacday duqeyn cirka ah oo lagu dilay afar qof, laba kalena lagu dhaawacay. Hase yeeshee, cidda fulisay duqeynta si rasmi ah looma xaqiijin, mana cadda in dadka la bartilmaameedsaday ay dhammaantood ka tirsanaayeen burcad-badeedda afduubtay LUTUF. Dhanka kale, dowladda Turkiga wali si rasmi ah ugama hadlin faahfaahinta dhacdadan, waxaana weli socda dadaallo lagu xaqiijinayo xaaladda markabka, shaqaalaha iyo xamuulka saaran. Dhacdadan ayaa muujinaysa in afduubka LUTUF uu noqday arrin xasaasi ah oo ku lug leh amniga badda Soomaaliya iyo danaha militari ee Turkiga.

items.title: Dowladda oo shaacisay in la dilay Cabdullaahi Faadhuud iyo Xasan Garabdheere
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya oo warsaxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa faah-faahin ka bixisay howlgal ay Jimcihii ciidamada Macawiisleyda ka fuliyeen deegaano ka tirsan gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, kaas oo lagu beegsaday horjoogayaal ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab. Howlgalka koowaad oo ka dhacay duleedka deegaanka Daaru-nicma ayaa lagu beegsaday goob ay ku dhuumaaleysanayeennmaleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta, waxaana lagu dilay horjooge lagu magacaabi jiray Xasan Xuseen Xuurshow, oo loo yaqaanay Xasan Garabdheere. Horjoogahan ayaa Al-Shabaab u qaabilsanaa waxa ay ugu yeeraan Sakawaadka ee deegaannada Cadcaddeey, Cadaan-lexeey iyo Daaru-nicma, kuwaas oo hoostaga degmada Ruun-nirgood ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Sidoo kale waxaa isla weerarkan lagu dilay mid ka mid ah maleeshiyaadkii waardiyaha u ahaa horjoogaha, halka mid kale oo ka tirsanaa maleeshiyaadka lagu dhaawacay, sida ay shaacisay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Weerarka labaad ayaa sidoo kale isla maalintaas ciidamada Macawiisleyda waxa ay ka fuliyeen deegaanka Tawakal, halkaas oo ay ku dileen horjooge kale oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab, kaas oo lagu magacaabi jiray Cabdullaahi Maxamuud Odowaa (Faadhuud) 57 sanno jir Khawaarijta u qaabilsanaa waxa ay ugu yeeraan Zakawaadka kuna biiray sanadkii 2009-kii. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiggu ayaa ugu dambeyn bogaadisay kacaanka shacabka ee ka dhanka ah argagixisada, kaas oo sii xoogeysanaya, iyadoo ciidamada deegaanka ay door muuqda ka qaadanayaan dagaalka lagu ciribtirayo Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab. Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa deegaanka ayaa kordhiyay dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ee ka socda gobollada Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe ee Maamulka HirShabelle. The post Dowladda oo shaacisay in la dilay Cabdullaahi Faadhuud iyo Xasan Garabdheere appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Daawo: Arrin cusub oo kasoo korortay xaaladda Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Booliska Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda ammaan ee degmadaasi iyo barakac la sheegay inay bilaabeen qaar kamid ah dadka deegaanka ee ku dhaqan magaaladaasi oo dhawaan ay ku dagaalameen ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kuwa taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Taliyaha Saldhiga Booliska Baydhaba, Cali Taagey ayaa sheegay in dadka haatan ka baxaya magaalada ay u badan yihiin dad markii hore qax ahaan ku yimid Baydhaba iyo xaasaska Al-Shabaab, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Dadka Baydhabo ka qaxaya awalba qax ayey ku yimaadeen magaalada hanaga baxaan, waa xaasaskii niyuu Al-Shabaab,” ayuu yiri Taliyuhu. Cali Taagey ayaa sidoo kale farriin culus u diray shacabka magaalada Baydhaba, wuxuuna ugu baaqay inay daganaan muujiyaan, isla markaana ay ku nagaadaan guryahooda, maadaama hadda xaaladda guud ay dagan tahay. “Shacabka Baydhaba waxaan ugu baaqayaa inay is dajiyaan waxaan u sheegaynaa khaladaadka meel kasta ayuu ka dhacaa, laakiin guud ahaan magaalada waa nabad, amnigana waa sugan yahay,” ayuu raaciyay. Dhinaca kale, wuxuu digniin u diray askarta rasaasta ka dhex rida maaalada gudaheeda, isaga oo talisyada ugu baaqay inay xakameeyaan ciidamadooda, isla markaana tallaabo adag laga qaado askarigii ku xadgudba shacabka. Xaaladda guud ee magaalada Baydhaba ayaa hadda deggan, waxaana laba todobaad kadib saaka dib ugu laabtay Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo maalmahan ku sugnaa magaalada Muqdisho. Aadan Madoobe ayaa intii uu joogay caasimada kulamo la yeeshay madaxda dowladda oo uu kala hadlay xaaladaha kasoo cusboonaaday maamulkaasi. The post Daawo: Arrin cusub oo kasoo korortay xaaladda Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo 11 dal oo soo saaray qoraal kadib weerarkii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Soomaaliya iyo 11 dal oo kale ayaa si adag u cambaareeyay duqeymaha ay Israel toddobaadkan ka geysatay saldhigga milatari ee Abu al-Duhur ee waqooyi-galbeed Suuriya, iyagoo ku tilmaamay weerarradaasi “xiisad aad u daran oo sii kordheysa” iyo xadgudub ka dhan ah madaxbannaanida dalka Suuriya. Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee Türkiye, Aljeeriya, Indonesia, Urdun, Lubnaan, Malaysia, Mauritania, Pakistan, Falastiin, Qatar, Sacuudiga iyo Soomaaliya ayaa bayaan wadajir ah oo ay soo saareen ku sheegay in duqeymaha Israel ay yihiin “xadgudub cad oo ka dhan ah madaxbannaanida, wadajirka dhuleed iyo midnimada siyaasadeed” ee Suuriya. Wasiirradu waxay walaac xooggan ka muujiyeen weerarrada joogtada ah ee lagu beegsanayo dhulka iyo kaabeyaasha Suuriya, iyagoo ka digay in tallaabooyinkaas ay halis gelin karaan dadaallada lagu doonayo in dalka lagu soo celiyo amniga, lagu dhiso hay’adihiisa qaran, laguna yareeyo saameynta bani’aadannimo ee ka dhalatay sannado badan oo colaado ah. Waxay sidoo kale ka digeen in xadgudubyada joogtada ah ee Israel ay ku hayso madaxbannaanida iyo dhuleednimada Suuriya ay horseedi karaan in xiisadaha gobolka ay sii xoogeystaan, isla markaana ay wiiqaan nabadda iyo xasilloonida Bariga Dhexe. Wasiirradu waxay ugu baaqeen beesha caalamka inay qaadato mowqif “adag, cad oo ku saleysan mabaadi’da” oo looga hortagayo weerarrada joogtada ah ee ka dhanka ah Suuriya, ayna qaaddo tallaabooyin waafaqsan sharciga caalamiga ah iyo Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay si loo soo afjaro xadgudubyada. Sidoo kale, waxay ku baaqeen in si buuxda loo ixtiraamo heshiiskii Kala leexashada ee la gaaray 1974-kii, iyadoo dalalkaasi dalbadeen in ciidamada Israel ay ka baxaan goobaha ay qabsadeen. Wasiirrada ayaa sheegay in tallaabooyinkaas ay muhiim u yihiin ka hortagga in xaaladdu sii xumaato iyo ilaalinta nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Ugu dambeyn, Soomaaliya iyo dalalka kale ee bayaanka saxiixay waxay mar kale xaqiijiyeen muhiimadda ay leedahay in la dhowro madaxbannaanida, xornimada, wadajirka dhuleed iyo midnimada siyaasadeed ee Suuriya, iyagoo si cad u diiday isku day kasta oo lagu wiiqayo qodobadaas. The post Soomaaliya iyo 11 dal oo soo saaray qoraal kadib weerarkii… appeared first on Caasimada Online .
